32.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

45.translation: 能不支付法术力费用来施放

159.oracleText: Choose a creature to take damage.
159.translation: 选择一个要受到伤害的生物。

176.oracleText: {1, plural, =1 {Discard a card.} other {Discard {1, Number} cards.}}
176.translation: {1, plural, =1 {弃一张牌。} other {弃{1, Number}张牌。}}

187.oracleText: The game has ended in victory. Team {1, WinningTeamId} has won the game.
187.translation: 本盘游戏最终获胜。队伍{1, WinningTeamId}赢得这盘游戏。

188.oracleText: The game has ended in a draw.

189.oracleText: The match has ended in victory. Team {1, WinningTeamId} has won the match{2, select, =0 {.} =1 {3, select, =0 { because the opposing team ran out of time.} =1 { because the opposing team was inactive for too long.}}}
189.translation: 本盘游戏最终获胜。队伍{1, WinningTeamId}赢得这局对局{2, select, =0{。}=1 {3, select, =0 {因为对手队伍逾时。} =1 {因为对手队伍闲置过久。}}}

190.oracleText: The match has ended in a draw.

195.oracleText: Would you like to mulligan to {1, NumberOfCards} card(s)?
195.translation: 是否要再调度至{1, NumberOfCards}张牌？

207.oracleText: Player {1, PlayerId} flips a coin. The result is "{2, CoinFlipResult}".
207.translation: 牌手{1, PlayerId}掷了一枚硬币。结果为「{2, CoinFlipResult}」。

214.oracleText: Minimum number of blockers not met for {1, CardId}.
214.translation: {1, CardId}的阻挡者数量未达最低要求。

215.translation: 是否要在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物？

217.translation: 是否要移动一个+1/+1指示物？

219.oracleText: Pay {1, Cost} to return {2, CardId} from your graveyard to your hand?
219.translation: 是否要支付{1, Cost}将{2, CardId}从你的坟墓场移回你手上？

223.oracleText: Provoke a creature controlled by the defending player?
223.translation: 是否要挑拨一个由防御牌手操控的生物？

225.oracleText: Cast the exiled card or click OK to continue without casting
225.translation: 施放被放逐的牌，或点击「确定」继续游戏且不施放

227.oracleText: Return target spirit to your hand?
227.translation: 是否要将目标精怪移回你手上？

233.oracleText: Choose the legendary permanent that you wish to keep. All others will go to their owner's graveyard.
233.translation: 选择你要留下的传奇永久物。其余将会进入其拥有者的坟墓场。

235.oracleText: Select the replacement effect to apply next.
235.translation: 选择接下来要生效的替代性效应。

246.oracleText: Select an order for the cards entering your graveyard. The first card in the order will become the top card.
246.translation: 决定进入你坟墓场牌张的顺序。排在首位的牌将在顶上。

247.oracleText: Select an order for the cards entering your library. The first card in the order will become the top card.
247.translation: 决定进入你牌库牌张的顺序。排在首位的牌将在顶上。

249.oracleText: Select two untapped creatures that share a color with this spell.
249.translation: 选择两个未横置且与此咒语有共通颜色的生物。

252.oracleText: Select a timestamp order for the objects entering the battlefield.
252.translation: 为进入战场的物件决定时间印记顺序。

253.oracleText: Put any number of cards on the bottom of your library and the rest on top in any order.
253.translation: 将任意数量的牌置于你牌库底，其余则以任意顺序置于你牌库顶。

255.oracleText: Action cannot be completed due to unpayable cost.
255.translation: 由于费用无法支付，不能完成行动。

256.oracleText: Cast for madness cost or put into graveyard.
256.translation: 支付疯魔费用施放，或将其置入坟墓场。

262.oracleText: An infinite loop is preventing the game from progressing. You must make an alternate choice to continue.
262.translation: 无限循环导致游戏无法进行。你必须作出不同选择以让游戏继续。

263.oracleText: An infinite loop is preventing the game from progressing. Opponent must make an alternate choice to continue.
263.translation: 无限循环导致游戏无法进行。对手必须作出不同选择以让游戏继续。

267.oracleText: Request made with out of date game state.
267.translation: 以过期的游戏状态提出的请求。

268.oracleText: Player has acted out of turn.

269.oracleText: Response does not match the pending request.
269.translation: 响应与挂起的请求不匹配。

270.oracleText: Attempted to batch actions that must be performed one at at time.
270.translation: 尝试批量执行需要依次执行的操作。

271.oracleText: Attempted to perform an action not currently on the list of legal actions.
271.translation: 试图执行不在合法操作列表中的操作。

272.oracleText: An optional field in the message should have been supplied based on the contents of the required fields, but was not.
272.translation: 应该根据请求的字段内容填写消息中的可选字段，但是并没有。

273.oracleText: Selected an option that is not on the list of legal options.
273.translation: 选择的选项不在合法选项列表之内。

274.translation: 消息中包含错误的枚举值。

275.oracleText: Targeted spell or ability does not have sufficient valid targets.
275.translation: 目标咒语或异能没有足够的有效目标。

276.oracleText: Target specified for out-of-range target index.
276.translation: 指定的目标超出了目标索引的范围。

277.oracleText: Specified target is not on the legal targets list.
277.translation: 指定的目标不在合法的目标列表之内。

279.oracleText: Specified option selection is not valid.

280.oracleText: The message received was not expected by the GRE.
280.translation: GRE收到了预期之外的消息。

281.oracleText: Player input is below a specified minimum or above a specified maximum.
281.translation: 玩家的输入低于指定的最小值或高于指定的最大值。

306.translation: 阻挡者无法阻挡攻击者

307.oracleText: Damage ordering contains omissions or additions

310.oracleText: Attempt to assign damage such that non-lethal damage is assigned to anything other than the last recipient in the order
310.translation: 尝试分配伤害，确保最后一个受伤的单位之前的所有单位都被分配到致命伤害

351.oracleText: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.
351.translation: 从最暗沉的灰烬中长出最坚强的种子。

376.translation: 选择一个要牺牲的神器。

428.translation: 你操控所结附的永久物。

452.translation: 结附于由你操控的神器

458.oracleText: "Let no trace of the vampires' foulness remain."
458.translation: 「吸血鬼邪秽气息必得清理干净。」

463.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may have two target players exchange life totals.
463.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以令两位目标牌手彼此交换总生命。

466.oracleText: Its roaring challenge is punctuated by the slam of its tail on the earth, rousing the herds of the plains.
466.translation: 长尾锤击地面轰声阵阵，助长其迎敌尖啸声势，激发原野龙群斗志。

477.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target Vampire. 
• Destroy target enchantment.
477.translation:
选择一项～
•消灭目标吸血鬼。
•消灭目标结界。

499.oracleText: Its assistance is unnervingly similar to its hunting technique.
499.translation: 它引人升空的姿势与狩猎时毫无二致，因此总让人胆战心惊。

506.oracleText: "The Immortal Sun will bring us true eternal life to replace the everlasting shadow of undeath."
506.translation: 「永生圣阳能为吾人带来真正不老之身，不再笼罩在死气沉沉的黑影当中。」

510.oracleText: Aboard her ship, the Dragon's Smile, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.
510.translation: 上了龙笑号飞船后，卡丽泽夫就只会遵守自己订下的规矩。

511.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells with the same name as the exiled card.
511.translation: 所有对手都不能施放与所放逐的牌同名之咒语。

514.oracleText: Subtlety is not a necessary part of sabotage.

522.oracleText: "My lance was once wielded by Venerable Tarrian. In his name and by his might, I cast you down!"
522.translation: 「这柄长枪曾是圣塔理安手中兵器。以彼之名，借彼之力，夺你性命！」

523.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. If you have the city's blessing, those creatures get +2/+2 until end of turn instead.
523.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果你有黄金城祝福，则改为这些生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

524.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/5.
524.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的神器成为基础力量与防御力为5/5的神器生物。

525.oracleText:
"I claim this land in the name of the queen."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio
525.translation:
「我以女王之名占领此地。」
～卢吉奥的安卓恩艾唐托

531.oracleText:
"All buildings are subject to search. Resistance will be punished."
—Enforcer-Chief Ranaj
531.translation:
「所有建筑都要接受检查。反抗必受惩罚。」 
～执法长拉纳吉

532.oracleText: Nature can't be tamed, but the Sun Empire believes that humans are made stronger when they test themselves against the wild strength of the dinosaurs.
532.translation: 虽然无法驯服自然，但烈阳帝国相信人类只要敢于挑战恐龙蛮荒之力，以此考验自己，就能变得更加强壮。

535.oracleText: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.
535.translation: 乱匠在轻型振翼机上搭载了一部乙太干扰器，用来摧毁泰兹瑞的时空渡桥。

538.oracleText:
"How easily your flames are quenched."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance
538.translation:
「熄灭你的火焰易如反掌。」
～监察长巴罗

539.oracleText: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.
539.translation: 反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。

540.oracleText: "Ours is the true and righteous path. You will bow before our might."
540.translation: 「吾等才为世间正道。汝将屈服于吾人之力。」

543.oracleText: Distribute damage among any number of target creatures.
543.translation: 在任意数量的目标生物之间分配伤害。

548.oracleText: "To rise like the sun—there is no greater feeling."
548.translation: 「如旭日般腾空～此等感觉无与伦比。」

563.oracleText: You gain twice X life. Put CARDNAME on the bottom of its owner's library.
563.translation: 你获得两倍于X的生命。将CARDNAME置于其拥有者的牌库底。

566.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn.
566.translation: 目标生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。

570.oracleText:
"The invaders cloak themselves in the shadows of dusk. Aerosaurs hide in the brilliance of the noonday sun."
—Caparocti Sunborn
570.translation:
「入侵者拿暮影作掩护。翔翼龙用烈阳藏行踪。」
～炫日卡帕罗提

582.translation: 结附于由你操控的生物

586.oracleText: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.
586.translation: 杰斯翻落瀑布，一头扎进过往回忆当中。

599.oracleText: Creatures you control are the chosen type in addition to their other types. The same is true for creature spells you control and creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
599.translation: 由你操控的生物均额外具有该类别。由你操控的生物咒语和由你拥有且不在战场上的生物牌也额外具有该类别。

601.oracleText:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit
601.translation:
「连暴风云都向艾维欣俯首敬拜。」
～长老琳海

602.oracleText: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
602.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物，然后将该牌在你的操控下移回战场。

612.oracleText: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.
612.translation: 无论是种子萌芽，藤瓜成熟，还是收割者在收获月割下谷粒，它时时都在。

626.oracleText:
"Our people and our very lands disappear as if they never were. We no longer fight for glory, or honor. We battle now for the right to exist."
—General Tazri, allied commander
626.translation:
「我们的人民和身处的大地荡然无存。荣耀和荣誉都已不再是我们战斗的目标。我们如今为生存的权利而战。」
～盟军指挥官塔兹莉将军

641.oracleText: "The elders say that if the intruders discovered the secret of the golden city, it would mean an end to our people."
641.translation: 「长老说，如果入侵者发现了黄金城的秘密，我们的同胞就会万劫不复。」

644.oracleText: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.
644.translation: 能举起武器者，都加入了重夺海户的战斗。

649.oracleText: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.
649.translation: 姆拉撒大陆上覆厚密植被，庞巨盘枝交错横生，尚有居民从未见过其下大地。

650.oracleText: Create two tokens that are copies of CARDNAME, except they're not legendary.
650.translation: 派出两个衍生物，这些衍生物为CARDNAME的复制品，但不是传奇。

654.oracleText: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.
654.translation: 塔晋大陆上，湍急河水涌经迫窄峡谷，奔腾激流直入雾漫湖泊。

655.oracleText: Abilities your opponents activate that target a Merfolk you control cost {o2} more to activate.
655.translation: 由对手起动且以由你操控的人鱼为目标之异能增加{o2}来起动。

656.translation: 横置还是重置目标生物？

664.oracleText: Not an arrow loosed, javelin thrown, nor sword raised. None were needed.
664.translation: 一箭未放，一枪未掷，一剑未举。只因全无必要。

665.oracleText: Target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature get -3/-3 until end of turn.
665.translation: 目标生物及所有与其同名的其他生物各得-3/-3直到回合结束。

670.oracleText: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.
670.translation: 真相如同长川不息湍流一般向库莫那涌来：将敌人驱离隐蔽之城的唯一途径，就是将其力量占为己有。

683.oracleText:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane
683.translation:
「当大地发怒，它们也闹脾气。」
～妮莎瑞文

686.oracleText:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee
686.translation:
「我们只能从少数幸存者口中得知克洛萨树林的状况。」
～妖精难民

687.oracleText: Sacrifice a Beast: You gain 4 life.
687.translation: 牺牲一个野兽：你获得4点生命。

691.oracleText: She arrived like a meteorite, and the enemy fell in a shock wave of holy vengeance.
691.translation: 她如流星般突现战场，随之降临的复仇圣击将敌人湮没殆尽。

692.oracleText: In the Brazen Coalition, the wheels of business are greased with plunder.
692.translation: 出海掠夺为莽霸联盟的商业发展提供助力。

698.oracleText: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."
698.translation: 「我听到了劫夺的呼唤。它指名道姓要我去。」

699.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a noncreature, nonland card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
699.translation: {o2oU}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张非生物且非地的牌，并将其置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

704.oracleText: One pirate's wreck is another's reward.

710.oracleText: Black spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
710.translation: 你施放的黑色咒语减少{o1}来施放。

712.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Counter target spell or ability that targets you or a creature you control.
712.translation: {oU}，牺牲CARDNAME：反击目标咒语或异能，且其须以你或由你操控的生物为目标。

718.oracleText:
"My conquistadors are never slain, merely laid to rest."
—Queen Miralda the Pious
718.translation:
「朕的征服者永不死，他们只是躺下浅眠。」
～虔诚者米拉达女王

729.oracleText: Put any number of target creature cards from your graveyard on top of your library.
729.translation: 将任意数量的目标生物牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

742.oracleText:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess
742.translation:
「死亡不是抗命的藉口。」
～莉莲娜维斯

743.oracleText: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. That creature is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.
743.translation: 将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。该生物额外具有黑色此颜色与灵俑此类别。

745.oracleText: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.
745.translation: 神器师曾能利用至纯黄金打造的戒指捕获来自遥远星辰的光芒，这门技艺如今早已亡佚。

750.oracleText: "They shall give us all they have as penance for their resistance. Their ships. Their goods. Their rebellious blood."
750.translation: 「他们要交出一切东西，来为他们的抵抗赎罪。他们的船只。他们的货物。他们的忤逆鲜血。」

754.oracleText: All lands lose all abilities except mana abilities.
754.translation: 所有地均失去法术力异能以外的所有异能。

756.oracleText: {o7oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target opponent loses 4 life and you gain 4 life.
756.translation: {o7oB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标对手失去4点生命且你获得4点生命。

758.oracleText: When a paladin undertaking the Blood Fast finally gives in to hunger, the violence is sudden, explosive, and complete.
758.translation: 当进行血禁仪式的神圣武士最终屈服于饥渴时，便会在转瞬之间大杀四方，毫无保留。

772.oracleText:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher
772.translation:
「外观上的美丽并不总是等同于触觉上的舒适。」
～费米瑞甫哲学家奈玛

773.oracleText: Despite their noble heritage, the pirates of the Deadeye Fleet are known for underhanded tactics and despicable trickery.
773.translation: 虽然必达舰队的海盗个个出身名门望族，但整支舰队却以行事肮脏，手段卑劣而闻名。

788.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, CARDNAME deals 15 damage to target creature an opponent controls and that creature deals damage equal to its power to you.
788.translation: 在你的维持开始时，CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物造成15点伤害，且该生物对你造成等同于其力量的伤害。

798.oracleText: Play with the top card of your library revealed.
798.translation: 你以展示牌库顶牌的方式进行游戏。

805.oracleText: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave—much to the other guilds' dismay.
805.translation: 卓塔妮的影响力逐渐扩张，盟会的活力强大得让其他公会更加担忧。

806.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has trample and lifelink.
806.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有践踏与系命异能。

810.oracleText: Choose a creature token you control.
810.translation: 选择一个由你操控的衍生生物。

811.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
811.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

817.oracleText:
"Through your sacrifice of self, you become holy. Through your strength, all will be saved."
—From the Rite of Redemption
817.translation:
「牺牲自我，便得入圣。借汝之力，救赎众生。」
～救赎仪式祭文

832.oracleText: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."
832.translation: 「没必要为这个混蛋自讨麻烦。」

836.oracleText: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.
836.translation: 访圣骑士团是第一批漂洋过海的骑士团，而至今他们仍是最为狂热的一批。

843.oracleText:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors
843.translation:
「魔鬼的每项破坏都藏着恶魔的计谋。」
～审判官之刃连卡洛

846.oracleText: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.
846.translation: 若徘徊于死亡门口，小心会给请进去。

853.oracleText: Target creature fights another target creature.
853.translation: 目标生物与另一个目标生物互斗。

858.oracleText: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.
858.translation: 虽然其心智早已腐烂消失，它使剑功夫依旧致命。

859.oracleText: Other Zombie creatures you control get +1/+1.
859.translation: 由你操控的其他灵俑生物得+1/+1。

860.oracleText: Whenever another Zombie you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life.
860.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的灵俑死去时，目标对手失去1点生命。

863.oracleText: It wasn't long before the taverns of High and Dry were full of whispers about the new captain who could turn a person to stone with a glance.
863.translation: 绝涛城的酒馆里很快就传开了这样的流言：有位新船长只消一瞪眼就能将人变成石头。

864.oracleText: Exile target creature or planeswalker. You gain 2 life.
864.translation: 放逐目标生物或鹏洛客。你获得2点生命。

870.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a loyalty counter on Tezzeret.
870.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，在泰兹瑞上放置一个忠诚指示物。

883.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Treasure, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
883.translation: 每当你牺牲一个珍宝时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

887.oracleText: An intelligent jetpack for those who find themselves lost in space.
887.translation: 适合在宇宙中迷途时使用的智能喷气背包。

897.oracleText: The frillbacks of Orazca soak up the sun on their tall spinal fins. They look slow and sleepy—until they catch the scent of prey.
897.translation: 常能见到欧拉兹卡的鳍背龙脊鳍尽展，沐浴日光。它们虽然看起来行动缓慢，举止慵懒～但一闻到猎物气息就截然不同。

899.oracleText: As she charges into battle, her arcane tattoos stir and crawl like fiery serpents.
899.translation: 随着她冲入战局，她的神秘纹身也开始扭动弯曲，宛如火蛇一般。

900.oracleText: When this creature dies, draft a card from Faithful Disciple's spellbook.
900.translation: 当此生物死去时，从虔心信徒的法术书中抽选一张牌。

906.oracleText: {o7oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to each of up to two target creatures.
906.translation: {o7oR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对至多两个目标生物各造成3点伤害。

911.oracleText: Sun Empire warriors are taught to emulate the fearless raptors that fling themselves against towers of horn and muscle a hundred times their size.
911.translation: 这些无畏的迅猛龙在面对犄角和体型都数百倍于自己的庞然巨物时，依然会奋不顾身地扑击上前。烈阳帝国的战士正是以此为榜样。

914.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control other than CARDNAME.
914.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控两个或更多已横置的生物，则在CARDNAME以外每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

920.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from white and from black.
920.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有反白保护与反黑保护。

921.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you gain 3 life and you may return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
921.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你获得3点生命，且你可以将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

925.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, draw two cards.
925.translation: 每当佩戴此武具的生物死去时，抓两张牌。

934.oracleText: "Forward! Let the Burning Sun's light guide you to deserving prey!"
934.translation: 「上吧！愿炙阳光芒指引你们找到猎物！」

946.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand?
946.translation: 是否要将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上？

958.oracleText: Destroy target land. CARDNAME deals 20 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
958.translation: 消灭目标地。CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成20点伤害。

963.oracleText: Untap up to two target creatures.
963.translation: 重置至多两个目标生物。

965.oracleText: One alone is dangerous, and they are never alone.
965.translation: 落单一头已十分凶险，何况它们从不落单。

967.oracleText: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.
967.translation: 她双眼只见伊莫库目中残景。

968.oracleText: All creatures attack enchanted creature's controller each combat if able.
968.translation: 所有生物每次战斗若能攻击所结附的生物之操控者，则须如此作。

970.oracleText: Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.
970.translation: 眼见姐妹落此凄惨境地，只余席嘉妲空自悲切。

971.oracleText: . . . but every end is a new beginning.

973.oracleText: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition are the descendants of those displaced by the Legion of Dusk, and they are eager for vengeance.
973.translation: 暮影军团一路侵袭，致使无数家庭颠沛流离；其后人无奈落草为寇，加入莽霸联盟，因而复仇意识十分强烈。

974.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.
974.translation: 消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

976.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.
976.translation: 在每个由目标牌手操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

977.oracleText: As long as you control another Dinosaur, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and has trample.
977.translation: 只要你操控另一个恐龙，CARDNAME便得+2/+0且具有践踏异能。

979.oracleText: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.
979.translation: 她双耳只闻伊莫库口中幽声。

980.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control a Dinosaur, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
980.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控恐龙，则CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

982.oracleText: Amid the gibbering chorus that rose from the drownyard temple, Jace recognized a single word: "Emrakul."
982.translation: 从沉船地殿堂传出的断续吟唱中，杰斯听出了三个字：「伊莫库」。

983.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it becomes a copy of another target nonlegendary attacking creature until end of turn.
983.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择另一个目标进行攻击且非传奇的生物。它成为该生物的复制品直到回合结束。

985.oracleText:
"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess
985.translation:
「干得漂亮，杰斯。你一直很擅长玩失踪这类把戏。」
～莉莲娜维斯

986.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put up to two noncreature, nonland permanent cards with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
986.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中至多两张法术力值等于或小于3、非生物且非地的永久物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

988.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
988.translation: 目标生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

989.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
989.translation: 目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

992.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. If it's a nonland card, you may cast that card this turn.
992.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是非地牌，则本回合中，你可以施放该牌。

993.oracleText:
"The light does not ask permission to cut through the darkness."
—Mentor Ultimate, to Regent Maximum Taman IV
993.translation:
「辉光不需许可亦能穿透黑暗。」
～至高导师教导最高摄政塔曼四世

994.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
994.translation: 目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

995.oracleText: Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
995.translation: 目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

996.oracleText: . . . resting in the splendor of the dead.
996.translation: …发现她正在壮丽墓所中安眠。

999.oracleText: Goblins climb and swing with ease, whether through a pirate ship's rigging or a tree's branches.
999.translation: 鬼怪长于攀缘摆荡，无论是船上支索还是树上枝桠都能如履平地。

1001.oracleText: It is taller than all but the tallest trees, and older than all but the oldest.
1001.translation: 它仅矮于参天大树，仅幼于传世古木。

1003.oracleText: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.
1003.translation: 它的吐息如狂风席卷。它的怒吼似火山喷发。它的愤怒能让灵魂出窍。

1007.oracleText: "I see you, shiny soldiers, but you won't see me."
1007.translation: 「我看见你们了，金光闪闪的士兵们，但你们看不见我。」

1010.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you have the city's blessing, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
1010.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你有黄金城祝福，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1017.oracleText: {o6oB}: Target opponent loses 1 life for each Spider you control.
1017.translation: {o6oB}：你每操控一个蜘蛛，目标对手便失去1点生命。

1019.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}: Target creature gains haste until end of turn.
1019.translation: {oR}，{oT}：目标生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

1021.oracleText: Other tapped legendary creatures you control have indestructible.
1021.translation: 由你操控且已横置的其他传奇生物具有不灭异能。

1022.oracleText: Return target Angel or Human creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield?
1022.translation: 是否将目标天使或人类生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场？

1024.oracleText:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa
1024.translation:
「不要以为占据制高点就能高枕无忧。」
～塑形师吐瓦萨

1025.oracleText: Choose an instant or sorcery card.
1025.translation: 选择一张瞬间或法术牌。

1026.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target creature with flying. 
• Destroy target enchantment.
1026.translation:
选择一项～
•消灭目标具飞行异能的生物。
•消灭目标结界。

1028.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic Plains card or a creature card with mana value 1 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1028.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌或一张法术力值等于或小于1的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1034.oracleText: Its wings disturb more than air.
1034.translation: 其翅翼比所卷起的气流更扰乱人心。

1038.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 as long as you control a Dinosaur.

1041.oracleText: "By accepting my smallness I am vast."
1041.translation: 「接受自身渺小，就能承载浩瀚之力。」

1044.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, it explores.
1044.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，令它勘察。

1057.oracleText: {o7oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn.
1057.translation: {o7oG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：直到回合结束，目标生物得+5/+5且获得践踏异能。

1063.oracleText: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.
1063.translation: 散绿菌将腐生物游牧四方，以各处的养分碎屑喂养之。

1064.oracleText: Choose a green or white creature card.
1064.translation: 选择一张绿色或白色的生物牌。

1065.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile a creature card from your hand. If you do, search your hand and library for any number of cards with the same name, exile them, then shuffle. Choose a creature card you own from outside the game. Conjure a duplicate of that card into your hand for each card exiled from your hand this way.
1065.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则从你的手牌和牌库中搜寻任意数量与之同名的牌，将它们放逐，然后洗牌。从游戏外选择一张由你拥有的生物牌。每以此法从你手上放逐一张牌，便将该牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。

1066.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 as long as you control another Merfolk or an Island.
1066.translation: 只要你操控海岛或另一个人鱼，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

1071.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If that creature is an Ally, it also gains flying until end of turn.
1071.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果该生物是伙伴，则它再获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1072.oracleText: The Sun Empire bends nature—rivers, mountainsides, dinosaurs—to its unyielding will.
1072.translation: 烈阳帝国以刚毅的意志征服自然：不论是河流、山峦或恐龙。

1074.oracleText: "The jungle was here before any city. It will be here after the last city falls."
1074.translation: 「城市出现之前，丛林就已座落于此。城市灭亡以后，丛林还将成长于斯。」

1082.oracleText:
"The family is a tree, and in times of need, every branch can be a weapon."
—Daghatar the Adamant
1082.translation:
「家族如树，在困厄之时任一支都如良兵在侧。」
～坚毅的达哈塔

1083.oracleText: A daggertooth's triumphant roar makes all the sounds of jungle life fall silent.
1083.translation: 匕牙龙得胜咆哮，能让整个丛林静寂无声。

1088.oracleText: So long as death follows life, the supply lines of the Sultai will never be cut.
1088.translation: 只要生死循环仍在，苏勒台的补给就永远不会中断。

1089.oracleText: Older than the Eumidian seedships that populated Evendo.
1089.translation: 比殖民埃文多的蝣美迪殖种船还要古老。

1092.oracleText: {o1oU}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put a stun counter on up to one target tapped creature.
1092.translation: {o1oU}，牺牲CARDNAME：在至多一个目标已横置的生物上放置一个晕眩指示物。

1093.oracleText: Destroy target creature that was dealt damage this turn.
1093.translation: 消灭目标于本回合受过伤害的生物。

1097.oracleText:
"When their community grows cluttered, thallids begin a traditional bobbing dance, then trek out in all directions."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. III
1097.translation:
「一旦其群落变得拥挤，散绿菌便会依传统摇摆起舞，随后就四散远行。」
～《撒尔帕汀帝国》，卷三

1101.oracleText: Lurking beneath the murky waters of Ixalan's rivers, sailbacks can rip a meal off the shore in the blink of an eye.
1101.translation: 帆背龙潜伏在依夏兰浑浊的河水之中，眨眼间就能从岸边咬下一顿美餐。

1112.oracleText: Choose a creature you control with the least toughness among creatures you control.
1112.translation: 选择一个由你操控的生物，且须是由你操控的生物中防御力最小者。

1113.oracleText: The dryads of the forest have no stake in Ixalan's conflict, but they hate to see any living being suffer.
1113.translation: 林中的树灵虽不参与依夏兰的纷争，却也不愿看到任何生灵受难。

1115.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to its owner's hand."
1115.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得「当此生物死去时，将它移回其拥有者手上。」

1120.oracleText: She has never touched a loom, yet the tapestries she weaves are vast and beautiful.
1120.translation: 她从未碰过织机，却能纺出巨幅精致壁饰。

1123.oracleText: "Our foes are many and mighty, but not as many as the trees or as mighty as the sea."
1123.translation: 「敌人虽众，但比不过丛林繁木；对手虽强，但比不过大海汪洋。」

1126.oracleText:
"Hear me, stone, root, branch: be the fist of this land. Turn back those who trample upon your domain."
—Song of the Shaper
1126.translation:
「石头、盘根、枝杈速速听我令：化作此地之拳，击退踏足此地来者。」
～塑形师幽歌

1129.oracleText: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."
1129.translation: 「你和你的船能为我的舰队增色不少。」

1134.oracleText: Return all legendary permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1134.translation: 将所有传奇永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

1145.oracleText: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.
1145.translation: 波洛斯建立了一座空中牢狱，俄佐立的法规在此处无法约束其正义感。

1152.oracleText:
"Selesnya denied us tribute. Let's show them the error of their ways."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate
1152.translation:
「瑟雷尼亚拒绝向我们进贡。就用他们的方法来点出这项错误。」
～欧佐夫神职者米拉娜

1155.oracleText: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.
1155.translation: 在锻炉街暴乱后，逮捕人胡边试图禁止使用棍棒。这当然引发了另一场暴乱。

1156.oracleText: Illvoi nervous systems are decentralized. Even as one part runs calculations, another might contemplate the depths of Uthros.
1156.translation: 依沃伊人的神经系统并没有统一的指挥中枢。就算其中有部分正在作紧张计算，也可能还有其他部分仍在欣赏乌索斯的深邃美景。

1169.oracleText:
"Wherever the Threefold Sun shines, great wings may go."
—Emperor Apatzec Intli III
1169.translation:
「烈阳三相照耀处，巨翼飞龙任翱翔。」
～阿帕泽英利三世皇帝

1173.oracleText: When this creature enters, creatures your opponents control get -3/-0 until your next turn.
1173.translation: 当此生物进场时，由对手操控的生物得-3/-0直到你的下一个回合。

1179.oracleText: Create a 2/2 black Pirate creature token with menace.
1179.translation: 派出一个2/2黑色，具威慑异能的海盗衍生生物。

1183.oracleText: "If I fail to offer myself, we will surely be overrun. My fate would be the same."
1183.translation: 「如果我不奉献自己，我们必会溃败。而我也将面临同样命运。」

1184.translation: 流离失所者靠乐天精神凝聚在一起。

1186.oracleText:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn
1186.translation:
「这朵完美的莲花让我想起我对这个世界的希望…以及我的失败过往。在我还没完成赎罪之前，我决不止歇。」
～卡恩

1190.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice an artifact. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and draw a card.
1190.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器。当你如此作时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并抓一张牌。

1193.oracleText: Have this creature fight another target creature?
1193.translation: 是否要令此生物与另一个目标生物互斗？

1195.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
1195.translation: {o6}，{oT}：将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1199.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may transform CARDNAME.
1199.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以转化CARDNAME。

1207.oracleText: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
1207.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌但牌库没有牌，则改为你赢得这盘游戏。

1210.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may discard a card. If you do, untap CARDNAME.
1210.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则重置CARDNAME。

1216.oracleText: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."
1216.translation: 「艾维欣的守护遍布各处。从神圣教会到圣洁林地，我们双眼所见之物尽受她慈爱眼神的关照。」

1219.oracleText: In the Rite of Redemption, nobles take the same vows as Elenda, the first vampire, and make the same eternal sacrifice.
1219.translation: 在救赎仪式中，贵族会许下与最初的吸血鬼依莲达同样的誓言，并作出同样永恒的牺牲。

1225.oracleText: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
1225.translation: 派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

1228.oracleText:
"Log entry cycle 33,507: Tenuous perception of psionic activity emanating from Uthros's core. Nature: Nonlinguistic, fragmentary. Content: Isolation, apoplexy. It wants free."
—Uthros Combine research notes
1228.translation:
「日志记录，第33,507周期：感知到源自乌索斯核心的微弱心能活动。类别：非语言，不成句。内容：孤立，抽搐。它想要自由。」
～乌索斯联合研究笔记

1233.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
1233.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

1237.oracleText: He can deny his true nature for only so long.
1237.translation: 他想抗拒自己的本性，但也撑不了太久。

1238.oracleText: Other Human creatures you control get +1/+1.
1238.translation: 由你操控的其他人类生物得+1/+1。

1241.oracleText: Void — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, defending player loses half their life, rounded up.
1241.translation: 空洞～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则防御牌手失去一半数量的生命，小数点后进位。

1244.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Untap Grimgrin and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
1244.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：重置邪笑且在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1245.oracleText: Whenever Grimgrin attacks, destroy target creature defending player controls, then put a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin.
1245.translation: 每当邪笑攻击时，消灭目标由防御牌手操控的生物，然后在邪笑上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1247.translation: 是否要放逐另一个目标生物？

1249.oracleText: {oT}: Untap target attacking creature an opponent controls and remove it from combat.
1249.translation: {oT}：重置目标由对手操控且进行攻击的生物并将其移出战斗。

1253.oracleText: Half the treasure is the glory of finding it.
1253.translation: 珍宝的价值一半来自找到它的荣耀。

1263.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
1263.translation: 目标生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。

1267.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, if it had counters on it, put its counters on this creature.
1267.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有指示物，则将死去生物上的指示物置于此生物上。

1277.oracleText: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.
1277.translation: 此门接纳拥有拉尼卡一流创意，又富实现创意的胆识者。

1278.oracleText:
You draw two cards and lose 2 life. 
Void — If a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, instead you draw two cards and each opponent loses 2 life.
1278.translation:
你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。
空洞～如果本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则改为你抓两张牌且每位对手各失去2点生命。

1281.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Then if that creature's power is 0 or less, destroy it.
1281.translation: 目标生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。然后如果该生物的力量等于或小于0，则将它消灭。

1282.oracleText:
"Just imagine what's waiting around the bend. Adventure. Discovery. Riches for the taking. This is why I sail."
—Captain Lannery Storm
1282.translation:
「想像一下驶过弯后可能出现什么。冒险。发现。取之不尽的财富。这便是我扬帆起航的原因。」
～兰娜莉速腾船长

1290.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
1290.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+0且获得先攻异能。

1292.oracleText: Creatures you control get +3/+3 and gain trample until end of turn.
1292.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。

1295.oracleText: Target creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn.
1295.translation: 目标生物得+4/+4直到回合结束。

1302.oracleText: "We drove the Sun Empire out of the forest long ago, and we will not let them return."
1302.translation: 「很久以前我们就将烈阳帝国赶出了森林，从此不容许他们再踏足半步。」

1310.oracleText: "I fight for the suns, the surface, and everything in between."
1310.translation: 「我为了太阳，大地，以及之间的所有东西而战。」

1334.oracleText:
"Don't worry, they don't bite. They much prefer setting people on fire."
—Jaya Ballard, to Chandra
1334.translation:
「别担心，它们不咬人。它们比较喜欢烧人。」
～雅亚巴拉德告诉茜卓

1354.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} fight another target creature?
1354.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}与另一个目标生物互斗？

1380.oracleText: The swarm lacked a natural predator, so the Eumidians became one.
1380.translation: 虫群本来没有自然天敌，于是蝣美迪人便充当了这一角色。

1393.oracleText:
"Rejoice, and know all will join you soon."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin
1393.translation:
「欢呼吧，世间万物很快都会跟你一道上路。」
～奇相教杀手凯尔南

1395.oracleText:
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. 
Void — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
1395.translation:
目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。
空洞～如果本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则改为该生物得-10/-10直到回合结束。

1397.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +4/+4 and has vigilance and lifelink.
1397.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+4/+4且具有警戒与系命异能。

1398.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1.
1398.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或神器：刺探1。

1404.oracleText: Surveil 2, then draw two cards. Notion Rain deals 2 damage to you.
1404.translation: 刺探2，然后抓两张牌。心念如雨对你造成2点伤害。

1412.oracleText: "They will call you a monster, but I call you worthy."
1412.translation: 「他们会叫你怪物，而我会叫你宝贝。」

1416.oracleText: Destroy all creatures with toughness X or less. You lose X life. If X is 6 or more, return a creature card put into a graveyard this way to the battlefield under your control.
1416.translation: 消灭所有防御力等于或小于X的生物。你失去X点生命。如果X等于或大于6，则将一张以此法进入坟墓场的生物牌在你操控下移回战场。

1417.oracleText: The Sun Empire's most sacred sites are protected by more than prayers.
1417.translation: 烈阳帝国最神圣的场所远不止有祈祷保护。

1434.oracleText: Villagers employ watchdogs as guardians and companions. Druids prefer something a little bigger.
1434.translation: 村民把看门狗当作守卫和伴侣。德鲁伊则喜欢稍大一点的家伙。

1436.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
1436.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1446.oracleText: Search for a card named Teferi, Timebender.
1446.translation: 搜寻一张名称为曲时大师泰菲力的牌。

1458.oracleText: "If I am to die, I will die in the embrace of immeasurable flame."
1458.translation: 「若我死期将至，我要死在无尽烈焰的拥抱之中。」

1475.translation: 所有生物具有敏捷异能。

1479.oracleText: It's not just the wind. It's not all in your head. And it's definitely something to worry about.
1479.translation: 那不只是风。那不只存于你脑中。而且那绝对值得担心。

1483.oracleText: Those of esteemed birth earn a most esteemed death.
1483.translation: 生有尊贵身分，死亦华美可期。

1484.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
1484.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。

1489.oracleText: Destiny exalts a chosen few, but even heroes break.
1489.translation: 纵使能得命运青睐，英雄最终也难逃宿命。

1490.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。

1493.oracleText: Whether it is magical, lucky, or merely old, it is cherished, and that gives it power.
1493.translation: 无论这个护身符是附有魔法，能带来好运，还只是祖传之物，它都备受珍惜，而这正是其魔力之源。

1495.oracleText: The Ulvenwald makes no allowances for youth. Today's newborn is either tomorrow's hunter or tomorrow's lunch.
1495.translation: 沃文森没有幼小者容身之地。今日的新生儿若非明日的猎人，就是明日的午餐。

1498.oracleText:
"Soldiers win battles, but supplies win wars."
—Kadri, Abzan caravan master
1498.translation:
「战斗大计在于兵，战争大计在于粮。」
～阿布赞商队主卡德里

1507.oracleText: Excess energy from the moxite core is focused into a destructive ray of plasma.
1507.translation: 玛珂矿核心过量能量集束而形成的破坏性电浆射线。

1512.oracleText: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.
1512.translation: 有明光作武装，就连个扈从都能成为同袍之光。

1513.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a gold counter from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
1513.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个黄金指示物：抓一张牌。

1520.oracleText:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai
1520.translation:
「阻挡启悟之道的，正是我们自己。」
～洁斯凯可汗娜尔施

1521.oracleText: Integrity // Intervention deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
1521.translation: 致善对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

1523.oracleText: Intervention deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
1523.translation: 致善对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

1528.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as you control a blue creature.
1528.translation: 只要你操控蓝色生物，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

1530.translation: 即使是邪恶之徒也有噩梦。

1531.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1531.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1541.oracleText: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.
1541.translation: 即使人类重获优势，仍有人自愿以生命换取永生的机会。

1542.oracleText: Whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much life.
1542.translation: 每当一位对手失去生命时，你获得等量的生命。

1547.oracleText: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.
1547.translation: 比起腐肉，他们更渴求死者的临终话语。

1548.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
1548.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

1551.oracleText: White spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
1551.translation: 你施放的白色咒语减少{o1}来施放。

1552.oracleText: Blue spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
1552.translation: 你施放的蓝色咒语减少{o1}来施放。

1555.oracleText: All the books were dusty with disuse, save the one titled Camouflage and Its Practical Applications.
1555.translation: 书架上所有书都因乏人问津而遍布灰尘，唯一本《伪装术与实际应用》例外。

1556.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
1556.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

1564.oracleText:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren
1564.translation:
「我曾以为某些事情是能力所及的最高成就，殊不知那只是向无尽未来探出的最初几步。」
～杰斯贝连

1565.oracleText: Carnival // Carnage deals 3 damage to target opponent. That player discards two cards.
1565.translation: 暴虐向目标对手造成3点伤害。该牌手弃两张牌。

1568.oracleText: Counter target activated or triggered ability.
1568.translation: 反击目标起动式或触发式异能。

1570.oracleText: Tel-Jilad, sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.
1570.translation: 泰几朗，远古巨魔的圣域，守卫秘罗地起源之谜。

1578.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1}. When you do, target creature can't block this turn.
1578.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

1579.oracleText: {o6oR}: Target creature you control gets +4/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
1579.translation: {o6oR}：目标由你操控的生物得+4/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

1582.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1582.translation: 当此太空船进场时，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1585.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a Lander token.
1585.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个探地器衍生物。

1588.oracleText:
Maybe in your next evolution.
—Eumidian insult
1588.translation:
等你下次进化再看吧。
～蝣美迪辱骂语

1597.oracleText: {o7}: Put a conqueror counter on Zhao.
1597.translation: {o7}：在赵将军上放置一个征服者指示物。

1602.oracleText:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils
1602.translation:
「你们每人都拥有山崩般的潜力。」
～熊野勉励弟子

1603.oracleText: Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature, where X is your life total.
1603.translation: 在目标生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你的总生命。

1609.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 as long as you control an Ajani planeswalker.
1609.translation: 只要你操控阿耶尼鹏洛客，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

1612.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}: Exile target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard. Each opponent loses 2 life.
1612.translation: {oB}，{oT}：将目标瞬间或法术牌从坟墓场放逐。每位对手各失去2点生命。

1613.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. You gain 2 life.
1613.translation: {oG}，{oT}：将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。你获得2点生命。

1616.oracleText:
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain
1616.translation:
「试想像一场闪电风暴，同时又是个战术天才，那就是他了。」
～炎拳队长达斯葛托

1617.oracleText: Until your next turn, target artifact you control becomes a 5/5 creature in addition to its other types.
1617.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，目标由你操控的神器成为5/5生物，且仍具有原本类别。

1620.oracleText:
"My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on."
—Vy Covalt, Mirran resistance
1620.translation:
「恶物，我的肉体没藏什么秘密。 秘罗地的精神会继续战斗。」
～秘罗志士范科沃

1621.oracleText: "Safe passage requires only a simple answer to a simple question, traveler."
1621.translation: 「旅人呀，想要安全通过，只需简单地回答一个简单问题。」

1626.oracleText: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."
1626.translation: 「瑟班是我们的家乡，我不会让它落入孽物大军手中。」

1627.oracleText: Noncreature spells cost {o1} more to cast.
1627.translation: 非生物咒语增加{o1}来施放。

1635.oracleText: As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.
1635.translation: 随着绿阳登顶，非瑞克西亚的预言在传说之树上闪耀。

1643.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a Lander token.
1643.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个探地器衍生物。

1651.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, earthbend 2. Then search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1651.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，运土2。然后从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将它横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1654.oracleText: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.
1654.translation: 他们生时是各式各样的成员：农夫，地主，扒手，僧侣。他们死后则结合成单一的仁爱趋力。

1655.oracleText: Creature tokens you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.
1655.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物得+1/+1且具有警戒异能。

1657.oracleText: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."
1657.translation: 「我并不怀念树海。我的家乡不是树海，而是整个神河；神河子民都是我的家人。不论我栖身何处，都像是回到了家。」

1658.oracleText: You may play two additional lands on each of your turns.
1658.translation: 你在自己的每个回合中可以额外使用两个地。

1660.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1660.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1661.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
1661.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

1666.oracleText: Creatures you control get +4/+4 and gain trample until end of turn.
1666.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+4/+4且获得践踏异能。

1669.oracleText:
"If the populace fears our authority, then I'd say we have an appropriately sensible populace."
—Dovin Baan
1669.translation:
「如果民众畏惧我们的权威，那我得说民众们相当明事理。」
～多温班恩

1677.oracleText: Permanents you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
1677.translation: 由你操控的永久物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1678.oracleText: Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
1678.translation: 目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

1682.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
1682.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1686.translation: 指定一个无色非地永久物为目标。

1688.oracleText: The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still.
1688.translation: 让凯尔顿人恢复理智的诀窍就是让他们动弹不得。

1692.oracleText: When Kyoshi Island Plaza enters, search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is the number of Shrines you control. Put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1692.translation: 当虚子岛广场进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多X张基本地牌，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。将这些牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1693.oracleText:
"Old turf. Powerful turf. Much good blood spilled here."
—Ruric Thar
1693.translation:
「老地盘。强大的地盘。抛洒热血的地盘。」
～鲁瑞杂尔

1702.oracleText: You gain shroud until end of turn.
1702.translation: 你获得帷幕异能直到回合结束。

1711.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Create a Lander token.
1711.translation: 你获得2点生命。派出一个探地器衍生物。

1713.oracleText: Whenever Golden Argosy attacks, exile each creature that crewed it this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
1713.translation: 每当黄金阿格西号攻击时，放逐所有本回合中搭载过它的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

1716.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, create a Lander token.
1716.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，派出一个探地器衍生物。

1721.oracleText: You gain 2 life and draw a card.
1721.translation: 你获得2点生命且抓一张牌。

1723.oracleText: The Eumidians sought to keep Evendo a gentle world—at any cost.
1723.translation: 蝣美迪人仍想保留埃文多平静祥和的原始生态～并为此付出了不懈努力。

1726.oracleText: Eumidian thermal wands protect their new home as well as thaw it.
1726.translation: 蝣美迪热能杖不仅能够开辟疆土，同时还能保护家园。

1728.oracleText: It comes off as easily as your own skin.
1728.translation: 脱下它就跟脱下自己的皮一样简单。

1732.translation: 指定至多五张牌为目标。

1733.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
1733.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

1734.oracleText: Distribute damage among one, two, or three targets.
1734.translation: 在一个、两个或三个目标之间分配伤害。

1736.oracleText: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.
1736.translation: 她是神器师手艺的极致，以贱金属呼唤出的神性精魂。

1737.oracleText: For Eumidians, terraforming and evolution are one and the same. They grow as their planet grows, in lockstep coexistence.
1737.translation: 对蝣美迪人来说，地貌改造与自身进化是相同的事情。他们随着自己所处的星球一同成长，完美共存。

1740.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have 40 or more life, you win the game.
1740.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你的总生命为40或更多，你便赢得此盘游戏。

1742.oracleText: Ragefire deals 3 damage to target creature.
1742.translation: 怒火烧身对目标生物造成3点伤害。

1746.oracleText: When Alpharael enters, draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.
1746.translation: 当阿法雷进场时，抓两张牌。然后除非你弃一张神器牌，否则弃两张牌。

1752.oracleText: {o8}: Draw two cards and create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1752.translation: {o8}：抓两张牌并派出一个2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1759.oracleText: "A whole life, full of memories and experience, love and sorrow, drained drop by drop into this bottle. Could any feast be more glorious?"
1759.translation: 「不知这段生命有过何种经历过往，又有过多少爱恨情仇，其血液精华尽皆点滴流入这一瓶中。联想到此，还能有何等盛宴更为美好？」

1762.oracleText: Exile any number of other nontoken creatures you control.
1762.translation: 放逐任意数量由你操控且非衍生物的其他生物。

1763.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if there's a Lesson card in your graveyard, you gain 2 life.
1763.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若你坟墓场中有课程牌，则你获得2点生命。

1764.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
1764.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为施放它时所支付的法术力数量。

1765.oracleText: Dyadrine enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
1765.translation: 代卓灵进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为施放它时所支付的法术力数量。

1766.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may remove a +1/+1 counter from each of two creatures you control. If you do, draw a card and create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1766.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以从两个由你操控的生物上各移去一个+1/+1指示物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌并派出一个2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1777.oracleText: Scry 3 at the beginning of your first upkeep.
1777.translation: 在你的第一个维持开始时占卜3。

1783.oracleText: Target creature gets +10/+10 and gains trample until end of turn.
1783.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+10/+10且获得践踏异能。

1788.oracleText: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.
1788.translation: 树灵聚集时的激动回声吸引了迷失的灵魂。

1789.oracleText: Search for up to three land cards.

1793.oracleText: Target an attacking or blocking creature with power 3 or less.
1793.translation: 选择一个进行攻击或阻挡且力量等于或小于3的生物为目标。

1796.oracleText: Artifacts you control are Foods in addition to their other types and have "{o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life."
1796.translation: 由你操控的神器均额外具有食品此类别，且具有「{o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：你获得3点生命。」

1808.oracleText: Target up to one artifact, creature, or enchantment.
1808.translation: 指定至多一个神器，生物或结界为目标。

1810.oracleText: Exhaust — {o4}: Earthbend 4. Activate only during your turn.
1810.translation: 竭绝～{o4}：运土4。只能于你的回合中起动。

1811.oracleText: Return a tapped land you control to its owner's hand.
1811.translation: 将一个由你操控的且已横置的地移回其拥有者手上。

1812.oracleText: Target an artifact, creature, or planeswalker.
1812.translation: 指定一个神器，生物或鹏洛客为目标。

1813.oracleText: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."
1813.translation: 「兰卡的把戏只能骗骗小孩。我的手段能够倾覆王国。」

1814.oracleText:
"We may fight the Temur when territory demands it, but we've no desire to profane their sacred places."
—Taklai, Mardu convoy
1814.translation:
「我们或会因领土争端而与铁木尔人作战，但我们并无意玷污他们的圣洁地域。」
～玛尔都车队护卫泰莱

1816.oracleText: Destroy all creatures, then any number of target players each mill half their library, rounded down.
1816.translation: 消灭所有生物，然后任意数量的目标牌手各磨其牌库数量一半的牌，小数点后舍去。

1817.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
1817.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

1820.translation: 指定一个杰斯鹏洛客为目标。

1826.translation: 指定至多两张牌为目标。

1829.oracleText:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer
1829.translation:
「吉拉波的怪灵数量已对展区的基础建设造成威胁。而威胁必得消灭。」
～资深建筑师斯勒姆

1830.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed this way.
1830.translation: 消灭所有生物。每以此法消灭一个生物，你便获得1点生命。

1834.oracleText: Some display their trophies at the Hall of Mechanists. Others display their talent in the streets of Ghirapur.
1834.translation: 有些人在技师名人堂展示自己的奖杯。有些人在吉拉波街头展现自己的才华。

1835.oracleText:
"Only when I saw my enemy walk through all my defenses, untouchable as the moon in the sky, did I truly know what it is to be afraid."
—King Ixes
1835.translation:
「只有当我亲眼见到敌人毫发无伤地穿越防线，像当空皓月一般伸手难及之时，我才真正知道什么叫恐惧。」
～国王依柯兹

1837.oracleText: "Let us never forget the joy that lies at the heart of invention."
1837.translation: 「永别忘记深藏在发明之中的那份喜悦。」

1838.oracleText: Servos and Thopters you control get +1/+1.
1838.translation: 由你操控的自动机和振翼机得+1/+1。

1839.oracleText: {o3oW}: Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
1839.translation: {o3oW}：派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

1841.oracleText:
"There's no reason to buy a new one when I've got the tools to fix the one you've got."
—Ripu, repair specialist
1841.translation:
「我手头有修理你这东西的工具，没必要去买新的。」
～修理能手丽普

1842.oracleText: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1842.translation: 将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

1844.oracleText: "By order of Consulate Mandate 482, I am required to detain you, citizen."
1844.translation: 「市民，根据执政院482号命令，我必须拘捕你。」

1845.oracleText: At night, bats will feast on whatever is drawn to lanterns and streetlights.
1845.translation: 在夜间，蝙蝠以一切受街灯明光吸引的生物为食。

1847.oracleText:
"The judges really put them through their paces, but they prevailed. I think they even impressed Head Judge Tezzeret."
—Ritika, artificer
1847.translation:
「评审严格检验其各项性能，但它们一一过关。就连主审泰兹瑞都对其留下深刻印象。」
～神器师黎提克

1848.oracleText: Create two 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.
1848.translation: 派出两个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

1850.oracleText: "If you wish to produce the finest work, you must start with the finest tools."

1851.oracleText: Search for a card named Domri, City Smasher.
1851.translation: 搜寻一张名称为焚城暴徒多密的牌。

1855.oracleText: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.
1855.translation: 它在午夜时分扇动双翼划过天空，唤醒恐惧尸群跟随。

1857.oracleText: "It's a multifunctional radial extension system with superlateral, force-amplifying rigging. Of course it will win."
1857.translation: 「它不仅有多功能放射状延展系统，还配备超外层增力传动装置。它当然会赢。」

1860.oracleText: Consulate engineers have developed safe methods of harvesting aether, but renegades aren't always so careful.
1860.translation: 执政院的工程师早已开发出了采集乙太的安全方法，但乱匠并不太在意安全这事。

1861.oracleText: Firebending X, where X is Fire Lord Zuko's power.
1861.translation: 振火X，X为烈火君苏科的力量。

1863.oracleText: "Citizens, do not resist. This is for your safety. Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now."
1863.translation: 「市民，不要反抗；这是为了你的安全着想。泰兹瑞要求你交出你的发明，就是现在。」

1864.translation: 指定一个由你操控的骑士为目标。

1870.translation: 由你操控的神器具有辟邪异能。

1873.oracleText: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.
1873.translation: 由于实验结果，列施蜜禁不住思考：除了她所处的现实以外，是否还有许多现实存在。

1883.oracleText: "When the time comes, let go. Nothing lasts forever."
1883.translation: 「寿数将尽时，便顺其自然。万物皆有终了时。」

1884.oracleText: Choose target creature. You get {oEoE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}. The creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn for each {oE} paid this way.
1884.translation: 选择目标生物。你得到{oEoE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。每以此法支付一个{oE}，该生物便得-1/-1直到回合结束。

1887.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent. This ability costs {o3} less to activate if you attacked with a Spacecraft this turn.
1887.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：消灭目标非地永久物。如果你本回合中以太空船攻击过，则此异能减少{o3}来起动。

1889.oracleText: "When you have the chance, take it. Laugh, sing, dance. Don't allow the night to end."
1889.translation: 「抓住一切机会，欢笑，欢唱，欢舞。切勿虚度夜晚好时光。」

1890.oracleText: You draw two cards, lose 2 life, and get {oEoE}.
1890.translation: 你抓两张牌，失去2点生命，并得到{oEoE}。

1895.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken artifact creature you control deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters.
1895.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的神器生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手得到两个中毒指示物。

1896.oracleText:
"That's no ordinary eruption!"
—Grazlash Stonehold, last words
1896.translation:
「这喷发可不寻常！」
～石堡葛莱许的遗言

1897.translation: 当此太空船进场时，刺探2。

1898.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, you lose 1 life.
1898.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，你失去1点生命。

1900.oracleText: Target an attacking Knight you control.
1900.translation: 指定一个由你操控且进行攻击的骑士为目标。

1902.translation: 指定一个进行攻击的骑士为目标。

1903.oracleText: Target a Human or artifact an opponent controls.
1903.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的人类或神器为目标。

1911.oracleText: Cast up to three face-up cards your opponents own from exile without paying their mana costs?
1911.translation: 是否要从放逐区施放至多三张由对手拥有且牌面朝上的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用？

1914.oracleText:
"Friend and foe alike are irresistibly drawn to its beauty—the good, to their lasting reward, and the evil, to their brief and painful regret."
—Vivien Reid
1914.translation:
「无论敌友都无法抗拒其华美而趋前～对于善者而言，这会是其受用终身的奖赏；而对恶者而言，这便是其短暂却又痛苦的惩罚。」
～薇薇安瑞德

1917.oracleText: Tap two untapped Spirits you control.
1917.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的精怪。

1925.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
1925.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

1927.oracleText:
"I'd just let the monkey have it if I were you. You can make another, but the same can't be said of your fingers."
—Turni, Greenwheel groundskeeper
1927.translation:
「换作我，就会任那猴子抢去。东西能重做，但手指不会重生。」
～绿环区管理员图尼

1928.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. You gain 2 life.
1928.translation: 消灭目标神器或结界。你获得2点生命。

1931.oracleText:
"Log 2.5.325: A newborn moon, Aqqat still churns with the fires of creation. I'm eager to see what it will become!"
—Maisie's Edge Chronicles
1931.translation:
「日志第2.5.325条：阿夸特，这颗卫星刚刚成型，表面仍有创世火焰翻腾不息。我都迫不及待想要看看它最终变成什么样子！」
～《麦斯边域编星录》

1932.oracleText: Other multicolored creatures you control get +1/+0.
1932.translation: 由你操控的其他多色生物得+1/+0。

1934.oracleText: Never before have there been so many brilliant minds and wondrous inventions in one place. Denizens from every corner of Kaladesh will flock to the once-in-a-lifetime Inventors' Fair.
1934.translation: 从未有如此多的聪明才俊和神奇发明齐聚一地。卡拉德许各个地方的居民都将涌入终身难忘的发明家博览会。

1935.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to players this turn.
1935.translation: 于本回合中，防止将对牌手造成的所有战斗伤害。

1937.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Professor Zei: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only during your turn.
1937.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲翟教授：将目标瞬间或法术牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你的回合中起动。

1940.oracleText:
"Log 2.9.089: Lammuat, the cemetery moon of salvage and secrets. Could be profitable for those brave enough to plumb its recesses."
—Maisie's Edge Chronicles
1940.translation:
「日志第2.9.089条：拉暮特，埋藏废品与秘密的墓地卫星。若有人胆敢登星发掘，或能获益不浅。」
～《麦斯边域编星录》

1941.oracleText: Remove X counters from target permanent, where X is the number of Elves you control.
1941.translation: 从目标永久物上移去X个指示物，X为由你操控的妖精数量。

1944.oracleText: Target a noncreature artifact you control.
1944.translation: 指定一个由你操控的神器为目标。

1945.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker that is black or red.
1945.translation: 指定一个黑色或红色的生物或鹏洛客为目标。

1946.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact or Lesson spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1946.translation: 每当你施放神器或课程咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1947.oracleText: Search for a card named Rowan, Fearless Sparkmage.
1947.translation: 搜寻一张名称为星火勇花萝婉的牌。

1948.translation: 铸生智者奥薇亚帕西理

1949.oracleText: "Inspiration is reciprocal: we all have a responsibility to each other to create."
1949.translation: 「灵感妙思是互惠的：我们都有促进彼此创作的责任。」

1950.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
1950.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

1951.oracleText: {o4oG}, {oT}: Create an X/X colorless Construct artifact creature token, where X is the number of creatures you control.
1951.translation: {o4oG}，{oT}：派出一个X/X无色组构体衍生神器生物，X为由你操控的生物数量。

1953.oracleText: As unpredictable as aether, and just as hard to contain.
1953.translation: 如乙太一般捉摸不透，也同样难以束缚。

1954.oracleText: Tap four untapped creatures you control with flying.
1954.translation: 横置四个由你操控、具飞行异能且未横置的生物。

1955.oracleText: Search your library for a card named Alpine Watchdog and/or a card named Igneous Cur?
1955.translation: 是否要搜寻一张名称为山地看护犬的牌和／或一张名称为火热杂狗的牌？

1957.translation: 指定一个灵俑牌为目标。

1960.oracleText: Whenever Suki attacks, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token that's tapped and attacking.
1960.translation: 每当苏琪攻击时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

1961.oracleText: Put three of those cards into your hand.
1961.translation: 将其中三张置于你手上。

1962.oracleText: Your opponents can't untap more than two permanents during their untap steps.
1962.translation: 对手于其重置步骤中所重置的永久物不能多于两个。

1965.oracleText: "For years, I studied the aethersphere from afar, but it was not until I touched the aether for myself that I came to know the power contained in the swirling sky."
1965.translation: 「我多年来都从远方钻研乙太层，但是直到亲自触碰了乙太，我才领悟到乙太漫旋的天空所蕴含之力量。」

1968.oracleText: "There are many reasons we invent, of which survival is not the least."
1968.translation: 「我们有种种发明的理由，其中就包括了求取生存。」

1969.oracleText: Creatures with no counters on them get -2/-2 until end of turn.
1969.translation: 其上没有指示物的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

1971.oracleText: Search for a card named Liliana, Death Mage.
1971.translation: 搜寻一张名称为死亡法师莉莲娜的牌。

1975.oracleText: Search for a card named Garruk, Savage Herald.
1975.translation: 搜寻一张名称为蛮力具现贾路的牌。

1976.oracleText: Lesson spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
1976.translation: 你施放的课程咒语减少{o1}来施放。

1978.oracleText: While most power is used for ordinary, everyday tasks, one shouldn't underestimate its potential for the extraordinary.
1978.translation: 虽然大部分的能量都用在了普通的日常事务上，但绝不应低估它在特殊应用方面的潜在威力。

1979.oracleText: {o3}: This creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
1979.translation: {o3}：此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

1980.oracleText:
"Chronomancers have a rather different definition of living in the moment."
—The Millennium Tome
1980.translation:
「不同时间术士对于『活在当下』的定义各不相同。」
～《千年巨著》

1982.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control is put into a graveyard, you get {oE}.
1982.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物进入坟墓场时，你得到{oE}。

1983.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
1983.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

1986.oracleText: Target a green or white creature.
1986.translation: 指定一个绿色或白色的生物为目标。

1987.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Choose a counter on target permanent or player. Give that permanent or player another counter of that kind.
1987.translation: {o3}，{oT}：选择目标永久物或牌手上的一个指示物。该永久物或牌手得到另一个该种类的指示物。

1992.oracleText: Tap another untapped Rogue you control.
1992.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的浪客。

1993.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker that is green or white.
1993.translation: 指定一个绿色或白色的生物或鹏洛客为目标。

1995.oracleText: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.
1995.translation: 它绝对忠诚，甚至会预测主人的需要。

2002.oracleText: Whenever you get one or more {oE}, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
2002.translation: 每当你得到一个或数个{oE}时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

2006.oracleText: Discard a Mountain card or a red card.
2006.translation: 弃一张山脉牌或红色牌。

2011.oracleText: Search for an instant or sorcery card with the same name as a card in your graveyard.
2011.translation: 搜寻一张瞬间或法术牌，且其须与你坟墓场中的某张牌同名。

2012.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
2012.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

2014.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
2014.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

2016.oracleText: Return a creature they control to its owner's hand.
2016.translation: 将一个由其操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

2018.oracleText: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.
2018.translation: 听者各闻心中悦音，独特旋律为其特别奏响。

2019.oracleText: Sacrifice that token at end of combat.
2019.translation: 在战斗结束时，牺牲该衍生物。

2026.oracleText: Search for up to two creature cards with different names.
2026.translation: 搜寻至多两张名称各不相同的生物牌。

2027.oracleText: Tap an untapped permanent you control.
2027.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的永久物。

2031.oracleText:
"Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves."
—Saheeli Rai
2031.translation:
「我们的造物不只是物。我们将自身的一部分托付其中，蕴含着生命的灵动。」
～莎希莉莱伊

2032.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
2032.translation: {o4}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

2034.oracleText: Sometimes the smallest things make the biggest difference.
2034.translation: 有时最渺小的东西能产生最深远的影响。
