"Though the slivers may sometimes resemble us, they are not human. Anyone who fights them must remember this."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge
42788.translation:
「裂片妖有时看起来像人，但他们并非人类。与他们对阵的人须牢记这一点。」
～北境神圣武士莎雷娜

42789.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物得+0/+1。

42793.oracleText:
"They are the finest companions in the realm. Swift, clever, and easily trained to hunt intruders."
—Almira, falconer
42793.translation:
「它们是境内最优秀的：迅捷、聪明、易于训练猎捕入侵者。」
～驯隼师雅米拉

42806.oracleText: "I'll make ice chimes of your bones."
42806.translation: 「我要把你的骨头冻成冰当钟敲。」

42834.oracleText: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.
42834.translation: 在伊弗斯岛上，迅捷且强大的艾文负责执行史芬斯统治者之意愿。

42835.oracleText: Creature spells with flying you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
42835.translation: 你施放之具飞行异能的生物咒语减少{o1}来施放。

42837.oracleText: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."
42837.translation: 「你的脑袋塞满了愚蠢的担忧，以致无法听到微风带来的细微低语。」

42838.oracleText: Whenever a creature with flying attacks, you may draw a card.
42838.translation: 每当一个具飞行异能的生物攻击时，你可以抓一张牌。

42841.oracleText: {o1oU}: Target creature gains flying until end of turn.
42841.translation: {o1oU}：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

42855.oracleText: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."
42855.translation: 「最困难的部份是找出正确的原料。」

42858.oracleText:
"He expects a reward, but the only piece of silver he'll get from me is my blade in his gut."
—Shelac, necromancer
42858.translation:
「他想要报酬，但他从我这里得到的白银只可能是刺入肠子的利刃。」
～死灵术士歇拉

42866.oracleText:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer
42866.translation:
「再想也只不过是徒添伤感。」
～柯帮刑吏虎克

42868.oracleText: Its back bubbles like a witch's cauldron, and it smells just as vile.
42868.translation: 它的背就像女巫的鼎镬般起泡，并发出恶臭。

42871.oracleText: On still nights you can hear its rotted teeth grinding tirelessly on scavenged bones.
42871.translation: 在寂静的夜晚，你能听到它腐烂的牙齿不知疲倦地磨着捡来的骨头。

42872.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
42872.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲一个生物：目标牌手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

42886.oracleText:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess
42886.translation:
「每个活人的族谱上都有世世代代的亡者。你比较想统治哪个领域？」
～莉莲娜维斯

42887.oracleText: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
42887.translation: 将所有坟墓场中的所有生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。

42917.oracleText: Goblin generals don't distinguish between troops and ammunition.
42917.translation: 鬼怪将军不会区分部队和弹药。

42921.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物得+2/+0。

42930.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
42930.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

42936.oracleText: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.
42936.translation: 巨龙出生的巢穴里散落着宝物，用以诱使幼龙破卵而出。

42944.oracleText: "I'm not running away! I'm figuring out the best routes."
42944.translation: 「我不是逃跑！我是在找最佳路线。」

42956.oracleText: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.
42956.translation: 食人魔由激情，愤怒，以及身后另一个手拿皮鞭的食人魔所驱使。

42964.oracleText:
"It is not in me to tread lightly."
—Ryda, geomancer
42964.translation:
「蹑手蹑脚不是我的本性。」
～大地术士濑达

42965.oracleText: When you see the world as a dragon sees it, everything looks fit to burn.
42965.translation: 当你以龙的角度看待世界，一切都适合烧掉。

42973.oracleText:
"The common folk call it the breaking of the crust or the spilling of fire. Geomancers call it target practice."
—Ryda, geomancer
42973.translation:
「普通人称之为地壳断裂或火焰涌出。大地术士称之为练习打靶。」
～大地术士濑达

42976.oracleText: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.
42976.translation: 献祭是最真诚的奉承形式。

42977.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token.
42977.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个1/1红色元素衍生生物。

42979.oracleText: "I am neither their drover nor their leader. To these majestic beasts, I am simply their herdmate and nothing more."
42979.translation: 「我既非它们的牧人，亦非其领袖。对这些雄伟野兽而言，我只是它们的同伴，仅此而已。」

42980.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on target Beast creature you control.
42980.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在目标由你操控的野兽生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

42984.oracleText:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane
42984.translation:
「生命在各处成长。我的族人只是在寻找成长最旺的地方。」
～妮莎瑞文

42986.oracleText: Target creature gets +7/+7 and gains trample until end of turn. It must be blocked this turn if able.
42986.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+7/+7且获得践踏异能。它本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

42988.oracleText: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put all creature cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
42988.translation: 展示你牌库顶的五张牌。将以此法展示的所有生物牌置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

43009.oracleText:
"I see in their interconnectedness a strange embodiment of the natural order."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid
43009.translation:
「我在他们的相互关联中，看到了自然秩序的奇怪体现。」
～妖精高位德鲁伊戴欧诺

43018.oracleText: No matter how much the slivers change, their collective might remains.
43018.translation: 不论裂片妖有多少变化，他们始终拥有群体的力量。

43019.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物得+1/+1。

43021.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
43021.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

43022.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
43022.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

43024.oracleText:
"You don't survive in the wild by standing in plain sight."
—Garruk Wildspeaker
43024.translation:
「如果丝毫不掩蔽行踪，你将无法在野地存活。」
～召兽使贾路

43027.oracleText: In the dim light beneath the vast trees of Deepglade, baloths prowl in search of prey. Their guttural calls are more felt than heard, but their attack scream carries for miles.
43027.translation: 在邃林巨木底层的微光中，巴洛西四处游猎。比起用耳朵听，它们的喉音还比较经常因振动而感知，但它们出击时的吼声却可远扬数哩。

43032.oracleText:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist
43032.translation:
「如果你威胁到其领域，它会产生孢子。事实上，无论你做什么，它都会产生孢子。」
～卡拉谷博物学者哈地卡登

43045.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain 4 life.
43045.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：你获得4点生命。

43046.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature named Festering Newt: Each opponent loses 4 life. You gain life equal to the life lost this way.
43046.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个名称为腐臭水蝾的生物：每位对手各失去4点生命。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于以此法失去的生命总和。

43048.oracleText:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer
43048.translation:
「它照映出过往秘罗地的纯洁。」
～锤族的寇斯

43055.oracleText: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.
43055.translation: 头脑就像山脉一般，无论多么雄伟宏大，都依旧可以化为尘埃。

43087.oracleText: Every world is a work in progress, constantly reshaped by time, disasters, and even the powerful magic of Planeswalkers.
43087.translation: 每个世界都是一项正在进行的工程，不断地被时间、灾害，甚至是鹏洛客的强大法术重塑。

43108.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +4/+4 and has flying and first strike.
43108.translation: 所结附的生物得+4/+4且具有飞行与先攻异能。

43110.translation: 结附于由你操控的山脉

43113.oracleText:
"Training and studies aid a soldier in meager amounts. The gods do the rest."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis
43113.translation:
「单凭训练和研习尚不足以让士兵成才。剩下的得看天意。」
～迈勒提斯士兵布莉戈涅

43116.oracleText:
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail."
—Cymede, queen of Akros
43116.translation:
「阿喀洛斯人必须向我们的狮族对手学习。倘若我方信念之坚贞有若对方蛮猛之刚强，我们绝不会落败。」
～阿喀洛斯皇后赛美狄

43117.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+2 until end of turn.
43117.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+2/+2直到回合结束。

43123.oracleText: Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
43123.translation: 派出三个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

43125.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have flying.
43125.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2且具有飞行异能。

43132.oracleText: "You. Poet. Be sure to write this down."
43132.translation: 「写诗的。就是你。别忘了把这件事记下来。」

43147.oracleText: Other creatures you control have vigilance.
43147.translation: 由你操控的其他生物具有警戒异能。

43148.oracleText: {o2oWoW}: Create a 2/1 white Cleric enchantment creature token.
43148.translation: {o2oWoW}：将一个2/1白色僧侣衍生结界生物放进战场。

43154.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
43154.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

43171.oracleText: His soldiers etch his words on the insides of their shields, their inspiration always in sight during battle.
43171.translation: 士兵将他的言辞蚀刻在盾牌内侧，以便在战役中时时得到鼓舞。

43188.oracleText: "I hear the gods' voices in my dreams each night, and I offer bloody trophies on their altars each day."
43188.translation: 「每晚，我都在梦中听到诸神的声音；每天，我都向他们的祭坛献上血染的贡品。」

43189.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a multicolored spell, you gain 1 life.
43189.translation: 每当任一对手施放多色咒语时，你获得1点生命。

43198.oracleText: Trust is the only bridle a pegasus will accept.
43198.translation: 能够驾驭飞马的唯一鞍辔就是信任。

43204.translation: 每当所结附的生物攻击时，占卜1。

43210.oracleText: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.
43210.translation: 凡人的愿望如潮汐般多变。

43211.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card.
43211.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以抓一张牌。

43212.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Creatures your opponents control attack this turn if able.
43212.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：由对手操控的生物本回合若能攻击，则必须攻击。

43214.oracleText: Don't try to ride this steed unless you've got gills too.
43214.translation: 别妄想骑这匹马，除非你也有鳃。

43240.translation: 由你操控的元素生物得+1/+1。

43249.oracleText: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.
43249.translation: 当她说出那些预言时连自己也大吃一惊。

43273.oracleText:
"The most enlightened mages create beauty from violence."
—Medomai the Ageless
43273.translation:
「造诣最高的法师能够从暴力中创出美感。」
～永生者墨冬迈

43274.oracleText: Counter target enchantment, instant, or sorcery spell. Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.
43274.translation: 反击目标结界，瞬间或法术咒语。其操控者派出一个2/2蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

43277.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 1.
43277.translation: 在你的维持开始时，占卜1。

43296.oracleText: Philosophers say those lost at sea ascended to a more perfect realm. Sailors say they drowned.
43296.translation: 哲人说海上的失踪者升华去了一个更完美的领域。水手说他们淹死了。

43310.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has deathtouch.
43310.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有死触异能。

43319.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has intimidate.
43319.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有威吓异能。

43324.oracleText:
"You're just like me: ruthless, cunning, and ambitious. Obviously you're a threat."
—Basarios the Blade
43324.translation:
「你就跟我一样：冷酷无情、阴险狡猾、野心勃勃。很显然，你是个威胁。」
～剑刃巴萨瑠斯

43376.oracleText: Driven away by his living kin, he wanders mourning through the wilderness, seeking the dead city of Asphodel.
43376.translation: 被在世的亲属赶走后，他悲伤地在旷野间徘徊，寻找死城安福陵。

43397.oracleText: An Akroan soldier's worth is measured by the number of swords raised by his battle cry.
43397.translation: 阿喀洛斯士兵的价值是由他战呼之后举起的刀剑数量所决定。

43403.oracleText: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.
43403.translation: 伊洛安斯竞技会并不会向胜者颁发奖牌。选手们是为了能得到谒见胜利之神伊洛安斯的机会而奋勇拼搏。

43406.oracleText:
"You have led us to triumph over the forces of Mogis!" said Brygus the Brave, clapping the Champion on the back.
The Champion wiped the sweat and blood from her brow.
"I count eight graves," she said. "Too many to call this a victory."
—The Theriad
43406.translation:
「您率领我们战胜了墨癸斯的势力！」勇者布瑞古斯敬佩地拍着天尊的后背。天尊擦去眉间血汗，说道：「我们损失了八条性命。如此惨烈，难称胜利。」
～《塞洛亚特》

43411.oracleText: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.
43411.translation: 当胸前插着长矛时，很难喊出「举起盾牌！」。

43412.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +1/+0 and gain first strike until end of turn.
43412.translation: 直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。

43440.oracleText: "It used to be a lair. Now it's just a tunnel."
43440.translation: 「它曾是个巢穴。现在它只是条隧道。」

43449.oracleText:
"Their only dreams are of full stomachs."
—Kleon the Iron-Booted
43449.translation:
「他们唯一的梦想就是填饱胃袋。」
～铁靴克利恩

43458.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Scry 1.
43458.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。占卜1。

43465.oracleText: {o2oR}: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
43465.translation: {o2oR}：由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

43468.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and has menace.
43468.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+3且具有威慑异能。

43472.oracleText:
"I see a spark of pure rage. Soon that spark will spread from the depths of Kragma. Soon its fire will engulf the polis."
—Hira, street oracle
43472.translation:
「我看到一丝纯怒的火花。很快，这一丝火花就将从夸格玛深处扩散。很快，它的火焰就将吞没城邦。」
～街头先知亥菈

43473.oracleText: Other Minotaur creatures you control get +1/+1 and have trample.
43473.translation: 由你操控的其他牛头怪生物得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

43492.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+1 until end of turn. Scry 1.
43492.translation: 目标生物得+3/+1直到回合结束。占卜1。

43523.oracleText: For the first time in many years, Elspeth asked for help.
43523.translation: 这是艾紫培多年来首次求援。

43524.oracleText: Reveal the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature or enchantment card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
43524.translation: 展示你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张生物或结界牌置于你手上。将其余牌置入你的坟墓场。

43531.oracleText: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.
43531.translation: 倪勒娅神圣的山猫守护着尊崇奈西安树林的人，猎杀那些不尊崇的人。

43540.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has reach.
43540.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有延势异能。

43546.oracleText: {o7oGoG}: Monstrosity 5. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each creature card in your graveyard.
43546.translation: {o7oGoG}：蛮化5。你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

43548.oracleText: It's not the two heads you should fear. It's the four fangs.
43548.translation: 你该畏惧的不是那两个头，而是那四根毒牙。

43553.oracleText: Other creatures you control have trample.
43553.translation: 由你操控的其他生物具有践踏异能。

43560.oracleText: Enchanted land is every basic land type in addition to its other types.
43560.translation: 所结附的地额外具有所有基本地类别。

43579.oracleText:
Thakolides the Mighty
Slayer of minotaurs
Vanquisher of giants
Killed by a scorpion
—Inscription on an Akroan grave
43579.translation:
强者萨克洛里得斯
牛头怪杀手
巨人征服者
因蝎子而死
～某阿喀洛斯人的墓志铭

43587.oracleText: Those who enter the copse never leave. They find peace there and take root, becoming part of the ever-growing grove.
43587.translation: 移居杂木林间的人从未离开。他们得享安宁并扎根于斯，变成这片永生树林的一部分。

43589.oracleText: Choose target creature an opponent controls. When that creature dies this turn, you gain 3 life. Target creature you control fights that creature.
43589.translation: 选择目标由对手操控的生物。当该生物于本回合中死去时，你获得3点生命。目标由你操控的生物与该生物互斗。

43591.oracleText: "None can own the land's bounty. The gods made this world for all to share its riches. And I'm not just saying that because you caught me stealing your fruit."
43591.translation: 「没有人能独享大地的馈赠。众神创造了这个世界，让众生分享其成果。我可不是因为偷水果被你逮着才这么说的。」

43596.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
43596.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

43602.oracleText: Akros's greatest heroes are also its royalty.
43602.translation: 阿喀洛斯最伟大的英雄伴侣，也是皇室伉俪。

43605.oracleText: One offering to appease her on her arrival. Another to celebrate her departure.
43605.translation: 一份献礼用于在她到来时讨其欢心，另一份则用于在她离去时欢庆无休。

43621.oracleText:
"Stoke a fire hot enough and you'll never run out of things to burn."
—Xenagos, the Reveler
43621.translation:
「让火旺到一定程度，你就再也不缺烧的东西了。」
～贪欢者谢纳戈斯

43644.oracleText: You may cast creature spells as though they had flash.
43644.translation: 你可以将生物咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

43662.oracleText: Keranos is a fickle god, delivering punishment as readily as prophecy.
43662.translation: 刻拉诺斯喜怒无常，随时准备施以处罚和预言。

43663.oracleText: Reveal the top five cards of your library and separate them into two piles. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
43663.translation: 展示你牌库顶的五张牌，并分成两堆。任一对手选择其中一堆。将该堆牌置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。

43678.oracleText: Create a 2/2 red and green Satyr creature token with haste.
43678.translation: 派出一个2/2，红绿双色，具敏捷异能的羊蹄人衍生生物。

43684.oracleText:
"I know its lightness, for I have seen it fly. I know its weight, for I have seen it strike."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis
43684.translation:
「其身轻如燕，我曾亲眼见它飞翔天空。其力大无穷，我曾亲眼见它突袭成功。」
～迈勒提斯士兵布莉戈涅

43689.oracleText: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.
43689.translation: 由神明之手铸造，在凡人领域游荡。

43699.oracleText: Equipped creature has flying and haste.
43699.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有飞行与敏捷异能。

43747.oracleText: "Trust me. When you have earned a god's favor, you'll know."
43747.translation: 「相信我。得到神恩眷顾时，你自然会知道。」

43757.oracleText: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
43757.translation: 将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

43763.oracleText: Some adopted the tactics of the leonin to combat the ferocity of the minotaurs.
43763.translation: 有人已学会利用狮族的战术来化解牛头怪的残暴攻势。

43771.translation: 放逐目标已横置的生物。

43776.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has double strike.
43776.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有连击异能。

43789.oracleText: "My left has felled a cyclops. My right has slain a giant. I bring both to every fight."
43789.translation: 「我左砍独眼巨人，右斩巨人，每一战均全力以赴。」

43790.oracleText: Aura spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
43790.translation: 你施放的灵气咒语减少{o1}来施放。

43796.oracleText:
"Even if I should die in the saddle, she will not let me fall to the ground."
—Hypatia of the Winged Horse
43796.translation:
「就算我于马鞍之上丧命，她也不会让我坠落地面。」
～翼马的希帕提娅

43816.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land.
43816.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲此地：消灭目标非基本地。

43818.oracleText: Students at the Dekatia Academy learn that being sent to study with her is a lesson in itself.
43818.translation: 得卡提亚学院的学生明白了：被送去和她一起学习，本身就是一场考验。

43822.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
43822.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

43899.oracleText:
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa."
—Kiora
43899.translation:
「怪不得塔萨会对它着迷。」
～奇奥拉

43997.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Discard a card: Draw a card.

44003.oracleText: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.
44003.translation: 侮辱熔锻神是不智之举。站在侮辱熔锻神的人附近也同样不智。

44004.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.
44004.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对另一个目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

44014.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to its owner's hand.
44014.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

44021.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may sacrifice this land. If you do, search your library for a colorless creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
44021.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的无色咒语时，你可以牺牲此地。若你如此作，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张无色生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

44051.oracleText: Purphoros's blessing: sometimes a boon, sometimes a bane. Always ablaze.
44051.translation: 普罗烽斯的祝福，有时是福有时是祸；但总是闪耀着烈焰。

44066.translation: 「即使独身，我也在数量上压倒你。」

44067.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your devotion to green.
44067.translation: 目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你的绿色献力。

44069.oracleText:
"If the hierarchies of nature were determined by ferocity alone, the badger would be lord of the beasts."
—Anthousa of Setessa
44069.translation:
「若大自然的阶级仅仅取决于残暴程度，则獾必定是万兽之王。」
～瑟特萨的安陶莎

44081.oracleText: "You cannot achieve greatness if its seed has not already been planted in your heart."
44081.translation: 「如果没在心中播下伟大种子，就不可能成就伟业。」

44084.oracleText: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.
44084.translation: 若要加入瑟特萨的莱纳塔战士之列，你必须不畏死亡，只怕失败。

44085.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw that many cards.
44085.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓等量的牌。

44117.oracleText: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.
44117.translation: 在欢宴后第一个苏醒的羊蹄人，必须负责寻找下一场欢宴的地点。

44136.oracleText: Thaumaturges of Theros have learned to weave their magic into the world around them, but it can be pulled apart strand by strand.
44136.translation: 塞洛斯的奇术师已学会利用自身魔法来织化出周遭世界，但这些魔法造物却可一丝丝地剥解殆尽。

44139.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +4/+4 and has flying, first strike, vigilance, trample, and lifelink.
44139.translation: 所结附的生物得+4/+4且具有飞行、先攻、警戒、践踏与系命异能。

44142.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if you had another creature enter the battlefield under your control last turn, draw a card.
44142.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若上回合中有另一个生物在你的操控下进战场，则抓一张牌。

44154.oracleText: Until your next turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target permanent an opponent controls.
44154.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，防止目标由对手操控的永久物将受到或造成的所有伤害。

44156.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 9/9 blue Kraken creature token.
44156.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个9/9蓝色巨海兽衍生生物。

44159.oracleText: "She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."
44159.translation: 「她自称奇奥拉，但我相信她就是塔萨，海洋的化身和深渊的女王。」

44191.oracleText: "The music is in the drum. I simply coax it out to be heard."
44191.translation: 「音乐就在鼓里。我只是诱哄它出来给人听。」

44202.oracleText: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield?
44202.translation: 是否要将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场？

44238.oracleText: It is the soul of a philosopher who died of starvation contemplating the universe.
44238.translation: 塞洛斯各族的哲学演绎，唯人类进展最为不彰，因为他们得耗费时间来进食入睡。

44243.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature blocks or becomes blocked by one or more creatures, you may exile one of those creatures.
44243.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物阻挡一个或数个生物或被一个或数个生物阻挡时，你可以放逐后者生物之一。

44249.oracleText: Go forth with honor, return with glory.

44253.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token that's tapped and attacking.
44253.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

44261.oracleText: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.
44261.translation: 众神着迷于其无邪外表，或许是因为自身缺乏此特质。

44262.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you gain 1 life.
44262.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你获得1点生命。

44273.oracleText:
"A tiny flame is enough to dispel the night."
—Elspeth
44273.translation:
「点滴星火就足以耀亮夜空。」
～艾紫培

44288.oracleText: "Death is tyranny. Like all tyranny, it must be opposed."
44288.translation: 「死亡如同暴政，而暴政必遭反抗。」

44353.oracleText: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.
44353.translation: 克罗芬斯将对人类最可怕的预言藏起，让人类永远找不到，而屈东也不会费神去读。

44365.oracleText: "Who will miss you, drywalker? A wife? A child? Perhaps they will blame the sea for your fate, and teach future generations to stay far away from it."
44365.translation: 「地上人，谁会思念你？妻子？孩子？或许他们会将你的命运归咎于大海，教导后世子孙远离它。」

44391.oracleText: "I take no pleasure in your suffering, but it is necessary. Once you accept your fate you'll find eternity more tolerable."
44391.translation: 「我并不以你的痛苦为乐，但这是你的必经之路。一旦你接受自己的命运，就会发现来世还好过些。」

44394.oracleText: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.
44394.translation: 身前恐惧蔓延。身畔恶臭随行。身后尸横遍野。

44428.oracleText: The serpents' dens built into statues of Pharika serve not only to consecrate her temples, but as a hidden line of defense.
44428.translation: 蛇穴与芳瑞卡的雕像化为一体，不仅可以用来献祭神庙，还可以当作隐秘防线。

44454.oracleText: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.
44454.translation: 艾紫培害怕的就是她擅闯尼兹的下场。

44472.translation: 塞洛斯陷入烈焰时，谢纳戈斯正乐在其中。

44477.oracleText: A minotaur does not distinguish between human, satyr, and triton. They are all meat.
44477.translation: 牛头怪分辨不出人类、羊蹄人和屈东。就都是肉类而已。

44478.oracleText: Create two 2/3 red Minotaur creature tokens with haste.
44478.translation: 派出两个2/3红色，具敏捷异能的牛头怪衍生生物。

44494.oracleText: "I fight for Keranos and for mortals. I see no contradiction."
44494.translation: 「我同时为刻拉诺斯和凡人而战，我看不出这有什么矛盾。」

44511.oracleText: "Xenagos has become what he once despised: a tyrant and an oppressor."
44511.translation: 「谢纳戈斯已成为他一度厌弃的人：暴君和压迫者。」

44531.oracleText: Setessan warriors of Bassara Tower are known for their guerrilla tactics and skill with the bow. Interlopers into the Nessian Wood do not get far.
44531.translation: 巴萨剌塔的瑟特萨战士以游击战术和弓技著称。闯入奈西安森林者根本走不远。

44555.oracleText: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.
44555.translation: 旅人间相传着：多头龙会咬掉自己的头，以便变得更致命。

44612.oracleText: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.
44612.translation: 将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标由你操控的生物。

44613.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Aura, creature, or planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
44613.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张灵气、生物或鹏洛客牌，并将其置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

44617.oracleText: Whenever another creature you own dies, return it to your hand unless target opponent pays 3 life.
44617.translation: 每当另一个由你拥有的生物死去时，除非目标对手支付3点生命，否则将它移回你手上。

44628.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to attacking creatures you control.
44628.translation: 防止将对由你操控且进行攻击的生物造成的所有伤害。

44639.oracleText: {oBoG}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Its owner creates a 1/1 black and green Snake enchantment creature token with deathtouch.
44639.translation: {oBoG}：将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。其拥有者派出一个1/1黑绿双色，具死触异能的蛇衍生结界生物。

44664.oracleText: Five rivers encircle Theros, flowing with waters more ancient than the world itself.
44664.translation: 五河环绕着塞洛斯，河中流淌着比这个世界更古老的水。

44681.oracleText: Distribute counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.
44681.translation: 将指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标由你操控的生物。

44688.oracleText: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."
44688.translation: 「逝者就该离苦得乐，免遭奴役。」

44705.oracleText: Once you've been dragged down the currents of time, you'll never quite trust your own permanence again.
44705.translation: 一旦你从时间流中给拉出来，就再也难以确定自己是否存在了。

44708.oracleText:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren
44708.translation:
「照我的想法做，别照我的做法做。」
～杰斯贝连

44739.oracleText:
"As with any malevolent being, the trick is knowing how long you can afford to keep it in your service."
—Liliana Vess
44739.translation:
「与任何邪恶的生物一样，诀窍在于知道自己能让它为你效力多久。」
～莉莲娜维斯

44740.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
44740.translation: 在每个维持开始时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

44744.oracleText: There is nothing more repulsive than a cockroach—except a cockroach and all its friends.
44744.translation: 没有什么比蟑螂更让人厌恶的了～除了蟑螂和它的朋友们。

44756.oracleText:
"There are dark, ancient arts that fascinate even me."
—Sorin Markov
44756.translation:
「有些黑暗而古老的艺术，甚至连我都会入迷。」
～索霖马可夫

44757.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if you control no Snakes, create a 1/1 black Snake creature token with deathtouch.
44757.translation: 在每个维持开始时，如果你未操控蛇，则派出一个1/1黑色具有死触异能的蛇衍生生物。

44759.oracleText: Death is no excuse to stop working.
44759.translation: 死亡不能作为停止工作的藉口。

44768.oracleText:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept
44768.translation:
「隔离随云漂移的瘟疫是至难之业。」
～治疗专家易萨拉

44770.oracleText: All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn.
44770.translation: 所有生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。

44806.oracleText: If one or more tokens would be created, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
44806.translation: 如果将派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出两倍数量的该类衍生物。

44822.oracleText: {o1oGoWoU}: Put Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
44822.translation: {o1oGoWoU}：将德蕾薇从统帅区放进战场。

44882.oracleText: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.
44882.translation: 整排的米捷球助她的心灵深探思想领域，寻访其间智慧灵光。

44914.oracleText:
"You can't think your way out of this, Jace. Thought implies life, and life requires a pulse—music to a hunter's ears."
—Vraska
44914.translation:
「你不可能想出脱困之法，杰斯。思考意味着生命，而生命需要脉搏～那正是猎人耳中的音乐。」
～瓦丝卡

44918.oracleText:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska
44918.translation:
「我见识过让弱者哭泣胡言之物。想认识看看吗？」
～瓦丝卡

44920.oracleText:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription
44920.translation:
在亡魂的国度中，无所谓光荣。
～维克族墓碑铭

44923.oracleText: The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.
44923.translation: 僧侣盼你受苦，愿你绝望。

44928.oracleText: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.
44928.translation: 没能壮大者会死去。而死者壮大了塔莫耶夫。

44930.oracleText:
"Master the chaotic forces of nature, and you shall master magic."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest
44930.translation:
「通晓自然的混沌之力，你就能掌握魔法。」
～格拉莫树林守卫叶提娃

44956.oracleText: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.
44956.translation: 优秀的策士把握机会。伟大的策士创造机会。

44982.oracleText: The calm comes after the storm.

45017.oracleText: With a commando around, somebody's gonna get hurt.
45017.translation: 突击兵登场，必有人挂彩。

45055.oracleText: Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards.
45055.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

45057.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets one or more permanents, gain control of those permanents.
45057.translation: 每当你施放以一个或数个永久物为目标的咒语时，获得这些永久物的操控权。

45089.oracleText: The academy worked with time—until time ran out.
45089.translation: 大学院研究的主题是时间～直到他们将时间用尽。

45094.oracleText: Until end of turn, up to one target creature gets +1/+1 and gains first strike, vigilance, and lifelink.
45094.translation: 直到回合结束，至多一个目标生物得+1/+1且获得先攻，警戒与系命异能。

45096.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to you or a planeswalker you control, prevent all but 1 of that damage.
45096.translation: 如果某来源将对你或由你操控的鹏洛客造成伤害，则防止其中除了1点以外的所有伤害。

45111.oracleText: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

45119.oracleText: The blessings of Heliod are apparent for all to see.
45119.translation: 赫利欧德的祝福所有人都看得见。

45122.oracleText: An overwhelming sense of calm accompanies the gryffs that wheel above the roofs of Gavony.
45122.translation: 在加渥尼房顶上空盘旋的骏鹭带有一种压倒性的静谧感。

45133.oracleText: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.
45133.translation: 响应警报就如眨眼和呼吸一样，是一种下意识的反应。

45154.oracleText: The sacred feathers of the pegasus are said to have healing powers.
45154.translation: 飞马神圣的羽毛据说能够疗伤。

45182.oracleText:
"The hive shimmered, and its walls seemed a living mirror."
—Hastric, Thunian scout
45182.translation:
「母巢闪烁着光芒，它的墙壁犹如一面活生生的镜子。」
～图恩斥候海司齐

45183.oracleText: Whenever a Sliver creature you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {o2}.
45183.translation: 每当任一由你操控的裂片妖生物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，除非该咒语或异能的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。

45186.oracleText: Too often, some self-described genius comes up with a "labor-saving device" that ends up creating far more work.
45186.translation: 某些自诩的奇才发明出的「省力装置」到头来往往只会让人更费力。

45187.oracleText: Enchanted artifact is a creature with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types.
45187.translation: 所结附的神器是基础力量与防御力为5/5的生物，且仍具有原本类别。

45189.oracleText: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.
45189.translation: 得知对方无从反击之后，它便跃跃欲试准备捕猎更大的猎物。

45193.oracleText:
"In a daze, I woke and looked upon the battlefield, where I could swear my dreams were laying waste to the enemy."
—Letter from a soldier
45193.translation:
「朦胧之中，我醒转过来，茫然地看着战场周遭的一切；我敢发誓是我的迷梦在对敌人大开杀戒。」
～士兵的来信

45205.oracleText:
"It's a truly disconcerting sight to see their shadows cast upon the deck."
—Captain Triff
45205.translation:
「看到他们的影子投射在甲板上，这种景象着实令人不安。」
～船长特里夫

45239.oracleText: It would be ill-mannered to decline his invitation. It would be ill-advised to accept it.
45239.translation: 拒绝他的邀请有失礼数。接受他的邀请有失明智。

45271.oracleText:
"Seeing one slowly devour one of my party begged the question—do they know what cruelty is?"
—Hastric, Thunian scout
45271.translation:
「眼看我的同伴遭其中一员缓慢吞噬，我心中不禁产生了这样的疑问～他们知道什么叫残忍吗？」
～图恩斥候海司齐

45272.oracleText: Whenever a Sliver you control attacks, defending player loses 1 life.
45272.translation: 每当一个由你操控的裂片妖攻击时，防御牌手失去1点生命。

45301.oracleText:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess
45301.translation:
「如果目的仅在于致命，这就够了。但这门技艺是要使它造成的痛苦达到最大。」
～莉莲娜维斯

45302.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. You lose 3 life.
45302.translation: 目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。你失去3点生命。

45310.oracleText: Whenever an opponent discards a creature card, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
45310.translation: 每当一位对手弃一张生物牌时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

45312.oracleText: Whenever an opponent discards a noncreature, nonland card, draw a card.
45312.translation: 每当一位对手弃一张非生物且非地的牌时，你抓一张牌。

45314.oracleText: Some bog witches practice the strange art of batrachomancy, reading portents in the number, size, and color of warts on a toad's hide.
45314.translation: 有些腐沼女巫擅观蛙相，这门奇特技艺能从蟾蜍身上肉瘤的数量、大小和颜色中解读出未来预兆。

45329.oracleText:
"The slivers became adept at provoking a fear response in other species."
—Hastric, Thunian scout
45329.translation:
「裂片妖越来越擅长激起其他种族心中的恐惧。」
～图恩斥候海司齐

45330.oracleText: Sliver creatures you control have menace.
45330.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物具有威慑异能

45335.oracleText: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.
45335.translation: 虽然她确实令人畏惧，但其战斗事迹却鲜有流传，因为没人能活过她的突袭。

45341.oracleText: "With rage as your forge, your hammer can smite anything."
45341.translation: 「你的怒气若能如锻炉般火爆，你的重锤就将无坚不摧。」

45345.oracleText: A bit of pain never hurts.

45355.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token with haste.
45355.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个1/1红色，具敏捷异能的鬼怪衍生生物。

45360.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has haste.
45360.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有敏捷异能。

45372.oracleText: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.
45372.translation: 召使闪电就如同驾驭混乱。

45384.oracleText: It requires immense pressure to imbue an item with magic. If the spell is broken . . .
45384.translation: 将魔法注入物品需要庞大的压力。如果灌注的咒语被打破...

45393.oracleText: There will always be those who presume to improve nature, or dare to befoul it. And nature will always have a response.
45393.translation: 总有人自以为自己有能力改善自然，甚或有权利糟蹋自然。而自然总会作出回应。

45424.oracleText: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.
45424.translation: 它擅长扑杀离群落单者。

45432.oracleText: The Conclave acts with a single will, expressed by countless warriors.
45432.translation: 盟会的行动由无数战士实施，但背后只有一个意志。

45439.oracleText: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."
45439.translation: 「无论是由石匠塑造，由铁匠锻造，或由法师赐予生命者，我都会让它们重归大地怀抱。」

45452.oracleText: {o4oW}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
45452.translation: {o4oW}：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

45453.oracleText: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.
45453.translation: 大家伙靠力量统治。小家伙凭智慧生存。小心变成大家伙的小家伙。

45473.oracleText:
"This is the source, the line unbroken since the calamity that brought such monsters to our shores."
—Hastric, Thunian scout
45473.translation:
「这就是灾祸的源头，他的存在让这些威胁我们海滨的怪物绵延不绝。」
～图恩斥候海司齐

45474.oracleText: Sliver creatures you control have indestructible.
45474.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物具有不灭异能。

45480.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has trample.
45480.translation: 佩戴此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有践踏异能。

45483.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: For each planeswalker you control, you may activate one of its loyalty abilities once this turn as though none of its loyalty abilities have been activated this turn.
45483.translation: {o4}，{oT}：对每个由你操控的鹏洛客而言，于本回合中，你能起动一次该鹏洛客上的任一忠诚异能，且能视同此回合未起动过其忠诚异能地来起动之。

45489.oracleText: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.
45489.translation: 许多被围攻的城市一听到攻城巨车那独特的轰鸣声便缴械投降。

45496.oracleText: Once a year, the skies over Paliano fill with the flying machines of those who hope to be taken on as pupils by the artificer Muzzio.
45496.translation: 帕兰诺城每年都会出现一次无数飞行装置漫天飞舞的盛况，这些器械打造者渴望能以此得到神器师穆齐奥的青睐，被他收为学徒。

45498.oracleText: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy. To disrupt one is to unleash devastation and chaos.
45498.translation: 赞迪卡每一块晶石的位置都经过灵龙乌金的仔细调整，以引导地脉之中的能量流动。打乱其中一块就会引发灾难与混乱。

45500.oracleText:
"To be in the presence of a revoker is to be truly alone."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent
45500.translation:
「在断念妖的面前才是真正的孤独。」
～纽若克密探凯拉黎

45517.oracleText: {o5}: Permanents you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
45517.translation: {o5}：直到回合结束，你操控的永久物获得不灭。

45523.oracleText: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.
45523.translation: 玄铁所建之物，不受战事侵袭，不留岁月痕迹。

45525.oracleText:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane
45525.translation:
「每个人都重视疲惫的旅人能安心喝水的地方。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

45541.oracleText: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."
45541.translation: 「不论我去向何方，先祖都与我同在。」

45543.oracleText: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has lifelink.
45543.translation: 每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物均具有系命异能。

45545.oracleText: The fastest way across the dunes is above.
45545.translation: 横跨沙丘的捷径在空中。

45547.oracleText: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

45549.oracleText: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has first strike.
45549.translation: 每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物均具有先攻异能。

45551.oracleText: The appearance of a kirin signifies the passing or arrival of an important figure. As word of sightings spread, all the khans took it to mean themselves. Only the shaman Chianul thought of Sarkhan Vol.
45551.translation: 麒麟现身，预示有伟人降世或离逝。自从目见麒麟的消息传开，五位可汗都认为这位伟人就是自己。只有祭师恰努尔想到了萨坎沃。

45555.oracleText: When Anafenza holds court under the First Tree, the gates of Mer-Ek are sealed. No safer place exists in all of Tarkir.
45555.translation: 莫克的城门会在阿娜芬札于族源之树升帐之时全数闭锁，鞑契全境再无比之更安全的所在。

45558.oracleText:
"Stand where the whole battle can see you. Strike so they'll never forget."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan
45558.translation:
「于战场中心奋勇拼杀。让敌人闻风丧胆。」
～阿布赞可汗阿娜芬札

45559.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
45559.translation: 目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

45561.oracleText: Her palm flared like the eye of a waking dragon. Then all was calm.
45561.translation: 她掌心微光闪烁，正如苏醒巨龙明澈的双目。转瞬之间一切都归于平静。

45562.oracleText: Destroy all creatures and all permanents attached to creatures.
45562.translation: 消灭所有生物和所有结附或装备在生物上的永久物。

45563.oracleText:
"Truth is hard enough to see, let alone understand. We must remove all distractions to find clarity."
—Zogye, wandering sage
45563.translation:
「真相得见亦难，得知更难。吾等必须摒除杂念，才能见其根本。」
～云游智者邵格

45565.oracleText: Dragons are extinct on Tarkir, but Abzan magic still emulates their endurance.
45565.translation: 虽然龙已在鞑契绝迹，但其坚忍仍得见于阿布赞的魔法之中。

45566.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.
45566.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。选择一种颜色。该生物获得反该色保护异能直到回合结束。

45568.oracleText: "What warrior worth the name fears to leave a trail? If my enemies seek me, let them follow the ashes in my wake."
45568.translation: 「名副其实的战士哪里会怕留下踪迹？如果敌人要找我，尽管让他们追着我的灰迹过来。」

45575.oracleText: {o3oW}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
45575.translation: {o3oW}：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

45579.oracleText: Mardu archers are trained in Dakla, the way of the bow. They never miss their target, no matter how small, how fast, or how far away.
45579.translation: 玛尔都弓箭手的驭弓之道称为巫箭流。不论多小、多快、多远的目标，他们都不会失手。

45584.oracleText: The horde grows with each assault.
45584.translation: 每一次突袭都让部落更加壮大。

45589.oracleText: The Mardu charge reflects the dragon's speed—and its hunger.
45589.translation: 玛尔都式冲锋迅猛之余不乏欲望～正如龙群一般。

45590.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. Warrior creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.
45590.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。由你操控的战士生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

45592.oracleText: These winged warriors meditate in flight, tracing mandalas in the clouds.
45592.translation: 这些有翼战士在飞行中冥想，绘曼荼罗于云端。

45596.oracleText: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."
45596.translation: 「我也不知道我命属何方，但一定不在这。」

45599.oracleText:
"They thought their fortress impregnable . . . until we marched up with ours, and blocked out the sun."
—Golran, dragonscale captain
45599.translation:
「他们开始还以为自己的要塞固若金汤...但等到我方遮天蔽日的要塞兵临城下之后，很快就屈服了。」
～龙鳞队长高勒岚

45601.oracleText:
"The dragons thought they were too strong to be tamed, too large to fall. And where are they now?"
—Khibat the Revered
45601.translation:
「龙也曾自恃强大无人能敌，自倚势大不虞衰落。他们现在呢？」
～尊贵的席巴特

45605.oracleText:
"Many scales make the skin of a dragon."
—Abzan wisdom
45605.translation:
「无数鳞片相织方成就龙鳞坚忍。」
～阿布赞哲语

45606.oracleText: Create three 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens.
45606.translation: 派出三个1/1白色战士衍生生物。

45610.oracleText: Lammasu are the enigmatic travelers of Tarkir, soaring high above all lands in all seasons. None know their true purpose, but they often arrive on the eve of great conflicts or turning points in history.
45610.translation: 拉玛苏是鞑契的神秘旅人，终年高飞于万里长空，穿行世界。没人知道他们目的何在，不过常常能在历史剧变或转捩前夕见到他们的身影。

45612.oracleText:
"The Houses always hope for peace, but we always pack for war."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar commander
45612.translation:
「眷族希冀和平永驻，但我们一直在行军备战。」
～孑遗指挥官格瓦巴泽

45620.oracleText:
"The stronger our enemies seem, the more vulnerable they are."
—Sultai secret
45620.translation:
「敌人看起来越强大，实际上就越脆弱。」
～苏勒台秘录

45621.oracleText:
"Even the greatest inferno begins as a spark. And anyone can snuff out a spark."
—Chanyi, mistfire sage
45621.translation:
「燎原业火，亦星火生之，然星火人人均可熄之。」
～雾火智者禅益

45625.oracleText: In the silence of the ice, even dreams become still.
45625.translation: 寒冰无言，就连梦境也随之静止。

45627.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
45627.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余的牌则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

45635.oracleText: Arel dreamed of winter's end. The next morning she followed a strange trail and found a seedling in the snow.
45635.translation: 阿瑞尔在睡梦中，看到了寒冬终结的景象。次日清晨，她循着一条莫名踪迹，在雪中寻得一株新绿。

45638.oracleText: Where an enemy once rode, not even a whisper remains.
45638.translation: 曾有敌军驰骋，如今悄无声息。

45641.oracleText:
"Have you spent a winter high in the mountains, where the ice walks and speaks to the wind? It is not a place for those who have not learned respect."
—Ulnok, Temur shaman
45641.translation:
「你可曾在山巅过冬？那里有起身踏步，呼啸狂风的冰川。不知道何谓敬畏的人根本待不下去。」
～铁木尔祭师乌勒诺克

45643.oracleText: "Do not think the sand or the sun will hold back the breath of winter."
45643.translation: 「不要以为黄砂或烈日就能阻挡寒冬吐息。」

45655.oracleText:
"The arrow strikes one bird down, but the flock remains."
—Jeskai teaching
45655.translation:
「只箭伤落羽，无力撼集群。」
～洁斯凯教谕

45657.oracleText: "There are no obstacles, only different paths."
45657.translation: 「世上没有不通的路，只有未觉之道。」

45665.oracleText: Adepts of the Riverwheel Stronghold can run through rain and never get wet; masters use the raindrops as stepping stones.
45665.translation: 河轮城塞武技纯熟者能穿雨而过不湿分毫；炉火纯青者则能踏雨而上直入云霄。

45667.oracleText: The Temur believe that scaldkin are born when eruptions melt the frozen whispers of sleeping ancestors.
45667.translation: 铁木尔族相信，沸身乃是先祖冰霜梦呓遭喷发山火熔化而成。

45670.oracleText:
"There is nothing so free as the spring river born of winter's ice."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller
45670.translation:
「凛冬寒冰融化，一江春水翻腾，世间万物没有比此更自由奔跃者。」
～召猎人妮图拉

45673.oracleText: The envoy spoke, and Sidisi replied.

45679.oracleText: The Temur have no patience for subtlety.
45679.translation: 铁木尔没有耐心讲究细节。

45682.oracleText: "The Jeskai would have me bow in restraint. So I have found a people unafraid of true power."
45682.translation: 「洁斯凯还想迫使我屈服，既然他们毫不畏惧，就让他们瞧瞧真正的力量。」

45687.oracleText: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.
45687.translation: 金玉漂流在外，阴谋勾画其间。

45689.oracleText:
"Be as water: untamed and unheld, yet inexorably flowing toward a greater goal."
—Shensu, Riverwheel mystic
45689.translation:
「正如这流水：形不羁而向高远，行无常而道恒定。」
～河轮秘教徒申苏

45691.oracleText: Temur shamans speak of three destinies: the now, the echo of the past, and the unwritten. They find flickering paths among tangled possibilities.
45691.translation: 铁木尔祭师论及三条命途：眼下当世，过往回响，以及口耳传闻。从三者相互交织产生的无限可能之中，他们找出明灭不定的动向。

45698.oracleText:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov
45698.translation:
「乌金，原来你沉眠于此。众世界的残骸也将到墓中与你相聚。」
～索霖马可夫

45699.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 2 life.
45699.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。你失去2点生命。

45701.oracleText: "Death is merely another foe the Mardu will overcome."
45701.translation: 「死亡对玛尔都而言，只不过是又一个手下败将。」

45705.oracleText:
Got a diving lesson
—Sultai expression meaning
"was fed to the crocodiles"
45705.translation:
下水了
～苏勒台用语，意指
「被送去喂鳄鱼」

45708.oracleText:
"If weakness does not exist within the Temur then we shall force it upon them."
—Sidisi, khan of the Sultai
45708.translation:
「如果铁木尔没有弱点，那么我们就强加一个上去。」
～苏勒台可汗谢迪西

45709.oracleText:
"You have returned from fire, traitor. This time I will see you leave as ashes."
—Zurgo, to Sarkhan Vol
45709.translation:
「叛徒，那场大火也没能把你烧死。这次我一定要把你化作灰烬。」
～珠高怒斥萨坎沃

45711.oracleText: Long after death, the spirits of the Disowned continue to seek redemption among their Abzan kin.
45711.translation: 即使死后很久，遭弃者的灵魂仍在他们的阿布赞亲人中寻求救赎。

45717.oracleText: Create X tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
45717.translation: 派出X个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

45720.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, draw a card.
45720.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

45722.oracleText:
"Anything a falcon can do, a bat can do in pitch darkness."
—Urdnan the Wanderer
45722.translation:
「猎隼能做的事情，蝙蝠在一片漆黑中也能做到。」
～云游者乌尔德南

45724.oracleText: It stares through the empty, pain-twisted faces of those it has drained.
45724.translation: 它以其受害者因痛苦扭曲的空洞面庞为容。

45725.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with toughness 4 or greater dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
45725.translation: 每当一个由你操控且防御力等于或大于4的生物死去时，每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

45728.oracleText: Its hunting instincts have long since rotted away. Its hunger, however, remains.
45728.translation: 它的狩猎本性早已腐朽，但其胃口仍存。

45731.oracleText: "The Abzan replaced my savagery with a noble heritage. I would give my life for my House."
45731.translation: 「阿布赞以崇高传统洗刷我蛮野本性。我愿为眷族奉献一生。」

45737.oracleText: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has deathtouch.
45737.translation: 每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物均具有死触异能。

45739.oracleText: Flesh wounds are meaningless to those who discard their flesh so readily.
45739.translation: 对于随时都能蜕下肉身者而言，受点皮肉之伤根本不算什么。

45745.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Exile X cards from your graveyard: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
45745.translation: {oX}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐X张牌：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。

45747.oracleText:
"To conquer is to eat."
—Edicts of Ilagra

45748.oracleText: Whenever a Warrior you control deals combat damage to a player, you may pay 1 life. If you do, draw a card.
45748.translation: 每当一个由你操控的战士对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以支付1点生命。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

45753.oracleText: Abzan ancestors died to protect their Houses, and they protect them still.
45753.translation: 阿布赞祖灵因卫护眷族而捐躯，死后仍尽效保护之责。

45754.oracleText: {oB}, Remove X +1/+1 counters from among creatures you control: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
45754.translation: {oB}，从由你操控的生物上移去总共X个+1/+1指示物：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。

45757.oracleText: Destroy target creature. If that creature had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 1/1 green Snake creature token.
45757.translation: 消灭目标生物。如果该生物上有+1/+1指示物，则将一个1/1绿色的蛇衍生生物放进战场。

45759.oracleText: Mastodons became extinct long ago, but foul forces of the Gurmag Swamp sometimes animate their decaying remains. The Sultai happily exploit such creatures but consider them inferior to their own necromantic creations.
45759.translation: 乳齿象很早之前就已灭绝，但谷尔玛沼泽的邪恶力量偶尔还会驱使它们的腐败残躯为己所用。苏勒台虽乐享其成，却不大以此为意；他们更偏好自己的死灵术造物。

45768.oracleText: Since they guard armies of walking carrion, Sultai aven are never far from a meal.
45768.translation: 自从他们担任腐肉行尸军队护卫之后，苏勒台的艾文就再无食物来源之虞。

45770.oracleText: In the Gudul delta, bloodfly bites are indistinguishable from spear wounds.
45770.translation: 谷渡三角洲一带的血蝇叮咬与长矛戳刺几无二致。

45774.oracleText:
"The best servants are made from those who died without a scratch."
—Sidisi, khan of the Sultai
45774.translation:
「留得全尸的死者才是最好的仆役。」
～苏勒台可汗谢迪西

45776.oracleText: "The man whom I call father killed the orc who sired me, offering his world and his blade in return."
45776.translation: 「我如今的父亲正是杀害我生父的元凶，为了弥补过失，他待我视同己出，传我手中巨剑。」

45780.oracleText: Some ainok of the mountains are accepted among the Temur as trusted hunt-mates.
45780.translation: 铁木尔人将部分山麓犬人当作可靠猎伴。

45783.oracleText: First the thunder, then the rain.

45789.oracleText: Crude tactics can be effective nonetheless.
45789.translation: 战术虽然粗糙，却依然有效。

45794.oracleText: The adept underwent months of preparation to withstand pain, until he was finally ready to receive the efreet master's teachings.
45794.translation: 善武者先要耗费数月时光提升自己耐痛之法，才能够接受魔神大师的教诲。

45795.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

45797.oracleText:
"People are often humbled by the elements. But the elements, too, can be humbled."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur
45797.translation:
「酷境常让人望而生畏，但我们也能够还以颜色。」
～铁木尔可汗苏拉克

45800.oracleText:
"Your corruption will burn, serpent, until there is nothing left to defile."
—Asmala, bloodfire mystic
45800.translation:
「蛇妖，你所有腐化之物都将付之一炬，再无他物为你亵渎。」
～炽血秘教徒阿玛拉

45803.oracleText: The broken Qal Sisma foothills make poor terrain for cavalry, but a perfect setting for ambushes.
45803.translation: 黑山崎岖的丘陵地形让骑兵无用武之处，却是进行伏击的完美地点。

45809.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+0 and has first strike.
45809.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+0且具有先攻异能。

45811.oracleText: "We are the flicker of the flame and its heat, the two sides of a single blade."
45811.translation: 「独焰散光热，利剑分双锋，吾二人正如此形影不相离。」

45813.oracleText: Goblins, like snowflakes, are only dangerous in numbers.
45813.translation: 鬼怪就像雪花，只有数量多了才危险。

45814.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token with haste.
45814.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1红色，具敏捷异能的鬼怪衍生生物。

45826.oracleText: "Strength batters down barriers. Discipline ignores them."

45829.oracleText:
"Make sure he's pointed in the right direction before you light him. And don't let the goblins anywhere near the torch."
—Kerai Suddenblade, Mardu hordechief
45829.translation:
「在你点燃他之前，确保他朝着正确的方向。还有，千万别让鬼怪靠近火炬。」
～玛尔都部落长迅刃柯莱

45832.oracleText: "Those who have never ridden before the wind do not know the true joy of war."
45832.translation: 「那些从未顺风骑行的人不会知道战争真正的乐趣。」

45835.oracleText:
"No body can contain so much fury. It reminds me of another battle, long past."
—Sarkhan Vol
45835.translation:
「没有人能承载那么多怒火。它让我想起了很久很久以前的另一场战斗。」
～萨坎沃

45838.oracleText: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.
45838.translation: 迅笔血迹舞就战地行书。

45844.oracleText: The ogre's mind snapped. The bow was next. The archer followed quickly after.
45844.translation: 食人魔理智断线，一把折断弓身，随即了结箭手。

45846.oracleText:
"Do you hunt the yetis of the high peaks, stripling? They are as fierce as the bear that fears no foe and as sly as the mink that creeps unseen. You will be as much prey as they."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller
45846.translation:
「年轻人，你在峰顶猎捕过雪怪吗？他们跟无所畏惧的熊一样凶猛，跟来去无踪的貂一样狡猾。你同样也是他们的猎物。」
～召猎人妮图拉

45848.oracleText: Shintan sensed the malice in his opponent, but he did not strike until the orc's muscles tensed in preparation to throw the first punch.
45848.translation: 辛坦感觉到了对手的恶意，但直到这个半兽人肌肉紧绷准备挥出第一拳时，他才发动了攻击。

45851.oracleText:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol
45851.translation:
「讨厌的想法在我脑海中挥之不去。这是我自己的疯狂，还是他者的细语？」
～萨坎沃

45853.oracleText:
"Do you hear that, Sarkhan? The glory of the horde! I made a legend from what you abandoned."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
45853.translation:
「萨坎，你听到了吗？这是部落的荣耀！我从你放弃的东西中创造了传奇。」
～玛尔都可汗珠高

45855.oracleText: Mardu riders' greatest fear is that a battle might end before their weapons draw blood.
45855.translation: 玛尔都劫掠者最怕的是他们的武器还没沾血，战斗就结束了。

45858.oracleText: No battle means more to a Mardu warrior than the one that earns her war name.
45858.translation: 对玛尔都战士而言，为其赢得战名的战斗最为难忘。

45864.oracleText: Every shaft is graven with a name from a kin tree, calling upon the spirits of the ancestors to make it fly true.
45864.translation: 每一支箭都刻有族树上的名字，用以召唤先祖的灵魂保佑箭矢准确命中。

45867.oracleText: When Temur warriors enter the battle trance known as "awakening the bear," they lose all sense of enemy or friend, seeing only threats to the wilderness.
45867.translation: 一旦铁木尔战士进入「醒觉熊性」专注状态，他们眼中便没有敌我之分，看到的都是对荒野的威胁。

45869.oracleText: Target creature gets +6/+6 until end of turn.
45869.translation: 目标生物得+6/+6直到回合结束。

45871.oracleText:
"When we were lost and weary, the ainok showed us how to survive. They have earned the right to call themselves Abzan, and to wear the Scale."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan
45871.translation:
「我们迷茫困顿时，犬人教导我们如何生存。他们属于阿布赞，他们配得上这身龙鳞。」
～阿布赞可汗阿娜芬札

45872.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature and untap it.
45872.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

45874.oracleText: The Temur believe three things only are needed in life: a hot fire, a full belly, and a strong companion.
45874.translation: 铁木尔相信生命中只需要三件事：热火、饱腹和强伴。

45877.oracleText:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain
45877.translation:
「那伽视蜕鳞皮为常。我们以着鳞甲为荣。」
～龙鳞队长高勒岚

45880.oracleText: In the high caves of the Qal Sisma mountains, young hunters quest to hear the echoes of their fierce ancestors.
45880.translation: 年轻的猎人探索黑山深处的洞窟，希冀听闻凶猛祖灵的呼号回响。

45883.oracleText:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon her head. This one hears the whispers."
—Chianul, at the weaving of Arel
45883.translation:
「猎杀一头雄鹿，把犄角绑在她的头上。她能听见低语。」
～恰努尔在为阿瑞尔编算命运时说道

45890.oracleText: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.
45890.translation: 擅闯苏勒台领地者，最终往往会被拿去喂鳄鱼或逗狒狒。

45891.oracleText: The bonds of family cross the boundaries of race.
45891.translation: 家庭的羁绊跨越了种族的界限。

45893.oracleText: "The amber of the tree and the blood of my veins are the same."

45897.oracleText: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has reach.
45897.translation: 每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物均具有延势异能。

45900.oracleText: The remains of ancient sky tyrants now feed the war-torn land.
45900.translation: 古老空中霸主的残骸现在滋养着被战争破坏的土地。

45909.oracleText: His arrows whistle like a serpent's hiss.
45909.translation: 其箭矢呼啸有如吐信嘶响。

45913.oracleText:
"I am in my element: the element of surprise."
—Mogai, Sultai scout
45913.translation:
「这正是我的拿手好戏：骇人大戏。」
～苏勒台斥候毛盖

45916.oracleText: The Temur call the flickering lights the Path of Whispers, believing that they lead the way to ancestral knowledge.
45916.translation: 铁木尔将这灵动辉光称为细语之路，相信它们领向先祖知识之所在。

45918.oracleText: "See your enemies from a thousand sides. Then you will find a thousand ways to kill them."
45918.translation: 「从一千个侧面观察你的敌人。你就能找到一千种杀死他们的方法。」

45921.oracleText: "You can have the body, necromancer. I just want the skin."
45921.translation: 「你可以拿走尸体，死灵术士。我只要皮。」

45922.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with toughness 4 or greater dies, you gain 4 life.
45922.translation: 每当一个由你操控且防御力等于或大于4的生物死去时，你获得4点生命。

45932.oracleText: One quiet word sets off the stampede.
45932.translation: 低声轻语便能引领狂奔。

45934.oracleText:
"When the last dragon fell, its spirit escaped as a roar into the wind."
—Temur tale
45934.translation:
「当最后一条龙死去时，它的灵魂化作咆哮逃入风中。」
～铁木尔传说

45936.oracleText: Even among the hardiest warriors of the Temur, loxodons are respected for their adaptation to the mountain snows.
45936.translation: 就连铁木尔最耐寒的战士，也对能够适应山地暴雪的象族带有几分敬意。

45942.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
45942.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

45944.oracleText: Exile target creature with power 3 or greater.
45944.translation: 放逐目标力量等于或大于3的生物。

45947.oracleText: "These roads are desolate and changeable. Follow me, or die in the wastes."
45947.translation: 「这些路途荒凉而多变。跟着我，否则你就会命丧荒野。」

45950.oracleText: Rarely at rest on the Amber Throne, Anafenza always leads the Abzan Houses to battle.
45950.translation: 阿娜芬札常年亲率阿布赞眷族南征北战，从未流连帐中琥珀宝座。

45954.oracleText: The stature of the fighter matters less than the depth of the cut.
45954.translation: 相比刀伤的深度，斗士的身材就不那么重要了。

45957.oracleText: The Abzan avoid extended supply lines by incorporating weapons stores into their battle formations.
45957.translation: 阿布赞将武器店铺也纳入阵中，避免补给线拉得过长的烦恼。

45960.oracleText:
"Hold the high ground, then bring it to your enemy."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur
45960.translation:
「占据有利地势，将敌人一举击溃。」
～铁木尔可汗苏拉克

45963.oracleText: "The Sultai came hunting for a bear hide. Now I have a belt of naga skin, and my friend has a full belly."
45963.translation: 「苏勒台为了熊皮前来狩猎。现在我有了一条那伽皮的腰带，我的朋友则吃得饱饱的。」

45968.oracleText: "We are the swift, the strong, the blade's sharp shriek! Fear nothing, and strike!"
45968.translation: 「我们行动迅捷，力量强壮，手中利刃呼啸！无所畏惧，勇往直前！」

45969.oracleText: Other Warrior creatures you control get +1/+0.
45969.translation: 由你操控的其他战士生物得+1/+0。

45971.oracleText: "We are the shield unbroken. If we fall today, we will die well, and our trees will bear our names in honor."
45971.translation: 「我们的盾牌坚不可摧。如果我们今天阵亡，我们将得到安眠，我们的族树上会光荣地刻上我们的名字。」

45972.oracleText: Other Warrior creatures you control get +0/+1.
45972.translation: 由你操控的其他战士生物得+0/+1。

45974.oracleText: Do not fear the lightning. Fear the one it obeys.
45974.translation: 闪电不可怕。可怕的是驱使闪电的人。

45977.oracleText: The crocodiles' putrid jaws swallow everything but the screams.
45977.translation: 鳄鱼的腐臭巨口吞噬一切，空余惨叫回荡。

45978.oracleText: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. Whenever a creature dies this turn, you gain 1 life.
45978.translation: 所有生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。本回合中，每当一个生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

45982.oracleText: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.
45982.translation: 阿布赞不到万不得已不会使用这个咒语，因为其结果注定是他们最恐惧的东西：孤单。

45983.oracleText: Choose up to one creature. Destroy the rest.
45983.translation: 选择至多一个生物。将其他的消灭。

45988.oracleText: There are many Jeskai styles: Riverwalk imitates flowing water, Dragonfist the ancient hellkites, and Flying Crane the wild aven of the high peaks.
45988.translation: 洁斯凯有许多招式：流水步如行云流水，翔龙拳若远古恶龙，鹤形掌似峰顶野禽。

45989.oracleText: Untap all creatures you control. They gain flying and double strike until end of turn.
45989.translation: 重置所有由你操控的生物。它们获得飞行与连击异能直到回合结束。

45991.oracleText: Its wings produce a high-pitched, barely audible whirring sound in flight. Only Jeskai masters are quiet enough to hear one coming.
45991.translation: 它的翅膀飞行时会发出几不可闻的高频嗡响。只有洁斯凯大师能平静到足以听见它到来。

45996.oracleText: Abzan soldiers march to war confident that their Houses march with them.
45996.translation: 阿布赞士兵坚信行军路上有眷族相随。

45999.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Untap those creatures.
45999.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。重置这些生物。

46000.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
46000.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

46003.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain lifelink until end of turn.
46003.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得系命异能。

46006.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {o2oB}. If you do, return a creature card at random from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains flying, trample, and haste. Exile that card at the beginning of your next end step. If it would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
46006.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以支付{o2oB}。若你如此作，则随机将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得飞行，践踏与敏捷异能。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该牌。如果它将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。

46008.oracleText: The passing years add new rings to the tree's trunk, bolstering the spirits that dwell within.
46008.translation: 岁月给族树增加了新的年轮，增强了居住其中的灵魂。

46009.oracleText: Create an X/X black and green Spirit Warrior creature token, where X is the greatest toughness among creatures you control.
46009.translation: 派出一个X/X，黑绿双色的精怪／战士衍生生物，X为由你操控的生物中防御力最大者的数值。

46011.oracleText: Mantis riders know their mounts owe them no allegiance. Even a mantis ridden for years would consume a rider who loses focus for only a moment.
46011.translation: 飞螳骑兵明白他们的坐骑对他们没有任何忠诚。只要骑手稍不留神，即使是骑乘了多年的螳螂也会把骑手吃掉。

46020.oracleText: The most ferocious saddlebrutes lead the assault, ramming through massed pikes and stout barricades as if they were paper and silk.
46020.translation: 最威猛的巨兽骑士引领进攻，冲破无数长矛和坚固路障，就好像它们是纸糊丝制的。

46023.oracleText:
"The Way has no beginning and no end. It is simply the path."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai
46023.translation:
「灵宗并无终始。是为道。」
～洁斯凯可汗娜尔施

46026.oracleText:
"The past and the unwritten are frozen. To understand their meaning requires heat."
—Arel the Whisperer
46026.translation:
「过往和传言都被冰封了。想理解它们的含义需要热量。」
～低语者阿瑞尔

46041.oracleText:
"I will wash you from my hooves!"
—Mardu taunt
46041.translation:
「我的马蹄会将你碾碎！」
～玛尔都挑衅语

46042.oracleText: Destroy target blocking creature. Creatures that were blocked by that creature this combat gain trample until end of turn.
46042.translation: 消灭目标进行阻挡的生物。本次战斗中被该生物阻挡的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

46044.oracleText: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

46045.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.
46045.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

46047.oracleText: The Sagu Jungle's thick undergrowth conceals even the largest predators—if they wish to remain hidden.
46047.translation: 萨谷丛林浓密的灌木丛能藏下最大的掠食者～如果它们愿意保持隐蔽的话。

46055.translation: 由你操控且牌面朝下的生物得+0/+1。

46056.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control is turned face up, draw a card.
46056.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物翻回正面时，抓一张牌。

46059.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
46059.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

46061.oracleText: The mere approach of an Abzan war beast is enough to send enemies fleeing in panic.
46061.translation: 阿布赞战争巨兽只消接近，就足以让敌人落荒而逃。

46064.oracleText: Sure-footed, strong-willed, and ill-tempered—and so is the ram.
46064.translation: 步伐稳健，意志坚强，脾气暴躁～其坐骑也如此。

46067.oracleText: Until your next turn, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain lifelink.
46067.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得系命异能。

46073.oracleText: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."
46073.translation: 「出击。」烟雾嘶嘶作响。「用你的野心建立一个王国。」

46076.oracleText: The naga of the Sultai Brood made deals with dark forces to keep their power.
46076.translation: 苏勒台族群的那伽和黑暗力量进行交易以维持他们的力量。

46079.oracleText: Both his rank and his scars were earned in single combat against a cave bear.
46079.translation: 单挑穴熊之壮举造就其今日显赫地位与身上触目疤痕。

46085.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. It fights target creature you don't control.
46085.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。它与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

46086.oracleText: Creatures with power 3 or less can't block this turn.
46086.translation: 力量为3或更少的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

46089.oracleText:
"Meat sustains the body. The spirit requires different sustenance."
—Arel the Whisperer
46089.translation:
「躯体靠血肉维系。灵魂的寄托则有所不同。」
～低语者阿瑞尔

46090.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature.
46090.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。在至多一个目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

46092.oracleText:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
46092.translation:
「我来寻求挑战。可我只找到了你。」
～玛尔都可汗珠高

46098.oracleText: The wardens guard the sacred documents of Tarkir's history, though they are forbidden to read the words.
46098.translation: 护卫看守着鞑契历史的神圣档案，但是他们禁止阅读其中的文字。

46101.oracleText:
"The mountains scream with the dragons' throats."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice
46101.translation:
「群山经巨龙之吼尖啸。」
～通灵祭师恰努尔

46109.oracleText: Stone to endure, roots to remember.

46113.oracleText: Supplicants offer flesh and silver, flowers and blood. The altar takes what it will, eyes gleaming with unspoken promises.
46113.translation: 祈求者献上鲜肉与白银、鲜花和血液。祭坛取走它想要的，眼睛闪烁着不成文的诺言。

46116.oracleText: Victory is certain. The price, negotiable.

46123.oracleText: What once soared high above Tarkir is now reduced to a seat.
46123.translation: 曾翱翔在鞑契上空的巨物如今沦落成他人宝位。

46124.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Other creatures you control gain trample and get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
46124.translation: {o2}，{oT}：直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+X，X为此生物的力量。

46127.oracleText: If you fear the dragon's fire, you are unworthy to wield it.
46127.translation: 如果你怕龙火，那么你便没资格挥舞它。

46130.oracleText: Designed by an ancient artificer, the finest Mardu bows are carved from dragon bone and strung with the wind itself.
46130.translation: 最好的玛尔都弓出自先人工匠之手，以龙骨雕身，借风作弦。

46133.oracleText: Discipline to persevere, insight to discover.

46137.oracleText:
"Water shifts and confuses, but as ice it holds the stillness of truth."
—Arel the Whisperer
46137.translation:
「水千变万化且让人迷乱，但就像冰一样，它拥有真相的宁静。」
～低语者阿瑞尔

46144.oracleText: Power to dominate, cruelty to rule.

46148.oracleText: Savagery to survive, courage to triumph.

46155.oracleText: It strode through the clash of dragons, the fall of Ugin, and the rise of the khans.
46155.translation: 它经历了巨龙的冲突、乌金的死亡以及可汗的崛起。

46160.oracleText: Where dragons once triumphed, their bones now molder.
46160.translation: 群龙得胜处，空余骨朽败。

46167.oracleText: Where dragons once slept, their bones now rest.
46167.translation: 群龙栖息处，空余骨安眠。

46169.oracleText:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice
46169.translation:
「最强力的梦境只会眷顾那些住在龙颅里的人。」
～通灵祭师恰努尔

46178.oracleText:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
46178.translation:
「只有弱者才把自己关在城墙后面。我们在风中自由地生活，而自由让我们强壮。」
～玛尔都可汗珠高

46181.oracleText: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.
46181.translation: 茂密丛林当中辟出大片富饶奢绮地域，隐约可见卡尔西宫殿的尖顶耸立中央。

46183.oracleText: Where dragons once prevailed, their bones now sink.
46183.translation: 群龙耀威处，空余骨沉沦。

46208.oracleText: Where dragons once roared, their bones now keen.
46208.translation: 群龙咆哮处，空余骨嘶鸣。

46209.oracleText: Where dragons' breath once burned, their bones now freeze.
46209.translation: 群龙焚息处，空余骨凝雪。

46211.oracleText: Exile target creature with toughness 3 or greater?
46211.translation: 是否放逐目标防御力等于或大于3的生物？

46220.oracleText: Distribute counters among one or two target creatures you control.
46220.translation: 将指示物分配给由你操控的一个或两个目标生物。

46222.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies this turn, you gain 1 life.
46222.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

46223.oracleText: Return another target creature to its owner's hand?
46223.translation: 是否将另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上？

46237.oracleText: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.
46237.translation: 有些保护需要无微不至。

46249.oracleText: {o3oWoW}: Attacking creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
46249.translation: {o3oWoW}：由你操控且进行攻击的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为进行攻击的生物数量。

46291.oracleText: At the beginning of your draw step, draw two additional cards.
46291.translation: 在你的抓牌步骤开始时，额外抓两张牌。

46300.oracleText: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."
46300.translation: 「基拉夫，你非得喋喋不休吗？我什么都不同意。我要什么时候召唤食尸鬼，就什么时候召唤。」

46341.oracleText: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."
46341.translation: 「根据经验判断，灾祸永不单行。」

46393.translation: 亚格斯守护灵泰坦尼亚

46395.oracleText: Whenever a land you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 5/3 green Elemental creature token.
46395.translation: 每当一个由你操控的地从战场进入坟墓场时，派出一个5/3绿色元素衍生生物。

46418.oracleText: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.
46418.translation: 远古文明若遭后人遗忘，定会带来惨烈后果以警醒世人。此座石碑之坍塌亦然。

46434.oracleText:
"He has been to the heart of the wood. Did you truly expect to wield power over him?"
—Oakhide druid
46434.translation:
「他就连树林腹地都能来去自如。你真以为能有办法对付他？」
～橡隐德鲁伊

46437.oracleText: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.
46437.translation: 大部分的书只是传达知识，但这一本还期待些回馈。

46439.oracleText:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords
46439.translation:
「贸然参战乃是智者所为…如果你做好了准备的话。」
～千刃团队长肯耶珂

46500.oracleText: Every action has a foreseen purpose.
46500.translation: 凡因皆有果，因果早注定。

46510.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 white Monk creature token with prowess.
46510.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

46524.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
46524.translation: 派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

46530.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you control have lifelink.
46530.translation: 由你操控的瞬间和法术咒语具有系命异能。

46533.oracleText:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol
46533.translation:
「每个选择都会影响命途走向。」
～萨坎沃

46534.oracleText: Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
46534.translation: 消灭目标防御力等于或大于4的生物。

46609.oracleText: Few truly live in the moment.
46609.translation:
「我不是和你说话，而是透过你说话。你是先知，你已经完成了你的本分。」
～密涅瓦

46646.oracleText: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle. He failed to notice the Sultai leader's cruel smile.
46646.translation: 塔西格为玛尔都战士指明穿出丛林的道路之后便挥手让他速速离去。大喜过望的玛尔都人根本没留意到苏勒台可汗脸上那丝残忍微笑。

46656.oracleText: If everything in the Gurmag Swamp hungers for human flesh, what bait could be more effective?
46656.translation: 如果谷尔玛沼泽里所有东西都想吃人肉，还有比它更有效的饵吗？

46702.oracleText: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.
46702.translation: 塔西格委派那伽前去拜访阿布赞哨站，而真正的使节是那伽带去的播疫老鼠。

46710.oracleText: The scent of cooked flesh lingers in the charred landscape of Tarkir.
46710.translation: 烤肉的气味在鞑契烧焦的大地上经久不散。

46713.oracleText: Bloodfire practitioners train to focus their rage, building it deep inside themselves until they are ready to release it as a devastating attack.
46713.translation: 炽血求道者练习将自身怒气汇集蓄积体内，直到能爆发出猛烈一击。

46719.oracleText: It is much easier to create fire than to contain it.
46719.translation: 制造火焰比遏制火焰容易得多。

46748.oracleText:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder
46748.translation:
「你曾属玛尔都，已有健硕身躯与顽强意志。如今我们必须锻炼你的心灵。」
～洁斯凯长老侯恩

46754.oracleText: Dragonslayers learned to keep silent about their deeds after seeing the terrible vengeance wrought by Kolaghan and her brood.
46754.translation: 在亲眼目睹寇安甘及其一脉龙群的可怖复仇之后，屠龙者才晓得不该将自己的所作所为大肆宣扬。

46786.translation: 千万别误把欺瞒当机灵。

46835.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
46835.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。

46845.oracleText: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.
46845.translation: 先是呢喃细语述说远古过往。后有万千景象展现动荡未来。

46866.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, manifest the top card of your library.
46866.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，显化你的牌库顶牌。

46867.oracleText: When this creature dies, manifest the top card of your library.
46867.translation: 当此生物死去时，显化你的牌库顶牌。

46929.oracleText: Exile target creature card from a graveyard?
46929.translation: 是否要将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐？

46938.oracleText: For hundreds of years Ugin slept, encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron. As Ugin lay dormant, his spectral guardians kept vigil.
46938.translation: 乌金闭关于萨坎用赞迪卡晶石碎片创造出的魔法石茧阵中，沉眠达数百年之久。这段期间内，他的幽灵护卫依然忠于职守，毫不懈怠。

46940.oracleText: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.
46940.translation: 她因尊崇先祖而遭难，如今和先祖一道庇佑人民。

46993.oracleText:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior
46993.translation:
「卓茉卡所赐诸般神通当中，最为重要当属无翼飞翔之力。」
～卓茉卡族战士乌尔德南

47027.oracleText:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior
47027.translation:
「变幻荒漠保卫我们部落永世安宁。保护这片大地是我们应尽之责。」
～卓茉卡族战士卡德里

47028.oracleText: Create X 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens.
47028.translation: 派出X个1/1白色战士衍生生物。

47037.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
47037.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

47053.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
47053.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

47078.oracleText: Rakshasa waste no opportunity to display their wealth and power, even in the midst of a sorcerous duel.
47078.translation: 就算是在斗法对决当中，罗刹也不会浪费任何展示其财富和力量的机会。

47079.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +0/+3 and gains hexproof until end of turn.
47079.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+0/+3且获得辟邪异能。

47106.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a creature card.
47106.translation: 抓三张牌。然后除非你弃一张生物牌，否则弃两张牌。

47113.oracleText: Create a 2/2 blue Djinn Monk creature token with flying.
47113.translation: 派出一个2/2蓝色，具飞行异能的巨灵／修行僧衍生生物。

47171.oracleText:
"Every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of our dragonlord."
—Xathi the Infallible
47171.translation:
「席穆嘉族人的每把剑刃都受过吾王祝福。」
～从不失手的珊西

47172.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+2 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
47172.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+2且获得死触异能。

47189.oracleText: The dragon who eats the last head in the basket is entitled to the servant's.
47189.translation: 吃掉篮子里最后一颗头的龙能把仆人的头一起吃掉。

47239.oracleText:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer
47239.translation:
「寇安甘军派他们来对付我们。我们杀了他们然后复活他们。他们再和下一波寇安甘军作战。这个小循环不错吧。」
～席穆嘉族术士阿玛拉

47251.oracleText: Silumgar takes pride in the diversity of his sibsig.
47251.translation: 席穆嘉以其尸虏的多样性为傲。

47254.oracleText:
"The Silumgar hide behind the deadly wildlife of their swamps. They'd rather scheme in their jungle palaces than face us."
—Khibat, Kolaghan warrior
47254.translation:
「席穆嘉族躲藏在他们沼泽的致命野生动物之后。他们宁愿在丛林宫殿中谋划，而不愿面对我们。」
～寇安甘族战士席巴特

47255.oracleText:
"The realization that one is dying is far more terrifying than death itself."
—Sidisi, Silumgar vizier
47255.translation:
「意识到自己行将死去此事比死亡本身要可怕得多。」
～席穆嘉族宰相谢迪西

47257.oracleText:
"This pestilence robs us of glorious death in battle. We starve to death with full bellies and drown trying to slake our unnatural thirst."
—Kerai Hatesinger, Kolaghan warrior
47257.translation:
「瘟疫夺走了我们战死沙场的荣耀。我们饱食却饿死，试图解消异样口渴时却被淹死。」
～寇安甘族战士咏仇凯莱

47270.oracleText: Attacking creatures you control have double strike.
47270.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的生物具有连击异能。

47283.oracleText: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.
47283.translation: 安塔卡族的鬼怪和他们铁木尔的同胞一样随时准备赴死，但他们通常死在大型的有翼阴影之下。

47292.oracleText: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.
47292.translation: 服侍安塔卡的鬼怪在身上涂满加了毒草的油脂，希望他们永无餍足的主人不会拿他们加菜。

47293.oracleText: Dragon spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
47293.translation: 你施放的龙咒语减少{o1}来施放。

47298.oracleText:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior
47298.translation:
「如果他们耳朵贴地，我们就会让他们见血。」
～寇安甘族战士塔克莱

47323.oracleText: The sky offers few hiding places.

47327.oracleText:
"Intruders in the lands of Atarka have but two choices: be consumed by fire, or be consumed by maw."
—Ulnok, Atarka shaman
47327.translation:
「安塔卡领地的入侵者只有两个选择：被火焰吞噬，或者被巨嘴吞噬。」
～安塔卡族祭师乌勒诺克

47332.oracleText: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.
47332.translation: 鞑契的人述说着一个古老的传说，一个名叫萨坎的龙人是所有可汗中最伟大的。

47340.oracleText: The shaman opened the earth beneath their feet, trapping the survivors within the crevices of Ayagor for Atarka to devour at her leisure.
47340.translation: 祭师撕裂了脚下的土地，将生还者困在阿亚戈的裂缝之中，供安塔卡闲时果腹。

47356.oracleText: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.
47356.translation: 引起巨龙的注意可能是你最不该犯的错误。

47377.oracleText:
"In the Tarkir I once knew, the Abzan revered their ancestor trees. Now, as Dromoka, they cut their finest groves to make weapons."
—Sarkhan Vol
47377.translation:
「在我印象中的鞑契里，阿布赞人尊崇先祖之树。如今的卓茉卡人伐良木以造兵。」
～萨坎沃

47383.oracleText: Each creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
47383.translation: 由你操控的每个生物皆依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

47385.oracleText: {o2oG}: Creatures you control get +0/+1 until end of turn.
47385.translation: {o2oG}：由你操控的生物得+0/+1直到回合结束。

47390.oracleText: It exemplifies the ideals of the Dromoka: strength, unity, and honor.
47390.translation: 它象征着卓茉卡人的理念：强壮、团结、荣誉。

47434.oracleText: Draw a card for each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it. Those creatures gain indestructible until end of turn.
47434.translation: 你每操控一个其上有+1/+1指示物的生物，便抓一张牌。这些生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

47481.oracleText: The Atarka use them not just for food, but also to clear away snow, trees, and enemy forces.
47481.translation: 安塔卡族不仅把它们当食物，而且用它们清除积雪、树木和敌人的军队。

47486.oracleText: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

47494.oracleText: Your opponents can't gain life this turn.
47494.translation: 本回合中，对手不能获得生命。

47496.oracleText: You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
47496.translation: 你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

47497.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain reach until end of turn.
47497.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得延势异能。

47500.oracleText: When battling the Kolaghan, consider yourself lucky if lightning strikes the same place only twice.
47500.translation: 与寇安甘族作战时，如果闪电只打中同一个地方两次，那你就走运了。

47508.oracleText: Dromoka's followers forsake blood ties so that they may join a greater family.
47508.translation: 卓茉卡的追随者舍弃了血缘羁绊，这样他们就能加入一个更大的家庭。

47512.oracleText: Other creatures you control have haste.
47512.translation: 由你操控的其他生物具有敏捷异能。

47518.oracleText: Silumgar never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.
47518.translation: 席穆嘉不放过任何一个增加他财富的机会。

47521.oracleText: Prevent all damage target instant or sorcery spell would deal this turn.
47521.translation: 于本回合中，防止目标瞬间或法术咒语将造成的所有伤害。

47538.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells.
47538.translation: 所有对手都不能施放非生物咒语。

47563.oracleText: The mage awakened the statue in hopes of learning the lost lore of her clan, but the statue was interested only in war.
47563.translation: 法师原希望唤醒雕像能够从中获知部落亡佚知识，然而雕像所晓只有战事。

47572.oracleText: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.
47572.translation: 巨龙重回鞑契巅峰，人民转而侍奉五大龙王～这尊铸于可汗衰亡时期的雕像，正是彼时芸芸众生的最佳见证。

47600.oracleText: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.
47600.translation: 大地坚韧不息；即使死去，也必重生。

47635.oracleText: Not all heroes die in armor.
47635.translation: 不是所有英雄都披甲而亡。

47653.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, tap target creature defending player controls.
47653.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，横置目标由防御牌手操控的生物。

47656.oracleText: Creatures of darkness instinctively hide from the light.
47656.translation: 暗夜生物本能地趋避明光。

47670.oracleText: {o2oW}: Kytheon gains indestructible until end of turn.
47670.translation: {o2oW}：库忒昂获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

47673.oracleText: Until your next turn, target creature gains indestructible. Untap that creature.
47673.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，目标生物获得不灭异能。重置该生物。

47682.oracleText: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."
