52167.translation: {o3oU}，{oT}，横置X个由你操控且未横置的神器：检视你牌库顶的X张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

52175.oracleText: The Consulate prizes innovation when it is dependable and replicable.
52175.translation: 执政院其中那些可靠而可复制的创造发明。

52187.oracleText: Shipwrecks do wonders for the local fauna, providing both shelter and aether.
52187.translation: 船难为水底动物动物创造了奇迹，不仅提供栖所，更是乙太来源。

52194.oracleText:
"I've made some fine acquisitions of late, so I'm planning to make commensurate improvements to my security systems. I have a consultant coming tomorrow."
—Kurna Majan, Luminary League
52194.translation:
「余近日购得珍玩数件，故欲将保全系统修葺一新，以相般配。明日已约顾问前来洽谈。」
～名仕盟的库纳默金

52358.translation: 是否要在{1, CardId}上放置一个+1/+1指示物？

53277.oracleText: Have opponent targeting you draw three cards?
53277.translation: 是否要令以你为目标的对手抓三张牌？

53288.translation: 是否要将{1, CardId}贴附于它？

53293.translation: 是否要在{1, CardId}上放置N个+1/+1指示物？

54433.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} deal 1 damage to that source's controller?
54433.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}对该来源的操控者造成1点伤害？

54439.oracleText: Have your opponent put that card into your graveyard?
54439.translation: 是否要令对手将该牌置入你的坟墓场？

54516.oracleText: Put a quest counter on {1, CardId}?
54516.translation: 是否要在{1, CardId}上放置一个探索指示物？

54640.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, for each kind of counter on target permanent or player, give that permanent or player another counter of that kind.
54640.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择目标永久物或牌手；对其上每种指示物而言，该永久物或牌手得到另一个同种类的指示物。

54684.oracleText: At end of combat, if CARDNAME attacked or blocked this combat, put a velocity counter on it. Then if it has two or more velocity counters on it, sacrifice it and draw two cards.
54684.translation: 在战斗结束时，若CARDNAME在本次战斗中攻击或阻挡过，则在其上放置一个速度指示物。然后如果其上有两个或更多速度指示物，则牺牲它且抓两张牌。

54761.oracleText: {oR}: CARDNAME gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

54772.oracleText: {o3oU}: CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn.
54772.translation: {o3oU}：CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

54820.oracleText: {oT}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.

54824.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature equal to the number of creatures you control.
54824.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

54886.oracleText: {o1}: CARDNAME gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

54887.oracleText: {o1}: CARDNAME gets -1/+1 until end of turn.

54945.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform CARDNAME.
54945.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若某牌手上回合施放了两个或更多咒语，则转化CARDNAME。

54965.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform CARDNAME.
54965.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若上回合没有任一咒语施放过，则转化CARDNAME。

55053.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you both own and control CARDNAME and a creature named Bruna, the Fading Light, exile them, then meld them into Brisela, Voice of Nightmares.
55053.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若由你拥有且由你操控的永久物中同时有CARDNAME与一个名称为渐逝之光布鲁娜的生物，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为梦魇异音布瑟拉。

55056.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, draw a card.

55072.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you both own and control CARDNAME and a creature named Midnight Scavengers, exile them, then meld them into Chittering Host.
55072.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若由你拥有且由你操控的永久物中同时有CARDNAME与一个名称为午夜拾荒客的生物，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为吱响寄主。CARDNAME

55083.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create two 1/1 red Human creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
55083.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出两个1/1红色人类衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。

55086.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create two 3/2 colorless Eldrazi Horror creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
55086.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出两个3/2无色奥札奇／惊惧兽衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。CARDNAME

55093.oracleText: {o3oRoR}, {oT}: If you both own and control CARDNAME and a creature named Hanweir Garrison, exile them, then meld them into Hanweir, the Writhing Township.
55093.translation: {o3oRoR}，{oT}：如果由你拥有且由你操控的永久物中同时有CARDNAME与一个名称为翰威驻防兵的生物，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为纠拧镇区翰威。

55096.oracleText: {o(U/R)}: CARDNAME gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

55218.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks an opponent, you may put an Angel, Demon, or Dragon creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
55218.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击任一对手时，你可以将一张天使，恶魔或龙生物牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正向该对手进行攻击。

55232.oracleText: {o1oW}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
55232.translation: {o1oW}，牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

55256.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, other Humans you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
55256.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，由你操控的其他人类得+1/+1直到回合结束。

55269.oracleText: When CARDNAME has two or fewer loyalty counters on him, transform him.
55269.translation: 当CARDNAME的忠诚指示物为两个或更少时，转化他。

55270.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. That creature deals damage equal to its power to him.
55270.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。该生物对他造成等同于该生物力量的伤害。

55315.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature.
55315.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

55376.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
55376.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出两个1/1白色士兵衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。

55450.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice CARDNAME.
55450.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，牺牲CARDNAME。

55561.oracleText: As long as you have 30 or more life, CARDNAME gets +5/+5 and has flying.
55561.translation: 只要你的总生命为30或更多，CARDNAME便得+5/+5且具有飞行异能。

55633.oracleText: {oT}: Put a charge counter on CARDNAME.

55640.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.
55640.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的山脉数量。

55655.oracleText: {o(R/W)}: CARDNAME gains first strike until end of turn.
55655.translation: {o(R/W)}：CARDNAME获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

55780.oracleText: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target player loses the game.
55780.translation: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标牌手输掉这盘游戏。

55815.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
55815.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

55846.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it and tap up to one target creature defending player controls.
55846.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，并横置至多一个目标由防御牌手操控的生物。

55864.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle gains first strike until end of turn.
55864.translation: 每当CARDNAME搭载载具时，该载具获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

61296.oracleText: Put target attacking creature on the bottom of its owner's library. Its controller gains life equal to its toughness.
61296.translation: 将目标进行攻击的生物置于其拥有者的牌库底。其操控者获得等同于其防御力的生命。

61310.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Morbid — That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if a creature died this turn.
61310.translation: 目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。丧心～如果本回合有生物死去，则改为该生物得-13/-13直到回合结束。

61329.oracleText: Each other creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf gets +1/+1.
61329.translation: 由你操控的其他狼生物或狼人生物得+1/+1。

61330.oracleText: Non-Human Werewolves you control can't transform.
61330.translation: 由你操控且非人类的狼人不能转化。

61404.oracleText: Creatures with power less than CARDNAME's power can't block it.
61404.translation: 力量小于CARDNAME的生物不能阻挡它。

61418.oracleText: Escalate—Tap an untapped creature you control.
61418.translation: 增效～横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物。

61434.oracleText: Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand.
61434.translation: 将目标咒语或生物移回其拥有者手上。

61455.oracleText: {oT}: Exchange target opponent's life total with CARDNAME's toughness.
61455.translation: {oT}：将目标对手的总生命与CARDNAME的防御力交换。

61530.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature fights target creature you don't control.
61530.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

61546.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
61546.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，将所放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

61576.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.
61576.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。

61589.oracleText: Each other creature you control that's a Werewolf or a Wolf gets +1/+1.
61589.translation: 由你操控的其他狼人生物与狼生物得+1/+1。

61596.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking. Exile that token at end of combat.
61596.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在战斗结束时放逐该衍生物。

61743.oracleText: {o3}: Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.

61876.oracleText: As long as your devotion to black is less than five, Erebos isn't a creature.
61876.translation: 只要你的黑色献力小于五，厄睿柏斯便不是生物。

61877.translation: 所有对手都不能获得生命。

61916.oracleText: CARDNAME doesn't untap during your untap step.
61916.translation: CARDNAME于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

61941.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
61941.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于你的手牌数量。

62075.oracleText: You can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game.
62075.translation: 你这盘游戏不会输，对手也不会赢。

62086.oracleText: You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
62086.translation: 你不因总生命为0或更少而输掉这盘游戏。

62132.oracleText: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
62132.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物，然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

62146.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击。

62169.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't attack, block, or crew Vehicles.
62169.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击、阻挡或搭载载具。

62185.oracleText: Return target permanent you control and target permanent you don't control to their owners' hands.
62185.translation: 将目标由你操控的永久物与目标不由你操控的永久物各移回其拥有者手上。

62197.oracleText: Return any number of target nonland, nontoken permanents you control to their owners' hands. Draw a card for each card returned to your hand this way.
62197.translation: 将任意数量目标由你操控且既非地也非衍生物的永久物移回其拥有者手上。每以此法将一张牌移回你手上，便抓一张牌。

62224.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, target opponent loses life equal to CARDNAME's power.
62224.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器从战场进入坟墓场时，目标对手失去等同于CARDNAME力量的生命。

62275.oracleText: Untap target land you control. Until your next turn, it becomes a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.
62275.translation: 重置目标由你操控的地。直到你的下一个回合，它成为5/5，具敏捷异能的元素生物。它仍然是地。

62276.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
62276.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

62290.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -3/-0 and its activated abilities can't be activated.
62290.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物得-3/-0，且其起动式异能也不能起动。

62291.oracleText: You gain 2 life and draw a card.
62291.translation: 你获得2点生命且抓一张牌。

62293.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Your opponents can't untap more than two permanents during their untap steps."
62293.translation: 你获得具有「对手于其重置步骤中所重置的永久物不能多于两个」的徽记。

62305.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or creature you control, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types. That token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
62305.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的神器或生物之复制品，但它额外具有神器此类别。该衍生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

62309.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
62309.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，本回合中你每施放过一个咒语，便获得1点生命。

62323.oracleText: {oR}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put all cards exiled with CARDNAME into their owners' hands.
62323.translation: {oR}，弃掉你的手牌，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌置于其拥有者手上。

62389.oracleText: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
62389.translation: 将所有坟墓场中的所有生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。

62428.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't attack or block.
62428.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

62431.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card.
62431.translation: 在每位牌手的抓牌步骤开始时，该牌手额外抓一张牌。

62496.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated.
62496.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡，且其起动式异能都不能起动。

62503.oracleText: {o2oUoU}, Remove a wish counter from CARDNAME: Reveal the top card of your library. You may play that card without paying its mana cost. If you don't, exile it.
62503.translation: {o2oUoU}，从CARDNAME上移去一个祈愿指示物：展示你的牌库顶牌。你可以使用该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未如此作，则将它放逐。

62555.translation: 目标牌手的总生命成为10。

62556.oracleText: You control target player during that player's next turn.
62556.translation: 目标牌手在其下个回合由你来操控。

62566.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
62566.translation: {oT}：目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

62618.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller.
62618.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害，且对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

62680.oracleText: CARDNAME can't block and can't be blocked.
62680.translation: CARDNAME不能进行阻挡，也不能被阻挡。

62732.oracleText: Any number of target players each draw twenty cards.
62732.translation: 任意数量的目标牌手各抓二十张牌。

62753.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
62753.translation: 横置至多两个目标生物。这些生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

62793.oracleText: Destroy target land. Creatures without flying can't block this turn.
62793.translation: 消灭目标地。不具飞行异能的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

62937.oracleText: Put target creature on top of its owner's library.
62937.translation: 将目标生物置于其拥有者的牌库顶。

62961.oracleText: {o1}: CARDNAME becomes a 2/2 creature with all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.
62961.translation: {o1}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为2/2生物并具有所有生物类别。它仍然是地。

62976.oracleText: Return target creature you control and target creature you don't control to their owners' hands.
62976.translation: 将目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

62986.oracleText: Enchanted creature has lifelink and "Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
62986.translation: 所结附的生物具有系命异能与「每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」

63005.oracleText: Destroy target creature. You gain life equal to its toughness.
63005.translation: 消灭目标生物。你获得等同于其防御力的生命。

63007.oracleText: Target opponent gets an emblem with "Whenever a creature attacks you, it gets +5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn."
63007.translation: 目标对手获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当一个生物攻击你时，直到回合结束，它得+5/+5且获得践踏异能。」

63106.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You control target player during that player's next turn.
63106.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标牌手在其下个回合由你来操控。

63116.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
63116.translation: {oU}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

63193.oracleText: {o2oC}: Exile another target creature, then return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control.
63193.translation: {o2oC}：放逐另一个目标生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

63213.oracleText: Destroy target non-Zombie creature. It can't be regenerated. Return up to one target Zombie card from your graveyard to your hand.
63213.translation: 消灭目标非灵俑的生物。它不能重生。将至多一张目标灵俑牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

63241.oracleText: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand.
63241.translation: 展示你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则将之放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。

63243.oracleText: Untap up to six target lands. They become 6/6 Elemental creatures. They're still lands.
63243.translation: 重置至多六个目标地。它们成为6/6元素生物。它们仍然是地。

63288.oracleText: Whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
63288.translation: 每当一张牌从任何区域置入对手的坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

63341.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
63341.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

63362.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library.
63362.translation: 当CARDNAME从任何区域置入坟墓场时，将它洗入其拥有者的牌库。

63365.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, return the exiled cards to the battlefield under their owner's control.
63365.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，将所放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

63412.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't attack, block, or transform.
63412.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击、阻挡或转化。

63449.oracleText: {o1oU}: Return target Spirit you control to its owner's hand.
63449.translation: {o1oU}：将目标由你操控的精怪移回其拥有者手上。

63470.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Then that player discards a card if you control a Zombie.
63470.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。然后如果你操控灵俑，则该牌手弃一张牌。

63481.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
63481.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

63504.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
63504.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

63537.oracleText: When CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, return it to its owner's hand.
63537.translation: 当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

63554.oracleText: At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
63554.translation: 在所结附的牌手之维持开始时，该牌手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

63575.oracleText: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. Each of those creatures is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types. Put CARDNAME on the bottom of its owner's library.
63575.translation: 将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。这些生物各额外具有黑色此颜色与灵俑此类别。将CARDNAME置于其拥有者的牌库底。

63607.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may pay {oB}. If you do, return it to its owner's hand.
63607.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，将它移回其拥有者手上。

63645.oracleText: Each Vampire creature card you own that isn't on the battlefield has madness. The madness cost is equal to its mana cost.
63645.translation: 每张由你拥有且不在战场上的吸血鬼生物牌都具有疯魔异能。其疯魔费用等同于其法术力费用。

63648.oracleText: Whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to you or a permanent you control, you may have CARDNAME deal 1 damage to that source's controller.
63648.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的来源对你或任一由你操控的永久物造成伤害时，你可以让CARDNAME对该来源的操控者造成1点伤害。

63658.oracleText: CARDNAME can't block unless you control another Wolf or Werewolf.
63658.translation: 除非你操控另一个狼或狼人，否则CARDNAME不能进行阻挡。

63720.oracleText: Each creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf gets +1/+1 and has trample.
63720.translation: 由你操控且为狼或狼人的生物得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

63731.oracleText: Choose target creature you don't control. Each creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf deals damage equal to its power to that creature.
63731.translation: 选择目标不由你操控的生物。每个由你操控且为狼或狼人的生物各依本身力量对该生物造成伤害。

63734.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
63734.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

63736.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the total number of cards in all players' hands.
63736.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于所有牌手手牌的总数。

63743.oracleText: For each token you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent.
63743.translation: 对每个由你操控的衍生物而言，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该永久物的复制品。

63832.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of cards in your hand.
63832.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于你手牌数量的两倍。

63918.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack during extra turns.
63918.translation: 在额外的回合中，CARDNAME不能攻击。

63978.oracleText: Creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield have flash.
63978.translation: 由你拥有且不在战场上的生物牌具有闪现异能。

63983.oracleText: {o1oG}: CARDNAME becomes a 3/3 green Ape creature with trample until end of turn. It's still a land.
63983.translation: {o1oG}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为3/3绿色，具践踏异能的猿猴生物。它仍然是地。

64069.oracleText: If CARDNAME would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal CARDNAME and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.
64069.translation: 如果CARDNAME将从任何区域置入坟墓场，则改为展示CARDNAME，并将它洗入其拥有者的牌库。

64133.oracleText:
Choose one or more — 
• Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.
64133.translation:
选择一项或多项～
•消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。
•消灭目标结界。
•在每个由目标牌手操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

64149.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. 
• Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
64149.translation:
选择一项或都选～
•目标生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。
•目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

65069.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, choose one — 
• Each player with exactly 13 life loses the game, then each player gains 1 life. 
• Each player with exactly 13 life loses the game, then each player loses 1 life.
65069.translation:
在你的维持开始时，选择一项～
•每位总生命正好为13的牌手各输掉这盘游戏，然后每位牌手各获得1点生命。
•每位总生命正好为13的牌手各输掉这盘游戏，然后每位牌手各失去1点生命。

70001.oracleText: Come to learn. Stay to teach.

70002.oracleText: Silumgar's remnants drown, a new Sultai rises.
70002.translation: 席穆嘉的残党沉沦，苏勒台的故事新启。

70003.oracleText: There is always an influx of visiting Temur families when the geothermal vents are most active.
70003.translation: 当地热喷口最为活跃时，铁木尔家族的访客络绎不绝。

70004.oracleText: In every biome of Tarkir, the storms spew forth dragons well suited to dominate.
70004.translation: 鞑契的每一处生态域中，风暴都会喷吐出最适应领地的巨龙。

70005.oracleText: Some believe dragonstorms to be the combined dregs of the vanquished dragonlords' fury.
70005.translation: 有些人认为龙袭风暴不过是战败龙王们怒火的残渣汇聚。

70006.oracleText: It gulps from the lava flow to spew gouts of molten rock upon its prey.
70006.translation: 它从熔岩流中大口吞饮，将炽热的岩浆喷吐向猎物。

70007.oracleText: Some dragonstorms pass without a trace. Others can conquer worlds.
70007.translation: 有些龙袭风暴悄然消逝，不留痕迹。有些则能征服世界。

70008.oracleText: The Stormnexus Ritual brought forth draconic protectors, but unleashed the chaos of storms.
70008.translation: 风暴连结点仪式召来了龙形守护者，却也释放了风暴的混沌。

70009.oracleText: The most curious and contemplative dragons gravitate towards Shiko and the scholars of the Jeskai.
70009.translation: 最为好奇且喜好沉思的巨龙会被席科和洁斯凯学者所吸引。

70010.oracleText:
"When we first saw her exulting in the storm's thunder, we knew she belonged with us."
—Tersa Lightshatter
70010.translation:
「当我们初次见到她在风暴的雷鸣中欢欣鼓舞时，便知她注定与我们同行。」
～折雳缇莎

70011.oracleText: Dragon scholars flock to understand the innumerable species across Tarkir, but the question of "What is a dragon?" gets more difficult to answer every day.
70011.translation: 龙族学者蜂拥而至，试图理解鞑契大陆上数之不尽的龙种，但「何为巨龙？」这个问题的答案却日益难以界定。

70012.oracleText: Dragon's scales to adorn the hilt, dragon's bones to polish the blade, and dragon's breath to kindle its edge.
70012.translation: 龙鳞装饰剑柄，龙骨打磨剑刃，龙息淬炼锋芒。

70014.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a number of +1/+1 counters on up to one other target creature you control equal to the amount of life you gained this turn. Return up to one target creature card with mana value less than or equal to the amount of life you lost this turn from your graveyard to the battlefield.
70014.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在至多另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置若干个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你本回合中获得的生命数量。选择至多一张目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌，且其法术力值须等于或小于你本回合中失去的生命数量。将该牌从该处移回战场。

70016.oracleText: Whenever Elsha deals combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess.
70016.translation: 每当艾尔莎对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出等量1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

70018.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. If that spell's power is 4 or greater, draw a card. If that spell's power is 6 or greater, CARDNAME deals damage equal to CARDNAME's power to each opponent.
70018.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。如果该咒语的力量等于或大于4，抓一张牌。如果该咒语的力量等于或大于6，则CARDNAME向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于CARDNAME的力量。

70019.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Eshki. If that spell's power is 4 or greater, draw a card. If that spell's power is 6 or greater, Eshki deals damage equal to Eshki's power to each opponent.
70019.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，在艾丝琦上放置一个+1/+1指示物。如果该咒语的力量等于或大于4，抓一张牌。如果该咒语的力量等于或大于6，则艾丝琦向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于艾丝琦的力量。

70021.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness, then discard cards equal to its power.
70021.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物：抓等同于所牺牲生物之防御力的牌，然后弃等同于其力量的牌。

70022.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a creature spell from your graveyard by exiling three other cards from your graveyard in addition to paying its other costs.
70022.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放生物咒语，但在其他费用外，还须从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

70023.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control enter, if one or more of them entered from a graveyard or was cast from a graveyard, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
70023.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的生物进场时，若其中的一个或数个是从坟墓场进场或从坟墓场施放，则在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

70024.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control enter, if one or more of them entered from a graveyard or was cast from a graveyard, put two +1/+1 counters on Kotis.
70024.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的生物进场时，若其中的一个或数个是从坟墓场进场或从坟墓场施放，则在柯提斯上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

70026.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the number of differently named tokens you control. During any turn you attacked with a commander, you may play those cards.
70026.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，从你的牌库顶放逐若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控之衍生物中名称不同者的种数。于你以指挥官攻击过的回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

70027.oracleText: Whenever Neriv attacks, exile a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the number of differently named tokens you control. During any turn you attacked with a commander, you may play those cards.
70027.translation: 每当涅雳伏攻击时，从你的牌库顶放逐若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控之衍生物中名称不同者的种数。于你以指挥官攻击过的回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

70028.translation: 人龙合一席科与娜尔施

70031.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy that spell if it targets a permanent or player, and you may choose new targets for the copy. If you don't copy a spell this way, draw a card.
70031.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，如果该咒语之目标包含任一永久物或牌手，则复制该咒语，且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。如果你未以此法复制咒语，则抓一张牌。

70033.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, mill three cards. Then you may return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
70033.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，磨三张牌。然后你可以将一张地牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。

70034.oracleText: Whenever Teval attacks, mill three cards. Then you may return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
70034.translation: 每当特瓦尔攻击时，磨三张牌。然后你可以将一张地牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。

70035.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, create a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token.
70035.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你坟墓场时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。

70037.oracleText: Whenever Ureni enters or attacks, look at the top eight cards of your library. You may put a Dragon creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
70037.translation: 每当乌列尼进场或攻击时，检视你牌库顶的八张牌。你可以将其中一张龙生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

70039.oracleText: Whenever a creature token you control leaves the battlefield, draw a card if it was attacking. Otherwise, each opponent loses 1 life.
70039.translation: 每当一个由你操控的衍生生物离开战场时，如果它正进行攻击，抓一张牌。若否，则每位对手各失去1点生命。

70040.oracleText: Target up to one creature card with mana value less than or equal to the amount of life you lost this turn.
70040.translation: 指定至多一张生物牌为目标，且其法术力值须等于或小于你本回合失去的生命。

70041.oracleText: The essence of dragonfire has permeated Tarkir's landscapes since time immemorial.
70041.translation: 龙焰菁华自古便已渗透鞑契的每寸山河。

70042.oracleText: Only Temur whisperers are allowed in the Dragon's Throat. All others must justify their presence to the valley's guardian.
70042.translation: 唯有铁木尔低语者方可进入龙喉之地。其余人等必须向山谷守护者证明自己到此的理由。

70043.oracleText: "For the Mardu, the shelter of my wings; for our foes, the searing heat of lightning."
70043.translation: 「以我双翼庇护玛尔都，以我霹雳灼烧众敌寇。」

70044.oracleText: Dragonstorms are a dragon's first natural habitat. They rarely have any issues navigating the howling energies to come to the Abzan's aid.
70044.translation: 龙袭风暴是巨龙最初的自然栖息地。它们驾驭呼啸的能量来援助阿布赞时很少遇到困难。

70045.oracleText: When caught in a dragonstorm, Mardu and Abzan scouts have no choice but to ride together.
70045.translation: 当遭遇龙袭风暴时，玛尔都与阿布赞的斥候们别无选择，只能同骑而行。

70046.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, look at the top eight cards of your library. You may put a Dragon creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
70046.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，检视你牌库顶的八张牌。你可以将其中一张龙生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

70047.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess.
70047.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出等量1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

70048.oracleText: When Neriv enters, create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
70048.translation: 当涅雳伏进场时，派出两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

73125.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
73125.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

74680.oracleText: Target creature gains flying and double strike until end of turn.
74680.translation: 目标生物获得飞行与连击异能直到回合结束。

74681.oracleText: Create X 2/2 white Cat creature tokens, where X is your life total.
74681.translation: 派出X个2/2白色猫衍生生物，X为你的总生命。

75944.oracleText: Select a zone for the object to move to.
75944.translation: 选择该物件要移至的区域。

76282.oracleText: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, put it into its owner's hand instead of into that player's graveyard.
76282.translation: 反击目标咒语。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它置于其拥有者手上，而非置入该牌手的坟墓场。

76295.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block alone.
76295.translation: CARDNAME不能单独进行攻击或阻挡。

76302.oracleText:
"The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them."
—Gideon Jura
76302.translation:
「此地神明与民同在，但并不与民同心。」
～基定尤拉

76308.oracleText: "The only question we need to ask is how best to fulfill the will of the God-Pharaoh."
76308.translation: 「我们唯一要问的问题，便是如何彻底执行法老神的旨意。」

76310.oracleText: What the gods decree, the mummies enforce.
76310.translation: 神明下旨令，木乃伊执行。

76317.oracleText: The pain of death is nothing compared to the pain of failure.
76317.translation: 死亡之痛远不及失败之苦。

76318.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this creature: You gain 2 life.

76319.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "{o2}, Sacrifice this creature: You gain 2 life."
76319.translation: 所结附的生物具有「{o2}，牺牲此生物：你获得2点生命。」

76323.oracleText: "When I wish to be strong, I train. When I wish to be wise, I study. When I wish to rest, I start again."
76323.translation: 「我想要强壮时，就刻苦训练；我想要智慧时，就努力学习；我想要休息时，就加倍努力。」

76324.oracleText: Untap target creature. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
76324.translation: 重置目标生物。于本回合中，防止将对它造成的所有伤害。

76326.oracleText: Rest sometimes requires the right prompting.
76326.translation: 有时需要适当的推动才能安息。

76328.oracleText: "Why cling to these trappings? They are but tools and affectations. True wealth can be possessed only in the afterlife."
76328.translation: 「何必留恋于这些身份象征？它们不过是器具和虚饰。只有在来世才能获得真正的财富。」

76330.oracleText: Until your next turn, prevent all damage target permanent would deal.
76330.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，防止目标永久物将造成的所有伤害。

76332.oracleText: As long as you control a Gideon planeswalker, you can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game.
76332.translation: 只要你操控基定鹏洛客，你这盘游戏不会输，对手也不会赢。

76333.oracleText: You get an emblem with "As long as you control a Gideon planeswalker, you can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game."
76333.translation: 你获得具有「只要你操控基定鹏洛客，你这盘游戏不会输，对手也不会赢」的徽记。

76336.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells with the chosen name.
76336.translation: 所有对手都不能施放具该名称的咒语。

76337.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you and permanents you control by sources with the chosen name.
76337.translation: 防止具该名称的来源将对你和由你操控之永久物造成的所有伤害。

76339.oracleText:
"Fly as an arrow through the trials, and never waver in your course."
—Oketra, god of solidarity
76339.translation:
「在祀炼中如离弦飞矢，勇往直前。」
～团结之神欧柯塔

76340.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+3 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
76340.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+3且获得系命异能。

76343.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
76343.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

76344.oracleText: To a trained warrior, there is scarcely a more potent weapon than patience.
76344.translation: 对于训练有素的战士而言，鲜有比耐心更为有力的武器。

76345.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
76345.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。

76347.oracleText:
"A single grain of sand is insignificant, but a sandstorm can reduce pyramids to dust. Stand with your crop. Become the storm."
—Oketra, god of solidarity
76347.translation:
「单颗沙砾虽不起眼，但一股沙暴能将金字塔化作灰土。与你们的祀群并肩而战。聚沙成暴。」
～团结之神欧柯塔

76348.oracleText: Zombies you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
76348.translation: 由你操控的灵俑得+2/+1直到回合结束。由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

76349.oracleText: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."
76349.translation: 「我感受到神日中法老神的存在，我朝其光芒而起。」

76351.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless you control at least three other creatures.
76351.translation: 除非你操控至少三个其他生物，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

76356.oracleText: Part of the acolytes' training is to walk along the Hekma, staring out at the ravenous horrors kept at bay by the God-Pharaoh's barrier.
76356.translation: 侍僧训练中的一个环节便是到避世帘旁走一遭，正视被法老神屏障阻挡在外的凶残邪物。

76358.oracleText: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.
76358.translation: 欧柯塔最贴身的维齐尔被称为她的精卫，而这个别称给到其他生物或许更为贴切。

76359.oracleText: Other Cats you control get +1/+1 and have lifelink.
76359.translation: 由你操控的其他猫得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

76361.oracleText: "To see gods among the people, part of their daily lives . . . It's inspiring."
76361.translation: 「看到神明亲临凡间，体恤民情…真令人振奋。」

76374.oracleText:
"We each have a weight to carry on the road to the afterlife."
—Oketra, god of solidarity
76374.translation:
「在通往来世的路上，我们都有各自的包袱。」
～团结之神欧柯塔

76377.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
76377.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

76384.oracleText: "You will succeed as one or fail as many."
76384.translation: 「团结一心定能成功，各自为战必将失败。」

76394.oracleText: "You'll need all your strength for the trials to come."
76394.translation: 「痊愈之后，你才能在未来祀炼中全力以赴。」

76395.oracleText: If one or more -1/-1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many -1/-1 counters minus one are put on it instead.
76395.translation: 如果将会在某个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个-1/-1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量减一的-1/-1指示物。

76397.oracleText:
"When the Hour of Promise arrives, the God-Pharaoh will tear down the Hekma, for its protection will be needed no longer."
—The Accounting of Hours
76397.translation:
「当允诺时刻来临时，法老神将撤下避世帘，因为我们不再需要它的保护。」
～《时刻全志》

76398.oracleText: The banks of the Luxa River attract all manner of predator but only the most resilient of prey.
76398.translation: 罗夏河的两岸吸引了各种捕食者，但只有最顽强的猎物才会来到此地。

76403.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a time counter on CARDNAME.
76403.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个计时指示物。

76409.oracleText: Cartouches chronicle the initiates' achievements in the trials.
76409.translation: 魔符记录着祀徒在祀炼中的各项成就。

76413.oracleText:
"How can there be doubt in the presence of such blessings?"
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation
76413.translation:
「在此等福祉面前，缘何会有疑虑？」
～启程维齐尔乌凯特

76415.oracleText: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.
76415.translation: 它能绕过感官，束缩感觉并毒害感知。

76418.oracleText: To consult a sphinx is a test in patience. Perhaps that's the point.
76418.translation: 咨询史芬斯要考验耐心。或许这便是其意义所在。

76419.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard another card, scry 1.
76419.translation: 每当你循环或弃另一张牌时，占卜1。

76423.oracleText:
"If you want to truly test your survival skills, walk the Obelisk Path when the drakes are feeding."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop
76423.translation:
「如果你诚心想检验自己的生存技巧，挑龙兽觅食时去石碑道走走。」
～雷特祀群祀徒爱瑟

76424.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
76424.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2蓝色，具飞行异能的龙兽衍生生物。

76425.oracleText: Dependence on luck is anathema to Kefnet's rigorous studies. Those who hope to escape his maze by chance never succeed.
76425.translation: 刻法涅的缜密研究中容不得半点投机取巧。希望靠运气走出他迷宫的人从未成功。

76427.oracleText:
"It usually appears placid, but don't be fooled. The Luxa River is a snake, and it can swallow you whole."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet
76427.translation:
「平日里，罗夏河看似宁静，但切勿被其迷惑。罗夏河是一条蛇，能将你们尽数吞没。」
～刻法涅维齐尔奈珀内

76428.oracleText: Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
76428.translation: 将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

76436.oracleText: "The God-Pharaoh created the Hekma to protect us from the horrors beyond and to surround us in his love."
76436.translation: 「法老神架起避世帘保护我们不受外界邪物的侵扰，将我们笼罩在他的关爱之下。」

76437.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
76437.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

76439.oracleText: "The answers are here. This is the way through the trial."
76439.translation: 「这就是答案。这就是通过祀炼的方法。」

76443.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless you have seven or more cards in hand.
76443.translation: 除非你的手牌有七张或更多，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

76444.oracleText: {o3oU}: Draw a card, then you may return a land you control to its owner's hand.
76444.translation: {o3oU}：抓一张牌，然后你可以将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者的手上。

76446.oracleText: When CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it.
76446.translation: 当CARDNAME成为咒语的目标时，将它牺牲。

76449.oracleText: Initiates need worry only about the trials. Everything else is in the hands of the gods.
76449.translation: 祀徒只需专注祀炼。其余尽在神明的掌握之中。

76452.oracleText: "All questions will be answered during the Hour of Revelation."
76452.translation: 「所有疑问都将在预示时刻得到解答。」

76455.oracleText: Understanding is a matter of perspective.

76457.oracleText: As long as you have seven or more cards in hand, you may pay {o0} rather than pay cycling costs.
76457.translation: 只要你的手牌有七张或更多，你便可以支付{o0}，而不支付循环费用。

76462.oracleText:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop
76462.translation:
「我用自己的时间处理事宜。」
～雷特祀群祀徒爱瑟

76463.oracleText: Draw X cards, then discard a card.

76474.oracleText: The Trial of Knowledge challenges and broadens the minds of initiates.
76474.translation: 知识祀炼能挑战并拓展祀徒的心智。

76477.oracleText: They are drawn by the brilliant blue glint of the mineral lazotep from the mines below.
76477.translation: 它们被地下矿场中闪着耀眼蓝色晶光的拉佐特石吸引而来。

76479.oracleText: Some naga initiates move as silently as the suns' reflections on the water.
76479.translation: 有些那伽祀徒移动时静如双日水中映影。

76481.oracleText: Initiates live and train with their crop, the unit that begins the trials together.
76481.translation: 一同踏上祀炼征途的人组成祀群，祀徒会跟自己的祀群一起生活、训练。

76488.oracleText: "Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."
76488.translation: 「时间就像罗夏河～尽管只流向一方，但仍能牵动。」

76491.oracleText: "I have foreseen that you will not pass my trial."
76491.translation: 「我已预见你无法通过我的祀炼。」

76497.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard another card, put a -1/-1 counter on each creature your opponents control.
76497.translation: 每当你循环或弃另一张牌时，在由对手操控的每个生物上各放置一个-1/-1指示物。

76499.oracleText:
"Not all in our crop deserve the afterlife. We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop
76499.translation:
「本祀群并非人人配得来世。撒姆特，我们得放弃配不上的人。」
～塔哈祀群祀徒杰鲁

76502.oracleText: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.
76502.translation: 有两个太阳的阿芒凯从无暗夜，因此蝙蝠大多出没于频繁沙暴笼罩的昏暗之中。

76503.oracleText: {o1}: CARDNAME gains haste until end of turn.
76503.translation: {o1}：CARDNAME获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

76505.oracleText: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.
76505.translation: 它们是逆徒在流放路途中的首批访客。

76508.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless a creature died under your control this turn.
76508.translation: 除非本回合有生物在你的操控下死去，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

76513.oracleText: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.
76513.translation: 当基定看到祀徒亲手杀害自己的群伴时，他对拿塔蒙城的敬仰转瞬就变成了恐惧。

76516.oracleText:
"Look! That is why we must never waver. That is what awaits us if we fail."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop
76516.translation:
「看啊！这就是我们不能动摇的原因。这就是我们失败的下场。」
～塔哈祀群祀徒杰鲁

76520.oracleText: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.
76520.translation: 被逐出法老神城市的人，面前只有一种命运。

76521.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
76521.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

76526.oracleText: The scouring sands of Shefet polish its carapace, and the ranks of the cursed fill its belly.
76526.translation: 谢菲的猛烈风沙磨亮其甲壳，大群受诅者则填饱其肚子。

76528.oracleText:
"The more I see of this place, the less I want to."
—Chandra Nalaar
76528.translation:
「这个地方我越看越不想看。」
～茜卓纳拉

76529.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, you may pay {o1}. If you do, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
76529.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

76531.oracleText: As its parched flesh withers away, its malignant hunger grows.
76531.translation: 身上死肉逐渐剥落，内底恶欲逐渐增长。

76532.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
76532.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以在目标生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

76534.oracleText: Those who earn a glorious death are given the highest honor. They are carried on funeral barges through the gate to the afterlife.
76534.translation: 光荣成仁者能享受最高的荣耀，得灵船载遗体穿大门往来生。

76535.oracleText: In Amonkhet's ever-shifting sands, nothing stays buried for long.
76535.translation: 在阿芒凯的流沙之下，谁都无法长久安息。

76538.oracleText: CARDNAME gets -1/-1 for each card in your hand.

76540.oracleText: It feeds on dry bones in the sand and desperate pleas in the wind.
76540.translation: 它以沙漠中的枯骨和风中的绝望求救为食。

76541.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard another card, CARDNAME gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
76541.translation: 每当你循环或弃另一张牌时，CARDNAME得+2/+1直到回合结束。

76547.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.
76547.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。该生物额外具有黑色此颜色与灵俑此类别。

76550.oracleText: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."
76550.translation: 「数量可真多。它们好像正等着服侍人。」

76554.oracleText: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.
76554.translation: 漂浪诅咒只会留下憎恶。

76555.translation: 由你操控的其他灵俑得+1/+1。

76556.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}: All Zombies gain menace until end of turn.
76556.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}：所有灵俑获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

76558.oracleText: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.
76558.translation: 其气息不侵袭感官，而是污染心灵。

76560.oracleText:
"They are small, but they always want more. Learn from them."
—Bontu, god of ambition
76560.translation:
「它们虽然渺小，但总是索求更多。多跟它们学学。」
～野心之神芭图

76561.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more -1/-1 counters on a creature, create that many 1/1 black Insect creature tokens.
76561.translation: 每当你在一个生物上放置一个或数个-1/-1指示物时，派出等量的1/1黑色昆虫衍生生物。

76565.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
76565.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

76571.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, you may pay {o1}. If you do, put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
76571.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则在目标生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

76573.oracleText:
"The face of mediocrity is wrapped in anointed linen. Aspire to a better end."
—Epnokep, vizier of Bontu
76573.translation:
「经圣洗的麻布包裹住凡庸面容。让人希望得到善终。」
～芭图维齐尔埃诺科

76575.oracleText:
"Death has seeped into every part of this plane. I can feel it on my skin and taste it like sand in my mouth."
—Nissa Revane
76575.translation:
「死亡渗透了这个时空的各方面。有如污秽沾身挥之不去，又如黄沙进口苦不堪言。」
～妮莎瑞文

76576.oracleText: Return to your hand all cards in your graveyard that you cycled or discarded this turn.
76576.translation: 将你坟墓场中所有你于本回合中循环或弃掉的牌移回你手上。

76578.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature for each -1/-1 counter on CARDNAME.
76578.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以在目标生物上放置若干-1/-1指示物，其数量等同于CARDNAME上-1/-1指示物的数量。

76580.oracleText:
"Wherever you are in the city, you can feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh. Take comfort in that."
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation
76580.translation:
「无论你在城中何处，都会感受到法老神的存在。接受这一点吧。」
～启程维齐尔乌凯特

76581.oracleText: Distribute two -1/-1 counters among one or two target creatures.
76581.translation: 将两个-1/-1指示物分配给一个或两个目标生物。

76587.oracleText:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu
76587.translation:
「众生非平等～无论是生前还是死后。受芭图眷宠者会永远屹立巅峰。」
～芭图维齐尔瑟尼法

76588.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control.
76588.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

76589.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control."
76589.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。」

76591.oracleText: Even in the relative safety of the city, there are places best left undisturbed.
76591.translation: 即便是城中较安全的区域，也有些避之为妙的地方。

76595.oracleText:
"Ambition requires clarity. If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned."
—Bontu, god of ambition
76595.translation:
「野心要纯。如有疑虑，必须舍弃。」
～野心之神芭图

76597.oracleText: Forever restless. Forever growing in number.

76599.oracleText: All but the gods fear the scorpion's sting.

76601.oracleText:
"Hesitation breeds dissension. To be worthy of the next life, you must never look back."
—Anep, vizier of Hazoret
76601.translation:
「犹豫生杂议。若想配得上拥有来世，必须勇往向前。」
～哈佐蕾维齐尔阿内普

76602.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, target creature can't block this turn.
76602.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

76604.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks.
76604.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。

76605.oracleText: Whenever you exert a creature, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
76605.translation: 每当你耗竭一个生物时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

76608.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
76608.translation: CARDNAME向由对手操控的每个生物各造成1点伤害。

76610.translation: 「为了胜利！为了荣誉！为了永生！」

76612.oracleText: To Hazoret, those who fight for her are her beloved children.
76612.translation: 对哈佐蕾来说，为她而战的都是她的子民。

76614.oracleText: "Oketra had our crop build an obelisk to prove the power of working together. But I am stronger without the weak."
76614.translation: 「欧柯塔让我们祀群建造石碑，想要证明团结的力量。但倘若没有弱者拖累，我会更强。」

76616.oracleText:
"Dissent? Your gods can't even begin to comprehend the dissent that's about to happen here!"
—Chandra Nalaar
76616.translation:
「逆徒？这里都快要变天了，你们的神却都还蒙在鼓里！」
～茜卓纳拉

76619.oracleText: The fifth cartouche is the final affirmation of glory, granted only to the worthy dead.
76619.translation: 第五个魔符是最后一个荣誉证明，只有光荣成仁者才能获得。

76622.oracleText: If CARDNAME hasn't been exerted this turn, you may exert it as it attacks. When you do, untap all other creatures you control and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
76622.translation: 如果本回合尚未耗竭CARDNAME，则你可以于其攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，重置所有由你操控的其他生物，且在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

76625.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a -1/-1 counter on this creature.
76625.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在此生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

76628.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 7 damage to target creature.
76628.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成7点伤害。

76632.oracleText: The endless expanse of desert surrounding Naktamun sometimes yields threats that the gods themselves must answer.
76632.translation: 拿塔蒙周围一片广袤无垠的沙漠中，有时也会出现这类需要神明亲自处理的威胁。

76634.oracleText: "Some hid from the storm. I embraced it and learned its name."
76634.translation: 「有些人对风暴避犹不及。而我却迎风而上，将其中奥妙为己所用。」

76636.oracleText: "My stride will break only against the twin points of Hazoret's spear."
76636.translation: 「只有哈佐蕾长矛的双尖能打断我的冲锋。」

76637.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+1 and gains menace until end of turn.
76637.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+1且获得威慑异能。

76639.oracleText:
"Allow zealous flames to light your path and the glory you seek will be revealed."
—Hazoret, god of zeal
76639.translation:
「让赤忱烈焰照亮你的前进道路，所追寻的荣耀便近在眼前。」
～热忱之神哈佐蕾

76640.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
76640.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

76641.oracleText: Never flinch. Never falter. Never fear.
76641.translation: 从不畏惧。从不退缩。从不害怕。

76643.oracleText: At the beginning of your next end step, you lose the game.
76643.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，你输掉这盘游戏。

76645.oracleText: What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.
76645.translation: 祀徒会在终极祀炼中面对什么，完全由哈佐蕾决定。

76646.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it deals 4 damage to target non-Dragon creature an opponent controls.
76646.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它向目标由对手操控的非龙生物造成4点伤害。

76651.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless you have one or fewer cards in hand.
76651.translation: 除非你的手牌为一张或更少，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

76652.oracleText: {o2oR}, Discard a card: Hazoret deals 2 damage to each opponent.
76652.translation: {o2oR}，弃一张牌：哈佐蕾向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

76662.oracleText:
"When the time comes, only one of you will be honored by my spear."
—Hazoret, god of zeal
76662.translation:
「到时，我手中长矛只能赐予你们其中一人荣耀。」
～热忱之神哈佐蕾

76663.oracleText:
"Ashes can't be embalmed."
—Neheb, initiate of Ahn crop
76663.translation:
「烧成灰就没法留下来了。」
～阿恩祀群祀徒内赫布

76668.oracleText: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."
76668.translation: 「有翅膀会飞算不上什么优势。瞧我把它们都钉在避世帘顶上。」

76669.oracleText: {o1oR}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

76671.oracleText: "If you do not feel the thrill of battle, alive like a flame, you will never triumph."
76671.translation: 「如果你没有战斗时的亢奋，没有火焰般的热忱，你将无法得胜。」

76672.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+2 until end of turn.
76672.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+1/+2直到回合结束。

76674.oracleText:
"In the Hour of Glory, the gods and the untested will prove their worth before the God-Pharaoh."
—The Accounting of Hours
76674.translation:
「待到荣光时刻，诸神与未受祀炼者需在法老神面前证明自己是否够格。」
～《时刻全志》

76676.oracleText: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."
76676.translation: 「闯通祀炼的寻常道路太过无趣。」

76678.oracleText:
"Combat is a form of worship, the clash of steel a solemn prayer."
—Pytamun, initiate of Nef crop
76678.translation:
「战斗是崇拜的一种形式，钢铁互击即是庄严祷告。」
～奈法祀群祀徒拜塔蒙

76680.oracleText: If a source you control would deal noncombat damage to a creature an opponent controls, put that many -1/-1 counters on that creature instead.
76680.translation: 如果由你操控的某来源将对任一由对手操控的生物造成非战斗伤害，则改为在该生物上放置等量的-1/-1指示物。

76682.oracleText: The Hekma may repel storms and monsters, but nothing holds back the heat of the suns.
76682.translation: 避世帘或能抵御狂风与怪物，但什么都挡不住烈日热浪。

76683.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each creature.
76683.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成3点伤害。

76685.oracleText: The sound of its plated tail beating on desert rocks is often mistaken for the footfalls of a much larger predator.
76685.translation: 它尾巴上有层层鳞甲，敲打砂岩时发出的声响常被当作大型捕食者的脚步声。

76686.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+2 as long as you have one or fewer cards in hand.
76686.translation: 只要你的手牌为一张或更少，CARDNAME便得+1/+2。

76687.oracleText: "You are undeserving of the afterlife. You will never feel the God-Pharaoh's embrace."
76687.translation: 「你不配拥有来世。你永远无法感受法老神的恩泽。」

76690.translation: 「永恒的荣耀等待着你，我的孩子。」

76692.oracleText: Shoulder to shoulder until blade must turn against blade.
76692.translation: 齐心克敌，最后终需反目相弑。

76693.oracleText: Whenever you exert a creature, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
76693.translation: 每当你耗竭一个生物时，由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

76697.oracleText: Minotaurs favor magic that manifests as weapons wrapped in flame.
76697.translation: 牛头怪偏好可具现为炽焰武器的魔法。

76708.oracleText: The only way to finish the Trial of Strength is with a basilisk scale in hand.
76708.translation: 要完成力量祀炼，唯有拔下蜥怪鳞片一途。

76709.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
76709.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

76716.oracleText:
"Everything in the trial has teeth. You will overcome them, or you will feed them."
—Rhonas, god of strength
76716.translation:
「这祀炼中你所面对的一切都有尖牙利齿。赢不了的话，你就会成为盘中美餐。」
～力量之神罗纳斯

76718.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more -1/-1 counters on CARDNAME, remove a -1/-1 counter from another target creature you control.
76718.translation: 每当你在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个-1/-1指示物时，从另一个目标由你操控的生物上移去一个-1/-1指示物。

76720.oracleText:
"When all doubts have melted away, the worthy will meet the Hour of Eternity and earn a place at the God-Pharaoh's side."
—The Accounting of Hours
76720.translation:
「待疑虑散尽，豪英将迎来永恒时刻，赢得法老神近侧一席之位。」
～《时刻全志》

76723.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, remove a -1/-1 counter from it. If you do, you gain 1 life.
76723.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，从其上移去一个-1/-1指示物。若你如此作，你获得1点生命。

76727.oracleText: A sandwurm can lie in wait beneath the sands for years until the slightest tremor alerts it to the presence of prey.
76727.translation: 沙丘亚龙可蛰伏黄沙之中长达数年之久，猎物稍有动静都能引其现身。

76728.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
76728.translation: CARDNAME不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

76739.oracleText: Nagas wielding twin daggers excel at the fighting technique known as the Bite of Rhonas.
76739.translation: 善使双匕的那伽都擅使罗纳斯之刺这一招式。

76740.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
76740.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

76742.oracleText:
"I'd like to say that it's our pet, but the reverse may be closer to the truth."
—Ixor, initiate of Rhet crop
76742.translation:
「我也想说这是我们的宠物，但可能倒过来说会比较符合实际。」
～雷特祀群祀徒依瑟

76743.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, untap target creature or land.
76743.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置目标生物或地。

76744.oracleText: Few can overcome an assault of such aggressive serenity.
76744.translation: 安详如此袭来，几乎没人挡得住。

76746.oracleText:
"Rely too much on your weapons and watch your dreams shatter in your hands."
—Rhonas, god of strength
76746.translation:
「若是过于依靠武器，你就只能眼睁睁地看着你的梦想在手中破碎。」
～力量之神罗纳斯

76749.oracleText: "The lands of the God-Pharaoh are suffused with his breath."
76749.translation: 「法老神的土地上也弥漫着法老神的吐息。」

76751.oracleText: "Like fruits in the field, we will be harvested when the season is right."
76751.translation: 「我们跟田地里的水果一样，到了收获季节就会被采摘。」

76754.oracleText: Debate rages among the viziers whether comparing the kudu's horns to the God-Pharaoh's is blasphemy or reverence.
76754.translation: 拿法老神尊角与羚羊长角相提并论到底算是亵渎还是崇敬，诸位维齐尔激烈争辩，莫衷一是。

76756.oracleText: Rhonas's monument is home to a wider variety of creatures than anywhere else in the city of Naktamun—a feature most initiates fail to appreciate.
76756.translation: 在罗纳斯纪念碑内栖息的生物种类，远比拿塔蒙城内其他地方要多～这一点许多祀徒都欣赏不来。

76758.oracleText: The viziers serving Rhonas, the god of strength, maintain the menagerie of animals employed during his trial.
76758.translation: 侍奉力量之神罗纳斯的维齐尔负责饲养会在祀炼中出现的各类猛兽。

76759.oracleText: Creature spells you control can't be countered.
76759.translation: 由你操控的生物咒语不能被反击。

76761.oracleText: They labor beside the anointed, constructing the vast monuments of Naktamun.

120849.translation: {o2oG}：目标由你操控的生物本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

120863.oracleText: Target creature you control gains vigilance and trample until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
120863.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得警戒与践踏异能。它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

120879.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
120879.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

120907.translation: 对每个由你操控的载具而言，只要它是生物，便得+1/+1。

120921.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn.

120921.translation:
选择一项～
•直到回合结束，目标生物得+5/+5且获得践踏异能。

120940.oracleText: Destroy target creature. If you control an artifact, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
120940.translation: 消灭目标生物。如果你操控神器，则CARDNAME对该生物的操控者造成3点伤害。

120943.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
120943.translation: 每当CARDNAME搭载载具时，该载具得+1/+1直到回合结束。

120977.oracleText: {o1oW}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
120977.translation: {o1oW}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

120986.translation: {o4}，{oT}：将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

121025.oracleText: {oT}, Discard a card: Up to one target creature can't be blocked this turn.
121025.translation: {oT}，弃一张牌：至多一个目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

121026.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes untapped, you may pay {o2}. If you do, draw a card.
121026.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为未横置时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

121028.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
121028.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

121037.oracleText: {oG}: CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn.
121037.translation: {oG}：CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。

121050.oracleText: {oB}: CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
121050.translation: {oB}：CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

121073.oracleText: {o2oG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You gain 3 life and get {oEoEoE}.

121095.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
121095.translation: 每当CARDNAME进攻或阻挡时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

121131.oracleText: Search for an Assembly-Worker creature card.
121131.translation: 搜寻一张组装工人生物牌。

121153.oracleText: {oW}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return up to one target artifact card and up to one target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
121153.translation: {oW}，牺牲CARDNAME：将至多一张目标神器牌和至多一张目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

121172.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a Vehicle, it's a creature in addition to its other types.
121172.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是载具，它便额外具有生物此类别。

121261.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Creatures without flying can't block this turn.
121261.translation:
选择一项～
•消灭目标神器。
•不具飞行异能的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

121276.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature gets +4/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. 
• Two target creatures each get +2/+0 and gain trample until end of turn.
121276.translation:
选择一项～
•直到回合结束，目标生物得+4/+0且获得践踏异能。
•直到回合结束，两个目标生物各得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。

121349.oracleText: Exile target creature. Its controller gains life equal to its power.
121349.translation: 放逐目标生物。其操控者获得等同于其力量的生命。

121350.oracleText: Put five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control and five loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
121350.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置五个+1/+1指示物，并在每个由你操控的其他鹏洛客上各放置五个忠诚指示物。

121365.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap another target artifact or creature you control.
121365.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置另一个目标由你操控的神器或生物。

121426.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
121426.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

121435.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature you control gets +1/+2 until end of turn. 
• Return target creature you control to its owner's hand.
121435.translation:
选择一项～
•目标由你操控的生物得+1/+2直到回合结束。
•将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

121451.oracleText: Return up to three target artifacts and/or creatures to their owners' hands.
121451.translation: 将至多三个目标神器和／或生物移回其拥有者手上。

121504.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature. Tap target land. That land doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
121504.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害。横置目标地。该地于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

121528.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
121528.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

121561.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, target creature can't block this turn.
121561.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

121581.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
121581.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

121615.oracleText: Pay {oE}: CARDNAME gets +2/-2 until end of turn.

121621.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
121621.translation: 牺牲一个神器：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

121627.oracleText: Pay {oE}: CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
121627.translation: 支付{oE}：CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

121678.oracleText: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.
121678.translation: 溪流自大地穿行而过，照映出乙太流穿越云间的路径。

121682.oracleText:
"The dead perform all the work here—farming, building, teaching, even embalming their fellow mummies. The living need do nothing but train. What system could be more perfect?"
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun
121682.translation:
「死者在这里负责所有的工作～耕种、建造、授课，甚至还为木乃伊同伴处理防腐。生者只管专心训练。还有更完美的体制吗？」
～拿塔蒙维齐尔蒂穆特

121684.oracleText:
"Why so many questions?"
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun
121684.translation:
「怎么问题这么多？」
～拿塔蒙维齐尔蒂穆特

121685.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Scry 1. Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
121685.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物：占卜1。每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

121686.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact, creature, or land on the battlefield, if it isn't a mana ability, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player.
121686.translation: 每当任一对手起动战场上任一神器、生物或地的起动式异能时，若其不是法术力异能，则CARDNAME对该牌手造成2点伤害。

121690.oracleText: Untap up to two target lands you control. They become 5/5 Elemental creatures with flying and haste until end of turn. They're still lands.
121690.translation: 重置至多两个目标由你操控的地。它们成为5/5，具飞行与敏捷异能的元素生物直到回合结束。它们仍然是地。

121695.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls?
121695.translation: 是否要放逐目标有对手操控的非地永久物？

121696.translation: 是否要横置目标神器或生物？

123176.oracleText: Search your library for up to two land cards?
123176.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张地牌？

123227.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Forest card?
123227.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌？

123229.oracleText: {o3oW}: Create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token with vigilance.
123229.translation: {o3oW}：派出一个1/1白色，具警戒异能的战士衍生生物。

123231.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens with vigilance.
123231.translation: 派出两个1/1白色，具警戒异能的战士衍生生物。

123232.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token with vigilance.
123232.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具警戒异能的战士衍生生物。

123258.oracleText: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.
123258.translation: 在混乱不堪的吉拉波之外，是一片生机盎然的世界，那里的乙太在自然中川流不息。

123259.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} deal 2 damage to target creature?
123259.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}对目标生物造成2点伤害？

123260.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card?
123260.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌？

123261.oracleText: Search for a basic land card or a Desert card.
123261.translation: 搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌。

123262.oracleText: Search for a card named God-Pharaoh's Gift.
123262.translation: 搜寻一张名称为法老神赋礼的牌。

123265.oracleText: Search for any number of cards with the chosen name.
123265.translation: 搜寻任意数量具所选名称的牌。

124977.oracleText: Untap all other creatures you control and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
124977.translation: 重置所有由你操控的其他生物，且在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

124984.oracleText: Untap all other creatures you control.
124984.translation: 重置所有由你操控的其他生物。

124991.oracleText: At the beginning of your next end step, you lose the game.
124991.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，你输掉这盘游戏。

124994.oracleText: Target creature can't block this turn.
124994.translation: 目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

125002.oracleText: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
125002.translation: 你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

125005.oracleText: It gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

125018.oracleText: The angels did not deceive. From the start, they were clear their allegiance was to the God-Pharaoh and to him alone.
125018.translation: 天使并未欺骗众生。他们自始至终都只效忠法老神。

125020.oracleText: "This storm will calm. We must believe that."

125022.oracleText:
"It is evidence that some pure corner of the world must still exist."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate
125022.translation:
「这便证明了世间尚有纯净之处。」
～原塔哈祀群祀徒杰鲁

125023.oracleText: Other Horses you control have indestructible.
125023.translation: 由你操控的其他马具有不灭异能。

125024.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, create a 5/5 white Horse creature token.
125024.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中你曾获得生命，则派出一个5/5白色的马衍生生物。

125026.oracleText: In the chaos brought by the new gods, swift-winged aven served as pathfinders, leading the last of the people away from the ruins of Naktamun.
125026.translation: 在新神降临引致的混乱之中，身手敏捷的艾文率先当起探路先锋，引导遗民逃离拿塔蒙废墟。

125027.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap target creature you control.
125027.translation: 当CARDNAME攻击时，重置目标由你操控的生物。

125034.oracleText:
"I was promised an afterlife, not this. Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate
125034.translation:
「他们口口声声说我赢得了来世，但我眼前只有末日。撒姆特没错。法老神在撒谎。」
～原塔哈祀群祀徒杰鲁

125053.oracleText: "Oketra's arrow is my spear, and her love my shield."
125053.translation: 「欧柯塔所掷飞矢即是手中长矛，所赐关爱即是周身护罩。」

125054.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
125054.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，防止本回合中将对它造成的所有战斗伤害。

125059.oracleText: Creatures enchanted player controls lose all abilities and have base power and toughness 1/1.
125059.translation: 由所结附之牌手操控的生物均失去所有异能，且基础力量与防御力为1/1。

125060.oracleText: Enchanted player can't activate abilities that aren't mana abilities or loyalty abilities.
125060.translation: 所结附的牌手不能起动不是法术力异能或忠诚异能的起动式异能。

125066.oracleText: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh marked a betrayal of both gods and mortals.
125066.translation: 法老神的到来标志着神明与凡人均遭背叛。

125068.oracleText: Counters can't be put on artifacts, creatures, enchantments, or lands.
125068.translation: 不能在神器，生物，结界或地上放置指示物。

125070.translation: 沙漠虽不宜居，但并非无法安身。

125071.oracleText: CARDNAME has lifelink as long as you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard.
125071.translation: 只要你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，CARDNAME便具有系命异能。

125075.oracleText: In the midst of disaster, heroic acts became almost ordinary, and ordinary warriors became heroes.
125075.translation: 灾难当头，英勇行为差不多成了平凡之举，平凡的战士也成为了英雄。

125076.oracleText: {oT}, Exert CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token with vigilance.
125076.translation: {oT}，耗竭CARDNAME：派出一个1/1白色，具警戒异能的战士衍生生物。

125086.oracleText:
"Kefnet taught us to turn obstacles into advantages."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet
125086.translation:
「刻法涅教导我们把障碍化为优势。」
～刻法涅维齐尔奈珀内

125087.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature gains flying until end of turn.
125087.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

125089.oracleText: "Our best chance against the Eternals will be tactics they've never seen and styles they've never trained in."
125089.translation: 「对抗永生者的最佳办法，便是采用它们未曾见过的战术，使出它们未曾练过的招式。」

125094.oracleText: The Eternals had long since mastered every technique taught during the trials.
125094.translation: 永生者早已掌握了祀炼中所教授的每一项技巧。

125100.oracleText:
"If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?"
—Jace Beleren
125100.translation:
「如果波拉斯在这里的计划是创造永生者，那他对于那些永生者又有什么安排？」
～杰斯贝连

125102.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks and isn't blocked, draw a card.
125102.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击且未受阻挡时，抓一张牌。

125121.oracleText: The sphinxes began to speak only after the Second Sun aligned. They whispered dire warnings, though no one listened.
125121.translation: 神日落位后，史芬斯才缓缓开口。他们低语严峻警告，但无人听闻。

125122.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
125122.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

125127.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may have CARDNAME become a 3/3 Sphinx creature with flying in addition to its other types until end of turn.
125127.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以令CARDNAME成为3/3，具飞行异能的史芬斯生物直到回合结束，且仍具有原本类别。

125129.oracleText: "The truth? It's been here all along. The Hours as we understood them are lies."
125129.translation: 「真相？它一直都在这里。我们所知的『时刻』全都是谎言。」

125134.oracleText:
"They were once our brothers and sisters."
—Etha, former Rhet-crop initiate
125134.translation:
「我们原本情同手足。」
～原雷特祀群祀徒爱瑟

125137.oracleText: The denizens of the Luxa River woke angry on the currents of blood.
125137.translation: 血腥的河水让罗夏河中的生物暴怒而醒。

125139.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o3}. 
• Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
125139.translation:
选择一项～ 
•除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。 
•检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

125147.oracleText: Sphinx spells you cast cost {o2} less to cast.
125147.translation: 你施放的史芬斯咒语减少{o2}来施放。

125154.oracleText: Whenever you activate an eternalize or embalm ability, draw a card.
125154.translation: 每当你起动永生或遗存异能时，抓一张牌。

125156.oracleText: {o1oB}: Target attacking Zombie gains indestructible until end of turn.
125156.translation: {o1oB}：目标进行攻击的灵俑获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

125159.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, put a -1/-1 counter on CARDNAME.
125159.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

125160.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, remove all -1/-1 counters from it.
125160.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，移去其上所有的-1/-1指示物。

125168.oracleText: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.
125168.translation: 临终时，芭图只望成为法老神的第一批子民。

125169.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. Lands you control don't untap during your next untap step.
125169.translation: 消灭所有生物。由你操控的地于你的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

125174.oracleText:
"This place has outlived its usefulness."
—Nicol Bolas
125174.translation:
「此地利用价值已尽，留之无用。」
～尼可波拉斯

125187.oracleText: For many years, servant mummies toiled in the mines to extract lazotep. The emergence of the Eternals revealed the sacred substance's true purpose.
125187.translation: 多年来，仆从木乃伊一直在矿场中开采拉佐特石。永生者的出现揭示了这种神圣物质的真实用途。

125190.oracleText: Initiates once believed defeat was the worst fate possible—a sentiment they quickly abandoned.
125190.translation: 祀徒曾以为失败是最糟糕的命运～这想法很快便被摒除。

125192.oracleText:
"All the power you have gathered for yourself, Liliana, I can take away."
—Nicol Bolas
125192.translation:
「莉莲娜，你苦心积累的所有力量，我都能夺走。」
～尼可波拉斯

125193.oracleText: Destroy target black creature or black planeswalker. If that permanent was a Liliana planeswalker, her controller loses 3 life.
125193.translation: 消灭目标黑色生物或黑色鹏洛客。如果该永久物是莉莲娜鹏洛客，则其操控者失去3点生命。

125197.oracleText: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.
125197.translation: 避世帘被毁后，曾妄图进入拿塔蒙的漂浪亡者终可肆虐全城。

125198.oracleText: CARDNAME can't block unless you control another Zombie.
125198.translation: 除非你操控另一个灵俑，否则CARDNAME不能进行阻挡。

125205.oracleText: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.
125205.translation: 莉莲娜坚持要来阿芒凯，就是为了要对付和她立约的最后两个恶魔之一。

125210.oracleText: From every shadow came the dull scratch of teeth on bones.
125210.translation: 每处阴影都传出牙齿啃骨头的声音。

125211.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, exile target card from an opponent's graveyard.
125211.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将目标牌从对手的坟墓场放逐。

125219.oracleText: Like a carpet unrolling for their god, the scarabs poured out from the necropolis.
125219.translation: 圣甲虫从古陵寝中涌出，好似为迎接圣甲虫神而铺开地毯。

125225.oracleText: The glyphs writhed and twisted, spewing out dark, vengeful magic.
125225.translation: 图符不断抽搐扭动，喷吐出黑暗恶毒的魔法。

125226.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each card with cycling in your graveyard.
125226.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张具循环异能的牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

125233.oracleText: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.
125233.translation: 沙漠是一头贪餍的野兽，能将骨肉砂石悉数吞没。

125234.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. 
• Destroy target artifact.
125234.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

125236.oracleText: Samut battled her way through the hordes, shouting the names of those who'd died in her crop and those she hoped yet to save.
125236.translation: 撒姆特在尸群中杀出一条血路，大声呼叫着阵亡团伴和希望尚能救出者的名字。

125237.oracleText: Put a -1/-1 counter on target creature. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that creature's controller.
125237.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。CARDNAME对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

125239.oracleText: "There is no afterlife. Not for me, and not for you. So think again before getting in my way."
125239.translation: 「哪有什么来世。我没有，你也不会有。所以在挡我道之前可得想清楚了。」

125240.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard a card: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

125242.oracleText:
"Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?"
—Nicol Bolas
125242.translation:
「火焰？茜卓，你就只会这点把戏？」
～尼可波拉斯

125243.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target red creature or red planeswalker. If that permanent is a Chandra planeswalker, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
125243.translation: CARDNAME对目标红色生物或红色鹏洛客造成5点伤害。如果该永久物是茜卓鹏洛客，则你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

125245.oracleText: The food chain doesn't end at sandwurms.
125245.translation: 处于食物链顶端的并不是沙丘亚龙。

125248.oracleText:
"We have to get out of the city, Djeru. All of us! Gather as many as you can."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate
125248.translation:
「杰鲁，我们得离开这座城市。全得离开！尽可能召集更多的人。」
～原塔哈祀群祀徒撒姆特

125249.oracleText: Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
125249.translation: 由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

125256.oracleText: "Everyone here is a honed fighter. We'll respond the only way we know how."
125256.translation: 「这里每个人都是百炼成钢的战士。我们会以自己掌握的唯一手段作出回应。」

125257.oracleText: {oT}, Exert CARDNAME: It deals 1 damage to target creature.
125257.translation: {oT}，耗竭CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成1点伤害。

125259.oracleText: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.
125259.translation: 一句复仇，她的箭矢便燃起了烈焰。

125260.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
125260.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

125264.oracleText: Those who fled the destruction of the city stumbled into the territory of their prickly neighbors.
125264.translation: 由于城市遭毁而出逃的人们又落入了他们多棘邻居的领地。

125268.oracleText:
"Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch."
—Nicol Bolas
125268.translation:
「此间万物的存亡由我定。包括你们，守护者。」
～尼可波拉斯

125269.oracleText: All creatures lose indestructible until end of turn. CARDNAME deals 5 damage to each creature and each non-Bolas planeswalker.
125269.translation: 所有生物失去不灭异能直到回合结束。CARDNAME对每个生物和每个非波拉斯的鹏洛客各造成5点伤害。

125277.oracleText: "There is no tomorrow, so hold nothing back."
125277.translation: 「已经没有明天了，倾尽全力吧。」

125278.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
125278.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

125281.oracleText: Sand into glass and flesh into ash—such are the markers of its domain.
125281.translation: 熔为玻璃的砂石和化作灰土的血肉～这些便是它领地的标志。

125282.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a -1/-1 counter on CARDNAME.
125282.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

125283.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, remove a -1/-1 counter from CARDNAME.
125283.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，从CARDNAME上移去一个-1/-1指示物。

125287.oracleText:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas
125287.translation:
「这便是荣耀的样子。」
～尼可波拉斯

125290.oracleText: Some khenra archers fashion their arrows with a personal touch.
125290.translation: 有些胡狼人弓箭手为自己的箭矢添上了个人特色。

125292.oracleText:
"Neither the false God-Pharaoh nor his bugs will decide our fate."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate
125292.translation:
「无论法老神还是他的那些害虫，都不能决定我们的命运。」
～原塔哈祀群祀徒撒姆特

125294.oracleText: The bombardment of sand disorients, chokes, and ultimately tenderizes its prey.
125294.translation: 在扬沙的冲击之下，它的猎物先是迷失方向，进而无法呼吸，最终全身麻痹。

125299.oracleText: The plating of its horns is a token of honor from Hazoret, who favors creatures with great hearts.
125299.translation: 勇猛生物深得哈佐蕾青睐，其角上覆辉便是荣耀象征。

125300.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, target creature can't block this turn.
125300.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，则目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

125306.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
125306.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。它对目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

125308.oracleText: Though buried and muffled, nature's whisper still called to Nissa.
125308.translation: 虽自然已遭黄砂深埋掩盖，妮莎仍能听闻其低语。

125318.oracleText: Once favored companions, many cats were left to fend for themselves.
125318.translation: 猫曾是许多人的钟爱同伴，如今大多只能自谋生路。

125323.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains reach until end of turn.
125323.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得延势异能。

125331.oracleText: Some refused to leave their shattered homes, vowing to rebuild at any cost.
125331.translation: 有些人拒绝离开自己破碎的家园，誓言不惜代价重建。

125332.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exert CARDNAME: Untap two target lands.

125334.oracleText:
"If you believe the God-Pharaoh tests you, charge with me to prove yourself. If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!"
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate
125334.translation:
「如果你认为这是法老神的祀炼，就随我冲锋来证明自己。如果你认为法老神已背叛我们，就与我并肩为明天而战！」
～原塔哈祀群祀徒撒姆特

125335.oracleText: You gain 4 life. If a creature died this turn, you gain 8 life instead.
125335.translation: 你获得4点生命。如果本回合中有生物死去，则改为你获得8点生命。

125337.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of creatures you control.
125337.translation: CARDNAME的力量与防御力各等同于由你操控的生物数量之两倍。

125340.oracleText:
"The soul of this world is gone, Nissa, and I would gladly kill it again."
—Nicol Bolas
125340.translation:
「妮莎，这世界的灵魂已不复存在，我也乐意让它再死一次。」
～尼可波拉斯

125341.oracleText: Destroy target Forest, green enchantment, or green planeswalker. If that permanent was a Nissa planeswalker, draw a card.
125341.translation: 消灭目标树林，绿色结界或绿色鹏洛客。如果该永久物是妮莎鹏洛客，则抓一张牌。

125343.oracleText: "It's only the end if we allow it."

125346.oracleText:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer
125346.translation:
「前进！拿下地平线！」
～御夫凯齐兹

125347.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.
125347.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

125349.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each other Cat you control.
125349.translation: 你每操控一个其他的猫，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

125350.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Exert CARDNAME: Create two 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink.
125350.translation: {oW}，{oT}，耗竭CARDNAME：派出两个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物。

125357.oracleText: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."
125357.translation: 「这个世界曾在拿塔蒙屏障之外也有广阔天地。」

125369.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn and can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
125369.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束，且本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

125371.oracleText:
"Those who embrace the harsh land rather than fight it find they have a powerful ally."
—Nissa Revane
125371.translation:
「面对险恶地况，积极适应比消极对抗更能将其间地利为己所用。」
～妮莎瑞文

125372.oracleText: As long as you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and has trample.
125372.translation: 只要你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

125374.oracleText:
"Rhonas's monument belongs to the wurms now. Look elsewhere for refuge."
—Arnun, vizier of the menagerie
