229312.oracleText: Each player returns two land cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
229312.translation: 每位牌手各将两张地牌从其坟墓场移回战场。

229313.oracleText: Each player returns two land cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
229313.translation: 每位牌手各将两张地牌从其坟墓场移回战场。

229349.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control CARDNAME.
229349.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

229362.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control CARDNAME.
229362.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

229364.oracleText: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.
229364.translation: 唯有显威之时，方能见证内心之力。

229365.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+7 until end of turn.
229365.translation: 目标生物得+1/+7直到回合结束。

229367.oracleText: Most smiths shape metal, but some prefer more delicate materials.
229367.translation: 大多数工匠都在打造金属，但有些则偏好使用更精巧的原料。

229368.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target artifact creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
229368.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的神器生物得+2/+2且获得不灭异能。

229370.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
229370.translation: 在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

229372.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create three 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink.
229372.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出三个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物。

229373.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, create three 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink."
229373.translation: 你获得具有「在你的结束步骤开始时，派出三个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物」的徽记。

229375.oracleText: Whenever a creature or planeswalker you control dies, you may sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, create a 4/4 white Avatar creature token with flying.
229375.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客死去时，你可以牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的圣者衍生生物。

229376.oracleText: When a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard this card, if you control a Plains, create a 4/4 white Avatar creature token with flying.
229376.translation: 当由对手操控的咒语或异能使得你弃掉此牌时，若你操控平原，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的圣者衍生生物。

229378.oracleText: "You cannot defend others if your own well-being is neglected."
229378.translation: 「罔顾自身福祉，便无暇保护他人。」

229381.oracleText: She sings for all those who have been silenced.

229385.oracleText: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.
229385.translation: 在生命的最后时刻，恶魔仰望天空，眼中只见至纯光辉。

229386.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy all creatures. 
• Destroy all artifacts and enchantments.
229386.translation:
选择一项～
•消灭所有生物。
•消灭所有神器和结界。

229388.oracleText: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."
229388.translation: 「愿明光照我身，引领迷途之人。」

229390.oracleText: "These storied halls are under my protection."
229390.translation: 「这些宏伟大厅悉数由我保护。」

229392.oracleText: "Our duty does not stop at our borders."
229392.translation: 「我们的职责不只是守卫边境。」

229394.oracleText: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.
229394.translation: 僧侣祈救赎；士兵求胜利；两者皆得应。

229395.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you gain 2 life.
229395.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你获得2点生命。

229397.translation: 法律既有保护，也有惩罚。

229399.oracleText: Threefold were his crimes, doubled were his pleas, singular was his fate.
229399.translation: 三重罪行，两倍求饶，一生孤独。

229404.oracleText: "As long as my faith persists, so shall I."
229404.translation: 「抱持坚定信念，便能屹立不摇。」

229406.oracleText: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."
229406.translation: 「旁观者与作恶者无异，都应遭人唾弃。」

229408.oracleText: Sacrifice Lena: Creatures you control with power less than Lena's power gain indestructible until end of turn.
229408.translation: 牺牲莉娜：由你操控且力量小于莉娜的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

229410.oracleText: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.
229410.translation: 最优秀的战士既善于致伤，亦精于治伤。

229411.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you gain 1 life.
229411.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多生物，则CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束，且你获得1点生命。

229413.oracleText: When one leonin hunts, many more are surely nearby.
229413.translation: 狮族一人狩猎，多人必不远之。

229414.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create two 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink that are tapped and attacking.
229414.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出两个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。

229416.oracleText: Loxodons are firm in stature and spirit. No matter the odds, they are always first into battle.
229416.translation: 象族身心强健。无论胜算几何，他们总会率先参加战斗。

229420.oracleText: Even the greatest hero begins with nothing.
229420.translation: 就算是最伟大的英雄，刚起步时也是一张白纸。

229421.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is enchanted or equipped, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
229421.translation: 只要CARDNAME上结附了灵气或佩带了武具，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

229422.oracleText: The leonin of Oreskos are quick to take offense—not because they are thin-skinned, but because they are always ready for a fight.
229422.translation: 俄瑞恣狮族的性情火爆并不是因为敏感易怒，而是因为天性好战。

229424.oracleText: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.
229424.translation: 假意奉供一生也换不来永世安息。

229427.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained 5 or more life this turn, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
229427.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中你获得了5点或更多生命，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使衍生生物。

229428.oracleText: {o3oWoWoW}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 and gains lifelink.
229428.translation: {o3oWoWoW}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+2/+2且获得系命异能。

229430.oracleText:
"A potion is no substitute for a skilled surgeon, but it will hold your bits in."
—Torricks, battlefield medic
229430.translation:
「药水虽代替不了妙手回春的医士，但好歹能堵上你的伤口。」
～战场医护员托瑞克

229432.oracleText: Native to wide prairies and scrublands, falcons occasionally roost in dragon skeletons.
229432.translation: 猎鹰以辽阔草原与灌丛为家，偶而在龙骸上停歇。

229434.oracleText: When it passes, order defeats chaos.
229434.translation: 所经之处，守序之秩压乱世。

229437.oracleText: White as starlight on snow, it appears only on the eve of the winter solstice.
229437.translation: 此鹿洁白如雪上星光，唯冬至前夜方现世间。

229439.oracleText: Remove all counters from target creature. It can't have counters put on it for as long as CARDNAME remains on the battlefield.
229439.translation: 移去目标生物上的所有指示物。于CARDNAME仍在战场上的时段内，该生物上不能放置指示物。

229440.oracleText: Target opponent loses all counters. That player can't get counters for as long as CARDNAME remains on the battlefield.
229440.translation: 目标对手失去所有指示物。于CARDNAME仍在战场上的时段内，该牌手不能得到指示物。

229443.oracleText: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."
229443.translation: 「你的死亡抚慰人心，你的离世彰显天理；闻听你已毙命，所有人都将如释重负。」

229445.oracleText:
"Margaret has traveled with me to the end of the world and back."
—Hewen Frit, merchant
229445.translation:
「玛格丽特已经伴我往返于天涯海角。」
～商人赫文费特

229448.oracleText: "Defeat is no reason for retreat. It is a sign we must redouble our efforts to win this fight."
229448.translation: 「失败不是撤退的理由。而是警示我们必须多付出双倍努力才能赢下这场战斗。」

229449.translation: 由你操控的其他骑士得+1/+1。

229450.oracleText: {o3oWoW}: Knights you control gain double strike until end of turn.
229450.translation: {o3oWoW}：由你操控的骑士获得连击异能直到回合结束。

229452.oracleText: If you can't find a doorway, make one.
229452.translation: 如果你找不到门路，那就自己造一条。

229453.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
229453.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

229455.oracleText: "My skill sharpens with each beat of my wings."
229455.translation: 「我的双翼扑扇一次，技艺便精湛一分。」

229456.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
229456.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

229458.oracleText: "They say perfection is unattainable, but they said that about flight too."
229458.translation: 「他们口口声声说完美不可及，但他们之前对飞行也是这态度。」

229459.oracleText: "I decide what stands in my way."

229461.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked except by Spirits.

229462.oracleText: {o3oU}: Another target creature you control can't be blocked this turn except by Spirits.
229462.translation: {o3oU}：另一个目标由你操控的生物本回合只能被精怪阻挡。

229463.oracleText: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."
229463.translation: 「星相记录了你的命途。接受由此揭露的命运吧。」

229465.oracleText: The collection didn't have room to expand, so the wizard improvised a solution.
229465.translation: 由于无处摆放更多藏品，法术师即兴想出了一个解决方法。

229466.oracleText: When enchanted creature blocks, destroy it.
229466.translation: 当所结附的生物进行阻挡时，将它消灭。

229468.oracleText: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.
229468.translation: 胜利之路，从挑选打得过的对手开始。

229470.oracleText:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler
229470.translation:
「钓上来。不对，等等！抛回去！」
～深海钓客格楚德

229471.oracleText: {o5oUoU}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.

229473.oracleText: Young artificers on Kaladesh let their imaginations run wild.
229473.translation: 卡拉德许的年轻神器师会任由自身想象尽情发挥。

229477.oracleText: Enchanted creature is a copy of the chosen creature.
229477.translation: 所结附的生物是所选生物的复制品。

229479.oracleText: The life of a shapeshifter is one of constant change.
229479.translation: 变形兽的生活也在一直变化。

229482.oracleText: Hospitality is of little concern to those who do not wish to be disturbed.
229482.translation: 不愿受扰者从不讲究什么待客之道。

229485.oracleText: The delight of discovery drives the pursuit of knowledge.
229485.translation: 发现之喜推动求知之道。

229488.oracleText:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret
229488.translation:
「在我把时空渡桥拼接到身上时，我感到自己的鹏洛客火花闪耀全身。整个多重宇宙都是我的玩物。这感觉…无与伦比。」
～泰兹瑞

229491.oracleText: Nicol Bolas would not rest until he was restored to his former glory.
229491.translation: 不重振昔日雄风，尼可波拉斯誓不罢休。

229494.oracleText:
"To break another's mind is to deliver a fate worse than death. It is a terrifying power."
—Jace Beleren
229494.translation:
「粉碎心灵会让对方生不如死。这种力量令人恐惧。」
～杰斯贝连

229497.oracleText: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."
229497.translation: 「量产品若不加修饰，产出物与垃圾无异。」

229498.oracleText: {o1oU}, Sacrifice two artifacts: Draw a card.

229500.oracleText: The greatest treasure of the deep is an echo from above.
229500.translation: 深洋中最珍贵的宝物，恰也是水面上备受重视之物。

229502.oracleText: "The path of the stars is as reliable as the instruments that measure them."
229502.translation: 「星辰的行迹稳定不变，如同量测它们的工具。」

229507.oracleText: A king's knowledge does not vanish when the heart stops beating.
229507.translation: 国王的智识不会随着心脏停止跳动而消逝。

229508.translation: 由你操控的其他精怪得+1/+1。

229510.oracleText: When it passes, waves touch the sky.
229510.translation: 所经之处，骇浪惊涛高及天。

229511.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
229511.translation: 每当CARDNAME向任一对手造成伤害时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

229512.oracleText: {o1oU}: CARDNAME gets +2/-2 until end of turn.

229514.oracleText: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
229514.translation: 派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。你获得1点生命。

229515.oracleText: Draw a card. If you control three or more artifacts, draw two cards instead.
229515.translation: 抓一张牌。如果你操控三个或更多神器，则改为抓两张牌。

229519.oracleText: The cold slowed their movements until only their panicked eyeballs swiveled beneath the ice.
229519.translation: 他们的动作因严寒不断减慢，不久就只剩下惊恐的眼睛在寒冰底下乱转。

229521.oracleText: The seafloor is flecked with the bones of fools who dared to sail into the mist.
229521.translation: 原本敢于深入迷雾的诸位勇士，如今都已化作尸骨散落海底。

229523.translation: 希望逝去之后，便靠不屈求存。

229525.oracleText: Predicting the future is a messy business.

229526.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
229526.translation: 牺牲一个生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

229528.oracleText:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid
229528.translation:
「它们虽然个头大，但都是温顺的食草动物。小心靠近，然后口中哼点小曲，让它们知道你没有恶意。」
～薇薇安瑞德

229530.oracleText: Its roar is the clatter of a thousand bones.
229530.translation: 身上骨骸敲击，便是其咆哮怒吼。

229533.oracleText: A pit yawned open, a column of oily smoke arose, and a towering form hissed, "I accept this offering."
229533.translation: 暗渊打开，污烟升起，只闻一道巨影低语：「我收下这份祭礼。」

229535.oracleText: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."
229535.translation: 「肉香浓郁，稍带一丝皮味。实属佳酿。」

229538.oracleText: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.
229538.translation: 世界愈合疗愈了多重宇宙，同时也打乱了尼可波拉斯的力量之源。

229541.oracleText:
"Rise and shine, my dears. We have work to do."
—Isareth the Awakener
229541.translation:
「起来开工，伙计们。准备做事了。」
～唤尸依萨蕾

229542.oracleText: {o2oB}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
229542.translation: {o2oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

229544.oracleText: "If you want them dead, buy some poison. If you want them to have the worst day of their life before dying, then let's talk price."
229544.translation: 「如果你想要他们的命，自己买药去下毒就好。如果你想让他们在丧命前『好好』过上最后一天，那我们来谈谈价格吧。」

229546.oracleText: "When these intruders are gone, Zendikar will be my throne, my palace, my playground."
229546.translation: 「待这些入侵者都消失殆尽，赞迪卡便会成为我的宝座，我的宫殿，我的乐园。」

229547.oracleText: Exile target colorless creature. You gain life equal to its power.
229547.translation: 放逐目标无色生物。你获得等同于其力量的生命。

229551.oracleText: A lich must consume mortal souls to feed its eternal life.
229551.translation: 巫妖须不断吸食生者灵魂，方能维系自己的永恒生命。

229552.oracleText: Destroy target creature. You gain 3 life.
229552.translation: 消灭目标生物。你获得3点生命。

229555.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Zombies you control.
229555.translation: 目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的灵俑数量。

229558.translation: 长生不死值得付出一切代价去争取。

229560.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control four or more Demons with different names, you win the game.
229560.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控四个或更多恶魔，且其名称各不相同，则你赢得这盘游戏。

229562.oracleText: That feeling of something on your chest is usually sleep paralysis. Occasionally, it's something else.
229562.translation: 睡时感觉有异物压胸通常只是睡瘫症，但有时真是鬼压身。

229563.oracleText: You gain 1 life. Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
229563.translation: 你获得1点生命。目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你于本回合中所获得的生命数量。

229565.oracleText: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.
229565.translation: 原本只是个寻常夜晚，但很快就会让人永生难忘。

229566.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
229566.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

229568.oracleText: When it passes, those who sleep dream of sickness and death.
229568.translation: 所经之处，沉沉眠者梦厉疾。

229571.oracleText: A harpy's hoard is a filthy, bloodstained pile of trinkets and corpses.
229571.translation: 哈痞的藏品是一堆肮脏染血的琐物和死尸。

229572.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
229572.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

229574.oracleText:
"When it comes to killing with precision, a soul is but a hindrance."
—Isareth the Awakener
229574.translation:
「需要精准击杀时，灵魂只会成为障碍。」
～唤尸依萨蕾

229577.oracleText:
"You have given all to your kingdom, dear knight. Serenity shall be your prize."
—Queen Lian
229577.translation:
「骑士，你已为国家奉献一切。安眠是你应得的嘉奖。」
～丽安女王

229578.oracleText: Target player loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
229578.translation: 目标牌手失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

229583.oracleText: Imagine a thousand tiny mushrooms cropping up within your lungs.
229583.translation: 想象一下你的肺中冒出千朵蘑菇。

229585.oracleText:
"Thread the torsos together with angel hair to ensure they will cooperate in battle."
—The Stitcher's Tome
229585.translation:
「用天使头发缝合尸身，便能确保他们在战斗中互相合作。」
～《拼接师文典》

229587.oracleText: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.
229587.translation: 或有一天，他们会成为致命与优雅并存的典范。但眼下他们只有饱食之欲。

229588.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
229588.translation: {o2}，{oT}：每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

229590.translation:
「效忠于我，会得嘉奖。」
～丽安女王

229595.oracleText: Lands your opponents control with the chosen name lose all land types and abilities, and they gain "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
229595.translation: 由对手操控且具有该名称的地失去所有地类别和异能，且获得「{oT}：加一点任一颜色的法术力。」

229597.oracleText:
"As I desire, so it shall be."
—Nicol Bolas
229597.translation:
「吾之所欲，必能成型。」
～尼可波拉斯

229599.oracleText: If this spell was cast from your hand, add ten mana of any one color.
229599.translation: 如果此咒语是从你手上施放，则加十点任意颜色的单色法术力。

229601.oracleText: As the hyperstormic generator crept past redline, a being emerged from the arc.
229601.translation: 超风暴发生器一过临界值，电弧中便冒出一个生物。

229604.oracleText: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

229605.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a creature: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
229605.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个生物：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

229607.oracleText: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.
229607.translation: 骑士与爱马之间的不渝忠诚也只能到此为止。

229611.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 4 damage to target creature.
229611.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成4点伤害。

229613.oracleText: First the insult, then the encore.

229614.oracleText: When you cast your next instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
229614.translation: 本回合中，当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

229617.oracleText: It treads on feet of coals and strikes with the force of a volcano.
229617.translation: 它踏着煤炭的脚步，以火山的威力攻击。

229622.translation: 微言细语亦能煽起熊熊烈焰。

229624.oracleText: "Folks 'round here are too in love with their contraptions. Does them some good if we smash one every so often."
229624.translation: 「这里的人过度迷恋自己的发明。不时砸掉一些对他们有好处。」

229625.translation: 由你操控的其他鬼怪得+1/+1。

229626.oracleText: Sacrifice a Goblin: Destroy target artifact.
229626.translation: 牺牲一个鬼怪：消灭目标神器。

229627.oracleText: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"
229627.translation: 「我发现一件新玩具。一起玩吗？」

229629.oracleText: For devils, burning things is the highest form of comedy, diversion, and artistic expression.
229629.translation: 在魔鬼的眼里，烧东西便是喜剧、欺敌和艺术表现的集大成之作。

229631.oracleText: The bellow of a minotaur always translates to "charge."
229631.translation: 牛头怪的嚎吼永远都意味着「冲锋」。

229633.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if CARDNAME attacked or blocked this turn, its owner shuffles it into their library.
229633.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若CARDNAME本回合曾进行攻击或阻挡，则其拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

229636.oracleText: {o1oR}: Dragons you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
229636.translation: {o1oR}：由你操控的龙得+1/+0直到回合结束。

229637.oracleText: When it passes, storm clouds bolt across the land.
229637.translation: 所经之处，暴风雷云盖世间。

229640.oracleText: The ogres you know are nothing like the Onakke. Possessing both intellect and industry, they had brute strength without being brutish.
229640.translation: 欧纳克一族和你所知的食人魔完全不同。他们聪明又勤奋，身怀蛮力却不粗蛮。

229642.oracleText: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
229642.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

229643.oracleText: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast Dragon spells.
229643.translation: 加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放龙咒语。

229644.oracleText: Create four 5/5 red Dragon creature tokens with flying.
229644.translation: 派出四个5/5红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

229646.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 4, 5, or 6, CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target.
229646.translation: 每当你施放力量为4，5或6的生物咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

229647.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 7 or greater, CARDNAME deals 4 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.
229647.translation: 每当你施放力量等于或大于7的生物咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。

229649.oracleText: No rampart can withstand the fury of a giant.
229649.translation: 没有壁垒能挡得住巨人的怒火。

229650.oracleText: {o3oR}: Target creature can't block this turn.
229650.translation: {o3oR}：目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

229651.oracleText: The creation of new weapons demands the destruction of others.

229653.oracleText: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.
229653.translation: 愚钝之人以为寇安甘一脉的龙群随闪电风暴而行。智者知道事实正相反。

229659.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target.
229659.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量。

229660.oracleText: The sound of the trumpets lights a fire in the hearts of the bold and snuffs the courage of the cowardly.
229660.translation: 号角声点亮了勇者心中的火焰，掐灭了懦夫仅剩的勇气。

229662.oracleText: "I trained with the Ghitu, and I respect the fire as they do."
229662.translation: 「我和基图部落一同训练，和他们一样崇敬火焰。」

229668.oracleText:
"Nicol Bolas destroyed my world. I owe it to Skalla to celebrate all life, no matter how dangerous."
—Vivien Reid
229668.translation:
「尼可波拉斯毁灭了我的世界。为了斯凯拉，我要赞颂所有生命，无论他们有多危险。」
～薇薇安瑞德

229670.oracleText:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight
229670.translation:
「强威不仅能建立帝国；它还能守护帝国。」
～烈阳帝国骑士因缇

229671.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
229671.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则抓一张牌。

229672.oracleText: Its ventricles weep venom, and it consumes only poison.
229672.translation: 它的心房内流淌着毒液，平日只食毒物。

229674.oracleText:
"If you think yourself a chief, then prove your might."
—Gar-Tun, Mistvalley silverback
229674.translation:
「如果你自诩族长，那就证明你的力量。」
～雾谷银背葛顿

229675.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. All creatures able to block it this turn do so.
229675.translation: 目标生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。本回合中，所有能够阻挡它的生物皆须阻挡之。

229677.oracleText: No welcome for those who trespass. Only fang and horn and claw.
229677.translation: 侵入者不会受到欢迎。只会见到尖牙、长角和利爪。

229678.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Aura spell that targets CARDNAME, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
229678.translation: 每当你施放一个以CARDNAME为目标的灵气咒语时，派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

229680.oracleText: "The land already knows its destiny. I simply ask it to share the tale with me."
229680.translation: 「大地早已知晓自己的命运。我不过是求其与我分享。」

229681.oracleText: {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.
229681.translation: {oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是地牌，你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。

229683.oracleText: No single root feeds the forest.

229684.translation: 由你操控的其他妖精得+1/+1。

229689.oracleText: They grow closer with every passing season.
229689.translation: 每过一季他们便靠近一些。

229690.oracleText:
"After everything I've survived, it's hard to be frightened by anything anymore."
—Vivien Reid
229690.translation:
「经过种种历难之后，再也没有什么东西能吓到我了。」
～薇薇安瑞德

229692.oracleText:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid
229692.translation:
「每颗巨齿都有一匹马那般长，每隔十六天还会新长出一批。我们来仔细瞧瞧！」
～薇薇安瑞德

229694.oracleText: You don't want to know how she got that name.
229694.translation: 你不会想知道她因何得名。

229695.oracleText: Creature spells you cast with power 4 or greater cost {o2} less to cast.
229695.translation: 由你施放且力量等于或大于4的生物咒语减少{o2}来施放。

229696.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, each creature you control with power 4 or greater gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
229696.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，直到回合结束，每个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物各得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

229698.oracleText: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.
229698.translation: 在林地外一哩的范围内，你就能感受到她的目光。在林地之内，你就能感受到她的利刃。

229699.oracleText:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon Arel's head. She hears the wisdom of our ancestors."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice
229699.translation:
「猎杀一头雄鹿，把犄角绑在阿瑞尔头上。她能听见先祖的智慧。」
～通灵祭师恰努尔

229701.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, put that many +1/+1 counters on it.
229701.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，在其上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

229703.oracleText:
"Look how cute it is now!"
—Vivien Reid
229703.translation:
「瞧瞧它现在多可爱呀！」
～薇薇安瑞德

229704.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +7/+7 and has trample.
229704.translation: 所结附的生物得+7/+7且具有践踏异能。

229705.oracleText: "The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."
229705.translation: 「逝者的骨骸会诉说他们的故事～只要你了解他们的语言。」

229707.oracleText: "The further into the future I look, the less certain my vision. Even now, the middle distance is obscured by fire."
229707.translation: 「我望向未来，看得越远，我的预示就越难确定。即使是现在，中间不远处也因火焰而变得模糊不清。」

229709.oracleText: The only casualties were a snapped spear, a lost helmet, and some bruised egos.
229709.translation: 仅有的战损是折断一柄长矛，丢失一顶头盔，以及丧失部分信心。

229711.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a creature or land that isn't a mana ability, you may draw a card.
229711.translation: 每当任一对手起动生物或地上不属法术力异能之异能时，你可以抓一张牌。

229712.oracleText:
"Whether we like it or not, our arrival has altered the landscape."
—Malcolm, navigator of the Belligerent
229712.translation:
「不管怎样，我们的到来已经改变了地境。」
～好战者号领航员马科姆

229716.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
229716.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

229719.oracleText: When it passes, the dead are displaced by flourishing life.
229719.translation: 所经之处，枯骨朽尸展新碧。

229721.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229721.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物或地牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229722.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
229722.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。

229723.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have vigilance, trample, and indestructible.
229723.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2且具有警戒，践踏与不灭异能

229724.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have vigilance, trample, and indestructible."
229724.translation: 你获得具有「由你操控的生物得+2/+2且具有警戒，践踏与不灭异能」的徽记。

229725.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. When a creature is put onto the battlefield this way, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
229725.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以将其中一张生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。当以此法将生物放进战场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

229727.oracleText: The best of their trade know every bolt of their rigs, stem to stern.
229727.translation: 业内最顶尖的人熟悉从船头到船尾的每一颗螺栓。

229728.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and has flying.
229728.translation: 只要你操控神器，CARDNAME便得+2/+0且具有飞行异能。

229731.oracleText: Each creature you control with defender assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power and can attack as though it didn't have defender.
229731.translation: 每个由你操控且具守军异能的生物皆依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量；且能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

229733.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
229733.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

229734.oracleText: Discard a card: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a Human with base power and toughness 1/1, loses all abilities, and gains hexproof. It can't be blocked this turn.
229734.translation: 弃一张牌：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为基础力量与防御力为1/1的人类，失去所有异能，并获得辟邪异能。它本回合不能被阻挡。

229736.oracleText: {o7}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.
229736.translation: {o7}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个5/5红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

229737.oracleText: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets beyond imagining. Many have become meals trying to learn them.
229737.translation: 祀徒相信它身上藏有远超想象的秘密。但大多数想要解开秘密的人都成了它的盘中餐。

229739.oracleText: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.
229739.translation: 苦痛呻吟迅速唤来行动呐喊。

229740.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens. Until end of turn, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain haste.
229740.translation: 派出两个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得敏捷异能。

229744.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 10 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
229744.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成10点伤害。

229745.oracleText: Put target creature or planeswalker card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
229745.translation: 将目标生物或鹏洛客牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

229746.oracleText: Exile all but the bottom card of target player's library.
229746.translation: 放逐目标牌手牌库中除了最后一张以外的所有牌。

229748.oracleText: Sister of Nicol Bolas. Survivor of the Elder Dragon War. The most vicious of her kin.
229748.translation: 尼可波拉斯的妹妹。长老龙之战的幸存者。在其族内最为残暴。

229749.oracleText: CARDNAME has hexproof if it hasn't dealt damage yet.
229749.translation: 如果CARDNAME还没造成过伤害，则它具有辟邪异能。

229750.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
229750.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

229752.oracleText: "I turn around and see nothing, yet I know it is behind me. Its fingers rummage in my mind, crafting new ideas."
229752.translation: 「我转身望去，什么也没看见，但我确信它就在身后。它的手指在我脑中拨弄，正欲构筑全新思想。」

229755.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
229755.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中你曾获得生命，则派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

229757.oracleText: "The threads of magic that protect this place were woven by my will."
229757.translation: 「保护此地的缕缕魔法由我的意志织成。」

229759.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oGoU}. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control, and that creature gains flying until end of turn.
229759.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oGoU}。当你如此作时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且该生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

229761.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, for each player, choose target permanent that player controls. Those players sacrifice those permanents. Each player who sacrificed a permanent this way reveals the top card of their library, then puts it onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card.
229761.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，为每位牌手各选择目标由该牌手操控的永久物。这些牌手牺牲这些永久物。每位以此法牺牲永久物的牌手各展示其牌库顶牌，然后如果它是永久物牌，该牌手便将它放进战场。

229763.oracleText: Whenever you become the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {o1}.
229763.translation: 每当你成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，除非该咒语或异能的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

229766.oracleText: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.
229766.translation: 知识本身无正邪之分。不法之徒手持善典也能毁灭世界，而正义之士手持恶籍也能拯救众生。

229769.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant or sorcery card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of that library in a random order.
229769.translation: {o4}，{oT}：目标对手从其牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张瞬间或法术牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。然后将所有以此法放逐且未施放的牌以随机顺序置于该牌库底。

229770.oracleText: The grave robbers were startled, for the door to the mausoleum was already open.
229770.translation: 盗墓者看到陵墓大门早已洞开，自己也受惊不浅。

229771.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
229771.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

229773.translation: 所经之处，七彩虹霓紧相随。

229777.oracleText: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.
229777.translation: 不少商人打过出售泉水的念头，但却没人成功。无论水中蕴含何种魔法，一经装瓶便都消失无踪。

229780.oracleText: Made in its creator's image, though slightly more clangy.
229780.translation: 依创造者想象而建，只是更为浮夸。

229781.oracleText: Planeswalkers seek out great monuments throughout the Multiverse, knowing that their builders were unwittingly drawn by the convergence of mana in the area.
229781.translation: 鹏洛客在多重宇宙间寻找巨大纪念碑，因为他们晓得其建造者是不自觉地受该处聚集的法术力吸引而来。

229782.oracleText: A sharp axe solves most problems.
229782.translation: 利斧在手，能解决大多数问题。

229783.oracleText: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.
229783.translation: 冲击将士兵四散震飞～随后坑中有人影起身。

229785.oracleText: Thievery requires subtlety, from the beginning of the heist to the end.
229785.translation: 盗窃需要从始至终都心细。

229787.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0, has vigilance, and is a Knight in addition to its other types.
229787.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0，具有警戒异能，且额外具有骑士此类别。

229788.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance that's attacking.
229788.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物，且正进行攻击。

229790.oracleText: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.
229790.translation: 市议会广泛使用扑翼机，多数是为了搜集敌对议员的污点。

229795.oracleText: Its light exposes enemies and lays secrets bare.
229795.translation: 它的灯光能暴露敌人，揭露秘密。

229796.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Until end of turn, your opponents and creatures your opponents control with hexproof can be the targets of spells and abilities you control as though they didn't have hexproof.
229796.translation: {o1}，{oT}：直到回合结束，对具辟邪异能的对手及由对手操控且具该异能的生物而言，你能将其视同不具该异能地指定为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标。

229797.oracleText: The most holy treasures are kept far from unclean soil.
229797.translation: 最神圣的珍宝存放在远离不洁土壤之处。

229798.oracleText: The bedrock has many gifts to give.

229799.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
229799.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

229801.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a white card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229801.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张白色牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229803.oracleText:
"The healers of Bant are second to none. I owe them a great deal for their tutelage."
—Ajani Goldmane
229803.translation:
「班特治疗师的医术举世无双。他们的指导让我受益良多。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

229805.oracleText: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.
229805.translation: 她像撒拉守护众生一般保卫全城。

229807.oracleText: A pair of domesticated griffins escaped from captivity a century ago. Now the skies are filled with the songs of their descendants.
229807.translation: 百年前，一对驯养狮鹫逃出囚笼。如今其后裔的歌声响彻云际。

229815.oracleText: {o5oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control can't be blocked this turn.
229815.translation: {o5oU}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

229817.oracleText: As long as you control a Tezzeret planeswalker, CARDNAME has menace.
229817.translation: 只要你操控泰兹瑞鹏洛客，CARDNAME便具有威慑异能。

229820.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
229820.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

229821.oracleText: Destroy up to two target creatures. Put up to two creature cards from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
229821.translation: 消灭至多两个目标生物。将至多两张生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

229822.oracleText:
"I'm not picky about what comes up, but the less decay, the better."
—Liliana Vess
229822.translation:
「我对唤起的东西并不挑剔，不过腐烂程度越低越好。」
～莉莲娜维斯

229823.oracleText: CARDNAME has deathtouch as long as you control a Liliana planeswalker.
229823.translation: 只要你操控莉莲娜鹏洛客，CARDNAME便具有死触异能。

229824.oracleText: Once every seven years it flies on spectral wings over the moors of ancient battlefields.
229824.translation: 每隔七年，它就会扇起魂魅之翼，飞越曾为厮杀战场的漫漫荒野。

229825.oracleText: {o5oBoB}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
229825.translation: {o5oBoB}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

229827.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a black card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229827.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张黑色牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229828.oracleText: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city of Naktamun crave only to spread their curse.
229828.translation: 他们死后漂浪在拿塔蒙城护帘之外，唯愿能有更多的人遭受这般诅咒。

229829.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature your opponents control.
229829.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

229830.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
229830.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

229832.oracleText: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."
229832.translation: 「给予龙应有的尊重者，才配冠上我们的称号。」

229833.oracleText: As long as you control a Dragon, CARDNAME has flying.
229833.translation: 只要你操控龙，CARDNAME便具有飞行异能。

229835.oracleText: "I am most myself when I am least human."

229836.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a red card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229836.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张红色牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229838.oracleText: Whenever you activate an ability of a Sarkhan planeswalker, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
229838.translation: 每当你起动萨坎鹏洛客的异能时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

229840.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
229840.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

229842.oracleText:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid
229842.translation:
「从后方靠近。这样就算它暴冲，你也不会立刻遭殃。」
～薇薇安瑞德

229844.oracleText:
"This imprint was the familiar of a friend."
—Vivien Reid
229844.translation:
「这印记来自一位朋友的佣兽。」
～薇薇安瑞德

229847.oracleText: "Would you rather feel the edge of my blade or the sharpness of my fangs?"
229847.translation: 「你是想尝尝我的利刃还是我的尖牙？」

229849.oracleText: Each of Vivien's arrows is an invocation of a species.
229849.translation: 薇薇安每枝箭都是一种生灵的具现。

229851.oracleText: Sarkhan wandered into a tomb and back in time.
229851.translation: 萨坎步入一处坟墓，然后回到了过去。

229852.oracleText: Just as the sun rises at dawn and the days lengthen in summer, the Sun Empire has awakened after long years of quiet.
229852.translation: 如同破晓日升，夏昼渐长，烈阳帝国在沉寂多年后已然觉醒。

229853.oracleText: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against enemy forces.
229853.translation: 川流使凭借无匹匿踪绝技，与敌对势力拉锯对抗。

229861.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control, and that creature gains flying until end of turn.

273045.translation: 刺探2，然后抓两张牌。CARDNAME对你造成2点伤害。

273050.oracleText: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
273050.translation: 检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张置入你的坟墓场。

273051.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature equal to the total number of instant and sorcery cards you own in exile and in your graveyard.
273051.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于放逐区中由你拥有之瞬间与法术牌数量和你坟墓场中这两类牌数量的加总。

273053.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this emblem deals 4 damage to any target and you draw two cards.
273053.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成4点伤害且你抓两张牌

273054.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this emblem deals 4 damage to any target and you draw two cards."
273054.translation: 你获得具有「每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成4点伤害且你抓两张牌」的徽记。

273061.oracleText: Tap target creature. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that creature's controller.
273061.translation: 横置目标生物。CARDNAME对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

273062.oracleText: Tap target creature. Sonic Assault deals 2 damage to that creature's controller.
273062.translation: 横置目标生物。音波来袭对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

273066.oracleText: {o4oB}, {oT}: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain menace until end of turn.
273066.translation: {o4oB}，{oT}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

273069.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to each creature defending player controls.
273069.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对由防御牌手操控的每个生物各造成1点伤害。

273073.oracleText: Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to other creatures you control.
273073.translation: 防止将对由你操控的其他生物造成的所有非战斗伤害。

273080.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy it for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.
273080.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你本回合于此咒语之前每施放过一个瞬间或法术咒语，便将此咒语复制一次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

273084.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each player gains control of all creatures they own.
273084.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每位牌手各获得所有由其拥有之生物的操控权。

273086.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target player.
273086.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，它对目标牌手造成等量的伤害。

273089.oracleText: Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn. Then target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
273089.translation: 由你操控的生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。然后目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

273092.oracleText: If you would draw a card, instead look at the top three cards of your library, then put one into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
273092.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌，则改为检视你牌库顶的三张牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

273093.oracleText: Pay 4 life: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
273093.translation: 支付4点生命：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

273098.oracleText: You may sacrifice another permanent. If you do, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
273098.translation: 你可以牺牲另一个永久物。若你如此作，则你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

273100.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game.
273100.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏

273101.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game."
273101.translation: 你获得具有「每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏」的徽记。

273106.oracleText: As long as it's your turn, CARDNAME has first strike.
273106.translation: 只要是在你的回合中，CARDNAME具有先攻异能。

273109.oracleText: As long as you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender.
273109.translation: 只要你本回合施放过瞬间或法术咒语，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

273116.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
273116.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

273117.oracleText: Create three 2/2 green and white Elf Knight creature tokens with vigilance.
273117.translation: 派出三个2/2，绿白双色，具警戒异能的妖精／骑士衍生生物。

273121.oracleText: Gain control of target creature with power 2 or less.
273121.translation: 获得目标力量等于或小于2的生物之操控权。

273122.oracleText: Surveil 3, then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
273122.translation: 刺探3，然后将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

273132.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. Target player draws X cards.
273132.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。目标牌手抓X张牌。

273133.oracleText: Expansion // Explosion deals X damage to any target. Target player draws X cards.
273133.translation: 迸裂对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。目标牌手抓X张牌。

273136.oracleText: Explosion deals X damage to any target. Target player draws X cards.
273136.translation: 迸裂对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。目标牌手抓X张牌。

273138.oracleText: You may put two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control. Then all creatures get -4/-4 until end of turn.
273138.translation: 你可以在一个由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。然后所有生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。

273153.oracleText: Response // Resurgence deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
273153.translation: 回击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成5点伤害。

273154.oracleText: Creatures you control gain first strike and vigilance until end of turn. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase.
273154.translation: 由你操控的生物获得先攻与警戒异能直到回合结束。在此行动阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段，以及接于其后之一个额外的行动阶段。

273155.oracleText: Response deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
273155.translation: 回击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成5点伤害。

273158.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
273158.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得死触异能。

273159.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, creature, or enchantment.
273159.translation: 消灭目标神器，生物或结界。

273168.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Remove X +1/+1 counters from CARDNAME: It deals X damage to any target.
273168.translation: {oX}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去X个+1/+1指示物：它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

273178.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each Gate you control and has vigilance and menace.
273178.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有警戒与威慑异能，且你每操控一个门，它便得+1/+0。

273186.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
273186.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

273191.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to target creature.
273191.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。

273195.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Shuffle up to five target cards from your graveyard into your library.
273195.translation: {o2}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：将至多五张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

273213.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
273213.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

273215.oracleText: Draw seven cards. CARDNAME deals 7 damage to each creature your opponents control.
273215.translation: 抓七张牌。CARDNAME向由对手操控的每个生物各造成7点伤害。

273220.oracleText: Precision Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
273220.translation: 精准电击对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

273222.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control a Ral planeswalker, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each card in your hand until end of turn.
273222.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控拉尔鹏洛客，则你每有一张手牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

273225.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. That creature gains menace until end of turn.
273225.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

273226.oracleText: For each creature card in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
273226.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

273229.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if you control a Vraska planeswalker, you gain life equal to CARDNAME's power.
273229.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若你操控瓦丝卡鹏洛客，则你获得等同于CARDNAME之力量的生命。

273235.oracleText: Target a legendary permanent that is an artifact, creature, or enchantment.
273235.translation: 指定一个神器，生物或结界为目标，且该永久物须为传奇。

273236.oracleText: Target a creature with toughness 4 or greater.
273236.translation: 指定一个防御力等于或大于4的生物为目标。

273237.oracleText: Target an attacking creature without flying.
273237.translation: 指定一个进行攻击且不具飞行异能的生物为目标。

273238.oracleText: Shuffle up to four target cards from your graveyard into your library?
273238.translation: 是否要将至多四张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库？

273243.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} deal 4 damage to them?
273243.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}对他造成4点伤害？

273244.oracleText: Search for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards.
273244.translation: 搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或门牌。

273245.oracleText: Search for a basic land card or Gate card.
273245.translation: 搜寻一张基本地牌或门牌。

273246.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card or Gate card?
273246.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或门牌？

273248.translation: 牺牲一个具守军异能的生物。

273249.oracleText: Target up to three multicolored cards.
273249.translation: 指定至多三张多色牌为目标。

273250.oracleText: Target up to one creature you control.
273250.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的生物为目标。

273251.oracleText: At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.
273251.translation: 在该回合的结束步骤开始时，你输掉这盘游戏。

273255.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature.
273255.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害。

273258.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped creatures you control.
273258.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的生物。

273262.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control?
273262.translation: 是否要在一个由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物？

273264.oracleText: Search for a basic Forest or Plains card.
273264.translation: 搜寻一张基本树林牌或平原牌。

273266.oracleText: Search for an instant card and/or a sorcery card.
273266.translation: 搜寻一张瞬间牌和／或一张法术牌。

273268.oracleText: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.
273268.translation: 夏浓山峰从无静寂之时。

273432.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} deal 4 damage to you?
273432.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}对你造成4点伤害？

273568.oracleText: The Cabal assured the Seven Houses that hostages receive all the food and rest they require.
273568.translation: 柯帮向七大家族担保，人质所需的食物与休息都会得到满足。

273570.oracleText: "No single arrow can pierce an entire flock."

273573.oracleText: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.
273573.translation: 它古老而巨大，且诱惑难挡。

273576.oracleText: "Those who stood in my path now lay behind me."

273580.oracleText: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.
273580.translation: 凤凰火焰安静不张狂，悄无声息地掠过峡谷。

273584.oracleText: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.
273584.translation: 参天大树也敌不过重跺恐龙。

273586.oracleText: "Watch carefully. The gap between death and victory is thinner than your blade."
273586.translation: 「看仔细了。丧命与获胜之间的距离，比剑刃还窄。」

273589.oracleText: "Lately I've seen the biggest bounties of my career—and for the biggest names."
273589.translation: 「自从我干这行以来，从未见过最近这样如此高额的赏金～要的还全是大人物的命。」

273593.oracleText: Selesnya guildmages do not sleep so the rest of the Conclave can.
273593.translation: 瑟雷尼亚的公会法师彻夜看守，确保整个盟会都能安然入眠。

273596.oracleText:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant
273596.translation:
「你们这些家伙就在拘留所里好好待着吧。保证让你们吃得到饭。但抬不起头。」
～波洛斯军士黎布斯

273599.oracleText:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant
273599.translation:
「四个城区内爆发古鲁骚乱。从块头最大的闹事者开始，一个一个都给我逮起来。」
～波洛斯军士黎布斯

273604.oracleText: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.
273604.translation: 伊捷法师知道这样一来，不仅手中的热能反转器会一去不返，自己也无法享受亲手引爆它的快感。

273609.oracleText:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara
273609.translation:
「若要兴战，须先保证心境祥和。」
～艾玛拉

273613.oracleText: There's no greater honor than joining your chosen guild, and no greater shame than failing it.
273613.translation: 效命公会可算无上荣耀，辜负公会则是最大耻辱。

273616.oracleText: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.
273616.translation: 天使谢过了广场上喂鸟群众的好意。

273619.oracleText: "Yes, there's competition between our equenauts and the Boros skyjeks. At least they think it's a competition."
273619.translation: 「没错，波洛斯会拿我们的飞马骑士和自己的空耶克做对比。至少他们觉得还有得比。」

273621.oracleText:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia
273621.translation:
「你们不必掌握高深剑法，不用依靠厚重盾牌，也无需仰赖我的祝福。只要心存真理，就能为阳园而战。」
～欧瑞梨

273624.oracleText: Ravnica's convoluted power structure often boils down to who can muster the most swords on a given block.
273624.translation: 拉尼卡的复杂权力结构通常一句话就能说清楚：谁能在地头上集结到更多打手，谁就是老大。

273628.oracleText: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.
273628.translation: 伤员还未看到它自云中振翅现身，便已望见其所携药瓶反射的微光。

273630.oracleText: He ferried weapons, spells, exotic animals—but his most dangerous cargo was the truth.
273630.translation: 他经手送过各种货物～武器、咒语、异兽～但其中最危险的还是真相。

273634.oracleText: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.
273634.translation: 生活分两段：见过独角兽之前，和见过独角兽之后的。

273638.oracleText: Good at carrying things. Really good at knocking them down.
273638.translation: 善于驮载货物。更善于弄翻载荷。

273642.oracleText: "I've raised her since she was a pup, and she's raised me since I was a recruit."
273642.translation: 「我从她还是幼狼时就抚养她长大；她从我还是新兵起就拉扯我成长。」

273649.oracleText:
"Article 5.8.2. Ensure proper restraint of any and all arms, legs, claws, jaws, tails, tentacles, and tendrils as appropriate."
—Azorius Arrester Procedure, Appendix B
273649.translation:
「第5.8.2条 拘束时务请确保所有手、脚、爪、颚、尾、须、卷等部位均已妥善固定。」
～《俄佐立逮捕人规程》附录B

273651.oracleText: "Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."
273651.translation: 「在黑暗世道中，有太多的人迷途不归。我就是指引他们回家的明光。」

273653.oracleText:
"The Golgari believe they should be given what they deserve. On this we agree."
—Tajic
273653.translation:
「葛加理人觉得他们应得的就该给他们。我们同意这一说法。」
～塔疾克

273656.oracleText: Rocs' innate fearlessness makes them ideal mounts for emergency response.
273656.translation: 洛克鸟天性勇敢，无所畏惧，正是紧急出动时的理想坐骑。

273660.oracleText: "Sometimes an angel passes by and gives me a little nod, like, ‘You're a daring one!' That always makes my day."
273660.translation: 「有时身边会有天使飞过向我点头致意，好像在跟我说『你真厉害！』这就值了。」

273664.oracleText: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"
273664.translation: 「在把剑交给你之前，让我先瞧瞧你能不能躲过我这一下！」

273666.oracleText:
"The trouble with youths these days is that, in outright defiance of their elders, they refuse to be bought."
—Karlov of the Ghost Council
273666.translation:
「年轻人如今的问题在于，出于对长者的强烈叛逆，他们拒绝被收买。」
～鬼影议会的卡洛夫

273669.oracleText: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.
273669.translation: 波洛斯士兵会利用战前的片刻宁静来默念祷文，用以集中精神、平复情绪。

273672.oracleText: "The Tenth has always been my home. This city is constantly embroiled in one crisis or another, but I'm determined to protect my piece."
273672.translation: 「我一直以第十区为家。虽然整座城市危机接连不断，但我决心守护自己的一切。」

273681.oracleText: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."
273681.translation: 「我专长于统一极限理论，熟知超越这一极限的各类方法。」

273684.oracleText: All those who trade in questions must answer to the Dimir.
273684.translation: 所有惹出是非的人都要被底密尔查个究竟。

273691.oracleText: First, dispose of the evidence. Then dispose of your knowledge of its disposal.
273691.translation: 首先，将证据处理干净。然后，再将处理证据这事的记忆处理干净。

273694.oracleText: The letters arrive, all sealed and read.
273694.translation: 信件已平安送达，虽封缄安然无恙，但内容均尽收眼底。

273698.oracleText: "Laws apply only to those who lack the vision to see past them."
273698.translation: 「律法只能约束那些无法看穿它的人。」

273705.oracleText: Beneath Ravnica's streets runs a layer of tunnels, then caverns and waterways, then terrors and nightmares.
273705.translation: 拉尼卡街道下方有一层隧道，其下方是洞穴与水道，更下方便是惊惧兽与梦魇。

273708.oracleText:
"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav
273708.translation:
「谁是底密尔的密探？谁都不是，谁也都是。」
～拉札夫

273713.oracleText: In a climate of suspicion, Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.
273713.translation: 在重重疑云笼罩之下，伊佩利召集各公会面议，大胆提出建言：合作。

273718.oracleText:
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer
273718.translation:
「多数只在地上捕食昆虫。有些则会栖息在伊捷实验室附近，借着热气流高升。」
～析米克生物工程师约洛夫

273726.oracleText: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.
273726.translation: 谣言如鸦群飞舞城中，看似不经意间就停在市民肩头。

273729.oracleText: A composer wrote a symphony based on the drakes screeching outside her window. Reviews were mixed—except among the drakes.
273729.translation: 某位作曲家就着自家窗外的龙兽啸鸣谱写了一支交响曲。听众褒贬不一～但龙兽的回应却出奇一致。

273732.oracleText:
"What bait do you cast to catch a dream?"
—Ravnican riddle
273732.translation:
「捕梦该投什么饵？」
～拉尼卡谜语

273737.oracleText:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security
273737.translation:
「我们这是在四十楼，只有一扇窗户，连阳台都没有。谁都不可能进得来。」
～欧佐夫警卫长米诺斯

273741.oracleText: She memorized every arcane text in the Ismeri Library by the time she was sixteen. Now she quizzes sphinxes in her spare time.
273741.translation: 她在十六岁时就已将依梅里图书馆内每条秘法咒文倒背如流。如今她在闲暇之余以给史芬斯出题为乐。

273744.oracleText: "My doors are called trespassing, my signatures, forgeries. They don't respect my talents, and I don't respect their labels."
273744.translation: 「我造门通行无阻，他们说我擅闯空门；我签名随心所欲，他们说我伪造印鉴。既然他们看不起我的才能，我也不理会他们对我的看法。」

273750.oracleText: Genius is finding the edge of what's possible, then jumping over it.
273750.translation: 所谓天才之举，便是发现可能的边界，然后一跃而过。

273752.oracleText:
"How thoughtful of the Legion to train its soldiers to fit our spell's specifications."
—Nefara, Dimir agent
273752.translation:
「教团真为我们着想，士兵的训练方式根本就契合我们咒语特性。」
～底密尔密探涅法拉

273755.oracleText:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav
273755.translation:
「我们收到情报，某些公会已经受到了外来入侵者的影响。直到我们调查清楚之前，务必挡下一切恶意行为。」
～拉札夫

273763.oracleText: The first thing the mist chills is the mind. Victims never cry out or even murmur in surprise.
273763.translation: 雾气首先麻痹心智。受害者从没有机会大声叫喊，甚至都不会发出惊呼。

273766.oracleText: "There's no need to sound the alarm. You are minding your post admirably. I am authorized. All is well."
273766.translation: 「不必拉响警报。你正恪尽职守。我已获准通行。一切平安无事。」

273769.oracleText: Fog haunts the streets, rendering the familiar as otherworldly, changing neighbors into shadows, and muffling cries for help.
273769.translation: 浓雾弥漫大街小巷，置街景如异境，化邻里作魅影，掩呼救于其中。

273773.oracleText:
"What wishes do they grant? Mostly pinching-related ones."
—Omik, superintendent of waterworks
273773.translation:
「它们能满足什么愿望？应该都是跟夹人有关的吧。」
～水务主管欧米克

273776.oracleText: The Dimir rarely make statements, but when they do, the message is clear.
273776.translation: 底密尔很少公开发声，可一旦如此，他们的信息便再明确不过。

273780.oracleText:
"Bats are welcome to eat thousands of my pets. I have multitudes more that will ultimately eat the bats."
—Izoni
273780.translation:
「蝙蝠大可畅食我那数以千计的宠物。我拥有的数量之大，终将吃掉蝙蝠。」
～依佐妮

273788.oracleText:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni
273788.translation:
「连老鼠都会囤积财宝。你的珍贵宝贝又有什么特别呢？」
～依佐妮

273790.oracleText: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.
273790.translation: 拒不参加公会～这便是她的处世原则。底密尔吸血鬼让她心神不宁，析米克想要拿她来活体研究，波洛斯誓要将她处以火刑，瑟雷尼亚愿能为她「治愈」一切。而阴影是她所需的唯一依靠。

273797.oracleText: All things considered, his first day on patrol could have gone better.
273797.translation: 从各方面的情况来看，他的第一天巡逻本可以更顺利些。

273802.oracleText: The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.
273802.translation: 每一则扭曲秘密的声音都诱惑着你再听一则。

273805.oracleText: The party of Rakdos revelers cackled and capered as the thing approached. It hissed, and they jabbed their torches at it, giggling when it recoiled. Then, one by one, the torches went out—and the screaming began.
273805.translation: 拉铎司狂欢人眼见怪物靠近，愈发情绪高涨、欢声雷动。见到此物仅会嘶嘶作响，他们便争先恐后用手中火把戳刺，以其蜷缩躲避之姿为乐。突然之间，火把接连熄灭～而后尖叫四起。

273807.oracleText:
"Variety is also the spice of death."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman
273807.translation:
「物种多样也为死亡增趣。」
～葛加理祭师习拉雅

273810.oracleText: "They don't even feel the cut. I'm ordering a drink in a nearby tavern before anyone notices something's wrong."
273810.translation: 「对方一点都不会觉得痛。等到有人发现出事的时候，我已经在附近酒馆喝上一杯了。」

273813.oracleText: The hive has a long memory. It knows how every member ever died, and to whom it owes the grudge.
273813.translation: 母巢的记性极佳。它清楚每一位成员的死因，以及要寻仇的对象。

273818.oracleText:
"I prefer the big and looming to the small and skittering."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman
273818.translation:
「相比渺小掠行的生物，我更喜欢大到遮天的那种。」
～葛加理祭师习拉雅

273824.oracleText: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.
273824.translation: 拉尼卡最安全的堡垒通常既不安全也保不住人。

273827.oracleText: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.
273827.translation: 无人欢迎他的到来，但人人都得奉上贡品。

273834.oracleText: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.
273834.translation: 瓯坎的杀手会从他们之前的杀害对象身上提炼毒素。

273837.oracleText: Dimir assassins have the precision to slay a single memory.
273837.translation: 底密尔杀手能精确地将单段记忆斩草除根。

273843.oracleText: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."
273843.translation: 「我的能力可谓慷慨。我让从我手下幸存的人对生命心怀感恩。」

273849.oracleText: Only the patrol's armor was found, so tainted with the acrid smell of sudden death that it could never be worn again.
273849.translation: 整支巡逻队尸骨无存，就连仅剩的盔甲也被猝死产生的恶臭熏得再也无法穿戴。

273852.oracleText: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."
273852.translation: 「我已亲眼见过拉尼卡的命运。相信我，我这是为你好。」

273855.oracleText: The Golgari adorn themselves with the exoskeletons of iridescent insects. It's only fair the insects do likewise.
273855.translation: 葛加理人喜欢用多彩昆虫的外骨骼打扮自己。昆虫也只好仿效人类而为之。

273859.oracleText: In its territory, living is an affront.
273859.translation: 在它的地盘上，活着就是令它难堪。

273863.oracleText:
"I sang songs of sorrow for my lost love. Imagine my horror when, one night, they were answered."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate
273863.translation:
「我经常会用悲伤的歌曲来缅怀逝去的爱人。有一天晚上这曲突然有回声应和，不难想像我当时会有多惊恐。」
～欧佐夫神职者米拉娜

273866.oracleText:
"The alliances were already frayed. All we do is find the loose threads and pluck."
—Lazav
273866.translation:
「同盟早已松动。我们只是找到线头，然后一抽而已。」
～拉札夫

273871.oracleText: "Sure, I hear things. I hear plenty. But how am I to talk with this parched throat?"
273871.translation: 「没错，我消息灵通，情报繁多。但我这副干涩的嗓子又能说什么呢？」

273880.oracleText: "Don't stop till your horns come out their back."
273880.translation: 「在牛角戳穿他们之前不要停。」

273882.oracleText: "Not my first edition of The Advokist and the Urchin!"
273882.translation: 「放过我那本初版《倡议人和恼人鬼》！」

273886.oracleText: In the wake of Niv-Mizzet's disappearance, Ral found himself leading the guild. He had dreamed of this day, but couldn't help feeling like a pawn in someone else's game.
273886.translation: 尼米捷失踪之后，拉尔发现自己可以领导公会。他曾梦想过这一天的到来，却又不禁感觉自己像是旁人局中的棋子。

273889.oracleText: "This sort of innovation occurs when you set out to improve an electric tea kettle and misplace a decimal."
273889.translation: 「如果你准备改进电茶壶，但算错了一位小数点，就会出现这类创新。」

273895.oracleText:
"It's both an ingress-denial mechanism and an attractive hallway light!"
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer
273895.translation:
「这东西既是个不错的门禁装置，也是盏漂亮的廊灯！」
～伊捷电流术士达西维

273900.oracleText:
"The League accepts no responsibility for former members and the damage they may cause."
—Maree, Izzet chamberlain
273900.translation:
「因伊捷联盟原成员之私人行为导致的一切后果，本联盟概不负责。」
～伊捷侍从玛蕾

273904.oracleText: Turns out coffee is the weird aunt of invention.
273904.translation: 其实发明之母还有咖啡。

273911.oracleText: "I spent some time in the Legion, but I'm done taking orders all day."
273911.translation: 「我在教团待了一段时间，但我受够了整天听人指挥。」

273913.oracleText: Rain runoff in the Smelting District is known to spontaneously burst into flame.
273913.translation: 矿石提炼区的雨后积水常会自燃。

273918.oracleText: The Boros banner stands tall even if its bearer doesn't.
273918.translation: 即使掌旗身材矮小，波洛斯旗帜仍能高高屹立。

273927.oracleText:
"He's got more finesse than most goblins. He smashes windows with his fist rather than his forehead."
—Arrester Polgar
273927.translation:
「他比多数鬼怪更有手段。他会用拳头来砸窗，而不是用脑袋。」
～逮捕人波嘉

273933.oracleText:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler
273933.translation:
「它们平时就会相互吐火嬉闹。如果哪天有条龙向你喷出爱的火焰，可别觉得它恨你。」
～拉铎司训龙师艾丝菲

273937.oracleText:
"The Izzet are blamed for every little disaster, which is unfair because we only cause most of them."
—Mizzix of the Izmagnus
273937.translation:
「他们每场小灾难都要拿我们伊捷是问，这太不公平了，又不是全部都是我们造成的。」
～伊捷首法师米捷兹

273941.oracleText:
"Commander, we caught the Dimir spy and took her ashes into custody."
—Kramm, Wojek security officer
273941.translation:
「指挥官，我们逮到了底密尔间谍，她的灰烬已经收监。」
～沃耶克警卫克拉姆

273947.oracleText:
"They tell us the wilds are ours, then they brick them over. They can lie to our faces but not to our fists."
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage
273947.translation:
「他们曾说荒野都归我们，然后就用砖块把野地都盖住。他们的谎言也许骗得过我们的耳朵，但挡不住我们的铁拳。」
～古鲁公会法师顾拉

273952.oracleText: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."
273952.translation: 「根本就没人听我抱怨！就算我用棒子逼着，他们都不听！」

273959.oracleText: Some Gruul druids believe that boars are spawn of the great Ilharg, the mighty Raze-Boar who will one day rise and level the city.
273959.translation: 某些古鲁的德鲁伊相信，野猪都是伟大的衣哈格留下的后代，并且这位强大的蛮野猪神总有一天会崛起并夷平整座城市。

273968.translation:
「别逮捕他，召他入伍！」
～指挥官叶程

273971.oracleText:
"They said obey and you'll be happy. They said you'll be safe. But we're not safe. We're not happy. And we will not obey."
—Domri Rade
273971.translation:
「他们说，听他们的就会好过。他们还说，听他们的就会安全。但我们一点都不安全。我们一点都不好过。我们再也不听他们的了。」
～多密雷德

273973.oracleText: "I packed three more electroconduits into each test wand. You'll experience a brief tingling sensation."
273973.translation: 「我在测试用魔杖里又多塞了三个电流导管。你可能会觉得有些许刺痛。」

273975.oracleText: "Light a torch and deliver this letter" were his instructions, which he unfortunately reversed.
273975.translation: 原本给的指示是「点火，送信」，但他弄反了。

273979.oracleText: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."
273979.translation: 「有本事你就试试看能不能再靠近队长一步。」

273982.oracleText: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.
273982.translation: 问题不在于巨犀兽的热情，在于拉尼卡缺少护栏。

273987.oracleText: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."
273987.translation: 「对我来说，再小的老鼠口中话语之声，都比整条锡街的喧闹狂欢来得响亮。」

273990.oracleText:
"I am the very soul of battle, but even I would never advise open war with the Conclave."
—Aurelia
273990.translation:
「我是战斗之魂，但就连我也不建议对盟会开战。」
～欧瑞梨

273993.oracleText:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide
273993.translation:
「两点之间最近的路线并不总是最安全的。」
～城区向导塔米娜

273995.oracleText:
"The Dimir may look all they want. We never grow tired of swatting their bugs."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant
273995.translation:
「底密尔可以尽情刺探。我们会不厌其烦地拍扁他们的臭虫。」
～瑟雷尼亚法皇荷路杰

273997.oracleText: "This is Mileva, in the Tenth. We've got an elf in the plaza with a chip on her shoulder. Actually, it's more of a morningstar."
273997.translation: 「我是第十区的米勒娃。我们在广场上发现了一个刺头妖精。确切地说，扛着一把刺头锤。」

274001.oracleText: "The route is direct but challenging. Incidentally, how are you with heights?"
274001.translation: 「路线可直达但较具挑战。顺便问一句，你恐高吗？」

274005.oracleText: Cats place their gifts with care, so that a bare foot will step on them in the middle of the night.
274005.translation: 猫会精心摆放自己的礼物，好让打赤脚的人在深夜踩个正着。

274008.oracleText: What the Golgari can't claim through patient undercity expansion, they seize in brazen topside sorties.
274008.translation: 凡是葛加理无法藉助缓慢扩张地底城以获取之物，他们便会靠野蛮地面侵攻来夺。

274012.oracleText: Some rooftop gardens attract bees; others capture dragons.
274012.translation: 有的屋顶花园吸引蜜蜂；而有的则能困住巨龙。

274018.oracleText: Nearly invisible strands of web reach far beyond its lair to alert it of the approach of prey.
274018.translation: 一条条肉眼难见的蛛丝延伸至远离巢穴之处，提醒它有猎物靠近。

274020.oracleText:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

274025.oracleText:
Feed on food, you eventually rot. Feed on rot, you live forever.
—Kraul saying
274025.translation:
以粮为食，终成腐尸。以腐为食，必得永生。
～刻洛谚语

274032.oracleText:
"There is nothing stronger than many hearts united for a single cause."
—Emmara

274041.oracleText: Selesnya grows its ranks in more ways than one.
274041.translation: 瑟雷尼亚扩张军伍的方式不止一种。

274049.oracleText: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."
274049.translation: 大自然版本的「长路归家」。

274051.oracleText:
"Light up the dark to find your way, and the dark may seek you out."
—Zalin the Gutter Bard
274051.translation:
「点亮黑暗把路寻，黑暗便会要你命。」
～贫窟吟游诗人翟林

274053.oracleText: Suddenly, all the haggling didn't seem so important.
274053.translation: 突然间，什么买卖都不重要了。

274058.oracleText: Ravnica's diversity produces blossoms of opinion in a rich soil of perspectives.
274058.translation: 拉尼卡的多样理念浇溉，加之广阔视野的沃土栽培，方有如今百花齐放的社会盛景。

274065.oracleText: Golgari crops bloom in strange soils, touched only by long-traveled light.
274065.translation: 葛加理的作物能在奇异土壤上生长，仅靠远距阳光滋养。

274069.oracleText:
"Be like the grazers of the Saruli. Keep your herd close, and stay alert for encroaching danger."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad
274069.translation:
「效法撒路里的草食动物吧。紧密集结成群，并时刻提防危险来袭。」
～瑟雷尼亚树灵拉黎亚

274071.oracleText: Once part of a wealthy merchant's private zoo, the herd roams feral throughout the Tenth, where it will remain until the guilds can agree to relocate, cull, or befriend it.
274071.translation: 这群冠角牛曾经属于某位富商的私人动物园，如今它们在第十区野放漫游，直到各公会同意重新安置、汰劣留良或细心安顿之。

274073.oracleText: Dimir assassinations are choreographed like dance routines. Each challenge is anticipated and countered with graceful ease.
274073.translation: 底密尔的刺杀如同精心设计的舞蹈动作。完美预计到每一项挑战，并从容应对。

274077.oracleText: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.
274077.translation: 俄佐立的权力真空。瓦丝卡的留念信物。

274089.oracleText: "Send your champion. I could use a light workout."
274089.translation: 「派你们的冠军过来。我正好要热热身。」

274093.oracleText:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant
274093.translation:
「在太瑟雷尼亚的歌声之中，独木成林。」
～瑟雷尼亚法皇荷路杰

274097.oracleText: "Please accept this offering. I sincerely hope to leave my mace at my side."
274097.translation: 「请接受这份馈赠。我衷心希望不用举起手边的战锤。」

274101.oracleText: "It is not your time. The Legion still needs your blade."
274101.translation: 「还没到你就义的时候。教团依旧需要你执剑战斗。」

274110.oracleText: "Just as leaves fall and the tree blooms again, one day I will fall and the Conclave will endure."
274110.translation: 「叶落枝复繁，就算我哪天倒下，盟会亦将长存。」

274122.oracleText: "I've seen your house, and you've been a lovely, if unwitting, host. But at last it's time for farewells."
274122.translation: 「敝人曾在贵府盘桓数日。阁下虽乏细致，但款待还算周到。叨扰多时，这生就此别过。」

274127.oracleText:
"Commander, what's the signal to attack?"
"You'll know."
274127.translation:
「指挥官，进攻的信号是什么？」
「到时候就知道了。」

274133.oracleText: Just assume every conversation is on record.
274133.translation: 你当每句话都有据可查就好。

274136.oracleText:
"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav
274136.translation:
「相比干嚼乏味的真相，人们更愿意品尝甜蜜的谎言。」
～拉札夫

274142.oracleText: "Whatever hatred destroys, a single act of trust can revive."
274142.translation: 「无论仇恨摧毁何物，只消一丝信任便能重生。」

274146.oracleText:
"The Erstwhile—rotten of body and outmoded in dress, but unfailing in loyalty."
—Vraska
274146.translation:
「故军～内有腐烂肉身，外有过时着装，可是忠心不二。」
～瓦丝卡

274161.oracleText: In the Legion, no flagpole is merely decorative, and every ceremonial sword bears an edge.
274161.translation: 教团之内，装饰旗杆非摆设，仪式用剑尽开刃。

274165.oracleText: From death she grows living grandeur.
274165.translation: 她能从死亡中催化灿烂生机。

274170.oracleText:
"Result 752: Rapid mass redistribution.
"Result 753: Calamitous reverse synthesis.
"Result 754: Acute disarrayment."
—Izzet research notes
274170.translation:
「结果752：物质快速重新分配。
「结果753：逆向合成造成灾难性后果。
「结果754：严重紊乱。」
～伊捷研究纪录

274172.oracleText: "We gather the past from surface dwellers and sell it right back to them."
274172.translation: 「我们收集地上居民的过往，再卖回给他们。」

274177.oracleText: Giants know a solid hit is one part strength, four parts leverage.
274177.translation: 巨人都知道重击靠的是一分力量和四分巧劲。

274182.oracleText:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker
274182.translation:
「就像是在热压爆炸中把奥术图书馆炸飞了一样。不过结果是好的那种。」
～伊捷觅爆师波力安东

274186.oracleText: "Countermagic is a simple process of breaking matter into its elementary particles."
274186.translation: 「反击魔法是将物质碎散成基本粒子的简单过程。」

274194.oracleText: "We are the shield that never breaks, the bough that never burns, the song that can never be silenced."
274194.translation: 「我们是敲不碎的盾牌，是点不着的粗枝，是掩不住的歌声。」

274197.oracleText:
"Those who show no mercy to the weak deserve no mercy from the strong."
—Firemane Kavrova
274197.translation:
「不愿对弱者手下留情的人，也不配获得强者的宽恕。」
～炎鬃卡洛娃

274223.oracleText: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."
274223.translation: 「我军人数比维图加基的树叶还多。别惹我们。」

274235.oracleText:
"Three daggers left in an angel's back, three enforcers with memory loss, three keys stolen from my own belt—and you talk of peace?"
—Tajic, to Aurelia
274235.translation:
「天使的背上插着三把匕首，三名执法者的记忆缺漏，本人的腰带上有三把钥匙被偷～这时跟我谈和平？」
～塔疾克质问欧瑞梨

274242.oracleText: City air is a constant drizzle of private thoughts.
274242.translation: 城市的空气是不断飘落的个人思绪。

274247.oracleText: "The dagger is just the distraction. I carry the real killer in a vial at my side."
274247.translation: 「匕首只是幌子而已。我随身携带的瓶子才是真正的杀人利器。」

274257.oracleText:
"The dead gain new purpose here. What is strange in the eyes of other guilds is harmonious in ours."
—Devesh, Golgari shaman
274257.translation:
「亡者在此地收获了全新的目标。其他公会眼中的怪异，即是我们眼中的和谐。」
～葛加理祭师得维许

274262.oracleText: "I long for peaceful times, when I may tend to my garden instead of our borders."
274262.translation: 「我期盼重回能够照看花园而不是看管边境的和平年代。」

274264.oracleText: Squadrons of skyknights are available for deployment around the clock, capable of reaching any district in the city within minutes.
274264.translation: 空骑士中队随时可供调遣，能在几分钟内抵达城市内任何地区。

274266.oracleText: He heard stars and saw thunder.

274276.oracleText:
"Now do you understand what we meant when we said disperse?"
—Eksari, Boros patrol leader
274276.translation:
「现在都明白听见『散开』时该怎么作了吗？」
～波洛斯巡队首领艾萨莉

274280.oracleText: A swiftblade is an artist, each fiery trail of their blades a fleeting masterpiece traced on the air.
274280.translation: 快剑手挥洒如艺师，每道迅猛的剑光都会在空中留下一副转瞬即逝的杰作。

274289.oracleText: "It's truly the highest honor, isn't it? To be remembered? Pity for you."
274289.translation: 「英勇事迹被人永记心间？这确实算是最高荣誉了吧？真可惜。」

274291.oracleText: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.
274291.translation: 拉尔的风暴在玄秘探测之时劈啪作响：鹏洛客正在潜入拉尼卡。

274301.translation:
「现在该轮到你们躲躲藏藏了。」
～瓦丝卡

274310.oracleText: A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.
274310.translation: 说对词，或能将心智恢复，或能让其崩溃。

274319.oracleText:
"Something's causing electrospheric disruption in the blazekite's spire-vanes. Find the cause, and tell them to keep it up!"
—Juzba, Izzet tinker
274319.translation:
「有东西导致火焰风筝螺旋叶上的电子层受到干扰。找出原因，让他们再加把劲！」
～伊捷修补匠裘巴

274325.oracleText:
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade."
—Tajic
274325.translation:
「请始终坚持心中理念。行伍一生当中，它要比身上盔甲或手中利剑经受更多考验。」
～塔疾克

274329.oracleText: Its hyperpneumatics can punch through a wall and the spy on the other side.
274329.translation: 它的超冲拳能砸穿墙壁，以及在墙壁另一头的间谍。

274333.oracleText: "The reign of the Swarm begins. Let us rise now and dress ourselves in vengeance."
274333.translation: 「群落的统治开始了。让我们披上复仇的外衣，崛起吧。」

274335.oracleText: "Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."
274335.translation: 「瑟雷尼亚的土地神圣不可侵犯，而你马上就会用脸来见识一下。」

274337.oracleText: He has a job to finish, and it's you.
274337.translation: 他还有一件工作要收尾～就是你。

274393.oracleText:
"We pass these along to our fellow soldiers to recognize deeds of valor. It won't stay with you for long."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage
274393.translation:
「坠饰会在同袍将士之间相传，当作英勇行为的褒奖。你不会一直留着它。」
～波洛斯公会法师阿劳涅

274404.oracleText: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.
274404.translation: 按照公会传统，凡是多彩混色灯光照亮的鹅卵石地面，都可当作中立地带。

274407.oracleText:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster
274407.translation:
「戴上此物，与阴影同行～机敏、致命、隐密。」
～底密尔间谍大师依蕾娅

274411.oracleText: Each night it visits a different guildgate around the city, digging its talons into fresh stone.
274411.translation: 它每晚都会前往城内不同的公会门，在此前从未停留过的石块上歇脚。

274417.oracleText:
"Wear it at all times. It will guide our reanimators to your corpse."
—Mazirek, kraul death priest
274417.translation:
「请随时将此物戴在身上。它能够指引我们的复活师找到你的尸体。」
～刻洛死亡僧侣马兹瑞

274421.oracleText:
"Remember to discharge your locket every seven hours. Unless you prefer the spontaneous aether overload, of course."
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer
274421.translation:
「切记每七小时给你的坠饰放电一次。当然如果你喜欢它自发引起的乙太过载则另当别论。」
～伊捷电流术士达西维

274425.oracleText: "Be advised: suspect is nine stories tall, marble hair, answers to Saint Gusztav."
274425.translation: 「请周知：疑犯有九层楼高，大理石头发，跟圣古塔夫一模一样。」

274435.oracleText: "These terms are acceptable to House Dimir. Shall we shake on it?"
274435.translation: 「底密尔会堂接受你们的条件。握个手吧？」

274439.oracleText: Made by the mad for the work of the wicked.
274439.translation: 由疯子制成，为邪恶所用。

274444.oracleText:
"The more trust breaks down, the more we must throw open the front gates."
—Aurelia
274444.translation:
「彼此之间信任越是薄弱，我们就越要敞开大门。」
～欧瑞梨

274446.oracleText:
"It is our duty to protect all those in need. But the other guilds have never shown themselves worthy of that protection."
—Tajic
274446.translation:
「虽说为需要帮助的人提供保护是我们的职责，但其他公会从来就不值得我们去保护。」
～塔疾克

274448.oracleText:
"Every guild dreads infiltration. I should know—I've been a member of all of them."
—Lazav
274448.translation:
「每一个公会都憎恨被渗透。这点我清楚～我每一个公会都待过。」
～拉札夫

274450.oracleText:
"You've found this place only because you were summoned. Pray you're worthy of the invitation."
—Etrata
274450.translation:
「你能发现这里纯粹是因为你被召来此地。希望你配得上这份邀请。」
～艾庄塔

274452.oracleText: The Chamber of the Guildpact stands as a reminder that even the bitterest struggles can end in cooperation.
274452.translation: 十会盟堂的存在时刻提醒着人们，即便是最艰苦的斗争也能以合作收场。

274456.oracleText:
"Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom."
—Vraska
274456.translation:
「把大门关上。在地底境里，我们能安度来袭的末日。」
～瓦丝卡

274458.oracleText:
"Jarad was a friend to the Devkarin. Now we slink through neglected tunnels, befriending those who crawl them."
—Izoni
274458.translation:
「贾雷曾是戴卡林一族的朋友。如今我们在遭弃的隧道中潜逃，与爬行其中的家伙们作伴。」
～依佐妮

274462.oracleText: Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.
274462.translation: 每一间实验室都忙着全新的实验，每一项实验都是拉尔野心计划的拼图。

274464.oracleText:
"Yesterday I didn't recognize my own guild. Today I see why. And for tomorrow I must be prepared."
—Niv-Mizzet
274464.translation:
「遥想昨日，公会翻天变化让我不敢相认。时至今日，我方才洞悉其中缘由。为了明日，我必须做好准备。」
～尼米捷

274467.oracleText: Cradle of the Golgari's new kingdom. Grave of those who wronged its queen.
274467.translation: 葛加理新王朝的摇篮。迫害其女王者的坟墓。

274472.oracleText:
"You will not be trained here. You will be forged."
—Commander Yaszen
274472.translation:
「在此处你不仅将受到严格训练，更将经受千锤百炼。」
～指挥官叶程

274475.oracleText:
"Everyone who crosses that threshold is our most cherished friend. Everyone who crosses it again is our bitterest enemy."
—Trostani
274475.translation:
「踏入那门槛者，便是我们最亲的朋友。踏出那门槛者，便是我们最恨的敌人。」
～卓塔妮

274477.oracleText:
"We leave our gardens open, so all may know wonder, but guarded, so all may know peace."
—Emmara
274477.translation:
「我们敞开花园，让人人都能见证奇迹；但也严加看守，让人人都能享受和平。」
～艾玛拉

274480.oracleText:
"A massive new Izzet building project with an unstated purpose? Probably fine."
—Zija, Simic mutationist
274480.translation:
「伊捷意图不明的全新大型建设计划？应该没什么蹊跷。」
～析米克突变师琪佳

274483.oracleText:
"Where the roots reach, there the temple rises."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel
274483.translation:
「繁根所及之处，殿堂拔地而起。」
～瑟雷尼亚福音师尼斯卡

274486.oracleText: Few believe Duskmantle exists. Fewer find it. None live to bear witness.
274486.translation: 没什么人相信暮篷存在。亲眼见到者更少。而见到后还能报信的，则一个都没有。

274496.oracleText: Ral had wielded lightning all his life but had never harnessed the power of an entire guild.
274496.translation: 拉尔能随意召使闪电，但却从未驾驭过整个公会的力量。

274505.oracleText: The kraul once skulked in the outskirts of Golgari society, but with Vraska's rise, they became valued forces of the Swarm.
274505.translation: 刻洛族过去在葛加理社群的地位非常边缘，但随着瓦丝卡崛起，它们成为群落的主力军。

274507.oracleText: When the Erstwhile were unearthed from their tombs, they became a ready-made army for Vraska.
274507.translation: 故军从坟墓中破土而出后，立即成了瓦丝卡现成的军队。

274513.oracleText: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

274544.oracleText: Search for a card named Ral, Caller of Storms.
274544.translation: 搜寻一张名称为风暴唤师拉尔的牌。

274545.oracleText: Search for a card named Vraska, Regal Gorgon.
274545.translation: 搜寻一张名称为蛇发女王瓦丝卡的牌。

274547.oracleText: If this spell was cast from your hand and you've cast another spell named Approach of the Second Sun this game, you win the game. Otherwise, put Approach of the Second Sun into its owner's library seventh from the top and you gain 7 life.
274547.translation: 如果此咒语是从你手上施放，且你本盘游戏中施放过另一个名称为神日迫临的咒语，则你赢得这盘游戏。若否，则将神日迫临置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第七张的位置，且你获得7点生命。

274593.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: A Multicolored Creature Spell
274593.translation: 用于支付以下费用时有额外效应：多色生物咒语

274698.oracleText:
