"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis
274698.translation:
「到头来，还是第一个世界最难征服。随着我在世界之间穿行，我的力量愈发强大；无论向哪里下手，都会让下一次更为轻松。」
～欧尼希兹

274700.oracleText: Target an attacking creature to give a +1/+1 counter.
274700.translation: 指定一个攻击生物为目标，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

274702.oracleText: Seismic Rupture deals 2 damage to each creature without flying.
274702.translation: 地动爆裂对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成2点伤害。

274703.oracleText: Tap all creatures your opponents control with toughness 2 or less.
274703.translation: 横置所有由对手操控且防御力等于或小于2的生物。

274704.oracleText: Target blocking or blocked creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
274704.translation: 目标由你操控且进行阻挡或被阻挡的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

274721.oracleText: Cast this spell only if a creature is attacking you.
274721.translation: 只能于有生物攻击你时施放此咒语。

274992.oracleText: Each player with exactly 13 life loses the game, then each player gains 1 life.
274992.translation: 每位生命正好为13的牌手各输掉这盘游戏，然后每位牌手各获得1点生命。

274994.oracleText: Each player with exactly 13 life loses the game, then each player loses 1 life.
274994.translation: 每位生命正好为13的牌手各输掉这盘游戏，然后每位牌手各失去1点生命。

275022.translation: 消灭目标无色非地永久物。

275101.oracleText: Put any number of cards into your graveyard and the rest on top in any order.
275101.translation: 将任意数量的牌置入你的坟墓场，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

275102.oracleText: This creature must be blocked by each creature able to do so.
275102.translation: 所有能够阻挡此生物的生物皆须阻挡之。

275166.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature card from it. That player discards that card.
275166.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非生物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

275172.oracleText: Have Risk Factor deal 4 damage to you? If you decline your opponent draws three cards.
275172.translation: 是否要令风险因素对你造成4点伤害？如果你选择「拒绝」，则对手抓三张牌。

275607.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: An Instant or Sorcery Spell
275607.translation: 用于支付以下费用时有额外效应：瞬间或法术咒语

275608.oracleText: Spend only on: A Creature Spell of the Chosen Type: {0}
275608.translation: 只能用于支付：所选类别的生物咒语：{0}

275610.oracleText: Spend only on: Instant or Sorcery Spells
275610.translation: 只能用于支付：瞬间或法术咒语

275611.translation: 只能用于支付：已增幅的咒语

275614.oracleText: Spend only on: A Creature Spell
275614.translation: 只能用于支付：生物咒语

275654.translation: 只能用于支付：神器咒语

275739.translation: 从这些生物中选择一个。

275768.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}与该生物互斗？

276556.oracleText: Spend only on: An Instant or Sorcery Spell
276556.translation: 只能用于支付：瞬间或法术咒语

276832.oracleText: Skeletons you control and other Zombies you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.
276832.translation: 由你操控的骷髅妖与由你操控的其他灵俑得+1/+1且具有死触异能。

278358.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand?
278358.translation: 是否要将目标由对手操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上？

278360.oracleText: Choose an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard.
278360.translation: 选择你坟墓场中的一张瞬间或法术牌。

278393.oracleText: Return a creature card to the battlefield.
278393.translation: 将一张生物牌移回战场。

279365.translation: 指定至多一位牌手为目标。

279450.oracleText:
"If we cannot have peace, we will have justice."
—Aurelia
279450.translation:
「如果和平不保，我们必将昭彰正义。」
～欧瑞梨

279451.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
279451.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的生物数量。

279453.oracleText: A ray of hope breaks through the shroud of rain.
279453.translation: 冲破风雨阴云的希望之光。

279457.oracleText: Law is the light of civilization.

279458.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, that creature gains flying until end of turn.
279458.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则该生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

279460.oracleText: "In you go, big guy. Watch your head."

279461.oracleText: Exile target creature with power 4 or greater.
279461.translation: 放逐目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

279463.oracleText: "These are your streets. Defend them! This is your neighborhood. Honor it! This is your city. Save it!"
279463.translation: 「这是你们的街道。要自己来守护！这是你们的家园。要自己来添辉！这是你们的城市。要自己来拯救！」

279465.oracleText:
"What makes a frog lizard any worse than a bird horse? Prejudice against the Simic, that's what. It's unfair!"
—Thados Arquef, Guardian Project biomancer
279465.translation:
「长得像青蛙的蜥蜴凭什么比不上长着翅膀的马？告诉你，就凭大家对析米克有成见。太不公平了！」
～卫护计划生机术士萨多斯阿奎夫

279467.oracleText:
"Lies cannot long withstand the harsh light of day."
—Lavinia
279467.translation:
「谎言终将暴露在明光之下。」
～拉温妮

279468.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Scry 1.
279468.translation: 消灭目标神器或结界。占卜1。

279474.oracleText: "You two, cover the alley! You, with me! Eyes on windows, balconies, and rooftops. Who knows what a fish-octopus-crab can do!"
279474.translation: 「你们俩，给我看好巷子！你，跟我来！窗口、阳台、屋顶这些地方都给我盯紧了。谁知道那个鱼头蟹身八爪怪能闹出什么乱子来！」

279477.oracleText: When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.
279477.translation: 现有秩序崩溃之后，只见平凡民众在乱世中艰难求存。

279478.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
279478.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

279480.oracleText: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.
279480.translation: 在动荡之时，民众更渴望从严正说辞中得到慰藉。

279483.oracleText: With the new guildmaster's innovations, arresters can arrive on the scene moments before a crime is committed.
279483.translation: 自从有了新公会首领的发明之后，逮捕人现可在罪行刚要发生之时赶到现场。

279484.oracleText: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. It gains first strike until end of turn.
279484.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物，然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

279486.oracleText: The helmet reveals no eyes to witness your penance, no mouth to offer absolution.
279486.translation: 这面头盔上不露眼，无从看你忏悔；下无开口，不能赐你宽恕。

279492.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 for each card exiled with it.
279492.translation: 每以CARDNAME放逐一张牌，它便得+2/+2。

279495.oracleText: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.
279495.translation: 罪行代价账期一到，行商教会便会上门收取。

279498.oracleText: A hunter in the city requires the utmost cunning to survive. It must pounce only if the kill is certain, and leave the remains where no one will see.
279498.translation: 生于城市的捕猎者需深谙机敏狩猎之道方能存活：有十足把握时方才扑击，而后藏猎物遗骸于隐蔽之处。

279500.oracleText: The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.
279500.translation: 虽然公会首领在政治领域可谓举足轻重，但最终掌控拉尼卡命运的还是拉尼卡人民。

279501.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+3 until end of turn. Untap them.
279501.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+3直到回合结束。将它们重置。

279503.oracleText: A friend in good times, a guardian in bad times, and a savior when all else fails.
279503.translation: 顺境中的挚友，战乱下的靠山，绝望时的救星。

279504.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
279504.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

279510.oracleText:
"If you can't control your mount, I will control it for you."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar
279510.translation:
「如果你管不住自己的坐骑，那就让我来替你管。」
～俄佐立轻骑兵米瑞拉

279511.oracleText: Enchanted creature has defender and loses flying.
279511.translation: 所结附的生物具有守军异能且失去飞行异能。

279513.translation:
「我在等你的馈赠。」
～欧佐夫僧侣达莎

279516.oracleText: She breathes fair winds to tired griffins and lifts songbirds beyond the reach of stalking cats.
279516.translation: 她向疲惫狮鹫送去助力清风，将受困鸣鸟拎离野猫魔爪。

279518.oracleText: Any challenge to Azorius authority is met with swift and potent retribution.
279518.translation: 任何胆敢挑战俄佐立权威的人都会立遭严惩。

279522.oracleText:
"Many wings haunt the skies these days. Few of them bear good tidings."
—Lavinia
279522.translation:
「如今天空布满羽翼，但鲜有好事相传。」
～拉温妮

279524.oracleText: "I keep reminding myself we do this because others can't, because we love this city. If we don't save it, no one will."
279524.translation: 「我时刻提醒自己：我们甘愿披上戎装，是因为我们无可替代，是因为我们深爱这座城市。如果我们不出面，还有谁能来救？」

279525.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap another target creature you control.
279525.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置另一个目标由你操控的生物。

279528.oracleText: During your turn, spells your opponents cast cost {o1} more to cast and abilities your opponents activate cost {o1} more to activate unless they're mana abilities.
279528.translation: 在你的回合中，对手施放的咒语增加{o1}来施放，对手起动的异能也增加{o1}来起动，但法术力异能除外。

279530.oracleText: A pet that can hunt both flesh and spirit is precious in a place where smiling assassins keep company with ghostly shadows.
279530.translation: 在笑面杀手和魂魅幽影共处之地，既能追击活物又能猎捕鬼魂的宠物就显得尤为珍贵。

279533.oracleText: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures and they gain vigilance until end of turn.
279533.translation: 由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则在这些生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它们获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

279535.oracleText: Loitering is not only illegal but unwise, since those who stay too long in one place are apt to be stepped on.
279535.translation: 滞留街头既触犯法律，也非明智之举：因为在一处逗留过久容易被踩扁。

279538.oracleText: Law is the voice of reason.

279539.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, draw a card.
279539.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则抓一张牌。

279544.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, draw a card, then discard a card.
279544.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

279547.oracleText: If you can see your breath, it's too late to run.
279547.translation: 如果你能看到自己的呼气，就已经来不及跑了。

279551.oracleText:
"The best way to keep a secret is to forget it."
—Lazav
279551.translation:
「守住秘密最好的办法，就是将它彻底忘记。」
～拉札夫

279552.oracleText: Target player shuffles their graveyard into their library.
279552.translation: 目标牌手将其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

279556.oracleText: Few Ravnicans are aware of the vast reefs in their world's hidden ocean. Far beneath the great sinkholes, where the light is blue and dim, merfolk tend the coral labyrinths that feed the benthic ecosystem.
279556.translation: 几乎没有拉尼卡人知道，这个世界的隐密汪洋之还遍布有广阔暗礁。海底深处仅得泛蓝微光，人鱼在此悉心照料盘曲交错的珊瑚丛，进而维系整个赖此为生的深洋生态。

279558.oracleText:
"It's not enough to defeat our foes. We must learn from them, too."
—Vannifar
279558.translation:
「光是击败敌人还不够。我们还必须效仿他们。」
～凡妮法

279559.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.
279559.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

279561.translation: 「就连我的脑袋里都有他们的眼睛！」

279565.oracleText: Faeries are easily offended and quick to exact a quirky revenge.
279565.translation: 你很容易就会冒犯到仙灵，然后转眼就会受到他们的诡异报复。

279569.oracleText: "I've been through every guildgate in this city, and no one sees me come or go."
279569.translation: 「我已拜访过全城每一扇公会门，但从未有人见我进出。」

279574.oracleText: Searching the city for Fblthp felt like sifting the rain for a single drop of blood.
279574.translation: 在全城人海中找到夫毕佐，就像在滂沱大雨中筛出血滴。

279576.oracleText: Those who cross the Dimir find enemies everywhere they turn.
279576.translation: 反抗底密尔的人会发现自己四面皆敌。

279577.oracleText: Gain control of X target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
279577.translation: 获得X个目标生物和／或鹏洛客的操控权。

279579.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks a creature, that creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
279579.translation: 每当此生物阻挡一个生物时，后者于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

279582.oracleText: CARDNAME has hexproof as long as you control an Illusion.
279582.translation: 只要你操控虚影，CARDNAME便具有辟邪异能。

279587.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Persistent Petitioners.
279587.translation: 名称为执着诉愿人的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

279589.oracleText: "To control the present we must master the future."
279589.translation: 「为宰制当下，我们必须掌控未来。」

279590.oracleText: Draw three cards. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, instead scry 3, then draw three cards.
279590.translation: 抓三张牌。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则改为占卜3，然后抓三张牌。

279592.oracleText: "Citizen! Your crime has been recorded. Cease movement and await arrest, or further penalties will be immediately imposed."
279592.translation: 「市民！你的罪行已被记录。请立刻停止手中行动，静待被捕，否则将绝不宽贷。」

279595.oracleText: {o7oU}: Adapt 4. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
279595.translation: {o7oU}：演化4。你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

279597.oracleText: "When properly invoked, the plasma globule encloses the offensive spell with a satisfying slurp."
279597.translation: 「如能恰当召唤，电浆球应会完全包裹攻击咒语，你还能听到一声饱嗝。」

279599.oracleText: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.
279599.translation: 如今拉尼卡大街小巷到处都是公会离脱成员，滥用专业技能牟取私利。

279602.oracleText:
"This Dovin Baan came from nowhere. Watch him. Read his letters. He is more than he appears."
—Lazav
279602.translation:
「多温班恩此人来路不明。留意他的举动。拆阅他的信件。他一定别有所图。」
～拉札夫

279605.oracleText:
"There's something peculiar about the rain today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker
279605.translation:
「今天的雨总有点不自然。」
～锡街修补匠贾诺克

279606.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
279606.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

279609.oracleText:
"A better Ravnica begins with a better Simic."
—Vannifar
279609.translation:
「更好的拉尼卡，始于更好的析米克。」
～凡妮法

279612.oracleText:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer
279612.translation:
「生命没有错误，只有不断试验。」
～析米克生物工程师约洛夫

279615.oracleText:
"Relax. It's quite harmless. And it will dissolve completely in a month or two."
—Navona, Simic field tester
279615.translation:
「别紧张。这东西无害。一两个月后就会消失干净。」
～析米克实证师纳沃娜

279618.oracleText: "I do not understand the future I see: the guilds subverted, the world at war, armies bent to a cruel conqueror's will."
279618.translation: 「我无法理解眼见的未来：公会倾覆，战火遍地，军队臣服于残酷征服者的意志。」

279619.oracleText: You may reveal this card from your opening hand. If you do, scry 3 at the beginning of your first upkeep.
279619.translation: 你可以从你的起手牌中展示此牌。如果你如此作，则在你的第一个维持开始时占卜3。

279622.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Put target creature on top of its owner's library. 
• Return target creature to its owner's hand.
279622.translation:
选择一项或都选～
•将目标生物置于其拥有者的牌库顶。
•将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

279624.oracleText:
"I can think of no greater punishment than answering your question in full."
—Lazav
279624.translation:
「完整回答你的问题，便是我能想到之最严厉处罚。」
～拉札夫

279627.oracleText:
"Here, there is only truth."
—Barvisa, Azorius emissary
279627.translation:
「进去，里面只有真相。」
～俄佐立密使巴维莎

279628.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls becomes tapped, if it isn't being declared as an attacker, you may draw a card.
279628.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物成为横置时，若它并非于将其宣告为攻击者时而如此，则你可以抓一张牌。

279629.translation: {o4oU}：横置目标不具飞行异能的生物。

279631.oracleText: Those who intrude upon the Dimir seldom remember that they have done so.
279631.translation: 曾擅闯底密尔地盘的人，没几个还记得自己曾做过这事。

279634.oracleText: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.
279634.translation: 龙兽在为秋季迁徙作储备时，食欲会变得非常旺盛，从早到晚都能见到它们飞翔在街道上空攻击行人。

279635.oracleText: Other creatures you control with flying get +1/+0.
279635.translation: 由你操控且具飞行异能的其他生物得+1/+0。

279637.oracleText: In preparation for the conflict all foresaw, the Golgari called upon an army that had slept for millennia beneath the city.
279637.translation: 为备战迫在眉睫的冲突，葛加理唤醒了已在城市地底长眠数千年之久的军队。

279638.oracleText: Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then creates that many 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
279638.translation: 每位牌手各弃掉其手牌，然后派出等量的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

279640.oracleText: "Your spirits can rest in peace, for your debts are paid."
279640.translation: 「你的负债尽数付讫，你的灵魂现可安息。」

279641.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice two creatures.
279641.translation: 牺牲两个生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

279647.oracleText:
"The pain of searing iron and razor edges pales beside the pleasure of performance."
—Judith
279647.translation:
「在表演的快感之下，炙热铁器和尖锐利刃带来的痛楚显得苍白无力。」
～裘蒂丝

279649.oracleText: Blood seeks blood, and nothing shall hold back its hunger.
279649.translation: 血觅血而行，任万物都压抑不住它的饥渴。

279650.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
279650.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

279653.oracleText: No scrap of nutrition goes to waste in the undercity.
279653.translation: 地底城里的营养分毫都不会被浪费。

279657.oracleText:
"I am sewer-king!" said Rat. "I am quick and cunning and I know every tunnel."
"No, I am king!" said Zombie. "I am cold and deadly and no rot can harm me."
Then Croc came and ate them both.
279657.translation:
「我是下水道之王！」老鼠说道。「我又快又精，每条隧道都一清二楚。」
「我才是下水道之王！」灵俑说道。「我又酷又强，潮湿腐败都伤不了我。」
然后鳄鱼出现，一口吃掉他俩。

279659.oracleText: "Make way! It's time for the final act!"

279660.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, you may return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
279660.translation: 目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则你可以将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

279662.oracleText: First your whole life flashes before your eyes. Then you have considerable time to reflect on every regret as you plummet.
279662.translation: 一开始，你的眼前会浮现此生往事。随后，你有足够的时间在下坠过程中反思每一丝悔恨。

279663.oracleText: Destroy target creature. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that creature's controller.
279663.translation: 消灭目标生物。CARDNAME对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

279664.oracleText: Destroy target creature. Consign to the Pit deals 2 damage to that creature's controller.
279664.translation: 消灭目标生物。坠入深渊对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

279666.oracleText: If your ears bleed, it's a party. If your eyes bleed, it's a Rakdos party.
279666.translation: 如果耳朵流血，这是场普通派对。如果眼睛流血，这是场拉铎司派对。

279667.oracleText: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. Exile all creature cards in all graveyards that were put there from the battlefield this turn. If a creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
279667.translation: 所有生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。放逐所有坟墓场中的所有于本回合中从战场进入该处之生物牌。如果本回合中有生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

279669.oracleText: You're only as dead as you feel.
279669.translation: 等到自己觉得没劲的时候，才是真的死了。

279672.oracleText: By design, the sarcophagus muffles the debtors' moans but does not silence them.
279672.translation: 石椁设计上就只是为了盖过负债者的呻吟声，而不是将其彻底消除。

279677.oracleText:
"No worthwhile reward is easily gained."
—Nicol Bolas
279677.translation:
「珍贵回报绝无可能唾手而得。」
～尼可波拉斯

279678.oracleText: Whenever you pay life, put that many blood counters on CARDNAME.
279678.translation: 每当你支付生命时，在CARDNAME上放置等量的鲜血指示物。

279680.oracleText: {o1oB}, Remove four blood counters from CARDNAME: Destroy target creature.
279680.translation: {o1oB}，从CARDNAME上移去四个鲜血指示物：消灭目标生物。

279683.oracleText:
"A debtor's soul has little value, except as a warning to others who might consider defaulting on their loans."
—Ubea, Orzhov ministrant
279683.translation:
「负债者的灵魂毫无价值，不过倒是可以拿来以儆效尤，吓唬那些想要赖帐的人。」
～欧佐夫主礼人尤蓓

279685.translation:
「在这底下，死掉的东西可不安分。」
～拉温妮

279690.oracleText: "The suffering of others is not my concern."

279691.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.
279691.translation: 在你的维持开始时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

279693.oracleText: {o5oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 4 damage to target opponent and you gain 4 life.
279693.translation: {o5oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：它向目标对手造成4点伤害且你获得4点生命。

279696.oracleText:
"Behold the groodion! Ichor-slurper, oozing fiend. Foulest wonder underground. Grandest vermin of them all!"
—Zalin the Gutter Bard
279696.translation:
「瞧瞧这头古汀兽！吞吐脓水的恶鬼。地底城最污劣的奇观。世间最毒的病媒！」
～贫窟吟游诗人翟林

279698.oracleText: "You'll pay what you owe, with your money or your life."
279698.translation: 「欠下的债都得还，用钱用命都可以。」

279703.oracleText: Its stench corrodes steel. Its miasma sickens angels. Its finality ends hope.
279703.translation: 腐败恶臭能让钢铁锈蚀。弥漫瘴气能令天使染疾。绝命之势将希望终结。

279704.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you control have deathtouch.
279704.translation: 由你操控的瞬间与法术咒语具有死触异能。

279706.oracleText: For some goods, the best couriers are the dead.
279706.translation: 对于某些货物而言，最合适的搬运工就是亡者。

279707.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked, each creature blocking it gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
279707.translation: 每当CARDNAME被阻挡时，每个阻挡它的生物各得-1/-1直到回合结束。

279710.oracleText: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.
279710.translation: 欧佐夫既不是拉尼卡唯一的宗教教派，也不算最古老的一个。

279713.oracleText:
"The louder their performance, the quieter we become in comparison. They are the perfect distractions, for only fools ignore the Rakdos."
—Lazav
279713.translation:
「他们的演出越是吵闹，我们就会显得越安静。他们是最完美的幌子，只有傻子才会忽视拉铎司。」
～拉札夫

279714.oracleText: {o3oR}: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

279718.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each player. Then if you have 10 or less life, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
279718.translation: 在你的维持开始时，CARDNAME对每位牌手各造成1点伤害。然后如果你的总生命为10或更少，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

279721.oracleText: Its mandibles can leave a rider in the clouds astride a headless griffin.
279721.translation: 它的利颚能让云中骑手座下的狮鹫突然没了脑袋。

279725.oracleText:
"Your life is a blinding light, your breath a gale, your pulse a deafening drum. Be still. Be still."
—Dahlya Trul, "Irbitov Lament"
279725.translation:
「你的生命似耀眼明光，你的呼吸同强风来袭，你的脉动如震耳鼓声。安息吧。安息吧。」
～达娅楚尔，《依毕托夫挽歌》

279728.oracleText:
"We grow strong by feasting on failure."
—Izoni
279728.translation:
「我们以失败为食，逐渐壮大。」
～依佐妮

279735.oracleText: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.
279735.translation: 理论上，十会盟能管住公会世仇不致一发而不可收。但私人宿怨就管不到了。

279736.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.
279736.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

279738.oracleText: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.
279738.translation: 在拉铎司人眼中看来，残酷背叛不过是一场特技表演。

279740.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Until your next turn, CARDNAME's base power becomes twice that card's power and its base toughness becomes twice that card's toughness. Put the revealed cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
279740.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到你展示出一张生物牌为止。直到你的下一个回合，CARDNAME的基础力量成为该牌力量的两倍，且其基础防御力成为该牌防御力的两倍。将所展示的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

279743.oracleText:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman
279743.translation:
「古鲁人血液中的怒火，从先人在创世之初升起第一簇盛大篝火起就开始燃烧，一直延续至今。这股怒火同样也在你的体内燃烧。」
～古鲁祭师克许卡

279745.oracleText: The ostentatious splendor of the Orzhov church was just asking to be smashed.
279745.translation: 欧佐夫教堂那过于浮夸的壮丽装潢，仿佛就想让人把它尽数砸烂。

279749.oracleText: Let the Dimir worry about witnesses. For the Rakdos, screams count as applause.
279749.translation: 有没有人证那是底密尔操心的事情。对于拉铎司人而言，尖叫就是喝彩。

279750.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 1 or less attacks, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking.
279750.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或小于1的生物攻击时，CARDNAME对其所攻击的牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

279754.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature an opponent controls can't block this turn.
279754.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

279757.oracleText: "Keep coming. I have knives enough for everyone."

279761.translation:
「一块石头都不要放过。」
～鲁瑞杂尔

279762.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target creature with defender.
279762.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标具守军异能的生物。

279764.oracleText: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."
279764.translation: 「基本上，我们只是把几束小闪电揉在一起变成一束大闪电。」

279768.oracleText:
"Lost are the lush meadows and verdant forests, where maaka prowled and lammasu soared. Lost are the wilds, where our hearts were free."
—Daiva, Gruul storyteller
279768.translation:
「昔时曾有茂密草地与葱郁森林，随处可见玛卡兽潜伏其间、拉玛苏翱翔天空，如今一切不复存。昔时曾有不驯荒野，寄托吾人奔放心胸，如今一切不复存。」
～古鲁说书人戴娃

279770.oracleText: "Fire will cure a multitude of ills."

279771.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls. Then CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each other creature that player controls if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
279771.translation: CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物造成4点伤害。然后如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则CARDNAME对每个由该牌手操控的其他生物各造成2点伤害。

279772.oracleText: Flames of the Raze-Boar deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls. Then Flames of the Raze-Boar deals 2 damage to each other creature that player controls if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
279772.translation: 野猪神烈焰向目标由对手操控的生物造成4点伤害。然后如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则野猪神烈焰对每个由该牌手操控的其他生物各造成2点伤害。

279774.oracleText: When the Izzet's spirit of invention extends to the city's infrastructure, the results are sometimes explosive.
279774.translation: 当伊捷将创新精神拓展到城市的基础建设上后，有时会收获爆炸性的结果。

279775.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature, where X is the number of Gates you control.
279775.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的门数量。

279776.oracleText: Gates Ablaze deals X damage to each creature, where X is the number of Gates you control.
279776.translation: 城门失火对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的门数量。

279778.oracleText: "Today the Rubblebelt is a bit larger. That's a good day's work."
279778.translation: 「今天瓦砾区的占地又扩大了。干得不错。」

279780.oracleText: Two's a party. Three's a felony.
279780.translation: 两个开派对。三个闯大祸。

279782.oracleText: Create a number of 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens equal to two plus the number of cards named Goblin Gathering in your graveyard.
279782.translation: 派出若干1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其数量等同于你坟墓场中名称为鬼怪集群之牌的数量加二。

279784.oracleText:
"No peace accord will save Ravnica. You don't build on rot. You burn it down and start again."
—Domri Rade
279784.translation:
「和平条约救不了拉尼卡。你不能在腐败根基上做修补。你只能全部烧掉然后重头再来。」
～多密雷德

279785.oracleText: {o3oG}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

279790.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact, creature, or land that isn't a mana ability, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to that player.
279790.translation: 每当任一对手起动神器、生物或地上不属法术力异能之异能时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成1点伤害。

279792.oracleText: {o3oRoR}: CARDNAME gets +3/+3 and gains menace until end of turn.
279792.translation: {o3oRoR}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+3/+3且获得威慑异能。

279797.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
279797.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

279805.oracleText: Gruul oracles see omens in all forms of destruction: the entrails of a maaka's prey, the flight of vultures over a battlefield, the scattering of toppled stone.
279805.translation: 古鲁的先知能从各式各样的破坏之中见得预兆：无论是玛卡兽猎物的内脏、战场上空秃鹫的踪迹，还是倾颓建物的碎石。

279809.oracleText: Joining a guild, even the Gruul, would mean giving up some of his independence. He'd rather smash what he wants to smash.
279809.translation: 如果要加入公会，哪怕是加入古鲁，都意味着要放弃部分独立自由。他宁愿由着性子去破坏。

279816.oracleText: "Have you seen your face? Trust me, this will be an improvement."
279816.translation: 「你有没有见过自己的脸？相信我，这会让你更好看。」

279817.oracleText: Scorchmark deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
279817.translation: 烙印对目标生物造成2点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

279822.oracleText: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.
279822.translation: 观看拉铎司演出很危险。提早退场有丧命之虞。

279823.oracleText: Skewer the Critics deals 3 damage to any target.
279823.translation: 遏止倒彩对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

279829.oracleText:
"Don't waste time aiming, you lazy gob-slug! Fire!"
—Krenko, mob boss
279829.translation:
「别再浪费时间瞄准了，你这个懒鬼！射击！」
～暴民头目克仑可

279830.oracleText: {oT}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each player.

279833.oracleText: "Every street's a stage, and every screaming bystander's an audience."
279833.translation: 「每条街道都是舞台，每位尖叫的路人都是观众。」

279836.oracleText: "My shout is thunder and my fist is lightning!"

279837.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
279837.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。占卜1。

279839.oracleText: "That giant didn't even see me, let alone catch me! And I was close enough to smell him! Of course, that's not saying much."
279839.translation: 「那个巨人根本就没看见我，更别说逮住我！我都近得能闻到他身上的味道了。当然，这没什么好炫耀的。」

279840.oracleText: {oR}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with defender.
279840.translation: {oR}：CARDNAME本回合只能被具守军异能的生物阻挡。

279843.oracleText:
"Imagine a gigantic pine cone that's extremely territorial and always in a foul mood."
—Zhosmir, urban huntmaster
279843.translation:
「想象一枚巨大的松果，不但领地意识极强，还常带着坏脾气。」
～城市猎师佐斯密尔

279847.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each Ooze you control.
279847.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在每个由你操控的流浆上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

279848.oracleText: {o1oGoGoG}: Create a 2/2 green Ooze creature token.
279848.translation: {o1oGoGoG}：派出一个2/2绿色流浆衍生生物。

279850.oracleText:
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means."
—Vannifar
279850.translation:
「为在特殊时期求存，我们须以特殊方法进化。」
～凡妮法

279851.oracleText: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on each of those creatures.
279851.translation: 将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标生物，然后分别将这些生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

279857.oracleText: "There's no time to calm it down! Run!"
279857.translation: 「没时间让它冷静下来了！快逃！」

279860.oracleText: So-called "battering rams" pale in comparison to the real thing.
279860.translation: 所谓的「羊头撞锤」在原型面前相形见绌。

279861.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each Gate you control.

279863.oracleText: As long as you control two or more Gates, CARDNAME has vigilance and trample.
279863.translation: 只要你操控两个或更多门，CARDNAME便具有警戒与践踏异能。

279865.oracleText:
"When the sky screams, when the ground groans, the End-Raze will soon begin."
—Nikya of the Old Ways
279865.translation:
「当天空尖啸、大地低吟，便是灭世劫之始。」
～古式信徒妮恰

279872.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
279872.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

279875.oracleText: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.
279875.translation: 析米克的力量源自于其多元物种。

279878.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any type that a land you control could produce. If CARDNAME has a +1/+1 counter on it, add three mana of that type instead.
279878.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其类别为由你操控的地能产生之任一类别。如果CARDNAME上有+1/+1指示物，则改为加三点该类别的法术力。

279881.oracleText:
"The good news is that the migrating drakes are no longer a problem."
—Bell Migellic, Azorius hussar
279881.translation:
「好消息是，我们再也不用担心迁徙的龙兽了。」
～俄佐立轻骑兵贝尔米格力

279883.oracleText:
"If you don't have a destination in mind, the route is all that matters."
—Tamina, district guide
279883.translation:
「如果你还没想好要去哪，就只需要考虑路线。」
～城区向导塔米娜

279886.oracleText: "Rage! Rage until the whole world burns!"

279887.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts and enchantments. For each permanent destroyed this way, its controller creates a 3/3 green Centaur creature token.
279887.translation: 消灭所有神器和结界。每以此法消灭一个永久物，其操控者便派出一个3/3绿色半人马衍生生物。

279891.oracleText:
"When you get right down to it, the difference between death and life is just a membrane-enclosed environment maintained by a metabolic process."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer
279891.translation:
「如果你究其根本，生与死的差别不过是在封膜环境内的新陈代谢过程。」
～析米克生机术士顾里斯坦

279892.oracleText: Return up to two target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.
279892.translation: 将至多两张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

279893.oracleText: The roots run deep under stone and street, with strength that needs but a whisper to awaken.
279893.translation: 重根深深地埋在街道的石块底下，只消一声低语的力量便能唤醒。

279895.oracleText:
"My bowstring hums in tune with the song of the Worldsoul."
—Alcarus, Selesnya sagittar
279895.translation:
「我的弓弦之音与世界之魂咏颂同调。」
～瑟雷尼亚射手艾凯勒

279896.oracleText: Destroy target creature with flying. CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature with flying your opponents control.
279896.translation: 消灭目标具飞行异能的生物。CARDNAME向每个由对手操控且具飞行异能的生物各造成1点伤害。

279897.oracleText: Destroy target creature with flying. Sagittars' Volley deals 1 damage to each creature with flying your opponents control.
279897.translation: 消灭目标具飞行异能的生物。射手齐发向每个由对手操控且具飞行异能的生物各造成1点伤害。

279899.oracleText: "I hold the seed of our new beginning."

279902.oracleText:
"Within each of us, the potential for great power waits to be released."
—Zija, Simic mutationist
279902.translation:
「我们每个人体内都有尚待释放的巨大潜能。」
～析米克突变师琪佳

279905.oracleText: "Stay close! It's just a little farther."

279910.oracleText:
"If the Fin Clade cannot produce a reliable venomous krasis, mobile in both air and water, then the Guardian Project will absorb its resources."
—Vannifar
279910.translation:
「如果鳍进化组造不出在水中和空中都具有绝佳机动性且可靠的有毒融合体，那卫护计划就会吸纳它们的资源。」
～凡妮法

279913.oracleText: "What you build, we will destroy . . . and bury you in the rubble!"
279913.translation: 「你们造什么，我们就毁什么…然后把你们埋进瓦砾！」

279914.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Untap that creature.
279914.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。重置该生物。

279916.oracleText: The mournful lowing of brushstriders warns of changing weather and ill winds.
279916.translation: 拂行兽的低声哀吼提醒着人们季节变化和灾难来袭。

279919.oracleText:
"The presence of the strong will make you stronger."
—Yeva, Nature's Herald
279919.translation:
「强者的存在能让你变得更强。」
～自然传令使叶娃

279924.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if it targets a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
279924.translation: 如果此咒语以由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物为目标，则它减少{o1}来施放。

279925.oracleText:
"We've been practicing for this all our lives. This is the final test!"
—Korun Nar, Rubblebelt hunter
279925.translation:
「我们这招已经练习了一辈子。这就是最终的考验！」
～瓦砾区猎手柯伦那

279930.oracleText:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade
279930.translation:
「城墙崩毁。高楼坍塌。野地总会复归。」
～多密雷德

279931.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, untap all lands you control.
279931.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，重置所有由你操控的地。

279933.oracleText:
"The best construction makes the most satisfying destruction."
—Domri Rade
279933.translation:
「最优秀的建筑成就最赏心悦目的破坏。」
～多密雷德

279934.oracleText: "In your misguided attempt to subvert the law, you have eloquently explained why the law must exist."
279934.translation: 「在你试图颠覆律法的错误过程中，你已经完美地阐述了律法为何必须存在。」

279937.oracleText:
"The absence of binocular vision imposes certain challenges for a flying creature, which are overcome via echolocation."
—Simic research notes
279937.translation:
「对于飞行生物而言，没有双眼视觉多少会有点不便，但这个缺点能靠回声定位来弥补。」
～析米克研究纪录

279940.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. 
• Return target creature to its owner's hand.
279940.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•目标生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。 
•将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

279942.oracleText: Thanks to the magic in his Writ of Passage, alms beasts lumbered aside, anarchs bowed their heads, and even Rakdos acrobats rolled their spikewheels out of his way.
279942.translation: 他凭手中通行令之魔法加持，让救济兽退开，使无政府者俯首，就连刺轮上的拉铎司杂技演员也挪出走道。

279945.oracleText: "These new thopters are all well and good, but four eyes are better than none."
279945.translation: 「虽然新的振翼机很不错，但四只眼怎样都比没眼强。」

279947.oracleText: You can hear their tolling only when your debt is due.
279947.translation: 你只会在账期将至时听到他们的钟声。

279951.oracleText:
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger."
—Tajic
279951.translation:
「人们很容易就会被演出所吸引，享受点不太正经的娱乐。不过切记：拉铎司宗派是威胁。」
～塔疾克

279952.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, creature, or planeswalker.
279952.translation: 消灭目标神器，生物或鹏洛客。

279955.oracleText: {oT}: The next time target creature adapts this turn, it adapts as though it had no +1/+1 counters on it.
279955.translation: {oT}：目标生物于本回合中下一次演化时，它视同其上没有+1/+1指示物地演化。

279957.oracleText: Jaharg discovered that the shapes and symmetries so pleasing to the sculptor's eye also yielded a well-balanced bludgeon.
279957.translation: 贾哈格发现，雕塑师觉得顺眼的形状和对称结构，同样能用作趁手的棍棒。

279958.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
279958.translation: {oT}，从由你操控的生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

279966.oracleText: Each opponent creates five 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
279966.translation: 每位对手各派出五个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

279967.oracleText: Each opponent creates five 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
279967.translation: 每位对手各派出五个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

279968.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, choose one that hasn't been chosen — 
• Your life total becomes 4. 
• Discard your hand. 
• Each opponent creates five 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
279968.translation:
在你的维持开始时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ 
•你的总生命成为4。 
•弃掉你的手牌。 
•每位对手各派出五个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

279970.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a noncreature spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to that player.
279970.translation: 每当任一对手施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成1点伤害。

279972.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller.
279972.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标神器或结界。CARDNAME对该永久物的操控者造成2点伤害。

279975.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}: Target creature can't block this turn.
279975.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}：目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

279976.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}: Target land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn. It's still a land.
279976.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}：目标由你操控的地成为4/4，具敏捷异能的元素生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

279979.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Move a +1/+1 counter from target creature you control onto another target creature you control.
279979.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：将一个+1/+1指示物从目标由你操控的生物移到另一个目标由你操控的生物上。

279982.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
279982.translation: {oR}，{oT}：CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

279988.oracleText: Add {oR} or {oG}. If that mana is spent on a creature spell, it gains riot.
279988.translation: 加{oR}或{oG}。如果该法术力用以支付生物咒语，则它获得起事异能。

279989.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal up to two creature cards from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
279989.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中至多两张生物牌，并将它们置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

279990.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, create a 4/4 red and green Beast creature token with trample.
279990.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，派出一个4/4，红绿双色，具践踏异能的野兽衍生生物。

279991.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of each end step, create a 4/4 red and green Beast creature token with trample."
279991.translation: 你获得具有「在每个结束步骤开始时，派出一个4/4，红绿双色，具践踏异能的野兽衍生生物」的徽记。

279993.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
279993.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

279995.oracleText: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying. You gain 1 life.
279995.translation: 派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。你获得1点生命。

279996.oracleText: Look at the top ten cards of your library. Put three of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
279996.translation: 检视你牌库顶的十张牌。将其中三张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

279998.oracleText: Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska . . . and Bolas made an even six.
279998.translation: 多温掰着手指数了数鹏洛客：自己、多密、卡娅、拉尔、瓦丝卡…再加上波拉斯，正好六个。

280001.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant spell during your main phase, you may return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
280001.translation: 每当你在你的行动阶段施放瞬间咒语时，你可以将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

280007.oracleText:
"Time to let the dead be dead."
—Kaya, to Teysa
280007.translation:
「是时候让死者安息了。」
～卡娅致泰莎

280009.oracleText: {o2oWoB}: Exile target card from an opponent's graveyard. If it was a creature card, you create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
280009.translation: {o2oWoB}：将目标牌从任一对手的坟墓场放逐。如果它是生物牌，则你派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

280011.oracleText: There's nothing quite like the feeling of paying off a large debt.
280011.translation: 大笔债务付清后的感受非同凡响。

280012.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay 5 life or sacrifice a creature or enchantment.
280012.translation: 支付5点生命或牺牲一个生物或结界，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

280014.oracleText: "Let's find out what kind of audience you are. Festive? Fearless?"
280014.translation: 「让我们来瞧瞧你属于哪样的观众。是喜欢搞事的？还是无所畏惧的？」

280015.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice a creature. When you do, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
280015.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

280018.oracleText: {o4oRoG}: CARDNAME gets +3/+0 until end of turn.

280022.translation: 「你的到来虽在意料之中…但不受欢迎。」

280026.oracleText:
"I might have overfed him."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer
280026.translation:
「我好像喂得太多了。」
～析米克生机术士顾里斯坦

280030.oracleText:
"Vraska sees the grandeur in death but misses the hilarity."
—Judith
280030.translation:
「瓦丝卡看见了死亡的壮美，但却错过了其中的乐趣。」
～裘蒂丝

280033.oracleText: "Debt due! Debt due!" The thrull's screeching makes children flinch and debtors quail. "Debt due!"
280033.translation: 「收债了！收债了！」索尔兽的尖鸣声让孩子们畏惧，令负债者心惊。「收债了！」

280037.oracleText: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.
280037.translation: 涡进化组专注于研究轮转螺旋趋势，致力让自然循环重现活力。

280038.oracleText: Draw a card. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
280038.translation: 抓一张牌。你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

280040.oracleText: She displays her scars with pride.
280040.translation: 她骄傲地展示自己的伤疤。

280044.oracleText: "As I contemplate what is, I dive ever deeper into the depths of possibility. Then I set an experiment in motion and watch the truth rise to the surface."
280044.translation: 「在我探究的过程中，我更进一步地深入挖掘可能性。然后我进行试验，静观真相浮出水面。」

280047.oracleText: "They all want to see me fall."

280052.oracleText: Creatures you control can attack as though they didn't have defender.
280052.translation: 由你操控的生物能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

280056.oracleText: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.
280056.translation: 破坏不过是获取数据的小小代价。

280057.oracleText: When you cast this spell, you gain half X life and draw half X cards. Round down each time.
280057.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，你获得X一半数量的生命，且抓X一半数量的牌。各数量小数点后均舍去。

280060.oracleText: The rights of ghosts are strictly protected under Orzhov bylaws, and those who enforce them can count on the ghosts' assistance.
280060.translation: 鬼魂的权益受到欧佐夫章程的严格保护，执行章程的人也能指望鬼魂的协助。

280062.oracleText: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.
280062.translation: 待演出结束，她独立舞台中央，浑身闪耀血光。

280063.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
280063.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

280067.oracleText: Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard. You gain 2 life if at least one creature card was exiled this way.
280067.translation: 将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌放逐。如果以此法放逐了至少一张生物牌，则你获得2点生命。

280069.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target player equal to the number of cards that player owns in exile and you gain that much life.
280069.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于放逐区中由该牌手拥有之牌的数量，且你获得等量的生命。

280072.oracleText: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.
280072.translation: 泰莎召集了欧节达会议。卡娅终结了一切。

280073.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. You gain life equal to the number of creatures you controlled that were destroyed this way.
280073.translation: 消灭所有生物。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控的生物中，以此法被消灭的数量。

280076.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice another nontoken creature: Create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
280076.translation: {o3}，牺牲另一个非衍生物的生物：派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

280079.oracleText: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."
280079.translation: 「我曾告诉杰斯，如果他不认真肩负起自己的责任，拉尼卡便会分崩离析。我多希望自己错了。」

280081.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, if no mana was spent to cast it, counter that spell.
280081.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语，若施放它时未支付过法术力，则反击该咒语。

280084.translation: 拉铎司把「丧事」变成「爽事」。

280085.oracleText: Put target creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gets +2/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
280085.translation: 将目标生物牌在你的操控下从对手的坟墓场放进战场。直到回合结束，它得+2/+0且获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

280086.translation:
「你的债务已一笔勾销。」
～欧佐夫安乐艺师希佳尔

280088.oracleText: "The hooves of the Raze-Boar will trample the weak—and their city—to dust!"
280088.translation: 「蛮野猪神的巨蹄会把弱者～和他们的城市～夷为平地！」

280089.oracleText: Whenever you tap a land for mana, add one mana of any type that land produced.
280089.translation: 每当你横置一个地以产生法术力时，加一点该地已产生的类别之法术力。

280091.oracleText: "Pay in gold. Pay in blood. Pay with the servitude of your spirit kin. But pay you must."
280091.translation: 「可以用金子付，可以鲜血付，也可以用你亲人鬼魂的服务来付。但无论如何都得付。」

280092.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.
280092.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME获得死触与不灭异能直到回合结束。

280102.oracleText: Ever wonder why you never see an old Rakdos cultist?
280102.translation: 有没有想过为什么从来没见过年长的拉铎司教徒？

280106.oracleText:
"That one has a bright future—perfect instincts for the rhythm of mayhem."
—Judith
280106.translation:
「那家伙前途不可限量～天生与混乱完美合拍。」
～裘蒂丝

280107.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
280107.translation: 每当CARDNAME被阻挡时，它对所攻击之牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

280114.oracleText: CARDNAME fights target creature you don't control.
280114.translation: CARDNAME与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

280116.oracleText: Destroy target land with an activated ability that isn't a mana ability.
280116.translation: 消灭目标地，且其须具有不属法术力异能的起动式异能。

280117.oracleText: Destroy target land with an activated ability that isn't a mana ability.
280117.translation: 消灭目标地，且其须具有不属法术力异能的起动式异能。

280121.oracleText: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.
280121.translation: 有人觉得多密的意外崛起是蛮野猪神衣哈格即将回归的征兆。

280122.oracleText: Nontoken creatures you control have riot.
280122.translation: 由你操控且非衍生物的生物具有起事异能。

280124.oracleText: The sly, stealthy warriors of the Slizt Clan survive by hiding in high ground and ambushing their enemies. Other Gruul call them skulkers and cowards, but only from a safe distance.
280124.translation: 西兹族战士狡黠又长于灭迹，生存之道是藏在高地伏击敌人。其他古鲁人管他们叫做怯徒懦夫，但只敢在远处嘟囔。

280125.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creature tokens.

280128.oracleText: A Gruul berserker is never unarmed.
280128.translation: 古鲁狂战士从不缺武器。

280129.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. It fights target creature you don't control.
280129.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。它与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

280136.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
280136.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

280139.oracleText: {o1oGoU}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
280139.translation: {o1oGoU}：在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

280140.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on a creature you control, put that many growth counters on CARDNAME.
280140.translation: 每当在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在CARDNAME上放置等量的生长指示物。

280142.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if CARDNAME has twenty or more growth counters on it, you win the game.
280142.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若CARDNAME上有二十个或更多生长指示物，则你赢得这盘游戏。

280145.oracleText: Azorius sphinxes are loyal to the precepts of the law, not to any particular guildmaster—even one of their own kind.
280145.translation: 俄佐立的史芬斯忠于律法本身，而非公会首领～即便是他们同族。

280148.oracleText: "Do not think me blind to your true mission . . . or your true master, Grand Arbiter."
280148.translation: 「别以为我看不穿你的真实目的…以及你真正的主人，大仲裁者。」

280149.oracleText: Draw two cards. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, you gain 2 life.
280149.translation: 抓两张牌。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则你获得2点生命。

280151.oracleText: "You take our wilds, we take your city."
280151.translation: 「你们夺走我们的荒野，我们就夺走你们的城市。」

280153.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, destroy target artifact or enchantment that player controls.
280153.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的神器或结界。

280156.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Tap target creature with power 4 or greater.
280156.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：横置目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

280157.oracleText: {o4oB}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
280157.translation: {o4oB}，{oT}：CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

280160.oracleText: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.
280160.translation: 卡娅当上公会首领后，泰莎就在欧佐夫权力网的中心静观其变。

280161.oracleText: If a creature dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
280161.translation: 如果某个死去的生物触发由你操控之永久物的触发式异能，则该异能额外触发一次。

280162.oracleText: Creature tokens you control have vigilance and lifelink.
280162.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物具有警戒与系命异能。

280164.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library.
280164.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。

280167.oracleText: {o3oR}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
280167.translation: {o3oR}：CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

280174.oracleText: Among the Zhur-Taa Clan, goblins are the first to enter battlefury. When the battle is over, the survivors are still frothing at the mouth, looking for someone to hit.
280174.translation: 在筑塔族中，鬼怪总是先人一步进入战怒状态。战斗结束后，幸存者依然满腔怒火，想要敲人。

280176.oracleText:
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!"
—Judith
280176.translation:
「这盏脚灯坏了。给我把舞台工找来！」
～裘蒂丝

280177.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals 1 damage to any target.
280177.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

280180.oracleText:
"Tear down the city, lie by lie. Then throw it back at the liars, stone by stone."
—Domri Rade
280180.translation:
「推倒城市，戳穿每一句谎言。然后一颗颗石头回敬骗子。」
～多密雷德

280184.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has a +1/+1 counter on it, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
280184.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有+1/+1指示物，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

280187.oracleText:
"The Senate griffins overhead used to make people think of order and safety. Not anymore."
—Lavinia
280187.translation:
「头上的参议院狮鹫曾让人们感到法治与安全。这种感觉如今已不复存在。」
～拉温妮

280190.oracleText: Orzhov vampires look for allies in unlikely places in case their new guildmaster turns on them. The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.
280190.translation: 欧佐夫的吸血鬼会去出人意料的地方寻求同伴，以防他们的全新首领反戈一击。欧节达的命运证明了卡娅的力量和她对不死生物的痛恨。

280192.oracleText: Destroy target nonbasic land. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
280192.translation: 消灭目标非基本地。CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

280193.oracleText: Destroy target nonbasic land. Bedeck // Bedazzle deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
280193.translation: 消灭目标非基本地。扮炫向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

280196.oracleText: Destroy target nonbasic land. Bedazzle deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
280196.translation: 消灭目标非基本地。扮炫向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

280198.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target creature or planeswalker and 1 damage to that permanent's controller.
280198.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成1点伤害，且对该永久物的操控者造成1点伤害。

280199.oracleText: Carnival // Carnage deals 1 damage to target creature or planeswalker and 1 damage to that permanent's controller.
280199.translation: 暴喜对目标生物或鹏洛客造成1点伤害，且对该永久物的操控者造成1点伤害。

280200.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target opponent. That player discards two cards.
280200.translation: CARDNAME向目标对手造成3点伤害。该牌手弃两张牌。

280202.oracleText: Carnival deals 1 damage to target creature or planeswalker and 1 damage to that permanent's controller.
280202.translation: 暴喜对目标生物或鹏洛客造成1点伤害，且对该永久物的操控者造成1点伤害。

280204.oracleText: Carnage deals 3 damage to target opponent. That player discards two cards.
280204.translation: 暴虐向目标对手造成3点伤害。该牌手弃两张牌。

280206.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature with flying.
280206.translation: CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成6点伤害。

280207.oracleText: Collision // Colossus deals 6 damage to target creature with flying.
280207.translation: 蛮掷对目标具飞行异能的生物造成6点伤害。

280209.oracleText: Collision deals 6 damage to target creature with flying.
280209.translation: 蛮掷对目标具飞行异能的生物造成6点伤害。

280212.oracleText: Target player sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control. You gain life equal to its power.
280212.translation: 目标牌手牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最大者。你获得等同于其力量的生命。

280216.oracleText: Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying, then you gain 1 life for each creature you control.
280216.translation: 派出两个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物，然后你每操控一个生物，便获得1点生命。

280220.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
280220.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

280221.oracleText: Exile target creature. That creature's controller creates a 3/3 green Frog Lizard creature token.
280221.translation: 放逐目标生物。该生物的操控者派出一个3/3绿色蛙／蜥蜴衍生生物。

280225.oracleText: Double your life total. Target opponent loses half their life, rounded up.
280225.translation: 将你的总生命加倍。目标对手失去一半生命，小数点后进位。

280229.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.

280238.oracleText:

"It looks expensive, doesn't it? You have no idea . . ."

332802.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果于你施放此咒语时，你展示了龙牌或操控龙，则CARDNAME对所影响之生物的操控者造成3点伤害。

332803.oracleText: Draconic Roar deals 3 damage to target creature. If you revealed a Dragon card or controlled a Dragon as you cast this spell, Draconic Roar deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
332803.translation: 龙语怒吼对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果于你施放龙语怒吼时，你展示了龙牌或操控龙，则龙语怒吼对所影响之生物的操控者造成3点伤害。

332850.oracleText: Rending Volley deals 4 damage to target white or blue creature.
332850.translation: 撕裂齐射对目标白色或蓝色生物造成4点伤害。

332854.oracleText: Roast deals 5 damage to target creature without flying.
332854.translation: 炙烤对目标不具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。

332860.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to any target. If you control no Dragons, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to you.
332860.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。如果你未操控龙，则CARDNAME对你造成2点伤害。

332861.oracleText: Sarkhan's Rage deals 5 damage to any target. If you control no Dragons, Sarkhan's Rage deals 2 damage to you.
332861.translation: 萨坎之怒对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。如果你未操控龙，则萨坎之怒对你造成2点伤害。

332886.oracleText: Twin Bolt deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.
332886.translation: 双矢击对一个或两个目标造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。

333034.oracleText: Atarka's Command deals 3 damage to each opponent.
333034.translation: 安塔卡的指命向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

333038.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Your opponents can't gain life this turn. 
• Atarka's Command deals 3 damage to each opponent. 
• You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. 
• Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain reach until end of turn.
333038.translation:
选择两项～ 
•本回合中，所有对手不能获得生命。 
•安塔卡的指命向每位对手各造成3点伤害。 
•你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。 
•直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得延势异能。

333053.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a creature or planeswalker spell with the same name as a card in their graveyard, that player loses 10 life.
333053.translation: 每当任一对手施放与其坟墓场中任一张牌同名的生物或鹏洛客咒语时，该牌手失去10点生命。

333056.oracleText: Dragonlord Ojutai has hexproof as long as it's untapped.
333056.translation: 只要龙王欧祝泰未横置，它便具有辟邪异能。

333058.oracleText: Whenever Dragonlord Ojutai deals combat damage to a player, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
333058.translation: 每当龙王欧祝泰对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

333099.oracleText: Draw a card, then add one mana of any color.
333099.translation: 抓一张牌，然后加一点任意颜色的法术力。

333103.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, add {oRoRoRoGoGoG}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
333103.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，加{oRoRoRoGoGoG}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

333156.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 2 damage to target creature.
333156.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成2点伤害。

333160.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Dragon creature spell.
333160.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放龙生物咒语。

333166.oracleText: Exile an instant or sorcery card.
333166.translation: 放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。

333174.oracleText: Target an artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
333174.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的神器或结界为目标。

333180.oracleText: Target any number of creatures and/or planeswalkers your opponents control.
333180.translation: 指定任意数量由你对手操控的生物和／或鹏洛客为目标。

333184.oracleText: Return a nonland permanent you control to its owner's hand.
333184.translation: 将一个由你操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

333185.oracleText: Spend only on: A Dragon Creature Spell
333185.translation: 只能用于支付：龙生物咒语

333186.oracleText: Target a Dragon creature card or Ugin planeswalker card.
333186.translation: 指定一张龙生物或乌金鹏洛客牌为目标。

333281.oracleText: For each player, you choose from among the permanents that player controls an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker. Then each player sacrifices all other nonland permanents they control.
333281.translation: 对每位牌手而言，你从由该牌手操控的永久物中选择一个神器，一个生物，一个结界和一个鹏洛客。然后每位牌手各牺牲所有由他操控的其他非地永久物。

333305.oracleText: Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. If it's your turn, end the turn.
333305.translation: 每位牌手将其手牌与坟墓场洗入其牌库，然后各抓七张牌。如果是在你的回合中，则结束本回合。

333396.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target and you gain 4 life.
333396.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害，且你获得4点生命。

333402.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, choose one that hasn't been chosen — 
• CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target and you gain 4 life. 
• Target opponent discards two cards. 
• Draw two cards. 
• You lose the game.
333402.translation:
在你的维持开始时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ 
•CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害且你获得4点生命。 
•目标对手弃两张牌。 
•抓两张牌。 
•你输掉这盘游戏。

333528.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target. Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, this spell can't be countered.
333528.translation: 精巧火术对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。 精熟咒语～如果你坟墓场中有两张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，则此咒语不能被反击

333559.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a land card.
333559.translation: 弃一张地牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

333566.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice an artifact: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
333566.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲一个神器：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

333567.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice an artifact: Pia and Kiran Nalaar deals 2 damage to any target.
333567.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲一个神器：琵雅纳拉与基岚纳拉对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

333625.oracleText: Each player shuffles all cards from their hand and all permanents they own into their library, then draws that many cards. Each player may put any number of land cards from their hand onto the battlefield. Exile CARDNAME.
333625.translation: 每位牌手将其手牌和由其拥有的所有永久物洗入其牌库，然后各抓等量的牌。每位牌手可以将任意数量的地牌从其手上放进战场。放逐CARDNAME。

333626.oracleText: Each player shuffles all cards from their hand and all permanents they own into their library, then draws that many cards. Each player may put any number of land cards from their hand onto the battlefield. Exile The Great Aurora.
333626.translation: 每位牌手将其所有手牌和由他拥有的所有永久物洗入其牌库，然后各抓等量的牌。每位牌手可以将任意数量的地牌从其手上放进战场。放逐伟大极光。

333687.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
333687.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个其他生物：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

333721.oracleText: Zendikar Incarnate's power is equal to the number of lands you control.
333721.translation: 赞迪卡化身的力量等同于由你操控的地数量。

333758.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. When that mana is spent to cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.
333758.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。 当该法术力用来施放红色瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语，且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

333789.translation: 指定一张非传奇的生物牌为目标。

333792.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with power 2 or less.
333792.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且力量等于或小于2的生物为目标。

333802.oracleText: Target an instant, sorcery, or creature card.
333802.translation: 指定一张瞬间、法术或生物牌为目标。

333804.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: A Red Instant or Sorcery Spell
333804.translation: 用于支付以下费用时有额外效应：红色瞬间或法术咒语

333805.oracleText: When that mana is spent to cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.
333805.translation: 当该法术力用来施放红色瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语，且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

333808.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player exiles two permanents they control.
333808.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手放逐两个由其操控的永久物。

333851.oracleText: When you cast this spell, exile two target permanents.
333851.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，放逐两个目标永久物。

333852.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player exiles the top twenty cards of their library.
333852.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手放逐其牌库顶的二十张牌。

334044.oracleText: Take an extra turn after this one. Exile Part the Waterveil.
334044.translation: 于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。放逐分开水帘。

334583.translation: 放逐两个由其操控的永久物。

334594.translation: 指定一张非地永久物牌为目标。

334628.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if you have fewer than seven cards in hand, draw cards equal to the difference.
334628.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若你的手牌数量少于七张，则抓等同于该差距数量的牌。

334804.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you control can't be countered.
334804.translation: 由你操控的瞬间与法术咒语不能被反击。

334909.oracleText: Kozilek's Return deals 2 damage to each creature.
334909.translation: 寇基雷再临对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

334925.oracleText: Boulder Salvo deals 4 damage to target creature.
334925.translation: 巨石迸发对目标生物造成4点伤害。

334964.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if a planeswalker entered the battlefield under your control this turn, Oath of Chandra deals 2 damage to each opponent.
334964.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有鹏洛客在你的操控下进战场，则茜卓的誓约向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

334968.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
334968.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

335005.oracleText: When you cast this spell, exile target artifact, enchantment, or land.
335005.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，放逐目标神器，结界或地。

335164.oracleText: Target a creature with power or toughness 1 or less.
335164.translation: 指定一个力量或防御力等于或小于1的生物为目标。

335168.oracleText: Target a creature or enchantment an opponent controls.
335168.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的生物或结界为目标。

335169.oracleText: Tap an untapped Ally you control.
335169.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的伙伴。

335181.oracleText: Target up to one creature an opponent controls.
335181.translation: 指定至多一个由对手操控的生物为目标。

335183.oracleText: Target a creature or land card.
335183.translation: 指定一张生物或地牌为目标。

335185.oracleText: Switch the power and toughness of each of up to two target creatures until end of turn.
335185.translation: 将至多两个目标生物各自的力量与防御力互换直到回合结束。

336178.oracleText: Activated abilities of artifacts your opponents control can't be activated.
336178.translation: 由对手操控的神器之起动式异能都不能起动。

336182.oracleText: Colorless spells you cast cost {o2} less to cast.
336182.translation: 你施放的无色咒语减少{o2}来施放。

336184.oracleText: Destroy target permanent that's one or more colors.
336184.translation: 消灭目标有色的永久物。

336188.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to CARDNAME while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove that many +1/+1 counters from CARDNAME.
336188.translation: 如果CARDNAME于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从CARDNAME上移去等量的+1/+1指示物。

336190.oracleText: Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.
336190.translation: 鹏洛客变幻出旧时战友的模样，提醒自己：倘若这次波拉斯得胜，下一个遭殃的便是自己的家园。

336192.oracleText: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."
336192.translation: 「欢迎加入教团。你拯救了这片城区～现在让我们一同拯救世界。」

336193.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains first strike until end of turn. You gain 2 life.
336193.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。你获得2点生命。

336195.oracleText: "We agree that order benefits everyone, but not until you enforce it."
336195.translation: 「我们均同意，制订法条虽能维护秩序，但需切实执行才能惠泽万民。」

336196.oracleText: Tap all creatures your opponents control. Creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.
336196.translation: 横置所有由对手操控的生物。由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

336198.oracleText:
"Where did she come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura
336198.translation:
「她从哪来的？更重要的是，还有更多她这样的人吗？」
～基定尤拉

336201.oracleText:
"There's something peculiar about the cats today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker
336201.translation:
「今天的猫总有点不自然。」
～锡街修补匠贾诺克

336204.oracleText: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."
336204.translation: 「多亏一位波洛斯士兵出手搭救，我的家人才得以幸存。这就是我要加入教团的原因。从今而后，我就是保护者。」

336207.oracleText: Divine Arrow deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
336207.translation: 神箭穿心对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。

336209.oracleText:
"A company of infantry is trapped behind the lines. We need to strike hard and fast to free them, or the casualties will be horrific. Send the griffins."
—Tajic
336209.translation:
「有一整连的部队被困在敌后。我们得迅猛出击、快速行动把他们救出来，否则伤亡不堪设想。派狮鹫过去。」
～塔疾克

336212.oracleText: Create X 2/2 white Soldier creature tokens with vigilance. If X is 10 or more, also create X 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance.
336212.translation: 派出X个2/2白色，具警戒异能的士兵衍生生物。如果X等于或大于10，则再派出X个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使衍生生物。

336216.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to CARDNAME during your turn.
336216.translation: 防止于你的回合中将对CARDNAME造成的所有伤害。

336217.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to Gideon Blackblade during your turn.
336217.translation: 防止于你的回合中将对乌锋基定造成的所有伤害。

336221.oracleText: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.
336221.translation: 令莉莲娜意外的是，背叛波拉斯的后果并未落在自己头上。

336224.oracleText: His triumph came not from victory over his enemies, but from the salvation of those who survived.
336224.translation: 他的胜利并非源自敌人的失败，而是源自幸存者的救赎。

336228.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 4/4 black Zombie Warrior creature token with vigilance.
336228.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，派出一个4/4黑色，具警戒异能的灵俑／战士衍生生物。

336229.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put it into its owner's library third from the top.
336229.translation: 当CARDNAME死去或从战场进入放逐区时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

336230.oracleText: When God-Eternal Oketra dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put it into its owner's library third from the top.
336230.translation: 当永生煞神欧柯塔死去或从战场进入放逐区时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

336232.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, proliferate.
336232.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，增殖。

336235.oracleText:
"If you can't save yourself, you fight to give someone else a chance."
—Ajani Goldmane
336235.translation:
「如果你自己劫数难逃，那就为让他人能够逃出生天而努力奋战。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

336238.oracleText:
"We need to block the exits from the plaza! What's big, heavy, and available?"
—Gideon Jura
336238.translation:
「我们必须把广场的出口都堵上！手边有什么又大又沉的东西吗？」
～基定尤拉

336243.oracleText: His voice is both war horn and rallying cry, a trumpeting call that stirs even the faintest heart.
336243.translation: 他的震耳吼声乃作战信号与激扬呼喊合一，能让最怯懦的心灵都为之振奋。

336247.oracleText: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.
336247.translation: 他们兵员薄弱，队形散乱，武器不整，但你最好还是躲着点。

336251.oracleText: "If I am to die in service, there is no more worthy fight than this."
336251.translation: 「倘若我真要战死沙场，这便是我人生中最光荣的战役。」

336254.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create two 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance that are attacking.
336254.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出两个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使衍生生物，且正进行攻击。

336255.oracleText: Whenever Parhelion II attacks, create two 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance that are attacking.
336255.translation: 每当幻日二号攻击时，派出两个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使衍生生物，且正进行攻击。

336257.oracleText: "I don't understand. He's normally so well behaved!"

336260.oracleText: After millennia to craft victory, Bolas had eternity to contemplate defeat.
336260.translation: 波拉斯原已耗费千年来谋划胜利，如今更有永生时间来反思失败。

336265.oracleText: Even the clouds became a field of battle. Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.
336265.translation: 就连云端也成了杀戮战场。永生者与天使军团在这片人称空舞战阵的修罗炼狱之处殊死作战。

336266.oracleText: Untap all creatures you control. Creatures you control with flying get +2/+2 until end of turn.
336266.translation: 重置所有由你操控的生物。由你操控且具飞行异能的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

336268.oracleText: The heart of Ravnica disappeared before anyone could strike a blow in its defense.
336268.translation: 在有人能够染指拉尼卡核心之前，它就已然消失不见。

336271.oracleText: Grief is a crucible where resolve is tempered.

336272.oracleText: Whenever another creature or planeswalker you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
336272.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

336276.oracleText: Each player chooses a creature or planeswalker they control, then sacrifices the rest. Players can't cast creature or planeswalker spells until the end of your next turn.
336276.translation: 每位牌手各选择一个由他操控的生物或鹏洛客，然后牺牲其余生物和鹏洛客。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，牌手不能施放生物或鹏洛客咒语。

336281.oracleText: Create a 0/3 white Wall creature token with defender.
336281.translation: 派出一个0/3白色，具守军异能的墙衍生生物。

336283.oracleText: Teyo gifted his shields to as many allies as possible, knowing he could not always be there to protect them himself.
336283.translation: 泰佑自知无法始终亲身守护在友军身旁，便广为造盾赠予他们当作护符。

336286.oracleText: "Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."
336286.translation: 「有些人曲解律法。我将律法无从解起。」

336288.oracleText: Your opponents can't play land cards from graveyards.
336288.translation: 对手不能从坟墓场使用地牌。

336290.oracleText: Bolas cared little when his statue fell, thinking it a useful distraction, underestimating the surge of resolve it gave his opponents.
336290.translation: 波拉斯眼见大军推翻自己塑像，只当它成功拖住敌军脚步而不以为意，却忽略了对方由此涌升的必胜信念。

336291.oracleText: Tap target permanent. If it's an artifact, destroy it.
336291.translation: 横置目标永久物。如果它是神器，则消灭之。

336293.oracleText: "Would you give your life to save this world?" Gideon murmured. The pegasus snorted and spread wide its mighty wings.
336293.translation: 「你是否愿意为拯救这个世界献出生命？」基定轻声相问。飞马不屑地喷了个响鼻，毅然展开双翼。

336296.oracleText: Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to you and other permanents you control.
336296.translation: 防止将对你和由你操控之其他永久物造成的所有非战斗伤害。

336297.oracleText: Exile target creature with power 4 or greater.
336297.translation: 放逐目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

336299.oracleText:
"Precise, clean cuts. No one saw anything. Again. Tag the report with my code and file it."
—Lavinia
336299.translation:
「切口精准、整齐。没人看清发生了什么。和上次一样。将报告附上我的代码，整理归档。」
～拉温妮

336300.translation: 放逐目标生物，然后增殖。

336303.oracleText: {o5oW}, {oT}: Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
336303.translation: {o5oW}，{oT}：由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

336306.oracleText: {o3oU}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.

336308.oracleText: "There is no future save the one my master wills."
336308.translation: 「世上只有我主人意欲的未来。」

336310.oracleText:
"I've never seen the firemane angels so anxious."
—Tajic
336310.translation:
「我从未见过炎鬃天使如此紧张。」
～塔疾克

336314.oracleText: "Together we can unlock secrets no one has even dreamed of. I might even let you remember some of them."
336314.translation: 「我们携手，定能超脱常人所想，破解众多秘密。我甚至可能准你把一些留在脑海。」

336318.oracleText:
"They make it clear we are nothing to them."
—Lavinia
336318.translation:
「他们清楚表明：对付我们易如反掌。」
～拉温妮

336321.translation:
「就连神明也得屈膝听令。」
～尼可波拉斯

336324.oracleText: Niv-Mizzet had perfected a plan, but he had no control over the mortal minds who had to agree to implement it.
336324.translation: 尼米捷本已布下绝妙好局，可惜凡人只知盲从，让没法控制心灵的尼米捷无可奈何。

336326.oracleText:
"All I ask is complete obedience."
—Nicol Bolas
336326.translation:
「我要求的是彻底服从。」
～尼可波拉斯

336329.oracleText: An Izzet experiment begins with a "what if," gets approved with a "why not," and concludes with a "eureka!"
336329.translation: 伊捷的实验大致流程如下：从「如果」开始，经「何不」证实，以「有了！」告终。

336333.oracleText: Zombie tokens you control have flying.
336333.translation: 由你操控的灵俑衍生物具有飞行异能。

336337.oracleText: When Fblthp becomes the target of a spell, shuffle Fblthp into its owner's library.
336337.translation: 当夫毕佐成为咒语的目标时，将夫毕佐洗入其拥有者的牌库。

336339.oracleText: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.
336339.translation: 波拉斯靠着这颗巨大宝石来维持与冥想境的联系。在乌金眼中，这正是打倒其胞弟的关键所在。

336343.oracleText: "Inform our allies in the Tenth and throw the circuit. It's about to get weird."
336343.translation: 「通告第十区战友，扔出电圈。好事要来了。」

336344.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, proliferate.
336344.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，增殖。

336346.oracleText: You may reveal the first card you draw each turn as you draw it. Whenever you reveal an instant or sorcery card this way, copy that card and you may cast the copy. That copy costs {o2} less to cast.
336346.translation: 你可以于你抓每回合第一张牌时展示之。每当你以此法展示一张瞬间或法术牌时，复制该牌，且你可以施放该复制品。该复制品减少{o2}来施放。

336347.oracleText: When God-Eternal Kefnet dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put it into its owner's library third from the top.
336347.translation: 当永生煞神刻法涅死去或从战场进入放逐区时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

336350.oracleText: Draw seven cards. Then if your library has no cards in it, you win the game.
336350.translation: 抓七张牌。然后如果你的牌库没有牌，则你赢得这盘游戏。

336352.oracleText: His triumph was not in outsmarting Bolas's plan, but in understanding why ultimate power is self-defeating.
336352.translation: 他的胜利并非因他能算准波拉斯的计划，而是因他能看透为何盛极必衰。

336353.oracleText: Draw two cards. If you control a Jace planeswalker, draw three cards instead.
336353.translation: 抓两张牌。如果你操控杰斯鹏洛客，则改为抓三张牌。

336356.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target a creature or planeswalker you control cost {o2} more to cast.
336356.translation: 对手施放且以由你操控之生物或鹏洛客为目标的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

336357.oracleText: Create a 2/2 blue Wizard creature token. Draw a card, then discard a card.
336357.translation: 派出一个2/2蓝色法术师衍生生物。抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

336359.oracleText:
"Hop away now, little Eternal. Go eat some flies."
—Kasmina
336359.translation:
「到别处蹦去，小永生者。去抓苍蝇吃。」
～克蜜娜

336360.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 1/1.
336360.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且基础力量与防御力为1/1。

336366.oracleText: You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn.
336366.translation: 你和由你操控的永久物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

336371.oracleText: Each opponent can't draw more than one card each turn.
336371.translation: 每位对手每回合所抓的牌不能多于一张。

336372.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a noncreature, nonland card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
336372.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张非生物且非地的牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

336374.oracleText:
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon."
—Narset
336374.translation:
「在乱战之中，敌人的攻击可能就是你最称手的武器。」
～娜尔施

336375.oracleText: Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it to its owner's hand. You may choose new targets for the copy.
336375.translation: 复制目标瞬间或法术咒语，然后将该咒语移回其拥有者的手上。你可以为复制品选择新的目标。

336380.oracleText: They approach in formation, every movement efficient and sure. They halt, listen, and then press on in silent unison.
336380.translation: 他们列阵推进，动作俐落果断。他们停止，听令，而后又迈着同一步调，无声前行。

336383.oracleText: "Now, little fighter, show me you deserved this second chance."
336383.translation: 「现在，小小战士，向我证明你配得上我给你的这第二次机会。」

336387.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, draw a card.
336387.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

336390.oracleText: Courier owls joined the fray, attacking the Dreadhorde with a viciousness usually reserved for mail thieves.
336390.translation: 信使猫头鹰加入战局，拿出平日里对付窃信贼的凶狠姿态向震惧军袭去。

336391.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
336391.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

336397.oracleText: They worked well as a team, but they knew it couldn't last forever.
336397.translation: 它们合作无间，但也清楚这种模式无法长久。

336398.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
336398.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

336401.oracleText:
"What they don't know will definitely hurt them."
—Lazav
336401.translation:
「他们不明白的东西绝对能重创他们。」
～拉札夫

336402.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. That creature can't be blocked this turn.
336402.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。该生物本回合不能被阻挡。

336404.oracleText: Tamiyo wished only to observe the war, but she soon realized neutrality was not an option.
336404.translation: 多美代原本只想旁观战乱进展，但她很快就意识到自己根本没法抽身事外。

336406.oracleText: "The safest place for you is not now."

336410.oracleText: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.
336410.translation: 时空渡桥的出现在乙太中荡起涟漪，创出全新物种的同时转化了其他旧有面孔。

336411.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
336411.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

336413.oracleText: At least this was better than that week at the Juri Revue.
336413.translation: 至少这比上次在裘里剧团度过的那周好些。

336418.oracleText: "I never liked you. Now get up—we have a fight to finish."
336418.translation: 「我从没喜欢过你们。但现在赶紧起来～仗还没打完。」

336419.oracleText: Return target planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
336419.translation: 将目标鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

336420.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. 
• Return target planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
336420.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 
•将目标鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

336423.oracleText:
"I wish I could train a pack of them for hunting in the undercity. But I'd never dare turn my back, and I hate to think what I'd have to feed them."
—Zhosmir, urban huntmaster
336423.translation:
「我虽然希望自己能训练一群这样的猎犬在地底城里狩猎，但我绝不敢掉以轻心，也讨厌去想该拿什么来喂它们。」
～城市猎师佐斯密尔

336429.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice ten nonland permanents: Each opponent loses 10 life.
336429.translation: {oT}，牺牲十个非地永久物：每位对手各失去10点生命。

336436.oracleText: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army, gritting her teeth behind the Chain Veil.
336436.translation: 虽然莉莲娜坐拥号令波拉斯大军的兵权，但在锁链面纱之下，却是一副咬牙切齿的表情。

336441.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has one or fewer cards in hand, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to them.
336441.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，若该牌手的手牌为一张或更少，则CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

336445.oracleText: Shadows coiled around the witness's mind. Then the moment vanished, leaving only the sting of its loss.
336445.translation: 阴影在目击者的思绪当中聚集。然后脑海中的那一瞬间突然消失，只剩下失忆带来的隐隐刺痛。

336447.oracleText: Choose up to four target cards in your graveyard. If you control a Bolas planeswalker, return those cards to your hand. Otherwise, an opponent chooses two of them. Leave the chosen cards in your graveyard and put the rest into your hand.
336447.translation: 选择至多四张目标在你坟墓场中的牌。如果你操控波拉斯鹏洛客，则将这些牌移回你手上。若否，则任一对手从中选择两张。将所选的牌留在你的坟墓场，其余的牌则置于你的手上。

336452.oracleText: Whenever a Zombie token you control with power 6 or greater attacks, it gains lifelink until end of turn.
336452.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或大于6的灵俑衍生物攻击时，它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

336454.oracleText: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.
336454.translation: 这只永生猫似乎感受到莉莲娜的号令，但仅抬头不屑地看了她一眼，而后悠闲地舔了舔自己的爪子，穿过屋顶跑开。

336455.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature or planeswalker: Put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
336455.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物或鹏洛客：在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

336458.oracleText:
