Gideon eyed the Dimir emissary warily. "Could your agents slip inside Bolas's citadel?"
The figure met his gaze with icy resolve. "We already have."
336458.translation:
基定怀疑地看着底密尔密使：「你们的密探能不能进到波拉斯尊殿中一探究竟？」
对方直视基定目光，冷冰冰地回道：「我们已经去过了。」

336464.oracleText:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren
336464.translation:
「他们叫做『永生者』。他们永远不会停息。」
～杰斯贝连

336466.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o2oB}. If you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
336466.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o2oB}。若你如此作，则将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

336469.oracleText: When you rule by fear, your greatest weakness is one who's no longer afraid.
336469.translation: 如果你利用恐惧来统治，那你最大的弱点便是无所畏惧之人。

336470.oracleText: Destroy up to three target creatures with toughness X or less. If X is 10 or more, return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
336470.translation: 消灭至多三个目标防御力等于或小于X的生物。如果X等于或大于10，则将所有生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

336474.oracleText: When God-Eternal Bontu dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put it into its owner's library third from the top.
336474.translation: 当永生煞神芭图死去或从战场进入放逐区时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

336476.oracleText: Amonkhet's dead flowed into a new world in service to their God-Pharaoh.
336476.translation: 阿芒凯的亡者听令法老神，纷纷涌入新世界。

336480.oracleText: The Eternals found some sparks to be quite slippery.
336480.translation: 永生者发现某些狡猾的火花抓不住。

336481.oracleText: Enchant creature or planeswalker you control
336481.translation: 结附于由你操控的生物或鹏洛客

336482.oracleText: When enchanted permanent dies or is put into exile, return that card to the battlefield under your control.
336482.translation: 当所结附的永久物死去或进入放逐区时，将该永久物牌在你的操控下移回战场。

336487.oracleText: Despite their many forms, the Eternals worked in chilling harmony, unburdened by instinct or emotion.
336487.translation: 虽然永生者形态各异，但他们合作时的默契令人胆寒，完全不受本能或情绪拖累。

336490.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, draw a card.
336490.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

336491.oracleText: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
336491.translation: 派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

336493.oracleText: Each opponent chooses a permanent they control of each permanent type and sacrifices the rest.
336493.translation: 每位对手各从由其操控的永久物中为每种永久物类别各选择一个，然后牺牲其余永久物。

336495.oracleText: Her triumph came not from escaping her death, but in claiming her independence.
336495.translation: 她的胜利并非源自幸免死亡，而是源自重获自由。

336502.oracleText: Destroy target creature. Its controller draws two cards.
336502.translation: 消灭目标生物。其操控者抓两张牌。

336504.oracleText: Trapped on Ravnica with no affection for either side, Ob Nixilis sought gratification in random acts of torment.
336504.translation: 受困拉尼卡后，无意加入任一方的欧尼希兹只能从恣意折磨中寻得慰藉。

336505.oracleText: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
336505.translation: 目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

336507.oracleText: The moment Liliana defied Nicol Bolas, her contract was broken, and her life was forfeit. But she was free to choose her fate, and she decided it was worth the price.
336507.translation: 从莉莲娜以实际行动违抗尼可波拉斯那一刻起，她就已经破弃自己立下的契约，放弃了自己的生命。但这样便能自主选择命运走向，她甘愿付出代价。

336508.oracleText: Remove up to five counters from target artifact, creature, planeswalker, or opponent.
336508.translation: 从目标神器，生物，鹏洛客或对手上移去至多五个指示物。

336510.oracleText:
"It's faster than we are. Draw its attention while the Ledev take aim!"
—Shauntal, Boros legionnaire
336510.translation:
「它比我们还快。吸引它的注意力，好让列夫借机瞄准！」
～波洛斯军团兵沙陶

336512.oracleText:
"I see you're out of the wall."
—Nahiri
336512.translation:
「似乎你从墙里出来了。」
～娜希丽

336514.oracleText: With the harvest of Domri's spark, the Elderspell began to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.
336514.translation: 至尊咒收下多密的火花后，开始让波拉斯渐现神格。

336515.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {o3oB}.
336515.translation: 牺牲一个生物或支付{o3oB}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

336517.oracleText:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya
336517.translation:
「我知道它们都是为收割灵魂而生的不息战士～可它们的手法未免太粗鲁了。」
～卡娅

336518.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice a creature or planeswalker: You gain 1 life and draw a card.
336518.translation: {o3}，牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客：你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

336520.oracleText:
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them."
—Teysa
336520.translation:
「我常说充裕的战备资金能帮我们赢得胜利，但并不是说要用装满金币的箱子去砸敌人。」
～泰莎

336524.oracleText:
"No one will ever ride me again, Gideon. Expect no further favors."
—Rakdos
336524.translation:
「基定，这是我最后一次让人骑在我头上。别指望我会再帮你。」
～拉铎司

336525.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
336525.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得不灭异能。

336528.oracleText: {o6oB}: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
336528.translation: {o6oB}：每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

336532.oracleText: Zombie tokens you control have deathtouch.
336532.translation: 由你操控的灵俑衍生物具有死触异能。

336535.oracleText: "You might have pleaded your case with my queen earlier. Now I am here, and it is far too late."
336535.translation: 「之前你或许向女王求过情。但既然我已出现在你面前，说明为时已晚。」

336539.oracleText:
"Give me a crew like this one and I'd rule any sea I sailed."
—Angrath
336539.translation:
「给我一队这样的船员，我就能称霸四海。」
～安戈斯

336541.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
336541.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

336544.oracleText:
"Peril is in the eye of the beholder. At least, if your aim is good."
—Jaya Ballard
336544.translation:
「各人看到的危险各不相同。至少，你得先看得准。」
～雅亚巴拉德

336545.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target creature. That creature can't block this turn.
336545.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成1点伤害。该生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

336546.oracleText: Blindblast deals 1 damage to target creature. That creature can't block this turn.
336546.translation: 眩目冲击对目标生物造成1点伤害。该生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

336548.oracleText:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek
336548.translation:
「向他们倾尽你所能…以及你所不能。」
～拉尔查雷克

336549.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
336549.translation: 如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

336550.oracleText: Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target.
336550.translation: 为仅指定单一目标的目标咒语或异能更改目标。

336552.oracleText: "Why don't we fight for what's right and let bureaucrats argue over details?"
336552.translation: 「我们为何不联合为正确的事情而战，把繁文缛节留给官僚去考虑？」

336553.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any other target.
336553.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。CARDNAME对任意另一个目标造成2点伤害。

336554.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Bond of Passion deals 2 damage to any other target.
336554.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。热情璧合对任意另一个目标造成2点伤害。

336556.oracleText: "This day will end in death, but not the one you hoped for. This day will end in victory, but not the one you expected."
336556.translation: 「这天终会有人丧生，但非你所愿之日。这日终会有人得胜，但非你所料之时。」

336557.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn, then scry 1.
336557.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束，然后占卜1。

336560.oracleText:
"You say this Tenth District, not Rubblebelt. But where smash happen, that Rubblebelt. Rubblebelt state of mind."
—Urgdar, cyclops philosopher
336560.translation:
「你说这第十区，不是瓦砾区。但有破坏在，就是瓦砾区。瓦砾区精神。」
～独眼巨人哲学家厄哥达

336564.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
336564.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

336566.oracleText:
"Now that I've dealt with your little toys, I can focus on the real problem: you."
—Chandra Nalaar, to Dovin Baan
336566.translation:
「你的小玩具已经全部处理干净，现在能够专心来对付真正的问题了：你。」
～茜卓纳拉怒喝多温班恩

336568.oracleText: Her triumph came not from achieving her ideal self, but from rejecting the idea of perfection.
336568.translation: 她的胜利并非源自实现理念中的自我，而是源自抛弃追求完美的念头。

336575.oracleText:
"For every inch of land they take from us, we take it back or we burn it. Give them nothing."
—Aurelia
336575.translation:
「他们从我们手中夺走的每一寸土地，抢不回来的就给我烧干净。什么都不给他们留下。」
～欧瑞梨

336577.oracleText: There's no crisis a hellion can't make worse.
336577.translation: 地狱兽能把所有危机都变得更糟糕。

336585.oracleText: Zombie tokens you control have trample.
336585.translation: 由你操控的灵俑衍生物具有践踏异能。

336589.oracleText: What he lacks in patience, intelligence, empathy, lucidity, hygiene, ability to follow orders, self-regard, and discernible skills, he makes up for in sheer chaotic violence.
336589.translation: 他耐心不够，脑子不灵，热情不足，神志不清，体味不佳，模仿不好，自制不行，啥都不会，但他的野蛮破坏力补回了这一切。

336591.oracleText: Under the veneer of the various guilds, each goblin has the same basic need: to run screaming at the enemy and hit a bunch of stuff.
336591.translation: 虽然表面上所属公会不同，但私底下鬼怪都一样：尖叫着冲向敌人，拿各种东西砸上去。

336594.oracleText: Beneath each gleaming mineral shell rots a once-proud warrior of Amonkhet.
336594.translation: 在每尊闪亮的矿石外壳底下，都是一具阿芒凯勇士的腐尸。

336599.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or planeswalker.
336599.translation: 牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

336600.oracleText: Heartfire deals 4 damage to any target.
336600.translation: 心源烈焰对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

336602.oracleText: In life, they revered a diverse pantheon of gods. Now they revere only the God-Pharaoh.
336602.translation: 他们生前信仰各不相同。如今他们只膜拜法老神。

336606.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. Return that creature to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
336606.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该生物移回你手上。

336610.oracleText:
"Fall back! You are no match for this."
—Samut
336610.translation:
「退后！你们不是这东西的对手。」
～撒姆特

336613.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
336613.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

336617.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. Scry 1.
336617.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。占卜1。

336618.oracleText: Jaya's Greeting deals 3 damage to target creature. Scry 1.
336618.translation: 雅亚的问候对目标生物造成3点伤害。占卜1。

336620.oracleText: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."
336620.translation: 「大家都逃了，敌人还没来～正是抢劫好时机。」

336624.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature and gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
336624.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为神器生物且得+1/+1。

336628.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+0 until end of turn.
336628.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+2/+0直到回合结束。

336630.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, you may discard any number of cards. If you do, draw that many cards and add that much {oR}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
336630.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成伤害时，你可以弃任意数量的牌。若你如此作，则抓等量的牌并加等量的{oR}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

336633.oracleText:
"Seeing so much easy prey makes her crazy. See how she snorts and drools?"
—Dhuuz, kronch wrangler
336633.translation:
「看到遍地猎物唾手可及让她兴奋不已。看见她喷响鼻流口水了吗？」
～恐骐兽驯师杜兹

336636.oracleText: Samut's war was intensely personal. Every hour she faced enemies she once loved as friends and horrors she once revered as gods.
336636.translation: 这场战争对撒姆特折磨尤甚。她每时每刻都在与曾经情同手足的好友为敌，无时无刻不在与曾经顶礼膜拜的神明作战。

336637.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+1 and gains haste until end of turn. Scry 1.
336637.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+1且获得敏捷异能。占卜1。

336639.oracleText: Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, each Dragon you control deals 1 damage to that creature.
336639.translation: 每当一个生物攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客时，每个由你操控的龙各对该生物造成1点伤害。

336640.oracleText: Until end of turn, each planeswalker you control becomes a 4/4 red Dragon creature and gains flying.
336640.translation: 直到回合结束，每个由你操控的鹏洛客均成为4/4红色的龙生物且获得飞行异能。

336641.oracleText: Create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
336641.translation: 派出一个4/4红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

336644.oracleText: Sarkhan's Catharsis deals 5 damage to target player or planeswalker.
336644.translation: 萨坎的净秽对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

336646.oracleText: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.
336646.translation: 两只怪奇从各自的实验室里逃出之后组成搭档，以战场上的奥术能量为食。

336655.oracleText: Common Gruul career aspirations: berserker, shaman, catapult.
336655.translation: 古鲁常见的职业目标：狂战士、祭师、投石兵。

336659.oracleText:
"We fight to stop a tyrant, but we also fight for the gentle creatures who have no concept of what befalls their world."
—Vivien Reid
336659.translation:
「我们为击倒暴君而战斗，同时也为了那些温顺的生物而战斗；它们无法理解是何等灾难降临自己世界。」
～薇薇安瑞德

336664.oracleText: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
336664.translation: 派出一个2/2绿色狼衍生生物。

336669.oracleText: The Eternal armies advanced on Vitu-Ghazi. At Nissa's command, Vitu-Ghazi advanced on them.
336669.translation: 永生者大军向维图加基进发。但在妮莎一声令下，维图加基反向他们袭来。

336670.oracleText: Put nine +1/+1 counters on target land you control. It becomes a legendary 0/0 Elemental creature with haste named Vitu-Ghazi. It's still a land.
336670.translation: 在目标由你操控的地上放置九个+1/+1指示物。它成为传奇的0/0元素生物，名称为维图加基，且具有敏捷异能。它仍然是地。

336672.oracleText: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.
336672.translation: 在危难之时，上古元祖原本对城市的憧憬重回世间。

336673.oracleText: Up to two target creatures you control each deal damage equal to their power to another target creature.
336673.translation: 选择至多两个目标由你操控的生物和另一个目标生物。前者各依其力量对后者造成伤害。

336675.oracleText:
"Tread upon these flower beds at your own peril."
—Emmara
336675.translation:
「踩到这些花床后果自负。」
～艾玛拉

336678.oracleText: "We agree that life should flourish. We disagree on the optimal number of limbs."
336678.translation: 「我们都同意生命应得滋养绽放，但对手脚的最优数量有所分歧。」

336679.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. You gain 3 life.
336679.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中的一张永久物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。你获得3点生命。

336681.oracleText: "I call upon the vigor of the grasses, the hopes of the flowers, and the dreams of the trees."
336681.translation: 「我唤起青草的活力，鲜花的希望，树木的梦想。」

336684.oracleText: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.
336684.translation: 战争对多数人而言是灾难。对少数人而言是机遇。对极少数人而言则是乐趣。

336685.oracleText: Each creature you control with power 4 or greater can't be blocked by more than one creature.
336685.translation: 每个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物均不能多于一个生物阻挡。

336688.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature, then proliferate.
336688.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后增殖。

336693.oracleText: Some spells sing a quiet tune. Others roar.
336693.translation: 有些咒语低吟浅唱，有些则放声咆哮。

336696.oracleText: The druid knew only one spell, a charm to encourage rapid plant growth. When airborne Eternals invaded her arboretum, she had to get creative.
336696.translation: 看护植物园的德鲁伊只晓得一种咒语：滋养植物快速生长的符咒。当飞空永生者入侵她的地界时，她必须发挥创意。

336697.oracleText: Put target creature with flying on the bottom of its owner's library.
336697.translation: 将目标具飞行异能的生物置于其拥有者的牌库底。

336698.oracleText:
"Sometimes Mowu is content to gnaw on a bone. Sometimes he wants the whole skeleton."
—Jiang Yanggu
336698.translation:
「有时默武叼根骨头就能满足。有时他想啃整个骨架。」
～姜旸谷

336702.oracleText: When God-Eternal Rhonas dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put it into its owner's library third from the top.
336702.translation: 当永生煞神罗纳斯死去或从战场进入放逐区时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

336705.oracleText: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
336705.translation: 每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物均具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

336706.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
336706.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

336709.oracleText: He listens to the sounds of battle filtering down from above, waiting for silence, waiting for his time to claim the streets.
336709.translation: 他倾听地面上层层传下的打斗声响，静待尘埃落定的那一刻，静待他夺回街道的时机。

336715.oracleText: Wherever Yanggu goes, Mowu follows—sometimes at his side, sometimes obscuring him from view entirely.
336715.translation: 旸谷所至，默武随之～或相伴左右，或挺身护主。

336716.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on CARDNAME, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
336716.translation: 如果将会在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

336719.oracleText: Whenever you tap a Forest for mana, add an additional {oG}.
336719.translation: 每当你横置一个树林以产生法术力时，额外加{oG}。

336720.oracleText: Put three +1/+1 counters on up to one target noncreature land you control. Untap it. It becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with vigilance and haste that's still a land.
336720.translation: 在至多一个目标由你操控且非生物的地上放置三个+1/+1指示物。将之重置。它成为0/0，具警戒与敏捷异能的元素生物，且仍然是地。

336721.translation: 由你操控的地具有不灭异能

336724.oracleText: Her triumph came not from destroying the unnatural, but from fostering life.
336724.translation: 她的胜利并非源自消灭造物，而是源自滋养生命。

336739.oracleText: Elite training, single-minded devotion, and lazotep coating help only so much for invaders who are fundamentally bite-sized.
336739.translation: 虽然入侵者们经过超凡训练，信念坚定统一，还有拉佐特石护甲佑体，但面对一口能将他们吞下的敌人，这些都帮不上什么忙。

336742.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Exile target card from a graveyard.
336742.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

336744.oracleText:
"Let's lure the drakes to the webs over the Samok Stand. Keep the spiders content."
—Aurelia
336744.translation:
「我们去把龙兽都引到撒莫林的蛛网那里。让蜘蛛们饱餐一顿。」
～欧瑞梨

336748.oracleText: Untap target creature. It gets +1/+4 and gains reach until end of turn.
336748.translation: 重置目标生物。直到回合结束，它得+1/+4且获得延势异能。

336751.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, destroy target artifact or enchantment defending player controls.
336751.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，消灭目标由防御牌手操控的神器或结界。

336752.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, destroy target artifact or enchantment defending player controls."
336752.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得「每当此生物对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，消灭目标由防御牌手操控的神器或结界。」

336754.oracleText:
"I thought this was a civilized plane. How are there so many feral beasts?"
—Dovin Baan
336754.translation:
「我原以为这是个文明时空。但为何会有如此多的狂暴野兽？」
～多温班恩

336758.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gains vigilance and reach.
336758.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物获得警戒与延势异能。

336763.oracleText: {o3oG}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a creature or planeswalker card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, put it on the bottom of your library.
336763.translation: {o3oG}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是生物或鹏洛客牌，你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。如果你未将该牌置于你手上，则将其置于你的牌库底。

336765.oracleText:
"The Eternals had to endure Amonkhet's five trials. Let's see if they can pass the Trial of Ravnica."
—Jace Beleren
336765.translation:
「永生者都需经历阿芒凯的五重祀炼。让我们瞧瞧他们能不能通过拉尼卡试炼。」
～杰斯贝连

336769.oracleText: "Grand city? No. This is nothing but another squalid cage."
336769.translation: 「宏伟都市？错。这里不过又是一个破败的囚笼。」

336777.oracleText: Whenever one or more loyalty counters are put on planeswalkers you control, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
336777.translation: 每当在由你操控的鹏洛客上放置一个或数个忠诚指示物时，在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

336780.oracleText:
Choose one or more — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target creature. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Destroy target land. 
• Destroy target planeswalker.
336780.translation:
选择一项或多项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标生物。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•消灭目标地。 
•消灭目标鹏洛客。

336782.oracleText: "Whichever side wins, I'm sure the banquet will be superb."
336782.translation: 「无论哪方得胜，宴会定将丰盛无比。」

336783.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature or planeswalker you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
336783.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

336789.oracleText: Add {oR} or {oG}. Creature spells you cast this turn can't be countered.
336789.translation: 加{oR}或{oG}。本回合中，你施放的生物咒语不能被反击。

336790.oracleText: Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
336790.translation: 目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

336793.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
336793.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

336797.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
336797.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

336799.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
336799.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

336802.oracleText:
"Be careful. You'll have more than Dovin to contend with if you hope to breach New Prahv."
—Lavinia, to Chandra Nalaar
336802.translation:
「当心。如果你想要突破新布拉夫，要对付的并不只有多温。」
～拉温妮提醒茜卓纳拉

336809.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature you control, exile that card instead of putting it into your graveyard as it resolves. If you do, return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
336809.translation: 每当你施放一个以由你操控之生物为目标的瞬间或法术咒语，于该咒语结算时，改为放逐该牌，而非将其置入你的坟墓场。若你如此作，则在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

336812.oracleText: Zombie tokens you control have hexproof and menace.
336812.translation: 由你操控的灵俑衍生物具有辟邪与威慑异能。

336815.oracleText: Discard all the cards in your hand, then draw that many cards plus one. You gain life equal to the number of cards in your hand.
336815.translation: 弃掉你的手牌，然后抓该数量加一的牌。你获得等同于你手牌数量的生命。

336817.oracleText: The essence of Ixalan was never far from Huatli's heart.
336817.translation: 依夏兰的菁华从未远离华特莉的内心。

336820.oracleText: Death greeted the world with a roar of desert air.
336820.translation: 死亡用充满沙漠气息的狂吼向世界致意。

336823.oracleText: It feeds on the dark energies that course through the deep world—and on any other creature lured by the leyline's pull.
336823.translation: 它吸食飘荡在地底世界的黑暗能量～以及任何其他被地脉吸引而来的生物。

336826.oracleText: Whenever a player sacrifices a permanent, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
336826.translation: 每当任一牌手牺牲一个永久物时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

336835.oracleText: CARDNAME has all loyalty abilities of all other planeswalkers on the battlefield.
336835.translation: CARDNAME具有战场上所有其他鹏洛客的所有忠诚异能。

336837.oracleText: You draw a card. Each opponent exiles a card from their hand or a permanent they control.
336837.translation: 你抓一张牌。每位对手各放逐一张手牌或一个由其操控的永久物。

336838.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。

336839.oracleText: Each opponent who doesn't control a legendary creature or planeswalker loses the game.
336839.translation: 每位未操控传奇生物或传奇鹏洛客的对手各输掉这盘游戏。

336844.oracleText: "So everyone gets what they truly deserve, I will keep watch."
336844.translation: 「只要人人各得其所，我便将挚诚守护。」

336850.oracleText:
"No one hero will save this day. Today we must all be heroes."
—Gideon Jura
336850.translation:
「如今没人能单枪匹马力挽狂澜。今天我们都必须挺身而出。」
～基定尤拉

336851.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. You gain 1 life for each creature you control.
336851.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。你每操控一个生物，便获得1点生命。

336853.oracleText: Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
336853.translation: 每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

336857.oracleText:
"Time to find the melting point of lazotep."
—Ral Zarek
336857.translation:
「该找出拉佐特石的熔点了。」
～拉尔查雷克

336858.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
336858.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

336859.oracleText: Ral's Outburst deals 3 damage to any target. Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
336859.translation: 拉尔的爆发对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

336863.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, proliferate, then proliferate again.
336863.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，增殖，然后再增殖。

336866.oracleText: Uthlon the Wise scandalized sphinx society, hooting the answers to riddles as he rampaged through Tin Street. Grangle, on the other hand, sat for hours, deep in thought, largely ignored by fellow goblins.
336866.translation: 智者乌斯隆的作为大出所有史芬斯的意料：他在锡街上四处跳窜，尖啸着喊出谜语的答案。而戈兰格则蹲坐数小时，陷入沉思，很多鬼怪同胞无视他的存在。

336867.oracleText: Exchange control of two target permanents that share a permanent type.
336867.translation: 选择两个目标具共通永久物类别的永久物。交换两者的操控权。

336869.oracleText:
"If the system is broken, break the system."
—Domri Rade
336869.translation:
「如果整个体系都已崩坏，那就将体系本身破坏干净。」
～多密雷德

336870.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
336870.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为由你操控的生物中力量最大者的数值。

336876.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
336876.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

336880.oracleText: As the Eternal's cold fingers tightened around his throat, Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.
336880.translation: 随着永生者扼在自己喉咙上的冰冷手指慢慢收紧，多密终于看穿自己急切想要去服侍之主人的真面目。

336881.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a counter from an artifact, creature, land, or planeswalker you control: Draw a card.
336881.translation: {oT}，从由你操控的神器、生物、地或鹏洛客上移去一个指示物：抓一张牌。

336884.oracleText: In times of war, only death flourishes.
336884.translation: 战争时代，绽放的只有死亡。

336885.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, return to your hand target creature or planeswalker card in your graveyard that wasn't put there this combat.
336885.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的生物或鹏洛客牌，且不能是本次战斗中进入该处者。将该牌移回你手上。

336888.oracleText: Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause you to discard cards or sacrifice permanents.
336888.translation: 由对手操控的咒语和异能无法让你弃牌或牺牲永久物。

336889.oracleText: Choose a nonland card name, then reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all cards with the chosen name from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
336889.translation: 选择一个非地牌的名称，然后展示你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中所有具该名称的牌置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

336890.oracleText: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
336890.translation: 将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

336892.oracleText: Until your next turn, you may cast sorcery spells as though they had flash.
336892.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，你可以将法术咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

336893.oracleText: Return up to one target artifact, creature, or enchantment to its owner's hand. Draw a card.
336893.translation: 将至多一个目标神器，生物或结界移回其拥有者的手上。抓一张牌。

336896.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets CARDNAME, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME, then scry 1.
336896.translation: 每当你施放以CARDNAME为目标的咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后占卜1。

336899.oracleText:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi
336899.translation:
「我得花上数年来研究时间才能得出完整解释。但简单来说，他们现在根本就还没出生。」
～泰菲力

336900.oracleText: Return a creature you control to its owner's hand, then destroy all creatures.
336900.translation: 将一个由你操控的生物移回其拥有者的手上，然后消灭所有生物。

336907.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard a land card: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
336907.translation: {o1oR}，弃一张地牌：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

336909.oracleText: {oG}: Return a tapped land you control to its owner's hand.
336909.translation: {oG}：将一个由你操控且已横置的地移回其拥有者手上。

336911.oracleText: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."
336911.translation: 莉莲娜向欧柯塔和芭图尚存的意识低语道：「你们才是神明。他不过是篡位者。你们清楚该怎么办。」

336914.oracleText:
"The hero with the magic sword slays the dragon? Not this time."
—Nicol Bolas
336914.translation:
「英雄手持魔剑击杀巨龙？这次可不会这样。」
～尼可波拉斯

336922.oracleText: Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause their controller to search their library.
336922.translation: 由对手操控的咒语和异能无法让其操控者搜寻其牌库。

336925.oracleText: Artifact, instant, and sorcery spells your opponents cast cost {o1} more to cast.
336925.translation: 对手施放的神器、瞬间和法术咒语增加{o1}来施放。

336926.oracleText: Until your next turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target permanent an opponent controls.
336926.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，防止目标由对手操控的永久物将受到与造成的所有伤害。

336928.oracleText: You gain life equal to the greatest toughness among creatures you control.
336928.translation: 你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控的生物中防御力最大者的数值。

336930.oracleText: Your opponents and permanents your opponents control with hexproof can be the targets of spells and abilities you control as though they didn't have hexproof.
336930.translation: 对具辟邪异能的对手及由对手操控且具该异能的永久物而言，你能将其视同不具该异能地指定为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标。

336937.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target tapped creature.
336937.translation: CARDNAME对目标已横置的生物造成X点伤害。

336940.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
336940.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

336941.oracleText: Target artifact you control becomes a copy of another target artifact or creature you control until end of turn, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
336941.translation: 目标由你操控的神器成为另一个目标由你操控的神器或生物之复制品直到回合结束，但它额外具有神器此类别。

336943.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+1 and gains haste until end of turn. Scry 1.
336943.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+1且获得敏捷异能。占卜1。

336945.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with deathtouch deals damage to a player or planeswalker, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
336945.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具死触异能的生物对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成伤害时，在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

336949.oracleText: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.
336949.translation: 虽然尼米捷离故让全城陷入悲痛，但他已为新生做好万全准备。

336951.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana of different colors.

336953.oracleText: A dictator's infuriating smirk, an affront to everything Ravnica stood for.
336953.translation: 专横暴君的挑衅面容，恰是对拉尼卡代表之合作精神全面宣战。

336954.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast cost {o2} more to cast.
336954.translation: 对手施放的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

336955.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses 1 life.
336955.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

336957.oracleText:
"Hopefully Ravnica will prove harder to break."
—Karn
336957.translation:
「希望拉尼卡更能经受住考验。」
～卡恩

336959.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add two mana of different colors.
336959.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：加两点不同颜色的法术力。

336962.oracleText:
"Why would someone have built . . . wait, never mind. Send it to the front lines!"
—Commander Grozdan
336962.translation:
「为什么会有人造出这种…等等，没事了。把它派到前线去！」
～指挥官戈洛兹丹

336965.oracleText:
"I don't care if it's an all-powerful relic or a street vendor's lucky charm. If it brings you courage, wear it."
—Saheeli Rai
336965.translation:
「我不在乎这是蕴藏强大力量的遗宝，还是街头小贩手中的护符。只要它能让你获得勇气，那就戴上。」
～莎希莉莱伊

336968.oracleText: It didn't budge when the portal opened, nor when the ancient gods emerged. It came to life only when all ten guilds came together to face a common threat.
336968.translation: 它在通道开启时并无任何动静，古神现身时也没有声响。只有当十大公会携手齐心共抗威胁时，方才醒转过来。

336969.oracleText: {o2}: Add one mana of any color.

336971.oracleText: "Track the source of those thopters," Saheeli told her creation. "And feel free to snack on as many as you want."
336971.translation: 「去追踪这些振翼机的来源，」莎希莉命令自己的造物。「要当点心吃到饱也行。」

336975.oracleText: The Planar Bridge opened over the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing the symbol of Ravnica's endurance to rubble.
336975.translation: 时空渡桥在十会盟堂正上方打开，将拉尼卡长存象征化作废墟。

336976.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
336976.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：于本回合中，你可以将咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

336978.oracleText: Guild leaders focused their magic on the portal scar. Where the Chamber perished, a parun could be reborn.
336978.translation: 公会长们合力将魔法灌注到通道残骸之上。十会盟堂消失之地，正是元祖重生之所。

336980.oracleText: Whenever you cast a planeswalker spell, you gain 1 life.
336980.translation: 每当你施放鹏洛客咒语时，你获得1点生命。

336981.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Add two mana of different colors. Spend this mana only to cast planeswalker spells.
336981.translation: {o1}，{oT}：加两点不同颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放鹏洛客咒语。

336983.oracleText:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn
336983.translation:
「我无法保护所有人。但所有能保护的，我都会尽力而为。」
～卡恩

336985.oracleText: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.
336985.translation: 有时候帮手就是你手中的最强武器。

336986.oracleText: {o4}: CARDNAME becomes a 3/3 Citizen creature with vigilance until end of turn. It's still a land. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature and planeswalker you control.
336986.translation: {o4}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为3/3，具警戒异能的市民生物。它仍然是地。你每操控一个传奇生物或传奇鹏洛客，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

336990.oracleText: {oXoX}, {oT}: Put X charge counters on CARDNAME.

336995.oracleText: Whenever you attack with two or more non-Gideon creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures.
336995.translation: 每当你以两个或更多非基定的生物攻击时，在这些生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

336996.oracleText: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a 5/5 white Soldier creature that's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
336996.translation: 直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为5/5士兵生物，且仍然是鹏洛客。防止本回合中将对他造成的所有伤害。

336998.oracleText: Exile CARDNAME and each creature your opponents control.
336998.translation: 放逐CARDNAME和所有由对手操控的生物。

337001.oracleText: Ravnica held its breath as the hero of the resistance—their last hope—flew through the sky, his dark sword ready to strike a god.
337001.translation: 拉尼卡的最后希望就已寄托在这位仍奋力抗争的勇士身上。只见他手握乌锋一跃而起，直向神龙命门冲去～这一刻全城皆尽屏息凝视。

337002.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn. You gain 2 life.
337002.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得飞行异能。你获得2点生命。

337004.oracleText: "Break their formation! Thin their ranks! I'm right behind you!"
337004.translation: 「冲散敌人阵型！击倒敌人兵员！我与你们生死与共！」

337009.oracleText: {o3oW}: Put a loyalty counter on target Gideon planeswalker.
337009.translation: {o3oW}：在目标基定鹏洛客上放置一个忠诚指示物。

337011.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
337011.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

337012.oracleText: Creatures you control can't be blocked this turn.
337012.translation: 由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

337017.oracleText: "Pardon me if I seem distracted. Part of me is reconnoitering the Tenth District."
337017.translation: 「如果你觉得我没有全力以赴，还请见谅。因为我还在分心关注第十区的情况。」

337019.oracleText: {o3oU}: Put a loyalty counter on target Jace planeswalker.
337019.translation: {o3oU}：在目标杰斯鹏洛客上放置一个忠诚指示物。

337024.oracleText: Creature and planeswalker spells you cast have affinity for artifacts.
337024.translation: 你施放的生物与鹏洛客咒语具有神器共鸣异能。

337025.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of artifacts you control. You gain X life.
337025.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的神器数量。你获得X点生命。

337027.oracleText: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
337027.translation: 将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

337028.oracleText: Exile the top ten cards of your library. Put all artifact cards from among them onto the battlefield.
337028.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的十张牌。将其中所有神器牌放进战场。

337035.oracleText: Target a permanent that is one or more colors.
337035.translation: 指定一个有色永久物为目标。

337036.oracleText: Target up to one other creature you control.
337036.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的其他生物为目标。

337037.oracleText: Choose a creature or planeswalker you control.
337037.translation: 选择一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客。

337038.oracleText: Put it into its owner's library third from the top?
337038.translation: 是否将其置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第三张的位置？

337039.oracleText: Search for up to two planeswalker cards.
337039.translation: 搜寻至多两张鹏洛客牌。

337041.oracleText: Return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards to your hand.
337041.translation: 将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌移回你手上。

337042.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker spell.
337042.translation: 指定一个生物或鹏洛客咒语为目标。

337043.translation: 指定一张鹏洛客牌为目标。

337045.oracleText: Target any number of creature and/or planeswalker cards in graveyards.
337045.translation: 指定任意数量在坟墓场中的生物和／或鹏洛客牌为目标。

337046.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或鹏洛客。

337047.translation: 选择一个由你操控的鹏洛客。

337048.translation: 指定任意数量的鹏洛客为目标。

337050.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of other permanents.
337050.translation: 牺牲任意数量的其他永久物。

337051.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker you control.
337051.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客为目标。

337055.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
337055.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客为目标，且须为于本回合受过伤害者。

337058.oracleText: Return that creature to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
337058.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该生物移回你手上。

337061.oracleText: Target up to one noncreature land you control.
337061.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控且非生物的地为目标。

337062.oracleText: Search for any number of Forest cards.
337062.translation: 搜寻任意数量的树林牌。

337063.oracleText: Search for up to two basic Forest cards.
337063.translation: 搜寻至多两张基本的树林牌。

337067.translation: 指定一个基定鹏洛客为目标。

337068.oracleText: Target up to one noncreature artifact.
337068.translation: 指定至多一张非生物的神器为目标。

337097.oracleText: {o0}: Add {oWoUoBoRoG}. Activate this ability only once each turn.
337097.translation: {o0}：加{oWoUoBoRoG}。此异能每回合只能起动一次。

337098.oracleText: Choose a creature card in your hand at random.
337098.translation: 从你手上随机选择一张生物牌。

337100.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library face down and look at it. Create a 2/2 colorless Spirit creature token. When that token leaves the battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand.
337100.translation: 面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌并检视之。派出一个2/2无色精怪衍生生物。当该衍生物离开战场时，将所放逐的牌置于你手上。

337101.oracleText: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.
337101.translation: 看到欧柯塔射出飞矢洞穿飞马，守卫拉尼卡的战士面如死灰。只见基定手中紧握乌锋，身影直坠而下。

337102.oracleText: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.
337102.translation: 尊殿上空剑光翻腾，宛若乌云压境，暮色沉沉。片刻之后，天使战群冲破云层，展露曙光。

337103.oracleText: Up to one other target creature you control gains your choice of vigilance, lifelink, or indestructible until end of turn.
337103.translation: 选择警戒，系命或不灭。至多另一个目标由你操控的生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

337104.oracleText: Choose a creature or planeswalker you control. All damage that would be dealt this turn to you and permanents you control is dealt to the chosen permanent instead.
337104.translation: 选择一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客。本回合中，将会对你和由你操控之永久物造成的所有伤害，改为对所选永久物造成之。

337105.oracleText:
"See that no one enters or leaves New Prahv today. And notify me at once of any Planeswalker activity."
—Dovin Baan
337105.translation:
「牢牢守好新布拉夫，今天谁都不许进出。若发现任何鹏洛客活动，立即通知我。」
～多温班恩

337106.oracleText:
Not even a threat to the entire Multiverse
could persuade them to put aside their feud.
337106.translation:
就算是威胁整个多重宇宙的大敌当前，
也无法说服二人暂时将私仇放在一旁。

337107.oracleText: At Feather's command, squadrons of battle angels swarmed out of the Parhelion II, unsheathing blades made of molten dawn.
337107.translation: 随着飞羽一声令下，战天使大军手中淬有黎明光芒利刃出鞘，纷纷从幻日二号上涌出。

337108.oracleText: Lands on the battlefield and land cards in graveyards can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control.
337108.translation: 战场上的地和坟墓场中的地牌不能成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标。

337109.oracleText: Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.
337109.translation: 盟会训练的猎鹰翱翔维图加基、新布拉夫和欧佐瓦天空，不时提供重要情报。

337110.oracleText:
"Fear writhes and whispers in the shadows of your mind. It is the enemy you always knew would come."
—Ashiok
337110.translation:
「在你的心灵阴影处，有种叫恐惧的情绪不断扭曲触动你的情绪，低语瓦解你的心防。它是你早知道会找上门来的敌人。」
～安梭苛

337111.oracleText: Draw X cards. If X is 10 or more, instead shuffle your graveyard into your library, draw X cards, untap up to five lands, and you have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
337111.translation: 抓X张牌。如果X等于或大于10，则改为将你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库，抓X张牌，重置至多五个地，且于这盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌数量没有上限。

337112.oracleText:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora
337112.translation:
「如果敌人四处逃窜，那就派大海去追。」
～奇奥拉

337113.oracleText:
"I recognize that headdress. This one was feared even by her fellow initiates."
—Samut
337113.translation:
「我认得那头饰。就连她同群的其他祀徒也怕她三分。」
～撒姆特

337114.oracleText: Jace surmised that they were walking into Bolas's trap. He felt no joy in being right.
337114.translation: 杰斯猜测他们正一步步走进波拉斯的圈套。但猜对了也不值得高兴。

337115.oracleText: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
337115.translation: 反击目标生物或鹏洛客咒语。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

337116.oracleText:
"It's strangely satisfying seeing an undead killing machine from another world standing befuddled in front of a wall of text."
—Lavinia
337116.translation:
「看着来自另一个世界的不死杀人机器在满是文字的墙前茫然不已，我有一种莫名的满足感。」
～拉温妮

337117.oracleText: "Today we throw off the yoke of death. Either this is an affirmation of the eternal cyclical nature of life, or it's just hilarious—depends on which of us you ask."
337117.translation: 「今天我们共同抛开死亡的束缚。这既是对生命永恒轮回本质的肯定，也是对此的不屑～端看你问的是哪一方。」

337118.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until your next turn.
337118.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能直到你的下一个回合。

337119.oracleText: "War or no war, your donations are due, as always."
337119.translation: 「不管打仗还是没打仗，你的捐款期到了，这点雷打不动。」

337121.oracleText: The path to power is often paved with atrocities.
337121.translation: 权力之道往往以暴行铺就。

337122.oracleText: Destroy any number of target planeswalkers. Choose a planeswalker you control. Put two loyalty counters on it for each planeswalker destroyed this way.
337122.translation: 消灭任意数量的目标鹏洛客。选择一个由你操控的鹏洛客。在它上面放置若干忠诚指示物，其数量等同于以此法消灭之鹏洛客数量的两倍。

337123.oracleText:
"I know I should be more concerned. But a big, blue zombie-potamus from beyond the stars? This is what they're invading us with?"
—Mileva, Boros legionnaire
337123.translation:
「我知道我的重点不该放在这。但一头来自外星的巨大蓝色灵俑河马？他们就用这种东西来入侵我们？」
～波洛斯军团兵米勒娃

337124.oracleText: Whenever one or more loyalty counters are removed from CARDNAME, she deals that much damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
337124.translation: 每当从CARDNAME上移去一个或数个忠诚指示物时，她向目标对手或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

337126.oracleText: Exile the top seven cards of your library. You may play them this turn.
337126.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的七张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

337133.oracleText: The mage looked within and realized there was still one piece of fuel to burn.
337133.translation: 法师看向内心，发现还剩最后一块燃料。

337134.oracleText: "We have visitors? Well, it'd be rude not to give them a traditional Keral Keep welcome."
337134.translation: 「有人来访？要是不拿出科瑞尔要塞的传统礼数招待一下，那可就太失礼了。」

337135.oracleText: The ancient Planeswalkers Sorin and Nahiri battled across Ravnica, their blows cutting as deep as their grudge.
337135.translation: 远古鹏洛客索霖与娜希丽之间有血海深仇。如今他们战场遍布拉尼卡各处，留下同样深不见底的创痕。

337136.oracleText: "You once brought havoc to my home and ruined my mind. I'm here to return the favor, Bolas."
337136.translation: 「你曾经破坏我的家园，摧毁我的心智。现在我来找你寻仇了，波拉斯。」

337137.oracleText:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith
337137.translation:
「搞清楚是谁的东西。我喜欢它的活力。」
～裘蒂丝

337138.oracleText:
"If you don't speak Wolf, allow me to translate: ‘One step closer and I'll rip out your throat.'"
—Arlinn Kord
337138.translation:
「如果你听不懂狼语，那就让我来翻译一下：『再敢靠近一步，我就撕开你的喉咙。』」
～雅琳珂德

337139.oracleText: "Thanks to my father, I know how to fight. He also showed me why I must."
337139.translation: 「父亲之前教了我战斗的技巧。如今他给了我战斗的理由。」

337140.oracleText: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."
337140.translation: 「关怀自己，栽培世界。关怀世界，栽培自己。」

337142.oracleText: Looking over two city blocks of destruction, he could only cackle with pride.
337142.translation: 望着两片城区的毁灭景象，他自豪地放声大笑。

337143.oracleText: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."
337143.translation: 「世上有许多使命，我的使命就是照管世界，令其茁壮长存。」

337144.oracleText:
"Yes, nature is stronger. You don't see little buildings sprouting on trees."
—Emmara
337144.translation:
「没错，自然更强大。你可看不到树上探出建物。」
～艾玛拉

337145.oracleText: The archer's heart broke seeing her compatriots die far below, but she held position until the enemy was in range.
337145.translation: 弓箭手眼见同伴在塔下阵亡心痛不已，但她依旧坚守阵地，静待敌人进入射程。

337146.oracleText:
"If we die, we die. But we cannot let him win."
—Ajani Goldmane
337146.translation:
「如果我们会死，便随它去。但我们绝不能让他赢。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

337147.oracleText:
"They say nothing lasts forever. I say everything lasts forever, just not in the form you may be accustomed to." 
—Vraska
337147.translation:
「他们都说无物可长存。但在我看来，万物皆可长存，只是可能会换一种你不太熟悉的形态。」
～瓦丝卡

337148.oracleText: "When civilization teeters on the brink, I'll be there to kick it the rest of the way."
337148.translation: 「文明在崩溃边缘时，我就会去把它踢下深渊。」

337149.oracleText: "I see you've learned nothing, Chandra. You'd still put a match to something rather than understand it."
337149.translation: 「你好像没有吸取教训，茜卓。你还是想把问题一烧了事，而从没尝试着去了解它。」

337150.oracleText: Kytheon had known war every day of his life. Now he finally knew peace.
337150.translation: 库忒昂这一生每天都与战事为伍。如今他终于得享安宁。

337151.oracleText: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.
337151.translation: 虽然城市存亡攸关拉铎司教众生死，但他们绝不愿放过任何制造混乱的机会。

337152.oracleText: Whenever an opponent attacks a planeswalker you control with one or more creatures, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player and you gain 2 life.
337152.translation: 每当任一对手以一个或数个生物攻击一个由你操控的鹏洛客时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

337153.oracleText: Whenever an opponent attacks a planeswalker you control with one or more creatures, Oath of Kaya deals 2 damage to that player and you gain 2 life.
337153.translation: 每当任一对手以一个或数个生物攻击一个由你操控的鹏洛客时，卡娅的誓约对该牌手造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

337154.oracleText: When Roalesk dies, proliferate, then proliferate again.
337154.translation: 当罗列茨死去时，增殖，然后再增殖。

337155.oracleText:
"The primary weapon is nothing more than light. It shows them what they are, and they burn of their own accord."
—Aurelia
337155.translation:
「主要武器就仅是光线照射，别无他物。他们从明光中见到自身本质，从而起火自焚。」
～欧瑞梨

337157.oracleText:
"The Tenth is under heavy attack, but it's being handled. I sent Mileva."
—Tajic
337157.translation:
「第十区正遭受猛烈袭击，但一切尽在掌控。我派了米勒娃。」
～塔疾克

337161.oracleText: "The Eternals can recognize faces. They just think I look like a blue minotaur."
337161.translation: 「永生者能认得面容。他们就只觉得我长得一副蓝色牛头人模样。」

337166.oracleText:
"The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!"
—Nikya of the Old Ways
337166.translation:
「衣哈格的铁蹄惊世间，拉尼卡古地皆醒转。」
～古式信徒妮恰

337601.translation: 移动任意数量的+1/+1指示物。

337701.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the total power of creatures you control.
337701.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为由你操控之生物的力量总和。

337751.translation: 移去任意数量的+1/+1指示物。

337752.oracleText: Target a creature to put on top of its owner's library.
337752.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，将它置于其拥有者的牌库顶。

337753.oracleText: Target a creature to return to its owner's hand.
337753.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，将它移回其拥有者手上。

337765.oracleText: When CARDNAME has no ice counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, create Marit Lage, a legendary 20/20 black Avatar creature token with flying and indestructible.
337765.translation: 当CARDNAME上没有寒冰指示物时，将它牺牲。若你如此作，则派出传奇衍生生物玛莉雷基，其为20/20黑色，具飞行与不灭异能的圣者。

337766.oracleText: When Dark Depths has no ice counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, create Marit Lage, a legendary 20/20 black Avatar creature token with flying and indestructible.
337766.translation: 当黑暗深渊上没有寒冰指示物时，将它牺牲。若你如此作，则派出传奇衍生生物玛莉雷基，其为20/20黑色，具飞行与不灭异能的圣者。

340870.oracleText: Search for a card named Gideon, the Oathsworn.
340870.translation: 搜寻一张名称为守誓卫士基定的牌。

340873.oracleText: Search for a card named Jace, Arcane Strategist.
340873.translation: 搜寻一张名称为奥术策士杰斯的牌。

340889.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker card in your graveyard that wasn't put there this combat.
340889.translation: 指定一张在你坟墓场中的生物或鹏洛客牌为目标，且不能是本次战斗中进入该处者。

341384.oracleText:
Target creature gets -4/-0 until end of turn. Draw a card. 
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, tap that creature and it doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
341384.translation:
目标生物得-4/-0直到回合结束。抓一张牌。
附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则横置该生物，且它于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

341407.oracleText: Choose a card that is exactly those colors.
341407.translation: 选择一张颜色正好为该色组的牌。

341419.oracleText:
Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. 
Morbid — That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if a creature died this turn.
341419.translation:
目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。
丧心～如果本回合有生物死去，则改为该生物得-13/-13直到回合结束。

341446.oracleText: Create a 2/2 Citizen creature token that's all colors.
341446.translation: 派出一个2/2五色市民衍生生物。

341449.oracleText:
Choose four. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
• Create a 2/2 Citizen creature token that's all colors. 
• Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. 
• Proliferate. 
• You gain 4 life.
341449.translation:
选择四项。你可以多次选择同一项。 
•派出一个2/2五色市民衍生生物。 
•将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 
•增殖。 
•你获得4点生命。

341491.oracleText: Whenever you reveal an instant or sorcery card this way, copy that card and you may cast the copy. That copy costs {o2} less to cast.
341491.translation: 每当你以此法展示一张瞬间或法术牌时，复制该牌，且你可以施放该复制品。该复制品减少{o2}来施放。

341513.oracleText: Confirm the permanents and/or players to gain an additional counter.
341513.translation: 确认会多获得指示物的永久物和／或牌手。

341520.oracleText: Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
341520.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

341555.oracleText: When that token leaves the battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand.
341555.translation: 当该衍生物离开战场时，将所放逐的牌置于你手上。

341562.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
341562.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

341563.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature that attacked or blocked this turn.
341563.translation: 牺牲一个本回合中曾进行攻击或阻挡的生物。

341564.oracleText: Sacrifice two creatures that attacked or blocked this turn.
341564.translation: 牺牲两个本回合中曾进行攻击或阻挡的生物。

341579.oracleText: Target an artifact, creature, planeswalker, or opponent.
341579.translation: 指定一个神器，生物，鹏洛客或对手为目标。

341873.oracleText:
Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. 
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, that creature gains flying until end of turn.
341873.translation:
目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。
附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则该生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

341954.oracleText:
Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. 
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures and they gain vigilance until end of turn.
341954.translation:
由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。
附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则在这些生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它们获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

341962.oracleText:
Return target creature to its owner's hand. 
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, draw a card.
341962.translation:
将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。
附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则抓一张牌。

342015.oracleText:
Draw three cards. 
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, instead scry 3, then draw three cards.
342015.translation:
抓三张牌。
附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则改为占卜3，然后抓三张牌。

342603.oracleText:
Draw two cards. 
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, you gain 2 life.
342603.translation:
抓两张牌。
附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则你获得2点生命。

350708.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature with the greatest power among creatures you control.
350708.translation: 牺牲一个生物，且须是由你操控的生物中力量最大者。

350714.oracleText: Exile a card in your hand or a permanent you control.
350714.translation: 放逐一张手牌或一个由你操控的永久物。

350715.oracleText: Target two permanents that share a permanent type.
350715.translation: 指定两个具共通永久物类别的永久物为目标。

351655.translation: 只能用于支付：鹏洛客咒语

351656.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Ajani's Pridemate.
351656.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在阿耶尼的群伴上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351658.oracleText:
"Oh, you must be mistaken. Hawks are solitary hunters, you see."
—Bunder Diedreck, ornithologist
351658.translation:
「噢，你肯定哪里搞错了。老鹰虽凶猛，但不会一起行动。」
～鸟类学家本德迪垂克

351659.oracleText: Destroy target tapped creature. You gain 1 life for each creature you control with flying.
351659.translation: 消灭目标已横置的生物。你每操控一个具飞行异能的生物，便获得1点生命。

351661.oracleText: You gain life equal to the number of creatures you control plus the number of planeswalkers you control.
351661.translation: 你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量与由你操控的鹏洛客数量之总和。

351663.oracleText: If you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, exile CARDNAME and each artifact and creature your opponents control.
351663.translation: 如果你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多15点，则放逐CARDNAME和所有由对手操控的神器与生物。

351669.oracleText: If you would gain life, you gain that much life plus 1 instead.
351669.translation: 如果你将获得生命，则改为你获得原数量加1点生命。

351670.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 as long as you have 25 or more life.
351670.translation: 只要你的总生命为25或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+2。

351673.oracleText: Waves of gloom crash in vain against his unyielding light.
351673.translation: 刚毅明光迫去阵阵邪影侵袭。

351674.oracleText: {o2}: Exile target card from a graveyard.

351676.oracleText: "With me! Break this line and the rest will fall!"
351676.translation: 「一起上！拿下这道防线，敌人便会溃败！」

351679.oracleText: "Within every angel is a spirit of light that will fight as long as there is darkness."
351679.translation: 「天使之灵，光明所存；黑暗不息，争斗不止。」

351681.oracleText: Whenever an Angel you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
351681.translation: 每当一个由你操控的天使死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

351683.oracleText:
"As long as your courage remains, your life will not falter."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade
351683.translation:
「英勇仍在，气数犹存。」
～驭空刃席斐拉

351684.oracleText: Choose up to two target permanent cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped.
351684.translation: 选择至多两张目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌，且须为于本回合中从战场进入该处者。将它们横置移回战场。

351688.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
351688.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

351691.oracleText:
"As the sun rose behind the Bone Spire, an angel appeared over the charnel fields, bringing a surge of new hope."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
351691.translation:
「随着骨塔之后天空夜色渐散，天使偕同太阳破晓降临世间，将希望随着光芒洒向这片死气沉沉的大地。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

351694.oracleText:
"It is not punishment. I am simply making things as they should be."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade
351694.translation:
「这不是惩罚。我只是还原事物本貌。」
～驭空刃席斐拉

351695.oracleText: Exile target creature or planeswalker that's black or red. Scry 1.
351695.translation: 放逐目标黑色或红色的生物或鹏洛客。占卜1。

351696.oracleText: Where the holy light of the angels has shone, only purity remains.
351696.translation: 凡得天使圣光照耀之处，唯有纯净留存。

351698.oracleText: "Well, at least it's a lovely view."

351699.oracleText: Put target creature with power 4 or greater on the bottom of its owner's library.
351699.translation: 将目标力量等于或大于4的生物置于其拥有者的牌库底。

351700.oracleText: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."
351700.translation: 他的英勇让无所属者有希望，让他们得以坚决抵抗暴行。

351702.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +0/+2 and assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
351702.translation: 所结附的生物得+0/+2，且依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

351704.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "{o2oW}: Untap this creature."
351704.translation: 所结附的生物具有「{o2oW}：重置此生物。」

351705.oracleText:
"Here is a companion who will never falter, no matter how desperate the battle!"
—Ajani Goldmane
351705.translation:
「我们这位伙伴战意坚定，无论胜算有多么渺茫，也绝不会后退半步！」
～金鬃阿耶尼

351711.oracleText: "Fear neither clouds nor darkness. The light shall overcome them all."
351711.translation: 「无惧阴云，不畏黑暗。光明能够照亮万物。」

351712.oracleText: {o3oW}: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature with flying.
351712.translation: {o3oW}：在另一个目标具飞行异能的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351713.oracleText: "We are armed with light and steel. Who can stand against us?"
351713.translation: 「用钢铁当护甲，以明光作武装。还有谁挡得住我们？」

351714.oracleText: "Time to show the foe our true mettle."
351714.translation: 「让敌人见识一下我们的真正本事。」

351718.oracleText: {o5oW}: CARDNAME gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your life total.
351718.translation: {o5oW}：CARDNAME得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你的总生命。

351720.oracleText: Phyrexian artificers remove the flesh they no longer need and use it to bring their unholy creations to a greater semblance of life.
351720.translation: 非瑞克西亚的胜利已在眼前，旗下每个分部已开始整顿基础。

351721.oracleText: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"
351721.translation: 「我大个子想静一下心也有错？」

351722.oracleText: The law is meant to ensure that people kill each other with only the utmost fairness.
351722.translation: 法律的意义，在于确保人们只能以最公平的方式来自相残杀。

351724.oracleText: You may pay {oW} and tap four untapped creatures you control with flying rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
351724.translation: 你可以支付{oW}并横置四个由你操控、具飞行异能且未横置的生物，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

351725.oracleText: Other creatures you control with flying have indestructible.
351725.translation: 由你操控且具飞行异能的其他生物具有不灭异能。

351727.oracleText: The strength of the one is the strength of the many.

351731.oracleText: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

351732.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
351732.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351735.oracleText: "Get up, slugabeds! We've got company, and they're not dressed for a party!"
351735.translation: 「懒虫们，快起来！外头有人来了，而且看着不太客气！」

351737.oracleText: The courage of those who work the land is born of long days of labor in the hot summer sun and the cold winter wind. It is the courage of the earth itself.
351737.translation: 经年累月在酷暑与寒冬中辛勤劳作，让耕耘大地者也具备坚韧的胸怀。这便是大地的勇气。

351739.oracleText: The chill wind extinguishes flame, and frosts the leaf on the branch.

351742.oracleText: "The more secrets you have, the more easily you become my pawn."
351742.translation: 「你的秘密越多，就越容易成为我的棋子。」

351745.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more permanents you don't own, draw three cards.
351745.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控三个或更多不由你拥有的永久物，则抓三张牌。

351747.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: Draw two cards, then discard a card.

351755.oracleText: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."
351755.translation: 「我总是从望远镜看不到的地方动手。」

351756.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
351756.translation: 每当你在对手的回合中施放咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351760.oracleText: Return up to three target creatures to their owners' hands.
351760.translation: 将至多三个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

351763.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, shuffle it into its owner's library, then scry 2.
351763.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它洗入其拥有者的牌库，然后占卜2。

351766.oracleText: Dragons avoid the bright colors of its wings.
351766.translation: 巨龙都会避开其双翼上的亮彩。

351767.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Counter target spell that targets you.
351767.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：反击目标咒语，且该咒语须以你为目标。

351771.oracleText: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

351773.oracleText: "Let's see how badly you want what you came for!"

351775.oracleText:
"From a sea of infinite possibilities, our choices create the future."
—Mu Yanling
351775.translation:
「世间的种种可能如汪洋般浩瀚，而未来则从你我的选择中逐步成形。」
～沐燕灵

351776.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
351776.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

351778.oracleText:
"I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean."
—Mu Yanling
351778.translation:
「我暗自神伤，泪河涌注，只为能涤净这片大地。」
～沐燕灵

351779.oracleText: Return all nonland permanents to their owners' hands. If you return four or more nontoken permanents you control this way, you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
351779.translation: 将所有非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果你以此法移回四个或更多由你操控且非衍生物的永久物，则你可以将一张永久物牌从你手上放进战场。

351781.oracleText: A good book is a refuge, but a great book is a fortress.
351781.translation: 书籍是心灵的港湾，好书则是身体的堡垒。

351782.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +0/+2 and has "{oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card."
351782.translation: 所结附的生物得+0/+2且具有「{oT}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。」

351784.oracleText: Create two 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature tokens.
351784.translation: 派出两个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。

351785.oracleText: Choose target artifact you control. Each other artifact you control becomes a copy of that artifact until end of turn.
351785.translation: 选择目标由你操控的神器。每个由你操控的其他神器均成为该神器的复制品直到回合结束。

351786.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Create two 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature tokens. 
• Choose target artifact you control. Each other artifact you control becomes a copy of that artifact until end of turn.
351786.translation:
选择一项～ 
•派出两个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。 
•选择目标由你操控的神器。每个由你操控的其他神器均成为该神器的复制品直到回合结束。

351788.oracleText:
"Come on, it's not even that deep!"
—Gorin the Brazen

351791.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -2/-0 and loses flying.
351791.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物得-2/-0且失去飞行异能。

351792.oracleText: Create a 4/4 blue Elemental Bird creature token with flying.
351792.translation: 派出一个4/4蓝色，具飞行异能的元素／鸟衍生生物。

351793.oracleText: Islands you control have "{oT}: Draw a card."
351793.translation: 由你操控的海岛具有「{oT}：抓一张牌。」

351794.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Islands you control have ‘{oT}: Draw a card.'"
351794.translation: 你获得具有「由你操控的海岛具有『{oT}：抓一张牌』」的徽记。

351796.oracleText: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.
351796.translation: 它从周遭每一道浪潮漩涡当中，看到未来事物逐渐苏醒。

351799.oracleText:
"If you need to disappear for a while, I know a place."
—Bilivus, master archivist
351799.translation:
「如果你要消失一阵，我知道一个好地方。」
～书库辖员总管比利沃斯

351801.oracleText: "Forget what you have learned from other teachers. I bring you the truth."
351801.translation: 「忘记你从别人那学到的东西。我来告诉你真相。」

351803.oracleText: "I study the past to find hope for the future."
351803.translation: 「我究研过去，是为了替将来寻找希望。」

351807.oracleText:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass
351807.translation:
「久行于这片险恶海域的船只，都免不了碰上一两个鬼魂。」
～贝克蒂霸司总帅

351809.oracleText:
"When you are gone, will anyone remember your story?"
—Unknown
351809.translation:
「你死去后，是否还会有人会记得你的故事？」
～无名氏

351810.oracleText: Counter target activated ability, triggered ability, or legendary spell.
351810.translation: 反击目标起动式异能，触发式异能或传奇咒语。

351811.oracleText:
"Don't you have somewhere else to be?"
—Sharuum the Hegemon
351811.translation:
「难道你没有其他该去的地方吗？」
～支配者韶伦

351813.oracleText: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.
351813.translation: 天空遍布咒文，魔法如甘霖一般落向饥渴的大地，播撒时节智慧。

351814.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control a creature with flying.
351814.translation: 如果你操控具飞行异能的生物，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

351816.oracleText:
"Yarok's waters rush and rage
Where armies bled into the sand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 2
351816.translation:
「奋战勇士尽血染，
雅魔奔流空飞涎。」
～《哀巴勒格》，2节

351818.oracleText:
"The knights charged forward on wings of wind, and the necromancer's horde roared in helpless rage."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
351818.translation:
「骑士大军乘风冲锋从天而降，空留死灵术士大军无助怒吼。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

351820.oracleText:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood
351820.translation:
「虽然夺命实际只需一瞬间，但之前的苦痛会让你觉得要一辈子。」
～鲜血掮客维利司

351821.oracleText: Agonizing Syphon deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
351821.translation: 苦痛吸魂对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

351823.oracleText: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."
351823.translation: 「技能、预想、本事：这一切都只有在你有胆去作的时候才有用。」

351824.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
351824.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

351826.oracleText: "One knife, two knives, three knives, four—which will drop you to the floor?"
351826.translation: 「一二三四飞刀起～猜猜哪刀中到你？」

351828.oracleText: Leaf and soul alike wither at its touch.
351828.translation: 经它触碰，枝叶灵魂尽枯萎。

351829.oracleText: Creatures your opponents control can't have +1/+1 counters put on them.
351829.translation: 由对手操控的生物上不能放置+1/+1指示物。

351831.oracleText:
"You've heard that a vampire can't enter a home without an invitation? A lie meant to help you sleep at night."
—Kerin, watch sergeant
351831.translation:
「有人跟你说吸血鬼从来不会擅闯家门？那不过是骗你夜晚安睡的谎言罢了。」
～警备队长柯林

351835.oracleText: Return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield, then return another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
351835.translation: 将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，然后将另一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

351837.oracleText: Blood seeps into the stone, and darkness emerges.
351837.translation: 鲜血渗入石缝，黑暗随之现身。

351840.oracleText: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.
351840.translation: 她生时是马戏团的杂技演员，因而练就了一身流畅华美的杀人技艺，就连遭她毒手的人也对其表演赞叹不已。

351842.oracleText:
"I will make your bones into a weapon that will lay even the mighty low."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
351842.translation:
「我会将你的骨头化作击倒强敌的武器。」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

351844.oracleText: "Living or dead, everyone responds to the proper motivation."
351844.translation: 「无论是死是活，只要给对刺激都会动。」

351852.oracleText:
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure."
—Exdratha, bog witch
351852.translation:
「用这疤痕来让你永远铭记这次失败。」
～腐沼巫婆艾卓莎

351854.oracleText: It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.
351854.translation: 它在黑暗之中静静等待，悄然回应。

351855.oracleText: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
351855.translation: 你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

351856.oracleText: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
351856.translation: 你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

351857.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
351857.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

351863.translation: 「我感受到了你的痛苦。很精致。」

351866.oracleText:
"If you manage to get to the heart of the bog, you'll find things there that make zombies seem downright lovable."
—Byaras, backwoods guide
351866.translation:
「如果你能够进到腐沼中心，你会发现跟那里的东西比起来，还是灵俑来得顺眼。」
～蛮荒林向导拜亚斯

351871.oracleText: His whips twist and tremble like living things, moved by the fury of the horde he commands.
351871.translation: 他手中长鞭像活物版不停翻搅、抖动，随着他麾下大军怒火而动。

351875.oracleText: {o2oB}: CARDNAME gets +3/+3 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
351875.translation: {o2oB}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+3/+3且获得死触异能。

351877.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
351877.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌手失去过4点或更多生命，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351880.oracleText:
"With a single word, they were unmade."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
351880.translation:
「只消念动一字，他们全都化烟散去。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

351882.oracleText:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand
351882.translation:
「无论我日程有多满，我都会挤出时间来亲自动手。」
～玛切莎女王

351884.oracleText:
"The bog doesn't give a stinking bubble about your title, wealth, or piety. It's just hungry."
—Byaras, backwoods guide
351884.translation:
「无论你是达官显贵、万贯财主还是虔诚信徒，对于这片腐沼都没有区别。它就是饿了。」
～蛮荒林向导拜亚斯

351885.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker that's green or white. You gain 1 life.
351885.translation: 消灭目标绿色或白色的生物或鹏洛客。你获得1点生命。

351888.oracleText:
"Now, that's a zombie!"
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
351888.translation:
「乖乖，这才是灵俑！」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

351889.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, discard a card.
351889.translation: 在你的维持开始时，弃一张牌。

351891.oracleText:
"One for you, one for me. What could be more fair?"
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand
351891.translation:
「你一个，我一个。还有更公平的方式吗？」
～幕宾柯希斯

351894.oracleText: "The Great Serpent slumbers now, but all warmbloods will grovel in the dirt at its awakening!"
351894.translation: 「虽然巨蛇仍在沉睡，但待它觉醒之时，所有温血动物都将屈膝臣服！」

351895.oracleText: {o5oB}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
351895.translation: {o5oB}，{oT}：CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

351898.oracleText: Target creature you control gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. If it's a Vampire, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
351898.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。如果它是吸血鬼，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351899.oracleText: You may sacrifice a Vampire. When you do, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
351899.translation: 你可以牺牲一个吸血鬼。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

351901.oracleText: You may put a Vampire creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
351901.translation: 你可以将一张吸血鬼生物牌从你手上放进战场。

351903.oracleText:
"The skull is rigid, but the mind is so deliciously supple."
—Eromena the Mind Render
351903.translation:
「虽然头骨坚硬，但心灵可口。」
～裂灵埃罗梅纳

351904.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. Exile all noncreature, nonland cards from that player's hand and graveyard.
351904.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。放逐该牌手手上和坟墓场中所有非生物且非地的牌。

351905.oracleText:
"There are always more like you."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
351905.translation:
「总有更多像你这样的。」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

351907.oracleText:
"Don't think of it as selling your soul. It's more like you're bequeathing it to me."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood
351907.translation:
「别把它当作是出卖灵魂。不妨想作你把灵魂留给了我。」
～鲜血掮客维利司

351908.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
351908.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将该生物牌在你的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

351910.oracleText: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."
351910.translation: 「这地方适合我：管制宽松，猎物充足。」

351912.oracleText: "Try to steal from me and I'll add your skull to my collection."
351912.translation: 「尽管来试着偷我东西，我的收藏品里还没有你的脑袋。」

351913.oracleText: Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
351913.translation: 每当你每回合首度失去生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351916.oracleText: "You can sign, or you can spend your life imagining what might have been yours."
351916.translation: 「在这签字吧，不然你花一辈子也想象不到自己能得到什么。」

351917.oracleText: {oB}, Pay 2 life: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
351917.translation: {oB}，支付2点生命：目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

351918.oracleText: Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards.
351918.translation: 每当你失去生命时，抓等量的牌。

351920.oracleText:
"Yarok's nightmares lurk and wait
Where dark despair is near at hand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 3
351920.translation:
「黑暗绝境临眼前，
雅魔梦魇静沉眠。」
～《哀巴勒格》，3节

351925.oracleText: {o1oR}: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
351925.translation: {o1oR}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

351928.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals X damage to each opponent and each planeswalker they control, where X is the number of land cards in your graveyard.
351928.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它向每位对手和每个由对手操控的鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中的地牌数量。

351931.oracleText: Put a loyalty counter on each red planeswalker you control.
351931.translation: 在每个由你操控的红色鹏洛客上各放置一个忠诚指示物。

351932.oracleText: Create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
351932.translation: 派出两个1/1红色元素衍生生物。它们获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们牺牲。

351935.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this emblem deals 1 damage to you.
351935.translation: 在你的维持开始时，此徽记对你造成1点伤害。

351936.oracleText: Each opponent gets an emblem with "At the beginning of your upkeep, this emblem deals 1 damage to you."
351936.translation: 每位对手各获得具有「在你的维持开始时，此徽记对你造成1点伤害」的徽记。

351937.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each non-Elemental creature.
351937.translation: CARDNAME对每个非元素的生物各造成3点伤害。

351939.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
351939.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

351942.oracleText: Elementals you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
351942.translation: 由你操控的元素得+2/+0直到回合结束。

351946.translation:
「球？毛球冒火时看你怎么对付。」
～茜卓纳拉

351947.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Spend this mana only to cast an Elemental spell or a Chandra planeswalker spell.
351947.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。此法术力只能用来施放元素咒语或茜卓鹏洛客咒语。

351948.oracleText:
"There's plenty of fire to go around."
—Chandra Nalaar
351948.translation:
「火还有很多，尽管烧。」
～茜卓纳拉

351950.oracleText: Whenever you activate a loyalty ability of a Chandra planeswalker, you may pay {o1}. If you do, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
351950.translation: 每当你起动茜卓鹏洛客的忠诚异能时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则复制该异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

351951.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Discard a Mountain card or a red card: Draw a card.
351951.translation: {o1}，{oT}，弃一张山脉牌或红色牌：抓一张牌。

351957.oracleText: "I love digging. It gives me lots of time to think about how much I love digging."
351957.translation: 「我喜欢挖东西。挖东西的过程中有很多时间让我想我有多喜欢挖东西。」

351958.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact or land: Draw a card.
351958.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲一个神器或地：抓一张牌。

351959.oracleText:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words
351959.translation:
「没错，虽然它比我们强壮，还能喷火。但我们比它聪明！」
～睿敏塔蒂丝的遗言

351961.oracleText:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words
351961.translation:
「快散开，你们这帮蠢货！快散开！」
～队长马登的遗言

351962.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 4 damage to any target and 3 damage to each of up to two other targets.
351962.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成4点伤害，且对至多两个其他目标各造成3点伤害。

351964.oracleText: Not every job in the goblin army is glamorous. Actually, no job in the goblin army is glamorous.
351964.translation: 并非鬼怪军队中所有差事都是体面活。实际上，鬼怪军队里没有体面活。

351966.oracleText:
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—"
—Thaedus the Clever, last words
351966.translation:
「我都计算过，一条飞空巨龙单次喷吐能够覆盖的范围是～」
～聪智塞得斯的遗言

351967.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature except for creatures you control with flying.
351967.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成2点伤害，但由你操控且具飞行异能的生物除外。

351968.oracleText: Flame Sweep deals 2 damage to each creature except for creatures you control with flying.
351968.translation: 烈焰横扫对每个生物各造成2点伤害，但由你操控且具飞行异能的生物除外。

351970.oracleText:
"I'm afraid your dinner got a little . . . overcooked."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper
351970.translation:
「你的晚餐恐怕有些…糊了。」
～旅店主马兰法斯瓦

351971.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker that's white or blue.
351971.translation: CARDNAME对目标白色或蓝色的生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

351972.oracleText: Fry deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker that's white or blue.
351972.translation: 煎烤对目标白色或蓝色的生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

351975.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
351975.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

351980.oracleText: "I opens my mouth to catches the bugs!"

351984.oracleText: "I am but a humble traveler. I have no taste for sneakery nor thiefiness."
351984.translation: 「我只是个普通的旅客。我没兴趣悄悄将东西带进来，也不热衷偷偷把东西顺出去。」

351985.oracleText: {oT}: Another target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
351985.translation: {oT}：另一个目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

351987.oracleText:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign
351987.translation:
「衣冠不整，恕不接待。」
～市集招牌

351988.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+2 until end of turn.
351988.translation: 目标生物得+3/+2直到回合结束。

351990.oracleText: She swings with the ease of flowing lava and hits with the force of a meteor.
351990.translation: 她挥拳似熔岩流动般轻柔，似流星坠地般强劲。

351991.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Elemental you control.
351991.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你每操控一个元素，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

351995.oracleText: Whenever you and/or at least one permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player.
351995.translation: 每当你和／或至少一个由你操控的永久物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，CARDNAME向该对手造成2点伤害。

351997.oracleText: Rage is the culmination of an accelerating cycle of anger and violence that feeds itself in battle, spreading like a flame from one warrior to another.
351997.translation: 狂怒是在战斗中不断累积的怒火与狂暴相互快速转，最终达顶的状态。这一情绪能如星火一般，接连点燃每位战士心中激情。

351999.oracleText:
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!"
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide
351999.translation:
「别乱动，尽可能别让自己看上去像是猎物！」
～旷野向导史格霍奈

352005.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: It deals 1 damage to any target.
352005.translation: 牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

352006.oracleText: Equipped creature has "Sacrifice this creature: It deals 1 damage to any target."
352006.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

352008.oracleText: Their loyalty is not to any master, but to the pack.
352008.translation: 它们的忠心不属于任何主人，而属于自己的犬群。

352010.oracleText: {o1oR}: Each creature you control named Pack Mastiff gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
352010.translation: {o1oR}：每个由你操控且名称为獒犬群的生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。

352012.oracleText:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words
352012.translation:
「我拿走几个它肯定也不会发～」
～妙手赛莉娅的遗言

352017.oracleText: Reckless Air Strike deals 3 damage to target creature with flying.
352017.translation: 鲁莽空袭对目标具飞行异能的生物造成3点伤害。

352018.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature with flying. 
• Destroy target artifact.
352018.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成3点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

352019.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Reckless Air Strike deals 3 damage to target creature with flying. 
• Destroy target artifact.
352019.translation:
选择一项～ 
•鲁莽空袭对目标具飞行异能的生物造成3点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

352020.oracleText:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator
352020.translation:
「在恶者终享安息之前，必须以火净化。」
～裁决者哈拉

352022.oracleText: It's in the nature of fire to grow.

352023.oracleText: When you next cast an instant spell, cast a sorcery spell, or activate a loyalty ability this turn, copy that spell or ability twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
352023.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放瞬间咒语，施放法术咒语或起动忠诚异能时，将该咒语或异能复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

352024.oracleText: Dinosaurs rarely understand the idea of boundaries between the wild and the urban landscape.
352024.translation: 随着拉尼卡的荒野增广，就连爱好自然者都不得不面对日益凶猛的自然威胁。

352026.oracleText:
"Keep your flammables out of reach."
—Kerin, watch sergeant
352026.translation:
「把手头的易燃物都放远点。」
～警备队长柯林

352031.oracleText:
"Yes, she can be a nuisance. But at least my tea never gets cold."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper
352031.translation:
「没错，她确实很烦人。但至少我的茶不会凉了。」
～旅店主马兰法斯瓦

352032.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
352032.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对所攻击之牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

352034.oracleText: "I love this thing! It's my best invention since the boulderfist gauntlet!"
352034.translation: 「我爱死这东西了！这是岩锤护手以来我最棒的发明！」

352036.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, choose target Elemental creature card in your graveyard with toughness less than CARDNAME's toughness. Return that card to the battlefield tapped and attacking. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
352036.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的元素生物牌，且其防御力须小于CARDNAME的防御力。将该牌横置移回战场且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

352038.oracleText: The cage is a crucible for the rage that builds inside, refining it into something pure and terrible.
352038.translation: 这铁笼好似熔炉，不断锤炼遭羁其中者积累的怒火，将其锻成更纯粹可怕之物。

352040.oracleText: Sathros turned his restraints to revenge.
352040.translation: 萨索洛斯把缚身刑具化作复仇武器。

352041.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as it's attacking.
352041.translation: 只要CARDNAME正进行攻击，它便得+2/+0。

352045.oracleText: {o1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from CARDNAME: CARDNAME gains hexproof until end of turn.
352045.translation: {o1}，从CARDNAME上移去一个+1/+1指示物：CARDNAME获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

352048.oracleText: "Many have walked here, but there is only one trail I seek."
352048.translation: 「此地足印繁杂，但我只追寻一条踪迹。」

352049.oracleText: {o5oG}, {oT}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
352049.translation: {o5oG}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。
