414490.oracleText: As long as you control a Rowan planeswalker, CARDNAME gets +3/+0.
414490.translation: 只要你操控萝婉鹏洛客，CARDNAME便得+3/+0。

414496.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature you control.
414496.translation: 在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

414497.oracleText: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a copy of target creature you control. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
414497.translation: 直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。防止本回合中将对他造成的所有伤害。

414499.oracleText: Until end of turn, each creature you control has base power and toughness 10/10 and gains trample.
414499.translation: 直到回合结束，每个由你操控的生物均获得践踏异能，且基础力量与防御力都为10/10。

414501.oracleText: They function as everything from assassins to jesters in the name of their fae king.
414501.translation: 他们挂着其仙儿国王的名头，从刺客到弄臣等等什么都做。

414503.oracleText: No matter the cruelty of Oko's jokes, he's always guaranteed the sycophant's laughter.
414503.translation: 无论瓯柯的玩笑有多残酷，都会有人发出谄媚的笑声。

414507.oracleText:
"My advisors recommend I let them eat you."
—Oko
414507.translation:
「我的谋臣建议我让它们吃了你。」
～瓯柯

414510.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.

414512.oracleText: {oR}: All creatures gain trample and haste until end of turn.
414512.translation: {oR}：所有生物获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

414513.oracleText: {o1oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
414513.translation: {o1oG}：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

414516.oracleText: {o4oB}: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control.
414516.translation: {o4oB}：将目标生物牌在其拥有者的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

414518.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each charge counter on CARDNAME and has vigilance.
414518.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有警戒异能，且CARDNAME上每有一个充电指示物，它便得+1/+1。

414523.oracleText: Silverwing Squadron's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
414523.translation: 银翼中队的力量和防御力等同于由你操控的生物数量。

414524.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a number of 2/2 white Knight creature tokens with vigilance equal to the number of opponents you have.
414524.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出数个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。其数量等同于对手的数量。

414527.oracleText: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.
414527.translation: 这群仙灵流连于城堡之间，所经之处满是不幸爱情、中伤流言和丢失遗宝。

414528.oracleText: {o3oU}: Create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying. Draw a card.
414528.translation: {o3oU}：派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵衍生生物。抓一张牌。

414530.oracleText: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.
414530.translation: 靛青巨龙高兴地用其一小部分珍藏换来了永恒月光。

414531.oracleText: As long as you control four or more artifacts, CARDNAME has hexproof.
414531.translation: 只要你操控四个或更多神器，CARDNAME便具有辟邪异能。

414533.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts you control: Draw a card.
414533.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器：抓一张牌。

414535.oracleText:
"Fear not what's under the bed. The toys are watching."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414535.translation:
「无需害怕床底异响。那是玩具为你守护。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414536.oracleText: Artifact creatures you control have flying.
414536.translation: 由你操控的神器生物具有飞行异能。

414537.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target noncreature artifact you control become a 0/0 artifact creature. If you do, put four +1/+1 counters on it.
414537.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以令目标由你操控的非生物神器成为0/0神器生物。若你如此作，则在其上放置四个+1/+1指示物。

414541.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
414541.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲一个生物：目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

414543.oracleText:
"Hone the knife and mourn the least.
Three chimes to sound the sweet, grim feast."
—Barrow witch incantation
414543.translation:
「磨快手中刀具勿念悲伤过去，
耳闻悼铃三响静待苦宴就绪。」
～荒野巫婆咒文

414546.oracleText: "We fight with valor in our hearts and fire in our veins!"
414546.translation: 「我们心怀勇气，热血沸腾，誓死奋战！」

414548.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o2oR}. If you do, creatures you control get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of opponents you have.
414548.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o2oR}。若你如此作，由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X等同于对手的数量。

414551.oracleText: Many an ancient treasure has been reduced to jagged caltrops by its snapping jaws.
414551.translation: 许多上古珍宝经其强颚利齿之后，化作满地狼藉。

414552.oracleText: {o2oG}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from CARDNAME: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
414552.translation: {o2oG}，从CARDNAME上移去一个+1/+1指示物：消灭目标神器或结界。

414555.oracleText: It will come to the defense of all wild things, from the shivering wren to the towering giant.
414555.translation: 它会挺身守护一切幻野生灵～小至战栗鹪鹩，大至耸立巨人。

414560.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact or enchantment spell, create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying.
414560.translation: 每当你施放神器或结界咒语时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵衍生生物。

414562.oracleText: When you cast this spell from your hand, copy it if you control an artifact, then copy it if you control an enchantment. You may choose new targets for the copies.
414562.translation: 当你从你手上施放此咒语时，如果你操控神器则复制之，然后如果你操控结界则复制之。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

414563.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. You create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
414563.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。你派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

414565.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
414565.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

414566.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Return target creature you control to its owner's hand.
414566.translation: {o3}，{oT}：将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

414570.oracleText: {o1oG}, Sacrifice another nonland permanent: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
414570.translation: {o1oG}，牺牲另一个非地永久物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

414573.oracleText:
"By hoof, wing, or paw. For the realm!"
—Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
414573.translation:
「铁蹄翻腾，羽翼展扬，利爪出击。为了世境，全体冲锋！」
～灰谷英雄葛雯爵士

414574.oracleText: Whenever a Knight you control attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
414574.translation: 每当一个由你操控的骑士攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

414575.oracleText: {o6oWoB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return all Knight creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
414575.translation: {o6oWoB}，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有骑士生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

414579.oracleText: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.
414579.translation: 他于自己的婚礼上被变作龙形之后，随即吃掉了宴席、礼物和来宾。

414582.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on Korvold and draw a card.
414582.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，在寇沃上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

414584.oracleText: Squires throughout the realm aspire to her mix of panache and martial prowess.
414584.translation: 她形勇兼备，全世境的扈从都以她为榜样。

414585.oracleText: Whenever an equipped creature you control attacks, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
414585.translation: 每当一个由你操控且已佩带武具的生物攻击时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

414586.oracleText: Equipment you control have equip Knight {o0}.
414586.translation: 由你操控的武具具有佩带骑士{o0}。

414588.oracleText: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.
414588.translation: 它起初就只是水滴。魔法明镜将之晶化为更有用的事物。

414594.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Remove a page counter from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
414594.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个书页指示物：抓一张牌。

414596.oracleText:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened
414596.translation:
「近我高塔者，须诚心屈膝求见，否则便会化作轻烟飘去。」
～老年法师盖威克

414597.oracleText: Reveal a Knight, Aura, Equipment, or legendary artifact card?
414597.translation: 是否要展示一张骑士，灵气，武具或传奇神器牌？

414599.oracleText: Target an artifact card in your graveyard.
414599.translation: 指定一个在你坟墓场中的神器牌为目标。

414600.oracleText: Target two creatures controlled by different players.
414600.translation: 指定两个由不同牌手操控的生物为目标。

414602.translation: 指定一张骑士牌为目标。

414603.oracleText: Choose a creature card in your graveyard?
414603.translation: 是否要选择你坟墓场中的一张生物牌？

414605.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact or another creature.
414605.translation: 牺牲一个神器或另一个生物。

414608.oracleText: Target a planeswalker that player controls.
414608.translation: 指定一个由该牌手操控的鹏洛客为目标。

414611.translation: 牺牲一个非地且非衍生物的永久物。

414613.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to any target equal to the number of cards in your hand.
414613.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成等同于你手牌数量的伤害。

414614.oracleText: Reveal an artifact or enchantment card?
414614.translation: 是否要展示一张神器或结界牌？

414615.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or an artifact.
414615.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。

414617.oracleText: Spend only on: A Knight or Equipment Spell
414617.translation: 只能用于支付：骑士或武具咒语

414621.oracleText: Put a permanent card onto the battlefield?
414621.translation: 是否要将一张永久物牌放进战场？

414635.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that spell's controller.
414635.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为咒语的目标时，CARDNAME对该咒语的操控者造成2点伤害。

414637.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if an opponent controls a green permanent.
414637.translation: 如果任一对手操控绿色永久物，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

414647.oracleText: Search for a card named Oko, the Trickster.
414647.translation: 搜寻一张名称为幻法仙灵瓯柯的牌。

414765.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a Treasure token.
414765.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

414766.oracleText: Whenever Captain Lannery Storm attacks, create a Treasure token.
414766.translation: 每当兰娜莉速腾船长攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

414807.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a Treasure token.
414807.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

414888.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Scry 1. Put a landmark counter on CARDNAME. Then if there are three or more landmark counters on it, remove those counters, transform CARDNAME, and create three Treasure tokens.
414888.translation: {o1}，{oT}：占卜1。在CARDNAME上放置一个地标指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多地标指示物，则移去这些指示物，转化CARDNAME，并派出三个珍宝衍生物。

414934.oracleText: Create Ashaya, the Awoken World, a legendary 4/4 green Elemental creature token.
414934.translation: 派出传奇衍生生物醒转天地艾莎娅，其为4/4绿色的元素。

415157.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Create a Treasure token.
415157.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

415211.oracleText: Draw two cards. Create a Treasure token.
415211.translation: 抓两张牌。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

415314.oracleText: Destroy target creature. Create two Treasure tokens.
415314.translation: 消灭目标生物。派出两个珍宝衍生物。

415338.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a Treasure token.
415338.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

415387.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, create a Treasure token.
415387.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

415394.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Create two Treasure tokens.
415394.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲一个生物：派出两个珍宝衍生物。

415433.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, target opponent creates two Treasure tokens.
415433.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，目标对手派出两个珍宝衍生物。

415787.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, creature, or enchantment. Create a Treasure token.
415787.translation: 消灭目标神器，生物或结界。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

415839.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
415839.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

415967.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. You create a Treasure token.
415967.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

416099.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, create a Treasure token.
416099.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

416139.oracleText: For each land you control, create a Treasure token.
416139.translation: 你每操控一个地，便派出一个珍宝衍生物。

416193.oracleText: Draw two cards and create two Treasure tokens.
416193.translation: 抓两张牌并派出两个珍宝衍生物。

416432.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
416432.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

416536.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player may pay {o2}. If the player doesn't, you create a Treasure token.
416536.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌时，该牌手可以支付{o2}。若该牌手未如此作，则你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

417489.oracleText: Target an activated ability, triggered ability, or legendary spell.
417489.translation: 指定一个起动式异能、触发式异能或传奇咒语为目标。

417490.oracleText: WARNING: Please take a different action or the game will end in a draw.
417490.translation: 警告：请执行不同的操作，否则本局游戏将以平局结束。

417577.oracleText: Target an Angel or Human creature card.
417577.translation: 指定一张天使或人类生物牌为目标。

417750.oracleText: Put a card that has an Adventure that player owns into that player's graveyard?
417750.translation: 是否要将一张由该牌手拥有且具有历险的牌置入该牌手的坟墓场。

418350.oracleText:
"Think of the locket as a seed you bear, spreading life from Vitu-Ghazi across all of Ravnica."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant
418350.translation:
「将此坠饰当成你随身所携的种子，把生命从维图加基播撒至整个拉尼卡。」
～瑟雷尼亚法皇荷路杰

418460.oracleText: Target an Elemental creature card in your graveyard with toughness less than {1, CardId}'s toughness.
418460.translation: 指定一张在你坟墓场中且防御力小于{1, CardId}之防御力的元素生物牌为目标。

418464.translation: 指定一个由你操控的元素为目标。

418468.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
418468.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+1且获得飞行异能。

418471.translation: 消灭所有非巨人的生物。

418474.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Untap it.
418474.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。将之重置。

418476.oracleText: Target noncreature artifact you control becomes a 0/0 artifact creature. Put four +1/+1 counters on it.
418476.translation: 目标由你操控的非生物神器成为0/0神器生物。在其上放置四个+1/+1指示物。

418478.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
418478.translation: 将目标由对手操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

418486.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. You lose 2 life.
418486.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客，你失去2点生命。

418490.oracleText: You gain X life and each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of Knights you control.
418490.translation: 你获得X点生命且每位对手各失去X点生命，X为由你操控的骑士数量。

418492.oracleText: Damage can't be prevented this turn. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
418492.translation: 本回合中，伤害不能被防止。CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

418493.oracleText: Damage can't be prevented this turn. Stomp deals 2 damage to any target.
418493.translation: 本回合中，伤害不能被防止。一脚踩下对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

418496.oracleText: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
418496.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

418501.oracleText: Create three 2/2 green Bear creature tokens.
418501.translation: 派出三个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物。

418504.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
418504.translation: 派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

418506.oracleText: Add one mana of any color.
418506.translation: 加一点任意颜色的法术力。

418509.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Human creature tokens.
418509.translation: 派出两个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

419633.oracleText: Target up to one other card.
419633.translation: 指定至多另一张牌为目标。

419635.oracleText:
"Dawn-kissed, he nourishes the golden grain."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet
419635.translation:
「他挥洒晨光，滋养世间谷物。」
～迈勒提斯诗人普塞弥拉

419636.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature or enchantment you control gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.
419636.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：选择一种颜色。目标由你操控的生物或结界获得反该色保护异能直到回合结束。

419639.oracleText:
"The archon fell like a star from the sky, meeting the rising sun at the horizon's edge."
—The Cosmogony
419639.translation:
「统领如流星从苍穹坠落，会旭日于天际。」
～《天地起源论》

419640.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may return target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
419640.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

419643.oracleText: Pegasus creatures you control have lifelink.
419643.translation: 由你操控的飞马生物具有系命异能。

419645.oracleText:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—The Theriad
419645.translation:
天尊伸手想要去拿石块，赫利欧德则将整个太阳递到她掌心。
～《塞洛亚特》

419648.oracleText: Create a 0/4 colorless Wall artifact creature token with defender.
419648.translation: 派出一个0/4无色，具守军异能的墙衍生神器生物。

419651.oracleText:
"Gazing at the unicorn, I felt closer to the majesty of Nyx than I ever had before."
—Oineus, traveling merchant
419651.translation:
「我与独角兽对视时，感觉自己从未与尼兹神域如此接近。」
～云游商人俄涅乌斯

419654.oracleText: "In every one of you I see a hero's heart."
419654.translation: 「我看出你们人人都有一颗英勇雄心。」

419655.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
419655.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

419656.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has first strike and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token."
419656.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有先攻异能与「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。」

419658.oracleText: Is there a greater promise than the glory of the sunrise?
419658.translation: 还有什么承诺，比许你日升之耀更伟大？

419662.oracleText: Daxos's toughness is equal to your devotion to white.
419662.translation: 达克索斯的防御力等同于你的白色献力。

419665.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is your devotion to white.
419665.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为你的白色献力。

419667.oracleText: Those whose lives were uninspired are doomed to the wretched tedium of Phylias in death.
419667.translation: 活着虚度光阴的人，死后必会坠入虚妄境费拉司继续蹉跎岁月。

419670.oracleText: Death turned admirable conviction into pointless intransigence.
419670.translation: 令人钦佩的虔诚信念，在死后就变成了毫无意义的固执坚持。

419671.oracleText: Loyalty abilities of planeswalkers your opponents control cost {o1} more to activate.
419671.translation: 由对手操控之鹏洛客的忠诚异能增加{o1}来起动。

419674.oracleText: Noncreature spells your opponents cast cost {o2} more to cast until your next turn.
419674.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，对手施放的非生物咒语增加{o2}来施放。

419675.oracleText: Return target creature or planeswalker card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a +1/+1 counter or a loyalty counter on it.
419675.translation: 将目标生物或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物或一个忠诚指示物。

419677.oracleText: Up to two target creatures you control each get +2/+1 until end of turn.
419677.translation: 至多两个目标由你操控的生物各得+2/+1直到回合结束。

419678.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens.
419678.translation: 派出两个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

419680.oracleText: Escape—{o4oWoW}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard.
419680.translation: 逸脱～{o4oWoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌。

419682.oracleText: "The promise of victory fills my heart. There is no room for fear."
419682.translation: 「胜利许诺充盈内心，毫无怯惧容身之地。」

419686.oracleText: An infinite journey in an infinitesimal time.
419686.translation: 无穷短时间内的一次无限长旅行。

419687.oracleText: Exile target creature or enchantment, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
419687.translation: 放逐目标生物或结界，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

419689.oracleText: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"
419689.translation: 「吾人乃是远古之光的护持僧、日冠赫利欧德祝福的守护者。勇敢作战吧，明光定会庇护你！」

419690.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control attacks, it gets +0/+1 until end of turn.
419690.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物攻击时，它得+0/+1直到回合结束。

419692.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or enchantment you control.
419692.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在目标由你操控的生物或结界上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

419693.oracleText: {o1oW}: Another target creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
419693.translation: {o1oW}：另一个目标生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

419695.oracleText: "I bring a dawn that no night can follow."
419695.translation: 「我降下破晓曙光，纵暗夜亦不能掩。」

419696.oracleText: Destroy X target artifacts and/or enchantments.
419696.translation: 消灭X个目标神器和／或结界。

419697.oracleText: Target player gains twice X life.
419697.translation: 目标牌手获得两倍于X的生命。

419698.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy X target artifacts and/or enchantments. 
• Target player gains twice X life.
419698.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭X个目标神器和／或结界。 
•目标牌手获得两倍于X的生命。

419703.oracleText: {oT}: Remove a task counter from Heliod's Punishment. Then if it has no task counters on it, destroy Heliod's Punishment.
419703.translation: {oT}：从赫利欧德的惩罚上移去一个作业指示物。然后如果其上没有作业指示物，则消灭赫利欧德的惩罚。

419705.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't attack or block. It loses all abilities and has "{oT}: Remove a task counter from Heliod's Punishment. Then if it has no task counters on it, destroy Heliod's Punishment."
419705.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。它失去所有异能且具有「{oT}：从赫利欧德的惩罚上移去一个作业指示物。然后如果其上没有作业指示物，则消灭赫利欧德的惩罚。」

419707.oracleText: Leonin fight for neither god nor polis; their loyalty is to their pride.
419707.translation: 狮族既不忠于神明，也不隶属城邦；他们只为自己族群而战。

419708.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets CARDNAME, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
419708.translation: 每当你施放以CARDNAME为目标的咒语时，由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

419711.oracleText: To tame a griffin is to ride into legend.
419711.translation: 驯服狮鹫，就能飞往传奇。

419714.oracleText:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas
419714.translation:
「勇敢冲锋，无私作战，公义行事。伊洛安斯与你同在。」
～伊洛安斯的僧侣维瑞尼斯

419716.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's an enchanted creature or enchantment creature, it also gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
419716.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果它是结界生物或受有灵气的生物，则它再获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

419718.oracleText: "Our stories are full of ancient wisdom; they tell us who we are."
419718.translation: 「吾人的故事当中充满先人智慧；我们引以为鉴认清自身。」

419722.oracleText: Leonin band together in the Underworld, taking solace in their strength until, at last, both pride and self are forgotten.
419722.translation: 在冥界当中狮族也会聚作狮群，从集体力量寻得慰藉，直到最后群体与自身皆被遗忘。

419725.oracleText:
"Storms drove them westward to Ketaphos;
 wide plains shimmered in starlight.
Centaurs greeted them, offering
 gold-hued apples and grain-cakes."
—The Callapheia
419725.translation:
「狂风吹袭迫使众人西行来到刻塔福司；
这里平原广阔天地合一四处星光熠熠。
热情的半人马簇拥上前欢迎来客到访，
备好金色苹果与米谷蛋糕作离别饯礼。」
～《卡莱斐纪》

419727.oracleText: "My time will come, when every soul will bask in my glory and obey my law."
419727.translation: 「我的时刻终将到来，届时众生将浴我荣光、从我律法。」

419733.oracleText: Every soldier has a place to stand and a role to play.
419733.translation: 每个士兵在阵中都有自己的位置和作用。

419734.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+1 until end of turn. Each other creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
419734.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。每个由你操控的其他生物各得+1/+1直到回合结束。

419736.oracleText: Every footstep is a prayer, every road a temple.
419736.translation: 每步一诵拜，路路皆神庙。

419739.oracleText: "Zeal is the sharpest blade, and piety the strongest shield."
419739.translation: 「热诚是最锋利的尖刀，虔敬是最坚实的护盾。」

419742.oracleText:
"The time has come for us to throw off the chains of tyrannical gods and antiquated superstitions."
—Tikaia, disciple of Uremides
419742.translation:
「这天已经到来：吾辈苦于专横神明与陈腐迷信的桎梏，如今该挺身破除这一切。」
～乌瑞弥得斯学徒提卡伊亚

419744.oracleText:
"To provoke the mountain is to invite the avalanche."
—Perisophia the philosopher
419744.translation:
「激怒大山就是把山崩请上门。」
～哲人珀里索菲娅

419747.oracleText: Escape—{oW}, Exile two other cards from your graveyard.
419747.translation: 逸脱～{oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐两张其他牌。

419749.oracleText: When the gods go to war, mortals pay the highest price.
419749.translation: 神界混战时，最惨痛的代价往往要由凡界承担。

419750.oracleText: Each player who controls a creature with power 4 or greater draws a card. Then destroy all creatures.
419750.translation: 每位操控力量等于或大于4之生物的牌手各抓一张牌。然后消灭所有生物。

419752.oracleText: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.
419752.translation: 达克索斯被赫利欧德选中后，毫无畏惧地走向飞马，未着鞍辔即能自如驾驭。

419753.oracleText: {o1oW}: CARDNAME gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn.
419753.translation: {o1oW}：CARDNAME获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。

419755.translation: 阿喀洛斯老兵塔若妮卡

419756.oracleText: "I like to think Kytheon keeps watch over all of us."
419756.translation: 「我更愿相信是库忒昂在一直守护我们。」

419757.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap another target creature you control. Until end of turn, that creature has base power and toughness 4/4 and gains indestructible.
419757.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置另一个目标由你操控的生物。直到回合结束，该生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4且获得不灭异能。

419760.oracleText:
"The first griffins were made by the gods to capture falling stars; they were given the keenest eyes and the swiftest wings, and sent to keep watch above the clouds."
—The Cosmogony
419760.translation:
「诸神想要阻止流星再度坠地，便创造了狮鹫行守护之责；他们赋予狮鹫锐利双目与疾速翅膀，令其驻守云端随时戒备。」
～《天地起源论》

419762.oracleText: Not even death can quench a hero's inner fire.
419762.translation: 死亡也无法浇熄英雄的内心火焰。

419763.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater. You gain 3 life.
419763.translation: 消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。你获得3点生命。

419765.oracleText: "Why would I ever want to look away?"

419767.oracleText: Alirios doesn't untap during your untap step if you control a Reflection.
419767.translation: 如果你操控映影，则阿里流士于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

419774.oracleText: The oracles of Meletis foresaw neither its rise from the depths nor the destruction it would leave in its wake.
419774.translation: 迈勒提斯的先知既没有预见到会有巨人从深洋现身，更没料想到它会留下满目疮痍。

419777.oracleText: Callaphe's power is equal to your devotion to blue.
419777.translation: 卡莱斐的力量等同于你的蓝色献力。

419778.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target this permanent cost {o1} more to cast.
419778.translation: 对手施放之以此永久物为目标的咒语须额外支付{o1}来施放。

419779.oracleText: Creatures and enchantments you control have "Spells your opponents cast that target this permanent cost {o1} more to cast."
419779.translation: 由你操控的生物和结界具有「对手施放之以此永久物为目标的咒语增加{o1}来施放。」

419781.oracleText: Those who do not learn from their mistakes are bound to relive them.
419781.translation: 从未自错误中汲取教训的人，必将重蹈覆辙。

419782.oracleText: Target creature gets -4/-0 until end of turn. Scry 2.
419782.translation: 目标生物得-4/-0直到回合结束。占卜2。

419784.oracleText:
"A great wave crashed, and a mighty wind blew out the stars."
—The Cosmogony
419784.translation:
「巨浪冲袭天界，劲风吹散群星。」
～《天地起源论》

419785.oracleText: Counter target creature or enchantment spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
419785.translation: 反击目标生物或结界咒语。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

419787.oracleText: "And what did Erekastos teach us is the nature of the soul?"
419787.translation: 「难道厄勒卡托斯教导我们的，真是灵魂本质？」

419791.oracleText: The greatest minds in Meletis study under the masters at the Dekatia, a renowned school of magic and philosophy.
419791.translation: 得卡提亚学院是教导魔法与哲理的知名学府，迈勒提斯最顶尖的智者都云集于此拜师深造。

419794.oracleText:
"Freedom lies in accepting a single path."
—Nyklos, Meletian philosopher
419794.translation:
「认定方向一往无前，便能求得自由出路。」
～迈勒提斯哲人倪克洛斯

419795.oracleText: Escape—{o2oU}, Exile five other cards from your graveyard.
419795.translation: 逸脱～{o2oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐五张其他牌。

419797.oracleText: Tycthis's military career was a flop.
419797.translation: 提克提斯的军旅生涯就此扑腾落地。

419798.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a blue Fish with base power and toughness 0/1.
419798.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为0/1的蓝色鱼。

419800.oracleText: Create an 8/8 blue Kraken creature token with hexproof.
419800.translation: 派出一个8/8蓝色，具辟邪异能的巨海兽衍生生物。

419801.oracleText: Tap all nonland permanents target opponent controls. They don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
419801.translation: 横置由目标对手操控的所有非地永久物。它们于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

419802.oracleText: Gain control of target permanent an opponent controls. Untap it.
419802.translation: 获得目标由对手操控的永久物之操控权。将之重置。

419806.oracleText: When you cast a spell with the chosen name for the first time this turn, draw two cards.
419806.translation: 本回合中，当你首度施放具该名称的咒语时，抓两张牌。

419807.oracleText: Look at the top card of each player's library.
419807.translation: 检视每位牌手的牌库顶牌。

419809.oracleText: Alythos sat and stared blankly out over the glassy oceans of Nerono, trying in vain to remember what he knew he had forgotten.
419809.translation: 阿吕托斯呆坐着，无神目光投向奈洛诺的平静汪洋。他明知自己已遗忘一切，却仍徒劳地想要唤醒回忆。

419812.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {o1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and create a 1/1 blue Tentacle creature token.
419812.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且派出一个1/1蓝色触手衍生生物。

419815.oracleText:
"Wave-borne, he watches over secrets of the shore."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet
419815.translation:
「他生自波涛，守护岸边秘密。」
～迈勒提斯诗人普塞弥拉

419818.oracleText:
"Storm-tossed and broken, Callaphe
 cried out to deep-dwelling Thassa.
Tritons came swiftly to save her,
 bringing her north to the Lindus."
—The Callapheia
419818.translation:
「卡莱斐一行突遭遇暴风侵袭巨浪拍打，
她情急下疾呼塔萨，祈求救其命于绝地。
海中屈东闻讯急忙赶到助其挺过难关，
之后护送船队向北，指引她前往林都司。」
～《卡莱斐纪》

419820.oracleText: "My time will come, when the rising tide will surge above the tallest mountain."
419820.translation: 「我的时刻终将到来，届时汹涌潮水将吞没巍峨高山。」

419826.oracleText:
"Take your place among the stars."
—Kruphix, god of horizons
419826.translation:
「安身于群星之位。」
～天际神克罗芬斯

419828.oracleText: Enchanted permanent is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
419828.translation: 所结附的永久物是结界且失去所有其他牌张类别。

419830.oracleText: "Once you see past the veil we call ʻreality,' altering your own shape is elementary."
419830.translation: 「等你能够看穿这道称为『现实』的帘幕，就会发现变幻自身形态实属稀松平常。」

419834.oracleText:
"As the storm waves crushed my sailors, I cried out to Thassa. The next time I saw them, hard shells encased them, and they swam away to safety."
—Siona, captain of the Pyleas
419834.translation:
「当我的水手被狂风巨浪卷走时，我一时情急便向塔萨大声求援。转眼之间，只见硬壳海龟从海中出现将他们包住，缓缓游向安全之地。」
～皮勒阿斯号船长西俄娜

419836.oracleText: "I see destruction, suffering, and one tormented glimmer of hope."
419836.translation: 「我看到了毁灭、折磨，还有苦难中些微的希望。」

419839.oracleText: Instead of performing their daily devotions, Heliod's acolytes spent the morning picking strands of kelp off the altar.
419839.translation: 今天早晨，赫利欧德的侍僧并未按例礼拜，而是忙于清理祭坛周围的海藻。

419840.oracleText: Return up to three target creatures and/or enchantments to their owners' hands.
419840.translation: 将至多三个目标生物和／或结界移回其拥有者手上。

419842.oracleText: It swims upon the winds and soars through the waves.

419843.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return up to one other target enchantment you control to its owner's hand.
419843.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将至多另一个目标由你操控的结界移回其拥有者手上。

419845.oracleText: It eats the things that eat the things that are drawn to the light.
419845.translation: 有东西被光束吸引，继而被其他东西吃掉，其他东西继而被它吃掉。

419848.oracleText: Normally, a cerberus sleeps one head at a time.
419848.translation: 一般来说，地狱犬每次只有一颗头睡觉。

419849.oracleText: Escape—{o2oU}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard.
419849.translation: 逸脱～{o2oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

419854.oracleText: Cities offer tribute to Ephara and carve her image into their walls, imploring her to protect them from the dangers of the wild.
419854.translation: 各个城市都会敬奉厄芳拉，并将其形象刻画于墙上，以此恳求她保佑全城免遭荒野侵袭。

419855.oracleText: Return target creature or enchantment an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
419855.translation: 将目标由对手操控的生物或结界移回其拥有者手上。

419858.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, you may tap or untap target nonland permanent.
419858.translation: 每当你施放每个对手回合中你的第一个咒语时，你可以横置或重置目标非地永久物。

419860.oracleText: When memory is torment, oblivion is bliss.
419860.translation: 当记忆成了折磨，忘却便是美事。

419861.oracleText: Escape—{o3oU}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard.
419861.translation: 逸脱～{o3oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌。

419863.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, exile up to one other target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
419863.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，放逐至多另一个目标由你操控的生物，然后将该牌在你的操控下移回战场。

419866.oracleText: "I bring a flood that nothing can withstand."
419866.translation: 「我洒下汹涌洪流，纵万物亦不能挡。」

419867.oracleText: Look at the top X cards of your library. Put up to two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
419867.translation: 检视你牌库顶的X张牌。将其中至多两张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

419868.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays twice {oX}.
419868.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付两倍的{oX}，否则反击之。

419869.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Look at the top X cards of your library. Put up to two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. 
• Counter target spell unless its controller pays twice {oX}.
419869.translation:
选择一项～ 
•检视你牌库顶的X张牌。将其中至多两张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。 
•除非目标咒语的操控者支付两倍的{oX}，否则反击之。

419874.oracleText: A sip of recollection, an ocean of regrets.
419874.translation: 轻啜往昔回忆，跌落悔恨汪洋。

419875.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an enchantment card.
419875.translation: 抓三张牌。然后除非你弃一张结界牌，否则弃两张牌。

419881.oracleText: Even in their mountain fortresses, the Akroans have learned not to anger Thassa.
419881.translation: 即便躲在山脉要塞当中，阿喀洛斯人也学会了不要激怒塔萨。

419884.oracleText: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.
419884.translation: 塔萨的眷顾随着他进到冥界。就连奈洛诺境的波涛也听其号令。

419888.oracleText: "You can no more stop me than you can halt the tide."

419892.oracleText:
"May the skies be clear of gales and gulls."
—Meletian prayer
419892.translation:
「愿风平浪静，海鸥不现。」
～迈勒提斯祷文

419894.oracleText: Tritons search for omens in its wake.
419894.translation: 屈东随其行迹寻找预兆。

419895.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, draw a card.
419895.translation: 每当你施放每个对手回合中你的第一个咒语时，抓一张牌。

419898.oracleText: For each spell and ability your opponents control, counter it unless its controller pays {o4}.
419898.translation: 对每个由对手操控的咒语或异能而言，除非其操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。

419900.oracleText: "As the future slips its way into the present, it ceases to be my concern."
419900.translation: 「随着未来缓慢融入现在，我不再担忧来日。」

419903.oracleText: The sharp memory of Daxos's death stabbed into Elspeth's soul.
419903.translation: 达克索斯殒命的尖锐记忆深深刺入了艾紫培的灵魂。

419904.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it or a card from their graveyard. Exile that card. You lose 1 life.
419904.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你从其手上选择一张非地牌或从其坟墓场中选择一张牌。放逐该牌。你失去1点生命。

419906.oracleText:
"Sing, beauty. Sing for death, and for the dead."
—Ashiok
419906.translation:
「美人啊，放声歌唱吧。为死亡而歌，为逝者而唱。」
～安梭苛

419907.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may exile an enchantment card from your graveyard. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
419907.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张结界牌。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

419909.oracleText: "Some aspire to be mighty like the lion or the hydra. I am the parasite that feeds on them all."
419909.translation: 「有人希望成为狮子或多头龙一样的猛兽。而我宁作啃咬猛兽的寄生虫。」

419913.oracleText: Wherever it walks, famine follows behind.

419917.oracleText: In bleak Tizerus, all hope crumbles in your grasp.
419917.translation: 在阴黯的提泽拉司境内，所有希望都会在你掌心化作尘埃。

419918.oracleText: Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, you gain 3 life. Otherwise, you draw a card.
419918.translation: 将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果该牌是生物牌，则你获得3点生命。若否，你抓一张牌。

419919.oracleText: Escape—{o3oB}, Exile five other cards from your graveyard.
419919.translation: 逸脱～{o3oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐五张其他牌。

419922.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 0/1 white Goat creature token.
419922.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个0/1白色山羊衍生生物。

419925.oracleText: The more you struggle against death, the tighter its grip becomes.
419925.translation: 你挣扎得越狠，死亡便扯得越紧。

419927.oracleText:
"Kroxa devours what he may—not for sustenance or pleasure, but because it is his nature. He is unending hunger given form."
—Klothys, god of destiny
419927.translation:
「克罗刹吞得了他能吃下的所有东西～这并非为了求生或取乐，而只是天性使然。他正是无尽饥饿的具现。」
～命运神克洛缇丝

419930.oracleText: Destroy target creature an opponent controls with power 2 or less.
419930.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于2的生物。

419931.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature, nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
419931.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非生物且非地的牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

419932.translation: 放逐目标对手的坟墓场。

419934.oracleText:
"Evil flourishes where ignorance thrives."
—Perisophia the philosopher
419934.translation:
「无知遍行之处，邪恶随之昌盛。」
～哲人珀里索菲娅

419935.oracleText: CARDNAME gets -1/-1 for each card in your opponents' hands.
419935.translation: 所有对手每有一张手牌，CARDNAME便得-1/-1。

419938.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.
419938.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

419939.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Target creature gets -2/-1 until end of turn.
419939.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物：目标生物得-2/-1直到回合结束。

419941.oracleText: "I bring a death none can escape."
419941.translation: 「我取下苍生性命，纵英杰亦不能逃。」

419942.oracleText: Exile up to twice X target cards from graveyards.
419942.translation: 将至多两倍于X数量的目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

419943.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. You gain X life. 
• Exile up to twice X target cards from graveyards.
419943.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。你获得X点生命。 
•将至多两倍于X数量的目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

419945.oracleText: The Underworld erodes memory, identity, and eventually the physical form, leaving only crumbling statues called misera—hollow monuments to mortal futility.
419945.translation: 冥界会逐渐侵蚀亡者的记忆、身分乃至实体，最终只留下一尊脆弱悲像，作为凡人徒劳求生的空洞纪念。

419947.oracleText: One spiny tree with bitter fruit grows in the realm of Tizerus, outside the palace of Erebos.
419947.translation: 在提泽拉斯境内、厄睿柏斯宫殿之外，长着一棵多刺果树，结出苦涩果实。

419948.oracleText: Escape—{o3oB}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard.
419948.translation: 逸脱～{o3oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

419950.oracleText: Funerary masks help the newly dead resist the erosion of memory and identity in the Underworld.
419950.translation: 亡者身边的葬仪面具，能帮助他们在刚入冥界之时抵御此处对记忆和身分的侵蚀。

419956.oracleText: Spells you cast from your graveyard cost {o1} less to cast.
419956.translation: 你从你坟墓场施放的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

419958.oracleText: The Returned retain no memory of their identities, but sometimes they mindlessly attempt familiar tasks.
419958.translation: 转世者没有其身分的任何记忆，但有时仍会不由自主地作起熟悉的事情。

419961.oracleText: From the echoes of a violent life, a terrible foe is born.
419961.translation: 从暴躁生命的回响中，一位可怖劲敌逐渐成形。

419962.oracleText: Whenever an enchanted creature dies, draw a card for each Aura you controlled that was attached to it.
419962.translation: 每当一个受有灵气的生物死去时，其上贴附的灵气中每有一个由你操控者，你便抓一张牌。

419964.oracleText:
"How many more will die before you accept your fate?"
—Erebos, god of the dead
419964.translation:
「你在接受自己的命运之前，会牺牲多少条性命？」
～死神厄睿柏斯

419965.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature."
419965.translation: 所结附的生物具有「在你的维持开始时，牺牲一个生物。」

419967.oracleText:
"Grief-struck, she weeps for each mortal's final death."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet
419967.translation:
「她满怀悲痛，泪悼凡人殒命。」
～迈勒提斯诗人普塞弥拉

419968.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a creature: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
419968.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个生物：每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

419970.oracleText: As a mortal, Phenax was the first to escape the Underworld. As a god, he brings his pawns along the same dark path.
419970.translation: 当他还是凡人时，斐纳克第一个逃出冥界。当他身为神明后，他引领自己走卒依同样道路回生。

419973.oracleText: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.
419973.translation: 徘徊在生与死、地与海、忆与忘之间。

419977.oracleText: Those caught attempting to escape the Underworld spend the rest of their existence trapped in the Mire of Punishment.
419977.translation: 试图逃离冥界而被抓到者，其接下来实体仍存的时光，都是被埋在惩戒泥沼中度过。

419980.oracleText: Rage-crowned Mogis swiftly rewards the virtue of brutality.
419980.translation: 怒冕墨癸斯很快就让暴力美德得到嘉奖。

419983.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may exile it. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's 1/1 and it's a Nightmare in addition to its other types.
419983.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品，但它是1/1，且额外具有梦魇此类别。

419985.oracleText:
"Callaphe guided them into the
 darkness of Hetos, the bleak mire;
Blood-horned minotaurs circled them,
 axes aglimmer in shadow."
—The Callapheia
419985.translation:
「卡莱斐率领手下来到黑暗泥沼赫托泽，
此处空有明月高悬，却依然是黯淡无光。
血角牛头怪忽然出现将众人团团围住，
纵使八方黑影幢幢，仍见利斧星光闪亮。」
～《卡莱斐纪》

419987.oracleText: "My time will come, when life's frantic striving will fade into the boundless quiet of death."
419987.translation: 「我的时刻终将到来，届时聒絮生机将化作静寂死亡。」

419992.oracleText: "If you will not pour your drink out for me, I shall pour mine out for you."
419992.translation: 「如果你不为我倒干佳酿，那就换我为你倒干杯中一切。」

419996.oracleText: Escape—{o5oB}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard.
419996.translation: 逸脱～{o5oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

420000.oracleText: The fury of the slaughter god Mogis burns within him.
420000.translation: 屠戮神墨癸斯的怒火在他体内燃烧。

420004.oracleText: Desecrating the dead is a convenient way for harpies to expand their foul collections.
420004.translation: 亵渎亡者，是哈痞增加自己秽物收藏的快捷方式。

420007.oracleText: "We offer to Mogis the blood of the weak, and in return he makes us strong."
420007.translation: 「我们向墨癸斯献上弱者鲜血，他以让我们变强为报。」

420008.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Draw a card.

420010.oracleText: "I don't know if the gods watch over their temples, but I figure it's best to be stealthy just in case."
420010.translation: 「我不知道神明是否会照看自己的殿堂，但我最好还是悄悄行动以防万一。」

420011.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by enchanted creatures or enchantment creatures.
420011.translation: CARDNAME不能被结界生物或受有灵气的生物阻挡。

420014.oracleText: Phenax is generous with gifts and unforgiving of debts.
420014.translation: 斐纳克赋礼从不严格，还愿从不宽容。

420016.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you lose 1 life.
420016.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，你失去1点生命。

420021.oracleText: You gain X life and scry X, where X is the number of Zombies you control.
420021.translation: 你获得X点生命且占卜X，X为由你操控的灵俑数量。

420023.oracleText: Tymaret's toughness is equal to your devotion to black.
420023.translation: 提玛瑞的防御力等同于你的黑色献力。

420024.oracleText: {o1oB}: Exile up to two target cards from graveyards. You gain 1 life for each creature card exiled this way.
420024.translation: {o1oB}：将至多两张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。每以此法放逐一张生物牌，你便获得1点生命。

420027.oracleText: Escape—{o4oB}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard.
420027.translation: 逸脱～{o4oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

420028.oracleText: CARDNAME escapes with two +1/+1 counters on it.
420028.translation: CARDNAME逸脱时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

420030.oracleText: Dreams are just one more form of torment.
420030.translation: 梦境不过是另一种形式的折磨。

420033.oracleText: "Many have sought snake-twined Pharika's panacea. Do you wish to share their fate?"
420033.translation: 「许多人都在苦苦寻求缠蛇芳瑞卡的万灵药。你也想加入他们吗？」

420039.oracleText: Escape—{o3oBoB}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard.
420039.translation: 逸脱～{o3oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌。

420042.oracleText: Gain control of target creature for as long as CARDNAME remains on the battlefield.
420042.translation: 于CARDNAME仍在战场上时段内，获得目标生物的操控权。

420044.oracleText: Until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able.
420044.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，由对手操控的生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

420045.oracleText: Each tapped creature deals damage to itself equal to its power.
420045.translation: 每个已横置的生物各对本身造成等同于其力量的伤害。

420047.oracleText: Anax's power is equal to your devotion to red.
420047.translation: 阿那克斯的力量等同于你的红色献力。

420050.oracleText: "It's not enough to surprise your opponent. You have to delight the crowd as well."
420050.translation: 「光吓到对手还不够。你还得乐到观众。」

420051.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
420051.translation: 每当你施放每个对手回合中你的第一个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

420058.oracleText: It's a small step from revel to bloodbath.
420058.translation: 从狂欢盛宴到血色浸染不过一步之遥。

420059.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
420059.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

420061.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature or enchantment: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target creature. That creature can't block this turn.
420061.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物或结界：CARDNAME对目标生物造成1点伤害。该生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

420064.oracleText:
"Renata was mesmerized by the satyr's dance of gleeful indifference, of reckless grace and bright disaster."
—Luphea of Setessa, Histories
420064.translation:
「羊蹄人的舞蹈在冷漠中流露欢欣，在美善中夹杂无情，在灾难中体现希望，瑞娜塔就此沉迷其中。」
～瑟特萨的吕菲娅，《史典》

420065.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
420065.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

420068.oracleText: Magic is the true artist's medium.
420068.translation: 真正的艺术家以魔法作媒材。

420069.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o2oR} and sacrifice a nonland permanent. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland permanent card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
420069.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o2oR}并牺牲一个非地永久物。若你如此作，则从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到你展示出一张非地永久物牌为止。将该牌放进战场，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

420071.oracleText: Purphoros forged the manticore's tail from bronze, its teeth from silver, and its heart from hate.
420071.translation: 普罗烽斯在铸造蝎狮时，以青铜作尾，白银当牙，仇恨为心。

420072.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
420072.translation: 每当你施放每个对手回合中你的第一个咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

420075.oracleText: "Not even death can catch me now!"

420076.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has haste.
420076.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

420077.oracleText: Escape—{o1oR}, Exile two other cards from your graveyard.
420077.translation: 逸脱～{o1oR}，从你的坟墓场放逐两张其他牌。

420079.oracleText:
"Everything will be put back in its proper place."
—Klothys, god of destiny
420079.translation:
「万物都将回归正位。」
～命运神克洛缇丝

420080.oracleText: Fateful End deals 3 damage to any target. Scry 1.
420080.translation: 宿命终结对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。占卜1。

420082.oracleText: Those who fought without honor in life are taken to Agonas and doomed to fight forever in its arenas.
420082.translation: 生前在战斗中苟且之人，死后会坠入阿戈纳司境内的竞技场里战斗不休。

420083.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or enchantment.
420083.translation: 牺牲一个生物或结界，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

420084.oracleText: Final Flare deals 5 damage to target creature.
420084.translation: 终命火光对目标生物造成5点伤害。

420086.oracleText:
"A cyclops thinks slowly but strikes quickly. Try to keep it thinking."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis
420086.translation:
「独眼巨人动脑慢，但下手快。想办法让它一直动脑。」
～迈勒提斯士兵布莉戈涅

420087.oracleText: Whenever two or more creatures your opponents control attack, CARDNAME can't block this combat.
420087.translation: 每当两个或更多由对手操控的生物攻击时，CARDNAME本次战斗中不能进行阻挡。

420090.oracleText: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.
420090.translation: 克洛缇丝着手修补塞洛斯的命运，每针都由怒火引线。

420091.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until you exile another card with CARDNAME.
420091.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则放逐你的牌库顶牌。你可以使用该牌，直到你以CARDNAME放逐另一张牌为止。

420094.oracleText: Winners of the Iroan Games are forever remembered as heroes of their people.
420094.translation: 伊洛安斯竞技会的冠军，会被人民当作英雄永远铭记。

420097.oracleText: Brashness is close enough to bravery.

420102.oracleText: "Feast, for your next meal may be your last!"
420102.translation: 「下顿也许就是最后一顿，现在尽情吃喝吧！」

420103.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and attacks each combat if able.
420103.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+3，且每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

420104.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
420104.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，CARDNAME对该生物的操控者造成3点伤害。

420107.oracleText: The flamespeakers of Akros live passionately, devoted to Purphoros and the cycle of destructive creation.
420107.translation: 阿喀洛斯的焰语者生性热情，将身心都献给了普罗烽斯与创灭循环。

420110.oracleText:
"Renata launched a dozen arrows into the minotaur's thick hide, but the monster didn't slow its charge. The fury of Mogis was upon it."
—Luphea of Setessa, Histories
420110.translation:
「瑞娜塔接连向牛头怪射出十余支箭。虽然每箭都准确命中牛头怪的躯体，但其冲锋速度丝毫未减。此刻它正有墨癸斯怒火加身。」
～瑟特萨的吕菲娅，《史典》

420112.oracleText: The blessing is not the strength itself, but the knowledge of how to use it.
420112.translation: 这份祝福并非赐你力量，而是赐你学会如何发力。

420116.oracleText: To some satyrs, only blasphemy is sacred.
420116.translation: 对部分羊蹄人而言，只有亵渎神明才是致敬。

420117.oracleText: CARDNAME gains haste until end of turn.
420117.translation: CARDNAME获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

420122.oracleText:
"One-eyed and frightful, the cyclops
 lifted a boulder and hurled it
seaward from cliff's edge, shattering
 masts and scattering sailors."
—The Callapheia
420122.translation:
「这个巨人仅有一眼，故承名库克洛普斯，
惟其体魄孔武有力，纵远隔也令人胆颤。
只见他站在悬崖边，举起巨石掷向海面，
桅杆遭袭应声碎裂，甲板水手四下逃散。」
～《卡莱斐纪》

420124.oracleText: "My time will come, when all the world will be reforged in the fires of my invention."
420124.translation: 「我的时刻终将到来，届时创生烈焰将重铸世间一切。」

420129.oracleText:
"Flame-wrapped, she dances a burning swath amid the clouds."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet
420129.translation:
「她伴火共舞，焰迹遍现云端。」
～迈勒提斯诗人普塞弥拉

420132.oracleText: Escape—{oRoR}, Exile eight other cards from your graveyard.
420132.translation: 逸脱～{oRoR}，从你的坟墓场放逐八张其他牌。

420133.oracleText: CARDNAME escapes with a +1/+1 counter on it.
420133.translation: CARDNAME逸脱时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

420137.oracleText: Escape—{o2oRoR}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard.
420137.translation: 逸脱～{o2oRoR}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

420139.oracleText: Mogis can fan a small flame of resentment into an inferno of madness.
420139.translation: 墨癸斯能将怨恨星火化作狂愤炼狱。

420141.oracleText: {o2oR}: You may put a red creature card or an artifact creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
420141.translation: {o2oR}：你可以将一张红色生物牌或神器生物牌从你手上放进战场。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

420143.oracleText: "I bring a fire to recast all the world."
420143.translation: 「我引下熊熊烈火，纵现世亦能重铸。」

420144.oracleText: Create an X/1 red Elemental creature token with trample and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
420144.translation: 派出一个X/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的元素衍生生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

420145.oracleText: CARDNAME deals twice X damage to target creature or planeswalker.
420145.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

420146.oracleText: Purphoros's Intervention deals twice X damage to target creature or planeswalker.
420146.translation: 普罗烽斯的干预对目标生物或鹏洛客造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

420147.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Create an X/1 red Elemental creature token with trample and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. 
• CARDNAME deals twice X damage to target creature or planeswalker.
420147.translation:
选择一项～ 
•派出一个X/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的元素衍生生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

420148.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Create an X/1 red Elemental creature token with trample and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. 
• Purphoros's Intervention deals twice X damage to target creature or planeswalker.
420148.translation:
选择一项～ 
•派出一个X/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的元素衍生生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。 
•普罗烽斯的干预对目标生物或鹏洛客造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

420150.oracleText: It's hard to keep a satyr down, even in the Underworld.
420150.translation: 要让羊蹄人冷静下来很难，在冥界也一样。

420152.oracleText: Escape—{o2oR}, Exile two other cards from your graveyard.
420152.translation: 逸脱～{o2oR}，从你的坟墓场放逐两张其他牌。

420155.oracleText: Whenever another creature becomes the target of an ability of a land you control named Labyrinth of Skophos, you may have CARDNAME fight that creature.
420155.translation: 每当另一个生物成为由你操控、且名称为斯科福司迷宫的地之异能目标时，你可以令CARDNAME与该生物互斗。

420158.oracleText: The minotaur polis of Skophos boasts grand temples to the god of slaughter.
420158.translation: 牛头怪城邦斯科福司内有一座供奉屠戮神的巨大神庙，整个城邦都以此为荣。

420159.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice another creature or an enchantment: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
420159.translation: {oR}，牺牲另一个生物或一个结界：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

420162.oracleText: To a satyr, a stampede is just another kind of revelry.
420162.translation: 对羊蹄人而言，狂奔不过是另一种狂欢。

420163.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
420163.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

420169.oracleText: Distant thunder rumbled, a dread forewarning of Keranos's displeasure.
420169.translation: 远处雷鸣隆响，正是刻拉诺斯不悦的恐怖前兆。

420170.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
420170.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。

420171.oracleText: Storm's Wrath deals 4 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
420171.translation: 风暴之怒对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。

420173.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent.
420173.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

420175.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
420175.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。从中选择一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

420176.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
420176.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。从中选择一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

420177.oracleText:
Whenever CARDNAME attacks or becomes the target of a spell an opponent controls, choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent. 
• Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
420177.translation:
每当CARDNAME攻击或成为由对手操控之咒语的目标时，选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME向每位对手各造成3点伤害。 
•放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。从中选择一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

420179.oracleText: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."
420179.translation: 「眼下，在这创造的最初时刻，灿烂成果或破烂废铁就在一念之间。」

420183.oracleText: Target creature you control fights up to one target creature you don't control.
420183.translation: 目标由你操控的生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

420185.oracleText: Each nonland card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard.
420185.translation: 你坟墓场中的每张非地牌都具有逸脱异能。其逸脱费用等同于该牌的法术力费用加上从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

420188.oracleText: The Underworld is anything but a resting place.
420188.translation: 冥界唯独不是安息之所。

420189.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
420189.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

420190.oracleText: Underworld Fires deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
420190.translation: 冥界业火对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

420193.oracleText: Escape—{o3oR}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard.
420193.translation: 逸脱～{o3oR}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

420195.oracleText: Bright flames quell the darkest nightmares.
420195.translation: 明亮的火焰能消除最黑暗的梦魇。

420197.oracleText: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.
420197.translation: 她以万千青丝织成重重罗网，从尼兹直垂凡间，乃至深入冥界。

420198.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/2 green Spider creature token with reach.
420198.translation: 每当任一对手施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个1/2绿色，具延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

420201.oracleText: Exile up to two target cards from graveyards. For each creature card exiled this way, you gain 1 life.
420201.translation: 将至多两张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。每以此法放逐一张生物牌，你便获得1点生命。

420202.oracleText: Return target creature or land card from your graveyard to your hand.
420202.translation: 将目标生物或地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

420206.oracleText: Escape—{o3oGoG}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard.
420206.translation: 逸脱～{o3oGoG}，从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌。

420207.oracleText: CARDNAME escapes with three +1/+1 counters on it.
420207.translation: CARDNAME逸脱时上面有三个+1/+1指示物。

420210.oracleText: Creature and enchantment spells you control can't be countered.
420210.translation: 由你操控的生物和结界咒语不能被反击。

420211.oracleText: {o3oG}: Target land you control becomes an X/X Elemental creature with trample and haste until end of turn, where X is the number of enchantments you control. It's still a land.
420211.translation: {o3oG}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的地成为X/X，具践踏与敏捷异能的元素生物，X为由你操控的结界数量。它仍然是地。

420213.oracleText:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet
420213.translation:
「他遍身碧蔓，培育冥界新生。」
～迈勒提斯诗人普塞弥拉

420214.translation: 第一届伊洛安斯竞技会

420215.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
420215.translation: 派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

420216.oracleText: Put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
420216.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

420217.oracleText: If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw two cards.
420217.translation: 如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则抓两张牌。

420219.oracleText: The Nessian Wood is never without defenders.
420219.translation: 奈西安树林从缺少守卫者。

420222.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, double the number of +1/+1 counters on enchanted creature.
420222.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将所结附的生物上之+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

420224.oracleText: The scouts of Hyrax Tower keep watch at the edge of Setessan territory, protecting the polis from inhuman monsters and enemy armies.
420224.translation: 许拉兹塔斥候看守瑟特萨领地边境，保护城邦免受怪兽与敌军滋扰。

420227.oracleText: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.
420227.translation: 被尊为英雄者死后可进入安宁兴盛的依吕夏境内。此处为少有的安全境域，与冥界他处的黑暗阴沉形成鲜明对比。

420228.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, add two mana of any one color instead.
420228.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则改为加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。

420230.oracleText: Nylea appeared amid the howl of a hundred beasts.

420231.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn except combat damage that would be dealt by enchanted creatures and enchantment creatures. Scry 2.
420231.translation: 防止本回合中将造成的所有战斗伤害，但结界生物或受有灵气的生物造成的战斗伤害除外。占卜2。

420233.oracleText: The god of destiny grants her followers vision deeper than sight.
420233.translation: 命运神会让追随者窥探未来预示，其间景象远超双眼所见。

420234.oracleText: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your devotion to green.
420234.translation: 由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你的绿色献力。

420236.oracleText:
"I see . . . elk? And lion? And . . . teeth! A lot of teeth!"
—Teraklos of Meletis
420236.translation:
「我看到的这是…麋鹿？和狮子？还有…牙齿！好多的牙齿！」
～迈勒提斯的忒拉罗斯

420237.oracleText: Escape—{o4oG}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard.
420237.translation: 逸脱～{o4oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张其他牌。

420240.oracleText:
"Be fearless, for a furious rebirth awaits you."
—Nylea, god of the hunt
420240.translation:
「无畏向前，迎接凶猛重生。」
～猎神倪勒娅

420241.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create two 2/2 green Wolf creature tokens.
420241.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，派出两个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

420244.oracleText: Nylea watches over all the creatures of the forest except for the snakes. Blessed by Pharika, they can take care of themselves.
420244.translation: 倪勒娅照管树林中的所有生物，唯独蛇类除外。因为它们受芳瑞卡庇佑，可自立维生。

420246.oracleText:
"No power is too great to be undone."
—Karametra, god of harvests
420246.translation:
「没有哪种力量能强到撤销不了。」
～丰收神卡拉美特拉

420247.oracleText: Put target enchantment on the bottom of its owner's library.
420247.translation: 将目标结界置于其拥有者的牌库底。

420249.oracleText: Renata led the best hunters in all of Theros on a quest to bring down the terror of the Setessan wilds.
420249.translation: 塞洛斯全境优秀猎人集结瑞娜塔麾下，力图消灭瑟特萨荒野的恐惧之源。

420251.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller draws a card.
420251.translation: 每当CARDNAME被一个生物阻挡时，该生物的操控者抓一张牌。

420254.oracleText:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis
420254.translation:
「我们可以从弱小的角虫处领悟到政治学的首要准则：培养一位强力的同伴。」
～迈勒提斯智者皮塔摩恩

420255.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
420255.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控另一个力量等于或大于4的生物，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

420262.oracleText: The Summer Nexus is a holy grove in Setessa where the starfields of Nyx glitter in the shadows.
420262.translation: 「盛夏交汇点」是瑟特萨内一处神圣林地，你可以在此处树荫之中见到尼兹星域闪光。

420265.oracleText: {o2oG}: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, you may put it into your graveyard.
420265.translation: {o2oG}：展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是生物牌，则将它置于你手上。若否，你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

420267.oracleText: Where its feet tread, the thunder of many others will follow.
420267.translation: 它开拓之处，必有雷鸣蹄声相随。

420269.oracleText: Nature is stillness and savagery in equal measure.
420269.translation: 自然既有平静祥和，也会翻腾显威。

420272.oracleText: "I bring a wilderness no law can tame."
420272.translation: 「我驱下凶猛野兽，纵规绳亦不能驯。」

420274.oracleText: CARDNAME deals twice X damage to each creature with flying.
420274.translation: CARDNAME对每个具有飞行异能的生物各造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

420275.oracleText: Nylea's Intervention deals twice X damage to each creature with flying.
420275.translation: 倪勒娅的干预对每个具有飞行异能的生物各造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

420279.oracleText:
"A piercing call, bright as the stars, rang out across the valley, calling the Pheres band to war, to blood and savagery."
—Luphea of Setessa, Histories
420279.translation:
「刺耳号声响起，绽放耀眼星光，传彻整片山谷。斐力兹族就此现身，共同浴血奋战。」
～瑟特萨的吕菲娅，《史典》

420280.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target enchanted creature or enchantment creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
420280.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控之结界生物或受有灵气的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

420282.oracleText: Ancient yet ever-young, it is wise and subtle—and cruel and reckless as the spring itself.
420282.translation: 它既古老又年轻，既睿智又机敏～还跟春天一样既残酷又无情。

420283.oracleText: If you tap a permanent for mana, it produces three times as much of that mana instead.
420283.translation: 如果你横置某永久物以产生法术力，则改为它产生三倍的该类法术力。

420285.oracleText:
"Tree-tall giants confronted her,
 fiercely demanding her tribute;
Fox-cunning Callaphe's slippery
 speaking entangled their senses . . ."
—The Callapheia
420285.translation:
「身高齐树的壮硕巨汉挡在卡莱斐面前，
凶猛拦住去路要求留下贡品方可通过。
但她灵思如狐想出巧妙之策加以应对，
利用雄辩口才迷惑对方思绪趁乱逃脱…」
～《卡莱斐纪》

420287.oracleText: "My time will come, when no road will divide the endless verdure of the trees."
420287.translation: 「我的时刻终将到来，届时漫天葱翠将无人辟路穿行。」

420293.oracleText: An arrow from Nylea's bow never fails to find its mark.
420293.translation: 倪勒娅神弓射出的箭从不错失目标。

420295.oracleText: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.
420295.translation: 凯利斯不急不躁，他一直暗中跟踪艾紫培的动向，直到宿命的交锋时刻。

420296.oracleText: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
420296.translation: 展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中的一张生物牌和／或一张地牌置于你手上。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

420298.oracleText: Renata's power is equal to your devotion to green.
420298.translation: 瑞娜塔的力量等同于你的绿色献力。

420300.oracleText:
"Far-seeing Kruphix glimpsed the end: Heliod's spear cast down and broken."
—The Cosmogony
420300.translation:
「看透未来的克罗芬斯已预见这一结果：赫利欧德的长矛直坠而下断成数截。」
～《天地起源论》

420302.oracleText: "A blessing is not a gift. It is a duty."
420302.translation: 「蒙神赐福并非领受赠礼，而是承担责任。」

420306.oracleText: "Cypress leaves for family, larkspur for protection, amaranth for a bountiful harvest."
420306.translation: 「刺柏叶保佑家人健康，飞燕草庇护自身平安，皱果苋祈求大地丰收。」

420309.oracleText: Bassara, the tower of the fox, houses the elite skirmishers who guard the Nessian Wood against trespassers.
420309.translation: 巴萨剌塔又名狐狸之塔，看守奈西安树林的精英侦卫驻扎于此，保护其免遭外敌入侵。

420313.oracleText: In the heart of Setessa, the warriors of Leina Tower defend the polis and train its daughters.
420313.translation: 莱纳塔位于瑟特萨中心，其间勇士保护城邦，训练其女儿成长。

420316.oracleText: "From the ashes of last night's revel, I bring the dawn of new growth."
420316.translation: 「从昨夜欢宴的余烬中，我带来了新生长的黎明。」

420317.oracleText: Whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, you gain 1 life.
420317.translation: 每当一张地牌从任何区域置入你的坟墓场时，你获得1点生命。

420321.oracleText: A typhon's escape from the Underworld makes armies flee and kingdoms fall.
420321.translation: 堤丰从冥界逃出的消息令军队闻风而逃，王国不战而衰。

420322.oracleText: Escape—{o5oGoG}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard.
420322.translation: 逸脱～{o5oGoG}，从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌。

420331.oracleText: The best healers are intimately familiar with death.
420331.translation: 最优秀的医者，都与死亡有过亲密接触。

420335.oracleText: The light of hope blinded Pantor to the ills of the world.
420335.translation: 潘托拉眼中只看到这道希望光芒，全然不顾由此引发的世间灾祸。

420336.oracleText: Reveal the top six cards of your library. An opponent exiles a nonland card from among them, then you put the rest into your hand. That opponent may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
420336.translation: 展示你牌库顶的六张牌。任一对手放逐其中的一张非地牌，然后你将其余的牌置于你手上。该对手可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

420340.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand, then that player exiles a card from their hand.
420340.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上，然后该牌手从他手上放逐一张牌。

420346.oracleText: {oGoW}: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
420346.translation: {oGoW}：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

420348.oracleText: {oGoW}: Enchanted creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
420348.translation: {oGoW}：所结附的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

420349.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return it to the battlefield. It's an Aura enchantment with enchant creature you control and "{oGoW}: Enchanted creature gains indestructible until end of turn," and it loses all other abilities.
420349.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它移回战场。它是灵气结界，且具有「结附于由你操控的生物」与「{oGoW}：所结附的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束」，并失去所有其他异能。

420353.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an enchantment card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
420353.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张结界牌，并将该牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

420354.oracleText: Exile target creature or enchantment you don't control until target enchantment you control leaves the battlefield.
420354.translation: 放逐目标不由你操控的生物或结界，直到目标由你操控的结界离开战场为止。

420355.oracleText: Return all enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
420355.translation: 将所有结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

420358.oracleText: His imagination soars from the depths of the sea to the heights of the heavens.
420358.translation: 他的丰富想象从海底深渊直冲天际云霄。

420359.oracleText: Equipped creatures you control have flying and haste.
420359.translation: 由你操控且佩带武具的生物具有飞行与敏捷异能。

420361.oracleText: It slips silently through the still waters of the Labyrinth of Memories to feed.
420361.translation: 它无声滑过悲忆迷宫的死水，自在觅食。

420362.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into your graveyard from your library, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
420362.translation: 每当一张或数张牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

420366.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
420366.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

420368.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, draw a card.

420374.oracleText: Nylea speaks to her in the windblown leaves; Thassa in the rushing tides.
420374.translation: 倪勒娅借清风拂叶向她传话；塔萨则靠汹涌洪流对她发声。

420378.oracleText: Other Satyrs you control get +1/+1 and have haste.
420378.translation: 由你操控的其他羊蹄人得+1/+1且具有敏捷异能。

420379.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may discard a card at random. If you do, draw two cards.
420379.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，你可以随机弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

420381.oracleText: "Many have sought my weakness. All have failed."
420381.translation: 「很多人想要找到我的弱点。他们都失败了。」

420386.translation: 英雄勇行鼓舞新一代英雄出现。

420391.oracleText: As long as your devotion to red and green is less than seven, Klothys isn't a creature.
420391.translation: 只要你的红绿两色献力小于七，克洛缇丝便不是生物。

420397.oracleText: Escape—{oBoBoRoR}, Exile five other cards from your graveyard.
420397.translation: 逸脱～{oBoBoRoR}，从你的坟墓场放逐五张其他牌。

420398.translation: 雅睿欧斯猎犬库诺罗斯

420399.oracleText: Three sharp barks announce an attempt to escape the Underworld. Three sharp bites end it.
420399.translation: 三声尖锐犬吠表示有人想要逃离冥界。三下锐利撕咬终结妄想。

420400.oracleText: Creature cards in graveyards can't enter the battlefield.
420400.translation: 坟墓场中的生物牌不能进战场。

420401.oracleText: Players can't cast spells from graveyards.
420401.translation: 牌手不能从坟墓场施放咒语。

420403.oracleText: Some curiosities are best left alone.
420403.translation: 有些好奇心最好别去满足。

420404.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent. Scry 1.
420404.translation: 每当你施放每个对手回合中你的第一个咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。占卜1。

420409.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to Polukranos while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove that many +1/+1 counters from it.
420409.translation: 如果波禄卡诺斯于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从其上移去等量的+1/+1指示物。

420410.translation: {o1oBoG}：波禄卡诺斯与另一个目标生物互斗。

420411.oracleText: Escape—{o4oBoG}, Exile six other cards from your graveyard.
420411.translation: 逸脱～{o4oBoG}，从你的坟墓场放逐六张其他牌。

420413.oracleText: A hero dies, and a legend arises.

420414.oracleText: Return target Aura card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
420414.translation: 将目标灵气牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

420415.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. 
• Return target Aura card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
420415.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。 
•将目标灵气牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

420416.translation: 皮勒阿斯号船长西俄娜

420419.oracleText: Whenever an Aura you control becomes attached to a creature you control, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
420419.translation: 每当一个由你操控的灵气新贴附在由你操控的生物上时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

420421.oracleText: "Mogis is pleased by this offering. Bring him more!"
420421.translation: 「墨癸斯很喜欢这件供品。继续奉上！」

420422.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
420422.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

420424.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another creature or an enchantment: CARDNAME gains first strike until end of turn.
420424.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个生物或一个结界：CARDNAME获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

420427.oracleText:
"Only cowards flee from the truth."
—Perisophia the philosopher
420427.translation:
「只有懦夫才逃避真相。」
～哲人珀里索菲娅

420428.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
420428.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有系命异能与「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。」

420432.oracleText: Escape—{oGoGoUoU}, Exile five other cards from your graveyard.
420432.translation: 逸脱～{oGoGoUoU}，从你的坟墓场放逐五张其他牌。

420434.oracleText: "Strength, skill, rage—all have their limits, but patience can be infinite."
420434.translation: 「力量、技艺、愤怒～这些都有限，而耐心无限。」

420435.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack unless you control another creature with power 4 or greater.
420435.translation: 除非你操控另一个力量等于或大于4的生物，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击。

420438.oracleText: Your devotion to each color and each combination of colors is increased by one.
420438.translation: 你每种颜色和每种颜色组合的献力都加一。

420439.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. If you control a God, a Demigod, or a legendary enchantment, you gain 1 life.
420439.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。如果你操控神、半神或传奇结界，则你获得1点生命。

420441.oracleText: Every strike of the smith's hammer infuses a sword with the determination of its creator.
420441.translation: 铁匠每次敲击手中锤子，都为所铸宝剑注入一分信念。

420443.oracleText: Its strings are wayward threads of fate.
420443.translation: 这把琴以命运的任性脉络为弦。

420445.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: Tap target creature with power X or less. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as CARDNAME remains tapped.
420445.translation: {oX}，{oT}：横置目标力量等于或小于X的生物。于CARDNAME持续横置的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

420448.oracleText: Whenever a creature with deathtouch blocks or becomes blocked by this creature, destroy that creature.
420448.translation: 每当具死触异能的生物阻挡此生物或被此生物阻挡时，消灭前者。

420449.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+2 and has hexproof and "Whenever a creature with deathtouch blocks or becomes blocked by this creature, destroy that creature."
420449.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+2且具有辟邪异能与「每当具死触异能的生物阻挡此生物或被此生物阻挡时，消灭前者。」

420452.oracleText: {oT}: Choose a color. Add an amount of mana of that color equal to your devotion to that color.
420452.translation: {oT}：选择一种颜色。加若干该色法术力，其数量等同于你的该色献力。

420454.oracleText: A weapon of darkness for a warrior of light.
420454.translation: 光明斗士手中的黑暗武器。

420455.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has trample and lifelink.
420455.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有践踏与系命异能。

420456.oracleText: {o1}: Permanents your opponents control lose hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
420456.translation: {o1}：由对手操控的永久物失去辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

420459.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile each opponent's graveyard.
420459.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：放逐每位对手的坟墓场。

420463.oracleText: Meletian mages can't claim the title of thaumaturge until they have received a gift or omen from the gods. Ephara likes to give tangible tokens of her favor.
420463.translation: 只有在获得神明赋力或预示之后，迈勒提斯的法师才能真正成为奇术师。厄芳拉的赋礼就比较具体。

420466.oracleText: In times of conflict, the philosophers of Meletis trade their podiums for conveyances of war.
420466.translation: 战争期间，迈勒提斯的哲人将讲坛换成作战载具。

420467.oracleText: A vision of home, and a glimpse of hope.

420469.oracleText: Dalakos's invention worked . . . until it didn't.
420469.translation: 达拉科斯的发明很有用…直到它不能用为止。

420470.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Equipped creature can't be blocked this turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
420470.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：佩带此武具的生物本回合不能被阻挡。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

420473.oracleText: For centuries, the minotaur polis of Skophos was unknown to humans. It remains unexplored.
420473.translation: 数百年来，人类完全不知道牛头怪城邦斯科福司的存在。直到现今仍未曾有人到过此地。

420474.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Remove target attacking or blocking creature from combat.
420474.translation: {o4}，{oT}：将目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物移出战斗。

420475.oracleText:
"Callaphe gazed on the coastline,
 certain her destiny called her
here, where the mist-shrouded rocks sang,
 promising glories undreamed of."
—The Callapheia
420475.translation:
「卡莱斐伫立于高处，出神凝望静谧湾岸，
她遵命运之声召唤，来到这片神秘海域。
眼见峭壁迷雾缭绕，耳闻山岩曼语轻歌，
种种异象许下承诺：自己命定非凡荣誉。」
～《卡莱斐纪》

420477.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
420477.translation: 在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

420479.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control gain flying and get +X/+X, where X is your devotion to white.
420479.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得飞行异能且得+X/+X，X为你的白色献力。

420481.oracleText:
"Agios was felled by a minotaur's blade, but I swear I have seen him since—in the midst of battle, wherever help is needed most."
—Phrokos, soldier of Akros
420481.translation:
「虽然阿伊奥斯死在牛头怪刀下，但我发誓在那之后还见过他的身影～在战况最激烈、同袍最需要帮助的时刻。」
～阿喀洛斯士兵佛罗科斯

420482.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
420482.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

420484.oracleText: "For her, I would gladly die again."

420488.oracleText:
"Even in her absence, the light Elspeth
kindled in our hearts never faltered."
420488.translation:
「就算艾紫培已不在，她所激发的
内心明光也从未消逝。」

420490.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 as long as you control an Elspeth planeswalker.
420490.translation: 只要你操控艾紫培鹏洛客，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

420494.oracleText: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
420494.translation: 将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

420495.oracleText: Gain control of all creatures target opponent controls.
420495.translation: 获得由目标对手操控之所有生物的操控权。

420498.oracleText: Ashiok's minions plumb the depths of the ocean and the psyche.
420498.translation: 安梭苛的手下既能畅游深洋，也能究索心灵。

420499.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +3/+0 as long as there are ten or more cards in a single graveyard.
420499.translation: 只要某个坟墓场中有十张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+3/+0。

420501.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked as long as you control an Ashiok planeswalker.
420501.translation: 只要你操控安梭苛鹏洛客，CARDNAME便不能被阻挡。

420504.oracleText: Harpies are among the most detested creatures in all of Theros . . . and they thoroughly deserve it.
420504.translation: 要说塞洛斯全境都遭人痛恨的生物，自非哈痞莫属…而它们当之无愧。

420511.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a coin counter on another target creature.
420511.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在另一个目标生物上放置一个钱币指示物。

420512.oracleText: Whenever a creature with a coin counter on it dies or is put into exile, return that card to the battlefield under your control.
420512.translation: 每当一个其上有钱币指示物的生物死去或进入放逐区时，将该牌在你的操控下移回战场。

420514.oracleText: Mirinthes thought death was seconds away when the giant's fist closed around him. Two days later, he was praying for death's release.
420514.translation: 当弥林忒斯被巨人一手抓住时，他以为自己死期已到。两天之后，他还在祈祷死期快到。

420515.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked by a creature, exile that creature until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
420515.translation: 每当CARDNAME被生物阻挡时，放逐该生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

420518.oracleText: Her paean is the clash of spears, her prayer a battle cry.
420518.translation: 矛枪铿锵，正是圣歌旋律；战吼震天，正是祈念祷文。

420519.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
420519.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

420521.oracleText: Riddles draw you in, paradoxes hold you fast, and answers shatter your perceptions.
420521.translation: 谜题引你深入，悖论令你驻足，答案毁你认知。

420525.oracleText:
"Gleams like moonlight on water drew us through the storm and toward our doom."
—Siona, captain of the Pyleas
420525.translation:
「海面泛着粼粼波光，好似朗月当空，引我们穿过风暴、驶向灭亡。」
～皮勒阿斯号船长西俄娜

420526.oracleText: Krakens, Leviathans, Octopuses, and Serpents you control can't be blocked except by Krakens, Leviathans, Octopuses, and Serpents.
420526.translation: 由你操控的巨海兽、海怪、章鱼与巨蛇只能被巨海兽、海怪、章鱼与巨蛇阻挡。

420528.oracleText: Hatred is a potent ally, but an insatiable master.
420528.translation: 仇恨虽能为你达成目标提供助力，但也会令你屈从其间无法自拔。

420531.oracleText: Deathless soldiers called phylaskia guard the borders of the Underworld.
420531.translation: 这些不死哨兵唤作「冥卫」，随时把守冥界边境防止有人逃离。

420532.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile target creature card from your graveyard.
420532.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。

420534.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put all cards exiled with it onto the battlefield.
420534.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将所有以它放逐的牌放进战场。

420537.oracleText: Deathbellow Canyon echoes with the roars of minotaurs calling each other to battle.
420537.translation: 牛头怪群的备战咆哮此起彼伏，回荡整个亡啸山谷。

420540.oracleText: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.
420540.translation: 普罗烽斯的锻炉座落在维鲁斯山脉核心之中，其熊熊烈焰吸引四方巨龙探访。

420544.oracleText:
"Put down your bows, you fools! Arrows only make it angry!"
—Callia, Hyrax Tower scout
420544.translation:
「把弓放下，你们这些蠢货！箭矢只会激怒它！」
～许拉兹塔斥候卡莱娅

420545.oracleText: If a creature would deal combat damage to CARDNAME, prevent that damage and put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
420545.translation: 如果某生物将对CARDNAME造成战斗伤害，则防止该伤害且在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

420548.oracleText: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.
420548.translation: 往昔智慧全都刻进了祖兽骨头里。

420550.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, draw three cards.

420552.oracleText: Target a creature or enchantment you control.
420552.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物或结界为目标。

420553.oracleText: Search for a basic Plains card.

420556.oracleText: Put target enchantment card from your graveyard on top of your library?
420556.translation: 是否要将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶？

420557.oracleText: Target a creature or enchantment spell.
420557.translation: 指定一个生物或结界咒语为目标。

420558.oracleText: Target up to three creatures and/or enchantments.
420558.translation: 指定至多三个生物和／或结界为目标。

420559.oracleText: Target up to one other enchantment you control.
420559.translation: 指定至多另一个由你操控的结界为目标。

420560.oracleText: Tap or untap target nonland permanent?
420560.translation: 横置还是重置目标非地永久物？

420561.oracleText: Put up to two of them into your hand.
420561.translation: 将其中至多两张置于你手上。

420562.oracleText: Put up to one of them into your library.
420562.translation: 将其中至多一张置入你的牌库。

420563.translation: 是否要放逐一张结界牌？

420564.oracleText: Exile a creature or enchantment card?
420564.translation: 是否要放逐一张生物或结界牌？

420565.translation: 是否要牺牲一个非地永久物？

420567.oracleText: Put a red creature card or an artifact creature card onto the battlefield?
420567.translation: 是否要将一张红色生物牌或神器生物牌放进战场？

420568.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
420568.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

420569.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or an enchantment.
420569.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或一个结界。
