434345.oracleText: Not all storms come from the sky.
434345.translation: 并非所有的风暴都来自天空。

434346.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
434346.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

434352.oracleText: Whenever Muxus attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each other Goblin you control.
434352.translation: 每当穆克斯攻击时，你每操控一个其他鬼怪，它便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

434356.oracleText: {o2o(B/R)}: Minotaurs you control get +1/+0 and gain menace and haste until end of turn.
434356.translation: {o2o(B/R)}：直到回合结束，由你操控的牛头怪得+1/+0且获得威慑与敏捷异能。

434358.oracleText: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.
434358.translation: 魔鬼自认化白鸽为战火是项绝妙讽刺。但镇民就不太吃这套。

434360.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
434360.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

434364.oracleText: Whenever one or more Devils you control attack one or more players, you and those players each draw a card, then discard a card at random.
434364.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个魔鬼攻击一位或更多牌手时，你和这些牌手各抓一张牌，然后各随机弃一张牌。

434367.oracleText: Green spells you control can't be countered.
434367.translation: 由你操控的绿色咒语不能被反击。

434368.oracleText: {o4oGoG}: Until end of turn, each Elf creature you control has base power and toughness 5/5 and becomes a Dinosaur in addition to its other creature types.
434368.translation: {o4oGoG}：直到回合结束，每个由你操控的妖精生物成为基础力量与防御力为5/5的恐龙，且额外具有其他原本生物类别。

434370.oracleText:
"Is it the water? The stars? Whatever it is, something incredible is happening here."
—Eris, zoologist, journal entry
434370.translation:
「是水？是星空？不论是什么，这里正发生着不可思议的事。」
～动物学家艾瑞丝，日记摘录

434371.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on that creature instead.
434371.translation: 如果将会在某个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量两倍的+1/+1指示物。

434373.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control fight or become blocked, draw a card.
434373.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物互斗或被阻挡时，抓一张牌。

434374.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {o2o(R/G)}. If you do, double target creature's power until end of turn. That creature must be blocked this combat if able.
434374.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{o2o(R/G)}。若你如此作，则将目标生物的力量加倍直到回合结束。该生物本次战斗若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

434379.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature with defender: All creatures gain trample until end of turn.
434379.translation: 牺牲一个具守军异能的生物：所有生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

434381.oracleText:
"That's the third time this month it's exploded on site. Maybe we should switch to something a little less defective."
—Kerrin, archaeologist
434381.translation:
「这已经是本月第三次在现场爆炸了。或许我们该换个没那么多瑕疵的东西。」
～考古学家柯琳

434382.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to any target.
434382.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意目标造成3点伤害。

434385.oracleText: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.
434385.translation: 无数世代过去，石头磨损，显露出高山核心处的丰富颜色。

434389.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR} or one mana of the chosen color.
434389.translation: {oT}：加{oR}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434391.oracleText: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.
434391.translation: 人类视界之外还有一片隐蔽乐土，此处鸟语花香，绿意盎然。

434395.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} or one mana of the chosen color.
434395.translation: {oT}：加{oG}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434397.oracleText: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.
434397.translation: 驱使这片野花绽放的，并非季节更替，而是魔力起伏。

434401.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW} or one mana of the chosen color.
434401.translation: {oT}：加{oW}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434403.oracleText: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.
434403.translation: 于精妙微观世界中，尽览自然伟大奇迹。

434407.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU} or one mana of the chosen color.
434407.translation: {oT}：加{oU}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434409.oracleText: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.
434409.translation: 此地美景尽藏奇异之处，唯眼光独到者方能得见。

434413.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oB} or one mana of the chosen color.
434413.translation: {oT}：加{oB}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434415.oracleText: The best techniques outlive their creators.

434416.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures attack, you may have target attacking creature gain double strike until end of turn.
434416.translation: 每当一个或数个生物攻击时，你可以使目标进行攻击的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

434417.oracleText: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the guard. The kami are coming."
434417.translation: 勇丸闻闻气味，喉间发出低吼。武野将军低头瞧着勇丸，轻抚其身以令其冷静。「叫部队留意。神明来了。」

434419.oracleText: The view is truly spectacular—as long as you don't look at Rishada itself.
434419.translation: 景色真的十分壮观～只要你不看李夏达。

434420.oracleText:
"The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands."
—Janus, speaker of the synod
434420.translation:
「知识之池知晓世界。蒙纳坷了解世界。」
～悉诺议长杰努斯

434421.oracleText:
"Well, this can't be a good sign." 
—Old Rutstein
434421.translation:
「嗯，这可不是个好兆头。」
～老鲁斯登

434422.oracleText: Takedowns in Valor's Reach are never meant to be lethal, but that doesn't mean they won't be incredibly painful.
434422.translation: 在英勇巅较量中，击倒对手时都不会狠下杀招，但这不意味着会手下留情。

434423.translation:
「你最好别让我白费劲。」
～莉莲娜维斯

434430.oracleText: Some Akroans make the dangerous pilgrimage to the volcanic temples of Purphoros, where oracles known as flamespeakers glean omens from lava.
434430.translation: 普罗烽斯火山殿堂内的焰语者先知善从熔岩中预知先兆，因此不少阿喀洛斯人甘冒危险前往朝圣。

434432.oracleText: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"
434432.translation: 「时机就在眼前。眼前只有荣誉。为了胜利与家人～前进！」

434434.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
434434.translation: {oG}，{oT}：加X点法术力，其颜色组合可任意选择，X为由你操控的生物中力量最大者的数值。

434435.oracleText: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.
434435.translation: 它以粗枝阔叶承载赞迪卡久战荒野的复苏希望。

434438.oracleText: Creature spells you cast of the chosen type cost {o1} less to cast.
434438.translation: 你施放之具该类别生物咒语减少{o1}来施放。

434439.oracleText:
"Yawgmoth is dead, and his citadels lie empty. But there will always be some who seek power at any price."
—Karn
434439.translation:
「约格莫夫已死，其城塞空空如也。但总有人会不惜一切代价去追求力量。」
～卡恩

434440.oracleText: Discard three cards with different names.
434440.translation: 弃三张名称各不相同的牌。

434441.oracleText: Cast target instant, sorcery, or artifact card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
434441.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间、法术或神器牌？

434442.oracleText: Target an instant, sorcery, or artifact card.
434442.translation: 指定一张瞬间、法术或神器牌为目标。

434443.oracleText: Have target attacking creature gain double strike until end of turn?
434443.translation: 是否要使目标进行攻击的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束？

434444.oracleText: Search for a card named Festering Newt or Bubbling Cauldron.
434444.translation: 搜寻一张名称为腐臭水蝾或冒泡鼎镬的牌。

435145.oracleText: Search for a card named Whisper Squad.
435145.translation: 搜寻一张名称为幽语小队的牌。

435146.oracleText: Put a menace counter on a creature you control.
435146.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个威慑指示物。

435147.oracleText: Put a deathtouch counter on a creature you control.
435147.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个死触指示物。

435148.oracleText: Put two loyalty counters on a planeswalker you control.
435148.translation: 在一个由你操控的鹏洛客上放置两个忠诚指示物。

436112.oracleText: Put a phylactery counter on an artifact you control.
436112.translation: 在一个由你操控的神器上放置一个避邪符指示物。

436917.oracleText: Select whether to mutate this card under or over the targeted creature. They mutate into the creature on top plus all abilities from under it.
436917.translation: 选择将此牌合变到目标生物的顶上还是底下。它们合变作顶上的生物，外加具有底下所有异能。

436922.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, proliferate.
436922.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，增殖。

436924.oracleText: A common foe is the death of old hatreds.
436924.translation: 共同敌人为世代怨仇划上句点。

436925.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
436925.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

436928.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you and that player each gain that much life.
436928.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你和该牌手各获得等量的生命。

436929.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, each player CARDNAME attacked this turn loses the game.
436929.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多15点，则CARDNAME本回合中攻击过的每位牌手各输掉这盘游戏。

436935.oracleText:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane
436935.translation:
「虽然这条远古时期订立的假定难经推敲，但不妨碍统领依此执行正义。」
～妮莎瑞文

436938.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of creatures in your party.
436938.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你冒险团中的生物数量。

436939.oracleText: Archpriest of Iona's power is equal to the number of creatures in your party.
436939.translation: 艾欧娜大祭司的力量等同于你冒险团中的生物数量。

436940.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you have a full party, target creature gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
436940.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你的冒险团满编，则直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

436942.oracleText: "My cats have taught me more about the sacred than anything in some old ruin."
436942.translation: 「我身旁这些猫教会我有关圣物的事情，比某些古老遗迹还要多。」

436943.oracleText: Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.
436943.translation: 每当你每回合首度获得生命时，派出一个1/1白色的猫衍生生物。

436944.oracleText: {o2oW}: Another target Cleric gains lifelink until end of turn.
436944.translation: {o2oW}：另一个目标僧侣获得系命异能直到回合结束。

436946.oracleText:
"Move, you wretched thing! You're scaring the hurdas!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad
436946.translation:
「快走，你这怪东西！荷得都被你吓到了！」
～哥马法达游牧人布斯陶

436950.oracleText: "I swing a sword. It's a simple life. A lot of adventurers just see me as some cheap muscle, but if my steel lets them return home with their lives and limbs intact, then I've done my job."
436950.translation: 「我用得一手好剑。生活就是这么简单。虽然许多冒险者只把我当成廉价打手，但只要我手中武器能够保证他们四肢健全平安归家，那我也算完成任务了。」

436952.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, those creatures get +2/+1 until end of turn instead.
436952.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为这些生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

436953.oracleText: "From legend it was forged, and to legend it returns."

436955.oracleText: "The gifts of the past must find their way into deserving hands."
436955.translation: 「历史的赠礼，必须平安送抵应授之人手中。」

436959.oracleText:
"Iona no longer guards this place. We do."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd
436959.translation:
「艾欧娜虽不再庇佑此地。但我们仍继续守护。」
～伊美黎牧者卡丝拉

436960.oracleText: Create two 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature tokens with flying. Non-Angel creatures you control gain indestructible until your next turn.
436960.translation: 派出两个4/4白色，具飞行异能的天使／战士衍生生物。由你操控的非天使生物获得不灭异能直到你的下一个回合。

436963.oracleText:
"You called it the castle of a god. It is less than that, and so much more."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd
436963.translation:
「你们将这称作神佑之城。神明已逝，天威犹存。」
～伊美黎牧者卡丝拉

436969.oracleText: In any adventuring party, the cleric is the heart: healing wounds, inspiring courage, and raising morale.
436969.translation: 无论哪支冒险团队，牧师都是队中核心：他们能够治疗伤口、激励斗志、鼓舞士气。

436970.oracleText: CARDNAME has lifelink as long as you control another Cleric.
436970.translation: 只要你操控另一个僧侣，CARDNAME便具有系命异能。

436973.oracleText: "I've walked every one of the Teetering Peaks and never set a foot wrong. I can get you to safety."
436973.translation: 「我曾遍足晃摇山峰每座山头，一步都未曾走错。我能带你平安下山。」

436977.oracleText: Griffins nest in precarious places, so fledglings often find themselves taking their first flights at surprising moments.
436977.translation: 狮鹫通常会在危险的地方筑巢，因此雏鹫的首次飞行往往发生在不经意之间。

436981.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token.
436981.translation: 派出一个2/2白色的猫／野兽衍生生物。

436982.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token.
436982.translation: 派出一个2/2白色的猫／野兽衍生生物。

436983.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.
436983.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。这些生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

436984.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.
436984.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。这些生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

436987.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature in your party.
436987.translation: 你冒险团中每有一个生物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

436990.oracleText: Ondu moas make wildly uncomfortable mounts, but for determined warriors, their speed is enough to make up for it.
436990.translation: 虽然昂度恐鸟骑乘起来非常难受，但在专职战士眼中，它们的速度足以弥补这缺点。

436994.oracleText:
"Down below's where things go to die."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
436994.translation:
「掉下去就是死路一条。」
～裂船湾的奎嘎

436995.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker.
436995.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

436996.oracleText: Kabira Takedown deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker.
436996.translation: 卡彼拉猎捕对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

436998.oracleText:
"Wise adventurers—and clever beasties—stick to the higher ground."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
436998.translation:
「只要是聪明的冒险者～还有机智的野兽～都会乖乖留在高地。」
～裂船湾的奎嘎

437002.oracleText: Too flashy to ignore. Too fast to catch.
437002.translation: 炫得明目张胆。快得追赶不上。

437006.oracleText: Every kor blade is imbued with the skill of a thousand generations.
437006.translation: 每把寇族刀剑都有千代先民技艺承载其中。

437007.oracleText: Equipped Warriors you control have double strike.
437007.translation: 由你操控且佩带武具的战士具有连击异能。

437009.oracleText: "The landbind ritual connects us to our sacred sites. More importantly, it binds us with every other kor who has visited here, through countless generations."
437009.translation: 「结地祭礼将我们与吾族圣地紧密相连。更重要的是，这仪式还能让我们跨越无数世代，与所有到过此地的寇族相连。」

437012.translation: 「我们声势浩大，我们彰显正义。」

437016.oracleText: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"
437016.translation: 「集结于我的明光之下，团结起来我们必能驱散这波暗流！」

437017.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
437017.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437019.oracleText:
"May bloodflies empty your veins and turn you into a dried leather sack, cow!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad
437019.translation:
「愿无数血蝇吸干你的每滴鲜血，将你化作一副干皮囊，臭牛！」
～哥马法达游牧人布斯陶

437022.oracleText:
"They say the wind carved out these canyon walls. But the floor was hammered flat by hooves."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
437022.translation:
「他们说峡谷山壁是被风吹成这样；但这地面可是给蹄子踏平的。」
～裂船湾的奎嘎

437024.oracleText:
"The ground is rumbling. Better hope it's just the Roil!"
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
437024.translation:
「地在晃。希望就只是狂搅！」
～裂船湾的奎嘎

437029.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has flying and first strike.
437029.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有飞行与先攻异能。

437032.oracleText: Its ferocity is tempered by patience, knowing it must wait for just the right moment to strike a killing blow.
437032.translation: 它知道只有在恰当的时机出击才能夺人性命，因此便学会了用耐性来掩盖自己的野性。

437036.oracleText: "This is my world, Jace, down to its very bones."
437036.translation: 「杰斯，这是我的世界，里里外外都属于我。」

437039.oracleText:
"At first rumble you'd best hold on tight and pray to any gods you still hold dear."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
437039.translation:
「刚有响声你就得紧紧抓牢，然后求哪个神都好，让它保佑自己能一直抓稳。」
～海户探陷人尼斯达

437041.oracleText:
"It always seems so quiet in the aftermath of wrenching violence."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
437041.translation:
「剧烈动荡后，一切总是显得如此平静。」
～海户探陷人尼斯达

437045.oracleText: "If we fight as one, nothing can stand in our way!"
437045.translation: 「只要我们齐心作战，就没人能挡我们的路！」

437046.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME and at least one other Warrior attack, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
437046.translation: 每当CARDNAME与至少另一个战士攻击时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437049.oracleText: Each individual has their own crucial role to play.
437049.translation: 每个人都是团队不可或缺的一份子。

437050.oracleText: Choose target attacking or blocking creature. CARDNAME deals damage to that creature equal to twice the number of creatures in your party.
437050.translation: 选择目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物。CARDNAME对该生物造成伤害，其数量等同于你冒险团中生物数量的两倍。

437051.oracleText: Choose target attacking or blocking creature. Practiced Tactics deals damage to that creature equal to twice the number of creatures in your party.
437051.translation: 选择目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物。熟练战法对该生物造成伤害，其数量等同于你冒险团中生物数量的两倍。

437052.oracleText: Poke a drake in the right place and it becomes as docile as a pet. Poke it in the wrong place and goodbye, hand.
437052.translation: 点对了地方，龙兽也能像宠物般乖巧。点错了地方，就坦然跟自己的手道别。

437054.oracleText: On occasion, felidars leave meaty "gifts" outside the tents of explorers they consider worthy.
437054.translation: 有时候，晶角兽会在它们认为够格的探险家帐篷外留下丰盛「肉礼」。

437057.oracleText:
"If you practice something often enough, it becomes part of you. That's why we train, and that's why we survive."
—Tasha, Graypelt veteran
437057.translation:
「如果你认准一件事情不断练习，久了它就会成为你本能反应的一部分。这就是我们不断训练的原因，这就是我们能存活下来的缘由。」
～灰皮老兵塔莎

437058.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's a Warrior, you may attach an Equipment you control to it.
437058.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果它是战士，则你可以将一个由你操控的武具贴附于其上。

437060.oracleText: The Sea Gate Expeditionary House was founded after the discovery of the Skyclave over Tazeem. Now its banners fly over every corner of Zendikar.
437060.translation: 人们在塔晋上空发现空境之后，便成立了海户探险队。如今，这支队伍的旗帜已遍布赞迪卡每个角落。

437062.oracleText:
"It blocks the windswept salt and frigid air, but the loneliness of Sejiri remains."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437062.translation:
「虽然这能帮你挡住风中盐碱和冰冷空气，但无法帮你缓解独处塞基黎的那份孤独。」
～海户探险队的恩沃

437064.oracleText:
"This place offers nothing and takes everything."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437064.translation:
「此处寸草不生，侵蚀万物。」
～海户探险队的恩沃

437067.translation: 「休息吧，朋友们。我会保护你们。」

437076.oracleText:
"Well, she can jump farther than I can."
—Aelah, expedition cleric
437076.translation:
「嗯，她跳得比我远。」
～探险队牧师艾乐

437079.oracleText:
"As points of no return go, it is quite epic."
—Aelah, expedition cleric
437079.translation:
「就无路可退的绝境而言，此处景观颇为壮丽。」
～探险队牧师艾乐

437084.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you have a full party, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
437084.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你的冒险团满编，则直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

437085.oracleText:
"Darkness always flees from the light, and I am the breaking dawn."
—Kordain, luminarch of Kabira
437085.translation:
「明光所及之处，黑暗必将逃散，而我正是破晓清辉。」
～卡彼拉辉侯柯尔丹

437087.oracleText:
"It's good to see the eagles circling the Lighthouse once again."
—Tazri
437087.translation:
「很高兴看到灯塔上空再有老鹰盘旋。」
～塔兹莉

437091.oracleText: {o(2/U)o(2/B)o(2/R)o(2/G)}: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal up to two Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard, and/or Ally cards from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
437091.translation: {o(2/U)o(2/B)o(2/R)o(2/G)}：检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的至多两张僧侣、浪客、战士、法术师和／或伙伴牌，并将它们置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

437094.oracleText: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell unless its controller pays {o2}. If an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, instead counter that spell, then scry 2.
437094.translation: 除非目标生物或鹏洛客咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。如果任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，则改为反击该咒语，然后占卜2。

437096.oracleText:
"All you minnows in the murk, come to my light."
—Jejenar, Silundi lullmage
437096.translation:
「浓雾中的小鱼，快来聚于这亮光周围。」
～希隆迪息法师杰耶纳

437098.oracleText:
"Stay close to my light. You don't want to get lost on the rocks."
—Jejenar, Silundi lullmage
437098.translation:
「跟紧这道亮光。莫在乱岩中迷路。」
～希隆迪息法师杰耶纳

437105.oracleText: "Perhaps you can't see the path, but that doesn't mean it isn't there."
437105.translation: 「也许你没看到路，但这不代表眼前没有路。」

437110.oracleText: Zendikar's seas are deeper than anyone can fathom.
437110.translation: 赞迪卡的海洋深到无人能勘测。

437112.oracleText: {o3}: Charix gets +X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Islands you control.
437112.translation: {o3}：凯立茨得+X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的海岛数量。

437114.oracleText:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder
437114.translation:
「叫你往前冲，活该。」
～海户探陷人卡理耶

437116.oracleText: "Before my people turned to false gods, we built a glittering city beneath the northern sea ice. The magic of ancient Benthidrix lives in me!"
437116.translation: 「早在族人转而信奉伪神之前，我们就已在北洋冰面下造就一座金光之城。远古深洋殿的魔力与我同存！」

437119.oracleText: "You mess with one of us, you mess with all of us!"
437119.translation: 「惹到其中一个，便是惹到所有人！」

437120.oracleText: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o1} plus an additional {o1} for each creature in your party.
437120.translation: 除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o1}，并为你冒险团中的每个生物各支付{o1}，否则反击之。

437125.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, draw a card, then discard a card.
437125.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

437129.oracleText: "Come on, Skitch, we'll lose them in the geyserfield."
437129.translation: 「快点，阿蜥，到了热泉原就能甩掉他们了。」

437133.oracleText: "I can't see all that the future holds, but I can keep us one step ahead of death."
437133.translation: 「我虽不能看透未来的一切，但能让我们避开死亡一步。」

437135.oracleText: Wizards' spells twist the fabric of reality to channel elemental energies, peer into the future, and even calm the Roil.
437135.translation: 法师咒语能够扭曲现实束缕，从而通联元素能量、窥见未来世界，甚或平息暴怒狂搅。

437136.oracleText: As long as you control another Wizard, CARDNAME has "When this creature dies, draw a card."
437136.translation: 只要你操控另一个法术师，CARDNAME便具有「当此生物死去时，抓一张牌。」

437139.oracleText: "In the field, speed-reading is a survival skill."
437139.translation: 「到了实地，读得快才能保住命。」

437140.oracleText: Draw two cards. If this spell was kicked, draw three cards instead.
437140.translation: 抓两张牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为抓三张牌。

437142.oracleText: Tap target creature. Its controller mills two cards. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
437142.translation: 横置目标生物。其操控者磨两张牌。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

437145.oracleText:
"When I touched the Glasspool, I tasted infinite possibility."
—Ashen Wal, Akoum Expeditionary House
437145.translation:
「我手刚触碰璃池水面，便尝到了无尽可能。」
～阿库姆探险队的爱森瓦

437149.oracleText:
"Past and possibility come together in the vastness of infinite reflection."
—Ashen Wal, Akoum Expeditionary House
437149.translation:
「在广阔湖面倒影中，过往视像与未来愿景融为一体。」
～阿库姆探险队的爱森瓦

437155.oracleText: Target player creates an X/X blue Illusion creature token, where X is the number of cards in their hand.
437155.translation: 目标牌手派出一个X/X蓝色虚影衍生生物，X为其手牌数量。

437156.oracleText:
Choose one. If this spell was kicked, choose any number instead. 
• Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands. 
• Scry 2, then draw two cards. 
• Target player creates an X/X blue Illusion creature token, where X is the number of cards in their hand.
437156.translation:
选择一项。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为选择任意数量的选项。 
•将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。 
•占卜2，然后抓两张牌。 
•目标牌手派出一个X/X蓝色虚影衍生生物，X为其手牌数量。

437157.oracleText: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.
437157.translation: 理论上，奥札奇灭亡应能平息狂搅。实际上没有。

437165.oracleText:
"You worry too much."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
437165.translation:
「你担心得太多了。」
～海户探陷人尼斯达

437167.oracleText:
"The Ondu Skyclave was a center for rebellion against the capital in Makindi. Of course they built in deadly traps."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder
437167.translation:
「当初马钦迪境内爆发针对都城的反抗斗争时，昂度空境便是争夺焦点。其中当然布有各式致命陷阱。」
～海户探陷人尼斯达

437170.oracleText:
"If you don't like the weather, just wait a few minutes and it'll change . . . probably for the worse."
—Amandi, kitesail expert
437170.translation:
「你要是不喜欢这天气，只需等几分钟它就会变天…但多半是越变越差。」
～航筝专家阿曼迪

437172.oracleText: "One spell to quiet the Roil, one to quash the will. The principle is the same."
437172.translation: 「一个咒语平息狂搅，另外一个击碎意志。两者原理相通。」

437173.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a creature whose controller has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
437173.translation: 如果为此咒语目标的生物之操控者坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

437175.oracleText: Jace traced Nahiri to the Singing City, but the magic of the ancient ruins threatened to overwhelm his mind.
437175.translation: 杰斯一路跟随娜希丽来到魅歌城，但这处远古遗迹的魔法却试图压垮他的心智。

437176.oracleText: Each opponent mills eight cards. If this spell was kicked, instead each opponent mills half their library, rounded up.
437176.translation: 每位对手各磨八张牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为每位对手各磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后进位。

437179.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, you may have CARDNAME's base power and toughness become 4/1 or 1/4 until end of turn.
437179.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，你可以使CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力成为4/1或1/4直到回合结束。

437182.oracleText: "For generations, we have bred and trained falcons for expeditions into Emeria. Now more sky ruins open themselves to those with the means to reach the heights!"
437182.translation: 「数个世代之前，我们为了深入伊美黎探险，便早已开始繁育和训练猎隼。如今随着更多天空遗迹现身世间，唯有自由翱翔天空的族群才能在其间自由穿行。」

437183.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, scry 2.
437183.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，占卜2。

437185.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player mills a card.
437185.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手磨一张牌。

437189.oracleText: "The ancient kor were a clever bunch with a taste for nasty traps. Spikes, poison, fire pouring forth with no warning . . . I've seen and disabled them all. If you intend to raid a Skyclave, you'd be wise to hire me on."
437189.translation: 「古代寇族头脑机敏，偏好摆弄凶险陷阱。出钉子的、涂剧毒的、突然喷火的…这些都被我一一看穿并全数解除。如果你想要去空境探险，带上我才是明智之举。」

437191.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked if you had another Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
437191.translation: 如果本回合中有另一个僧侣，浪客，战士或法术师在你的操控下进战场，则CARDNAME不能被阻挡。

437194.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you have a full party, creatures you control gain "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card" until end of turn.
437194.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你的冒险团满编，则由你操控的生物获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌」直到回合结束。

437196.oracleText:
"Most days the sea is my friend. But only most days."
—Jori En, expedition leader
437196.translation:
「大多数日子里，大海都是我的朋友。但也只有大多数日子里是这样。」
～探险队长裘黎恩

437197.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, CARDNAME has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
437197.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

437202.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
437202.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，派出一个2/2蓝色，具飞行异能的龙兽衍生生物。

437204.oracleText: To an explorer, a priceless treasure. To the crab, a rock to call home.
437204.translation: 在探险家眼中，这是无价之宝。在螃蟹眼中，这不过是块可以当家的石头。

437207.oracleText:
"We have much to remember . . . and much we can never forget."
—Tazri
437207.translation:
「我们有太多需要记住的…也有太多不能忘记的。」
～塔兹莉

437208.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand plus one. You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
437208.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于你的手牌数量加一。在本盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌数量没有上限。

437210.oracleText:
"We carry on the legacy of those who defended our world by continuing to unearth its secrets."
—Tazri
437210.translation:
「我们继承守卫世界先人的衣钵，继续发掘其中秘密。」
～塔兹莉

437218.oracleText: {o4oU}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each creature in your party.
437218.translation: {o4oU}：CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。你冒险团中每有一个生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

437221.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +0/+3 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature also gains hexproof until end of turn.
437221.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+0/+3直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则该生物再获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

437223.oracleText:
"Feel the current? Rough waters lie ahead."
—Jori En, expedition leader
437223.translation:
「感受到这水流了吗？前面会十分湍急。」
～探险队长裘黎恩

437224.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an instant or sorcery card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
437224.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张瞬间或法术牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

437226.oracleText:
"From the hedron fields of Agadeem to the Faduun of Jwar Isle, the islands of the Silundi Sea offer one mystery after another."
—Jori En, expedition leader
437226.translation:
「从艾格丁的晶石原野，到爪尔岛的冯颅石像，希隆迪海上的诸岛屿有着解不完的秘密。」
～探险队长裘黎恩

437229.oracleText: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is three plus the number of creatures in your party. Put three of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
437229.translation: 检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为你冒险团中的生物数量加三。将其中三张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

437231.oracleText: An ancient sea monster dragged the Murasa Skyclave under the waves, then smaller sea monsters moved in.
437231.translation: 远古海怪一举将姆拉撒空境拖入波涛之下，体型较小的海怪随即入住。

437235.oracleText: "I've yet to discover the ruin that can keep me out."
437235.translation: 「这世上还没见过我进不去的遗迹。」

437236.oracleText: Tap another untapped Rogue you control: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
437236.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的浪客：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

437247.oracleText:
"You see a waterfall. I see a way up."
—Ko Dari, expedition wizard
437247.translation:
「你看到的是瀑布。我看到的是上行道路。」
～探险队法师蔻达黎

437248.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn.
437248.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

437251.oracleText:
"The source of the Umara River sits high above Oran-Rief, ever weeping on the jungle below."
—Ko Dari, expedition wizard
437251.translation:
「乌玛拉河的源头位于欧兰黎上空，滴落涓涓细流滋养其下丛林。」
～探险队法师蔻达黎

437255.oracleText: "It's an ideal method for exploring sky ruins. The drakes sniff me briefly but then lose interest."
437255.translation: 「这是探索天空遗迹的理想办法。虽然龙兽嗅到了我的味道，但很快就失去了兴趣。」

437256.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
437256.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

437264.oracleText:
"Now is the death-hour, just before dawn. Wake, sleepers, and haunt the living!"
—Vivias, Witch Vessel
437264.translation:
「现在正是拂晓之前的死亡时刻。觉醒吧，沉睡者，齐去侵扰生灵！」
～祟体女巫威皮斯

437267.oracleText:
"Here below the hedron fields, souls and secrets lie entombed."
—Vivias, Witch Vessel
437267.translation:
「晶石原野之下，灵魂与秘密埋藏其间。」
～祟体女巫威皮斯

437271.oracleText:
"If you ever want to get back up, do what I say."
—Exena, expedition rogue
437271.translation:
「如果你还想爬出来，就按我说的去做。」
～探险队盗贼埃席娜

437272.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +3/+0 as long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
437272.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+3/+0。

437275.oracleText:
"The Raimunza River flows along the branches of jaddi trees for miles before plunging down to feed Blackbloom Lake."
—Exena, expedition rogue
437275.translation:
「莱姆札河顺着贾迪树丛枝蔓绵延数哩，最终全数汇入黑郁湖中。」
～探险队浪客埃席娜

437279.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. If this spell was kicked, instead return two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
437279.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为将两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

437282.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. You lose 2 life.
437282.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余的牌则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。你失去2点生命。

437284.oracleText: "We are free. It is our duty to live well."
437284.translation: 「我们已得解放。因此有义务好好活下去。」

437289.oracleText: "He could handle any one of us, but he's no match for all of us!"
437289.translation: 「也许我们当中任一个都不是他的对手，但他应付不了我们所有人！」

437291.oracleText: Taborax's cultists are the latest in a long history of beings who have desired to see Zendikar torn to pieces.
437291.translation: 悠悠历史长河中，曾有无数势力希望眼见赞迪卡彻底毁灭；塔博锐教众是其中最新一支。

437303.oracleText: Its silent slithering belies its bulk.
437303.translation: 它静不可闻的滑行声响掩盖了庞巨身躯。

437307.oracleText: Rogues bring an array of useful skills to the work of an adventuring party: stealth, agility, the ability to locate and disarm traps, and a subtle, deadly fighting style.
437307.translation: 盗贼具备的独特技艺往往能让冒险团队事半功倍：他们难觅踪迹、身手敏捷，精于识破并解除陷阱，同时还可在无声之间取人性命。

437308.oracleText: CARDNAME has deathtouch as long as you control another Rogue.
437308.translation: 只要你操控另一个浪客，CARDNAME便具有死触异能。

437311.oracleText:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription
437311.translation:
「邪翼蔽日，血雨腥风，虫群必将崛起。」
～空境铭文

437317.oracleText: Death comes in many forms on Guul Draz, most of them slow, subtle, and agonizing. At least a monstrous crocodile offers a swift death.
437317.translation: 虽然在古坠兹丢掉性命的方式多种多样，但其中大多都耗时漫长、难寻缘由、痛苦无比。好歹凶猛鳄鱼还能让你死得瞑目。

437321.oracleText: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has menace.
437321.translation: 每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物均具有威慑异能。

437323.translation:
「蒂恩，转头！快转头！」
～探险队向导多罗斯

437324.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if an opponent controls no basic lands.
437324.translation: 如果任一对手未操控基本地，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

437326.oracleText:
"I think we somehow got turned around."
—Doros, expedition guide
437326.translation:
「我想我们算是转过头了。」
～探险队向导多罗斯

437330.oracleText: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.
437330.translation: 随着血侯在自由派与臣服派的战争中全数败亡，马拉奇周边的沼泽如今满是想要出人头地的年轻凶残吸血鬼。

437335.oracleText: Heedless of Nissa's warnings, Nahiri repeated history.
437335.translation: 娜希丽置妮莎警告于不顾，决心重演历史。

437337.oracleText: Enchanted land loses all land types and abilities and has "{oT}: Add {oC}" and "{oT}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color."
437337.translation: 所结附的地失去所有地类别和异能，且具有「{oT}：加{oC}」与「{oT}，支付1点生命：加任意一点颜色的法术力。」

437343.oracleText:
"Those who fail to escape Malakir become part of the city's defense."
—Doros, expedition guide
437343.translation:
「没能逃出马拉奇的人最终都为城防部队中的一员。」
～探险队向导多罗斯

437344.oracleText: Choose target creature. You lose 2 life. Until end of turn, that creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control."
437344.translation: 选择目标生物。你失去2点生命。直到回合结束，该生物获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。」

437346.oracleText:
"Getting into Malakir isn't difficult. It's getting out that's the hard part."
—Doros, expedition guide
437346.translation:
「马拉奇进去不难。要出来才麻烦。」
～探险队向导多罗斯

437350.oracleText: "The vampires never had gods. We followed our bloodchiefs. Now they are gone. What is left? Destruction and death, my friends. That is enough."
437350.translation: 「吸血鬼一族从未信奉过神明。我们唯血侯为尊。如今他们也一去不返。你要说还剩下什么？朋友，只要毁灭和死亡还在，这就足够了。」

437353.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0. It gets +3/+1 instead as long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
437353.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0。只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，便改为它得+3/+1。

437356.oracleText: "The meal was exquisite. The conversation, less so."

437357.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards, mills a card, and loses 1 life. You gain 1 life.
437357.translation: 目标对手弃两张牌，磨一张牌，并失去1点生命。你获得1点生命。

437359.oracleText: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.
437359.translation: 在哲娜的带领下，吸血鬼在团结中发现新的力量。

437360.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to 1 plus the number of card types among cards in your opponents' graveyards.
437360.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于所有对手坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量加1。

437361.oracleText: Nighthawk Scavenger's power is equal to 1 plus the number of card types among cards in your opponents' graveyards.
437361.translation: 夜盗清理客的力量等同于所有对手坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量加1。

437363.oracleText: "When navigating dangerous terrain, one hundred legs are better than two."
437363.translation: 「在危险地带穿行时，一百条腿可比两条腿强。」

437364.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and has menace.
437364.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且具有威慑异能。

437367.oracleText: The Free City of Nimana is a great place to recruit adventurers with shady skill sets.
437367.translation: 自由城尼麻纳是招募身怀卑劣绝技冒险者的好去处。

437374.oracleText:
"Indulge the void. Become the void. Consume all you touch."
—Drana, the last bloodchief
437374.translation:
「纵溺虚空。成为虚空。吞噬一切。」
～最终血侯哲娜

437375.oracleText: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. Draw a card if that creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
437375.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。如果该生物上有+1/+1指示物，则抓一张牌。

437377.oracleText:
"I knew we shouldn't have come this way."
—Sneeflebrix, expedition rogue
437377.translation:
「我就知道不该走这条路。」
～探险队浪客斯泥夫必

437380.oracleText:
"As a child, I was afraid of the dark. Now, I'm afraid of the things I know are lurking in the dark, waiting to bite my head off."
—Sneeflebrix, expedition rogue
437380.translation:
「小的时候，我害怕黑暗的地方。现在，我害怕的是见过的东西潜伏在暗处，等着咬掉我脑袋。」
～探险队盗贼斯泥夫必

437383.oracleText: Vampires are now masters of their own fates, commanders of their own legions.
437383.translation: 如今吸血鬼能够掌控自己的命运，指挥自己的军团。

437387.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if it was kicked, each player loses half their life, rounded up.
437387.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若它已增幅，则每位牌手各失去一半数量的生命，小数点后进位。

437388.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to 20 minus the highest life total among players.
437388.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于20减去牌手中总生命最高者的数值。

437389.oracleText: Scourge of the Skyclaves's power and toughness are each equal to 20 minus the highest life total among players.
437389.translation: 空境祸害的力量和防御力各等同于20减去牌手中总生命最高者的数值。

437391.oracleText: Tap another untapped Rogue you control: CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn.
437391.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的浪客：CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。

437393.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player mills three cards.
437393.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手磨三张牌。

437396.oracleText: The shadows of death fall over everyone in the end.
437396.translation: 最后，死亡的阴影落在了所有人头上。

437405.oracleText:
"Perhaps its distant ancestors were radiant felidars, but no hint of their nobility remains."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger
437405.translation:
「它们的远亲也许还能跟耀目晶角兽攀上关系，但那股高贵感在它们身上荡然无存。」
～寇族掷索人娅奇丽

437406.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
437406.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437408.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, draw a card.
437408.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

437410.oracleText: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.
437410.translation: 卡加诸部族先祖曾齐心力克阿库姆空境取得辉煌胜利，同时也付出了惨痛代价。如今这传说仍在各部传扬。

437412.oracleText: Silence is an underrated hunting strategy.
437412.translation: 悄然出击是种被严重低估的行猎策略。

437415.oracleText: CARDNAME has lifelink as long as it has five or more +1/+1 counters on it.
437415.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有五个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有系命异能。

437417.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Taborax. If that creature was a Cleric, you may draw a card. If you do, you lose 1 life.
437417.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，在塔博锐上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若该死去的生物是僧侣，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则你失去1点生命。

437419.oracleText: Return target creature card and up to one target Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
437419.translation: 将目标生物牌和至多一张目标僧侣，浪客，战士或法术师生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

437420.oracleText: Open conflict between expeditionary houses—or even individual adventuring parties—is discouraged, but "accidents" happen.
437420.translation: 虽然台面上不提倡探险队甚或个别冒险团队之间公然对抗，但私底下的「意外」总是难免。

437422.oracleText:
"Annihilation surrounds us. Our call is to embrace its ceaseless hunger."
—Voshk, oblivion priest
437422.translation:
「毁灭将我们包围。我们的唯一出路便是屈服于这无尽饥渴。」
～佚界僧侣沃什克

437423.oracleText: Each opponent loses 4 life and you gain 4 life.
437423.translation: 每位对手各失去4点生命，且你获得4点生命。

437425.oracleText:
"Look at this place. What more evidence do you require that existence is bleak and meaningless?"
—Voshk, oblivion priest
437425.translation:
「看看这里。你哪里还需要更多证据才明白生命孱弱无力、了无意义？」
～佚界僧侣沃什克

437429.oracleText: Hellhound packs roam the Spikefields, basking in the harsh sunlight and lighting the night with their flames.
437429.translation: 地狱犬群在尖岩原四处游荡，白天享受此处严酷阳光，晚间便用自身火光照亮夜空。

437432.oracleText:
"I'm not cruel, but I have no patience for your mistakes."
—Tyrux, expedition warrior
437432.translation:
「我并不残忍，但你犯了错误我就不能忍。」
～探险队战士泰鲁兹

437434.oracleText:
"Rock. Lava. Gravity. They're not cruel, but they're not forgiving either."
—Tyrux, expedition warrior
437434.translation:
「尖石、熔岩、重力。它们都不残忍，但也都不宽容。」
～探险队战士泰鲁兹

437442.oracleText: Every inferno begins with a spark.
437442.translation: 每场炼狱都始于点滴星火。

437443.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature. If it was kicked, it deals 2 damage to each creature instead.
437443.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成1点伤害。如果它已增幅，则改为它对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

437444.oracleText: Cinderclasm deals 1 damage to each creature. If it was kicked, it deals 2 damage to each creature instead.
437444.translation: 烬火断层对每个生物各造成1点伤害。如果它已增幅，则改为它对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

437446.oracleText: Every rebirth looks like a death.

437449.oracleText: Warriors are combat specialists who bring their deadly skills to bear against the many foes that adventurers face in the course of their journeys.
437449.translation: 战士都是战斗专家，能够于冒险团队在旅程中遇袭时，运用自己杀敌技巧化险为夷。

437450.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as you control another Warrior.
437450.translation: 只要你操控另一个战士，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

437453.oracleText: "Down in flames" isn't a destination, but a journey.
437453.translation: 「引火烧身」说的不是结果，而是过程。

437454.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is equipped, it has haste.
437454.translation: 只要CARDNAME佩带武具，它便具有敏捷异能。

437458.oracleText: He might call up a burst of lava or a raging hellion from Akoum's volcanic depths. Or he might just fall in.
437458.translation: 他或许能从阿库姆的火山深渊中召出喷发熔岩或是狂怒狱兽。也或许会就此失足坠落。

437461.oracleText:
"Her weapon's impressive, sure. But you should see her wield it."
—Gred, expedition warrior
437461.translation:
「没错，她的武器确实令人眼前一亮。但你更该看看她挥舞时的样子。」
～探险队战士格雷德

437462.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature an opponent controls with power less than or equal to the number of Warriors you control can't block this turn.
437462.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于由你操控之战士数量的生物。该生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

437466.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each creature in your party.
437466.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你冒险团中每有一个生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

437469.oracleText: Naturally inquisitive and adaptable, goblins can turn their small stature to their advantage as rogues.
437469.translation: 鬼怪天生好奇心旺盛，又极易适应周遭环境，当起浪客来更能将自己个头矮小的优势发挥得淋漓尽致。

437470.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
437470.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

437473.oracleText:
"In my years wandering this land I've seen a veritable menagerie of fantastic creatures, but one that has eluded me thus far is the fabled ‘easygoing minotaur.'"
—Ko, expedition wizard
437473.translation:
「我已在这片土地上游历有年，亲眼见到的奇幻生物数量数不胜数，但迄今为止从未遇到传说中提到过的『随和牛头怪』。」
～探险队法师蔻达黎

437474.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+2 until end of turn. Scry 1.
437474.translation: 目标生物得+3/+2直到回合结束。占卜1。

437477.oracleText: Target creature becomes a Coward until end of turn.
437477.translation: 目标生物成为懦夫直到回合结束。

437478.oracleText: Target creature becomes a Coward until end of turn.
437478.translation: 目标生物成为懦夫直到回合结束。

437479.oracleText: Target Warrior gains trample until end of turn.
437479.translation: 目标战士获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

437480.oracleText: Target Warrior gains trample until end of turn.
437480.translation: 目标战士获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

437481.oracleText:
{o1}: Choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — 
• CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn. 
• Target creature becomes a Coward until end of turn. 
• Target Warrior gains trample until end of turn.
437481.translation:
{o1}：选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的～ 
•CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。 
•目标生物成为懦夫直到回合结束。 
•目标战士获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

437484.oracleText:
"The toll is steep, but the cliffs are steeper."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House
437484.translation:
「过路费虽高，但山崖更高。」
～姆拉撒探险队的莎米勒

437485.oracleText: Kazuul's Fury deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target.
437485.translation: 克卒怒火对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。

437487.oracleText:
"The path up the cliffs is nothing but steep switchbacks and rickety lifts, made by elves, maintained by humans, and guarded by ogres. But it's the best way into the heart of Murasa."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House
437487.translation:
「这条山崖通路由妖精建造、人类维护、食人魔看守。虽然不过是一条陡峭迂回，崎岖不平的便道，但却是进入姆拉撒中心地带的最佳路线。」
～姆拉撒探险队的莎米勒

437491.oracleText: You don't lose unspent red mana as steps and phases end.
437491.translation: 你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去未用尽的红色法术力。

437492.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may pay any amount of {oR}. When you do, it deals that much damage to any target.
437492.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以支付任意数量的{oR}。当你如此作时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

437495.oracleText: As long as there are four or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +3/+1.
437495.translation: 只要你的坟墓场中有四张或更多瞬间和／或法术牌，CARDNAME便得+3/+1。

437497.oracleText: {oT}, Discard a card: Exile the top two cards of your library, then choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
437497.translation: {oT}，弃一张牌：放逐你牌库顶的两张牌，然后选择其中一张。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

437499.oracleText: Life among the sudden tremors and violent eruptions of Akoum demands a healthy fear of both.
437499.translation: 阿库姆经常发生地震或火山爆发。要想在这生活，就得时刻对两者保持警惕。

437500.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
437500.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

437501.oracleText: Molten Blast deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
437501.translation: 热熔冲击波对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

437502.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target artifact.
437502.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

437503.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Molten Blast deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target artifact.
437503.translation:
选择一项～ 
•热熔冲击波对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

437505.oracleText: Each creature you control gets +1/+0 for each time it has attacked this turn.
437505.translation: 对每个由你操控的生物而言，它本回合中每攻击过一次，便得+1/+0。

437508.oracleText: "Zendikar has suffered enough. It is time, at last, for my home to know peace."
437508.translation: 「赞迪卡已饱受摧残。如今终于轮到我的家园得享平静。」

437511.oracleText:
"The difference between a hellion and a volcano is that volcanoes don't get hungry."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House
437511.translation:
「地狱兽和火山的区别在于，火山不会饿。」
～阿库姆探险队的莎琦儿

437516.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this creature deals 1 damage to you.
437516.translation: 在你的维持开始时，此生物对你造成1点伤害。

437520.oracleText: "You can cower from the crushing shards or embrace the danger of Akoum. I've made my choice."
437520.translation: 「在面对山岩崩落时，你可以选择畏缩不前，也可以去直面阿库姆的危险。我已作好选择。」

437521.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
437521.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

437524.oracleText:
"Our feeble villages and tiny encampments stand only at the whim of the Roil."
—The Invokers' Tales
437524.translation:
「我们的孱弱村庄和渺小营地能否存留，端看狂搅脸色。」
～《召现师传说》

437525.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. If this spell was kicked, it deals 5 damage instead.
437525.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为它造成5点伤害。

437526.oracleText: Roil Eruption deals 3 damage to any target. If this spell was kicked, it deals 5 damage instead.
437526.translation: 狂搅爆发对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为它造成5点伤害。

437528.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to them.
437528.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，CARDNAME对其造成1点伤害。

437530.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, if no mana was spent to cast that spell, CARDNAME deals 5 damage to that player.
437530.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语，若施放该咒语时未支付过法术力，则CARDNAME对该牌手造成5点伤害。

437532.oracleText: {oR}: Your opponents can't gain life this turn.
437532.translation: {oR}：本回合中，对手不能获得生命。

437537.oracleText: "Lava flows where it pleases. I'm just happy to be along for the ride!"
437537.translation: 「熔岩随意奔流。我很乐意顺流而行。」

437542.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if CARDNAME doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it, return it to its owner's hand.
437542.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若CARDNAME上没有+1/+1指示物，则将它移回其拥有者手上。

437545.oracleText:
"We just pay him and point him at problems."
—Aro, Sea Gate adventurer
437545.translation:
「我们就只是给他钱，告诉他哪有事。」
～海户冒险家阿罗

437547.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage divided as you choose among up to two target creatures and/or planeswalkers. If X is 6 or more, CARDNAME deals twice X damage divided as you choose among them instead.
437547.translation: CARDNAME对至多两个目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果X等于或大于6，则改为CARDNAME对它们造成共两倍于X数量的伤害，你可以任意分配。

437548.oracleText: Shatterskull Smashing deals X damage divided as you choose among up to two target creatures and/or planeswalkers. If X is 6 or more, Shatterskull Smashing deals twice X damage divided as you choose among them instead.
437548.translation: 碎颅落岩对至多两个目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果X等于或大于6，则改为碎颅落岩对它们造成共两倍于X数量的伤害，你可以任意分配。

437550.oracleText:
"The safest way across the Skyfangs is to fly. Shatterskull Pass is a pretty distant second."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House
437550.translation:
「穿越穹牙山脉的最安全方式是从空中飞过。取道碎颅隘口是万不得已的备选。」
～姆拉撒探险队的莎米勒

437554.oracleText:
"A thousand sparks can burn through your defenses just as quickly as one massive blaze."
—Attikar, Akoum elementalist
437554.translation:
「不论是千颗火星还是一束火光，烧穿你防线的速度一样快。」
～阿库姆元素师阿提卡

437555.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature that blocked this turn.
437555.translation: CARDNAME对目标本回合中进行过阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。

437556.oracleText: Sizzling Barrage deals 4 damage to target creature that blocked this turn.
437556.translation: 火热齐击对目标本回合中进行过阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。

437558.oracleText: Wrenched from the ground like a dirt-caked rock, the ancient Skyclave wriggled with life.
437558.translation: 远古空境仿佛有生命一般，自行松脱泥土展现全貌。

437563.oracleText:
"I'm not proud of the things I did. But all I could think about at the time was how to make the noise stop."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437563.translation:
「我确实干了些不怎么光荣的事情。但我当时就只想着快点让噪音消失。」
～海户探险队的耶悟茨

437565.oracleText:
"They call it the Singing City, but those eerie sounds aren't music. They worm their way into your brain until rational thought is impossible."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437565.translation:
「他们把这里叫做魅歌城，但那诡异旋律根本不能叫歌。它们只会钻进你的脑子里，让你完全无法理智思考。」
～海户探险队的耶悟茨

437569.oracleText:
"Stop screaming! You'll only bring down more spikes."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
437569.translation:
「不要叫！这样只会让更多尖石落下来。」
～抄捷径鬼怪食虫拉夫

437570.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
437570.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

437571.oracleText: Spikefield Hazard deals 1 damage to any target. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
437571.translation: 尖岩原险境对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

437573.oracleText:
"Silence until we're through. Even a whisper's echo can dislodge death from above."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
437573.translation:
「在穿过这里之前，千万不能发出声音。就算声音再低，有一丝回响都会让死亡从天而降。」
～抄捷径鬼怪食虫拉夫

437577.oracleText:
"If you hear a choking sort of cough, it's about to get really hot."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
437577.translation:
「如果你听到像有什么东西噎住一样的咳嗽声，周围很快就变热。」
～抄捷径鬼怪食虫拉夫

437581.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature and X damage to that creature's controller, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
437581.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害，并对该生物的操控者造成X点伤害，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

437582.oracleText: Synchronized Spellcraft deals 4 damage to target creature and X damage to that creature's controller, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
437582.translation: 同调咒艺对目标生物造成4点伤害，并对该生物的操控者造成X点伤害，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

437584.oracleText: Goblins from the Makindi Trenches of Ondu make surprisingly skilled climbing guides due to their habit of scaling the cliffs to drop onto unsuspecting foes.
437584.translation: 来自昂度马钦迪战壕的鬼怪习惯攀登山头从上方袭击毫无防备的敌人，找他们来作登山向导意外好用。

437587.oracleText:
"Fire is too imprecise for my tastes. I'd rather rely on a single, well-placed bolt of lightning."
—Lyrus, Sea Gate wizard
437587.translation:
「对我来说，火焰准头不行。我更愿意依靠一道恰到好处的闪电。」
～海户法术师莱鲁斯

437588.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
437588.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

437589.oracleText: Thundering Rebuke deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
437589.translation: 雷霆拒斥对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

437594.oracleText: Kargan tribal lands rarely have issues with goblin raids. Coincidentally, they also rarely have issues keeping their dragons fed.
437594.translation: 卡加部落领地很少因为遇到鬼怪突袭而发愁。巧的是，他们也很少由于喂不饱巨龙而烦恼。

437596.oracleText: As with everything else, goblins believe fortifications benefit from as many spiky bits as possible.
437596.translation: 鬼怪认为工事跟其他东西一样，尖头越多越可靠。

437598.oracleText:
"My ancestors reshaped the world to their vision. I have a few ideas of my own."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic
437598.translation:
「我的先祖按照他们的视像重塑了整个世界。而我有我自己的想法。」
～锻石秘教徒塔斯欧岚

437599.oracleText: Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your library, then draw that many cards plus one.
437599.translation: 将任意数量的牌从你手上置于你的牌库底，然后抓该数量加一的牌。

437601.oracleText:
"I can hear the echo of their hammers, long stilled."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic
437601.translation:
「虽然他们的巨锤早已闲置多年，我依然能听见敲打的回响。」
～锻石秘教徒塔斯欧岚

437605.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are cards exiled with CARDNAME, put them into their owner's graveyard, then CARDNAME deals that much damage to each opponent.
437605.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若放逐区中有以CARDNAME放逐的牌，则将其置入其拥有者的坟墓场，然后CARDNAME向每位对手各造成等量的伤害。

437608.oracleText: Goblin cavalry tactics consist of pointing a beast in a direction and hanging on for as long as possible.
437608.translation: 鬼怪骑兵的战术包括：给坐骑指方向，以及尽量骑背上。

437609.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, return a land you control to its owner's hand.
437609.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

437612.oracleText: "Good, we're all here. Let's get started!"

437613.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, draw a card.
437613.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果你未以此法将牌置于手上，则抓一张牌。

437615.oracleText: When the ruins awakened, so did their defenses.
437615.translation: 遗迹醒转时，其防线亦然。

437616.oracleText: You may play lands from your graveyard.
437616.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中使用地牌。

437620.oracleText: Nontoken creatures you control are Forest lands in addition to their other types.
437620.translation: 由你操控且非衍生物的生物都是树林地，且仍具有原本类别。

437622.oracleText:
"Always have a backup plan."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
437622.translation:
「随时备妥候选方案。」
～巴勒格向导多拉尔

437624.oracleText:
"I know it's around here somewhere."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
437624.translation:
「我就知道在这附近。」
～巴勒格向导多拉尔

437628.oracleText: Getting airborne with a kitesail is easy. It's everything afterward that takes focus, skill, and luck.
437628.translation: 驾驭航筝起飞升空并不难。之后的事情才需要专注、技巧和运气来应对。

437630.oracleText:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House
437630.translation:
「你甚至能察觉到它在仔细盘算～我们是否美味到值得它冒险扑过来？」
～姆拉撒探险队的莎米勒

437635.oracleText: "I've got a little surprise for you, beasties! Come and get it!"
437635.translation: 「我给你们准备了些惊喜，臭野兽！快过来啊！」

437638.oracleText: Where mana flows, the gnarlids follow.
437638.translation: 魔力充盈之处，糙节兽必随至。

437641.oracleText: Target player gains X life, where X is the greatest power among creatures they control.
437641.translation: 目标牌手获得X点生命，X为由其操控的生物中力量最大者的数值。

437642.oracleText:
Choose one. If this spell was kicked, choose any number instead. 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. 
• Target player gains X life, where X is the greatest power among creatures they control. 
• Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
437642.translation:
选择一项。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为选择任意数量的选项。 
•在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。 
•目标牌手获得X点生命，X为由其操控的生物中力量最大者的数值。 
•目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

437644.oracleText: The hatchlings will fill the jungles of Murasa in a glittering tide.
437644.translation: 其幼虫会让整个姆拉撒丛林色彩斑斓。

437645.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token for each +1/+1 counter you've put on creatures under your control this turn.
437645.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你本回合中每在由你操控的生物上放置过一个+1/+1指示物，便派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

437647.oracleText: "If you only follow where the paths lead, you merely go where others have gone before you."
437647.translation: 「如果你只沿着大路走，那你只能去到前人到过之处。」

437650.oracleText:
"It doesn't obey me. It cooperates with me."
—Triel, Kazandu tuskcaller
437650.translation:
「它不听我的话。它只是配合我行动。」
～卡赞度召牙师翠儿

437653.oracleText:
"The elves stick to the trees. Here, where the trees welcome the sky and leave room for grazing herds—this is our land."
—Triel, Kazandu tuskcaller
437653.translation:
「妖精依树而生。而这里正是我们的理想家园～植木高耸迎天长，旷野坦阔任兽行。」
～卡赞度召牙师翠儿

437657.oracleText:
"The scythe-like forelegs are crucial for its survival, because it tastes really good and every inhabitant of Murasa knows it."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder
437657.translation:
「它们正是依靠那对如镰刀般锋利的前肢才得以存活至今，因为它们实在很美味，全姆拉撒的居民都知道。」
～卡赞度探陷人亚哈娜

437659.oracleText: Elves revere cycles of renewal, but they prefer cycles that don't involve their homes getting smashed.
437659.translation: 妖精崇敬轮回新生，但他们更希望看到家园不会被夷为平地的那种轮回。

437663.oracleText:
"The difference between life and death in Ora Ondar is about three seconds of startled screaming."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
437663.translation:
「欧拉昂达上生与死之间的差距不过三秒钟的尖叫而已。」
～抄捷径鬼怪食虫拉夫

437665.oracleText:
"If you wander into the Khalni Garden without knowing the signs of a scythecat's territory, you're not going to live long enough to learn."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
437665.translation:
「如果你不慎误闯坎尼花园，而又不知道哪里是镰刃猫的领地，那你应该活不到学会分辨的那一刻。」
～抄捷径鬼怪食虫拉夫

437667.oracleText: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.
437667.translation: 它颈部鼓胀便是警告：收下礼物，切勿靠近。

437669.oracleText: The continent of Murasa is defined by irrepressible growth, both natural and otherwise.
437669.translation: 姆拉撒大陆的特征在于万物成长不受控制，无论自然与否。

437670.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets +5/+5 until end of turn instead.
437670.translation: 目标生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为该生物得+5/+5直到回合结束。

437672.oracleText: Some adventuring parties are made up of old friends, their common bonds bolstering them in the face of peril. Other parties simply hire the biggest, meanest muscle they can find.
437672.translation: 有些冒险团队成员相互熟识，在遇到危险时依靠彼此鼓励挺过难关。而有些冒险团队就只是去物色最孔武有力的巨汉雇来当打手。

437674.oracleText: The seeds of memory grow eternal.

437678.oracleText: Enchanted land is a 4/4 Elemental creature with reach and haste. It's still a land.
437678.translation: 所结附的地是4/4，具敏捷与延势异能的元素生物。它仍然是地。

437681.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each attacking creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
437681.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个进行攻击且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437683.oracleText: A healthy felidar is voracious yet regal. A rabid felidar is nothing more than appetite lashed to frothing jaws.
437683.translation: 健康的晶角兽虽也会大口吞咽，但仍不失威严气质。染疾的晶角兽就只晓得张开血盆大口，屈从于无魇食欲。

437687.oracleText:
"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane
437687.translation:
「树根会想方设法穿过石块，就连高山也得给新苗让路。」
～妮莎瑞文

437691.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. You gain 2 life. You may play an additional land this turn.
437691.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。你获得2点生命。本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

437693.oracleText:
"Survival rule 782: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter
437693.translation:
「生存法则第782项：硬盔虫只会更多。」
～抄捷径鬼怪组棣

437697.oracleText: For use on cliffs and other faces.
437697.translation: 适用于山崖及其他表面。

437701.oracleText: Hope and courage bloom in her wake.
437701.translation: 希望与勇气随她脚步绽放。

437704.oracleText: "This expedition doesn't succeed unless we all succeed!"
437704.translation: 「所有人都同享喜悦，本次冒险才算成功！」

437705.oracleText: Choose target creature you control. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature in your party.
437705.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物。你冒险团中每有一个生物，便在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437708.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it becomes the target of a spell an opponent controls, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
437708.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物成为由对手操控之咒语的目标时，派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

437711.oracleText: Ora Ondar, the Khalni Garden, is a lush tangle of growth in the harsh lands of Akoum. Its plant growth is marvelously diverse: a brilliant spectrum of vibrant life . . . and speedy death.
437711.translation: 欧拉昂达又称坎尼花园，是阿库姆荒地中一处葱郁丛林。此处植物种类繁多、包罗万象：既有茁壮成长的盎然生机…也有能迅速致命的剧烈毒物。

437713.oracleText: CARDNAME is also a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.
437713.translation: CARDNAME也是僧侣、浪客、战士和法术师。

437714.oracleText: Tajuru Paragon is also a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.
437714.translation: 特裘如典范也是僧侣、浪客、战士和法术师。

437718.oracleText: Elves of the Tajuru Nation spend their lives in the ancient jaddi trees' expansive canopy, some living and dying without ever touching the ground.
437718.translation: 特裘如一族妖精终生居于古老贾迪巨树广阔林冠之上，有些人一辈子都未曾接触地面。

437720.oracleText:
"As Bala Ged regrows, new forms of life blossom with unfettered wonder."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
437720.translation:
「随着巴勒格开始复苏，新的生命如奇迹般恣意绽放。」
～巴勒格向导多拉尔

437722.oracleText:
"We would do well to open our eyes and remember what it is to wonder."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
437722.translation:
「我们只需要睁大双眼，好好记住这片自然奇迹。」
～巴勒格向导多拉尔

437730.oracleText: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.
437730.translation: 如果站在镰刃猫和它的猎物之间，你就成了开胃菜。

437733.oracleText: "For so long, this land cried out in pain. Now, as the flow returns to its balance point, a new harmony echoes in the trees."
437733.translation: 「许多年来，这片大陆在痛苦呻吟。如今能量流动重归平衡，林木之间回响着全新和韵。」

437738.oracleText:
"The trees here twist around spikes of mana, feeding off the flowing power."
—Jori En, expedition leader
437738.translation:
「此处的树木绕着涌出的魔力成长，汲取其间流动能量为生。」
～探险队长裘黎恩

437742.oracleText:
"When you understand nature's ways, you're never unarmed."
—Eyza, Joraga guide
437742.translation:
「只要你理解自然之道，便永远不会缺少武器。」
～玖瑞加向导爱札

437744.oracleText:
"Never underestimate the ferocity of the imperative to thrive."
—Eyza, Joraga guide
437744.translation:
「永远不要低估生长本能的血性。」
～玖瑞加向导爱札

437751.oracleText: Veteran Adventurer is also a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.
437751.translation: 资深冒险者也是僧侣、浪客、战士和法术师。

437753.oracleText:
"It's cute now, but those things tend to get a lot bigger when you're not looking."
—Fahar, expedition wizard
437753.translation:
「虽然它现在看上去很可爱，但是你一转眼它们就会变得巨大无比。」
～探险队法师伐赫

437754.oracleText: The first kicked spell you cast each turn costs {o1} less to cast.
437754.translation: 你每回合中施放的第一个已增幅咒语减少{o1}来施放。

437755.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
437755.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437758.oracleText: "No angel bars our ascent. Emeria waits above!"
437758.translation: 「天使也不能阻挡我们的攀爬脚步。伊美黎在上面等着我们！」

437759.oracleText: Whenever you attack a player with one or more equipped creatures, draw a card.
437759.translation: 每当你以一个或数个佩带武具的生物攻击一位牌手时，抓一张牌。

437760.oracleText: {oW}: You may unattach an Equipment from a creature you control. If you do, tap that creature and it gains indestructible until end of turn.
437760.translation: {oW}：你可以将任一由你操控的生物上之一个武具卸装。如果你如此作，则横置该生物且它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

437767.oracleText: Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
437767.translation: 每当你每回合首度获得生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437772.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, put a +1/+1 counter on Grakmaw.
437772.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有+1/+1指示物，则在血盆口上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

437773.oracleText: When Grakmaw dies, create an X/X black and green Hydra creature token, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on Grakmaw.
437773.translation: 当血盆口死去时，派出一个X/X，黑绿双色的多头龙衍生生物，X为血盆口上+1/+1指示物的数量。

437775.oracleText: From rebellion against the Akoum Skyclave to fighting the Eldrazi titans, the dragon-riding Kargan tribes have never missed an opportunity to defy the odds.
437775.translation: 从反抗阿库姆空境到对抗奥扎奇巨怪，生活在龙背上的卡加部落从未缺席挑战不利局面的机会。

437776.translation: 由你操控的其他战士得+1/+1。

437778.oracleText: "What sort of life is that, huddling in the familiar and safe? No thanks. Put me right in the center of the action."
437778.translation: 「呆在熟悉又安全的地方混日子算什么名堂？谢了。还是让我去找点刺激吧。」

437779.oracleText: {oT}: The next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the number of Wizards you control as this ability resolves.
437779.translation: {oT}：你本回合中施放的下一个瞬间或法术咒语减少来施放，{oX}为于此异能结算时由你操控的法术师数量。

437782.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you have a full party, choose target nonland permanent an opponent controls. Until your next turn, it can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated.
437782.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你的冒险团满编，则选择目标由对手操控的非地永久物。直到你的下一个回合，它不能进行攻击或阻挡，其起动式异能也不能起动。

437783.oracleText: Sacrifice Linvala: Choose hexproof or indestructible. Creatures you control gain that ability until end of turn.
437783.translation: 牺牲琳法拉：选择辟邪或不灭。由你操控的生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

437785.oracleText:
"They store energy in special gastric organs . . . but I guess you'd probably rather have me clear the path than ramble about guts."
—Fahar, expedition wizard
437785.translation:
「它们会用特殊的胃来储存能量…但我想你应该会让我来替你开路，而不是鼓起胆量自己领头。」
～探险队法师伐赫

437786.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, you gain 2 life.
437786.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，你获得2点生命。

437792.oracleText: Few other creatures so closely embody Murasa's rapid cycles of growth.
437792.translation: 没有其他生物能够如此精准地重现姆拉撒的快速生长周期。

437793.oracleText: {oT}: You may put a basic land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
437793.translation: {oT}：你可以将一张基本地牌从你手上放进战场。

437794.oracleText: {oT}: Return target basic land you control to its owner's hand.
437794.translation: {oT}：将目标由你操控的基本地移回其拥有者手上。

437796.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Kor Warrior creature token. You may attach an Equipment you control to it.
437796.translation: 派出一个1/1白色寇族／战士衍生生物。你可以将一个由你操控的武具贴附于其上。

437797.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Warrior or Equipment card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
437797.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张战士或武具牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

437798.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to twice the number of Equipment you control.
437798.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之武具数量的两倍。

437803.oracleText: Untap target land you control. You may have it become a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste and menace until end of turn. It's still a land.
437803.translation: 重置目标由你操控的地。你可以使它成为3/3，具敏捷与威慑异能的元素生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

437818.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each creature in your party and has menace.
437818.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有威慑异能，且你冒险团中每有一个生物，它便得+1/+0。

437821.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, Rogues you control get +1/+0.
437821.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，由你操控的浪客便得+1/+0。

437822.oracleText: Whenever one or more Rogues you control attack, each opponent mills two cards.
437822.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个浪客攻击时，每位对手各磨两张牌。

437824.oracleText: Survival itself is no small reward.
437824.translation: 活下来本身就是一笔不小的奖赏。

437825.oracleText: You gain 3 life and draw three cards.
437825.translation: 你获得3点生命且抓三张牌。

437827.oracleText: "We tolerate the North Hada thieves' den, but cutthroats who wander downriver earn a skymanta ride out to sea."
437827.translation: 「我们能够容忍盗贼在北哈达安营，但倘若割喉客胆敢顺流而下，他们就会被穹鳐扔到海里去。」

437828.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
437828.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

437835.oracleText: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.
437835.translation: 牙刹巨蹄踩过之处，贫瘠沙漠也能变作肥沃土壤。

437837.oracleText: Players can't pay life or sacrifice nonland permanents to cast spells or activate abilities.
437837.translation: 牌手不能以支付生命或牺牲非地永久物的方式施放咒语或起动异能。

437839.oracleText: Other creatures you control have deathtouch.
437839.translation: 由你操控的其他生物具有死触异能。

437840.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a planeswalker, destroy that planeswalker.
437840.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，消灭该鹏洛客。

437844.oracleText: Whenever Zareth San deals combat damage to a player, you may put target permanent card from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
437844.translation: 每当泽雷尚对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将目标永久物牌在你的操控下从该牌手的坟墓场放进战场。

437846.oracleText: Made from canvas, wood, and hope.
437846.translation: 用帆布、木材和希望制成。

437849.oracleText:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims
437849.translation:
「我们将永生追随。」
～坚信朝圣客高阶僧侣艾栗

437850.translation: 由你操控的无色生物得+2/+2。

437851.oracleText: Whenever you tap a permanent for {oC}, add an additional {oC}.
437851.translation: 每当你横置一个永久物以产生时{oC}，额外加{oC}。

437852.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell, you gain 2 life.
437852.translation: 每当你施放无色咒语时，你获得2点生命。

437854.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
437854.translation: {o2}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的起动式或触发式异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

437855.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
437855.translation: {o3}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

437856.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Copy target permanent spell you control.
437856.translation: {o4}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的永久物咒语。

437860.oracleText: When CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it and create a number of 1/1 colorless Construct artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
437860.translation: 当CARDNAME成为咒语的目标时，将它牺牲，并派出若干1/1无色组构体衍生神器生物，其数量等同于它的力量。

437863.translation: 古老力量派上全新用场。

437864.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, put a charge counter on CARDNAME.
437864.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个充电指示物。

437866.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove all charge counters from CARDNAME: It deals that much damage to target creature.
437866.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去所有充电指示物：它对目标生物造成等量的伤害。

437868.oracleText: "It's light as a feather, but it hits with the force of a boulder. A very sharp boulder."
437868.translation: 「它虽然轻如羽毛，力道却重如巨岩。异常锋利的巨岩。」

437870.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1. If it's a Warrior, it gets +2/+1 instead.
437870.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1。如果它是战士，则改为它得+2/+1。

437872.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
437872.translation: 除非任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

437876.oracleText: As long as you control a Cleric, CARDNAME has "Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
437876.translation: 只要你操控僧侣，CARDNAME便具有「每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。」

437879.oracleText:
"When you are battered and exhausted, look up and be inspired by its resolve."
—Tazri
437879.translation:
「如果你已伤痕累累、精疲力竭，请抬头看看，希望它的坚毅决心能让你重燃信心。」
～塔兹莉

437881.oracleText: Skyclaves held the key to reshaping the world.
437881.translation: 重塑世界的关键藏于空境之中。

437888.oracleText:
"It's better to carry a little extra weight than to find yourself halfway down a baloth's throat with no knife."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide
437888.translation:
「宁愿背包重那么一点，也不要在快被巴洛西吞下时发现手头连刀都没有。」
～巴勒格向导多拉尔

437894.oracleText: It will happily carry home your treasure or drag you back to civilization, as circumstances demand.
437894.translation: 它很乐意帮你把宝藏载回家，或把你拖回文明世界，看情况而定。

437895.oracleText: Stonework Packbeast is also a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.
437895.translation: 石工驮兽也是僧侣、浪客、战士和法术师。

437897.oracleText: "Hold on a second, I have just the thing."

437900.oracleText: A new dawn, a new adventure.

437902.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard spell or to activate an ability of a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard.
437902.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放僧侣、浪客、战士或法术师咒语，或是起动僧侣、浪客、战士或法术师的异能。

437904.oracleText:
"Not for the bumble-footed nor wobble-stomached."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
437904.translation:
「手脚不利落、肚量特别大的走不了。」
～裂船湾的奎嘎

437906.oracleText:
"The path is stable. It's the gusts all around it that are a bit ‘whoosh—oops—bye.'"
—Kreq of Sunder Bay
437906.translation:
「道路本身很平稳。「路本身是很稳。但只要周围突然起风，可能就会听到『飕飕～糟糕～再见』。」
～裂船湾的奎嘎

437908.oracleText:
"Why risk life and limb exploring the wilds? For this."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437908.translation:
「你问为什么要冒着失去生命、断手断脚的危险探索野外？就是为了这个。」
～海户探险队的耶悟茨

437910.oracleText:
"My mother wanted me to take over the family dry goods business, but no. I had to come here."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437910.translation:
「母亲想让我接手家族的织品杂货生意，但我拒绝了。
我必须来这里一趟。」
～海户探险队的耶悟茨

437912.oracleText:
"Just when the river seems most peaceful, suddenly you round a bend and hurtle down a waterfall."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader
437912.translation:
「就在河流水势看来最平缓的地方，你忽然之间就会被吸进急流，掉入瀑布。」
～哈利玛探险队长萨格达

437914.oracleText:
"Here, at least, the danger is usually in plain sight."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader
437914.translation:
「而这里，至少你一眼就能看到危险所在。」
～哈利玛探险队长萨格达

437916.oracleText:
"The greatest danger on the path is a failure of nerve."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437916.translation:
「一路上最大的危险就是突然丧失勇气。」
～海户探险队的恩沃

437918.oracleText:
"Walk quickly and ignore any roars from the undergrowth."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House
437918.translation:
「快速通过，不要理会底下的嚎叫声。」
～海户探险队的恩沃

437921.oracleText: {o4}: Put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME. Then you may have it become a 0/0 Elemental creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
437921.translation: {o4}：在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。然后你可以使它成为0/0元素生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

437924.oracleText:
"Once you really trust the rope, you'll learn to sleep standing up."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger
437924.translation:
「等到你完全信任绳索后，你甚至能学会站着睡觉。」
～寇族掷索人娅奇丽

437926.oracleText:
"The oxen here take an almost feline delight in pushing things over the edge."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger
437926.translation:
「这里的牛就跟猫一样，喜欢把东西往悬崖边上推。」
～寇族掷索人娅奇丽

437928.oracleText:
"The wind knows the way. Just let it carry you there."
—Amandi, kitesail expert
437928.translation:
「清风知晓道路。尽管随风而行。」
～航筝专家阿曼迪

437930.oracleText:
"Don't fear the heat. Just let it lift you up."
—Amandi, kitesail expert
437930.translation:
「无需惧怕高热。尽管随之腾飞。」
～航筝专家阿曼迪

437933.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a charge counter from CARDNAME: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast kicked spells.
437933.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个充电指示物：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。此法术力只能用来施放已增幅的咒语。

437941.oracleText: Reveal up to two Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard, and/or Ally cards?
437941.translation: 是否要展示至多两张僧侣，浪客，战士，法术师和／或伙伴牌？

437942.oracleText: Reveal a card with a kicker ability?
437942.translation: 是否要展示一张具任一增幅异能的牌？

437945.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with power less than or equal to the number of Warriors you control.
437945.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且力量等于或小于由你操控之战士数量的生物为目标。

437948.oracleText: Distribute damage among up to two target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
437948.translation: 将伤害分配给至多两个目标生物和／或鹏洛客。

437949.oracleText: Target a creature that blocked this turn.
437949.translation: 指定一个本回合中进行过阻挡的生物为目标。

437950.oracleText: Return up to two lands you control to their owner's hand.
437950.translation: 将至多两个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

437951.oracleText: Target a card with a kicker ability.
437951.translation: 指定一张具增幅异能的牌为目标。

437953.oracleText: Target a basic land you control.
437953.translation: 指定一个由你操控的基本地为目标。

437957.translation: 是否要从{1, CardId}上移去两个+1/+1指示物？

437958.oracleText: Search for a basic Forest card and a basic Plains card.
437958.translation: 搜寻一张基本树林牌和一张基本平原牌。

437959.oracleText: Return an unblocked attacking Rogue you control to its owner's hand.
437959.translation: 将一个由你操控、进行攻击且未受阻挡的浪客移回其拥有者手上。

437960.oracleText: Target an activated or triggered ability you control.
437960.translation: 指定一个由你操控的起动式或触发式异能为目标。

437966.translation: 完全生命体戴斯特洛伊亚

437979.oracleText: If you control a commander, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost.
437979.translation: 如果你操控指挥官，则你可以施放此咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

437980.oracleText: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
437980.translation: 由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

437987.oracleText: You may choose new targets for target spell or ability.
437987.translation: 你可以为目标咒语或异能选择新的目标。

437990.translation: 指定一个咒语或异能为目标。

438121.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, destroy target noncreature permanent. Its controller creates a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
438121.translation: 每当此生物合变时，消灭目标非生物永久物。其操控者派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

438145.oracleText: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.
438145.translation: 花斑细绒成为厚实皮毛。软弱小嘴长出尖锐獠牙。窝中嬉闹变作生存竞争。

439083.oracleText: This spell has flash as long as you control a Merfolk.
439083.translation: 只要你操控人鱼，此咒语便具有闪现异能。

439133.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile the top card of each player's library, then you may cast any number of spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs.
439133.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌，然后你可以从这些牌之中施放任意数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

439255.oracleText: Cast any number of spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs?
439255.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从中施放任意数量的咒语？

439379.oracleText: You may cast instant and sorcery spells from your graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
439379.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放瞬间与法术咒语。如果以此法施放的咒语将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。

439380.oracleText: You get an emblem with "You may cast instant and sorcery spells from your graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead."
439380.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「你可以从你的坟墓场中施放瞬间与法术咒语。如果以此法施放的咒语将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。」

439461.oracleText: During each of your turns, you may play a land and cast a permanent spell of each permanent type from your graveyard.
439461.translation: 于你的每个回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场中使用一个地，且可以从该处施放永久物咒语，但每种永久物类别限一个。

439503.oracleText: You may cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
439503.translation: 本回合中，你可以从你坟墓场中施放灵俑牌。

439519.oracleText: Exile the top seven cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among them.
439519.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的七张牌。直到回合结束，你可以从其中施放咒语。

439588.oracleText: You may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
439588.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

439589.oracleText: You can't play lands or cast spells from your hand.
439589.translation: 你不能从你手上使用牌。

439910.oracleText: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {o2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
439910.translation: 由你操控的生物之起动式异能减少{o2}来起动。此效应无法让起动异能所需的法术力费用少于一点法术力。

439983.oracleText: During your turn, if an opponent lost life this turn, you may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled with CARDNAME.
439983.translation: 于你的回合中，如果有对手本回合中失去过生命，则你可以从以CARDNAME放逐的牌之中使用地和施放咒语。

440516.oracleText: You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.
440516.translation: 如果你的牌库顶牌是神器牌或无色非地牌，你可以施放之。

440724.oracleText: You may cast up to three spells from among face-up cards your opponents own from exile without paying their mana costs.
440724.translation: 你可以从放逐区施放至多三张由对手拥有且牌面朝上的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

440886.oracleText: You may cast instant and sorcery spells from the top of your library.
