440886.translation: 如果你的牌库顶牌是瞬间或法术牌，你可以施放之。

441357.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn to Dogs you control.
441357.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防止本回合中将对由你操控的狗造成之所有战斗伤害。

441891.oracleText: Cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard?
441891.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场中施放目标红色瞬间或法术牌？

441892.oracleText: Target a red instant or sorcery card.
441892.translation: 指定一张红色瞬间或法术牌为目标。

441896.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then discard a card unless you attacked this turn.
441896.translation: 抓两张牌。然后除非你于本回合中曾进行攻击，否则弃一张牌。

441906.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards. Raid — If you attacked this turn, create a Treasure token.
441906.translation: 目标对手弃两张牌。突击～如果你本回合中攻击过，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

441907.oracleText:
Target opponent discards two cards. 
Raid — If you attacked this turn, create a Treasure token.
441907.translation:
目标对手弃两张牌。
突击～如果你本回合中攻击过，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

441908.oracleText: Raid — At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked this turn, target opponent discards a card.
441908.translation: 突击～在你的结束步骤开始时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则目标对手弃一张牌。

441910.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. Raid — CARDNAME deals 6 damage instead if you attacked this turn.
441910.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。突击～如果你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则改为CARDNAME对该生物造成6点伤害。

441911.oracleText:
Firecannon Blast deals 3 damage to target creature. 
Raid — Firecannon Blast deals 6 damage instead if you attacked this turn.
441911.translation:
火炎炮轰击对目标生物造成3点伤害。
突击～如果你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则改为火炎炮轰击对该生物造成6点伤害。

441916.oracleText: Raid — At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked this turn, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
441916.translation: 突击～在你的结束步骤开始时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

442020.oracleText: Raid — If you attacked this turn, you may pay {oU} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
442020.translation: 突击～如果你于本回合中曾进行攻击，你可以支付{oU}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

442099.oracleText: Raid — This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you attacked this turn.
442099.translation: 突击～如果你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

443239.oracleText: You may cast spells from among cards exiled with Rona.
443239.translation: 你可以施放以罗娜放逐的非地牌。

443398.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: You may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
443398.translation: {o2oU}，{oT}：你可以从你手上施放一张瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

444221.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand without paying its mana cost?
444221.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个瞬间或法术咒语？

446062.oracleText: You may play lands from the top of your library.
446062.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶使用地。

446155.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
446155.translation: 每当CARDNAME对牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你手上使用一张非地的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

446280.oracleText: Cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost?
446280.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个咒语？

446285.oracleText: "I've sworn to protect the people from the horrors that would destroy them—even if those horrors are the angels themselves."
446285.translation: 「瑟班是生者之地。未彻底净化之前，我绝不歇息。」

446286.oracleText: "I serve the soft light of the moon that holds back the terrors of the night. I serve the bonds between us, driving out the fear that would break us apart."
446286.translation: 「瑟班是生者之地。未彻底净化之前，我绝不歇息。」

446287.oracleText: "I would rather be a heretic than betray my conscience."
446287.translation: 「我宁愿当个异教徒，也不愿违背良心。」

446288.oracleText: "I am the Guardian of Thraben, and I claim my right to speak before the council."
446288.translation: 「我是瑟班守护者，我有权在议会发言。」

446323.oracleText: Target a creature to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
446323.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，它得+0/+2直到回合结束。

446324.oracleText: Target a creature to get -2/-0 until end of turn.
446324.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，它得-2/-0直到回合结束。

446329.oracleText: Not all enormous beasts are quick to anger.
446329.translation: 并不是所有大块头都有爆脾气。

446354.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
446354.translation: 每当CARDNAME被阻挡时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

446356.oracleText: Choose a nonland permanent that player controls.
446356.translation: 选择一个由该牌手操控的非地永久物。

446551.oracleText: Whenever a source deals damage to CARDNAME, that source's controller mills that many cards.
446551.translation: 每当任一来源对CARDNAME造成伤害时，该来源的操控者磨等量的牌。

446553.oracleText: Draw a card. Target player mills a card.
446553.translation: 抓一张牌。目标牌手磨一张牌。

446940.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may mill two cards.
446940.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以磨两张牌。

447554.oracleText: You may cast spells that have a cycling ability from your graveyard.
447554.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放具循环异能的非地牌。

447555.oracleText: If a card that has a cycling ability would be put into your graveyard from anywhere and it wasn't cycled, exile it instead.
447555.translation: 如果某张具循环异能的牌将从任何区域置入你的坟墓场，且未有牌手循环之，则改为将它放逐。

447606.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target player mills half their library, rounded up.
447606.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标牌手将其牌库从顶上算起一半数量的牌置入其坟墓场，小数点后进位。

447647.oracleText: Mill three cards. If at least one Zombie card is milled this way, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
447647.translation: 磨三张牌。如果其中至少有一张是灵俑牌，则每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

447696.oracleText: Target player mills two cards. Draw a card.
447696.translation: 目标牌手磨两张牌。抓一张牌。

447883.oracleText: Target player mills four cards. Then exile each opponent's graveyard.
447883.translation: 目标牌手磨四张牌。然后放逐所有对手的坟墓场。

447952.oracleText: Adamant — If at least three black mana was spent to cast this spell, mill four cards.
447952.translation: 固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点黑色法术力，则磨四张牌。

447981.translation: {o1oB}：每位牌手各磨一张牌。（他们各将其牌库顶的牌置入其坟墓场。）

448095.oracleText: Mill three cards. Then you may exile a creature or enchantment card from your graveyard. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
448095.translation: 磨三张牌。然后你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物或结界牌。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

448096.oracleText: Mill three cards. Then you may exile a creature or enchantment card from your graveyard. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
448096.translation: 磨三张牌。然后你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物或结界牌。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

448325.oracleText: Choose target creature. Mill three cards, then put a +1/+1 counter on that creature for each creature card in your graveyard.
448325.translation: 选择目标生物。磨三张牌，然后你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，便在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

448335.oracleText: You have protection from the chosen card name.
448335.translation: 你具有反该牌名保护异能。

448420.oracleText: Protection from the chosen card name

448421.oracleText: Move your commander to the command zone?
448421.translation: 是否要将你的指挥官移至统帅区？

448743.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may mill three cards.
448743.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以磨三张牌。

448745.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
448745.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

449143.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Each player mills two cards.
449143.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。每位牌手各磨两张牌。

476988.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

476990.oracleText: "Today we are not Beskir or Tuskeri. We must fight as one clan, shoulder to shoulder, to defend our rightful home!"
476990.translation: 「今天我们没有贝斯奇与塔科力之分。必须团结如一，并肩奋战，才能共同保卫我们的家园！」

476994.oracleText: There are rules, and then there are gods.
476994.translation: 世界原来就有规则，但后来又有了神明。

476995.oracleText: Exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls. That player may put a permanent card from their hand onto the battlefield.
476995.translation: 放逐目标由对手操控的神器，生物或结界。该牌手可以将一张永久物牌从其手上放进战场。

476997.oracleText: The realms crashed together, with Bretagard at the center of the calamity.
476997.translation: 境域交汇，碧塔嘉顿成灾难中心。

477000.oracleText: "Giants and monsters loom on the horizon, and the elves plan to murder our gods!"
477000.translation: 「天边已然隐现巨人怪物，而妖精居然还想去弑神！」

477001.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, you gain 2 life.
477001.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，你获得2点生命。

477004.oracleText:
"How strong is he? Well, I once lost control of the plow, and he carved a furrow right through my house! Didn't even slow down."
—Guldir, Beskir farmer
477004.translation:
「他有多强壮？有一次我没管住犁头，他就硬生生地在我房子中间挖了条沟过去！一点都没有慢下来。」
～贝斯奇农夫古迪尔

477005.oracleText: CARDNAME crews Vehicles using its toughness rather than its power.
477005.translation: CARDNAME利用其防御力来搭载载具，而不是力量。

477012.oracleText: Not a single rat has been seen in Istfell since the gods moved in.
477012.translation: 自从诸神搬过来后，伊斯费再也没见过哪怕一只老鼠。

477015.oracleText: "That was nothing. I once took down a frost giant with a spoon!"
477015.translation: 「这算什么。我之前光用勺子就打倒了霜巨人！」

477018.oracleText: Creatures you control that are enchanted or equipped have double strike.
477018.translation: 由你操控且受有灵气或佩带武具的生物具有连击异能。

477019.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, you may attach target Aura or Equipment attached to a creature you control to target creature you control.
477019.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，选择目标贴附在由你操控之生物上的灵气或武具和目标由你操控的生物。你可以将前者贴附在后者上。

477021.oracleText: It cuts through the Cosmos itself, carving new Omenpaths between the realms.
477021.translation: 它能劈开寰宇，在境域之间辟出新的预兆径路。

477022.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0 and has vigilance.
477022.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0且具有警戒异能。

477023.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, return it to its owner's hand.
477023.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物死去时，将该生物移回其拥有者手上。

477025.oracleText: "Let's see how brave you really are behind all that oak and steel."
477025.translation: 「我们来看看躲在木盾铁甲背后的你们到底有多勇敢。」

477027.oracleText: "You'll raid nothing but mist in Istfell."
477027.translation: 「你能从伊斯费抢走的只有迷雾。」

477028.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target tapped creature.
477028.translation: CARDNAME对目标已横置的生物造成5点伤害。

477029.oracleText: Iron Verdict deals 5 damage to target tapped creature.
477029.translation: 铸铁裁定对目标已横置的生物造成5点伤害。

477033.oracleText: "All my scars have stories to tell."

477037.oracleText: Halvar united the spirits of all the clans into a single, devastating force.
477037.translation: 哈尔瓦一统各部亡魂，将其集聚成团结力量，所向披靡。

477043.oracleText: If a source an opponent controls would deal damage to you or a permanent you control, prevent 1 of that damage.
477043.translation: 如果某个由对手操控的来源将对你或任一由你操控的永久物造成伤害，则防止该伤害中的1点。

477044.oracleText: Whenever you or another permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {o1}.
477044.translation: 每当你或另一个由你操控的永久物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，除非该咒语或异能的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

477048.oracleText: Esika alone knows how to distill the essence of the World Tree into the Cosmos Elixir, a magical substance which grants the Skoti god-family immortality.
477048.translation: 世间唯有埃西卡知晓将世界树菁华提炼成寰宇琼浆的方法，斯科提神族也凭此魔法物质得以永生。

477051.oracleText: As long as you have at least 7 life more than your starting life total, creatures you control get +2/+2.
477051.translation: 只要你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多7点，由你操控的生物便得+2/+2。

477055.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it has lifelink.
477055.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便具有系命异能。

477056.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有系命异能。

477057.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is an Equipment, it has "Equipped creature has lifelink."
477057.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是武具，它便具有「佩带此武具的生物具有系命异能。」

477061.oracleText: You may pay {o1} rather than pay the mana cost for Rune spells you cast.
477061.translation: 你可以支付{o1}，而不支付你施放之符文咒语的法术力费用。

477078.oracleText: You may pay {o1oW} and exile a creature card from your graveyard rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
477078.translation: 你可以支付{o1oW}并从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

477080.oracleText: Every worthy warrior who arrives in Starnheim is gifted a mount befitting their heroism, a mighty pegasus raised and trained by the valkyries.
477080.translation: 每位来到斯达海姆的英灵战士都会获赠一匹与其辉煌事迹相称飞马坐骑。这些飞马由女武神亲自豢养训练，因而强大异常。

477081.oracleText: Artifact and enchantment spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
477081.translation: 你施放的神器与结界咒语减少{o1}来施放。

477083.oracleText: Create a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying and vigilance. If this spell was foretold, create X of those tokens instead.
477083.translation: 派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使／战士衍生生物。如果此咒语已预示，则改为派出X个此类衍生物。

477086.oracleText: Dwarven skalds are the most renowned storytellers in all of Kaldheim. They travel across the realms, seeking out heroic deeds and chronicling them in epic sagas.
477086.translation: 矮人北地诗人是全凯德海姆最有名的说书人。他们踏遍每处境域，探寻英雄事迹，将之编入竞相传颂的宏伟诗篇。

477088.oracleText: "I have led ten thousand through these mists and never lost the way."
477088.translation: 「我曾带领上万亡者穿越迷雾，从未迷失前路。」

477089.oracleText: Boast — {o1oW}: Create a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token.
477089.translation: 炫威～{o1oW}：派出一个1/1白色人类／战士衍生生物。

477094.oracleText: "If I am to die, let it be a hero's death!"
477094.translation: 「就算我要死，也要像个英雄一般上路！」

477095.oracleText: When enchanted creature leaves the battlefield, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
477095.translation: 当所结附的生物离开战场时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

477099.oracleText: The wolf's startled yelp changed quickly to a howl of elation as she soared over her envious packmates.
477099.translation: 这只狼在同伴艳羡的目光下逐渐飞升，起初的惊恐吠声很快变成了喜悦嚎叫。

477100.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+3 and gains flying until end of turn. Untap it.
477100.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+3且获得飞行异能。将之重置。

477102.oracleText: Alrund gets +1/+1 for each card in your hand and each foretold card you own in exile.
477102.translation: 你每有一张手牌或放逐区中每有一张由你拥有且己预示的牌，艾朗德便得+1/+1。

477105.oracleText: Alrund's raven soars between realms; no secret is beyond his grasp.
477105.translation: 艾朗德派乌鸦翱翔诸境，所有秘密尽收眼底。

477106.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, return it to its owner's hand, then scry 2.
477106.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它移回其拥有者手上，然后占卜2。

477109.oracleText: Create two 1/1 blue Bird creature tokens with flying. Take an extra turn after this one. Exile CARDNAME.
477109.translation: 派出两个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。放逐CARDNAME。

477110.oracleText: Create two 1/1 blue Bird creature tokens with flying. Take an extra turn after this one. Exile Alrund's Epiphany.
477110.translation: 派出两个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。放逐艾朗德的顿悟。

477112.oracleText:
"Many giants have tried to crush me with their hammers. You'll never stop me with that little toy."
—Stigur of the Omenseekers
477112.translation:
「曾有无数巨人想用手中巨锤把我砸扁。你那小玩具可拦不住我。」
～预兆觅径人斯提格

477114.oracleText: {oSioSi}: CARDNAME becomes a Spirit Warrior with base power and toughness 2/3.
477114.translation: {oSioSi}：CARDNAME成为基础力量与防御力为2/3的精怪／战士。

477116.oracleText: {oSioSioSi}: If CARDNAME is a Warrior, put a flying counter on it and it becomes a Spirit Warrior Angel with base power and toughness 4/4.
477116.translation: {oSioSioSi}：如果CARDNAME是战士，则在其上放置一个飞行指示物且它成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的精怪／战士／天使。

477118.oracleText: {oSioSioSioSi}: If CARDNAME is an Angel, put two +1/+1 counters on it and it gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
477118.translation: {oSioSioSioSi}：如果CARDNAME是天使，则在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物且它获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。」

477121.oracleText: Some ravens collect shiny baubles; others hoard omens and secrets.
477121.translation: 有些乌鸦喜欢收集闪亮饰品；还有一些则喜欢收集预兆秘密。

477124.oracleText: {o2}: Target snow land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with hexproof and haste until end of turn. It's still a land.
477124.translation: {o2}：目标由你操控的雪境地成为4/4，具辟邪与敏捷异能的元素生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

477126.oracleText: Countless worlds unfolded before Niko, every one in need of heroes.
477126.translation: 尼科面前出现了无数世界，每个世界都需要英雄。

477131.oracleText: Sarulf's snarl of rage shook the World Tree.
477131.translation: 萨茹夫的怒嚎连世界树都为之一震。

477135.oracleText: Locked in the ice of Karfell, the treasures of ancient nobles await in ruins guarded by the dead.
477135.translation: 在卡尔费冰层底下的遗迹中，有无数由亡灵看管的远古贵族珍宝待人去发现。

477141.oracleText: Whenever a Vehicle you control deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles that many cards from the top of their library. You may play lands from among those cards for as long as they remain exiled.
477141.translation: 每当一个由你操控的载具对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手从其牌库顶放逐等量的牌。于这些牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以从其中使用地。

477144.oracleText: Foretelling cards from your hand costs {o1} less and can be done on any player's turn.
477144.translation: 从你手上预示牌的费用减少{o1}，且你能在任何牌手的回合中如此作。

477147.oracleText: Frost giants study for centuries in isolation, honing their ability to harness elemental mayhem.
477147.translation: 霜巨人闭门研习数百年，练就一身掌控元素造成破坏的本领。

477151.oracleText: "My home calls to me. I must go."

477153.oracleText:
"The skald boasted that he could outsing the sea. Cosima heard him, and drowned his village with a single wave."
—Longbeard Saga
477153.translation:
「曾有一位北地诗人夸下海口，号称自己歌声能胜过汪洋。这件事情传到寇西玛耳中后，他便用一道巨浪将其村庄淹没。」
～《长须传》

477156.oracleText: The worst part is that you won't even remember how much he's taken from you.
477156.translation: 最惨的地方在于，你甚至不会记得被他偷走了多少。

477160.oracleText: From the barest crack in the ice, she teases forth a swirling, living map of the Cosmos.
477160.translation: 哪怕冰面只有一道光秃裂痕，她也能从其上闪转腾挪，演绎出一幅活灵活现的寰宇地图。

477161.oracleText: {oSi}, {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a snow card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.
477161.translation: {oSi}，{oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是雪境牌，则你可以展示该牌并将它置于你手上。

477163.oracleText: Some heroes line their coats with yeti fur. More yetis line their bellies with heroes.
477163.translation: 有些英雄用雪怪皮毛填充衣物。但更多雪怪用英雄尸体填饱肚子。

477164.oracleText: {o1oSi}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.

477167.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control a Giant or a Wizard.
477167.translation: 如果你操控巨人或法术师，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

477173.oracleText: This creature has hexproof as long as it's untapped.
477173.translation: 只要此生物未横置，它便具有辟邪异能。

477174.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+1 and has "This creature has hexproof as long as it's untapped."
477174.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+1且具有「只要此生物未横置，它便具有辟邪异能。」

477180.oracleText: The runes glow beneath the snow, bearing memories of a time when the old gods ruled the realms.
477180.translation: 石上符文记号在积雪底下闪耀光辉，记载着古神统领境域的远古记忆。

477181.oracleText: Scry X, where X is the amount of {oSi} spent to cast this spell, then draw three cards.
477181.translation: 占卜X，X为施放此咒语时支付过的{oSi}数量，然后抓三张牌。

477183.oracleText:
"Oh, Valki. I'm disappointed in you. How could the god of lies be so gullible?"
—Tibalt
477183.translation:
「噢，瓦尔基。你太令我失望了。你尊为谎言神，怎会如此容易受骗？」
～提勃

477189.oracleText: Return three snow lands you control to their owner's hand: Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
477189.translation: 将三个由你操控的雪境地移回其拥有者手上：将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

477192.oracleText: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.
477192.translation: 预兆觅径人编绘的每条径路，都深深蚀刻在她眼中。

477194.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, draw three cards if three or more creatures died this turn.
477194.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，如果本回合中有三个或更多生物死去，则抓三张牌。

477195.oracleText: When Inga Rune-Eyes dies, draw three cards if three or more creatures died this turn.
477195.translation: 当符眼茵嘉死去时，如果本回合中有三个或更多生物死去，则抓三张牌。

477197.oracleText: "This is a realm of the living. King Narfi's legion is coming to change that."
477197.translation: 「这里是生者的境域。但奈尔非国王的军团一到，就会将这点改写。」

477198.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to foretell a card from your hand or cast an instant or sorcery spell.
477198.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来从你手上预示牌，或是施放瞬间或法术咒语。

477200.oracleText: Like calls to like, and none are forgotten.

477206.oracleText: The Skelle raiders boasted that nothing could stop them, certainly not a bit of fog.
477206.translation: 斯凯尔劫掠者声称什么都挡不住他们，区区雾气更不在话下。

477208.oracleText:
"To escape Littjara, follow a bird."
—Tuskeri folklore
477208.translation:
「要离利雅拉，务必跟鸟走。」
～塔科力民间传说

477209.oracleText: {o1oU}: CARDNAME gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

477214.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, if it targets one or more other permanents you control, create a token that's a copy of one of those permanents.
477214.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，若该咒语以一个或数个由你操控的其他永久物为目标，则派出一个为其中任一永久物之复制品的衍生物。

477215.oracleText: When a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard this card, create a token that's a copy of target permanent.
477215.translation: 当由对手操控的咒语或异能使得你弃掉此牌时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标永久物的复制品。

477217.oracleText:
"Well, at least it left us a mouse in exchange. Er . . . ugh . . . make that half a mouse."
—Binhald, Beskir veteran
477217.translation:
「好吧，至少它还留了只老鼠当作交换。呃…呕…是半只老鼠。」
～贝斯奇老兵宾哈德

477218.oracleText: {oSi}, {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

477220.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature. Its controller creates a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying.
477220.translation: 放逐目标神器或生物。其操控者派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

477222.oracleText: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.
477222.translation: 面具顺流而下直达镜湖，湖中浮出面容欣然戴上。

477224.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen type, copy that spell.
477224.translation: 每当你施放该类别的咒语时，复制该咒语。

477226.oracleText:
"Which one of you slug-brained milksops forgot to make an offering to Cosima?"
—Jolkur, navigator
477226.translation:
「你们哪个无脑懦夫忘记供奉寇西玛了？」
～领航员乔克尔

477231.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it has flying.
477231.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便具有飞行异能。

477232.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is an Equipment, it has "Equipped creature has flying."
477232.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是武具，它便具有「佩带此武具的生物具有飞行异能。」

477235.oracleText: Alrund sees the future as a whorl of signs and symbols, omens interwoven in an intricate knotwork only he can decipher.
477235.translation: 艾朗德眼中的未来，是一个满是符号与标志的漩涡；各式预兆交织其间形成繁复编结，唯有他才能解读其中奥妙。

477237.oracleText:
"The currents are strange today, and the fish are fearful. Something's stirring in the depths."
—Rathstaf, Kannah fisherman
477237.translation:
「今日洋流有异，鱼群惊慌失措。海底可能有什么动静。」
～卡纳渔夫拉斯塔弗

477241.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy all creatures. 
• Destroy all planeswalkers.
477241.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭所有生物。 
•消灭所有鹏洛客。

477245.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME. It gains menace until end of turn.
477245.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

477252.oracleText: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.
477252.translation: 无尽风暴的恶魔涌入碧塔嘉一路烧杀，惊恐便如同野火一般迅速蔓延开来。

477253.oracleText: Choose a creature type. Creatures that aren't of the chosen type get -3/-3 until end of turn.
477253.translation: 选择一种生物类别。不为该类别的生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

477255.oracleText:
"Sven felled the elf with an arrow through the chest, but moments later, the corpse rose with a sneer to fight again."
—Longbeard Saga
477255.translation:
「斯温一箭射穿妖精胸膛将他放倒，但没过多久那具尸体便起身再战，脸上还带着一丝轻蔑笑容。」
～《长须传》

477256.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if its power was 3 or greater, create a 2/2 black Zombie Berserker creature token.
477256.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若它的力量等于或大于3，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／狂战士衍生生物。

477259.oracleText: It began as a flavor on the tongue, like a bloody morsel of roast boar—but soon the power was a conflagration in her veins.
477259.translation: 开始先是口中涌现血腥滋味，像是吃下一块渗血未熟透的烤野猪肉～但这股力量很快就烧遍周身经脉。

477260.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
477260.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

477261.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control."
477261.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。」

477263.oracleText: Kaya had stalked countless horrific foes, but never one that killed with such callous precision and twisted creativity.
477263.translation: 虽然卡娅也曾追踪过数不清的可怕敌手，但遇到下手如此精准而又别出心裁的却是头一遭。

477264.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
477264.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

477266.oracleText: If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, exile that card with an ice counter on it instead.
477266.translation: 如果某个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物将死去，则改为放逐该牌，且上面有一个寒冰指示物。

477267.oracleText: You may cast spells from among cards in exile your opponents own with ice counters on them, and you may spend mana from snow sources as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
477267.translation: 你可以从放逐区里由对手拥有且其上有寒冰指示物的牌之中施放咒语，且你可以将产自雪境来源之法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这类咒语的费用。

477269.oracleText: "You cannot stand against us, but when you fall, you will stand with us!"
477269.translation: 「你不是我们的对手，但等你死后，就会成为我们的帮手！」

477270.oracleText: Boast — {o3oB}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
477270.translation: 炫威～{o3oB}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

477275.oracleText:
"What kind of monstrous grave robber leaves the treasures, but takes the bodies?"
—Fjall, Beskir elder
477275.translation:
「哪门子的盗墓贼会把珍宝留下，而把尸体带走？」
～贝斯奇长老弗亚尔

477276.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Target opponent loses 3 life.
477276.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：目标对手失去3点生命。

477278.oracleText: Each nonland card in your hand without foretell has foretell. Its foretell cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {o2}.
477278.translation: 你手上每张不具预示的非地牌均具有预示异能。其预示费用等同于其法术力费用减{o2}。

477279.oracleText: Whenever you foretell a card, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
477279.translation: 每当你预示牌时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

477283.oracleText: Boast — {o1}: Target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
477283.translation: 炫威～{o1}：目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

477285.oracleText: Egon ages backward, his wisdom soured by youthful spite.
477285.translation: 埃甘的岁数随年头递减，其沉稳睿智也越来越受其年轻气盛的影响。

477286.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile two cards from your graveyard. If you can't, sacrifice Egon and draw a card.
477286.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从你的坟墓场放逐两张牌。若你无法如此作，则牺牲埃甘并抓一张牌。

477288.oracleText: It offers all the warmth and comfort of the grave.
477288.translation: 墓地的温度与体感之完美重现。

477289.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, mill a card.
477289.translation: 在你的维持开始时，磨一张牌。

477290.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Draw a card.
477290.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：抓一张牌。

477292.oracleText: "One day, the great serpent will rejoin us on Skemfar, and those who've wronged us will taste of our venom."
477292.translation: 「总有一天，伟大盘蛇将在斯肯法与我们重聚，届时所有伤害过我们的人都将尝到毒液滋味。」

477297.oracleText: Boast — {o1oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker.
477297.translation: 炫威～{o1oB}，牺牲一个生物：每位对手各牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客。

477299.oracleText: He spent the final moments of his existence tumbling down the length of the serpent's jaws, driven mad by the magnitude of the Cosmos.
477299.translation: 他生命最后光阴就在跌落盘蛇巨口后的下坠过程中度过，时间长到足以让他因寰宇之大而发狂。

477300.translation: 放逐目标生物或鹏洛客。

477302.oracleText: She was a ragged shadow of her living form, but she had lost none of her deadly prowess.
477302.translation: 如今只能从她残缺的阴影中瞥见她生前的样貌，不过她致命的本领一点没丢。

477303.oracleText: {o1oSi}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
477303.translation: {o1oSi}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

477306.oracleText: When the path to Starnheim was opened, vengeance rained down upon the enemies of Bretagard.
477306.translation: 通往斯达海姆的道路出现之时，复仇冰霜在碧塔嘉境敌人的头顶倾泻。

477307.oracleText: {oSioSi}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

477310.oracleText: Choose a creature type. Return up to two creature cards of that type from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was foretold, return all creature cards of that type from your graveyard to the battlefield instead.
477310.translation: 选择一种生物类别。将至多两张该类别的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。如果此咒语己预示，则改为将所有该类别的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

477313.oracleText:
"Here, my pet. Another little light for you to snuff out."
—Kzarakh, Immersturm gamekeeper
477313.translation:
「来，小可爱。也把这点光亮掐灭吧。」
～无尽风暴猎场看守人卡札剌

477314.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and it gains flying until end of turn.
477314.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

477320.oracleText: Trapped in a realm of dead flesh and scarce hunting, the ravenous wolves of Karfell follow the Dread Marn to warm game.
477320.translation: 卡尔费此境域满是不死生物，几乎无从狩猎；被困于此的贪食狼群只得跟随玛恩惧怖军来活动筋骨。

477324.oracleText: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."
477324.translation: 「伟大盘蛇，且听我一曲！吾人笃信如初，待你荣光归返。」

477325.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, each player mills three cards.
477325.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，每位牌手各磨三张牌。

477328.oracleText: Dark schemes cut down what armies cannot.
477328.translation: 阴谋能解决军队所解决不了的问题。

477329.oracleText: Destroy target creature. If this spell was foretold, scry 2.
477329.translation: 消灭目标生物。如果此咒语已预示，则占卜2。

477334.oracleText: "King Narfi calls. We go to war!"
477334.translation: 「奈尔非国王号令。我们征战沙场！」

477336.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If it's an Elf, create two 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens.
477336.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。如果它是妖精，则派出两个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

477339.oracleText: Create X 2/2 black Zombie Berserker creature tokens, where X is the number of nontoken creatures that died this turn.
477339.translation: 派出X个2/2黑色灵俑／狂战士衍生生物，X为本回合中死去之非衍生物的生物数量。

477343.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it has deathtouch.
477343.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便具有死触异能。

477344.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is an Equipment, it has "Equipped creature has deathtouch."
477344.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是武具，它便具有「佩带此武具的生物具有死触异能。」

477346.oracleText: Stripped of their divinity, the elves of Skemfar channeled their rage and sorrow into bloody brutality.
477346.translation: 斯肯法妖精原本崇拜的神明遭逐后，他们便借助血腥暴行来宣泄愤怒及悲恸。

477347.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken Elf or Berserker you control dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
477347.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的妖精或狂战士死去时，你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

477349.oracleText: Each opponent loses X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
477349.translation: 每位对手各失去X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

477350.oracleText: Each opponent loses X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
477350.translation: 每位对手各失去X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

477351.oracleText: You gain X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
477351.translation: 你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

477352.oracleText: You gain X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
477352.translation: 你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

477356.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards. If fewer than two cards were discarded this way, you draw cards equal to the difference.
477356.translation: 目标对手弃两张牌。如果以此法弃掉的牌少于两张，则你抓等同于该差距数量的牌。

477358.oracleText: Fear is her one true companion.

477359.oracleText: Whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent or discards a permanent card, you may put that card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
477359.translation: 每当任一对手牺牲一个非衍生物的永久物或弃一张永久物牌时，你可以将该牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

477361.oracleText: When Tergrid was a child, her shadow tried to kill her. Only her lantern keeps it at bay.
477361.translation: 在特格莉德年幼时，她的影子曾想置她于死地。唯靠手中提灯才令其无从近身。

477366.oracleText: Tergrid, god of fright, never acknowledges her own shadow . . . or its murderous deeds.
477366.translation: 惊惶神特格莉德从不承认自己有影子…也不承认其犯下的谋杀行径。

477372.oracleText: You may play cards exiled with Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
477372.translation: 你可以使用以寰宇冒名客提勃放逐的牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术为来支付施放这类咒语的费用。

477374.oracleText: Exile the top card of each player's library.
477374.translation: 放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌。

477379.oracleText: "I waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard."
477379.translation: 「我涉越火焰河流，以令死亡降临碧塔嘉。」

477383.oracleText: The Skelle raise scorn poles in conquered villages—cursed totems of wood and bone that sap survivors of physical strength and the will to fight back.
477383.translation: 斯凯尔人每征服一处村庄，都会在当地立起兽头棒～这种利用木棒与骨头制成的诅咒图腾像能够削弱幸存者的力气和反抗意志。

477385.oracleText: The draugr often drown intruders. Years later, their corpses rise from the depths to join the ranks of the Dread Marn.
477385.translation: 尸鬼通常会将入侵者沉入水底。多年之后，尸体便会浮出深渊，来为玛恩惧怖军效力。

477387.oracleText:
"We'll see each other again soon."
—Egon, god of death
477387.translation:
「我们很快会再见。」
～死亡神埃甘

477388.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life unless you sacrifice this creature.
477388.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你牺牲此生物，否则失去1点生命。

477389.oracleText: Enchanted creature has base power 0 and has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life unless you sacrifice this creature."
477389.translation: 所结附的生物之基础力量为0且具有「在你的维持开始时，除非你牺牲此生物，否则失去1点生命。」

477391.translation: 「巨魔挨了我一记头锤。我就赢了。」

477392.oracleText: Boast — {o1}: You may change CARDNAME's base power to 1 plus the greatest power among other creatures you control until end of turn.
477392.translation: 炫威～{o1}：你可以将CARDNAME的基础力量更改为「由你操控之其他生物中力量最大者的数值加1」直到回合结束。

477395.oracleText:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"
477395.translation:
骑羊当马
～矮人用语，意指
「愚勇之举」

477400.oracleText: "This is a tale to make all Kaldheim tremble . . ."
477400.translation: 「这个故事能让整个凯德海姆都为之一震…」

477401.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, add {oR}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
477401.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，加{oR}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

477402.oracleText: Creatures you control can boast twice during each of your turns rather than once.
477402.translation: 于你的每个回合中，由你操控的生物能够炫威两次，而不是一次。

477404.oracleText: Like her well of stories, Birgi's horn never runs dry.
477404.translation: 碧尔琪故事灵思如泉涌，她的觥号内蜜酒永不断。

477405.oracleText: Discard a card: Exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
477405.translation: 弃一张牌：放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

477407.oracleText: "Go for the knees! The last giant who tried to get past us got rolled back down the mountain in a dozen pieces."
477407.translation: 「照着膝盖砍过去！上一个想要跨过我们的巨人，就是被砍得滚落高山不得好死。」

477409.oracleText: He'd ignite the World Tree itself if he could.
477409.translation: 他恨不得去亲手把世界树点燃。

477410.oracleText: If a Giant source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage to that permanent or player instead.
477410.translation: 如果某个由你操控的巨人来源将对任一永久物或牌手造成伤害，则改为它对该永久物或牌手造成两倍的伤害。

477412.oracleText: What fire giants lack in arcane prowess, they make up for with reckless, explosive rage.
477412.translation: 火巨人并不善使奥术秘法，但他们会用鲁莽爆怒来弥补。

477413.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals 7 damage to a creature an opponent controls chosen at random.
477413.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它对随机选择之一个由对手操控的生物造成7点伤害。

477417.oracleText: Abandoned at birth, the giant was raised by goats. Ironically, it grew up to be the most cautious member of the herd.
477417.translation: 这巨人生来便被抛弃，此后便由山羊抚养至今。讽刺的是，长大后的他成了整个羊群中最小心的人。

477421.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
477421.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成2点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

477422.oracleText: Crush the Weak deals 2 damage to each creature. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
477422.translation: 碾压弱者对每个生物各造成2点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

477425.translation:
「把他们从天上烧下来。」
～威拉格斯

477426.oracleText: Demon Bolt deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
477426.translation: 恶魔电击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

477432.oracleText: Boast abilities you activate cost {o1} less to activate for each Dragon you control.
477432.translation: 你每操控一个龙，你起动的炫威异能便减少{o1}来起动。

477433.oracleText: Boast — {o4oR}: Create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.
477433.translation: 炫威～{o4oR}：派出一个5/5红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

477441.oracleText: Create two 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature tokens.
477441.translation: 派出两个2/1红色矮人／狂战士衍生生物。

477444.oracleText: "No one else had the spine for it, so I ran right between that giant's legs and hauled poor Valdir back to Axgard!"
477444.translation: 「眼看其他人都畏缩不前，于是我就看准巨人两腿之间的空档直冲过去，把可怜的瓦迪尔拖回了艾席嘉！」

477445.oracleText: Boast — {o2oR}: Create a 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token.
477445.translation: 炫威～{o2oR}：派出一个2/1红色矮人／狂战士衍生生物。

477448.oracleText: Boast — {o2oR}: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

477451.oracleText: "Arrogant maggot. You won't be so proud when I rip out your tongue and drink from your skull!"
477451.translation: 「你这些不自量力的蛆虫。等我把你的舌头扯下，把你的头当杯子来喝酒后，看你还有多神气！」

477452.oracleText: Whenever you activate a boast ability, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
477452.translation: 每当你起动炫威异能时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477455.oracleText:
"Don't wander far—it's a bit nippy out there!"
—Leidurr, expedition leader
477455.translation:
「别走太远～外面寒风有点刺骨！」
～探险队长蕾达儿

477456.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you control three or more snow permanents, it deals 3 damage instead.
477456.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果你操控三个或更多雪境永久物，则改为它造成3点伤害。

477457.oracleText: Frost Bite deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you control three or more snow permanents, it deals 3 damage instead.
477457.translation: 冰霜噬咬对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果你操控三个或更多雪境永久物，则改为它造成3点伤害。

477459.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or becomes the target of a spell, create a Treasure token.
477459.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或成为咒语的目标时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

477461.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add two mana of any one color.
477461.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。

477462.oracleText: Treasures you control have "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add two mana of any one color."
477462.translation: 由你操控的珍宝具有「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。」

477466.oracleText: Boast — {o1oR}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
477466.translation: 炫威～{o1oR}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

477469.oracleText: The demons took no captives and claimed no spoils; they sought only to destroy.
477469.translation: 恶魔不留俘虏，不取财物；他们只求破坏。

477472.translation: 由你操控的其他矮人得+1/+0。

477473.oracleText: Whenever a Dwarf you control becomes tapped, create a Treasure token.
477473.translation: 每当一个由你操控的矮人成为横置时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

477476.oracleText: Add two mana of any one color and two mana of any other color. Spend this mana only to cast creature or enchantment spells.
477476.translation: 加两点任一颜色的单色法术力，并加两点另一颜色的单色法术力。此法术力只能用来施放生物或结界咒语。

477477.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Add two mana of any one color and two mana of any other color. Spend this mana only to cast creature or enchantment spells. 
• Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
477477.translation:
选择一项～ 
•加两点任一颜色的单色法术力，并加两点另一颜色的单色法术力。此法术力只能用来施放生物或结界咒语。 
•由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

477479.oracleText:
"I like burning and pillaging as much as anyone, but sometimes it's just easier to throw a rock and let the trolls do the work."
—Urik, Tuskeri raid leader
477479.translation:
「我跟你们一样喜欢打砸抢烧，但有的时候丢颗石头出去让巨魔来代劳更方便。」
～塔科力突击团长乌力克

477480.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. If a creature is dealt damage this way, it gets +5/+0 until end of turn.
477480.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。如果某生物以此法受到伤害，则它得+5/+0直到回合结束。

477481.oracleText: Provoke the Trolls deals 3 damage to any target. If a creature is dealt damage this way, it gets +5/+0 until end of turn.
477481.translation: 激怒巨魔对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。如果某生物以此法受到伤害，则它得+5/+0直到回合结束。

477483.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent. This ability triggers only if CARDNAME is on the battlefield or if CARDNAME is in your graveyard and you control a Giant.
477483.translation: 在你的维持开始时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。此异能只有于CARDNAME在战场时或于CARDNAME在你坟墓场中且你操控巨人时才会触发。

477484.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, Quakebringer deals 2 damage to each opponent. This ability triggers only if Quakebringer is on the battlefield or if Quakebringer is in your graveyard and you control a Giant.
477484.translation: 在你的维持开始时，撼地狂汉向每位对手各造成2点伤害。此异能只有于撼地狂汉在战场时或于撼地狂汉在你坟墓场中且你操控巨人时才会触发。

477488.oracleText: Create X 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature tokens, where X is the number of Vehicles you control plus the number of Equipment you control. For each of those tokens, you may attach an Equipment you control to it.
477488.translation: 派出X个2/1红色矮人／狂战士衍生生物，X为由你操控的载具数量与由你操控的武具数量之总和。为每个这类衍生物各进行以下流程～你可以将一个由你操控的武具贴附于其上。

477489.oracleText:
"A Tuskeri never shrinks from battle! Quite the opposite in fact."
—Arni Brokenbrow
477489.translation:
「畏缩的不是塔科力人，是脚下战场。」
～断角亚尼

477492.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +1/+0 and has haste.
477492.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

477493.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is an Equipment, it has "Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has haste."
477493.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是武具，它便具有「佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。」

477495.oracleText: "Grab what you want and burn the rest. Leave nothing behind."
477495.translation: 「把想要的都带走，剩下的全烧掉。什么都别留下。」

477496.oracleText: Draw two cards and create a Treasure token.
477496.translation: 抓两张牌并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

477498.oracleText: In that instant, Toralf felt only the power of the storm and the need to destroy.
477498.translation: 在那一瞬间，托拉夫只感受到风暴的力量和破坏的渴望。

477499.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage, destroy target Equipment attached to it.
477499.translation: 每当此生物造成伤害时，消灭目标贴附在其上的武具。

477500.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it gains haste and "Whenever this creature deals damage, destroy target Equipment attached to it."
477500.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。直到回合结束，它获得敏捷异能与「每当此生物造成伤害时，消灭目标贴附在其上的武具。」

477502.oracleText:
"Who said there's no profit in destruction?"
—Magda, brazen outlaw
477502.translation:
「谁说破坏没好处？」
～莽勇狂徒玛格妲

477503.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or land. If an artifact is destroyed this way, create a Treasure token.
477503.translation: 消灭目标神器或地。如果以此法消灭的是神器，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

477505.oracleText: The troll had recently crushed a human in much the same way. Sadly, he expired too quickly to appreciate the irony.
477505.translation: 这巨魔最近刚以同样方式压扁了一个人类。可惜的是，他还没来得及感叹报应就咽了气。

477506.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you control a Giant.
477506.translation: 如果你操控巨人，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

477507.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
477507.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成6点伤害。

477508.oracleText: Squash deals 6 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
477508.translation: 压扁对目标生物或鹏洛客造成6点伤害。

477510.oracleText: Counter target spell. Choose 1, 2, or 3 at random. Its controller mills that many cards, then exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card with a different name than that spell. They may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then they put the exiled cards on the bottom of their library in a random order.
477510.translation: 反击目标咒语。随机选择1，2或3。其操控者磨等量的牌，然后从其牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张名称与该咒语不相同的非地牌为止。他可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。然后他将所放逐的牌以随机顺序置于其牌库底。

477512.oracleText: Whenever a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls is dealt excess noncombat damage, Toralf deals damage equal to the excess to any target other than that permanent.
477512.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客受到过量之非战斗伤害时，托拉夫对任意一个该永久物以外的目标造成等同于该过量数额的伤害。

477514.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Unattach Toralf's Hammer: It deals 3 damage to any target. Return Toralf's Hammer to its owner's hand.
477514.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，将托拉夫之锤卸装：托拉夫之锤对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。将托拉夫之锤移回其拥有者手上。

477515.oracleText: Equipped creature has "{o1oR}, {oT}, Unattach Toralf's Hammer: It deals 3 damage to any target. Return Toralf's Hammer to its owner's hand."
477515.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「{o1oR}，{oT}，将托拉夫之锤卸装：托拉夫之锤对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。将托拉夫之锤移回其拥有者手上。」

477516.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+0 as long as it's legendary.
477516.translation: 只要佩带此武具的生物是传奇，它便得+3/+0。

477519.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to defending player.
477519.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物被阻挡时，它对防御牌手造成1点伤害。

477521.oracleText: The only thing that smells worse than troll is burnt troll.
477521.translation: 比巨魔更难闻的，就只有烧焦了的巨魔。

477522.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Add {oC} for each {oSi} spent to cast this spell. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
477522.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。施放此咒语时每支付过一点{oSi}，便加{oC}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

477523.oracleText: Tundra Fumarole deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Add {oC} for each {oSi} spent to cast this spell. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
477523.translation: 苔原火孔对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。施放此咒语时每支付过一点{oSi}，便加{oC}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

477525.oracleText: "Toralf blessed me with fire. I am worthy of Starnheim!"
477525.translation: 「托拉夫以火光为我祝福。我够格荣升斯达海姆！」

477526.oracleText: Boast — {o1}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
477526.translation: 炫威～{o1}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

477528.oracleText: The dwarves believe works of art should be passed down the generations, not buried with the dead.
477528.translation: 矮人觉得工艺品应该代代相传，而不是和死人埋在一起。

477529.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a Treasure token.
477529.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

477531.oracleText: Deep within endless webs of clinging silk, the weaver waits.
477531.translation: 在无尽缠丝组成的层层罗网深处，编织者在静静等待猎物落网。

477532.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2, has reach, and is every creature type.
477532.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2，具有延势异能，且是所有生物类别。

477534.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw a card.
477534.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以抓一张牌。

477537.oracleText: A friend of Jorn is never cold.
477537.translation: 约恩的朋友永远不会觉得寒冷。

477538.oracleText: Distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of creatures you control, where X is the amount of {oSi} spent to cast this spell. Then draw a card for each creature you control with power 4 or greater.
477538.translation: 将X个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量由你操控的生物，X为施放此咒语时支付过的{oSi}数量。然后你每操控一个力量等于或大于4的生物，便抓一张牌。

477540.oracleText: Choose target creature you control and target creature you don't control. If you control three or more snow permanents, the creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn. Then those creatures fight each other.
477540.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物和目标不由你操控的生物。如果你操控三个或更多雪境永久物，则直到回合结束，该由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。然后这些生物互斗。

477543.oracleText:
"Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely. When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true."
—Saga of the Wisdom Seeker
477543.translation:
「芬恩爬上山峰之巅，在此静心等候。他屏息凝神丝毫不动，直到落雪覆遍周身与山脉同成白皑一体。正当巨鹰飞过之时，他准确出手命中目标。」
～《智者传》

477545.oracleText: "Our ancestors grew complacent in their divinity, allowing their lessers to topple them. Never again."
477545.translation: 「我们的祖先高居神位却骄纵自满，让逆贼得以篡位夺势。绝不容许此事再度发生。」

477550.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+2 and has reach.
477550.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+2且具有延势异能。

477553.oracleText: {o5oGoG}: Elves you control get +2/+2 and gain deathtouch until end of turn.
477553.translation: {o5oGoG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的妖精得+2/+2且获得死触异能。

477555.oracleText: "I know this world, from canopy to roots."
477555.translation: 「从树根到树梢，我通晓这世界每处角落。」

477556.oracleText: Other legendary creatures you control have vigilance and "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
477556.translation: 由你操控的其他传奇生物具有警戒异能与「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

477559.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature or planeswalker card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
477559.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张生物或鹏洛客牌为止。将该牌放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

477563.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
477563.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控之衍生物的复制品。

477564.oracleText: Whenever Esika's Chariot attacks, create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
477564.translation: 每当埃西卡的战车攻击时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控之衍生物的复制品。

477566.oracleText: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"
477566.translation: 「寇玛，来啊，来夺回你丢失的东西啊！难道伟大盘蛇会害怕与我再战一回？」

477569.oracleText: At last, the storm's rage subsided, leaving silent, frozen beauty in its wake.
477569.translation: 最后风暴消退，留下一片静谧的冰封美景。

477572.oracleText: Fed up with webs impeding travelers in other realms, Kolvori banished the giant spiders to Gnottvold, where their webs snare only the occasional rampaging troll.
477572.translation: 蔻沃莉在其他境域中看够了蛛网阻挡旅人的事情，于是她将巨型蜘蛛全都逐往诺特瓦，这样它们还能帮忙缠住偶尔发狂的巨魔。

477574.oracleText: "Sure, a horse might be faster. But I'd like to see a horse take the head clean off a troll in one swipe!"
477574.translation: 「没错，骑马也许是能快一点。但我倒想知道哪种马能一爪就把巨魔的脑袋给削下来！」

477576.oracleText: The raiders' only warning was a whisper floating through the mist: "Trespassers."
477576.translation: 劫掠者听到的唯一警告，就只是迷雾中传出的这句游荡幽声：「有入侵者。」

477579.oracleText: "A five-day climb? Ha! I'll do it in two."
477579.translation: 「你说要爬五天？哈！我两天就能登顶。」

477582.oracleText: A troll's greatest weapon is its ability to emerge unexpectedly from the landscape.
477582.translation: 巨魔最得意的武器，莫过于能从地表任何地方突然窜出的本事。

477583.oracleText: {oSioSi}: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
477583.translation: {oSioSi}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+2/+0且获得不灭异能。将之横置。

477588.oracleText: The arrows of the elvish elite strike as true and deadly as the fangs of the Cosmos Serpent they revere.
477588.translation: 妖精菁英射出的箭矢又准又狠，如同他们崇敬的寰宇盘蛇毒牙一般致命。

477592.oracleText: Whenever Jorn attacks, untap each snow permanent you control.
477592.translation: 每当约恩攻击时，重置所有由你操控的雪境永久物。

477595.oracleText: As the sagas tell it, Jorn collects a sliver of ice from every realm he visits.
477595.translation: 一如史记所述，约恩每到一处境域，就会收集一片当地的冰晶。

477598.oracleText: "We will destroy the pretenders and reclaim the divinity of the Einir."
477598.translation: 「我们必将消灭伪神，让妖精古神回归正位。」

477599.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+1 for each creature you control and gains trample. It must be blocked this turn if able.
477599.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能，且你每操控一个生物，它便得+1/+1。它本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

477601.oracleText: As long as you control three or more legendary creatures, Kolvori gets +4/+2 and has vigilance.
477601.translation: 只要你操控三个或更多传奇生物，蔻沃莉便得+4/+2且具有警戒异能。

477602.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a legendary creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
477602.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张传奇生物牌并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

477604.oracleText: Kolvori's love for her family knows no bounds.
477604.translation: 蔻沃莉对家族的爱永无止境。

477606.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG}. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell of the chosen type or a legendary creature spell.
477606.translation: {oT}：加{oG}。此法术力只能用来施放传奇生物咒语或所选类别的生物咒语。

477608.oracleText: In every tree, a restless spirit.
477608.translation: 每株树内，都有一个不息的灵魂。

477611.oracleText: Thus the longhall became a flathall.
477611.translation: 从此立会厅便成了评会厅。

477625.oracleText: {o2oWoUoBoRoG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You gain 2 life and draw two cards. Target opponent loses 2 life. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to up to one target creature. You create a 2/2 green Bear creature token.
477625.translation: {o2oWoUoBoRoG}，牺牲CARDNAME：你获得2点生命且抓两张牌。目标对手失去2点生命。CARDNAME对至多一个目标生物造成2点伤害。你派出一个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物。

477628.oracleText:
"I'm no coward, but I'd sooner tangle with a rampaging Torga troll than a hungry lindwurm!"
—Yegar, Beskir warrior
477628.translation:
「我不是懦夫，但我宁愿和莽闯的托尔嘉巨魔缠斗，也不愿遇上饥饿的鳞龙！」
～贝斯奇战士耶格尔

477632.oracleText: You may cast creature spells of the chosen type from the top of your library.
477632.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶施放该类别的生物咒语。

477634.oracleText:
"We are bound to wander this forest forever. Sometimes I think it wanders with us."
—Ogni, Kannah scout
477634.translation:
「我们怕是要在这树林里走上一辈子。有时候我觉得是树林在带着我们走。」
～卡纳斥候欧格妮

477638.oracleText: Though imprisoned in Jaspera trees, the elvish gods known as the Einir still whisper through the ages.
477638.translation: 虽然称作埃尼尔神族的妖精古神被禁锢在雅斯佩树中，但他们的低语依旧能穿越时代。

477639.oracleText: Mill three cards, then return a land card or Elf card from your graveyard to your hand. If you can't, draw a card.
477639.translation: 磨三张牌，然后将一张地牌或妖精牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果你无法如此作，则抓一张牌。

477642.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +1/+1 and has trample.
477642.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

477643.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is an Equipment, it has "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has trample."
477643.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是武具，它便具有「佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。」

477648.oracleText: "I and my kin remember the old ways. The frost whispers to me in a language too ancient for the Skoti usurpers to comprehend."
477648.translation: 「我和族人依旧记得古法。冰霜用着斯科提逆神一族无法理解的古老语言，向我述说一切。」

477651.oracleText: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."
477651.translation: 「巨蛇会边叫着边追踪猎物吗？不会。它们只是静等无知猎物送上门来。」

477652.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains hexproof until end of turn.
477652.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

477656.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each other snow permanent you control.
477656.translation: 你每操控一个其他雪境永久物，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

477659.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.
477659.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

477662.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
477662.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

477665.translation: 由你操控的妖精具有「{oT}：加{oB}。」

477666.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target Elf. Untap it. It gains deathtouch until end of turn.
477666.translation: 在至多一个目标妖精上放置一个+1/+1指示物。将之重置。它获得死触异能直到回合结束。

477667.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
477667.translation: 派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

477668.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Elf spell, it gains haste until end of turn and you draw two cards.
477668.translation: 每当你施放妖精咒语时，它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束且你抓两张牌。

477669.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast an Elf spell, it gains haste until end of turn and you draw two cards."
477669.translation: 你获得具有「每当你施放妖精咒语时，它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束且你抓两张牌」的徽记。

477672.oracleText: If you would put one or more counters on a permanent or player, put twice that many of each of those kinds of counters on that permanent or player instead.
477672.translation: 如果你将在某永久物或牌手上放置一个或数个指示物，则改为在该永久物或牌手上放置两倍数量的各种指示物。

477673.oracleText: If an opponent would put one or more counters on a permanent or player, they put half that many of each of those kinds of counters on that permanent or player instead, rounded down.
477673.translation: 如果对手将在某永久物或牌手上放置一个或数个指示物，则改为他在该永久物或牌手上放置一半数量的各种指示物，小数点后舍去。

477675.oracleText: Whenever a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls is dealt excess damage, if a Giant, Wizard, or spell you controlled dealt damage to it this turn, draw a card.
477675.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客受到过量伤害时，若本回合中有由你操控的巨人，法术师或咒语对它造成过伤害，则你抓一张牌。

477677.oracleText: Target creature you control fights up to one target creature you don't control.
477677.translation: 目标由你操控的生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

477678.oracleText: Add {oR}. Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature you control.
477678.translation: 加{oR}。在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

477679.oracleText: You gain life equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
477679.translation: 你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控的生物中力量最大者的数值。

477681.oracleText: Choose a creature you control. Until your next turn, all damage that would be dealt to creatures you control is dealt to that creature instead.
477681.translation: 选择一个由你操控的生物。直到你的下一个回合，所有将对由你操控之生物造成的伤害改为对该生物造成之。

477682.oracleText: Choose a creature you control. Until your next turn, all damage that would be dealt to creatures you control is dealt to that creature instead.
477682.translation: 选择一个由你操控的生物。直到你的下一个回合，所有将对由你操控之生物造成的伤害改为对该生物造成之。

477683.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it. That creature is an Angel Warrior in addition to its other types.
477683.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个飞行指示物。该生物额外具有天使与战士此两种类别。

477685.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token.
477685.translation: 派出一个1/1白色人类／战士衍生生物。

477686.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
477686.translation: 派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

477687.oracleText: Choose any number of artifact tokens and/or creature tokens you control with different names. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of it.
477687.translation: 选择任意数量由你操控的衍生神器和／或衍生生物，且其名称须各不相同。对每个这类衍生物而言，派出一个为前者之复制品的衍生物。

477689.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to each non-Giant creature and each planeswalker.
477689.translation: CARDNAME对每个非巨人生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。

477694.oracleText: Create a 2/2 blue Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
477694.translation: 派出一个2/2蓝色，具化形异能的变形兽衍生生物。

477695.oracleText: Any number of target Shapeshifter creatures you control have base power and toughness 4/4.
477695.translation: 选择任意数量目标由你操控的变形兽生物。它们的基础力量与防御力为4/4。

477696.oracleText: Choose up to one target creature or planeswalker. Each creature with power 4 or greater you control deals damage equal to its power to that permanent.
477696.translation: 选择至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客。每个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物各依本身力量对该永久物造成伤害。

477698.oracleText: Destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
477698.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控的非地永久物。

477700.oracleText: Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn.
477700.translation: 由你操控的生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

477702.oracleText: Create a 2/3 red Demon Berserker creature token with menace.
477702.translation: 派出一个2/3红色，具威慑异能的恶魔／狂战士衍生生物。

477703.oracleText: Whenever a Berserker attacks this turn, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
477703.translation: 本回合中，每当一个狂战士攻击时，你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

477704.oracleText: Add {oR} for each Berserker you control. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
477704.translation: 你每操控一个狂战士，便加{oR}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

477706.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature.
477706.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477707.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature.
477707.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477708.oracleText: Exile a creature with the greatest power among creatures target opponent controls.
477708.translation: 放逐一个由目标对手操控的生物，且须为这些生物中力量最大者。

477710.oracleText: She is both shepherd and reaper, and her judgment is final.
477710.translation: 既是护生使，又是索命官，她的裁决即刻定谳。

477711.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
477711.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

477713.oracleText: Create a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying and vigilance.
477713.translation: 派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使／战士衍生生物。

477714.oracleText: {oT}: Destroy target creature with power less than this creature's power.
477714.translation: {oT}：消灭目标力量小于此生物的生物。

477715.oracleText: Until end of turn, Angels you control gain "{oT}: Destroy target creature with power less than this creature's power."
477715.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的天使获得「{oT}：消灭目标力量小于此生物的生物。」

477716.oracleText: Angels you control gain double strike until end of turn.
477716.translation: 由你操控的天使获得连击异能直到回合结束。

477725.oracleText: Mill three cards. You may put an Elf or Tyvar card from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
477725.translation: 磨三张牌。你可以将一张妖精或泰瓦牌从你的坟墓场放进战场。

477726.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Elf you control.
477726.translation: 在每个由你操控的妖精上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477727.oracleText: Whenever an Elf you control attacks this turn, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
477727.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的妖精攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

477729.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, exile up to one target card from a graveyard and put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
477729.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐并在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477731.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
477731.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

477734.oracleText: Draw a card. Then you may reveal a Giant card from your hand. When you do, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
477734.translation: 抓一张牌。然后你可以从你手上展示一张巨人牌。当你如此作时，CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

477736.oracleText: The next Giant spell you cast this turn costs {o2} less to cast.
477736.translation: 你于本回合中施放的下一个巨人咒语减少{o2}来施放。

477740.oracleText: Whenever an attacking creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
477740.translation: 每当一个进行攻击的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

477742.oracleText: You may sacrifice a creature. When you do, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
477742.translation: 你可以牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

477745.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a +1/+1 counter on it. It gains haste until your next turn.
477745.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得敏捷异能直到你的下一个回合。

477747.oracleText: When this creature dies or is put into exile, return it to its owner's hand and create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
477747.translation: 当此生物死去或进入放逐区时，将它移回其拥有者手上并派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

477748.oracleText: Put a ghostform counter on up to one target nontoken creature. It gains "When this creature dies or is put into exile, return it to its owner's hand and create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying."
477748.translation: 在至多一个目标非衍生物的生物上放置一个魂体指示物。它获得「当此生物死去或进入放逐区时，将它移回其拥有者手上并派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。」

477750.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may cast a legendary spell from your hand, from your graveyard, or from among cards you own in exile without paying its mana cost.
477750.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以从你手上，你的坟墓场或放逐区里由你拥有的牌之中施放一个传奇咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

477751.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may cast a legendary spell from your hand, from your graveyard, or from among cards you own in exile without paying its mana cost."
477751.translation: 你获得具有「在你的维持开始时，你可以从你手上，你的坟墓场或放逐区里由你拥有的牌之中施放一个传奇咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用」的徽记。

477753.oracleText: Each player mills four cards. Then you may exile a creature or planeswalker card from each graveyard.
477753.translation: 每位牌手各磨四张牌。然后你可以从每个坟墓场各放逐一张生物或鹏洛客牌。

477754.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among cards exiled with CARDNAME, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
477754.translation: 直到回合结束，你可以从以CARDNAME放逐的牌之中施放咒语，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这类咒语的费用。

477756.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among cards exiled with CARDNAME, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
477756.translation: 直到回合结束，你可以从以CARDNAME放逐的牌之中施放咒语，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这类咒语的费用。

477759.oracleText: Using tyrite from a fallen Cosmos monster, Koll forged a weapon to awe Halvar himself.
477759.translation: 为能亲自折服哈尔瓦，寇尔利用从死去寰宇怪物体内提炼的钛晶打造出一把绝世神兵。

477760.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, if it was enchanted or equipped, return it to its owner's hand.
477760.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，若它受有灵气或佩带武具，则将它移回其拥有者手上。

477761.oracleText: Creature tokens you control that are enchanted or equipped get +1/+1.
477761.translation: 由你操控且受有灵气或佩带武具的衍生生物得+1/+1。

477763.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 3/3 blue Serpent creature token named Koma's Coil.
477763.translation: 在每个维持开始时，派出一个3/3蓝色，名称为寇玛缠蛇的巨蛇衍生生物。

477764.oracleText: Tap target permanent. Its activated abilities can't be activated this turn.
477764.translation: 横置目标永久物。本回合中其起动式异能不能起动。

477765.oracleText: Tap target permanent. Its activated abilities can't be activated this turn.
477765.translation: 横置目标永久物。本回合中其起动式异能不能起动。

477766.oracleText: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
477766.translation: CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

477768.oracleText:
Sacrifice another Serpent: Choose one — 
• Tap target permanent. Its activated abilities can't be activated this turn. 
• CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
477768.translation:
牺牲另一个巨蛇：选择一项～ 
•横置目标永久物。本回合中其起动式异能不能起动。 
•CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

477771.oracleText: "Our enemies have breached our realm. To survive, the clans must fight as one!"
477771.translation: 「我境已遭外敌入侵。若想要活下来，各部落必须团结迎战！」

477777.oracleText: To serve the god of death, Narfi forfeited the warmth of life.
477777.translation: 为能侍奉死亡之神，奈尔非甚至抛弃了生命的温暖。

477778.oracleText: Other snow and Zombie creatures you control get +1/+1.
477778.translation: 由你操控的其他雪境生物与灵俑生物得+1/+1。

477785.oracleText: Up to one target creature you control can't be blocked this turn. Whenever that creature deals damage this turn, return it to its owner's hand.
477785.translation: 至多一个目标由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。本回合中，每当该生物造成伤害时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

477786.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target tapped creature for each card you've drawn this turn.
477786.translation: 选择目标已横置的生物。你本回合中每抓过一张牌，CARDNAME便对它造成2点伤害。

477787.oracleText: Niko Aris deals 2 damage to target tapped creature for each card you've drawn this turn.
477787.translation: 选择目标已横置的生物。你本回合中每抓过一张牌，尼科阿理斯便对它造成2点伤害。

477790.oracleText: You gain 2 life for each foretold card you own in exile.
477790.translation: 放逐区中每有一张由你拥有且已预示的牌，你便获得2点生命。

477791.oracleText: Add {oWoU}. Spend this mana only to foretell cards or cast spells that have foretell.
477791.translation: 加{oWoU}。此法术力只能用来预示牌，或是施放具有预示异能的咒语。

477792.oracleText: Return target card with foretell from your graveyard to your hand.
477792.translation: 将目标具预示异能的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

477794.oracleText: Create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying. You gain 2 life.
477794.translation: 派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。你获得2点生命。

477795.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control with flying deal combat damage to a player this turn, look at that player's hand and draw a card.
477795.translation: 本回合中，每当一个或数个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视该牌手的手牌且你抓一张牌。

477796.oracleText: You may put a card you own from outside the game on top of your library.
477796.translation: 你可以将一张由你拥有的牌从游戏外置于你的牌库顶。

477798.oracleText: Whenever a permanent an opponent controls is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
477798.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的永久物从战场进入坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477802.oracleText: Exile the top four cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
477802.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的四张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

477803.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
477803.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放咒语时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477804.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
477804.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放咒语时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477806.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Create a colorless snow artifact token named Icy Manalith with "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
477806.translation: {o3}，{oT}：派出一个无色，名称为寒冰魔巨石的衍生雪境神器，且具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

477807.oracleText: {o6oRoG}, {oT}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may cast a spell from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
477807.translation: {o6oRoG}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以从其中施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

477810.oracleText: Return up to two target snow permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.
477810.translation: 将至多两张目标雪境永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

477811.oracleText: Choose three cards in each graveyard. Their owners shuffle those cards into their libraries.
477811.translation: 从每个坟墓场中各选择三张牌。其拥有者将这些牌洗入各自的牌库。

477813.oracleText: You may exchange control of two target creatures.
477813.translation: 选择两个目标生物。你可以交换两者的操控权。

477814.oracleText: You may exchange control of two target nonbasic, noncreature permanents that share a card type.
477814.translation: 选择两个目标具共通牌张类别的非基本且非生物永久物。你可以交换两者的操控权。

477815.oracleText: Target player loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
477815.translation: 目标牌手失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

477817.oracleText: One eye sees the past, one the present, and one the future—and none can be deceived.
477817.translation: 一眼看向过去，一眼紧盯现在，一眼预视将来～每只眼睛都能洞悉真相。

477818.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, draw a card.
477818.translation: 每当你从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，抓一张牌。

477821.oracleText: Put target land card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
477821.translation: 将目标地牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

477822.oracleText: Choose target opponent. If they control fewer lands than you, create a number of 4/4 green Troll Warrior creature tokens with trample equal to the difference.
477822.translation: 选择目标对手。如果其操控的地比你少，则你派出等同于该差距数量之4/4绿色，具践踏异能的巨魔／战士衍生生物。

477828.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, add {oWoWoW} and you gain 3 life. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
477828.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，加{oWoWoW}且你获得3点生命。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

477831.oracleText: The Skoti owe their immortality to the elixir, and the manner of its creation is their most closely guarded secret.
477831.translation: 斯科提神族正是靠此琼浆得享永生，因此对其提炼方式三缄其口，唯恐秘密旁落。

477832.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, draw a card if your life total is greater than your starting life total. Otherwise, you gain 2 life.
477832.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，如果你的总生命大于你的起始总生命，则抓一张牌。若否，则你获得2点生命。

477834.oracleText:
"Cast onto the windless water, he drifted until the sea turned to sky."
—Saga of the Lost King
477834.translation:
「随舟漂流无风洋，逐波沧海变蓝天。」
～《先王传》

477837.oracleText: Creatures you control are every creature type. The same is true for creature spells you control and creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
477837.translation: 由你操控的生物是所有生物类别。由你操控的生物咒语和由你拥有且不在战场上的生物牌也是如此。

477838.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Create a 2/2 blue Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
477838.translation: {o3}，{oT}：派出一个2/2蓝色，具化形异能的变形兽衍生生物。

477842.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped.
477842.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。

477845.oracleText:
"There are some places even our ships cannot travel. I would know their secrets too."
—Inga Rune-Eyes
477845.translation:
「世界上还有我们航遍天涯也到不了之处。而我也想知晓存于该处的秘密。」
～符眼茵嘉

477846.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0, has flying, and is a Bird in addition to its other types.
477846.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0，具有飞行异能，且额外具有鸟此类别。

477848.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a night counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has eight or more night counters on it, remove all of them and create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
477848.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个夜晚指示物。然后若其上有八个或更多夜晚指示物，则移去所有此类指示物，并派出八个无色，名称为受造指环的衍生雪境神器，且具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

477854.oracleText: It remembers every wound it has seen or suffered—and nothing else.
477854.translation: 它记得自己见过或受过的所有创伤～除此之外眼中别无他物。

477857.oracleText: Nonland permanent cards in graveyards and libraries can't enter the battlefield.
477857.translation: 坟墓场和牌库中的非地永久物牌不能进战场。

477859.oracleText:
"Here perished Rognar the Reckless after his hundred-day battle with the Ironmaw Dragon. We raised these stones to mark his resting place."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477859.translation:
「勇莽洛格纳在与铁口巨龙大战百日之后咽气于此。我们在他安息之处周围设立石碑以资纪念。」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477862.oracleText:
"When the Light of Starnheim shines here, every frost-edged needle glitters with the reflected glory of the Cosmos."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477862.translation:
「一旦斯达海姆之光照耀此地，覆霜草叶尖端全都染上亮泽，共同闪烁寰宇荣辉。」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477869.oracleText:
"Listen! The trees tell tales of their ancestors in the whisper-song of leaves."
—Inga Rune-Eyes
477869.translation:
「仔细听！落叶扑簌成曲，树木正借此歌颂先祖传说。」
～符眼茵嘉

477871.oracleText:
"Trust in the path, and it will bear you to safety."
—Inga Rune-Eyes
477871.translation:
「相信径路，它便会将你带至安全之所。」
～符眼茵嘉

477873.oracleText:
"The waters smell oddly sweet, but do not be enticed. You don't want to meet what lurks below the surface."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior
477873.translation:
「此处池水虽散发出奇异甜美气息，但切勿受其迷惑。你不会想遇上藏身水面下的东西。」
～贝斯奇战士索兰

477875.oracleText:
"Our brave Tuskeri brethren blaze new trails, and we follow, mapping the routes of those who survive."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior
477875.translation:
「我们勇敢的塔科力兄弟开辟出新的路径，而我们跟随而上，沿着幸存者的脚步绘出行路地图。」
～贝斯奇战士索兰

477881.oracleText:
"Hush, and stay still. No matter how dreary the darkness, a light in the Skelle Mire is never a good sign."
—Haugar, Kannah wayfinder
477881.translation:
「嘘，站定别动。尽管置身死寂般黑暗并不好受，但在斯凯尔泥沼见到亮光绝不是什么好兆头。」
～卡纳引路人豪格

477883.oracleText:
"The Cosmos Serpent carved these tunnels, and his echo remains, a twisting aura of ferocity and boundless growth."
—Haugar, Kannah wayfinder
477883.translation:
「这些隧道乃是由寰宇盘蛇辟就，因此带来的扭曲影响依旧回荡其间，引致万物迅猛成长永不停歇。」
～卡纳引路人豪格

477885.oracleText: It is everywhere and nowhere, a place unbound by logic, just beyond the real.
477885.translation: 这里既是所有地方，又不是任何地方；它不受逻辑束缚，乃是一处超越实界的存在。

477886.oracleText: {oSioSioSi}: CARDNAME becomes a 4/3 creature with vigilance and all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.
477886.translation: {oSioSioSi}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为4/3，具警戒异能的生物且具有所有生物类别。它仍然是地。

477890.oracleText: {o2oWoUoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You gain 2 life and draw two cards.
477890.translation: {o2oWoUoU}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：你获得2点生命且抓两张牌。

477893.oracleText:
"A cliff once rose from the surf here—until Bjora Dawn-Greeter declared that it was blocking her view and pulled it down bare-handed."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477893.translation:
「此处波涛拍岸，经年累月曾积起高耸冰崖～但有天报晓者碧约拉嫌它妨碍视线，便徒手将其夷为平地。」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477897.oracleText: {o3oRoGoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target land. Create a 4/4 green Troll Warrior creature token with trample.
477897.translation: {o3oRoGoG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标地。派出一个4/4绿色，具践踏异能的巨魔／战士衍生生物。

477904.oracleText:
"I cannot read these runes, yet somehow they seem like a warning. Have we passed unknowingly into a new realm?"
—Ekken, Omenseeker navigator
477904.translation:
「我读不懂这些文字，但它们看起来像是某种警告。难道我们在不知不觉间来到了新的境域？」
～预兆觅径人领航员埃肯

477906.oracleText:
"I've never seen mist so unnaturally thick as this—where does the sea end and the sky begin?"
—Ekken, Omenseeker navigator
477906.translation:
「我从未见过如此不自然的浓雾～大海止于何方，天空又始于何处？」
～预兆觅径人领航员埃肯

477908.oracleText:
"Tread carefully! The last time I walked this path, half the snowdrifts were, in fact, sleeping trolls. I've never run so fast in my life!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477908.translation:
「下脚的时候当心点！我上次走这条路时，这里至少有一半的雪堆是熟睡的巨魔。我这辈子从没跑得那么快！」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477911.oracleText:
"The ice cracked underfoot; strange shapes swam beneath the surface. Who else has walked this blighted path?"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477911.translation:
「冰面在脚下裂开，奇异形体在水底游动。你们还有谁走过这条诅咒之路？」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477923.oracleText: {o3oUoBoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Mill four cards, then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
477923.translation: {o3oUoBoB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：磨四张牌，然后将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

477926.oracleText:
"For a fortnight, our warband lay still beneath the icy waters, breathing through reeds as we waited for the great bear to appear."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477926.translation:
「我们的部队整整在此埋伏了十四天，隐身于寒冷彻骨的水面之下借助苇杆呼吸，静静等待巨熊出现。」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477929.oracleText: Reflections from the wind-sculpted snow gleam with every color of the rainbow.
477929.translation: 寒风塑造的多样积雪折射出彩虹的斑斓光辉。

477937.oracleText:
"Young Vitima bellowed to the Cosmos, daring the gods to punish her hubris! Well, she got their attention, as you can see."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477937.translation:
「年轻的维提玛曾向寰宇狂啸，想看看自己的无礼行为会不会受到诸神惩罚。正如你们所见，诸神听到了她的要求。」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477940.oracleText:
"In my youth, we used to best each other at hopping rabbit-fast between the lava spouts, the burning tar spattering our legs."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477940.translation:
「年轻的时候，我们曾把岩浆口当作格子比谁能跳得更快，全然不顾飞溅到腿上的滚烫焦油。」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477947.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Target legendary creature becomes a God in addition to its other types. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
477947.translation: {o2}，{oT}：目标传奇生物成为神，且仍具有原本类别。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

477948.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put an indestructible counter on target God.
477948.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：在目标神上放置一个不灭指示物。

477951.oracleText:
"I watched with my own eyes as Jari Eagle-Caller fell from these cliffs, only to be snatched from the air by a giant bird!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477951.translation:
「我曾亲眼见到唤鹰师耶力从峭壁顶端跌落，不过转眼之间就有只大鸟从天而降把他接住！」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477954.oracleText:
"Is this the grave of a god? A tunnel carved by the Cosmos Serpent? It matters not. It is no place for us."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller
477954.translation:
「这里是神的墓地？还是寰宇盘蛇辟出的隧道？这些都不重要。我只知道这里不属于我们。」
～卡纳说书人伊斯琴

477958.oracleText: As long as you control six or more lands, lands you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
477958.translation: 只要你操控六个或更多地，由你操控的地便具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

477962.oracleText: Where she flies, the Light of Starnheim shines.
477962.translation: 她翅翼所及，便是斯达海姆光芒耀威之地。

477963.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained 4 or more life this turn, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
477963.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得了4点或更多生命，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使衍生生物。

477965.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a Giant card from your hand or pay {o2}.
477965.translation: 从你手上展示一张巨人牌或支付{o2}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

477966.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
477966.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从你手上施放一张瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

477969.oracleText: "I won't pollute my blade with your blood, demon. You'll die by your own axe!"
477969.translation: 「恶魔，我不会让你的污血沾染我的宝剑；而会用你的利斧来取你性命！」

477974.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target. If the sacrificed creature was a Giant, CARDNAME deals twice that much damage instead.
477974.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。若所牺牲的生物是巨人，则改为CARDNAME造成该数量两倍的伤害。

477977.oracleText: "Death and life are two ends of the same spear."

477979.oracleText: The dwarves of Axgard seldom have reason to leave their impregnable underground kingdom—but when they do, they go in force.
477979.translation: 艾席嘉矮人平时不常需要离开自己坚不可摧的地底王国～当他们真有需要时，必会武装稳妥。

477980.oracleText: Vehicles you control become artifact creatures until end of turn. Choose a Dwarf you control. Attach any number of Equipment you control to it.
477980.translation: 由你操控的载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。选择一个由你操控的矮人。将任意数量由你操控的武具贴附于其上。

477982.oracleText: "I do not fear death. I know my soul will rise to Starnheim, where I will feast forever among valkyries and heroes. Can you say the same?"
477982.translation: 「我并不惧怕死亡。我知道自己的灵魂必将荣升斯达海姆，同女武神与众英雄永享盛筵。你可有此等自信？」

477983.oracleText: Angel spells you cast cost {o2} less to cast.
477983.translation: 你施放的天使咒语减少{o2}来施放。

477985.oracleText: "Who will be the hero of my tale?"

477986.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, if it's enchanted or equipped, create a 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token.
477986.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，若它受有灵气或佩带武具，则派出一个2/1红色矮人／狂战士衍生生物。

477989.oracleText: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.
477989.translation: 年轻女武神必须先了解宗祖的千则传说，才有机会成为斯达海姆盛筵主宾。
