477993.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. You may have Shapeshifters you control become copies of that creature until end of turn.
477993.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。你可以使由你操控的变形兽都成为该生物的复制品直到回合结束。

477995.oracleText: "Behave and you'll be a fine pet. Bite me and you're ammunition."
477995.translation: 「要是听话，我就把你好好养着。敢要乱咬，我就把你扔得远远。」

477996.translation: 结附于由你操控的巨人

478000.oracleText: Her fingers stiffened as the shrouded corpse stirred. Her final, ragged breath was one of triumph. "Return, my chosen, and grant our people victory!"
478000.translation: 随着裹尸布下的尸体开始扭动，她的指节动作逐渐变得僵硬。当她咽下最后一口气时，脸上露出成功的喜悦：「回来吧，受福者，带领人民走向胜利！」

478001.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target Elf card from your graveyard to your hand.
478001.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一张目标妖精牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

478007.oracleText: Remove X counters from target permanent, where X is the number of Elves you control.
478007.translation: 从目标永久物上移去X个指示物，X为由你操控的妖精数量。

478008.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Elves you control.
478008.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的妖精数量。

478009.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Elves you control.
478009.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的妖精数量。

478013.oracleText: Every dwarven artisan spends the first hundred years of their life forging a single weapon and infusing it with runic magic.
478013.translation: 每位矮人工匠的一生，都会先花上百年时间来打造一柄无双精兵，并将符文魔法灌注其中。

478014.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each Dwarf, Equipment, and/or Vehicle you control.
478014.translation: 你每操控一个矮人，武具和／或载具，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

478016.oracleText: So ended the feast, the hall, and the clan.
478016.translation: 盛宴就此付之一炬，连同大厅和整个部落。

478017.oracleText: Target Giant you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn. Whenever it deals combat damage to a player this turn, exile that many cards from the top of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
478017.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的巨人得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。本回合中，每当它对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你的牌库顶放逐等量的牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

478022.oracleText:
"No elf can match a Tuskeri in combat. Why not charge?"
—Knorjolvin, Tuskeri raider
478022.translation:
「塔科力人单挑一定赢妖精。直接冲锋不就好了？」
～塔科力突击兵诺约尔温

478027.oracleText: "This is a foul place. Cleanse it."

478038.oracleText: Target an artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls.
478038.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的神器、生物或结界为目标。

478039.oracleText: Exile any number of non-Angel creatures you control?
478039.translation: 是否要放逐任意数量由你操控的非天使生物？

478041.oracleText: Attach target Aura or Equipment attached to a creature you control to target creature you control?
478041.translation: 是否要将目标贴附于由你操控之生物上的灵气或武具，贴附于目标由你操控的生物上？

478042.oracleText: Target an Aura or Equipment attached to a creature you control.
478042.translation: 指定一个贴附在由你操控之生物上的灵气或武具为目标。

478044.translation: 是否要放逐另一张生物牌？

478045.oracleText: Target up to one attacking or blocking creature.
478045.translation: 指定至多一个进行攻击或阻挡的生物为目标。

478046.oracleText: Target an Aura or Equipment card.
478046.translation: 指定一张灵气或武具牌为目标。

478047.oracleText: Put that card into their graveyard?
478047.translation: 是否要将该牌置入他的坟墓场？

478048.oracleText: Return three snow lands you control to their owner's hand.
478048.translation: 将三个由你操控的雪境地移回其拥有者手上。

478049.oracleText: Target two creature cards that share a creature type.
478049.translation: 指定两张具共通生物类别的生物牌为目标。

478050.oracleText: Put that card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control?
478050.translation: 是否要将该牌在你的操控下从坟墓场移回战场？

478054.oracleText: Search for an artifact or Dragon card.
478054.translation: 搜寻一张神器牌或龙牌。

478057.oracleText: Target an Equipment attached to it.
478057.translation: 指定一个贴附在它上的武具为目标。

478058.translation: 指定一个由你操控的衍生物为目标。

478060.translation: 结附于由你操控的树林

478061.oracleText: Search for a creature card with power or toughness 6 or greater.
478061.translation: 搜寻一张力量等于或大于6的生物牌。

478062.oracleText: Return a land card or Elf card to your hand.
478062.translation: 将一张地牌或妖精牌移回你手上。

478063.translation: 指定还多一个妖精为目标。

478065.oracleText: Target any number of Shapeshifter creatures you control.
478065.translation: 指定任意数量由你操控的变形兽生物为目标。

478066.oracleText: Whenever a Berserker attacks this turn, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
478066.translation: 本回合中，每当一个狂战士攻击时，你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

478067.oracleText: Exile a creature with the greatest power among creatures target opponent controls.
478067.translation: 放逐一个由目标对手操控的生物，且须为这些生物中力量最大者。

478068.oracleText: Target a creature with power less than this creature.
478068.translation: 指定一个力量等于或小于此生物的生物为目标。

478069.oracleText: Whenever an Elf you control attacks this turn, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
478069.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的妖精攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

478070.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
478070.translation: CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

478071.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
478071.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

478072.oracleText: Whenever that creature deals damage this turn, return it to its owner's hand.
478072.translation: 本回合中，每当该生物造成伤害时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

478073.oracleText: Put a card you own into your library?
478073.translation: 是否要将一张由你拥有的牌置于你手上？

478074.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
478074.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放咒语时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

478075.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
478075.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放咒语时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

478076.oracleText: Target up to two snow permanent cards.
478076.translation: 指定至多两张雪境永久物牌为目标。

478077.oracleText: Choose three cards in each graveyard.
478077.translation: 选择每个坟墓场中的三张牌。

478078.oracleText: Exchange control of two target nonbasic, noncreature permanents that share a card type?
478078.translation: 是否要交换两个目标具共通牌张类别的非基本且非生物永久物的操控权？

478079.oracleText: Target two nonbasic, noncreature permanents that share a card type.
478079.translation: 指定两个具共通牌张类别的非基本且非生物永久物为目标。

478080.oracleText: Search for an Aura card and/or an Equipment card.
478080.translation: 搜寻一张灵气牌和／或武具牌。

478081.oracleText: Sacrifice {1, CardId} and a creature you control.
478081.translation: 牺牲{1, CardId}和一个你操控的生物。

478082.oracleText: Search for any number of God cards.

478084.translation: 指定一个由你操控的巨人为目标。

478085.translation: 指定一张妖精牌为目标。

478086.oracleText: Whenever it deals combat damage to a player this turn, exile that many cards from the top of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
478086.translation: 本回合中，每当它对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你的牌库顶放逐等量的牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

478088.translation: 指定一个由你操控的树林为目标。

478091.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. It gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each card named Compound Fracture in your graveyard.
478091.translation: 目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。你的坟墓场中每有一张名称为复合性骨折的牌，该生物便额外得-1/-1直到回合结束。

478103.translation: 是否要选择一张生物牌？

479158.oracleText: It deals that much damage to any target.
479158.translation: 它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害

479159.translation: 是否要支付任意数量的{oR}？

479160.oracleText: Choose any amount of {oR} to pay.

479164.translation: 是否要贴附一个由你操控的武具？

479420.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each other creature named Seven Dwarves you control.
479420.translation: 你每操控一个其他名称为七个矮人的生物，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

479454.oracleText: Put a card you own from outside the game into your hand.
479454.translation: 从游戏外选择一张由你拥有的牌，并将它置于你手上。

479921.oracleText: Put a card you own into your hand.
479921.translation: 将一张由你拥有的牌置于你手上。

479925.oracleText: You may reveal an artifact card you own from outside the game or choose a face-up artifact card you own in exile. Put that card into your hand.
479925.translation: 你可以从游戏外或放逐区中选择一张由你拥有的神器牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。

480213.oracleText: Reveal a face-up artifact card you own?
480213.translation: 是否要展示一张由你拥有且牌面朝上的神器牌？

480493.oracleText: You may reveal a creature card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand.
480493.translation: 你可以从游戏外选择一张由你拥有的生物牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。

480615.oracleText: Attach any number of Equipment you control.
480615.translation: 贴附任意数量由你操控的武具。

480617.oracleText: Search for a card named Halvar, God of Battle or an Equipment card.
480617.translation: 搜寻一张名称为战斗神哈尔瓦的牌或一张武具牌。

480618.oracleText: Reveal an Elf, Warrior, or Tyvar card?
480618.translation: 是否要展示一张妖精，战士或泰瓦牌？

480619.oracleText: Put an Elf or Tyvar card onto the battlefield?
480619.translation: 是否要将一张妖精或泰瓦牌放进战场？

480620.oracleText: Target up to one nontoken creature.
480620.translation: 指定至多一个非衍生物的生物为目标。

480622.oracleText: Nontoken creatures you control are Forest lands in addition to their other types. (They're still affected by summoning sickness.)
480622.translation: 由你操控且非衍生物的生物都是树林地，且仍具有原本类别。（它们仍会受召唤失调影响。）

480623.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, you may remove two +1/+1 counters from Verazol. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
480623.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，你可以从威拉佐上移去两个+1/+1指示物。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

480624.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Copy target permanent spell you control. (The copy becomes a token.)
480624.translation: {o4}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的永久物咒语。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

480625.oracleText: Target up to one Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard creature card.
480625.translation: 指定至多一张僧侣，浪客，战士或法术师生物牌为目标。

480648.oracleText: Choose cards to reveal to your opponent. (They will choose one of those cards for you to discard.)
480648.translation: 选择展示给对手的卡牌。（他将从中选择一张，你弃掉该牌。）

480854.oracleText: Reveal a creature card you own?
480854.translation: 是否要展示一张由你拥有的生物牌？

481910.oracleText: You may reveal a noncreature card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand.
481910.translation: 你可以从游戏外展示一张由你拥有的非生物牌，并将它置于你手上。

482003.oracleText: Reveal a noncreature card you own?
482003.translation: 是否要展示一张由你拥有的非生物牌？

482240.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: You gain life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness. Draw a card.
482240.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物：你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。抓一张牌。

483849.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen type, copy that spell. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
483849.translation: 每当你施放该类别的咒语时，复制该咒语。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

483850.oracleText: "I need no axe to best these weaklings."
483850.translation: 「我不用斧子也能制服这帮软脚虾。」

483851.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a tapped 4/4 green Troll Warrior creature token with trample.
483851.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个已横置的4/4绿色，具践踏异能之巨魔／战士衍生生物。

483852.oracleText: Enchanted Forest has "{oT}: Add {oGoG}" and "{o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a tapped 4/4 green Troll Warrior creature token with trample."
483852.translation: 所结附的树林具有「{oT}：加{oGoG}」与「{o1}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个已横置的4/4绿色，具践踏异能之巨魔／战士衍生生物。」

483853.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if it was a creature, return it to the battlefield. It's an Aura enchantment with enchant Forest you control and "Enchanted Forest has ‘{oT}: Add {oGoG}' and ‘{o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a tapped 4/4 green Troll Warrior creature token with trample.'"
483853.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若它是生物，则将它移回战场。它是灵气结界，且具有「结附于由你操控的树林」和「所结附的树林具有『{oT}：加{oGoG}』与『{o1}，{oT}：牺牲此地：派出一个已横置的4/4绿色，具践踏异能之巨魔／战士衍生生物。』」

483856.oracleText: {oT}, Pay {oE}: Target player mills three cards.

483858.oracleText: {oT}: This artifact deals 2 damage to any target.
483858.translation: {oT}：此神器对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

483862.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} card.} other {Target {2, Number} cards.}}
483862.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定{2, Number}张牌为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}张牌为目标。}}

483863.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Tap {2, Number} untapped artifact you control.} other {Tap {2, Number} untapped artifacts you control.}}
483863.translation: {2, plural, =1 {横置{2, Number}个由你操控且未横置的神器。} other {横置{2, Number}个由你操控且未横置的神器。}}

484794.oracleText: Spend only on: A Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard Spell or an Ability of a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard
484794.translation: 只能用于支付：僧侣、浪客、战士或法术师咒语，或僧侣、浪客、战士或法术师的异能

485953.oracleText: Change {1, CardId}'s base power to 1 plus the greatest power among other creatures you control?
485953.translation: 是否要将{1, CardId}的基础力量更改为「由你操控之其他生物中力量最大者的数值加1」？

485986.translation: 指定一张具预示异能的牌为目标。

485988.oracleText: Perfected by the kinetic sculptor Shanti Makam, these self-assembling metal strands can be coaxed into any shape imaginable.
485988.translation: 这些可自动组装的金属细丝，经由动态雕塑家尚蒂马卡姆精巧雕琢，能随意塑造成任何形状。

485989.oracleText:
"Consider all confiscated items hostile until proven otherwise."
—Confiscation directive
485989.translation:
「在没有证明之前，将所有被没收的物品视为敌对物品。」
～征收令

485990.oracleText:
"This device was submitted to the Fair anonymously. It is imperative that its maker be found. We must understand it."
—Confiscation directive
485990.translation:
「这装置是匿名送至博览会。务必找到其制造者。我们必须了解它。」
～征收令

485991.oracleText:
"Rashmi's design was just the beginning. We are most eager to see what the High Consul has planned for it."
—Consulate engineer's log
485991.translation:
「列施蜜的设计只是个开端。我们最想知道的是执政官大人会用它来做什么。」
～执政院工程师日志

485992.oracleText: Impressing a judge is one thing. Delighting a child is another.
485992.translation: 吸引评委需独具匠心，取悦儿童则需别出心裁。

486058.oracleText: Search for a snow permanent card, a legendary card, or a Saga card.
486058.translation: 搜寻一张雪境永久物牌、传奇牌或传纪牌。

487141.oracleText: Return up to two creature cards of that type to the battlefield.
487141.translation: 将至多两张该类别的生物牌移回战场。

487145.oracleText: Evoke—Exile a white card from your hand.
487145.translation: 呼魂～从你手上放逐一张白色牌。

487149.oracleText: Evoke—Exile a blue card from your hand.
487149.translation: 呼魂～从你手上放逐一张蓝色牌。

487152.oracleText: CARDNAME has indestructible as long as you control at least two other Merfolk.
487152.translation: 只要你操控至少两个其他人鱼，CARDNAME便具有不灭异能。

487154.oracleText: Whenever Svyelun attacks, draw a card.
487154.translation: 每当希亚尔攻击时，抓一张牌。

487155.oracleText: Other Merfolk you control have ward {o1}.
487155.translation: 由你操控的其他人鱼具有守护{o1}。

487159.oracleText: Evoke—Exile a black card from your hand.
487159.translation: 呼魂～从你手上放逐一张黑色牌。

487162.oracleText: Whenever an opponent discards a card, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
487162.translation: 每当任一对手弃一张牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

487168.oracleText: Evoke—Exile a red card from your hand.
487168.translation: 呼魂～从你手上放逐一张红色牌。

487171.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token and exile the top card of that player's library. Until end of turn, you may cast that card.
487171.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物并放逐该牌手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

487175.oracleText: If one or more tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus that many 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens are created instead.
487175.translation: 如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出该些衍生物加上同样数量的1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

487176.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice X Squirrels: Target creature gets +X/-X until end of turn.
487176.translation: {oB}，牺牲X个松鼠：目标生物得+X/-X直到回合结束。

487180.oracleText: Evoke—Exile a green card from your hand.
487180.translation: 呼魂～从你手上放逐一张绿色牌。

487198.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
487198.translation: 将目标法术力值为1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

487199.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
487199.translation: 将目标法术力值为1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

487200.oracleText:
At the beginning of your end step, choose one — 
• You gain 1 life. 
• Return target creature card with mana value 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
487200.translation:
在你的结束步骤开始时，选择一项～ 
•你获得1点生命。 
•将目标法术力值为1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

487207.oracleText: It flickered to life, saw itself alone, and began to build.
487207.translation: 它一闪入魂，有感形单影只，便开始建造。

487225.oracleText: Heart of a titan, faith as bright as the dawn.
487225.translation: 雄心堪比泰坦，信念光耀如晨。

487229.oracleText: The more Esper changes, the more he refuses to.
487229.translation: 艾斯波改变得越多，他就越加抗拒改变。

487230.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn, draw a card unless that player pays {oX}, where X is CARDNAME's power.
487230.translation: 每当任一对手施放每回合中其第一个非生物咒语时，除非该牌手支付{oX}，否则你抓一张牌，X为CARDNAME的力量。

487237.oracleText: "You are unworthy of life, but take heart. You have earned a clean death."
487237.translation: 「你不配活着，但别气馁。你能死得干脆。」

487238.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if you have more life than an opponent, CARDNAME gains double strike until end of turn.
487238.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若你的生命比某对手多，则CARDNAME获得连击异能直到回合结束。

487244.oracleText: The sight of a flock overhead is bittersweet. It means many are wounded, but it also means help is on the way.
487244.translation: 看到鹰群飞过，让人五味杂陈。这既意味着受伤者众，但也意味着援助将至。

487255.oracleText: "I knew you were set in your ways, friend, but even I didn't expect you to keep our engagement, under the circumstances."
487255.translation: 「朋友，我知道你习惯从不轻改，但没想到在这种情况下，你竟然还能赴约。」

487256.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Create a Food token.
487256.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。派出一个食品衍生物。

487264.oracleText: Though Heliod turned against humanity in his hunger for power, the ideals he once championed still stand strong.
487264.translation: 尽管赫利欧德因追求力量而背叛人类，但他所推崇的理想仍屹立不摇。

487265.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, you may put that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control. Do this only once each turn.
487265.translation: 每当你获得生命时，你可以在每个由你操控的生物上各放置等量的+1/+1指示物。每回合只能如此作一次。

487275.oracleText: Converge — Exile target nonland permanent if its mana value is less than or equal to the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.
487275.translation: 聚辉～如果目标非地永久物的法术力值等于或小于施放此咒语时用来支付费用的法术力颜色数量，则放逐该非地永久物。

487284.oracleText: Even in the most barren wastelands, every death feeds more life.
487284.translation: 即使在最贫瘠的荒地，一场死亡也可以喂饱更多生命。

487292.oracleText: You and creatures you control have protection from the chosen card type.
487292.translation: 你和由你操控的生物具有反该牌张类别保护异能。

487294.oracleText: {o2oW}: Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand. Activate only if CARDNAME is on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
487294.translation: {o2oW}：将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。只能于CARDNAME在战场上或在你的坟墓场中时起动。

487295.oracleText: {o2oW}: Return Skyblade's Boon to its owner's hand. Activate only if Skyblade's Boon is on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
487295.translation: {o2oW}：将飞空剑恩泽移回其拥有者手上。只能于飞空剑恩泽在战场上或在你的坟墓场中时起动。

487306.oracleText:
"Fear not the angels' constant eyes,
E'er on watch from lightless skies;
Eternal vigil will we keep,
Protectors of the Blessed Sleep."
487306.translation:
「勿惧天使无间注目，
黯淡黑夜时刻看护；
永恒守夜保障万全，
卫佑众生受福安眠。」

487307.oracleText: Other nontoken creatures you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.
487307.translation: 由你操控且非衍生物的其他生物得+1/+1且具有警戒异能。

487312.translation: 「这些金光闪闪的东西重得该死！」

487314.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a token, CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn.
487314.translation: 每当你牺牲一个衍生物时，CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

487324.oracleText: "Thopters from a foundry always lack that personal touch."
487324.translation: 「锻炉造出的振翼机总是少了几分个人特色。」

487325.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
487325.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于4的咒语时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

487327.oracleText:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dexterous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves." 
—Coruk, Esper artificer
487327.translation:
「最完美的助理要反应快，手工巧，还能摸到架子最高处。」
～艾斯波神器师寇路

487328.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of artifacts you control.
487328.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

487329.oracleText: Filigree Attendant's power is equal to the number of artifacts you control.
487329.translation: 丝金随员的力量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

487336.oracleText: Delirium — CARDNAME gets +1/+0 as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
487336.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

487344.oracleText: {o2oU}: Another target creature gains flying until end of turn.
487344.translation: {o2oU}：另一个目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

487348.oracleText: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.
487348.translation: 调查员感到脚踝有阵刺痛。他低头一瞧，发现沙堆中有东西闪闪发光。

487349.oracleText: Create a 0/3 blue Crab creature token.
487349.translation: 派出一个0/3蓝色的蟹衍生生物。

487351.oracleText: Search target opponent's library for a creature card and put that card onto the battlefield under your control. Then that player shuffles.
487351.translation: 从目标对手的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，并将该牌在你的操控下放进战场。然后该牌手洗牌。

487367.oracleText:
"Crack it open. Maybe it knows something we can use."
—Kara Vrist, Mirran resistance
487367.translation:
「打开看看。或许它知道些什么能让我们派上用场。」
～秘罗志士凯拉黎

487374.oracleText: "Fear not, child. Open your eyes and witness Keranos's truth!"
487374.translation: 「别害怕，孩子。睁开双眼，见证刻拉诺斯的真相吧！」

487375.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oU}, {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
487375.translation: 躁狂～{o2oU}，{oT}：抓一张牌。只能于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多时起动。

487377.oracleText:
"Trial 991: Still encountering issues with accidental aetherization. Maybe if we widen the dimensional matrix to 0.7?"
—Izzet research notes
487377.translation:
「尝试991：依然会遇上突发乙太化问题。不如我们把次元矩阵上调至0.7试试？」
～伊捷研究纪录

487378.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. If you've discarded a card this turn, draw a card.
487378.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。如果你本回合中弃过牌，则抓一张牌。

487380.oracleText: Target noncreature artifact you control becomes a 0/0 artifact creature. Put four +1/+1 counters on each artifact that became a creature this way.
487380.translation: 目标由你操控的非生物神器成为0/0神器生物。在每个以此法成为生物的神器上各放置四个+1/+1指示物。

487388.oracleText:
"We're going to need more butter."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa
487388.translation:
「我们得需要更多奶油。」
～尸鬼牧者基沙

487389.oracleText: {o1}, Discard a card: Create a 0/3 blue Crab creature token.
487389.translation: {o1}，弃一张牌：派出一个0/3蓝色的蟹衍生生物。

487390.oracleText: Delirium — Crabs you control get +1/+1 as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
487390.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，由你操控的蟹便得+1/+1。

487435.oracleText: Malice spreads on wings of tyranny.

487439.oracleText: In the Kathari dumping grounds known as the Boneheaps, it's not hard to improvise an offense.
487439.translation: 卡刹立的垃圾场又名「骨堆」，在此处加害他人不需什么事前准备。

487440.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or discard a card.
487440.translation: 牺牲一个生物或弃一张牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

487445.oracleText: "Hear our prayers, oh Shadowed One, and bless us in bloody agony."
487445.translation: 「黯影之主啊，请倾听祈祷，以血腥痛苦祝福我们。」

487446.oracleText: Discard a card: CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
487446.translation: 弃一张牌：CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

487458.oracleText: Destroy target creature. A creature destroyed this way can't be regenerated.
487458.translation: 消灭目标生物。以此法消灭的生物不能重生。

487462.oracleText: If a card would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, instead exile it with a void counter on it.
487462.translation: 如果某牌将从任何区域进入对手的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐并在其上放置一个虚空指示物。

487463.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Choose an exiled card an opponent owns with a void counter on it. You may play it this turn without paying its mana cost.
487463.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：选择一张由对手拥有、已放逐且其上有虚空指示物的牌。本回合中，你可以使用它，且不需支付其法术力费用。

487471.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You gain life equal to the greatest power among creature cards put into your graveyard this way.
487471.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于以此法置入你坟墓场的生物牌中力量最大者之数值。

487473.oracleText: A single ambition unleashes a legion of horrors.
487473.translation: 带出恐怖大军的一股野心。

487474.oracleText: Return target creature card and all other cards with the same name as that card from your graveyard to your hand.
487474.translation: 将目标生物牌和所有与之同名的其他牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

487483.oracleText:
"Let's just say my people are in the business of capital acquisition and intellectual property speculation."
—Er-Miral
487483.translation:
「姑且这么说，我的人手从事资产收购和知识产权投机买卖。」
～厄米拉尔

487484.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Pay 1 life: Draw a card. Activate only if you've discarded a card this turn.
487484.translation: {o1}，{oT}，支付1点生命：抓一张牌。只能于你弃过牌的回合中起动。

487486.oracleText: It feeds on shadows, fear, and blood.
487486.translation: 它以阴影、恐惧和鲜血为食。

487491.oracleText: It takes guts to be a trailblazer.

487504.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of creature cards in all graveyards.
487504.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于所有坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

487505.oracleText: Necrogoyf's power is equal to the number of creature cards in all graveyards.
487505.translation: 死冥耶夫的力量等同于所有坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

487508.oracleText: Hellbent — CARDNAME has lifelink as long as you have no cards in hand.
487508.translation: 背水战～只要你没有手牌，CARDNAME便具有系命异能。

487513.oracleText: Home is where the heart was.

487514.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create X tapped 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens, where X is CARDNAME's power.
487514.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出X个已横置的1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物，X为CARDNAME的力量。

487517.oracleText: Return target nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
487517.translation: 将目标非传奇的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个-1/-1指示物。

487521.oracleText: Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
487521.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。

487527.oracleText:
"Throw that one back. I don't like how it's looking at me."
—Netos, Meletian fisherman
487527.translation:
「把那只扔回去，我讨厌它盯着我看的样子。」
～迈勒提斯渔夫涅托斯

487530.oracleText:
"In one future, I see glory. In the other . . . well, that's another story."
—Whisper, blood liturgist
487530.translation:
「在一种未来，我瞥见荣景。至于另一种…呃，就是另一番光景。」
～鲜血仪礼师魏飒璞

487537.oracleText: The same hymns Tourach sang to praise the Ebon Praetor would later be adapted to glorify Tourach himself.
487537.translation: 妥拉克曾啸咏黑檀手魔判官的赞歌，后经改编用以褒扬妥拉克本人。

487538.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a card from it. That player discards that card, then discards a card at random.
487538.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张牌。该牌手弃掉该牌，然后随机弃一张牌。

487545.oracleText: Search your library for a nonlegendary card, put that card into your graveyard, then shuffle.
487545.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张非传奇的牌，将该牌置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

487547.oracleText:
"Once, vampires ruled this world, commanding the fear and respect that befit our noble blood. Have we truly sunk so low?"
—Sorin Markov
487547.translation:
「吸血鬼曾统治这世界，博得与我们高贵血统相称的恐惧和尊敬。难道我们已彻底堕落至此？」
～索霖马可夫

487548.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
487548.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物：每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

487557.oracleText: "Who needs imaginary friends when you've got dead ones?"
487557.translation: 「有了亡者朋友，谁还需要虚幻朋友？」

487563.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell other than your first spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
487563.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你第一个咒语以外的咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

487568.oracleText: {oR}: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
487568.translation: {oR}：CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

487575.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
487575.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

487576.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
487576.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

487577.oracleText:
{oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Choose one — 
• Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card. 
• Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
487577.translation:
{oT}，牺牲一个神器：选择一项～ 
•放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。 
•目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

487582.oracleText: The Spitfire Bastion bristles with cannons claimed from every ship she's conquered.
487582.translation: 喷火堡垒上林立的炮阵缴获自她征服的每艘船。

487583.oracleText: Whenever you cast your third spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME, then it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
487583.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第三个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后它对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

487584.oracleText: Whenever you cast your third spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Captain Ripley Vance, then it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
487584.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第三个咒语时，在蕾普莉凡丝船长上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后它对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

487589.oracleText: All that's left are broken beliefs.

487590.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw a card.
487590.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。

487592.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw two cards.
487592.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓两张牌。

487593.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each creature without flying.
487593.translation: CARDNAME对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成3点伤害。

487594.oracleText: Fast // Furious deals 3 damage to each creature without flying.
487594.translation: 激情对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成3点伤害。

487597.oracleText: Furious deals 3 damage to each creature without flying.
487597.translation: 激情对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成3点伤害。

487607.oracleText: Abandoned years ago, the experiment continues to iterate upon itself.
487607.translation: 多年前已遭放弃的实验仍持续自行重启。

487608.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. During your next turn, you may play that card.
487608.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。于你的下个回合中，你可以使用该牌。

487619.oracleText: He can't fear what he can't see.

487620.oracleText: Delirium — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature defending player controls.
487620.translation: 躁狂～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则CARDNAME对每个由防御牌手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

487623.oracleText: Each note strikes with deadly precision.

487626.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, surveil 1.
487626.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，刺探1。

487627.oracleText: Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+2, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.
487627.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+2，具飞行异能，且每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

487634.oracleText: When wielded, it begs to be released.
487634.translation: 它舞动时亟欲脱手而出。

487635.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has trample.
487635.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

487636.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to any target.
487636.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

487640.oracleText: If it's your turn, you may sacrifice a Mountain rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
487640.translation: 如果是在你的回合中，则你可以牺牲一个山脉，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

487641.oracleText: Mine Collapse deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
487641.translation: 矿井塌方对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

487657.oracleText: Imbued with life by a stray bolt of spellcraft, it began to wander about the foundry, to the blacksmiths' alarm.
487657.translation: 由打歪了的咒语赋予生命后，它开始在铸造厂里游荡，铁匠纷纷避走。

487658.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an artifact: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
487658.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个神器：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

487661.oracleText: Everyone wants to be on the winning side.
487661.translation: 谁都想站在打赢那一边。

487662.oracleText: Gain control of target creature you don't control until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
487662.translation: 获得目标不由你操控的生物之操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

487664.oracleText: A few coins soon grow into an obsession.
487664.translation: 几枚硬币过后迅速上瘾。

487671.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Delirium — CARDNAME deals 6 damage instead if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
487671.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则改为CARDNAME造成6点伤害。

487672.oracleText:
Unholy Heat deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
Delirium — Unholy Heat deals 6 damage instead if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
487672.translation:
不洁热火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。
躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则改为不洁热火造成6点伤害。

487674.oracleText: "Victory is the greatest motivator of all. So sayeth the bey."
487674.translation: 「胜利便是最大的动力。先生是这么说的。」

487675.oracleText: {oT}, Discard a card: Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
487675.translation: {oT}，弃一张牌：由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

487678.oracleText: Choose land or nonland. Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card of the chosen kind. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
487678.translation: 选择地或非地。从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张该种类的牌为止。将该牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

487680.oracleText: CARDNAME isn't legendary if it's a token.
487680.translation: 如果CARDNAME是衍生物，则它不是传奇。

487691.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice a token. If you do, put an acorn counter on CARDNAME.
487691.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲一个衍生物。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个橡实指示物。

487693.oracleText: Squirrels you control get +1/+1 for each acorn counter on CARDNAME.
487693.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个橡实指示物，由你操控的松鼠便得+1/+1。

487695.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.
487695.translation: {oG}，{oT}：派出一个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

487700.oracleText: "You didn't come all this way just to bother me, did you? Say your piece and be gone."
487700.translation: 「你大老远跑来不是只为打扰我，对吧？快说，快走。」

487721.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may play lands and cast spells from your graveyard.
487721.translation: 直到回合结束，你可以从你的坟墓场中使用地和施放咒语。

487723.oracleText: "Tricks and treats, souls and sweets! On wooded path, whom shall we meet?"
487723.translation: 「给了糖果也作坏，灵魂零食揣满怀！悠悠林间小路上，看看可有朋友来？」

487724.oracleText: Sacrifice a token: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
487724.translation: 牺牲一个衍生物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

487735.oracleText: Baloth social structure is simple: the biggest one's the leader.
487735.translation: 巴洛西社会结构很简单：体型最大的就是领袖。

487739.oracleText: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.
487739.translation: 他守护恶臭腐沼，将光明、生命与嘲笑者摒除在外。

487741.oracleText:
"Sure, they're worth a lot, but I'd rather survive to spend my earnings."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter
487741.translation:
「是啦，它们值很多钱，但我更愿有命来花。」
～卡隆尼亚猎人默卡

487747.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
487747.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

487751.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of enchantments you control.
487751.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为由你操控的结界数量。

487753.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, you may create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.
487753.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以派出一个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

487756.oracleText:
"It's fun when they run a little."
—Wasitora, Nekoru queen
487756.translation:
「他们跑起来的时候要有趣得多。」
～猫龙后鹫虎

487757.oracleText: Target creature you control fights up to one target creature you don't control.
487757.translation: 目标由你操控的生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

487761.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, you may pay {o1}. If you do, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
487761.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

487766.translation: 由你操控的其他松鼠得+1/+1。

487768.oracleText:
The harsher the winter, the more glorious the spring.
—Yavimaya saying
487768.translation:
冬寒越凛冽，春色越辉煌。
～亚维马雅谚语

487777.oracleText: Stop, smell the roses, eat the peoples.
487777.translation: 停，闻闻这玫瑰，把人都吃掉。

487778.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, proliferate.
487778.translation: 激怒～每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，增殖。

487781.oracleText: Target player creates two tapped 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens.
487781.translation: 目标牌手派出两个已横置的1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

487782.oracleText: Counter target loyalty ability of a planeswalker.
487782.translation: 反击目标由鹏洛客具有的忠诚异能。

487783.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Target player creates two tapped 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens. 
• Counter target loyalty ability of a planeswalker. 
• Exile target card from a graveyard. 
• Target player gains 3 life.
487783.translation:
选择两项～ 
•目标牌手派出两个已横置的1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。 
•反击目标由鹏洛客具有的忠诚异能。 
•将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。 
•目标牌手获得3点生命。

487792.oracleText: "Archery requires holding an enormous amount of tension and making it look effortless."
487792.translation: 「所谓弓术，需要你在看似不经意间把弦拉满。」

487794.oracleText: Each other creature you control without a +1/+1 counter on it has outlast {o(G/W)}.
487794.translation: 每个由你操控且上面没有+1/+1指示物的其他生物均具有延生{o(G/W)}。

487801.oracleText: A deadly charge in eerie silence.
487801.translation: 奇诡静寂中的致命冲锋。

487815.oracleText: Creature tokens you control have flying.
487815.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物具有飞行异能。

487816.oracleText: {o2oGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice a token: Create a 4/4 green Beast creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
487816.translation: {o2oGoU}，{oT}，牺牲一个衍生物：派出一个4/4绿色野兽衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

487827.oracleText: He gave the squirrels acorns. They gave him vengeance.
487827.translation: 他喂松鼠橡实。松鼠为他复仇。

487830.oracleText: {o3oB}: Squirrels you control get +1/+0 and gain menace until end of turn.
487830.translation: {o3oB}：直到回合结束，由你操控的松鼠得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

487849.oracleText: A good Gruul shaman can work a whole clan into a frenzy. A great one will wait until the enemy's nearby.
487849.translation: 好的古鲁祭师能令整个部落陷入狂热。伟大的古鲁祭师会等到敌人靠近后再这么作。

487850.oracleText: Each spell you cast that's red or green costs {o1} less to cast.
487850.translation: 你施放之为红色或绿色的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

487852.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
487852.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

487853.oracleText: Return up to two target creature cards with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
487853.translation: 将至多两张目标力量等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

487854.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. 
• Return up to two target creature cards with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
487854.translation:
选择一项～ 
•将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。 
•将至多两张目标力量等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

487859.oracleText: You may sacrifice a creature. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker.
487859.translation: 你可以牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。

487860.oracleText: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
487860.translation: 每位对手各失去等同于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的生命。

487867.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice X Clues: Target opponent reveals the top X cards of their library. You may put a nonland permanent card with mana value X or less from among them onto the battlefield under your control. That player puts the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.
487867.translation: {oT}，牺牲X个线索：目标对手展示其牌库顶的X张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物牌在你的操控下放进战场。该牌手将其余的牌以随机顺序置于其牌库底。

487882.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 3 life, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
487882.translation: {oT}，支付3点生命，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

487886.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target.
487886.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

487888.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
487888.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

487892.oracleText:
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels."
—Joskun, An-Havva constable
487892.translation:
「不，树林里没有怪物。那里只有松鼠。」
～安哈瓦保安官约昆

487893.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact or creature, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
487893.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器或生物时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

487895.oracleText: {o1oBoG}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: You gain 1 life and draw a card.
487895.translation: {o1oBoG}，牺牲一个神器或生物：你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

487899.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
487899.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

487905.oracleText: The lives of Keranos's chosen are brief and brilliant as lightning.
487905.translation: 刻拉诺斯爱民的生命如闪电一般短暂而辉煌。

487909.oracleText: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."
487909.translation: 「这片片青葱田野，那根根硕果枝桠，一切都是卡拉美特拉的关爱具现。」

487910.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
487910.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

487912.oracleText: His mouth melted to slag, yet somehow he kept screaming.
487912.translation: 虽然嘴已遭熔毁，但他仍在狂啸。

487915.oracleText: Domain — Territorial Kavu's power and toughness are each equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control.
487915.translation: 领土～据地卡甫的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地中基本地类别之数量。

487916.oracleText: Discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
487916.translation: 弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

487917.oracleText: Discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
487917.translation: 弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

487918.oracleText: Exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
487918.translation: 将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

487919.oracleText: Exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
487919.translation: 将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

487920.oracleText:
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, choose one — 
• Discard a card. If you do, draw a card. 
• Exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
487920.translation:
每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择一项～ 
•弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。 
•将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

487931.oracleText: If you would create a Clue, Food, or Treasure token, instead create one of each.
487931.translation: 如果你将派出一个线索，食品或珍宝衍生物，则改为这三种衍生物各派出一个。

487935.oracleText: Lhurgoyf creatures you control have trample.
487935.translation: 由你操控的拉高耶夫生物具有践踏异能。

487937.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance and lifelink.
487937.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒与系命异能。

487966.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, exile that creature.
487966.translation: 每当此生物对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，放逐后者。

487969.oracleText: An unfinished body with unfinished business.
487969.translation: 躯体尚未完工，使命亦未完成。

487971.oracleText: {o1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from CARDNAME: It deals 1 damage to any target.
487971.translation: {o1}，从CARDNAME上移去一个+1/+1指示物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

487974.oracleText:
"They're useful creatures, but quite replaceable. I find it best not to get too attached."
—Pontifex, elder researcher
487974.translation:
「这些生物很合用，但也极易取代。千万不要舍不得。」
～大学者庞棣飞

487977.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
487977.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

487985.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control three or more tokens, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
487985.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控三个或更多衍生物，则直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+2/+0且获得先攻异能。

488007.oracleText: If a modular triggered ability would put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
488007.translation: 如果某套件触发式异能将在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

488011.oracleText: The path to power is forged in ruthlessness.

488014.oracleText: The path to ruin is forged in pain.

488021.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
488021.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语，或是起动神器的异能。

488026.oracleText: The path to strength is forged in stability.

488029.oracleText: The path to glory is forged in ambition.

488033.oracleText: The path to genius is forged in creativity.

488036.oracleText: The path to action is forged in confidence.

488039.oracleText: The path to change is forged in insight.

488042.oracleText: The path to growth is forged in balance.

488051.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card with mana cost {o0} or {o1}, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
488051.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力费用为{o0}或{o1}的神器牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

488053.oracleText:
"Multani's heart is a seed, and all of Yavimaya is its flower. There is as much life here as in the rest of Dominaria together."
—Karn
488053.translation:
「穆塔尼的心是种子，整个亚维马雅都是它开出的花朵。此处的生命和多明纳里亚其他地方加起来的一样多。」
～卡恩

488054.oracleText: Each land is a Forest in addition to its other land types.
488054.translation: 每个地均额外具有树林此地类别。

488059.oracleText:
"It fell silently from the sky and broke the surface without a ripple. Was it even here at all?"
—Fisherman's journal
488059.translation:
「它悄然从天而降，撞破水面却不起涟漪。它真的出现过吗？」
～渔夫日志

488065.oracleText: With one motion, a pest is removed and a scourge inflicted.
488065.translation: 只见扳机一动，消灭一只害虫，造成一场灾难。

488068.oracleText: There is no "I" in "team," but there is definitely "meat."
488068.translation: 单人无众威，双人尝肉味。

488070.oracleText: An army of squirrels is still an army.
488070.translation: 虽只由松鼠组成，军队仍是军队。

488123.oracleText: Target up to one creature spell or planeswalker spell.
488123.translation: 指定至多一个生物咒语或鹏洛客咒语为目标。

488124.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Sacrifice {2, Number} Squirrel.} other {Sacrifice {2, Number} Squirrels.}}
488124.translation: {2, plural, =1 {牺牲{2, Number}个松鼠。} other {牺牲{2, Number}个松鼠。}}

488125.oracleText: Protection from the chosen card type

488130.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token?
488130.translation: 是否要派出一个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物？

488131.oracleText: Target a loyalty ability of a planeswalker.
488131.translation: 指定一个鹏洛客的忠诚异能为目标。

488133.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。

488138.oracleText:
"We don't make mistakes, just happy little accidents."
—Bob Ross
488138.translation:
「我们不会犯错，只会犯些快乐的小意外。」
～鲍勃罗斯

488141.oracleText: First-years quickly learn how the Vastlands earned its name.
488141.translation: 一年级新生很快就知晓旷土之名由何而来。

488142.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 2 life.
488142.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得2点生命。

488144.oracleText: "Changing the equation from incremental to exponential was a stroke of genius on my part."
488144.translation: 「把原来增量算式改成指数形式，算是我的点睛之笔吧。」

488145.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn.
488145.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

488147.oracleText:
"I've never seen a student fail quite so spectacularly. There's potential in that."
—Hostram, professor of arcanochemistry
488147.translation:
「我从没见过哪个学生就连失败也如此壮观。但有潜力暗藏其间。」
～神奥化学教授霍斯东

488148.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller draws a card.
488148.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者抓一张牌。

488150.oracleText: Final grades are posted on the first day of class.
488150.translation: 在开学第一天，就张榜公布了所有学生的期末成绩。

488152.oracleText:
"Don't just win the game. Win the crowd."
—Moriana, Mage Tower coach
488152.translation:
「我们不仅要赢下比赛胜利。还要赢得观众青睐。」
～斗法塔教练摩莲娜

488153.oracleText: Create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying, a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token, and a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488153.translation: 派出一个2/1、白黑双色、具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物，一个3/2、红白双色的精怪衍生生物和一个4/4、蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488157.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts an instant or sorcery spell, they may pay {o2}. If they don't, you may copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
488157.translation: 每当任一对手施放瞬间或法术咒语时，他可以支付{o2}。若他未如此作，则你可以复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

488162.oracleText: Choose a nonland card name. Opponents can't cast spells with the chosen name until your next turn.
488162.translation: 选择一个非地牌的名称。直到你的下一个回合，所有对手都不能施放具该名称的咒语。

488163.oracleText: Choose target nonland permanent. Until your next turn, it can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated.
488163.translation: 选择目标非地永久物。直到你的下一个回合，它不能进行攻击或阻挡，其起动式异能也不能起动。

488164.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Choose a nonland card name. Opponents can't cast spells with the chosen name until your next turn. 
• Choose target nonland permanent. Until your next turn, it can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated.
488164.translation:
选择一项～ 
•选择一个非地牌的名称。直到你的下一个回合，所有对手都不能施放具该名称的咒语。 
•选择目标非地永久物。直到你的下一个回合，它不能进行攻击或阻挡，其起动式异能也不能起动。

488166.oracleText: Ancient ruins dot the world of Arcavios, most older than Strixhaven itself and many still guarded by soldiers from the Blood Age, centuries after their deaths.
488166.translation: 阿凯维沃世界上古代遗迹星罗棋布，其中大多数的历史比斯翠海文学院本身都要悠久。虽然血腥时代距今已有数百年，其时士兵早已逝去，但如今他们仍在继续守卫这些遗迹。

488168.oracleText:
"I've lived too long in my father's shadow. It's time to find my own light."
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student
488168.translation:
「我已在父亲的阴影下活得太久。现在该去寻找属于自己的光明。」
～银毫修习法师齐力安

488170.oracleText: "You're too dim to realize it, but you've already lost."
488170.translation: 「以你的愚蠢可能还没意识到：你已经输了。」

488171.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
488171.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

488175.oracleText: "Before Yovus was cut down at Pranticle Peak, she performed which maneuver? Anyone? From the reading?"
488175.translation: 「尤娲在潘迪科峰上被砍倒之前，她使出的是哪一招？谁来回答一下？书里写过喔。」

488176.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
488176.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得警戒异能。

488178.oracleText: Professors scrambled to push the mage hunters back, leaving the heart of Strixhaven undefended.
488178.translation: 教授急忙出击阻击猎法妖，使得斯翠海文核心顿失防备。

488179.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. 
• Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.
488179.translation:
选择一项～ 
•由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。 
•消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

488181.oracleText: {o3}: Destroy CARDNAME. Only your opponents may activate this ability and only as a sorcery.
488181.translation: {o3}：消灭CARDNAME。只有对手可以起动，且仅限法术时机。

488184.oracleText: You may pay {o2oWoW} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488184.translation: 你可以支付{o2oWoW}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488185.oracleText: If the {o2oWoW} cost was paid, an opponent chooses up to two nonland permanents they control and returns them to their owner's hand.
488185.translation: 如果曾支付此{o2oWoW}费用，则任一对手选择至多两个由其操控的非地永久物，并将它们移回其拥有者手上。

488188.oracleText: {o4oW}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
488188.translation: {o4oW}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488190.oracleText: Today, she learns the basics. She'll knock out advanced theory later this week.
488190.translation: 今天，她已学会入门基础。相信本周内她就能掌握高级理论。

488191.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
488191.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

488194.oracleText: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, World Champion XXVI
488194.translation: 第二十六届世界冠军Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa

488198.oracleText: Quintorius was a daydreamer, far happier digging through history books than practicing battle tactics. He agreed with the military academy on only one thing: he did not belong in their ranks.
488198.translation: 昆托力想象力丰富，相较于刻苦训练战术，他更喜欢遨游历史书海。不过他跟军事学院倒有一点意见相同：他不适合参军。

488200.oracleText: When honormancers work together, their compliments are complementary.
488200.translation: 当荣耀术士携手合作时，其颂美之声也盛赞相承。

488203.oracleText: All who hear his inspiring words are filled with hope and pride.
488203.translation: 凡听闻其鼓舞颂赞者，内心无不壮志昂扬。

488204.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
488204.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

488207.oracleText: {o0}: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn. If that spell doesn't target a creature you control, it costs {o8} more to cast this way. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only once each turn.
488207.translation: {o0}：本回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌。如果该咒语未以由你操控的生物为目标，则以此法施放时增加{o8}来施放。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。每回合只能起动一次。

488214.oracleText: Gentle hands of stone whisk the careless from the crumbling ruins of Pillardrop.
488214.translation: 石头伸出手臂，轻巧而迅速地将粗心者带离摇摇欲坠的避柱遗迹。

488218.oracleText: "A language isn't dead until we stop learning from it."
488218.translation: 「只要还有人在研习，语言就没有消亡。」

488222.oracleText:
"Do not flinch from studying the horrors of the past. History's most important lessons are cloaked in terror and tragedy."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
488222.translation:
「研究过往惨事时，千万不要畏缩。历史最深刻的教训，就掩藏在这种种恐怖与悲剧之下。」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

488223.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488223.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488225.oracleText: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.
488225.translation: 虽然斯翠海文五个学院鼓励学生间的对抗情绪，但有些羁绊能够跨越一切阻碍。

488226.oracleText: You and target opponent each draw three cards.
488226.translation: 你和目标对手各抓三张牌。

488230.oracleText: When you cast this spell, copy it for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.
488230.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，你本回合中每施放过一个其他的瞬间和法术咒语，便将此咒语复制一次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

488231.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn.
488231.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

488234.oracleText: Whenever you attack, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature and untap it.
488234.translation: 每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

488236.oracleText: "When I'm done here, they'll name entire buildings after me."
488236.translation: 「待我学成后，他们会用我的名字来命名整座校园！」

488238.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
488238.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

488242.oracleText:
"Hey, my great-great-grandfather had a dog just like that!"
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student
488242.translation:
「嘿，我曾曾祖父也养过一条这样的狗！」
～衡鉴修习法师卓迪尔

488243.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
488243.translation: 每当一张或数张牌在你的回合中进入放逐区时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

488246.oracleText: The carved cliffs of Pillardrop thrum with the sounds of ancient spirits rising from the past.
488246.translation: 古代魂灵自过往现身，由此造成的动静令避柱峭壁嗡嗡作响。

488247.oracleText: {o4}, Exile a card from your graveyard: Target creature gains flying until end of turn.
488247.translation: {o4}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张牌：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

488249.oracleText: "You might believe being dead for centuries has made me more lenient. I think you'll find the opposite to be true."
488249.translation: 「你可能会觉得，死了几百年后的我也许会变得宽容一些。但我觉得事实跟你想的恰好相反。」

488252.oracleText: "You've been cramming all night. You're taking a nap whether you like it or not."
488252.translation: 「你整晚都在挑灯夜读。不论你愿不愿意，现在你要休息。」

488254.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gains flying until end of turn if you control a creature with flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, indestructible, lifelink, menace, and trample.
488254.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，如果你操控具飞行异能的生物，则它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。且先攻、连击、死触、不灭、系命、威慑与践踏异能亦比照办理。

488257.oracleText: The class learned little that day.
488257.translation: 那天全班学到了很小的东西。

488259.oracleText: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.
488259.translation: 有些荣休教授会定期回到校园，与学生分享自己漫游阿凯维沃时遇到的奇闻轶事。

488260.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card.
488260.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，抓一张牌。

488263.oracleText: Students who seek river herbs in Doradur quickly find themselves slightly damp and thoroughly surrounded.
488263.translation: 前往多拉度采摘河草的学生，很快就发现自己周身沾水，陷入重重包围。

488267.oracleText: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.
488267.translation: 茂典阁禁止携入兵器，但聪明的法师从不会毫无防备。

488268.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets an attacking creature.
488268.translation: 如果此咒语以进行攻击的生物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

488270.oracleText: "Kathorran War Chants, Vol. III? That doesn't even belong in this wing!"
488270.translation: 「《卡瑟朗战歌，卷三》？这书根本就不属于这一区！」

488273.oracleText: "Misery. Inadequacy. Failure. The common denominator is you."
488273.translation: 「悲剧。不足。失败。它们的公分母都是你。」

488274.oracleText: Return target spell or permanent with mana value 1 or greater to its owner's hand.
488274.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或大于1的咒语或永久物移回其拥有者手上。

488280.oracleText: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.
488280.translation: 斗法塔比赛中，最重要的技巧是保持冷静。

488283.oracleText: You may pay {o2oU} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488283.translation: 你可以支付{o2oU}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488284.oracleText: If the {o2oU} cost was paid, you draw three cards, then an opponent creates two Treasure tokens and they scry 2. If that cost wasn't paid, you draw X cards.
488284.translation: 如果曾支付此{o2oU}费用，则你抓三张牌，然后任一对手派出两个珍宝衍生物且其占卜2。如果并非支付此费用，则你抓X张牌。

488286.oracleText: Kelpies are drawn to paradoxes, making them ideal companions for Quandrix mages.
488286.translation: 骏妖天生就会被矛盾事物吸引，这点让它们成为量析法师的理想旅伴。

488287.oracleText: {oT}: Untap another target permanent you control.
488287.translation: {oT}：重置另一个目标由你操控的永久物。

488288.oracleText: {oT}: Tap target permanent. Activate only if you control eight or more lands.
488288.translation: {oT}：横置目标永久物。只能于你操控八个或更多地时起动。

488290.oracleText: Kasmina had encouraged the twins to apply. Strixhaven would test not only their magical potential, but also their character.
488290.translation: 克蜜娜鼓励冰火双子申请进入斯翠海文学院深造：这里不仅能考验他们的魔法潜能，还可锤炼他们的人格品质。

488291.oracleText: When you cast this spell, copy it if you control a planeswalker, Cleric, Druid, Shaman, Warlock, or Wizard.
488291.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，如果你操控鹏洛客，僧侣，德鲁伊，祭师，邪术师或法术师，则复制该咒语。

488294.oracleText: "For sun's sake, I just want a crab!"
488294.translation: 「太阳在上，我只想变出一只蟹！」

488295.oracleText: Until end of turn, target nonland permanent loses all abilities and becomes your choice of a blue Frog creature with base power and toughness 1/1 or a blue Octopus creature with base power and toughness 4/4.
488295.translation: 直到回合结束，目标非地永久物失去所有异能，且依照你的选择成为基础力量与防御力为1/1的蓝色蛙生物或基础力量与防御力为4/4的蓝色章鱼生物。

488297.oracleText: If X is 1, scry 1, then draw a card.
488297.translation: 如果X为1，则占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

488298.oracleText: If X is 2, you may choose a player. They return a creature they control to its owner's hand.
488298.translation: 如果X为2，则你可以选择一位牌手。他将一个由其操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

488299.oracleText: If X is 3, create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488299.translation: 如果X为3，则派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488300.oracleText: If X is 4 or more, do all of the above.
488300.translation: 如果X等于或大于4，则以上皆作。

488302.oracleText: "Today is hydromancy? I thought it was amplimancy! I studied for amplimancy!"
488302.translation: 「今天是考水文占卜？我以为是考增效术！我都在念增术！」

488304.oracleText:
"Grux, for the last time, you have to do more than simply shout ‘Apply!' at the administrators."
—Pavil, admissions officer
488304.translation:
「葛兹，我最后一次告诉你：光对招生老师大叫『我要报名！』我们是绝对不会录取你的。」
～招生委员帕威

488305.oracleText: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell unless its controller pays {o3}. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
488305.translation: 除非目标生物或鹏洛客咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

488307.oracleText: Critics were struck first by the elemental's surprising grace, and then by its fists.
488307.translation: 评委先是为这元素的绝伦优雅倾倒，而后被它的数记重拳击倒。

488308.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature. Its controller creates a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488308.translation: 放逐目标神器或生物。其操控者派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488310.translation:
「数学会咬人。」
～衡鉴修习法师毕姆

488311.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is one plus the total number of instant and sorcery cards you own in exile and in your graveyard.
488311.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为在放逐区和你的坟墓场中由你拥有之瞬间和法术这两类牌的总数加一。

488313.oracleText:
"Advanced Elemental Manifestations is canceled until all students have thawed."
—Prismari dormitory notice
488313.translation:
「高等元素具现学课程即日取消，复课日期待学生解冻后另行通知。」
～粹丽寝室公告

488315.oracleText: Zimone's brilliance drew attention from many, including the sinister mages known as the Oriq.
488315.translation: 琦梦的横溢才华引起诸方关注，包括欧理可那群恶法师。

488316.oracleText: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
488316.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张瞬间或法术牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

488318.oracleText: One of the first lessons divination students learn is how to recognize the difference between a portent and a simple surface ripple.
488318.translation: 在占卜学最初的几堂课上，学生们主要学习如何区分水面涟漪是否含有预示征兆。

488320.oracleText: "By my calculations, I should be able to achieve true enlightenment before graduation."
488320.translation: 「根据我的计算，我应能在毕业之前获致真正启蒙。」

488323.oracleText: Mages seek out the ancient beings known as the Archaics for their boundless knowledge of history and magic, dispensed only in cryptic metaphors.
488323.translation: 远古生灵古旅人遗世绝俗，其历史与魔法造诣深不可测，故而吸引众多法师苦寻其下落一求真知，到头却只收获晦涩难懂的神秘比喻。

488324.oracleText: If an opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw two cards. Draw three cards instead if an opponent has at least four more cards in hand than you.
488324.translation: 如果某对手的手牌比你多，则你抓两张牌。如果某对手的手牌比你至少多四张，则改为你抓三张牌。

488326.oracleText: To exact his vengeance, Extus needed followers. His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.
488326.translation: 埃陀斯需要更多人手才能实现他的复仇大计。于是他派渗透者深入自己意图破坏的各处学堂，就地招募有为修习法师来实施计划。

488327.oracleText: For each opponent, gain control of up to one target creature or planeswalker that player controls with mana value 3 or less.
488327.translation: 为每位对手各进行以下流程～获得至多一个目标由其操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物或鹏洛客之操控权。

488329.oracleText: Counter target instant or sorcery spell. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that spell and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
488329.translation: 反击目标瞬间或法术咒语。从其操控者的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与该咒语同名的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每有一张以此法放逐的手牌，他便抓一张牌。

488331.oracleText: "By using the vortex, I can study for at least fifteen extra minutes between every class. I wasn't being reckless, Dean Imbraham. I was being efficient."
488331.translation: 「借助漩涡，我就能在每次课间至少空出十五分钟的学习时间。英巴罕院长，我这不是无谋，反而是在追求效率。」

488332.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more lands, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
488332.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

488335.oracleText: Form and function in perfect unity.
488335.translation: 形式与功能的完美统一。

488338.oracleText: After drownings, devourings, and one highly unpleasant algae infestation, unsupervised portal use on campus was banned.
488338.translation: 自从多次溺水、吞噬事故和一次令人极度不快的野藻入侵后，学校当即禁止学生在未经监督的情况下开启传送通道。

488339.oracleText: {o3oU}: Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
488339.translation: {o3oU}：目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

488341.oracleText: "I would be kinder to my peers, Professor, but I simply don't have any."
488341.translation: 「教授，我也想对功力相若的人客气些，但就是遇不上。」

488342.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay 2 life. If you do, it gains flying until end of turn.
488342.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

488345.oracleText: You may pay {o1oB} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488345.translation: 你可以支付{o1oB}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488346.oracleText: If the {o1oB} cost was paid, an opponent draws a card.
488346.translation: 如果曾支付此{o1oB}费用，则任一对手抓一张牌。

488348.oracleText: Most trudges are covered with decaying plant matter, making them ideal breeding grounds for fungal spores.
488348.translation: 大多数楚吉兽背上都覆有一片腐植层，令它们成为培养真菌孢子的最佳选择。

488357.translation: 放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

488358.translation: 放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

488362.oracleText: "Why, Gideon? Of all people, why save me?"
488362.translation: 「为什么，基定？为什么茫茫众生，你偏偏救了我？」

488363.oracleText: Return target planeswalker card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
488363.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于X的鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

488364.oracleText: Remove twice X loyalty counters from target planeswalker an opponent controls.
488364.translation: 从目标由对手操控的鹏洛客上移去两倍于X数量的忠诚指示物。

488365.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Return target planeswalker card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. 
• Remove twice X loyalty counters from target planeswalker an opponent controls.
488365.translation:
选择一项～ 
•将目标法术力值等于或小于X的鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。 
•从目标由对手操控的鹏洛客上移去两倍于X数量的忠诚指示物。

488367.oracleText: Most students could barely endure Dean Embrose's scrutiny for a semester or two; Killian lived with it his entire life.
488367.translation: 面对安博斯院长的百般挑剔，大多数学生连一两个学期都忍不下去；但齐力安却得忍受一辈子。

488368.oracleText: Each player loses 2 life. You draw two cards.
488368.translation: 每位牌手各失去2点生命。你抓两张牌。

488370.oracleText: "I'd say it's still a fair fight—now my friend is about the size of your ego."
488370.translation: 「我觉得这还算是公平对决～现在我朋友已经跟你的自尊一样大了。」

488371.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. It gains lifelink until end of turn.
488371.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

488374.oracleText: Oculomancers see the ideal potion ingredient. The bats don't see it that way.
488374.translation: 在视像术士眼中，这是理想的药剂配方。但在巨眼蝠眼中，它们可不这么想。

488377.oracleText:
"I assure you, no one fails my course more than once."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
488377.translation:
「我向你保证，我的课最多只会不及格一次。」
～银毫院长安博斯

488378.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is 7 minus the number of cards in that creature's controller's hand.
488378.translation: 目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为7减去该生物操控者的手牌数量。

488380.oracleText: The only feeling worse than not knowing the answer is the certainty you once did.
488380.translation: 比现在解不出题目更难受的，是你确信自己此前解出过同一题。

488384.oracleText:
"The strongest shadow spells come from disdain for someone else, not frustration with yourself."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
488384.translation:
「最强大的黯影咒语源自蔑视他人，而非自我悔恨。」
～银毫院长安博斯

488385.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/-2 until end of turn.
488385.translation: 目标生物得+2/-2直到回合结束。

488387.oracleText: "Everyone thinks that leeches maintain a strictly sanguivorous diet, but in fact, most freshwater leeches are carnivores. Wait, where are you going?"
488387.translation: 「所有人都以为蚂蟥仅摄食血液，但实际上大多数的淡水水蛭也具有肉食习性。等等，你们怎么都走了？」

488390.oracleText: One of the Oriq's most powerful tools is the mage hunter, a vile monstrosity created to seek out and snuff out the arcane.
488390.translation: 猎法妖是专为找出并掐灭秘法来源而创造出来的恶毒怪物，因此它们算得上欧理可众手中的最强武器。

488391.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts or copies an instant or sorcery spell, they lose 1 life.
488391.translation: 每当任一对手施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，其失去1点生命。

488393.oracleText: Extus stood before his alma mater for a moment, remembering first his studies, then his vengeance. At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.
488393.translation: 埃陀斯驻足母校门前，心中澎湃的先是校园回忆，然后很快变成复仇恨意。随着他一声令下，猎法妖蜂拥而出。

488394.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller loses 1 life.
488394.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者失去1点生命。

488396.oracleText: When live specimens aren't readily available, Witherbloom mages make creative use of ragged spirits clinging to long-dead bodies.
488396.translation: 当手头没有可用的活体标本时，靡华法师便活用仍留在久逝尸体上的破碎灵魂来作替代。

488399.oracleText: "The professor said to first extract the venom glands, then the acid sac. Next up, the . . . meeping organ?"
488399.translation: 「教授说先摘除毒腺，然后再取下酸囊。下一步是…发声结？」

488400.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
488400.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

488402.oracleText: Nothing can quell the Oriq's thirst for the forbidden secrets of the past.
488402.translation: 没有什么能够浇灭欧理可众对于过往禁忌秘密的渴望。

488403.oracleText: {oT}: Search your library for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle. If it's an instant or sorcery card, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488403.translation: {oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。如果它是瞬间或法术牌，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488406.oracleText: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.
488406.translation: 斯翠海文禁止使用血腥时代的任何魔法，于是埃陀斯的研究从此开始。

488407.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice one or more creatures. When you do, copy this spell for each creature sacrificed this way.
488407.translation: 你可以牺牲一个或数个生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。当你如此作时，每以此法牺牲一个生物，便将此咒语复制一次。

488410.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
488410.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

488413.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
488413.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

488414.oracleText: You lose 1 life. Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
488414.translation: 你失去1点生命。检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

488415.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls.
488415.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最大者。

488416.oracleText: Each opponent may discard a card. If they don't, they lose 3 life. Repeat this process six more times.
488416.translation: 每位对手各可以弃一张牌。若其未如此作，则其失去3点生命。将此流程再重复六次。

488418.oracleText: Professor Onyx urged the twins to prepare for the dark mage Extus, sounding very much like someone familiar with the rise of tyrants.
488418.translation: 黑玉教授提醒冰火双子对黑暗法师埃陀斯早作准备，口气听起来仿佛就像她自己亲历过暴君崛起一样。

488419.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. 
• Target creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
488419.translation:
选择一项～ 
•在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•目标生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

488421.oracleText: "Your technique is sloppy, but there is talent there. Do it again, and keep your right arm in position this time."
488421.translation: 「你虽然技艺粗糙，但也还算是可塑之材。再作一次，这次记得把右手摆正位置。」

488422.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, draw a card.
488422.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若其上有+1/+1指示物，则抓一张牌。

488428.oracleText: Foul specters hunt down those who try to back out of a deal with a daemogoth.
488428.translation: 与无丈魔交易后想要反悔者，下场就是会被邪秽幽魂找到。

488429.oracleText: {o5oB}: Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
488429.translation: {o5oB}：目标对手失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

488431.oracleText: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."
488431.translation: 「啊，我的画作中又多一位未来的大法师。」

488433.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
488433.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

488435.oracleText: The sport of Mage Tower was conceived as a playful testing ground for young spellcasters.
488435.translation: 斗法塔运动既充满竞技又富有乐趣，因此被视作年轻法师的最佳试炼场。

488437.oracleText: Create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
488437.translation: 派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。

488440.oracleText:
"Don't look at me like that. It was either this or being eaten by a groff."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student
488440.translation:
「别这样看着我。你要么吃这个，要么被泽犬吃。」
～靡华修习法师迪娜

488444.oracleText: "I'll show you original research, you hack!"
488444.translation: 「让我给你瞧瞧真正的原创研究，你个代写枪手！」

488445.oracleText: Target creature blocks this turn if able. You may have it gain reach until end of turn.
488445.translation: 目标生物本回合若能进行阻挡，则必须阻挡。你可以使其获得延势异能直到回合结束。

488447.oracleText: "The Founder Dragons weren't even hatched when this scroll was written!"
488447.translation: 「这张卷轴写就时，创院巨龙都还没孵出来呢！」

488448.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may put an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard on the bottom of your library. If you do, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
488448.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库底。若你如此作，则放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

488451.oracleText: His troops took the Fortress of Caerdoon centuries ago, yet he fights on.
488451.translation: 虽然他手下部队数百年前就已攻占瑟盾要塞，但他仍在沙场征战。

488452.oracleText: {oT}: Attacking Spirits get +1/+0 until end of turn.
488452.translation: {oT}：进行攻击的精怪得+1/+0直到回合结束。

488454.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1} and discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
488454.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1}并弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

488456.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards, you may exile one of them from your graveyard. If you do, you may cast it this turn.
488456.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张非地牌时，你可以将其中一张从你的坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则本回合中，你可以施放它。

488458.oracleText: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl. For a moment, she was luminous, transcendent, terrible.
488458.translation: 看着萝婉不断地从斯翠海文魔旋中汲取原始魔力，威尔不由得屏住呼吸。在一瞬之间，只见萝婉通体红光闪耀，宛若毁灭神下凡。

488459.oracleText: CARDNAME deals five times X damage to each of up to X targets.
488459.translation: CARDNAME对至多X个目标各造成五倍于X数量的伤害。

488460.oracleText: Crackle with Power deals five times X damage to each of up to X targets.
488460.translation: 聚力劈响对至多X个目标各造成五倍于X数量的伤害。

488462.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard.
488462.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

488463.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each non-Dragon creature, where X is the exiled card's mana value. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
488463.translation: CARDNAME对每个非龙生物各造成X点伤害，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

488464.oracleText: Draconic Intervention deals X damage to each non-Dragon creature, where X is the exiled card's mana value. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
488464.translation: 龙族干预对每个非龙生物各造成X点伤害，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

488467.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent. You may exile CARDNAME and four cards named Dragon's Approach from your graveyard. If you do, search your library for a Dragon creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
488467.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成3点伤害。你可以放逐CARDNAME，并从你的坟墓场放逐四张名称为巨龙来袭的牌。若你如此作，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张龙生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

488468.oracleText: Dragon's Approach deals 3 damage to each opponent. You may exile Dragon's Approach and four cards named Dragon's Approach from your graveyard. If you do, search your library for a Dragon creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
488468.translation: 巨龙来袭向每位对手各造成3点伤害。你可以放逐巨龙来袭，并从你的坟墓场放逐四张名称为巨龙来袭的牌。若你如此作，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张龙生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

488469.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Dragon's Approach.
488469.translation: 名称为巨龙来袭的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

488474.oracleText: "If the pen is mightier than the sword, just think what a giant tome could do!"
488474.translation: 「如果要说文胜于武、笔强于剑，那一本『巨』著威力该有多大！」

488476.oracleText: Rowan and Will were a natural fit in Prismari College, the school of outrageous elemental arts.
488476.translation: 粹丽学院以研究出格元素技艺闻名，正是最契合萝婉与威尔的去处。

488477.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to any target and 3 damage to any other target. Add {oRoRoR}.
488477.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成5点伤害，且对任意另一个目标造成3点伤害。加{oRoRoR}。

488478.oracleText: Explosive Welcome deals 5 damage to any target and 3 damage to any other target. Add {oRoRoR}.
488478.translation: 热烈欢迎对任意一个目标造成5点伤害，且对任意另一个目标造成3点伤害。加{oRoRoR}。

488480.oracleText: You may pay {o2oRoR} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488480.translation: 你可以支付{o2oRoR}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488481.oracleText: If the {o2oRoR} cost was paid, an opponent discards any number of cards, then draws that many cards.
488481.translation: 如果曾支付此{o2oRoR}费用，则任一对手弃任意数量的牌，然后抓等量的牌。

488482.oracleText: Search your library for up to three cards, put them into your hand, shuffle, then discard three cards at random.
488482.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张牌，将它们置于你手上，洗牌，然后随机弃三张牌。

488486.oracleText: Some spirits share ancient wisdom. Others just get mad you touched their stuff.
488486.translation: 有的魂灵乐于分享古代智慧。而有的则会因你乱碰私物而动怒。

488487.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488487.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488489.oracleText: On rare occasions, a Prismari student will summon an elemental that shows such promise that it's permitted to stay and enroll.
488489.translation: 有的时候，粹丽学生能够召唤出颇具天资的元素，令到学院破格准许它们留存甚至入学。不过这极其罕见。

488492.oracleText: "No unauthorized summoning. No writing in the library books. And absolutely no indoor dueling!"
488492.translation: 「未经许可禁止召唤。馆藏书籍禁止涂写。绝对不准室内决斗！」

488494.oracleText: "While you were wasting time with abstract equations, I mastered ancient Oggyar fire magic. Your move."
488494.translation: 「当你还在浪费时间解开抽象算式时，我早已掌握了古代欧格牙烈焰魔法。看你的了。」

488495.oracleText: Heated Debate deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
488495.translation: 火热争辩对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

488497.oracleText: Prismari fosters a burning need to create.
488497.translation: 粹丽学院志在培育对创造的热切需求。

488498.oracleText: Igneous Inspiration deals 3 damage to any target.
488498.translation: 火灵启迪对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

488500.oracleText: "Look at the detail in this stonework! Professor, our assumptions about early Kathorran tool use may not be correct."
488500.translation: 「看看这石雕细部的精妙处理！教授，也许我们对于卡瑟朗族早期使用工具的假设有误。」

488501.oracleText: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards. Then if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488501.translation: 弃任意数量的牌，然后抓等量的牌。然后如果你的坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488503.oracleText: The most distinguished Lorehold professors are eligible to receive extended tenure, even beyond the limits of their own mortality.
488503.translation: 衡鉴学院最杰出的教授有资格终身获聘，就算其业已离世也可继续任教。

488507.oracleText: Far from the trappings of royalty, Rowan and Will found inspiration from the most popular sport on campus, Mage Tower.
488507.translation: 在摆脱皇家礼典的束缚之后，萝婉和威尔能够积极参加校园内最受欢迎的运动项目～斗法塔，并从中收获大量灵感。

488508.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a creature token.
488508.translation: 如果此咒语以衍生生物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

488510.oracleText: When art projects collapse, Prismari students revel in the beauty of destruction. Everyone else runs for cover.
488510.translation: 当艺术作品轰然倒塌时，粹丽学生会在毁灭之美中尽情狂欢。而其他人则会慌忙寻找避难处。

488511.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
488511.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成5点伤害。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

488512.oracleText: Pigment Storm deals 5 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
488512.translation: 染料风暴对目标生物造成5点伤害。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

488515.oracleText: A giant statue of a dwarf is still a giant statue.
488515.translation: 巨型的矮人雕像，也算是巨人雕像。

488516.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
488516.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于法术时机起动。

488524.oracleText: "I don't care what they think!" Rootha snapped. "I know I can do better."
488524.translation: 「我不在乎他们怎么想！」如莎打断道，「我只知道我能做得更好。」

488525.oracleText: Start from Scratch deals 1 damage to any target.
488525.translation: 从头开始对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

488526.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. 
• Destroy target artifact.
488526.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

488527.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Start from Scratch deals 1 damage to any target. 
• Destroy target artifact.
488527.translation:
选择一项～ 
•从头开始对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

488529.oracleText: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.
488529.translation: 捕捉到的元素虽不稳定，但能够成为强大的能量来源。

488531.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, create a Treasure token.
488531.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

488533.oracleText: Rootha created constantly, passionately, in hopes of impressing her greatest critic: herself.
488533.translation: 如莎对每次创作都投入十二分的专注和热情，只为能让最挑剔她的批评家满意：她自己。

488535.oracleText:
"Quintorius, would you care to explain why you didn't complete your homework?"
