—Augusta, Lorehold dean
488535.translation:
「昆托力，你能不能解释一下为何没完成作业？」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

488536.oracleText: {oT}, Exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488536.translation: {oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488539.oracleText: "May your wretched name never grace the annals of history, you ignorant buffoon!"
488539.translation: 「祝你的丑陋名字永无法登诸年志之端，你个无知蠢货！」

488541.oracleText: "Tincture of murkroot and lizard feet? Simple. One that doesn't taste like murkroot and lizard feet? I'm working on it."
488541.translation: 「黯根蜥爪酊？轻而易举。要喝起来没有黯根和蜥爪味的？正在研究。」

488542.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
488542.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

488544.oracleText: "I made that! It's mine! Did you see that?"
488544.translation: 「那是我变的！是我变的！看到了吗？」

488545.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You gain 3 life.
488545.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。你获得3点生命。

488548.oracleText:
"Groffs are great for tracking pests through the muck, but securing the pests before the groff devours them is a dicey endeavor."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean
488548.translation:
「虽然泽犬擅于穿梭淤泥间找到害虫下落，但要想在它们吞下之前把害虫救出来，就得冒着生命危险。」
～靡华院长莉塞特

488549.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {o3}.
488549.translation: 牺牲一个生物或支付{o3}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

488551.oracleText:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator
488551.translation:
「留给量析队的时间不多了。如果他们想要抢下靡华队的苑像，他们得拿出镇住全场的本事。」
～斗法塔赛评夸米克

488552.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains reach until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
488552.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得延势异能。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488554.oracleText: It takes "devouring a book in one sitting" to a frightening extreme.
488554.translation: 它把「一口气消化一本书」演绎到了惊人的极端。

488559.oracleText:
"What a move! Lorehold gets caught flat-footed, and Witherbloom barrels ahead."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator
488559.translation:
「精彩突破！衡鉴队显得有点不知所措，靡华队趁机拉开距离。」
～斗法塔赛评夸米克

488561.oracleText: For pestkeepers, there's no sound more disheartening than breaking glass.
488561.translation: 对害虫看守来说，最吓人的莫过于听到玻璃碎裂的声音。

488564.oracleText: Witherbloom spells often take on the appearance—and personality—of their components.
488564.translation: 靡华咒语通常会保留其主要成分的外形～甚至天性。

488565.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control. When the permanent you don't control dies this turn, you gain 2 life.
488565.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。本回合中，当该不由你操控的永久物死去时，你获得2点生命。

488567.oracleText: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."
488567.translation: 「创院巨龙终结了血腥时代。能够侍奉他们是我的荣幸。」

488568.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488568.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488570.oracleText: {o4oGoG}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.

488573.oracleText: Search your library and graveyard for up to four creature cards with different names that each have mana value X or less and reveal them. An opponent chooses two of those cards. Shuffle the chosen cards into your library and put the rest onto the battlefield. Exile CARDNAME.
488573.translation: 从你的牌库和坟墓场中搜寻至多四张名称各不相同的生物牌，且其法术力值均须等于或小于X，展示这些牌。任一对手选择其中两张牌。将所选之牌洗入你的牌库，其余则放进战场。放逐CARDNAME。

488574.oracleText: Search your library and graveyard for up to four creature cards with different names that each have mana value X or less and reveal them. An opponent chooses two of those cards. Shuffle the chosen cards into your library and put the rest onto the battlefield. Exile Ecological Appreciation.
488574.translation: 从你的牌库和坟墓场中搜寻至多四张名称各不相同的生物牌，且其法术力值均须等于或小于X，展示这些牌。任一对手选择其中两张牌。将所选之牌洗入你的牌库，其余则放进战场。放逐生态鉴赏。

488576.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. That land becomes a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature that's still a land. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each land you had enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
488576.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。该地成为0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵生物，且仍然是地。在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于本回合中在你操控下进战场的地数量。

488578.oracleText: Most Quandrix students fundamentally disagree with the concept of "enough."
488578.translation: 大多数量析学生都从根本上反对「适量」这一说法。

488579.oracleText: Until end of turn, double target creature's power X times.
488579.translation: 直到回合结束，将目标生物的力量加倍X次。

488581.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Forest card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
488581.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

488583.oracleText: "If a seedling can push through solid stone, there's no limit to what I could do."
488583.translation: 「如果连幼苗都能突破顽石自由成长，那我的能力便高无止境。」

488584.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
488584.translation: 你获得2点生命。目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

488590.oracleText: First in his clan to attend Strixhaven, and now first in his class.
488590.translation: 他是曾是该部落第一位入学斯翠海文的巨魔，如今更是班上第一名。

488591.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+1 as long as you have 25 or more life.
488591.translation: 只要你的总生命为25或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+1。

488594.oracleText:
"She showed up to class on a what?"
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean
488594.translation:
「她是骑什么上学的来着？」
～靡华院长瓦伦丁

488595.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
488595.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488597.oracleText:
"Do you still believe my work is nothing but dry, boring equations?"
—Cairu, Quandrix mage-student
488597.translation:
「你还觉得我的成果就只是枯燥无聊的算式吗？」
～量析修习法师凯依璐

488598.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of lands you control.
488598.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的地数量。

488600.oracleText: "Remember the rules. No spells to the face!"
488600.translation: 「请双方注意规则。咒语不能打脸！」

488601.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you've cast another instant or sorcery spell this turn.
488601.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过其他瞬间或法术咒语，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488602.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+2 until end of turn. Then it fights target creature you don't control.
488602.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+2直到回合结束。然后它与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

488605.oracleText: Tondo lost his very first duel and has spent his entire life trying to get even.
488605.translation: 汤多输掉了平生第一次决斗，而后便耗尽余生要讨平旧账。

488606.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power equal to its toughness attacks, it gains trample until end of turn.
488606.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量与防御力相等的生物攻击时，它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

488612.oracleText: She's brilliant, if a bit overbearing.
488612.translation: 她聪智过人，甚至可以说是凌人。

488616.oracleText: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"
488616.translation: 「线性增长？你当我还是一年级新生吗？」

488617.oracleText: {o4oG}: Double CARDNAME's power and toughness until end of turn.
488617.translation: {o4oG}：将CARDNAME的力量与防御力加倍直到回合结束。

488620.oracleText: Scurrid teeth evolved to crack open nuts, but they work just as well for crushing bones if the nest is threatened.
488620.translation: 怖鼠的牙齿进化后已能咬碎坚果，但如果巢穴受到威胁，也能用来咬碎骨头。

488621.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 as long as you control eight or more lands.
488621.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，CARDNAME便得+2/+2。

488624.oracleText:
"The bogs are deeper than you realize. Most of the space beneath the surface is taken up by these enormous karoks. You might think your feet are touching the bottom. They're probably not."
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef
488624.translation:
「腐沼的深度远超乎你的实感。这些庞大的鳄兽占据了水面下大多数空间。你会以为自己的脚已触到沼底。你很可能感觉错了。」
～靡华主厨纪尧姆

488626.oracleText: Cervins feed on the mana-rich plants around the star arches, imbuing their bodies with extraordinary grace and vitality.
488626.translation: 魔鹿以星拱周围富含法力的植物为食，因而体态优雅、充满活力。

488629.oracleText:
"It's like that old saying: what goes up . . . feeds the arboretum."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean
488629.translation:
「有谚道：凡事有起…必喂植物。」
～靡华院长莉塞特

488630.oracleText: Tangletrap deals 5 damage to target creature with flying.
488630.translation: 缠草捕物对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。

488631.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature with flying. 
• Destroy target artifact.
488631.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

488632.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Tangletrap deals 5 damage to target creature with flying. 
• Destroy target artifact.
488632.translation:
选择一项～ 
•缠草捕物对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

488634.oracleText: You may pay {o3oG} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488634.translation: 你可以支付{o3oG}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488635.oracleText: Search your library for up to four basic land cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped under an opponent's control if the {o3oG} cost was paid. Put two of them onto the battlefield tapped under your control and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.
488635.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多四张基本地牌并展示之。如果曾支付此{o3oG}费用，则将其中一张在任一对手的操控下横置放进战场。将其中两张在你的操控下横置放进战场，其余的牌则置于你手上。然后洗牌。

488637.oracleText: "Hold still. I have a theory about what's going to happen to your face."
488637.translation: 「站定别动。我有一套关于你的面容即将变化的理论。」

488639.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more lands, CARDNAME gets +5/+5.
488639.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，CARDNAME便得+5/+5。

488646.oracleText: Pests are typically harvested before they outgrow their enclosures. Blex is far from typical.
488646.translation: 害虫一般在体型长超围笼之前就被采走备用。但毕雷兹很不一般。

488648.oracleText: Other Pests, Bats, Insects, Snakes, and Spiders you control get +1/+1.
488648.translation: 由你操控的其他害虫、蝙蝠、昆虫、蛇和蜘蛛得+1/+1。

488652.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put any number of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 3 life for each card you put into your hand this way.
488652.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中任意数量的牌置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。你每以此法将一张牌置于你手上，便失去3点生命。

488654.oracleText: "Join me for the dawn of a new age."

488656.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, return target nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
488656.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，将目标非传奇的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488664.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability that isn't a mana ability, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to that player.
488664.translation: 每当任一对手起动不属法术力异能的异能时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成1点伤害。

488670.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells or activate planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
488670.translation: 本回合中，所有对手都不能施放咒语或起动鹏洛客的忠诚异能。

488675.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a nonland card, you may cast it by paying {o1} rather than paying its mana cost. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield.
488675.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是非地牌，则你可以施放它，但须支付{o1}，而非支付其法术力费用。如果它是地牌，则将之放进战场。

488677.oracleText: To find Jadzi, one need only wander.

488679.oracleText: You may put any number of land cards from your hand onto the battlefield. Then if you control eight or more lands, you may discard a card. If you do, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
488679.translation: 你可以将任意数量的地牌从你手上放进战场。然后如果你操控八个或更多地，则你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

488680.oracleText: You may put any number of land cards from your hand onto the battlefield. Then if you control eight or more lands, you may discard a card. If you do, return Journey to the Oracle to its owner's hand.
488680.translation: 你可以将任意数量的地牌从你手上放进战场。然后如果你操控八个或更多地，则你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则将追寻圣法谕移回其拥有者手上。

488683.oracleText: {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put a study counter on it.
488683.translation: {oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，则将它置于你手上。若否，则在其上放置一个读书指示物。

488684.oracleText: {o4oG}: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each different mana value among nonland cards you own in exile with study counters on them.
488684.translation: {o4oG}：派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于放逐区中由你拥有且其上有读书指示物之各牌间不同的法术力值数量。

488687.oracleText: {oXoUoU}, {oT}: Exile the top X cards of your library and put a study counter on each of them. Then you may put a card you own in exile with a study counter on it into your hand.
488687.translation: {oXoUoU}，{oT}：放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，并在所放逐的每张牌上各放置一个读书指示物。然后你可以将放逐区中一张由你拥有且其上有读书指示物的牌置于你手上。

488690.oracleText: Whenever an opponent attacks one or more planeswalkers you control, put a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
488690.translation: 每当任一对手攻击由你操控的一个或数个鹏洛客时，在每个由你操控的鹏洛客上各放置一个忠诚指示物。

488693.oracleText: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card. If a creature card was discarded this way, draw two cards instead.
488693.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌。如果以此法弃掉一张生物牌，则改为抓两张牌。

488694.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of your next upkeep.
488694.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在你的下一个维持开始时，将它放逐。

488699.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Each opponent mills cards equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
488699.translation: {o1}，{oT}：每位对手各磨若干牌，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

488700.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Exile four target cards from a single graveyard. Draw a card.
488700.translation: {o4}，{oT}：将四张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌放逐。抓一张牌。

488702.oracleText: "Death? Everyone does death. Let me show you something actually impressive."
488702.translation: 「死去？人人都会死去。让我给你看看更精彩的东西。」

488704.oracleText: Return up to two target creature, land, and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand. Each player gains 4 life. Exile CARDNAME.
488704.translation: 将至多两张目标生物，地和／或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。每位牌手各获得4点生命。放逐CARDNAME。

488705.oracleText: Return up to two target creature, land, and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand. Each player gains 4 life. Exile Restorative Burst.
488705.translation: 将至多两张目标生物，地和／或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。每位牌手各获得4点生命。放逐复归爆发。

488708.oracleText: {o4oR}, {oT}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonlegendary, nonland card with mana value 3 or less. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
488708.translation: {o4oR}，{oT}：从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值等于或小于3且既非传奇也非地的牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。将所有以此法展示且未施放的牌依随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

488710.oracleText: Other tapped creatures you control get +1/+0.
488710.translation: 由你操控且已横置的其他生物得+1/+0。

488711.oracleText: Other untapped creatures you control get +0/+1.
488711.translation: 由你操控且未横置的其他生物得+0/+1。

488712.oracleText: Whenever you attack, untap each creature you control, then tap any number of creatures you control.
488712.translation: 每当你攻击时，重置所有由你操控的生物，然后横置任意数量由你操控的生物。

488715.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent. If you've drawn three or more cards this turn, she deals 3 damage to each opponent instead.
488715.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过三张或更多牌，则改为她向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

488717.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
488717.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

488718.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy."
488718.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。」

488721.oracleText: Up to one target creature has base power and toughness 0/2 until your next turn.
488721.translation: 至多一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为0/2直到你的下一个回合。

488723.oracleText: Exile up to five target permanents. For each permanent exiled this way, its controller creates a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488723.translation: 放逐至多五个目标永久物。对每个以此法放逐的永久物而言，其操控者派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488725.oracleText: He offered his light to make sure no others would be dimmed.
488725.translation: 他奉献自身光芒，确保无人生命就此黯淡。

488727.oracleText: Exile CARDNAME: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
488727.translation: 放逐CARDNAME：由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

488730.oracleText: She cast a spell to purge all weakness. When the ink cleared, she stood alone.
488730.translation: 她施咒涤净弱者。墨渍褪去唯她孑自独立。

488731.oracleText: Choose a creature or planeswalker, then destroy all other creatures and planeswalkers.
488731.translation: 选择一个生物或鹏洛客，然后消灭所有其他生物和鹏洛客。

488733.oracleText: "You are so much stronger than you know."

488735.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
488735.translation: {oT}：在每个本回合在你的操控下进战场的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488737.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature, then CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that creature.
488737.translation: {oT}：在另一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后CARDNAME对该生物造成2点伤害。

488744.oracleText: He channels his heart's passion into every fiery note.
488744.translation: 他将自己的内心激情，全数化作火焰音符喷薄而出。

488745.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw a card. When you discard an instant or sorcery card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
488745.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张瞬间或法术牌时，CARDNAME对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所弃之牌的法术力值。

488746.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw a card. When you discard an instant or sorcery card this way, Flamethrower Sonata deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
488746.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张瞬间或法术牌时，喷焰奏曲对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所弃之牌的法术力值。

488749.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove a hone counter from it.
488749.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，则从其上移去一个磨练指示物。

488750.oracleText: When the last hone counter is removed from this card, if it's exiled, you may cast it. It costs {o4} less to cast this way.
488750.translation: 当从此牌上移去最后一个磨练指示物时，若它已放逐，则你可以施放它。它以此法施放时减少{o4}来施放。

488754.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of each opponent's library. Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among those exiled cards, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
488754.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐每位对手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放所放逐之牌中的非地牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这些咒语的费用。

488755.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488755.translation: 每当你从放逐区中施放咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488761.oracleText: "Life is as fleeting as it is vibrant. Embrace the brief blessing of a flower before it withers."
488761.translation: 「万物生命越短暂，生机就越旺盛。好好把握鲜花凋谢之前那转瞬即逝的祝福。」

488763.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {o1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and those creatures gain trample until end of turn.
488763.translation: 每当你获得生命时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物，且这些生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

488765.oracleText: Some Quandrix mages prefer to study at twilight, watching their experimental equations trace glowing trails against the encroaching darkness.
488765.translation: 有些量析法师喜欢等到黄昏时刻才开始研究，因为在逐渐笼罩下来的夜幕当中，他们才能看到自己实验算式画出的轨迹辉光。

488766.oracleText: Return target permanent to its owner's hand. Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
488766.translation: 将目标永久物移回其拥有者手上。将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488769.oracleText: Pay 10 life: Untap all lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
488769.translation: 支付10点生命：重置所有由你操控的地。每回合只能起动一次。

488775.oracleText: "So you see, the reckless battle strategy of the Kathorran orcs was effective, but ultimately proved to be a double-edged sword. As did their double-edged swords."
488775.translation: 「所以我们可以看到，卡瑟朗族半兽人所采用的鲁莽战术虽然有效，但最终来说却是一把双刃剑。就跟他们挥舞的双刃剑一样。」

488778.oracleText: "Dean Valentin warns us not to consume the samples for our safety, but I think he's just being greedy."
488778.translation: 「瓦伦丁院长告诫我们说，为了自身安全着想，请勿吞服样品。但我觉得他就是太贪心。」

488781.oracleText: A drop of ink is a nuisance. A torrent of inklings is a menace.
488781.translation: 一滴墨水只是小麻烦。一股墨灵则是大威胁。

488782.oracleText: Create X tapped 2/1 white and black Inkling creature tokens with flying. If X is 6 or more, destroy all noncreature, nonland permanents.
488782.translation: 派出X个已横置的2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。如果X等于或大于6，则消灭所有非生物且非地的永久物。

488784.oracleText: Needledeep had promised that his final project would be his biggest one yet.
488784.translation: 邃针曾向大家保证，他最后一个作品会是他有史以来最大的。

488785.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of cards in your library.
488785.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你牌库中牌的数量。

488788.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast during your end step.
488788.translation: 于你的结束步骤中，此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488789.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker you don't control. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.
488789.translation: 消灭目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客。在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488791.oracleText: The only thing more delicious than a top grade is Gyome's signature cake.
488791.translation: 比好成绩更诱人的，只有纪尧姆的招牌蛋糕。

488793.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to any target. Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
488793.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

488794.oracleText: Creative Outburst deals 5 damage to any target. Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
488794.translation: 创意爆发对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

488798.oracleText: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."
488798.translation: 「你失败的原因在于自身的软弱。我只不过是为你指出这一点。」

488799.oracleText: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less. Add {oB} or {oG} for each permanent destroyed this way.
488799.translation: 消灭所有法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物。每以此法消灭一个永久物，便加{oB}或{oG}。

488801.oracleText: Will's quick thinking meshed with Rowan's raw power to bring down the Blood Avatar.
488801.translation: 威尔的敏捷思维佐以萝婉的天赐纯力，双子齐心最终得以击败血腥圣者。

488802.oracleText: Exile the top X cards of your library. For each land card exiled this way, create a Treasure token. For each blue card exiled this way, draw a card. For each red card exiled this way, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488802.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的X张牌。每以此法放逐一张地牌，便派出一个珍宝衍生物。每以此法放逐一张蓝色牌，便抓一张牌。每以此法放逐一张红色牌，CARDNAME便向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488803.oracleText: Exile the top X cards of your library. For each land card exiled this way, create a Treasure token. For each blue card exiled this way, draw a card. For each red card exiled this way, Culmination of Studies deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488803.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的X张牌。每以此法放逐一张地牌，便派出一个珍宝衍生物。每以此法放逐一张蓝色牌，便抓一张牌。每以此法放逐一张红色牌，研学巅峰便向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488805.oracleText:
"Of course it offered you power. Demons always do. But trust me—the sweeter the prize, the more ruinous the price."
—Professor Onyx
488805.translation:
「它当然会赐予你力量。恶魔都如此。不过请听我一言～奖赏越甜美，代价越惨痛。」
～黑玉教授

488806.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, sacrifice a creature.
488806.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，牺牲一个生物。

488809.oracleText: "Your pain for my wisdom. You'll get no better deal."
488809.translation: 「用你的痛苦换取我的智慧。你找不到更合算的交易了。」

488810.oracleText: When you sacrifice CARDNAME, each opponent discards a card, you draw a card, and you gain 2 life.
488810.translation: 当你牺牲CARDNAME时，每位对手各弃一张牌，你抓一张牌，且你获得2点生命。

488813.oracleText: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.
488813.translation: 从来没人问过迪娜的合剂里面有些什么，只要药效到了就行。

488817.oracleText: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o3}.
488817.translation: 除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

488818.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control. 
• Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o3}.
488818.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。 
•除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

488821.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
488821.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

488824.oracleText: "Now I can dedicate myself fully to zoetimancy and void theory!"
488824.translation: 「现在我就能专心研究雄生术和虚空理论了！」

488825.oracleText: Copy target creature spell you control, except it isn't legendary if the spell is legendary.
488825.translation: 复制目标由你操控的生物咒语，但如果该咒语是传奇，则复制品不是传奇。

488827.oracleText: The enraptured audience barely noticed their programs were suddenly blank.
488827.translation: 观众看得入神，根本没注意到他们的节目单瞬间变作空白。

488828.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
488828.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

488831.oracleText: If this creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
488831.translation: 如果此生物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。

488835.oracleText: Rootha passed with flying, living colors.
488835.translation: 如莎以出色的优异成绩高分过关。

488836.oracleText: Create two 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature tokens.
488836.translation: 派出两个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488839.oracleText:
"You've made a splash. Now show me a torrent."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean
488839.translation:
「你已能溅起水花。现在让我看看水流。」
～粹丽院长乌薇妲

488840.oracleText: Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488840.translation: 派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488842.oracleText: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"
488842.translation: 「一开始，这些算式就只是数字。但我先从连串数字中读出故事，而又在故事之间发现规律，一切突然就对上了！」

488843.oracleText: Draw two cards. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
488843.translation: 抓两张牌。你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

488845.oracleText: His words poured forth on waves of golden light, scouring all fear from his audience's hearts and minds.
488845.translation: 他的言辞化作道道金光照耀众人，将听众心灵之间所有恐惧打消一空。

488846.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
488846.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

488848.oracleText: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.
488848.translation: 在激情与精进的张力之间，粹丽学生尽情起舞。

488849.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand, put one of them on the bottom of your library, and exile one of them. You may play the exiled card this turn.
488849.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，一张置于你的牌库底，一张放逐。本回合中，你可以使用所放逐的牌。

488851.oracleText:
"Fractals are just pseudo-dimensional manifestations of asynchronous biosymmetries. It's really quite simple."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean
488851.translation:
「分灵只不过是异步生物对称体在假维度空间下的具现。原理非常简单。」
～量析院长齐安妮

488852.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it.
488852.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物。

488854.oracleText:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr
488854.translation:
「年轻法师，你的反抗有点意思。现在你该了解自己实际上有多脆弱。」
～埃陀斯纳尔

488855.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker.
488855.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或鹏洛客。

488858.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell.
488858.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语。

488859.oracleText: Artifacts you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell."
488859.translation: 由你操控的神器具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语。」

488861.oracleText:
"When I look around, I see a world defined by patterns that still manages to defy them."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean
488861.translation:
「我环顾四周，看到的是一个早已有无数规律定义，却还能不断打破规则的世界。」
～量析院长齐安妮

488862.oracleText: Draw a card for each different power among creatures you control.
488862.translation: 由你操控的生物中每有一种力量数值，便抓一张牌。

488864.oracleText:
"As I stepped into the star arch, it all became perfectly clear. Life and death are not opposites, but an endless path, twisting around and back upon itself, never ending and never beginning."
—Zhaer, professor of biophilosophy
488864.translation:
「我踏入星拱，一切都变得豁然开朗。生死并非对立两面，而是一条无尽通途。这条道路蜿蜒缠绕，最后连结一体，无所谓终，也无所谓始。」
～生物哲学教授札依儿

488865.translation: 交换你的手牌和坟墓场。

488868.oracleText: Spirits you control get +1/+1 and have trample and haste.
488868.translation: 由你操控的精怪得+1/+1且具有践踏与敏捷异能。

488873.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
488873.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488875.oracleText: Dina raised her cup to Killian's lips, and for the first time in his life, he knew compassion.
488875.translation: 迪娜将杯子捧到齐力安嘴边，让他首度尝到受人同情的滋味。

488876.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains deathtouch and "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control."
488876.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得死触异能与「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。」

488878.oracleText:
"Think of an insult so vicious, so vulgar, that you hesitate to speak it aloud. The strongest, most aggressive inklings are born from such scorn."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
488878.translation:
「在心里想一句骂人的话。它要够恶毒、够粗俗、够难听，到你自己都不好意思大声骂出口的地步。最强大、最凶猛的墨灵，就是诞生自这种辱骂之中。」
～银毫院长安博斯

488880.oracleText: Each other planeswalker you control has the loyalty abilities of CARDNAME.
488880.translation: 每个由你操控的其他鹏洛客均具有CARDNAME的所有忠诚异能。

488882.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it.
488882.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物。

488883.oracleText: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card that shares a color with this planeswalker, exile that card, then shuffle. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
488883.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张与此鹏洛客具共通颜色的瞬间或法术牌，放逐该牌，然后洗牌。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

488885.oracleText: "When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option."
488885.translation: 「身为安博斯院长的儿子，我不能只屈居第二。」

488886.oracleText: Spells you cast that target a creature cost {o2} less to cast.
488886.translation: 你施放之以生物为目标的咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488888.oracleText: Ancient footfalls echo in her head, their timeless rhythm guiding the present.
488888.translation: 远古足音在她脑中回响，这段永恒踢踏节奏正指引当下发展。

488889.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488889.translation: {oT}：此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488890.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, until end of turn, Spirit creatures you control gain "{oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to each opponent."
488890.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，直到回合结束，由你操控的精怪生物获得「{oT}：此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。」

488892.oracleText: Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488892.translation: 派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488893.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible and haste until end of turn.
488893.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得不灭与敏捷异能。

488894.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Target player gains 3 life.
488894.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。目标牌手获得3点生命。

488895.oracleText: Lorehold Command deals 3 damage to any target. Target player gains 3 life.
488895.translation: 衡鉴指命对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。目标牌手获得3点生命。

488896.oracleText: Sacrifice a permanent, then draw two cards.
488896.translation: 牺牲一个永久物，然后抓两张牌。

488897.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token. 
• Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible and haste until end of turn. 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Target player gains 3 life. 
• Sacrifice a permanent, then draw two cards.
488897.translation:
选择两项～ 
•派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。 
•直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得不灭与敏捷异能。 
•CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。目标牌手获得3点生命。 
•牺牲一个永久物，然后抓两张牌。

488898.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token. 
• Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible and haste until end of turn. 
• Lorehold Command deals 3 damage to any target. Target player gains 3 life. 
• Sacrifice a permanent, then draw two cards.
488898.translation:
选择两项～ 
•派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。 
•直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得不灭与敏捷异能。 
•衡鉴指命对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。目标牌手获得3点生命。 
•牺牲一个永久物，然后抓两张牌。

488900.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, mill a card. If a land card was milled this way, you gain 1 life. Otherwise, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488900.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，磨一张牌。若以此法磨掉一张地牌，则你获得1点生命。若否，则CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488902.oracleText: {o5}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a tapped 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488902.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个已横置的3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488905.oracleText: "The weight of history can empower you or it can crush you. It's your choice."
488905.translation: 「历史之重能赐你力量，也能将你压垮。端看你如何抉择。」

488908.oracleText: She's an inspiration to everyone, even herself.
488908.translation: 她是所有人的灵感源泉，包括她自己。

488909.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {oX} less to cast, where X is CARDNAME's power as this ability resolves.
488909.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你本回合中施放的下一个瞬间或法术咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为于此异能结算时CARDNAME的力量。

488912.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. Tap two target permanents. Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token. Draw two cards.
488912.translation: CARDNAME对任意数量的目标造成共4点伤害，你可以任意分配。横置两个目标永久物。派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。抓两张牌。

488913.oracleText: Magma Opus deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. Tap two target permanents. Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token. Draw two cards.
488913.translation: 至炫熔彩对任意数量的目标造成共4点伤害，你可以任意分配。横置两个目标永久物。派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。抓两张牌。

488916.oracleText: Those who do learn from history may still choose to repeat it.
488916.translation: 从历史中学到教训的人，仍可能选择去重演历史。

488917.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. When that creature dies this turn, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488917.translation: 目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488919.oracleText: The first thing a Quandrix mage learns is the laws of metaphysics. The second thing is how to break them.
488919.translation: 量析法师要学习的第一项内容，便是形上学哲理。第二项内容便是如何打破它们。

488923.oracleText: Necroluminescence is common among the undead creatures of Sedgemoor, giving the midnight swamp an eerie glow. It's comforting—from a distance.
488923.translation: 蓑草原上的不死生物大多会发出死冥磷火，令午夜时分的沼泽四处都有怪异幽光。看起来却也令人安心～只要你别靠近。

488926.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you gained life this turn.
488926.translation: 如果你本回合中获得过生命，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488929.oracleText: As they learn to fly, young drakes have a tendency to accidentally impale trees, cliffs, and unsuspecting students.
488929.translation: 幼年龙兽在学习飞行时，往往会不小心穿透树木、山崖以及没留神的学生。

488931.oracleText: "May Ganathog bless us with bloody visions of glory restored!"
488931.translation: 「愿噶纳索予吾人荣耀复兴的血腥视像！」

488936.oracleText:
"Step 1: Put the pests in mud.
"Step 2: Wait."
—Gyome's Guide to Pest Breeding
488936.translation:
「第一步：把害虫埋入土中。
第二步：等着。」
～《纪尧姆育虫导论》

488939.oracleText: The twins each researched spells to defeat Extus in their own way. Will hit the library. Rowan hit everything else.
488939.translation: 冰火双子分头研究能够击败埃陀斯的咒语：威尔习图书。萝婉袭他物。

488940.oracleText: Draw four cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an instant or sorcery card.
488940.translation: 抓四张牌。然后除非你弃一张瞬间或法术牌，否则弃两张牌。

488942.oracleText: "No one ever created great art by playing it safe!"

488943.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn. If that spell has mana value 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488943.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。如果该咒语的法术力值等于或大于5，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488946.oracleText: Prismari Command deals 2 damage to any target.
488946.translation: 粹丽指命对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

488947.oracleText: Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards.
488947.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

488948.oracleText: Target player creates a Treasure token.
488948.translation: 目标牌手派出一个珍宝衍生物。

488949.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. 
• Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards. 
• Target player creates a Treasure token. 
• Destroy target artifact.
488949.translation:
选择两项～ 
•CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。 
•目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。 
•目标牌手派出一个珍宝衍生物。 
•消灭目标神器。

488950.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Prismari Command deals 2 damage to any target. 
• Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards. 
• Target player creates a Treasure token. 
• Destroy target artifact.
488950.translation:
选择两项～ 
•粹丽指命对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。 
•目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。 
•目标牌手派出一个珍宝衍生物。 
•消灭目标神器。

488952.oracleText: Many have the talent to create, but few have the courage to share their creations.
488952.translation: 人人都有创造才华，但鲜有人有勇气分享。

488953.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
488953.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

488956.oracleText: "The secrets of our world will be mine."
488956.translation: 「这个世界的秘密都将属于我。」

488957.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
488957.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中的一张地牌，并将该牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

488959.oracleText: Return target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
488959.translation: 将目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。

488960.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Return target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand. 
• Counter target artifact or enchantment spell. 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. 
• Target player shuffles up to three target cards from their graveyard into their library.
488960.translation:
选择两项～ 
•将目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。 
•反击目标神器或结界咒语。 
•在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。 
•目标牌手将至多三张目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

488963.oracleText: In the gardens spread across the Quandrix campus, fern turns to forest before class is even over.
488963.translation: 在遍布整个量析校区的花园里面，蕨类植物不消一节课的时间便能生长成林。

488967.oracleText: "The first step toward transcending physical limitations is discarding assumptions about what is possible."
488967.translation: 「超越实体界限的第一步，便是抛弃所有对于可能性的假设。」

488970.oracleText: "Every life has a story to tell. I won't let them be forgotten."
488970.translation: 「每条生命都有属于自己的故事。我绝不会让它们就此埋没。」

488972.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488972.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488974.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
488974.translation: 在你的维持开始时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。本回合中，你可以施放它。若以此法施放的咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

488976.oracleText: Return up to one target artifact card, up to one target enchantment card, up to one target instant card, up to one target sorcery card, and up to one target planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
488976.translation: 将至多一张目标神器牌，至多一张目标结界牌，至多一张目标瞬间牌，至多一张目标法术牌和至多一张目标鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488979.oracleText: When it comes to transporting priceless, delicate artifacts, safety is more important than speed.
488979.translation: 当要运送易碎的无价宝时，安全性远比速度更重要。

488981.oracleText: Lorehold spirit statues are not forbidden from raising statues of their own.
488981.translation: 从未有人禁止衡鉴魂灵雕塑为自己立像。

488985.oracleText: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.
488985.translation: 摘离历史。摘离记忆。摘离现实。

488986.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
488986.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

488987.oracleText: Rip Apart deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
488987.translation: 拆离对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

488988.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
488988.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器或结界。

488989.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Rip Apart deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
488989.translation:
选择一项～ 
•拆离对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器或结界。

488991.oracleText: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step toward vengeance.
488991.translation: 只消致命一击，埃陀斯就将欧理可众的掌控权收入囊中，展开复仇的第一步。

488992.oracleText: Exile target creature. Exile up to one target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard.
488992.translation: 放逐目标生物。将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从坟墓场放逐。

488994.translation: 「艺术从无止境。只是会被抛弃。」

488995.oracleText: {o2}, Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
488995.translation: {o2}，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

488998.oracleText: Witherbloom students learn to see death not as tragedy, but as opportunity.
488998.translation: 靡华学生早已学会把死亡当作机遇，而非悲剧。

488999.oracleText: Choose target creature. When that creature dies this turn, search your library for a creature card with lesser mana value, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
488999.translation: 选择目标生物。本回合中，当该生物死去时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值小于前述生物的生物牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

489001.oracleText: "Would you prefer I destroy you using prose or verse?"
489001.translation: 「你希望我用什么来毁掉你，散文还是诗歌？」

489002.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with flying dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
489002.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489004.oracleText: Target player creates a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
489004.translation: 目标牌手派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。

489005.oracleText: Target player creates a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
489005.translation: 目标牌手派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。

489006.oracleText: Target player draws a card and loses 1 life.
489006.translation: 目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

489007.oracleText: Target player draws a card and loses 1 life.
489007.translation: 目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

489008.oracleText: Target player puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
489008.translation: 目标牌手在每个由其操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489009.oracleText: Target player puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
489009.translation: 目标牌手在每个由其操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489010.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may choose two. Each mode must target a different player. 
• Target player creates a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying. 
• Target player draws a card and loses 1 life. 
• Target player puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
489010.translation:
在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以选择两项。每项均须以不同的牌手为目标。 
•目标牌手派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。 
•目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 
•目标牌手在每个由其操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489012.oracleText: She had spoken the words a hundred times, but under the spotlight, in front of everyone, something new emerged. And the crowd went wild.
489012.translation: 虽然同样的内容她早已排演过数百遍，但这次在聚光灯下，在人群面前，她讲出了新意。观众情绪瞬间引爆。

489013.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
489013.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

489015.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
489015.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

489018.oracleText: "I avoid violence. It is the last resort of the witless. But if you insist, I'll make an exception for you."
489018.translation: 「我一心避免暴力。那是蠢人的绝望之举。但如果你坚持，我会为你破例。」

489019.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME gains your choice of flying or lifelink until end of turn.
489019.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，选择飞行或系命，CARDNAME获得该异能直到回合结束。

489022.oracleText: "I am very much in the mood to start handing out expulsions."
489022.translation: 「我正巧有兴致来给你们签发开除令。」

489024.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell with the chosen name, they lose 3 life and you draw a card.
489024.translation: 每当任一对手施放具该名称的咒语时，他失去3点生命，且你抓一张牌。

489026.oracleText: "It would be a crime to withhold my light from the world."
489026.translation: 「遮蔽我的光芒不让世界看到，这简直就是犯罪。」

489027.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast with mana value 5 or greater cost {o1} less to cast.
489027.translation: 你施放之法术力值等于或大于5的瞬间或法术咒语减少{o1}来施放。

489029.oracleText:
"Books are fantastic, but if you're really curious about the distant past, why not ask someone who was there?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
489029.translation:
「虽然书中记述非常精彩，但如果你真对这段遥远过往感兴趣的话，为什么不直接去问当事人呢？」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

489031.oracleText: "Don't you know first-years pay a toll to walk through here?"
489031.translation: 「你不知道一年级新生走这条路要付钱吗？」

489035.oracleText: Sometimes the most radical thing you can do is think inside the box.
489035.translation: 有时候规圆矩方，便是你能作到的最出格事情。

489036.oracleText: Target creature has base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn.
489036.translation: 目标生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。

489038.oracleText: Quintorius beamed, his mind eager to absorb every historical fact the spirit wanted to divulge.
489038.translation: 昆托力脸上露出笑容，内心早急切想要吸收魂灵透露的一切史实。

489039.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, scry 1.
489039.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，占卜1。

489043.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may have the base power and toughness of other creatures you control become equal to CARDNAME's power and toughness until end of turn.
489043.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以使由你操控之其他生物的基础力量与防御力成为等同于CARDNAME之力量和防御力直到回合结束。

489044.oracleText: Whenever Tanazir Quandrix attacks, you may have the base power and toughness of other creatures you control become equal to Tanazir Quandrix's power and toughness until end of turn.
489044.translation: 每当塔那吉量析攻击时，你可以使由你操控之其他生物的基础力量与防御力成为等同于塔那吉量析之力量和防御力直到回合结束。

489046.oracleText:
"Learning to imitate a master is the first step in becoming one."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean
489046.translation:
「学着模仿大师，是成为大师的第一步。」
～粹丽院长乌薇妲

489048.oracleText: "I've got a special treat for you today."

489051.oracleText:
"This must be the lost city of Zantafar, where my people lived before becoming nomads. Think of the history we'll learn here!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student
489051.translation:
「这里就是失落之城赞塔法。在成为游牧民之前，我的族人便是住在这边。想想我们能在这里学到多少历史！」
～衡鉴修习法师昆托力

489052.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Then you may discard two cards. If you do, draw three cards.
489052.translation: 你获得2点生命。然后你可以弃两张牌。如果你如此作，则抓三张牌。

489054.oracleText: "Whoever summoned that thing had better confess right this moment, or the whole class will be cleaning the ink receptacles for a month!"
489054.translation: 「召唤那东西的人最好现在就站出来认错，否则全班都得陪着你去洗一个月墨胆！」

489057.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value less than or equal to CARDNAME's power from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
489057.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以从其中施放一个法术力值等于或小于CARDNAME之力量的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

489058.oracleText: Whenever Velomachus Lorehold attacks, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value less than or equal to Velomachus Lorehold's power from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
489058.translation: 每当维洛马楚衡鉴攻击时，检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以从其中施放一个法术力值等于或小于维洛马楚衡鉴之力量的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

489060.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage CARDNAME dealt to that player.
489060.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为CARDNAME对该牌手造成的伤害数量。

489063.oracleText: "All we are—every feeling, every action—powered by a single, delicate little organ. Life is so terrifyingly, beautifully fragile."
489063.translation: 「我们的一切～包括感情、动作～都源自这么一个小小的器官。生命这东西虽纤弱得可怕，但也纤弱得美丽。」

489064.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
489064.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

489066.oracleText: Target player mills three cards, then you return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
489066.translation: 目标牌手磨三张牌，然后你将一张地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

489067.oracleText: Destroy target noncreature, nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less.
489067.translation: 消灭目标非生物且非地的永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于2。

489068.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Target player mills three cards, then you return a land card from your graveyard to your hand. 
• Destroy target noncreature, nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less. 
• Target creature gets -3/-1 until end of turn. 
• Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
489068.translation:
选择两项～ 
•目标牌手磨三张牌，然后你将一张地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 
•消灭目标非生物且非地的永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于2。 
•目标生物得-3/-1直到回合结束。 
•目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

489071.oracleText: "'Death is really just a transfer of energy. Those pests I harvested have the honor of becoming pure magic. What could be more beautiful?"
489071.translation: 「死亡不过是能量转移。我捉到的这些害虫有幸能够转变成纯粹魔法。还有比这更美丽的东西吗？」

489072.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, you gain 1 life.
489072.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，你获得1点生命。

489074.oracleText: "What are they complaining about? It's not like axiomatic leyline paratrigonometrics is hard."
489074.translation: 「他们在抱怨什么？公理系地脉对三角学又不难。」

489075.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
489075.translation: {o1}，{oT}：你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。

489076.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Draw a card. If you control eight or more lands, draw two cards instead.
489076.translation: {o4}，{oT}：抓一张牌。如果你操控八个或更多地，则改为抓两张牌。

489078.oracleText:
"I appreciate the help, and honestly, it's very entertaining."
—Isabough of the Biblioplex
489078.translation:
「非常感谢你的帮忙，老实说，看着很有趣。」
～茂典阁的伊瑟伯

489082.oracleText: "There's nowhere in Strixhaven I can't find. Where do you need to go?"
489082.translation: 「斯翠海文没有我不知道的地方。你们要去哪？」

489086.translation: 你不能施放永久物咒语。

489089.oracleText:
"It's the largest library in the Multiverse. Of course it has the largest librarians."
—Kasmina
489089.translation:
「这里是多重宇宙中最大的图书馆。自然也有最大的图书馆员。」
～克蜜娜

489090.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
489090.translation: {o2}，{oT}：将目标牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

489092.oracleText:
"Don't be fooled by the quiet. These old stones are trying to talk to you."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
489092.translation:
「别给这安静氛围给骗了。这旧石头想要跟你说话呢。」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

489095.oracleText: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven. Will saw a chance for arcane study. Rowan saw a chance for power.
489095.translation: 信封自动打开，邀请冰火双子就读斯翠海文。威尔将其视为研习秘法的良机。萝婉将其视作增强力量的际遇。

489098.oracleText: "We don't cut through Sedgemoor anymore. Can't get five steps without a groff trying to fight its own reflection."
489098.translation: 「我们不会再抄蓑草原的近道了。走不出五步就会有泽犬跑来想与自己的镜像打架。」

489099.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only CARDNAME, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
489099.translation: 每当你施放仅以CARDNAME为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

489102.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a book counter on CARDNAME.
489102.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个书籍指示物。

489104.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a book counter from CARDNAME: Add {oC}.
489104.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个书籍指示物：加{oC}。

489106.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Remove three book counters from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
489106.translation: {o3}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去三个书籍指示物：抓一张牌。

489109.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Put a point counter on CARDNAME.
489109.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。在CARDNAME上放置一个得分指示物。

489111.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, remove a point counter from CARDNAME.
489111.translation: 每当一个生物对你造成战斗伤害时，从CARDNAME上移去一个得分指示物。

489113.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a point counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has ten or more point counters on it, remove them all and that player loses the game.
489113.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个得分指示物。然后如果其上有十个或更多得分指示物，则移去所有此类指示物且该牌手输掉这盘游戏。

489116.oracleText: Choosing a college based on Mage Tower results is discouraged, but not unheard of.
489116.translation: 虽然不鼓励学生根据斗法塔成绩来选择学院，但这事并不罕见。

489117.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance and trample.
489117.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒与践踏异能。

489120.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
489120.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

489122.oracleText: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.
489122.translation: 欧理可众密探潜伏在阿凯维沃的黑暗角落，难见踪影却无处不在。

489123.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target creature with power 3 or less can't be blocked this turn.
489123.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标力量等于或小于3的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

489128.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's an instant or sorcery card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard. Activate only if you have exactly zero or seven cards in hand.
489128.translation: {o2}，{oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是瞬间或法术牌，则你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。如果你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。只能于你有正好零张或七张手牌时起动。

489130.oracleText: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.
489130.translation: 寒冰火焰形成的闷燃风暴。

489134.oracleText: A seething locus of reverent rage.
489134.translation: 虔静怒火形成的沸涌中心。

489139.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
489139.translation: {oT}：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你施放过瞬间或法术咒语的回合。

489141.oracleText: Mage-students obsessed with the secrets of the past choose Lorehold, the college of archaeomancy.
489141.translation: 着迷过往的修习法师，会选读究古学院衡鉴，深研历史之谜。

489145.oracleText: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.
489145.translation: 盎然凋败形成的饥饿巢穴。

489149.oracleText: Mage-students who see spellcraft as the highest form of expression choose Prismari, the college of elemental arts.
489149.translation: 热爱咒艺的修习法师，会选读元素学院粹丽，再创展现之威。

489152.oracleText: Mage-students who see the beauty in patterns and equations choose Quandrix, the college of numeromancy.
489152.translation: 醉心算式的修习法师，会选读数法学院量析，探寻规律之美。

489155.oracleText: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.
489155.translation: 正气堕落形成的闪烁信标。

489159.oracleText: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.
489159.translation: 沉溺言辞的修习法师，会选读宏辩学院银毫，掌握文笔之力。

489162.oracleText: A verdant paradox of primal logic.
489162.translation: 原始逻辑形成的新绿矛盾。

489166.oracleText: Mage-students fascinated by the energies of life and death choose Witherbloom, the college of essence studies.
489166.translation: 痴狂生死的修习法师，会选读知命学院靡华，深耕菁华之能。

489168.oracleText:
"This must not become common knowledge. The consequences of such a spell are too great. Lock it away in the restricted archive, and destroy its record in the catalog."
—Director Taiva, to Isabough
489168.translation:
「这绝不能成为公共知识。此类咒语后果难以收拾。务必将其锁入受限文库，并销毁目录中的记载。」
～泰瓦馆长叮嘱伊瑟伯

489169.oracleText:
"For twelve days and twelve nights, Somat assailed the monster's shell. On the thirteenth morning, it cracked with the dawn."
—Heroics: A Book of Fables
489169.translation:
「索马特不断敲击怪物甲壳，十二昼十二夜间从未中断。到了第十三天清晨，甲壳终于裂出曙光。」
～《勇行故事：寓言合辑》

489170.oracleText:
"Evil is to be unshackled, not slain. Unlock your foe and release the miracle within."
—Keevan, docent of Kollema Hall
489170.translation:
「邪恶需要释放，而非消灭。解开封印敌人的枷锁，展现其中的惊人奇迹。」
～科玛学堂讲师基万

489171.oracleText:
"We asked for a home and received the world."
—Scroll of Nine Blessings
489171.translation:
「我们祈求一处家园，却得到了整个世界。」
～《九福卷轴》

489172.oracleText:
"The tyrant's bellow of rage trailed off into a whimper as the last of his fortune escaped his grasp."
—The Dethroner's Grimoire
489172.translation:
「眼见最后一丝财富逐渐抽离手中，暴君的愤怒狂啸也慢慢变成低声啜泣。」
～《逆臣秘录》

489173.oracleText:
"Knight Kathryn closed her eyes, bracing herself for the end. When she opened them again, she stood triumphant over her foe."
—Thadus the Healer, Memoirs
489173.translation:
「骑士凯萨琳闭紧双眼，准备好迎接生命最终时刻。但当她再次睁开时，却发现是她对手倒在脚下。」
～治疗师萨都丝，《回忆录》

489174.oracleText:
"The blademaster turned his fury to his new foes: root rot and cabbage slugs."
—Myths and Miracles, Vol. VII
489174.translation:
「大剑师转而将怒火发泄在新的敌人身上：腐根和菜虫。」
～《神话与奇迹》，卷七

489176.oracleText: Until your next turn, your life total can't change and you gain protection from everything. All permanents you control phase out.
489176.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，你的总生命不会改变，且你获得反一切保护异能。所有由你操控的永久物跃离。

489178.oracleText:
"Five suns! Can you even imagine how complicated the orbital calculations must be? What I wouldn't give to tackle an equation like that!"
—Zimone, Quandrix mage-student
489178.translation:
「五个太阳！你能想象这样轨道计算会有多复杂吗？真希望我能去处理这样的算式！」
～量析修习法师琦梦

489179.oracleText:
Infinite ideas flow through the Multiverse, waiting for an open mind."
—The Biblioplex: An Introduction
489179.translation:
「无数思绪在多重宇宙中流动，只待开明思想前去发现。」
～《茂典阁志：前言》

489180.oracleText:
"Every Planeswalker remembers the first time their mind touched the staggering vastness of the Multiverse."
—Kasmina
489180.translation:
「当思绪首度触碰广袤多重宇宙时感到的震撼，相信每位鹏洛客都不会忘记。」
～克蜜娜

489181.oracleText:
"One need not know the specific details of a spell to suppress its effect. Simply rearrange the rules of the reality within which the spell operates."
—Imbraham, Quandrix dean
489181.translation:
「至于压制咒语效果的具体细节也不用去了解。只需重新整理咒语作用实界内的规则就可实现。」
～量析院长英巴罕

489182.oracleText:
"Where do our forgotten thoughts go? I knew once, but I can't remember."
—Director Taiva, journal entry
489182.translation:
「那些遗忘的思绪都去到了哪里？我曾探见其踪迹，但也无从记起。」
～泰瓦馆长，日志一笔

489183.oracleText:
"Shatter your opponent's spell with enough force, and you'll shatter their confidence with it."
—Tome of Obstructions, marginalia
489183.translation:
「用足够的力量粉碎对手的咒语，还能一并粉碎对手的信心。」
～《障法巨著》，旁批

489184.oracleText:
"The wish most often granted is the wish to choose one's own destiny."
—Aethershrine, inscription
489184.translation:
「最常被保佑的愿望，都是希冀能选择自身命运者。」
～《乙太祭祠》，铭文

489185.oracleText:
"I can offer only information, young one. What path you choose is up to you."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios
489185.translation:
「年轻人，我只能提供信息。至于要走哪条路得你自己选。」
～阿凯维沃圣法谕贾琦

489186.oracleText:
"If they try to storm your palace, you must become the storm."
—Handbook of Imperial Spellcraft
489186.translation:
「如果他们想要如风暴般强袭你的宫殿，那你就必须化身风暴。」
～《皇家咒艺手册》

489187.oracleText:
"Guilt is not absolution. Regret is not justice. But it is right that you suffer."
—Extus Narr
489187.translation:
「内疚不是解脱。后悔也非正义。但你理应受苦。」
～埃陀斯纳尔

489188.oracleText:
"One brother fought for the sake of the Multiverse. The other for himself."
—The Elderspell Parable
489188.translation:
「兄弟争斗：一位心系多重宇宙，另一位只为自身称雄。」
～《至尊咒寓言》

489189.oracleText:
"They distrust my methods, but when they want results, whom do you think they seek?"
—Incantations of Lim-Dul
489189.translation:
「他们不相信我的方法，但当他们想要结果时，你猜又会去找谁？」
～《林杜咒文集》

489190.oracleText:
"Demons prefer to deal with those who believe themselves too wise to be fooled."
—Scroll case inscription
489190.translation:
「自以为绝顶聪明不会受骗者，正是恶魔青睐的交易对手。」
～卷轴盒铭文

489191.oracleText:
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest."
—Ob Nixilis
489191.translation:
「天使能如阳光耀世，能鼓舞弱者，甚至可能战胜黑暗。但最终这一切都不重要，因为他们也会像害虫般死去。」
～欧尼希兹

489192.oracleText:
"Magic brought peace to the Vastlands but was soon corrupted."
—The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells
489192.translation:
「魔法曾给过旷土和平，但很快就被腐化。」
～《神秘时代：咒法传》

489193.oracleText:
"It takes so little energy to erase a person. It's almost like the universe doesn't care that they existed at all."
—Extus Narr
489193.translation:
「彻底抹除一个人根本不费什么工夫。看似宇宙根本不在乎他们是否存在。」
～埃陀斯纳尔

489194.oracleText:
"To dwell within the Blind Eternities is unthinkable. To encounter those who do could shatter the mind."
—Chronicle of the Titans
489194.translation:
「深居黑暗虚空，此事根本无法想象：面会其间生灵，思绪便遭粉碎。」
～《巨物编年史》

489195.oracleText:
"It's always my brightest students who make the worst decisions."
—Shaile, Silverquill dean
489195.translation:
「作出最糟糕决定的，总是我那帮最聪明的学生。」
～银毫院长莎依儿

489196.oracleText:
"My colleagues revile the barbarity of the Blood Age, but I believe we have much to learn from the magics of endless war."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
489196.translation:
「虽然同僚都厌恶去研究血腥时代的野蛮暴行，但我相信那段无尽战乱时期的魔法有很多值得我们学习。」
～银毫院长安博斯

489197.oracleText:
"Be careful when handling old magical trinkets. You never know who they've been."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
489197.translation:
「处理古老魔法物品时请务必当心。你不会知道它们曾经是什么。」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

489198.oracleText:
"Will! They have a copy of Tales of the Fae here! Want me to read you a bedtime story?"
—Rowan Kenrith
489198.translation:
「威尔！他们这有本《仙儿传说》！要我给你读段睡前故事吗？」
～萝婉肯理斯

489199.oracleText:
"How did you get your hands on that? Wait, never mind. I don't want to know."
—Plargg, Lorehold dean
489199.translation:
「你是怎么拿到那东西的？算了，没事。我也不想知道。」
～衡鉴院长帕葛

489200.oracleText:
"Some mages duel using intricate spellcraft and superior tactics. Others just get really, really mad."
—Secrets of the Feradorn Sorcerers
489200.translation:
「有些法师是靠繁复咒语或超凡战术来赢得决斗。还有些就只是靠变得非常、非常狂暴。」
～《法拉东术士秘辛》

489201.oracleText:
"The first mages witnessed the fury of the raging storm and wished to answer back."
—The Stormwright Texts
489201.translation:
「原初法师曾亲眼见证翻腾风暴的怒火，并希冀能够对等回应。」
～《造风师手记》

489203.oracleText: Exile target card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile CARDNAME.
489203.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐CARDNAME。

489204.oracleText: Exile target card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile Mizzix's Mastery.
489204.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐米捷兹的精研。

489206.oracleText:
"To this day, I have no idea if the heavens were obeying him or attacking him."
—Ral Zarek, research notes
489206.translation:
「时至今日，我都还没弄清楚上天是在顺他的心，还是逆他的意。」
～拉尔查雷克，研究纪录

489207.oracleText:
"If the prospect of what could be doesn't electrify you to your core, why attend Strixhaven at all?"
—Nassari, Prismari dean
489207.translation:
「如果未来前景都无法从心底打动你，那又何必要来斯翠海文？」
～粹丽院长纳撒理

489208.oracleText:
"Her quest began as all quests do, with one small step in an unexpected direction."
—The Explorer's Testament
489208.translation:
「她的探索起初与其他人作法无异，都是朝着未曾想到的方向迈出了一小步。」
～《探索箴言》

489209.oracleText:
"As long as you are breathing, you always have something more to give."
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean
489209.translation:
「只要你还有气在，就总能贡献更多。」
～靡华院长瓦伦丁

489210.oracleText:
"You'd be amazed how much a single plant has to teach you."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean
489210.translation:
「你要是知道一株植物能教导你多少东西，必定会大吃一惊。」
～靡华院长莉塞特

489211.oracleText:
"The bloody din of invasion faded
And silent song rang through the woods again."
—"Song of Freyalise"
489211.translation:
「血腥侵略喧嚣退去，
静寂歌声传扬林间。」
～「妃雅丽兹颂歌」

489212.oracleText:
"On a world where time was torn asunder, destruction ruled the minds of all."
—Multiversal Metahistories
489212.translation:
「在时间支离破碎的世界上，破坏才是所有人的共识。」
～《多重宇宙元史学》

489213.oracleText:
"Nature is neither cruel nor kind. It operates on necessity, not sentiment."
—-Dina, Witherbloom mage-student
489213.translation:
「自然既不残忍也不仁慈。它行事遵循需求，而非情感。」
～靡华修习法师迪娜

489214.oracleText:
"Centuries of war had broken Arcavios, but a single seed began the long process of renewal."
—The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells
489214.translation:
「数百年连绵战事令阿凯维沃饱受创伤，但随着一颗种子落地，漫长复兴过程就此展开。」
～《神秘时代：咒法传》

489215.oracleText:
"Never reject the kindness of a serpent. It will not be offered twice."
—Druidic manuscript fragment
489215.translation:
「不要拒绝巨蛇心意。它不会来第二次。」
～德鲁伊手稿残篇

489216.oracleText:
"Neither blade nor tempest can assail the serenity of a tranquil mind."
—The Turrau Carvings
489216.translation:
「刀剑狂风都无法扰动平静心灵。」
～《图拉乌石刻》

489217.oracleText:
"A tale of a tyrant being humiliated and losing all his power? I'm inspired already!"
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student
489217.translation:
「暴君惨遭羞辱，力量尽失的故事？我有灵感了！」
～银毫修习法师齐力安

489218.oracleText:
"The hydraulic power grip was a failure, but the gauntlets were a shocking success."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus
489218.translation:
「虽然液压强力握把并不出色，但护手仍算巨大成功。」
～伊捷首法师的日记

489219.oracleText:
"I've gleaned greater insight from the spiraling of a single fern than I have from all the books I've ever read."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean
489219.translation:
「我从这株小小蕨类螺旋屈伸中得到的启悟，比我读过的所有书都要深刻。」
～量析院长齐安妮

489220.oracleText:
"Mages in the Blood Age would call down actual thunderstorms on their enemies. I bet we can replicate their technique."
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student
489220.translation:
「血腥时代的法师能够召唤真正的雷暴来攻击敌人。我相信我们也能做到。」
～衡鉴修习法师卓迪尔

489221.oracleText:
"From monarch to mulch as quick as could be."
—The Dethroner's Grimoire
489221.translation:
「最快速度化君王为粪土。」
～《逆臣秘录》

489228.oracleText: Target a planeswalker an opponent controls.
489228.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的鹏洛客为目标。

489229.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller loses 1 life.
489229.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者失去1点生命。

489230.oracleText: Have it gain reach until end of turn?
489230.translation: 是否要使它获得延势异能直到回合结束？

489232.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
489232.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌？

489235.oracleText: When the permanent you don't control dies this turn, you gain 2 life.
489235.translation: 本回合中，当该不由你操控的永久物死去时，你获得2点生命。

489237.oracleText: Put any number of land cards onto the battlefield?
489237.translation: 是否要将任意数量的地牌放进战场？

489238.oracleText: Exile it at the beginning of your next upkeep.
489238.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

489240.oracleText: Target up to two creature, land, and/or planeswalker cards.
489240.translation: 指定至多两张生物，地和／或鹏洛客牌为目标。

489241.oracleText: Tap any number of creatures you control.
489241.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控的生物。

489242.translation: 指定至多五个永久物为目标。

489243.translation: 选择一个生物或鹏洛客。

489244.oracleText: Target a creature spell you control.
489244.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物咒语为目标。

489245.oracleText: Put one of them into your library.
489245.translation: 将其中一张置入你的牌库。

489246.oracleText: Target an artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker.
489246.translation: 指定一个神器、结界或鹏洛客为目标。

489247.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
489247.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

489248.oracleText: Discard an instant or sorcery card?
489248.translation: 是否要弃一张瞬间或法术牌？

489249.oracleText: Target a Spirit, instant, or sorcery card.
489249.translation: 指定一张精怪、瞬间或法术牌为目标。

489251.translation: 指定一个单色永久物为目标。

489252.oracleText: Return a land card to your hand.
489252.translation: 将一张地牌移回你手上。

489253.oracleText: Reveal an Island or Mountain card?
489253.translation: 是否要展示一张海岛或山脉牌？

489254.oracleText: Reveal a Mountain or Plains card?
489254.translation: 是否要展示一张山脉或平原牌？

489255.oracleText: Reveal a Swamp or Forest card?
489255.translation: 是否要展示一张沼泽或树林牌？

489256.oracleText: Reveal a Plains or Swamp card?
489256.translation: 是否要展示一张平原或沼泽牌？

489257.oracleText: Reveal a Forest or Island card?
489257.translation: 是否要展示一张树林或海岛牌？

489258.oracleText: Search for up to three Plains cards.
489258.translation: 搜寻至多三张基本平原牌。

489259.oracleText: Target a card that is an instant or sorcery.
489259.translation: 指定一张瞬间或法术牌为目标。

489260.oracleText:
"Nassari's work is extravagant, but unfocused. They must refine their technique."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean
489260.translation:
「纳萨里的作品虽然华丽，但却欠缺焦点。他们必须精进技艺。」
～粹丽院长乌薇妲

489264.oracleText: Exile a creature card they revealed this way.
489264.translation: 放逐一张以此法他展示的一张生物牌。

489356.oracleText: Choose a creature an opponent controls chosen at random.
489356.translation: 随机选择一个由对手操控的生物。

489405.oracleText: Spend only on: Creature or Enchantment Spells
489405.translation: 只能用于支付：生物或结界咒语

489454.oracleText: Target up to one artifact card.
489454.translation: 指定至多一张神器牌为目标。

489455.oracleText: Target up to one enchantment card.
489455.translation: 指定至多一张结界牌为目标。

489598.oracleText: Spend only on: Foretelling Cards or Spells That Have Foretell
489598.translation: 只能用于支付：预示牌，具有预示异能的咒语

489654.oracleText: Cast a legendary spell from your hand, from your graveyard, or from among cards you own in exile without paying its mana cost?
489654.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从手上、你的坟墓场或放逐区里施放由你拥有的牌一个传奇咒语？

489657.oracleText: Choose any number of artifact tokens and/or creature tokens you control with different names.
489657.translation: 选择任意数量由你操控且名称各不相同的衍生神器和／或衍生生物。

490431.oracleText: Spend only on: Foretelling a Card From Your Hand or an Instant or Sorcery Spell
490431.translation: 只能用于支付：预示牌，瞬间或法术咒语

491682.oracleText: Have Shapeshifters you control become copies of that creature until end of turn?
491682.translation: 是否要使由你操控的变形兽都成为该生物的复制品直到回合结束？

491684.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent to put in its owner's library.
491684.translation: 指定一个非地永久物为目标，将其置入其拥有者的牌库。

491685.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent to return to its owner's hand.
491685.translation: 指定一个非地永久物为目标，将其移回其拥有者的手上。

491686.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Remove {2, Number} counter.} other {Remove {2, Number} counters.}}
491686.translation: {2, plural, =1 {移去{2, Number}个指示物。} other {移去{2, Number}个指示物。}}

491690.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, target creature you control has base power 2 until end of turn.
491690.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，目标由你操控的生物之基础力量为2直到回合结束。

491691.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
491691.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

491693.oracleText: {oT}: You may exile an instant or sorcery card from your hand and put three hone counters on it. It gains "At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove a hone counter from it" and "When the last hone counter is removed from this card, if it's exiled, you may cast it. It costs {o4} less to cast this way."
491693.translation: {oT}：你可以从你手上放逐一张瞬间或法术牌并在其上放置三个磨练指示物。它获得「在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，则从其上移去一个磨练指示物」与「当从此牌上移去最后一个磨练指示物时，若它已放逐，则你可以施放它。它以此法施放时减少{o4}来施放。」

491694.oracleText: Exile an instant or sorcery card?
491694.translation: 是否要放逐一张瞬间或法术牌？

491699.oracleText: Put a voyage counter on it?
491699.translation: 是否要在其上放置一个远行指示物？

491707.translation: 指定一张雪境永久物牌为目标。

491920.oracleText: Distribute counters among any number of creatures you control.
491920.translation: 将指示物分配给任意数量由你操控的生物。

492330.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with deathtouch deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters.
492330.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具死触异能的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手得到两个中毒指示物。

492417.oracleText: Exile a card from your graveyard: Add {oC}. Spend this mana only to cast a spell that's one or more colors without {oX} in its mana cost.
492417.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐一张牌：加{oC}。此法术力只能用来施放法术力费用中不包含{oX}的有色咒语。

492598.oracleText: Search for exactly two cards not named {1, CardId} that have different names.
492598.translation: 搜寻正好两张不同名称且其名称都不能是{1, CardId}的牌。

492599.oracleText: Search your library for exactly two cards not named {1, CardId} that have different names?
492599.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻正好两张不同名称且其名称都不能是{1, CardId}的牌？

492621.oracleText: Spend only on: A Spell That Is One or More Colors Without {oX} In Its Mana Cost
492621.translation: 只能用于支付：法术力费用中不包含{oX}的有色咒语

492630.oracleText: Choose a card to put into your opponent's hand.
492630.translation: 选择一张牌，将其置于对手手上。

492691.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Until end of turn, you may cast a creature spell from among cards exiled with CARDNAME without paying its mana cost.
492691.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：直到回合结束，你可以从以CARDNAME放逐的牌中施放一个生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

492953.oracleText: Select whether to place this card into its owner's graveyard or back on top of their library.
492953.translation: 选择将此牌置入其拥有者的坟墓场还是牌库顶。

494061.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player chooses a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard. You return that card to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. The creature is a Vampire in addition to its other types.
494061.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手选择你坟墓场中的一张非传奇生物牌。你将该牌移回战场，且其上额外有一个+1/+1指示物。该生物额外具有吸血鬼此类别。

494694.oracleText: Protection from spells that are one or more colors

495888.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Plains card?
495888.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本平原牌？

495911.oracleText: Search for up to four basic land cards.
495911.translation: 搜寻至多四张基本地牌。

495912.oracleText: Put one of them onto the battlefield.

495913.oracleText: Put two of them onto the battlefield.

495929.oracleText: Search for a basic Forest or Island card.
495929.translation: 搜寻一张基本树林或海岛牌。

495930.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Forest or Island card?
495930.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张树林或海岛牌？

495937.oracleText: Each player looks at the top five cards of their library and may reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card from among them. Each player puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order. Each player gains 3 life.
495937.translation: 每位牌手各进行以下流程～检视其牌库顶的五张牌，展示其中的一张地牌和／或一张瞬间或法术牌，然后将以此法展示的牌置于其手上，其余则以随机顺序置于其牌库底。每位牌手各获得3点生命。

495939.oracleText: Reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card?
495939.translation: 是否要展示一张地牌和／或一张瞬间或法术牌？

495946.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker to return to its owner's hand.
495946.translation: 指定一个生物或鹏洛客为目标，将其移回其拥有者手上。

495947.oracleText: Target up to one enchantment card
495947.translation: 指定至多一张结界牌为目标。

495950.oracleText: Target up to one planeswalker card.
495950.translation: 指定至多一张鹏洛客牌为目标。

495951.oracleText: Search for an instant or sorcery card that shares a color with this planeswalker.
495951.translation: 搜寻一张与此鹏洛客具共通颜色的瞬间或法术牌。

496055.oracleText: Put any number of them into your hand?
496055.translation: 是否要将其中任意数量置于你手上？

496083.oracleText: Have the base power and toughness of other creatures you control become equal to {1, CardId}'s power and toughness until end of turn?
496083.translation: 是否要使由你操控之其他生物的基础力量与防御力成为等同于{1, CardId}之力量和防御力直到回合结束？

497103.oracleText: Exile each card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile CARDNAME.
497103.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐CARDNAME。

497104.oracleText: Exile each card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile Mizzix's Mastery.
497104.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐米捷兹的精研。

497172.oracleText: Choose two cards to be shuffled into your opponent's library.
497172.translation: 选择两张牌，将其洗入对手的牌库。

497185.oracleText: When you discard an instant or sorcery card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
497185.translation: 当你以此法弃掉一张瞬间或法术牌时，CARDNAME对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所弃之牌的法术力值。

497198.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, search your library for a creature card with lesser mana value, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
497198.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值小于前述生物的生物牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

497210.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature: Target player mills cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
497210.translation: 牺牲一个生物：目标牌手将其牌库顶若干牌置入其坟墓场，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。

497211.oracleText: Return it to its owner's hand?
497211.translation: 是否要将它移回其拥有者手上？

497212.oracleText: Have target player mill two cards?
497212.translation: 是否要令目标牌手磨两张牌？

497214.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Return {2, Number} card at random to your hand.} other {Return {2, Number} cards at random to your hand.}}
497214.translation: {2, plural, =1 {随机将{2, Number}张牌移回你手上。} other {随机将{2, Number}张牌移回你手上。}}

497215.oracleText:
"Into the smothering dark, Serra spoke a single word: ‘Hope.'"
—Song of All, canto 2
497215.translation:
「撒拉迈入窒息黯境，双唇微吐二字：『希望』。」
～《万物之歌》，2节

497218.oracleText: "No signs of any suspicious activity. Yet."
497218.translation: 「没有任何可疑活动的迹象。暂时还没。」

497226.oracleText: Exile target creature card from your graveyard. Create X 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying, where X is the exiled card's toughness.
497226.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。派出X个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物，X为所放逐之牌的防御力。

497229.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
497229.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控之衍生物的复制品。

497231.oracleText: It feeds on metal filings suspended in the water, sieving flecks of precious ore through magnetic baleen.
497231.translation: 它摄食悬浮水中的金属屑，以带磁鲸须筛出碎粒稀有矿石。

497235.oracleText: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.
497235.translation: 它浮游水银海上空，警示任何将成形的违规思想。

497236.oracleText:
"I'm sure they were once someone important, but I couldn't tell you who they were."
—Doros, expedition guide
497236.translation:
「我确定他们生前都大有来头，但我没法一个个讲出名头。」
～探险队向导多罗斯

497237.oracleText: Delirium — This spell has cascade as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
497237.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，此咒语便具有倾曳异能。

497238.oracleText: "Good ol' rock," muttered Rhirhok as the shaking began. "Nice ol' rock . . . ."
497238.translation: 「好石头，」随着矿井开始颤动，瑞虎克嘟囔道。「乖石头…」

497241.oracleText: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

497243.oracleText:
"Friends, foragers, fuzzy fighters! Tonight we're after more than just acorns!"
—Larrel, Deep Forest hermit
497243.translation:
「各位朋友，各位食客，各位斗士！今晚，我们的目标不仅是橡实！」
～深林隐者拉蕾儿

497244.oracleText: {o5oG}, {oT}: Draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each +1/+1 counter on creatures you control.
497244.translation: {o5oG}，{oT}：抓一张牌。由你操控的生物上每有一个+1/+1指示物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

497245.oracleText: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.
497245.translation: 它们经常在街灯上休息，其重量把灯柱都压垮了。

497248.oracleText: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .
497248.translation: 为了统治赤杨环树林，饭尾从巢风偷来了巢风从班奇、班奇从灵足、灵足从叶爪，以及叶爪从黑毛…等偷来的橡实。

497250.oracleText: The boggart hopped carelessly among the roots . . . until the roots woke up.
497250.translation: 波尬在根须间无忧无虑地跳跃…直到根须醒转过来。

497256.oracleText:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer
497256.translation:
「你已经长大了，想变作什么？」
～析米克生物工程师约洛夫
