529960.oracleText: A heavy net doesn't always mean a good catch.
529960.translation: 沉重渔网不一定是有好收成。

529963.oracleText: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.
529963.translation: 趁着席嘉妲和索霖交锋时，雅琳和泰菲力趁机从马可夫家墓穴中取回了钥匙。

529964.oracleText: Investigate. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, investigate twice instead.
529964.translation: 探查。如果此咒语是从坟墓场中施放，则改为探查两次。

529966.oracleText: A loyal crew sticks together, even after death.
529966.translation: 忠心水手始终相伴，死后亦然。

529968.oracleText: Whenever you discard a Spirit card or a card with disturb, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
529968.translation: 每当你弃一张精怪牌或一张具惊扰异能的牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

529971.oracleText: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.
529971.translation: 乌妲在塞贺开的精品帽屋毁于狼人之手后，她便搬出城镇，决心展现自己另一门缝纫手艺。

529973.oracleText: Tracking it isn't the hard part.

529976.oracleText: Non-Horror creatures with slime counters on them lose all abilities and have base power and toughness 2/2.
529976.translation: 所有其上有黏菌指示物的非惊惧兽生物都失去所有异能，且基础力量与防御力均为2/2。

529981.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-0 until end of turn. Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
529981.translation: 目标生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

529982.oracleText: The weary travelers mistook the flickering lights for a candleguide pointing the way to Harvesttide. Their relief turned to terror as lightning lit the sky.
529982.translation: 疲惫旅人看到闪光，以为自己见到了指向收成节的引路烛光。但这份放松心情在看到闪电大作后就化为恐惧。

529985.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
529985.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

529991.oracleText: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.
529991.translation: 她总愿意出手相助。反正不是自己的手。

529992.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand, you win the game.
529992.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你的手牌正好为十三张，则你赢得此盘游戏。

529994.oracleText:
"Day 77: The homunculus within the crystal continues to mimic my every movement. I wonder what they are writing?"
—Laboratory notes of Yzlkpk
529994.translation:
「第77天：水晶内的造妖仍继续模仿我的一举一动。我好奇他们会写什么呢？」
～耶泽萍的实验室纪录

529995.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to pay a disturb cost or cast an instant or sorcery spell.
529995.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来支付惊扰费用，或是施放瞬间或法术咒语。

529996.oracleText: Though their work is widely reviled, stitchers see themselves as being on the cutting edge of science.
529996.translation: 虽然拼接师的工作遭人唾弃，但他们觉得自己在引领技术尖端。

529998.oracleText: The debased remnants of the Falkenrath bloodline prowl the passes near their ruined castles.
529998.translation: 伐肯纳血脉的落魄遗民仍围聚自家城堡废墟附近，于周遭通路徘徊。

530002.oracleText: "I was a mere cutpurse until I learned the going rate for fresh corpses."
530002.translation: 「我原本只是做着小偷小摸的勾当，直到有天我知道新鲜尸体行价可观。」

530006.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocking CARDNAME dies, that creature's controller loses 1 life.
530006.translation: 每当一个阻挡CARDNAME的生物死去时，该生物的操控者失去1点生命。

530009.oracleText: "My little winged friends tell me which of these townsfolk are worth tasting for myself."
530009.translation: 「我的有翼伙伴会给出建议，哪些镇民值得去亲自品尝。」

530012.oracleText: Skirsdag cultists believe that the right poison "purifies" a tainted soul before it makes its way to Ormendahl.
530012.translation: 史革达教众相信，在污化灵魂见到欧魔达之前，用对毒药便能将其「净化」。

530014.oracleText: Griselbrand's defeat did not mark the end of the Skirsdag cult. They simply turned their worship to the next demon to emerge from the shadows bearing offers of power.
530014.translation: 棘泽边落败并非史革达教派的终点。他们就只是转而崇拜黯影中崛起的另一位恶魔，同样祈求对方赐予力量。

530016.oracleText: "Forget your human ancestors. You're part of my family now."
530016.translation: 「忘记你的人类族谱吧。你现在是我家的人了。」

530017.oracleText: Creature tokens get -2/-2 until end of turn.
530017.translation: 衍生生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

530018.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn. 
• Creature tokens get -2/-2 until end of turn.
530018.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。 
•衍生生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

530020.oracleText: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.
530020.translation: 对于有讲究的吸血鬼而言，粉碎心智要比单纯吸血更具乐趣。

530024.oracleText: He rose from the graf for every cobbler, tanner, and fool who'd been slaughtered in the parish—and they rose and shambled after him.
530024.translation: 他从埋葬教区里每一个遇难鞋匠，染匠，以及愚人的墓地中爬起～而他们也跟随挺身。

530032.oracleText:
"It has no need of wealth in the afterlife. It steals and kills purely for its own spiteful amusement."
—Kaya
530032.translation:
「它死后不再需要财富，一切偷盗和杀戮都只是为了满足自身的恶毒趣味。」
～卡娅

530033.oracleText: If Covetous Geist would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
530033.translation: 如果隐匿游魂将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

530035.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target Zombie you control.
530035.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。在至多一个目标由你操控的灵俑上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530037.oracleText: As this permanent transforms into CARDNAME, attach it to a player.
530037.translation: 于此永久物转化为CARDNAME时，将它贴附在一位牌手上。

530038.oracleText: As this permanent transforms into Curse of Leeches, attach it to a player.
530038.translation: 于此永久物转化为血蛭诅咒时，将它贴附在一位牌手上。

530039.oracleText: At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, they lose 1 life and you gain 1 life.
530039.translation: 在所结附的牌手之维持开始时，其失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

530042.oracleText: First darkness falls. Then it burrows in.
530042.translation: 先是黑暗降临，它便随之潜入。

530044.oracleText: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.
530044.translation: 如果教士知道新换的楼窗会冠上他的名字，兴许还会好受一些。

530045.translation: 消灭目标不具飞行异能的生物。

530051.oracleText: It herds souls toward eternal torment.
530051.translation: 它把灵魂赶向无限苦难。

530053.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies or a creature card is put into a graveyard from a library, each opponent loses 1 life.
530053.translation: 每当一个生物死去或一张生物牌从牌库进入坟墓场时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

530054.oracleText: The Voldaren torture pits are so expansive that prisoners have a nasty tendency to be forgotten for years.
530054.translation: 沃达连地下刑房空间广阔，因此其中不乏关押数年都无人过问的囚人。

530056.oracleText:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain
530056.translation:
「如果你听见地窖传出呻吟声，不要好奇妄动。不要分头行事。只管闩紧门口，全力顶住。」
～守卫队长艾蜜莉

530058.oracleText: "Great Ormendahl, I kneel before you, a fragment of your will, a servant of your tyranny. I beg you, release the strength within me!"
530058.translation: 「欧魔达魔神在上，吾在你面前屈膝：承载共通意志，甘愿俯身为奴。在此虔诚请求，释吾内在之威！」

530059.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw a card, then transform CARDNAME. Activate only once each turn.
530059.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物：抓一张牌，然后转化CARDNAME。每回合只能起动一次。

530062.oracleText: Bones cracked, flesh split apart, and the screams of euphoric agony gave way to unholy laughter.
530062.translation: 颅脑迸裂，骨肉四散，狂喜尖啸就此转变为邪恶咆哮。

530064.oracleText: The evidence was overwhelming. Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.
530064.translation: 眼前证据已说明一切：托瓦拉嚎群越来越大胆、越来越聪明，也越来越强大。

530065.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 2 or less. Investigate.
530065.translation: 消灭目标力量等于或小于2的生物。探查。

530067.oracleText: It was a family reunion to die for.

530068.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures die, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed. This ability triggers only once each turn.
530068.translation: 每当一个或数个非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

530070.oracleText: If a creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead.
530070.translation: 如果某个由对手操控的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

530071.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put all creature cards exiled with CARDNAME onto the battlefield under your control. They gain decayed.
530071.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将所有以CARDNAME放逐的生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。它们获得败朽异能。

530080.oracleText: "Speak my name thrice, and be rewarded."

530081.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Pay 1 life, Discard a card: Draw a card, mill a card, then put a ritual counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has three or more ritual counters on it, remove them and transform it. Activate only as a sorcery.
530081.translation: {o1}，{oT}，支付1点生命，弃一张牌：抓一张牌，磨一张牌，然后在CARDNAME上放置一个仪式指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多仪式指示物，则移去这类指示物并转化它。只能于法术时机起动。

530084.oracleText: "Well done, young fool, well done! Now for your reward."
530084.translation: 「做得好，小傻瓜，做得好！这就是你的回报。」

530085.oracleText: {o2oB}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
530085.translation: {o2oB}：将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530088.oracleText:
"I see someone tried to stop you, my pet. How delightful."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa
530088.translation:
「好像有人想要阻止你，宝贝。真有趣。」
～尸鬼牧者基沙

530089.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
530089.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

530092.oracleText: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.
530092.translation: 人称烬口的喷火裂谷内住有古老邪物，随时准备吞噬胆敢单独上路的愚蠢旅人。

530093.oracleText: Destroy target creature. You lose 2 life.
530093.translation: 消灭目标生物。你失去2点生命。

530094.translation: 涅非利亚尸鬼牧者贾达

530095.oracleText: "Rise, my pretty thing. Why rot in the river when you can serve at my bidding?"
530095.translation: 「起身，我的宝贝。如果你能服侍我，又何必烂在河里？」

530096.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control no creatures with decayed, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
530096.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你未操控具败朽异能的生物，则派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

530100.oracleText: {o2}: Target Human you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
530100.translation: {o2}：目标由你操控的人类获得系命异能直到回合结束。

530101.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have exactly 13 life, you may pay {o4oBoB}. If you do, transform Jerren.
530101.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你的总生命正好为13，你可以支付{o4oBoB}。若你如此作，则转化耶仑。

530103.oracleText: "Ah, Jerren. You've been such a faithful, useful insect."
530103.translation: 「啊，耶仑。你真是一只忠实可靠的虫子。」

530104.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Draw a card.
530104.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：抓一张牌。

530106.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Target player mills three cards.
530106.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物：目标牌手磨三张牌。

530107.oracleText: Pay 1 life: Add {oC}. Spend this mana only to cast a spell from your graveyard.
530107.translation: 支付1点生命：加{oC}。此法术力只能用来从你坟墓场中施放咒语。

530109.oracleText: The legacy of evil lives on.
530109.translation: 邪恶遗物得以继续流传。

530110.oracleText: Equipped creature has flying and lifelink.
530110.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有飞行与系命异能。

530111.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, you may pay X life, where X is its power. If you do, draw X cards.
530111.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，你可以支付X点生命，X为其力量。若你如此作，则抓X张牌。

530115.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
530115.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

530116.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, you gain 1 life.
530116.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

530118.oracleText: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.
530118.translation: 在依尼翠，横财往往由他人倒毙泥中而起。

530119.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures die, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
530119.translation: 每当一个或数个其他生物死去时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

530121.oracleText:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa
530121.translation:
「我倒要看看弟弟拼接出来的小玩具有没有这东西厉害。」
～尸鬼牧者基沙

530122.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {o1oB}.
530122.translation: 牺牲一个生物或支付{o1oB}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

530124.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
530124.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530125.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "Whenever another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
530125.translation: 所结附的生物具有「每当另一个生物死去时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」

530126.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is its power. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
530126.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为其力量。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

530128.oracleText: In the maze-like passages of the Erdwal, a wrong turn can be fatal.
530128.translation: 尔卓道上通路交错颇似迷宫，一拐错弯可能就会丧命。

530129.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards. You create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
530129.translation: 目标对手弃两张牌。你派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

530131.oracleText: All across Gavony, in shuttered bedrooms and locked barns, young people seek the answers their elders failed to provide.
530131.translation: 在整个加渥尼，都有年轻人将自己关在紧闭卧室与上锁谷仓之中，致力搜寻前一辈人未能给出的答案。

530132.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
530132.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

530135.oracleText: "And you were almost finished with that ritual, weren't you, darling? How very rude of me. To make it up to you, I'll send you an invitation to my wedding."
530135.translation: 「亲爱的，你是不是差点就完成仪式了？瞧瞧我真是粗鲁。你们会收到我的婚礼邀请函，算是我的一点心意。」

530136.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If it's night, that creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead.
530136.translation: 目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。如果当前是黑夜，则改为该生物得-13/-13直到回合结束。

530138.oracleText: Aunt and Uncle Greyfeld loved dinner guests.
530138.translation: 格雷非舅舅夫妇喜欢晚餐宴客。

530139.oracleText: Exile up to one target card from a graveyard. Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
530139.translation: 将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

530141.oracleText: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.
530141.translation: 陌生人没有跟任何人搭话，村民也乐得不用搭理他。

530143.oracleText: Tomorrow a new village, and new victims.
530143.translation: 新的一天，新的村庄，新的受害者。

530145.oracleText: A barricade only buys time. So the wealthy buy more barricades.
530145.translation: 工事只能拖延时间。所以富人买下了更多工事。

530146.oracleText: Tap three untapped creatures you control: Each opponent loses 1 life.
530146.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的生物：每位对手各失去1点生命。

530148.oracleText: From every kill, a gruesome trophy.
530148.translation: 每杀一人，就多一件骇人纪念品。

530153.oracleText: With House Voldaren ascendant, some members of the Stromkirk line took it upon themselves to "borrow" from the blood tithes.
530153.translation: 随着沃达连家族地位日渐提高，溪堡血脉中开始有人主动上门「预支」血税。

530154.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target Vampire you control.
530154.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则在目标由你操控的吸血鬼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530158.oracleText: The Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings from the villagers in their territory. Their agents arrive from the sky to collect the ceremonial bowls in eerie silence.
530158.translation: 沃达连血脉开始要求辖内村民供奉鲜血。其代表悄然从天而降，将各地祭祀钵收归囊中。

530160.oracleText: As the flames consumed the killer, his eyes remained fixed on the executioner's face, his hands twitching like angry spiders.
530160.translation: 火舌逐渐吞没凶手，但后者眼睛仍死死盯着刽子手面庞，双手如愤怒蜘蛛一般不停抽搐。

530162.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
530162.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化，并贴附在目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客上。

530165.oracleText: The next day, the executioner was found with ashen handprints on his throat.
530165.translation: 第二天，人们发现刽子手脖子周围满是灰白手印。

530166.oracleText: Enchant creature or planeswalker an opponent controls
530166.translation: 结附于由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客

530169.oracleText: You don't have to outrun the werewolf; you only have to outrun your fellow guard.
530169.translation: 你不用跑得比狼人快；你只要跑得比同伴快就行。

530171.oracleText: While the Dawnhart witches focus their magic on nature and community, other covens consort with devils and twist the elements to their will.
530171.translation: 曙鹿集女巫将魔法聚焦于自然与社群，其他女巫集群则选择与魔共舞或曲物自用。

530178.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
530178.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

530181.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
530181.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成5点伤害。

530182.oracleText: Burn Down the House deals 5 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
530182.translation: 焚毁房屋对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成5点伤害。

530187.oracleText: Nothing remained but a few drifting embers and the smell of smoldering hair.
530187.translation: 火光之后，唯有几缕余火和毛发烧焦气味尚存。

530188.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
530188.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成5点伤害，且对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

530189.oracleText: Burn the Accursed deals 5 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
530189.translation: 焚净遭诅者对目标生物造成5点伤害，且对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

530191.oracleText: "Leave behind the sorrow of this body. Be blessed, being of light."
530191.translation: 「愿你忘却肉身所历伤悲。愿你蒙受祝福，化身光辉。」

530192.oracleText: Cathartic Pyre deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
530192.translation: 净灵葬火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

530193.oracleText: Discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
530193.translation: 弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

530194.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
530194.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 
•弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

530195.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Cathartic Pyre deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
530195.translation:
选择一项～ 
•净灵葬火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 
•弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

530197.oracleText: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.
530197.translation: 纵使是在礼拜堂的神圣大厅中，魔鬼邪笑仍能盖过他的祷告。

530198.oracleText: Whenever enchanted player casts a spell other than the first spell they cast each turn or copies a spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to them.
530198.translation: 每当所结附的牌手复制咒语或于其每回合施放的第一个咒语以外再施放咒语时，CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

530202.oracleText: "Lady Anje sends her regards. I'll carve the rest of her message into your skin."
530202.translation: 「安姬大人来信致意。我会把信中其他内容刻在你肌肤上。」

530203.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to defending player.
530203.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对防御牌手造成1点伤害。

530206.oracleText: In the arena, vampires set aside all pretense of honor or civilization and fight like the predators they know themselves to be.
530206.translation: 在斗技场中，吸血鬼撕下所有荣誉和斯文的伪装，像潜藏在心底深处的捕食者一般搏斗。

530207.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard a card, Sacrifice a Vampire: Draw two cards. Activate only if an opponent lost life this turn.
530207.translation: {o1oR}，弃一张牌，牺牲一个吸血鬼：抓两张牌。只能于有对手失去过生命的回合中起动。

530209.oracleText: Furious to find the workshop empty, the starving vampires flew into a frenzy.
530209.translation: 在愤怒地发现作坊内空无一人后，饥肠辘辘的吸血鬼顿时狂躁起来。

530213.oracleText: As long as the sun is up, you'll only lose your purse.
530213.translation: 只要太阳还在天上，你会丢掉的就只有钱包。

530214.oracleText: {o1oR}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
530214.translation: {o1oR}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。

530218.oracleText: {o4oR}: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
530218.translation: {o4oR}：由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

530220.oracleText: So many candles. So many flammables. So little time.
530220.translation: 蜡烛很多，能烧的很多，时间太少。

530223.oracleText: At the edge of night, on the cusp of winter, the allure of fire grows ever stronger.
530223.translation: 在夜幕初临、寒冬迫近时刻，火焰显得愈发诱人。

530224.oracleText: When a spell you control deals damage, transform CARDNAME.
530224.translation: 每当一个由你操控的咒语造成伤害时，转化CARDNAME。

530227.oracleText: Never again would she fear the dusk.
530227.translation: 她从此再也不惧怕黄昏。

530228.oracleText: Whenever a spell you control deals damage, put a flame counter on CARDNAME.
530228.translation: 每当一个由你操控的咒语造成伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烈焰指示物。

530230.oracleText: {o1}, Remove a flame counter from CARDNAME: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
530230.translation: {o1}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烈焰指示物：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

530234.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Remove any number of charge counters from CARDNAME: It deals that much damage to any target.
530234.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去任意数量的充电指示物：它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

530236.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
530236.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

530238.oracleText: He was one masked stranger among many. Blending in was child's play.
530238.translation: 在人群之中，他不过是个戴着面具的陌生人。混迹其间简直易如反掌。

530240.oracleText: When Tovolar's howl sounded from the woods, it was answered from the heart of the festival.
530240.translation: 当听闻托瓦拉林中嚎叫，收成节中心便响起回应。

530241.oracleText: Nothing is funnier to a devil than setting someone—anyone—on fire.
530241.translation: 对魔鬼来说，最有趣的事情莫过于把人点着～谁都行。

530243.oracleText:
"This Tovolar is no brainless brute. He sends his howling minions to terrorize a village for months. Sleepless nights and fear take their toll. Only then, when morale is at its worst, does he strike."
—Barnes, village watch
530243.translation:
「这个托瓦拉并非无脑蛮汉。他会派遣手下嚎群接连数月侵扰村庄，让民众夜夜无眠，恐惧气息逐步蔓延。等到士气最低落时才会出手袭击。」
～村庄守夜人巴恩斯

530245.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. It deals X plus 1 damage instead if that target is a creature or planeswalker.
530245.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。如果该目标为生物或鹏洛客，则改为它造成X加1点伤害。

530246.oracleText: Light Up the Night deals X damage to any target. It deals X plus 1 damage instead if that target is a creature or planeswalker.
530246.translation: 照亮黑夜对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。如果该目标为生物或鹏洛客，则改为它造成X加1点伤害。

530247.oracleText: Flashback—{o3oR}, Remove X loyalty counters from among planeswalkers you control. If you cast this spell this way, X can't be 0.
530247.translation: 返照～{o3oR}，从由你操控的鹏洛客上移去总共X个忠诚指示物。如果你以此法施放此咒语，则X不能为0。

530249.oracleText: In the adrenaline-fueled chaos, she hadn't even felt the bite.
530249.translation: 在充满紧张氛围的混乱当中，她甚至没感觉自己已经被咬。

530250.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +X/+0 and gains first strike and trample until end of turn.
530250.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0且获得先攻与践踏异能。

530252.oracleText: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.
530252.translation: 待托瓦拉亲自上阵，便如同秋风扫落叶一般将护教军彻底击溃。

530253.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it's night.
530253.translation: 如果当前是黑夜，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

530254.oracleText: Moonrager's Slash deals 3 damage to any target.
530254.translation: 月怒狼挥击对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

530256.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw a card for each of that spell's colors.
530256.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，你可以弃掉你的手牌。若你如此作，则该咒语每有一种颜色，便抓一张牌。

530257.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of colors among permanents you control.
530257.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之永久物中的颜色数量。

530260.oracleText: Markov vampires cultivate an image of such decadent elegance that it can be easy to forget they can field a deadly fighting force.
530260.translation: 马可夫吸血鬼营造出的颓废而不失优雅形象，常让人们忘记他们尚有致命战力。

530264.oracleText:
"We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast."
—Anje Falkenrath
530264.translation:
「我们存在的意义，便是为了追求首夜盛宴的欢愉。」
～安姬伐肯纳

530265.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control a Vampire.
530265.translation: 如果你操控吸血鬼，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

530266.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target creature and 1 damage to its controller. Draw a card.
530266.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成1点伤害，并对其操控者造成1点伤害。抓一张牌。

530267.oracleText: Neonate's Rush deals 1 damage to target creature and 1 damage to its controller. Draw a card.
530267.translation: 稚儿血欲对目标生物造成1点伤害，并对其操控者造成1点伤害。抓一张牌。

530269.oracleText: "Sleep? I can sleep when I'm dead!"
530269.translation: 「睡觉？死了之后有的是时间睡！」

530271.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
530271.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

530273.oracleText: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.
530273.translation: 托瓦拉号令狼嚎难以抗拒，纵连雅琳自己的忠诚狼群亦为之动摇。

530274.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If you control a Wolf or Werewolf, scry 2.
530274.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果你操控狼或狼人，则占卜2。

530276.oracleText: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.
530276.translation: 魔鬼发现人类居所过于寒冷、黑暗、缺乏火光生机。

530277.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. If a player is dealt damage this way, scry 1.
530277.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。如果以此法对一位牌手造成伤害，则占卜1。

530278.oracleText: Play with Fire deals 2 damage to any target. If a player is dealt damage this way, scry 1.
530278.translation: 戏火作乐对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。如果以此法对一位牌手造成伤害，则占卜1。

530280.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to target creature defending player controls. If that creature is a Zombie, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to it instead.
530280.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对目标由防御牌手操控的生物造成1点伤害。如果该生物是灵俑，则改为CARDNAME对它造成2点伤害。

530283.oracleText: The folk of Kessig build up their courage by burning effigies of the things they fear.
530283.translation: 凯锡革民众将自己惧怕之物作成肖像并一焚了之，借此壮胆。

530284.oracleText: Target attacking creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
530284.translation: 目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

530285.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Target attacking creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
530285.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

530287.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains haste until end of turn.
530287.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

530289.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains trample and haste until end of turn.
530289.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得践踏与敏捷异能。

530295.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a number of ember counters on CARDNAME equal to the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. Then if CARDNAME has seven or more ember counters on it, remove them and transform CARDNAME.
530295.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置若干余烬指示物，其数量等同于施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量。然后如果CARDNAME上有七个或更多余烬指示物，则移去这类指示物并转化CARDNAME。

530298.oracleText: A dragon is born. A province burns.

530299.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
530299.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

530304.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
530304.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

530307.oracleText: "There's nothing like a good meal to really lift the spirit."

530308.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+1 until end of turn. If it's your turn, that creature gains trample until end of turn. Otherwise, it gains first strike until end of turn.
530308.translation: 目标生物得+3/+1直到回合结束。如果当前是你的回合，则该生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。若否，则它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

530314.oracleText: She dispatched every challenger with a sickening snap of bone.
530314.translation: 所有向她挑战的人，都在一声骇人折骨声响后败下阵来。

530316.oracleText: With every arm in sight broken, she turned her attention to the furniture.
530316.translation: 在掰坏所有人手腕之后，她便将注意力转移到了家具上。

530318.oracleText: "You have my word. You'll see no wolf attacks while we're around!"
530318.translation: 「我向你们保证。只要我们在，村庄就不会受到狼群袭击！」

530320.oracleText: With no guards to be seen, the cobbled streets of Gatstaf echoed with howls.
530320.translation: 守夜人已然不见踪影，只剩狼嚎在卡兹特街头回荡。

530321.oracleText: Wolves and Werewolves you control have haste.
530321.translation: 由你操控的狼和狼人具有敏捷异能。

530327.oracleText: A duel to first blood means something very different when a vampire is involved.
530327.translation: 见血即止的决斗规矩，在有吸血鬼参与的情况下其意义已大不相同。

530331.oracleText: Coven — As long as you control three or more creatures with different powers, you may cast creature spells from the top of your library.
530331.translation: 鸠集～只要你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，你便可以从你的牌库顶施放生物咒语。

530333.oracleText: She won't rest until she's collected specimens of every bird on Innistrad.
530333.translation: 她立志集齐依尼翠上所有鸟类标本，不达目的誓不罢休。

530335.oracleText: Her hunger won't be sated until she's tasted every bird on Innistrad.
530335.translation: 她立志尝遍依尼翠上所有鸟类滋味，不达目的誓不罢休。

530337.oracleText: With their usual prey scared off by werewolves, the wolves of the Ulvenwald adopted inventive new hunting techniques.
530337.translation: 在平常猎物都被狼人吓跑之后，沃文森的狼不得不创新捕猎技巧。

530342.oracleText: As long as you control a token, CARDNAME gets +2/+0.
530342.translation: 只要你操控衍生物，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

530345.oracleText: Travelers in the Somberwald scan the ground for werewolves and other threats, unaware of what lurks above.
530345.translation: 进到松柏森的旅人通常会仔细检查地面，查看有无狼人或其他威胁痕迹，而忽略了头顶动向。

530346.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/2 green Spider creature token with reach.
530346.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/2绿色，具延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

530351.oracleText: "On this night, the dark will fear us."

530352.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, CARDNAME gains trample until end of turn.
530352.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则CARDNAME获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

530354.oracleText: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.
530354.translation: 随着狼人袭击渐频，癫狂劫后就未见过的强力武器又被取出清洁，重新服役。

530356.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
530356.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

530357.oracleText: Consuming Blob's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
530357.translation: 噬物黏浆的力量等同于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

530361.oracleText: "Welcome to the greatest show in Kessig!"
530361.translation: 「欢迎来到凯锡革最精彩的演出现场！」

530363.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
530363.translation: 鸠集～在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530366.oracleText: Coven — {o5oG}: Target creature you control gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
530366.translation: 鸠集～{o5oG}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

530368.oracleText: "Wherever there is life, there is power for one who knows the old ways."
530368.translation: 「但凡有生命之处，知晓古道之人就能积聚力量。」

530371.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, mill a card. Then if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, transform CARDNAME.
530371.translation: 在你的维持开始时，磨一张牌。然后若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则转化CARDNAME。

530375.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile a card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
530375.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。若以此法放逐一张生物牌，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530378.oracleText: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.
530378.translation: 女巫、狼人和护教军并肩站在仪式中心的旭金锁周围，准备誓死抵御托瓦拉的袭击。

530379.oracleText: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.
530379.translation: 将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标由你操控的生物。

530383.oracleText: Coven — Choose target creature you control and target creature you don't control. If you control three or more creatures with different powers, put a +1/+1 counter on the chosen creature you control. Then the chosen creatures fight each other.
530383.translation: 鸠集～选择目标由你操控的生物和目标不由你操控的生物。如果你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则在所选之由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后所选的生物互斗。

530385.oracleText: "Careful now. Don't want to get the seeds stuck to your feelers like last time."
530385.translation: 「这次慢点吃。别像上次那样把南瓜籽沾得满触角都是。」

530389.oracleText: She patrols the darkness so that others can forget their worries for one bright evening.
530389.translation: 她在黑暗中巡逻，好让他人能够忘却烦恼，尽情享受光明傍晚。

530390.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
530390.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则CARDNAME本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

530393.oracleText: "You and me, we're not built for captivity."
530393.translation: 「你和我一样，天性不该受人使唤。」

530395.oracleText: Other Wolves and Werewolves you control have trample.
530395.translation: 由你操控的其他狼和狼人具有践踏异能。

530400.oracleText: Brimming with power from their disrupted ritual, the Dawnhart witches lashed out at the werewolf intruders.
530400.translation: 曙鹿集女巫浑身满盈从遭阻仪式中获得的力量，奋起反击狼人入侵者。

530401.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Coven — Then if you control three or more creatures with different powers, draw a card.
530401.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。鸠集～然后如果你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则抓一张牌。

530402.oracleText:
Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. 
Coven — Then if you control three or more creatures with different powers, draw a card.
530402.translation:
目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。
鸠集～然后如果你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则抓一张牌。

530408.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, destroy target artifact or enchantment defending player controls.
530408.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，消灭目标由防御牌手操控的神器或结界。

530411.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if there are three or more basic land types among lands you control, scry 1.
530411.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。然后如果由你操控的地中有三种或更多基本地类别，则占卜1。

530413.oracleText: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.
530413.translation: 吃过灵俑而幸存的狼群，会将亡者腐疫播散到它们所经之处。

530414.oracleText: {o2oG}: CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn.
530414.translation: {o2oG}：CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。

530416.oracleText:
"A creature of stone was never meant to fly. And I see the Ulvenwald agrees with me."
—Halana, Kessig ranger
530416.translation:
「石头变成的生物本该不能飞。原来沃文森看法跟我一样。」
～凯锡革护林者荷拉娜

530420.oracleText:
"Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
530420.translation:
「就算是顽石寒钢，最终也会回归吉琳达努怀抱。」
～曙鹿集巫首凯蒂妲

530422.oracleText: Create two 3/3 green Insect creature tokens. You gain 2 life.
530422.translation: 派出两个3/3绿色昆虫衍生生物。你获得2点生命。

530424.oracleText: Other tapped creatures you control have deathtouch.
530424.translation: 由你操控且已横置的其他生物具有死触异能。

530425.oracleText: Other untapped creatures you control have hexproof.
530425.translation: 由你操控且未横置的其他生物具有辟邪异能。

530426.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Untap another target creature or land you control.
530426.translation: {o1}，{oT}：重置另一个目标由你操控的生物或地。

530428.oracleText:
"Werewolves leave tracks. Vampires leave wrung-out corpses. This is something else."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald
530428.translation:
「狼人留下踪迹。吸血鬼留下干尸。这是其他东西留下的。」
～松柏森布陷人堡霖

530431.oracleText:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words
530431.translation:
「噢，感恩天使。它不是狼人，只是头普通的拉～」
～沃文森向导布鲁诺的遗言

530434.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put up to two permanent cards with mana value 5 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
530434.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中至多两张法术力值等于或小于5的永久物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

530437.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
530437.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

530438.oracleText: Hiring an experienced wilderness guide isn't cheap, but it costs less than a search party. Or a funeral.
530438.translation: 虽然雇佣一位经验丰富的荒郊向导并不便宜，但总比叫上搜救队来得划算。或是葬礼。

530440.oracleText: The new hire proved more than enough to replace the three farmhands who disappeared the week before.
530440.translation: 新雇上这位工人干的活，比上周失踪的三名农工加起来还要多。

530442.oracleText: A few townsfolk had their suspicions, but none dared accuse him openly.
530442.translation: 虽然有的镇民心存疑虑，但谁也不敢公开指控。

530444.oracleText: "Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair."
530444.translation: 「闻到了吗，伙计们？恐惧和绝望。」

530449.oracleText: {o2oGoG}: Another target Wolf or Werewolf you control fights target creature you don't control.
530449.translation: {o2oGoG}：另一个目标由你操控的狼或狼人与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

530451.oracleText: Choose up to three target cards in graveyards. The owners of those cards shuffle them into their libraries. You gain 2 life.
530451.translation: 选择至多三张目标在坟墓场中的牌。这些牌的拥有者将其洗入各自的牌库。你获得2点生命。

530453.oracleText: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.
530453.translation: 随着昼夜轮回消失，月亮的扭曲影响逐渐加剧。而且愈演愈烈。

530454.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, double the power and toughness of each creature you control until end of turn.
530454.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，将每个由你操控之生物的力量和防御力均加倍直到回合结束。

530457.oracleText: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.
530457.translation: 死于树下，醒来时便融为一体。

530458.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
530458.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530462.oracleText: Reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all land cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
530462.translation: 展示你牌库顶的四张牌。将以此法展示的所有地牌置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

530463.oracleText: Put any number of land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
530463.translation: 将任意数量的地牌从你手上横置放进战场。

530465.oracleText: Return all permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand. You get an emblem with "You have no maximum hand size."
530465.translation: 将所有永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「你的手牌数量没有上限。」

530467.oracleText: "My angel is the flint, and I am her steel."
530467.translation: 「天使燃我战意，我愿当其尖刀。」

530468.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. It gains vigilance, trample, lifelink, indestructible, and haste until end of turn.
530468.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。直到回合结束，它获得警戒、践踏、系命、不灭与敏捷异能。

530471.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an instant or sorcery card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
530471.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张瞬间或法术牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

530475.oracleText: Create two 2/2 green Wolf creature tokens.
530475.translation: 派出两个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

530478.oracleText: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a 5/5 Werewolf creature with trample, indestructible, and haste.
530478.translation: 直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为5/5，具践踏、不灭与敏捷异能的狼人生物。

530481.oracleText: The surviving militia members reunited with their fallen comrades sooner than they'd hoped.
530481.translation: 幸存民兵队员与过世战友的重逢之日，来得比他们想象的要早一些。

530482.translation: 由你操控的其他灵俑得+1/+0。

530484.oracleText: Death is no impediment to dinner.

530485.oracleText: If this creature would die, exile it instead.
530485.translation: 如果此生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

530486.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains "If this creature would die, exile it instead."
530486.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得「如果此生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。」

530489.oracleText: Create an X/X blue and black Zombie creature token with menace, where X is the total power of the sacrificed creatures.
530489.translation: 派出一个X/X，蓝黑双色，具威慑异能的灵俑衍生生物，X为所牺牲之生物的力量总和。

530492.oracleText: Frog is the sincerest form of flattery.

530493.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target non-Frog creature, except it's a 1/1 green Frog.
530493.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标非蛙生物的复制品，但它是1/1绿色的蛙。

530496.oracleText: "The balance of day and night is shattered. We must find the Moonsilver Key."
530496.translation: 「昼夜平衡已被破坏，我们必须找到月银钥。」

530497.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
530497.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

530501.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into graveyards from anywhere, investigate. This ability triggers only once each turn.
530501.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌从任何区域进入坟墓场时，探查。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

530505.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard, tap target creature you don't control.
530505.translation: 每当你从你坟墓场中施放咒语时，横置目标不由你操控的生物。

530509.oracleText: If Departed Soulkeeper would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
530509.translation: 如果离世守魂灵将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

530511.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or land. If a land was destroyed this way, its controller may search their library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Otherwise, its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
530511.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或地。如果以此法消灭一个地，则其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。若否，则其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

530514.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature that died this turn.
530514.translation: 本回合中每有一个生物死去，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

530517.oracleText: "What has been looted can be restored. The church lives on within us."
530517.translation: 「遭掠之处可以复原。而教会长存心中。」

530518.oracleText: You gain 2 life, draw two cards, then discard two cards.
530518.translation: 你获得2点生命，抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

530521.oracleText: A soulless husk of endless hunger.
530521.translation: 无魂躯壳具有无尽饥渴。

530522.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another creature, you gain 1 life and scry 1.
530522.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个生物时，你获得1点生命并占卜1。

530523.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
530523.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

530531.oracleText: Create X 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens with decayed, where X is half the number of creature cards in your graveyard, rounded up.
530531.translation: 派出X个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物，X为你坟墓场中生物牌数量的一半，小数点后进位。

530535.oracleText: The hunters spent the evening celebrating their kill and the rest of the night running from it.
530535.translation: 猎人傍晚还在为狩猎庆功，之后整晚都被所猎之物追捕、疲于奔命。

530538.oracleText: Exile target nonlegendary creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Otherwise, tap it.
530538.translation: 放逐目标非传奇的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。如果它是在你的操控下进战场，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则将之横置。

530540.oracleText: Create a 3/1 black and red Vampire creature token with trample, lifelink, and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
530540.translation: 派出一个3/1，黑红双色，具践踏、系命与敏捷异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

530543.oracleText: "We can go into the dark hand-in-hand or alone. I know which I prefer."
530543.translation: 「黑暗降临之时，我们可以携手同行，也可孑然面对。我知道我会选哪样。」

530546.oracleText: "The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not."
530546.translation: 「天使或许已经抛弃我们，但吉琳达努还没有。」

530547.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any of this creature's colors.
530547.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其颜色为此生物的任一颜色。

530548.oracleText: Human creatures you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any of this creature's colors."
530548.translation: 由你操控的人类生物具有「{oT}：加一点法术力，其颜色为此生物的任一颜色。」

530549.oracleText: {o4oGoW}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
530549.translation: {o4oGoW}，{oT}：在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530551.oracleText: "Far from home, little one? I know the feeling."
530551.translation: 「你也是背井离乡吗，小家伙？我知道你的感受。」

530552.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, add {oR} or {oG}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
530552.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，加{oR}或{oG}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

530557.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, return that card to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.
530557.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌移回其拥有者手上。

530561.oracleText: {oXoUoUoBoB}, Exile X creature cards from your graveyard: Transform Ludevic. X can't be 0. Activate only as a sorcery.
530561.translation: {oXoUoUoBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐X张生物牌：转化卢德维。X不能为0。只能于法术时机起动。

530563.oracleText: As this creature transforms into Olag, Ludevic's Hubris, it becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with it, except its name is Olag, Ludevic's Hubris, it's 4/4, and it's a legendary blue and black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on Olag equal to the number of creature cards exiled with it.
530563.translation: 于此生物转化为卢德维巨作欧拉格时，它成为一张以其放逐之生物牌的复制品，但其名称是卢德维巨作欧拉格，为4/4，额外是蓝黑双色的传奇灵俑，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。在欧拉格上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于以其放逐的生物牌数量。

530565.oracleText: When you cast this spell, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X creature cards. Put all creature cards revealed this way into your graveyard, then put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
530565.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出X张生物牌为止。将以此法展示的所有生物牌置入你的坟墓场，然后将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

530566.oracleText: Old Stickfingers's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
530566.translation: 老枯指的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

530568.oracleText: If a spell would deal damage to you or another permanent you control, prevent that damage.
530568.translation: 如果某咒语将对你或另一个由你操控的永久物造成伤害，则防止该伤害。

530569.oracleText: If a spell would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.
530569.translation: 如果某咒语将向任一对手或任一由对手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加1点伤害。

530571.oracleText: Nature bends to the witches' call.

530575.oracleText: Revenge is a circle without end.
530575.translation: 复仇是个没有尽头的循环。

530576.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a nonland permanent.
530576.translation: 牺牲一个非地永久物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

530580.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast spells from your graveyard.
530580.translation: {oT}：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。此法术力只能用来从你坟墓场中施放咒语。

530581.oracleText: {oGoU}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Return target card with flashback you own from exile to your hand.
530581.translation: {oGoU}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：将目标由你拥有且具返照异能的牌从放逐区移回你手上。

530584.oracleText:
"Do not confuse justice with mercy."
—Odric, Order of Saint Traft
530584.translation:
「切勿将正义与怜悯混为一谈。」
～圣沙弗骑士团的欧吉克

530585.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
530585.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

530586.oracleText: Sacred Fire deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
530586.translation: 圣洁火焰对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

530589.oracleText: Coven — Whenever Sigarda attacks, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Human creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
530589.translation: 鸠集～每当席嘉妲攻击时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张人类生物牌并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

530595.oracleText: Remove three +1/+1 counters from Slogurk: Return it to its owner's hand.
530595.translation: 从斯罗咕上移去三个+1/+1指示物：将它移回其拥有者手上。

530596.oracleText: When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, return up to three target land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
530596.translation: 当斯罗咕离开战场时，将至多三张目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

530601.oracleText: "Like us, the morning fights for survival."
530601.translation: 「跟我们一样，清晨也在艰苦求存。」

530603.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
530603.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530605.oracleText: Choose up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, and up to one target land. Untap the chosen permanents you control. Tap the chosen permanents you don't control. You gain 2 life.
530605.translation: 选择至多一个目标神器，至多一个目标生物和至多一个目标地。重置所选永久物中由你操控者。横置所选永久物中不由你操控者。你获得2点生命。

530606.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
530606.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

530607.oracleText: Untap all permanents you control during each opponent's untap step.
530607.translation: 于每位对手的重置步骤中，重置所有由你操控的永久物。

530608.oracleText: You draw a card during each opponent's draw step.
530608.translation: 于每位对手的抓牌步骤中，你抓一张牌。

530609.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Untap all permanents you control during each opponent's untap step" and "You draw a card during each opponent's draw step."
530609.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「于每位对手的重置步骤中，重置所有由你操控的永久物」与「于每位对手的抓牌步骤中，你抓一张牌。」

530611.oracleText: Whenever a Wolf or Werewolf you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
530611.translation: 每当一个由你操控的狼或狼人对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

530612.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control three or more Wolves and/or Werewolves, it becomes night. Then transform any number of Human Werewolves you control.
530612.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控三个或更多狼和／或狼人，则当前成为黑夜。然后转化任意数量由你操控的「人类／狼人」。

530614.oracleText: {oXoRoG}: Target Wolf or Werewolf you control gets +X/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
530614.translation: {oXoRoG}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的狼或狼人得+X/+0且获得践踏异能。

530616.oracleText: It becomes night. Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
530616.translation: 当前成为黑夜。直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得践踏与「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。」

530620.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {oX} less to cast, where X is Vadrik's power.
530620.translation: 你施放的瞬间与法术咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为瓦垂格的力量。

530621.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, put a +1/+1 counter on Vadrik.
530621.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，在瓦垂格上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

530627.oracleText: Choose up to two target creature cards in your graveyard. An opponent chooses one of them. Return that card to your hand. Return the other to the battlefield under your control. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
530627.translation: 选择至多两张目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌。任一对手从中选择一张。将该牌移回你手上。将另一张牌在你的操控下移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

530630.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control. Tap up to one target creature you don't control, and that creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
530630.translation: 在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。横置至多一个目标不由你操控的生物，且该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

530634.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: If it's night, it becomes day. Otherwise, it becomes night. Activate only as a sorcery.
530634.translation: {o3}，{oT}：如果当前是黑夜，则成为白昼。若否，则成为黑夜。只能于法术时机起动。

530635.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, you gain 1 life. You may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
530635.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，你获得1点生命。你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

530637.oracleText: Do the candleguides' heads turn to follow you as you pass, or is it merely a trick of the flickering light?
530637.translation: 到底是烛光向导在你经过时扭头看了你，还是仅为闪烁烛光引起的错觉？

530640.oracleText: By the end of the festival, it was the only thing still grinning.
530640.translation: 收成节落幕时，只有它上面还挂着笑脸。

530641.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile up to one target card from a graveyard. Draw a card.
530641.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。抓一张牌。

530646.oracleText: To restore the day-night balance, the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock must be reunited with its long-lost key.
530646.translation: 要恢复日夜平衡，就必须用遗失已久的钥匙去打开穹天仪的核心机关～旭金锁。

530647.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for an artifact card with a mana ability or a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
530647.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张具法术力异能的神器牌或一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

530650.oracleText: It waited on the barn wall for decades, forgotten, looking for the perfect opportunity.
530650.translation: 数十年来，它一直无人问津，静静挂在谷仓墙上等待完美时机。

530654.oracleText: Under the light of an unnatural moon, it walked out on legs of straw with joints of hinges ripped from the barn doors.
530654.translation: 于异常之月的光芒下，它借助谷仓大门铰链与稻草拼合而成的四肢昂首挺立。

530655.oracleText: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.
530655.translation: 有的时候尸嵌会记得前生太多往事。幸运的是，有种办法可以简单解决。

530657.oracleText:
"When a werewolf charges, you'll only have time for one shot. Best make it count."
—Captain Eberheart
530657.translation:
「狼人冲锋后，你只有射一箭的机会。不要浪费。」
～船长艾博汉

530658.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to target creature. If a Werewolf is dealt damage this way, destroy it.
530658.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果某狼人以此法受到伤害，则消灭该狼人。

530661.oracleText: It takes a taxidermist of unusual skill to cleanly stuff and mount a beast without severing its primal, predatory drive.
530661.translation: 仔细填充野兽尸身令其站立，同时又不失却其原初猎捕本能，这需要超凡技艺的标本师才能做到。

530662.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME becomes a 4/4 green Bear artifact creature until end of turn.
530662.translation: {o2}：CARDNAME成为4/4绿色的熊神器生物直到回合结束。

530665.oracleText: Drownyard floods and unnatural frost made the once peaceful boardwalk deceptively treacherous.
530665.translation: 沉船地的洪流和诡异冰霜，让这原本平稳的木板路径也变得颇为凶险。

530668.oracleText:
"Stensia blazes with new heat. Nephalia's tides are chaotic. And everywhere, this unnatural frost. The land is sending a warning."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
530668.translation:
「若你过度聚焦阴影找寻邪恶，便会错过这世界上光明之处的众多美景。」
～曙鹿集巫首凯蒂妲

530670.oracleText: Swirling eddies of ash hide crumbling cliffs, treacherous drops, and the slavering maws of unknown evils.
530670.translation: 漩涡灰雾之下，藏着的是崩毁山崖、险峻峭壁和恶物血口。

530673.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Put a soul counter on CARDNAME. Then if there are three or more soul counters on it, remove those counters, transform it, then untap it. Activate only as a sorcery.
530673.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个灵魂指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多灵魂指示物，则移去这类指示物，转化它，然后将它重置。只能于法术时机起动。

530677.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of creature cards exiled with CARDNAME.
530677.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为以CARDNAME放逐的生物牌数量。

530682.oracleText: A few weed-choked gourd patches are all that remain of the proud, thriving farms that once blanketed the province.
530682.translation: 覆盖行省的傲人沃田如今已然荒芜，只剩丛生杂草点缀其间。

530685.oracleText: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.
530685.translation: 嚎群在凯锡革狭窄山谷间追捕猎物，惊慌哀号回荡此处经久不绝。

530688.oracleText: The bones of doomed ships jut out from the muck while the bones of their sailors molder below.
530688.translation: 遭难船只船身突出淤泥，船员尸身则在底下腐烂。

530691.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
530691.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

530692.oracleText: Target up to two creature cards with mana value 2 or less.
530692.translation: 指定至多两张法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌为目标。

530693.oracleText: Shuffle up to three target cards from your graveyard into your library?
530693.translation: 是否要讲至多三张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库？

530694.oracleText: Target a creature you don't control that was dealt damage this turn.
530694.translation: 指定一个不由你操控且本回合中受过伤害的生物为目标。

530695.oracleText: Target up to one Zombie you control.
530695.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的灵俑为目标。

530697.translation: 是否要支付{2, Number}点生命？

530699.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Remove {2, Number} loyalty counter.} other {Remove {2, Number} loyalty counters.}}
530699.translation: {2, plural, =1 {移去{2, Number}个忠诚指示物。} other {移去{2, Number}个忠诚指示物。}}

530700.oracleText: Return a land card to your hand?
530700.translation: 是否要将一张地牌移回你手上？

530701.oracleText: Target a creature or land you control.
530701.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物或地为目标。

530702.oracleText: Put up to two permanent cards with mana value 5 or less onto the battlefield?
530702.translation: 是否要将至多两张法术力值等于或小于5的永久物牌放进战场？

530703.oracleText: Target a Wolf or Werewolf you control.
530703.translation: 指定一个由你操控的狼或狼人为目标。

530704.oracleText: Target up to three cards in graveyards.
530704.translation: 指定至多三张坟墓场中的牌为目标。

530705.oracleText: Put any number of land cards onto the battlefield.
530705.translation: 将任意数量的地牌放进战场。

530706.translation: 指定一个非蛙生物为目标。

530707.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
530707.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

530708.oracleText: Return that card to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.
530708.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌移回其拥有者手上。

530709.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Exile {2, Number} creature card.} other {Exile {2, Number} creature cards.}}
530709.translation: {2, plural, =1 {放逐{2, Number}张生物牌。} other {放逐{2, Number}张生物牌。}}

530712.oracleText: Target a card with flashback you own.
530712.translation: 指定一张由你拥有且具返照异能的牌为目标。

530713.translation: 指定至多一个地为目标。

530714.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with a mana ability or a basic land card.
530714.translation: 搜寻一张具法术力异能的神器牌或基本地牌。

530720.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, amass X, where X is that spell's mana value.
530720.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，囤兵X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

532874.oracleText: Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle. Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, add {oBoBoB}.
532874.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。 精熟咒语～如果你坟墓场中有两张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，则加{oBoBoB}。

532875.oracleText:
Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle. 
Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, add {oBoBoB}.
532875.translation:
从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。
精熟咒语～如果你坟墓场中有两张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，则加{oBoBoB}。

532903.oracleText: Discard a card: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only once each turn.
532903.translation: 弃一张牌：转化CARDNAME。每回合只能起动一次。

532925.oracleText: Return target nonlegendary creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield.
532925.translation: 将目标法术力值为X且非传奇的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

532959.oracleText: Discard a card: Vampires you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
532959.translation: 弃一张牌：由你操控的吸血鬼得+1/+1直到回合结束。此异能每回合只能起动一次。

533229.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic Forest cards, reveal those cards, and put one onto the battlefield tapped and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle. Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, search your library for up to three basic Forest cards instead of two.
533229.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本的树林牌，展示这些牌，然后将一张横置放进战场，其余的牌则置于你手上。然后洗牌。 精熟咒语～如果你坟墓场中有两张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，则改为从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张基本的树林牌，而非两张。

533230.oracleText:
Search your library for up to two basic Forest cards, reveal those cards, and put one onto the battlefield tapped and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle. 
Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, search your library for up to three basic Forest cards instead of two.
533230.translation:
从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本的树林牌，展示这些牌，然后将一张横置放进战场，其余的牌则置于你手上。然后洗牌。

543142.translation: 呵欠大门 — 你获得1点生命。

543145.oracleText: Twisted Caverns — Target creature can't attack until your next turn.
543145.translation: 扭曲洞窟 — 目标生物不能攻击直到你的下一个回合。

543147.oracleText: Runestone Caverns — Exile the top two cards of your library. You may play them.
543147.translation: 符文石洞窟 — 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。你可以使用它们。

543148.oracleText: Muiral's Graveyard — Create two 1/1 black Skeleton creature tokens.
543148.translation: 穆拉的坟墓 — 派出两个1/1黑色骷髅妖衍生生物。

543150.oracleText: Mad Wizard's Lair — Draw three cards and reveal them. You may cast one of them without paying its mana cost.
543150.translation: 疯狂法师巢穴 — 抓三张牌并展示它们。你可以施放其中的一张牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

543153.oracleText: Goblin Lair — Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
543153.translation: 哥布林巢穴 — 派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

543154.oracleText: Mine Tunnels — Create a Treasure token.
543154.translation: 矿坑隧道 — 派出一个珍宝衍生物。

543155.oracleText: Storeroom — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
543155.translation: 储物房间 — 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

543156.oracleText: Dark Pool — Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
543156.translation: 黑暗之池 — 每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

543157.oracleText: Fungi Cavern — Target creature gets -4/-0 until your next turn.
543157.translation: 真菌洞窟 — 目标生物得-4/-0直到你的下一个回合。

543158.oracleText: Temple of Dumathoin — Draw a card.
543158.translation: 杜马松神殿 — 抓一张牌。

543160.oracleText: Trapped Entry — Each player loses 1 life.
543160.translation: 设陷入口 — 每位牌手各失去1点生命。

543161.oracleText: Veils of Fear — Each player loses 2 life unless they discard a card.
543161.translation: 恐惧帘幕 — 对每位牌手而言，除非他弃一张牌，否则失去2点生命。

543163.oracleText: Oubliette — Discard a card and sacrifice a creature, an artifact, and a land.
543163.translation: 囚禁密牢 — 弃一张牌并牺牲一个神器、一个生物和一个地。

543164.oracleText: Cradle of the Death God — Create The Atropal, a legendary 4/4 black God Horror creature token with deathtouch.
543164.translation: 死神摇篮 — 派出传奇衍生生物萎缩者，其为4/4黑色，具死触异能的神／惊惧兽。

543165.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature, an artifact, and a land.
543165.translation: 牺牲一个生物，一个神器和一个地。

544161.oracleText: Put a Dragon creature card onto the battlefield?
544161.translation: 是否要将一张龙生物牌放进战场？

544176.oracleText: Cast one of them without paying its mana cost?
544176.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用施放其一？

544177.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature, artifact, or land?
544177.translation: 是否要牺牲一个生物，神器或地？

544178.oracleText: Return {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} creature} other {{2, Number} creatures}} they control to their owner's hand.
544178.translation: 将{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个} other {{2, Number}个}}由其操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

544179.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.]
544179.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [每当你获得生命时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。]

544182.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [Whenever you attack, until end of turn, target attacking creature gets +1/+1 for each other attacking creature and gains double strike.]
544182.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [每当你攻击时，直到回合结束，目标进行攻击的生物获得连击异能，且每有一个其他进行攻击的生物，便得+1/+1。]

544183.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [When this Class becomes level 2, draw two cards.]
544183.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [当此职业成为等级2时，抓两张牌。]

544184.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.]
544184.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [每当你抓一张牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。]

544185.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [When this Class becomes level 2, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.]
544185.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [当此职业成为等级2时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。]

544186.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses life equal to the life they lost this turn.]
544186.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [在你的结束步骤开始时，每位对手各失去等同于其本回合中曾失去之数量的生命。]

544187.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [Whenever you roll one or more dice, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.]
544187.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得威慑异能。]

544188.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [由你操控的生物具有敏捷异能。]

544189.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [You may play an additional land on each of your turns.]
544189.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [你在自己的每个回合中可以额外使用一个地。]

544191.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [When this Class becomes level 3, target land you control becomes a creature with haste and "This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control." It's still a land.]
544191.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [当此职业成为等级3时，目标由你操控的地成为生物，且具有敏捷与「此生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。」它仍然是地。]

544192.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [Legendary spells you cast cost {oRoG} less to cast. This effect reduces only the amount of colored mana you pay.]
544192.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [你施放的传奇咒语减少{oRoG}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的有色法术力数量。]

544193.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [Whenever you cast a legendary spell, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play them this turn.]
544193.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [每当你施放传奇咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。]

544194.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [Equip abilities you activate cost {o2} less to activate.]
544194.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [你起动的佩带异能减少{o2}来起动。]

544195.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [Whenever a creature you control attacks, up to one target creature blocks it this combat if able.]
544195.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，至多一个目标生物本次战斗若能阻挡它，则须如此作。]

544196.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [When this Class becomes level 2, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.]
544196.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [当此职业成为等级2时，将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。]

544197.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. For as long as it remains exiled, it has "You may cast this card from exile as long as you've cast another spell this turn."]
544197.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于其持续放逐的时段内，它具有「只要你本回合中施放过其他咒语，你便可以从放逐区施放此牌。」]

544198.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [由你操控的生物具有威慑异能。]

544201.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [Creatures you control have "{oT}: Add {oU} or {oR}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell or to gain a Class level."]
544201.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2+] [] [由你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加{oU}或{oR}。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语，或是获得职业等级。」]

544202.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, that spell deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of instant and sorcery spells you've cast this turn.]
544202.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，该咒语向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于你本回合中施放过的瞬间和法术咒语数量。]

545315.oracleText: You may cast the copy by pay -ing {o1} rather than pay -ing its mana cost.
545315.translation: 你可以施放该复制品，但须支付{o1}，而非支付其法术力费用。

545324.oracleText: Spend only on: An Instant or Sorcery Spell or a Class Level
545324.translation: 只能用于支付：瞬间或法术咒语，获得职业等级

545521.oracleText: Return up to one creature card with mana value 3 or less to the battlefield.
545521.translation: 将至多一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌移回战场。

545522.oracleText: "I refuse to die before I see the sun rise again."
545522.translation: 「在见到太阳再度升起之前，我拒绝死去。」

545525.oracleText: "Stand strong. We will reclaim the dawn."
545525.translation: 「坚持作战。我们定能重唤黎明。」

545529.oracleText: Faith is a cathar's greatest weapon, but a sword of blessed silver is a close second.
545529.translation: 坚定信念是护教军最强武器，受福银剑则以毫厘之差居次。

545530.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +3/+3, up to one other target creature gets +2/+2, and up to one other target creature gets +1/+1. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.
545530.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3，至多另一个目标生物得+2/+2，且至多再另一个目标生物得+1/+1。这些生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

545532.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0. It gets an additional +0/+2 and has first strike as long as an Equipment named Groom's Finery is attached to a creature you control.
545532.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0。只要由你操控的生物上贴附有名称为新郎礼服的武具，则佩带此武具的生物便再得+0/+2且具有先攻异能。

545534.oracleText: The red envelopes guarantee safe passage through the Lurenbraum barrier. Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.
545534.translation: 手持红色喜帖便能安心通过卢仁堡设防关卡。奥莉薇亚有令：没有请柬，不得进入，无一例外。

545539.oracleText: Whenever you play a land or cast a spell, if it shares a card type with the exiled card, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
545539.translation: 每当你使用地或施放咒语时，若它与所放逐的牌具共通之牌张类别，则派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

545542.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a Vampire spell with the same name as a card exiled with CARDNAME, you gain 2 life.
545542.translation: 每当对手施放与以CARDNAME放逐之牌同名的吸血鬼咒语时，你获得2点生命。

545546.oracleText: "Our bodies may lie slain, but perhaps we can still complete the ritual. I'd rather not spend my afterlife in this wretched eternal night."
545546.translation: 「我们肉身虽已遇害，但现在或仍能完成仪式。我可不愿来生仍在这悲惨永夜中度过。」

545547.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you gain 2 life.
545547.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，你获得2点生命。

545555.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature attacks, tap target creature defending player controls."
545555.translation: 所结附的生物具有「每当此生物攻击时，横置目标由防御牌手操控的生物。」

545556.oracleText: If Clever Distraction would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545556.translation: 如果扰神妙法将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545558.oracleText: He swore to protect the Moorlands. A little thing like death was no excuse to break his oath.
545558.translation: 他发誓要保卫荒野。死亡这种小事并不能当作违背誓言的理由。

545560.oracleText: When he could no longer carry on, he imparted his strength to the one who took up his duty.
545560.translation: 等到实在无力坚持时，他便将力量传承给继任者。

545561.oracleText: If Drogskol Armaments would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545561.translation: 如果卓兹克战具将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545563.oracleText: The door to her home survived the fires of the Malignus. Now it's her greatest weapon.
545563.translation: 她家大门经毒怨妖烈焰炙烤而未毁。如今这已成为她最强力的武器。

545564.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1}. If you do, it gains indestructible until end of turn.
545564.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

545567.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if CARDNAME has two or fewer judgment counters on it, put a judgment counter on it.
545567.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若CARDNAME上有两个或更少裁决指示物，则在其上放置一个裁决指示物。

545569.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has three or more judgment counters on it, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
545569.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有三个或更多裁决指示物，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

545573.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a judgment counter on CARDNAME. Then if there are three or more judgment counters on it, enchanted player loses the game.
545573.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个裁决指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多裁决指示物，则所结附的牌手输掉这盘游戏。

545575.oracleText: If Sinner's Judgment would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545575.translation: 如果降罪判决将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545577.oracleText: "It won't bring them back, but it will bring me peace."
545577.translation: 「这虽不能让他们复活，却能让我安心。」

545579.translation: 消灭目标［进行攻击的］生物。

545581.oracleText: {oW}, Exile three cards from your graveyard: CARDNAME gains first strike until end of turn.
545581.translation: {oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：CARDNAME获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

545583.oracleText: Discard a card: Exile CARDNAME. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
545583.translation: 弃一张牌：放逐CARDNAME。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

545586.oracleText:
"Keep your heels down and bend at the hips as your mount takes flight. She'll do the rest."
—Anders, cathar drillmaster
545586.translation:
「坐骑准备起飞时，你只要脚跟下沉、屁股抬起。她会完成剩下的步骤。」
～护教军教官安德斯

545588.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, target attacking creature without flying gains flying until end of turn.
545588.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则目标进行攻击且不具飞行异能的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

545591.oracleText: As long as you control seven or more enchantments, creatures you control have flying and vigilance.
545591.translation: 只要你操控七个或更多结界，由你操控的生物便具有飞行与警戒异能。

545595.oracleText: {o1oW}: CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
545595.translation: {o1oW}：CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

545601.oracleText: {o2oW}, Remove two +1/+1 counters from among creatures you control: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
545601.translation: {o2oW}，从由你操控的生物上移去总共两个+1/+1指示物：消灭目标神器或结界。

545604.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of permanents you control that are Spirits and/or enchantments.
545604.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控且为精怪和／或结界之永久物的数量。

545608.oracleText: Enchanted creature has flying, lifelink, and protection from Vampires, and it gets +X/+X, where X is the number of permanents you control that are Spirits and/or enchantments.
545608.translation: 所结附的生物具有飞行、系命与反吸血鬼保护异能，且它得+X/+X，X为由你操控且为精怪和／或结界之永久物的数量。

545609.oracleText: If Katilda's Rising Dawn would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545609.translation: 如果凯蒂妲破晓之威将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545613.oracleText: "Thank you, Grandmother. I love you too."

545614.oracleText: If Ancestor's Embrace would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545614.translation: 如果先祖之拥将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545617.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life. [X is the number of creatures you control.]
545617.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。［X为由你操控的生物数量。］

545618.oracleText: Lantern Flare deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life. [X is the number of creatures you control.]
545618.translation: 提灯闪光对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。［X为由你操控的生物数量。］

545620.oracleText: "We can wait like helpless children for a hero, or we can gather our courage and be the heroes. Who's with me?"
545620.translation: 「与其像无助小孩坐等英雄解救，我们更该齐心奋勇化作英雄。谁跟我一起上？」

545622.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap target creature.
545622.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置目标生物。

545625.oracleText: A moment of distraction, an hour off course.

545632.oracleText: "Stay in the light. I don't know what lurks in those shadows, and I'd like to keep it that way."
545632.translation: 「留在光亮的地方。我不知道阴影中藏着什么，也不想去知道。」

545633.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
545633.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得系命与不灭异能直到回合结束。

545637.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life.
545637.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

545639.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, transform CARDNAME.
545639.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则转化CARDNAME。

545642.oracleText: "Ha! They fall for it every time."

545644.oracleText: {o1oB}: CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn.
545644.translation: {o1oB}：CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。

545647.oracleText: The recruits trained in eternal night, fueled by the hope that they might one day see the sun again.
545647.translation: 新兵在永夜黑暗中刻苦训练，心中满是再见日光破晓的殷切希望。

545650.oracleText:
"Creatures of the night dissolve like shadows in the light of faith."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
545650.translation:
「黯夜邪物如同阴影一般，经信念明光照耀便会消散。」
～瑟班守护者莎利雅

545651.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. Scry 1.
545651.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。占卜1。

545652.oracleText: Piercing Light deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. Scry 1.
545652.translation: 穿心明光对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。占卜1。

545654.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has vigilance.
545654.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+0且具有警戒异能。

545658.oracleText:
"Even in times of brutal darkness, never mistake beauty and delicacy for weakness."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
545658.translation:
「哪怕是在暴力横行的黑暗岁月当中，也绝不要把柔美误作软弱。」
～瑟班守护者莎利雅

545661.oracleText:
"It's not that I didn't expect some defiance, but I did hope it wouldn't be so heavily armed."
—Olivia Voldaren
545661.translation:
「倒不是说我没想过他们会反抗，而是没想到会有如此的重装部队。」
～奥莉薇亚沃达连

545665.oracleText:
"Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
545665.translation:
「奥莉薇亚沃达连只顾自己。我们则为更崇高的理念效命。」
～瑟班守护者莎利雅

545667.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME trains, exile up to one other target creature from the battlefield or creature card from a graveyard.
545667.translation: 每当CARDNAME见习时，选择至多另一个目标战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌。将从该处它放逐。

545669.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, put the exiled cards onto the battlefield under their owners' control.
545669.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，将所放逐之牌在其拥有者的操控下放进战场。

545672.oracleText: {o4oW}: Exile enchanted creature. Create a Blood token.
545672.translation: {o4oW}：放逐所结附的生物。派出一个血滴衍生物。

545674.oracleText: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.
545674.translation: 趁奥莉薇亚分神之际，席嘉妲挣脱束缚，召来麾下苍鹭天使。

545675.oracleText: Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have base power and toughness 4/4, have flying, and are Angels in addition to their other types.
545675.translation: 由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物之基础力量与防御力为4/4，具有飞行异能，且额外具有天使此类别。

545677.oracleText: This spell has flash as long as you control a Spirit.
545677.translation: 只要你操控精怪，此咒语便具有闪现异能。

545678.oracleText: When you cast this spell, tap up to two target creatures you don't control.
545678.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，横置至多两个目标不由你操控的生物。

545679.oracleText: "Thraben belongs to the living. I will not rest until it is cleansed."
545679.translation: 「瑟班是生者之地。未彻底净化之前，我绝不歇息。」

545681.oracleText: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.
545681.translation: 席嘉妲宗僧侣走遍大陆每个角落，不断传扬希望与生机，就连在最黑暗的时光当中也从未间断。

545682.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. You gain 1 life. Activate only as a sorcery.
545682.translation: {oT}：目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。你获得1点生命。只能于法术时机起动。

545684.oracleText: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.
545684.translation: 她只身一人面对整支嚎群，牺牲自己救下全镇性命。

545687.oracleText: Since her passing, many more travelers have made it home alive.
545687.translation: 她过世后，庇护了更多旅人安全返家。

545688.oracleText: If Twinblade Invocation would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545688.translation: 如果双刃祝愿将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545690.oracleText:
"Is this twisted ceremony simply a mockery of the human rite, or has Olivia fallen for her own charade?"
—Sorin Markov
545690.translation:
「究竟这颠狂庆典是用来嘲弄人类的仪式，或者奥莉薇亚已太过入戏无法自拔？」
～索霖马可夫

545694.oracleText: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed. When she brought one down herself, she realized she had found her calling.
545694.translation: 当眼见卡娅拯救村庄之时，蓓丽特才意识到原来吸血鬼也能被杀死。当亲手解决一个之后，她才意识到自己的使命。

545695.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage to a Vampire, destroy that creature.
545695.translation: 每当CARDNAME对一个吸血鬼造成伤害时，消灭后者。

545699.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and vigilance.
545699.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有四个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有飞行与警戒异能。

545701.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has ten or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has indestructible.
545701.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有十个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有不灭异能。

545704.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an invitation counter on CARDNAME. If you attacked with two or more creatures this turn, draw a card. Otherwise, create a 1/1 white Human creature token. Then if CARDNAME has three or more invitation counters on it, transform it.
545704.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个请柬指示物。若你本回合中曾以两个或更多生物攻击，则抓一张牌。若否，则派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。然后若CARDNAME上有三个或更多请柬指示物，则转化它。

545707.oracleText: Vampires from every bloodline mingled together, all swelling with pride to be seen at the event of the century.
545707.translation: 各血脉的吸血鬼全都受邀齐聚一堂，个个盛饰严装期望在这世纪庆典上展现风采。

545709.oracleText: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.
545709.translation: 婚礼贵客甫抵会场，便受到华服礼宾热情相迎。

545712.oracleText: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.
545712.translation: 对大多数人来说，这是可怖亡魂。对死灵炼金术士而言，则是潜在燃料。

545714.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent [you control] to its owner's hand.
545714.translation: 将目标［由你操控的］非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。
