554501.translation: {oT}，放逐秽暗之书和由你操控且名称为威可那法眼与威可那魔手的神器：派出传奇衍生生物威可那，其为8/8黑色灵俑／神，且具有不灭与所放逐之牌的所有触发式异能。

554502.oracleText: When the creature you control wins the fight, draw a card.
554502.translation: 当由你操控的生物赢得互斗时，抓一张牌。

554503.translation: 指定第三个生物为目标。

554547.oracleText: Target a creature to get a +1/+1 counter.
554547.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，它得一个+1/+1指示物。

554548.oracleText: Target a creature to get two +1/+1 counters.
554548.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，它得两个+1/+1指示物。

554549.oracleText: Target a creature to get three +1/+1 counters.
554549.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，它得三个+1/+1指示物。

554628.oracleText: Seek a creature card of the most prevalent creature type in your library.
554628.translation: 取出一张在你牌库中生物类别最普遍的生物牌。

554632.oracleText: Return an unblocked attacking creature you control to its owner's hand.
554632.translation: 将一个由你操控且未受阻挡的攻击生物移回其拥有者手上。

555780.oracleText: Target up to one creature you own.
555780.translation: 指定至多一个由你拥有的生物为目标。

555801.translation: 指定至多两个生物为目标。

555809.oracleText: Sacrifice it at end of combat.
555809.translation: 在战斗结束时将它牺牲。

555812.oracleText: Target up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} other artifact, creature, or enchantment} other {{2, Number} other artifacts, creatures, and/or enchantments}}.
555812.translation: 指定至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个其他神器，生物或结界} other {{2, Number}个其他神器，生物和／或结界}}为目标。

555815.oracleText: Target up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less} other {{2, Number} instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less}}.
555815.translation: 指定至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}张法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间／或法术牌} other {{2, Number}张法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间和／或法术牌}}为目标。

555817.oracleText: Target up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} land} other {{2, Number} lands}} you control.
555817.translation: 指定至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个} other {{2, Number}个}}由你操控的地为目标。

555818.oracleText: Target any number of players other than that player.
555818.translation: 指定该牌手之外的任意数量牌手为目标。

555994.oracleText: Return a random creature card with the highest mana value among creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
555994.translation: 随机将你坟墓场生物牌中法术力值最高的一张生物牌移回战场。

556001.oracleText: If it becomes day or night or if a daybound permanent enters the battlefield, track day/night for the rest of the game.
556001.translation: 如果天色成为白昼或黑夜，或是有昼形永久物进战场，便需在本盘游戏的剩余时段中记录当前天色状态。

556002.oracleText: As it becomes day, transform all nightbound permanents.
556002.translation: 与天色变为白昼时，转化所有夜形永久物。

556003.oracleText: If a player casts no spells during their own turn, it becomes night next turn.
556003.translation: 如果牌手于自己回合中没有施放咒语，则下一个回合成为黑夜。

556004.oracleText: As it becomes night, transform all daybound permanents.
556004.translation: 与天色变为黑夜时，转化所有昼形永久物。

556005.translation: 永久物以夜形状态进战场。

556006.oracleText: If a player casts at least two spells during their own turn, it becomes day next turn.
556006.translation: 如果牌手于自己回合中施放至少两个咒语，则下一个回合成为白昼。

556011.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if it's neither day nor night, it becomes day.
556011.translation: 在你的维持开始时，如果当前既非白昼也非黑夜，则天色成为白昼。

556012.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
556012.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

556147.oracleText: Remove any number of charge counters.
556147.translation: 移去任意数量的充电指示物。

556150.oracleText: Target up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} other artifacts, creatures, and/or enchantment} other {{2, Number} other artifacts, creatures, and/or enchantments}}.
556150.translation: 指定至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个其他神器，结界和／或结界} other {{2, Number}个其他神器，结界和／或结界}}为目标。

556151.oracleText: Target up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or les} other {{2, Number} instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less}}.
556151.translation: 指定至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}张法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间和／或法术牌} other {{2, Number}张法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间和／或法术牌}}为目标。

556323.oracleText: Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
556323.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

556324.oracleText: Target up to two creature cards in your graveyard.
556324.translation: 指定至多两张在你坟墓场中的生物牌为目标。

556371.oracleText: Choose a card to return to your opponent's hand.
556371.translation: 选择一张牌，将其移回对手手上。

556373.oracleText: Spend only on: A Spell From Your Graveyard
556373.translation: 只能用于支付：你坟墓场中的咒语

556446.oracleText: Spend only on: A Disturb Cost or an Instant or Sorcery Spell
556446.translation: 只能用于支付：惊扰费用，瞬间或法术咒语

556494.oracleText: Select a creature card to copy.
556494.translation: 选择并复制一张生物牌。

557287.oracleText: Spend only on: Spells From Your Graveyard
557287.translation: 只能用于支付：你坟墓场中的咒语

557289.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may pay {o1}. When you do, attach CARDNAME to it.
557289.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

557292.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of nonland permanent cards with total mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
557292.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中任意数量的非地永久物牌放进战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于4。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

557293.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of nonland permanent cards with total mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
557293.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中任意数量的非地永久物牌放进战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于4。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

557294.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on each permanent you control that's a creature or Vehicle.
557294.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物或载具永久物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

557295.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on each permanent you control that's a creature or Vehicle.
557295.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物或载具永久物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

557296.oracleText:
When CARDNAME dies, choose one — 
• Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of nonland permanent cards with total mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on each permanent you control that's a creature or Vehicle.
557296.translation:
当CARDNAME死去时，选择一项～ 
•检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中任意数量的非地永久物牌放进战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于4。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。 
•在每个由你操控的生物或载具永久物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

557300.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact, enchantment, or tapped creature. Then if you control an artifact and an enchantment, create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with vigilance.
557300.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器，结界或已横置的生物。然后如果你同时操控神器和结界，则派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。

557302.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
557302.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

557303.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
557303.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

557304.oracleText: Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.
557304.translation: 放逐此传纪，然后将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化。

557306.oracleText:
"The moths of Eiganjo were once no different from any other great beast of Kamigawa's wilds. It took years of patience and dedication to convince them to bear riders."
—History of the Empire
557306.translation:
「永岩城飞蛾原与神河野境巨兽并无二致，唯经十数年耐心化育，终令它们愿意偕人同翔。」
～《帝国通史》

557309.oracleText: In the time it takes most to master one blade, he mastered two.
557309.translation: 这训练时间大多数人能舞好单剑已属不易，他却能将双刀运用自如。

557312.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +1/+1 for each creature and/or Vehicle you control.
557312.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，则你每操控一个生物和／或载具，它便得+1/+1。

557313.oracleText: This creature crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.
557313.translation: 此生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。

557317.oracleText:
"We have done our best to heal this land together, but now I must entrust the future to my sister. She will carry our dreams onward into the sunrise."
—Michiko Konda's journal
557317.translation:
「我们已竭尽所能来治愈这片土地，如今我必须将未来托付予我的姐妹。她将承载吾人梦想腾飞天际，与旭日同辉。」
～今田魅知子的札记

557318.oracleText: Return all artifact and enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
557318.translation: 将所有神器和结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

557321.oracleText: Equipped creature has flying and "You can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game."
557321.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有飞行与「你这盘游戏不会输，对手也不会赢。」

557324.oracleText: Cutting-edge Imperial sentinel mechs patrol the skies over Eiganjo.
557324.translation: 皇室卫兵机体乃以尖端科技打造，护永岩城于云霄。

557326.oracleText: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.
557326.translation: 皇室武士须经严格训练，不断磨炼战技、净化灵魂，以期自己够格蒙受神明祝福。

557327.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
557327.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，该生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557331.oracleText:
"We have endured lifetimes of war and carved our way to peace by blade and conquest. Now, united at last under Kyodai's guidance, we lay down our weapons and open our minds."
—Aoha, general of the First Emperor
557331.translation:
「我辈一生饱受战事之苦，凭手中刀剑与无畏征伐方才辟出和平大道。如今得香醍引领，吾人甘愿团结一心，抛却手中武器，放开脑中思绪。」
～始帝将军青叶

557333.oracleText: Exile target creature an opponent controls with mana value 4 or greater.
557333.translation: 放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或大于4的生物。

557334.oracleText: Each player gains control of all permanents they own.
557334.translation: 每位牌手各获得所有由其拥有之永久物的操控权。

557336.oracleText: For his transgressions against the kami, Lord Konda's immortal body was turned to stone, then shattered into a thousand still-living pieces.
557336.translation: 今田城主犯下逆神行径，其不朽身躯被化作石像，后又碎落成千百块在生碎片。

557340.oracleText:
Choose one or more — 
• Exile all artifacts. 
• Exile all creatures. 
• Exile all enchantments. 
• Exile all graveyards.
557340.translation:
选择一项或多项～ 
•放逐所有神器。 
•放逐所有生物。 
•放逐所有结界。 
•放逐所有坟墓场。

557342.oracleText: It seeks those who act with kindness and offers friendship.
557342.translation: 寻善心之士，以友谊相报。

557343.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token for each Shrine you control.
557343.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则你每操控一个祭祠，便派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

557345.oracleText: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.
557345.translation: 永岩城内设金尾院，由狐族一脉相承负责教导，其间学子不论是武打技艺还是帝业忠诚均无出其右。

557348.oracleText: "If your mech is factory standard, you might as well be walking."
557348.translation: 「如果你的机体是量产型的话，还是走着比较可靠。」

557349.oracleText: CARDNAME crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.
557349.translation: CARDNAME搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。

557352.oracleText: Those chosen to guard the Imperial Palace are not only unrivaled warriors but also lionhearted champions of the Imperial cause.
557352.translation: 被选中卫护皇宫者不仅战技无匹，亦是帝业拥趸。

557353.oracleText: Create three 2/2 white Samurai creature tokens with vigilance. Scry 3.
557353.translation: 派出三个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。占卜3。

557355.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, return target creature or Vehicle card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
557355.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物或载具牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557359.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, tap target creature you don't control.
557359.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，横置目标不由你操控的生物。

557361.oracleText: Enchanted permanent can't attack, block, or crew Vehicles. Its activated abilities can't be activated unless they're mana abilities.
557361.translation: 所结附的永久物不能进行攻击、阻挡或搭载载具。除了法术力异能之外，其起动式异能都不能起动。

557363.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield, then distribute four +1/+1 counters among any number of creatures and/or Vehicles target player controls.
557363.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，然后将四个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量由目标牌手操控的生物和／或载具。

557366.oracleText: That Vehicle gains first strike until end of turn.
557366.translation: 该载具获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

557367.oracleText: That Vehicle gains first strike until end of turn.
557367.translation: 该载具获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

557370.oracleText:
Whenever a Vehicle you control attacks, choose one — 
• That Vehicle gains first strike until end of turn. 
• Untap CARDNAME.
557370.translation:
每当一个由你操控的载具攻击时，选择一项～ 
•该载具获得先攻异能直到回合结束。 
•重置CARDNAME。

557375.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}: Kyodai gets +5/+5 until end of turn.

557377.oracleText: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."
557377.translation: 「彼处死路一条。此路仍有生机。」

557378.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle. Untap it.
557378.translation: 在目标生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。将它重置。

557379.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle. Untap it. 
• Return target permanent you control to its owner's hand.
557379.translation:
选择一项～ 
•在目标生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。将它重置。 
•将目标由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

557388.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
557388.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个+1/+1指示物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

557392.oracleText: The playful kami reserved its greatest blessings for those who brought not wealth or rare delicacies, but particularly amusing trinkets.
557392.translation: 这有趣神明并不看重财富或珍馐，反而会让供奉特别有趣琐物者交上大运。

557393.oracleText: Destroy target artifact with mana value 3 or less. You gain 3 life.
557393.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器。你获得3点生命。

557395.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of white cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
557395.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的白色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

557396.oracleText: Exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment with mana value X or less.
557396.translation: 放逐目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器，生物或结界。

557398.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
557398.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，目标生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557399.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
557399.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，目标生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557401.oracleText: Long ago, as the first mortal to bond with Kyodai, Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.
557401.translation: 今田魅知子是首位与神明缔结亲缘的凡人，许久之前正是她凭此终结逆神之战，引领神河进入布真和谐的全新时代。

557402.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
557402.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

557406.oracleText:
"Be proud, young pup! You've earned your wings. Rise and become the western wind."
—Swift-Arm, Golden-Tail headmaster
557406.translation:
「抬头挺胸，小子！你已得蛾翼相助。勇敢飞翔，化作西风。」
～金尾院长迅腕

557409.oracleText: "The blades will have their say, but peace is built with words."

557410.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may cast target enchantment card from your graveyard this turn.
557410.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，本回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场施放目标结界牌。

557412.oracleText: Before her spark pulled her away again, the Emperor appointed the wise Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.
557412.translation: 在火花再次带她远行前，飘萍皇立明臣轻脚为相，嘱其在自己云游期间统领神河。

557413.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's an enchantment creature or legendary creature, instead put a +1/+1 counter on it and it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
557413.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果它是结界生物或传奇生物，则改为在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557415.oracleText:
"You are a guest in this realm, and you've overstayed your welcome."
—Yui, Imperial intercessor
557415.translation:
「你在此界虽为客，但也不能真把这当家。」
～皇室调停人由依

557416.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Exile target creature with power 4 or greater. 
• Exile target enchantment.
557416.translation:
选择一项～ 
•放逐目标力量等于或大于4的生物。 
•放逐目标结界。

557418.oracleText: You may discard a card. When you do, return target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
557418.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

557420.oracleText:
"A visionary looks at rubble and sees not only what was, but also what could be."
—Onyx-Eye, architect of Eiganjo
557420.translation:
「从瓦砾之间，有远见者不仅能看到过往旧貌，更能构出未来蓝图。」
～永岩城筑师瑙眼

557421.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
557421.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

557424.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, it gains lifelink until end of turn.
557424.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

557427.oracleText: "I have taught you all I can. Take this blade and rise as my equal."
557427.translation: 「我已再无他物能够传授于你。请收下此刃，承我之业。」

557431.oracleText: Imperial samurai who show exceptional honor and dexterity are invited to train as mothriders, elite guards charged with protecting the skies of Eiganjo.
557431.translation: 英勇果敢、身手过人的皇室武士会获邀受训转晋翔蛾骑士，摇身成为戍卫永岩城天空的菁英护卫。

557433.oracleText: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.
557433.translation: 她与几个淘气神灵结下友谊，很快这一「小团体」就成为永岩城内诸多恶戏的根源。

557444.oracleText: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion. One mighty slash was enough to take the praetor out of the fight.
557444.translation: 金吉塔厦自认大局底定时，飘萍突然现身，手中长剑已扬。只见亮光闪过，她的一记重斩就足以击碎魔判官的所有胜算。

557445.oracleText: Wanderer's Intervention deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
557445.translation: 飘萍干预对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。

557449.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. It gains first strike until end of turn.
557449.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

557450.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with vigilance.
557450.translation: 派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。

557451.oracleText: Exile target tapped creature. You gain 2 life.
557451.translation: 放逐目标已横置的生物。你获得2点生命。

557453.oracleText: Since Imperial custom strictly forbade the Emperor to reveal her name—even to Kaito, her closest childhood friend—she had to suffer him calling her "your emperorness" for much of their shared youth.
557453.translation: 皇室严禁今上向任何人透露自己姓名～就连她的青梅竹马魁渡也不例外。因此在共度的大半年少岁月中，她只得一直忍受对方称呼自己「皇上」。

557454.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control an artifact and an enchantment, those creatures also gain lifelink until end of turn.
557454.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果你同时操控神器和结界，则这些生物再获得系命异能直到回合结束。

557457.oracleText: You can never have too many arms.

557458.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
557458.translation: 每当CARDNAME或佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

557461.oracleText: The Wanderer sighed in relief as the Reality Chip tethered her wayward spark to Kamigawa.
557461.translation: 飘萍眼见实界晶片将其难控火花栓定神河之后，反而长舒一口气。

557462.oracleText: Search your library for an Equipment or Vehicle card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle. If it has mana value less than the sacrificed permanent's mana value, scry 2.
557462.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张武具或载具牌，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。如果该牌的法术力值小于所牺牲之永久物，则占卜2。

557465.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+1 and has ward {o2}.
557465.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+1且具有守护{o2}。

557470.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it has base power and toughness 1/1.
557470.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它的基础力量与防御力便为1/1。

557472.oracleText: Creatures you don't control get -2/-0 until your next turn.
557472.translation: 不由你操控的生物得-2/-0直到你的下一个回合。

557473.oracleText: If you have one or fewer cards in hand, draw four cards. Otherwise, scry 2, then draw two cards.
557473.translation: 如果你的手牌为一张或更少，则抓四张牌。若否，则占卜2，然后抓两张牌。

557475.oracleText: Even as her students' minds succumbed to madness, Azami's obsession with the kami of forbidden knowledge only grew.
557475.translation: 纵使学院门生难承重压失智发狂，但蓟夫人对禁识神痴迷之情却只增不减。

557476.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each card in your hand.

557479.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may put an artifact card with mana value less than or equal to that damage from your hand onto the battlefield.
557479.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于该伤害的神器牌从你手上放进战场。

557482.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. Exile one of them face down and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost if it's an instant spell with mana value 2 or less. If you don't, put that card into your hand.
557482.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。牌面朝下地放逐其中一张，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果所放逐之牌是法术力值等于或小于2的瞬间咒语，则你可以施放它，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未如此作，则将该牌置于你手上。

557484.oracleText: "Let's just turn that off, shall we?"

557485.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap an untapped artifact you control or pay {o1}.
557485.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器或支付{o1}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

557486.oracleText: The Futurists regard the tradition of kami-bonding as anachronistic and inefficient, striving constantly to surpass spiritual power with technology.
557486.translation: 赛博派觉得「结神缘」这一传统既过时效果又不彰，故而致力发展科技，希冀有朝一日以此超越灵力。

557488.oracleText: "The Imperials can't arrest you for illegal tech if you never even existed."
557488.translation: 「如果你未曾存在，皇室当然就没法以滥用技术罪名来拘捕你。」

557489.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is tapped, it's a Human Citizen with base power and toughness 1/1 and can't be blocked.
557489.translation: 只要CARDNAME已横置，它便是基础力量与防御力为1/1的人类／市民，且不能被阻挡。

557493.oracleText:
"I folded a model in paper first to test the relative tensile strength of the plates."
—Katsumasa, the Animator
557493.translation:
「我是先用纸来折出模型，好测试钢板之间的相对拉伸强度。」
～灵机贺津间佐

557495.oracleText: It seeks those driven by curiosity and offers enlightenment.
557495.translation: 寻好奇之士，以启蒙相报。

557496.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, target player mills X cards, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
557496.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，目标牌手磨X张牌，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

557500.oracleText: Modified creatures you control can attack as though they didn't have defender.
557500.translation: 由你操控且有饰装的生物能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

557502.oracleText: Return up to one target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
557502.translation: 将至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。

557503.oracleText: Return an artifact card from your graveyard to your hand. If you can't, draw a card.
557503.translation: 将一张神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果你无法如此作，则抓一张牌。

557505.oracleText:
"While they squabble below, let us rise above."
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists
557505.translation:
「趁他们还在下面争执不休，我们借机飞升即位。」
～赛博派会长依民列

557506.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, your opponents can't cast spells with the same mana value as that spell until your next turn.
557506.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，直到你的下一个回合，所有对手都不能施放与该咒语具相同法术力值的咒语。

557508.oracleText:
"Are you seriously telling me your heavy combat mech . . . blew away?"
—Risona, leader of the Asari Uprisers
557508.translation:
「你说你的重型战斗机体被风吹飞了…认真的？」
～浅利起事军首领理想那

557509.oracleText: Gain control of target artifact or creature. Untap it.
557509.translation: 获得目标神器或生物的操控权。将它重置。

557511.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact, instant, or sorcery spell, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn.
557511.translation: 每当你施放神器，瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

557512.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact, instant, or sorcery spell, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
557512.translation: 每当你施放神器，瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。此异能每回合只会触发一次。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

557513.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts an artifact, instant, or sorcery spell, counter that spell. This ability triggers only once each turn.
557513.translation: 每当任一对手施放神器，瞬间或法术咒语时，反击该咒语。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

557515.oracleText: Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands.
557515.translation: 选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。

557516.oracleText: Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands.
557516.translation: 选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。

557517.oracleText: Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
557517.translation: 磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557518.oracleText: Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
557518.translation: 磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557519.oracleText:
When CARDNAME dies, choose one — 
• Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands. 
• Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
557519.translation:
当CARDNAME死去时，选择一项～ 
•选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。 
•磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557522.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of blue cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
557522.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的蓝色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

557523.oracleText: Up to X target creatures phase out.

557525.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying.
557525.translation: 每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为已搭载时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为目标本回合中搭载它之非传奇生物的复制品，但它是4/3，额外是载具神器，且具有飞行异能。

557531.oracleText:
"Let the Imperials search our laboratories. Will they think to look for secrets in a pretty bauble?"
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists
557531.translation:
「实验室就让皇室放手去查。反正他们也想不到要在漂亮饰品中去找秘密。」
～赛博派会长依民列

557536.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes crewed, up to one other target Vehicle you control becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
557536.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为已搭载时，至多另一个目标由你操控的载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

557539.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
557539.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

557540.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
557540.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

557542.oracleText: It drifted from the spirit realm into a neon world full of new possibilities . . . and decided to stay.
557542.translation: 它从灵界误入一个充满全新可能性的霓虹新世界…于是决定就此留下。

557547.oracleText: "Research is hardly the dry, serious pastime outsiders make it out to be."
557547.translation: 「研究从来就不是外人想象中那种枯燥严肃的消遣。」

557551.oracleText: {oT}, Tap an untapped artifact or creature you control: Add {oC}.
557551.translation: {oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器或生物：加{oC}。

557558.oracleText: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."
557558.translation: 「不出所料。他们自以为把终端机藏好之后，就不用费心去加密了。」

557562.oracleText: Jin-Gitaxias had long coveted the secrets of planeswalking. Spirits that could pass between worlds made for perfect test subjects.
557562.translation: 金吉塔厦早对穿行时空的秘密觊觎多时。能够穿行两界的灵体正是最佳实验对象。

557563.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
557563.translation: 放逐目标神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

557565.oracleText: Whenever one or more Ninja or Rogue creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
557565.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个忍者或浪客生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

557568.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is attached to a creature, you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
557568.translation: 只要CARDNAME贴附于生物上，你便可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

557569.oracleText: As long as The Reality Chip is attached to a creature, you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
557569.translation: 只要实界晶片贴附于生物上，你便可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

557572.oracleText: Kaito grabbed the chip, hoping it held answers.
557572.translation: 魁渡抢下晶片，希望能从其中找到答案。

557573.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal up to two artifact cards from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
557573.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中的至多两张神器牌，并将它们置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

557576.oracleText: "Step one is innovation. Step two is production. Sometimes step one is optional."
557576.translation: 「第一步是创新。第二步是制造。但有的时候也可以跳过第一步。」

557579.oracleText: One to clear the way, another to erase their trail.

557583.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets -3/-0 and loses flying.
557583.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得-3/-0且失去飞行异能。

557585.oracleText: Once they swam alone among the clouds, but now the people of Kamigawa have built high enough to reach them.
557585.translation: 它们曾经遨游云端，如今神河建物已高到让民众也能漫步天际。

557587.oracleText: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.
557587.translation: 魁渡和多美代的所有计划里面，都没想到他们会要对上全力出击的非瑞克西亚魔判官。

557589.oracleText: With a reckless leap into the pilot's seat, Hirori went from smallest kid on the block to biggest hero in the city.
557589.translation: 弘理纵身跳向机师驾驶座，转眼就从街区最弱少年摇身变为城中最大英雄。

557590.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature or Vehicle becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 4/5.
557590.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物或载具成为基础力量与防御力为4/5的神器生物。

557592.oracleText: Whenever one or more noncreature permanents are returned to hand, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
557592.translation: 每当一个或数个非生物永久物移回任一牌手的手上时，你抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

557593.oracleText: {oXoW}, Return a land you control to its owner's hand: Return target artifact or enchantment card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
557593.translation: {oXoW}，将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上：将目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

557595.translation: 结附于神器，生物或鹏洛客

557598.oracleText: Enchanted permanent loses all abilities and doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
557598.translation: 所结附的永久物失去所有异能，且于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

557600.oracleText: The first activated ability of an artifact you activate each turn costs {o2} less to activate.
557600.translation: 你每回合起动的首个神器起动式异能减少{o2}来起动。

557601.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.
557601.translation: 抓两张牌。然后除非你弃一张神器牌，否则弃两张牌。

557602.oracleText: Target artifact becomes an artifact creature. If it isn't a Vehicle, it has base power and toughness 4/4.
557602.translation: 目标神器成为神器生物。如果它不是载具，则它的基础力量与防御力为4/4。

557603.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control becomes tapped, draw a card.
557603.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器成为横置时，抓一张牌。

557604.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever an artifact you control becomes tapped, draw a card."
557604.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当一个由你操控的神器成为横置时，抓一张牌。」

557605.oracleText: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."
557605.translation: 「知识是整个多重宇宙的通货。它就是力量。它就是自由。它就是可能。」

557610.oracleText: A Reckoner always has another trick up their sleeve—or as their sleeve.
557610.translation: 帮派成员总有暗藏玄机～或隐于袖中，或纹于身上。

557611.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control an artifact and {o1} less to cast if you control an enchantment.
557611.translation: 如果你操控神器，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放；如果你操控结界，则此咒语也减少{o1}来施放。

557615.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may remove a menace counter from it. When you do, that player reveals their hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card.
557615.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去一个威慑指示物。当你如此作时，该牌手展示其手牌且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。

557619.oracleText: Equipped creature has base power and toughness 5/5, has menace, and is a black Demon in addition to its other colors and types.
557619.translation: 佩带此武具之生物的基础力量与防御力为5/5，具威慑异能，且额外具有黑色此颜色与恶魔此类别。

557623.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or equipped creature attacks, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
557623.translation: 每当CARDNAME或佩带此武具的生物攻击时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

557626.oracleText: A kami's anger never fades, never sleeps, never loosens its grasp.
557626.translation: 神明怒火永不消退，永不歇息，永不放手。

557627.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets -1/-1 and can't block.
557627.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得-1/-1且不能进行阻挡。

557628.oracleText: Enchanted permanent has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life."
557628.translation: 所结附的永久物具有「在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命。」

557630.oracleText: The masters weren't speaking figuratively when they said guilt could be all-consuming.
557630.translation: 罪行要穷尽一生补偿；师父对弟子的谨慎告诫远超言喻。

557631.oracleText: Target opponent exiles an enchantment they control.
557631.translation: 目标对手放逐一个由其操控的结界。

557632.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target opponent exiles a creature they control. 
• Target opponent exiles an enchantment they control.

557636.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲一个神器或生物：抓一张牌。

557639.oracleText: Don't fear the blade, fear the shadows.
557639.translation: 刀不可怕，可怕的是阴影。

557641.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may discard a creature card. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
557641.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以弃一张生物牌。当你如此作时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

557645.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes attached to a creature, tap that creature.
557645.translation: 每当CARDNAME新贴附在生物上时，横置该生物。

557648.oracleText: It seeks those with hate in their hearts and offers vengeance.
557648.translation: 寻怨恨之士，以复仇相报。

557649.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, destroy target creature with toughness X or less, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
557649.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，消灭目标防御力等于或小于X的生物，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

557651.oracleText: It appears only to those whose lives are ending, welcoming them to their fate.
557651.translation: 这精魂仅有将死之士得见，每次出没只为奉迎逝者安息。

557657.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you exile a nonland card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the exiled card's mana value to any target.
557657.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。当你以此法放逐一张非地牌时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所放逐之牌的法术力值。

557660.oracleText: "They can't follow your footprints if you never touch the ground."
557660.translation: 「只要脚不着地，你就没有脚印会让人追踪。」

557661.oracleText: {o3oB}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

557664.oracleText: Although officials said it was a sewer failure, the people whispered that it was a warning of night's reach.
557664.translation: 虽然正式公告只说这是下水道不畅，但人们纷纷传言这是夜幕明神的警告。

557674.oracleText: Kaito knew every rooftop in the city, and closed in quickly on his quarry—but he knew nothing of the Planar Bridge until it was already too late.
557674.translation: 虽然魁渡熟知城里每一片屋瓦，得以凭地利快速逼近猎物～但他对时空渡桥却一无所知，待他弄清头绪时早已过晚。

557675.oracleText: Target player discards two cards. Ninjas and Rogues you control gain menace until end of turn.
557675.translation: 目标牌手弃两张牌。由你操控的忍者与浪客获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

557677.oracleText: Return up to one target Ninja or Rogue creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
557677.translation: 将至多一张目标忍者或浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557678.oracleText: Return up to one target Ninja or Rogue creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
557678.translation: 将至多一张目标忍者或浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557679.oracleText: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
557679.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

557680.oracleText: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
557680.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

557684.oracleText: It feeds on things better left unknown, savoring the bitterness of lies and regrets.
557684.translation: 它以不应为人所知之事为食，细细品味谎言与悔恨当中的苦涩。

557690.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. It gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each modified creature you controlled as you cast this spell.
557690.translation: 选择目标生物。该生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。你于施放此咒语时每操控一个有饰装的生物，则所选生物便再得一次-1/-1直到回合结束。

557693.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. 
• Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

557693.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。 
•目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。 
•你获得2点生命。

557695.oracleText:
"Some called him the hero of the Kami War, others a selfish thief. As ever, the truth is hidden somewhere in between."
—Reki, founder of the Living Historians
557695.translation:
「有人尊他为逆神之战的英雄，有人则唾其为自私窃贼。如世间诸事一般，真相往往藏于两者之间。」
～现世史家始祖历

557696.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Add {oB}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell.
557696.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：加{oB}。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语。

557701.oracleText: The dark myojin's gifts were instrumental in ending the Kami War.
557701.translation: 这黑暗明神的赠礼，乃是逆神之战终结的关键。

557702.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in defending player's graveyard.
557702.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为防御牌手坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

557705.oracleText:
"That? A minor test, nothing more. Incompleat flesh is weak."
—Jin-Gitaxias
557705.translation:
「那个啊？只是个小小测试罢了。未经完化的肉身果然很弱。」
～金吉塔厦

557707.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of black cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
557707.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的黑色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

557708.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life.
557708.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。

557709.oracleText: March of Wretched Sorrow deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life.
557709.translation: 伤悲行进对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。

557711.oracleText: The Mukotai Reckoners specialize in stealth and subterfuge.
557711.translation: 无孤帮众精于匿踪隐遁。

557713.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another artifact or creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and it gains menace until end of turn.
557713.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

557716.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of each player's library. Until end of turn, you may play one of those cards. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
557716.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用其中一张。如果你以此法施放咒语，则支付等同于其法术力值的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

557719.oracleText: "It's not one or the other, kami or technology. Both offer power. I will not limit myself."
557719.translation: 「神明与科技并非互斥之物，两者均能予人力量。而我不愿只选其一。」

557720.oracleText: CARDNAME has deathtouch as long as you control an artifact.
557720.translation: 只要你操控神器，CARDNAME便具有死触异能。

557722.oracleText: CARDNAME has menace as long as you control an enchantment.
557722.translation: 只要你操控结界，CARDNAME便具有威慑异能。

557728.oracleText: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
557728.translation: 每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

557729.oracleText: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
557729.translation: 每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

557731.oracleText: United by defiant pride in their outsider status, the nezumi of the Okiba Reckoners boast the most advanced cyberbikes and the best riders of all the Reckoner gangs.
557731.translation: 炽场帮鼠人因同以局外人为豪而结聚成团，如今他们拥有各黑道帮派中最高段的赛博机车和机车骑士。

557732.translation: 由你操控的载具具有威慑异能。

557734.oracleText: "Some fool would rather throw a whole mech away than repair one hydraulic actuator? It must be my lucky day."
557734.translation: 「居然有人连一个小小的液压致动器都不修，就把机体整个丢弃？我今天一定是走大运了。」

557735.oracleText: Return target creature or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Then put two +1/+1 counters on that permanent if you control an artifact and an enchantment.
557735.translation: 将目标生物或载具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。然后如果你同时操控神器和结界，则在该永久物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

557737.oracleText:
"That's a start. What else do you have for us?"
—Takumi, Reckoner enforcer
557737.translation:
「这只是开始。你还有什么没告诉我们的？」
～帮派打手拓巳

557738.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player discards that card. If you don't, put two +1/+1 counters on a creature or Vehicle you control.
557738.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。如果你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌。如果你未如此作，则在一个由你操控的生物或载具上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

557740.oracleText: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair—the sacred, neutral meeting ground of all Reckoner gangs.
557740.translation: 在育龙巢这块所有黑道帮派都不许妄动的面会中立圣地上，每年都举办一场限要人参加的特殊拍卖。

557741.oracleText: You gain life equal to the sacrificed permanent's mana value. Draw two cards.
557741.translation: 你获得若干生命，其数量等同于所牺牲之永久物的法术力值。抓两张牌。

557743.oracleText:
"You're hurt? Too bad. You stop fighting when I say, and not a moment sooner."
—Satoru Umezawa
557743.translation:
「你受伤了？可惜啊。你只有在我说停的时候才能停，早一刻都不行。」
～梅泽悟

557744.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains lifelink and "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control."
557744.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得系命与「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。」

557746.oracleText: Return target creature or planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
557746.translation: 将目标生物或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557749.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
557749.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

557750.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, if you don't control a creature named Keimi, create Keimi, a legendary 3/3 black and green Frog creature token with "Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
557750.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，若你未操控名称为哇魅的生物，则派出传奇衍生生物哇魅，其为3/3，黑绿双色的蛙，且具有「每当你施放结界咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。」

557751.oracleText: {o1o(G/U)}: CARDNAME and target Frog you control can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with flying or reach.
557751.translation: {o1o(G/U)}：CARDNAME与目标由你操控的蛙本回合只能被具飞行或延势异能的生物阻挡。

557754.oracleText: Each opponent creates a 1/1 black Rat Rogue creature token.
557754.translation: 每位对手各派出一个1/1黑色老鼠／浪客衍生生物。

557755.oracleText: Each opponent creates a 1/1 black Rat Rogue creature token.
557755.translation: 每位对手各派出一个1/1黑色老鼠／浪客衍生生物。

557759.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

557762.oracleText: Evil kami are drawn to mortals who share their grim fascinations.
557762.translation: 寡情冷酷的凡人会招惹上冷酷寡情的邪恶神明。

557763.oracleText: Enchant artifact or creature you control
557763.translation: 结附于由你操控的神器或生物

557766.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +1/+1.
557766.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+1/+1。

557768.oracleText: "That will pay for another arm extension all by itself! Well, as long as it doesn't explode."
557768.translation: 「光这东西就能值回一套延展义肢！只要它不爆炸。」

557769.oracleText: {oT}: Create a Treasure token. Activate only if a creature died this turn.
557769.translation: {oT}：派出一个珍宝衍生物。只能于有生物死去的回合中起动。

557771.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the number of modified creatures you control.
557771.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为由你操控且有饰装的生物数量。

557774.oracleText:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent
557774.translation:
「他们得耗上好几天时间来检查代码，才能发现根源在哪！」
～赛博派特务映太

557777.oracleText: So swift and sharp was his blade that the ogre never even felt the cut.
557777.translation: 他手起刀落，剑锋行云流水，食人魔甚至从未察觉身躯已分为二。

557780.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken modified creature you control dies, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
557780.translation: 每当一个由你操控、有饰装且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

557783.oracleText:
"Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade."
—Keni-Keni, akki smith
557783.translation:
「把熔炉怒火带到钢刃上，别让它灭了。」
～恶鬼铁匠柯尼柯尼

557784.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
557784.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

557786.oracleText: Akki paint bright, bold designs on their salvaged Imperial mechs, leaving no doubt as to who they belong to now.
557786.translation: 恶鬼会在拾荒捡回的皇室机体上涂绘鲜艳大胆的图案，让其如今归属一目了然。

557787.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +2/+1.
557787.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+2/+1。

557789.oracleText: In the clangor and chaos of the akki attack, few even noticed the frogs on their heads.
557789.translation: 恶鬼攻势阵仗混乱喧闹异常，在这情况下几乎没人注意到他们头上顶着的是青蛙。

557790.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. If you control a modified creature, draw a card.
557790.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。如果你操控有饰装的生物，则抓一张牌。

557792.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
557792.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

When CARDNAME dies, choose one —
