567011.translation: 她犹如高地园屋顶静肃的饰像，悲悯地俯视着城市。

567014.oracleText: "My sources say the Beamtown Bullies were spotted in the Mezzio. Keep your eyes sharp and stay close to me."
567014.translation: 「我的线人说梅齐奥区有钢梁镇蛮汉团出没。睁大眼，跟紧我。」

567017.oracleText: Don't try to cut in. They'll cut back.
567017.translation: 别妄想插队。他们会插回来的。

567018.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, CARDNAME and up to one other target creature you control both gain your choice of first strike or lifelink until end of turn.
567018.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，CARDNAME和至多另一个目标由你操控的生物均依你的选择获得先攻或系命异能直到回合结束。

567021.oracleText:
"Saving a stranger's life is an excellent recruitment method. Luckily, peril is so easy to come by."
—Falco Spara
567021.translation:
「拯救陌生人的性命非常利于招募成员。幸运的是，危险无处不在。」
～冯柯斯帕拉

567022.oracleText: Put a shield counter on target creature.
567022.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

567025.oracleText: Regarding the relative might of pen and sword, the official position of the Brokers is "Why choose?"
567025.translation: 关于笔与剑何者较强，扶济社的正式立场是「何不全拿？」

567026.oracleText: {o4o(G/U)}: CARDNAME has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
567026.translation: {o4o(G/U)}：CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

567029.oracleText: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.
567029.translation: 大嘴米奇的名号在他和葛古理奥达成交易后依旧保留了下来，虽然他此后再也没说过半句话。

567030.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a Treasure token.
567030.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567032.oracleText: After a brief but memorable incident at her first performance, she was never heckled again.
567032.translation: 她的首演有段令人难忘的小风波，此后她再也没听过嘘声。

567039.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Citizen's Crowbar: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
567039.translation: {oW}，{oT}，牺牲市民撬棒：消灭目标神器或结界。

567040.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "{oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Citizen's Crowbar: Destroy target artifact or enchantment."
567040.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「{oW}，{oT}，牺牲市民撬棒：消灭目标神器或结界。」

567042.oracleText: Descended from Old Capenna's paladins, the Brokers are masters of defensive combat.
567042.translation: 扶济社渊流自旧卡佩纳的神圣武士，精通防御战术。

567047.oracleText: No screams rang out. No blood stained the streets. In an instant, the bustling metropolis simply fell silent.
567047.translation: 街上没有呼喊，也没留血迹。熙熙攘攘的大都市倏地安静下来。

567048.oracleText: Each player who controls a multicolored creature draws a card. Then destroy all creatures.
567048.translation: 每位操控多色生物的牌手各抓一张牌。然后消灭所有生物。

567050.oracleText: Choose up to one target creature. Put a +1/+1 counter and a counter from among flying, first strike, lifelink, or vigilance on it.
567050.translation: 选择至多一个目标生物。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物和一个飞行，先攻，系命或警戒指示物。

567051.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may put a permanent card with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield with a shield counter on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
567051.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌放进战场，且上面有一个后盾指示物。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

567052.oracleText: Create five 3/3 white Angel creature tokens with flying.
567052.translation: 派出五个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

567057.oracleText: A plus-one is simply not enough.
567057.translation: 只有一人说「我也来」远远不够。

567061.oracleText: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.
567061.translation: 乐舞会全部的金圆竟来自一名少女。

567063.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW}. Spend this mana only to cast an Angel spell.
567063.translation: {oT}：加{oW}。此法术力只能用来施放天使咒语。

567065.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Untap a tapped creature you control: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567065.translation: {oW}，{oT}，重置一个由你操控且已横置的生物：派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567066.oracleText: {oWoW}, {oT}, Untap two tapped creatures you control: Draw a card.
567066.translation: {oWoW}，{oT}，重置两个由你操控且已横置的生物：抓一张牌。

567067.oracleText: {oWoWoWoWoW}, {oT}, Untap fifteen tapped creatures you control: You win the game.
567067.translation: {oWoWoWoWoW}，{oT}，重置十五个由你操控且已横置的生物：你赢得这盘游戏。

567069.oracleText:
"Let's find out how much your friends think you're worth."
—Gino, hired kidnapper
567069.translation:
「且来瞧瞧你的朋友们觉得你值多少钱。」
～受雇绑匪基诺

567070.oracleText: {o7}: Hold for Ransom's controller sacrifices it and draws a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
567070.translation: {o7}：囚禁索赎的操控者将它牺牲并抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

567071.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't attack or block and has "{o7}: Hold for Ransom's controller sacrifices it and draws a card. Activate only as a sorcery."
567071.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡，且具有「{o7}：囚禁索赎的操控者将它牺牲并抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。」

567073.oracleText: The Obscura reserve their keenest blades for traitors in their midst.
567073.translation: 秘闻帮最快的刀专门伺候自家叛徒。

567074.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell you control, it connives.
567074.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为由你操控之咒语的目标时，令它筹谋。

567077.oracleText:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard
567077.translation:
「这座城市确实需要更多神力相助。」
～巡检员吉勒德

567079.oracleText:
"In the assassination trade, no one lives to make more than one mistake."
—Anhelo, the Painter
567079.translation:
「在刺客这行，一个失误就能赔掉性命。」
～华艺家安海洛

567081.oracleText: "Subsequent efforts to deconstruct this facility will be punished with increasing severity."
567081.translation: 「倘有进一步毁坏本设施之情事，将实施更严厉的处分。」

567082.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a red creature.
567082.translation: 如果此咒语以红色生物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

567083.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature and you gain 2 life.
567083.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

567084.oracleText: Knockout Blow deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature and you gain 2 life.
567084.translation: 致昏重击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

567087.oracleText: Crime sometimes makes unlikely allies into lifelong friends.
567087.translation: 脱法之举有时能将机缘凑合的同伙化为终生相随的朋友。

567095.oracleText: "Don't tell me who sent you or who you work for. The less I know, the better."
567095.translation: 「别告诉我是谁派你来或替谁做事。我知道得越少越好。」

567096.oracleText: Return up to three target creature cards with total mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
567096.translation: 将至多三张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于3。

567099.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more creatures, create that many 1/1 green and white Citizen creature tokens. Then if you control ten or more creatures, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567099.translation: 每当你以一个或数个生物攻击时，派出等量的1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。然后如果你操控十个或更多生物，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567104.oracleText: "I've analyzed the vault schematic. Do you want the fast way, the easy way, or the secret way in?"
567104.translation: 「我已将宝库图纸分析完毕。你想怎么进去？要快，要方便，还是要隐密？」

567108.oracleText: Her opponent threw her through the window, so she retaliated by throwing the window through her opponent.
567108.translation: 对手将她扔穿窗户，所以她的回报是将窗户扔穿对手。

567109.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+7 until end of turn. Untap it.
567109.translation: 目标生物得+2/+7直到回合结束。将它重置。

567111.oracleText: As Ob Nixilis closed in, Halo swept through Giada like an electrical current, and inside her, something long dormant unfurled its wings.
567111.translation: 欧尼希兹逐步逼近，金圆突如电流通导吉娅妲全身，体内一股沉睡已久的力量终得展翼。

567112.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it has a counter on it, it also gains flying and lifelink until end of turn.
567112.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果其上有指示物，则它再获得飞行与系命异能直到回合结束。

567114.oracleText: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."
567114.translation: 「它们的主人毫无戒心地自言自语，里头透露的事情可真有意思。」

567123.oracleText: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"
567123.translation: 「号外！尚夺尔勋爵遇害！嫌犯在逃！」

567124.oracleText: {o3oW}: You and target opponent each draw a card.

567126.oracleText: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."
567126.translation: 「朋友啊，不管你在烦什么，今晚这杯就消愁！明天更有气力！」

567134.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-0 until your next turn, where X is the number of different mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567134.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-0直到你的下一个回合，X为你坟墓场中牌的不同法术力值种数。

567136.oracleText: "I could show you what's in the case, but it'd be the last thing you ever see."
567136.translation: 「我是可以给你看箱子里装着什么，但这会是你这辈子最后看的东西。」

567137.oracleText: As long as there are two or more counters among creatures you control, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender.
567137.translation: 只要由你操控的生物上总共有两个或更多指示物，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

567140.oracleText: One last job before he retires.

567141.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put a shield counter on target creature you control.
567141.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

567144.oracleText: Steel doors and iron bars are child's play for an Obscura operative.
567144.translation: 钢门铁栏对秘闻帮特务只是小菜一碟。

567145.oracleText: Draw two cards, then look at the top card of each player's library.
567145.translation: 抓两张牌，然后检视每位牌手的牌库顶牌。

567148.oracleText: Target player mills half their library, rounded down.
567148.translation: 目标牌手磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

567149.oracleText:
"I've known for a year that you would cast this exact spell, at this exact spot, at this exact time."
—Raffine
567149.translation:
「时间、地点、咒语：你的所有作为与我一年前所料分毫不差。」
～拉斐茵

567152.oracleText: The rendezvous took place hours ago, but the Obscura agent read the residue with ease.
567152.translation: 密会落幕多时，但秘闻帮密探不费吹灰之力便判读出迹证。

567155.oracleText: Few know her face, but everyone knows her work.
567155.translation: 她的样貌鲜为人知，但作品无人不识。

567156.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Copy target spell you control that wasn't cast. You may choose new targets for the copy.
567156.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控且未经施放的咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

567158.oracleText: Those who try to rob the Obscura often leave behind more than they take away.
567158.translation: 妄图抢劫秘闻帮的人，最后留下的东西比带走的多。

567159.oracleText: This spell costs {oUoUoU} less to cast if an opponent has drawn four or more cards this turn.
567159.translation: 如果任一对手本回合中抓过四张或更多牌，则此咒语减少{oUoUoU}来施放。

567161.oracleText:
"Altonio? No, I'm sorry. No one by that name works here."
—Raffine
567161.translation:
「阿托尼奥？抱歉，我们这里没有这号人物。」
～拉斐茵

567164.oracleText: "Greedy vault guard, wouldn't share. Now there's Halo in your hair!"
567164.translation: 「宝库守卫贪婪无度不肯分享。就让我来抹点金圆到你头上！」

567166.oracleText: "All is calm. All is well. You know me to be a trusted member of your family, and I would like to discuss the contents of our safe."
567166.translation: 「你感到平静。你感到安全。你知道我是值得信赖的家族成员，我想谈谈我们保险箱里的东西。」

567171.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, CARDNAME connives.
567171.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中他的第二个咒语时，令CARDNAME筹谋。

567176.oracleText: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.
567176.translation: 新卡佩纳的雕像掩藏着旧卡佩纳的秘密。

567177.oracleText: Until end of turn, target artifact or creature becomes a 4/4 Angel artifact creature and gains flying.
567177.translation: 直到回合结束，目标神器或生物成为4/4天使神器生物且获得飞行异能。

567180.oracleText: Obscura initiates are required to bring a gift of information. They are judged on both how useful it is and how hard it was to obtain.
567180.translation: 秘闻帮的新手需要带一份情报当入门礼。情报价值与获取难度都会影响自己的评定。

567181.oracleText: {o1o(W/B)}: CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
567181.translation: {o1o(W/B)}：CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

567184.oracleText: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.
567184.translation: 艾紫培想要答案。尚夺尔需要间谍。其命运注定交会。

567185.oracleText: Counter target noncreature spell. Its controller creates two Treasure tokens.
567185.translation: 反击目标非生物咒语。其操控者派出两个珍宝衍生物。

567188.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a green permanent.
567188.translation: 如果此咒语以绿色永久物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

567190.oracleText: She knows your next move before you do.
567190.translation: 在你行动前，她就知道你的下一步。

567196.oracleText: Every Halo smuggler walks a razor's edge between untold riches and sudden disaster.
567196.translation: 每名金圆走私犯都游走在无尽财富和意外遭难的边缘。

567197.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, draw a card.
567197.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

567203.oracleText: Better to depart in haste than be dearly departed.
567203.translation: 宁愿仓皇逃命，也不要一命呜呼。

567205.oracleText: As long as enchanted creature is attacking alone, it can't be blocked.
567205.translation: 只要所结附的生物单独进行攻击，它便不能被阻挡。

567206.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, it connives.
567206.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，令它筹谋。

567207.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, it connives."
567207.translation: 所结附的生物具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，令它筹谋。」

567209.oracleText:
"Quick, let's hide in the sewer!"
—Ginsi the Thief, now deceased
567209.translation:
「快，我们躲到下水道去！」
～盗贼金曦，喊于生前

567210.oracleText: {o3oU}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn. This ability costs {o3} less to activate if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567210.translation: {o3oU}：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。如果你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则此异能减少{o3}来起动。

567217.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It phases out.
567217.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。令它跃离。

567223.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, up to one other target creature gains flying until end of turn.
567223.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，至多另一个目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

567226.oracleText: Whenever you draw your first card during each of your draw steps, draw a card. Then if you have nine or more cards in hand, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567226.translation: 每当你抓你每个抓牌步骤中你的第一张牌时，抓一张牌。然后如果你有九张或更多手牌，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567228.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green and white Citizen creature with base power and toughness 1/1 named Legitimate Businessperson.
567228.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为1/1，名称为合法商人的绿白双色市民生物。

567231.oracleText: "If you wish for blessings, mortal, ask your demon masters. We've given enough to your kind."
567231.translation: 「凡人，要祈福就去找你的恶魔老板吧。吾辈已向你们施舍得够多了。」

567232.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to you, prevent that damage and mill twice that many cards.
567232.translation: 如果你将受到伤害，则防止该伤害并磨两倍于该数量的牌。

567234.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, CARDNAME connives.
567234.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，令CARDNAME筹谋。

567236.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target non-Rogue creature card with equal or lesser power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
567236.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一张目标力量等于或小于它的非浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

567239.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may mill three cards. Then if there are twenty or more cards in your graveyard, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567239.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以磨三张牌。然后如果你坟墓场中有二十张或更多牌，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567241.oracleText:
"I wouldn't call what they have here a justice system. More like an auction."
—Elspeth
567241.translation:
「依我看，这一套与其说是司法流程，倒更像是拍卖流程。」
～艾紫培

567244.oracleText: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."
567244.translation: 「不要大惊小怪。我只是背着一卷地毯而已。没错，地毯也穿鞋。别问了。」

567246.oracleText: Everybody is worth their weight in gold.
567246.translation: 每个人都值与其等重的黄金。

567249.oracleText: The fights may sometimes be rigged, but the front-row spectators know the wounds are real.
567249.translation: 虽然有些格斗赛会作假，但前排观众都知道伤口是实打实的。

567250.oracleText: Pay 1 life: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
567250.translation: 支付1点生命：CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

567253.oracleText:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus
567253.translation:
「把劲爆的背叛谣言抖给传谣者。挑起这两方的恩怨，会是我们的好生意。」
～秘闻帮天眼卡蜜兹

567254.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. Target player mills three cards.
567254.translation: 目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。目标牌手磨三张牌。

567256.oracleText: Ob Nixilis extends his hand not in partnership, but to affirm your subservience.
567256.translation: 欧尼希兹伸手不是跟你合作，而是要你效忠。

567258.oracleText: Mill two cards, then you may return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
567258.translation: 磨两张牌，然后你可以将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

567260.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature, discard a card, or pay 4 life.
567260.translation: 牺牲一个生物，弃一张牌或支付4点生命，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

567264.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a creature, enchantment, or planeswalker card from it. That player discards that card.
567264.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张生物，结界或鹏洛客牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

567267.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token.
567267.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，且你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567268.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token."
567268.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，且你派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

567270.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Rogue creature token.
567270.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色浪客衍生生物。

567274.oracleText: "Up and at 'em, buddy. We've got more work to do."
567274.translation: 「醒醒啦，兄弟。还有好多活等着我们呢。」

567275.oracleText: This spell has flash as long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567275.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，此咒语便具有闪现异能。

567277.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. If it was dealt noncombat damage this turn, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to it and you gain 3 life. Otherwise, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to it and you gain 1 life.
567277.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。如果它本回合中受过非战斗伤害，则CARDNAME对它造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。若否，则CARDNAME对它造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

567278.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. If it was dealt noncombat damage this turn, Grisly Sigil deals 3 damage to it and you gain 3 life. Otherwise, Grisly Sigil deals 1 damage to it and you gain 1 life.
567278.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。如果它本回合中受过非战斗伤害，则恐怖印记对它造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。若否，则恐怖印记对它造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

567280.oracleText: Whatever the Maestros had ordered, it wasn't anyone's business, including his.
567280.translation: 绝艺盟下订的东西，对谁来说都不是上门的好生意，包括他。

567282.oracleText:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator
567282.translation:
「换作是我，我会检查一下那个妖精的大衣。就在你来之前，我看到他把什么东西塞进了自己的口袋。」
～惹事包工寇兰多

567285.translation: 「大块头，我们现在是一家人了。」

567286.oracleText: Create a 4/3 black Ogre Warrior creature token.
567286.translation: 派出一个4/3黑色食人魔／战士衍生生物。

567288.oracleText:
"How far are you willing to go for your family, cleanblade?"
—Lord Xander
567288.translation:
「新来的，你会为家族付出多少？」
～尚夺尔勋爵

567292.oracleText: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.
567292.translation: 高地园的宽敞马路和优雅高楼是富人的游乐场。入夜后，这里也是片不错的狩猎场。

567293.oracleText: Ob Nixilis decided the fastest way to seize control of New Capenna would be to usurp the networks of power already hidden there. Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.
567293.translation: 欧尼希兹认定，掌控新卡佩纳最迅速的方法，便是篡夺此城既有地下势力网。尚夺尔的绝艺盟最先遭殃。

567299.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
567299.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

567304.oracleText: Between the five of them, they'd committed every crime on the books and invented a few new ones.
567304.translation: 他们五位犯过世上所有的罪行，甚至新发明了几条。

567305.oracleText: For each color, return up to one target creature card of that color from your graveyard to your hand.
567305.translation: 对每种颜色而言，将至多一张目标该颜色的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

567308.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.
567308.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

567310.oracleText:
"Build your towers as tall as you want. The shadow always reaches higher."
—Message scrawled on an alley wall
567310.translation:
「任你万丈高楼拔地起，阴影更有一山高。」
～暗巷墙上留字

567311.oracleText: If your life total is less than your starting life total, this spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the difference.
567311.translation: 如果你的总生命小于你的起始总生命，则此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为两者之间的差值。

567313.oracleText: "Look, we both get what we want. I get your Halo. You get to keep your kneecaps."
567313.translation: 「你瞧，这样我们两边都高兴。我拿到你的金圆。你留住自己的膝盖。」

567314.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player may have you draw a card. If they do, untap CARDNAME and remove it from combat.
567314.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手可以令你抓一张牌。若他如此作，则重置CARDNAME并将其移出战斗。

567316.oracleText: "Only a chump stops after one unlucky loss. You're not a chump, are you?"
567316.translation: 「不小心输一把就收手的人最傻。你不傻吧？」

567322.oracleText: No one remains on her list for long.
567322.translation: 名字在她的清单上待不久。

567323.oracleText: Whenever you gain life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
567323.translation: 每当你于你的回合中获得生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567325.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
567325.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567329.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a white creature.
567329.translation: 如果此咒语以白色生物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

567331.oracleText:
"The little guy had guts at least. You can see 'em right there between those cobbles."
—Glunk, freelance crusher
567331.translation:
「那矮子胆子还挺大。你可以去瞧瞧，就散在那些鹅卵石之间。」
～猛击包工葛朗克

567332.oracleText: Target creature gets +4/+3 until end of turn.
567332.translation: 目标生物得+4/+3直到回合结束。

567334.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. Then copy each card exiled with CARDNAME. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
567334.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。然后复制每张以CARDNAME放逐的牌。你可以施放任意数量的复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567337.oracleText: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a vivid imagination."
567337.translation: 「有钱到难以想象？我向你保证，我有丰富的想象力。」

567339.oracleText: For the next week, Park Heights smelled of burnt oil paint and brimstone.
567339.translation: 接下来的一周，高地园弥漫着烧焦的油漆和硫磺味。

567340.oracleText: Players can't gain life this turn. Damage can't be prevented this turn. CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
567340.translation: 本回合中，牌手不能获得生命。本回合中，伤害不能被防止。CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

567341.oracleText: Players can't gain life this turn. Damage can't be prevented this turn. Call In a Professional deals 3 damage to any target. (Shield counters don't prevent this damage as they're removed.)
567341.translation: 本回合中，牌手不能获得生命。本回合中，伤害不能被防止。找来行家对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。（此时仍要移去后盾指示物，但如此也无法防止伤害。）

567343.oracleText: As the Adversary's forces descended upon the gala, Elspeth whispered to Giada, "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."
567343.translation: 见到魔头的部队突临晚会，艾紫培对吉娅妲悄悄说道，「我能带你逃出去，但马上得走。」

567346.oracleText: Nobody thought twice about checking their weapons at the door, until they were informed there was no weapon check at the door.
567346.translation: 所有人想都没想就在门口寄存了自己的武器；后来他们才知道进门不用寄存武器。

567350.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567350.translation: 派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567351.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567351.translation: 派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567355.oracleText: The only thing Ziatora desires is "more."
567355.translation: 齐朵拉想要的只有「更多」。

567356.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Put a stash counter on CARDNAME.
567356.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。在CARDNAME上放置一个匿物指示物。

567358.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of stash counters on CARDNAME.
567358.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为CARDNAME上的匿物指示物数量。

567362.oracleText: The staccato clatter of its metal claws on pavement is unmistakable.
567362.translation: 它铁爪摩擦地面刮出的刺耳声响，绝对没人会听错。

567365.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token for each artifact they control.
567365.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，他每操控一个神器，你便派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567368.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Create a Treasure token.
567368.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567370.translation:
「精细徒有虚名。」
～蛮石欧菲奥先生

567375.oracleText: Light 'Em Up deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567375.translation: 全烧光对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

567377.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
567377.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

567383.oracleText: Sacrifice a Treasure: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
567383.translation: 牺牲一个珍宝：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

567389.oracleText: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.
567389.translation: 从损坏的家具到不该出现的尸体，一切都会成为齐朵拉不熄锻炉之燃料。

567390.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of permanents you've sacrificed this turn.
567390.translation: {o1}，{oT}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为你本回合中已牺牲的永久物数量。

567393.oracleText:
"It's too quiet tonight. Go make trouble."
—Ziatora
567393.translation:
「今晚太安静了。去惹点麻烦。」
～齐朵拉

567394.oracleText: Ready to Rumble deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567394.translation: 准备出击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

567395.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target artifact.
567395.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

567396.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Ready to Rumble deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target artifact.
567396.translation:
选择一项～ 
•准备出击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

567399.oracleText: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.
567399.translation: 年轻的凡尔西诺蜂拥加入勤工联追随齐朵拉，渴望释放自己的龙性。

567400.oracleText: {o1o(B/G)}: CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn.
567400.translation: {o1o(B/G)}：CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。

567405.oracleText: "Well, I guess stealth's out of the question."

567406.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
567406.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

567410.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
567410.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567411.oracleText: Enchanted creature has menace and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token."
567411.translation: 所结附的生物具有威慑与「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

567413.oracleText: They'd warned him greed would be the death of him. He never thought to take it literally.
567413.translation: 被警告过贪心会要命，但他从没认真听进去。

567414.oracleText: Strangle deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567414.translation: 勒颈对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

567416.oracleText: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.
567416.translation: 万通汇遭袭后，各势力间本就脆弱的平衡被彻底打破，城市陷入混乱。

567417.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts, then CARDNAME deals damage to each creature equal to the number of artifacts that were put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn.
567417.translation: 消灭所有神器，然后CARDNAME对每个生物各造成伤害，其数量等同于本回合中从战场进入坟墓场的神器数量。

567418.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts, then Structural Assault deals damage to each creature equal to the number of artifacts that were put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn.
567418.translation: 消灭所有神器，然后摧朽突袭对每个生物各造成伤害，其数量等同于本回合中从战场进入坟墓场的神器数量。

567421.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a blue permanent.
567421.translation: 如果此咒语以蓝色永久物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

567422.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567422.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。

567423.oracleText: Torch Breath deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567423.translation: 焰炬吐息对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。

567425.oracleText: The guard took a midnight shift to earn a promotion. Unfortunately, so did the assassin.
567425.translation: 警卫为了升职来上夜班。不幸的是，杀手也一样。

567426.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, exile the top two cards of your library. Until your next end step, you may play one of those cards.
567426.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用其中的一张。

567429.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
567429.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

567430.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, the next time they would draw a card this turn, instead they exile the top card of their library. They may play it this turn.
567430.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，于本回合中，他下一次将抓一张牌时，改为他放逐其牌库顶牌。本回合中，他可以使用该牌。

567432.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, create a Treasure token. Then you may pay {oWoUoBoRoG}. If you do, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567432.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后你可以支付{oWoUoBoRoG}。若你如此作，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567435.oracleText: If you're lucky, you'll walk out with just your ego singed.
567435.translation: 运气好的话，离场时只有自尊受损。

567439.oracleText: They built the neighborhood. They know its weak points. They know all the hiding places. When they come for you, they'll find you and bring the roof down on your head.
567439.translation: 这街区是他们造的。他们清楚哪里脆弱，哪里能躲要是惹上他们，就等着给破门而入，断瓦临头。

567441.translation: 「来向我的小宝贝打个招呼吧。」

567445.oracleText: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.
567445.translation: 柯达亚街道底下通路繁杂如迷宫，为事业心强旺的走私犯提供无数秘径。

567447.oracleText: Lands you control have "{oT}: Create a Treasure token."
567447.translation: 由你操控的地具有「{oT}：派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

567449.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a black permanent.
567449.translation: 如果此咒语以黑色永久物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

567450.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
567450.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

567451.oracleText: Bouncer's Beatdown deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
567451.translation: 保镖强击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

567452.oracleText: New Capenna's demonic masters are quick to extinguish any hint of the angels' power reawakening.
567452.translation: 新卡佩纳的恶魔老板将任何天使势力复苏的希望迅速浇灭。

567455.oracleText:
"Now there's a fellow who knows how to have a good time!"
—Jetmir
567455.translation:
「终于有人知道该如何享受好时光了！」
～杰米尔

567456.oracleText: {o2o(R/W)}: CARDNAME gains double strike until end of turn.
567456.translation: {o2o(R/W)}：CARDNAME获得连击异能直到回合结束。

567463.oracleText: Sacrifice a Treasure: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
567463.translation: 牺牲一个珍宝：CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

567466.oracleText: "I've told you knuckleheads a hundred times: You can kill 'em here, but bury the bodies somewhere else. If you disturb my prized azaleas again, you'd better dig a second hole for yourself!"
567466.translation: 「我都跟你们这些没脑子的说过几百遍了：在这里杀人不干我事，在这里埋尸体绝对不成。下次要动到我娇贵的杜鹃花，最好替自己多挖个坑！」

567467.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap target creature or land.
567467.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置目标生物或地。

567479.oracleText: "Terribly sorry, but this is a private party, and your name isn't on the list."
567479.translation: 「非常抱歉，这是场私人派对，你不在受邀名单上。」

567483.oracleText: In with the old, out with the new.

567484.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Count the colors of the sacrificed creature, then search your library for a creature card that's exactly that many colors plus one. Exile that card, then shuffle. You may cast the exiled card. Activate only as a sorcery.
567484.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：计算所牺牲生物的颜色种数，然后从你牌库中搜寻一张颜色种数正好为该数量加一的生物牌。放逐该牌，然后洗牌。你可以施放所放逐的牌。只能于法术时机起动。

567486.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then if you control a creature with power 7 or greater, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567486.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后如果你操控力量等于或大于7的生物，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567488.oracleText: The Cabaretti cultivate an image of harmless hedonism, happy for the other families to underestimate their formidable firepower.
567488.translation: 乐舞会披着毫无威胁的贪欢客形象，甘心让其他四家低估自己威猛的火力。

567489.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control four or more creatures, that creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn instead.
567489.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果你操控四个或更多生物，则改为该生物得+4/+4直到回合结束。

567491.oracleText: He never asks why. Just who, when, and where.
567491.translation: 他从不问原因。只问目标，时间和地点。

567492.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest power and/or toughness among other creatures you control.
567492.translation: 每当CARDNAME进行攻击或阻挡时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之其他生物中的最大力量和／或防御力。

567496.translation: 派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。

567497.translation: 派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。

567501.oracleText: Street corners in the Mezzio are a tantalizing bazaar of the fantastic, the illicit, and the fake.
567501.translation: 梅齐奥区的街头巷尾充斥着各色流动摊贩，售卖好货、黑货和假货。

567504.oracleText: Slicing girders, rescuing trapped workers, killing gigantic rust flies—one tool does it all!
567504.translation: 切断大梁，解救被困工人，击杀巨型锈蝇～一物万用！

567507.oracleText: "They can afford the loss. They build it into their prices."
567507.translation: 「如此损失他们承受得起。这些早都算进价格里了。」

567510.oracleText:
"Crisp, flavorful, and energizing. Perhaps the most elegant offering of Halo in Park Heights. Five stars."
—Conzuelo, restaurant critic
567510.translation:
「口感爽脆、风味十足，令人活力充沛。可能是高地园最顶级的金圆制品。五星。」
～餐评家孔觉罗

567511.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn. Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567511.translation: 目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束。派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567513.oracleText: Overnight, Elspeth was branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.
567513.translation: 一夜之间，艾紫培被冠以新卡佩纳最危险的罪犯这名号。

567514.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, create two Treasure tokens.
567514.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，派出两个珍宝衍生物。

567516.translation: 体重低下，报酬低廉，实力低估。

567518.oracleText: When all you have is a warhammer, every face looks like a nail.
567518.translation: 如果手上只有一把战锤，那每张脸看上去都像是钉子。

567520.oracleText: CARDNAME has trample as long as it has a shield counter on it.
567520.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有后盾指示物，它便具有践踏异能。

567523.oracleText: He keeps the heat off his allies—by drawing it all to himself.
567523.translation: 他让焦点远离同伴～并悉数引到自己身上。

567526.oracleText: "It's all about who you know, darling. And now you're lucky enough to know me."
567526.translation: 「这里全看你认识谁，亲爱的。现在你有幸认识了我。」

567529.oracleText: No institution, however grand, can withstand the collective will of the people.
567529.translation: 衙门再大，也大不过人民众志。

567530.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn. Citizens you control get an additional +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
567530.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。直到回合结束，由你操控的市民再得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

567533.oracleText: Create a 4/4 green Rhino Warrior creature token.
567533.translation: 派出一个4/4绿色犀牛／战士衍生生物。

567534.oracleText: Create a 4/4 green Rhino Warrior creature token.
567534.translation: 派出一个4/4绿色犀牛／战士衍生生物。

567535.oracleText: Put a shield counter on a creature you control.
567535.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

567536.oracleText: Put a shield counter on a creature you control.
567536.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

567543.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless you control seven or more lands.
567543.translation: 除非你操控七个或更多地，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

567549.oracleText: You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
567549.translation: 你可以牺牲一个生物。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，且其法术力值须等同于所牺牲之生物的法术力值加1，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

567550.oracleText: Mill five cards, then put any number of creature cards milled this way into your hand.
567550.translation: 磨五张牌，然后将任意数量以此法磨掉的生物牌置于你手上。

567551.oracleText: Create a 4/4 green Rhino Warrior creature token.
567551.translation: 派出一个4/4绿色犀牛／战士衍生生物。

567554.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature you control has base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn.
567554.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由你操控的生物之基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。

567557.oracleText: "Welcome to the family. Chef Rocco sends their congratulations."
567557.translation: 「欢迎加入家族。请享用主厨罗孔招待的小小心意。」

567558.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567558.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567561.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 4/4 green Rhino Warrior creature token.
567561.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个4/4绿色犀牛／战士衍生生物。

567566.oracleText: As long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 and has deathtouch.
567566.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+2且具有死触异能。

567568.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, mill two cards, then draw a card.
567568.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，磨两张牌，然后抓一张牌。

567571.oracleText: "I have exactly what you need. The question is, how badly do you need it?"
567571.translation: 「我这里正巧有你想要的。问题是，你有多想要？」

567572.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to you for each Treasure you control.
567572.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你每操控一个珍宝，CARDNAME便对你造成2点伤害。

567575.oracleText: "Kill count? I lost track years ago."
567575.translation: 「杀过多少个？我老早就不数了。」

567576.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another creature, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
567576.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个生物时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567578.oracleText: {oBoR}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gains menace until end of turn.
567578.translation: {oBoR}，牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

567581.oracleText: "Trust me, you want to deal with me. My associates are much less pleasant."
567581.translation: 「相信我，你会宁愿对上我。我的同事们可没那么友善。」

567582.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
567582.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

567585.oracleText: "This is the beginning of a beautiful friendship. And more importantly, a profitable one. Now sign here."
567585.translation: 「这是一段美好友谊的开始。更重要的是，一段有利可图的友谊。在这里签名吧。」

567586.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
567586.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物，并在每个由你操控的鹏洛客上各放置一个忠诚指示物。

567588.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
567588.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

567589.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Draw two cards.
567589.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•抓两张牌。

567591.oracleText: "Whatever you're looking for—food, family, Halo—we've got the best in town."
567591.translation: 「无论你想要什么～食物，家庭还是金圆～我们都有全城最好的选择。」

567592.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. If it's a creature or planeswalker card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
567592.translation: 在你的维持开始时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是生物或鹏洛客牌，则你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。如果你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置于你的牌库底。

567594.oracleText: Cabaretti Charm deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker.
567594.translation: 乐舞会护符对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

567595.oracleText: Create two 1/1 green and white Citizen creature tokens.
567595.translation: 派出两个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567596.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain trample until end of turn. 
• Create two 1/1 green and white Citizen creature tokens.
567596.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。 
•直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。 
•派出两个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567597.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Cabaretti Charm deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain trample until end of turn. 
• Create two 1/1 green and white Citizen creature tokens.
567597.translation:
选择一项～ 
•乐舞会护符对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。 
•直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。 
•派出两个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567602.oracleText: Construction in New Capenna is imbued with tradition and ritual.
567602.translation: 新卡佩纳的建设工作充满着传统和仪式感。

567603.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+1 and has trample.
567603.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+1且具有践踏异能。

567606.oracleText: "Together we can build a safer, brighter New Capenna!"
567606.translation: 「只要我们携手合作，就能建立更安全、更光明的新卡佩纳！」

567607.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may tap another untapped Citizen you control. If you do, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
567607.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以横置另一个由你操控且未横置的市民。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得系命异能。

567610.oracleText: She sees the world as a gift meant for her.
567610.translation: 她将世界视作献给她的赠礼。

567611.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Add {oUoBoR}. Spend this mana only to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
567611.translation: {o1}，{oT}：加{oUoBoR}。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间和／或法术咒语。

567612.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
567612.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

567615.oracleText: "Scarcely a mark. A true work of art!"

567619.oracleText:
"Well, that's one way to scatter her ashes."
—Calvey, funeral director
567619.translation:
「行吧，这倒也是抛洒她骨灰的一种方法。」
～殡葬师考维

567620.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the exiled card's power to each creature and each planeswalker.
567620.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成伤害，其数量等同于所放逐之牌的力量。

567621.oracleText: Corpse Explosion deals damage equal to the exiled card's power to each creature and each planeswalker.
567621.translation: 尸爆术对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成伤害，其数量等同于所放逐之牌的力量。

567623.oracleText: The Riveteers are as good at raising buildings as they are at razing them.
567623.translation: 勤工联建楼的能力有多强，他们毁楼的本事就有多大。

567627.oracleText: The people flocked to the glittering parade, turning their backs on the threats in the shadows.
567627.translation: 人们纷纷加入盛大游行队伍，把黑暗中的威胁抛诸脑后。

567628.translation: 由你操控的其他市民得+1/+0。

567629.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567629.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567632.oracleText: Brokers agents defend their charges by all means available, from intricate logic to blunt force trauma.
567632.translation: 从编造难懂逻辑到制造钝器重击，扶济社密探会用一切手段来摆脱控罪。

567635.oracleText: After diverting around the eleventh construction barrier, the taxi driver began to suspect she was being herded into a trap.
567635.translation: 绕过第十一道路障后，出租车司机开始怀疑自己是否被带进了陷阱。

567640.oracleText: Once each turn, you may play a card from exile with a collection counter on it if it was exiled by an ability you controlled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
567640.translation: 限每回合一次，如果放逐区中某张其上有收藏指示物的牌是以由你操控的异能放逐，则你可以从放逐区中使用之，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放它的费用。

567642.oracleText: Investigators observed that Altonio's beloved fish were thriving after his disappearance.
567642.translation: 调查员观察到，自从阿托尼奥失踪后，他珍爱的鱼变得格外活跃。

567647.oracleText: You may cast spells from the top of your library by removing a counter from a creature you control in addition to paying their other costs.
567647.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶施放咒语，但在其他费用以外，还须从由你操控的生物上移去一个指示物。

567651.oracleText: The Vanto Beatdown began as an improvised dance-battle at the Rose Room lounge. When word spread of how many were slain at the first event, it became a citywide obsession.
567651.translation: 万通斗舞最初是蔷薇间的一种即兴舞蹈对决。第一场舞会的死亡人数传开后，它便开始风靡全城。

567653.oracleText: "Big furnace like this can reduce anything to ash. You got something you need reduced to ash?"
567653.translation: 「任何东西进了这样的大型熔炉都会烧成灰。你有什么要烧成灰的东西吗？」

567654.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice one or more other creatures, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent. This ability triggers only once each turn.
567654.translation: 每当你牺牲一个或数个其他生物时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

567662.oracleText: Ob Nixilis smiled. It had been over one thousand years since his last conquest.
567662.translation: 欧尼希兹笑了。距离他上一次征服已经过了千年有余。

567663.oracleText: Up to one target creature has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn. Up to one other target creature has base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn. Then CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each creature.
567663.translation: 至多一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为1/1直到回合结束。至多另一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。然后CARDNAME对所有生物各造成3点伤害。

567664.oracleText: Up to one target creature has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn. Up to one other target creature has base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn. Then Hostile Takeover deals 3 damage to each creature.
567664.translation: 至多一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为1/1直到回合结束。至多另一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。然后敌意接管对所有生物各造成3点伤害。

567666.oracleText: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute. When the room fell silent, she was surrounded only by rose petals falling gently to the floor.
567666.translation: 刺客们将琪特坎托团团包围，此时只闻她嗓音朝上翻了两番，竟长达一分钟毫无间断。随后屋内重归寂静，唯有轻轻洒落的玫瑰花瓣簇拥着女伶。

567667.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each nontoken creature.
567667.translation: CARDNAME对每个非衍生物的生物各造成3点伤害。

567668.oracleText: Incandescent Aria deals 3 damage to each nontoken creature.
567668.translation: 炽热咏叹调对每个非衍生物的生物各造成3点伤害。

567670.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and have vigilance as long as you control three or more creatures.
567670.translation: 只要你操控三个或更多生物，由你操控的生物便得+1/+0且具有警戒异能。

567671.oracleText: Creatures you control also get +1/+0 and have trample as long as you control six or more creatures.
567671.translation: 只要你操控六个或更多生物，由你操控的生物便再得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

567672.oracleText: Creatures you control also get +1/+0 and have double strike as long as you control nine or more creatures.
567672.translation: 只要你操控九个或更多生物，由你操控的生物便再得+1/+0且具有连击异能。

567674.oracleText: When you lose Jetmir's trust, his family makes sure you lose everything else.
567674.translation: 如果你失去了杰米尔的信任，他的家族便会确保你失去一切。

567675.oracleText: {oRoG}: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If mana from a Treasure was spent to activate this ability, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME instead.
567675.translation: {oRoG}：CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果起动此异能时支付过来自珍宝的法术力，则改为在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567678.oracleText: She watches Jetmir's back while her companions watch hers.
567678.translation: 她替杰米尔提防暗算，她的众多同伴则替她提防暗算。

567679.oracleText: If you would create one or more tokens, you may instead create that many 2/2 green Cat creature tokens with haste or that many 3/1 green Dog creature tokens with vigilance.
567679.translation: 如果你将派出一个或数个衍生物，则你可以改为派出等量的2/2绿色、具敏捷异能的猫衍生生物或等量的3/1绿色、具警戒异能的狗衍生生物。

567687.oracleText: Whenever Lord Xander attacks, defending player mills half their library, rounded down.
567687.translation: 每当尚夺尔勋爵攻击时，防御牌手磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

567690.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard by sacrificing a creature in addition to paying its other costs. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
567690.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语，但在其他费用以外，还须牺牲一个生物。如果以此法施放的咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

567692.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
567692.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

567693.oracleText: Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
567693.translation: 每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

567694.oracleText: Maestros Charm deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567694.translation: 绝艺盟护符对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

567695.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. 
• Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life. 
• CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567695.translation:
选择一项～ 
•检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。 
•每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

567696.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. 
• Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life. 
• Maestros Charm deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567696.translation:
选择一项～ 
•检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。 
•每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。 
•绝艺盟护符对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

567698.oracleText: "Where did I find my horned friend? Now there's a story worth telling. . . ."
567698.translation: 「我是在哪里找到这位长角朋友？这故事我可得好好讲一讲…」

567706.oracleText: For years, the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace, and the city prospered.
567706.translation: 多年来，五大家族统治着新卡佩纳，此城在脆弱的和平中繁荣发展。

567707.oracleText: Exile the top ten cards of your library. You may cast spells with exactly three colors from among them this turn. Add {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}. Spend this mana only to cast spells with exactly three colors.
567707.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的十张牌。本回合中，你可以从其中施放正好为三色的咒语。加{oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}。此法术力只能用来施放正好为三色的咒语。

567709.oracleText:
"Angels are living proof that power does not always lead to corruption."
—Elspeth
567709.translation:
「力量并不一定会导致腐败，天使便是活生生的例子。」
～艾紫培

567710.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more creatures with counters on them, draw a card.
567710.translation: 每当你以一个或数个其上有指示物的生物攻击时，抓一张牌。

567712.oracleText: Once he was jumped by a dozen Maestros agents. You can still see their imprints in the pavement if you know where to look.
567712.translation: 有次他遭到一伙绝艺盟密探突袭。如果你知道大致位置，现在还能见到那伙密探在水泥路里的样子。

567713.oracleText: Whenever you attack, double target creature's power until end of turn.
567713.translation: 每当你攻击时，将目标生物的力量加倍直到回合结束。

567718.oracleText: Casualty X. The copy isn't legendary and has starting loyalty X.
567718.translation: 催命X。该复制品不是传奇，且起始忠诚为X。

567719.oracleText: Each opponent loses 2 life unless they discard a card. If you control a Demon or Devil, you gain 2 life.
567719.translation: 对每位对手而言，除非他弃一张牌，否则失去2点生命。如果你操控恶魔或魔鬼，则你获得2点生命。

567720.oracleText: Target player draws seven cards and loses 7 life.
567720.translation: 目标牌手抓七张牌且失去7点生命。

567722.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if its mana value is equal to 1 plus the number of soul counters on CARDNAME, put a soul counter on CARDNAME, then create a 2/2 white Spirit creature token with flying.
567722.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若其法术力值等同于CARDNAME上的灵魂指示物数量加1，则在CARDNAME上放置一个灵魂指示物，然后派出一个2/2白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

567724.oracleText: As long as there are five or more soul counters on CARDNAME, Spirits you control get +3/+3.
567724.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有五个或更多灵魂指示物，由你操控的精怪便得+3/+3。

567727.oracleText: Return target multicolored permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
567727.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的多色永久物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

567728.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Return target multicolored permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. 
• Counter target instant or sorcery spell. 
• Destroy target creature or planeswalker with mana value 3 or less.
567728.translation:
选择一项～ 
•将目标法术力值等于或小于3的多色永久物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。 
•反击目标瞬间或法术咒语。 
•消灭目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物或鹏洛客。

567733.oracleText: Ziatora's second-in-command has a habit of appearing when and where her enemies least expect her.
567733.translation: 齐朵拉的副官总在敌人意料之外的时间与地点现身。

567734.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with haste attacks, create a tapped Treasure token.
567734.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具敏捷异能的生物攻击时，派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。

567736.oracleText: The burglar turned, bowed, and dropped from the ledge onto her waiting mount.
567736.translation: 盗贼转身弯腰自窗口坠下，直落在等着接应的坐骑身上。

567737.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, draw a card if you had two or more creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
567737.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，如果本回合中有两个或更多生物在你的操控下进战场，则抓一张牌。

567741.oracleText: Some try to unravel the tangled skeins of fate. She reweaves them to her own deadly design.
567741.translation: 有些人试图解开纠缠不清的命运束缕。而她则将之编织成独门的夺命计划。

567742.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
567742.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

567745.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target attacking creature connives X, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
567745.translation: 每当你攻击时，令目标进行攻击的生物筹谋X，X为进行攻击的生物数量。

567753.oracleText: Whenever you attack a player or planeswalker with one or more creatures with power 1 or less, draw a card.
567753.translation: 每当你以一个或数个力量等于或小于1的生物攻击一位牌手或鹏洛客时，抓一张牌。

567755.oracleText: "We are this city, down to its bones."
567755.translation: 「从门面到核心，我们就是这座城市。」

567756.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a creature, you may return target creature card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Do this only once each turn.
567756.translation: 每当你牺牲一个生物时，你可以将目标法术力值小于它的生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。每回合只能如此作一次。

567759.oracleText: Exile the top three cards of your library. Until your next end step, you may play those cards.
567759.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用这些牌。

567762.oracleText: They wouldn't admit it, but some people join the Cabaretti just for the food.
567762.translation: 虽然有些人不愿承认，但他们加入乐舞会就是为了这里的美食。

567768.oracleText: Activated abilities of the chosen permanent can't be activated.
567768.translation: 所选永久物的起动式异能都不能起动。

567769.oracleText: CARDNAME has all activated abilities of the chosen permanent except for loyalty abilities. You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to activate those abilities.
567769.translation: CARDNAME具有所选永久物的所有起动式异能，但忠诚异能除外。你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付起动这些异能的费用。

567772.oracleText: Unlucky assassins find out why he's called "Brick Wall" Balzano.
567772.translation: 衰运的杀手才会知道「砖墙」包札诺这外号是怎么来的。

567773.oracleText: You may pay {oRoG} rather than pay this spell's mana cost. Spend only mana produced by Treasures to cast it this way.
567773.translation: 你可以支付{oRoG}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。以此法施放时只能利用珍宝产生的法术力来支付。

567781.oracleText: As long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
567781.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，CARDNAME便得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

567784.oracleText: Light poured from every crack as the sleepers awoke from their long stone slumber.
567784.translation: 沉睡者自长眠苏醒，条条缝隙顿时溢满光线。

567794.oracleText: Sacrifice a Treasure: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567794.translation: 牺牲一个珍宝：派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567796.oracleText: The mansion's vaulted ceilings provided the perfect cover for an ambush.
567796.translation: 豪宅拱顶为伏击提供了完美掩护。

567797.oracleText: As long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+2.
567797.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+2。

567800.oracleText: Their toast to good health went immediately, horribly awry.
567800.translation: 在他们为健康而干杯后，情况急转直下。

567801.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then discard a card unless there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567801.translation: 抓两张牌。然后除非你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，否则弃一张牌。

567804.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, exile them from your graveyard.
567804.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，将它们从你的坟墓场放逐。

567805.oracleText: When Toluz dies, put the cards exiled with it into their owner's hand.
567805.translation: 当涂璐丝死去时，将以它放逐的牌移回其拥有者手上。

567807.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 7 damage to target creature or planeswalker. When it deals excess damage this way, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to that amount of excess damage.
567807.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成7点伤害。当它以此法造成过量伤害时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界，且其法术力值须等于或小于该过量伤害数量。

567808.oracleText: Unleash the Inferno deals 7 damage to target creature or planeswalker. When it deals excess damage this way, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to that amount of excess damage.
567808.translation: 释放狱火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成7点伤害。当它以此法造成过量伤害时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界，且其法术力值须等于或小于该过量伤害数量。

567810.oracleText: Bits of the missing agent were discovered in various alleys across all three boroughs.
567810.translation: 失踪密探的遗骸散落在全部三个区的大小巷道。

567812.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target and you create three Treasure tokens.
567812.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量，且你派出三个珍宝衍生物。

567815.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, look at the top card of your library. You may play a land from the top of your library or cast a spell with mana value less than or equal to the damage dealt from the top of your library without paying its mana cost. If you don't, put that card into your hand.
567815.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以从你的牌库顶使用一张地牌，或从该处施放一个法术力值等于或小于所造成伤害之数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你皆未作，则将该牌置于你手上。

567819.oracleText: "I'm fresh out of mercy today. Why don't you ask Sparky here for forgiveness?"
567819.translation: 「我今天的仁慈额度刚用完。你不如向辉辉求情吧？」

567820.oracleText: {o1}: This creature deals 1 damage to target creature that's blocking it.
567820.translation: {o1}：此生物对目标阻挡它的生物造成1点伤害。

567821.oracleText: Equipped creature has "{o1}: This creature deals 1 damage to target creature that's blocking it."
567821.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「{o1}：此生物对目标阻挡它的生物造成1点伤害。」

567823.oracleText: When you cast this spell, copy it.
567823.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，将它复制。

567824.oracleText: When you cast this spell, copy it. (The copy becomes a token.)
567824.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，将它复制。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

567825.oracleText: Equipped creature has double strike as long as two or more Equipment are attached to it.
567825.translation: 只要佩带此武具的生物上贴附了两个或更多武具，它便具有连击异能。

567827.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, tap this creature.
567827.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，横置此生物。

567828.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+3 and has "At the beginning of your end step, tap this creature."
567828.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+3且具有「在你的结束步骤开始时，横置此生物。」

567830.oracleText:
"I always say, ‘If it's breathing, it's lying.' Luckily my friend here does neither."
—Lord Xander
567830.translation:
「我常说，『只要是会呼吸的，都会撒谎。』幸好我这位朋友都不会。」
～尚夺尔勋爵

567833.oracleText: For those who need to make a quick departure without attracting undue attention.
567833.translation: 适合需要低调行事、迅速离开者。

567834.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, return up to one target creature that crewed it this turn to its owner's hand.
567834.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，将至多一个目标本回合中搭载它的生物移回其拥有者手上。

567839.oracleText: It pulses with the colors that best complement the wearer's outfit.
567839.translation: 它闪烁着最契合佩戴者服饰的颜色。

567843.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each counter on it.
567843.translation: 佩带此武具的生物上每有一个指示物，便得+1/+1。

567844.oracleText: Equipped permanent isn't a planeswalker and is a creature in addition to its other types.
567844.translation: 佩带此武具的永久物不是鹏洛客，且额外具有生物此类别。

567847.oracleText: The rest of Anhelo's assistant arrived over the following week.
567847.translation: 安海洛助手的其他部分在接下来一周陆续送达。

567848.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
567848.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

567850.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 4 damage to target creature.
567850.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成4点伤害。

567853.oracleText: No true angels have been created since the founding of New Capenna, but artisans have learned to craft elegant facsimiles.
567853.translation: 新卡佩纳成立后，再也没有诞生过真正的天使，但匠人学会了打造优雅的复制品。

567854.oracleText: {o3}: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If exactly three colors of mana were spent to activate this ability, put a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
567854.translation: {o3}：CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果起动此异能时支付过正好三色的法术力，则改为在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567860.oracleText: Porter, cleaner, and bouncer all in one.
567860.translation: 搬运，清扫，安保，一体全包。

567861.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control two or more multicolored permanents, CARDNAME gains double strike until end of turn.
567861.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控两个或更多的多色永久物，则CARDNAME获得连击异能直到回合结束。

567863.oracleText: The great library in the Museum of Old Capenna has a million volumes on display—and miles of passages hidden behind them.
567863.translation: 旧卡佩纳博物馆的大图书室陈列着上百万本书册～其背后还藏着绵延无数里的暗道。

567865.oracleText: {oT}: Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard.
567865.translation: {oT}：将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。

567866.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards exiled with it.
567866.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于以它放逐之牌的数量。

567867.oracleText: Unlicensed Hearse's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards exiled with it.
567867.translation: 无牌灵车的力量和防御力各等同于以它放逐之牌的数量。

567869.oracleText: Public parks are a favored meeting spot for those considering a shift in allegiance.
567869.translation: 人们若想改换东家，公园是很理想的会面场所。

567874.oracleText: Once the witness was inside, the safe house vanished first from sight, then from memory.
567874.translation: 目击证人进门后，藏身处先从视线中消失，再自记忆中抹除。

567878.oracleText: So long as the Halo keeps flowing, the festivities never end.
567878.translation: 只要金圆持续流转，节庆就永不结束。

567883.oracleText: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.
567883.translation: 乐舞会公园般的地盘提供休憩和美食，同时也是甩掉跟踪的完美场所。

567886.oracleText: Only extraordinary performers are invited to grace the grandest stage in New Capenna.
567886.translation: 只有最优秀的演出者才会获邀登上新卡佩纳最豪华的舞台。

567890.oracleText: In volatile times, a sense of certainty is in high demand.
567890.translation: 在动荡的年代，人们极度需要安全感。

567894.oracleText: Purchasing chrome racehorses with cash is a common means of dispersing mysterious income.
567894.translation: 用现金购买铬亮赛马，是漂白神秘收入的常见手段。

567900.oracleText: The Obscura's Cloud Spire dominates the skyline, its eye a beacon of progress that sees all.
567900.translation: 秘闻帮的尖云顶耸立天际线，有如进展明灯将一切尽收眼底。

567903.oracleText: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.
567903.translation: 外梁上有许多以丝金雕刻的名字，这些都是建设过程中失足丧命者。

567907.oracleText: New Capenna's districts are a series of tiers; wealth and power always rise to the top.
567907.translation: 新卡佩纳的地区按层分级，富人和权贵总是在顶部。

567912.oracleText: To most, the Nido Sanctuary is an office complex. To the Brokers, it's a vault of secrets.
567912.translation: 在多数人眼里，尼多厅舍是一幢办公大楼。对扶济社而言，这是一座装满秘密的宝库。

567915.oracleText: A ten-minute ride can take you to the luxury of Park Heights, or the grit of the Caldaia.
567915.translation: 只消十分钟，便能亲享高地园的富贵，或是感受柯达亚的无情。

567920.oracleText: The bottom of the dark canals is littered with countless corpses and treasures.
567920.translation: 漆黑的运河底部散落着无数尸体和宝物。

567926.oracleText: Maestros agents can lie low in high style at the opulent Shadow Hostel.
567926.translation: 奢华的聚影舍让绝艺盟密探不需牺牲时尚品味也能低调行事。

567930.oracleText: Restless Riveteers can always find a sparring partner in the sprawling Treza warehouse.
567930.translation: 坐不住的勤工联成员总能在庞杂的崔栅窟仓库里找到切磋对手。

567932.oracleText: Put a permanent card with mana value 3 or less onto the battlefield?
567932.translation: 是否要将一张法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌放进战场？

567933.oracleText: Search for any number of cards named Gathering Throng.
567933.translation: 搜寻任意数量名称为集群民众的牌。

567934.oracleText: Search your library for any number of cards named Gathering Throng?
567934.translation: 是否要从你牌库中搜寻任意数量名称为集群民众的牌？

567935.oracleText: Spend only on: An Angel Spell
567935.translation: 只能用于支付：天使咒语。

567936.oracleText: Untap a tapped creature you control.
567936.translation: 重置一个由你操控且已横置的生物。

567937.oracleText: Untap two tapped creatures you control.
567937.translation: 重置两个由你操控且已横置的生物。

567938.oracleText: Untap fifteen tapped creatures you control.
567938.translation: 重置十五个由你操控且已横置的生物。

567939.oracleText: Target up to three creature cards with total mana value 3 or less.
567939.translation: 指定至多三张生物牌为目标，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于3。

567941.oracleText: Target a spell you control that wasn't cast.
567941.translation: 指定一个由你操控且未经施放的咒语为目标。

567943.oracleText: Choose a creature, enchantment, or planeswalker card?
567943.translation: 是否要选择一张生物，结界或鹏洛客牌？

567944.oracleText: Target two creatures controlled by the same player.
567944.translation: 选择两个目标由同一牌手操控的生物。

567948.oracleText: Tap another untapped Citizen you control?
567948.translation: 是否要横置另一个由你操控的市民？

567949.oracleText: Spend only on: Instant And/Or Sorcery Spells
567949.translation: 只能用于支付：瞬间和／或法术咒语

567951.oracleText: Sacrifice {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} nonland permanent} other {{2, Number} nonland permanents}} you control.
567951.translation: 牺牲{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个由你操控的非地永久物} other {{2, Number}个由你操控的非地永久物}}。

567952.oracleText: Choose an artifact, instant, or sorcery card.
567952.translation: 选择一张神器，瞬间或法术牌。

567953.oracleText: Target a multicolored permanent card with mana value 3 or less.
567953.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于3的多色永久物牌为目标。

569119.oracleText: {oSioSioSi}: CARDNAME becomes a 3/3 creature with vigilance and all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.
569119.translation: {oSioSioSi}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为3/3，具警戒异能的生物且具有所有生物类别。它仍然是地。

569120.oracleText: {oSioSioSi}: Faceless Haven becomes a 3/3 creature with vigilance and all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.

569121.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

578986.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「由你操控的生物具有践踏与敏捷异能，且你完成过的地城中每有一个不同名称便得+2/+2。」

595454.oracleText: Modified creatures you control have menace.

595458.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, a random artifact card in your hand perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
595458.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你手上的一张随机神器牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

595492.translation: 如果你手上没有地牌，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

595508.translation: 随机将一张祭祠牌置于你手上。

595515.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, you may pay 1 life. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature. Otherwise, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

595529.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact or creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. It gains haste. Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
595529.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器或生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

595530.oracleText: Reveal the top card of your library and put that card into your hand. Each opponent loses life equal to its mana value.

595549.oracleText: Search your library for a creature card with mana value X or less, where X is 2 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value. Put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Exile Eldritch Evolution.
