596678.translation: 指定一个不由你操控的非基本地为目标。

596683.oracleText: Exile four other artifact creatures and/or Vehicles you control.
596683.translation: 放逐四个由你操控的其他神器生物和／或载具。

596689.oracleText: Sacrifice this permanent at the beginning of the next end step.
596689.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将此永久物牺牲。

597021.oracleText: Choose a nonland card in your opponent's graveyard.
597021.translation: 选择对手坟墓场中一张非地牌。

597073.oracleText: Choose a nonland card to return to your opponent's hand.
597073.translation: 选择一张非地牌，将它移回对手手上。

597784.oracleText: Choose a nonlegendary creature card in your opponent's graveyard.
597784.translation: 选择一张在对手坟墓场中的非传奇生物牌。

597785.oracleText: Discard {2, plural, =1 {a card. (If you discard a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on the conniving creature)} other {{2, Number} cards.}}
597785.translation: 弃{2, plural, =1 {一张牌。（如果你弃的牌不是地，则在进行筹谋的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物)} other {{2, Number}张牌。}}

598762.translation: 指定至多一个咒语为目标。

598763.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green and white Citizen creature with base power and toughness 1/1 named Legitimate Businessperson. (It loses all other colors, card types, creature types, and names.)
598763.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为1/1，名称为合法商人的绿白双色市民生物。（它失去所有其他颜色、牌张类别、生物类别以及名称。）

598764.oracleText: Equipped permanent isn't a planeswalker and is a creature in addition to its other types. (Loyalty abilities can still be activated.)
598764.translation: 佩带此武具的永久物不是鹏洛客，且额外具有生物此类别。（它的忠诚异能仍能起动。）

598768.oracleText: When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
598768.translation: 当此永久物从战场进入坟墓场时，抓一张牌。

598776.oracleText: Put a counter of that kind on either of those tokens.
598776.translation: 在前述衍生物之一上放置一个同类的指示物。

598817.oracleText: Choose a token to get one {3, Enum:CounterType} counter.
598817.translation: 选择一个衍生物来得到一个{3, Enum:CounterType}指示物。

598818.oracleText: Put a random creature card with mana value X or less from target opponent's library onto the battlefield under your control. It perpetually has base power and toughness X/X and gains ward {o1}.
598818.translation: 将一张法术力值等于或小于X的随机生物牌在你的操控下从目标对手的牌库放进战场。它的基础力量与防御力永久为X/X，且永久获得守护{o1}。

598824.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, choose land or nonland. Seek a permanent card of the chosen kind.
598824.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择地或非地。取出一张该种类的永久物牌。

598828.oracleText: Put a random creature card with mana value {2, Number} or less onto the battlefield.
598828.translation: 随机将一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌放进战场。

598829.oracleText: Seek a permanent card of the chosen kind.
598829.translation: 取出一张该种类的永久物牌。

599804.oracleText: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power 4 or more.
599804.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且力量总和等于或大于4的其他生物。

599806.oracleText: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power 2 or more.
599806.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且力量总和等于或大于2的其他生物。

599807.oracleText: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power 3 or more.
599807.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且力量总和等于或大于3的其他生物。

599812.oracleText: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power 1 or more.
599812.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且力量总和等于或大于1的其他生物。

599919.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose a card type, then reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all cards of the chosen type revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
599919.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，选择一种牌张类别，然后展示你牌库顶的三张牌。将所有该类别的牌置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

601016.oracleText: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power 6 or more.
601016.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且力量总和等于或大于6的其他生物。

601131.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, create a 1/1 black Skeleton creature token.
601131.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则派出一个1/1黑色骷髅妖衍生生物。

602037.oracleText: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power 5 or more.
602037.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且力量总和等于或大于5的其他生物。

603374.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, scry 2, then draw a card.
603374.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，占卜2，然后抓一张牌。

603377.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control exploits a creature, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
603377.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物榨取生物时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

603575.oracleText: Create that many 2/2 green Cat creature tokens with haste
603575.translation: 派出等量的2/2绿色、具敏捷异能的猫衍生生物

603576.oracleText: Create that many 3/1 green Dog creature tokens with vigilance
603576.translation: 派出等量的3/1绿色、具警戒异能的狗衍生生物

603577.oracleText: Choose which kind of token to create.

603578.oracleText: Choose an option to create that many Cat or Dog tokens instead.
603578.translation: 选择改为派出等量的猫或狗衍生物。

603585.oracleText: Target a non-Rogue creature card with equal or lesser power.
603585.translation: 指定一张目标力量等于或小于它的非浪客生物牌为目标。

603931.oracleText: Put any number of creature cards milled this way into your hand.
603931.translation: 将任意数量以此法磨掉的生物牌置于你手上。

603932.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature with power {2, Number} or greater.
603932.translation: 牺牲一个力量等于或大于{2, Number}的生物。

603933.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature with power X.
603933.translation: 牺牲一个力量为X的生物。

603934.oracleText: Target a card in a graveyard, spell, or nonland permanent.
603934.translation: 指定一个咒语，非地永久物或坟墓场中的牌为目标。

603944.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
603944.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个生物死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

604061.oracleText: Remove a counter from a creature or planeswalker you control?
604061.translation: 是否要从由你操控的生物或鹏洛客上移去一个指示物？

604076.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+2 and has protection from Demons and from Devils.
604076.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+2且具有反恶魔保护与反魔鬼保护。

604077.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, it perpetually gets +1/+0 if it has the same name as another creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard.
604077.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，如果它与由你操控的另一个生物或你坟墓场中的一张生物牌同名，则它永久得+1/+0。

604081.oracleText: Target creature perpetually loses all abilities, then CARDNAME deals damage to it equal to the number of creatures you control.
604081.translation: 目标生物永久失去所有异能，然后CARDNAME对其造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

604082.oracleText: Target creature perpetually loses all abilities, then Patriar's Humiliation deals damage to it equal to the number of creatures you control.
604082.translation: 目标生物永久失去所有异能，然后宗贵羞辱对其造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

604086.oracleText: Enchant creature or planeswalker you don't control
604086.translation: 结附于不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客。

604091.oracleText: Create two 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.
604091.translation: 派出两个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

604092.oracleText: Seek a nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less.
604092.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌。

604093.oracleText:
Choose one or more — 
• Create two 2/2 white Knight creature tokens. 
• Seek a nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less. 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Target player gains 3 life.
604093.translation:
选择一项或多项～ 
•派出两个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。 
•取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌。 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•目标牌手获得3点生命。

604097.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, it perpetually gains double team.
604097.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，它永久获得双打异能。

604102.oracleText: Rejuvenation — {o2oW}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. It perpetually gets +1/+1. Activate only if you control a 1/1 creature.
604102.translation: 返魂～{o2oW}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。它永久得+1/+1。只能于你操控1/1生物时起动。

604103.oracleText: Rejuvenation — {o2oW}: Return Vladimir and Godfrey from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. It perpetually gets +1/+1. Activate only if you control a 1/1 creature.
604103.translation: 返魂～{o2oW}：将弗拉基米尔与戈弗雷从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。它永久得+1/+1。只能于你操控1/1生物时起动。

604111.oracleText: Seek two nonland cards, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library.
604111.translation: 取出两张非地牌，然后将一张牌从你手上置于你的牌库底。

604119.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may copy a card exiled with CARDNAME. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
604119.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以复制以CARDNAME放逐的一张牌。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

604129.oracleText: Choose target spell. If it's a creature spell, it perpetually gets -2/-0. Counter that spell unless its controller pays {o2}.
604129.translation: 选择目标咒语。如果它是生物咒语，它永久得-2/-0。除非该咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。

604131.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME if the top card of your library is a nonland card. Otherwise, you may mill a card.
604131.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，如果你的牌库顶牌是非地牌，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则你可以磨一张牌。

604135.oracleText: Psionic Adept — Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked by a creature, that creature perpetually gets -2/-0.
604135.translation: 灵能导师～每当CARDNAME被生物阻挡时，该生物永久得-2/-0。

604141.oracleText: Molting Exoskeleton — When CARDNAME dies, it perpetually gets -1/-1. Then if that card's toughness is 1 or greater, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
604141.translation: 蜕变外骨骼～当CARDNAME死去时，它永久得-1/-1。然后如果该牌的防御力等于或大于1，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

604145.oracleText: Target opponent reveals each noncreature, nonland card in their hand. You choose a card revealed this way. That player discards that card. You lose 2 life. If they didn't reveal a card this way, you draw a card.
604145.translation: 目标对手展示其手上所有非生物且非地的牌。你选择一张以此法展示的牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。你失去2点生命。如果其未以此法展示牌，则你抓一张牌。

604147.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, this creature perpetually gets -1/-1.
604147.translation: 在每个维持开始时，此生物永久得-1/-1。

604148.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls perpetually gets -2/-2 and gains "At the beginning of each upkeep, this creature perpetually gets -1/-1."
604148.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物永久得-2/-2且获得「在每个维持开始时，此生物永久得-1/-1。」

604150.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Choose one of them and put all cards with the same name as the chosen card from among them into your hand. You lose 1 life for each card put into your hand this way. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
604150.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。选择其中一张，并将其中所有与该牌同名的牌置于你手上。每以此法将一张牌置于你手上，你便失去1点生命。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

604155.translation: 由你操控的其他邪术师得+1/+1。

604157.oracleText: Target player discards all the cards in their hand, then seeks that many nonland cards.
604157.translation: 目标牌手弃掉其手牌，然后取出等量的非地牌。

604158.oracleText: Target player discards all the cards in their hand, then seeks that many nonland cards.
604158.translation: 目标牌手弃掉其手牌，然后取出等量的非地牌。

604159.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target player and they create two Treasure tokens.
604159.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手造成2点伤害且该牌手派出两个珍宝衍生物。

604161.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature target player controls. Those creatures perpetually get +2/+0.
604161.translation: CARDNAME对每个由目标牌手操控的生物造成2点伤害。这些生物永久得+2/+0。

604166.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+2, has haste, and attacks each combat if able.
604166.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+2，具有敏捷异能且每次战斗若能攻击则必须攻击。

604177.oracleText: You may pay {oR} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
604177.translation: 你可以支付{oR}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

604178.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this artifact.
604178.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲此神器。

604186.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, seek a creature card with mana value 3 or less. That card perpetually gains haste, "This spell costs {o1} less to cast," and "At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this creature."
604186.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。该牌永久获得敏捷，「此咒语减少{o1}来施放」，与「在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲此生物。」

604189.oracleText: This creature attacks each combat if able.
604189.translation: 此生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

604190.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. It perpetually gains "This creature attacks each combat if able."
604190.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。它永久获得「此生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。」

604192.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a flame counter on it, then seek a card with mana value equal to the number of flame counters on it and exile that card face down.
604192.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在其上放置一个烈焰指示物，然后取出一张法术力值等同于其上烈焰指示物数量的牌，并牌面朝下地放逐该牌。

604196.oracleText: {oT}: Choose a creature card in your hand. It perpetually gains haste.
604196.translation: {oT}：选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得敏捷异能。

604202.oracleText: They fought with the desperate courage of those who have nothing left to lose.
604202.translation: 一无所有之后才能一往无前：他们正是抱着这样的勇气在战斗。

604203.oracleText: Other Demons, Devils, Imps, and Tieflings you control get +1/+0.
604203.translation: 由你操控的其他恶魔、魔鬼、小恶魔和魔人得+1/+0。

604205.oracleText: Target nontoken creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains double team until end of turn. It also gains first strike until end of turn if it has the same name as another creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard.
604205.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物得+2/+0且获得双打异能。如果它与另一个由你操控的生物或你坟墓场中的任一张生物牌同名，则它再获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

604211.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains reach and trample until end of turn.
604211.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得延势和践踏异能。

604219.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls of the noted type dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
604219.translation: 每当一个由对手操控且为所记下之类别的生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

604221.oracleText: Conjure a card of your choice from Follow the Tracks's spellbook onto the battlefield.
604221.translation: 从循迹追踪的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进战场。

604222.translation: 北极熊人欧娅米娜托克

604225.translation: 每当欧娅米娜托克对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个食品衍生物。

604228.oracleText: Seek a creature card if an opponent has cast a spell with mana value 3 or less this turn.
604228.translation: 如果对手本回合中施放过法术力值等于或小于3的咒语，则取出一张生物牌。

604230.oracleText: Seek X creature, enchantment, and/or planeswalker cards, where X is the highest mana value among creatures you control. Put those cards onto the battlefield.
604230.translation: 取出X张生物，结界和／或鹏洛客牌，X为由你操控之生物中的最大法术力值。将这些牌放进战场。

604232.oracleText: Aim for the Wyvern — Conjure a card named Plummet into your hand.
604232.translation: 瞄准飞龙～将一张名称为铅直落下的牌幻变进你手上。

604234.oracleText: Aim for the Cursed Amulet — Conjure a card named Naturalize into your hand.
604234.translation: 瞄准诅咒护符～将一张名称为回归自然的牌幻变进你手上。

604236.oracleText: Fire a Warning Shot — Draw a card.

604238.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Aim for the Wyvern — Conjure a card named Plummet into your hand. 
• Aim for the Cursed Amulet — Conjure a card named Naturalize into your hand. 
• Fire a Warning Shot — Draw a card.
604238.translation:
选择一项～ 
•瞄准飞龙～将一张名称为铅直落下的牌幻变进你手上。 
•瞄准诅咒护符～将一张名称为回归自然的牌幻变进你手上。 
•开枪警告～抓一张牌。

604240.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, draw a card if your library has more cards in it than target opponent's library. Otherwise, each opponent mills five cards.
604240.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，如果你牌库中牌的数量比目标对手牌库中牌的数量多，则抓一张牌。若否，则每位对手各磨五张牌。

604242.oracleText: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."
604242.translation: 「外面是一个鬼吃人的世界。要想活命就得听我号令。」

604243.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, each creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn if it has the same name as another creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard.
604243.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，如果某个由你操控的生物与另一个由你操控的生物或你坟墓场中的任一张生物牌同名，则该生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

604244.oracleText: {o1oRoW}: Another target nontoken creature you control gains first strike and double team until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
604244.translation: {o1oRoW}：另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物获得先攻与双打异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动且只能起动一次。

604245.translation: 至上真神教派的明萨拉

604247.oracleText: Creatures you control get +X/+0, where X is CARDNAME's intensity.
604247.translation: 由你操控的生物得+X/+0，X为CARDNAME的强度。

604254.oracleText: Target opponent puts a creature card of their choice from their graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. That creature gains ward {o2}.
604254.translation: 目标对手选择其坟墓场中的一张生物牌，并将该牌在你的操控下从该处放进战场。该生物获得守护{o2}。

604260.oracleText: Whenever Ulder Ravengard attacks, conjure a duplicate of another target nontoken attacking creature into your hand.
604260.translation: 每当乌尔德瑞文嘉德攻击时，将另一个目标非衍生物且进行攻击之生物的一张副本幻变进你手上。

604263.oracleText: An imposing visage that looms over all who would rise above their station.
604263.translation: 挡在渴望擢升者眼前的威严面容。

604265.oracleText: {o3oB}, {oT}: Seek a nonland card. Activate only once.
604265.translation: {o3oB}，{oT}：取出一张非地牌。只能起动一次。

604268.oracleText: A barrier that shields privileged eyes from the city's woes.
604268.translation: 帮助富足人家不见城中劣迹的高大围栏。

604270.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}: Seek a nonland card. Activate only once.
604270.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}：取出一张非地牌。只能起动一次。

604273.oracleText: An efficient route from a smuggler's ship to a patriar's manor.
604273.translation: 连接走私船只和贵族豪邸的迅捷通道。

604275.oracleText: {o3oU}, {oT}: Seek a nonland card. Activate only once.
604275.translation: {o3oU}，{oT}：取出一张非地牌。只能起动一次。

604278.oracleText: A beacon of order and safety, for those who can afford it.
604278.translation: 保障担负费用者安全的秩序信标。

604280.oracleText: {o3oW}, {oT}: Seek a nonland card. Activate only once.
604280.translation: {o3oW}，{oT}：取出一张非地牌。只能起动一次。

604283.oracleText: A partition between the hopeless living and the restless dead.
604283.translation: 分隔无望活人与不息亡者的天然屏障。

604285.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}: Seek a nonland card. Activate only once.
604285.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}：取出一张非地牌。只能起动一次。

604290.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn, create a 1/1 white Pegasus creature token with flying.
604290.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有由你操控的永久物离开战场，则派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的飞马衍生生物。

604297.oracleText: Only the good-hearted may set foot in a unicorn's domain.
604297.translation: 只有善心人士才能踏足独角兽的地盘。

604298.oracleText: {o3oW}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn. Activate only during your turn.
604298.translation: {o3oW}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。只能于你的回合中起动。

604306.oracleText: "It's as much a trick of the mind as it is a trick of the eye."

604308.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, scry 2.
604308.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语时，占卜2。

604311.oracleText: Erdur never thought of it as stealing. Treasure simply didn't deserve to be stuck underground where no one could admire it.
604311.translation: 伊朵从不觉得这是偷窃。宝藏原本就不应该深埋地下无人赏识。

604313.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, scry 1, then draw a card.
604313.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

604315.oracleText: "I see the far side of tomorrow and the lost memories of queens. What do you wish to learn?"
604315.translation: 「我能看见遥远未来和女王的失却记忆。你想听什么？」

604318.oracleText: Pseudodragons are favored companions of wizards, prized for their cunning and curiosity.
604318.translation: 伪龙天性聪慧、求知欲强，因而成了法师最喜欢的同伴。

604321.oracleText: "Of course it's part of my plan. Who do you think started the bar fight?"
604321.translation: 「这当然是我计划的一部分。不然你以为酒吧里是谁先动的手？」

604322.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if it wasn't blocking, draw a card.
604322.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若它并非正进行阻挡，则抓一张牌。

604325.oracleText: It listens to all of their plans and plots creative ways to turn them to ruin.
604325.translation: 它暗暗偷听他们的种种计划，设想新颖方式将其一一破坏。

604326.oracleText: Whenever one or more permanents you control leave the battlefield, scry 1.
604326.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的永久物离开战场时，占卜1。

604328.oracleText: The air itself shuddered at the wizard's words, and from the dark beyond, her call was answered.
604328.translation: 随着法师念咒声起，周遭空气开始随之抖动，而黑暗异界也响应了法师的召唤。

604329.oracleText: You may mill three cards. Then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
604329.translation: 你可以磨三张牌。然后将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

604332.oracleText: The best defense is not even knowing what the word "defense" means.
604332.translation: 最好的防守，就是完全不知道「防守」这个词。

604335.oracleText: The essence of a red dragon burns within, always ready to rise with wrath.
604335.translation: 红龙精华在其内燃烧，随时准备喷泻怒火。

604336.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. If that mana is spent on a Dragon creature spell, it gains haste until end of turn.
604336.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。如果该法术力用以支付龙生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

604339.oracleText:
"Filthy, sticky, vile, noxious—and I haven't even started describing the webs."
—Erinis, gloom stalker
604339.translation: 「污秽、粘稠、肮脏、剧毒～这还没说到网。」～幽域追踪者艾琳尼斯

604342.oracleText: "Breath of basilisk, sting of scorpion, or medusa's tears? All may be distilled, for a price."
604342.translation: 「你想提纯什么？石化蜥蜴喷息，蝎子毒刺，还是梅杜莎的眼泪？只要给够钱，什么都办得到。」

604345.oracleText: "Life always starts small. Only time will tell what heights it may reach."
604345.translation: 「生命总是从幼小开始。只有时间才能知道它最终能飞得多高。」

604346.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG}. When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, you gain 2 life.
604346.translation: {oT}：加{oG}。当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语时，你获得2点生命。

604348.oracleText: Water, barley, yeast, darkness—the tavern cellar had everything a growing mold could need.
604348.translation: 水源、大麦、酵母、黑暗～酒馆地窖有霉菌生长所需的一切。

604354.oracleText: Bone, root, and seed—the past, present, and future in one handful of earth.
604354.translation: 骨头、树根和种子～这三样象征过去、现在与未来的事物全聚集于手中这抔土中。

604355.oracleText: You may mill three cards. Then return up to one creature card and up to one land card from your graveyard to your hand.
604355.translation: 你可以磨三张牌。然后将至多一张生物牌和至多一张地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

604356.oracleText: "Boo, let's see how this miscreant handles a furry missile of justice!"
604356.translation: 「布布，让我们瞧瞧这个恶徒如何应对正义毛绒飞弹！」

604358.oracleText: The raging green dragon left destruction—and at least one admirer—in its wake.
604358.translation: 狂怒绿龙飞过，留下满地狼藉～与至少一名仰慕者。

604362.oracleText: Fortunately for lost travelers, chwingas' curiosity often gets the better of their shyness.
604362.translation: 怯蕴灵虽然怯生，但其好奇心更旺盛～这对迷途旅人来说正是幸运之事。

604366.translation: 艾瑞尼卡斯的邪恶副体

604367.oracleText:
"You will serve me better in this form."
—Jon Irenicus
604367.translation:
「你在这种形态给我的服侍最受用。」
～琼艾瑞尼卡斯

604371.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on equipped creature.
604371.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，在佩带此武具的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

604373.oracleText:
"We simply cannot tolerate a petty thief among the servants. I'm afraid I'll have to let you go."
—Rog, steward of House Rillyn
604373.translation:
「我们容不得佣人当中出现手脚不干净的人。恐怕我这就得将你扫地出门。」
～瑞尔林家执事罗格

604375.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, mill a card. When you do, if there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control and it gains deathtouch until end of turn.
604375.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，磨一张牌。当你如此作时，如果你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它获得死触异能直到回合结束。

604376.oracleText: "Of course it can be yours. Anything is possible, for the right price. Speaking of which . . ."
604376.translation: 「这当然可以是你的。只要价格合适，任何东西都可以。说起这事…」

604378.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, double its power until end of turn.
604378.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，将其力量加倍直到回合结束。

604380.oracleText: Target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn.
604380.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

604384.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may sacrifice one or more Treasures. When you do, up to that many target creatures gain double strike until end of turn.
604384.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以牺牲一个或数个珍宝。当你如此作时，至多该数量的目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

604386.oracleText: "We must never allow the deeds of our great ancestors to be forgotten."
604386.translation: 「我们必须要让伟大先祖的丰功伟绩流芳世间，莫遭人遗忘。」

604387.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may search your library for a Dragon card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
604387.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张龙牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

604390.oracleText: "That half is yours. These halves are mine."

604391.oracleText: Exile up to five target permanent cards from your graveyard and separate them into two piles. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
604391.translation: 将至多五张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场放逐，并分为两堆。由任一对手选择其中一堆。将该堆牌置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。

604394.oracleText: Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
604394.translation: 每当任一对手搜寻其牌库时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

604396.oracleText: Exile all nontoken creatures you control, then roll a d20. 1-9 | Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. 10-20 | Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control, then exile them again. Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
604396.translation: 放逐所有由你操控且非衍生物的生物，然后掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将这些牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。 10-20 | 将这些牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，然后再度将它们放逐。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将这些牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

604399.oracleText: Create X 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
604399.translation: 派出X个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

604401.oracleText: Exile target spell, then roll a d20 and add that spell's mana value. 1-14 | You may cast the exiled card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell. 15+ | You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled.
604401.translation: 放逐目标咒语，然后掷一颗d20，并将点数加上该咒语的法术力值。 1-14 | 于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放之，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。 15+ | 于该牌持续被放逐期间，你可以施放之，且不需支付其法术力费用。

604403.oracleText: A family that welcomes birds of all feathers.

604407.oracleText: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

604412.oracleText: Tap X target creatures. They don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.
604412.translation: 横置X个目标生物。它们于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

604414.oracleText:
"Isn't she the cutest thing you've almost seen?"
—Doen, purveyor of exotic pets
604414.translation:
「她是不是你这辈子见过最可爱的小东西？」
～异宠贩商多恩

604415.oracleText: Avoidance — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, exile up to one target nonland permanent you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
604415.translation: 回避～每当你施放非生物咒语时，放逐至多一个目标由你操控的非地永久物，然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

604418.oracleText: It offers the power to shape worlds, and the elegance to do so with style.
604418.translation: 它不仅让你掌握重塑世界的威力，还让你在如此作时不失优雅。

604419.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you draw that many cards.
604419.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓等量的牌。

604423.oracleText: For the patriar class, wealth is in the blood.
604423.translation: 对贵族阶级而言，财富乃流淌于血液之中。

604424.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. For each nontoken creature destroyed this way, you create a tapped Treasure token.
604424.translation: 消灭所有生物。每以此法消灭一个非衍生物的生物，你便派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。

604426.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Exile a creature you control: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
604426.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，放逐一个由你操控的生物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

604428.oracleText: Create a tapped 4/1 black Skeleton creature token with menace.
604428.translation: 派出一个已横置的4/1黑色，具威慑异能的骷髅妖衍生生物。

604432.oracleText: Body Thief — You may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled with CARDNAME. If you cast a spell this way, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
604432.translation: 窃夺躯体～你可以从以CARDNAME放逐的牌之中使用地和施放咒语。如果你以此法施放咒语，则你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放它的费用。

604436.oracleText: The Night Serpent tasted the warlock's ambition and savored the dark hunger in her soul.
604436.translation: 暗夜巨蛇仅浅尝一口邪术师的野心滋味，就开始回味起她灵魂中的乌黯饥渴。

604437.oracleText: Target player draws X cards and loses X life, where X is the number of cards in their graveyard.
604437.translation: 目标牌手抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为其坟墓场中牌的数量。

604439.oracleText: "We'll put it all back! The gems, the gold, the chalice that would've looked great on my mantle; we'll put everythi—"
604439.translation: 「我们会把东西都放回去！宝石、金币，还有那个跟我斗篷很搭的圣杯；我们都会放～」

604440.oracleText: Whenever a Dragon you control is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dragon.
604440.translation: 每当一个由你操控的龙受到伤害时，它对任意一个不为龙之目标造成等量的伤害。

604442.oracleText: The detail really makes the monsters jump off the page.
604442.translation: 细节描写生动具体，令怪物跃然纸面。

604443.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
604443.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}：你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

604445.oracleText: Mill five cards, then return a creature card milled this way to your hand.
604445.translation: 磨五张牌，然后将一张以此法磨掉的生物牌移回你手上。

604447.oracleText:
"By the time you've seen it all, all have already changed."
—Wandering treant, name unknown
604447.translation:
「待你见过万物，万物均已生变。」
～佚名漂泊树人

604448.oracleText: Search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control. Put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
604448.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多X张基本地牌，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。将这些牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

604451.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the total mana value of Dragons you control.
604451.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为由你操控之龙的法术力值总和。

604455.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gains deathtouch until end of turn. Mill two cards.
604455.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它获得死触异能直到回合结束。磨两张牌。

604457.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may play a land or cast a permanent spell from among cards in your graveyard that were put there from your library this turn.
604457.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从本回合自你牌库进入你坟墓场的牌之中使用一个地或施放一个永久物咒语。

604459.oracleText: "Would you like a song of wing-wind and fire, or one of gentle heartbeats atop a golden hoard?"
604459.translation: 「你是想听一曲翼风烈火交织的激情乐曲，还是坐拥金银财宝的抒情小调？」

604460.oracleText: You may cast Dragon spells from the top of your library.
604460.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶施放龙咒语。

604463.oracleText: Somehow, he never seems to run out of fresh meat.
604463.translation: 不知为何，他的鲜肉从来未曾缺货。

604464.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, double the power of each Dragon you control until end of turn.
604464.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将每个由你操控之龙的力量加倍直到回合结束。

604467.oracleText: They walk the Path of the Kensei with perfect balance.
604467.translation: 他以绝对平衡完美通过剑圣之途。

604470.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, exile up to one target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
604470.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，放逐至多一个目标由你操控的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

604473.oracleText: Each creature you control with a mana ability gets +2/+2.
604473.translation: 每个由你操控且具法术力异能的生物均得+2/+2。

604474.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a mana ability attacks, untap it.
604474.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具法术力异能的生物攻击时，将它重置。

604475.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if at least seven mana was spent to cast it, untap target creature. It gets +7/+7 and gains trample until end of turn.
604475.translation: 每当你施放咒语，若施放它时支付过至少七点法术力，则重置目标生物。直到回合结束，它得+7/+7且获得践踏异能。

604478.oracleText: Whenever an enchanted creature attacks one of your opponents, it gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
604478.translation: 每当一个受有灵气的生物攻击你的任一对手时，直到回合结束，它得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。

604479.oracleText: Whenever an Aura you control is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, exile it. Until the end of your next turn, you may cast that card.
604479.translation: 每当一个由你操控的灵气从战场进入你的坟墓场时，将它放逐。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

604482.oracleText: Feed — Target opponent loses life equal to the amount of life they lost this turn.
604482.translation: 相食～目标对手失去若干生命，其数量等同于他本回合中失去过的生命数量。

604483.oracleText: Feed — Target opponent loses life equal to the amount of life they lost this turn.
604483.translation: 相食～目标对手失去若干生命，其数量等同于他本回合中失去过的生命数量。

604484.oracleText: Friends — You gain life equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
604484.translation: 相伴～你获得若干生命，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

604485.oracleText: Friends — You gain life equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
604485.translation: 相伴～你获得若干生命，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

604487.oracleText:
At the beginning of your end step, choose one — 
• Feed — Target opponent loses life equal to the amount of life they lost this turn. 
• Friends — You gain life equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
604487.translation:
在你的结束步骤开始时，选择一项～ 
•相食～目标对手失去若干生命，其数量等同于他本回合中失去过的生命数量。 
•相伴～你获得若干生命，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

604489.oracleText: Better the cold night than her warm hospitality.
604489.translation: 宁可置身寒夜，也不要接受她的热情。

604490.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice up to three permanents: If there were three or more card types among the sacrificed permanents, each opponent loses 3 life, you gain 3 life, and you draw three cards.
604490.translation: {oT}，牺牲至多三个永久物：如果所牺牲的永久物中包括三种或更多牌张类别，则每位对手各失去3点生命，你获得3点生命，且你抓三张牌。

604494.oracleText: When the last time counter is removed from this card, if it's exiled, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste until end of turn.
604494.translation: 当从此牌上移去最后一个计时指示物时，若它已放逐，则你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。若你以此法施放生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

604495.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand and put a number of time counters on it equal to its mana value. It gains "When the last time counter is removed from this card, if it's exiled, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste until end of turn." Then remove a time counter from each other card you own in exile.
604495.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后从你手上放逐一张牌，并在其上放置若干计时指示物，其数量等同于其法术力值。它获得「当从此牌上移去最后一个计时指示物时，若它已放逐，则你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。若你以此法施放生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。」然后从放逐区中每张由你拥有的其他牌上各移去一个计时指示物。

604498.oracleText: Other Demons, Devils, Imps, and Tieflings you control get +1/+1 and have lifelink.
604498.translation: 由你操控的其他恶魔、魔鬼、小恶魔和魔人得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

604503.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact creature: Create two Treasure tokens.
604503.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器生物：派出两个珍宝衍生物。

604504.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a noncreature artifact: Create two 1/1 colorless Construct artifact creature tokens.
604504.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个非生物的神器：派出两个1/1无色组构体衍生神器生物。

604506.oracleText:
"Of course I know what ‘eponymous' means! It's a little horse."
—Krizz, gate guard
604506.translation:
「我当然知道『以他为名』是什么意思！但这不是以他之门啊。」
～城门守卫克力兹

604507.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of other Gates you control.
604507.translation: {o2}，{oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为由你操控之其他门的数量。

604509.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. When you do, put X +1/+1 counters on each of up to two target creatures, where X is the result.
604509.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。当你如此作时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为掷骰结果。

604511.translation: 历时英雄明斯克与布布

604515.oracleText: Put three +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature with trample or haste.
604515.translation: 在至多一个目标具践踏或敏捷异能的生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

604516.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature. When you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to any target, where X is that creature's power. If the sacrificed creature was a Hamster, draw X cards.
604516.translation: 牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为该生物的力量。如果所牺牲的生物是仓鼠，则抓X张牌。

604518.oracleText: Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes can be your commander.
604518.translation: 历时英雄明斯克与布布可用作指挥官。

604520.oracleText:
"I alone am worthy to decide where lightning strikes."
—Hekaton, storm giant king
604520.translation:
「我独自一人就能决定闪电落向何处。」
～风暴巨人王赫卡顿

604523.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. Draw cards equal to the result. You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
604523.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。抓等同于掷骰结果的牌。在本盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌数量没有上限。

604526.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. You create a number of 1/1 blue Faerie Dragon creature tokens with flying equal to the result.
604526.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。你派出若干1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵／龙衍生生物，其数量等同于掷骰结果。

604529.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. You create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the result.
604529.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。你派出若干珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于掷骰结果。

604538.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is attached to a creature, you don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
604538.translation: 只要CARDNAME贴附在某生物上，你便不会因总生命为0或更少而输掉这盘游戏。

604540.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, draw a card and reveal it. The creature gets +X/+X until end of turn and you lose X life, where X is that card's mana value.
604540.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，抓一张牌并展示之。该生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，且你失去X点生命，X为该牌的法术力值。

604542.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. When you do, put any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control, where X is the result.
604542.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。当你如此作时，将任意数量的目标生物牌从坟墓场在你操控下放进战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于X，X为掷骰结果。

604545.oracleText: Smoke clogged the streets and rubble littered the ground, but sunlight shining on the long-lost towers of Elturel was still a beautiful sight.
604545.translation: 虽然街道依旧黑烟滚滚、瓦砾遍地，但能重见阳光洒在失落已久的埃尔托瑞尔高塔之上，此等美景仍令人欣慰。

604546.oracleText: Return all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Exile CARDNAME.
604546.translation: 将所有法术力值等于或小于X的生物和鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。放逐CARDNAME。

604547.oracleText: Return all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Exile Ascend from Avernus.
604547.translation: 将所有法术力值等于或小于X的生物和鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。放逐突破禽绝地狱。

604549.oracleText: Equipped creature has base power and toughness 10/10.
604549.translation: 佩带此武具的生物之基础力量和防御力为10/10。

604550.oracleText: Equip {o10}. This ability costs {oX} less to activate, where X is the power of the creature it targets.
604550.translation: 佩带{o10}。此异能减少{oX}来起动，X是为此异能目标之生物的力量。

604552.oracleText: Every veteran adventurer will tell you to stick with your party, because the ones who split up aren't around to give advice.
604552.translation: 所有资深冒险者都告诫你要整团一起行动，因为分团行动的人都无法再提供建议了。

604553.oracleText: Each player chooses a party from among creatures they control, then sacrifices the rest.
604553.translation: 每位牌手各从由其操控的生物中选出一个冒险团，然后牺牲其余生物。

604556.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. If it's a permanent spell, the copy gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this permanent."
604556.translation: 每当你从放逐区施放咒语时，将其复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。如果它是永久物咒语，则该复制品获得敏捷与「在结束步骤开始时，牺牲此永久物。」

604557.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. If it's a permanent spell, the copy gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this permanent." (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
604557.translation: 每当你从放逐区施放咒语时，将其复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。如果它是永久物咒语，则该复制品获得敏捷与「在结束步骤开始时，牺牲此永久物。」（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

604559.oracleText: Sell Contraband — Create a Treasure token. You lose 1 life.
604559.translation: 出售禁品～派出一个珍宝衍生物。你失去1点生命。

604560.oracleText: Sell Contraband — Create a Treasure token. You lose 1 life.
604560.translation: 出售禁品～派出一个珍宝衍生物。你失去1点生命。

604562.oracleText: Buy Information — Draw a card. You lose 2 life.
604562.translation: 买通消息～抓一张牌。你失去2点生命。

604563.oracleText: Buy Information — Draw a card. You lose 2 life.
604563.translation: 买通消息～抓一张牌。你失去2点生命。

604565.oracleText: Hire a Mercenary — Create a 3/2 colorless Shapeshifter creature token with changeling. You lose 3 life.
604565.translation: 雇用佣兵～派出一个3/2无色，具化形异能的变形兽衍生生物。你失去3点生命。

604566.oracleText: Hire a Mercenary — Create a 3/2 colorless Shapeshifter creature token with changeling. You lose 3 life.
604566.translation: 雇用佣兵～派出一个3/2无色，具化形异能的变形兽衍生生物。你失去3点生命。

604572.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player may pay {o2}. If they do, they put a rope counter on a creature they control. Otherwise, exile CARDNAME and each creature without a rope counter on it, then remove all rope counters from all creatures.
604572.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，该牌手可以支付{o2}。若他如此作，则他在一个由其操控的生物上放置一个绳索指示物。若否，则放逐CARDNAME和每个其上没有绳索指示物的生物，然后移去所有生物上的所有绳索指示物。

604575.oracleText: Quenton barely had a second to admire his exquisite handsomeness before reality collapsed around him.
604575.translation: 昆顿还未来得及欣赏自己帅气的外表，周围的实界便开始坍塌。

604578.oracleText: Some patriars pay massive sums for exotic pets that can give their posh, predictable lives an edge of danger.
604578.translation: 有些贵族舍得花上大钱来购买珍奇宠物，好在自己奢华而一成不变的生活中体会些许危险。

604581.oracleText: "May Lady Luck smile upon you some other day, pal."
604581.translation: 「愿幸运女神改日再对你微笑，朋友。」

604582.oracleText: Sleight of Hand — {o8}: Draw two cards.

604584.oracleText: The wyrmling studied the ancient carvings and dreamed of a day when her own exploits would be immortalized in stone.
604584.translation: 雏龙正在研读古代雕文，梦想有一天她自己的成就也能永久留在石中。

604585.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you control a Dragon.
604585.translation: 如果你操控龙，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

604587.oracleText: For most, deadly. For a dragon, decadent.
604587.translation: 对多数人：致命威胁。对龙族同类：颓废败类。

604591.oracleText: "In the name of Tempus, Lord of Battles, you will die honorably in righteous fire."
604591.translation: 「以战斗之主坦帕斯之名，你将在正义火焰中光荣赴死。」

604592.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each non-Dragon creature.
604592.translation: CARDNAME对每个非龙生物各造成2点伤害。

604593.oracleText: Breath Weapon deals 2 damage to each non-Dragon creature.
604593.translation: 喷息武器对每个非龙生物各造成2点伤害。

604596.oracleText: A serpent's cruelty, a dragon's appetite.

604597.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or less.
604597.translation: CARDNAME不能被力量等于或小于3的生物阻挡。

604600.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature and untap it. It gains hexproof until end of turn.
604600.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物并重置它。它获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

604605.oracleText: Natural Recovery — When CARDNAME dies, return target land card from your graveyard to your hand.
604605.translation: 自然恢复～当CARDNAME死去时，将目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

604610.oracleText: When your pack is nowhere to be found, you form a new one.
604610.translation: 当你找不到自己的熊群时，你会重组一群。

604611.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if creatures you control have total power 8 or greater, draw a card.
604611.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若由你操控之生物的力量总和等于或大于8，则抓一张牌。

604616.oracleText: In her dream, Lola gazed into a mirror. Her familiar features warped, her jaw stretching wider and wider until it cracked and her reflection pulled her into its gaping maw.
604616.translation: 在梦境里面，萝拉凝视镜中。她原本熟悉的相貌扭曲变形，下巴越拉越开直至裂开，最终整个映像将她拉入血盆巨口之中。

604618.oracleText: As long as there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME has menace and deathtouch.
604618.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，CARDNAME便具有威慑与死触异能。

604627.oracleText: To these fiends, there's no symphony more beautiful than the melodies of rattling chains and ripping flesh.
604627.translation: 在这些邪魔耳中，锁链抖动的清脆响音配以皮肉撕裂的奇妙声效便是最美妙的交响乐。

604632.oracleText: The bell's unearthly chime slips into the ears of the dead, waking them rudely from their eternal slumber.
604632.translation: 异界钟声闯入亡者耳中，将它们从永眠当中粗鲁唤醒。

604633.oracleText: {o3oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
604633.translation: {o3oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

604636.oracleText: First discovered in ancient Netheril, chardalyn stones absorb and hold magical energy, enabling constructs to be infused with fearsome power and unnatural malice.
604636.translation: 卡达林魔晶最早是在远古的耐瑟瑞尔帝国领地上被人发现。这类晶石能够吸收并储存魔法能量，从而让构装生物拥有恐怖力量与超凡恶意。

604637.oracleText: Charting the Spine of the World is best left to the disposable.
604637.translation: 绘制世界之脊地图的工作，最好还是交给用完就丢的东西。

604642.oracleText: The strongest golems are forged from meteoric iron that has been tempered in the heat of an elemental plane.
604642.translation: 最强大的魔像，都是由经元素位面高热淬火的陨铁打造而成。

604644.oracleText:
"How about the power of silent flight? Does that suit your needs, cutthroat?"
—Rivalen Blackhand, proprietor of Sorcerous Sundries
604644.translation:
「能够安静飞翔的能力如何？这是你想要的吗，割喉客？」
～巫术百杂店主瑞瓦伦黑手

604646.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked as long as you've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
604646.translation: 只要你本回合中施放过非生物咒语，CARDNAME便不能被阻挡。

604650.oracleText: Their only mistake was giving the bard time to speak.
604650.translation: 他们唯一的失误，便是让吟游诗人有时间开口。

604651.oracleText: Stall for Time — Tap up to three target creatures.
604651.translation: 拖延时间～横置至多三个目标生物。

604653.oracleText: Call for Aid — Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
604653.translation: 呼叫帮手～派出三个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

604655.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Stall for Time — Tap up to three target creatures. 
• Call for Aid — Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
604655.translation:
选择一项～ 
•拖延时间～横置至多三个目标生物。 
•呼叫帮手～派出三个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

604657.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0 and has reach.
604657.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0且具有延势异能。

604658.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature is dealt damage, it deals damage equal to its power to target player or planeswalker.
604658.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物受到伤害时，它对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成等同于其力量的伤害。

604660.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each Equipment attached to it.
604660.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于贴附于其上的武具数量。

604662.oracleText: {o1}, Remove all +1/+1 counters from Catti-brie: It deals X damage to target attacking or blocking creature an opponent controls, where X is the number of counters removed this way.
604662.translation: {o1}，从凯蒂布莉儿上移去所有+1/+1指示物：它对目标由对手操控且进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成X点伤害，X为以此法移去的指示物数量。

604664.oracleText: Emerald dragons hate prying eyes, and they have a host of ways to deter them.
604664.translation: 翡翠龙讨厌被人窥视，且它们有多种方式来驱散。

604666.oracleText: Counter target activated or triggered ability from a noncreature source.
604666.translation: 反击目标来源为非生物的起动式或触发式异能。

604673.oracleText: "Get the remaining citizens to safety! These miscreants have an appointment with my spear."
604673.translation: 「把剩下的民众带到安全地带！这帮恶徒是想要会一会我的长矛。」

604676.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create two Treasure tokens.
604676.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出两个珍宝衍生物。

604677.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice X Treasures: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
604677.translation: {oB}，牺牲X个珍宝：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

604679.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks or blocks, it and Zombies you control gain deathtouch until end of turn.
604679.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击或阻挡时，它和由你操控的灵俑均获得死触异能直到回合结束。

604680.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, create that many 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
604680.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出等量的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

604682.oracleText: "You are safest in Candlekeep, Abdel, but I cannot keep you from the world forever."
604682.translation: 「阿波戴尔，你待在烛堡里最为安全，但我也不能让你永远与世隔绝。」

604683.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure spell, you may copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
604683.translation: 每当你施放历险咒语时，你可以将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

604685.oracleText: Mystic Arcanum — At the beginning of your end step, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
604685.translation: 玄奥秘法～在你的结束步骤开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

604687.oracleText: Pact Boon — Whenever you play a card from exile, create a Treasure token.
604687.translation: 魔契之赐～每当你从放逐区使用牌时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

604690.oracleText: You may cast Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard spells from the top of your library.
604690.translation: 你可以从你牌库顶施放僧侣、浪客、战士和法术师咒语。

604691.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you have a full party, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and those creatures gain deathtouch until end of turn.
604691.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你的冒险团满编，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物且这些生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

604693.oracleText:
"What's softer than silk, stronger than steel, and quieter than thought?"
—Warlock riddle
604693.translation:
「何物软过丝绸，硬过坚钢，静过思绪？」
～邪术师谜语

604694.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible.
604694.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

604696.oracleText: Travel the world without ever leaving the comfort of home.
604696.translation: 不出家门，就能环游世界。

604697.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
604697.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或门牌，展示这些牌，将一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

604700.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
604700.translation: {o4}，{oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则你可以将它置于你的牌库底。

604701.oracleText: To understand Baldur's Gate, one must first understand how wealth and commerce shape every facet of life.
604701.translation: 要想了解博德之门，就得从了解财富与商业如何影响生活的每个面向开始。

604703.oracleText: She channels myth and memory into waves of deadly arcane force.
604703.translation: 她通联传说与回忆，将其交织为络绎不绝的致命奥术之力。

604704.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure or Dragon spell, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target that isn't a commander.
604704.translation: 每当你施放历险咒语或龙咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个不为指挥官的目标造成伤害，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

604708.oracleText: Though her words may be unoriginal, her creations are anything but.
604708.translation: 她说的话可能是老调重弹，但她的造物总是充满新意。

604720.oracleText: When this creature specializes, seek three nonland permanent cards. Choose one of those cards and shuffle the rest into your library.
604720.translation: 当此生物精进时，取出三张非地永久物牌。选择其中一张，并将其余的牌洗入你的牌库。

604722.oracleText: When this creature specializes, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
604722.translation: 当此生物精进时，派出两个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

604726.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, create a 4/4 green Ox creature token.
604726.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，派出一个4/4绿色牛衍生生物。

604728.translation: 吉斯洋基战士莱埃泽尔

604731.oracleText: When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may exile this creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
604731.translation: 当此生物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以放逐此生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

604732.oracleText: When you cast this spell, it gains "When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may exile this creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control."
604732.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，它获得「当此生物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以放逐此生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。」

604749.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more other creatures with flying, you gain twice that much life.
604749.translation: 每当你以一个或数个具飞行异能的其他生物攻击时，你获得两倍于该数量的生命。

604751.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more other creatures with flying, draw that many cards, then discard a card.
604751.translation: 每当你以一个或数个具飞行异能的其他生物攻击时，抓等量的牌，然后弃一张牌。

604756.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more other creatures with flying, create that many 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
604756.translation: 每当你以一个或数个具飞行异能的其他生物攻击时，派出等量的1/1白色士兵衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

604758.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more other creatures with flying, those creatures get +2/+2 until end of turn.
604758.translation: 每当你以一个或数个具飞行异能的其他生物攻击时，这些生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

604764.oracleText: When this creature specializes, target creature card exiled with this creature perpetually loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 1/1.
604764.translation: 当此生物精进时，目标以此生物放逐的生物牌永久失去所有异能，且基础力量与防御力为1/1。

604766.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create two 1/1 blue Faerie Dragon creature tokens with flying.
604766.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出两个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵／龙衍生生物。

604769.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 4/1 black Skeleton creature token with menace.
604769.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个4/1黑色，具威慑异能的骷髅妖衍生生物。

604772.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
604772.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出三个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

604775.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create two 2/2 green Boar creature tokens.
604775.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出两个2/2绿色野猪衍生生物。

604800.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 white Pegasus creature token with flying.
604800.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的飞马衍生生物。

604802.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card, then discard a card.
604802.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

604804.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, each opponent loses 2 life.
604804.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，每位对手各失去2点生命。

604806.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME perpetually gains "Creatures you control get +1/+0."
604806.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME永久获得「由你操控的生物得+1/+0。」

604809.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
604809.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

604816.oracleText: Whenever Imoen deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
604816.translation: 每当爱蒙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。若你如此作，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

604819.oracleText: Whenever Imoen deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
604819.translation: 每当爱蒙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。当你如此作时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

604822.oracleText: Whenever Imoen deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
604822.translation: 每当爱蒙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

604825.oracleText: Whenever Imoen deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, Imoen deals 2 damage to each opponent.
604825.translation: 每当爱蒙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。若你如此作，则爱蒙向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

604828.oracleText: Whenever Imoen deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card and you may play an additional land this turn.
604828.translation: 每当爱蒙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌，且本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

604830.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card. Put a study counter on CARDNAME.
604830.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。在CARDNAME上放置一个读书指示物。

604845.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
604845.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

604847.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains first strike and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
604847.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得先攻异能且得+X/+0，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

604849.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature, instant, and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
604849.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中生物、瞬间和法术牌的数量加总。

604851.oracleText: When this creature specializes, seek a creature card and put it into your graveyard, then conjure two duplicates of it into your graveyard.
604851.translation: 当此生物精进时，取出一张生物牌并将它置入你的坟墓场，然后将该牌的两张副本幻变进你的坟墓场。

604853.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains menace and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
604853.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得威慑异能且得+X/+0，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

604855.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains trample and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
604855.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

604858.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each player.
604858.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，CARDNAME对每位牌手各造成1点伤害。

604862.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.
604862.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，你派出一个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

604865.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, draw a card.
604865.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，抓一张牌。

604870.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, Shadowheart deals that much damage to each opponent.
604870.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，影心向每位对手各造成等量的伤害。

604873.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, Shadowheart deals 1 damage to each player.
604873.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，影心对每位牌手各造成1点伤害。

604874.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Shadowheart.
604874.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，在影心上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

604888.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards.
604888.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓两张牌。

604891.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards. If you do, other creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
604891.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓两张牌。若你如此作，则由你操控的其他生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中所弃的牌数量。

604894.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may discard your hand and draw three cards.
604894.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓三张牌。

604897.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards. When you do, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
604897.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓两张牌。当你如此作时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中所弃的牌数量。

604903.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards. When you do, put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
604903.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓两张牌。当你如此作时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你本回合中所弃的牌数量。

604943.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you may sacrifice another creature or an artifact. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. If its mana value is 4 or greater, sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
604943.translation: 当此生物精进时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。如果其法术力值等于或大于4，则在你的下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

604945.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you may sacrifice another creature or an artifact. When you do, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
604945.translation: 当此生物精进时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。当你如此作时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

604947.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you may sacrifice another creature or an artifact. When you do, draw three cards unless target opponent pays 5 life.
604947.translation: 当此生物精进时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。当你如此作时，除非目标对手支付5点生命，否则你抓三张牌。

604949.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you may sacrifice another creature or an artifact. If you do, untap CARDNAME. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase.
604949.translation: 当此生物精进时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。若你如此作，则重置CARDNAME。在此行动阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段，以及接于其后之一个额外的行动阶段。

604952.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you may sacrifice another creature or an artifact. If you do, CARDNAME perpetually gets +3/+3 and gains trample.
604952.translation: 当此生物精进时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。如果你如此作，则CARDNAME永久得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。

604955.oracleText: "The Harpers' movement grows, but it needs sunlight to blossom. We can be that light."
604955.translation: 「虽然竖琴手同盟势力在发展壮大，但也需要阳光才能开花结果。我们能成为这缕阳光。」

604958.oracleText: When this creature specializes, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment. Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two other target creatures.
604958.translation: 当此生物精进时，消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。在至多两个其他目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

604960.oracleText: When this creature specializes, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment. Scry 2.
604960.translation: 当此生物精进时，消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。占卜2。

604962.oracleText: When this creature specializes, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment. Each opponent loses 3 life.
604962.translation: 当此生物精进时，消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。每位对手各失去3点生命。

604967.oracleText: When this creature specializes, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment. You gain 4 life.
604967.translation: 当此生物精进时，消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。你获得4点生命。

604974.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it unspecializes. If it unspecializes this way, return it to the battlefield tapped.
604974.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它失去精进。如果它以此法失去精进，则将它横置移回战场。

604978.oracleText: When this creature specializes, tap target nonland permanent an opponent controls. That permanent doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control CARDNAME.
604978.translation: 当此生物精进时，横置目标由对手操控的非地永久物。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，该永久物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

604979.oracleText: When Lukamina dies, it unspecializes. If it unspecializes this way, return it to the battlefield tapped.
604979.translation: 当卢卡米娜死去时，它失去精进。如果它以此法失去精进，则将它横置移回战场。

604988.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+1 and have trample.
604988.translation: 由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

605027.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent loses 3 life unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent or discards a card.
605027.translation: 在你的维持开始时，对每位对手而言，除非该牌手牺牲一个非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则失去3点生命。

605028.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent discards a card.
605028.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每位对手各弃一张牌。

605030.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 black Skeleton creature token.
605030.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出一个1/1黑色骷髅妖衍生生物。

605031.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-1 until your next turn.
605031.translation: 在你的维持开始时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-1直到你的下一个回合。

605034.translation: 由你操控的邪术师具有「守护～支付2点生命。」

605037.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent mills five cards. Then exile each opponent's graveyard.
605037.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每位对手各磨五张牌。然后放逐所有对手的坟墓场。

605038.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
605038.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

605040.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 2.
605040.translation: 在你的维持开始时，占卜2。

605041.oracleText:
"Hasn't she heard of knocking?!"
—Snerd, Flaming Fist guard
605041.translation:
「她难道不晓得要先敲门吗？！」
～焰拳佣兵守卫丝讷德

605046.oracleText: Seek two instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3.
605046.translation: 取出两张法术力值等于3的瞬间和／或法术牌。

605047.oracleText: Put one of them onto the battlefield?
605047.translation: 是否要将其中之一放进战场？

605048.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} nontoken permanent.} other {Target {2, Number} nontoken permanents.}}
605048.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定{2, Number}个非地永久物为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}个非地永久物为目标。}}

605049.oracleText: Choose a card revealed this way.
605049.translation: 选择以依法展示的一张牌。

605050.oracleText: Seek {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} nonland card} other {{2, Number} nonland cards}}.
605050.translation: 取出{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}张非地牌} other {{2, Number}张非地牌}}。

605052.translation: 指定至多三个神器为目标。

605053.oracleText: Seek a creature card with mana value 3 or less.
605053.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。

605054.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value equal to the number of flame counters on it.
605054.translation: 取出一张法术力值等同于其上烈焰指示物数量的牌。

605057.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Seek {2, Number} creature, enchantment, or planeswalker card.} other {Seek {2, Number} creature, enchantment, and/or planeswalker cards.}}
605057.translation: {2, plural, =1 {取出{2, Number}张生物、结界或鹏洛客牌。} other {取出{2, Number}张生物、结界和／或鹏洛客牌。}}

605060.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: A Dragon Creature Spell
605060.translation: 用于支付以下费用时有额外效应：龙生物咒语

605061.oracleText: When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, scry 2.
605061.translation: 当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，占卜2。

605063.oracleText: When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, you gain 2 life.
605063.translation: 当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，你获得2点生命。

605066.translation: 是否要牺牲一个或数个珍宝？

605067.oracleText: Target up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} creature} other {{2, Number} creatures}}.
605067.translation: 指定至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个生物} other {{2, Number}个生物}}为目标。

605068.oracleText: Target up to five permanent cards.
605068.translation: 指定至多五张永久物牌为目标。

605069.oracleText: Target any number of tapped nontoken creatures.
605069.translation: 指定任意数量已横置且非衍生物的生物为目标。

605070.oracleText: Target up to one nonland permanent you control.
605070.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的非地永久物为目标。

605071.oracleText: Return a creature card milled this way to your hand.
605071.translation: 将一张以此法磨掉的生物牌移回你手上。

605073.oracleText: Put X +1/+1 counters on each of up to two target creatures, where X is the result.
605073.translation: 在至多两个目标生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为掷骰结果。

605074.oracleText: Target up to one creature with trample or haste.
605074.translation: 指定至多一个具践踏或敏捷异能的生物为目标。

605077.oracleText: Put any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control, where X is the result.
605077.translation: 将任意数量的目标生物牌从坟墓场在你操控下放进战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于X，X为掷骰结果。

605078.oracleText: Put one of those cards cards onto the battlefield. The other will go into your hand.
605078.translation: 将该些牌中的一张放进战场。其余的牌将置于你手上。

605079.oracleText: Target an activated or triggered ability from a noncreature source.
605079.translation: 指定一个起动式或触发式异能为目标，其来源须为非生物。

605085.oracleText: Target up to one attacking creature.
605085.translation: 指定至多一个进行攻击的生物为目标。

605091.oracleText: Put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is the number of cards you have discarded this turn.
605091.translation: 在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你本回合中弃掉牌的数量。

605092.oracleText: Target an artifact or creature an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less.
605092.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且其法术力值等于或小于4的神器或生物为目标。

605094.oracleText: Seek a land card with a basic land type.
605094.translation: 取出一张具基本地类别的地牌。

605100.oracleText: Put a rope counter on a creature they control.

If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. If X is 10 or more, copy each of those spells twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.

606515.oracleText: You may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
606515.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌。如果该牌将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。

607275.oracleText: You may cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
607275.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标红色瞬间或法术牌。如果该咒语将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

608902.oracleText: Return target creature card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped?

608904.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you have no other creature cards in hand or if the only other creature cards in your hand are named Mothrider Cavalry.
608904.translation: 如果你手上没有其他生物牌或你手上的其他生物牌名称均为翔蛾骑兵，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

608906.oracleText: Target any number of other creatures controlled by different players.

608907.oracleText: Search for a creature card that is exactly that many colors plus one.
608907.translation: 搜寻一张颜色种数正好为该数量加一的生物牌。

608909.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the total mana value of Dragons you control not named Earthquake Dragon.
608909.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为由你操控且名称不为地震巨龙之龙的法术力值总和。

608911.translation: 炼-历时英雄明斯克与布布

610402.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature an opponent controls with power less than or equal to the number of Warriors and Equipment you control can't block this turn.
610402.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于由你操控之战士和武具数量加总的生物。该生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

610405.oracleText: Target Warrior gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
610405.translation: 直到回合结束，目标战士得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

610406.oracleText: Target Warrior gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
610406.translation: 直到回合结束，目标战士得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

610410.oracleText: Other Warriors you control get +1/+1 and have ward {o1}.
610410.translation: 由你操控的其他战士得+1/+1且具有守护{o1}。

610412.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张战士和／或武具牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

610413.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to twice the number of Warriors and Equipment you control.
610413.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之战士与武具数量加总的两倍。

610475.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with power less than or equal to the number of Warriors and Equipment you control.

610782.oracleText: Whenever you conjure one or more cards, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
610782.translation: 每当你幻变一张或数张牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

610785.oracleText:
Whenever CARDNAME attacks or dies, choose two. Each mode must target a different player.

每当CARDNAME攻击或死去时，选择两项。每项均须以不同的牌手为目标。

610788.oracleText: When Kardum dies, put all cards you own exiled with it into your hand. At the beginning of the end step of your next turn, discard those cards.
610788.translation: 当炎魔领主卡尔杜姆死去时，将所有以它放逐且由你拥有的牌置于你手上。在你下一回合的结束步骤开始时，弃等量的牌。

610795.oracleText: Target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal three creature cards. Put those cards onto the battlefield under your control. That player puts the rest into their graveyard.

610811.oracleText: When this creature specializes, remove all study counters from it. When you do, distribute that many +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures.

612836.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，目标由你操控的生物之基础力量为3直到回合结束。

612838.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove two book counters from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
612838.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去两个书籍指示物：抓一张牌。

614150.oracleText: {o0}: Attach target Equipment you control to target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
614150.translation: {o0}：将目标由你操控的武具贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。只能于法术时机起动，且每回合限一次。

614264.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate cost {o1} less to activate.
614264.translation: 你起动的佩带异能减少{o1}来起动。

614429.oracleText: Tap an untapped creature you control?
614429.translation: 是否要横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物？

614431.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}: Draft a card from Celestial Vault's spellbook and exile it face down.
614431.translation: {oW}，{oT}：从天界贮窖的法术书中抽选一张牌，并牌面朝下地放逐之。

614441.oracleText: No backroom deal is ever truly secure.
614441.translation: 没有幕后交易才真正安全。

614444.oracleText: Seek two cards. You may shuffle them into your library. If you do, seek two cards.
614444.translation: 取出两张牌。你可以将它们洗入你的牌库。若你如此作，则取出两张牌。

614450.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice a non-Demon creature.
614450.translation: 你可以牺牲一个非恶魔的生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

614454.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls perpetually gets -0/-3.
614454.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物永久得-0/-3。

614457.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control die, draft a card from Xander's Wake's spellbook. This ability triggers only once each turn.
614457.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的生物死去时，从尚夺尔守夜式的法术书中抽选一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

614459.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control become blocked, create a Treasure token.
614459.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物被阻挡时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

614460.oracleText: Sacrifice two artifacts: Draft a card from Big Spender's spellbook.
614460.translation: 牺牲两个神器：从挥金狂徒的法术书中抽选一张牌。

614466.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It perpetually gains haste, "This creature can't block," and "At the beginning of your upkeep, this creature deals 1 damage to you."
614466.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它永久获得敏捷异能、「此生物不能进行阻挡」和「在你的维持开始时，此生物对你造成1点伤害。」

614468.oracleText: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand. If it's a creature card, it perpetually gets +3/+3.
614468.translation: 将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。若它是生物牌，则它永久得+3/+3。

614472.oracleText: {o3}: Until end of turn, enchanted land becomes a copy of the exiled card, except it's a land in addition to its other types and it has haste.
614472.translation: {o3}：直到回合结束，所结附的地成为所放逐之牌的复制品，但它额外具有地此类别，且获得敏捷异能。

614475.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell that doesn't share a creature type with a creature card in your library, draw a card.
614475.translation: 每当你施放与你牌库中生物牌不具共通生物类别的生物咒语时，抓一张牌。

614477.oracleText: For the Cabaretti, everything is a party.
614477.translation: 对乐舞会人来说，一切都像是一场聚会。

614482.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the bottom creature card of your library. You may cast that card this turn. At the beginning of the next end step, if that card is still exiled, put it into your graveyard and create a Treasure token.
614482.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你牌库底的生物牌。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。在下一个结束步骤开始时，如果该牌仍被放逐，则将它置入你的坟墓场并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

614486.oracleText: If there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, draft a card from Bind to Secrecy's spellbook.
614486.translation: 如果你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，从强令守密的法术书中抽选一张牌。

614491.oracleText: "What are we celebrating? Join us and find out!"
614491.translation: 「我们在庆祝什么？ 加入我们就知道啦！」

614492.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, seek a creature card with lesser mana value, then put it onto the battlefield.
614492.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，取出一张法术力值比该咒语小的生物牌，然后将它放进战场。

614498.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create an X/X green Ooze creature token, where X is this card's power. Activate only as a sorcery.
614498.translation: {o2}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个X/X绿色流浆衍生生物，X为此牌的力量。只能于法术时机起动。

614499.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice CARDNAME or another creature, it perpetually gains "{o2}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create an X/X green Ooze creature token, where X is this card's power. Activate only as a sorcery."
614499.translation: 每当你牺牲CARDNAME或另一个生物时，它永久获得「{o2}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个X/X绿色流浆衍生生物，X为此牌的力量。只能于法术时机起动。」

614520.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each shield counter among other creatures you control.
614520.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，由你操控的其他生物上每有一个后盾指示物，CARDNAME便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

614529.translation: 是否要将它们洗入你的牌库？

614530.translation: 是否要牺牲一个非恶魔的生物？

614532.oracleText: Target a nonartifact creature you control.
614532.translation: 指定一个由你操控的非神器生物为目标。

614533.oracleText: Seek a creature card with lesser mana value.
614533.translation: 取出一张法术力值更小的生物牌。

614534.oracleText: Choose up to two creature and/or planeswalker cards in your hand.
614534.translation: 选择你手上至多两张生物和／或鹏洛客牌。

614537.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target card named Pass the Torch from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If you do, this creature perpetually loses this ability.
614537.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标名称为焰炬相传的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你如此作，则此生物永久失去此异能。

614538.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. Choose a creature card in your hand. It perpetually gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target card named Pass the Torch from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If you do, this creature perpetually loses this ability".
614538.translation: CARDNAME对任意目标造成2点伤害。选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标名称为焰炬相传的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你如此作，则此生物永久失去此异能。」

614539.oracleText: Pass the Torch deals 2 damage to any target. Choose a creature card in your hand. It perpetually gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target card named Pass the Torch from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If you do, this creature perpetually loses this ability".
614539.translation: 焰炬相传对任意目标造成2点伤害。选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标名称为焰炬相传的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你如此作，则此生物永久失去此异能。」

614542.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, seek a card that shares a card type with one of the discarded cards. This ability triggers only once each turn.
614542.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，取出一张与其中一张所弃之牌具共通牌张类别的牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

614547.oracleText: Seek a card that shares a card type with one of the discarded cards.
614547.translation: 取出一张与其中一张所弃之牌具共通牌张类别的牌。

614552.translation: 派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

614553.oracleText: Pay any amount of mana. Look at that many cards from the top of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
614553.translation: 支付任意数量的法术力，检视你牌库顶等数量的牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

614554.oracleText: Tap an untapped artifact you control: This emblem deals 1 damage to any target.
614554.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器：此徽记对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

614555.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Tap an untapped artifact you control: This emblem deals 1 damage to any target."
614555.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器：此徽记对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

614558.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast with the chosen name cost {o2} more to cast.
614558.translation: 对手施放之具该名称的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

614559.oracleText: Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name cost {o2} more to activate unless they're mana abilities.
614559.translation: 除法术力异能之外，具有该名称之来源的起动式异能都增加{o2}来起动。

614571.oracleText: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.
614571.translation: 新阿基夫热情接纳了因瑞斯时空覆盖而流离失所的寇族，寇族则以坚贞忠诚回报。

614574.oracleText: To conserve ammunition, Jhoira modified ancient Thran artillery cannons to fire gouts of pure Shivan lava.
614574.translation: 为了节约弹药，尤依拉改造了远古的索蓝火炮，好让它们发射纯粹的西瓦熔岩。

614575.oracleText: Domain — CARDNAME deals X damage to target tapped creature, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
614575.translation: 领土～CARDNAME对目标已横置的生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量加1。

614576.oracleText: Domain — Artillery Blast deals X damage to target tapped creature, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
614576.translation: 领土～火炮爆击对目标已横置的生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量加1。

614578.oracleText: "A single light can hold back endless darkness."
614578.translation: 「单缕明光就能阻挡无尽黑暗。」

614581.oracleText: Even he didn't know what he was until he felt his skin shifting and splitting, his mind overtaken by a chaos of whispers.
614581.translation: 直到感觉皮肤移位撕裂、心智遭混沌细语占据，他甚至自己都不知道其潜藏身份。

614584.oracleText:
"Argivia's walls may run on powerstones, but its real power comes from its people."
—King Darien XLVIII
614584.translation:
「阿基瓦的高墙靠魔力石来运转，但其真正力量来自城中人民。」
～国王达利安四十八世

614586.oracleText: "This battlefield is an anvil, my mace a forging hammer . . . and you, Phyrexian scum, are the scrap metal that's about to be reshaped as I see fit."
614586.translation: 「这战场就是铁砧，我的战锤便是锻锤…至于你，非瑞克西亚败类，就是块任我重塑的铁渣。」

614588.oracleText: "What lurks behind the faces of those you think you can trust?"
614588.translation: 「还不来看看忠厚之人表皮底下是副什么面孔？」

614594.oracleText: Argivia's clockwork fortifications are the stuff of legend, reminding all on Dominaria that ingenuity has saved them before and can do so again.
614594.translation: 阿基瓦的发条工事个个都是传奇，时刻提醒多明纳里亚的所有人：精巧装置曾救过生灵性命，且未来仍可安心仰仗。

614601.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast white permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {oW} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of white mana you pay.
614601.translation: 你可以支付2点生命，以作为施放白色永久物咒语的额外费用。如果你以此法支付生命，则该咒语减少{oW}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的白色法术力数量。

614602.oracleText: Whenever you cast a white permanent spell, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
614602.translation: 每当你施放白色永久物咒语时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

614604.oracleText: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.
614604.translation: 撒拉之美善最常体现为抚触治伤，但也能令邪物仁慈死亡。

614605.oracleText:
Choose one —
