"Feldon's latest discovery appears to draw upon the same ‘memories of the land' my wife studied. How I wish she could see it."
—Writings of Drafna
618959.translation:
「费顿最新的发现成就，似乎是循妻子先前的『大地回忆』研究结果而得。真希望她也能看到。」
～札夫拿的笔记

618960.oracleText:
"A key only unlocks a door. Its wielder must choose whether to cross the threshold."
—Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II
618960.translation:
「钥匙只能打开门锁。持钥人还须决定是否要亲自跨过门槛。」
～《河鼓形上学论》，卷II

618961.oracleText:
"Properly installed, each powerstone emits a targeted electromagnetic field that halts momentum as sure as stone."
—Tome of Obstructions
618961.translation:
「正确安装后，每颗魔力石都会发射指向性的电磁力场，能够确实阻止物体运动。」
～《障法巨著》

618962.oracleText:
"I have re-created a Thran portal at last! Before I inform Lord Urza, I'll test it myself."
—Oryan, Urzan artificer, final research note
618962.translation:
「我终于重建了索蓝境界通道！在通知克撒勋爵之前，我先自己来试一试。」
～克撒军神器师欧赖安，最后的研究纪录

618963.oracleText:
"My husband is clever enough to bottle the sky, and foolish enough to ignore its beauty."
—Queen Kayla bin-Kroog
618963.translation:
「我丈夫聪明绝顶，能够用瓶子装下天空；却又愚蠢至极，无视其间美景。」
～萼城的凯拉皇后

618964.oracleText:
"Delicate resonance detectors could scan the assembly lines for metallic impurities, loose bolts, and freak occurrences of sentience."
—Tawnos, proposal for overseer prototype
618964.translation:
「这批精巧的共振探测器能够用来扫描装配管线，检查金属杂质、松动螺栓和反常感知现象。」
～达硌士，关于试作监督械的提议

618965.oracleText:
"The lotus is a potent but ephemeral source of power. To preserve its potency, lacquer carefully with a conductive coating."
—Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II
618965.translation:
「这莲花是强力能源，但转眼就会耗尽。若要保存效能，务必仔细涂抹传导涂层。」
～《河鼓形上学论》，卷II

618966.oracleText:
"The Sardian dwarves have let superstition override common sense. There's plenty of ore left in the mountain, and we mustn't let it go to waste."
—Last dispatch of Bolgon, Argivian surveyor
618966.translation:
「沙地亚矮人迷信而不从常理。山中尚余许多矿石，决计不能浪费。」
～阿基夫勘探者波尔贡最后的电文

618967.oracleText:
"Should a single drop take hold, the oil begins to consume organic tissue and will multiply until it overwhelms the host."
—Yawgmoth, collected writings
618967.translation:
「只要沾到一滴，烁油就会开始吞噬有机组织、持续增生，最终彻底击垮宿主。」
～约格莫夫，著作集

618968.oracleText:
"In the early days, Urza's wondrous automatons were seen as symbols of hope and courage."
—The Antiquities War
618968.translation:
「早期，克撒的神奇自动机械被当作希望与勇气的象征。」
～《古文明之战》

618969.oracleText:
"Ringed by white stone, Terisia was a city of scholarship and knowledge, where magic promised a brighter future to a world devoured by artifice."
—The Antiquities War
618969.translation:
「泰瑞西亚周遭白石环绕，乃是求学与知识之城，此处的魔法允诺为遭奇械吞噬的世界带来光明未来。」
～《古文明之战》

618970.oracleText:
"These glyphs describe a Thran device capable of controlling a machine army, but the dimensions make no sense. It's nearly the size of the Null Moon."
—Urza, diary
618970.translation:
「这些图符讲述的是能够操控整支机械军队的索蓝装置，但上面写的尺寸并不合理。它就跟虚无之月一般大。」
～克撒，随身日记

618971.oracleText:
"Measure the angles carefully. Note the gauge of the paper. By your sixth birthday, I expect a flying prototype."
—Tawnos, letter to Harbin
618971.translation:
「仔细测量角度。记录纸张厚度。我期望到你六岁生日的时候，能看到一架能飞的试作品。」
～达硌士，写给哈宾的信

618972.oracleText:
"The new prototype utilizing a rotational axis is marvelously effective: it makes me want to tear my own ears off."
—Ashnod, to her assistants
618972.translation:
「这台用旋转轴制成的试作品简直太有效了：我现在恨不得把自己耳朵扯下来。」
～阿士诺告诉助手

618973.oracleText:
"Presented to the Chief Artificer in recognition of his unparalleled service to Yotia."
—Rusted plaque
618973.translation:
「铸物卿身居佑天多年，为国尽心戮力嘉慧良多。特颁此状，谨致谢忱。」
～锈蚀的牌匾

618974.oracleText:
"We've had a breakthrough on the fifth iteration. The subject's skin was entirely replaced within an hour, and he survived a full day after that!"
—Ashnod, to Mishra
618974.translation:
「我们在第五次试验时有了突破。实验对象的皮肤在一小时内就被完全取代，且他在此之后还活了一整天！」
～阿士诺告诉米斯拉

618975.oracleText:
"Progress update: the problem of the slagheap blocking the entrance seems to have solved itself."
—Mine supervisor's report
618975.translation:
「进度更新：矿渣阻挡出入口的问题似乎自行解决了。」
～矿井监工报告

618976.oracleText:
"I now believe the strange orb was some kind of Thran security device. Supporting this theory, I can no longer recall where I found it."
—Tocasia, journal entry
618976.translation:
「我现在相信这颗奇异法珠是某种索蓝安全装置。能佐证这想法的依据是，我已经想不起来是在哪找到它的了。」
～托卡西雅，日志一笔

618977.oracleText:
"In the lean months, communities lived off a bitterwheat berry so tough that its flour contained more millstone than grain."
—On the Early History of Keld
618977.translation:
「在困苦岁月中，民众依靠一种苦麦仁过活。这种麦仁异常坚硬，它经研磨而成的面粉当中，磨石的数量甚至比麦粒还多。」
～《凯尔顿前史》

618978.oracleText:
"I sit and I think of Lat-Nam, of the azure waves white with froth, suspended over the shore. I see the energy there and I call it here."
—Hurkyl, meditation notes
618978.translation:
「我正姿端坐，思绪回到了拉特南学院，脑海净是翻着洁白浪花的碧蓝海浪冲刷滩头的安稳景象。就在其中，我看到了能量所在，于是我将之召唤至此。」
～河鼓，冥思纪录

618979.oracleText:
"The secrets of my great-uncle's heirloom lie in the world where it was forged: the grease-stained wastes of Phyrexia."
—Jarsyl, diary
618979.translation:
「我伯祖父的传世秘密就落在它原本铸造出来的世界：非瑞克西亚满是油污的荒野。」
～贾索，随身日记

618980.oracleText:
"A crystallized moment in time from the Mending Era, first discovered during the Ice Age. A temporal conundrum, even to the great scholar himself."
—The Discoveries of Feldon
618980.translation:
「来自愈合年代的结晶时刻，却是在冰雪时代首先被人发现。这一时间难题，就连伟大学者自己也百思不得其解。」
～《费顿发现录》

618981.oracleText:
"Without Urza's ingenuity, the wings would never have borne weight. Without Mishra's courage, we would never have known the machine's true potential. I hope this persuades them to work together more."
—Tocasia, journal entry
618981.translation:
「倘若没有克撒的才智，翅翼将永不能承重。倘若没有米斯拉的勇气，我们永远无从知晓扑翼机的真正潜能。我希望这一成果能说服他们多加合作。」
～托卡西雅，日志一笔

618982.oracleText:
"As the years passed, Urza turned his focus from the Thran to worlds beyond his own, seeking any spell or technology that might break the Phyrexian scourge."
—Urza: From Prodigy to Planeswalker
618982.translation:
「随着岁月流逝，克撒逐渐超越索蓝放眼其他世界，寻找能够平息非瑞克西亚灾祸的咒文或技术。」
～《克撒：逸展鹏程》

618983.oracleText:
"These skittering creatures were created to hunt the one true threat to Phyrexia: dissent."
—Venser, journal
618983.translation:
「创造这种迅捷生物的真正目的，在于猎捕非瑞克西亚唯一的真正威胁：异见。」
～凡瑟，日志纪录

618984.oracleText:
"Serra built angels from the spirits of fallen warriors, but I believe a more mundane power source might suffice."
—Karn
618984.translation:
「撒拉利用逝去战士的灵魂来塑造天使，但我认为更平凡的力量来源就已足够。」
～卡恩

618985.oracleText:
"A rakalite core paired with a powerstone matrix has significantly increased the healing effects of my original amulet design."
—Urza, research notes
618985.translation:
「拉卡石核心配上魔力石间质，这样就能显著增强我原本护身符设计的疗伤效果。」
～克撒，研究纪录

618986.oracleText:
"Perhaps drawing the impossible monster will lessen the burden my memory must bear."
—Jarsyl, diary
618986.translation:
「也许画出这难喻怪兽，就能够减轻我记忆不得不承受之重。」
～贾索，随身日记

618987.oracleText:
"If powerstones are energy stored in material form, could we store matter as energy in the same way?"
—Rayne, research notes
618987.translation:
「如果魔力石是具形的能量，那我们是否能把物质作为能量储存其中？」
～蕾安，研究纪录

618988.oracleText:
"Harmonic resonance infusions amplify the natural abilities of the song mages of Sumifa."
—Drafna, research notes
618988.translation:
「注入和谐共振后，能够增强苏米法歌法师的自然能力。」
～札夫拿，研究纪录

618989.oracleText:
"Based on his early work with primal clay, Tawnos refined the rare metals in the earth into self-assembling strands."
—After the War
618989.translation:
「达硌士根据他对未塑型黏土的早期研究，将大地中的稀有金属精炼为能够自组成型的丝缕。」
～《战事后记》

618990.oracleText:
"Test 37: Sentience module is still too strong. It's adding ears again."
—Development log of Willa, Yotian artificer
618990.translation:
「测试37：感知模块还是太强。它又在新装耳朵。」
～佑天神器师薇拉的开发日志

618991.oracleText:
"The forges consumed all and still screamed for more."
—The Antiquities War
618991.translation:
「熔炉已然吞噬一切，却还尖啸着索求更多。」
～《古文明之战》

618992.oracleText:
"This war will be over quickly, so we can afford to make the medals out of gold."
—Dispatch from the Merchant Council of Korlis
618992.translation:
「战事不日即息，届时便可用金子铸造徽章。」
～寇利斯行商议会发出的电文

618993.oracleText:
"It is neither the species of leaf nor the thickness of branch that creates music. Gaea's song is already in the drum."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder
618993.translation:
「音乐的来源既非茂叶，亦非繁枝。盖亚之歌早已融于鼓中。」
～西坦努长者盖美伦

618994.oracleText:
"Give the schematic to the younger brother. Tell him that it will surely keep Argoth's resources out of Urza's hands."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor
618994.translation:
「把图解交给弟弟。告诉他这样就能让克撒动不到半分亚格斯的资源。」
～约格莫夫判官基克斯

618995.oracleText:
"Test 12: Boots now protect wearer from all hazards except blisters. Need to source better insoles."
—Development log of Willa, Yotian artificer
618995.translation:
「测试12：现在靴子能够保护穿戴者免受外来伤害，但仍会起水泡。还需要去找更好的内垫。」
～佑天神器师薇拉的开发日志

618996.oracleText:
"The geode must be mined in moonlight and broken open by a silver hammer."
—Tome of Obstructions
618996.translation:
「晶岩须在月光下开采，用银锤方能凿开。」
～《障法巨著》

618997.oracleText:
"Heat from the rotating mechanism is captured and converted into energy, allowing it to operate in perpetuity."
—Rusko's Compendium of Clockwork
618997.translation:
「捕捉回转装置产生的热量并将其转化为能源之后，就能让它永续运行。」
～《鲁斯柯发条学纲要》

618998.oracleText:
"A wish can be controlled. Dreams are far more chaotic, and ungoverned by rationale."
—Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II
618998.translation:
「愿望尚可操控。梦想则更要混沌许多，且不受理性约束。」
～《河鼓形上学论》，卷II

619002.oracleText: Exile a land named Argoth, Sanctum of Nature.
619002.translation: 放逐一个名称为自然圣所亚格斯的地。

619003.oracleText: Exile a creature named Phyrexian Dragon Engine.
619003.translation: 放逐一个名称为非瑞克西亚龙形引擎的生物。

619004.oracleText: Exile an artifact named The Mightstone and Weakstone.
619004.translation: 放逐一个名称为强能石与弱能石的神器。

619011.oracleText: When this card specializes from your graveyard, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield. It perpetually gains "This creature can't block."
619011.translation: 当此牌从你的坟墓场精进时，将它从你的坟墓场移回战场。它永久获得「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

619014.oracleText: When this card specializes from any zone, seek an instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less. Until end of turn, you may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
619014.translation: 当此牌从任何区域精进时，取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

619018.oracleText: When this card specializes from any zone, target creature an opponent controls can't block this turn.
619018.translation: 当此牌从任何区域精进时，目标由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

619020.oracleText: When this card specializes from any zone, another target creature you control gets +4/+4 until end of turn.
619020.translation: 当此牌从任何区域精进时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+4/+4直到回合结束。

619023.oracleText: Seek an instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less.
619023.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌。

619355.translation: 佩带祭师，邪术师或法术师{o1}

619448.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. If you do, a creature of your choice an opponent controls perpetually gets -1/-0.
619448.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该生物移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则由你选择一个由对手操控的生物，其永久得-1/-0。

619449.oracleText: Choose a creature an opponent controls.
619449.translation: 选择一个由对手操控的生物。

619490.oracleText: Target a Shaman , Warlock , or Wizard.
619490.translation: 指定一个祭师、邪术师或法术师为目标。

619554.oracleText: Dragon spells you cast with mana value 5 or greater cost {o1} less to cast.
619554.translation: 由你施放且法术力值等于或大于5的龙咒语减少{o1}来施放。

619588.oracleText: Return up to one creature card and up to one land card to your hand.
619588.translation: 将至多一张生物牌和至多一张地牌移回你手上。

619589.oracleText: Choose any target other than that permanent.
619589.translation: 选择该永久物之外的任意一个目标。

619590.oracleText: Choose any target that isn't a Dragon.
619590.translation: 选择任意一个不为龙的目标。

619591.oracleText: Choose any target that isn't a commander.
619591.translation: 选择任意一个不为指挥官的目标。

619844.oracleText: When this card specializes from any zone, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token. Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain haste until end of turn.
619844.translation: 当此牌从任何区域精进时，派出一个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得敏捷异能。

619848.oracleText: When this card specializes from any zone, you may sacrifice a creature. If you do, you draw two cards and each opponent loses 2 life.
619848.translation: 当此牌从任何区域精进时，你可以牺牲一个生物。如果你如此作，则你抓两张牌且每位对手各失去2点生命。

620552.oracleText: Each player chooses a party from among creatures they control, then sacrifices the rest. (To choose a party, choose up to one each of Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.)
620552.translation: 每位牌手各从由其操控的生物中选出一个冒险团，然后牺牲其余生物。（选出一个冒险团的流程是僧侣、浪客、战士及法术师各选择至多一个。）

620553.oracleText: Exile up to five target permanent cards from your graveyard and separate them into two piles. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. (Piles can be empty.)
620553.translation: 将至多五张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场放逐，并分为两堆。由任一对手选择其中一堆。将该堆牌置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。（牌堆可以是空的。）

620556.oracleText: Target a player to discard their hand. That player then seeks that many nonland cards.
620556.translation: 指定一位牌手为目标，该牌手弃掉其手牌，然后取出等量的非地牌。

620557.oracleText: Target a player to deal 2 damage to. That player creates two Treasure tokens.
620557.translation: 指定一位牌手为目标，对该牌手造成2点伤害且该牌手派出两个珍宝衍生物。

620558.oracleText: Target a player to deal 2 damage to each creature they control. Those creatures perpetually get +2/+0.
620558.translation: 指定一位牌手为目标，对由该牌手操控的所有生物各造成2点伤害，这些生物永久得+2/+0。

620559.oracleText: Choose a party (up to one Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard). Any creatures you don't choose will be sacrificed.
620559.translation: 选出一个冒险团，（流程是僧侣、浪客、战士及法术师各选择至多一个。）所有你未选的生物将被牺牲。

620560.oracleText: Choose a creature card to put onto the battlefield under your opponent's control.
620560.translation: 选择要在对手的操控下放进战场的一张生物牌。

620561.oracleText: Pay 5 life? If you decline your opponent draws three cards.
620561.translation: 是否要支付5点生命？如果你选择「拒绝」，则对手抓三张牌。

620564.oracleText: Choose a pile to put into your opponent's hand.
620564.translation: 选择要置于对手手上的一堆。

620565.oracleText: Create Boo, a legendary 1/1 red Hamster creature token with trample and haste?
620565.translation: 是否要派出布布？其为1/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的传奇仓鼠衍生生物。

620566.oracleText: Discard a white or Plains card.

620567.oracleText: Discard a blue or Island card.

620568.oracleText: Discard a black or Swamp card.

620569.oracleText: Discard a red or Mountain card.

620570.oracleText: Discard a green or Forest card.

620579.oracleText: Target a creature with total power and toughness 5 or less.
620579.translation: 以一个力量与防御力加总等于或小于5的生物为目标。

620583.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME at the beginning of the next end step.
620583.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始，将CARDNAME牺牲。

620810.oracleText: Search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
620810.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

620817.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each other creature on the battlefield named Relentless Rats.
620817.translation: 战场上每有一个名称为无情鼠群的其他生物，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

621357.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
621357.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

621363.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with mana value 1 or less.
621363.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于1的神器牌。

621410.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value 1 or less?
621410.translation: 是否从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于1的神器牌？

624615.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} land.} other {Target {2, Number} lands.}}
624615.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定{2, Number}个地为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}个地为目标。}}

628023.oracleText: Exile target creature. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
628023.translation: 放逐目标生物。其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

628041.oracleText: Search your library for up to three creature cards, put them into your graveyard, then shuffle.
628041.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多三张生物牌，将它们置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

629204.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} card.} other {Target up to {2, Number} cards.}}
629204.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定至多{2, Number}张牌为目标。} other {指定至多{2, Number}张牌为目标。}}

629851.oracleText: Counter target spell with mana value 2.
629851.translation: 反击目标法术力值为2的咒语。

630221.oracleText: Destroy each artifact, creature, and enchantment with mana value X.
630221.translation: 消灭所有法术力值为X的神器、生物和结界。

630367.oracleText: Target a spell with mana value 2.
630367.translation: 指定一个法术力值为2的咒语为目标。

630552.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Discard {2, Number} card at random.} other {Discard {2, Number} cards at random.}}
630552.translation: {2, plural, =1 {随机弃{2, Number}张牌。} other {随机弃{2, Number}张牌。}}

630808.oracleText: Search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
630808.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。

631762.oracleText: Return an Elf you control to its owner's hand: Untap target creature. Activate only once each turn.
631762.translation: 将一个由你操控的妖精移回其拥有者手上：重置目标生物。每回合只能起动一次。

631966.oracleText:
"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare."
—Crovax
631966.translation:
「我被睡眠所苦，为梦魇所困。」
～寇维克斯

631967.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature, Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
631967.translation: 牺牲一个生物，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

632137.oracleText: {oG}, Discard a creature card: Search your library for a creature card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
632137.translation: {oG}，弃一张生物牌：从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

632900.oracleText: The next sorcery spell you cast this turn can be cast as though it had flash.
632900.translation: 你本回合中施放的下一个法术咒语能视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

632903.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent with mana value X to its owner's hand.
632903.translation: 将目标法术力值为X的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

633410.oracleText: {o3}: Search your library for a Sliver card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
633410.translation: {o3}：从你牌库中搜寻一张裂片妖牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

633991.oracleText: enchant creature card in a graveyard.
633991.translation: 结附于坟墓场中的生物牌。

634424.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you gain 1 life.
634424.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你获得1点生命。

636320.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice three Clerics: Search your graveyard, hand, and/or library for a card named Scion of Darkness and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
636320.translation: {oT}，牺牲三个僧侣：从你的坟墓场，手牌和／或牌库中搜寻一张名称为幽域魔裔的牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

636538.translation: 指定一个非灵俑生物为目标。

637597.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
637597.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。然后洗牌。

637873.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library and put that card into your hand. You lose life equal to its mana value.
637873.translation: 在你的维持开始时，展示你的牌库顶牌，并将该牌置于你手上。你失去等同于其法术力值的生命。

638904.oracleText: {o1}: CARDNAME becomes a 1/1 Phyrexian Blinkmoth artifact creature with flying and infect until end of turn. It's still a land.
638904.translation: {o1}：CARDNAME成为1/1，具飞行与侵染异能的非瑞人／光蛾神器生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。（它会以-1/-1指示物的方式对生物造成伤害，并以中毒指示物的方式对牌手造成伤害。）

639535.oracleText: Search your library for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top. You lose 2 life.
639535.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。你失去2点生命。

639803.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you may search your library for up to three basic land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
639803.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻至多三张基本地牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

639860.oracleText: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next main phase, add an amount of {oC} equal to that spell's mana value.
639860.translation: 反击目标咒语。在你的下一个行动阶段开始时，加若干{oC}，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

640347.oracleText: At the beginning of your next main phase, add an amount of {oC} equal to that spell's mana value.
640347.translation: 在你的下一个行动阶段开始时，加若干{oC}，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

640719.oracleText: Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
640719.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

640905.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if you have exactly seven cards in hand.
640905.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌。只能于你有正好七张手牌时起动。

641149.oracleText: Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, then shuffle and put the card on top.
641149.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

641741.oracleText: Discard your hand, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add three mana of any one color. Activate only as an instant.
641741.translation: 弃掉你的手牌，牺牲CARDNAME：加三点任意颜色的单色法术力。只能于瞬间时机起动。

641866.oracleText:
"To the tutors, a ‘poem of sand' was of little account, a ‘poem of ivory,' priceless."
—Afari, Tales
641866.translation:
「对导师们来说，『砂之诗』毫无价值，而『象牙之诗』却是无价之宝。」
～雅法莉，故事集

641867.oracleText: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
641867.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张瞬间或法术牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

641892.oracleText:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor
641892.translation:
「我从不教导，只是点悟。」
～陶蒂，费米瑞甫导师

641893.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact or enchantment card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
641893.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张神器或结界牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

643765.oracleText: Search your library for up to two creature cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
643765.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。然后洗牌。

643767.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Search your library for up to two creature cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. 
• Put up to two creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
643767.translation:
选择一项～ 
•从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。然后洗牌。 
•将至多两张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

643796.oracleText: {o3oR}, Sacrifice an artifact: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value to any target.
643796.translation: {o3oR}，牺牲一个神器：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之神器的法术力值。

643800.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on CARDNAME, counter that spell.
643800.translation: 每当任一牌手施放法术力值等同于CARDNAME上充电指示物数量的咒语时，反击该咒语。

644906.oracleText: Choose target card in a graveyard other than a basic land card. Search its owner's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that card and exile them. Then that player shuffles.
644906.translation: 选择目标在坟墓场中的牌，且不能是基本地牌。从其拥有者的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与之同名的牌，并将它们放逐。然后该牌手洗牌。

645225.translation: 指定一张武具牌为目标。

646146.oracleText: Search your library for a card, put that card into your graveyard, then shuffle.
646146.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

646225.oracleText: Destroy target permanent that opponent controls?
646225.translation: 是否要消灭该对手操控的目标永久物？

646226.oracleText: Target a permanent that opponent controls.
646226.translation: 指定一个由该对手操控的永久物为目标。

646235.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Exile {2, Number} card.} other {Exile {2, Number} cards.}}
646235.translation: {2, plural, =1 {放逐{2, Number}张牌。} other {放逐{2, Number}张牌。}}

647113.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a Swamp or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

669037.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。威猛～如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则改为CARDNAME造成X加2点伤害。

669038.oracleText:
Crater's Claws deals X damage to any target. 
Ferocious — Crater's Claws deals X plus 2 damage instead if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
669038.translation:
山口龙爪对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。
威猛～如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则改为山口龙爪造成X加2点伤害。

669288.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile the top four cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may cast noncreature spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs.
669288.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，放逐你牌库顶的四张牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放本回合中以娜尔施放逐的非生物牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

669358.oracleText: Target opponent exiles the top X cards of their library. You may cast any number of spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs.
669358.translation: 目标对手放逐其牌库顶的X张牌。你可以施放其中任意数量总法术力等于或小于X的非地牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

669452.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, exile its controller's graveyard.
669452.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，放逐其操控者坟墓场中的所有牌。

669462.oracleText: Exile that card at the beginning of your next end step.
669462.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该牌。

669463.oracleText: Return a creature card at random to the battlefield.
669463.translation: 随机将一张生物牌移回战场。

669465.oracleText: Cast any number of spells with mana value {2, Number} or less from among them without paying their mana costs?
669465.translation: 是否要施放一个或数个法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的咒语，而不支付它们的法术力费用？

669976.oracleText: {oT}: Draw two cards. Target opponent gains control of CARDNAME. Activate only during your turn.
669976.translation: {oT}：抓两张牌。目标对手获得CARDNAME的操控权。只能于你的回合中起动。

670025.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
670025.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

670026.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
670026.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

670180.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with power less than {1, CardId}'s power.
670180.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且力量小于{1, CardId}之力量的生物为目标。

670502.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, you may search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
670502.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

670830.oracleText: Search your library for any number of Dragon creature cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
670830.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量的龙生物牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

670883.oracleText: Target a creature with mana value 3 or less an opponent controls.
670883.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物为目标。

670891.oracleText: Search your library for a card?
670891.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌？

670900.oracleText: Put a creature card with mana value 3 or less onto the battlefield?
670900.translation: 是否要将一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌放进战场？

670967.oracleText: As long as you control five or more enchantments, each other non-Aura enchantment you control is a creature in addition to its other types and has base power and base toughness each equal to its mana value.
670967.translation: 只要你操控五个或更多结界，由你操控且非灵气的其他结界便是生物，其基础力量与基础防御力各等同于其法术力值，且仍具有原本类别。

671030.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards. If two nonland cards that share a color were milled this way, repeat this process.
671030.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，目标对手磨两张牌。如果以此法磨掉两张具共通颜色的非地牌，则重复此流程。

671367.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells with even mana values.
671367.translation: 所有对手都不能施放法术力值为偶数的咒语。

671368.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells with even mana values. (Zero is even.)
671368.translation: 所有对手都不能施放法术力值为偶数的咒语。（零是偶数。）

671369.oracleText: Your opponents can't block with creatures with even mana values.
671369.translation: 所有对手都不能以法术力值为偶数的生物进行阻挡。

671646.oracleText: Converge — You draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.
671646.translation: 聚辉～你抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为施放此咒语支付的法术力颜色数量。

671669.oracleText: Exile target nonbasic land. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that land and exile them. Then that player shuffles.
671669.translation: 放逐目标非基本地。从其操控者的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与该地同名的牌，并将它们放逐。然后该牌手洗牌。

671738.oracleText: Converge — CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.
671738.translation: 聚辉～CARDNAME对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为施放此咒语支付的法术力颜色数量。

671739.oracleText: Converge — Radiant Flames deals X damage to each creature, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.
671739.translation: 聚辉～辉光火焰对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为施放此咒语时用来支付费用的法术力颜色数量。

671903.oracleText: Converge — Search your library for a creature, instant, or sorcery card with mana value less than or equal to the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell, exile that card, then shuffle. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
671903.translation: 聚辉～从你牌库中搜寻一张生物，瞬间或法术牌，且其法术力值须等于或小于施放此咒语时用来支付费用的法术力颜色数量，放逐该牌，然后洗牌。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

671994.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, search your library for a colorless creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
671994.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的无色咒语时，你可以牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张无色生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

672052.translation: 指定一个由你操控的伙伴为目标。

672069.oracleText: Discard a card with mana value X: Counter target spell with mana value X.
672069.translation: 弃一张法术力值为X的牌：反击目标法术力值为X的咒语。

672075.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, reveal the top card of your library. You may put that card onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card with mana value 3 or less. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.
672075.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌为永久物牌，且其法术力值等于或小于3，则你可以将它放进战场。若否，则将该牌置于你手上。

672104.oracleText: Search your library for a planeswalker card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
672104.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张鹏洛客牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。然后将你的牌库洗牌。

672211.oracleText: Return all nonland permanents to their owners' hands. If this spell's surge cost was paid, create an 8/8 blue Octopus creature token.
672211.translation: 将所有非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果曾支付触手压境的潮涌费用，则派出一个8/8蓝色章鱼衍生生物。

672428.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment with mana value 3 or less.
672428.translation: 消灭目标总法术力费用等于或小于3的神器或结界。

672468.oracleText: {o1oWoB}, Sacrifice another creature: Exile target nonland permanent. Activate only if you have at least 10 life more than your starting life total.
672468.translation: {o1oWoB}，牺牲另一个生物：放逐目标非地永久物。只能于你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多10点时起动。

672552.translation: 指定至多三个生物为目标。

672561.oracleText: Target an artifact or enchantment with mana value 3 or less.
672561.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的神器或结界为目标。

673070.oracleText: Spells you cast with mana value 6 or greater have cascade.
673070.translation: 你施放之法术力值等于或大于6的咒语具有倾曳异能。

673252.oracleText: Enchanters add layer upon layer of complexity to the world around them.
673252.translation: 咒术师会给周围的世界层层叠加复杂度。

673253.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile this enchantment. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
673253.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以放逐此结界。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

673403.oracleText: Whenever a Ninja you control deals combat damage to a player, reveal the top card of your library and put that card into your hand. Each opponent loses life equal to that card's mana value.
673403.translation: 每当一个由你操控的忍者对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，展示你的牌库顶牌，并将该牌置于你手上。每位对手各失去等同于该牌法术力值的生命。

673409.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked, that player draws three cards and gains control of CARDNAME. Untap it.
673409.translation: 每当由对手操控的一个或数个生物攻击你且未受阻挡时，该牌手抓三张牌并获得CARDNAME的操控权。将之重置。

673416.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
673416.translation: {o2}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色自动机神器衍生生物。

673417.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Servo: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
673417.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个自动机：派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机神器衍生生物。

673418.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a Thopter: Create a 4/4 colorless Construct artifact creature token.
673418.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个振翼机：派出一个4/4无色组构体神器衍生生物。

673456.oracleText: Other artifact creatures you control have haste.
673456.translation: 由你操控的其他神器生物具有敏捷异能。

673457.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifact creatures you control attack, CARDNAME deals X damage to any target and you scry X, where X is the number of tapped artifacts you control.
673457.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个神器生物攻击时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，且你占卜X，X为由你操控且已横置的神器数量。

673464.oracleText: If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
673464.translation: 如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出两倍数量的该类衍生物。

673496.oracleText:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology
673496.translation:
「你的自说自话让大家获益匪浅。务请继续。」
～古物密码学教授游尔德

673497.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts their second spell each turn, you create a Treasure token.
673497.translation: 每当任一对手施放每回合中其第二个咒语时，你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

673600.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
673600.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

673602.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile from your library and/or your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on Laelia.
673602.translation: 每当一张或数张牌从你的牌库和／或你的坟墓场进入放逐区时，在拉耶梨上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673607.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create X tokens that are copies of another target creature you control, where X is one plus the number of instant and sorcery spells you've cast this turn. They gain haste. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
673607.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出X个为另一个目标由你操控的生物之复制品的衍生物，X为你本回合中施放过的瞬间和法术咒语数量加一。它们获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们放逐。

673659.oracleText: "Even in death, we never stop growing."
673659.translation: 「即便死亡也不会阻止我们继续生长。」

673660.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control. It's a Forest land.
673660.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以将它在其拥有者的操控下牌面朝下地移回战场。它是树林地。

673691.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token with flying, a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token with vigilance, and a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token with trample.
673691.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个3/3无色、具飞行的魔像衍生神器生物，一个3/3无色、具警戒的魔像衍生神器生物和一个3/3无色、具践踏的魔像衍生神器生物。

673705.oracleText: Choose a nonland card exiled this way.
673705.translation: 选择以此法被放逐的一张非地牌。

673707.oracleText: Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
673707.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们放逐。

673710.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control?
673710.translation: 是否要将它在其拥有者的操控下牌面朝下地移回战场？

673712.oracleText: Her writhing, boneless movements are unsettling to humans, but hypnotic to her serpent brood.
673712.translation: 她宛若无骨的舞姿令人不安，但对于她的蛇而言却是催眠。

673738.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice X artifacts: Return target creature card with power X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. X can't be 0.
673738.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲X个神器：将目标力量等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。X不能为0。

673744.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}, {oT}: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
673744.translation: {oWoUoBoRoG}，{oT}：将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

673781.oracleText: Exile target opponent's graveyard. For each creature card exiled this way, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
673781.translation: 放逐目标对手的坟墓场。每以此法放逐一张生物牌，便派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

673852.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to X target creatures you control.
673852.translation: 在至多X个目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673853.oracleText: Auras, Equipment, and modified creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn.
673853.translation: 由你操控的灵气、武具与有饰装的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

673861.translation: 是否要牺牲另一个由你操控的生物？

673862.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Sacrifice {2, Number} artifact.} other {Sacrifice {2, Number} artifacts.}}
673862.translation: {2, plural, =1 {牺牲{2, Number}个神器} other {牺牲{2, Number}个神器}}

673863.oracleText: Target a creature card with power {2, Number} or less.
673863.translation: 指定一张力量等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌

673866.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} creature you control.} other {Target up to {2, Number} creatures you control.}}
673866.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定至多{2, Number}个由你操控的生物为目标。} other {指定至多{2, Number}个由你操控的生物为目标。}}

673879.oracleText: The Flowing Staff technique does not differentiate between offense and defense.
673879.translation: 流动的魔法没有进攻与防守之分。

673895.oracleText: "I'm sure we can come to an arrangement."

673896.oracleText: Whenever you or a permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw a card.
673896.translation: 每当你或一个由你操控的永久物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以抓一张牌。

673904.oracleText: Whenever one or more non-Human creatures you control attack, look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a Human creature card from among them onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. It gains indestructible until end of turn. Put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
673904.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的非人类生物攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张人类生物牌放进战场，其为横置且正进行攻击。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

673906.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, you may have CARDNAME's base power and toughness become 5/1 or 1/5 until end of turn.
673906.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，你可以使CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力成为5/1或1/5直到回合结束。

673910.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
673910.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673917.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
673917.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673928.oracleText: {oGoWoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control. They gain vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
673928.translation: {oGoWoW}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标生物。它们获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

673932.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
673932.translation: {oW}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673938.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy."
673938.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。」

673940.oracleText: Exile up to five target permanents. For each permanent exiled this way, its controller creates a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
673940.translation: 放逐至多五个目标永久物。对每个以此法放逐的永久物而言，其操控者派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

673944.oracleText: Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+0, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.
673944.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+0，具飞行异能，且每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

673947.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Delirium — CARDNAME deals 4 damage instead if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
673947.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则改为CARDNAME造成4点伤害。

673948.oracleText:
Unholy Heat deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
Delirium — Unholy Heat deals 4 damage instead if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
673948.translation:
不洁热火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。
躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则改为不洁热火造成4点伤害。

673956.oracleText: {oGoW}: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains trample and lifelink until end of turn.
673956.translation: {oGoW}：目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得践踏与系命异能直到回合结束。

673961.oracleText: Draw two cards, then nonland cards in your hand with mana value 3 or less perpetually gain "When you cast this spell, you lose 1 life."
673961.translation: 抓两张牌，然后你手上法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌永久获得「当你施放此咒语时，你失去1点生命。」

673962.oracleText: Select the starting number of lore counters.
673962.translation: 选择学问指示物的初始数量。

673966.oracleText: Search for up to two land cards that have a basic land type.
673966.translation: 至多搜寻两张具有据本地类别的地牌。

673972.oracleText: Cannot pay for: A Nonartifact Spell
673972.translation: 不能用于支付：非神器咒语

673973.oracleText: Choose any amount of mana to pay.
673973.translation: 选择任意数量想支付的法术力。

673983.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker?
673983.translation: 牺牲一个神器、生物、结界、地或鹏洛客？

673984.oracleText: Sacrifice a permanent that shares a card type with it?
673984.translation: 牺牲一个与它具有相同牌张类别的永久物？

673985.oracleText: Sacrifice a permanent of the corresponding type; if you decline, you lose 2 life and your opponent draws a card.
673985.translation: 牺牲一个具有相同类别的永久物；如果你拒绝，你将失去2点生命且你的对手将抓一张牌。

674036.oracleText: Tap a creature for {1, CardId} to enlist.
674036.translation: 点击一个生物使其被{1, CardId}征列。

674917.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped artifacts you control.
674917.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的神器。

674919.oracleText: Sacrifice a nonland, nontoken permanent; if you decline, you lose 2 life and your opponent draws a card.
674919.translation: 牺牲一个非地、非衍生永久物；如果你拒绝，你将失去2点生命且你的对手将抓一张牌。

675904.oracleText: Target an artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker card.
675904.translation: 指定一张神器、结界或鹏洛客牌为目标。

675964.translation: 不能用于支付：非神器咒语

675967.oracleText: Insufficent creatures to pay for Enlist costs.
675967.translation: 没有足够的生物来支付征列费用。

675973.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, choose a creature card in your hand at random. It perpetually becomes a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.
675973.translation: 在你的维持开始时，随机选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久成为非瑞人，且仍具有原本类别。

675974.oracleText: Whenever a Phyrexian you control deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters.
675974.translation: 每当一个由你操控的非瑞人对一个牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手获得两个中毒指示物。

676001.oracleText: Whenever you draw a Dragon card, it perpetually gets +1/+1.
676001.translation: 每当你抓一张龙牌，它永久得+1/+1。

676010.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature card in your graveyard perpetually becomes an artifact. You may cast that card this turn. (It loses all other card types.)
676010.translation: {oT}：目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌永久成为神器。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。（它会失去所有其他类别。）

676012.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature that crewed it this turn perpetually gains your choice of menace, deathtouch, or lifelink.
676012.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标本回合中曾搭载它的生物依你的选择永久获得威慑、死触或系命异能。

676015.oracleText: At the beginning of your precombat main phase, you may discard a card. If you do, seek a card with greater mana value and exile it. Until the end of your next turn, you may play the exiled card.
676015.translation: 在你的战斗前的行动阶段开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则取出一张法术力值比该牌大的牌并将它放逐。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用所放逐的牌。

676018.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, conjure a random card from Goblin Influx Array's spellbook into your hand.
676018.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，从鬼怪汹涌阵的法术书中将一张随机牌幻变进你手上。

676020.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enlists a nontoken creature, you may conjure a duplicate of that creature into the top five cards of your library at random. The duplicate perpetually gets +1/+0 and gains haste.
676020.translation: 每当CARDNAME征列一个非衍生物的生物时，你可以将该生物的一张副本随机幻变进你牌库顶的五张牌中。该副本永久得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

676025.oracleText: "We are one family, connected by the sacred roots of Llanowar."
676025.translation: 「我们是一个家族，由神圣的罗堰之根链接。」

676026.oracleText: Conjure a card named Marwyn, the Nurturer and X cards named Llanowar Elves onto the battlefield.
676026.translation: 将一张名称为培育人玛雯的牌和X张名称为罗堰妖精的牌幻变进战场。

676032.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a random land card from your library into your graveyard.
676032.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，将一张随机的地牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场。

676034.oracleText: "It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, Ichabod."

676035.oracleText: Domain — {o7oG}: Seek a creature card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
676035.translation: 领土～{o7oG}：取出一张生物牌。由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

676041.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Choose a nonland card in your hand. It perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
676041.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：选择你手上的一张非地牌。它永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

676043.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove an egg counter from it. Then if it has no egg counters on it, put it onto the battlefield.
676043.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，从其上移去一个蛋卵指示物。然后如果其上没有蛋卵指示物，将之放进战场。

676044.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, conjure a random card from Darigaaz, Shivan Champion's spellbook into exile face down with three egg counters on it. It gains "At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove an egg counter from it. Then if it has no egg counters on it, put it onto the battlefield."
676044.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，从西瓦斗龙达里迦的法术书中将一张随机牌牌面朝下地幻变进放逐区，且上面有三个蛋卵指示物。它获得「在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，则从其上移去一个蛋卵指示物。然后若其上没有蛋卵指示物，则将它放进战场。」

676050.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
676050.translation: 每当此生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

676056.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes crewed, until end of turn, it becomes a copy of the exiled card, except it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types.
676056.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为已搭载时，直到回合结束，它成为所放逐之牌的复制品，额外具有载具与神器类别。

676059.oracleText: At last, some room to grow.
676059.translation: 最后，还有一些成长空间。

676063.oracleText: Counter target spell. Each card in its controller's graveyard, hand, and library with the same name as that spell perpetually gain "This spell costs {o2} more to cast."
676063.translation: 反击目标咒语。其操控者坟墓场、手牌及牌库中与该咒语同名的每张牌均永久获得「此咒语增加{o2}来施放。」

676065.oracleText: When CARDNAME or another legendary creature you control crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle perpetually gets +1/+0.
676065.translation: 当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的传奇生物搭载载具时，该载具永久得+1/+0。

676068.oracleText: Whenever one or more other nontoken creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, choose one of those creatures. Conjure a duplicate of the chosen creature into your hand.
676068.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的其他生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择其中一个生物。将该生物的一张副本幻变进你手上。

676075.oracleText:
"Superior force meets woefully inadequate object. What paradox were you expecting?"
—Azguri, archmage of Evos Isle
676075.translation:
「强劲力道遇上微渺物件。你觉得会产生怎样的吊诡？」
～伊弗斯岛大法术师厄齐桂

676076.oracleText: Choose a nonland card in your hand.
676076.translation: 选择一张你手中的非地牌。

676078.oracleText: Target a creature that crewed it this turn.
676078.translation: 指定一个本回合中搭载它的生物为目标。

676079.oracleText: Seek a card with greater mana value.
676079.translation: 取出一张法术力值更大的牌。

676080.oracleText: Target a card in an opponent's graveyard.
676080.translation: 以任一牌手坟墓场中的牌为目标。

676081.oracleText: Put a random land card into your graveyard.
676081.translation: 随机将一张地牌置入你的坟墓场。

676082.oracleText: Target a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn.
676082.translation: 指定一张在你坟墓场中的非传奇生物牌为目标，且须为于本回合中从战场进入坟墓场的。

676084.oracleText: "Baldurians are free to worship any deities they choose. Where will faith and fate lead me?"
676084.translation: 「博德之门的居民可以自由崇拜任何他们选择的神祇。我的信仰和命运将指引我走向何方？」

676085.oracleText: "May Lathander's light guide you to greet tomorrow's sunrise."
676085.translation: 「愿洛山达的光辉引导你迎接明日的日出。」

676086.oracleText: "Have you seen the Unrolling Scroll? A truly marvelous shrine dedicated to Oghma's wisdom and teachings."
676086.translation: 「你见过展开卷轴吗？那是座真正奇妙的神殿，献给欧格玛的智慧与教义。」

676087.oracleText: "The Dead Three—Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul—walk among us. It's time we remake this city to their liking."
676087.translation: 「死亡三神——班恩、巴尔与米尔寇——行走于我们之间。是时候按照他们的喜好重塑这座城市了。」

676088.oracleText: "The rage of Talos is mine own, and I am become the eye of the storm."
676088.translation: 「塔洛斯的怒火便是我的怒火，我已成为风暴中心。」

676089.oracleText: "Silvanus and Chauntea, like grass in cracked stone, can always find little spaces to flourish."
676089.translation: 「西凡纳斯与裳提亚，就像裂缝中的草，总能找到生长的狭小空间。」

676092.oracleText: "You know what must be done. Do it now!"
676092.translation: 「你知道必须做什么。现在就去做！」

676093.oracleText: "You've a sharp tongue, elf. Would that your mind proved its equal."
676093.translation: 「你伶牙俐齿，精灵。希望你的头脑同样敏锐。」

676095.oracleText: "A githyanki creche must be near; its caretaker has the means to cleanse us."
676095.translation: 「这附近一定有吉斯洋基养育所；那的守护者有办法净化我们。」

676096.oracleText: "Most of my memory is gone, and I don't remember why."
676096.translation: 「我的大部分记忆都消失了，我不记得为什么。」

676097.oracleText: "Maybe, just maybe, there's a little spark of goodness in Zariel still."
676097.translation: 「有可能，只是可能，扎瑞尔心中仍留存一丝善意。」

676098.oracleText: "The sword, the sword! I know where it is!"
676098.translation: 「那把剑，那把剑！我知道它在哪！」

676099.oracleText: "Through the gate to Avernus we went, tearing through devils like a song through air."
676099.translation: 「我们穿过阿佛纳斯的门，像歌曲穿透空气一样，撕裂了恶魔。」

676100.oracleText: "The Zariel I knew is gone, replaced by a devil with a halo of fire and vengeance."
676100.translation: 「我认识的扎瑞尔已经消失，取而代之的是一个带着火焰与复仇光环的恶魔。」

676101.oracleText: "I wandered Avernus for a time—a harsh, horrible place devoid of growth."
676101.translation: 「我曾在阿佛纳斯徘徊了一段时间——一个残酷、可怕且毫无生机的地方。」

676103.oracleText: "Those who walk the path of evil will never know peace."
676103.translation: 「那些走在邪恶之路上的人将永远无法获得安宁。」

676104.oracleText: "I shall endeavor to let wisdom be our torch."
676104.translation: 「我会竭尽全力，让智慧成为我们的火炬。」

676105.oracleText: "My heart is not so peaceful as it may seem."
676105.translation: 「我的内心并不像看起来那么平静。」

676109.oracleText: "Isn't this great? All of us, doing nice things, being happy."
676109.translation: 「这不是很棒吗？我们所有人，都在做着美好的事情，开心快乐。」

676110.oracleText: "I knew a mage once, but he was pretty stuffy. You're not like that."
676110.translation: 「我以前认识一个法师，但他相当古板。你可不像他。」

676111.oracleText: "I'm so sweet, I've got rotting teeth and gums!"
676111.translation: 「我太甜了，牙齿和牙龈都烂掉了！」

676112.oracleText: "Hey, I think everyone would be happier if we were a little nicer."
676112.translation: 「嘿，我觉得如果我们都友善一点，大家会更快乐。」

676113.oracleText: "What a great forest, huh? I've never seen trees like these before."
676113.translation: 「这真是片好森林，对吧？我以前从没见过这样的树。」

676117.oracleText: "No rest for the wicked, I see."

676119.oracleText: "Oh, what a tangled Weave we web."
676119.translation: 「哦，我们编织了多么错综复杂的魔网啊。」

676121.oracleText: "I'll stick with you, no matter what."
676121.translation: 「无论发生什么，我都会跟着你。」

676123.oracleText: "Just like old times. Well, except for the torture and all."
676123.translation: 「就像过去一样。嗯，除了那些拷问和一切。」

676124.oracleText: "My blade will cut ya down to size!"
676124.translation: 「我的刀会把你砍成那样的大小！」

676125.oracleText: "I wish I could spend more time in the forest. I feel so alive."
676125.translation: 「真希望能在森林里多待些时间。我感觉很有活力。」

676126.translation: 「让我看看…青足龙蛇，眼魔…啊哈！巴尔之子。」

676127.oracleText: "The Demiplanar Chambers take a lot longer to clean than you'd think."
676127.translation: 「半位面室比你想象的要难打扫得多。」

676128.oracleText: "I find the Endless Chant comforting. How else could I fall asleep?"
676128.translation: 「我觉得无尽诵经让人安心。不然我怎么能睡着呢？」

676129.oracleText: "If you've never met Miirym, I'll say nothing else. Let it be a fun surprise."
676129.translation: 「如果你没见过米瑞穆，那我就不再多说了。让这成为一个有趣的惊喜吧。」

676130.oracleText: "Whoever's stealing potions and gold from my personal chambers better fess up now!"
676130.translation: 「谁偷了我私人房间里的药水和金币，最好现在就坦白！」

676131.oracleText: "An undiscovered prediction of Alaundo! . . . Or just his recipe for Three-Chicken Pie."
676131.translation: 「一条未曾揭示的阿兰多预言！…或者只是他做三鸡派的食谱。」

676132.oracleText: "We children of Bhaal cannot be stopped."
676132.translation: 「我们这些巴尔之子势不可挡。」

676133.oracleText: "This is how it was meant to be. Let no one bar our path."
676133.translation: 「这就是命中注定。不要让任何人阻挡我们的道路。」

676135.oracleText: "Death comes for you. Feel its icy breath!"
676135.translation: 「死亡向你袭来。感受它冰冷的气息！」

676136.oracleText: "We should kill something soon. My impatience grows."
676136.translation: 「我们应该快点杀点什么。我已经越来越不耐烦了。」

676137.oracleText: "In this light, it seems all the insects that prey on the living have retreated to the shadows."
676137.translation: 「在这种光线下，似乎所有以生者为食的昆虫都退到了阴影中。」

676142.oracleText: "Got to keep focused—can't afford to get attached. To anyone."
676142.translation: 「必须保持专注——不能有任何情感牵绊，不能对任何人产生感情。」

676145.oracleText: "With the guidance of Shar, we shall prosper."
676145.translation: 「在莎尔的指引下，我们将繁荣昌盛。」

676146.oracleText: "I see you have learned much in your short life span."
676146.translation: 「我看你在短暂的生命中学到了很多。」

676147.oracleText: "Trust is for the foolish. And the dead."
676147.translation: 「信任是愚者的事情，也是死者的事情。」

676149.oracleText: "Your forests seem very strange . . . and yet somehow familiar."
676149.translation: 「你的森林看起来很奇怪……但不知为何，又有些熟悉。」

676150.oracleText: "This better be good if ye're thinking to keep the ale from me lips."
676150.translation: 「如果你想让我暂时离开麦酒，那最好有点好事。」

676152.oracleText: "Not a sight ye'd see every day, eh?"
676152.translation: 「这可不是你每天都能看到的景象，对吧？」

676153.oracleText: "If ye have coin and drink, we're bound to be friends."
676153.translation: 「只要你有钱和酒，我们就注定会成为朋友。」

676154.translation: 「保卫自己的家园是一种荣誉。」

676155.oracleText: "Cross me, and I'll leave ye held and helpless in the forest."
676155.translation: 「惹到我，我会让你无助地在森林中动弹不得。」

676156.oracleText: "Us True Souls gotta look out for one another."

676157.oracleText: "All you need to do is open yourself to the Absolute, and I'll do the rest."
676157.translation: 「你需要做的就是向至上真神敞开心扉，剩下的我来处理。」

676158.oracleText: "Got a lot of weird things swimmin' around in that head of yours."
676158.translation: 「你的脑袋里可游荡着不少怪东西。」

676159.oracleText: "You're gonna be my new pet. A ferocious squiddie, all for myself."
676159.translation: 「你会成为我的新宠物。一只凶猛的小鱿鱼，全是我的。」

676160.oracleText: "The Absolute's voice is a blade—it'd cut your brain to bits."
676160.translation: 「至上真神的声音如同一把刀——它会将你的大脑切成碎片。」

676161.oracleText: "Yer flesh is marked. The Absolute is upon you!"
676161.translation: 「你的肉体被标记了。至上真神要来找你了！」

676162.oracleText: "Most souls in Avernus are just meat for the grinder. But not me."
676162.translation: 「在阿佛纳斯，大多数灵魂不过是磨坊里的肉。但我不是。」

676163.oracleText: "I didn't escape the hells to lose my soul to another evil."
676163.translation: 「我可不是为了将灵魂献给另一个邪恶而逃离地狱的。」

676164.oracleText: "Until I've shaken Zariel off my back, I'd only put a target on yours."
676164.translation: 「在我从背后甩掉扎瑞尔之前，我只会把你当作目标。」

676165.oracleText: "Want me to send them to the Hells? Just say the word."
676165.translation: 「想让我把他们送到地狱去？只需要一句话。」

676166.oracleText: "I've spat in Baphomet's eye and lived to tell the tale."
676166.translation: 「我曾朝巴弗灭的眼睛吐口水，还活着讲这个故事。」

676167.oracleText: "It's a rescue mission then—should be fun. Let's get to work."
676167.translation: 「那么这是一次营救任务——应该会很有趣。开始工作吧。」

676179.oracleText: "Like the moon, I appear in many phases."
676179.translation: 「如同月亮，我以多种形态出现。」

676180.oracleText: "None as observant or elegant as the hawk."
676180.translation: 「没有什么比鹰更敏锐和优雅了。」

676181.oracleText: "No creature as tenacious and calculating as the crocodile."
676181.translation: 「没有什么比鳄鱼更顽强和精明了。」

676182.oracleText: "Never an animal as deadly and venomous as the scorpion."
676182.translation: 「没有什么比蝎子更致命和剧毒了。」

676183.oracleText: "Nothing as ferocious or wily as the wolf."
676183.translation: 「没有什么比狼更凶猛和狡猾了。」

676184.oracleText: "There's not a beast as mighty or primal as the bear."
676184.translation: 「没有什么比熊更强大和狂野了。」

676185.oracleText: "Do not place your aggression on one if you cannot handle the wrath of many."
676185.translation: 「如果你无法承受众怒，就不要向某一个人发泄你的愤怒。」

676186.oracleText: "Surviving the frigid cold means hunting without patience or mercy."
676186.translation: 「在极寒中生存意味着狩猎时不能带有任何耐心或怜悯。」

676187.oracleText: "The meek and ugly masses would be wise to not sully my master's lands."
676187.translation: 「那些卑微且丑陋的众生最好不要玷污我主的领地。」

676188.oracleText: "Intelligence is a delusion of the weak. Brutality is power's true measure."
676188.translation: 「智慧是弱者的妄想。残暴才是力量真正的标尺。」

676189.oracleText: "All will bow and swear fealty to my master. Dragonkind included."
676189.translation: 「所有人都将屈膝并宣誓效忠于我的主人，包括龙族在内。」

676190.oracleText: "Brute strength is a waste of effort when deception will fare more elegantly."
676190.translation: 「当欺骗能更优雅地解决问题时，蛮力只是在浪费力气。」

676936.oracleText: Target up to one creature you don't control with flying.
676936.translation: 选择至多一个不由你操控且具飞行异能的生物为目标。

677249.oracleText: When you cast this spell, create a Treasure token and this spell perpetually loses this ability.
677249.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，派出一个珍宝衍生物且此咒语永久失去此异能。

677469.translation: 以一个非衍生、非地永久物为目标。

677921.oracleText: Target a creature you control with flying.
677921.translation: 以一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物为目标

678383.oracleText: {o4oW}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn. Activate only during your turn.
678383.translation: {o4oW}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。只能于你的回合中起动。

678387.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, scry 2.
678387.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，占卜2。

678395.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. If that mana is spent on a Dragon creature spell, it gains haste until end of turn.
678395.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

678400.oracleText: You may mill three cards. Then return up to two creature and/or land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
678400.translation: 你可以磨三张牌。然后将至多两张生物和／或地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

678407.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
678407.translation: {o3}，{oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则你可以将它置于你的牌库底。

678409.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
678409.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或门牌，展示这些牌，将一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

678513.oracleText: When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, scry 2.
678513.translation: 当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，占卜2。

678514.oracleText: Return up to two creature and/or land cards to your hand.
678514.translation: 将至多两张生物和／或地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

678519.oracleText: Select a permanent that was exiled. You will reveal cards until you reveal a card that shares a type with the selected permanent.
678519.translation: 选择一个被放逐的永久物。你一直展示牌直到展示一张与所选永久物具有相同类别的牌为止。

678520.oracleText: Choose a nonland permanent card in your hand.
678520.translation: 在你的手牌中选择一张非地永久物牌。

678562.oracleText: Goblin spells you cast cost {oR} less to cast. (If it doesn't require {oR}, it costs {o1} less to cast.)
678562.translation: 你施放的鬼怪咒语减少{oR}来施放。(如果它不需要{oR}，则它减少{o1}来施放。)

678563.oracleText: Conjure a duplicate of that creature into the top five cards of your library at random?
678563.translation: 是否将该生物的一张副本随机幻变进你牌库顶的五张牌中？

678820.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} for each creature you control with defender.
678820.translation: {oT}：你每操控一个具守军异能的生物，便加{oG}。

678845.oracleText: When this Class becomes level 3, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
678845.translation: 当此职业成为等级3时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。

678846.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [When this Class becomes level 3, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain life equal to that creature's toughness.]
678846.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [当此职业成为等级3时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。]

679789.oracleText: Draw a card for each creature you control [with flying].
679789.translation: 你每操控一个[具飞行异能的］生物，便抓一张牌。

679790.oracleText: Draw a card for each creature you control [with flying].
679790.translation: 你每操控一个[具飞行异能的］生物，便抓一张牌。

680947.oracleText: Each opponent chooses a permanent they control that shares a card type with the sacrificed permanent and sacrifices it.
680947.translation: 每位对手各选择一个由其操控的永久物，且其须与所牺牲永久物具有共通的牌张类别，并将它牺牲。

681279.oracleText: Choose a permanent you control that shares a card type with the sacrificed permanent.
681279.translation: 选择一个由你操控且与被牺牲永久物具共通牌张类别的永久物。

682058.oracleText: Choose up to one artifact or creature card with mana value 1 discarded this way, up to one artifact or creature card with mana value 2 discarded this way, and up to one artifact or creature card with mana value 3 discarded this way.
682058.translation: 选择至多一张以此法弃掉且法术力值为1的神器或生物牌，至多一张以此法弃掉且法术力值为2的神器或生物牌，和至多一张以此法弃掉且法术力值为3的神器或生物牌。

682059.oracleText: Choose artifact or creature cards you discarded with mana value 1, mana value 2, and mana value 3 to return to the battlefield.
682059.translation: 从你弃掉的牌中，法术力值为1，2，3的神器或生物牌各选择一张。将这些牌移回战场。

682320.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you may put it on the bottom of its owner's library. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order. This ability triggers only once each turn.
682320.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，你可以将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。若你如此作，则从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。然后将所有以此法展示且未经施放的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

682356.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature card in your graveyard perpetually becomes an artifact. You may cast that card this turn.
682356.translation: {oT}：目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌永久成为神器。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。

682364.oracleText: Goblin spells you cast cost {oR} less to cast.
682364.translation: 你施放的鬼怪咒语减少{oR}来施放。

682365.oracleText: Create X 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
682365.translation: 派出X个1/1绿色树林／树灵衍生地生物。

682366.oracleText: Choose a permanent to return to your hand. Your other nonland permanents will be shuffled into their owner's library.
682366.translation: 选择一个永久物移回你手上。你的其它非地永久物将会被洗回其拥有者的牌库。

682367.oracleText: Target a creature to deal X damage to.
682367.translation: 指定一个目标生物以造成X点伤害。

682368.oracleText: Target a planeswalker to deal X damage to.
682368.translation: 指定一个目标鹏洛客以造成X点伤害。

682369.oracleText: Target a creature to get +X/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
682369.translation: 指定一个目标生物得+X/+0且获得敏捷异能。

682844.oracleText: Choose a Plains, an Island, a Swamp, a Mountain, and a Forest.
682844.translation: 选择一个平原，一个海岛，一个沼泽，一个山脉和一个树林。

682845.oracleText: Choose a land of each basic land type to destroy.
682845.translation: 为每种基本地类别各选择一个地以消灭。

682847.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
682847.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

682848.oracleText: Return target artifact or creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
682848.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

682849.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Exile target artifact or creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. 
• Return target artifact or creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
682849.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•放逐目标由你操控的神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。 
•将目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

682851.oracleText: There's never a need to change the watch, for the servants of Norn are sleepless.
682851.translation: 他们放哨从来不需要换岗，因为艾蕾侬的仆从全都不眠不休。

682856.oracleText: "Be not afraid of the holy chorus. Join in rapturous harmony."
682856.translation: 「圣歌齐颂非滋扰，携手同心共欢愉。」

682857.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, CARDNAME has double strike.
682857.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

682864.oracleText: "Let those thanebound dissenters prattle about their dead god. I serve the Mother of Machines, and in her name I carve out their heresy."
682864.translation: 「就让那些忠于伯爵的逆徒念叨他们死去的神。我侍奉机械之母，誓以她之名涤净异端。」

682867.oracleText: {o1}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
682867.translation: {o1}：从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

682870.oracleText: Charge of the Mites deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker.
682870.translation: 虫械冲锋对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

682875.oracleText: "Elspeth, my friend, the Multiverse has answered my prayers to bring you here so that I may gather you into my pride and forever protect you."
682875.translation: 「吾友艾紫培，多重宇宙终于回应我的祈祷带你前来；你将融入狮群，永享我的守护。」

682876.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If that creature has toxic, draw a card.
682876.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果该生物具有下毒异能，则抓一张牌。

682878.oracleText: "We need not be swift. We are inexorable."
682878.translation: 「我们不需快步前行。我们齐心势不可当。」

682882.oracleText: "There is no hate behind our blades. We kill out of love, and the desire to share Norn's blessings with all."
682882.translation: 「我们的剑不带仇恨。我们为大爱杀戮，渴望分送艾蕾侬的福祉给众生。」

682887.oracleText: No more than one creature can attack CARDNAME each combat.
682887.translation: 每次战斗中，攻击CARDNAME的生物不得多于一个。

682888.oracleText: No more than one creature can attack The Eternal Wanderer each combat.
682888.translation: 每次战斗中，攻击永世飘萍的生物不能多于一个。

682889.oracleText: Exile up to one target artifact or creature. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of that player's next end step.
682889.translation: 放逐至多一个目标神器或生物。在其拥有者的下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

682890.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with double strike.
682890.translation: 派出一个2/2白色，具连击异能的武士衍生生物。

682891.oracleText: For each player, choose a creature that player controls. Each player sacrifices all creatures they control not chosen this way.
682891.translation: 为每位牌手各选择一个由其操控的生物。每位牌手各牺牲所有由其操控但未以此法选中的生物。

682896.oracleText: "My mother wore this into battle against the first Phyrexians. Now I wear it in her honor."
682896.translation: 「我的母亲曾头戴此盔，在非瑞克西亚首度入侵时奋战。如今我头戴此盔继承她的志业。」

682900.oracleText: Creatures you control that are equipped get +1/+0.
682900.translation: 由你操控的生物且佩带武具的生物得+1/+0。

682903.oracleText:
"You think it's creepy now? You should see how it eats."
—Melira
682903.translation:
「这你就觉得恶心了？那你该去看看它是怎么吃东西的。」
～梅梨莱

682904.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
682904.translation: 腐化～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

682912.oracleText: "I have room for a few more teeth in my collection. Who's next?"
682912.translation: 「我的藏品里还有几颗牙齿的位置。下一个谁来？」

682916.oracleText: {o3oWoW}: Create a 2/2 white Cat creature token.
682916.translation: {o3oWoW}：派出一个2/2白色的猫衍生生物。

682918.oracleText: "It's hard to fight for the future if you can't see the way forward."
682918.translation: 「看不清前路，就很难为未来而战。」

682919.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is equipped, it gets +1/+1.

682922.oracleText: While one mouth feeds, the other chatters mindless paeans of Elesh Norn's glory.
682922.translation: 一张嘴只顾吃喝，另一张嘴则用来吟唱艾蕾侬荣光的机械颂歌。

682926.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+1 and has vigilance.
682926.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+1且具有警戒异能。

682929.oracleText: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}, Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
682929.translation: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}，牺牲两个其他神器和／或生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

682932.translation:
「没溺其中，你便能再度呼吸。」
～亚崔夏

682933.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, scry 1 and put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
682933.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1并在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

682935.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Remove two oil counters from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
682935.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去两个烁油指示物：抓一张牌。

682938.oracleText: The mites sniff out any potential interlopers. He handles the rest.
682938.translation: 虫械能嗅出潜藏的入侵者。之后就由他接手。

682939.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as you control two or more artifacts.
682939.translation: 只要你操控两个或更多神器，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

682942.oracleText: Only Elesh Norn's most loyal servants are granted the honor of becoming part of her throne.
682942.translation: 只有艾蕾侬最忠诚的仆从，才有幸纳入她圣座一隅。

682943.translation: 结附于由你操控的基本地

682947.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to CARDNAME, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, CARDNAME deals that much damage to any other target.
682947.translation: 如果CARDNAME将受到伤害，则防止该伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，CARDNAME对任意另一个目标造成等量的伤害。

682950.oracleText: New Phyrexia's planar defenses scattered the Planeswalker strike team on arrival. Elesh Norn knew they were coming.
682950.translation: 鹏洛客突袭队刚到新非瑞克西亚，便遭此处的时空防御打散：艾蕾侬早就知道他们会来。

682952.oracleText:
"Witness the glory of true, unwavering unity."
—Ajani
682952.translation:
「敬请见证精纯无他的团结荣光。」
～阿耶尼

682954.oracleText: "There is a single, glorious truth, etched in the hearts of the faithful. Join in unity, or be washed away."
682954.translation: 「信众心中均已镌刻此等真理，它独一无二、光荣至上：携手共晋大一统，自立独行无前路。」

682955.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If that creature has toxic, instead it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
682955.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。若该生物具有下毒异能，则改为它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

682957.oracleText: "Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes!" said Koth. "I was about to say the same, my friend," Elspeth replied.
682957.translation: 「啊，还能见到你真是太好了！」寇斯说。「老朋友，我也一样。」艾紫培展颜相迎。

682958.oracleText: Equipped creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
682958.translation: 由你操控且佩带武具的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

682960.oracleText: He spreads word of the Argent Etchings to a captive audience.
682960.translation: 他广为传扬《银蚀圣典》箴言，藉此将观众一网打尽。

682961.oracleText: Corrupted — {oW}, {oT}: Tap target creature. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
682961.translation: 腐化～{oW}，{oT}：横置目标生物。只能于某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动。

682965.oracleText: {o(W/P)}, {oT}: Choose a color. Another target creature you control gains toxic 1 and hexproof from that color until end of turn. It can't be blocked by creatures of that color this turn.
682965.translation: {o(W/P)}，{oT}：选择一种颜色。直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得下毒1与反该色辟邪异能。它本回合不能被该色生物阻挡。

682968.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control with toxic have lifelink.
682968.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，由你操控且具下毒异能的生物便具有系命异能。

682970.oracleText:
"It's hard to tell with this glare, but those must be the skyhunter reinforcements! They have arrived at last!"
—Prahan, Mirran rebel
682970.translation:
「虽然强光刺眼看不清楚，但那些一定是来增援的空猎者！他们总算到了！」
～秘罗反抗军普拉翰

682972.oracleText: Faced with a blast that would level not only New Phyrexia, but also a dozen innocent worlds, Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.
682972.translation: 此般爆裂震荡行将横扫新非瑞克西亚、同时牵连诸多无辜世界；艾紫培毅然将之连同自身逐入诸界间的黑暗虚空。

682973.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} more to cast if it targets a creature.
682973.translation: 如果此咒语以生物为目标，则它增加{o3}来施放。

682975.oracleText:
"Hear only harmony. See only glory. Speak only truth."
—Atraxa
682975.translation:
「只闻和谐。只见荣光。只言真理。」
～亚崔夏

682981.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, enchanted creature gets an additional +1/+0 and has first strike.
682981.translation: 腐化～只要某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，所结附的生物便再得+1/+0且具有先攻异能。

682983.oracleText: For the aspirants of the Progress Engine, being launched into the sphere's upper reaches is a great honor. Some are even granted wings beforehand.
682983.translation: 对于进展引擎的望化兽来说，能被送入狱界外沿就已是莫大荣耀。还有些在此之前会得赐双翼。

682984.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+3 and gains flying and toxic 1.
682984.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+3且获得飞行与下毒1。

682987.oracleText: It is Jin-Gitaxias's deepest exasperation that any part of his domain still requires maintenance.
682987.translation: 自身地界中还有地方需要维护，这点令金吉塔厦极为恼火。

682988.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
682988.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

682990.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Target creature gains flying until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
682990.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

682993.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes attached to a creature, for as long as CARDNAME remains attached to it, you may have that creature become a copy of another target creature you control.
682993.translation: 每当CARDNAME新贴附在任一生物上时，于CARDNAME持续贴附于其上期间，你可以使该生物成为另一个目标由你操控之生物的复制品。

682996.oracleText:
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned."
—Monument inscription
682996.translation:
「于原本无知之地，金吉塔厦带来智识，进展时代就此兴起。」
～丰碑铭文

682997.oracleText: Gain control of target creature with mana value X or less. If X is 5 or more, create a token that's a copy of that creature.
682997.translation: 获得目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物之操控权。如果X等于或大于5，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品。

682999.oracleText: Kaya watched in horror as the illusion vanished from her hands. Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.
682999.translation: 卡娅惊恐地看着虚影在手中消逝。真正的同兆在杰斯手中～且他在心智遭非瑞化之前就已起动。

683000.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}. Corrupted — Counter that spell instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683000.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为反击该咒语。

683001.oracleText:
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}. 
Corrupted — Counter that spell instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683001.translation:
除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。
腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为反击该咒语。

683003.oracleText: It can catch a rat and perform a spinal tap with one graceful swipe of its paw.
683003.translation: 它只需爪子优雅一挥，就能轻松抓住老鼠抽取脊液。

683006.oracleText: "Free will was an illusion so perfect it fooled even me. I know better now."
683006.translation: 「自由意志这一幻象如此完美，连我都曾遭欺骗。现在的我看得更透彻。」

683007.oracleText: Corrupted — This spell costs {o2} less to cast if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
683007.translation: 腐化～如果某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

683009.oracleText:
"Careful—however they might look, they're not human. A step too close and they'll drag you in."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683009.translation:
「当心～不管样貌如何，他们现在都已不是人类。一旦走得太近，他们就会把你也拉进去。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683010.oracleText: Nonland permanents you control are artifacts in addition to their other types. The same is true for permanent spells you control and nonland permanent cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
683010.translation: 由你操控的非地永久物额外具有神器此类别。由你操控的永久物咒语和由你拥有且不在战场上的非地永久物牌也额外具有该类别。

683012.oracleText: One morning, the test subject decided to perform trials on the scientists.
683012.translation: 某天早晨，实验对象决定拿科学家来做实验。

683013.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-0 until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
683013.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-0直到回合结束，X为由你操控的神器数量。

683016.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. Proliferate.
683016.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。增殖。

683022.oracleText:
"Drink deeply of the truth, and become compleat."
—Tamiyo

683025.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target player mills X cards, where X is the number of oil counters on CARDNAME.
683025.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标牌手磨X张牌，X为CARDNAME上的烁油指示物数量。

683028.oracleText: An inconsistency in a routine vivisection sparked a revelation about the inner workings of the Orthodoxy's centurions.
683028.translation: 常规活体解剖过程中一次违规操作，碰巧揭示了机械正道百夫长的内部运作机理。

683032.oracleText: Bored with the ruins of Lumengrid, it migrated to the ruins of the Mephidross.
683032.translation: 在玩厌博识都遗迹之后，它来到蔓非沼废墟寻乐。

683035.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: CARDNAME gets +1/-1 until end of turn.
683035.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：CARDNAME得+1/-1直到回合结束。

683039.oracleText: "The oil is all-knowing. The trick is to ask the right questions."
683039.translation: 「全能烁油无所不知。关键在于问对问题。」

683041.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Scry 1.
683041.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：占卜1。

683044.oracleText: "I've isolated the chirality of the glistening oil, so there will be no wasted precursors."
683044.translation: 「我已将烁油的对掌性分离，从此不会再产生无用前质。」

683046.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has four or more oil counters on it, it gets +2/+0 and can't be blocked.
683046.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有四个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+2/+0且不能被阻挡。

683050.oracleText: Take an extra turn after this one.
683050.translation: 于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。

683051.oracleText: Planeswalkers you control have "[0]: Proliferate" and "[-12]: Take an extra turn after this one."
683051.translation: 由你操控的鹏洛客具有「[0]：增殖」与「[-12]：于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。」

683052.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, choose a counter on target permanent. Put an additional counter of that kind on that permanent.
683052.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，选择目标永久物上的一个指示物。在该永久物上额外放置一个同种类的指示物。

683054.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -3/-0.
683054.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物得-3/-0。

683055.oracleText: Target player mills three cards. Then if a graveyard has twenty or more cards in it, you draw three cards. Otherwise, you draw a card.
683055.translation: 目标牌手磨三张牌。然后如果某坟墓场中有二十张或更多牌，则你抓三张牌。若否，则你抓一张牌。

683056.oracleText: Target player mills three times X cards.
683056.translation: 目标牌手磨三倍于X数量的牌。

683059.oracleText: Each of the Gitaxian sectives watches the others, looking for any hint of imperfection.
683059.translation: 吉塔厦派各组之间互相监视，不放过一丝瑕疵。

683062.oracleText:
"Imagine a giant room, like a library . . . except instead of books, it's filled with body parts."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683062.translation:
「想象一个巨大的房间，就如图书馆那样…但里面堆满的不是书本，而是肢体。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683066.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: It becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
683066.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：它成为神器生物直到回合结束。

683078.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683078.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683080.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each oil counter on CARDNAME.
683080.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物，你施放的瞬间与法术咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

683083.oracleText: No matter how many times he saw it, Sarnvax always relished the look of dawning horror as his foes realized their mistake.
683083.translation: 无论看过多少遍，萨恩瓦依然享受对手在意识到自己失误时脸上浮现出的惊恐表情。

683084.oracleText: Counter target spell with mana value 1 or less.
683084.translation: 反击目标法术力值等于或小于1的咒语。

683086.oracleText: "Please, for science, tell me how it feels. Leave nothing out."
683086.translation: 「为科研发展，请如实告诉我期间感受。不要遗漏任何细节。」

683087.oracleText: Each opponent gets a poison counter.
683087.translation: 每位对手各得到一个中毒指示物。

683089.oracleText: It no longer needs to eat, but old instincts are put to use ridding the Surgical Bay of spies.
683089.translation: 虽然它已不用进食，但其古老本能仍能用来清除外展海湾的间谍。

683092.oracleText:
"Your theory holds merit. You do not."
—Sarnvax, Gitaxian sective
683092.translation:
「你的理论尚存价值。你却没有。」
～吉塔厦组的萨恩瓦

683093.oracleText: Counter target spell. If that spell's mana value was 3 or less, proliferate.
683093.translation: 反击目标咒语。如果该咒语的法术力值等于或小于3，则增殖。

683095.oracleText: "I bring a message from the Autonomous Furn—argh!"
683095.translation: 「我带来了自治熔炉的口信～啊！」

683096.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If that permanent had mana value 3 or less, proliferate.
683096.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果该永久物的法术力值等于或小于3，则增殖。

683098.oracleText: Visitors to the Surgical Bay often become permanent residents.
683098.translation: 外展海湾的访客通常都会永久居留。

683101.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Tap target artifact or creature.
683101.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：横置目标神器或生物。

683104.oracleText:
"We are opening a new chapter in the one true story of Phyrexia. Someone must record it for posterity."
—Tamiyo
683104.translation:
「我们将开启非瑞克西亚正统叙事的全新篇章。要有人为后世留下纪录。」
～多美代

683105.oracleText: {o5oU}, {oT}: Draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each other artifact you control.
683105.translation: {o5oU}，{oT}：抓一张牌。你每操控一个其他神器，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

683107.oracleText: If you would proliferate, proliferate twice instead.
683107.translation: 如果你将增殖，则改为增殖两次。

683108.oracleText: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}, Remove three counters from among other artifacts, creatures, and planeswalkers you control: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683108.translation: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}，从由你操控的其他神器、生物和鹏洛客上移去总共三个指示物：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683115.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each oil counter on it.
683115.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+1。

683120.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, draw a card, then discard a card.
