683120.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

683121.oracleText: Other blue creatures you control have "Whenever this creature becomes tapped, draw a card, then discard a card."
683121.translation: 由你操控的其他蓝色生物具有「每当此生物成为横置时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。」

683122.oracleText: {o(U/P)}: Until end of turn, target creature you control becomes a blue artifact in addition to its other colors and types. Activate only as a sorcery.
683122.translation: {o(U/P)}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物成为蓝色神器，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。只能于法术时机起动。

683127.oracleText: "Experimental Log 290: Leaving the subject's pain receptors active appears to yield an unprecedented combination of incoherence and hyperawareness."
683127.translation: 「实验日志290：保留对象的痛觉受体，似乎同时产生了无意识跟超意识的结果，此前从未观察到此类现象。」

683131.oracleText: After a series of ambushes, Uulbrek demanded a sentry with no blind spots.
683131.translation: 在遭受连串伏击后，乌布雷要求派没有丝毫盲点的哨卫来巡逻。

683133.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, draw cards equal to the number of oil counters on it.
683133.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，抓若干牌，其数量等同于其上的烁油指示物数量。

683136.oracleText: The Mirran forces thought they'd vanquished their foes . . . until a nearby monument got up and started stalking toward them.
683136.translation: 秘罗军以为已全歼敌人…直到附近的丰碑起身向他们缓步前进。

683140.oracleText: By gaze, sting, and claw, Vraska will see the will of Phyrexia done.
683140.translation: 瞪视、毒刺、利爪，瓦丝卡总有办法确保非瑞克西亚意志得以贯彻。

683141.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay {o4} or sacrifice an artifact or creature.
683141.translation: 支付{o4}或牺牲一个神器或生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

683143.oracleText: Many vatkeepers use necrogen etchings to judge the value of their aspirants. If the wounds rot and fester, the recipient is not worth further effort.
683143.translation: 许多司缸依据望化兽身上的化尸瘴蚀刻来判断其价值。如果其身上伤口腐败溃烂，就没必要继续投入精力。

683144.oracleText: Exile target creature if it has mana value 3 or less. Corrupted — Exile that creature instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683144.translation: 如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于3，则放逐之。腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为放逐该生物。

683145.oracleText:
Exile target creature if it has mana value 3 or less. 
Corrupted — Exile that creature instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683145.translation:
如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于3，则放逐之。
腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为放逐该生物。

683148.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from CARDNAME. Then if it has no oil counters on it, you lose the game.
683148.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物。然后如果其上没有烁油指示物，则你输掉这盘游戏。

683150.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, its controller loses 2 life.
683150.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，该操控者失去2点生命。

683152.oracleText:
"Watch your footing around here. Anything you might step on probably has teeth."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683152.translation:
「在这地方下脚时要当心。你踩到的任何东西都可能有牙齿。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683154.oracleText:
"Where once there was complacence, Sheoldred brought ambition, and soon the will of Yawgmoth reigned."
—Monument inscription
683154.translation:
「于原本自满之地，希欧蕊带来雄心，约格莫夫意志将成正统。」
～丰碑铭文

683155.oracleText: Up to one target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. If X is 5 or more, return a creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
683155.translation: 至多一个目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。如果X等于或大于5，则将一张法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

683159.oracleText:
"Get away from there! I must rebuild that one for the next bout. Shoo, shoo!"
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor
683159.translation:
「从那玩意上走开！我得重新修好那东西，下次战斗还要用。嘘，嘘！」
～血肉雕匠刻兹杰

683160.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, CARDNAME has deathtouch and lifelink.
683160.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，CARDNAME便具有死触和系命异能。

683163.oracleText: What cannot be remade will be unmade, one scrap at a time.
683163.translation: 不能修好重用的就将之弃置，一次销毁一小块。

683164.oracleText: Corrupted — Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Draw a card. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters and only once each turn.
683164.translation: 腐化～牺牲一个神器或生物：抓一张牌。只能于某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动，且每回合限一次。

683166.oracleText: The gospel of lies sounds sweetest when whispered by many mouths.
683166.translation: 只要众口齐声传唱，谎言福音就最为甜美。

683171.oracleText: "We both serve the Demon Thane. Your parts would better serve with me."
683171.translation: 「我们都服侍恶魔伯爵。但你化整为零为我所用，效果会更好。」

683172.oracleText: Sacrifice another artifact or creature: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
683172.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

683175.oracleText: {o(B/P)o(B/P)}, Exile three creature cards from your graveyard: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683175.translation: {o(B/P)o(B/P)}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张生物牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683178.oracleText: Sinking into the Dross is neither a gentle death nor a quiet one. But once the necrogen takes hold, it is inevitable.
683178.translation: 陷入深沼后死起来绝不安详，也绝不安静。但一旦吸入化尸瘴，就必死无疑。

683179.oracleText: Target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn. Proliferate.
683179.translation: 目标生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。增殖。

683180.oracleText:
"Give of yourself, for compleation awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred
683180.translation:
「请先奉献自己，因唯有已涤净者方得完化。」
～希欧蕊僧侣诺卡

683182.oracleText: They wished to become vital parts of the Dross Pits. Azax-Azog granted their request.
683182.translation: 他们希望能在蔓非深沼中担任要职。亚札佐从他们所愿。

683183.oracleText: You draw three cards and you lose 3 life. Corrupted — Each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 3 life.
683183.translation: 你抓三张牌且失去3点生命。腐化～每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去3点生命。

683184.oracleText:
You draw three cards and you lose 3 life. 
Corrupted — Each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 3 life.
683184.translation:
你抓三张牌且失去3点生命。
腐化～每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去3点生命。

683186.oracleText: What she lacks in skin she makes up in swagger.
683186.translation: 没有皮肤带来的劣势，她靠架势补回。

683190.oracleText: "It seems someone forgot to read the fine print."

683191.oracleText: {o1oBoB}, {oT}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains "If this creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else." Activate only as a sorcery.
683191.translation: {o1oBoB}，{oT}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得「如果此生物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。」只能于法术时机起动。

683193.oracleText:
"Does anyone else hear that horrible crunching sound?"
—Jace
683193.translation:
「你们都没人听到那恐怖的咔嚓声吗？」
～杰斯

683197.oracleText: "I give you pain, you give me information. A simple trade, is it not?"
683197.translation: 「我给你痛苦，你予我信息。很简单的交易，不是吗？」

683198.oracleText: You draw two cards and you lose 2 life. Each opponent gets a poison counter.
683198.translation: 你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。每位对手各得到一个中毒指示物。

683200.oracleText: Other Rats you control have toxic 1.
683200.translation: 由你操控的其他老鼠具有下毒1。

683203.translation: 所结附的生物具有下毒2。

683207.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683207.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683214.oracleText: "Give all you are to Phyrexia, and you will receive more than you could have ever desired."
683214.translation: 「将你的一切都献予非瑞克西亚，所得回报将远超所想。」

683216.oracleText: The praetors of the other Spheres privately wonder how Sheoldred always has a surplus of glistening oil at her disposal.
683216.translation: 其他狱界的魔判官私底下都想搞清楚，为何希欧蕊手边总有用不完的烁油。

683217.oracleText: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.
683217.translation: 在那苦乐参半的一瞬间，杰斯曾以为自己还有机会救下心中所爱。而瓦丝卡需要的就正是这一瞬间。她趁机低语道：「为了非瑞克西亚荣光。」

683218.oracleText:
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain."
—Sheoldred
683218.translation:
「让我看看那些谄媚艾蕾侬的家伙美丽瓷体底下都是些什么东西。」
～希欧蕊

683220.oracleText: Some of Sheoldred's goliaths spread the glory of Phyrexia. Others just eat.
683220.translation: 希欧蕊手下有些巨身兽努力散播非瑞克西亚荣光。而有些就只会吃。

683224.oracleText: "I have raised many of my own contenders for the Coliseum. This one will be fearsome one day, mark my words."
683224.translation: 「我曾为竞技场输送过不少亲自培养的精英选手。这位总有一天也会大杀四方，记住我的话。」

683225.oracleText: Whenever you proliferate, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
683225.translation: 每当你增殖时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

683233.oracleText: The punishment for sedition, like every other crime in the Dross Pits, is execution.
683233.translation: 煽动罪的刑责与蔓非深沼内其他罪行并无区别～都是死刑。

683235.oracleText: From within its form, a single word echoed forth: "Devour."
683235.translation: 从其体内，两个字音不断回响：「吞噬。」

683238.oracleText: She proudly carries the weight of Phyrexia's creed, both figuratively and literally.
683238.translation: 她光荣承担非瑞克西亚信条之重～无论精神上或肉体上皆是如此。

683239.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
683239.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

683242.oracleText: The first rebirth is a reward. The fifty-first is a punishment.
683242.translation: 第一次再生是奖赏。第五十一次则是惩罚。

683243.oracleText: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. Proliferate.
683243.translation: 将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。增殖。

683245.oracleText: Whenever another artifact or creature you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683245.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683247.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Remove four oil counters from CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
683247.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去四个烁油指示物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

683250.oracleText: "Soon enough each praetor will have hired me to kill the others, and I will stand alone as the true Father of Machines."
683250.translation: 「很快其他魔判官也都会来雇我来除掉魔判异己，最后只剩我成为真正机械之父。」

683251.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control die, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.
683251.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物死去时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

683253.oracleText: You draw a card and you lose 1 life. Proliferate.
683253.translation: 你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。增殖。

683254.oracleText: Target creature becomes a Treasure artifact with "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color" and loses all other card types and abilities.
683254.translation: 目标生物成为具「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力」的珍宝神器，且失去所有其他牌张类别和异能。

683255.oracleText: If target player has fewer than nine poison counters, they get a number of poison counters equal to the difference.
683255.translation: 如果目标牌手具有少于九个中毒指示物，则其得到等同于此差距数量的中毒指示物。

683257.oracleText: The dull, creeping pain of phyresis curdled in Vraska's blood. She knew as soon as it took her, she would betray everything—even Jace.
683257.translation: 非瑞化的针刺隐痛逐渐在瓦丝卡的血液凝结。她从自己染疾的那一刻起，就知道自己会背叛一切～甚至是杰斯。

683260.oracleText: "Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now."
683260.translation: 「无论生死，你现在都要服侍钢铁伯爵。」

683261.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Proliferate.
683261.translation: 目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。增殖。

683263.oracleText: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.
683263.translation: 移行树穿破黑暗虚空，令非瑞克西亚完化势力在多重宇宙之间自如奔流。

683264.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more counters on a permanent or player, CARDNAME deals that much damage to target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
683264.translation: 每当你在一个永久物或一位牌手上放置一个或数个指示物时，CARDNAME对目标对手，由对手操控的生物或由对手操控的鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

683267.oracleText:
"Without faith in each other, we truly would have nothing left. Isn't that right, Malach? . . . Malach?"
—Darven, Mirran rebel, last words
683267.translation:
「要彼此之间都信不过，我们就真的什么都没有了。你说是吧，马拉克？…马拉克？」
～秘罗反抗军达文的遗言

683268.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If it's equipped, you may destroy all Equipment attached to that creature.
683268.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果它佩带武具，则你可以消灭所有贴附在该生物上的武具。

683270.oracleText: "I will not rest until the truth of Phyrexia is inscribed across the Multiverse."
683270.translation: 「在非瑞克西亚真理刻遍整个多重宇宙之前，我不会停歇。」

683272.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME, Discard a card: Draw a card.
683272.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物，弃一张牌：抓一张牌。

683275.oracleText: "Finally, a safe way to punch the rotters in the face."
683275.translation: 「终于能够安全地照着腐化者脸上给他一拳。」

683277.oracleText: "To dance to the music of Juex, leap like the flickering flame and hit like the hammer."
683277.translation: 「若要随着朱业音乐起舞，只需如火焰般跃动，似铁锤般重击。」

683278.oracleText: Equipment spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
683278.translation: 你施放的武具咒语减少{o1}来施放。

683279.oracleText: Activated abilities of Equipment you control that target CARDNAME cost {o1} less to activate.
683279.translation: 对由你操控的武具而言，其以CARDNAME为目标的起动式异能减少{o1}来起动。

683282.oracleText:
"They call themselves the Quiet Furnace? Ironic."
—Tyvar
683282.translation:
「他们居然自称静谧熔炉？真是讽刺。」
～泰瓦

683285.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, proliferate.
683285.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则增殖。

683289.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you have nine or more cards in your graveyard.
683289.translation: 如果你的坟墓场中有九张或更多牌，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

683293.oracleText:
"They're violent, headstrong, and wildly unpredictable. It should be amusing to see how Norn's vaunted tactics try to cope with them."
—Urabrask
683293.translation:
「他们性情暴烈，头脑顽固，行不可测。用他们来试试艾蕾侬自诩的高明战术会如何应对，想必会很有意思。」
～洼巴司

683297.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put an oil counter on another target nontoken artifact or creature you control.
683297.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的神器或生物上放置一个烁油指示物。

683298.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature token. Activate only if an oil counter was removed from a permanent you controlled this turn or a permanent with an oil counter on it was put into a graveyard this turn.
683298.translation: {o2}，{oT}：派出一个1/1红色非瑞人／鬼怪衍生生物。只能于由你操控的永久物上移去烁油指示物，或是其上有烁油指示物之永久物进入坟墓场的回合起动。

683300.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has flying and haste.
683300.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有飞行与敏捷异能。

683303.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each oil counter on it.
683303.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+0。

683309.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may remove two oil counters from it. When you do, target creature can't block this turn.
683309.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从其上移去两个指示物。若你如此作，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

683312.oracleText: He finally understood that phyresis was not an ending, but a new, perfect beginning.
683312.translation: 他终于明白，非瑞化并非结束，而是一个全新的完美开始。

683313.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Put two oil counters on it.
683313.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。在其上放置两个烁油指示物。

683315.oracleText: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.
683315.translation: 她会给自己喜欢的造物打上炽灼印记，其他的就放任熔炉吞噬。

683316.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player unless they control two or more basic lands.
683316.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，除非该牌手操控两个或更多基本地，否则CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

683319.oracleText: With the Quiet Furnace closed to all other factions, Urabrask's smiths were free to build anything their creativity demanded.
683319.translation: 随着静谧熔炉向其他派系关闭后，洼巴司的工匠便能手随心动，自由打造创意想象之物。

683321.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Target creature you control gains haste until end of turn.
683321.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：目标由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

683324.oracleText: Urabrask encourages creativity in all its forms, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.
683324.translation: 洼巴司鼓励各式创新，甚至是毁灭式创新。特别是毁灭式创新。

683325.oracleText: Destroy target artifact. If you controlled that artifact, create three 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens.
683325.translation: 消灭目标神器。如果你操控该神器，则派出三个1/1红色非瑞人／鬼怪衍生生物。

683327.oracleText: The Machine Orthodoxy finds strength in numbers. The Quiet Furnace finds that amusing.
683327.translation: 机械正道认为数量就是力量。静谧熔炉认为这观点很可笑。

683328.oracleText: Hazardous Blast deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control. Creatures your opponents control can't block this turn.
683328.translation: 毒焰冲击波向每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

683332.oracleText:
"No matter how tough they are, even Phyrexians prefer to keep their guts on the inside."
—Jor Kadeen
683332.translation:
「无论非瑞克西亚人有多强，他们也更愿意内脏留在体内。」
～尤克定

683333.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature has toxic, CARDNAME deals 4 damage to that creature instead.
683333.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害。如果该生物具有下毒异能，则改为金角板斩击对该生物造成4点伤害。

683334.oracleText: Hexgold Slash deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature has toxic, Hexgold Slash deals 4 damage to that creature instead.
683334.translation: 金角板斩击对目标生物造成2点伤害。如果该生物具有下毒异能，则改为金角板斩击对该生物造成4点伤害。

683336.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
683336.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

683337.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.
683337.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的山脉数量。

683343.oracleText: You would laugh too if you just burned through a tyrranax's stomach.
683343.translation: 你要是刚从霸蛛龙的胃里烧穿出来，你也会笑。

683344.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of permanents you control with oil counters on them.
683344.translation: 每当 CARDNAME攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为由你操控且其上有烁油指示物的永久物数量。

683349.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand unless you remove two oil counters from it.
683349.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，除非你从CARDNAME上移去两个烁油指示物，否则将它移回其拥有者手上。

683352.oracleText: "Perhaps this will show the Orthodoxy what we think of their attempts at indoctrination."
683352.translation: 「或许这样能向机械正道表明我们对其试图教导的立场。」

683353.oracleText: Molten Rebuke deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
683353.translation: 熔铁拒斥对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

683355.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target Equipment.
683355.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 
•消灭目标武具。

683356.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Molten Rebuke deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target Equipment.
683356.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•熔铁拒斥对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 
•消灭目标武具。

683358.oracleText: Nahiri's last free breath became a defiant roar as she tore apart Sheoldred's Coliseum.
683358.translation: 娜希丽利用最后一口自由气息将希欧蕊竞技场彻底摧毁，令这声反抗怒吼震撼全域。

683359.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature with mana value X.
683359.translation: 牺牲一个法术力值为X的神器或生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

683360.oracleText: Nahiri's Sacrifice deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures.
683360.translation: 娜希丽献身对任意数量的目标生物造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。

683362.oracleText: Popular wisdom says that Phyrexians don't feel fear. But popular wisdom has never tried to hold a bridge against an angry ogre.
683362.translation: 一般认为非瑞克西亚人不晓得何谓恐惧。但在面对愤怒食人魔来袭时，一般也不会去妄想死守桥梁。

683365.oracleText: "That Great Work of yours is looking pretty fragile, Urabrask!"
683365.translation: 「洼巴司，你的伟大志业看起来不堪一击！」

683366.oracleText: Rebel Salvo deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. That permanent loses indestructible until end of turn.
683366.translation: 反抗迸火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。该永久物失去不灭异能直到回合结束。

683368.oracleText:
"Where once there was apathy, Urabrask brought passion, and the Great Work truly began."
—Monument inscription
683368.translation:
「于原本冷漠之地，洼巴司带来激情，伟大志业真切开展。」
～丰碑铭文

683369.oracleText: Destroy up to X target artifacts. If X is 5 or more, for each artifact destroyed this way, create a token that's a copy of it. Those tokens gain haste. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
683369.translation: 消灭至多X个目标神器。如果X等于或大于5，则每以此法消灭一个神器，便派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。这些衍生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们放逐。

683371.oracleText: When the Vulshok taught him the word for "home," he knew it was what he had been fighting for.
683371.translation: 当瓦许可人教会他「家」这个字时，便立刻明白这就是他一直为之战斗的东西。

683373.oracleText: Sometimes the Great Work requires destruction to allow for more efficient reconstruction.
683373.translation: 有时，伟大志业需要先毁坏才能更有效地重建。

683375.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: It deals 1 damage to each opponent.
683375.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

683378.oracleText:
"They may have unlimited mites, but that just means we have unlimited ammunition."
—Urabrask
683378.translation:
「他们或许有无数虫械，但这也就意味着我们会有无穷弹药。」
～洼巴司

683383.oracleText: Once he fought to save Mirrodin. Now he fights to remake it.
683383.translation: 他原来为保卫秘罗地而战。他现在为重塑秘罗地而战。

683384.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Add an amount of {oR} equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value. Spend this mana only to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
683384.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器：加若干{oR}，其数量等同于所牺牲神器的法术力值。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语，或是起动神器的异能。

683386.oracleText: If a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals double that damage to that player or permanent instead.
683386.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将向任一对手或由对手操控的永久物造成非战斗伤害，则改为它对该牌手或永久物造成两倍的伤害。

683387.oracleText: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}, Discard two cards: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683387.translation: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}，弃两张牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683389.oracleText: As the infection spread, Nahiri's thoughts grew tangled. She needed to protect what she loved from Phyrexia . . . or maybe only Phyrexia could protect what she loved.
683389.translation: 随着侵染不断扩散，娜希丽的思绪逐渐纠结。她需要保护心爱事物免遭非瑞克西亚毒手…但或许只有非瑞克西亚才能真正施以保护。

683391.oracleText: "You were so eager to spy on my work, I assume you'll appreciate a hands-on demonstration."
683391.translation: 「既然你这么迫不及待地想要偷看我的作品，那我觉得你会更喜欢来亲自体验。」

683395.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put an oil counter on CARDNAME, then create an X/1 red Phyrexian Horror creature token with trample and haste, where X is the number of oil counters on CARDNAME. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
683395.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物，然后派出一个X/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的非瑞人／惊惧兽衍生生物，X为CARDNAME上之烁油指示物数量。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

683398.oracleText: Her faith burns hot enough to sear away the flesh of the heretic.
683398.translation: 她的信念之火足够热烈，能烧尽异教徒的肉身。

683400.oracleText: {o6oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Discard your hand, then draw four cards. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each oil counter on CARDNAME.
683400.translation: {o6oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：弃掉你的手牌,然后抓四张牌。CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物,此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

683402.oracleText:
"There's a war brewing between Norn and Urabrask. Exploit the chaos, and we can take them both down for good."
—Koth
683402.translation:
「艾蕾侬与洼巴司之间的战争一触即发。利用这混乱，也许就能把他们两派一网打尽。」
～寇斯

683404.oracleText:
"Not my style, but it'll get the job done."
—Nahiri
683404.translation:
「虽不符我的风格，但一样能完事。」
～娜希丽

683407.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
683407.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得警戒异能。

683408.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
683408.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得警戒异能。

683413.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +3/+0 as long as it has three or more oil counters on it.
683413.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有三个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+3/+0。

683415.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, exile target card from a graveyard and put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683415.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐并在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683420.oracleText: Some Vicious Swarm aspirants hang motionless in the canopy for weeks, allowing poisonous flowers to root in their flesh and weave tendrils through their hair.
683420.translation: 有些暴恶蛮群的望化兽会在林冠上一动不动地垂挂数周，任由剧毒花朵扎根肉身，盘曲卷须直埋发梢。

683423.oracleText:
{o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Proliferate.
683423.translation:
{o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•增殖。

683426.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying. If that permanent's mana value was 3 or less, proliferate.
683426.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。如果该永久物法术力值等于或小于3，则增殖。

683428.oracleText: {oT}: Choose target nonland permanent card in your graveyard. If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card. If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
683428.translation: {oT}：选择目标在你坟墓场中的非地永久物牌。如果你本回合中未施放过咒语，则你可以施放该牌。若你如此作，则你本回合中不能再施放咒语。只能于法术时机起动。

683434.oracleText: Its webs are not true silk, but woven from thousands of delicate mycosynth strands.
683434.translation: 它的蛛网并非真正的蛛丝，而是由千万缕精细的构生菌丝线编纺而成。

683439.oracleText: CARDNAME has trample as long as it has two or fewer oil counters on it. Otherwise, it has hexproof.
683439.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有两个或更少烁油指示物，它便具有践踏异能。若否，则它具有辟邪异能。

683441.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from CARDNAME. Then if it has no oil counters on it, sacrifice it.
683441.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从蜕变斯宾驼登上移去一个CARDNAME。然后若其上没有烁油指示物，则将它牺牲。

683449.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. Put up to two land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you put fewer than two lands onto the battlefield this way, proliferate a number of times equal to the difference.
683449.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。将其中至多两张地牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果你以此法放进战场的地牌数量少于两张，则增殖等同于此差距数量的次数。

683451.oracleText: Reveal the top X plus one cards of your library. Choose a creature card and/or a land card from among them. Put those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If X is 5 or more, instead put the chosen cards onto the battlefield or into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
683451.translation: 展示你牌库顶的X加一张牌。选择其中一张生物牌和／或一张地牌。将这些牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果X等于或大于5，则改为将所选的牌都放进战场或置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

683454.oracleText: Warm forges and tasty goblins lured it from the Hunter Maze to the Quiet Furnace.
683454.translation: 温暖的锻坊跟美味的鬼怪将它从猎者迷林吸引到了静谧熔炉。

683456.oracleText:
"This one needs a bit longer to ripen."
—Glissa Sunslayer
683456.translation:
「这个要久一点才会熟透。」
～戮日者格莉莎

683458.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
683458.translation: {o4}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

683461.oracleText:
"Let me tell you why you must never close your eyes when on watch. Not even for a second."
—Jor Kadeen
683461.translation:
「我来告诉你为什么站岗的时候千万不能闭眼。哪怕一秒钟都不行。」
～尤克定

683462.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. Each opponent gets a poison counter.
683462.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。每位对手获得一个中毒指示物。

683464.translation:
「洼巴司的思维格局还不够大。」
～戮日者格莉莎

683466.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may remove an oil counter from it. If you do, untap it and it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
683466.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从其上移去一个烁油指示物。若你如此作，则将它重置且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

683472.oracleText: Create an X/X green Phyrexian Horror creature token, where X is CARDNAME's loyalty.
683472.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色非瑞人／惊惧兽衍生生物，X为CARDNAME的忠诚。

683475.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +1/+1 for each Forest you control and gain trample.
683475.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能，且你每操控一个树林，它们便得+1/+1。

683477.oracleText: Even as they brought the beast down, they could feel its poison working into their blood, altering their bodies, and filling their minds with the thrill of the eternal hunt.
683477.translation: 就算他们已然击倒野兽，也仍能感受到对方体内毒素在自己血液中穿行，改变众人肉身，令大家心智充满无尽狩猎的渴望。

683478.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn. Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller gets a poison counter.
683478.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者得到一个中毒指示物。

683481.oracleText: Metal or flesh, it didn't matter—seasoned with ichor, it all tasted so good.
683481.translation: 是铁是肉，都无所谓～佐以脓水，同样美味。

683485.oracleText: The strategies and politics of the Vicious Swarm are as subtle as Vorinclex himself.
683485.translation: 暴恶蛮群无论是作战策略还是政治手法，都跟弗霖凯本人一样精致。

683489.oracleText: {o2oG}: Each other creature you control with toxic gains toxic 1 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
683489.translation: {o2oG}：每个由你操控且具下毒异能的其他生物均获得下毒1直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

683491.oracleText:
"Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time."
—Melira
683491.translation:
「我们脚步最好不要停。刚才那阵咕噜声说明进食时间到了。」
～梅梨莱

683493.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
683493.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

683497.oracleText:
"All elves aspire to be part of nature. Only Phyrexia can truly grant that wish."
—Glissa Sunslayer
683497.translation:
「所有妖精都渴望能够融入自然。只有非瑞克西亚才能真正实现这愿望。」
～戮日者格莉莎

683498.oracleText: {oT}: Put an oil counter on CARDNAME.

683500.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Untap target land.
683500.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：重置目标地。

683503.oracleText: In the Hunter Maze, today's apex predator is tomorrow's prey.
683503.translation: 在猎者迷林中，今日的顶端猎者明日可能就成他人猎物。

683505.oracleText:
"I bet even Skithiryx would take the long way around this one."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683505.translation:
「我打赌就连极兹锐看到它也会绕远路。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683508.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +4/+4 and has trample.
683508.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+4/+4且具有践踏异能。

683511.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. 
• Proliferate.
683511.translation:
选择一项～ 
•从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。 
•增殖。

683513.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be the target of nongreen spells your opponents control or abilities from nongreen sources your opponents control.
683513.translation: 对由对手操控之非绿色咒语或由对手操控之非绿色来源的异能而言，CARDNAME不能成为其目标。

683516.oracleText:
"It is as the Mirrans say: True strength comes from within."
—Ich-Tekik, Salvage Splicer
683516.translation:
「就跟秘罗人常说的一样：真正的力量源自体内。」
～废品接合师衣克铁克

683519.oracleText: While some predators specialize in speed, size, or deadly venom, the adaptive tyrranax see no need to limit themselves.
683519.translation: 虽然有些猎者专精于发展速度、体型或致命毒素等优势，但善于适应环境的霸蛛龙觉得没必要限制自己。

683524.oracleText: "When they write songs about this battle, I will make sure your name is forgotten, devil."
683524.translation: 「当他们为这场战斗写颂歌时，我会确保其间不会提及你的名字，魔鬼。」

683525.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +X/+X and gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
683525.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X且获得辟邪与不灭异能。

683527.oracleText: "If you don't reassemble me immediately, the Mother of Machines will notice my absence, and this entire layer will face her wrath!"
683527.translation: 「如果你不立刻将我重新组装回来，机械之母便会知晓我未能赶到，而后整层狱界都将直面她的怒火！」

683528.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. Proliferate.
683528.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。增殖。

683530.oracleText:
"This was once a peaceful spring, but I wouldn't advise taking a sip."
—Melira
683530.translation:
「这里曾是一处祥和的涌泉，但如今我不建议饮用其流水。」
～梅梨莱

683531.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell, target opponent gets a poison counter.
683531.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物成为咒语的目标时，目标对手得到一个中毒指示物。

683539.oracleText: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}, Sacrifice two other creatures: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683539.translation: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}，牺牲两个其他生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683545.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate of other Equipment cost {o1} less to activate.
683545.translation: 你起动的其他武具之佩带异能减少{o1}来起动。

683549.oracleText: Silent observers swim through the air of Norn's Seedcore, watching the nascent Invasion Tree for any signs of interference.
683549.translation: 观察械安静地漂浮在艾蕾侬的树种核心空中，保卫刚萌芽的移行树免遭任何侵扰。

683550.oracleText: Cephalopod Sentry's power is equal to the number of artifacts you control.
683550.translation: 头足哨卫的力量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

683554.oracleText: Remove three oil counters from CARDNAME: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
683554.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去三个烁油指示物：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

683557.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each permanent you control with oil counters on it.
683557.translation: 你每操控一个其上有烁油指示物的永久物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

683561.oracleText: "Ah, my old friends. Have you decided at last to stop clinging to the past and join me in the grand pursuit of perfection?"
683561.translation: 「啊，我的老朋友。你是否已经决定放弃纠结过往，转而与我一同追求完美大业？」

683564.oracleText: Whenever you proliferate, draw a card.
683564.translation: 每当你增殖时，抓一张牌。

683566.oracleText: Remove up to three counters from target permanent.
683566.translation: 从目标永久物上移去三个指示物。

683567.oracleText: Remove up to three counters from target permanent.
683567.translation: 从目标永久物上移去三个指示物。

683568.oracleText:
Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, choose one — 
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Remove up to three counters from target permanent.
683568.translation:
每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择一项～ 
•你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•从目标永久物上移去至多三个指示物。

683569.oracleText:
Whenever Glissa Sunslayer deals combat damage to a player, choose one — 
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Remove up to three counters from target permanent.
683569.translation:
每当戮日者格莉莎对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择一项～ 
•你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•从目标永久物上移去至多三个指示物。

683574.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you may return one of them to its owner's hand. If you do, you may activate loyalty abilities of Kaito twice this turn rather than only once.
683574.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将其中一个移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则你本回合中可以起动魁渡的忠诚异能两次，而不是只能起动一次。

683575.oracleText: Up to one target creature can't attack or block until your next turn.
683575.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

683579.oracleText: Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
683579.translation: 每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

683580.oracleText: You draw two cards. Then each opponent may scry 1.
683580.translation: 你抓两张牌。然后每位对手各可以占卜1。

683581.oracleText: Exile target creature or enchantment. If it wasn't an Aura, create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 1/1 white Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.
683581.translation: 放逐目标生物或结界。如果它不是灵气，则派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它是1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

683583.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonlegendary creature card with lesser mana value, put it onto the battlefield, then put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
683583.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值比它小的非传奇生物牌为止，将该牌放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

683585.oracleText: Add {oRoG}. Spend this mana only to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
683585.translation: 加{oRoG}。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语，或是起动生物的异能。

683586.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Phyrexian Beast creature token with toxic 1.
683586.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色，具下毒1的非瑞人／野兽衍生生物。

683591.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if three or more artifacts entered the battlefield under your control this turn, create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
683591.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有三个或更多神器在你的操控下进战场，则派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。

683593.oracleText: If you would get one or more poison counters, instead you get one poison counter and you can't get additional poison counters this turn.
683593.translation: 如果你将得到一个或数个中毒指示物，则改为你得到一个中毒指示物且你本回合中不能再得到中毒指示物。

683594.oracleText: Exile CARDNAME: Choose another target creature or artifact. When it's put into a graveyard this turn, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
683594.translation: 放逐CARDNAME：选择另一个目标生物或神器。本回合中，当它进入坟墓场时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

683599.oracleText: {o1}, Remove an oil counter from Migloz: It gains vigilance and menace until end of turn.
683599.translation: {o1}，从冥洛兹上移去一个烁油指示物：它获得警戒与威慑异能直到回合结束。

683600.oracleText: {o2}, Remove two oil counters from Migloz: It gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
683600.translation: {o2}，从冥洛兹上移去两个烁油指示物：它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

683601.oracleText: {o3}, Remove three oil counters from Migloz: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
683601.translation: {o3}，从冥洛兹上移去三个烁油指示物：消灭目标神器或结界。

683603.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature attacks a player each combat if able.
683603.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物每次战斗若能攻击牌手，则必须如此作。

683604.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw a card.
683604.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。

683605.oracleText: Exile target creature or Equipment card with mana value less than Nahiri's loyalty from your graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of it. That token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
683605.translation: 将目标法术力值小于娜希丽忠诚的生物或武具牌从你的坟墓场放逐。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。该衍生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它放逐。

683608.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with toxic deals combat damage to a player, that player gets an additional poison counter.
683608.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具下毒异能的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手额外得到一个中毒指示物。

683609.oracleText: {o1oBoG}: Target creature you control with toxic gains deathtouch until end of turn.
683609.translation: {o1oBoG}：目标由你操控且具下毒异能的生物获得死触直到回合结束。

683613.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create X 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens, where X is the mana value of that spell. They gain haste until end of turn.
683613.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出X个1/1红色非瑞人／鬼怪衍生生物，X为该咒语的法术力值。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

683619.oracleText: Remove three oil counters from CARDNAME: Draw a card. Then you may discard a nonland card. When you discard a card this way, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Activate only as a sorcery.
683619.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去三个烁油指示物：抓一张牌。然后你可以弃一张非地牌。当你以此法弃牌时，浆液核盖美拉对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

683622.oracleText: After giving in to the thrill of the hunt, he could never again return to the quiet of the Basilica.
683622.translation: 在屈从于狩猎渴望之后，他就再也无法回归宗堂的寂静环境。

683623.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with toxic attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
683623.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且具下毒异能的生物攻击时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

683627.oracleText: Untap up to one target creature.
683627.translation: 重置至多一个目标生物。

683628.oracleText: Mill three cards, then you may return a creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
683628.translation: 磨三张牌，然后你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

683631.oracleText: If you don't control a creature named The Hollow Sentinel, create The Hollow Sentinel, a legendary 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
683631.translation: 如果你未操控名称为空心卫的生物，则派出传奇衍生神器生物空心卫，其为3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。

683632.oracleText: If you don't control a creature named The Hollow Sentinel, create The Hollow Sentinel, a legendary 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
683632.translation: 如果你未操控名称为空心卫的生物，则派出传奇衍生神器生物空心卫，其为3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。

683633.oracleText: Target artifact creature you control gains flying and lifelink until end of turn.
683633.translation: 目标由你操控的神器生物获得飞行与系命异能直到回合结束。

683634.oracleText: Target artifact creature you control gains flying and lifelink until end of turn.
683634.translation: 目标由你操控的神器生物获得飞行与系命异能直到回合结束。

683635.oracleText:
Whenever you proliferate, choose one — 
• If you don't control a creature named The Hollow Sentinel, create The Hollow Sentinel, a legendary 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token. 
• Target artifact creature you control gains flying and lifelink until end of turn.
683635.translation:
每当你增殖时，选择一项～ 
•如果你未操控名称为空心卫的生物，则派出传奇衍生神器生物空心卫，其为3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。 
•目标由你操控的神器生物获得飞行与系命异能直到回合结束。

683637.oracleText: "May you rejoice in the magnificence of Norn. May your flesh serve perfection."
683637.translation: 「愿你在艾蕾侬壮景下得享喜乐。愿你的肉身得以服侍完化。」

683645.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice CARDNAME unless you discard a card. When you discard a card this way, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to the mana value of the discarded card.
683645.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你弃一张牌，否则牺牲 CARDNAME。当你以此法弃牌时，消灭目标由对手操控的非地永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于所弃之牌的法术力值。

683649.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may remove an oil counter from CARDNAME. When you do, target creature you control gains your choice of flying, vigilance, deathtouch, or lifelink until end of turn.
683649.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物。当你如此作时，选择飞行，警戒，死触或系命，目标由你操控的生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

683652.oracleText: It shines with the conviction of a zealous acolyte.
683652.translation: 狂热侍僧的执着信念令其闪耀。

683654.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683654.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲CARDNAME：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得飞行异能。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683657.oracleText: It seethes with the ambition of a ruthless gladiator.
683657.translation: 无情斗士的上进雄心令其沸扬。

683659.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683659.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683662.oracleText: The shifting, unpredictable sands were deemed a disobedient affront to the Flesh Singularity.
683662.translation: 在骨肉合一派眼里，变化多端、难以预测的黄沙是对其信仰的肆意冒犯。

683665.oracleText: {oT}: Put an oil counter on The Filigree Sylex.
683665.translation: {oT}：在丝金同兆上放置一个烁油指示物。

683666.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of oil counters on CARDNAME.
683666.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭所有法术力值等同于CARDNAME上烁油指示物数量的非地永久物。

683667.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice The Filigree Sylex: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of oil counters on The Filigree Sylex.
683667.translation: {oT}，牺牲丝金同兆：消灭所有法术力值等同于丝金同兆上烁油指示物数量的非地永久物。

683668.oracleText: {oT}, Remove ten oil counters from among permanents you control and sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 10 damage to any target.
683668.translation: {oT}，从由你操控的永久物上移去总共十个烁油指示物并牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意一个目标造成10点伤害。

683669.oracleText: {oT}, Remove ten oil counters from among permanents you control and sacrifice The Filigree Sylex: It deals 10 damage to any target.
683669.translation: {oT}，从由你操控的永久物上移去总共十个烁油指示物并牺牲丝金同兆：它对任意一个目标造成10点伤害。

683671.oracleText: It burns with the passion of an unbound creator.
683671.translation: 无拘工匠的热血激情令其燃烧。

683673.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put two oil counters on target artifact or creature you control. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683673.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：在目标神器或生物上放置两个烁油指示物。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683676.oracleText: Juggernauts you control attack each combat if able.
683676.translation: 由你操控的攻城巨车每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

683677.oracleText: Juggernauts you control can't be blocked by Walls.
683677.translation: 由你操控的攻城巨车不能被墙阻挡。

683678.oracleText: Other creatures you control have base power and toughness 5/3 and are Juggernauts in addition to their other creature types.
683678.translation: 由你操控的其他生物之，基础力量与防御力为5/3，且额外具有攻城巨车此生物类别。

683681.oracleText: Creatures you control with oil counters on them get +1/+1.
683681.translation: 由你操控且其上有烁油指示物的生物得+1/+1。

683683.oracleText: It pulses with the might of an apex predator.
683683.translation: 顶端猎者的强劲力量令其鼓动。

683685.oracleText: {o2oG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683685.translation: {o2oG}，牺牲CARDNAME：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683688.oracleText:
"Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold. We should be safe inside."
—Koth
683688.translation:
「这是梅梨莱帮我设计的。遭烁油感染的人无法踏过门槛。我们在里面应该很安全。」
～寇斯

683689.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is on the battlefield, it has all activated abilities of all land cards in all graveyards.
683689.translation: 只要CARDNAME在战场上，它便具有所有坟墓场中所有地牌的所有起动式异能。

683692.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Search your library for a basic, Sphere, or Locus land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
683692.translation: {o3}，{oT}：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本，域界或处所地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

683693.oracleText: {o3}: CARDNAME becomes a 9/9 Phyrexian Construct artifact creature, loses all abilities, and gains indestructible and toxic 9. Activate only if there are nine or more lands with different names among the basic, Sphere, and Locus lands you control.
683693.translation: {o3}：CARDNAME成为9/9非瑞人／组构体神器生物，失去所有异能，并获得不灭与下毒9。只能于你操控九个或更多不同名称的基本、域界与处所地时起动。

683696.oracleText: Humble, obedient, and tireless, myr require little modification to excel as servants of Phyrexia.
683696.translation: 秘耳卑微、顺从、无休，因此几乎不需改造就能成为非瑞克西亚的优秀仆从。

683697.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 2 life: Add one mana of any color.
683697.translation: {oT}，支付2点生命：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

683699.oracleText:
"Myr will go where the work is. We always have. We always will."
—Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch
683699.translation:
「哪里有工作，秘耳就去哪里。过去一直如此。将来仍会如此。」
～蒙纳珂孑遗尔铁

683703.oracleText:
"Our resistance is like the myr: small and easily overlooked, but loyal and resilient beyond measure."
—Melira
683703.translation:
「我们的反抗就如同秘耳一般：虽势小易被看轻，但忠毅却难以估量。」
～梅梨莱

683707.oracleText: Since conquering Mirrodin, Phyrexian engineers have worked tirelessly to transform the plane's original two layers into a more fitting array of nine.
683707.translation: 自从征服秘罗地之后，非瑞克西亚工程师便不眠不休地改造此处，将此时空原本的两层结构改为更合适的九层。

683708.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 1 life.
683708.translation: 腐化～每当CARDNAME成为横置时，每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去1点生命。

683710.oracleText:
"The five suns may have dimmed, but their light still guides us."
—Thrun
683710.translation:
「五阳之光或已黯淡，但仍能指导我们前行。」
～图伦

683712.oracleText: Why carry a subject to a surgical lab when you can bring the surgical lab to them?
683712.translation: 当你能将手术实验室搬到对象身边时，为什么还要设法把对象搬进手术实验室？

683713.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+2 and has toxic 1.
683713.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+2且具有下毒1。

683717.oracleText:
"Lock the door and eat the key."
—Vraan, Executioner Thane
683717.translation:
「锁上大门，吞下钥匙。」
～行刑伯爵瓦兰

683718.oracleText: Permanent cards in graveyards can't enter the battlefield.
683718.translation: 坟墓场中的永久物牌不能进战场。

683719.oracleText: Players can't cast noncreature spells from graveyards or exile.
683719.translation: 牌手不能从坟墓场或放逐区中施放非生物咒语。

683721.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Destroy target permanent you own.
683721.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：消灭目标由你拥有的永久物。

683727.oracleText: It crackles with the intellect of a twisted genius.
683727.translation: 曲志天才的无边智慧令其脆响。

683729.oracleText: {o2oU}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683729.translation: {o2oU}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683732.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from red and from green.
683732.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有反红保护与反绿保护。

683733.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn. You may play an additional land this turn.
683733.translation: 每当佩戴此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

683736.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Activate only if CARDNAME has two or more oil counters on it.
683736.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。只能于CARDNAME上有两个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

683738.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if CARDNAME has five or more oil counters on it.
683738.translation: {o1}，{oT}：抓一张牌。只能于CARDNAME上有五个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

683741.oracleText: It watches through the never-ending day, motionless save for the unsettling, twitching dance it performs as each sun reaches its apex.
683741.translation: 它在无尽白昼中观察不辍，纹丝不动，唯有在每个太阳升到顶空时方才扭动身躯跳起奇诡舞蹈。

683742.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their first multicolored spell each turn, each other player draws a card.
683742.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中其第一个多色咒语时，每位其他牌手各抓一张牌。

683745.oracleText: In Urabrask's domain, mighty forges echo day and night with the clangor of the Great Work.
683745.translation: 在洼巴司的地界，巨大锻炉铿锵作响日夜不停，共同编绘伟大志业宏伟蓝图。

683749.oracleText: Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.
683749.translation: 在雄心与勤勉交汇之处，贪欲拖累上进激情。

683750.oracleText: Where fire meets ferocity, a greater evolution begins.
683750.translation: 在烈火与凶蛮交汇之处，碰撞推动进化发展。

683751.oracleText: Where curiosity meets cruelty, hideous innovations arise.
683751.translation: 在好奇与残暴交汇之处，骇人发明日新月异。

683753.oracleText: In Sheoldred's domain, the Steel Thanes wage a never-ending war in her long shadow.
683753.translation: 在希欧蕊的地界，钢铁伯爵兴战不休，却永难与她平起平坐。

683758.oracleText: In Elesh Norn's domain, the gospel of unity is the highest law.
683758.translation: 在艾蕾侬的地界，大一统福音便是最高戒律。

683763.oracleText: In Vorinclex's domain, only the mightiest survive, and all are prey in his endless hunt.
683763.translation: 在弗霖凯的地界，唯有最强者方能生存，其余物种均是其无尽行猎的猎物。

683773.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Put an oil counter on target artifact or creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
683773.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：在目标由你操控的神器或生物上放置一个烁油指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

683776.oracleText: As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.
683776.translation: 随着移行树不断生长，其枝干早已穿透这世界的静寂核心。

683777.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: CARDNAME becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X.
683777.translation: {oX}，{oT}：CARDNAME成为目标由你操控、法术力值为X且非衍生物的神器之复制品。

683779.oracleText: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.
683779.translation: 在演化与禁制交汇之处，原初蛮力桀骜不羁。

683780.oracleText: Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.
683780.translation: 在教导与求知交汇之处，平静之下激流涌动。

683782.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast Phyrexian creature spells.
683782.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放非瑞人生物咒语。

683783.oracleText: Corrupted — {oT}: Target 1/1 creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
683783.translation: 腐化～{oT}：目标1/1生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。只能于某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动。

683785.oracleText: In Jin-Gitaxias's domain, strange and terrible experiments iterate toward perfection, unbound by ethics.
683785.translation: 在金吉塔厦的地界，各式诡怖实验不断翻新日趋完美，丝毫不受道德约束。

683789.oracleText:
"The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule."
—Koth
683789.translation:
「非瑞克西亚今日丰碑不过明日尘土。假使给足明日，其霸权也将消亡。」
～寇斯

683794.oracleText: A thousand riddles, each with a single answer: "The glory of Phyrexia."
683794.translation: 谜面千变，谜底归一：「非瑞克西亚荣光」。

683796.oracleText: {oU}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Draw a card, then scry 2.
683796.translation: {oU}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：抓一张牌，然后占卜2。

683799.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may pay 2 life and exile it. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's 1/1 and has toxic 1.
683799.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以支付2点生命并将它放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品，但它是1/1且具有下毒1。

683802.oracleText: Never get between a goblin and the closest shiny object.
683802.translation: 千万别挡在鬼怪和离他最近的发光物中间。

683808.oracleText: Corrupted — At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent has three or more poison counters, choose a creature you control, then draw cards equal to its total toxic value.
683808.translation: 腐化～在你的维持开始时，若某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则你选择一个由你操控的生物，然后抓等同于其总下毒值的牌。

683814.oracleText: Obedience is the armor that turns any blade.
683814.translation: 服从便是抵御利刃加身的最佳护甲。

683815.oracleText: To resist the embrace of the Flesh Singularity is to reject unconditional acceptance.
683815.translation: 抵御骨肉合一派之包容，相当于抗拒无条件接纳。

683816.oracleText: Phyrexia will stretch from sea to sky, across worlds and realities, inescapable and perfect.
683816.translation: 非瑞克西亚必将蔽洋漫天，降临诸界；终竟没处可避、至善无暇。

683817.oracleText: Even the most insignificant creature can be perfected.
683817.translation: 就连最不起眼的生物，也能臻至完美。

683818.oracleText: Etch your victories in iron, that the world may celebrate them forever.
683818.translation: 将胜利蚀刻于钢铁之上，便可令全世颂扬不息。

683819.oracleText: Be the blade that severs hierarchy.

683820.oracleText: Will you be the flame which burns the world, or merely be consumed as fuel?
683820.translation: 你是愿当照亮世界的明焰，还是沦作维系火光的燃料？

683821.oracleText: Feel the joy of losing yourself to feed the land.
683821.translation: 敬请感受献身丰沃大地的喜悦。

683822.oracleText: In the embrace of the Mother of Machines, hard work never goes unrewarded.
683822.translation: 蒙机械之母加恩，辛勤工作绝非无报。

683823.oracleText: Submit and know the Mother‘s glory. Resist and and know her wrath.
683823.translation: 屈从得享圣母荣光。抵抗便知圣母怒火。

683824.oracleText: Take everything from them. Lives. Flesh. The very ground they walk on. Only then will your victory be compleat.
683824.translation: 夺去他们的一切：生命，血肉，脚下每寸土地。唯有如此，才算完化胜利。

683825.oracleText: Do not fear death. Fear failure.
683825.translation: 无需畏惧死亡。但要害怕失败。

683826.oracleText: The Forge embraces all who contribute to the Great Work.
683826.translation: 锻炉热忱接纳所有献身伟大志业者。

683827.oracleText: Who is an enemy but a friend who has yet to accept perfection?
683827.translation: 不过只是尚未接受完化的朋友罢了，怎么能算是敌人呢？

683828.oracleText: Target an artifact or creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less.
683828.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且其法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物为目标。

683829.oracleText: Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of that player's next end step.
683829.translation: 在其拥有者的下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

683830.oracleText: Choose a creature that player controls.
683830.translation: 选择一个由该牌手操控的生物。

683831.oracleText: Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures.
683831.translation: 牺牲两个其他神器和／或生物

683833.oracleText: Target a spell with mana value 1 or less.
683833.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于1的咒语为目标

683837.oracleText: Return a creature card with mana value {2, Number} or less to the battlefield.
683837.translation: 将一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌移回战场。

683838.translation: 牺牲另一个神器或生物。

683839.oracleText: Reveal any number of Rat cards?
683839.translation: 是否要展示任意数量的老鼠牌？

683841.oracleText: Destroy all Equipment attached to that creature?
683841.translation: 消灭所有贴附在该生物上的武具？

683843.oracleText: Search for a basic Mountain card.
683843.translation: 搜寻一张基本的山脉牌。

683844.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact or creature with mana value {2, Number}.
683844.translation: 牺牲一个法术力值等于{2, Number}神器或生物。

683846.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} artifact.} other {Target up to {2, Number} artifacts.}}
683846.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定{2, Number}个神器为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}个神器为目标。}}

683848.oracleText: Choose a creature card and/or a land card.
683848.translation: 选择一张生物和／或地牌。

683849.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller gets a poison counter.
683849.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者得到一个中毒指示物。

683850.oracleText: Return one of them to its owner's hand?
683850.translation: 将其中一个移回其拥有者手上？

683851.oracleText: When it is put into a graveyard this turn, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
683851.translation: 本回合中，当它进入坟墓场时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

683852.oracleText: Return a creature card with mana value 2 or less to the battlefield?
683852.translation: 将一张法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌移回战场？

683853.oracleText: When you discard a card this way, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to the mana value of the discarded card.
683853.translation: 当你以此法弃牌时，消灭目标由对手操控的非地永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于所弃之牌的法术力值。

683854.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to the mana value of the discarded card.
683854.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的且法术力值小于或等于所弃之牌的法术力值的非地永久物为目标。

683856.oracleText: Search your library for a Myr card?
683856.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张秘耳牌？

683857.oracleText: Spend only on: Phyrexian Creature Spells
683857.translation: 只能用于支付：非瑞人生物咒语

701509.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies or is put into your graveyard from your hand or library, conjure a card named Gixian Recycler into your graveyard.
701509.translation: 当CARDNAME死去或从你的手上或牌库进入你的坟墓场时，将一张名称为基克斯派回收械的牌幻变进你的坟墓场。

701518.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or dies, seek an Urza's land card.
701518.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或死去时，取出一张克撒的地牌。

701523.translation: 指定至多一个士兵为目标。

701524.oracleText: Choose a Soldier card in your hand.
701524.translation: 选择你手上的一张士兵牌。

701527.oracleText: Choose a creature with the least toughness among creatures your opponents control.
701527.translation: 选择一个生物，且须是由对手操控的生物中防御力最小者。

701528.oracleText: Target a nontoken creature or artifact you control.
701528.translation: 指定一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物或神器为目标。

701529.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} land you control.} other {Target {2, Number} lands you control.}}
701529.translation: {2, plural, =1 {选择目标由你操控的地。} other {选择{2, Number}个目标由你操控的地。}}

701530.oracleText: Target up to one creature with power 4 or greater.
701530.translation: 指定至多一个力量等于或大于4的生物为目标。

701531.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value equal to {1, CardId}'s intensity from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
701531.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放一个法术力值等同于{1, CardId}的强度的咒语？

701532.oracleText: Discard those cards at the beginning of your next turn's end step.
701532.translation: 在你下一回合的结束步骤开始时，弃掉这些牌。

701533.oracleText: Target artifact card in your graveyard perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast." If it is a creature or Vehicle card, it perpetually gets +2/+2. Put it into your library second from the top.
701533.translation: 目标你坟墓场中的神器牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放」。如果它是生物或载具牌，则它永久得+2/+2。将它置于你的牌库顶数来第二张的位置。

701534.oracleText: Target a creature card with power less than {1, CardId}'s power.
701534.translation: 选择一个力量小于{1, CardId}的生物牌为目标。

701580.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards you have discarded this turn.
701580.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中弃掉牌的数量。

701785.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value 2 or less and a card with mana value 3 or greater.
701785.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于2的牌和一张法术力值等于或大于3的牌。

701795.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that's exactly two colors, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a card that's exactly two colors from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
701795.translation: 每当你施放正好两色的咒语时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张正好两色的牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

701802.oracleText: "Heliod shines his light on all things, excising the shadows of doubt. Rejoice, for beneath his purifying eyes, Theros is united as one!"
701802.translation: 「赫利欧德光照万物，褪除疑影。欢呼吧，得他纯洁之眼涤净此处，塞洛斯必将万界归一！」

701804.oracleText: Elspeth shone like a sixth sun, inspiring hope in the Mirrans and terror in New Phyrexia.
701804.translation: 艾紫培如第六太阳照亮天空，给秘罗人以希望，陷新非瑞克西亚于恐惧。

701805.oracleText: Target creature or planeswalker you control gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice until end of turn. If it's a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
701805.translation: 选择一种颜色。目标由你操控的生物或鹏洛客获得反无色保护或反该色保护异能直到回合结束。如果它是生物，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

701807.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token with lifelink.
701807.translation: 派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的士兵衍生生物。

701808.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. It becomes an Angel in addition to its other types and gains flying.
701808.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它成为天使，且仍具有原本类别，并获得飞行异能。

701809.oracleText: Return all nonland permanent cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
701809.translation: 将所有法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

701812.oracleText: The same sturdy kitesail that once carried her safely through the Roil now allows her to monitor the pods' progress from above.
701812.translation: 同一航筝，往昔带她安全穿越狂搅，如今准她从高空监视树荚进展。

701813.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or battle, transform up to one target Incubator token you control.
701813.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，转化至多一个目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701817.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls.
701817.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物。

701819.oracleText: Her blades were twin beacons, calling the worthy to glory and the wretched to despair.
701819.translation: 她手中利刃宛如双重信标，引英灵向荣耀，赐堕者以绝望。

701821.oracleText: With one swift, merciful stroke, Tamiyo's story came to an end.
701821.translation: 剑光一闪，多美代的传典篇章直抵慈悲终焉。

701822.oracleText: Destroy target planeswalker that was activated this turn or tapped creature.
701822.translation: 消灭目标本回合中已起动的鹏洛客或已横置的生物。

701824.oracleText: "We sailed to Ixalan guided by a promise—the Age of Everflowing Blood. No machine will take that from us."
701824.translation: 「吾人不畏千辛远洋万里来到依夏兰，就只为探寻朱光时代这一美好承诺。任何机械都挡不住我们的追求。」

701825.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
701825.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

701828.oracleText: Whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to you or a permanent you control, that source's controller loses 2 life unless they pay {o1}.
701828.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的来源对你或任一由你操控的永久物造成伤害时，除非该来源的操控者支付{o1}，否则其失去2点生命。

701829.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice three other creatures: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
701829.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲三个其他生物：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

701830.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice three other creatures: Exile Elesh Norn, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
701830.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲三个其他生物：放逐艾蕾侬，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

701832.oracleText: Incubate 2 five times, then transform all Incubator tokens you control.
701832.translation: 抚育2五次，然后转化所有由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701833.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain double strike until end of turn.
701833.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得连击异能。

701834.oracleText: Destroy all other permanents except for artifacts, lands, and Phyrexians. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
701834.translation: 消灭所有其他永久物，但神器、地和非瑞人除外。放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

701837.oracleText: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.
701837.translation: 随着一道光辉直透胸膛，艾蕾侬惨叫之声回荡不息：她的噩梦终究成真。

701838.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
701838.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

701839.oracleText: Elspeth's Smite deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
701839.translation: 艾紫培的重击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

701841.translation: 「我会跟你在一起。永远不分离。」

701842.oracleText: When this creature dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
701842.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

701844.oracleText: Johar had never heard of a pterodon. He just knew Saheeli's new invention let him fly circles around the invading monsters.
701844.translation: 乔哈从没听说过什么翼牙龙。他只知道，莎希莉这个新发明能让他绕着侵攻怪物一直盘旋。

701846.oracleText: She was hope incarnate, an incandescent bulwark against the tide of machines.
701846.translation: 她乃希望化身，是抵御机械浪潮的耀亮堡垒。

701850.oracleText:
"Compleat the faith, compleat the god."
—Ajani Goldmane
701850.translation:
「完化信仰，就能完化神明。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

701853.oracleText: {o3o(U/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701857.oracleText:
"Compleat the god, compleat the plane."
—Ajani Goldmane
701857.translation:
「完化神明，就能完化时空。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

701858.oracleText: Spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each card your opponents have drawn this turn.
701858.translation: 所有对手本回合中每抓过一张牌，你施放的咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

701860.oracleText: The diamond storms of Gobakhan hampered Phyrexia's progress until they recruited some of the local shieldmages.
701860.translation: 高巴汗的钻石风暴大大延缓了非瑞克西亚的侵攻进展～直到他们将当地的盾法师招入麾下。

701863.oracleText:
"Let's show these soulless fiends what a real army looks like! Forward!"
—Shella, knight of Zhalfir
701863.translation:
「让这些没有灵魂的魔物见识一下何谓真正的军队！冲啊！」
～赛费尔骑士熙拉

701868.oracleText: "Just as a flute turns breath into music, we are the vessel through which the Sacred Winds produce glorious justice."
701868.translation: 「如气息经长笛可化作悠扬旋律，吾人之躯亦为乐器，得圣洁之风贯通即可奏响辉煌正义。」

701873.oracleText: "I was there when Phyrexia doomed Serra's realm with a single touch. I was there when Yawgmoth tried and failed to conquer Dominaria. And I will still be here when Elesh Norn lies dead."
701873.translation: 「我曾亲眼见证非瑞克西亚轻轻一触即葬送撒拉圣域。我也曾亲眼见证约格莫夫企图征服多明纳里亚而最终落败。我也一定能亲眼见证艾蕾侬殒命当场。」

701877.oracleText: The weight of Phyrexia crashed down upon Gobakhan, but the will of its people endured.
701877.translation: 非瑞克西亚之重全数倾注于高巴汗，但其人民意志承负巨压屹立不摇。

701878.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature that attacked this turn.
701878.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在每个本回合中攻击过的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

701879.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
701879.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

701885.oracleText: When the sun falters and the seas disperse, when the wilds wither and the forges go cold, when death itself succumbs, she endures.
701885.translation: 眼下，太阳凋零，海水退散，猎野枯朽，熔锻渐寒，死亡步趋，而她仍守念如初。

701886.oracleText: CARDNAME has lifelink and indestructible as long as you control at least three other enchantments.
701886.translation: 只要你操控至少三个其他结界，CARDNAME便具有系命与不灭异能。

701890.oracleText: "Brother, guide my right hand. Sister, my left. Rest well, my kin, but Lorwyn still needs me. I will not be joining you quite yet."
701890.translation: 「哥哥，请指引我的右手。姐姐，请指引我的左手。各位亲人，请先安息，但洛温还需要我。我还不能马上与你们团聚。」

701892.oracleText: Raised in a long tradition of heroes, every Benalish knight knows the day might come when they will be called to face Phyrexia.
701892.translation: 每位宾纳里亚骑士祖上都英雄辈出，他们都知道自己这辈总有一天也要与非瑞克西亚兵戎相见。

701898.oracleText: An ancient weapon for a modern war.
701898.translation: 一柄适于现代战争的远古武器。

701903.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control transforms into a Phyrexian, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
701903.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物转化为非瑞人时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

701907.translation: 由你操控的非瑞人具有警戒异能。

701909.oracleText: Quintorius muffled a sob as he watched the thing that was once Professor Pitnik "confiscate" yet another priceless historical tome.
701909.translation: 眼见先前还是皮尼克教授的怪物又「没收」了一本无价历史巨著，昆托力虽悲从中来，但也只能强忍泣声。

701910.oracleText: Each player can't cast more than one non-Phyrexian spell each turn.
701910.translation: 每位牌手每回合施放之不是非瑞人的咒语不能多于一个。

701916.oracleText: {oT}: Transform target Incubator token you control.
701916.translation: {oT}：转化目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701918.oracleText: The Invasion Tree wasn't merely a conduit through which to breach planes. It was a living, writhing extension of Phyrexia's will.
701918.translation: 移行树并非只是穿越时空的管道。而是非瑞克西亚意志的鲜活具现与扭曲延伸。

701920.oracleText: Bim lashed out with the only weapon she'd never run out of: lecture notes.
701920.translation: 毕姆使出了她唯一用之不竭的武器：课堂笔记。

701921.oracleText: Exile up to one target artifact, creature, or enchantment you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
701921.translation: 放逐至多一个目标由你操控的神器，生物或结界，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

701925.oracleText: The angels had vowed to protect New Capenna. She was determined to uphold that vow, no matter the cost.
701925.translation: 天使誓忠守卫新卡佩纳。她决心恪守诺言，不惜代价。

701926.oracleText: {o4o(B/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701929.oracleText: With her Halo reserves exhausted, she began to change, and she made a new promise to bless New Capenna with glistening perfection.
701929.translation: 当所蕴金圆耗尽后，她开始发生转变，之后更许下新的承诺：利用油亮完美赐福新卡佩纳。

701930.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, CARDNAME gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
701930.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则CARDNAME得+2/+1直到回合结束。

701933.oracleText: "Alara has been broken before. I will not let it break again."
701933.translation: 「阿拉若曾散作断片。我不许它再度破碎。」

701935.oracleText: Light glinted off the raised weapons of the Sun Empire, filling her with an unbreakable hope . . .
701935.translation: 烈阳帝国众将高举武器，其折射的熠熠光辉令她内心满是获胜希望，牢不可破…

701936.oracleText: {o5o(R/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701939.oracleText: . . . but even the unbreakable can be reshaped.
701939.translation: …但纵使牢不可破之物也能重塑。

701940.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of it. Put a +1/+1 counter on that token for each +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
701940.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个为它复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。CARDNAME上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便在该衍生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

701943.oracleText: Destroy target nontoken artifact or enchantment an opponent controls. Incubate 2.
701943.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控且非衍生物的神器或结界。抚育2。

701944.oracleText: Incubate 2, then transform an Incubator token you control.
701944.translation: 抚育2，然后转化一个由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701945.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target nontoken artifact or enchantment an opponent controls. Incubate 2. 
• Incubate 2, then transform an Incubator token you control.
701945.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭目标由对手操控且非衍生物的神器或结界。抚育2。 
•抚育2，然后转化一个由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701947.oracleText:
"Let the light scour away your imperfect flesh."
—Heliod
701947.translation:
「让明光扫除汝等不净肉身。」
～赫利欧德

701948.oracleText: Exile all creatures. Incubate X, where X is the number of creatures exiled this way.
701948.translation: 放逐所有生物。抚育X，X为以此法放逐的生物数量。

701950.oracleText: No Meletian had ever laid eyes on an angel, but when protective Halo flooded the Multiverse, they knew a divine blessing was at hand.
701950.translation: 虽然迈勒提斯人从未见过天使，但当保护性金圆浪潮充盈整个多重宇宙时，他们也知道神圣祝福就在身旁。

701951.oracleText: You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn. Prevent all damage that black and/or red sources would deal to creatures you control this turn.
701951.translation: 你和由你操控的永久物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。于本回合中，防止黑色和／或红色来源将对由你操控之生物造成的所有伤害。

701953.oracleText: The Royal Knights of Belenon are equally practiced in courtesy and combat.
701953.translation: 贝列侬皇家骑士的礼仪和战技俱佳。

701954.oracleText: CARDNAME has first strike as long as another Knight entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
701954.translation: 只要本回合中有另一个骑士在你的操控下进战场，CARDNAME便具有先攻异能。

701957.oracleText:
"Obey the teachings of the dragonlords, for they provide all. They grant us magic and safety, and in return we offer respect."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage
701957.translation:
「吾人应当谨遵龙王教诲，因龙王便是我们世界的一切。他们许吾辈以魔法与安全，而我们还他们以敬意与尊重。」
～卓茉卡族法师拜席尔

701958.oracleText: {o4o(G/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701962.oracleText:
"Your precious dragonlords repressed your instincts, cur. You were born a hunter. Evolve, and hunt again."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might
701962.translation:
「你们所谓的尊贵龙王不过是在压制你们的本能，杂种。你们生来就是猎手。进化吧，而后再度开始狩猎。」
～力量神殿高位德鲁伊班极

701964.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets one or more permanents, incubate 2.
701964.translation: 每当你施放以一个或数个永久物为目标的咒语时，抚育2。

701966.oracleText: The Phyrexians armored themselves against blades, fire, and every conjuration they could think of. She brought a war rhino.
701966.translation: 非瑞克西亚人全副武装，能够抵挡一切刀砍火烧及他们能想到的一切魔法。而她竟骑着一头战犀牛冲上前来。

701970.oracleText: Errant wouldn't allow anything to stop her from decorating the streets of New Capenna.
701970.translation: 流芳只想专心涂画新卡佩纳街头，不容任何干扰。

701971.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Counter target spell. 
• Draw two cards, then discard a card.
701971.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•反击目标咒语。 
•抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

701973.oracleText: "You have no viable escape vector. Cease your resistance and accept perfection."
701973.translation: 「你没有可行的逃脱线路。即刻停止抵抗，接受完化。」

701974.oracleText: Counter target creature or battle spell unless its controller pays {o4}. If they do, you incubate 2.
701974.translation: 除非目标生物或战役咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。若其如此作，则你抚育2。

701978.oracleText: Izzet researchers agreed to keep the unusual weird contained until they understood the extent of its powers.
701978.translation: 在遇到不寻常的怪奇时，伊捷研究员普遍会遵循这样的规范：先把它控制起来，直到弄清其力量底细为止。

701979.oracleText: {o3o(R/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701983.oracleText: The Furnace Host saw no need for such caution.
701983.translation: 而熔炉兵团就不需要这么谨慎。

701985.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Compleated Conjurer, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
701985.translation: 当此生物转化为完化成体时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

701987.oracleText: "It's not your fault. Strixhaven taught you an imperfect premise. Okay, the imperfect execution was your fault."
701987.translation: 「这也不是你的错。斯翠海文教给你之假定就是不完美的。好吧，演算时的不完美就是你的错。」

701988.oracleText: Counter target spell with mana value 2 or less.
701988.translation: 反击目标法术力值等于或小于2的咒语。

701989.oracleText: Counter target red or green spell with mana value 6 or less.
701989.translation: 反击目标法术力值等于或小于6的红色或绿色咒语。

701990.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Counter target spell with mana value 2 or less. 
• Counter target red or green spell with mana value 6 or less.
701990.translation:
选择一项～ 
•反击目标法术力值等于或小于2的咒语。 
•反击目标法术力值等于或小于6的红色或绿色咒语。

701993.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, incubate X, where X is that spell's mana value.
701993.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，抚育X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

701995.oracleText: You may cast sorcery spells this turn as though they had flash.
701995.translation: 本回合中，你可以将法术咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

701996.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
701996.translation: 本回合中，当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，将该咒语复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

702003.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets -X/-0, where X is the number of cards in its controller's graveyard.
702003.translation: 所结附的生物得-X/-0，X为其操控者坟墓场中牌的数量。

702005.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Surveil 2.
702005.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。刺探2。

702007.oracleText: Skills honed on perilous treasure hunts helped Zendikar's adventurers stay a crucial step ahead of their Phyrexian foes.
702007.translation: 赞迪卡冒险者在平时艰险寻宝之旅中磨练出来的过人技艺，让他们在面对非瑞克西亚敌人时能抢占重要先机。

702008.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender and it can't be blocked.
702008.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击，且不能被阻挡。

702011.oracleText: No longer bound by the myopic limitations of flesh, Ekken would truly see the realms.
702011.translation: 在视界脱离肉身局限后，埃肯方能真切见得各个境域。

702014.translation: 第二十七届世界冠军高桥优太

702015.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws their second card each turn, you draw a card.
702015.translation: 每当任一对手抓每回合中其第二张牌时，你抓一张牌。

702018.oracleText: Where had she first seen that symbol? She usually took such detailed notes, but her memory of it was like a fading nightmare.
702018.translation: 第一次见到这符号是在什么地方？通常她都会把这些内容事无巨细地记录下来，但对这符号的记忆却像是一场逐渐模糊的噩梦。

702020.oracleText: Innistrad's stitchers were practiced at incorporating magical substances into undead creations.
702020.translation: 将魔法物质与不死作品相结合，这可是依尼翠拼接师的长项。

702027.oracleText: No professors, no grades, no room for mistakes.
702027.translation: 不涉教授，不评成绩，不容有失。

702028.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand, you may copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
702028.translation: 每当你从你手上施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

702034.oracleText: The pace of Kamigawa's development meant that Jin-Gitaxias's intel was already outdated when the invaders arrived.
702034.translation: 神河方方面面都进步神速；这意味着当侵攻者降临时，金吉塔厦带回的情报就已经过时。

702035.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or battle, draw a card.
702035.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

702040.translation: 塞哥维亚海暴君凯特斯

702041.oracleText: Noncreature spells you cast have convoke.
702041.translation: 你施放的非生物咒语具有召集异能。

702042.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, untap up to four target creatures.
702042.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，重置至多四个目标生物。

702046.oracleText:
"On my signal, disable the safeguards. Let's blow these metal freaks right back to their own world!"
—Gav Beleren, mage-ring engineer
702046.translation:
「我一发号，就关掉所有保险。把这些金属怪物都炸回他们老家！」
～法师环塔工程师加夫贝连

702047.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Copy target spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
702047.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：复制目标由你操控的咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

702050.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell with mana value 3 or greater, draw a card.
702050.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于3的非生物咒语时，抓一张牌。

702051.oracleText: {o3oU}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you have seven or more cards in hand.
702051.translation: {o3oU}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你有七张或更多手牌时。

702052.oracleText: {o3oU}: Exile Jin-Gitaxias, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you have seven or more cards in hand.
702052.translation: {o3oU}：放逐金吉塔厦，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你有七张或更多手牌时。

702054.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand. You have no maximum hand size for as long as you control CARDNAME.
702054.translation: 抓等同于你手牌数量的牌。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，你的手牌数量没有上限。

702056.oracleText: Return all non-Phyrexian creatures to their owners' hands.
702056.translation: 将所有不是非瑞人的生物移回其拥有者手上。

702057.oracleText: You may cast any number of spells from your hand without paying their mana costs. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
702057.translation: 你可以从手上施放任意数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

702060.oracleText:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria
702060.translation:
「若有事看似不可能，你或未尝试求助。」
～多明纳里亚僧侣妮安碧

702062.oracleText: On the precipice of eternity, Elspeth made a choice. The fight would not end without her.
702062.translation: 在虚空边缘，艾紫培作了个决定。这场战斗要由她来终结。

702063.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand, one into your graveyard, and one on the bottom of your library.
702063.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，一张置入你的坟墓场，一张置于你的牌库底。

702064.oracleText: Teferi gave them time. Karn gave them a chance. But it was Melira who paid the ultimate price to free Ajani from Phyrexia's grasp.
702064.translation: 泰菲力赢回时间。卡恩夺回机会。但还是梅梨莱付出了生命代价，才最终救回阿耶尼，令其摆脱非瑞克西亚魔爪。

702066.oracleText: Even before Phyrexia's forces arrived on Tarkir, Silumgar's draconic brood had a discerning eye for valuables.
702066.translation: 在非瑞克西亚势力降临鞑契之前，席穆嘉一脉龙群就已生出对财宝挑剔的眼神。

702071.oracleText: After years of fabricating visions for naive customers of the Obscura, Stafano was flummoxed by the nightmarish scenes that played out unbidden in his mind's eye.
702071.translation: 斯塔法诺多年来都在为秘闻帮的无知客户编造视像，却因灵眼当中突现的噩梦景象困惑不已。

702072.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oCoU}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.
702072.translation: {oT}：加{oCoU}。此法术力只能用来起动异能。

702074.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
702074.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

702075.oracleText: Shuffle up to four target cards with mana value 3 or greater from your graveyard into your library.
702075.translation: 将至多四张目标法术力值等于或大于3的牌从你的坟墓场洗入你牌库。

702076.oracleText: Shuffle up to four target cards with mana value 3 or greater from your graveyard into your library.
