702076.translation: 将至多四张目标法术力值等于或大于3的牌从你的坟墓场洗入你牌库。

702080.oracleText: The Magic Mirror of Vantress showed Catrina a twisted vision of black oil and bloody machines.
702080.translation: 在卡翠娜面前，凡翠丝堡魔镜映出一副满是漆黑油污与血腥机械的扭曲景象。

702081.oracleText: {o3o(W/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702084.oracleText: Soon she understood that it was not the vision that had been twisted, but her own mind.
702084.translation: 她很快就明白过来：扭曲的并非镜中景象，而是其脑中思绪。

702089.oracleText: On Kylem, the omens of impending invasion went largely unnoticed, drowned out by the everyday fanfare of Valor's Reach.
702089.translation: 关于侵攻大军即将降临的预兆虽已传至凯勒姆，但大多数人都未曾听闻，因为每日英勇巅竞技场的喧嚣早就淹没了四处的示警呼声。

702093.oracleText: "Ingress without proper writ of extraplanar intent? Unacceptable!"
702093.translation: 「没有取得正式外时空意向手令就擅自闯入？无法接受！」

702097.oracleText: Whenever you cast a legendary spell, untap CARDNAME.
702097.translation: 每当你施放传奇咒语时，重置CARDNAME。

702099.oracleText: {o5o(B/P)}: Transform Rona. Activate only as a sorcery.
702099.translation: {o5o(B/P)}：转化罗娜。只能于法术时机起动。

702102.oracleText: Whenever a source deals damage to CARDNAME, that source's controller exiles a card from their hand at random. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield under your control. Otherwise, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
702102.translation: 每当一个来源对CARDNAME造成伤害时，该来源的操控者随机从其手上放逐一张牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之在你的操控下放进战场。若否，则你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

702105.oracleText: "Good luck getting through a class-seven proxy ward, creep."
702105.translation: 「这七级代理防护祝你破解顺利，杂碎。」

702108.oracleText: Copy target spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
702108.translation: 复制目标咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

702109.oracleText: Copy target spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
702109.translation: 复制目标咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

702113.oracleText: Together with her beloved falcon, she had explored every waterway on Zendikar, from the Tazeem highlands to the inland sea.
702113.translation: 她与心爱的猎隼一道，早已探遍赞迪卡的每处水道，到访上及塔晋高地，下至内陆汪洋的各个角落。

702117.oracleText: With her guidance, the oil coursed freely across the world.
702117.translation: 在她的指引下，烁油方能奔流不息地流经整个世界。

702119.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Skyclave Invader, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
702119.translation: 当此生物转化为空境入侵客时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

702121.oracleText: Old glitches in mage-ring function became critical tools in Vryn's defense.
702121.translation: 法师环塔的陈年故障，成了维林防线上的重要工具。

702122.oracleText: Enchanted creature has base power and toughness 0/2, has defender, and loses all other abilities.
702122.translation: 所结附的生物之基础力量与防御力为0/2，具有守军异能，且失去所有其他异能。

702125.oracleText: The owner of target nonland permanent puts it into their library second from the top or on the bottom.
702125.translation: 目标非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶数来第二张的位置或牌库底。

702127.oracleText: Just as all seemed lost, the griffin riders of Zhalfir arrived with the force of a gathered storm.
702127.translation: 就在看似败局已定之际，赛费尔狮鹫骑兵携雷霆万钧之势杀到。

702129.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may tap two other untapped creatures you control. If you do, CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
702129.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他生物。若你如此作，则CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

702132.oracleText: Wrenn reached out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, and an impossible connection flared across the vast emptiness.
702132.translation: 芮恩通过黑暗虚空想要向泰菲力传话，竟有一道非凡光芒闪过无垠旷域连接彼此。

702134.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures. Put a stun counter on either of them. Then put a stun counter on either of them.
702134.translation: 横置至多两个目标生物。在其中之一上放置一个晕眩指示物。然后在其中之一上放置一个晕眩指示物。

702136.oracleText: Phyrexia broke the laws of reality to invade the planes. On Xerex, reality merely bent around the invaders.
702136.translation: 非瑞克西亚破坏实界法则进军时空。但在兹雷兹，则是实界扭曲了入侵者。

702137.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance. Activate only if you've cast two or more spells this turn.
702137.translation: {oT}：派出一个2/2，白蓝双色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。只能于你施放过两个或更多咒语的回合中起动。

702142.oracleText: Patient and observant, the people of Zhalfir lurked beyond the veil of time until their moment came to finally strike at Phyrexia.
702142.translation: 赛费尔人民极具耐心、眼光敏锐，他们一直潜伏在时间帘幕之外，静心等待攻击非瑞克西亚的机遇到来。

702143.oracleText: Target creature has base power and toughness 4/3 until end of turn.
702143.translation: 目标生物的基础力量与防御力为4/3直到回合结束。

702145.oracleText: The Consulate of Kaladesh had always valued his particular talent for extracting information . . .
702145.translation: 卡拉德许执政院一直很器重他在刺取资讯方面的特殊天分…

702146.oracleText: {o4o(U/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702149.oracleText: . . . but the Chrome Host's methods were far more efficient.
702149.translation: …但铬亮兵团的方法效率更高。

702152.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
702152.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

702154.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: CARDNAME deals X damage to target opponent or battle and you gain X life, where X is the sacrificed permanent's mana value.
702154.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：CARDNAME向目标对手或战役造成X点伤害且你获得X点生命。X为所牺牲永久物的法术力值。

702156.oracleText: {o5o(R/P)}: Transform Ayara. Activate only as a sorcery.
702156.translation: {o5o(R/P)}：转化阿娅拉。只能于法术时机起动。

702159.oracleText: Ayara cherished her new machine servitors just as much as she once did her many suitors: not at all.
702159.translation: 阿娅拉对于全新机械随侍的怜惜程度，与万千准夫婿当初在她心中的地位无异：完全没有。

702160.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, return up to one target artifact or creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
702160.translation: 在回合的战斗开始时，将至多一个目标神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它放逐。

702165.oracleText: Mudcreep loved the taste of the funny oil that leaked from the wrecked machines in Urborg.
702165.translation: 匍泥喜欢乌尔博格破碎机械漏出来的怪油味道。

702166.oracleText: {o3o(G/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702169.oracleText: Then one day, Mudcreep started to feel funny itself.
702169.translation: 然后突然有一天,匍泥觉得自己也怪怪的。

702171.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Blightsower Thallid or dies, create a 1/1 green Phyrexian Saproling creature token.
702171.translation: 当此生物转化为播萎散绿菌或死去时，派出一个1/1绿色非瑞人／腐生物衍生生物。

702173.oracleText: Sacrifice another Phyrexian: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
702173.translation: 牺牲另一个非瑞人：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702175.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, incubate X, where X is its power.
702175.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，抚育X，X为其力量。

702178.translation:
「所有世界终将知晓完化之美。」
～艾蕾侬

702179.oracleText: Each player mills ten cards. For each player, choose a creature or planeswalker card in that player's graveyard. Put those cards onto the battlefield under your control. Then each creature you control becomes a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.
702179.translation: 每位牌手各磨十张牌。为每位牌手各选择一张在其坟墓场中的生物或鹏洛客牌。将这些牌在你的操控下放进战场。然后每个由你操控的生物均成为非瑞人，且仍具有原本类别。

702181.oracleText: Night fell all at once. Specifically, on the Phyrexian.
702181.translation: 突然之间重重夜幕降临。都砸在了同一个非瑞克西亚人身上。

702183.oracleText: The elves of Lorwyn sought perfection. The Etched Host supplied it.
702183.translation: 洛温的妖精追求完美。蚀刻兵团提供完美。

702184.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Incubate 3.
702184.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：抚育3。

702186.oracleText: Doji found the Phyrexian's essence foul, but every drop added an hour to their life.
702186.translation: 虽然杜吉嫌弃非瑞克西亚人的菁华污秽不堪，但它们只需一滴便能为其延寿四刻。

702188.oracleText:
"For the good of all, those who stand against the harmony of Phyrexia must be cut down."
—Ajani Goldmane
702188.translation:
「为全世福祉，凡反对非瑞克西亚和谐大义者均当斩。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

702190.oracleText: Daretti looked down disdainfully. "You call yourself machines? Where's the elegance? Nothing but ugly piles of scrap."
702190.translation: 达雷迪居高临下道：「你凭什么把自己当机械？你这样子哪有半点优雅？不过是堆丑陋的破铜烂铁罢了。」

702192.oracleText: Bodies too damaged to survive phyresis are collected and broken down into useful raw materials.
702192.translation: 受损严重而无法成功非瑞化的遗体都被收集起来，重新分解成有用原料。

702193.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
702193.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器或生物：每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

702199.oracleText: Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
702199.translation: 目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

702200.oracleText: Choose target battle. If an opponent protects it, remove three defense counters from it. Otherwise, put three defense counters on it.
702200.translation: 选择目标战役。若任一对手防卫之，则从其上移去三个布防指示物。若否，则在其上放置三个布防指示物。

702201.oracleText: Choose target battle. If an opponent protects it, remove three defense counters from it. Otherwise, put three defense counters on it.
702201.translation: 选择目标战役。若任一对手防卫之，则从其上移去三个布防指示物。若否，则在其上放置三个布防指示物。

702205.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，刺探2。

702207.oracleText: Strixhaven braced for another Oriq assault, but something far worse arrived.
702207.translation: 虽然斯翠海文为抵御欧理可下次攻击做好了十足准备，但没想到等来的却是更强之敌。

702208.translation: 增幅～牺牲一个神器或生物。

702209.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets -6/-6 until end of turn instead.
702209.translation: 目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为该生物得-6/-6 直到回合结束。

702216.oracleText: Whenever a Phyrexian you control dies, surveil 1.
702216.translation: 每当一个由你操控的非瑞人死去时，刺探1。

702218.oracleText: As oil began to pour from Ikoria's crystals, some monsters developed strange mechanical mutations. Others were simply pulled under.
702218.translation: 随着烁油从依克黎的水晶源源不断喷涌而出，有些怪兽因此进化出了奇异的机械突变。而其他的则被淹没其间。

702219.oracleText: All creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn. Creatures that are green and/or white get an additional -2/-2 until end of turn.
702219.translation: 所有生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。绿色和／或白色的生物额外得-2/-2直到回合结束。

702225.translation: 由你操控的其他非瑞人得+1/+1。

702231.oracleText: Spells you cast from exile have convoke.
702231.translation: 你从放逐区施放的咒语具有召集异能。

702237.oracleText: As oil seeped into their funeral shrouds, Tolvada's dead rose to join the invaders' ranks.
702237.translation: 随着烁油逐渐渗入包裹尸身的油布，托瓦达的亡者随即起身加入侵攻者的行列。

702238.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an artifact or creature was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
702238.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有神器或生物从战场进入坟墓场，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702243.oracleText: When the courts fell, Eldraine's fae turned from their usual pranks to deadlier tricks.
702243.translation: 宫殿尽墨后，艾卓的仙儿便将自己的日常恶戏换成夺命技俩。

702244.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has two or fewer cards in hand, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to them.
702244.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，若该牌手的手牌为两张或更少，则CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

702254.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, remove all counters from up to one target permanent.
702254.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，移去至多一个目标永久物上的所有指示物。

702256.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you haven't been dealt combat damage since your last turn, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
702256.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你在你上回合后都未受过战斗伤害，则你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

702261.oracleText: The eerie magic animating Innistrad's zombies rendered them immune to phyresis, making them crucial to the plane's defense.
702261.translation: 复苏依尼翠灵俑的奇异魔法同时也会令其免受非瑞化侵扰。如此便令灵俑成为保卫时空的重要战力。

702263.oracleText: {o2oB}: Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
702263.translation: {o2oB}：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果它是生物牌，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

702269.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and you gain 1 life.
702269.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且你获得1点生命。

702270.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Grandmother Ravi Sengir and you gain 1 life.
702270.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在拉薇辛格氏祖母上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且你获得1点生命。

702272.oracleText: As the harvesters bore away the last of his limbs, what remained of Urabrask heard Elesh Norn say, "Leave the traitor be."
702272.translation: 正当收割兽刚截下洼巴司最后余下的四肢时，他仅存的部分就听到艾蕾侬说：「这叛徒就留他这样吧。」

702275.oracleText: "You were my mistake. I will forever bear the weight of your horrors, and of your end."
702275.translation: 「你是我一手酿成的错误。我将永远承担你所施恐惧之重，铭记你最终覆亡之时。」

702278.oracleText: {o5o(W/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702281.oracleText: Freedom became a distasteful memory, a thing to fear and destroy.
702281.translation: 往昔的自由无拘，如今成了反胃记忆，必须避而灭之。

702283.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Hideous Fleshwheeler, put target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
702283.translation: 当此生物转化为骇人筋肉车手时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

702285.oracleText: "Tell Boss Umezawa there's a new gang moving in on our territory. I'm forwarding their insignia. Watch for it elsewhere."
702285.translation: 「告诉梅泽老大，有个新帮派在我们地盘上活动。现把他们的标志发给你。留意这符号有没有在其他地方出现。」

702287.oracleText:
"Of course I'd rather it hadn't skinned six of my best wizards, but as nightmare fuel goes, it's a truly inspired design."
—Braids
702287.translation:
「我当然希望它没有活剥我手下最强的那六位法师，不过就驱动梦魇的成效来说，这当真振奋人心。」
～布蕾德

702289.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Surveil 2.
702289.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。刺探2。

702291.oracleText: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source. The compleated invaders ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.
702291.translation: 随着新非瑞克西亚跃离实界，整个多重宇宙的烁油来源就此切断。*完化*侵攻者纷纷停止动弹，摊落在地。

702292.oracleText: Remove up to five counters from target permanent.
702292.translation: 从目标永久物上移去至多五个指示物。

702294.oracleText: "Before I fall, I will taste the blood of Sarulf himself!"
702294.translation: 「在我倒下前，我要亲自尝尝萨茹夫鲜血的滋味！」

702295.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card.

702299.oracleText: {o4oB}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
702299.translation: {o4oB}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌时。

702300.oracleText: {o4oB}: Exile Sheoldred, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
702300.translation: {o4oB}：放逐希欧蕊，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌时。

702302.oracleText: For each opponent, destroy up to one target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
702302.translation: 为每位对手各进行以下流程～消灭至多一个目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

702303.oracleText: Each opponent discards three cards, then mills three cards.
702303.translation: 每位对手各弃三张牌，然后各磨三张牌。

702304.oracleText: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
702304.translation: 将所有坟墓场中的所有生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

702308.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, each player mills a card.
702308.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，每位牌手各磨一张牌。

702311.oracleText: "My new form must be hard to understand."
702311.translation: 「我的新形态，你一定很难理解。」

702312.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a creature or battle card from it. If you do, that player discards that card. If you don't, incubate 3.
702312.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张生物或战役牌。如果你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌。若你未如此作，则抚育3。

702314.oracleText: On Amonkhet, Phyrexia found a ready-made army of horrors waiting for a new master.
702314.translation: 非瑞克西亚势力来到阿芒凯后，发现此处有支现成的恐怖大军深埋地底，静候新主人来发号施令。

702315.oracleText: Each player mills three cards. Then you return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
702315.translation: 每位牌手各磨三张牌。然后你将至多两张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

702316.oracleText: When Atraxa first arrived, the people of New Capenna rejoiced at the sight of such a grand angel. Then the slaughter began.
702316.translation: 亚崔夏初临新卡佩纳时，此处人民因得见此等壮美天使而欢欣不已。随之而来的却是惨不忍睹的屠杀悲剧。

702318.oracleText: The Furnace Host found great value in the chaotic ingenuity of Kamigawa's akki and allowed willing converts to "experiment" however they saw fit.
702318.translation: 熔炉兵团看中了神河恶鬼狂乱才智蕴含的巨大潜力，因而允许易化者随心所欲地「做实验」。

702319.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact or land: Draw a card.
702319.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，牺牲一个神器或地：抓一张牌。

702321.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token.
702321.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

702327.oracleText: Ixalan greeted Phyrexia with a defiant roar.
702327.translation: 依夏兰以无畏嘶吼迎接非瑞克西亚的到来。

702328.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
702328.translation: 直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+2/+0且获得敏捷异能。

702330.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn.
702330.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

702331.oracleText: Add two mana in any combination of colors.
702331.translation: 加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

702332.oracleText: Exile the top five cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among those exiled cards.
702332.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的五张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以从所放逐的牌之中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语。

702333.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each of up to two targets.
702333.translation: CARDNAME对至多两个目标各造成X点伤害。

702336.oracleText: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage instead.
702336.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将对任一永久物或牌手造成伤害，则改为它造成三倍的伤害。

702338.oracleText: "I have a reckless idea," Koth offered. Chandra grinned and cracked her knuckles.
702338.translation: 「我有个疯狂的想法，」寇斯提议道。茜卓咧嘴一笑，随即捏响拳头跃跃欲试。

702342.oracleText: {o9o(G/P)}: Transform Etali. Activate only as a sorcery.
702342.translation: {o9o(G/P)}：转化始霸埃泰力。只能于法术时机起动。

702345.oracleText: The contagion spreads and the Multiverse quakes.
702345.translation: 腐化传染快速扩散，多重宇宙随之震颤。

702346.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, they get that many poison counters.
702346.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手得到等量的中毒指示物。

702349.oracleText: "Hold nothing back, my friends. Tonight we feast in Starnheim!"
702349.translation: 「朋友们，今朝我们全力以赴杀来敌，夜晚齐聚斯达海姆享盛宴！」

702354.oracleText: With barely a moment's warning, a one-giant avalanche crashed into Kaldheim's defenders.
702354.translation: 警报声响刚传出，就见到一个巨人大小的雪崩直冲凯德海姆士兵防线。

702356.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token.
702356.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

702357.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it gains haste and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token."
702357.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。直到回合结束，它获得敏捷与「每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

702359.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
702359.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

702361.oracleText: As strange portals roared open across Theros, Lydus gathered his prototype and fled. He was so close to perfecting his design.
702361.translation: 眼见奇异通道在塞洛斯四处洞开，吕杜斯收起自己的试作品拔腿就跑。他只差一点就能令设计臻于完美。

702364.oracleText: Soaring in Realmbreaker's embrace, he finally understood what perfection was.
702364.translation: 得洞境树之拥而能翱翔天空后，他终于明白什么才是真的完美。

702366.oracleText: The rest of the Gatewatch retreated. Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.
702366.translation: 其余的守护者成员先行撤退。茜卓和芮恩火热前冲。

702367.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle.
702367.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物、鹏洛客、和战役各造成2点伤害。

702368.oracleText: Into the Fire deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle.
702368.translation: 进入焰境对每个生物、鹏洛客、和战役各造成2点伤害。

702369.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle. 
• Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your library, then draw that many cards plus one.
702369.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对每个生物、鹏洛客、和战役各造成2点伤害。 
•将任意数量的牌从你手上置于你的牌库底，然后抓该数量加一的牌。

702370.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Into the Fire deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle. 
• Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your library, then draw that many cards plus one.
702370.translation:
选择一项～ 
•进入焰境对每个生物、鹏洛客、和战役各造成2点伤害。 
•将任意数量的牌从你手上置于你的牌库底，然后抓该数量加一的牌。

702375.oracleText: The warriors of Kaldheim burned the soul of their world to keep it out of Phyrexia's hands.
702375.translation: 凯德海姆的战士将他们世界之魂付之一炬，令其免遭非瑞克西亚染指。

702377.oracleText: Whenever you discard a land card, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
702377.translation: 每当你弃一张地牌时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

702382.oracleText: The crystal landslide stirred over the shattered forms of the Machine Legion vanguard, and then it rose and rearranged itself into an avenging colossus.
702382.translation: 先是晶粒滑坡将机械军团先锋部队砸个粉碎，而后水晶聚集而起，化身愤怒巨像大杀四方。

702383.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.
702383.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

702388.oracleText: Inspired by tales of the legendary hero Squee, many young Kyren goblins strove to emulate his magical skill and courage in the face of danger.
702388.translation: 受传奇英雄斯奎的事迹鼓舞，许多年轻凯壬鬼怪都竞相模仿他的魔法技艺和面对危险时的勇气。

702389.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}, Discard a card: Create two 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature tokens. Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
702389.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}，弃一张牌：派出两个1/1，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

702394.oracleText: If a noncreature source you control would deal damage to a creature, battle, or opponent, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
702394.translation: 如果某个由你操控的非生物来源将向任一生物，战役或对手造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加2点伤害。

702399.oracleText:
"The Phyrexians are fools if they believe they can weather such a storm."
—Sarkhan Vol
702399.translation:
「如果非瑞克西亚人觉得他们能挺过这场风暴，那就真的太蠢了。」
～萨坎沃

702400.oracleText: Whenever a Dragon you control attacks, it deals 2 damage to any target.
702400.translation: 每当一个由你操控的龙攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

702402.oracleText: He stood his ground in the Mirrored Depths, his roar of defiance echoed by a thousand crystalline reflections.
702402.translation: 他坚守镜晶深渊防线，无畏怒吼经由数千晶块折射回响。

702403.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME's power is 5 or greater, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
702403.translation: 只要CARDNAME的力量等于或大于5，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

702409.oracleText:
"Bolas's methods were crude and inefficient, taking generations to refine the population into a reliable source of combat units. Still, it offers us something of a head start."
—Jin-Gitaxias
702409.translation:
「波拉斯的方法粗暴低效，要花上数代人的时间才能将全民化作可靠战力。不过，此举也算帮我们开了个好头。」
～金吉塔厦

702411.oracleText: Nahiri's rage shattered hedrons into deadly, burning ruin.
702411.translation: 娜希丽的怒火能够粉碎晶石，将之化作致命火迹。

702412.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target creature or planeswalker. It deals 5 damage instead if that target is white and/or blue.
702412.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。如果该目标为白色和／或蓝色，改为它造成5点伤害。

702413.oracleText: Lithomantic Barrage deals 1 damage to target creature or planeswalker. It deals 5 damage instead if that target is white and/or blue.
702413.translation: 砾岩齐击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。如果该目标为白色和／或蓝色，改为它造成5点伤害。

702419.oracleText: "Zendikar must be broken before it can be saved."
702419.translation: 「赞迪卡不彻底破坏，就无拯救之机。」

702420.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle. Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the excess damage dealt this way. You may exile one of those cards. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may play the exiled card this turn.
702420.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成5点伤害。检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为以此法造成的过量伤害数量。你可以放逐其中一张牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。本回合中，你可以使用所放逐的牌。

702421.oracleText: Nahiri's Warcrafting deals 5 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle. Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the excess damage dealt this way. You may exile one of those cards. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may play the exiled card this turn.
702421.translation: 娜希丽兴战对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成5点伤害。检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为以此法造成的过量伤害数量。你可以放逐其中一张牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。本回合中，你可以使用所放逐的牌。

702423.oracleText: With the ways between worlds thrown open, the Chain Veil's foul magic seeped from a vault deep within Ravnica all the way to Shandalar's dormant masters.
702423.translation: 随着各世界之间门户大开，锁链面纱的邪恶魔法便从拉尼卡的地窖深处一路渗透找回山德拉的沉眠主人。

702424.oracleText: {oT}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target player or battle.
702424.translation: {oT}：CARDNAME对目标牌手或战役造成2点伤害。

702427.oracleText: It'd played the same prank a hundred times, never noticing the flame's slowly evolving pattern.
702427.translation: 同样的把戏它已经玩上了一百多遍，但从未注意手下火焰正缓慢成形。

702428.oracleText: {o3o(B/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702432.oracleText: When it realized the symbol's true, glorious meaning, it began marking every surface on Innistrad with oil-soaked claws.
702432.translation: 当它明白符号的真确圣意后，便用油浸尖爪在依尼翠所有表面上都留下同样记号。

702436.oracleText: "Good thing maintenance never got around to decatalyzing the bithermic plasma displacement conduits!"
702436.translation: 「好在维护的时候从来没给双热电浆传导管作除媒！」

702437.oracleText: Create two 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature tokens.
702437.translation: 派出两个1/1，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

702439.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+1 and has trample.
702439.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+1且具有践踏异能。

702442.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to target planeswalker that player controls or battle that player protects.
702442.translation: 每当CARDNAME向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，它对目标由该牌手操控的鹏洛客或由该牌手防卫的战役造成等量的伤害。

702445.oracleText: Boffle was delighted to have an excuse to use the nice cutlery he'd liberated from Edgewall.
702445.translation: 波佛很开心，他终于有借口来试试从边墙镇起出来的这把好刀了。

702448.oracleText:
"My flesh is an affront to existence? Come say that to my fist, you bloated rust bucket."
—Koko, Riveteers welder
702448.translation:
「我的肉身是对生命的大不敬？有种你就再说一遍给我的拳头听听看，你这又肥又锈的铁桶。」
～勤工联焊工柯珂

702449.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, up to one target attacking creature gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. Return that creature to its owner's hand at end of combat.
702449.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，直到回合结束，至多一个目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。在战斗结束时，将该生物移回其拥有者的手上。

702452.oracleText: "You always were such a sharp student. Shame it took you so long to get the point."
702452.translation: 「你一直都是头脑敏锐的好学生。可惜花了这么久才知道要点在哪。」

702453.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. If it's a creature, it can't block this turn. Incubate 1.
702453.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。如果它是生物，则它本回合不能进行阻挡。抚育1。

702454.oracleText: Searing Barb deals 2 damage to any target. If it's a creature, it can't block this turn. Incubate 1.
702454.translation: 炙热钩刺对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。如果它是生物，则它本回合不能进行阻挡。抚育1。

702456.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle.
702456.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成6点伤害。

702457.oracleText: Shatter the Source deals 6 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle.
702457.translation: 粉碎祸端对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成6点伤害。

702458.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle. 
• Destroy target artifact.
702458.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成6点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

702459.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Shatter the Source deals 6 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle. 
• Destroy target artifact.
702459.translation:
选择一项～ 
•粉碎祸端对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成6点伤害。 
•消灭目标神器。

702461.oracleText: The New Coalition gave Shiv time to prepare a warm welcome for the invaders.
702461.translation: 新结联盟给西瓦留出了足够时间，好为侵攻者奉上一份火热的见面礼。

702462.oracleText: The Atarka shamans roused the fire into a scorching rebuke of the invaders and a beacon of hope for the survivors.
702462.translation: 安塔卡族祭师扬起熊熊烈焰，这不仅用热火击退了侵攻者，更以此点亮了余生者心中的希望信标。

702465.oracleText: With Urabrask in hiding, the masterless Furnace Host was unleashed on the Multiverse to spread mayhem and destruction.
702465.translation: 洼巴司消失无踪后，群龙无首的熔炉兵团散入多重宇宙，四处兴乱破坏。

702466.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks a battle, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
702466.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击任一战役时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

702469.oracleText: Spells once used to traverse Lorehold excavation sites were swiftly repurposed to keep the students one step ahead of the Invasion Tree's grasp.
702469.translation: 原本用于在衡鉴各发掘点中移动的咒语迅速改作他用，让学生能更早一步逃离移行树的魔爪。

702470.oracleText: {oT}: Another target creature gains haste until end of turn.
702470.translation: {oT}：另一个目标生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

702472.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent. Add {oR}.
702472.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成1点伤害。加{oR}。

702473.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Urabrask deals 1 damage to target opponent. Add {oR}.
702473.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，洼巴司向目标对手造成1点伤害。加{oR}。

702474.oracleText: {oR}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you've cast three or more instant and/or sorcery spells this turn.
702474.translation: {oR}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你施放过三个或更多瞬间和／或法术咒语的回合。

702475.oracleText: {oR}: Exile Urabrask, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you've cast three or more instant and/or sorcery spells this turn.
702475.translation: {oR}：放逐洼巴司，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你施放过三个或更多瞬间和／或法术咒语的回合。

702477.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target opponent and each creature they control.
702477.translation: CARDNAME向目标对手和每个由其操控的生物各造成3点伤害。

702480.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from any graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
702480.translation: 直到回合结束，你可以从任意坟墓场中施放瞬间与法术咒语。如果以此法施放的咒语将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

702483.oracleText: None may approach the Ashen Idol without an offering—an edict fortuitously absent from Phyrexian intelligence concerning the world of Azgol.
702483.translation: 未献祭者不得接近灰烬尸偶～非瑞克西亚人手中关于阿兹戈尔世界的情报唯独就缺了这条敕令。

702484.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle. You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library. If you do, draw a card.
702484.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成3点伤害。你可以将一张牌从你手上置于你的牌库底。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌。

702485.oracleText: Volcanic Spite deals 3 damage to target creature, planeswalker, or battle. You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library. If you do, draw a card.
702485.translation: 火山之怨对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成3点伤害。你可以将一张牌从你手上置于你的牌库底。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌。

702487.oracleText: "The end is always nigh. Let's have some fun!"
702487.translation: 「末日天天都有。不如及时行乐！」

702488.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals damage equal to its power to any target.
702488.translation: {o1}，牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

702491.oracleText:
"That's my girl. Just don't eat it—wouldn't want you getting an upset stomach again."
—Jalina, Ikorian bonder
702491.translation:
「不愧是我的好宝贝。只是别吃了它～我可不想你再闹一次肚子。」
～依克黎持绊人加林那

702492.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks a battle, double its power until end of turn.
702492.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击任一战役时，将其力量加倍直到回合结束。

702495.oracleText: Even as she burned, Wrenn bent Realmbreaker to her will.
702495.translation: 就算芮恩已然烈火加身，她仍能令洞境树屈从于她的意志。

702500.oracleText:
"Deploy the blightwidows. Rankle's pests should make for a delicious meal."
—Ayara, Furnace Queen
702500.translation:
「放出枯寡妇。兰卡手下那群恼人精应该能让它们饱餐一顿。」
～熔炉女王阿娅拉

702501.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains reach until end of turn. Untap it.
702501.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得延势异能。将它重置。

702503.translation:
「堕天使就应该躺下别起来。」
～万金油亨齐托雷

702504.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, battle, enchantment, or creature with flying.
702504.translation: 消灭目标神器，战役，结界或具飞行异能的生物。

702508.oracleText: Though both had lost their families, the eludha—the spiritual connection between the monsters of Ikoria and their human bonders—gave them something greater.
702508.translation: 虽然他们都失去了自己的亲族，但依克黎时空特有的灵绊能够让此世界的怪兽与持绊人心灵相通，令彼此联系更加紧密。

702509.oracleText: {o4o(R/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702512.oracleText: Now, united by the Great Work, they knew what it meant to be truly bonded.
702512.translation: 如今，他们经由伟大志业结合一起，终于明白什么才叫做真正的羁绊。

702514.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
702514.translation: 此生物不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

702516.oracleText: Slowly, the distinct screams of the trapped faded into muffled gurgles of glistening oil.
702516.translation: 慢慢地，受困者的清晰尖叫变成了深陷烁油的模糊咕囔。

702521.oracleText: Walls built to withstand assaults even from Ikoria's apex monsters were quickly deemed tactically irrelevant by Vorinclex's forces.
702521.translation: 原本甚至能够抵御依克黎霸兽攻袭的坚厚城墙，在弗霖凯的凶猛军势面前转眼间就失去了布防意义。

702523.oracleText: The Copper Host sought only the strongest converts. In Koma, it found perfection.
702523.translation: 绿铜兵团一直在寻觅最强生物来易化。而寇玛让它们得见完美。

702524.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature, planeswalker, or battle.
702524.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

702526.translation:
「污劣肉身兽，你怎么还不去死？」
～卢卡

702527.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and has ward {o2}.
702527.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+3且具有守护{o2}。

702529.oracleText: Her warning raced through the roots and rivers of Ixalan: prepare for war.
702529.translation: 她的警告经由繁根激流传遍整个依夏兰：准备应战。

702530.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or battle, surveil 1, then you may return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
702530.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，刺探1，然后你可以将一张地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

702533.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
702533.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶等量的牌。你可以展示其中一张生物或地牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

702535.oracleText: The denizens of Lorwyn were accustomed to resisting darkness.
702535.translation: 洛温居民早已习惯了抵抗黑暗。

702536.oracleText: Target player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffles. Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one target artifact or creature.
702536.translation: 目标牌手从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。你在至多一个目标神器或生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

702538.oracleText: Unleashed on new worlds, the Phyrexians were driven by a simple imperative: spread and conquer.
702538.translation: 非瑞克西亚人散入各处新时空后，便只受一则命令驱使：四散征服。

702539.oracleText: Incubate X twice, where X is the number of lands you control.
702539.translation: 抚育X两次，X为由你操控的地数量。

702541.oracleText: The Hagi trolls stood little chance against Phyrexia, having killed everyone who came to Gnottvold to warn them.
702541.translation: 但凡前往诺特瓦警告哈吉巨魔者都遭其杀害，使他们面对非瑞克西亚人毫无胜算。

702542.oracleText: {o5o(U/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702546.oracleText: Now they saw the truth. Divisions between Hagi and Torga were meaningless. There was only Phyrexia.
702546.translation: 如今他们已经得知真相。哈吉与托尔嘉之间的纷争毫无意义。万界皆归非瑞克西亚。

702547.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, up to one other target creature has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
702547.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，至多另一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

702550.oracleText: "As you see, these flowers . . . can have either restorative or poisonous . . . what is that?"
702550.translation: 「正如我们所见，这些花朵…既有药性，也有毒性…怎么了？」

702552.oracleText: {o6o(B/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702556.oracleText: "How dare you leave before my lesson is done!"

702563.oracleText: Phyrexia's largest goliaths stormed Ikoria, ready to challenge the world's great monsters. Zilortha was unimpressed.
702563.translation: 非瑞克西亚最大的巨身兽突袭依克黎，准备去挑战这个世界的庞巨怪兽。但兹罗塔完全不以为意。

702564.oracleText: For each non-Human creature you control, you may have that creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked.
702564.translation: 对每个由你操控的非人类生物而言，你可以使该生物视同未受阻挡地分配战斗伤害。

702569.oracleText:
"Careful. Its vision is based on fear, and it can smell movement . . . or something like that."
—Gregor, amateur zoologist
702569.translation:
「当心。它的眼神能够看到恐惧，它的嗅觉能够闻出动静…大概是这样吧。」
～业余动物学家格里戈

702570.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
702570.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

702576.oracleText: Before the tree of life branched into predators and prey, there was only shapeless hunger.
702576.translation: 在生命之树分生成猎者和猎物之前，其间只有无形饥渴。

702577.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, another target creature gets +2/+2 and loses all abilities until end of turn.
702577.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束另一个目标生物得+2/+2且失去所有异能。

702582.oracleText: Shandalar's wild magic stripped away the unnatural Phyrexian carapaces, reclaiming the true forms hidden underneath.
702582.translation: 山德拉的狂野魔法剥去非瑞克西亚人的异状外壳，将它们隐藏其下的真实形态重新加以利用。

702583.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
702583.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以将一张永久物牌从你手上放进战场。

702588.oracleText: Nahiri tried to bend Zendikar to Phyrexia's will. In response, the world rose against her.
702588.translation: 娜希丽试图令赞迪卡屈从非瑞克西亚。整个世界起身反抗为应。

702589.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is on the battlefield, it's a land in addition to its other types.
702589.translation: 只要CARDNAME在战场上，它便额外具有地此类别。

702592.oracleText: Her arm and spirit were weary, but as the Halo flowed across her blade, it became weightless, and new strength flooded through her. She would fight on.
702592.translation: 她原本已经身心俱疲，但当金圆注入其剑身后，顿时感到手中兵器轻若无物，有股新的力量充盈全身。她还能继续战斗。

702595.oracleText: Nashi knelt reverently before the kami and envisioned his family reunited.
702595.translation: 哪失虔敬地跪拜在神明面前，从视像中见到他与家人最终团聚。

702596.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a permanent you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on that permanent instead.
702596.translation: 如果将在某个由你操控的永久物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在该永久物上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

702597.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is CARDNAME's power.
702597.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为CARDNAME的力量。

702600.oracleText: If only the biofluctuations students could have seen what became of their prize specimen after its escape.
702600.translation: 要是生物异变学的学生能活着见到他们宝贝样本逃脱后的变化模样，该有多好。

702604.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on an artifact or creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
702604.translation: 如果将在某个由你操控的神器或生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

702605.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target artifact or creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
702605.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}：在目标由你操控的神器或生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

702608.oracleText: It had always loved munching on daisies and crystalweed, but lately its favorite snacks were the strange, round roots popping up everywhere.
702608.translation: 它以前喜欢吃雏菊和水晶草，但近来它的最爱餐点变成了到处都是的奇异圆根。

702612.oracleText: Freed from the Underworld, the World Eater resumed his endless feast with reckless enthusiasm.
702612.translation: 逃离冥界后，吞世客继续以不羁热情吞噬一切。

702613.oracleText: {o6o(W/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702614.oracleText: {o6o(W/P)}: Transform Polukranos Reborn. Activate only as a sorcery.
702614.translation: {o6o(W/P)}：转化返生的波禄卡诺斯。只能于法术时机起动。

702616.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken Hydra you control dies, create a 3/3 green and white Phyrexian Hydra creature token with reach and a 3/3 green and white Phyrexian Hydra creature token with lifelink.
702616.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的多头龙死去时，派出一个3/3，绿白双色，具延势异能的非瑞人／多头龙衍生生物和一个3/3，绿白双色，具系命异能的非瑞人／多头龙衍生生物。

702619.oracleText: In the days before the invasion, the symbol of its perpetrator appeared in strange places all across the Multiverse.
702619.translation: 于侵攻前几天，进军者的符号就已在多重宇宙各处奇异地方出现。

702620.oracleText: {oT}: Choose target battle. If an opponent protects it, remove a defense counter from it. Otherwise, put a defense counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
702620.translation: {oT}：选择目标战役。如果任一对手防卫之，则从其上移去一个布防指示物。若否，则在其上放置一个布防指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

702622.oracleText: Converter beasts were sent to ensnare as many of Ixalan's dinosaurs as possible. Many of them were converted themselves—into snacks.
702622.translation: 非瑞克西亚人大举派遣易化兽去依夏兰捕捉恐龙。它们其中多数确实有了变化～自己变成了零食。

702630.oracleText: Wrenn had given everything and asked for nothing. She deserved a monument, but rest in a quiet meadow is all she would've wanted.
702630.translation: 芮恩付出了一切，却未求丝毫回报。她虽配得上一座纪念碑，但安息在宁静牧草地中或才是她所希冀的归宿。

702631.oracleText: Mill two cards. You may put a permanent card from among the milled cards into your hand. You gain 2 life.
702631.translation: 磨两张牌。你可以将一张永久物牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。你获得2点生命。

702633.oracleText: "Kaldheim's cosmos was never yours to corrupt."
702633.translation: 「凯德海姆的寰宇永远轮不到你来腐化。」

702635.oracleText: In that moment, the fate of countless worlds rested with one dryad and a handful of the bravest Mirrodin had to offer.
702635.translation: 那一刻，无数世界的命运就掌握在一个树灵和一群最英勇的秘罗人手中。

702636.oracleText: Distribute four +1/+1 counters among up to four target creatures you control. Creatures you control gain vigilance and trample until end of turn.
702636.translation: 将四个+1/+1指示物分配给至多四个目标由你操控的生物。由你操控的生物获得警戒与践踏异能直到回合结束。

702638.oracleText: Like the laws, the rules of engagement always seem to bend in the Brokers' favor.
702638.translation: 交战规则跟法律一样，永远偏向扶济社。

702639.oracleText: This creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
702639.translation: 此生物依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

702641.oracleText:
"I take no pleasure in this, but Vadrok might."
—Vivien Reid, to Lukka
702641.translation:
「我并不觉得这样有趣，但瓦卓克可能会乐在其中。」
～薇薇安瑞德警告卢卡

702642.oracleText: Up to two target creatures you control each get +1/+0 until end of turn. They each deal damage equal to their power to another target creature, planeswalker, or battle.
702642.translation: 至多两个目标由你操控的生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。它们各依其力量对另一个目标生物，鹏洛客或战役造成伤害。

702646.translation: 由你操控的非瑞人具有延势异能。

702648.oracleText: Only the trees were old enough to remember what happened when Moag ignored warnings of Phyrexia millennia ago. They were determined not to repeat the mistake.
702648.translation: 只有此处的古老树木，才记得千年以前墨格忽略非瑞克西亚警告时发生的悲剧。它们决心不再重蹈覆辙。

702650.oracleText:
"The Tree was the heart of our world. It made me what I am and pulled me back from the brink of death. I won't allow it to be forgotten."
—Esika, god of the Tree
702650.translation:
「这棵树是我们世界的核心。是它成就了我，是它将我从死亡边缘拉回。我绝不会让它被人遗忘。」
～世界树神埃西卡

702653.oracleText: When Zendikar's defenders faltered, the Roil rose up to shake the invaders from its back.
702653.translation: 当赞迪卡守军败退之际，狂搅挺身而起将侵攻者抖落在地。

702654.oracleText: Target creature or land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with haste in addition to its other types until end of turn. It must be blocked this turn if able.
702654.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物或地成为4/4，具敏捷异能的元素生物，且仍具有原本类别。它本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

702658.oracleText: {o6oGoG}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
702658.translation: {o6oGoG}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

702659.oracleText: {o6oGoG}: Exile Vorinclex, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
702659.translation: {o6oGoG}：放逐弗霖凯，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

702661.oracleText: Mill ten cards. Put up to two creature cards from among the milled cards onto the battlefield.
702661.translation: 磨十张牌。将至多两张生物牌从所磨掉之牌中放进战场。

702662.oracleText: Distribute seven +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control.
702662.translation: 将七个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量之目标由你操控的生物。

702663.oracleText: {o1}: This creature fights target creature you don't control.
702663.translation: {o1}：此生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

702664.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control gain "{o1}: This creature fights target creature you don't control." Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
702664.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得「{o1}：此生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。」 放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

702667.oracleText: All children on Kamigawa learn of the Kami War. Hostilities with beings from another reality were understood, and no time was wasted in disbelief.
702667.translation: 神河所有孩童都会学习逆神之战。他们都理解该对另一世界的来客多加提防，且不应将时间浪费在猜忌怀疑上面。

702668.oracleText: CARDNAME has indestructible as long as it attacked a battle this turn.
702668.translation: 只要CARDNAME本回合中攻击过任一战役，它便具有不灭异能。

702672.oracleText: The Cabaretti performance had veered off-script . . . so how were the acrobats still moving in perfect unison?
702672.translation: 乐舞会的表演已经逐渐脱离剧本…但为什么他们的杂技演员动作还如此一致？

702676.oracleText: With Eldraine's human knights called away to defend the courts, lost travelers were surprised to find themselves whisked to safety by the secretive folk of the wilds.
702676.translation: 虽然艾卓的人类骑士都被召回以保卫宫殿，但迷途幻野的旅人讶异地发现此处也有神秘人物会迅速将其带离险境。

702681.oracleText: Up to one target land you control becomes a 3/3 Elemental creature with vigilance, hexproof, and haste until your next turn. It's still a land.
702681.translation: 至多一个目标由你操控的地成为3/3，具警戒、辟邪与敏捷异能的元素生物直到你的下一个回合。它仍然是地。

702682.oracleText: Mill three cards. You may put a permanent card from among the milled cards into your hand.
702682.translation: 磨三张牌。你可以将一张永久物牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。

702683.oracleText: You may play lands and cast permanent spells from your graveyard.
702683.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中使用地和施放永久物咒语。

702684.oracleText: You get an emblem with "You may play lands and cast permanent spells from your graveyard."
702684.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「你可以从你的坟墓场中使用地和施放永久物咒语。」

702686.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, you may cast a spell with lesser mana value that shares a card type with it from your hand without paying its mana cost. If you don't, create First Mate Ragavan, a legendary 2/1 red Monkey Pirate creature token. It gains haste until end of turn.
702686.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值比它小、又与之具共同牌张类别的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你未如此作，则派出传奇衍生生物勒格文大副，其为2/1红色的猴／海盗。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

702691.oracleText: {o1oU}: Put CARDNAME into its owner's library third from the top.
702691.translation: {o1oU}：将CARDNAME置于其拥有者的牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

702692.oracleText: {o1oU}: Put Borborygmos and Fblthp into its owner's library third from the top.
702692.translation: {o1oU}：将咕噜力莫与夫毕佐置于其拥有者的牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

702695.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another permanent you control, if it's the first time +1/+1 counters have been put on that permanent this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
702695.translation: 每当在另一个由你操控的永久物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，若这是本回合中第一次在该永久物上放置+1/+1指示物，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702699.oracleText: As long as you have one or fewer cards in hand, CARDNAME has vigilance and haste.
702699.translation: 只要你的手牌为一张或更少，CARDNAME便具有警戒与敏捷异能。

702700.oracleText: As long as you have one or fewer cards in hand, Djeru and Hazoret has vigilance and haste.
702700.translation: 只要你的手牌为一张或更少，杰鲁与哈佐蕾便具有警戒与敏捷异能。

702701.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may exile a legendary creature card from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. Until end of turn, you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
702701.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以放逐其中一张传奇生物牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。直到回合结束，你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

702702.oracleText: Whenever Djeru and Hazoret attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may exile a legendary creature card from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. Until end of turn, you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
702702.translation: 每当杰鲁与哈佐蕾攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以放逐其中一张传奇生物牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。直到回合结束，你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

702705.oracleText: CARDNAME has all activated abilities of all creatures your opponents control. You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to activate those abilities.
702705.translation: CARDNAME具有所有由对手操控之生物的所有起动式异能。你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来起动这些异能。

702706.oracleText: Drana and Linvala has all activated abilities of all creatures your opponents control. You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to activate those abilities.
702706.translation: 哲娜与琳法拉具有所有由对手操控之生物的所有起动式异能。你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来起动这些异能。

702710.oracleText: {o5}: Transform target Incubator token you control. Double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
702710.translation: {o5}：转化目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。将其上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

702713.oracleText: You may cast spells with flash or flying from the top of your library.
702713.translation: 你可以从牌库顶施放具闪现或飞行异能的咒语。

702716.oracleText: Create a tapped and attacking X/X green Dinosaur creature token with trample, where X is the greatest power among other attacking creatures.
702716.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击，X为进行攻击之其他生物中的最大力量。

702717.oracleText: Create a tapped and attacking X/X green Dinosaur creature token with trample, where X is the greatest power among other attacking creatures.
702717.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击，X为进行攻击之其他生物中的最大力量。

702718.oracleText: Create X 1/1 white Vampire creature tokens with lifelink, where X is the number of other attacking creatures.
702718.translation: 派出X个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物，X为进行攻击之其他生物中的数量。

702719.oracleText: Create X 1/1 white Vampire creature tokens with lifelink, where X is the number of other attacking creatures.
702719.translation: 派出X个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物，X为进行攻击之其他生物中的数量。

702720.oracleText:
Whenever you attack, choose one — 
• Create a tapped and attacking X/X green Dinosaur creature token with trample, where X is the greatest power among other attacking creatures. 
• Create X 1/1 white Vampire creature tokens with lifelink, where X is the number of other attacking creatures.
702720.translation:
每当你攻击时，选择一项～ 
•派出一个X/X绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击，X为进行攻击之其他生物中的最大力量。 
•派出X个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物，X为进行攻击之其他生物中的数量。

702724.oracleText: Transform all Incubator tokens you control.
702724.translation: 转化所有由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

702725.oracleText: Transform all Incubator tokens you control.
702725.translation: 转化所有由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

702726.oracleText: Phyrexians you control gain first strike and deathtouch until end of turn.
702726.translation: 由你操控的非瑞人获得先攻与死触异能直到回合结束。

702727.oracleText: Phyrexians you control gain first strike and deathtouch until end of turn.
702727.translation: 由你操控的非瑞人获得先攻与死触异能直到回合结束。

702728.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one — 
• Incubate 2 twice. 
• Transform all Incubator tokens you control. 
• Phyrexians you control gain first strike and deathtouch until end of turn.
702728.translation:
在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项～ 
•抚育2两次。 
•转化所有由你操控的抚育器衍生物。 
•由你操控的非瑞人获得先攻与死触异能直到回合结束。

702735.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, exile the top card of your library. Target opponent loses life equal to its mana value. If it's an instant or sorcery card, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
702735.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。目标对手失去等同于其法术力值的生命。如果它是瞬间或法术牌，则你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。

702736.oracleText: When Hidetsugu and Kairi dies, exile the top card of your library. Target opponent loses life equal to its mana value. If it's an instant or sorcery card, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
702736.translation: 当碑出告与开璃死去时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。目标对手失去等同于其法术力值的生命。如果它是瞬间或法术牌，则你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。

702738.oracleText: Creatures you control have vigilance and "{oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell."
702738.translation: 由你操控的生物具警戒与「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语。」

702739.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, if three or more mana from creatures was spent to cast it, draw a card.
702739.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过三点或更多来自生物的法术力，则抓一张牌。

702744.oracleText: Awaken the Maelstrom is all colors.

702745.oracleText: Target player draws two cards. You may put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield. Create a token that's a copy of a permanent you control. Distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three creatures you control. Destroy target permanent an opponent controls.
702745.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌。你可以将一张神器牌从你手上放进战场。派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为一个由你操控的永久物之复制品。将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个由你操控的生物。消灭目标由对手操控的永久物。

702750.oracleText: As the lazotep covered his body, he heard Norn's voice fade from a deafening clarion to a distant whisper.
702750.translation: 随着拉佐特石覆盖全身，他原本耳中艾蕾侬的震耳话语渐渐化作天边低语。

702757.translation: 无尽忿恨助燃无尽烈焰。

702758.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME if a permanent was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
702758.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，如果本回合中有永久物从战场进入坟墓场，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702764.oracleText: Throughout Ergamon's wild Truga Jungle, predator-prey relationships stopped until every last invader was crushed to dust.
702764.translation: 厄加蒙整片楚加丛林内的猎捕关系均已停滞，待侵攻者粉碎殆尽后方会恢复如常。

702770.oracleText: Inspired by the grace of Ixalan's pterodons, Saheeli built one of her own.
702770.translation: 莎希莉受依夏兰翼牙龙优雅外形启发，自己也造出了一艘类似器械。

702776.oracleText: "Let's give these creeps the old one-two!"
702776.translation: 「我们照老样子给这些怪物来套二杀一！」

702783.oracleText: The Phyrexian appearance was so offensive that perfects and eyeblights worked together in unprecedented kinship to destroy them.
702783.translation: 非瑞克西亚人的样貌是如此不堪，惹得至美与碍眼前所未有地联合起来要携手将其消灭干净。

702784.oracleText: Winnowing Forces's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
702784.translation: 筛除者大军的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

702788.oracleText: Against the implacable will of Phyrexia, the dryads of Moag raised a shield of living summer.
702788.translation: 面对非瑞克西亚的无理意志，墨格树灵举起活体夏日之盾以对。

702793.oracleText:
"They're using my Halo stockpile for what?"
—Jetmir
702793.translation:
「他们用我的金圆积蓄在做什么？」
～杰米尔

702794.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature and each other creature you control that shares a creature type with it.
702794.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，在该生物和每个由你操控且与之具共通生物类别的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702798.translation: 赛费尔的泰菲力亚柯撒

702799.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a creature card.
702799.translation: 抓两张牌。然后除非你弃一张生物牌，否则弃两张牌。

702800.oracleText: Knights you control get +1/+0 and have ward {o1}.
702800.translation: 由你操控的骑士得+1/+0且具有守护{o1}。

702801.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Knights you control get +1/+0 and have ward {o1}."
702801.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「由你操控的骑士得+1/+0且具有守护{o1}。」

702807.oracleText: To the slabhorn, the branches of the Invasion Tree were as brittle as the stems of a Pyrulean fern.
702807.translation: 对板角兽而言，移行树的树枝就像派鲁利亚的蕨类一样脆弱。

702808.oracleText: Other transformed permanents you control have trample and ward {o2}.
702808.translation: 由你操控且已转化的其他永久物具有践踏与守护{o2}。

702813.oracleText: Angry ghosts poured through and pummeled the Invasion Tree, filling the heavens with the rhythms of war.
702813.translation: 愤怒鬼魂纷纷涌入猛攻移行树，令战争旋律响彻天空。

702814.oracleText: Creature tokens you control get +1/+0 and have lifelink.
702814.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物得+1/+0且具有系命异能。

702815.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
702815.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

702819.oracleText: The literal-minded Phyrexians made the greatest mistake possible on Xerex: they tried to understand what they were seeing.
702819.translation: 死板的非瑞克西亚人犯了在兹雷兹上最不该犯的错：他们居然想要去理解他们眼前看到的一切。

702820.oracleText: Vertex Paladin's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
702820.translation: 顶点神圣武士的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的生物数量。

702824.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that has convoke, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and each battle they protect.
702824.translation: 每当你施放具召集异能的咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由其防卫的战役各造成1点伤害。

702828.oracleText: It gains trample and haste until end of turn.
702828.translation: 它获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

702829.oracleText: It gains trample and haste until end of turn.
702829.translation: 它获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

702830.oracleText: It fights target creature you don't control.
702830.translation: 它与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

702831.oracleText: It fights target creature you don't control.
702831.translation: 它与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

702837.oracleText: When the Invasion Tree reached the Underworld, it found only teeth and fury.
702837.translation: 当移行树伸入冥界时，发现只有尖牙怒火相迎。

702841.oracleText: "How kind of our foes to move in such perfect, predictable unison. Split into squadrons and execute the Lion's Claw!"
702841.translation: 「敌人行军如此步调一致，毫无变化，真是帮了我们大忙。分组成中队，采狮爪攻势！」

702844.oracleText: In the shield's gleaming surface, the Phyrexian saw a reflection of what it once had been, and paused.
702844.translation: 看到自己原本模样的映影在光亮盾牌表面一闪而过，非瑞克西亚人不由得怔了一下。

702845.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a backup ability, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn.
702845.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物成为任一后援异能的目标时，复制该异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

702848.oracleText: Much to the Phyrexians' delight, sheer curiosity drove many to willingly surrender to compleation.
702848.translation: 令非瑞克西亚人满意的是，有许多人单纯因为好奇心驱使自愿寻求完化。

702849.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each transformed permanent you control.
702849.translation: 你每操控一个已转化的永久物，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

702853.oracleText: If you would lose unspent mana, that mana becomes black instead.
702853.translation: 如果你将失去未用尽的法术力，则改为该份法术力都成为黑色。

702856.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, exile target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard. Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
702856.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，将目标既非生物也非地的牌从你的坟墓场放逐。派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

702857.oracleText: {o1oRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Spirit: Choose target card exiled with Quintorius. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
702857.translation: {o1oRoW}，{oT}，牺牲一个精怪：选择目标以昆托力放逐的牌。本回合中，你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

702859.oracleText: The Phyrexian juggernaut found itself crushed between a rock and a hard place.
702859.translation: 非瑞克西亚攻城巨车发现自己撞在了岩石和一块硬东西中间。

702860.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target attacking creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If it's attacking a battle, put a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
702860.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。若它正向战役进行攻击，则改为在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702863.oracleText: Each player creates a Treasure token.
702863.translation: 每位牌手各派出一个珍宝衍生物。

702864.oracleText: Each player creates a Treasure token.
702864.translation: 每位牌手各派出一个珍宝衍生物。

702865.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to a player or battle this turn, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
702865.translation: 如果某个来源本回合将对任一牌手或战役造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加2点伤害。

702866.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to a player or battle this turn, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
702866.translation: 如果某个来源本回合将对任一牌手或战役造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加2点伤害。

702873.oracleText: No amount of spilled oil and crushed metal could slake her bloodlust.
702873.translation: 无论打散多少油污，粉碎多少金属，都无法令她的嗜血欲望消减分毫。

702874.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
702874.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

702878.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, sacrifice a creature or land, then draw a card.
702878.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，牺牲一个生物或地，然后抓一张牌。

702879.oracleText: Whenever Thalia and The Gitrog Monster attacks, sacrifice a creature or land, then draw a card.
702879.translation: 每当莎利雅与噬人蛙怪攻击时，牺牲一个生物或地，然后抓一张牌。

702882.oracleText:
"I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled. "There was a time when I'd balk at your aid, phantom, but she has shown me the merit in Urborg's strange ways."
"Gnshhagghkkapphribbit," replied Yargle.
702882.translation:
「我经常听我女儿说起你，」穆塔尼低声道。「幽魅怪蛙，要是以前，我一定会对你的好意嗤之以鼻，但我女儿用乌尔博格的奇异方式让我看到了此间裨益。」
「咕唰嘎咔呸呱，」雅骨尔应道。

702885.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
702885.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

702886.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw a card. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. If you control eight or more lands, repeat this process once.
702886.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物：抓一张牌。你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。如果你操控八个或更多地，则将此流程再重复一次。

702890.oracleText: Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to a player or battle, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. You may return one of those Dragons to its owner's hand.
702890.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个龙对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。你可以将这些龙之一移回其拥有者手上。

702895.oracleText: Folded by an imaginative child, animated by a mischievous kami, and blessed by an otherworldly angel.
702895.translation: 奇想孩童折出，调皮神明化生，异界天使赐福。

702896.oracleText: "Just like dodging stampedes in the Makindi Trenches back home!"
702896.translation: 「跟在家乡的马钦迪战壕躲狂奔没两样！」

702898.oracleText: Silence quickly went from an annoying library rule to an imperative for survival.
702898.translation: 肃静很快就从图书馆规矩变成了生存要则。

702900.oracleText: If this land would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
702900.translation: 如果此地将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。

702901.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Target opponent mills three cards. Put a land card from their graveyard onto the battlefield tapped under your control. It gains "If this land would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else."
702901.translation: {o2}，{oT}：目标对手磨三张牌。将一张地牌在你的操控下从其坟墓场横置放进战场。它获得「如果此地将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。」

702902.oracleText: {o10}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for any number of Praetor cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
702902.translation: {o10}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻任意数量的魔判官牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

702904.oracleText: Though no bigger than a hand, the surveyors were as vital to the resistance as the largest war constructs.
702904.translation: 虽然勘探械还没有手掌大，但在志士眼中，它们的作用并不亚于最大型的战争机械。

702906.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from blue and from black.
702906.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有反蓝保护与反黑保护。

702907.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, surveil 2. Then you may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
702907.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，刺探2。然后你可以从你坟墓场中施放一个法术力值等于或小于2的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

702909.oracleText: Ephara blessed the defenders of Theros with godfire, a Nyx-infused incendiary substance that burned without fuel.
702909.translation: 厄芳拉赐塞洛斯守军神火助阵，此等物质充盈尼兹能量，无需消耗便能持续燃烧。

702910.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target creature or enchantment.

702912.oracleText: Having learned of New Capenna's Halo supply, Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa herself to bring the world to heel.
702912.translation: 在得知新卡佩纳有金圆供应后，艾蕾侬便派亚崔夏本尊去征服这个世界。

702913.oracleText: The Copper Host brought a hideous mockery of new life to Amonkhet's death-cursed desert.
702913.translation: 绿铜兵团为阿芒凯沙漠带来可怖新生，无视遍布此处的死亡诅咒。

702914.oracleText: The Invasion Tree's branches snaked through the streets of Otawara, turning Kamigawa's soaring city into a clouded nightmare.
702914.translation: 移行树蜷枝穿行大田原大街小巷，将这座神河霄城化作云端梦魇。

702915.oracleText: On the surface of Ixalan's vast tar pits, Phyrexian oil glistened, and old bones began to stir.
702915.translation: 在依夏兰宽广的焦油坑表面，非瑞克西亚烁油异光发亮，陈年尸骨也开始翻腾搅动。

702916.oracleText: The Roil, Zendikar's planewide immune system, rose in full force against the threat of Phyrexian infection.
702916.translation: 狂搅正是赞迪卡此时空遍及全界的自发抵抗机制，如今面对非瑞克西亚的侵染威胁也起身全力出击。

702917.oracleText: As oil seeped from Ikoria's crystals, strange metallic mutations emerged in monsters all across the plane.
702917.translation: 随着烁油从依克黎各处水晶渗出，此时空的怪兽纷纷涌现奇异金属突变。

702918.oracleText: Kaladesh's wondrous inventions and glowing aether were of utmost interest to Jin-Gitaxias and his Chrome Host.
702918.translation: 卡拉德许的奇妙发明与奔流乙太，正是金吉塔厦与麾下铬亮兵团最感兴趣之物。

702919.oracleText: Deep in Eldraine's wilds, strange eyelike appendages twined among the vines and faerie lights.
702919.translation: 在艾卓幻野深处，奇异的眼形怪肢缠绕在藤蔓与仙灵灯火之间，令此地愈发恐怖。

702920.oracleText: The sky darkened and the seas turned to oil as the gods of Theros themselves fell to New Phyrexia.
702920.translation: 塞洛斯诸神纷纷臣服于新非瑞克西亚，蔚蓝天空随之黯淡，汹涌海疆顿成烁油。

702921.oracleText: Serra was a symbol of hope to Dominaria, so Norn defiled her temples with monuments to Phyrexia.
702921.translation: 艾蕾侬深知撒拉乃是多明纳里亚的希望象征，于是她便在其殿堂内大肆增建非瑞克西亚纪念碑加以破坏。

702930.oracleText: Target up to one other creature or artifact you control.
702930.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的另一个生物或神器为目标。

702931.oracleText: Target an enchantment card that isn't a God.
702931.translation: 指定一张不是神的结界牌为目标。

702932.oracleText: Search for an Aura, God, or Demigod card.
702932.translation: 搜寻一张灵气，神或半神牌。

702933.oracleText: Reveal up to two creature cards with mana value {2, Number} or less?
702933.translation: 是否要展示至多两张法术力值小于或等于{2, Number} 的生物牌？

702934.oracleText: Target up to one artifact, creature, or enchantment you control.
702934.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的神器，生物或结界为目标。

702935.oracleText: Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
702935.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

702936.oracleText: Target a spell with mana value 2 or less.
702936.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于2的咒语为目标。

702937.oracleText: Target a red or green spell with mana value 6 or less.
702937.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于6的红色或绿色咒语为目标。

702939.oracleText: Search for an instant or sorcery card you own.
702939.translation: 搜寻一张你拥有的瞬间或法术牌。

702940.translation: 指定一个由你操控的咒语为目标。

702941.oracleText: Cast any number of spells from your hand without paying their mana costs?
702941.translation: 是否要施放任意数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

702942.oracleText: Target up to four cards with mana value 3 or greater.
702942.translation: 指定至多四张法术力值等于或大于3的牌为目标。

702943.oracleText: Exile a card from their hand at random.
702943.translation: 从他手上随机放逐一张牌。

702944.oracleText: Put it onto the battlefield under your control?
702944.translation: 是否要将它在你的操控下从放进战场？

702945.oracleText: Tap two other untapped creatures you control?
702945.translation: 是否要横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他生物？

702946.oracleText: Put a stun counter on either of them.
702946.translation: 在其中之一上放置一个晕眩指示物。

702947.oracleText: Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
702947.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

702948.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or creature card.
702948.translation: 指定至多一张神器或生物牌为目标。

702950.translation: 指定至多一个永久物为目标。

702951.oracleText: Sacrifice a nontoken creature or planeswalker.
702951.translation: 牺牲一个非衍生生物或鹏洛客。

702952.oracleText: Cast any number of spells from among the nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs?
702952.translation: 是否要施放任意数量以此法放逐的非地牌，且不需支付其法术力费用？

702954.oracleText: Reveal any number of Dragon cards.

702955.oracleText: Return that creature to its owner's hand at end of combat.
702955.translation: 在战斗结束时，将该生物移回其拥有者的手上。

702956.oracleText: Search for a non-Human creature card with mana value {2, Number} or less.
702956.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number} 的非人类牌。

702957.oracleText: Target up to three permanent cards.
702957.translation: 指定至多三张永久物牌为目标。

702958.oracleText: Distribute counters among up to four target creatures you control.
702958.translation: 将指示物分配给至多四个由你操控的目标生物。

702959.oracleText: Target up to four creatures you control.
702959.translation: 指定至多四个由你操控的生物为目标。

702961.translation: 是否要放逐其中一张传奇生物牌？

702963.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value {2, Number} from a graveyard without paying its mana cost?
702963.translation: 是否要从一个坟场施放目标法术力值为{2, Number}的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用？

702964.oracleText: Cast one of those two cards without paying its mana cost?
702964.translation: 是否要施放两张牌中的一张，且不需支付其法术力费用？

702965.oracleText: Target a non-Elf creature an opponent controls with power {2, Number} or less.
702965.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且力量等于或小于{2, Number}的非妖精生物为目标。

702967.translation: 是否要牺牲一个神器或生物？

702971.translation: 是否要放逐五张其他牌？

702972.oracleText: Search for any number of Praetor cards.
702972.translation: 搜寻任意数量的魔判官牌。

702973.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
702973.translation: 是否要从你坟墓场中施放一个法术力值等于或小于2的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

702974.oracleText: Target an Incubator token you control.
702974.translation: 指定一个由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

702975.oracleText: Target up to one Incubator token you control.
702975.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的抚育器衍生物为目标。

702976.oracleText: Put an instant, sorcery, or battle card into your library?
702976.translation: 是否要将一张瞬间、法术或战役牌置于你的牌库？

702977.translation: 指定一个对手或战役为目标。

702979.oracleText: Target a creature or battle card.
702979.translation: 指定一个生物或战役牌为目标。

702980.translation: 指定一个战役或对手为目标。

702981.oracleText: Target a creature, planeswalker, or battle.
702981.translation: 指定一个生物，鹏洛客或战役为目标。

702982.translation: 指定一个牌手或战役为目标。

702983.oracleText: Target an artifact, battle, enchantment, or creature with flying.
702983.translation: 指定一个神器，战役，结界或具飞行异能的生物为目标。

702984.oracleText: Return a land card to the battlefield?
702984.translation: 是否要将目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回战场？

702985.oracleText: Search for a land or battle card.

702986.oracleText: Return one of those Dragons to its owner's hand?
702986.translation: 是否要将这些龙之一移回其拥有者手上？

702987.oracleText: Cast a spell with lesser mana value that shares a card type with it from your hand without paying its mana cost?
702987.translation: 是否要从你手上施放一个法术力值比它小、又与之具共同牌张类别的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

702988.translation: 指定一张非战役永久物牌为目标。

702989.oracleText: The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be compleated.
702989.translation: 机械军团虽觊觎她的力量，但由黄砂、烈日与记忆组成的精魂永无完化可能。

702990.oracleText: "Rejoice, blessed evangels! The glorious light of compleation is nigh. Soon, we shall awaken the Multiverse from its slumber."
702990.translation: 「雀跃吧，蒙恩的福音师们！*完化*荣耀明光即将普照大地。沉眠的多重宇宙行将由我们唤醒。」

702991.oracleText:
"His blades were the ultimate agents of transformation. All Phyrexians who met them were transformed into pieces."
—Heroes of the Second Invasion
702991.translation:
「他手中双刃才是终极转化利器。所有被它们招呼过的非瑞克西亚人都已化作齑粉。」
～《二次战役英雄》

702992.oracleText:
"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face."
—Monument inscription
702992.translation:
「做事务必选好工具，尤其当你是要锤爆非瑞克西亚人时。」
～丰碑铭文

702993.oracleText: No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.
702993.translation: 这种面对强敌压境的感觉莎利雅并不陌生，幸存的护教军、镇民，甚至还有尸鬼牧者在她的指挥下团结如一，合力抗击。

702994.oracleText: In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.
702994.translation: 鉴于他积极防卫卡拉德许有功，执政院决议对其旧罪一笔勾销。

702995.oracleText: Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.
702995.translation: 她的船队快速穿越非瑞克西亚人无法觅踪的奇诡激流，将无数幸存者带到安全地带。

702996.oracleText: His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.
702996.translation: 他对于多重宇宙了解之深，令新非瑞克西亚对每个时空发动攻势时，都能如手术般精准地直击弱点。

702997.oracleText:
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—Heroes of the Second Invasion
702997.translation:
「她天分非凡，能深入敌后不被察觉，屡获关键情报确保多明纳里亚防线不失，可谓居功至伟。」
～《二次战役英雄》

702998.oracleText:
"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike."
—Records of the Living Historians
702998.translation:
「它所到之处，不论非瑞克西亚人或神河人尽皆暴毙，无一幸免。」
～现世史家的记载

702999.oracleText:
"In its hatred for the mortal realms, it fought on the side of the invaders, heedless of its own eventual fate."
—Records of the Living Historians
702999.translation:
「出于对实界的怨恨，它选择站在侵攻者一边，丝毫不顾自己的最终下场。」
～现世史家的记载

703000.oracleText: Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.
703000.translation: 对凡俗生灵而言，饮下哪怕只是一小滴烁油，便会染疾而亡。但雅骨尔可非泛泛之辈，它将传布乌尔博格各境的油污一饮而尽。

703001.oracleText:
"Squee had never wanted to be a king or a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians. Naturally, he found himself as both."
—Heroes of the Second Invasion
703001.translation:
「斯奎从未想过称王，亦未要当反抗非瑞克西亚人的榜样。而如今他自然坐拥两者。」
～《二次战役英雄》

703002.oracleText: While the other praetors eagerly prepared for invasion, Urabrask retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands.
703002.translation: 当其他魔判官迫不及待准备进军时，洼巴司反而退回了熔炉狱界，拒遵艾蕾侬一切命令。

703003.oracleText: To her delight, she was able to fully realize the explosive magical potential of hedrons.
703003.translation: 她终于有机会彻底弄清晶石的爆发潜力，令其狂喜不已。

703004.oracleText: "I always said I had a score to settle with that serpent. I'm a man of my word."
703004.translation: 「我一直说要找那盘蛇再战一回决出高下。我说到做到。」

703005.oracleText: She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.
703005.translation: 她向亡者祷颂远古祭词，确保其内在菁华遭机械复用前就会重归大地。

703006.oracleText: Though Phyrexian machines could adapt to extremes of heat or cold, they never figured out how to adapt to both at once.
703006.translation: 非瑞克西亚机械能够适应极端酷热或彻骨冰寒，但从不知道如何同时适应两者。

703007.oracleText:
"Teach these people the price of their insolence."
—Elesh Norn
703007.translation:
「让这些人明白无礼傲慢的代价。」
～艾蕾侬

703008.oracleText: Leading from behind had never been her style.
703008.translation: 幕后领导从不是她的风格。

703009.oracleText: Her concoctions corroded metal and fortified organic tissue. They would be studied for generations.
703009.translation: 她的合剂能腐蚀金属，强健肌体。其间奥秘值得好几代人来研究。

703012.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is the number of experience counters you have.
703012.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你具有的经验指示物数量。

703013.oracleText: Invader after invader fell before her, and to each she spoke a single word: "Unworthy."
703013.translation: 侵攻者一个接一个倒在了她的面前，她对每一个的裁决都是：「不配。」

703014.oracleText: She protected Ravnica with the same things that thrilled her fans: courage, charisma, and a grand assortment of spiked chains.
703014.translation: 她歌声予人勇气、外表魅力四射，会使各式带刺铁链：平时她凭此俘获观众欢心，战时则用这些来保卫拉尼卡。

703015.oracleText: "Sure, the invasion was violent, but where was the beauty? As an artist, I had to intervene."
703015.translation: 「对嘛，侵攻是很暴力，但美感在哪？基于艺术品味，我不得不插手。」

703016.oracleText:
"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons."
—Grand Warlord Radha
703016.translation:
「那些无脑奴兽永远不可能战胜我们。我们是凯尔顿人。」
～大军阀拉妲

703017.oracleText: His impromptu demonstration of the portable energy shield attachment both saved lives and increased demand for aether-powered multi-tool gauntlets tenfold.
703017.translation: 他对便携式能量盾附饰的即兴运用示范，不仅成功挽救了众人性命，而且还让市场对乙太能多用途手套的需求翻了十倍有余。

703018.oracleText: While many fought valiantly to preserve humanity, Rona wished only to strip hers away.
703018.translation: 正当众生英勇奋战为保人性存续时，罗娜只想将自身的人性抹除干净。

703019.oracleText:
"The Weatherlight gave so much. It deserved justice as much as any of us."
—Shanna
703019.translation:
「晴空号付出如此之多，理应与我们一样得享正义。」
～莎娜

703021.oracleText: Instant, sorcery, and Dragon spells you control can't be countered.
703021.translation: 由你操控的瞬间、法术和龙咒语不能被反击。

703022.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand, if CARDNAME attacked this turn, that spell gains rebound.
703022.translation: 每当你从你手上施放瞬间或法术咒语时，若CARDNAME本回合中攻击过，则该咒语获得弹回异能。

703024.oracleText: Her uncanny predictions of Phyrexian movements saved countless lives, though she never revealed the source of her information.
703024.translation: 她不可思议地对非瑞克西亚人的动向了如指掌，从而救下了无数生命，不过她却对情报来源三缄其口。

703025.oracleText:
"Its blighted heart, its spinous hands
To break the hosts that foul its lands."
—Triumph of Bala Ged, stanza 6
703025.translation:
「枯心棘手齐耀威，
污地兵团全击溃。」
～《兴巴勒格》，6节

703026.oracleText: Remove a slumber counter from {1, CardId}?
703026.translation: 是否要从{1, CardId}上移去一个静眠指示物？

703031.oracleText: Wormtongue bared his teeth; and then with a hissing breath he spat before the king's feet.
703031.translation: 佞舌龇牙咧嘴，随即嗤的一声往国王跟前吐了口痰。

703032.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a tapped creature.
703032.translation: 如果此咒语以已横置的生物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

703034.oracleText: The Tooks marched in with Pippin at their head. Merry now had enough sturdy Hobbitry to deal with the ruffians.
703034.translation: 图克家的人全都跟着皮平来到镇上。于是梅里就有了足够的霍比特壮汉来对付恶棍。

703035.oracleText: Destroy all creatures with power 3 or greater. Then create a Food token for each creature you control.
703035.translation: 消灭所有力量等于或大于3的生物。然后你每操控一个生物，便派出一个食品衍生物。

703038.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Until end of turn, target creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
703038.translation: 牺牲一个食品：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

703040.oracleText: "Farewell, Aragorn! Go to Minas Tirith and save my people!"
703040.translation: 「别了，阿拉贡！去米那斯提力斯，拯救我的人民！」

703041.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
703041.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。魔戒引诱你。

703046.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, remove a hope counter from CARDNAME. If you do, draw a card. Then if CARDNAME has no hope counters on it, sacrifice it and you gain 4 life.
703046.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，从CARDNAME上移去一个希望指示物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。然后如果新纪元的曙光上没有希望指示物，则将它牺牲且你获得4点生命。

703049.oracleText: The sword glinted in the westering sun.
703049.translation: 落日余晖映在宝剑上，照得闪闪发光。

703060.oracleText:
"The Rohirrim have long been the friends of the people of Gondor, though they are not akin to them."
—Aragorn
703060.translation:
「洛希尔人长久以来都是刚铎人民的朋友；不过他们之间并非同族。」
～阿拉贡

703061.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage to a Goblin or Orc, destroy that creature.
703061.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一鬼怪或半兽人造成伤害时，消灭后者。

703064.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature gains your choice of first strike or vigilance until end of turn. If that creature is equipped, it gains first strike and vigilance until end of turn instead.
703064.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标生物依你的选择获得先攻异能或警戒异能直到回合结束。若该生物佩带武具，则改为它获得先攻与警戒直到回合结束。

703066.oracleText: "Gondor is in great need. Lord Denethor asks for all your strength and all your speed, lest Gondor fall at last."
703066.translation: 「刚铎如今情势危急。德内梭尔城主请您倾力相助，尽速出兵，否则刚铎必将陷落。」

703070.oracleText:
"How far can you bear me?" asked Gandalf.
"Many leagues," said Gwaihir, "but not to the ends of the earth. I was sent to bear tidings, not burdens."
703070.translation:
「你能载我飞多远？」甘道夫问。
「许多里格，」格怀希尔说，「但不能去到大地的尽头。我是被派来送信的，不是来送人的。」

703072.oracleText:
"Where now the horse and the rider?
Where is the horn that was blowing?
Where is the helm and the hauberk,
and the bright hair flowing?"
—Lament for the Rohirrim
703072.translation:
「骏马骁骑在何方？
长鸣号角存何方？
贴身佩甲散沙场，
盔下金发飘何方？」
～《洛希尔人悼悲曲》

703073.oracleText: {o4oW}, {oT}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. This ability costs {o2} less to activate if you control a legendary creature.
