703073.translation: {o4oW}，{oT}：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果你操控传奇生物，则此异能减少{o2}来起动。

703075.oracleText: "A chance for Faramir, Captain of Gondor, to show his quality."
703075.translation: 「让刚铎统帅法拉米尔证明品格的机会。」

703076.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, draw a card.
703076.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物在你的操控下死去，则抓一张牌。

703077.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, if you chose a creature other than CARDNAME as your Ring-bearer, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
703077.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，若你选择CARDNAME以外的生物作你的持戒人，则派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

703080.oracleText: Aragorn planted the new tree in the court by the fountain, and swiftly and gladly it began to grow.
703080.translation: 阿拉贡将新树种在王庭喷泉边，于是它便欢快地迅速生长。

703081.oracleText: Legendary creatures you control get +2/+1 and have ward {o1}.
703081.translation: 由你操控的传奇生物得+2/+1且具有守护{o1}。

703082.translation: 由你操控的非传奇生物得+1/+1。

703084.oracleText:
"Cold be hand and heart and bone,
and cold be sleep under stone:
never more to wake on stony bed,
never, till the Sun fails and the Moon is dead."
703084.translation:
「手骨及心全结晶，
石窟长眠冰霜凌：
墓穴甜睡惊复醒，
直至日月不再明。」

703085.oracleText: Enchanted creature is a Spirit and can't attack or block.
703085.translation: 所结附的生物是精怪且不能进行攻击或阻挡。

703086.oracleText: Enchanted creature is a Spirit and can't attack or block. (It loses all other creature types.)
703086.translation: 所结附的生物是精怪且不能进行攻击或阻挡。（它失去所有其他生物类别。）

703091.oracleText: You may pay {o0} rather than pay the equip cost of the first equip ability you activate during each of your turns.
703091.translation: 对你于你的每个回合中首度起动的佩带异能而言，你可以支付{o0}，而不支付其佩带费用。

703093.oracleText: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}: If CARDNAME is a Citizen, it becomes a Halfling Scout with base power and toughness 2/3 and lifelink.
703093.translation: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}：如果CARDNAME是市民，则它成为基础力量与防御力为2/3、具系命异能的半身人／斥候。

703095.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game if the Ring has tempted you four or more times this game. Otherwise, the Ring tempts you.
703095.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，如果本盘游戏中魔戒已引诱你四次或更多，则该牌手输掉这盘游戏。若否，则魔戒引诱你。

703096.oracleText: {oBoBoB}: If Frodo is a Scout, it becomes a Halfling Rogue with "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game if the Ring has tempted you four or more times this game. Otherwise, the Ring tempts you."
703096.translation: {oBoBoB}：如果弗罗多是斥候，则它成为半身人／浪客，且具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，如果本盘游戏中魔戒已引诱你四次或更多，则该牌手输掉这盘游戏。若否，则魔戒引诱你。」

703099.oracleText: You may cast legendary spells and artifact spells as though they had flash.
703099.translation: 你可以将传奇咒语和神器咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

703100.oracleText: If a legendary permanent or an artifact entering or leaving the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
703100.translation: 如果由你操控之永久物具有的触发式异能因传奇永久物或神器进入或离开战场而触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

703102.oracleText: "One for the Shire!" cried Aragorn. "The Hobbit's bite is deep! You have a good blade, Frodo son of Drogo!"
703102.translation: 「夏尔名下记一个！」阿拉贡叫道，「霍比特人这一剑刺得够深！卓果之子弗罗多，你有一把好剑！」

703103.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of creatures you control plus the number of Foods you control.
703103.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的生物数量和由你操控的食品数量之总和。

703104.oracleText: Hobbit's Sting deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of creatures you control plus the number of Foods you control.
703104.translation: 霍比特人刺叮对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的生物数量和由你操控的食品数量之总和。

703107.oracleText: He passed over Udun and Gorgoroth and saw all the land in ruin and tumult beneath him, and before him Mount Doom blazing, pouring out its fire.
703107.translation: 他飞越乌顿和戈埚洛斯，看见身下大地分崩离析，轰鸣作响，而眼前末日山烈焰翻腾，倾泻热火。

703108.oracleText: Whenever two or more creatures you control attack a player, target attacking creature without flying gains flying until end of turn.
703108.translation: 每当由你操控的两个或更多生物攻击一位牌手时，目标进行攻击且不具飞行异能的生物获得飞行直到回合结束。

703110.oracleText:
"In the days of Isildur, the Ruling Ring passed out of all knowledge."
—Elrond
703110.translation:
「在伊熙尔杜的时代，就已无人知晓统御魔戒的下落。」
～埃尔隆德

703111.oracleText: Put target nonland historic permanent into its owner's library fourth from the top.
703111.translation: 将目标非地史迹永久物置于其拥有者的牌库顶数来第四张的位置。

703113.oracleText: The ruffian knew too little of Hobbits to understand his peril. Foolishly, he decided to fight.
703113.translation: 那恶棍领队太不了解这些霍比特人了，完全不知道他要面临怎样的危险。因此他愚蠢地决定跟他们千上一架。

703114.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice a Food or pay {o2oW}. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls.
703114.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品或支付{o2oW}。当你如此作时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

703116.oracleText: Now for Wrath, Now for Ruin!

703117.oracleText: The Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate and the might of Mordor.
703117.translation: 西方众将领终于来到黑门前，准备挑战魔多的势力。

703118.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. They gain vigilance until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
703118.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。它们获得警戒异能直到回合结束。魔戒引诱你。

703120.oracleText: Orcs were digging deep trenches in a huge ring, just out of bowshot of the walls, while the Men of Minas Tirith looked on, unable to hinder them.
703120.translation: 奥克就在城墙弓箭射程之外挖起深深的巨大环形壕沟，而米那斯提力斯的人类守军只能眼睁睁地看着，却无力阻止。

703123.oracleText: As Faramir and Eowyn stood so, their hands met and clasped, though they did not know it.
703123.translation: 于法拉米尔和伊奥温静静伫立时，他们双手交叠，彼此紧握，但两人却全然不知。

703128.oracleText: "You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay for it."
703128.translation: 「你伤了我家少爷，你这畜生，你要为此付出代价！」

703132.oracleText: The Hobbits of the Shire were fond of six meals a day—when they could get them.
703132.translation: 夏尔的霍比特人喜欢一天吃六餐～当他们吃得到的时候。

703133.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+1 until end of turn. Create a Food token.
703133.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+2/+1直到回合结束。派出一个食品衍生物。

703136.oracleText: "You're arrested for Gate-breaking, and Tearing up of Rules, and Trespassing, and Bribing Guards with Food."
703136.translation: 「你们因以下罪行被捕：破门而入、撕毁规定、擅闯地界，以及用食物贿赂守卫。」

703140.oracleText: How had it come to be on his finger? He wondered if the Ring itself had not played him a trick.
703140.translation: 这是怎么戴到他手指上去的？他在想是不是戒指本身就在作弄他。

703141.oracleText: Exile target creature you own, then return it to the battlefield under your control. The Ring tempts you.
703141.translation: 放逐目标由你拥有的生物，然后将它在你的操控下移回战场。魔戒引诱你。

703143.oracleText:
"The Dead awaken; for the hour is come for the oathbreakers."
—Malbeth the Seer
703143.translation:
「亡者苏醒，毁诺者时辰来临。」
～先知瑁贝斯

703146.oracleText:
"The Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River."
—Denethor
703146.translation:
「大敌若想渡过大河，也须付出惨痛代价。」
～德内梭尔

703151.oracleText: Target creature you control gains indestructible for as long as you control CARDNAME.
703151.translation: 于你操控CARDNAME之时段内，目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能。

703153.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
703153.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

703154.oracleText: Up to two target creatures you control each gain lifelink until end of turn.
703154.translation: 至多两个目标由你操控的生物各获得系命异能直到回合结束。

703156.oracleText: The Tooks came, a hundred strong, from Tuckborough and the Green Hills.
703156.translation: 图克家的人来了，足有一百个，都是从塔克领和绿丘陵赶来的。

703157.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, the Ring tempts you.

703160.oracleText: Search your library for a legendary creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
703160.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张传奇生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

703161.oracleText: Search your library for a legendary creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
703161.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张传奇生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

703162.oracleText: Creatures you control gain double strike until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
703162.translation: 由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。魔戒引诱你。

703164.oracleText:
"The Orcs were greater in number than we counted on. Great Orcs, who also bore the White Hand of Isengard."
—Eomer
703164.translation:
「奥克数量比我们估算的要多。都是些强大的奥克，身上全有艾森加德白手印。」
～伊奥梅尔

703165.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Activate only as a sorcery.
703165.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标神器或结界。只能于法术时机起动。

703168.oracleText: It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked. Fire came from its nostrils. But Gandalf stood firm.
703168.translation: 它扬起鞭子，鞭梢呼啸，啪作响；鼻孔还喷着火焰。但甘道夫屹立不摇。

703169.oracleText: Destroy target creature that blocked or was blocked by a legendary creature this turn.
703169.translation: 消灭目标生物，且须为本回合中曾阻挡传奇生物或被传奇生物阻挡者。

703171.oracleText: "Wear this now in memory of Elfstone and Evenstar with whom your life has been woven!"
703171.translation: 「请戴着它，以纪念织就你生命的精灵宝石和暮星！」

703172.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control two or more legendary creatures.
703172.translation: 如果你操控两个或更多传奇生物，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

703174.oracleText: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
703174.translation: 抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

703175.oracleText: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
703175.translation: 抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

703176.oracleText: Shuffle any number of target cards from your graveyard into your library. Add {oUoU}.
703176.translation: 将任意数量的目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。加{oUoU}。

703179.oracleText: If this creature would untap during your untap step, remove a +1/+1 counter from it instead. If you do, untap it.
703179.translation: 如果此生物将在你的重置步骤中重置，则改为从其上移去一个+1/+1指示物。若你如此作，则将它重置。

703180.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "If this creature would untap during your untap step, remove a +1/+1 counter from it instead. If you do, untap it." (Otherwise, it doesn't untap.)
703180.translation: 所结附的生物具有「如果此生物将在你的重置步骤中重置，则改为从其上移去一个+1/+1指示物。若你如此作，则将它重置。」（若未如此作，它便不能重置。）

703183.oracleText: Target opponent gains control of target Horse you control. If they do, remove Bill Ferny from combat and create three Treasure tokens.
703183.translation: 目标对手获得目标由你操控的马之操控权。若其如此作，则将比尔·蕨尼移出战斗且你派出三个珍宝衍生物。

703187.oracleText: As Bilbo finished his speech, he slipped the ring on his finger, and he was never seen by any Hobbit in Hobbiton again.
703187.translation: 比尔博甫一讲完话，就把手指套进戒指里，从此再也没有哪个霍比特人在霍比屯内见过他。

703188.oracleText: Draw a card. The Ring tempts you.

703190.oracleText:
"I looked on Aragorn and thought how great and terrible a Lord he might have become, had he taken the Ring for himself. Not for naught does Mordor fear him."
—Legolas
703190.translation:
「我看着阿拉贡，心想如果当初他把魔戒占为己有，会变成怎样一位强大又可怕的君王。魔多怕他不是没理由的。」
～莱戈拉斯

703191.oracleText: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
703191.translation: 本回合中，你可以将咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

703193.oracleText:
"There is a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin, manned by the Corsairs of Umbar in the South. They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor."
—Beregond
703193.translation:
「有支南方乌姆巴尔海盗摩下的强大舰队正在逼近安都因河口。他们早已不再惧怕刚铎声威。」
～贝瑞刚德

703195.oracleText:
"I will take the Ring to Mordor, though I do not know the way."
—Frodo
703195.translation:
「虽然我不识前路，但愿将魔戒带到魔多。」
～弗罗多

703199.oracleText:
"Tell Gandalf that he must seek my aid at once."
—Saruman
703199.translation:
「告诉甘道夫：他必须马上寻求我的援助。」
～萨茹曼

703202.oracleText: "I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night! All shall love me and despair!"
703202.translation: 「我不会是黑暗的，而会既美丽又恐怖，正如清晨与黑夜！众生万物都将爱我，都将绝望！」

703203.oracleText: Target creature has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
703203.translation: 目标生物的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。魔戒引诱你。

703205.oracleText: "This is the hour of the Shire-folk, when they arise from their quiet fields to shake the towers and counsels of the Great. Who of all the Wise could have foreseen it?"
703205.translation: 「这一时刻属于夏尔的子民，他们从宁静田野中挺身而出，撼动伟人的高塔与议会。又有哪位智者曾预见到这一刻？」

703209.oracleText: "After a hundred years, Hobbits can still surprise you at a pinch."
703209.translation: 「过了一百年，必要时霍比特人仍能给出惊喜。」

703210.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, if you chose a creature other than CARDNAME as your Ring-bearer, draw a card.
703210.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，若你选择CARDNAME以外的生物作你的持戒人，则抓一张牌。

703213.oracleText: The Elves of Lorien took Dol Guldur. Galadriel threw down its walls and laid bare its pits, and the forest was cleansed.
703213.translation: 罗瑞恩的精灵攻下了多古尔都。加拉德瑞尔推倒城墙，揭开地洞，净化森林。

703214.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. If it was a legendary spell, the Ring tempts you.
703214.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。如果它是传奇咒语，则魔戒引诱你。

703216.oracleText: "Fear nothing! For tonight you are under the roof of Tom Bombadil."
703216.translation: 「什么都不用怕！因为今晚你们来到了汤姆·邦巴迪尔的家。」

703219.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: Move one or more counters from Goldberry onto another target permanent you control. If you do, draw a card.
703219.translation: {oU}，{oT}：将一个或数个指示物从金莓移到另一个目标由你操控的永久物上。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

703222.oracleText: It was an old tradition that beyond the Shire stood the Grey Havens, from which at times elven-ships set sail, never to return.
703222.translation: 这是长久以来的传统：夏尔之外有处灰港，不时会有精灵船只从该处启航，永不归返。

703225.oracleText:
"If you will try to run away you must be tied; but we don't wish to hurt you."
—Sam
703225.translation:
「如果你想要逃跑，我们就要把你绑起来；但我们不想伤害你。」
～山姆

703228.oracleText: The black horses were filled with madness, and leaping forward in terror they bore their riders into the rushing flood.
703228.translation: 那些黑马全都发狂起来，惊恐地大步前冲，纷纷载着骑手一头扎进滚滚洪流当中。

703229.oracleText: Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands. Scry 1. The Ring tempts you.
703229.translation: 将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。占卜1。魔戒引诱你。

703231.oracleText: "I have been too busy with this and that to heed all the crying and shouting. All I hope is that those murdering devils do not come to this House and trouble the sick."
703231.translation: 「我都已经忙得不可开交了，根本没空理会四处的大呼小叫。我只希望那些杀人魔鬼别到这院里来找伤者麻烦。」

703232.oracleText: {oT}: Untap two other target legendary creatures.
703232.translation: {oT}：重置两个其他目标传奇生物。

703234.oracleText:
"They took me and set me on the pinnacle of Orthanc. I stood alone on an island in the clouds; I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter and cold."
—Gandalf
703234.translation:
「他们把我抓起来，关在欧尔桑克尖顶上。我就独身一人站在云间孤岛上；根本没有机会逃跑，日子过得又苦又冷。」
～甘道夫

703236.oracleText: After their reunion, the Hobbits spent many days in Ithilien. The stream that flowed from the falls of Henneth Annun could be heard in the night as it rushed down through its rocky gate.
703236.translation: 众人重聚过后，霍比特人仍在伊希利恩住上了许多日子。汉奈斯安努恩瀑布奔腾而下形成溪流，河水冲击该处岩石水口会发出激荡声响，在夜间时分就变得清晰可闻。

703239.oracleText: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate.
703239.translation: 就这样一支支队伍通过，迎着称赞与欢呼声穿过了城门。

703242.oracleText:
"Look on us now with friendly eyes! Behold the trees of the Naith of Lorien and be glad!"
—Haldir
703242.translation:
「现在请用友善的眼光来看待我们！敬请见证罗瑞恩耐斯森林，开心感受吧！」
～哈尔迪尔

703246.oracleText: Whenever you scry, put a verse counter on CARDNAME.
703246.translation: 每当你占卜时，在CARDNAME上放置一个词句指示物。

703248.oracleText: {o4oUoU}, Exile CARDNAME: Draw a card for each verse counter on CARDNAME. If it had seven or more verse counters on it, take an extra turn after this one. Activate only as a sorcery.
703248.translation: {o4oUoU}，放逐CARDNAME：CARDNAME上每有一个词句指示物，便抓一张牌。如果其上有七个或更多词句指示物，则于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。只能于法术时机起动。

703251.oracleText:
"Then come! We have need of speed greater than any wind, outmatching the wings of the Nazgul."
—Gandalf
703251.translation:
「那就来吧！我们需要的速度得快过疾风，能超过那兹古尔的双翼。」
～甘道夫

703252.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile up to one target creature you own, then return it to the battlefield under your control.
703252.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐至多一个目标由你拥有的生物，然后将它在你的操控下移回战场。

703255.oracleText:
"But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies."
—Haldir
703255.translation:
「不过我们有些人还是会出到外面收集消息，监视敌人。」
～哈尔迪尔

703256.oracleText: Whenever you scry, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
703256.translation: 每当你占卜时，CARDNAME看守得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

703259.oracleText: "The Corsairs are upon us! Back to the walls! Back to the City before all are overwhelmed!"
703259.translation: 「海盗来了！回到墙里来！在全军覆灭前回到石城里来！」

703262.oracleText: "I showed the blade reforged to him. He is not so mighty yet that he is above fear."
703262.translation: 「我向他展示了重铸的剑。他还没有强大到无所畏惧。」

703263.oracleText: Return target spell or nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with equal or lesser mana value from your hand without paying its mana cost.
703263.translation: 将目标由对手操控的咒语或非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值相等或较小的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

703265.oracleText: "We have a new errand on this journey: to ambush the Men of Harad."
703265.translation: 「我们此行有新使命：伏击哈拉德的人类。」

703269.oracleText: "Sauron's victory is at hand; and there will be rich reward for those who aided it."
703269.translation: 「索隆胜利唾手可得，出力相助者必得丰厚回报。」

703270.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, amass Orcs 2.
703270.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，囤兵半兽人2。

703272.oracleText:
"I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly."
—Saruman
703272.translation:
「我已给你心甘情愿协助我的机会。」
～萨茹曼

703274.oracleText: Gain control of up to one target artifact for as long as you control CARDNAME. The Ring tempts you.
703274.translation: 于你操控CARDNAME之时段内，获得至多一个目标神器的操控权。魔戒引诱你。

703276.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures. Put a stun counter on each of them.
703276.translation: 横置至多两个目标生物。在这些生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

703277.oracleText: Draw a card for each tapped creature target opponent controls.
703277.translation: 目标对手每操控一个已横置的生物，你便抓一张牌。

703279.oracleText: Frodo's heart sank. This was too much like trickery, and certainly what he did would seem a treachery to the poor treacherous creature.
703279.translation: 弗罗多的心顿时沉重起来。这实在太像骗局了，而且在这可怜的奸诈生物看来，他的作为肯定就是背叛。

703280.oracleText: Return target nontoken creature to its owner's hand. The Ring tempts you.
703280.translation: 将目标非衍生物的生物移回其拥有者手上。魔戒引诱你。

703282.oracleText: "Fool of a Took! This is a serious journey, not a Hobbit walking-party. Throw yourself in next time, and then you will be no further nuisance. Now be quiet!"
703282.translation: 「你这蠢图克！这是趟严肃旅程，不是霍比特人的远足聚会。下次你该把你自己丢下去，然后就不会再惹麻烦了。现在给我安静点！」

703283.oracleText: Counter target creature spell with power or toughness 2 or less.
703283.translation: 反击目标力量或防御力等于或小于2的生物咒语。

703285.oracleText: Isengard had once been filled with fruitful trees, but no green thing grew there in the latter days of Saruman.
703285.translation: 艾森加德曾经果树成林，但在萨茹曼统治后期，已然不见半点青翠踪迹。

703286.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy it, except the copy isn't legendary. You may choose new targets for the copy.
703286.translation: 每当你施放每回合你的第二个咒语时，将它复制，但该复制品不是传奇。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

703287.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy it, except the copy isn't legendary. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
703287.translation: 每当你施放每回合你的第二个咒语时，将它复制，但该复制品不是传奇。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

703289.oracleText: Amass Orcs 3, then target player mills X cards, where X is the amassed Army's power.
703289.translation: 囤兵半兽人3，然后目标牌手磨X张牌，X为该受囤兵的军队之力量。

703291.oracleText: Put up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard on top of your library.
703291.translation: 将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

703296.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card during an opponent's turn, create a 1/1 blue Tentacle creature token.
703296.translation: 每当你在对手的回合中抓一张牌时，派出一个1/1蓝色触手衍生生物。

703297.oracleText: Whenever a Tentacle you control dies, untap up to one target Kraken and put a stun counter on up to one target nonland permanent.
703297.translation: 每当一个由你操控的触手死去时，重置至多一个目标巨海兽，并在至多一个目标非地永久物上放置一个晕眩指示物。

703299.oracleText: The branches of the willow began to sway violently. Frodo called for help, but he could hardly hear his own voice: it was blown away from him by the willow-wind and drowned in a clamor of leaves.
703299.translation: 柳树的枝叶开始剧烈摆动。弗罗多虽然高声呼救，但他甚至都听不到自己的声音：话语甫一出口，就被柳树的风吹走，淹没在树叶的喧嚣中。

703302.oracleText:
"I tried to take the Ring from Frodo. I am sorry. I have paid."
—Boromir
703302.translation:
「我刚才试图从弗罗多手里抢过魔戒。非常抱歉。我已经付出了代价。」
～波洛米尔

703303.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a creature that was dealt damage this turn.
703303.translation: 如果此咒语以本回合中受过伤害的生物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

703305.oracleText:
"When the black breath blows, death's shadow grows."
—A rhyme of old days
703305.translation:
「时值黑息鼓动，死亡阴影渐浓。」 
～古代的歌谣

703306.oracleText: Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
703306.translation: 由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。魔戒引诱你。

703309.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, the Ring tempts you.
703309.translation: 在你的维持开始时，魔戒引诱你。

703310.oracleText: Whenever you choose a creature as your Ring-bearer, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.
703310.translation: 每当你选择一个生物作你的持戒人时，你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

703313.oracleText:
"Spies feared on Stairs. Double vigilance. Patrol to head of Stairs."
—Shagrat's orders
703313.translation:
「阶梯内恐有奸细。加倍警戒。巡逻到顶。」
～沙格拉特的命令

703314.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw a card, then create a Food token.
703314.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物：抓一张牌，然后派出一个食品衍生物。

703316.oracleText:
"I think it is a sad story, and it might have happened to others, even to some Hobbits that I have known."
—Gandalf
703316.translation:
「我认为这是个悲伤的故事。它可能发生在其他人身上，甚至在某些我认识的霍比特人身上。」
～甘道夫

703317.oracleText: Destroy target creature. The Ring tempts you.
703317.translation: 消灭目标生物。魔戒引诱你。

703319.oracleText:
"What's that, Strider? It don't look like a cloud."
—Sam
703319.translation:
「大步佬，那是什么？看起来不像是云。」
～山姆

703323.oracleText: An army of Easterlings charged forth, while from the hills poured Orcs innumerable.
703323.translation: 一支东夷军队冲锋向前，山坡上顿时有无数的奥克倾泻而出。

703328.oracleText: "They'll take it, steal my Precious. Thieves. We hates them."
703328.translation: 「他们会拿走它，偷走我的宝贝。小偷。我们恨他们。」

703329.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, the Ring tempts you.
703329.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，魔戒引诱你。

703333.oracleText:
"It was Pity that stayed Bilbo's hand. Do not be too eager to deal out death in judgment; Gollum has some part to play yet, before the end."
—Gandalf, to Frodo
703333.translation:
「正是由于心生怜悯，比尔博才没下手。别急着为他人定生死；到最后之前，咕噜还有他的作用。」
～甘道夫告诫弗罗多

703336.translation: 米那斯魔古尔的戈巴格

703337.oracleText:
Whenever a Goblin or Orc you control deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. When you do, choose one — 
• Draw a card. 
• Create a Treasure token.
703337.translation:
每当一个由你操控的鬼怪或半兽人对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。当你如此作时，选择一项～ 
•抓一张牌。 
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。

703338.translation: 魔古尔副头领勾斯魔格

703341.oracleText: Creature tokens you control have deathtouch.
703341.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物具有死触异能。

703343.oracleText: "Do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength. Let others deal with these irksome guests."
703343.translation: 「请您千万别累着，或是过度消耗您的体力。就让下人来应付这些烦人的宾客吧。」

703344.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Target player loses 1 life. If the sacrificed creature was legendary, amass Orcs 2.
703344.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物：目标牌手失去1点生命。如果所牺牲的生物是传奇，则囤兵半兽人2。

703346.oracleText: As long as it's your turn and you control an Army, CARDNAME is an artifact creature.
703346.translation: 只要是在你的回合中且你操控军队，CARDNAME便是神器生物。

703350.oracleText:
"You should not look in when the candles are lit."
—Gollum
703350.translation:
「蜡烛亮着的时候，你不该往里看的。」
～咕噜

703356.oracleText: Isildur cut the Ring from Sauron's hand with the hilt-shard of his father's sword, and Sauron himself was overthrown.
703356.translation: 伊熙尔杜用他父亲的断剑从索隆手上斩下魔戒，阻止了索隆的野心。

703357.oracleText: Destroy target creature. If its controller has more than four cards in hand, they exile cards from their hand equal to the difference.
703357.translation: 消灭目标生物。如果其操控者的手牌数量多于四张，则该牌手从其手上放逐等同于该差距数量的牌。

703359.oracleText: Even as the Balrog fell, it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about Gandalf's knees, dragging him to the brink of the abyss. "Fly, you fools!" he cried, and was gone.
703359.translation: 就当炎魔跌落时，它甩出鞭子，鞭梢直扑甘道夫而来，弯卷缠住了他的双膝，将他拉扯到深渊边缘。「快跑啊，你们这些傻瓜！」一声大喊过后，他随即消失不见。

703360.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {o4}.
703360.translation: 牺牲一个生物或支付{o4}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

703361.translation: 洛比莉亚·萨克维尔巴金斯

703365.oracleText: Like a storm, they broke upon the line of the Men of Gondor.
703365.translation: 就像风暴一样，他们转眼之间便突破了刚铎人类的阵线。

703369.oracleText:
"The enemy has many spies and many ways of hearing."
—Gandalf
703369.translation:
「敌人耳目众多，刺探有道。」
～甘道夫

703370.oracleText: Whenever you create or sacrifice a token, each opponent loses 1 life.
703370.translation: 每当你派出或牺牲一个衍生物时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

703372.oracleText:
"Orcs, thousands of Orcses. Nice Hobbits mustn't go to those places."
—Gollum
703372.translation:
「奥克，好几千奥克。好霍比特人不要去那些地方。」
～咕噜

703374.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more Goblins and/or Orcs, create a 2/1 colorless Construct artifact creature token with flying named Ballistic Boulder that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice that token at end of combat.
703374.translation: 每当你以一个或数个鬼怪和／或半兽人攻击时，派出一个2/1无色，名称为抛石弹，具飞行异能的组构体衍生神器生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在战斗结束时牺牲该衍生物。

703376.oracleText: Frodo felt a pain like a dart of poisoned ice pierce his left shoulder.
703376.translation: 弗罗多感到左肩传来痛楚，有种被寒冰毒镖刺穿的感觉。

703377.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile this creature unless you pay 2 life.
703377.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你支付2点生命，否则放逐此生物。

703378.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets -3/-0 and has "At the beginning of your upkeep, exile this creature unless you pay 2 life."
703378.translation: 所结附的生物得-3/-0且具有「在你的维持开始时，除非你支付2点生命，否则放逐此生物。」

703380.oracleText:
"And that's the end of that. A nasty end for Saruman, and I wish I needn't have seen it; but it's a good riddance."
—Sam
703380.translation:
「那事这样就算结束了。萨茹曼的下场真惨，我真希望没有看到那一幕；不过总算完了。」
～山姆

703381.oracleText: Draw two cards. If the sacrificed creature was legendary, draw three cards instead.
703381.translation: 抓两张牌。如果所牺牲的生物是传奇，则改为抓三张牌。

703385.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, put a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
703385.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，在每个由你操控的鬼魂上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

703386.oracleText: A deck can have up to nine cards named Nazgul.
703386.translation: 名称为那兹古尔的牌，在套牌中的数量能有至多九张。

703388.oracleText: You and target opponent each create a Food token.
703388.translation: 你和目标对手各派出一个食品衍生物。

703389.oracleText: Each opponent loses 3 life. Create a Treasure token.
703389.translation: 每位对手各失去3点生命。你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

703390.oracleText: Create three tapped 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
703390.translation: 派出三个已横置的1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

703391.oracleText: One Ring to Rule Them All

703392.oracleText: The Ring tempts you, then each player mills cards equal to your Ring-bearer's power.
703392.translation: 魔戒引诱你，然后每位牌手各磨若干牌，其数量等同于你持戒人的力量。

703394.oracleText: Each opponent loses 1 life for each creature card in that player's graveyard.
703394.translation: 对每位对手而言，该牌手坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，其便失去1点生命。

703399.oracleText: Target creature gains your choice of lifelink or indestructible until end of turn.
703399.translation: 选择系命或不灭。目标生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

703401.oracleText: "By all the signs, there's a large warrior loose, with an Elf-sword, and an axe as well maybe." Gorbag spat. Sam smiled grimly at this description of himself.
703401.translation: 「从所有的迹象看起来，有个大块头的战士跑掉了，带着精灵长剑，也许还有把斧头。」戈巴格吐了口痰。听着对方这么形容自己，山姆只能苦笑。

703402.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. The Ring tempts you.
703402.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。魔戒引诱你。

703408.oracleText: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly. His wrath blazed in consuming flame, but his fear rose like black smoke.
703408.translation: 弗罗多戴上魔戒后，索隆突然知晓自己到底有多么愚不可及。他的怒火爆发成熊熊烈焰，其恐惧也如黑烟高高升起。

703409.oracleText: Exile all creature cards from target player's graveyard. You may cast spells from among those cards for as long as they remain exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them.
703409.translation: 放逐目标牌手坟墓场中的所有生物牌。于这些牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以从这些牌之中施放咒语，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放。

703411.oracleText: As Frodo ran forward, eager, rejoicing to be free, Shelob with hideous speed came behind and stung him in the neck.
703411.translation: 正当弗罗多心中满是重获自由的喜悦，急切地向前狂奔时，希洛布以可怕的速度从后面跟上，一刺正中他的脖颈。

703412.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+2 and gains deathtouch until end of turn. Create a Food token.
703412.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+2且获得死触异能。派出一个食品衍生物。

703414.oracleText: A shuddering howl broke from him, as if he were a captain summoning his pack to the assault.
703414.translation: 他突然发出一声骇人吼叫，仿佛是领队呼唤狼群准备进攻。

703415.oracleText: As long as you control a Goblin or Orc, CARDNAME gets +1/+0.
703415.translation: 只要你操控鬼怪或半兽人，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

703418.oracleText: In Mordor, all that he knew was forced from him.
703418.translation: 在魔多，他被迫透露出了所知的一切。

703420.oracleText:
"A great cave-troll, I think. There is no hope of escape that way."
—Gandalf
703420.translation:
「我想，那是头巨大的洞穴食人妖。走那条路绝无逃生希望。」
～甘道夫

703424.oracleText: "What of the dawn? We are the Uruk-hai; we do not stop the fight for night or day, for fair weather or for storm. We come to kill, by sun or moon. What of the dawn?"
703424.translation: 「黎明破晓又怎样？我们是乌鲁克族；我们很能打仗，不管黑夜白天，不管晴天风暴。我们很能杀人，不管太阳月亮。黎明破晓又怎样？」

703433.oracleText: Discard a card: Witch-king of Angmar gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
703433.translation: 弃一张牌：安格玛巫王获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

703435.oracleText:
"An Orc shot Balin from behind a stone. We slew the Orc, but many more came."
—Book of Mazarbul
703435.translation:
「有个奥克从石头后射中了巴林。我们杀掉了那个奥克，但后面来了更多。」
～《马扎布尔之书》

703436.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to each creature blocking it.
703436.translation: 每当CARDNAME被阻挡时，它对每个阻挡它的生物各造成1点伤害。

703441.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain menace until end of turn.
703441.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

703443.oracleText: "It might have been mine. It should be mine. Give it to me!"
703443.translation: 「它本来有可能是我的。它应该是我的。把它给我！」

703444.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls deals damage equal to its power to another target creature that player controls. The Ring tempts you.
703444.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物向另一个目标由该牌手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。魔戒引诱你。

703446.oracleText:
"But for Gollum, I could not have destroyed the Ring. So let us forgive him! For the Quest is achieved, and now all is over."
—Frodo
703446.translation:
「要不是咕噜，我可能都没法毁掉魔戒。让我们原谅他吧！任务已完成，一切都结束了。」
～弗罗多

703447.oracleText: Cast into the Fire deals 1 damage to each of up to two target creatures.
703447.translation: 投入烈焰对至多两个目标生物各造成1点伤害。

703448.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each of up to two target creatures. 
• Exile target artifact.
703448.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对至多两个目标生物各造成1点伤害。 
•放逐目标神器。

703449.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Cast into the Fire deals 1 damage to each of up to two target creatures. 
• Exile target artifact.
703449.translation:
选择一项～ 
•投入烈焰对至多两个目标生物各造成1点伤害。 
•放逐目标神器。

703451.oracleText:
"The Nazgul closed round at night, and I was besieged. Such light and flame cannot have been seen on Weathertop since the war-beacons of old."
—Gandalf
703451.translation:
「到了晚上，那兹古尔便将我团团围住。自从古代战争烽烟以来，风云顶上就再没见过此等光亮与火焰。」
～甘道夫

703452.oracleText: Copy any number of target instant and/or sorcery spells. You may choose new targets for the copies.
703452.translation: 复制任意数量的目标瞬间和／或法术咒语。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

703454.oracleText: "Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never."
703454.translation: 「需求虽刻不容缓，迟到仍胜过不到。」

703455.oracleText: Whenever one or more other attacking legendary creatures you control die, untap all creatures you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. This ability triggers only once each turn.
703455.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且正进行攻击的其他传奇生物死去时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

703457.oracleText: But northward the white crest of Eomer led the great front of the Rohirrim which he had again gathered and marshaled.
703457.translation: 但在北边，伊梅奥尔重新集结起了洛希尔人，他们在国王白色马尾盔冠的率领下形成一道强壮锋线。

703458.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
703458.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控力量为战场上生物中最大值的生物，则派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

703461.oracleText:
"We make good armor and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that our fathers made before the dragon came."
—Gloin
703461.translation:
「我们虽能打造好甲长剑，但在恶龙来袭前，父辈还曾打造过更精良的锁甲利刃，而如今我们再也无法重制。」
～格罗因

703463.translation: 西伏尔德领主埃肯布兰德

703464.oracleText: Down from the hills leaped Erkenbrand, lord of Westfold, and the hosts of Isengard roared in fear.
703464.translation: 西伏尔德领主埃肯布兰德从山丘上一跃而出，艾森加德的大军吓得叫声连连。

703468.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls is dealt excess noncombat damage, amass Orcs X, where X is that excess damage.
703468.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物受到过量之非战斗伤害时，囤兵半兽人X，X为该过量伤害之数值。

703469.oracleText: {o7oR}: CARDNAME deals 7 damage to target creature.

703471.translation: 出事了，失火了，敌人来了！

703473.oracleText: Damage can't be prevented this turn. Fear, Fire, Foes! deals X damage to target creature and 1 damage to each other creature with the same controller.
703473.translation: 本回合中，伤害不能被防止。出事了，失火了，敌人来了！对目标生物造成X点伤害，且对每个操控者相同的其他生物各造成1点伤害。

703475.oracleText: Ash nazg durbatuluk, ash nazg gimbatul, ash nazg thrakatuluk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul.
703475.translation: Ash nazg durbatuluk, ash nazg gimbatul, ash nazg thrakatuluk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul.

703479.oracleText: The barricade was scattered as if by a thunderbolt.
703479.translation: 城防工事像遭到雷击一样，登时崩毁散落。

703480.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or land. Creatures without flying can't block this turn.
703480.translation: 消灭目标神器或地。不具飞行异能的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

703482.oracleText: Amass Orcs 2. When you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature an opponent controls, where X is the amassed Army's power.
703482.translation: 囤兵半兽人2。当你如此作时，CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物造成X点伤害，X为该受囤兵军队的力量。

703483.oracleText: Amass Orcs 2. When you do, Foray of Orcs deals X damage to target creature an opponent controls, where X is the amassed Army's power.
703483.translation: 囤兵半兽人2。当你如此作时，奥克突袭向目标由对手操控的生物造成X点伤害，X为该受囤兵军队的力量。

703485.oracleText: "Twenty-one!" cried Gimli. He hewed a two-handed stroke and laid the last Orc before his feet. "Now my count passes Master Legolas."
703485.translation: 「二十一个！」吉姆利叫道。他双手并用，一把将最后一个奥克砍倒在脚前。「现在我的纪录超过莱戈拉斯大人啦。」

703486.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to that creature's controller.
703486.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，CARDNAME对该生物的操控者造成1点伤害。

703489.oracleText: As long as equipped creature is legendary, it has menace.
703489.translation: 只要佩带此武具的生物是传奇，它便具有威慑异能。

703491.translation: 「两个！」吉姆利边说边拍了拍斧头。

703492.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+2 until end of turn. If it's legendary, it also gains trample until end of turn.
703492.translation: 目标生物得+3/+2直到回合结束。如果它是传奇，则它再获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

703494.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, create a Treasure token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
703494.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

703495.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a Treasure: Goad target creature.
703495.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个珍宝：煽惑目标生物。

703497.oracleText:
"Let us hope that fire now lies between us and pursuit. Come! There is no time to lose."
—Gandalf
703497.translation:
「希望大火现在横在我们与追兵之间。来吧！没时间可以浪费了。」
～甘道夫

703499.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
703499.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

703505.oracleText:
"In the South the Haradrim are moving, and fear has fallen on all our coastlands."
—Hirgon, errand-rider of Gondor
703505.translation:
「南方，哈拉德人正在调兵遣将，我们海滨全境已遭恐惧笼罩。」
～刚铎信使希尔巩

703506.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, another target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
703506.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

703508.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of lands. Reveal the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of lands sacrificed this way. Choose any number of artifact and/or land cards revealed this way. Put all nonland cards chosen this way onto the battlefield, then put all land cards chosen this way onto the battlefield tapped, then put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
703508.translation: 牺牲任意数量的地。展示你牌库顶的X张牌，X为以此法牺牲的地数量。选择任意数量以此法展示的神器和／或地牌。将所有以此法选择的非地牌放进战场，然后将所有以此法选择的地牌横置放进战场，然后将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

703510.oracleText:
"‘For a couple o' pins,' says Troll, and grins,
‘I'll eat thee too and gnaw thy shins.'"
—Sam
703510.translation:
「『吹灰不用动手功，』食人妖咧嘴笑，
『一口把你连人带皮全吃掉。』」
～山姆

703511.oracleText: Improvised Club deals 4 damage to any target.
703511.translation: 临时木棍对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

703513.oracleText: There was a rush of hoarse laughter, like the fall of sliding stones into a pit; amid the clamor a deep voice was raised in command.
703513.translation: 突然有阵像是滚石滑入坑底的嘶哑笑声传来；之后喧嚣之中发出深沉低语，有人开始发号施令。

703514.oracleText: Whenever a Goblin or Orc you control deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
703514.translation: 每当一个由你操控的鬼怪或半兽人对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

703516.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
703516.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。

703521.oracleText: Trolls were abroad, no longer dull-witted, but cunning and armed with dreadful weapons.
703521.translation: 食人妖也出动了～他们不再蠢笨待宰，变得聪明狡诈，手里还拿着可怖武器。

703522.oracleText: CARDNAME can't block unless you control a Goblin or Orc.
703522.translation: 除非你操控鬼怪或半兽人，否则CARDNAME不能进行阻挡。

703525.oracleText:
"It is a joy to us to see you return into your own."
—Eomer
703525.translation:
「真高兴见到您恢复原样。」
～伊奥梅尔

703526.oracleText: Draw two cards and create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
703526.translation: 抓两张牌并派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

703528.oracleText: With a cry and a great noise they charged. Down from the gates they roared, over the causeway they swept, and they drove through the hosts of Isengard as a wind among grass.
703528.translation: 随着战吼巨响，他们蜂拥而出～从堡门呼啸而下，横扫堤道敌人，如秋风扫落叶一般杀入艾森加德的大军。

703529.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens. Humans you control gain haste until end of turn.
703529.translation: 派出两个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。由你操控的人类获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

703531.oracleText:
"Keep close to the fire, with your faces outward! Get some of the longer sticks ready in your hands!"
—Strider
703531.translation:
「全都靠近火堆，脸朝外侧！手里都拿好长点的木棍！」
～大步佬

703532.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. The Ring tempts you.
703532.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。魔戒引诱你。

703533.oracleText: Ranger's Firebrand deals 2 damage to any target. The Ring tempts you.
703533.translation: 游民惹事对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。魔戒引诱你。

703535.oracleText:
"The Orcs are in the Deep! Helm! Helm! Forth Helmingas!"
—Gamling the Old
703535.translation:
「奥克进到深谷里去了！海尔姆！海尔姆！海尔姆一族，冲啊！」
～老甘姆林

703538.oracleText: Over the low hills the horns were sounding. Hastening down the long slopes were a thousand men on foot; their swords were in their hands.
703538.translation: 低岭上传出了号角声。随即便有支千人规模的步兵部队疾冲而下，尽皆长剑在手。

703539.translation: 由你操控的传奇生物得+1/+0。

703541.oracleText:
"Dire deeds awake, dark is it eastward.
Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!"
—Theoden
703541.translation:
「危难再临，东界无明。
备马佩鞍，号角齐鸣！」
～希奥顿

703544.oracleText: There was a horn-blast and a rush of feet, and Orcs one after another leaped into the chamber.
703544.translation: 号角一响，便有纷杂脚步传来，只见奥克一个接一个地跃进石室。

703545.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. If it's a Goblin or Orc, it also gains haste until end of turn.
703545.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。如果它是鬼怪或半兽人，则它再获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

703548.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. That creature loses indestructible until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
703548.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。该生物失去不灭异能直到回合结束。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

703549.oracleText: Smite the Deathless deals 3 damage to target creature. That creature loses indestructible until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
703549.translation: 击灭不死灵对目标生物造成3点伤害。该生物失去不灭异能直到回合结束。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

703551.translation:
「居心不良者活该受罪。」
～萨茹曼

703554.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures your opponents control die, you create a Treasure token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
703554.translation: 每当由对手操控的一个或数个生物死去时，你派出一个珍宝衍生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

703557.oracleText: Up to one target creature can't block for as long as you control CARDNAME. The Ring tempts you.
703557.translation: 于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，至多一个目标生物不能进行阻挡。魔戒引诱你。

703559.oracleText: Search your library for a Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
703559.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张山脉牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

703563.oracleText: Drums rolled, fires leaped, and great engines drawn by beasts crawled across the field.
703563.translation: 战鼓轰鸣，火光熊熊，野兽拖着大型器械慢慢穿过平野。

703564.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control with power 4 or greater dies, amass Orcs 2.
703564.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物死去时，囤兵半兽人2。

703567.oracleText:
"Dwarves' tongues run on when speaking of their handiwork, they say."
—Gloin
703567.translation:
「他们说，矮人一讲到自己的手艺就会滔滔不绝。」
～格罗因

703568.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of legendary creatures you control.
703568.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的传奇生物数量。

703571.oracleText:
"Hey dol! merry dol! ring a dong dillo!
Ring a dong! hop along! fal lal the willow!
Tom Bom, jolly Tom, Tom Bombadillo!"
703571.translation:
「嘿嘿咚！欢乐咚！敲响叮叮咚！
响叮咚！跳叮咚！柳树倒叮咚！
汤姆砰！开心砰！邦巴迪尔砰！」

703572.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
703572.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得辟邪异能。魔戒引诱你。

703574.oracleText:
"Your land must be a realm of peace and content, and there must gardeners be in high honor."
—Faramir
703574.translation:
「想必你们的国度是个和平、快乐的地方，园丁在那一定备受敬重。」
～法拉米尔

703575.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or leaves the battlefield, create a Food token.
703575.translation: 当CARDNAME进入或离开战场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

703578.oracleText: His eyes were keen as lances in starlight, and yet profound, the wells of deep memory.
703578.translation: 他的双眼如星耀长枪般尖锐，又如记忆深井般深沉。

703579.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more Elves, scry 1.
703579.translation: 每当你以一个或数个妖精攻击时，占卜1。

703580.oracleText: Whenever you scry, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each card looked at while scrying this way.
703580.translation: 每当你占卜时，以此法占卜期间每检视过一张牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

703583.oracleText:
"It is said, ‘Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes.'"
—Frodo
703583.translation:
「俗话说，『找谁也别找精灵开会，他们行与不行都说尽。』」
～弗罗多

703584.oracleText: Whenever you scry, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
703584.translation: 每当你占卜时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

703587.oracleText: There were toys the Hobbit-children had never seen before, all beautiful, and some obviously magical.
703587.translation: 霍比特小孩从来没有见过这种玩具：它们全都很精美，有些很明显带有魔法。

703588.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a legendary spell, and that spell can't be countered.
703588.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放传奇咒语，且该咒语不能被反击。

703590.oracleText: "Aragorn has need of his kindred. Let the Dunedain go to him in Rohan!"
703590.translation: 「阿拉贡需要自己的族人。让杜内丹人追随他去洛汗！」

703593.oracleText: "A Elbereth Gilthoniel, silivren penna miriel o menel aglar elenath!"
703593.translation: "A Elbereth Gilthoniel, silivren penna miriel o menel aglar elenath!"

703595.oracleText:
"Few can foresee whither their road will lead them, till they come to its end."
—Legolas
703595.translation:
「几乎没人能预见脚下的路会将他们带向何方，直到自己走到路的尽头。」
～莱戈拉斯

703596.oracleText: Scry 3, then you may reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, draw a card.
703596.translation: 占卜3，然后你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是生物牌，则抓一张牌。

703598.oracleText:
"They stand watching endlessly over the trees. It is difficult to see them moving, but they can move very quickly if they are angry."
—Merry
703598.translation:
「他们不眠不休地照管着树木。虽然平时看不出他们在动，但生起气来走得飞快。」
～梅里

703602.oracleText: Sacrifice a land. Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, instead search your library for up to three basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
703602.translation: 牺牲一个地。从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则改为从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

703604.oracleText:
"I came and called the trees by their long names, but they did not hear or answer—they lay dead."
—Quickbeam
703604.translation:
「我去到该处，用长长的名字叫那些树，但无人听闻、没有回应～都倒在地上死了。」
～急楸

703605.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control if its power is 4 or greater. Then that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and fights target creature you don't control.
703605.translation: 如果目标由你操控之生物的力量等于或大于4，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物得+1/+1直到回合结束，且与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

703607.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
703607.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

703608.oracleText: When this creature dies, draw two cards.
703608.translation: 当此生物死去时，抓两张牌。

703609.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "When this creature dies, draw two cards." Then that creature fights up to one other target creature.
703609.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得「当此生物死去时，抓两张牌。」然后该生物与至多另一个目标生物互斗。

703611.oracleText: "I am an Ent. Fangorn is my name according to some, Treebeard others make it."
703611.translation: 「我是个恩特。有些人叫我范贡，还有一些人叫我树须。」

703612.translation: 由你操控的树妖具有警戒异能。

703613.oracleText: Whenever one or more Treefolk you control attack, add twice that much {oG}.
703613.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个树妖攻击时，加该数量两倍的{oG}。

703618.oracleText: "I shall lead you well, and the paths are smooth and straight."
703618.translation: 「我会好好地领着你们，那些路又平又直。」

703624.oracleText:
"None have ever made to me a request so bold and yet so courteous."
—Galadriel
703624.translation:
「从没人向我提过如此大胆而又谦恭的要求。」
～加拉德瑞尔

703627.oracleText: On the Elf-lord's brow sat wisdom, and in his hand was strength.
703627.translation: 精灵领主眉宇间存有智慧，双手间握有力量。

703633.oracleText: Whenever you scry, choose one and Glorfindel, Dauntless Rescuer gets +1/+1 until end of turn. • Glorfindel must be blocked this turn if able. • Glorfindel can't be blocked by more than one creature each combat this turn.
703633.translation: 每当你占卜时，选择一项且无畏援骑格罗芬德尔得+1/+1直到回合结束。 •格罗芬德尔本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。 •本回合中，格罗芬德尔每次战斗不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

703635.oracleText:
"To Isengard with doom we come!
With doom we come, with doom we come!"
703635.translation:
「前往艾森加德，我们带着毁灭来！
我们带着毁灭来，我们带着毁灭来！」

703636.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the greatest toughness among creatures you control, then put any number of creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
703636.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控的生物中的最大防御力，然后将任意数量的生物牌从你手上放进战场。

703640.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets a creature you don't control, Legolas deals damage equal to its power to up to one target creature.
703640.translation: 每当你施放一个以不由你操控之生物为目标的咒语时，莱戈拉斯依本身力量对至多一个目标生物造成伤害。

703655.oracleText:
"That was the custom of the Elves of Lorien, to dwell in the trees. Therefore they were called Galadhrim, the Tree-people."
—Legolas
703655.translation:
「罗瑞恩精灵习惯住在树上。因此他们又被称为加拉兹民，也就是『树民』。」
～莱戈拉斯

703658.oracleText:
"For you in all the lands of the West there will ever be a welcome, dearest friend."
—Aragorn
703658.translation:
「西部全地都将永远欢迎你，最亲爱的朋友。」
～阿拉贡

703659.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Create a Food token.
703659.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。派出一个食品衍生物。

703661.oracleText: "My dear old Hobbit, you don't allow for the inquisitiveness of friends. I have known about the existence of the Ring for years."
703661.translation: 「我亲爱的老霍比特，你都没考虑到朋友的好奇心啊。我很多年前就已经知道魔戒的存在了。」

703662.oracleText: Whenever one or more Halflings you control attack a player, create a Food token.
703662.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个半身人攻击一位牌手时，派出一个食品衍生物。

703664.oracleText: Far and wide Shelob's lesser broods spread from glen to glen, to Dol Guldur and the fastnesses of Mirkwood.
703664.translation: 希洛布的后代散布得既远又广：从一处山谷到另一处山谷，再到多古尔都和黑森林的要塞。

703665.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target legendary creature you control gains deathtouch until end of turn.
703665.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由你操控的传奇生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

703668.oracleText:
"But still the sunken stars appear
In dark and windless Mirrormere;
There lies his crown in water deep,
Till Durin wakes again from sleep."
—Gimli's song
703668.translation:
「沉沦星辰今犹见，
静湖镜影幽底现；
都林冠冕匿水间，
唯待苏醒重赋衔。」
～吉姆利之歌

703671.oracleText:
"They won't harm you—not unless I tell 'em to. Here, Grip! Fang! Heel!"
—Farmer Maggot
703671.translation:
「它们不会伤害你的～除非我下令。过来，利爪！尖牙！停！」
～农夫马戈特

703672.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. It gains vigilance until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
703672.translation: 牺牲一个食品：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

703675.oracleText: "Sam! Get breakfast ready for half-past nine!"

703676.oracleText: If one or more tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus an additional Food token are created instead.
703676.translation: 如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出该些衍生物加上一个额外的食品衍生物。

703677.oracleText: Sacrifice three Foods: Draw a card.
703677.translation: 牺牲三个食品：抓一张牌。

703679.oracleText: Pippin stabbed upwards, and the written blade of Westernesse pierced through the hide and went deep into the vitals of the troll.
703679.translation: 皮平向上一刺，那把刻有铭文的西方之地利刃扎穿厚皮，直刺食人妖要害。

703680.oracleText: You may sacrifice a Food. If you do, target creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn. Otherwise, that creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
703680.translation: 你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则目标生物得+4/+4直到回合结束。若否，则该生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

703682.oracleText: "It is only a nickname, of course. They have called me that ever since I said yes to an elder Ent before he had finished his question."
703682.translation: 「当然，这只是个小名。自从我在一位年长的恩特还没问完问题就抢答『对』之后，他们就这么叫我了。」

703689.oracleText: In the Party Field, a beautiful young sapling leaped up: it was indeed a mallorn, and it was the wonder of the neighborhood.
703689.translation: 在集会场，一株美丽的小树苗破土而出：它真的是一棵瑁珑树，成了这一带的一道奇景。

703690.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. Create a Food token.
703690.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。派出一个食品衍生物。

703692.oracleText: The Ring tempts you. Then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X land cards, where X is the number of legendary creatures you control. Put those land cards onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
703692.translation: 魔戒引诱你。然后从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出X张地牌为止，X为由你操控的传奇生物数量。将这些地牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

703695.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
703695.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有由你操控的永久物离开战场，则在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

703697.oracleText:
"I wish there were more of your kin among us, Gimli. But even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them."
—Legolas
703697.translation:
「吉姆利，虽然我希望能有更多你的族人与我们并肩作战。但我现在更希望能有来自黑森林的一百名弓箭好手。我们需要他们。」
～莱戈拉斯

703698.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying. Scry 1.
703698.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。占卜1。

703700.oracleText: "Stew the rabbits?" squealed Gollum in dismay. "Spoil beautiful meat Smeagol saved for you, poor hungry Smeagol! What for?"
703700.translation: 「炖兔子？」咕噜错愕地尖叫道。「糟蹋斯密戈留给你们的好肉，可怜的斯密戈饿肚子！为什么？」

703701.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. Create a Food token.
703701.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。派出一个食品衍生物。

703703.oracleText: "Road is forgotten, but not by Wild Folk. Over hill and behind hill it lies still under grass and tree. Wild Folk will show you that road."
703703.translation: 「虽然众人忘记了路，但野人没忘。翻过山后，那路仍在山下，只是被草地跟树丛盖住了。野人会带你走那条路。」

703704.oracleText: {o6oG}, {oT}: Another target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.
703704.translation: {o6oG}，{oT}：直到回合结束，另一个目标生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。

703708.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more counters on Aragorn, put one of each of those kinds of counters on up to one other target creature.
703708.translation: 每当你在阿拉贡上放置一个或数个指示物时，选择至多另一个目标生物。将所放置的指示物每种各在该生物上放置一个。

703710.oracleText: Whenever you cast a white spell, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
703710.translation: 每当你施放白色咒语时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

703711.oracleText: Whenever you cast a blue spell, scry 2.
703711.translation: 每当你施放蓝色咒语时，占卜2。

703712.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red spell, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target opponent.
703712.translation: 每当你施放红色咒语时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成3点伤害。

703714.oracleText: Whenever you cast a green spell, target creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn.
703714.translation: 每当你施放绿色咒语时，目标生物得+4/+4直到回合结束。

703718.oracleText: {o1}, Remove an indestructible counter from Arwen: Another target creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter and a lifelink counter on that creature and a +1/+1 counter and a lifelink counter on Arwen.
703718.translation: {o1}，从阿尔玟上移去一个不灭指示物：另一个目标生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物和一个系命指示物，并在阿尔玟上放置一个+1/+1指示物和一个系命指示物。

703720.oracleText: She was called Undomiel, for she was the Evenstar of her people.
703720.translation: 她又被称为乌多米尔，因她是她族人的暮星。

703721.oracleText: Whenever you scry, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
703721.translation: 每当你占卜时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

703725.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each permanent sacrificed this turn.
703725.translation: 本回合中每牺牲过一个永久物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

703726.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked except by legendary creatures.

703728.oracleText: When The Balrog dies, destroy target artifact or creature an opponent controls.
703728.translation: 当炎魔死去时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或生物。

703730.oracleText: "I don't know half of you half as well as I should like; and I like less than half of you half as well as you deserve."
703730.translation: 「你们当中有一半人，我了解你们的程度还没有我了解喜欢人程度的一半；而你们当中少于一半人，我喜欢你们的程度也只有你们值得程度的一半。」

703731.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or leaves the battlefield, the Ring tempts you.
703731.translation: 当CARDNAME进入或离开战场时，魔戒引诱你。

703733.oracleText: Whenever Bilbo deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
703733.translation: 每当比尔博对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

703735.oracleText: "I hope you'll be comfortable. You'll be wanting supper, I don't doubt. As soon as may be. This way now!"
703735.translation: 「我希望你们住得舒服。你们一定想吃晚饭了吧。这就尽快送上。现请这边走！」

703736.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you don't control a Food, create a Food token.
703736.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你未操控食品，则派出一个食品衍生物。

703739.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
703739.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物在你的操控下死去，则派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

703740.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another creature: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
703740.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个生物：每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

703743.oracleText: Whenever you attack, scry 2, then you may reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, put it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. Until your next turn, it gains trample if you control a Dwarf and hexproof if you control an Elf.
703743.translation: 每当你攻击时，占卜2，然后你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。若它是生物牌，则将它横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。直到你的下一个回合，如果你操控矮人，则它获得践踏异能；如果你操控妖精，则它获得辟邪异能。

703745.oracleText: Whenever you scry, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to X target creatures, where X is the number of cards looked at while scrying this way.
703745.translation: 每当你占卜时，在至多X个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物，X为以此法占卜期间所检视的牌张数量。

703746.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw a card.
703746.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以抓一张牌。

703748.oracleText: "Am I not of the House of Eorl? I have waited on faltering feet long enough."
703748.translation: 「难道我不是埃奥尔家族的一员吗？我已经迟疑着等得足够久了。」

703751.translation: 伊希利恩亲王法拉米尔

703752.oracleText: The City was made more fair than it had ever been, even in the days of its first glory.
703752.translation: 白城增建得比它首度全盛时期还要美丽。

703753.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose an opponent. At the beginning of that player's next end step, you draw a card if they didn't attack you that turn. Otherwise, create three 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens.
703753.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，选择一位对手。在该牌手的下一个结束步骤开始时，如果其于该回合中未攻击你，则你抓一张牌。若否，则你派出三个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

703755.oracleText: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire, and the Balrog fell back.
703755.translation: 两剑交击发出脆响，迸出白焰，炎魔向后跌去。

703756.oracleText: Flame of Anor deals 5 damage to target creature.
703756.translation: 阿诺尔之火对目标生物造成5点伤害。

703757.oracleText:
Choose one. If you control a Wizard as you cast this spell, you may choose two instead. 
• Target player draws two cards. 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature.
703757.translation:
选择一项。如果你于施放此咒语时操控法术师，则改为你可以选择两项。 
•目标牌手抓两张牌。 
•消灭目标神器。 
•CARDNAME对目标生物造成5点伤害。

703758.oracleText:
Choose one. If you control a Wizard as you cast this spell, you may choose two instead. 
• Target player draws two cards. 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Flame of Anor deals 5 damage to target creature.
703758.translation:
选择一项。如果你于施放此咒语时操控法术师，则改为你可以选择两项。 
•目标牌手抓两张牌。 
•消灭目标神器。 
•阿诺尔之火对目标生物造成5点伤害。

703760.translation:
「四十二个，莱戈拉斯大人！」
～吉姆利

703761.oracleText: Target creature you control and up to one other target legendary creature you control each deal damage equal to their power to target creature you don't control.
703761.translation: 目标由你操控的生物与至多另一个目标由你操控的传奇生物各依其力量对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害。

703764.oracleText:
"Few have ever come hither through greater peril or on an errand more urgent."
—Elrond
703764.translation:
「来过这里的人当中，处境之艰险或任务之急迫更有甚于他的，寥寥无几。」
～埃尔隆德

703768.translation: 洛丝罗瑞恩的加拉德瑞尔

703769.oracleText: "I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel."
703769.translation: 「我通过了考验。我将衰微，前往西方，我仍是加拉德瑞尔。」

703770.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, if you chose a creature other than CARDNAME as your Ring-bearer, scry 3.
703770.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，若你选择CARDNAME以外之生物作你的持戒人，则占卜3。

703772.oracleText: Whenever you scry, you may reveal the top card of your library. If a land card is revealed this way, put it onto the battlefield tapped.
703772.translation: 每当你占卜时，你可以展示牌库顶牌。如果以此法展示出一张地牌，则将它横置放进战场。

703774.oracleText: You may tap or untap target permanent.
703774.translation: 你可以横置或重置目标永久物。

703776.oracleText: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
703776.translation: 复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

703777.oracleText: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
703777.translation: 复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

703779.oracleText: Put Gandalf on top of its owner's library.
703779.translation: 将甘道夫置于其拥有者的牌库顶。

703783.oracleText: There was a crack, and the staff split asunder in Saruman's hand, and the head of it fell down at Gandalf's feet.
703783.translation: 但听一声裂响，那根手杖在萨茹曼手中碎裂开来，杖头掉到了甘道夫脚前。

703784.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
703784.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中瞬间和法术牌的数量加总。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

703785.oracleText: Gandalf's Sanction deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
703785.translation: 甘道夫之罚对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中瞬间和法术牌的数量加总。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

703787.oracleText: CARDNAME has indestructible as long as two or more creatures died under your control this turn.
703787.translation: 只要本回合中有两个或更多生物在你的操控下死去，CARDNAME便具有不灭异能。

703789.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Gimli. When this ability resolves for the third time this turn, Gimli fights up to one target creature you don't control.
703789.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在吉姆利上放置一个+1/+1指示物。当此异能本回合中第三次结算时，吉姆利与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

703791.oracleText: There came Gwaihir the Windlord, greatest of all the Eagles of the North, mightiest of the descendants of old Thorondor.
703791.translation: 风王格怀希尔来了。他是北方大鹰中的最伟大者，老梭隆多最强大的后裔。

703792.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
703792.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

703793.oracleText: Other Birds you control have vigilance.
703793.translation: 由你操控的其他鸟具有警戒异能。

703795.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Spirit you control becomes the target of a spell, it phases out.
703795.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的精怪成为咒语的目标时，令它跃离。

703796.oracleText: Whenever King of the Oathbreakers or another Spirit you control becomes the target of a spell, it phases out.
703796.translation: 每当背誓者之王或另一个由你操控的精怪成为咒语的目标时，令它跃离。

703797.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Spirit you control phases in, create a tapped 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
703797.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的精怪跃回时，派出一个已横置的1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

703798.oracleText: Whenever King of the Oathbreakers or another Spirit you control phases in, create a tapped 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
703798.translation: 每当背誓者之王或另一个由你操控的精怪跃回时，派出一个已横置的1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

703800.oracleText: "Two?" said Legolas. "I make my tale twenty at the least."
703800.translation: 「两个？」莱戈拉斯说，「我最起码有二十个进账。」

703801.oracleText: Whenever you scry, if CARDNAME is tapped, you may untap it. Do this only once each turn.
703801.translation: 每当你占卜时，若CARDNAME已横置，则你可以将它重置。每回合只能如此作一次。

703803.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Legolas.
703803.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在莱戈拉斯上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

703805.oracleText:
"Whatever is wrong in the Shire, Lotho will be at the bottom of it: you can be sure of that."
—Pippin
703805.translation:
「不管夏尔出了什么事，罪魁祸首一定是洛索：这点你可以确定。」
～皮平

703806.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, you lose 1 life and create a Treasure token.
703806.translation: 每当任一牌手施放其每回合中第二个咒语时，你失去1点生命并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

703808.oracleText: "We are the servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand: the Hand that gives us Man's-flesh to eat."
703808.translation: 「我们是白手智者萨茹曼的仆人，这手给我们人肉吃。」

703809.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on an Army, Goblin, or Orc you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
703809.translation: 如果将在某个由你操控的军队，鬼怪或半兽人上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

703811.oracleText: Then suddenly Merry felt it at last, beyond doubt: a change. Wind was in his face!
703811.translation: 突然间，梅里终于感觉到了，毫无疑问：变化已至。风吹在他脸上！

703812.oracleText: CARDNAME has first strike as long as it's equipped.
703812.translation: 只要CARDNAME佩带武具，它便具有先攻异能。

703814.oracleText: Whenever you attack with Merry and another legendary creature, draw a card.
703814.translation: 每当你以梅里和另一个传奇生物攻击时，抓一张牌。

703819.oracleText: Old Man Willow's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
703819.translation: 柳树老头儿的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

703820.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or a token. When you do, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
703820.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个衍生物。当你如此作时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

703821.oracleText: Whenever Old Man Willow attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or a token. When you do, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
703821.translation: 每当柳树老头儿攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个衍生物。当你如此作时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

703823.oracleText: "Here I do swear fealty to Gondor, until my lord release me, or death take me."
703823.translation: 「自此刻起，我将效忠刚铎，直到我主解除我的义务，或死亡降临。谨誓。」

703824.oracleText: {oT}: Another target creature you control gains protection from the card type of your choice until end of turn.
703824.translation: {oT}：选择一种牌张类别。另一个目标由你操控的生物获得反该牌张类别保护异能直到回合结束。

703825.translation: 英俊的伊姆拉希尔亲王

703826.oracleText: "The Lord Aragorn I hold to be my liege lord, whether he claim it or no. His wish is to me a command."
703826.translation: 「无论阿拉贡大人宣称与否，我都视他为我的主君。他的期盼于我就是命令。」

703827.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
703827.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

703829.oracleText: Frodo was able to see beneath their black wrappings. In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes.
703829.translation: 弗罗多看得透包裹他们的黑衣。苍白脸庞上的残忍双眼明亮锐利。

703830.oracleText: The Ring tempts you. Search your library for a card that shares a color with a legendary creature you control, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
703830.translation: 魔戒引诱你。从你的牌库中搜寻一张与某个由你操控的传奇生物具共通颜色的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

703832.oracleText: In rode the Lord of the Nazgul, under the archway that no enemy ever yet had passed, and all fled before his face.
703832.translation: 那兹古尔之首逼上前来，立在那迄今从未有敌人穿过的拱道下，当者无不奔逃。

703836.oracleText: Sacrifice three Foods: Return target historic card from your graveyard to your hand.
703836.translation: 牺牲三个食品：将目标史迹牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

703838.oracleText: Ward—Discard an enchantment, instant, or sorcery card.
703838.translation: 守护～弃一张结界，瞬间或法术牌。

703839.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, each opponent mills two cards. When one or more cards are milled this way, exile target enchantment, instant, or sorcery card with equal or lesser mana value than that spell from an opponent's graveyard. Copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
703839.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，每位对手各磨两张牌。当以此法磨掉一张或数张牌时，将目标法术力值等于或小于该咒语的结界，瞬间或法术牌从对手的坟墓场中放逐。复制所放逐的牌。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

703841.oracleText: Ward—Sacrifice a legendary artifact or legendary creature.
703841.translation: 守护～牺牲一个传奇神器或传奇生物。

703842.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, amass Orcs 1.
703842.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，囤兵半兽人1。

703843.oracleText: Whenever an Army you control deals combat damage to a player, the Ring tempts you.
703843.translation: 每当一个由你操控的军队对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，魔戒引诱你。

703844.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw four cards.
703844.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，你可以弃掉你的手牌。若你如此作，则抓四张牌。

703846.oracleText: "He was dear to you, I see. And now he shall endure the slow torment of years."
703846.translation: 「我看得出来，他曾是对你很重要的人。现在他将受到长年累月的缓慢折磨。」

703847.oracleText: Choose an opponent. They look at the top four cards of your library and separate them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. The Ring tempts you.
703847.translation: 选择一位对手。该牌手检视你牌库顶的四张牌，并分成牌面朝下与牌面朝上各一堆。你将其中一堆置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。魔戒引诱你。

703849.oracleText:
"Whose shall the horn be? Who shall call them
from the grey twilight, the forgotten people?
The heir of him to whom the oath they swore."
—Malbeth the Seer
703849.translation:
「谁在鸣号？惨淡微光中
谁将被遗忘之人唤醒？
乃誓言所托者的后裔。」
～先知贝斯

703850.oracleText: Create two tapped 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
703850.translation: 派出两个已横置的1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

703852.translation: 由你操控的马具有敏捷异能。

703853.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may put a creature card with lesser power from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
703853.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以将一张力量比它小的生物牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。

703860.oracleText: Activated abilities of lands your opponents control can't be activated unless they're mana abilities.
703860.translation: 除了法术力异能之外，由对手操控之地的起动式异能都不能起动。

703861.oracleText: CARDNAME has all activated abilities of lands your opponents control except mana abilities.
703861.translation: CARDNAME具有由对手操控之地的所有起动式异能，但法术力异能除外。

703863.oracleText: Mana of any type can be spent to activate Sharkey's abilities.
703863.translation: 能用任意种类的法术力来起动沙基的异能。

703864.translation: 乌苟立安特后代希洛布

703866.oracleText: Other Spiders you control have deathtouch and ward {o2}.
703866.translation: 由你操控的其他蜘蛛具有死触与守护{o2}。

703869.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, the Ring tempts you.
703869.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物在你的操控下死去，则魔戒引诱你。

703870.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped under your control and the rest into their graveyard.
703870.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，目标对手从其牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止。将该牌在你的操控下横置放进战场，其余则置入其坟墓场。

703872.oracleText: The greatest traveler and huntsman of this age of the world.
703872.translation: 当今时代世上最伟大的旅者和猎人。

703875.oracleText: "Dark have been my dreams of late, but I feel new-awakened. I only fear that already you have come too late, Gandalf."
703875.translation: 「我最近的梦境总是一片黑暗，但我感觉自己像是大梦初醒。甘道夫，我只害怕你已经来得太迟了。」

703880.oracleText: As long as there are four or more lore counters among Sagas you control, CARDNAME has hexproof and indestructible.
703880.translation: 只要由你操控的传纪上总共有四个或更多学问指示物，CARDNAME便具有辟邪与不灭异能。

703881.oracleText: As long as there are four or more lore counters among Sagas you control, Tom Bombadil has hexproof and indestructible.
703881.translation: 只要由你操控的传纪上总共有四个或更多学问指示物，汤姆·邦巴迪尔便具有辟邪与不灭异能。

703882.oracleText: Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga you control resolves, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a Saga card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. This ability triggers only once each turn.
703882.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传纪之最终章节异能结算时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张传纪牌为止。将该牌放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

703884.oracleText: "I am Ugluk. I command. I return to Isengard by the shortest road."
703884.translation: 「我是乌格鲁克。我说了算。我回艾森加德，走最短的路。」

703888.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create two tapped 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying. If that creature is legendary, instead create two of those tokens that are tapped and attacking.
703888.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，派出两个已横置的1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。若该生物是传奇，则改为派出两个已横置且正进行攻击的上述衍生物。

703890.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, that creature loses all abilities until end of turn.
703890.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物阻挡生物或被生物阻挡时，后者失去所有异能直到回合结束。

703892.oracleText: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigor as it coursed upward, right to the tips of the hair.
703892.translation: 饮料的效果先从脚趾开始，缓慢攀升到四肢，一路带去焕新感觉与激情活力，直达发梢。

703893.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature with power X. Activate only as a sorcery.
703893.translation: {oX}，{oT}：在目标力量为X的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

703895.oracleText: Equipped creature has first strike and gets +1/+0 for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
703895.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有先攻异能，且你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，便得+1/+0。

703896.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to that damage without paying its mana cost.
703896.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于该伤害数量的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

703899.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Create X 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens, where X is the number of Humans you control.
703899.translation: {o3}，{oT}：派出X个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物，X为由你操控的人类数量。

703901.oracleText:
"He that blows this horn shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends."
—Eowyn
703901.translation:
「吹响这号角，就能使敌人丧胆，友人振奋。」
～伊奥温

703902.oracleText: Whenever two or more creatures you control attack a player, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
703902.translation: 每当由你操控的两个或更多生物攻击一位牌手时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

703904.oracleText:
"Keep it secret, and keep it safe!"
—Gandalf

703907.oracleText: They could eat of it and find new strength even as they ran.
703907.translation: 这种食物他们可以边跑边吃，重续体力。

703911.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, its owner shuffles it into their library.
703911.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，其拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

703914.oracleText: "Your Quest stands upon the edge of a knife. Stray but a little and it will fail, to the ruin of all. Yet hope remains while all the Company is true."
703914.translation: 「你们的任务正在刀尖边缘。稍有差池便会失败，全盘尽毁。但只要远征队精诚团结，就还有希望。」

703915.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Scry 1, then draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
703915.translation: {o5}，{oT}：占卜1，然后抓一张牌。你每操控一个传奇生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

703922.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life for each burden counter on CARDNAME.
703922.translation: 在你的维持开始时，CARDNAME上每有一个重负指示物，你便失去1点生命。

703923.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life for each burden counter on The One Ring.
703923.translation: 在你的维持开始时，至尊戒上每有一个重负指示物，你便失去1点生命。

703924.oracleText: {oT}: Put a burden counter on CARDNAME, then draw a card for each burden counter on CARDNAME.
703924.translation: {oT}：在CARDNAME上放置一个重负指示物，然后CARDNAME上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

703925.oracleText: {oT}: Put a burden counter on The One Ring, then draw a card for each burden counter on The One Ring.
703925.translation: {oT}：在至尊戒上放置一个重负指示物，然后至尊戒上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

703927.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an influence counter on CARDNAME and scry 2. Then target opponent may have you draw a card. If that player doesn't, you mill X cards, where X is the number of influence counters on CARDNAME, and that player loses life equal to the total mana value of those cards.
703927.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个感化指示物并占卜2。然后目标对手可以令你抓一张牌。若该牌手未如此作，则你磨X张牌，X为CARDNAME上之感化指示物数量，且该牌手失去等同于这些牌法术力值总和的生命。

703928.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an influence counter on Palantir of Orthanc and scry 2. Then target opponent may have you draw a card. If that player doesn't, you mill X cards, where X is the number of influence counters on Palantir of Orthanc, and that player loses life equal to the total mana value of those cards.
703928.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在欧尔桑克的帕蓝提尔上放置一个感化指示物并占卜2。然后目标对手可以令你抓一张牌。若该牌手未如此作，则你磨X张牌，X为欧尔桑克的帕蓝提尔上之感化指示物数量，且该牌手失去等同于这些牌法术力值总和的生命。

703930.oracleText: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out."
703930.translation: 「愿黑暗中众光熄灭时,它能成为你的明光。」

703931.oracleText: If you would draw a card while you have no cards in hand, draw two cards instead.
703931.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌时手上没有牌，则改为抓两张牌。

703932.oracleText: If you would gain life while you have 5 or less life, you gain twice that much life instead.
703932.translation: 如果你将获得生命时你的总生命为5或更少，则改为你获得该数量两倍的生命。

703934.translation:
「你这花园真是美不胜收！」
～甘道夫

703936.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, untap equipped creature.
703936.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，重置佩带此武具的生物。

703937.oracleText: Equipped creature has first strike as long as it's blocking or blocked by a Goblin or Orc.
703937.translation: 只要佩带此武具的生物正阻挡鬼怪或半兽人或正被后者阻挡，它便具有先攻异能。

703939.oracleText:
"At the Stone of Erech they shall stand again
and hear there a horn in the hills ringing."
—Malbeth the Seer
703939.translation:
「在埃瑞赫的黑石，他们将再起身
听见山陵中吹角回鸣。」
～先知瑁贝斯

703940.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile target player's graveyard. Draw a card.
703940.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。抓一张牌。

703941.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Stone of Erech: Exile target player's graveyard. Draw a card.
703941.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲埃瑞赫的黑石：放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。抓一张牌。

703944.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add X mana in any combination of colors.
703944.translation: {oX}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：加X点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

703948.oracleText:
"Those who pass the gates of Barad-dur do not return."
—Gandalf
703948.translation:
「那些进入巴拉督尔大门的，都一去不返。」
～甘道夫

703951.oracleText: {oXoXoB}, {oT}: Amass Orcs X. Activate only if a creature died this turn.
703951.translation: {oXoXoB}，{oT}：囤兵半兽人X。只能于有生物死去的回合中起动。

703953.oracleText:
"Renewed shall be blade that was broken:
The crownless again shall be king."
—Bilbo
703953.translation:
「青锋断刃将重铸，无冕者再临为王。」
～比尔博

703954.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast legendary spells.
703954.translation: {o1}，{oT}：加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放传奇咒语。

703956.oracleText: There dwelt Cirdan the Shipwright, and some say he dwells there still, until the Last Ship sets sail into the West.
703956.translation: 这正是造船者奇尔丹的居所，有人说他仍住在那里，直到「最后航船」扬帆驶向西方。

703958.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color among legendary creature cards in your graveyard.
703958.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其颜色为你坟墓场中传奇生物牌所具有的任一颜色。

703960.oracleText:
"I would see the White Tree in flower again in the courts of the kings, and Minas Tirith in peace."
—Faramir
703960.translation:
「我愿看见白树在诸王庭院中繁花重欣，米那斯提力斯安享和平。」
～法拉米尔

703962.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if you attacked with two or more creatures this turn.
703962.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：抓一张牌。只能于你以两个或更多生物攻击的回合中起动。

703964.oracleText:
"Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!"
—Gloin
703964.translation:
「墨瑞亚！墨瑞亚！北方世界的奇迹！」
～格罗因

703966.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}, Exile three cards from your graveyard: Create two Treasure tokens.
703966.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：派出两个珍宝衍生物。

703969.oracleText: {o1oBoR}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.

703970.oracleText: {o1oBoR}, {oT}: Mount Doom deals 1 damage to each opponent.
703970.translation: {o1oBoR}，{oT}：末日山向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

703971.oracleText: {o5oBoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME and a legendary artifact: Choose up to two creatures, then destroy the rest. Activate only as a sorcery.
703971.translation: {o5oBoR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME和一个传奇神器：选择至多两个生物，然后消灭其他生物。只能于法术时机起动。

703972.oracleText: {o5oBoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice Mount Doom and a legendary artifact: Choose up to two creatures, then destroy the rest. Activate only as a sorcery.
703972.translation: {o5oBoR}，{oT}，牺牲末日山和一个传奇神器：选择至多两个生物，然后消灭其他生物。只能于法术时机起动。

703974.oracleText:
"Were I to go where my heart dwells, I would now be wandering in the fair valley of Rivendell."
—Aragorn
703974.translation:
「假如能前往一心牵挂之地，那我现在就会倘祥在幽谷美丽山峡间。」
～阿拉贡

703976.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Scry 2. Activate only if you control a legendary creature.
703976.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：占卜2。只能于你操控传奇生物时起动。

703978.oracleText:
"You must start somewhere and have some roots, and the soil of the Shire is deep."
—Merry
703978.translation:
「你必须有个起步的地方，扎下些根，而夏尔的土壤是很深的。」
～梅里

703980.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Tap an untapped creature you control: Create a Food token.
703980.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物：派出一个食品衍生物。

703982.oracleText: Everything looked fresh, and the new green of Spring was shimmering in the fields.
703982.translation: 一切都显得清新，田野间无不闪烁着春天的新绿。

703983.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
703983.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

703990.translation: 指定一个非地史迹永久物为目标。

703993.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls.
703993.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。

703995.oracleText: Target a creature that blocked or was blocked by a legendary creature this turn.
703995.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，且须为本回合中曾阻挡传奇生物或被传奇生物阻挡者。

703996.translation: 指定一个由你操控的马为目标。

703999.translation: 指定两个其他传奇生物为目标。
