748526.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物：抓一张牌。如果所牺牲的生物已遭疑，则改为抓两张牌。

748530.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, target opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
748530.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，目标对手失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

748535.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
748535.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

748537.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, target opponent loses that much life.
748537.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，目标对手失去等量的生命。

748541.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you gain 1 life and surveil 1.
748541.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你获得1点生命且刺探1。

748546.oracleText: To solve — You control no suspected Skeletons.
748546.translation: 侦办～你未操控已遭疑的骷髅妖。

748547.oracleText: Solved — {o1oB}, Sacrifice this Case: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
748547.translation: 侦结～{o1oB}，牺牲此案件：从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

748549.oracleText:
"Never rely on secondhand description. Always review the memory yourself."
—Lazav
748549.translation:
「永远不要觉得二手转述靠得住。每次都要亲自检查记忆内容。」
～拉札夫

748550.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target opponent discards two cards. 
• Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
748550.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标对手弃两张牌。 
•目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

748552.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. If evidence was collected, exile a card from an opponent's graveyard. Then search its owner's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with that name and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
748552.translation: 消灭所有生物。如果已搜证，则从对手的坟墓场中放逐一张牌。然后从其拥有者的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每以此法从其手上放逐一张牌，其便抓一张牌。

748556.oracleText:
"Four Dead in Zombie Leech Attack, Dozens Nauseated"
—Tenth District Times headline
748556.translation:
「腐蛭肆虐，四人遇难，多人呕吐」
～《第十区时报》头条

748557.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you mill two cards.
748557.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你磨两张牌。

748559.oracleText: {o1oB}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
748559.translation: {o1oB}：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

748562.oracleText: In her line of work, the dead are often better sources than the living.
748562.translation: 侦查能力：无可挑剔。沟通能力：严重不足。

748563.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, investigate. This ability triggers only once each turn.
748563.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，探查。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

748568.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, each opponent loses 3 life.
748568.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，每位对手各失去3点生命。

748574.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with an impostor counter on it dies, exile it. Return up to one other target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
748574.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有冒名指示物的生物死去时，将它放逐。将至多另一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

748576.oracleText: Etrata had committed dozens of murders, all of which she recalled in perfect, loving detail. But no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't remember killing Zegana.
748576.translation: 艾庄塔干过十多票谋杀，每次细节她都能记得清清楚楚。但就是洁加娜这桩案子，她无论怎样试着回想，都没有印象自己动过手。

748577.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Suspect it.
748577.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。怀疑它。

748579.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
748579.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

748582.oracleText: "Ooh, this one does look nasty. Maybe they'll send Proft!"
748582.translation: 「哦哦，这桩案子太恶劣了。或许他们会派波费来！」

748586.oracleText: As the days grew longer, so did the list of missing persons.
748586.translation: 随着日子一天天过去，失踪人员的名字也在一个个增加。

748588.oracleText:
"Eyewitness testimony, coming right up! Just let me finish regenerating their eyes."
—Nelo, Agency coroner
748588.translation:
「下一个就轮到目击证人出庭作证了！让我先把他的眼睛重生出来。」
～魔调局验尸官涅洛

748589.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if a creature card was put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn.
748589.translation: 如果本回合中有生物牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

748591.oracleText: "‘Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."
748591.translation: 「『这是我干的吗？』你得具体说是哪件事。」

748592.translation: 由你操控的生物具有干枯异能。

748593.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, if its toughness was less than 1, draw a card.
748593.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，若其防御力小于1，则你抓一张牌。

748594.oracleText: Laughter and conversation trailed off as the revelers gathered around Zegana's body. Three things quickly became clear: it was a murder, the killer was likely among them, and Teysa's party was definitely over.
748594.translation: 随着狂欢人群聚拢在洁加娜遗体周围，欢声笑语逐渐止歇。大家很快就弄清楚了三件事：这是桩谋杀案；凶手就在众人之间；泰莎的派对当真结束了。

748599.oracleText:
"When you can't erase your own trail, leave as many false ones as possible."
—Etrata
748599.translation:
「如果你抹不掉自己的踪迹，那就尽可能多留一些假的痕迹。」
～艾庄塔

748600.oracleText: Target opponent exiles the top X cards of their library face down. You may look at and play those cards for as long as they remain exiled. If you cast a spell this way, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any type to cast it.
748600.translation: 目标对手牌面朝下地放逐其牌库顶的X张牌。于这些牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视并使用它们。如果你以此法施放咒语，则你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来施放。

748604.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Clue, target opponent gets two poison counters.
748604.translation: 每当你牺牲一个线索时，目标对手得到两个中毒指示物。

748608.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Collect evidence 3: Each opponent loses 3 life unless they discard a card or sacrifice a creature.
748608.translation: {o2}, {oT}，搜证3：对每位对手而言，除非其弃一张牌或牺牲一个生物，否则失去3点生命。

748610.oracleText: "Corpses are pulled from the undercity canals every day. They'll assume one's mine."
748610.translation: 「地底城运河里每天都会捞起新尸体。他们会把其中某具当成我的。」

748611.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and suspect it.
748611.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场并怀疑它。

748612.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and suspect it."
748612.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场并怀疑它。」

748614.oracleText: "Blasted sketch artist did too good a job. Looks like it's time for me to lie low for a little while."
748614.translation: 「这该死的素描画师画得也太像。我得低调一小段时间了。」

748615.oracleText: {o2oB}: If CARDNAME is suspected, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Otherwise, suspect it.
748615.translation: {o2oB}：如果CARDNAME已遭疑，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则怀疑它。

748618.oracleText: Every week, the necropsy lab's unclaimed bodies are transferred to the Golgari for "recycling."
748618.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，直到回合结束，腐尸农场杀生虫得+1/+0且获得威慑与系命异能。

748619.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains menace and lifelink until end of turn.
748619.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得威慑与系命异能。

748622.oracleText:
"Proft has been poking his nose where it doesn't belong. I want him out of the way."
—Judith, to Massacre Girl
748622.translation:
「波费最近的手伸得有些长。我想让他少管闲事。」
～裘蒂丝叮嘱杀戮女郎

748624.oracleText:
"Isn't it gorgeous? It's my most efficient corpse eliminator! One head bites while the other chews."
—Glogus, Golgari leechbreeder
748624.translation:
「厉害吧？它是我最高效的毁尸怪！一个脑袋咬，一个脑袋嚼。」
～葛加理育蛭人格噶斯

748625.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control with power 2 or less gets +1/+0 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
748625.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物得+1/+0且获得死触异能。

748627.oracleText:
"I'd offer your dog a treat, but I'm afraid I don't have any appendages to spare."
—Alquist Proft, to Judith
748627.translation:
「我真的很想喂喂你的狗，但可惜我没带多余的器官。」
～阿奎斯波费告诉裘蒂丝

748630.oracleText: Judith's plan was close to fruition. She couldn't have Agrus get in the way.
748630.translation: 裘蒂丝的计划就快大功告成。这时可不能让阿固寇斯坏了好事。

748633.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
748633.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

748635.oracleText: "Poison this deadly is only used by the Ochran. Either the Golgari are behind this, or someone wants us to think they are."
748635.translation: 「只有瓯坎的人才会用上这般猛烈的毒药。要么这就是葛加理干的，要么是有人想让我们以为是他们干的。」

748636.oracleText: Target creature gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. Investigate.
748636.translation: 目标生物获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。探查。

748638.oracleText: With their guild shunned for opening the doors to Phyrexia, some among the Golgari embraced their status as pariahs and took out their bitterness on all who crossed their paths.
748638.translation: 葛加理由于当初向非瑞克西亚打开门户，现在公会声望每况日下；其间部分成员也接受了最底层的身份，将一切苦楚都宣泄在不小心碰到的路人身上。

748643.oracleText: Obtaining evidence through the "proper" channels can take weeks of paperwork. Sometimes justice just can't wait.
748643.translation: 通过「正规」渠道取得证据得花上数周时间来走书面流程。有时正义等不了这么久。

748646.oracleText: "I'm afraid your investigation has reached a dead end."
748646.translation: 「恐怕你的调查已经走到了死路。」

748648.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies, target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
748648.translation: 每当一个生物死去时，目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

748650.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts you don't control, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of artifacts that were put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn. You may put a creature card exiled this way onto the battlefield. It gains haste. Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
748650.translation: 消灭所有不由你操控的神器，然后放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为本回合中从战场进入坟墓场的神器数量。你可以将以此法放逐的一张生物牌放进战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

748652.oracleText: Determining the culprit was not difficult. Getting him to stop committing the crime long enough to be arrested, however, was a massive challenge.
748652.translation: 找到犯事的人并不难。拖住让他不再轻举妄动乃至最终逮捕他，才是真正难的部分。

748656.oracleText: To solve — Three or more sources you controlled dealt damage this turn.
748656.translation: 侦办～本回合中有三个或更多由你操控的来源造成过伤害。

748657.oracleText: Solved — Sacrifice this Case: Exile the top three cards of your library. Choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
748657.translation: 侦结～牺牲此案件：放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。选择其中一张。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

748660.oracleText: To solve — You have no cards in hand.

748661.oracleText: Solved — At the beginning of your upkeep, discard your hand, then draw two cards.
748661.translation: 侦结～在你的维持开始时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓两张牌。

748663.oracleText: "Wait, stop! I've been framed! Extremely convincingly!"
748663.translation: 「等等，住手！我是被冤枉的！千真万确！」

748664.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Suspect it.
748664.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。怀疑它。

748666.oracleText: Etrata evaded the Boros arresters and Azorius lawmages, but not even a master assassin could give Kaya the slip.
748666.translation: 虽然艾庄塔逃过了波洛斯逮捕人，躲过了俄佐立律法师，但这位专业杀手也没能从卡娅手中溜走。

748667.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Investigate.
748667.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+0且获得先攻异能。探查。

748670.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, attach it to target creature you control.
748670.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

748673.oracleText: "How could I have missed it? The answer was right in front of me all along!"
748673.translation: 「我怎么就没看见呢？原来答案一直就近在眼前！」

748674.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, exile the top card of your library face down.
748674.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。

748675.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put all cards exiled with CARDNAME into their owners' hands.
748675.translation: {o1oR}，弃掉你的手牌，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌置于其拥有者手上。

748683.oracleText: Monax knew attacking the detective was a reckless move, but he was at the end of his rope.
748683.translation: 莫纳兹知道向侦探动手是鲁莽之举，但他绳子已经放到头了。

748688.oracleText: "But then he peeled off the mask, revealing a sight that made Groja's blood run cold—Brulu was actually Vogos in disguise!"
748688.translation: 「但之后他揭下了面具，眼前的一切顿时令格罗杰大惊失色～原来布露鲁一直都是沃戈斯假扮的！」

748689.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and add {oR}.
748689.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物并加{oR}。

748692.oracleText: After the attempt on Aurelia's life, she gave the Agency an ultimatum: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.
748692.translation: 欧瑞梨遭袭险丢性命后，她向魔调局发出最后通牒：二十四小时之内破不了案的话，波洛斯教团就会向拉铎司宗派宣战。

748693.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or discard a card.
748693.translation: 牺牲一个神器或弃一张牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

748695.translation: 天文数字的财富阻碍了平稳交接的过程。

748696.oracleText: Whenever a creature is dealt damage, its controller may exile that many cards from the top of their library. They may play those cards until the end of their next turn.
748696.translation: 每当一个生物受到伤害时，其操控者可以从其牌库顶放逐等量的牌。直到该牌手下一个回合的回合结束，其可以使用这些牌。

748698.oracleText: Turn target face-down creature face up.
748698.translation: 将目标牌面朝下的生物翻回正面。

748699.oracleText: Exile any number of face-up creatures you control with disguise in a face-down pile, shuffle that pile, then cloak them.
748699.translation: 放逐任意数量由你操控、具伪装异能且牌面朝上的生物并放作牌面朝下的一堆，将该堆洗牌，然后匿伏这些牌。

748700.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Turn target face-down creature face up. 
• Exile any number of face-up creatures you control with disguise in a face-down pile, shuffle that pile, then cloak them.
748700.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•将目标牌面朝下的生物翻回正面。 
•放逐任意数量由你操控、具伪装异能且牌面朝上的生物并放作牌面朝下的一堆，将该堆洗牌，然后匿伏这些牌。

748702.oracleText: It's hard to keep the peace if you can't even control your temper.
748702.translation: 如果连让自己和气都作不到，维护和平就更难了。

748703.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. When that creature dies this turn, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
748703.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得敏捷异能。本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

748709.oracleText: Disguise {o5oR}. This cost is reduced by {o1} for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
748709.translation: 伪装{o5oR}。你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，此费用便减少{o1}。

748710.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
748710.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

748713.oracleText: "Why doesn't Kylox put an off switch on these things?!"
748713.translation: 「奇洛兹为什么没在这些东西上装个开关？！」

748714.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. If you've drawn two or more cards this turn, CARDNAME deals 5 damage to that creature instead.
748714.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过两张或更多牌，则改为CARDNAME对该生物造成5点伤害。

748715.oracleText: Galvanize deals 3 damage to target creature. If you've drawn two or more cards this turn, Galvanize deals 5 damage to that creature instead.
748715.translation: 电流光闪对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过两张或更多牌，则改为电流光闪对该生物造成5点伤害。

748717.oracleText:
"In her defense, thopters are very fun to smash."
—Udol of the Foundway Associates
748717.translation:
「用她的话来说，这是因为扑翼机砸起来很有趣。」
～寻路侦探社的乌楚姆

748718.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact.
748718.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器。

748719.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact.
748719.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器。

748720.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
748720.translation: 牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

748726.oracleText: "When you can't show your own face, try one of mine!"
748726.translation: 「如果你露不了自己的脸，不妨来试试我的脸！」

748727.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, face-down spells you cast this turn cost {o1} less to cast.
748727.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你本回合中施放之牌面朝下的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

748730.oracleText: After the eleventh consecutive thopter failed to return from Gruul territory, she developed a disposable model.
748730.translation: 在向古鲁地界连续放飞十一个振翼机都有去无回之后，她开发出了用后即丢的型号。

748731.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying. It gains haste until end of turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
748731.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

748733.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may collect evidence X. When you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature and planeswalker that player controls.
748733.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以搜证X。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对由该牌手操控的每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成X点伤害。

748736.oracleText: "Whoops, this isn't my street! Don't mind me! I'll just be on my way while you enjoy your . . . very sharp knives."
748736.translation: 「哎呀，我想回我自己街上但走错路了！不用管我！我马上就走，你们慢慢忙…磨你的刀。」

748737.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt 3 or more damage, investigate.
748737.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到3点或更多伤害时，探查。

748743.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Goblin you control.
748743.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器：在每个由你操控的鬼怪上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748744.oracleText: Whenever an artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {oR}. If you do, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. It gains haste until end of turn.
748744.translation: 每当一个神器从战场进入坟墓场时，你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

748750.oracleText: The only warning was the faint smell of burning plasma.
748750.translation: 淡淡的电浆焦味是唯一警告。

748754.oracleText:
"In a city this big, anyone can blend in."
—Imel of the Foundway Associates
748754.translation:
「城市这么大，谁都可以混进去。」
～寻路侦探社的凌罗梅因

748759.oracleText: "Maybe they're following someone else," Alvis thought to himself, despite mounting evidence to the contrary.
748759.translation: 「也许他们跟踪的是别人，」阿维斯内心自语道。但有越来越多的证据表明并非如此。

748766.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control is turned face up, that creature deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
748766.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物翻回正面时，该生物向每位对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

748770.oracleText: He's gonna crack this thing wide open.
748770.translation: 他大动干戈想要砸破一切。

748771.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw a card and CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
748771.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个神器或弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌且CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

748775.oracleText:
"Thopters are but one option in our suite of autonomous surveillance solutions."
—Kylox
748775.translation:
「我们有许多自动化布控方案，扑翼机不过是其中一种。」
～奇洛兹

748779.oracleText: "I did it! Double—no, triple homicide! In a building I set on fire. Yep, all me."
748779.translation: 「我干的！两条～不，三条人命！就在我点着的那栋楼里。全是我干的。」

748780.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if it's not suspected, you may suspect it.
748780.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若它未遭疑，则你可以怀疑它。

748782.oracleText: She realized that she could not, in fact, handle the truth.
748782.translation: 实际上，她刚发现自己承受不了这现实。

748784.oracleText:
"Clearly someone wanted us to find this."
—Runubi of the Foundway Associates
748784.translation:
「显然有人希望我们留意到这个。」
～寻路侦探社的尔努库伐

748785.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
748785.translation: 如果你本回合中牺牲过神器，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

748786.oracleText: Suspicious Detonation deals 4 damage to target creature.
748786.translation: 可疑爆炸对目标生物造成4点伤害。

748788.oracleText: "I won't waste my time hunting down petty thieves while my brother's killer still walks free."
748788.translation: 「杀害我兄弟的凶手尚未伏法，我绝不会浪费时间去管什么小偷小摸。」

748789.oracleText: Whenever an opponent sacrifices an artifact, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to them.
748789.translation: 每当任一对手牺牲一个神器时，CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

748792.oracleText: "Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like . . . a lot more?"
748792.translation: 「谁能再帮我多拿点证据标牌来吗？大概要…很多个？」

748794.oracleText: {o3oG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
748794.translation: {o3oG}，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

748799.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and can't become suspected.
748799.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且不能成为遭疑。

748801.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may collect evidence 8.
748801.translation: 你可以搜证8，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

748802.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card. If evidence was collected, instead search your library for a creature or land card. Reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
748802.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌。如果已搜证，则改为从你牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌。展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748804.oracleText: Search your library for a creature or land card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land card. Otherwise, put it into your hand. Then shuffle.
748804.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌并展示之。如果它是地牌，则将它横置放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。然后洗牌。

748805.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
748805.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

748806.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Search your library for a creature or land card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land card. Otherwise, put it into your hand. Then shuffle. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. 
• Exile target artifact or enchantment.
748806.translation:
选择一项～ 
•从你牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌并展示之。如果它是地牌，则将它横置放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。然后洗牌。 
•在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。 
•放逐目标神器或结界。

748808.oracleText: Trostani was as regal and vibrant as ever, but Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off, some discordant note lurking deep within the chorus.
748808.translation: 卓塔妮依然威风堂堂、活跃如昔，但卡娅总感觉有哪里不对劲：表面和声韵集之下，仿佛有一些异声音符在鼓动。

748809.oracleText: Create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then draw cards equal to the number of differently named creature tokens you control.
748809.translation: 派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物，然后抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控之衍生生物中名称不同者的种数。

748813.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may collect evidence 6. This spell costs {o2} less to cast if evidence was collected.
748813.translation: 你可以搜证6，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。如果已搜证，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

748814.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
748814.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

748816.oracleText: To solve — You control seven or more lands.
748816.translation: 侦办～你操控七个或更多地。

748817.oracleText: Solved — You may look at the top card of your library any time, and you may play lands and cast creature and enchantment spells from the top of your library.
748817.translation: 侦结～你可以随时检视你的牌库顶牌，且你可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放生物与结界咒语。

748820.oracleText: To solve — Creatures you control have total power 8 or greater.
748820.translation: 侦办～由你操控之生物的力量总和等于或大于8。

748821.oracleText: Solved — Whenever you attack, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature. It gains trample until end of turn.
748821.translation: 侦结～每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

748823.oracleText:
"In your search for a suspect, never forget that the most important person is the victim."
—Ezrim, Agency chief
748823.translation:
「在追寻嫌犯时，绝对不要忘记受害人才是最重要的。」
～魔调局局长伊泽霖

748824.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token, then investigate.
748824.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物，然后探查。

748826.oracleText: The bite at the end of the tunnel.
748826.translation: 历经隧道险，苦尽血口来。

748831.oracleText: "What is this? An ambush or a staring contest?" Kaya taunted. As if in answer, the robed figure lunged forward.
748831.translation: 「现在是干吗？你是要动手还只是盯着看？」卡娅讥讽道。斗篷覆体的身影猛然挥击，算是给出了回应。

748833.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each Forest you control.
748833.translation: 你每操控一个树林，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

748835.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, search your library for up to two Forest cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
748835.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张树林牌并展示之。将其中一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748838.oracleText: "Apologies for using you like a stepladder. On the other hand, thank you, you're a wonderful stepladder!"
748838.translation: 「抱歉把你当成梯子一样到处踩。话说回来，也还得谢谢你，你当梯子真不赖！」

748839.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+1 for each creature you control and gains reach.
748839.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得延势异能，且你每操控一个生物，它便得+1/+1。

748841.oracleText: The spider just loved how the gems twinkled, and the high-class prey they attracted.
748841.translation: 这蜘蛛喜欢宝石闪闪发光的样子，以及宝石吸引来的高雅猎物。

748847.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
748847.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

748850.oracleText:
"Keen eyes and an analytical mind are some of a detective's most important tools. As is a mean left hook."
—Senior Inspector Holjo
748850.translation:
「敏锐目光跟灵活大脑是侦探不可或缺的重要工具。强劲勾拳也是其中之一。」
～资深巡检员何勒乔

748854.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}, Collect evidence 4: Target land you control becomes a 5/5 green Plant Boar creature with haste for as long as CARDNAME remains tapped. It's still a land. Activate only as a sorcery.
748854.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}，搜证4：于CARDNAME持续横置的时段内，目标由你操控的地成为5/5绿色，具敏捷异能的植物／野猪生物。它仍然是地。只能于法术时机起动。

748857.oracleText: The trees look beautiful . . . until they look back.
748857.translation: 这树很好看…直到它们看回来。

748858.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library, cloak two of them, and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
748858.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌，匿伏其中两张，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

748862.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME, Reveal the creature type you chose: If target attacking creature token is the chosen type, put three +1/+1 counters on it and it gains deathtouch until end of turn.
748862.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME，展示所选生物类别：如果目标进行攻击的衍生生物为该类别，则在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物且其获得死触异能直到回合结束。

748868.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
748868.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

748872.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, search your library for a land card with a basic land type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
748872.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻一张具基本地类别的地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748875.oracleText: A reliable, general-purpose toxin is a handy way to save on belt space.
748875.translation: 选用效果可靠、泛用性强的毒药能够有效节省腰带空间。

748882.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures that don't have a name.
748882.translation: CARDNAME不能被没有名称的生物阻挡。

748886.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the total toughness of creatures you control.
748886.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为由你操控之生物的防御力总和。

748887.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its toughness.
748887.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓等同于其防御力的牌。

748888.oracleText: {o2oUoU}: Until end of turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0, gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its toughness," and can attack as though it didn't have defender.
748888.translation: {o2oUoU}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0，获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓等同于其防御力的牌」，且能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

748889.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+2, has reach, and can't be blocked by more than one creature.
748889.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+2，具有延势异能，且不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

748897.oracleText: "Whatever broke out of here is at least half bear . . . and I'd say some lizard as well."
748897.translation: 「从这里逃出的有一半是熊…而且我看还有一部分是蜥蜴。」

748898.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may collect evidence 3. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
748898.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以搜证3。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748904.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green Ooze creature token with trample. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is two plus the total number of cards you own in exile and in your graveyard that are Oozes or are named Slime Against Humanity.
748904.translation: 派出一个0/0绿色，具践踏异能的流浆衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为放逐区和你坟墓场中由你拥有且为流浆或名称为反人淤泥者之牌的数量加二。

748905.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Slime Against Humanity.
748905.translation: 名称为反人淤泥的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

748907.oracleText:
"Running doesn't prove guilt, but innocent people don't typically flee into the North Ridge Forest."
—Alst of the Foundway Associates
748907.translation:
「虽说并非只有罪犯才会逃跑，但一般无辜的人逃命不会躲进北脊林里。」
～寻路侦探社的阿莱斯特

748908.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Investigate.
748908.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。探查。

748911.oracleText: The gardens around Karlov Manor are oddly bereft of birdsong.
748911.translation: 奇怪的是，卡洛夫庄园周围的花圃内都听不见鸟鸣。

748914.oracleText: "When your perp goes underground, I know where to find 'em."
748914.translation: 「如果你要抓的人往地底逃了的话，我知道能在哪里找到他。」

748915.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a face-down creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
748915.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌面朝下的生物在你操控下进战场，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748918.oracleText:
"I want eyes on the scene of the crime, day and night. I have a feeling our killer won't be able to resist coming back."
—Thare of the Foundway Associates
748918.translation:
「我要有人日夜盯着这犯罪现场。我感觉凶手会忍不住再回来看看。」
～寻路侦探社的特伐

748919.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
748919.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将目标地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

748921.oracleText: Seeking intact evidence in the Rubblebelt is a fool's errand.
748921.translation: 要在瓦砾区找到完好无损的证据，简直就是异想天开。

748928.oracleText: "Eventually I'll give retirement another shot. But not today."
748928.translation: 「有朝一日我会再考虑是否要退休。不过不是今天。」

748933.oracleText: {oXoWoUoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Clue: You draw X cards and gain X life.
748933.translation: {oXoWoUoU}，{oT}，牺牲一个线索：你抓X张牌且获得X点生命。

748936.oracleText: His claws tear at the foundations of civilization.
748936.translation: 他的利爪撕扯文明根基。

748939.oracleText: {o3oRoRoGoG}: Anzrag must be blocked each combat this turn if able.
748939.translation: {o3oRoRoGoG}：本回合中，安札格每次战斗若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

748940.oracleText:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates
748940.translation:
「不是随随便便哪个花匠都能种好这么大棵的月下美人。得有特定设施的屋顶暖房才能办到。」
～寻路侦探社的妮乌

748942.oracleText: Whenever a player attacks with three or more creatures, you draw a card.
748942.translation: 每当任一牌手以三个或更多生物攻击时，你抓一张牌。

748943.oracleText: Whenever a player attacks with five or more creatures, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each of your opponents and you gain 3 life.
748943.translation: 每当任一牌手以五个或更多生物攻击时，CARDNAME向你的每位对手各造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

748947.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures die, mill a card and put a bloodstain counter on CARDNAME. Then sacrifice it if it has five or more bloodstain counters on it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
748947.translation: 每当一个或数个生物死去时，磨一张牌并在CARDNAME上放置一个血迹指示物。然后如果其上有五个或更多血迹指示物，则牺牲它。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

748953.oracleText:
"People are being brainwashed into these attacks. We must find the puppet master."
—Alquist Proft
748953.translation:
「民众是被人鼓动了才这样四处攻击。我们必须把幕后黑手找出来。」
～阿奎斯波费

748954.oracleText: Enchanted creature has base power and toughness 1/1, has deathtouch, and is an Assassin in addition to its other types.
748954.translation: 所结附之生物的基础力量与防御力为1/1，具有死触异能，且额外具有杀手此类别。

748961.oracleText:
"When you said I could learn a lot from a corpse, I have to admit I wasn't expecting it to lecture me on forensic procedure."
—Kellan, to Ezrim
748961.translation:
「我必须说，当你告诉我尸体能教会我很多的时候，我绝没想过是尸体亲自来跟我讲法证规程。」
～凯澜告诉伊泽霖

748965.oracleText: Teysa's security was unrivaled. Etrata was locked up. Kaya was left with nothing but multiplying questions . . . and a dead friend.
748965.translation: 泰莎的警卫都是万里挑一。惯犯艾庄塔也已羁押在案。现在摆在卡娅面前的就只剩无尽的问题…和朋友的遗体。

748966.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target suspected creature you control. You may have it become no longer suspected.
748966.translation: 在目标由你操控且已遭疑的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。你可以使其不再遭疑。

748967.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Destroy target creature. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target suspected creature you control. You may have it become no longer suspected.
748967.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•消灭目标生物。 
•在目标由你操控且已遭疑的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。你可以使其不再遭疑。

748969.oracleText: It's a crime lab in a bag.
748969.translation: 打包带走的犯罪实验室。

748971.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying. Activate only if you've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
748971.translation: {oT}：派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。只能于你牺牲过神器的回合中起动。

748974.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, create two tapped 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
748974.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，派出两个已横置之1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

748977.oracleText:
"Suspect spotted at the Tin Street Market, Yescu Street entrance. And the Oak Street entrance. And somehow also in Lobar Alley!"
—Avult of the Foundway Associates
748977.translation:
「有人看到嫌犯在锡街市场的耶库街口出现。同时还在橡树街口出现。同时还能在阔叶巷出现！」
～寻路侦探社的戈瓦拉

748978.oracleText: For each of X target permanents, create X tokens that are copies of that permanent.
748978.translation: 为X个目标永久物各进行以下流程～派出X个为该永久物复制品的衍生物。

748980.oracleText: "Let's gather what we can before the Golgari tidy up the scene."
748980.translation: 「在葛加理来收拾之前，证据能搜集多少是多少。」

748981.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token. If a creature died this turn, you gain 2 life, surveil 2, then investigate.
748981.translation: 派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。如果本回合中有生物死去，则你获得2点生命，刺探2，然后探查。

748983.oracleText: {o2oUoB}: Turn this creature face up. If you can't, exile it, then you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
748983.translation: {o2oUoB}：将此生物翻回正面。若你无法如此作，则将它放逐，然后你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

748984.oracleText: Face-down creatures you control have "{o2oUoB}: Turn this creature face up. If you can't, exile it, then you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost."
748984.translation: 由你操控且牌面朝下的生物具有「{o2oUoB}：将此生物翻回正面。若你无法如此作，则将它放逐，然后你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用」。

748985.oracleText: Whenever an Assassin you control deals combat damage to an opponent, cloak the top card of that player's library.
748985.translation: 每当一个由你操控的杀手向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，匿伏该牌手的牌库顶牌。

748987.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may collect evidence 4.
748987.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以搜证4。

748992.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an artifact: Ezrim gains your choice of vigilance, lifelink, or hexproof until end of turn.
748992.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个神器：伊泽霖依你的选择获得警戒、系命或辟邪异能直到回合结束。

748995.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
748995.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

749003.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
749003.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749008.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, you may tap or untap target creature.
749008.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，你可以横置或重置目标生物。

749011.oracleText: Only too late did the Agency custodians realize the device had not been inactive—it was just waiting for the right trigger.
749011.translation: 当魔调局保管员发现看似静止的装置仍在运行时，一切都为时已晚～它只是在等合适的爆发时机。

749012.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then you may discard two cards. When you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature, where X is the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way.
749012.translation: 抓两张牌。然后你可以弃两张牌。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为以此法所弃各牌中的最大法术力值。

749013.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then you may discard two cards. When you do, Ill-Timed Explosion deals X damage to each creature, where X is the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way.
749013.translation: 抓两张牌。然后你可以弃两张牌。当你如此作时，厄时爆炸对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为以此法所弃各牌中的最大法术力值。

749015.oracleText: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi allowed Trostani to reach every crack and crevice in the city.
749015.translation: 维图加基的繁杂根系，让卓塔妮能自如触及城市中的每道缝隙。

749016.oracleText: Creature tokens you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
749016.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

749017.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then put a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
749017.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物，然后在每个由你操控的植物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749021.oracleText: Sacrifice four tokens: Surveil 2, then draw two cards. You gain 2 life.
749021.translation: 牺牲四个衍生物：刺探2，然后抓两张牌。你获得2点生命。

749023.oracleText: "I don't make my living hiding the truth, detective. I shout it from the stage."
749023.translation: 「侦探先生，隐藏真相可挣不了钱。在台上把它们大声喊出来才行。」

749024.oracleText: That spell gains deathtouch and lifelink.
749024.translation: 该咒语获得死触与系命异能。

749025.oracleText: That spell gains deathtouch and lifelink.
749025.translation: 该咒语获得死触与系命异能。

749031.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control and/or creature cards in your graveyard are put into exile, you may choose a creature card from among them. Until end of turn, target token you control becomes a copy of it, except it has flying.
749031.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的生物和／或一张或数张你坟墓场中的生物牌进入放逐区时，你可以选择其中一张生物牌。直到回合结束，目标由你操控的衍生物成为其复制品，但它具有飞行异能。

749032.oracleText: Surveil 2, then exile a card from a graveyard.
749032.translation: 刺探2，然后从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。

749033.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
749033.translation: 派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

749034.oracleText: Exile target creature you control. For each other player, exile up to one target creature that player controls.
749034.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物。为每位其他牌手各进行以下流程～放逐至多一个目标由该牌手操控的生物。

749037.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, destroy up to one target artifact. If you controlled that permanent, draw a card.
749037.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，消灭至多一个目标神器。如果你操控该永久物，则抓一张牌。

749040.oracleText: Investigate. You may play an additional land this turn.
749040.translation: 探查。本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

749043.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, sacrifice any number of other creatures, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is their total power. You may cast any number of instant and/or sorcery spells from among the exiled cards without paying their mana costs.
749043.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，牺牲任意数量的其他生物，然后放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为这些生物的力量总和。你可以从所放逐的牌之中施放任意数量的瞬间和／或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

749046.oracleText: Collect evidence 6: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
749046.translation: 搜证6：CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

749048.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with it. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
749048.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从以其放逐的牌之中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

749052.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile target card from a graveyard, then investigate.
749052.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐，然后探查。

749054.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Clue, you may have Lazav become a copy of a creature card exiled with it until end of turn.
749054.translation: 每当你牺牲一个线索时，你可以使拉札夫成为一张以其放逐之生物牌的复制品直到回合结束。

749057.oracleText: Each nonland permanent you control is all colors.
749057.translation: 每个由你操控的非地永久物均是五色。

749058.oracleText: After heavy casualties in the Phyrexian invasion, the Boros mage-priests trained as many rank-and-file soldiers as possible to wield the Legion's legendary battle magic.
749058.translation: 经历非瑞克西亚大侵攻的惨痛伤亡后，波洛斯的法师僧侣开始向普通士兵传授知识，希望有尽可能多的人能够自如运用教团的传奇战斗魔法。

749060.oracleText: "Well, if it isn't mean old Mr. Larchbottom, who's always been so eager to have the only dumpling stall in Oxblood Alley."
749060.translation: 「哎呀，这不是臭脾气的老松底先生嘛。你是不是还急着在牛血巷开出一家面点铺？」

749061.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, investigate.
749061.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，探查。

749064.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, it deals X damage to any target, target player draws X cards, and you gain X life, where X is the number of different color pairs among permanents you control that are exactly two colors.
749064.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，目标牌手抓X张牌，且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控且为正好两色的永久物中不同双色色组的种数。

749067.oracleText:
"Lies fester and flourish in shadow. Our job is to bathe them in light."
—Ezrim, Agency chief
749067.translation:
「黯影之中，谎言会不断腐生滋长。我们的任务便是将其曝露在明光之下。」
～魔调局局长伊泽霖

749068.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o3}. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
749068.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

749070.oracleText: No guest was permitted to leave before being questioned in an Azorius verity circle.
749070.translation: 每位宾客都要进入俄佐立真相环之中接受讯问，没完成之前不准离开。

749071.oracleText: This spell costs {oWoU} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
749071.translation: 此咒语在第一个目标之外每有一个目标，便增加{oWoU}来施放。

749072.oracleText: Choose any number of target players. Investigate X times, where X is the total number of creatures those players control.
749072.translation: 选择任意数量的目标牌手。探查X次，X为由这些牌手操控之生物的总数量。

749076.translation: 由你操控的其他侦探得+1/+1。

749077.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, target Detective can't be blocked this turn.
749077.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，目标侦探本回合不能被阻挡。

749079.oracleText: "Finally, a performance worthy of my applause!"
749079.translation: 「终于有了一场值得我亲自喝彩的演出！」

749086.oracleText:
"Many have tried to subjugate Ravnica. All have failed. All will fail."
—Museum of Ravnican History
749086.translation:
「曾有许多势力想要征服拉尼卡。它们过去没办到。将来也办不到。」
～拉尼卡历史博物馆

749087.oracleText: Return up to one target artifact card, up to one target land card, and up to one target non-Aura enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield. They are 5/5 Elemental creatures in addition to their other types.
749087.translation: 将至多一张目标神器牌，至多一张目标地牌和至多一张目标非灵气结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它们是5/5元素生物，且仍具有原本类别。

749089.oracleText:
"Remind me to send the biomancer team a gift basket."
—Olana, Simic field researcher
749089.translation:
「记得提醒我要给生机术士组送篮礼品。」
～析米克勘验学者欧兰纳

749090.oracleText: Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. Then counter up to one target spell unless its controller pays mana equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
749090.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物。然后除非至多一个目标咒语的操控者支付等同于由你操控之生物中最大力量的法术力，否则反击之。

749092.oracleText: Like any Ravnican denizen, it decided to visit Plaza West for lunch.
749092.translation: 跟其他拉尼卡市民一样，它也决定去西城广场用午餐。

749095.oracleText: Notice: Guests of Hellbender may be exposed to occasional bursts of flame.
749095.translation: 警告：参访地狱乐园的游客或会遭受偶发烈焰侵袭。

749098.oracleText: {o3oBoR}, Sacrifice a suspected creature: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.
749098.translation: {o3oBoR}，牺牲一个已遭疑的生物：目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。

749101.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
749101.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

749104.oracleText: Rakdos snitches rarely survive to get stitches.
749104.translation: 拉铎司告密者鲜少活到被发现的时候。

749108.oracleText: Taking a secret to your grave still doesn't make it safe from the Orzhov.
749108.translation: 就算你把秘密带进坟墓里，也还是瞒不过欧佐夫。

749109.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card. If the card's mana value is 1 or less, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
749109.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。如果该牌的法术力值等于或小于1，则派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

749111.oracleText: The great meditation garden of Sumala was no place for Ravnica's rising crime wave, and he would keep it that way.
749111.translation: 索马拉的大冥想花园仍旧清净，不受拉尼卡日益渐增的犯罪浪潮滋扰；而他意欲继续如此。

749112.oracleText: Whenever a face-down permanent you control is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it and a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
749112.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的永久物翻回正面时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749115.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, investigate for each opponent who lost life this turn.
749115.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每有一位本回合中失去过生命的对手，你便探查一次。

749116.oracleText: Whenever a Clue you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
749116.translation: 每当一个由你操控的线索从战场进入坟墓场时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

749119.oracleText: "The lawmages are trying to hush it up, but I'm telling you—the guard didn't fall off that balcony. He was pushed!"
749119.translation: 「律法师想要把这件事瞒过去，但我跟你说～守卫不是自己掉下阳台的。他是被人推下去的！」

749120.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oRoG}. Spend this mana only to cast face-down spells or to turn creatures face up.
749120.translation: {oT}：加{oRoG}。此法术力只能用来施放牌面朝下的咒语，或是将生物翻回正面。

749124.oracleText: Whenever a Wolf you control attacks, if Tolsimir attacked this combat, target creature an opponent controls blocks that Wolf this combat if able.
749124.translation: 每当一个由你操控的狼攻击时，若托西密本次战斗中攻击过，则目标由对手操控的生物本次战斗若能阻挡该狼，则须如此作。

749126.oracleText: Loot's easy to divide by one.

749127.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature that dealt damage this turn.
749127.translation: 牺牲一个本回合中造成过伤害的生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

749128.oracleText: Draw three cards. Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
749128.translation: 抓三张牌。每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

749130.oracleText: Tangled in the heart of Vitu-Ghazi, they guard their secrets from eager ears.
749130.translation: 她们三位一体居于维图加基中心，守护秘密让好奇之人无从探知。

749131.oracleText: {o1oG}: Target creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
749131.translation: {o1oG}：目标生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

749132.oracleText: {o(G/W)}: Target creature gains vigilance until end of turn.
749132.translation: {o(G/W)}：目标生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

749133.oracleText: {o2oW}: Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
749133.translation: {o2oW}：目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

749135.oracleText:
"The Golgari can read the dead like a newspaper."
—Taboro of the Foundway Associates
749135.translation:
「葛加理人解析遗体，就跟翻阅报纸一样轻松。」
～寻路侦探社的莱努瓦梅卡

749136.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, collect evidence X, where X is the total mana value of the permanents this spell targets.
749136.translation: 搜证X，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用，X为此咒语指定作目标之各永久物的法术力值总和。

749137.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, up to one target enchantment, and up to one target planeswalker.
749137.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器，至多一个目标生物，至多一个目标结界和至多一个目标鹏洛客。

749139.oracleText: Cloak a card from your hand.

749140.oracleText: Cloak a card from your hand.

749141.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
749141.translation: 在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749142.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
749142.translation: 在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749143.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one — 
• Cloak a card from your hand. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
749143.translation:
在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项～ 
•从你手上匿伏一张牌。 
•在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749145.oracleText: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock, desperate to stave off a war the guilds might not survive.
749145.translation: 一边欧瑞梨召集波洛斯教团整军备战，另一边卡娅与凯澜争分夺秒破解案件，竭尽全力要把这场可能会令所有公会同归于尽的战争扼杀在萌芽之中。

749149.oracleText: {o5oWoB}: Creatures you control with power 2 or less gain deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn.
749149.translation: {o5oWoB}：由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。

749151.oracleText: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"
749151.translation: 「囤物居奇，借灾牟利，勾结外敌～他们所有人都在拉尼卡最需要帮助的时候背叛了这座城市。他们都该死。我还没有完！」

749152.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. Put up to X land cards from your hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
749152.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。将至多X张地牌从你手上和／或你坟墓场中横置放进战场。

749153.oracleText: Worldsoul's Rage deals X damage to any target. Put up to X land cards from your hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
749153.translation: 世界之魂怒火对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。将至多X张地牌从你手上和／或你坟墓场中横置放进战场。

749154.oracleText: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

749155.oracleText: Whenever one or more face-down creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
749155.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且牌面朝下的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

749156.oracleText: Whenever a face-down creature you control dies, return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control if it's a permanent card, then turn it face up.
749156.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的生物死去时，如果它是永久物牌，则将它在其拥有者的操控下牌面朝下地移回战场，然后将它翻回正面。

749158.oracleText: Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard. Target player gains 2 life and draws a card.
749158.translation: 将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。目标牌手获得2点生命且抓一张牌。

749163.oracleText: Each opponent mills three cards, then you may cast a spell from each opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
749163.translation: 每位对手各磨三张牌，然后你可以从每位对手的坟墓场中各施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若以此法施放的咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

749167.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each attacking creature you control.
749167.translation: 在每个由你操控且进行攻击的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749168.oracleText: Create three 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying. Surveil 2.
749168.translation: 派出三个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。刺探2。

749172.oracleText: Target creature attacks or blocks this turn if able.
749172.translation: 目标生物本回合若能攻击或阻挡，则须如此作。

749173.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn. You may turn a creature you control face up.
749173.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。你可以将一个由你操控的生物翻回正面。

749177.oracleText: Put up to two target creature cards from a single graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. They gain haste until end of turn. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
749177.translation: 将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的生物牌在你操控下从该处放进战场。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

749181.oracleText: {oT}, Collect evidence 3: Add one mana of any color. Put an unlock counter on CARDNAME.
749181.translation: {oT}，搜证3：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在CARDNAME上放置一个解锁指示物。

749183.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Surveil 3, then draw three cards. Activate only if CARDNAME has five or more unlock counters on it.
749183.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：刺探3，然后抓三张牌。只能于CARDNAME上有五个或更多解锁指示物时起动。

749186.oracleText: The empty graves grew tired of waiting for bodies to fill them and set out to make some.
749186.translation: 空旷墓地等不及遗体自然填满，决定起身自己去开拓来源。

749191.oracleText: {o2}: Until end of turn, you may look at face-down creatures you don't control any time.
749191.translation: {o2}：直到回合结束，你可以随时检视不由你操控且牌面朝下的生物。

749194.oracleText: It recovers precious jewelry, murder weapons, and discarded food tins with equal excitement.
749194.translation: 奇洛兹迄今最先进的探测械。切勿让它靠近你的钥匙。

749198.oracleText:
"These footprints mean only one thing: the streetcleaner is running late!"
—Argyle, Agency junior detective
749198.translation:
「这些脚印只意味着一件事：清洁工迟到了！」
～魔调局初级侦探阿格雷

749200.oracleText: "I am once again bursting with discarded theories. Disposal imminent."
749200.translation: 「我又被废弃理论装满了。亟需清理。」

749203.oracleText:
"I find that my greatest insights rarely arrive when my ears are cold."
—Senior Inspector Holjo
749203.translation:
「我发现我的伟大见解，都是在耳朵没冻僵的时候想出来的。」
～资深巡检员何勒乔

749207.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, add two mana of any one color. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
749207.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

749216.oracleText: No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.
749216.translation: 但凡知道自己名声的罪犯，地下室里都不会只留有一条出路。

749218.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
749218.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

749254.oracleText: You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast Case spells.
749254.translation: 你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来施放案件咒语。

749257.oracleText: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know . . ."
749257.translation: 「嗯，这显然不是从我认识的人身上掉下来的…」

749258.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, investigate once for each opponent who has more cards in hand than you.
749258.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每有一位手牌比你多的对手，你便探查一次。

749260.oracleText: "Look, buddy, you're not in trouble. I just wanna ask you a questio—"
749260.translation: 「听我说，兄弟，你没惹上麻烦。我只是想问你个问～」

749263.oracleText: Thopters don't take breaks, and neither does he.
749263.translation: 振翼机从不休息，他也一样。

749266.oracleText: Whenever you collect evidence, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
749266.translation: 每当你搜证时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

749269.oracleText: To solve — Three or more creature cards were put into graveyards from anywhere this turn.
749269.translation: 侦办～本回合中有三张或更多生物牌从任何区域进入坟墓场。

749270.oracleText: Solved — This Case is a 4/4 Gorgon creature with deathtouch and lifelink in addition to its other types.
749270.translation: 侦结～此案件是4/4，具死触与系命异能的蛇发妖生物，且仍具有原本类别。

749274.oracleText: Whenever one or more suspected creatures you control attack, surveil 1.
749274.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且已遭疑的生物攻击时，刺探1。

749276.oracleText:
"He was scheduled to meet me tomorrow with something important to share. This was no coincidence."
—Algrom of the Foundway Associates
749276.translation:
「他原定明天要跟我碰面，有些重要情报要给我。这绝对不会是巧合。」
～寻路侦探社的阿尔戈罗格姆

749277.oracleText: CARDNAME deals twice X damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt to that creature this way, investigate.
749277.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成两倍于X数量的伤害。如果以此法对该生物造成过量伤害，则探查。

749278.oracleText: Torch the Witness deals twice X damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt to that creature this way, investigate.
749278.translation: 证人成炬对目标生物造成两倍于X数量的伤害。如果以此法对该生物造成过量伤害，则探查。

749281.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them. If that card has mana value 2 or less, you may put it onto the battlefield and it gains haste until end of turn. If you didn't put the revealed card onto the battlefield this way, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
749281.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张生物牌。如果该牌的法术力值等于或小于2，则你可以将它放进战场且它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。若你未以此法将所展示的牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

749283.oracleText:
"Er, sir, we could try to cite him for mishandling evidence, but I'm not sure he technically has hands."
—Argyle, Agency junior detective
749283.translation:
「呃，长官，我们是可以试着用动手毁损证物罪来逮捕他，但我不确定他那算不算有手。」
～魔调局初级侦探阿格雷

749291.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
749291.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌之总数量的两倍。

749293.oracleText: The first instant or sorcery spell you cast each turn costs {o3} less to cast.
749293.translation: 你每回合施放的第一个瞬间或法术咒语减少{o3}来施放。

749296.oracleText: Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, that opponent loses 3 life and you draw a card.
749296.translation: 每当任一对手以生物攻击时，若这些生物中有两个或更多正向你和／或由你操控的鹏洛客进行攻击，则该对手失去3点生命且你抓一张牌。

749298.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of Elves you control. Draw a card for each Wolf you control.
749298.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的妖精数量。你每操控一个狼，便抓一张牌。

749304.oracleText:
"Four prints plus one murder weapon equals a case even Juri won't be able to wriggle out of."
—Agency memo
749304.translation:
「四处指纹加一件凶器，等于一桩连裘里都赖不掉的铁案。」
～魔调局备忘录

749305.oracleText:
With the Gnat Alley mugging case solved, maybe we can finally figure out who's been leaving shoes all over the Sixth Precinct."
—Agency memo
749305.translation:
［蚊蚋巷劫案已侦结，现在也许能查清楚到底是谁在第六城区乱丢鞋子了。」
～魔调局备忘录

749306.oracleText:
"As we suspected, someone appears to be targeting Tolsimir specifically."
—Agency memo
749306.translation:
「跟我们怀疑的一样，似乎有人专门盯着托西密下手。」
～魔调局备忘录

749307.oracleText:
"Whatever it is, the smell alone could stun a loxodon. Simic involvement?"
—Agency memo
749307.translation:
「不管是什么，就凭这气味连象族都得晕眩半天。析米克插手了？」
～魔调局备忘录

749308.oracleText:
"Confiscated from the twin heirs of the Lusaht family. Will not be easy to unlock."
—Agency memo
749308.translation:
「自卢萨特家族双胞胎后人处没入。不易解锁。」
～魔调局备忘录

749310.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} other creature from the battlefield or creature card from graveyards.} other {Target up to {2, Number} other creatures from the battlefield and/or creature cards from graveyards.}}
749310.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定至多{2, Number}个其他战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌为目标。} other {指定至多{2, Number}个其他战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌为目标。}}

749311.oracleText: Target a creature you control other than enchanted creature.
749311.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物为目标，但不得是所结附的生物。

749312.oracleText: Target a creature you control with power 2 or less.
749312.translation: 指定一个由你操控，且力量等于或小于2的生物为目标。

749313.oracleText: Target an artifact, enchantment, or creature with power 4 or greater.
749313.translation: 指定一个神器，结界，或力量等于或大于4的生物为目标。

749314.oracleText: Put a stun counter on it?
749314.translation: 是否要在其上放置一个晕眩指示物？

749315.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
749315.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

749316.oracleText: Target a nonland card in a graveyard that was put there from anywhere this turn.
749316.translation: 指定一张坟墓场中的非地牌为目标，且它必须是本回合中进入坟墓场的。

749317.oracleText: Discard an instant or sorcery card or a creature card with flying?
749317.translation: 是否要弃一张瞬间或法术牌，或一张具飞行异能的生物牌？

749319.oracleText: Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
749319.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

749320.oracleText: Put a creature card exiled this way onto the battlefield?
749320.translation: 是否要将一张以此法放逐的生物牌放进战场？

749322.oracleText: Exile that many cards from the top of their library?
749322.translation: 是否要从其牌库顶放逐等量的牌？

749323.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
749323.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

749324.oracleText: Destroy up to one nonbasic land that player controls.
749324.translation: 消灭至多一个由该牌手操控的非基本地。

749327.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature, where X is the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way.
749327.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为以此法所弃各牌中的最大法术力值。

749329.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with it?
749329.translation: 是否要从以它放逐的牌中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语？

749331.translation: 是否要牺牲两个非地且非衍生物的永久物？

749333.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature that dealt damage this turn.
749333.translation: 牺牲一个本回合中造成过伤害的生物。

749334.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Put up to {2, Number} land card onto the battlefield.} other {Put up to {2, Number} land cards onto the battlefield.}}
749334.translation: {2, plural, =1 {将至多{2, Number}张地牌放进战场。} other {将至多{2, Number}张地牌放进战场。}}

749335.oracleText: Cast a spell from each opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost?
749335.translation: 是否要从每位对手的坟墓场中各施放一个咒语，且不支付其法术力费用？

749336.oracleText: Turn a creature you control face up?
749336.translation: 是否要将一个由你操控的生物翻到牌面朝上？

749337.oracleText: Tap an untapped artifact or land you control?
749337.translation: 是否要横置一个由你操控，且未横置的神器或地？

749338.oracleText: Target a token an opponent controls.
749338.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的衍生物为目标。

749340.oracleText: When equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, draw three cards.
749340.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则抓三张牌。

749343.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of lands that player controls.
749343.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于由该牌手操控的地数量。

749344.oracleText: Treacherous Terrain deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of lands that player controls.
749344.translation: 大地变节向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于由该牌手操控的地数量。

749406.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物得+2/+2。

749743.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may sacrifice another creature or an artifact. If you do, create a 4/1 black Skeleton creature token with menace that's tapped and attacking.
749743.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。若你如此作，则派出一个4/1黑色，具威慑异能的骷髅妖衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

750019.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw two cards.
750019.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓两张牌。

750207.oracleText: {o4}: Scry 1, then reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped. Otherwise, draw a card.
750207.translation: {o4}：占卜1，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，则将之横置放进战场。若否，则抓一张牌。

750211.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell each turn, choose an opponent at random. CARDNAME deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to that player or a planeswalker that player controls.
750211.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个咒语时，随机选择一位对手。CARDNAME对该牌手或任一由该牌手操控的鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

750248.translation: 指定一个由你操控的侦探为目标。

750249.oracleText: Search for a card named Magnifying Glass and/or a card named Thinking Cap.
750249.translation: 搜寻一张名称为放大镜的牌和／或一张名称为思考帽的牌。

750250.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
750250.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

750251.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
750251.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

750253.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token.
750253.translation: 牺牲一个神器、结界或衍生物。

750256.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, exile the top card of your library face down. (You can't look at it.)
750256.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。（你不能检视它。）

750477.oracleText: Look at the top two cards of target opponent's library. Exile one of them face down and put the other on the bottom of that library. You may play the exiled card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
750477.translation: 检视目标对手牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，另一张牌则置于该牌库底。于所放逐之牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以使用该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

750789.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped creatures you control. When you do, shuffle target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value X or less into its owner's library, where X is the number of creatures tapped this way.
750789.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的生物。当你如此作时，将目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物牌洗入其拥有者的牌库，X为以此法横置的生物数量。

750872.oracleText: Shuffle target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value X or less into its owner's library, where X is the number of creatures tapped this way.
750872.translation: 将目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物牌洗入其拥有者的牌库，X为以此法横置的生物数量。

751451.oracleText: Put an exiled creature card used to craft {1, CardId} onto the battlefield?
751451.translation: 是否要将一张用以化炼{1, CardId}所放逐的生物牌放进战场？

751454.oracleText: "Too bad for this Wicked Slumber-—I've always been an insomniac!"
751454.translation: “这邪恶倦眠真是太糟糕了——我一直都是一个失眠症患者！”

751459.oracleText: {o1oW}: Tokens you control gain indestructible until end of turn. Activate only once.
751459.translation: {o1oW}：由你操控的衍生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。只能起动一次。

751461.oracleText: The smallest bowl was temptingly cute; from the middle bowl wafted a soothing aroma; but the big bowl held a generous portion, and she was hungry . . .
751461.translation: 最小的碗可爱得诱人；大小中等的碗里飘出一股舒缓的香气；但大碗里的份量很大，她也饿了……

751462.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value less than the number of cards in your hand.
751462.translation: 取出一张法术力值小于你手牌数量的牌。

751463.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value greater than the number of cards in your hand.
751463.translation: 取出一张法术力值大于你手牌数量的牌。

751464.oracleText: Count the number of cards in your hand. You may cast a spell with mana value equal to that number from your hand without paying its mana cost.
751464.translation: 计算你的手牌数量。你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等同于该数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

751466.oracleText: Return target creature you control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
751466.translation: 将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

751467.oracleText: Return target creature you don't control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} more to cast."
751467.translation: 将目标不由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语增加{o1}来施放。」

751468.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Return target creature you control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast." 
• Return target creature you don't control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} more to cast."
751468.translation:
选择一项或都选～ 
•将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」 
•将目标不由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语增加{o1}来施放。」

751470.oracleText: "You spent your life toiling to learn a few simple tricks, and you call yourself an archmage? Truly, the arrogance of mortals knows no bounds."
751470.translation: “你辛苦了一辈子，才学会了几个简单的招数，还自称大法师？真是狂妄无边的凡人。”

751474.oracleText: Filled with illustrations by Gadwick himself, the prized tome is coveted by every apprentice, witch, and librarian on Eldraine.
751474.translation: 这本珍贵的书充满了盖威克亲自绘制的插图，为艾卓的每一个学徒、女巫和图书管理员所垂涎。

751477.oracleText: "The Wicked Slumber was just the beginning."

751483.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if three or more creatures died this turn, each opponent loses 5 life and you gain 5 life.
751483.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有三个或更多生物死去，则每位对手各失去5点生命且你获得5点生命。

751486.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have a boon, you mill three cards, draw a card, and lose 2 life.
751486.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你有恩泽，则你磨三张牌，抓一张牌，且失去2点生命。

751488.oracleText: Draconic Debut deals X damage to any target.
751488.translation: 龙威登场对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

751489.oracleText: The next Dragon creature spell you cast costs {oX} less to cast.
751489.translation: 你施放的下一个龙生物咒语减少{oX}来施放。

751495.oracleText: "You'll eat it and you'll like it! Anyone care to argue?"
751495.translation: “你会吃它并且会喜欢它的！有人愿意争辩吗？”

751496.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of your end step, create a Food token. If two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, instead conjure a card named Food Fight onto the battlefield.
751496.translation: 欢庆～在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个食品衍生物。若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进场，则改为将一张名称为食物大战的牌幻变进战场。

751498.oracleText: Tales of Will and Imodane's duel spread through the kingdom like wildfire, though the specifics varied greatly based on which side the teller supported.
751498.translation: 《意志的故事》和伊莫丹的决斗像野火一样传遍了整个王国，尽管具体细节因讲述者支持哪一方而有很大差异。

751499.oracleText: Damage isn't removed from creatures during cleanup steps.
751499.translation: 生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。。

751500.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. CARDNAME gains "Damage isn't removed from creatures during cleanup steps."
751500.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。CARDNAME获得「生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。。」

751502.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
751502.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

751504.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
751504.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

751507.oracleText: The gilded goose journeyed aimlessly across the land, laying eggs as she pleased and unwittingly granting lucky peasants the fortune of a lifetime.
751507.translation: 这只镀金的鹅漫无目的地在这片土地上旅行，随心所欲地产蛋，不知不觉地给幸运的农民带来了一生的财富。

751508.oracleText: Conjure a card named Gilded Goose onto the battlefield.
751508.translation: 将一张名称为金鹅的牌幻变进战场。

751509.oracleText: You may tap an untapped Bird you control and sacrifice an artifact. If you do, conjure a card named Golden Egg onto the battlefield.
751509.translation: 你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的鸟并牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则将一张名称为金蛋的牌幻变进战场。

751510.oracleText: You may tap an untapped Bird you control and sacrifice an artifact. If you do, conjure a card named Golden Egg onto the battlefield.
751510.translation: 你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的鸟并牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则将一张名称为金蛋的牌幻变进战场。

751512.oracleText: Growing up with Kellan gave him an uncanny knack for sniffing out traces of fae magic.
751512.translation: 与凯澜一起长大的经历赋予了它嗅出仙灵魔法痕迹的不可思议的本领。

751513.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure spell, if CARDNAME is on the battlefield or in exile, it perpetually gets +1/+1. Then if it's on the battlefield, exile it with a fetch counter on it.
751513.translation: 每当你施放历险咒语时，如果CARDNAME在战场上或放逐区中，则它永久得+1/+1。然后若它在战场上，则将它放逐且上面有一个取回指示物。

751517.oracleText:
"And the pigs called to the wolf, ‘WE'LL RIP YOUR CAVE DOWN STONE BY STONE . . .'"
—Gylwain, "The Pigs' Revenge"
751517.translation:
「群猪对狼喊道，‘我们会把你的洞穴一块一块地拆掉……’」
～桂尔温，《小猪的复仇》

751518.oracleText: If you control three or more Boars with different names, conjure each card from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield.
751518.translation: 如果你操控三个或更多名称各不相同的野猪，则将三只小猪的法术书中的每张牌幻变进战场。

751519.oracleText: If you control two or fewer Boars with different names, conjure two cards of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook into your hand, then put one of them onto the battlefield.
751519.translation: 如果你操控两个或更少名称各不相同的野猪，则从三只小猪的法术书中选择两张牌，将它们幻变进你手上，然后将其中一张放进战场。

751525.oracleText: "Back, fiend! It's a vegetarian life for you from this day forward!"
751525.translation: “回来吧，恶魔！从今天起你就过素食生活了！”

751526.oracleText: Conjure a card of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield.
751526.translation: 从三只小猪的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进战场。

751527.oracleText: Conjure a card of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield.
751527.translation: 从三只小猪的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进战场。

751528.oracleText: Return up to three target Boar creature cards with different names from your graveyard to the battlefield.
751528.translation: 将至多三张名称各不相同的目标野猪生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

751529.oracleText: Return up to three target Boar creature cards with different names from your graveyard to the battlefield.
751529.translation: 将至多三张名称各不相同的目标野猪生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

751533.oracleText: {o1o(G/W)}: Exile target artifact or enchantment. Activate only once.
751533.translation: {o1o(G/W)}：放逐目标神器或结界。只能起动一次。

751535.oracleText:
"True love can make the mundane magical and the unbearable bearable."
—Malacan, Vantress exile
751535.translation:
「真爱能让平凡变得神奇，让难以忍受变得可以忍受。」
～Malacan, Vantress exile

751536.oracleText: Seek two creature cards from among the top ten cards of your library, then shuffle. Creature cards in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.
751536.translation: 从你牌库顶的十张牌中取出两张生物牌，然后洗牌。你手上的生物牌永久得+1/+1。

751538.oracleText: A life-or-death struggle for a human is but a moment's entertainment for the fae.
751538.translation: 人类的生死之战对于仙灵来说不过是一时的娱乐而已。

751539.oracleText: Perpetually exchange target creature's base power with another target creature's base power.
751539.translation: 永久将目标生物与另一个目标生物的基础力量互换。

751540.oracleText: Perpetually exchange target creature's base power with another target creature's base power.
751540.translation: 永久将目标生物与另一个目标生物的基础力量互换。

751541.oracleText: CARDNAME perpetually has base power and toughness 4/1.
751541.translation: CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力永久为4/1。

751546.oracleText: "Hey, I don't hear any whistling! Get back to work!"
751546.translation: “嘿，我没有听到任何哨声！回去工作吧！”

751551.oracleText: She brings the crowd to their feet and her opponents to their knees.
751551.translation: 她让观众起立，让对手跪下。

751554.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to CARDNAME while it's equipped, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, sacrifice an Equipment attached to CARDNAME.
751554.translation: 如果CARDNAME于其佩带武具时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，牺牲一个贴附在CARDNAME上的武具。

751561.oracleText: Exile target creature. You gain 1 life for each Boar you control.
751561.translation: 放逐目标生物。你每操控一个野猪，便获得1点生命。

751563.oracleText: {o2o(W/B)o(W/B)}: CARDNAME perpetually becomes a Boar Spirit with base power and toughness 4/4 and gains flying. Activate only if CARDNAME isn't a Spirit.
751563.translation: {o2o(W/B)o(W/B)}：CARDNAME永久成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的野猪／精怪，且获得飞行异能。只能于CARDNAME不是精怪时起动。

751569.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. It gains haste until end of turn.
751569.translation: 派出一个1/1白色兔衍生生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

751571.oracleText: He scours the furthest reaches of Eldraine for novelties to add to Beluna's vault.
751571.translation: 他在艾卓最远的地方搜寻新奇的东西，以添加到贝伦娜的宝库中。

751575.oracleText: Conjure X random cards from Giant Secrets's spellbook into your hand.
751575.translation: 从巨人之秘的法术书中将X张随机牌幻变进你手上。

751576.translation: 约书华爵士与萨克森爵士

751577.oracleText: They were inseparable in waking life, and they fought in perfect coordination even as puppets of the Wicked Slumber.
751577.translation: 他们在清醒时形影不离，即使是成为邪恶倦眠者的傀儡，他们也能完美配合地战斗。

751578.oracleText: If you control exactly two legendary permanents named Syr Joshua and Syr Saxon, the "legend rule" doesn't apply to them.
751578.translation: 如果你操控正好两个名称为约书华爵士与萨克森爵士的传奇永久物，则「传奇规则」不对它们生效。

751579.oracleText: Each other creature you control named Syr Joshua and Syr Saxon has battle cry.
751579.translation: 每个由你操控且名称为约书华爵士与萨克森爵士的其他生物均具有战嚎异能。

751584.oracleText:
"All roads lead to where you are meant to go."
—Talion
751584.translation:
「所有的路都通向你想去的地方。」
～塔莱恩

751589.oracleText:
"The Ice Witch thinks this place silent and still. But beneath the surface, my people thrive."
—Sharae
751589.translation:
「冰雪女巫认为这个地方寂静无声。但在地表之下，我的人民正在蓬勃发展。」
～莎蕾

751593.oracleText: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.
751593.translation: 原本采自秘罗地光蛾的浆液，可让饮者眼中见得启悟。如今浆液萃自非瑞克西亚墨蛾，能令受者眼中得见完美。

751595.oracleText: Target up to one other nonland, nontoken permanent.
751595.translation: 指定至多另一个非地且非衍生物的永久物为目标。

751596.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value less than the number of cards in your hand.
751596.translation: 取出一张法术力值小于你手牌数量的牌。

751597.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value greater than the number of cards in your hand.
751597.translation: 取出一张法术力值大于你手牌数量的牌。

751598.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value equal to that number from your hand without paying its mana cost?
751598.translation: 是否从你手上施放一个法术力值等于该数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

751599.oracleText: Tap an untapped Bird you control?
751599.translation: 是否横置一个由你操控且未横置的鸟？

751600.oracleText: Target up to three Boar creature cards with different names.
751600.translation: 指定至多三张名称各不相同的野猪生物牌为目标。

751602.oracleText: When damage is prevented this way, sacrifice an Equipment attached to CARDNAME.
751602.translation: 当以此法防止伤害时，牺牲一个贴附在CARDNAME上的武具。

751603.oracleText: Sacrifice an Equipment attached to {1, CardId}.
751603.translation: 牺牲一个贴附在{1, CardId}上的武具。

751605.oracleText: Target up to one creature that was dealt damage this turn.
751605.translation: 指定至多一个本回合中受过伤害的生物为目标。

751744.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with mana cost {o0} or {o1}.
751744.translation: 搜寻一张法术力费用为{o0}或{o1}的神器牌。

751823.oracleText: Counter target activated or triggered ability. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
751823.translation: 反击目标起动式异能或触发式异能。（其目标不能是法术力异能。）

751828.oracleText: Put up to one creature card onto the battlefield.
751828.translation: 将至多一张生物牌放进战场。

751916.oracleText: Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards. (Damage causes loss of life.)
751916.translation: 每当你失去生命，抽等量的牌。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

752062.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Blood token, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
752062.translation: 每当你牺牲一个血滴衍生物时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

752091.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each Dragon card in your hand perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
752091.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你手上的每张龙牌均永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

752284.oracleText: Target up to one other artifact or creature you control.
752284.translation: 指定至多另一个由你操控的神器或生物为目标。

752285.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or creature an opponent controls.
752285.translation: 指定至多一个由对手操控的神器或生物为目标。

752287.oracleText: Target up to one spell or nonland permanent.
752287.translation: 指定至多一个咒语或非地永久物为目标。

752290.oracleText: If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead. (Damage causes loss of life.)
752290.translation: 如果某对手将于你的回合中失去生命，则改为其失去两倍于该数量的生命。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

752293.oracleText: Put any number of Aura cards onto the battlefield?
752293.translation: 将任意数量的灵气牌放进战场？

752294.oracleText: Activate each of those abilities only once each turn?
752294.translation: 是否要起动每个每回合只能起动一次的异能？

752295.oracleText: If this permanent would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it instead.
752295.translation: 如果此永久物将从战场进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

752312.oracleText: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
752312.translation: 反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。（其目标不能是法术力异能。）

753170.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control from an enchantment source. You may choose new targets for the copy. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
753170.translation: {oG}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控且来源为结界的起动式或触发式异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（其目标不能是法术力异能。）

753172.oracleText: Seek a card with the highest mana value among cards in your library with mana value less than or equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
753172.translation: 从你牌库中法术力值等于或小于你本回合中所获得之生命数量的牌中，取出一张法术力值最高的牌。

754100.oracleText: Exile four or more nonlands with activated abilities.
754100.translation: 放逐四个或更多具起动式异能的非地永久物。

754106.oracleText: Exile a Dinosaur, a Merfolk, a Pirate, and a Vampire.
754106.translation: 放逐一个恐龙、一个人鱼、一个海盗和一个吸血鬼。

754110.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. Then amass Orcs 1.
754110.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌，且不是其于自己的每个抓牌步骤中所抓的第一张牌时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。然后囤兵半兽人1。

754113.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a burden counter on CARDNAME, then draw a card for each burden counter on CARDNAME.
754113.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在CARDNAME上放置一个重负指示物，然后CARDNAME上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

754114.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a burden counter on The One Ring, then draw a card for each burden counter on The One Ring.
754114.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在至尊戒上放置一个重负指示物，然后至尊戒上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

754671.oracleText: You may pay {oWoUoBoRoG} rather than pay the mana cost for spells you cast.
754671.translation: 你可以支付{oWoUoBoRoG}，而不支付你施放之咒语的法术力费用。

754866.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, look at the top three cards of that player's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest into their graveyard. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
754866.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视该牌手牌库顶的三张牌，将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，然后将其余的牌置入其坟墓场。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视之，你可以施放之，且你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

755200.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell of the chosen type or activate an ability of a creature source of the chosen type.
755200.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放该类别的生物咒语，或是起动为该类别的生物来源的异能。

755268.oracleText: Spend only on: A Creature Spell of the Chosen Type or an Ability of a Creature Source of the Chosen Type: {0}
755268.translation: 只能用于支付：所选类别之生物咒语或所选类别之生物来源的异能：{0}

755394.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creature sources.
755394.translation: {oT}：加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语，或是起动生物来源异能。

755494.oracleText: Spend only on: Creature Spells or Abilities of Creature Sources
755494.translation: 只能用于支付：生物咒语或生物来源的异能

755498.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card.
755498.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，抓一张牌。

755513.oracleText:
"Few now have the skill in healing to match such evil weapons."
—Strider
755513.translation:
「现在几乎没有人能治疗这种邪恶武器造成的创伤。」
～大步佬

755518.oracleText:
"Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it has not yet been forged again."
—Elrond
755518.translation:
「纳熙尔圣剑被折断了，其上的光芒也消失了，它还没有被重铸。」
