～埃尔隆德

755522.oracleText: There loomed against the westward stars a dark black shape: a great barrow stood there.
755522.translation: 在西边星光的映衬下，有个黑色的东西隐约浮现：一座巨大的古墓矗立在那里。

755528.oracleText: The hall was long and wide and filled with shadows. Mighty pillars upheld its lofty roof.
755528.translation: 大厅长而宽阔，到处都是影子。巨大的柱子支撑着高大的屋顶。

755529.translation: 埃多拉斯金殿美杜塞尔德

755564.oracleText: There's a gnome built for just about every job in Oteclan, including building gnomes.
755564.translation: 在欧特克兰，存在一种几乎能胜任所有工作的侏械，包括制造侏械本身。

755565.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may exile another artifact you control or an artifact card in your graveyard. If you do, seek an artifact card. That card perpetually has base power and toughness 1/1 and becomes a Gnome creature in addition to its other types.
755565.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以放逐另一个由你操控的神器或你坟墓场中的一张神器牌。若你如此作，则取出一张神器牌。该牌的基础力量与防御力永久为1/1，成为地侏生物，且仍具有原本类别。

755569.oracleText: All Chorus cards you own intensify by 1.
755569.translation: 由你拥有的所有齐颂牌强化1。

755571.oracleText: Pure faith enkindled can sear even those blessed by the sun.
755571.translation: 心中燃起的纯真信仰之火甚至能灼伤那些烈阳眷恩者。

755572.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater. If you weren't the starting player, you gain 4 life.
755572.translation: 消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。若你不是先手牌手，则你获得4点生命。

755576.oracleText: The Thousand Moons chose to ride giant bats as a message to Aclazotz: Anything you twist can be undone.
755576.translation: 千月军选择骑乘巨型蝙蝠来向阿洛佐兹示意：你所扭曲的一切皆能复原。

755577.oracleText: When you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {o1}. If you don't, each opponent draws a card.
755577.translation: 当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。如果你未如此作，则每位对手各抓一张牌。

755578.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player gets a one-time boon with "When you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {o1}. If you don't, each opponent draws a card."
755578.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。如果你未如此作，则每位对手各抓一张牌。」

755581.oracleText:
"Dawn! The morning tide! Arise! Arise!"
—River Herald chant
755581.translation:
「黎明已至！早潮将临！苏醒吧！苏醒吧！」
～川流使号令

755582.oracleText: Draw a card. If a permanent you controlled explored this turn, seek a Merfolk card instead.
755582.translation: 抓一张牌。如果本回合中由你操控的永久物勘察过，则改为取出一张人鱼牌。

755584.oracleText:
"As there was one age, there shall be another."
—Hymn to the Ages, chorus

755585.oracleText: Draw a number of cards equal to this spell's intensity.
755585.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于此咒语的强度。

755587.oracleText: "Let's see: if that bit is the tunnel, and the blue scribble is the waterfall . . . yep, we're going the wrong way."
755587.translation: 「让我们看看地图：如果那一小块是隧道，那么涂画的蓝色这块就是瀑布…嗯，我们走错了。」

755589.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if two or more artifacts entered the battlefield under your control this turn, conjure a card named Thieving Magpie onto the battlefield.
755589.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多神器在你的操控下进场，则将一张名称为窃鹊的牌幻变进战场。

755591.oracleText: Seek a nonland artifact card with mana value X or less and put it onto the battlefield. If a card with mana value less than X is put onto the battlefield this way, this spell perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} more to cast," then return this spell to its owner's hand.
755591.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于X的非地神器牌，并将之放进战场。如果以此法将一张法术力值小于X的牌放进战场，则此咒语永久获得「此咒语增加{o1}来施放」，然后将此咒语移回其拥有者手上。

755593.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose target creature card in your graveyard. Conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard.
755593.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌。将该牌的一张副本幻变进你的坟墓场。

755594.oracleText: Descend 8 — Exile a permanent card from your graveyard: You may play it. Activate only as a sorcery and only if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
755594.translation: 落坟8～从你的坟墓场放逐一张永久物牌：你可以使用该牌。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌时。

755596.oracleText: In the darkness of Ixalan's underworld, the Legion found new lands to claim.
755596.translation: 于依夏兰地底世界黑暗深处，军团仍能开疆拓土。

755597.oracleText: Draw a card. If an opponent lost life this turn and you gained life this turn, seek two Vampire cards instead.
755597.translation: 抓一张牌。如果本回合中有对手失去过生命且你本回合中获得过生命，则改为取出两张吸血鬼牌。

755599.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard. The duplicate perpetually becomes a black Skeleton with base power and toughness 3/1 in addition to its other colors and types.
755599.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将至多一张目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则将该牌的一张副本幻变进你的坟墓场。该副本永久成为基础力量与防御力为3/1的黑色骷髅妖，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。

755601.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target creature card with power or toughness 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755601.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一张目标力量或防御力为1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

755604.translation: 他们齐声歌唱，永不停息。

755606.oracleText: Each player sacrifices X creatures and you gain X life, where X is this spell's intensity.
755606.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲X个生物且你获得X点生命，X为此咒语的强度。

755608.oracleText: If you weren't the starting player, this spell costs {o1} less to cast.
755608.translation: 如果你不是先手牌手，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

755609.oracleText: Target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand with mana value 4 or less. Choose a card revealed this way or a card in their graveyard. Exile that card.
755609.translation: 目标对手展示其手上所有法术力值等于或小于4的非地牌。选择一张以此法展示的牌或其坟墓场中的一张牌。放逐该牌。

755613.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put all cards exiled with it onto the battlefield under their owner's control. Conjure four cards named Volcanic Geyser into your library, then shuffle.
755613.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将所有以它放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下放进战场。将四张名称为火泉喷发的牌幻变进你的牌库，然后洗牌。

755618.oracleText: Whenever Kamachal deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token. Then exile from that player's library a random card with mana value equal to the damage dealt. You may cast that card this turn.
755618.translation: 每当卡玛查对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后从该牌手的牌库中放逐一张法术力值等同于所造成伤害的随机牌。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。

755620.oracleText: To the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, gold and distant horizons are both reason enough to set sail.
755620.translation: 对于莽霸联盟海盗们来说，黄金与远方的地平线皆足以吸引他们扬帆起航。

755621.oracleText: Draw a card. If mana from a Treasure was spent to cast this spell, seek a Pirate card instead.
755621.translation: 抓一张牌。如果施放此咒语时支付了来自珍宝的法术力，则改为取出一张海盗牌。

755625.oracleText: A harmonious crescendo that ends in a loud bellow.
755625.translation: 渐强之协音止于巨声之咆哮。

755626.oracleText: Conjure X cards named Colossal Dreadmaw onto the battlefield, where X is this spell's intensity.
755626.translation: 将X张名称为庞巨血口龙的牌幻变进战场，X为此咒语的强度。

755629.oracleText: Mythweaver Poq's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
755629.translation: 织谜谕使波克的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

755635.oracleText: Remove three spore counters from CARDNAME: Return target Fungus creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755635.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去三个芽孢指示物：将目标真菌生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

755638.oracleText: "Rough-Tail, old friend! You're far from the herd today. Is something stirring in the jungle?"
755638.translation: 「嗨，老朋友粗尾龙！你今日离开族群远道而来，是丛林中有什么躁动吗？」

755642.oracleText: Conjure a card named Savage Stomp into your hand.
755642.translation: 将一张名称为蛮野重跺的牌幻变进你手上。

755643.oracleText: Conjure a card named Savage Stomp into your hand.
755643.translation: 将一张名称为蛮野重跺的牌幻变进你手上。

755644.oracleText: Conjure a card named Naturalize into your hand.
755644.translation: 将一张名称为回归自然的牌幻变进你手上。

755645.oracleText: Conjure a card named Naturalize into your hand.
755645.translation: 将一张名称为回归自然的牌幻变进你手上。

755649.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If excess damage is dealt this way, conjure a card with mana value equal to that excess damage from Brazen Boarding's spellbook onto the battlefield. If that excess damage is 4 or greater, instead conjure a card named Admiral Beckett Brass onto the battlefield.
755649.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果以此法造成过量伤害，则从莽霸登舰的法术书中将一张法术力值等同于该过量伤害的牌幻变进战场。如果该过量伤害等于或大于4，则改为将一张名称为贝克蒂霸司总帅的牌幻变进战场。

755650.oracleText: Brazen Boarding deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If excess damage is dealt this way, conjure a card with mana value equal to that excess damage from Brazen Boarding's spellbook onto the battlefield. If that excess damage is 4 or greater, instead conjure a card named Admiral Beckett Brass onto the battlefield.
755650.translation: 莽霸登舰对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果以此法造成过量伤害，则从莽霸登舰的法术书中将一张法术力值等同于该过量伤害的牌幻变进战场。如果该过量伤害等于或大于4，则改为将一张名称为贝克蒂霸司总帅的牌幻变进战场。

755652.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, conjure a card named Arguel's Blood Fast onto the battlefield and you may transform it. If you control an enchantment named Arguel's Blood Fast and a land named Temple of Aclazotz, instead create two 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature tokens with flying.
755652.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将一张名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的牌幻变进战场，且你可以转化之。如果你操控名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的结界和名称为阿洛佐兹神殿的地，则改为派出两个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

755653.oracleText: When High Marshal Arguel dies, conjure a card named Arguel's Blood Fast onto the battlefield and you may transform it. If you control an enchantment named Arguel's Blood Fast and a land named Temple of Aclazotz, instead create two 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature tokens with flying.
755653.translation: 当高阶元帅阿古尔死去时，将一张名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的牌幻变进战场，且你可以转化之。如果你操控名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的结界和名称为阿洛佐兹神殿的地，则改为派出两个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

755655.oracleText: The farther she swam from one world, the closer she came to the next.
755655.translation: 她游离一世愈远，身临下一世愈近。

755660.oracleText: The mycelium pulsed slowly, as if counting the beats of an enormous heart. The bones around them shuddered, then stood again.
755660.translation: 智蕈缓缓蠕动，其声如巨大心脏之心跳。周围的骸骨随之一震，骤然而起。

755661.oracleText: Fathomless descent — Each creature card in your graveyard perpetually gets +X/+X, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard. Then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755661.translation: 落坟无边～你坟墓场中的每张生物牌均永久得+X/+X，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。然后将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

755666.oracleText: {o2}: Target creature you control becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
755666.translation: {o2}：目标由你操控的生物成为一张以CARDNAME放逐的生物牌之复制品。只能于法术时机起动且只能起动一次。

755669.oracleText: The Oltec learned from their Imperial cousins, and applied new magic to old artifice in defense of the Core.
755669.translation: 欧尔特人效仿其皇室亲眷，以新式魔法运用于旧时技艺来守卫世界核心。

755670.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, discover X, where X is that damage.
755670.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，倾探X，X为该伤害值。

755672.oracleText: Whenever you play a card from exile, conjure a duplicate of it into your hand.
755672.translation: 每当你从放逐区使用牌时，将它的一张副本幻变进你手上。

755674.oracleText:
"Give her space! She'll adapt to the Cosmium in her, or kill us trying."
—Yeyetzi, Sun Empire sergeant
755674.translation:
「离她远点！她会适应体内的宇金，那时我们可就惨了！」
～烈阳帝国军士耶耶吉

755675.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, other Dinosaurs you control and Dinosaur cards in your hand and library perpetually get +1/+1.
755675.translation: 激怒～每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，由你操控的其他恐龙和你手上与你牌库中的恐龙牌永久得+1/+1。

755680.oracleText:
"I, who have seen all the world, now go on to what comes next."
—Tan Jolom, last words
755680.translation:
「我曾历经此世，现将步往来世。」
～谭霍勒姆的遗言

755681.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose up to one target artifact or land you control that isn't a creature or token. Until end of turn, it becomes a 3/3 Spirit creature with vigilance and double team in addition to its other types.
755681.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择至多一个目标由你操控且不为生物或衍生物的神器或地。直到回合结束，它成为3/3，具警戒与双打异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

755683.oracleText: Return any number of creature cards with total mana value {2, Number} or less to the battlefield.
755683.translation: 将任意数量法术力值总和等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌移回战场。

755684.oracleText: Seek a nonland artifact card with mana value {2, Number} or less.
755684.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的非地神器牌。

755688.oracleText: Target a creature card with power or toughness 1.
755688.translation: 指定一个力量或防御力为1的生物牌为目标。

755693.translation: 指定一张真菌生物牌为目标。

755694.oracleText: Target a Merfolk creature you control.
755694.translation: 指定一个由你操控的人鱼生物为目标。

755697.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or land you control that isn't a creature or token.
755697.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控且既非生物也非衍生物的神器或地为目标。

755965.oracleText: Target a permanent you own but don't control.
755965.translation: 指定一个由你拥有但不由你操控的永久物为目标。

755966.oracleText: Target any number of permanents you control.
755966.translation: 指定任意数量由你操控的永久物为目标。

755967.oracleText: Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell.
755967.translation: 此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。

755968.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: Conjure a random card from Tome of the Infinite's spellbook into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755968.translation: {oU}，{oT}：从永恒巨著的法术书中将一张随机牌幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

755971.oracleText: Whenever a player discards a card during your turn, they choose another player. That player conjures a duplicate of that card into their hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755971.translation: 每当任一牌手于你的回合中弃一张牌时，其选择另一位牌手。该牌手将该牌的一张副本幻变进其手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

755977.oracleText: When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, exile the top three cards of your library. You may play one of those cards this turn.
755977.translation: 当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用其中一张。

755978.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. You get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, exile the top three cards of your library. You may play one of those cards this turn."
755978.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用其中一张。」

755979.oracleText: Electrostatic Blast deals 2 damage to any target. You get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, exile the top three cards of your library. You may play one of those cards this turn."
755979.translation: 静电冲击对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用其中一张。」

755990.oracleText: Target opponent discards a card. Then they may discard an additional card. If they don't, conjure a duplicate of a random card from their library into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755990.translation: 目标对手弃一张牌。然后他可以再弃一张牌。若他未如此作，则将其牌库中随机牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

755992.oracleText: When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this boon deals damage equal to the noted number to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
755992.translation: 当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此恩泽向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所记下的数字。

755993.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If excess damage was dealt this way, note that excess damage, then you get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this boon deals damage equal to the noted number to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls."
755993.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果以此法造成过量伤害，则记下该过量伤害，然后你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此恩泽向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所记下的数字。」

755994.oracleText: Molten Impact deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If excess damage was dealt this way, note that excess damage, then you get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this boon deals damage equal to the noted number to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls."
755994.translation: 熔融冲击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果以此法造成过量伤害，则记下该过量伤害，然后你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此恩泽向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所记下的数字。」

755996.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose target opponent. Conjure a duplicate of the top card of their library into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell." Then they exile the top card of their library face down.
755996.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择目标对手。将其牌库顶牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」然后该牌手牌面朝下地放逐其牌库顶牌。

755997.oracleText: Conjure a duplicate of target creature card in an opponent's graveyard into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755997.translation: 将目标在任一对手坟墓场中之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

755998.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Counter target noncreature spell. 
• Conjure a duplicate of target creature card in an opponent's graveyard into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755998.translation:
选择一项～ 
•反击目标非生物咒语。 
•将目标在任一对手坟墓场中之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

756002.oracleText: Return target nontoken, nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If this spell was kicked, conjure a duplicate of that card into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
756002.translation: 将目标非衍生物且非地的永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果此咒语已增幅，则将该牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

756007.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, it perpetually gets +X/+X, where X is its power.
756007.translation: 当你施放生物咒语时，它永久得+X/+X，X为其力量。

756027.oracleText: Weary travelers trade stories of the Eversaloon, an extraplanar respite that appears at the moment it is most needed.
756027.translation: 疲惫旅行者之间的谈资都少不了恒永吧，这处外时空的暂息之地总会在最需要的时候出现。

756028.oracleText: Exile any number of creatures you control, then return them to the battlefield under their owner's control. Then repeat this process X more times.
756028.translation: 放逐任意数量由你操控的生物，然后将它们在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。然后将此流程再重复X次。

756031.oracleText:
"I always wanted to ride a slow cannonball with legs!"
—Kellan
756031.translation:
「会爬的缓行炮弹！我一直都想骑一下。」
～凯澜

756032.oracleText: {o3oW}: CARDNAME gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is its toughness.
756032.translation: {o3oW}：CARDNAME得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为其防御力。

756037.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast from graveyards or from exile cost {o2} more to cast.
756037.translation: 对手从坟墓场或放逐区中施放的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

756040.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. You gain 1 life for each of those creatures.
756040.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。每有一个此类生物，你便获得1点生命。

756044.oracleText: No one could prove the ox did it, but no one tried to harness it again either.
756044.translation: 没人能证明是那头牛干的，但也没人再想去去拴住它。

756045.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or creature. Its controller creates a 2/2 white Ox creature token.
756045.translation: 消灭目标神器或生物。其操控者派出一个2/2白色的牛衍生生物。

756048.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, create a 1/1 white Sheep creature token.
756048.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个1/1白色绵羊衍生生物。

756059.oracleText: When Kellan questioned her, Eriette reminded him that she'd been asked only to put the guard to sleep—the request said nothing about waking up.
756059.translation: 当凯澜追究起来时，艾纶缇辩解说当初只是要让她把守卫弄睡着～能不能醒可没提。

756062.oracleText: + {o1} — All creatures lose all abilities until end of turn.
756062.translation: + {o1}～所有生物失去所有异能直到回合结束。

756063.oracleText: + {o1} — Choose a creature you control. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
756063.translation: + {o1}～选择一个由你操控的生物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

756068.oracleText: Whenever Fortune attacks while saddled, at end of combat, exile it and up to one creature that saddled it this turn, then return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control.
756068.translation: 每当福琼于已乘驾时攻击，在战斗结束时，将它和至多一个本回合中乘驾它的生物放逐，然后将这些牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

756074.oracleText: As the vault collapsed around them, Kellan made sure Akul couldn't follow them out.
756074.translation: 随着宝库在他们周围坍塌，凯澜终于确定阿库尔再也不会跟上来。

756075.oracleText: + {o1} — Exile target nontoken creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
756075.translation: + {o1}～放逐目标非衍生物的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

756076.oracleText: + {o2} — Destroy target creature if no other creature has greater power.
756076.translation: + {o2}～选择目标生物。如果其他生物中没有力量比它大的，则将它消灭。

756078.oracleText: They both knew only one of them would walk away.
756078.translation: 他们都清楚：两者之间只有一人能活着离开。

756079.oracleText: {o4oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 5 damage to any target.
756079.translation: {o4oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

756083.oracleText: After it passed by, the rancher swore she saw hope shining in the pigs' eyes.
756083.translation: 自从它飞过之后，牧场主发誓她看到自家的猪眼中都闪烁着希望。

756087.oracleText: "We must forge for ourselves the gifts that nature neglected to give us."
756087.translation: 「自然不愿赋予我们之技艺，我们必须自行打造。」

756088.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and CARDNAME doesn't have a flying counter on it, put a flying counter on it.
756088.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且CARDNAME上没有飞行指示物，则在其上放置一个飞行指示物。

756092.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
756092.translation: {oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

756096.oracleText: Kellan had no plan. He simply poured his focus into the train and willed it to stop.
756096.translation: 凯澜没有计划。他就只是将注意力倾注在列车上，用意念之力将之截停。

756100.oracleText: "Count yourself lucky I came upon you. This is not a world of second chances."
756100.translation: 「遇上我该算你自己走运。这世界通常不给人第二次机会。」

756104.oracleText: Freestriders took to patrolling near the Omenpaths, protecting new arrivals from the robbers and charlatans prowling for easy marks.
756104.translation: 畅行帮最近开始在预兆港附近巡逻，保护新来的人不被劫匪骗徒当凯子削。

756105.oracleText: CARDNAME has double strike as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
756105.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

756108.oracleText: + {o2} — Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
756108.translation: + {o2}～将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

756109.oracleText: + {o1} — Return target Mount or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
756109.translation: + {o1}～将目标坐骑或载具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

756110.oracleText: + {o1} — Return target Aura or Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to a creature you control.
756110.translation: + {o1}～将目标灵气或武具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在一个由你操控的生物上。

756112.oracleText: "What are you gonna do, walk a hundred miles for a second opinion?"
756112.translation: 「你要怎样，是要走一百哩后找第二个人问一问吗？」

756115.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
756115.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756117.oracleText: {o4oW}: Until end of turn, if you would put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, put that many plus one +1/+1 counters on it instead.
756117.translation: {o4oW}：直到回合结束，如果你将在某个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

756120.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a token: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
756120.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个衍生物：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

756123.oracleText: The Freestriders believe in liberation, in all its many forms.
756123.translation: 解放是畅行帮的信条～各种形式的解放都算。

756126.oracleText: + {o1} — Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.
756126.translation: + {o1}～在由目标牌手操控的每个生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756129.oracleText: + {o1} — Untap all creatures target player controls.
756129.translation: + {o1}～重置由目标牌手操控的所有生物。

756130.oracleText: + {o1} — Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
756130.translation: + {o1}～目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

756132.oracleText: It catches those who are not ready to fall.
756132.translation: 它会接住那些没准备好就跌落的人。

756142.oracleText:
"Just because you can saddle a critter, doesn't mean it'll let you ride."
—Annie Flash
756142.translation:
「牲口愿让你配鞍，并不代表它愿意被你骑。」
～电闪安妮

756143.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. CARDNAME deals 4 damage to that creature instead if you controlled a Mount as you cast this spell.
756143.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时操控坐骑，则改为CARDNAME对该生物造成4点伤害。

756144.oracleText: Steer Clear deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. Steer Clear deals 4 damage to that creature instead if you controlled a Mount as you cast this spell.
756144.translation: 扭身甩开对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时操控坐骑，则改为扭身甩开对该生物造成4点伤害。

756146.oracleText: "If you don't want to tell me where the stash is, you'd best start getting comfy in there. You just let me know when you've changed your mind."
756146.translation: 「你要是不愿告诉我东西藏哪了，那就在里头好好待着吧。等你改主意了再叫我。」

756149.oracleText: The Sterling Company can always rely on him to bring the thunder.
756149.translation: 银光社总能靠他雷震四方。

756152.oracleText: The frontier was an anvil on which many an unlikely hero would be forged.
756152.translation: 边疆就像座大铁砧，许多原本不像英雄的人在此都能锤炼成名。

756156.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, it gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
756156.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。占卜1。

756159.oracleText: "The Sterling Company says they protect us, but where are they when the Hellspurs burn half the town? Counting their vaults!"
756159.translation: 「银光社口口声声说会保护我们，但当炼刺帮烧掉大半个镇子时他们又在哪？清点对方的宝库！」

756160.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control die, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
756160.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756163.oracleText: Many a would-be captor has gotten close enough to count its feathers, only to be left behind with nothing but regret and a dangling rope.
756163.translation: 许多接近成功的擒手原本都追到能够数清羽毛的距离，但出手后又被其甩开，只能看着绳索落空，抱憾而归。

756164.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756164.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756168.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost. That card gains flashback {o0} until end of turn instead if CARDNAME is saddled.
756168.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得返照异能直到回合结束。其返照费用等同于其法术力费用。如果大法师的蝾螈已乘驾，则改为该牌获得返照{o0}直到回合结束。

756172.oracleText: They cluster near shallow river crossings, blending into the rocks, waiting for unsuspecting travelers to step within range of their claws.
756172.translation: 它们聚集在河口浅滩处，跟四周石头融成一体，静静等着没有提防的旅行者踏入钳子范围。

756174.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, draw a card, then discard a card.
756174.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语，则抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

756177.oracleText: It's amazing how many sticky situations you can get out of simply by being ten times faster than anyone expects.
756177.translation: 有太多的惊险情况，只需动作比其他人想的都要快十倍就能安然脱身。

756181.oracleText: "Heard you've been horning in on my turf. How about I introduce you to some surf?"
756181.translation: 「听说你最近在我的地盘上嚣张。要不要我介绍你点场子去转转？」

756182.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, each opponent mills three cards. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756182.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，每位对手各磨三张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756184.oracleText: No one knew if the waterfall was a natural wonder the djinn guarded or if he'd conjured it to hide something even greater.
756184.translation: 没人知道这瀑布是巨灵守护的自然奇观，还是他为隐藏更大秘密而变化出来的幻象。

756187.oracleText: The best alibi is being in multiple places at the same time.
756187.translation: 最好的不在场证明，便是同时在多个地方出场。

756188.oracleText: Whenever you cast an outlaw spell, copy that spell.
756188.translation: 每当你施放狂徒咒语时，复制该咒语。

756190.translation: 第二十八届世界冠军Nathan Steuer

756191.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of cards you've drawn this turn.
756191.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你本回合已抓的牌数量。

756192.oracleText: Duelist of the Mind's power is equal to the number of cards you've drawn this turn.
756192.translation: 心灵斗客的力量等同于你本回合已抓的牌数量。

756193.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756193.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756195.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and CARDNAME isn't a creature, it becomes a 3/3 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.
756195.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且CARDNAME不是生物，则它成为3/3，具飞行异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

756198.oracleText:
"We should have taken the blasted ferry!"
—Hope Hagan, prospector
756198.translation:
「我们当初就该去坐那该死的渡轮！」
～探矿人霍普海根

756199.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If you control a Desert, surveil 1.
756199.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果你操控沙漠，则刺探1。

756201.oracleText: The top card of your library has plot. The plot cost is equal to its mana cost.
756201.translation: 你的牌库顶牌具有设谋异能。其设谋费用等同于其法术力费用。

756202.oracleText: You may plot nonland cards from the top of your library.
756202.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶设谋非地牌。

756204.oracleText:
"You're not mad I pulled a little prank. You're just mad you fell for it."
—Oko, to Annie Flash
756204.translation:
「你气的不是我小小地骗了你一下。而是气你自己居然被骗了。」
～瓯柯嘲笑电闪安妮

756205.oracleText: Target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it becomes a copy of up to one other target creature.
756205.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。重置该生物。直到回合结束，它成为至多另一个目标生物的复制品。

756207.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell during your turn other than your first spell that turn, create a 2/2 blue and black Zombie Rogue creature token.
756207.translation: 每当你于你回合中你的第一个咒语以外，该回合再施放咒语时，派出一个2/2，蓝黑双色的灵俑／浪客衍生生物。

756210.oracleText: As mating season approaches, drakes dive through scalding geysers, revealing the brightly colored scales hidden beneath layers of dust.
756210.translation: 每逢求偶季节临近的时候，龙兽便会俯冲穿过滚烫喷泉，将覆盖在翅翼上的沙尘洗刷干净，现出隐藏其下的亮丽鳞彩。

756212.oracleText: It can see in both darkness and daylight, but it hunts best when thunder growls in the sky.
756212.translation: 虽然它黑夜白昼视觉并无差异，但漫天雷鸣才是最佳捕猎时期。

756214.oracleText: {o2oU}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

756216.oracleText: Satoru insisted he was just about to free himself.
756216.translation: 梅泽悟一直在抱怨，他本来只差一点就能自己逃掉。

756217.oracleText: + {o3} — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It can't be blocked this turn.
756217.translation: + {o3}～在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它本回合不能被阻挡。

756220.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may exile a nonland card from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
756220.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶等量的牌。你可以放逐其中一张非地牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

756228.oracleText: She poses a riddle to each mark, allowing them a chance to keep their goods. Thus far, none have succeeded.
756228.translation: 她劫掠时都会向对方出谜，让其有机会保住货物。但迄今为止从未有人成功。

756229.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, surveil 2. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756229.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，刺探2。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756231.oracleText: Rundo's craving for revenge was replaced by a craving for vegetables.
756231.translation: 伦多原本满心只争输赢，现在满心只想蔬菜。

756232.oracleText: + {o1} — Until end of turn, target creature becomes a white Rabbit with base power and toughness 0/1.
756232.translation: + {o1}～直到回合结束，目标生物成为基础力量与防御力为0/1的白色兔。

756235.oracleText: The hard part wasn't sneaking aboard. It was safely exiting with Slickshot flair.
756235.translation: 偷偷溜上列车不难，难的在于耍出花枪帮风范的同时安全下车。

756236.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked if you've committed a crime this turn.
756236.translation: 如果你本回合中曾犯下罪行，则CARDNAME不能被阻挡。

756244.oracleText: "Murder someone and you'll have a gaggle of folks lining up for revenge. Humiliate them, and they won't dare bother you again."
756244.translation: 「取人性命，会招来一堆仇家上门。给人教训，他们反而就不敢再来烦你。」

756248.oracleText: To his enemies' chagrin, Winston was every bit as meddlesome dead as he had been alive.
756248.translation: 令他对头懊恼的是，温斯顿死后也跟他生前一样爱管闲事。

756249.oracleText: + {o3} — Create a 2/2 white Spirit creature token with flying.
756249.translation: + {o3}～派出一个2/2白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

756250.oracleText: + {o1} — Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}.
756250.translation: + {o1}～除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。

756252.oracleText: Surveil 3 if you have no cards in hand. Then draw three cards.
756252.translation: 如果你没有手牌，则刺探3。然后抓三张牌。

756255.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. It can't be blocked this turn.
756255.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它本回合不能被阻挡。

756258.oracleText: Nolan refused to give up the vault's location. The strange figure simply smiled and reached into his mind.
756258.translation: 诺兰拒绝透露宝库位置。神秘身影只是笑了笑，随后便径直闯入他的心灵。

756259.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you've committed a crime this turn.
756259.translation: 如果你本回合中曾犯下罪行，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

756261.oracleText: Even when he missed the wrists, a pair of thundercuffs to the head got the job done.
756261.translation: 就算没命中手腕，他这副甩向脑袋的光雷铐也能把事情搞定。

756262.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, choose target creature an opponent controls. If it's tapped, put a stun counter on it. Otherwise, tap it.
756262.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，选择目标由对手操控的生物。如果它已横置，在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。若否，则将之横置。

756264.oracleText: + {o2} — Exchange control of two target creatures.
756264.translation: + {o2}～交换两个目标生物的操控权。

756265.oracleText: + {o1} — Exchange control of two target artifacts.
756265.translation: + {o1}～交换两个目标神器的操控权。

756266.oracleText: + {o1} — Exchange control of two target enchantments.
756266.translation: + {o1}～交换两个目标结界的操控权。

756271.oracleText: "Sure it's risky, but that's what makes it fun! That and the money. And the bankers' faces."
756271.translation: 「当然有风险，但这才是有趣的地方！这个加上钱。加上银行家脸上的表情。」

756272.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
756272.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

756275.oracleText: It once escaped a cook's pot. Now it fears neither heat nor human.
756275.translation: 它曾经从厨子的锅里逃了出来。现在，它既不怕高温，也不怕人类。

756276.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature defending player controls gets -3/-0 until end of turn.
756276.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控的生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。

756279.oracleText: Each player may shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library. Each player who does draws seven cards. Exile CARDNAME.
756279.translation: 每位牌手各可以将其手牌与坟墓场洗入其牌库。每位如此作的牌手各抓七张牌。放逐CARDNAME。

756280.oracleText: Each player may shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library. Each player who does draws seven cards. Exile Step Between Worlds.
756280.translation: 每位牌手各可以将其手牌与坟墓场洗入其牌库。每位如此作的牌手各抓七张牌。放逐界间漫步。

756283.oracleText: Lucky travelers reported a mighty winged creature among the geysers. Unlucky ones didn't make it back.
756283.translation: 幸运的旅行者回报说涌泉之间有个庞大有翼生物。不幸运的旅行者则根本没回来。

756284.oracleText: CARDNAME has hexproof as long as you haven't cast a spell this turn.
756284.translation: 只要你本回合中未施放过咒语，CARDNAME便具有辟邪异能。

756289.oracleText: Dewey had been briefed on every aspect of the plan . . . except the bit where he was left holding the bag.
756289.translation: 杜威在会上听到了这次抢劫计划的所有细节…但就没听说最后只留他下来拎钱袋。

756290.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-0 until end of turn. It gets -4/-0 until end of turn instead if you control an outlaw.
756290.translation: 目标生物得-1/-0直到回合结束。如果你操控狂徒，则改为它得-4/-0直到回合结束。

756292.oracleText: "All that fancy footwork, and you can't even dodge one silly little rope? Cryin' shame, that is."
756292.translation: 「脚下功夫如此华丽，却连这区区细绳都躲不开？让我说，这就是奇耻大辱。」

756293.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a permanent you control.
756293.translation: 如果此咒语以由你操控的永久物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

756295.oracleText: She'd planned for every eventuality, with the obvious exception of failure.
756295.translation: 她计划好了各种结果，其中显然没有失败。

756297.oracleText: + {o3} — Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or creature you control.
756297.translation: + {o3}～派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的神器或生物之复制品。

756298.oracleText: + {o2} — Draw two cards, then discard a card.

756302.oracleText:
"First rule of crossing Blacksnag Bog: if you can't see the bottom, don't."
—Chance Mulligan, wilderness guide
756302.translation:
「穿越墨钩沼的第一条规矩：如果一眼看不到底，就先别动。」
～荒野向导运再来

756306.oracleText: "The tighter I bind them, the looser their tongues become."

756307.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, they discard it. Otherwise, you may put a face-up exiled card they own into their graveyard.
756307.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。如果你如此作，该牌手将它弃掉。若否，则你可以将一张由其拥有且为牌面朝上地放逐的牌置入其坟墓场。

756313.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756313.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756315.oracleText: {o3oB}: Target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
756315.translation: {o3oB}：目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

756317.oracleText: It's never too late to start an afterlife of crime.
756317.translation: 多晚开启犯罪来生都不迟。

756318.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. If an outlaw was sacrificed this way, create a Treasure token.
756318.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。如果以此法牺牲的是狂徒，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

756322.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, reveal the top card of your library and put it into your hand. You lose life equal to that card's mana value if CARDNAME isn't saddled. Otherwise, each opponent loses that much life.
756322.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，展示你的牌库顶牌并置于你手上。如果蚀液野马未乘驾，你失去等同于该牌法术力值的生命。若否，则每位对手各失去该数量的生命。

756325.oracleText: The enforcer only got halfway through the arrest warrant before it—and he—went up in smoke.
756325.translation: 执法者的逮捕令刚展开到一半，整份文件就已灰飞烟灭～连同他一起。

756326.oracleText: Exile target creature. If it had mana value 3 or less, surveil 2.
756326.translation: 放逐目标生物。如果它的法术力值等于或小于3，则刺探2。

756327.oracleText: Every moving carriage is an accident waiting to happen, and the Hellspurs hate waiting.
756327.translation: 每辆奔驰的马车迟早都会出意外，而炼刺帮最讨厌等这个迟早。

756329.oracleText: He was glad when the mirages appeared. At least he wouldn't die alone.
756329.translation: 幻景出现时他很高兴。至少他死的时候不是孤独一人。

756330.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. It gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each Desert you control.
756330.translation: 选择目标生物。该生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。你每操控一个沙漠，它便再得一次-1/-1直到回合结束。

756332.oracleText: With no mammals around, some vampires tried to feed on cactusfolk, with horrible results for everyone involved.
756332.translation: 由于附近几无哺乳类，有些吸血鬼就试着去找仙掌人下口，结果每个人都很惨烈。

756334.oracleText:
"Oh, he's done bothering us. Trust me."
—Dwayne, Hellspur guard
756334.translation:
「噢，他不会再来烦我们了。相信我。」
～炼刺帮守卫德怀恩

756341.oracleText: Skeletons and Zombies you control get +1/+1 and have menace.
756341.translation: 由你操控的骷髅妖和灵俑得+1/+1且具有威慑异能。

756342.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, create two tapped 2/2 blue and black Zombie Rogue creature tokens. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756342.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，派出两个已横置之2/2，蓝黑双色的灵俑／浪客衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756348.oracleText: Akul didn't know what lay inside Tarnation's great vault, but the mystery fueled his obsession.
756348.translation: 阿库尔不知道恶狱镇的大宝库里面藏着什么，但神秘传言令其贪欲越来越旺。

756349.oracleText: + {o2} — Search your library for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top.
756349.translation: + {o2}～从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

756350.oracleText: + {oBoB} — Target player draws three cards and loses 3 life.
756350.translation: + {oBoB}～目标牌手抓三张牌且失去3点生命。

756352.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, exile up to one target black card from your graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy. If you do, you lose 2 life.
756352.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，将至多一张目标黑色牌从你的坟墓场放逐并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品。若你如此作，则你失去2点生命。

756354.oracleText: "Now rip your partner from the grave, and form an undead killing wave!"
756354.translation: 「现在把伙伴从墓里挖出来，形成一股不死杀生浪潮！」

756355.oracleText: + {o1} — Search your library for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle.
756355.translation: + {o1}～从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

756356.oracleText: + {o2} — Return up to two creature cards with total mana value 4 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
756356.translation: + {o2}～将至多两张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于4。

756358.oracleText: "Y'all should've known better than to buy me a coffin!"

756359.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756359.translation: 将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756361.oracleText: "Don't bother getting up. I'll see myself in."

756362.oracleText: Creatures target opponent controls get -1/-1 until end of turn. Surveil 2.
756362.translation: 由目标对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。刺探2。

756365.oracleText: "If they want to get to Prosperity so badly, they can walk there."
756365.translation: 「如果他们真那么想去兴旺镇，还可以走着去。」

756369.oracleText: Not everyone can be a pickpocket.
756369.translation: 并非所有人都能当扒手。

756370.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime during your turn, CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
756370.translation: 每当你于你的回合中犯下罪行时，CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

756373.oracleText: Akul saw his Hellspur followers as little more than ammunition to be expended.
756373.translation: 在阿库尔眼中，他手下的炼刺帮徒跟军火差不多，都是消耗品。

756374.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of permanents you control, then draw that many cards.
756374.translation: 牺牲任意数量由你操控的永久物，然后抓等量的牌。

756378.oracleText: Whenever an outlaw you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
756378.translation: 每当一个由你操控的狂徒死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

756381.oracleText: "Looking for a little liquid courage? I also stock liquid murder, if that's what you're after."
756381.translation: 「在找壮胆烈酒吗？我倒是也有夺命烈酒，我猜你想要的其实是这个。」

756382.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, target creature you control gains your choice of menace or lifelink until end of turn.
756382.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，目标由你操控的生物依你的选择获得威慑或系命异能直到回合结束。

756384.oracleText: A raven sighted at midnight often means there's unkindness on the way.
756384.translation: 午夜看见乌鸦，经常意味着前路险恶。

756385.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756385.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756395.oracleText: + {o2} — Target opponent discards half the cards in their hand, rounded up.
756395.translation: + {o2}～目标对手弃一半数量的手牌，小数点后进位。

756396.oracleText: + {o2} — Target opponent loses half their life, rounded up.
756396.translation: + {o2}～目标对手失去一半生命，小数点后进位。

756398.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, if you've committed a crime this turn, you may sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
756398.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若你本回合中曾犯下罪行，你可以牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

756401.oracleText:
"Now, where is that deputy?"
—Jana, Hellspur thunderslinger
756401.translation:
「告诉我，那警员在哪里？」
～炼刺帮光雷射手雅娜

756403.oracleText: "Why you yellow-bellied, loot-stealing, good-for-nothing, bottom-feeding, dog-faced, lily-livered . . ."
756403.translation: 「你胆小如鼠、中饱私囊、一无是处、欺软怕硬、面容猥琐、畏首畏尾…」

756405.oracleText: It was going to be the greatest heist of his unlife.
756405.translation: 这会是他这辈子最大的一票。

756410.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target nonland permanent card from that player's graveyard, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
756410.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从该牌手的坟墓场中施放目标非地永久物牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放该咒语。

756413.oracleText: The old miners' trail across Blacksnag Bog is littered with lost fortunes and the bones of those who searched for them.
756413.translation: 横穿墨钩沼的旧矿工径上遍布着失落财宝，以及想要寻找它们之探险者的尸骨。

756414.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Pay 1 life: Create a Treasure token.
756414.translation: {o1}，{oT}，支付1点生命：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

756416.oracleText:
"Looks like you've got a train to catch."
—Laughing Jasper Flint
756416.translation:
「你好像有班火车要赶。」
～笑面客燧火贾斯珀

756418.oracleText: + {o1} — Create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756418.translation: + {o1}～派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756424.oracleText: As long as Vadmir has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has menace and lifelink.
756424.translation: 只要瓦米尔上有四个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有威慑与系命异能。

756426.oracleText: "Kind of them to put all their valuables in the same place."
756426.translation: 「他们真好，把所有值钱的东西都放在了一起。」

756430.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756430.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756434.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, choose a nonlegendary creature that saddled it this turn and create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of it. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step. Repeat this process once.
756434.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，选择一个本回合中乘驾它的非传奇生物并派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。将此流程再重复一次。

756437.oracleText: + {o1} — CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each outlaw creature.
756437.translation: + {o1}～CARDNAME对每个狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。

756438.oracleText: + {o1} — Caught in the Crossfire deals 2 damage to each outlaw creature.
756438.translation: + {o1}～卷入争端对每个狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。

756439.oracleText: + {o1} — CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each non-outlaw creature.
756439.translation: + {o1}～CARDNAME对每个非狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。

756440.oracleText: + {o1} — Caught in the Crossfire deals 2 damage to each non-outlaw creature.
756440.translation: + {o1}～卷入争端对每个非狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。

756447.oracleText: Slickshots are always eager to demonstrate their skills to whomever questions them.
756447.translation: 花枪帮的人，总是迫不及待地想要向质疑他们的人展现自身技艺。

756450.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has menace and trample.
756450.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有威慑与践踏异能。

756454.oracleText: "Can I interest you in some herbs from Naktamun? Fresh from the Omenpath! Or a set of Fioran cookware? Finest in the Multiverse!"
756454.translation: 「拿塔蒙的草药要不要来看看？刚从预兆径路到的货！还是想要一套翡欧拉的餐具？全多重宇宙最精美！」

756458.oracleText: + {o2} — CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature.

756459.oracleText: + {o2} — Explosive Derailment deals 4 damage to target creature.
756459.translation: + {o2}～爆破脱轨对目标生物造成4点伤害。

756462.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
756462.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

756463.oracleText: Target creature you control gains menace and haste until end of turn.
756463.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得威慑与敏捷异能。

756464.oracleText: Target creature you control gains menace and haste until end of turn.
756464.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得威慑与敏捷异能。

756465.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one — 
• Target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn. 
• Target creature you control gains menace and haste until end of turn.
756465.translation:
在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项～ 
•目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。 
•直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得威慑与敏捷异能。

756468.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
756468.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

756471.oracleText: + {o2oR} — Untap all creatures you control. If it's your combat phase, there is an additional combat phase after this phase.
756471.translation: + {o2oR}～重置所有由你操控的生物。如果当前是你的战斗阶段，则在此阶段后额外多出一个战斗阶段。

756472.oracleText: + {o2} — Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain first strike until end of turn.
756472.translation: + {o2}～直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。

756473.oracleText: + {oR} — Choose target opponent. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to that player this turn, create a tapped Treasure token.
756473.translation: + {oR}～选择目标对手。本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物对该牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。

756475.oracleText: For years afterward, lucky explorers who found the cave could chip gold fragments off the rocky walls.
756475.translation: 之后许多年，发现这洞窟的幸运探险者都还能从岩石壁上凿下碎金。

756476.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature. Create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the amount of excess damage dealt to that creature this way.
756476.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害。派出若干已横置的珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于以此法对该生物造成的过量伤害数量。

756477.oracleText: Hell to Pay deals X damage to target creature. Create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the amount of excess damage dealt to that creature this way.
756477.translation: 严厉惩罚对目标生物造成X点伤害。派出若干已横置的珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于以此法对该生物造成的过量伤害数量。

756480.oracleText: The last fool who called him "cowboy" earned a free ride to the bottom of Blacksnag Bog.
756480.translation: 前一个叫他「牛仔」的蠢货，早已安静地躺在了墨钩沼底。

756484.oracleText: Other outlaws you control have haste.
756484.translation: 由你操控的其他狂徒具有敏捷异能。

756488.oracleText: The fires weren't even out before the backstabbing began.
756488.translation: 火都还没熄，就已经开始背后捅刀子了。

756489.oracleText: You may discard a card or sacrifice a land. If you do, draw two cards.
756489.translation: 你可以弃一张牌或牺牲一个地。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

756493.oracleText:
"The 3:10 to Omenport will be delayed."
—Prosperity Station announcement
756493.translation:
「3点10分开往预兆港方向的列车因故晚点。」
～兴旺镇车站广播

756494.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent. Scry 1.
756494.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成2点伤害。占卜1。

756502.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, create a tapped Treasure token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756502.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756503.oracleText: Sacrifice three Treasures: Create a 4/4 red Scorpion Dragon creature token with flying and haste. Activate only as a sorcery.
756503.translation: 牺牲三个珍宝：派出一个4/4红色，具飞行与敏捷异能的蝎子／龙衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

756505.oracleText:
"I didn't miss. Blasted thing snatched my bolt out of the air and ate it!"
—Lilah, Slickshot boss
756505.translation:
「我没打偏。那该死的东西一张嘴就在空中缠住了我的那道光雷，然后一口吞了下去！」
～花枪帮首领莉拉

756506.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, CARDNAME deals damage to that player equal to the number of noncreature spells they've cast this turn.
756506.translation: 每当任一牌手施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于其本回合中施放过的非生物咒语数量。

756512.oracleText: The only witness to their rampage was the stoic visage of the moon.
756512.translation: 他们宣泄满腔怒火，唯有冷漠月光见证。

756513.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. If you control an outlaw, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
756513.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。如果你操控狂徒，则放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

756516.oracleText: They grew together, awoke together, and took up arms together. If they were going to fall, they'd do that together too.
756516.translation: 他们一同成长，一同觉醒，一同击火。就算他们要倒下，也会一同如此。

756519.oracleText: The opening of the Omenpaths awoke the wild magic of Thunder Junction. Settlers dubbed it "thunder" and put it to use in everything from farming tools to deadly weapons.
756519.translation: 预兆径路洞开，令光雷驿此时空的狂野魔法随之觉醒。拓荒者称之为「光雷」，用它来驱使各式物品，从开垦农具到致命武器中都能见到。

756520.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains first strike until end of turn. Creatures target opponent controls lose first strike and double strike until end of turn.
756520.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得先攻异能。由目标对手操控的生物均失去先攻与连击异能直到回合结束。

756523.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, it gets +1/+2 and gains menace until end of turn.
756523.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，直到回合结束，它得+1/+2且获得威慑异能。

756526.oracleText: "First to the fray, first to the pay!"

756527.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw a card and create a Treasure token.
756527.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：抓一张牌并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

756530.oracleText:
"Chasing the roadrunner"
—Omenport slang for wasting energy on impossible pursuits
756530.translation:
「追野走鹃」
～预兆港俚语，意指徒劳之举

756532.oracleText: {o3}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste.
756532.translation: {o3}：CARDNAME本回合只能被具敏捷异能的生物阻挡。

756535.oracleText: "Don't you know it's rude not to share?"
756535.translation: 「你不知道不分享很没礼貌吗？」

756536.oracleText: + {o1} — Copy target instant spell, sorcery spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
756536.translation: + {o1}～复制目标瞬间咒语，法术咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

756537.oracleText: + {o1} — Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target.
756537.translation: + {o1}～为仅指定单一目标的目标咒语或异能更改目标。

756539.oracleText:
"My citizens throw good money at them, and for what? Cheap tricks and collateral damage. Damnable Slickshot charlatans."
—Baron Bertram Graywater
756539.translation:
「我的市民在他们身上花了大把的钱，又得到了什么呢？廉价把戏、连带损失。这些可恶的花枪帮骗子。」
～贝特伦灰水男爵

756540.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell each turn, add {oRoR}.
756540.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个咒语时，加{oRoR}。

756542.oracleText: The herd followed him through an Omenpath and found their curiosity rewarded with an untamed world rich with unsuspecting prey.
756542.translation: 恐龙群跟着他穿过了预兆径路，然后发现自己的好奇心换来了丰厚回报～一个满是毫无戒心猎物的未开化世界。

756543.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 3/1 red Dinosaur creature token if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
756543.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则派出一个3/1红色恐龙衍生生物。

756546.oracleText: Most outlaws prefer to strike when there are no witnesses. Slickshots prefer as many as possible.
756546.translation: 大多数狂徒都喜欢等到没人的时候再出手。但花枪帮的人则喜欢人越多越好。

756547.oracleText: Scorching Shot deals 5 damage to target creature.
756547.translation: 焦热击对目标生物造成5点伤害。

756549.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
756549.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

756555.translation: 「你的马该配个更勇敢的骑手！」

756556.oracleText: CARDNAME has flash as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
756556.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，CARDNAME便具有闪现异能。

756557.oracleText: Take for a Ride has flash as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
756557.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，暂借坐骑便具有闪现异能。

756559.oracleText: "You said one weapon in the duel. Ain't my fault you forgot to specify size."
756559.translation: 「你只说了决斗限带一把武器。没说大小可怪不得我。」

756560.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature, where X is 2 plus the number of other spells you've cast this turn.
756560.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为你本回合中施放过的其他咒语数量加2。

756561.oracleText: Thunder Salvo deals X damage to target creature, where X is 2 plus the number of other spells you've cast this turn.
756561.translation: 光雷迸发对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为你本回合中施放过的其他咒语数量加2。

756563.oracleText:
"Cowerin' behind your buddy ain't gonna help, ya yellow-bellied lowlife."
—Tyron, Slickshot duelist
756563.translation:
「畏畏缩缩地躲在同伴后面可救不了命，你这卑劣胆小的混蛋。」
～花枪帮斗客泰隆

756564.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature and 2 damage to up to one other target creature token.
756564.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成6点伤害，并对至多另一个目标衍生生物造成2点伤害。

756565.oracleText: Trick Shot deals 6 damage to target creature and 2 damage to up to one other target creature token.
756565.translation: 特技打击对目标生物造成6点伤害，并对至多另一个目标衍生生物造成2点伤害。

756572.oracleText:
"Little tip, newcomer. Give your boots a shake in the morning before you put them on."
—Annie Flash, to Kellan
756572.translation:
「新来的，有条小建议。早上穿鞋前先抖一抖。」
～电闪安妮告诫凯澜

756576.oracleText: The vault cracked open, and the unlikely alliance met the likeliest of ends, as greed, rage, and self-interest won out over any shred of loyalty.
756576.translation: 随着宝库大门轰然开启，由之迸发的贪念、怒火和私欲胜过了最后一丝忠诚，意料之外组成的联盟最后以意料之中的方式瓦解。

756577.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to each of two other target creatures.
756577.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对另两个目标生物各造成伤害，其数量均等同于前者的力量。

756580.oracleText: As she defends them in their youth, they shall someday defend her in her old age.
756580.translation: 幼狼年少时，她会守在他们身旁；待她年老时，他们就会守在她的身旁。

756584.oracleText: "Wake up, little ones. There's a new day ahead."
756584.translation: 「醒来吧，小家伙。新的一天开始了。」

756586.oracleText: {o3oGoG}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
756586.translation: {o3oGoG}：将每个由你操控的生物上之+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

756589.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control a Desert.
756589.translation: 如果你操控沙漠，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

756590.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw a card.
756590.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以抓一张牌。

756593.oracleText: CARDNAME has flash as long as you control a Desert.
756593.translation: 只要你操控沙漠，CARDNAME便具有闪现异能。

756594.oracleText: Colossal Rattlewurm has flash as long as you control a Desert.
756594.translation: 只要你操控沙漠，庞巨响尾亚龙便具有闪现异能。

756598.oracleText: + {o1} — Search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
756598.translation: + {o1}～从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

756599.oracleText: + {o3} — Create an X/X green Elemental creature token, where X is the number of lands you control.
756599.translation: + {o3}～派出一个X/X绿色元素衍生生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

756602.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
756602.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

756610.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756610.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756612.oracleText: The runaway train tore through the manicured streets of Prosperity, its new conductors reveling in the sheer destruction.
756612.translation: 亡命列车在兴旺镇的规整街道上横冲直撞，各位新任列车员在大肆破坏中尽情狂欢。

756613.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature.
756613.translation: 此生物不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

756614.oracleText: Until end of turn, each creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample and "This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature."
756614.translation: 直到回合结束，每个由你操控的生物各得+2/+2且获得践踏与「此生物不能被多于一个生物阻挡。」

756617.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature that saddled it this turn.
756617.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，在目标本回合中乘驾它的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756620.oracleText: "Don't believe anyone who tells you to bite it. If it's the real thing, you'll know."
756620.translation: 「不管谁让你咬一口试试，都别信他。如果是真东西，你自然会知道的。」

756621.oracleText: Create a Treasure token. Until end of turn, up to one target creature gets +2/+2 for each Treasure you control.
756621.translation: 派出一个珍宝衍生物。选择至多一个目标生物，直到回合结束，你每操控一个珍宝，该生物便得+2/+2。

756623.oracleText: The key is to slay it before it sprouts so many heads that your fear outpaces your greed.
756623.translation: 杀它的关键，在于趁着没长出太多头前就动手，不然就算你贪欲再大也压不住内心恐惧。

756625.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to its power.
756625.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出若干已横置的珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于它的力量。

756629.oracleText: Visitors to the town of Hardbristle found the locals to be quite prickly.
756629.translation: 来到硬鬃镇的旅行者发现当地人个个都是刺头。

756630.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, untap CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756630.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，重置CARDNAME。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756633.oracleText: "Never get too cocky. Remember you stay upright only by your mount's good graces."
756633.translation: 「千万不要自大。别忘了你能够站直全靠坐骑配合。」

756634.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast Mount or Vehicle spells.
756634.translation: {oT}：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。此法术力只能用来施放坐骑或载具咒语。

756636.oracleText: Pioneers with a distaste for crowds and cities are welcomed by the Outcasters, who celebrate solitude and find endless wonder in the natural world.
756636.translation: 莽野帮崇尚独来独往，乐于从自然世界中发掘无限奇观，因而会欢迎厌恶人群和都市的探险先驱加入。

756637.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Desert cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
756637.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或沙漠牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

756640.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
756640.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756641.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, double the number of +1/+1 counters on target creature.
756641.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，将目标生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

756644.oracleText: In the shade of his sword, the desert blooms.
756644.translation: 刀剑所及之处，沙漠绽放鲜花。

756647.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each Desert you control.
756647.translation: 你每操控一个沙漠，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

756654.oracleText: The Atiin delight in delving into the unique wonders of each world they visit.
756654.translation: 亚廷人喜欢深入了解他们造访的每个世界，探寻其间各处独特奇观。

756661.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, it gets +1/+2 until end of turn. Then you may return any number of creatures that saddled it this turn to their owner's hand.
756661.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，它得+1/+2直到回合结束。然后你可以将任意数量本回合中乘驾它的生物移回其拥有者手上。

756665.oracleText: It's not hard to know the right song for the occasion when most occasions are saloon brawls.
756665.translation: 根据场合来演奏乐曲一点都不难～特别是绝大多数都是酒馆斗殴的情况下。

756668.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+2 and has reach.
756668.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+2且具有延势异能。

756671.oracleText: Create X 2/1 green Varmint creature tokens, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
756671.translation: 派出X个2/1绿色害兽衍生生物，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

756673.oracleText: + {o2} — Mill four cards. You may put up to two creature and/or land cards from among the milled cards into your hand.
756673.translation: + {o2}～磨四张牌。你可以将至多两张生物和／或地牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。

756674.oracleText: + {o4oG} — You may put up to two creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
756674.translation: + {o4oG}～你可以将至多两张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

756675.oracleText: + {o1} — Creatures you control with power 4 or greater gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
756675.translation: + {o1}～由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

756676.oracleText: Most travelers panic when they stumble upon the skin of a giant rattlewurm. Landry saw it as a gift.
756676.translation: 大多数旅行者在踩到巨型响尾亚龙褪掉的皮时都会慌张不已。但兰德里会觉得这是上天赐予的厚礼。

756684.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes saddled for the first time each turn, mill two cards, then CARDNAME gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
756684.translation: 每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为已乘驾时，磨两张牌，然后CARDNAME兽得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

756687.oracleText:
"A little kindness would've carried you a lot farther than those spurs."
—Miriam, herd whisperer
756687.translation:
「如果想要坐骑载你走远路，或许和善相待效果会比马刺催促更好。」
～兽群语者米莉安

756688.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it instead if it's a Mount. Then it deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
756688.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果它是坐骑，则改为在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

756690.oracleText: + {o2} — Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
756690.translation: + {o2}～在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

756691.oracleText: + {o1} — Target creature gains trample until end of turn.
756691.translation: + {o1}～目标生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

756692.oracleText: + {o1} — Until end of turn, target creature gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw two cards."
756692.translation: + {o1}～直到回合结束，目标生物获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓两张牌。」

756694.oracleText: When weeds tumble against the wind, run.

756695.oracleText: Create an X/X green Elemental creature token, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
756695.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色元素衍生生物，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。

756698.oracleText:
"A varmint's diet consists of anything it can fit into its mouth and a surprising number of things it can't."
—Doc Aurlock
756698.translation:
「所有能塞进嘴巴里的东西害兽都吃。塞不进的东西它们也吃，数量还相当不少。」
～道奥洛克

756702.oracleText: Crackling with rage and stolen thunder, he drives the Hellspurs to ever-greater heights of violence.
756702.translation: 在自身怒火驱使与窃得光雷声威下，他将炼刺帮的暴行提升到了全新高度。

756703.oracleText: Sacrifice three other creatures: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
756703.translation: 牺牲三个其他生物：你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。只能于法术时机起动，且每回合限一次。

756707.oracleText: Whenever Annie Flash becomes tapped, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
756707.translation: 每当电闪安妮成为横置时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

756709.oracleText: One last job, then she could retire in peace.
756709.translation: 干完这最后一票，她就可以安心退休了。

756712.oracleText: If a triggered ability of a legendary creature you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
756712.translation: 如果由你操控的传奇生物之触发式异能触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

756716.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes attached to a creature, for as long as CARDNAME remains attached to it, that creature becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with CARDNAME.
756716.translation: 每当CARDNAME新贴附在任一生物上时，于CARDNAME仍贴附于其上的时段内，该生物成为以CARDNAME放逐之任一生物牌的复制品。

756720.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery." This ability triggers only once each turn.
756720.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756722.oracleText: The cactusfolk were a young culture, but they already knew the pains of death and joys of birth.
756722.translation: 虽然仙掌人文化底蕴尚浅，但他们也已深知死别的痛楚与新生的快乐。

756723.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Return up to one target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
756723.translation: 将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。将至多一张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

756725.oracleText: "Of course the law's on my side. I wrote it."
756725.translation: 「法律当然站在我这边。那是我写的。」

756727.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Draw a card.
756727.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：抓一张牌。

756731.oracleText: Whenever you attack, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield.
756731.translation: 每当你攻击时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上或你坟墓场中放进战场。

756733.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, flip a coin. When you win the flip, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. When you lose the flip, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target.
756733.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，你可以牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则掷一枚硬币。当你猜对此掷时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。当你猜错此掷时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

756736.oracleText: "I find a world where the herds finally listen to me, but now the plants have an attitude?"
756736.translation: 「我终于找到了一个兽群都听我话的世界，但现在轮到植物闹脾气了？」

756737.oracleText: Oxen you control have double strike.
756737.translation: 由你操控的牛具有连击异能。

756741.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, other creatures you control with power 4 or greater gain trample and haste until end of turn.
756741.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，由你操控且力量等于或大于4的其他生物获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

756744.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Mounts you control.
756744.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的坐骑数量。

756747.oracleText: "Learning stops only when you close your mind off to wonder."
756747.translation: 「只有在你封闭思维、不接受奇迹的时候，学习才会停止。」

756748.oracleText: Spells you cast from your graveyard or from exile cost {o2} less to cast.
756748.translation: 你从你坟墓场或放逐区中施放的咒语减少{o2}来施放。

756749.oracleText: Plotting cards from your hand costs {o2} less.
756749.translation: 从你手上设谋牌的费用减少{o2}。

756751.oracleText: "Your dreams and mine will soon align."
756751.translation: 「你我的梦境很快就会变得一样。」

756752.oracleText: Whenever an Aura you control becomes attached to a nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to that Aura's mana value, gain control of that permanent for as long as that Aura is attached to it.
756752.translation: 每当一个由你操控的灵气新贴附在任一由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于该灵气之法术力值的非地永久物上时，于该灵气贴附于后者上的时段内，你获得该永久物的操控权。

756756.oracleText: Whenever you activate an ability that targets a creature or player, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
756756.translation: 每当你起动以生物或牌手为目标的异能时，复制该异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

756758.oracleText: The terms were simple: half in advance, half when the entire town belonged to their employer.
756758.translation: 条件很简单：款项先给一半，另一半等整座镇子都归雇主之后再给。

756759.oracleText: Create X 1/1 red Mercenary creature tokens with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756759.translation: 派出X个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756761.oracleText: "The Conclave was soft. The Clans were trapped beasts. Here in this untamed wilderness, nature can truly roam free."
756761.translation: 「盟会软弱无能。部落则是笼中困兽。只有在这片未开化荒野上，自然才能真正无拘奔腾。」

756766.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice a creature that saddled it this turn. If you do, draw X cards, then put up to X land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
756766.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以牺牲一个本回合中乘驾它的生物。若你如此作，则你抓X张牌，然后将至多X张地牌从你手上横置放进战场，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

756774.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, you may return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
756774.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，你可以将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

756777.oracleText: The nomadic Atiin rarely settle anywhere for more than a few seasons, but Jem never lets that stop her from seeing every last corner.
756777.translation: 虽然游牧民族亚廷从来不会在同一处长居数季，但这也不会让简停下探遍当地的脚步。

756778.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, draw a card.
756778.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语，则抓一张牌。

756780.oracleText: "So, are we doing this the easy way or the fun way?"
756780.translation: 「那你想怎么解决，轻松点还是有趣点？」

756781.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more creatures with power 4 or greater, create a Treasure token.
756781.translation: 每当你以一个或数个力量等于或大于4的生物攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

756782.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice a Treasure: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
756782.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲一个珍宝：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

756793.oracleText: "I found out who I was. Now it's time to discover who I am."
756793.translation: 「我已弄清自己过去来历。现在该来探寻当下自我。」

756794.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, you may cast a permanent spell with equal or lesser mana value from your hand without paying its mana cost. If you don't, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
756794.translation: 每当你从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值相等或较小的永久物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你未如此作，则你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

756796.oracleText: Concerned for his apprentice's welfare, Ludevic sent his greatest creation to make sure Geralf got into the right kind of trouble.
756796.translation: 卢德维担心自己的学徒遇险，便派出自己最厉害的作品来确保基拉夫惹对麻烦。

756797.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and draw a card.
756797.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

756800.oracleText: Creatures you control but don't own are Mercenaries in addition to their other types.
756800.translation: 由你操控但不由你拥有的生物额外具有佣兵此类别。

756801.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top X cards of target opponent's library, where X is the number of outlaws you control. Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among those cards, and mana of any type can be spent to cast those spells.
756801.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐目标对手牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控的狂徒数量。直到回合结束，你可以从这些牌之中施放咒语，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放。

756806.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored instant or sorcery spell from your hand, exile that spell instead of putting it into your graveyard as it resolves. If you do, it becomes plotted.
756806.translation: 每当你从你手上施放多色瞬间或法术咒语，于该咒语结算时，改为将它放逐，而非置入你的坟墓场。若你如此作，则它成为已设谋。

756808.oracleText:
"Aim alone won't win you a duel if you can't keep your nerve."
—Annie Flash
756808.translation:
「如果你静不下心，光瞄得准可没法赢决斗。」
～电闪安妮

756809.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may exile a nonland card from among them. If you do, it becomes plotted. Put the rest into your hand.
756809.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以放逐其中一张非地牌。如果你如此作，则它成为已设谋。将其余的牌置于你手上。

756811.oracleText: "It's funny how rarely folks here think to look up."
756811.translation: 「真有趣，这里的人都不会想着往天上看一看。」

756812.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, investigate.
756812.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，探查。

756814.oracleText: "You should have folded when you had the chance."
756814.translation: 「你在原本还有机会时就该收手了。」

756815.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, you may pay {o1}. If you do, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
756815.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

756817.oracleText: "Anything willing to bear your weight and save your feet a trip across the hot sands deserves respect. Show some."
756817.translation: 「不管是什么动物，只要它愿承载你的重量，帮你在穿越火热沙漠时节省脚程，你就该好好谢谢它。别吝啬情感。」

756819.oracleText: Whenever a Mount or Vehicle you control attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
756819.translation: 每当一个由你操控的坐骑或载具攻击时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756821.translation: 「你的生命不过是在苟延残喘。」

756822.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you get that many additional upkeep steps after this phase.
756822.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你在此阶段后额外得到等量的维持步骤。

756825.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, CARDNAME becomes a copy of up to one target creature you control until end of turn, except he has hexproof.
756825.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，CARDNAME成为至多一个目标由你操控的生物之复制品直到回合结束，但他具有辟邪异能。

756827.oracleText: Draw two cards. If you've committed a crime this turn, discard a card. Otherwise, discard two cards.
756827.translation: 抓两张牌。如果你本回合中曾犯下罪行，弃一张牌。若否，则弃两张牌。

756828.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Elk creature token.
756828.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色麋鹿衍生生物。

756829.oracleText: For each other nonland permanent you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent.
756829.translation: 对每个由你操控的其他非地永久物而言，派出一个为该永久物之复制品的衍生物。

756831.oracleText: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is twice the number of lands you control. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
756831.translation: 检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控之地数量的两倍。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

756836.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control dies, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that creature's power to target opponent.
756836.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传奇生物死去时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成伤害，其数量等同于该生物的力量。

756837.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control dies, Rakdos Joins Up deals damage equal to that creature's power to target opponent.
756837.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传奇生物死去时，拉铎司入伙向目标对手造成伤害，其数量等同于该生物的力量。

756840.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another creature, exile cards equal to its mana value from the top of target player's library. Until your next end step, you may play those cards, and mana of any type can be spent to cast those spells.
756840.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个生物时，放逐目标牌手牌库顶的若干牌，其数量等同于该生物的法术力值。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用这些牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放这些咒语。

756841.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it. Activate only once each turn.
756841.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。每回合只能起动一次。

756844.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play it.
756844.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

756845.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play it.
756845.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

756846.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. It gains trample until end of turn.
756846.translation: 在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

756848.oracleText: Create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying.
756848.translation: 派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

756849.oracleText: Create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying.
756849.translation: 派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

756850.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a modal spell, choose up to X, where X is the number of times you chose a mode for that spell — 
• Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play it. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. It gains trample until end of turn. 
• Create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying.
756850.translation:
每当你施放具有模式的咒语时，选择至多X项，X为你选中该咒语各项模式的次数总和～ 
•放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。 
•在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。 
•派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

756855.oracleText: Whenever you tap an artifact token for mana, add one mana of any type that artifact token produced.
756855.translation: 每当你横置一个衍生神器以产生法术力时，加一点该衍生神器已产生的类别之法术力。

756857.oracleText: There's only one law that truly matters to the Sterling Company: never stand in the way of profit.
756857.translation: 银光社真正在意的法律只有一条：千万别挡生财道。

756861.oracleText: "This backwater doesn't have a single wall, ward, or guard that could keep me out."
756861.translation: 「这片与世隔绝的地方没有一处高墙、护咒或守卫能拦得住我。」

756865.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756865.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756866.oracleText: {oT}: Choose a color. Add one mana of that color for each different power among creatures you control.
756866.translation: {oT}：选择一种颜色。由你操控的生物中每有一种力量数值，便加一点该色的法术力。

756869.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
756869.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

756873.oracleText: "Shooting first don't mean much if you ain't got proper follow-through."
756873.translation: 「如果后续没有连上整套动作，抢得开火先机也没有太大意义。」

756874.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. If you've cast another spell this turn, draw a card.
756874.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。如果你本回合中施放过另一个咒语，则抓一张牌。

756875.oracleText: Slick Sequence deals 2 damage to any target. If you've cast another spell this turn, draw a card.
756875.translation: 顺势连环对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。如果你本回合中施放过另一个咒语，则抓一张牌。

756877.oracleText: "You'd best keep yourself out of my sights."

756878.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to a creature equal to that creature's toughness, draw a card.
756878.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源对任一生物造成等同于该生物防御力的非战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

756879.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: If a source you control would deal noncombat damage to a permanent or player this turn, it deals that much damage plus X instead.
756879.translation: {oX}，{oT}：本回合中，如果某个由你操控的来源将对任一永久物或牌手造成非战斗伤害，则改为它造成原数量加X点伤害。

756881.oracleText: It wasn't quite home, but the fire still burned bright and the bombs still went boom.
756881.translation: 虽然这里不是家乡，但火焰同样旺盛，炸弹依然爆响。

756885.oracleText: Letting Oko believe he held all the cards provided the perfect cover for her own scheme to unfold.
756885.translation: 让瓯柯误信他已掌握所有底牌，就是让自己计划逐渐成形的最佳掩护。

756888.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
756888.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传奇生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

756890.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature an opponent controls dies, you may pay {o1}. If you do, return that card to the battlefield tapped under your control. It's a Treasure artifact with "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color," and it loses all other card types.
756890.translation: 每当一个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则将该牌在你的操控下横置移回战场。它是具有「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力」的珍宝神器，且失去所有其他牌张类别。

756892.translation: 「伙记，心愿未了这事有好有坏。」
