823541.oracleText: Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1 for each fellowship counter on this artifact.
823541.translation: 此神器上每有一个情谊指示物，由你操控且为所选类别的生物便得+1/+1。

823543.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Tap Fishing Pole: Put a bait counter on Fishing Pole.
823543.translation: {o1}，{oT}：横置钓鱼竿：在钓鱼竿上放置一个钓饵指示物。

823544.oracleText: Equipped creature has "{o1}, {oT}, Tap Fishing Pole: Put a bait counter on Fishing Pole."
823544.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「{o1}，{oT}：横置钓鱼竿：在钓鱼竿上放置一个钓饵指示物。」

823545.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature becomes untapped, remove a bait counter from this Equipment. If you do, create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token.
823545.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物成为未横置时，从此武具上移去一个钓饵指示物。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物。

823547.translation: 它还在等待相配的主人。

823548.oracleText: If this card is in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield.
823548.translation: 如果你的起手牌中包含了此牌，则你可以让它在战场上来开始游戏。

823550.oracleText:
"Draw swiftly, strike cleanly, and sheathe before the ground tastes blood."
—Munetsugu Takeno, Way of the Samurai
823550.translation:
「迅速拔刀，利落斩击；血花舞空，刀已回鞘，」
～武野宗继，《武士道》

823551.oracleText: During your turn, equipped creature gets +2/+0 and has first strike.
823551.translation: 于你的回合中，佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0且具有先攻异能。

823553.oracleText: Each of its owners' final moments is remembered within the roiling stone.
823553.translation: 石头内里躁动不已，塞满主人临终时刻的每片回忆。

823554.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Draw a card and put a soul counter on this artifact. Activate only as a sorcery.
823554.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：抓一张牌并在此神器上放置一个灵魂指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

823555.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of soul counters on this artifact.
823555.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：每位对手各失去等同于此神器上灵魂指示物数量的生命。

823557.oracleText: It spreads the machine gospel of New Phyrexia, its task incomplete until all surrender to perfection.
823557.translation: 它致力传扬新非瑞克西亚的机械福音；直到万众臣服于完美，其任务才算圆满。

823558.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player draws a card.
823558.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每位牌手各抓一张牌。

823559.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life.
823559.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌时，该牌手失去1点生命。

823561.oracleText: By tradition, travelers touched the pillar for good luck. One day, it decided to travel as well.
823561.translation: 根据习俗，旅人触摸这根石柱可以祈求好运。而有一天，它决定自己也该去旅行。

823562.oracleText: {o4}: This land becomes a 3/3 creature with vigilance and all creature types. It's still a land.
823562.translation: {o4}：此地成为3/3，具警戒异能和所有生物类别的生物。它仍然是地。

823567.oracleText: Once rejected by his pride, Ajani is now revered by countless leonin as a healer and, more importantly, a friend.
823567.translation: 阿耶尼曾被自己的狮群驱逐，如今的他已为无数狮族尊为治疗名师与可靠朋友。

823571.oracleText: Clerics on both sides prayed for divine intervention to end the war. The gods didn't play favorites.
823571.translation: 两边的僧侣都向神明祈祷，希望能得其显威结束战争。但神明并没选边站。

823572.oracleText: Now she is New Capenna's greatest hope.
823572.translation: 现在她就是新卡佩纳最大的希望。

823573.oracleText: As far as the dog was concerned, anything that fit in its mouth was a toy.
823573.translation: 在狗看来，它张嘴能咬下的东西都是玩具。

823575.oracleText:
One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable.
—Benalish proverb
823575.translation:
雄狮独行威震四方；雄狮成群势不可当。
～宾纳里亚谚语

823576.oracleText:
"Who was that knight, so graceful and strong? Why did she flee before the food was gone?"
—Tale of the Masked Maiden
823576.translation:
「优雅女骑士，芳名为何？食未尽而去，又是为何？」
～《覆面女侠传》

823577.oracleText: On Ikoria, even the gentlest creatures are constantly evolving, outpacing tooth and claw with mighty natural armor.
823577.translation: 在依克黎，就连这最温顺的生物也得以不断进化，以生出尖牙利爪不侵的天然护甲。

823581.oracleText:
"The greatest victory is a battle unfought."
—Tome of Obstructions
823581.translation:
「最好的胜利就是不战而胜。」
～《障法巨著》

823583.oracleText: "Just one aether tiger? What do I look like, a peasant?"
823583.translation: 「才一头乙太虎？我看上去像是农村来的吗？」

823584.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of another target nonland permanent you control.
823584.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标由你操控的非地永久物之复制品。

823589.oracleText: "I think you'll find my terms quite agreeable, if you know what's good for you."
823589.translation: 「你要是知道什么对自己最好，不是该立刻接受我的条件吗？」

823592.oracleText: "I didn't say I would help you find your way home. I said I would help you finish your adventure."
823592.translation: 「我没说会帮你找路回家。而是说会助你结束冒险。」

823594.oracleText: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

823595.oracleText:
"If none of the bones are original, is it even the same skele—aaagh!"
—Mort the Philosopher, last words
823595.translation:
「如果每一根骨头都已经不是原本的，那这就不能说是同一具骷～啦啊啊！」
～哲学家末忒的遗言

823600.oracleText: Unlike Innistrad's more ostentatious vampire families, Stromkirk vampires take pride in silence and subterfuge.
823600.translation: 溪堡的吸血鬼崇尚低调隐匿，与依尼翠的浮夸吸血鬼家族大大不同。

823606.oracleText: In subsequent terms, first-year students were prohibited from enrolling in Introduction to Dragonkeeping.
823606.translation: 那学期之后，育龙导论这门课便禁止新生选修。

823607.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature or Dragon spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
823607.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语或龙咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

823618.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. 
• Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
823618.translation:
选择一项～ 
•由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。 
•派出两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

823620.oracleText: Once a mortal ogre, Hidetsugu devoured his demonic patron and transcended mortality in a fit of rage.
823620.translation: 碑出告曾是凡命食人魔，在盛怒之下吞噬自己的崇魔信众，便从此超脱了死亡命运。

823623.oracleText: "Threats? Extortion? Good sir, you have me all wrong. I am a legitimate businessman; my colleagues and I are simply here to conduct legitimate business."
823623.translation: 「威胁？勒索？先生您误会了。我是个规规矩矩的生意人，和朋友来这里规规矩矩地作生意。」

823624.oracleText: The raiding party advanced on the lone figure, confident they had her cornered and helpless. Then she raised her hands, and the ground opened with a fiery roar.
823624.translation: 劫匪冲向那孤独的身影，还以为她已经无处可逃；不料她抬起双手，顿时火焰咆哮、大地崩裂。

823632.oracleText:
"All the fancy spells and diabolical machines in the Multiverse are nothing compared to a good chomp."
—Vivien Reid
823632.translation:
「多重宇宙中所有的精巧咒语和凶恶器械，都敌不过及时一咬。」
～薇薇安瑞德

823638.oracleText: "They said we were weak, did they? Let's show them what happens when we fight as one!"
823638.translation: 「他们是不是小看我们？大家团结起来给个好看！」

823639.oracleText: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.
823639.translation: 罗堰森林的妖精代代守护此地，保护祖传家园不被外界影响污染是他们的神圣责任。

823641.oracleText: She had always believed in the transformative powers of great literature.
823641.translation: 她一直相信文学巨著能够转化人性。

823642.oracleText: {o3oG}: CARDNAME becomes a Werewolf. Put two +1/+1 counters on it and you draw a card. Activate only once.
823642.translation: {o3oG}：CARDNAME成为狼人。在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物且你抓一张牌。只能起动一次。

823647.oracleText: Giorgio paced the stage anxiously. This was their final rehearsal, but there were still so many mistakes!
823647.translation: 丘裘在舞台上不安地踱步。都已经是最终彩排了，怎么还有那么多问题！

823653.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens.
823653.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出等量的1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

823655.oracleText: {oT}, Tap ten untapped Elves you control: Each opponent loses 10 life and you gain 10 life.
823655.translation: {oT}，横置十个由你操控且未横置的妖精：每位对手各失去10点生命，且你获得10点生命。

823662.oracleText:
"Cyclical as the passing of days, the fiend would return again. And like the sun rising, so would a champion to slay it."
—Heroics: A Book of Fables
823662.translation:
「如同日月交替一般，邪魔必定会再度现身；而如同旭日东升一般，英雄必定会出世将其斩杀。」
～《勇行故事：寓言合辑》

823664.oracleText: Sailors swear by the Sphinx's stars, which always seem to point the way home.
823664.translation: 水手们相信史芬斯星群总是能指引归途。

823669.oracleText: "Follow me. I know these hills like the back of my stabbing knife."
823669.translation: 「跟我来。我对这片山丘了如指掌。」

823672.oracleText: "Hello again, my metamorphic friends. What stories have you brought to tell me today?"
823672.translation: 「又见面了，蜕变朋友们。今天你们带来了怎样的故事？」

823674.oracleText: Within sky-scraping gardens, New Capenna's fashionable druids maintain the last ties to the war-ravaged land their ancestors left behind.
823674.translation: 在高耸入云的花园中，新卡佩纳的时尚德鲁伊仍在照料着祖先留给他们的这片饱受战争摧残的土地。

823675.oracleText:
"Those who do evil shall face wrath unrelenting."
—Memorial inscription
823675.translation:
「作恶者定遭无情惩罚。」
～纪念碑铭文

823687.oracleText: "Horizon to horizon, mountain to sea. Everything within is ours to protect."
823687.translation: 「视界所及，山海之内，此间万物皆由吾人守护。」

823688.oracleText: Even millennia later, some war machines from the devastating Brothers' War continue to function. Thankfully, the weapons meant to destroy them still work too.
823688.translation: 即使千年过去，在那场毁天灭地的兄弟之战中留下的战争机械仍在运行。所幸用来摧毁它们的武器也仍然有效。

823700.oracleText: The god Kruphix was born when mortals first looked to the horizon and wondered what lay beyond.
823700.translation: 当凡人首次仰望天际，思索彼方究竟藏有何物时，神明克罗芬斯便由此诞生。

823702.oracleText: "Brother, your fate has always been bound to mine. Now we have reached the place where they shall both end."
823702.translation: 「兄弟，你我命运自始便紧密相连。如今我们已来到终结之地。」

823707.oracleText: The battalion thought they could escape the fog by marching in a straight line. Three days later, they began to suspect it was following them.
823707.translation: 部队以为只要笔直前行就能逃出迷雾。三天后，他们开始怀疑迷雾在跟着他们。

823716.oracleText: The waters that give the River Herald merfolk their name are sacred to their culture; they do not abide invaders to sail upon them.
823716.translation: 让川流使人鱼得名的河流在其文化中地位神圣；他们绝不容许侵略者在此航行。

823719.oracleText: "Oh, yes, many have come to take my power for their own. They will tell you all about their exploits when you meet them on the sea floor."
823719.translation: 「哦，是的，许多人都想来夺取我的力量。等你在海底遇见他们时，他们自会告诉你他们的丰功。」

823720.oracleText: Tolarian apprentices learn to liberate aetheric energy long before they are taught to bind it.
823720.translation: 陶拉里亚学徒在学习如何束缚乙太能量之前，早已学会如何将其解放。

823728.oracleText:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

823729.oracleText: Each player mills X cards. For each creature card put into a graveyard this way, you create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
823729.translation: 每位牌手各磨X张牌。每以此法将一张生物牌置入坟墓场，你便派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

823734.oracleText:
"Give of yourself, for compleation awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred
823734.translation:
「请先奉献自己，因唯有已涤净者方得完化。」
～希欧蕊僧侣诺卡

823750.oracleText:
"Secluded park. Dual puncture wounds. I told you these aren't random murders. Get the stakes ready."
—Rem Karolus, monster slayer
823750.translation:
「公园偏僻处。两道穿刺伤。我告诉过你们这不是随机杀人。备好木桩。」
～怪物克星连卡洛

823753.oracleText: The dead are lonely in the crypt and always eager for company.
823753.translation: 墓穴亡者甚感寂寥，时时盼望有伴相陪。

823774.oracleText:
"The bad news is the siege wall is gone. The good news is I've got ideas for a new battering ram."
—Sergeant Ginnick
823774.translation:
「坏消息是攻城墙没了。好消息是我对攻城锤有个新点子。」
～吉尼克中士

823807.oracleText: "Once, my guild welcomed outsiders. Too many preyed on our generosity, mistaking it for weakness. No more."
823807.translation: 「曾经，我的公会欢迎外来者。太多人利用了我们的慷慨，把这错当成软弱。到此为止了。」

823809.oracleText: Keldons live for the fervor of battle, as eager to receive scars as they are to give them.
823809.translation: 凯尔顿人为战斗的热爱而生，既渴望受疤在身，也渴望施疤于人。

823813.oracleText: The queen sent her champion to defeat the necromancer terrorizing the city. She found his helmet the next day, warped and stained in blood.
823813.translation: 女王派出她的勇士去清理死灵术士的威胁。翌日他的头盔被送了回来，扭曲变形，沾满鲜血。

823833.oracleText: Feldon bartered the second of these canes from a Yumok fisherman who had been using it as a boat tiller.
823833.translation: 第二根手杖是费顿从一位尤莫克渔夫手中换得，之前它一直被当做船桨。

823837.oracleText: Chandra treasures her mentor's goggles, not for their magical properties, but for the memory of the woman who taught her to truly harness the power of fire.
823837.translation: 茜卓珍视她导师留下的护目镜，不是因为它的魔法特性，而是为纪念那位教会她真正驾驭烈火之力的女性。

823853.oracleText: "But I brought enough for the whole class!"

823859.oracleText: What was supposed to be a quiet time in town turned into an adventure of its own.
823859.translation: 小镇原本的恬静时光平添几道浓墨重彩。

823861.oracleText:
"I'm not sure we can outlast them, Captain. Their ammunition appears to be lava, Captain."
—Stubert, pirate gunner
823861.translation:
「我不确定我们能否从他们这挺过去，船长。看起来他们的弹药是熔岩，船长。」
～海盗炮手斯图伯

823877.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.
823877.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此衍生物：你获得3点生命。

823878.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.
823878.translation: {oT}，牺牲此衍生物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

823880.translation: 指定一个由你操控的鬼怪为目标。

823882.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less.
823882.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物牌为目标。

823883.oracleText: Separate the top five cards of your library into a face-down pile and a face-up pile.
823883.translation: 将你牌库顶五张牌分为两堆，一堆面朝上，一堆面朝下。

823884.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls.
823884.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。

823885.oracleText: Return an instant or sorcery card to your hand.
823885.translation: 将一张瞬间或法术牌移回你手上。

823886.oracleText: Target a creature card from a graveyard that was put there this turn.
823886.translation: 指定一张坟墓场中的生物牌为目标，且须为本回合中进入该处者。

823888.oracleText: Target up to one Equipment attached to that creature.
823888.translation: 指定至多一个贴附在该生物上的武具为目标。

823889.oracleText: Reveal a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of lands you control?
823889.translation: 是否要展示一张法术力值等于或小于由你操控之地数量的生物牌？

823891.oracleText: Reveal cards from the top of your library?
823891.translation: 是否要从你的牌库顶开始展示牌？

823895.oracleText: Tap ten untapped Elves you control.
823895.translation: 横置十个由你操控且未横置的妖精。

823897.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever CARDNAME or another enchantment you control enters, choose target creature you control. Until end of turn, that creature has base power and toughness 4/4 and gains flying.
823897.translation: 星彩～每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，选择目标由你操控的生物。直到回合结束，该生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4且获得飞行异能。

823901.oracleText: "I seek no fight with you, but neither will I stand aside."
823901.translation: 「我不愿与你动手，但也绝不会让步。」

823906.oracleText: They communicate via the universal language of treats.
823906.translation: 美食这一普世认知，令它们彼此沟通毫无隔阂。

823907.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. This ability triggers only once each turn.
823907.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

823910.oracleText: "What do you think? New class pet?"
823910.translation: 「你们觉得怎样？新的教室宠物？」

823911.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each spell your opponents have cast this turn.
823911.translation: 所有对手本回合中每施放过一个咒语，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

823913.oracleText: "ATTENTION BEACHGOERS: This is a litter-free zone. Violators will be pinched."
823913.translation: 「致海滩游客：此处禁丢垃圾。违者必夹。」

823918.oracleText: It materialized in the mist, and the invading horde broke like waves against solid rock.
823918.translation: 它甫自雾中现形，便见汹涌来敌顿时像路遇岩石的浪涛一般，撞到屏障上后便四下散去。

823923.oracleText: "Arise, sister. Our journey has only just begun."
823923.translation: 「姐妹，醒过来吧。我们的旅程才刚刚开始。」

823924.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a creature card with mana value 3 or less.
823924.translation: 如果此咒语以法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

823925.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain 2 life.
823925.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。你获得2点生命。

823928.oracleText: Her hunger for blood is matched only by her hunger for vengeance.
823928.translation: 她渴求鲜血，正如她渴望复仇。

823929.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
823929.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

823932.oracleText: The professor of essence studies always relished the looks on the first-years' faces as their vivisections descended into chaos.
823932.translation: 每当新生的解剖实验陷入混乱时，他们脸上的各种表情总能让菁华学教授受用不已。

823933.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create two 1/1 black and green Worm creature tokens.
823933.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出两个1/1，黑绿双色的蠕虫衍生生物。

823935.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature or Dragon spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
823935.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语或龙咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

823938.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste.
823938.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1红色，具敏捷异能的士兵衍生生物。

823940.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single creature you control, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste, then copy that spell. The copy targets that token.
823940.translation: 每当你施放仅以单一由你操控之生物为目标的咒语时，派出一个1/1红色，具敏捷异能的士兵衍生生物，然后复制该咒语。此复制品以该衍生物为目标。

823942.oracleText:
"With you by my side, I am unstoppable."
—Halana, to Alena
823942.translation:
「有你在身边，我无人能敌。」
～荷拉娜私语阿雷娜

823943.oracleText: One or two target creatures each get +2/+1 until end of turn.
823943.translation: 一个或两个目标生物各得+2/+1直到回合结束。

823946.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice the token at the beginning of the next end step.
823946.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，选择目标由你操控的生物。派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

823949.oracleText: "If the fire is silent, I‘m technically not breaking the library rules!"
823949.translation: 「如果火焰没声音，那严格来说我也没违反图书馆的规矩！」

823950.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. You may cast that card until the end of your next turn.
823950.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

823953.oracleText: Spark or no, Nissa would always be an explorer.
823953.translation: 不管有没有火花，妮莎都会是探险家。

823954.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. 
• Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
823954.translation:
选择一项～ 
•从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。 
•目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

823956.oracleText: It supplements its leafy diet with delicacies snatched from low-flying airships.
823956.translation: 它虽以树叶为主食，但偶尔也会从低空飞过的飞船抓取食品来调剂。

823960.oracleText: "Let the beauty of our land lull them so that they may stumble upon its hidden thorns."
823960.translation: 「用我们家园的美丽景色让敌人放松警惕，这样他们就会踩上隐藏其下的陷阱。」

823961.oracleText: {o8}: CARDNAME and up to one other target creature each get +3/+3 until end of turn.
823961.translation: {o8}：CARDNAME和至多另一个目标生物各得+3/+3直到回合结束。

823964.translation: 它自己就是一个生生不息，自给自足的生态系统。

823968.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. 
• Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
823968.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

823971.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature instead.
823971.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则改为将该生物上的+1/+1指示物数量翻倍。

823974.oracleText: All throughout the glade, sprouts squelched happily along to the tune.
823974.translation: 整片林地从里到外，所有新芽都快乐地随着乐曲抽枝伸展。

823975.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If you control four or more creatures, it gets +2/+2 and gains indestructible until end of turn instead.
823975.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果你操控四个或更多生物，则改为它得+2/+2且获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

823978.oracleText:
"Drive the beasts into the enemy ranks, then stay back and let them do the work."
—Koth
823978.translation:
「把这些野兽往敌方阵地赶，之后我们远远看着它们发威就好。」
～寇斯

823979.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {o2oG}. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains trample until end of turn.
823979.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{o2oG}。当你如此作时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

823982.oracleText: "Your human laws mean nothing here. Plead your case before the tribunal of the wilds."
823982.translation: 「求情的话还是留到幻野法庭上再说吧。」

823983.oracleText: Whenever a Beast you control enters, draw a card.
823983.translation: 每当一个由你操控的野兽进场时，抓一张牌。

823986.oracleText: The Conflux proved that Alara's strength came from unity, not division.
823986.translation: 聚流此事，证明阿拉若合能集力，分则散威。

823988.oracleText: Made from a feather from Firja's wing, it marks a worthy hero with the blessing of the valkyries.
823988.translation: 此物由菲妍飞翼的落羽制成，代表勇者英灵已获女武神恩泽。

823989.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
823989.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。只能于法术时机起动。

823990.oracleText:
"The kami have declared that courtyard a no-fly zone."
—Light-Paws
823990.translation:
「神明宣布庭院属禁飞区。」
～轻脚

823991.oracleText:
"The true champion of the sun shall arrive on swift hooves, bearing a light to pierce the bleakest darkness."
—Korinna, Meletian oracle
823991.translation:
「真正的旭日天尊，当应四蹄翻腾，身携耀眼明光，刺破深沉黑黯。」
～迈勒提斯先知柯琳娜

823992.oracleText: Energized by a hearty lunch and a long nap in the afternoon sun, they were more than ready to take down any prey.
823992.translation: 在一餐丰盛中饭，一顿午后饱觉之后，他们重焕活力，能够击倒任何猎物。

823993.oracleText: "Considering your statures, let's start with the upward slash."
823993.translation: 「鉴于你们的体格，我们从向上劈砍开始。」

823994.oracleText: The city of Drannith danced to the music of the siege. Four bells meant a breach of the north wall. A horn blast meant all hands to arms. Additional gongs and tones indicated fire, poison, air raids, and more.
823994.translation: 随着攻城战事升级，卓尼斯城内皆随号音而动。四声钟响代表北墙破口。一声号鸣便要全民武装。其余鼓调则象征火灾、毒攻、空袭等等，不一而足。

823995.oracleText: As the majestic creature pranced through the market, furious haggling calmed and arguments trailed off.
823995.translation: 只见威严奇兽踱步市场，原本此起彼伏的买卖杂声顿时止息。

823996.oracleText:
"Deep in the ugliness of war, she appeared to remind us of the love for which we fight."
—Syr Agata of Ardenvale
823996.translation:
「当眼见战争深处的丑恶之时，她似乎在提醒我们不要忘记我们为之而战的那份美善。」
～雅登瓦的阿嘉塔爵士

823997.oracleText: One moment Dorica was meditating in her study, searching her mind for Thassa‘s guidance. Then, with a splash, she was underwater, face to face with a god.
823997.translation: 就在前一刻，多莉卡还在书房中冥想，在脑海中追寻塔萨的指引。转眼下一瞬，她就身处深洋，直面海神。

823998.oracleText: "Such dull wishes these humans make! To grant them as wished would be a dismal affair. Perhaps with a twist . . ."
823998.translation: 「这些人类许的都是些什么无聊愿望！原样实现毫无乐趣可言。也许我们可以稍加改动一下…」

823999.oracleText: "Go on now, get up there and take a gander at what's beyond those hills for me."
823999.translation: 「飞吧，翱翔蓝天，替我看看山的那边是怎样的景象。」

824000.oracleText: Sand to the eyes was against the rules. Unfortunately, there was no referee.
824000.translation: 沙子撒眼违反规则。但可惜这里没有裁判。

824001.oracleText: He sought to peer beneath the surface of the moon. Instead, he peeled back the skin of reality itself.
824001.translation: 他想要窥知隐藏在月亮表面之下的真相。然而他真正剥开却是现实的表皮。

824002.oracleText:
"Tormented screams are like snowflakes: no two are quite the same."
—Pedor, ice witch
824002.translation:
「受苦时的惨叫就跟雪花一样：没有两声完全相同。」
～寒冰女巫佩朵尔

824003.oracleText: "My blood was never my own. I carried it gladly for the Hungering One, and at last she arises to reclaim it."
824003.translation: 「我体内的血液从不属于我自己。我很乐意先代渴望魔保管，待她最后转生索回。」

824004.oracleText: Under Ormendahl's demonic influence, Bishop Jerren became the perfect agent of bloody blasphemy.
824004.translation: 受欧魔达的邪恶影响，耶仑主教成了血腥渎神之举的完美代理人。

824005.oracleText: "Newly conjured demons arrive confused, angry, and unsure how to direct their cruelty. I offer a few fun suggestions."
824005.translation: 「刚召出的恶魔现身时还满脸困惑、脾气暴躁，不知该如何宣泄残虐。我给出了一些有趣的建议。」

824006.oracleText: Fortune may favor the bold, but it also flattens the foolhardy.
824006.translation: 命运青睐勇敢者，也会压扁鲁莽者。

824007.oracleText: Flesh untouched by plague was a rare delicacy for the hungry creatures in Guul Draz.
824007.translation: 未受感染的血肉对古坠兹的饥饿生物眼中可是罕见佳肴。

824008.oracleText: Sometimes she considered how much easier it would have been to stay dead.
824008.translation: 有时她会想，一直没活过的话该会有多轻松。

824009.oracleText: The Dusk Legion demanded a share of the gold. The pirates happily obliged.
824009.translation: 暮影军团要求夺来的黄金要给他们分一份。海盗们爽快地答应了。

824011.oracleText:
"No such thing as ‘too quiet.' Quiet is good. Quiet means we don't end up dead in the mud, bleeding from our ears."
—Rem Karolus
824011.translation:
「没有什么『过分安静』。安静是好事。安静意味着我们不会双耳流血地倒在泥地中。」
～连卡洛

824015.oracleText: "Now really, was that the expression you wanted preserved on your face forever?"
824015.translation: 「说真的，刚刚那就是你想要永久留在脸上的表情？」

824019.oracleText: "Take my mind, so it may serve the will of Phyrexia. Take my flesh, so I may become compleat."
824019.translation: 「取我心智，让它服侍非瑞克西亚意志。取我血肉，让我得以完化。」

824022.oracleText: "Capenna needs some new blood. Preferably spilled by us."
824022.translation: 「卡佩纳需要一些新鲜血液。最好是出自我们之手。」

824025.oracleText:
"Patrol didn't find a single footprint, Captain. We should be safe to rest here."
—Lowell, army scout
824025.translation:
「队长，巡逻队没见到任何足迹。在此处扎营应当安全。」
～军队斥候罗威尔

824028.oracleText: "Looks like my Blood Fast is about to end early."
824028.translation: 「看来我的血禁仪式要提前结束了。」

824029.oracleText: The staff flared and rattled erratically, every twirl driving the wolf to greater heights of rage.
824029.translation: 只见法杖不停闪耀、疯狂抖动，每转一圈，都让恶狼怒火更涨一分。

824030.oracleText: Great goblin warlords lead vast hordes into battle from atop mighty siege-beasts. Lesser chiefs get a couple of squires and a big bug.
824030.translation: 强大的鬼怪首领骑在攻城巨兽上，率领庞大部族冲入战场。没那么强大的酋长，则是骑在大甲虫上，带领几个随从冲锋上前。

824032.oracleText: No wedding between rival vampire dynasties is complete without a few attempted murders at the reception.
824032.translation: 两家世仇吸血鬼王朝联姻时，晚宴上要是没发生几起谋杀未遂的事情，整场大婚都就不算完整。

824033.oracleText: "Depending what's behind that boulder, we're either about to be very rich or very disintegrated."
824033.translation: 「看看这块巨石后面到底藏着什么，我们要么就此一夜暴富，要么就此一命呜呼。」

824034.oracleText: As her pulse quickened, the snakes on her arms flared and writhed, eager to sink their fangs into the coming fray.
824034.translation: 她心跳加速，手臂上的蛇纹也随着闪光扭动，迫不及待地想要把尖牙刺入来敌体内。

824036.oracleText: The explorers didn't understand the lone sentry's jabbering, but they offered gold for passage. The counteroffer was a face full of molten rock.
824036.translation: 探险者听不懂这位孤独哨卫的胡言乱语，送上黄金想要换其让路。对方却以扑面而来的火热熔岩回应。

824038.oracleText: "Your steel fails you, surface-dweller. Perhaps I will reforge the fragments into something less embarrassing."
824038.translation: 「地上人，你手里那把钢刀辜负了你。也许我能把这些碎片重铸成不那么尴尬的东西。」

824039.oracleText: Born of fire yet not immune to it, the fiend lashes out in mindless rage, spurred by constant agony.
824039.translation: 邪鬼虽然生自火中，但却并不耐火；它们始终受苦痛刺激，经常无端出手释放怒气。

824040.translation: 克仑可的手下坚定而忠诚。

824041.oracleText: Only those who strike without a moment's hesitation may earn Hazoret's favor.
824041.translation: 只有毫不犹豫出击的人，才会获得哈佐蕾的眷顾。

824042.oracleText: "If you cling to the safety of the roots, you'll never climb high enough to see through the canopy."
824042.translation: 「如果你仅偏安于树根享受太平，那就永无可能爬到高处见得树冠美景。」

824043.oracleText: As he crested the final peak, Nidd gasped at the beauty laid out before him. Finally, he had found a place to rest his weary legs. A place to call home.
824043.translation: 尼德爬上最高峰之后，望着眼前美景长舒一口气。他终于找到一个可以休息疲惫双脚的地方。一个可以称为家的去处。

824045.oracleText: Once revered, then hunted, and now beyond memory.
824045.translation: 曾受尊敬，后被猎杀，现遭遗忘。

824051.oracleText: To Alara's Wild Nacatl, the greatest blessing is to be spared by the behemoths.
824051.translation: 对阿拉若的野群拿卡地来说，巨兽脚下留情便是最大的祝福。

824053.oracleText: "This forest is your birthright. From now until your final breath, you and Llanowar are bound. Keep each other safe."
824053.translation: 「这片树林是你的天赋之地。从现在这一刻起到咽气为止，你都与罗堰相连一体。务必确保彼此安全。」

824054.oracleText:
"Granted, we were trying to make perfume, but I'd still say the experiment was a success!"
—George, underground alchemist
824054.translation:
「虽然我们一开始想要做的是香水，但现在来看实验依然可以说是大成功！」
～地下炼金术士乔治

824055.oracleText: The beacon shone over the city, its lights a message to every traveler: whoever you are, you belong here.
824055.translation: 信标明光照亮城市上空，用五彩光线向每位旅行者传去这样一则讯息：无论你是谁，你都属于这里。

824057.oracleText: "Our enemies may be more metal than flesh. Good reason to wield a blade that will cut either."
824057.translation: 「我们的敌人身上可能金属更胜血肉。准备一把能够同时切开两者的利刃就很有必要。」

824058.oracleText: Every evening a rainbow of industry illuminates the skies above Eiganjo.
824058.translation: 每天傍晚，永岩城上空都会被一道工业兴盛的七彩虹光照亮。

824060.oracleText:
"You should have granted us an audience. Instead, you now reign over a kingdom of ruins."
—Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker
824060.translation:
「你本应接见我们。如今你的王国治下只剩废墟残垣。」
～龙语者萨坎

824062.oracleText: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.
824062.translation: 原本相距甚远的各块大陆在聚流的影响下相继靠近、聚拢，而后就像被卷入风暴的船只般相互冲撞，最终融合一体。

824077.oracleText:
"If a vampire were feeding on you every night, wouldn't you have bite marks? Stop wasting my time."
—Donya, village healer
824077.translation:
「如果是吸血鬼每晚都来吸你的血，那你至少会有牙印吧？别再浪费我的时间了。」
～村庄治疗师唐娅

824078.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
824078.translation: 在你的维持开始时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。你获得等同于以此法所造成的伤害之生命。

824124.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
824124.translation: 每当你获得生命时，CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

824125.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, Rodolf Duskbringer gains indestructible until end of turn.
824125.translation: 每当你获得生命时，暮光使者朗多夫获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

824126.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1o(W/B)}. When you do, return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
824126.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1o(W/B)}。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

824133.oracleText: Despite the name, they'll happily devour the flesh too.
824133.translation: 虽然名为血蝇，但也很乐意吃肉。

824141.oracleText: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.
824141.translation: 由于要共同对抗奥札奇，许多吸血鬼已学会与人类共存。但有些就是学不来。

824143.oracleText: Havengul wakes are widely regarded as great entertainment. If you're lucky, the guest of honor climbs out of the casket and joins in the festivities.
824143.translation: 海温古醒夜祭公认是最佳娱乐庆典。如果你够幸运，主宾会从棺材里爬出来一同狂欢。

824157.oracleText:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dexterous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer
824157.translation:
「最完美的助理要反应快，手工巧，还能摸到架子最高处。」
～艾斯波神器师寇路

824170.oracleText: Maintaining a personal bubble is even more important when you have gills.
824170.translation: 如果你有鳃，那维持个人气泡就显得尤为重要。

824180.oracleText: A precious shell without, a delicious taste within.

824182.oracleText: Though Captain Riptide's corpse was mostly recovered from the shipwreck, no one ever managed to find his favorite hat.
824182.translation: 尽管激流船长尸体的大部分都从船难现场打捞出来，但他的宝贝帽子却始终下落不明。

824187.oracleText: It's easy to be two steps ahead when you can see their every thought.
824187.translation: 如果你能看清对手每道思绪，那么能预先考虑两步也并非难事。

824188.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o4}. 
• Draw two cards.
824188.translation:
选择一项～ 
•除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。 
•抓两张牌。

824190.oracleText: "I would be a fool if I taught you everything I know."
824190.translation: 「我若把毕生知识悉数传授于你，那我未免太过愚蠢。」

824204.oracleText:
"Mowu was wary that day, as though he sensed the danger ahead."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue
824204.translation:
「那日，默武突而间警觉起来，似乎它也嗅到了我们即将面临的危险。」
～旸谷纪行

824220.oracleText: Even war cannot dull Skemfar's beauty.
824220.translation: 连绵战火也抹不去斯肯法的美丽。

824279.oracleText: "Ancient ones, I call on you, your wisdom and your power, your will to claim again all that is rightfully yours."
824279.translation: 「远古诸神啊，吾人在此诚心召唤你们现身，祈求古老的智慧、力量与意志能再回世间，重夺属于你们的一切。」

824302.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
824302.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

824321.oracleText: Half the size, double the mayhem.

824322.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to an opponent, it deals double that damage to that player instead.
824322.translation: 如果某来源将向任一对手造成伤害，则改为它对该牌手造成两倍的伤害。

824329.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}: If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent this turn, it deals double that damage to that player instead.
824329.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}：本回合中，如果由你操控的某来源将对任一对手造成伤害，则改为它对该牌手造成两倍的伤害。

824331.oracleText: Slonk was struck by lightning twenty-seven times before he got the idea. Another forty-three hits and he'd perfected it.
824331.translation: 司隆克在被闪电劈中二十七次后，终于有个想法。再被劈中四十三次后，他才把这想法完善成形。

824334.translation: 「那人留给我！她看上去很有钱！」

824345.oracleText: Whenever a creature dealt damage by CARDNAME this turn dies, create a Blood token.
824345.translation: 每当一个本回合中受过CARDNAME伤害的生物死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

824357.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken Vampire you control dies, create a Treasure token.
824357.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的吸血鬼死去时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

824359.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice two artifacts: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
824359.translation: {oR}，牺牲两个神器：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

824365.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
824365.translation: 每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为咒语或异能的目标时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824367.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying.
824367.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有三个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有飞行异能。

824377.translation: 所结附的生物具有守护{o2}。

824401.oracleText: The competition is but one aspect of the spectacle.
824401.translation: 不仅只比试，更有诸般精彩。

824402.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {o3oW}. If you do, support 2.
824402.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{o3oW}。若你如此作，则支援2。

824432.oracleText: Raksha's sudden departure split the leonin into two prides. The fight for survival reunited them.
824432.translation: 拉夏突然消失，令狮族分裂成两群。御敌求生之战，令他们重归于一体。

824441.oracleText: "I've beaten far better than you, in far greater numbers. So go ahead, draw your swords."
824441.translation: 「我打败过比你强得多，也多得多的敌人。所以来吧，拔剑吧。」

824442.oracleText: "Good work, but I know you can do better. Try again."
824442.translation: 「干得不错，但我知道你能做得更好。再来一次。」

824443.oracleText: "Do not mistake complexity for brilliance. It takes a master to perfect a simple design."
824443.translation: 「切勿以为复杂就代表精妙。只有大师才能将简单设计做到极致。」

824444.oracleText: She rode forth from Vantress an emissary, a marshal, and a paragon of style.
824444.translation: 她自凡翠丝出发，既是使者，又是统帅，更是风格典范。

824445.oracleText: "I see no heroes upon this field. Only tinder awaiting my spark."
824445.translation: 「我在这战场上没看到英雄。只有等着我点燃的柴火。」

824449.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of creature cards from your graveyard. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
824449.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场放逐任意数量的生物牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

824452.oracleText: "Sign or don't, it makes little difference to me. It is your fate that hangs in the balance."
824452.translation: 「要签名就签，不签也没关系。你的命运才是关键。」

824453.oracleText: "Oppose us and die a heretic. Join us and be blessed with immortality."
824453.translation: 「反对者死于异端之火。加入者得享永生之福。」

824458.oracleText: If she commands it, her subjects will burn the world to ash.
824458.translation: 若她下令，臣民会将世界化为灰烬。

824461.oracleText: She pulverizes each hedron and consumes the dust, absorbing the power within.
824461.translation: 她将每颗晶石都研磨成粉，吞下粉尘，吸取其中力量。

824462.oracleText: Various cultures of Ixalan tell stories of the monsters of legend that ended up as gristle between Ghalta's teeth.
824462.translation: 依夏兰各族文化都流传着传说中的怪物最后成为戈厄塔牙缝间碎肉的故事。

824463.oracleText: In his sleep, he twitched and snarled, dreaming of glorious battle against the undead hordes.
824463.translation: 他在梦中扭动咆哮，梦见自己与不死大军的荣耀战斗。

824465.oracleText: "Soil and stone, hear my call! Branch and bone, yield your all!"
824465.translation: 「土石听我号令！枝骨尽我所用！」

824467.translation: 迈勒提斯士兵布莉戈涅

824471.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from Brigone: Draw a card.
824471.translation: {oT}，从布莉戈涅上移去一个+1/+1指示物：抓一张牌。

824472.translation: 迈勒提斯诗人普塞弥拉

824473.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first enchantment spell each turn, create a 2/2 white Nymph enchantment creature token.
824473.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个结界咒语时，派出一个2/2白色宁芙衍生结界生物。

824474.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if you control five or more enchantments, CARDNAME gets +4/+4 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
824474.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若你操控五个或更多结界，则直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+4/+4且获得系命异能。

824479.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Qala.
824479.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在卡拉上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824482.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Pegasus, Unicorn, or Horse creature spell, copy it.
824482.translation: 每当你施放飞马，独角兽或马生物咒语时，将它复制。

824483.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Pegasus, Unicorn, or Horse creature spell, copy it. (The copy becomes a token.)
824483.translation: 每当你施放飞马，独角兽或马生物咒语时，将它复制。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

824484.oracleText: Other Pegasi, Unicorns, and Horses you control get +1/+1.
824484.translation: 由你操控的其他飞马、独角兽和马得+1/+1。

824485.translation: 卓茉卡族战士乌尔德南

824486.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
824486.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824488.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target attacking creature with a +1/+1 counter on it gains first strike until end of turn. If that creature has two or more +1/+1 counters on it, it gains double strike until end of turn instead.
824488.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标进行攻击且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。若该生物上有两个或更多+1/+1指示物，则改为它获得连击异能直到回合结束。

824490.oracleText: "Once you build up an immunity to their deadly venom, they're really quite cuddly!"
824490.translation: 「等致命毒素不再困扰你后，它们其实还挺可爱的！」

824491.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or dies, create a 1/1 blue Jellyfish creature token with flying.
824491.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或死去时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的水母衍生生物。

824494.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, target player mills cards equal to its power.
824494.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，目标牌手磨等同于其力量的牌。

824496.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard or activate an ability of a card in your graveyard, draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on Neerdiv.
824496.translation: 每当你从你坟墓场中施放咒语或起动你坟墓场中牌的异能时，抓一张牌并在涅迪芙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824499.oracleText: "No more lurking in the shallows. We ride!"
824499.translation: 「我们不该继续蛰伏浅滩。勇猛出击！」

824500.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card for each creature you control with toughness greater than its power.
824500.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个防御力比力量大的生物，便抓一张牌。

824502.oracleText: {o(W/U)}: Target creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power this turn.
824502.translation: {o(W/U)}：本回合中，目标由你操控的生物依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

824505.oracleText: "‘Real' is a more flexible concept than you might think."
824505.translation: 「『真实』的含义，比你所想的还要广泛。」

824506.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose a creature type. Draw a card for each creature you control of that type.
824506.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择一种生物类别。你每操控一个该类别的生物，便抓一张牌。

824510.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control leaves the battlefield, if it didn't die, scry 1 and put a +1/+1 counter on Taeko.
824510.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，若它未死去，则占卜1并在塔耶壳上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824511.oracleText: Whenever Taeko attacks, you may pay {o(U/B)}. When you do, target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn.
824511.translation: 每当塔耶壳攻击时，你可以支付{o(U/B)}。当你如此作时，目标进行攻击的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

824513.oracleText: Whenever Aphelia attacks, you may pay {o1o(B/G)}. If you do, create a 1/1 black Snake creature token with deathtouch.
824513.translation: 每当艾斐莉娅攻击时，你可以支付{o1o(B/G)}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1黑色，具死触异能的蛇衍生生物。

824514.oracleText: {o4oB}: Until end of turn, whenever one or more Gorgons and/or Snakes you control deal combat damage to a player, that player loses half their life, rounded up.
824514.translation: {o4oB}：直到回合结束，每当由你操控的一个或数个蛇发妖和／或蛇对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手失去一半数量的生命，小数点后进位。

824518.oracleText: When Evereth dies, you may pay {o1o(B/R)}. When you do, Evereth deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
824518.translation: 当艾霏蕾死去时，你可以支付{o1o(B/R)}。当你如此作时，艾霏蕾向每位对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

824521.oracleText: Whenever a player sacrifices a nontoken creature, create a 1/1 black Insect creature token with flying.
824521.translation: 每当任一牌手牺牲一个非衍生物的生物时，你派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的昆虫衍生生物。

824522.oracleText: Whenever an Insect, Leech, Slug, or Worm you control attacks, defending player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
824522.translation: 每当一个由你操控的昆虫，蛭，蛞蝓或蠕虫攻击时，防御牌手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

824524.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a feeding counter on CARDNAME.
824524.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个喂养指示物。

824526.oracleText: Whenever Nazar attacks, you may remove three feeding counters from it. If you do, you draw three cards and you lose 3 life.
824526.translation: 每当纳萨尔攻击时，你可以从其上移去三个喂养指示物。若你如此作，则你抓三张牌且失去3点生命。

824532.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
824532.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

824533.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token, then look at the top card of that player's library and exile it face down. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled.
824533.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物，然后检视该牌手的牌库顶牌，并牌面朝下地放逐它。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放之。

824535.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
824535.translation: 于CARDNAME攻击时，你可以耗竭之。当你如此作时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

824538.oracleText: "Let us dance 'round the funeral pyres of our foes!"
824538.translation: 「就让我们围着敌人葬火，一起舞蹈庆祝！」

824539.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets Cleon, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until the end of your next turn.
824539.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以克莱昂为目标的咒语时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

824541.oracleText: To cross swords with her is a shockingly bad idea.
824541.translation: 跟她拼剑，这想法糟糕到会震到你。

824542.oracleText: Whenever one or more Goblins you control attack, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
824542.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个鬼怪攻击时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

824543.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
824543.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

824546.oracleText: Whenever one or more Warriors you control attack a player, target creature that player controls becomes a Coward.
824546.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个战士攻击一位牌手时，目标由该牌手操控的生物成为懦夫。

824547.oracleText: Attacking Warriors you control get +X/+0, where X is the number of Cowards your opponents control.
824547.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的战士得+X/+0，X为由所有对手操控的懦夫数量。

824549.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and whenever it deals combat damage to a player, create a Blood token.
824549.translation: 当CARDNAME进场和每当它对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

824551.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, put a +1/+1 counter on Ivora.
824551.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，在依沃拉上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824553.oracleText: "Your claim to this land is as tenuous as my tolerance of your presence on it."
824553.translation: 「这片土地留不下你，正如我眼里容不下你。」

824555.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
824555.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

824557.translation: 妖精高位德鲁伊戴欧诺

824558.oracleText: "My people are like the great magnigoth trees. We've seen ice, flood, invasions, and wars, yet our roots remain strong."
824558.translation: 「我的子民正如参天的马尼古斯大树，虽历经冰寒、洪水、侵攻、战争种种劫难，但仍然牢牢扎根于此。」

824559.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped during your turn, untap it and put a +1/+1 counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
824559.translation: 每当此生物于你的回合中成为横置时，将它重置并在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

824560.oracleText: Elves you control have "Whenever this creature becomes tapped during your turn, untap it and put a +1/+1 counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn."
824560.translation: 由你操控的妖精具有「每当此生物于你的回合中成为横置时，将它重置并在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。」

824562.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a Food token.
824562.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个食品衍生物。

824564.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {o(G/W)}. When you do, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the amount of life you gained.
824564.translation: 每当你获得生命时，你可以支付{o(G/W)}。当你如此作时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你获得的生命数量。

824566.oracleText: His laughter—and everything else about him—was infectious.
824566.translation: 他的笑声～以及关于他的一切～都会很快传染开来。

824567.oracleText: Whenever a Saproling you control deals combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
824567.translation: 每当一个由你操控的腐生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出等量的1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

824569.oracleText: Beast spells you cast cost {o2} less to cast.
824569.translation: 你施放的野兽咒语减少{o2}来施放。

824570.oracleText: Each other Beast creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
824570.translation: 每个由你操控的其他野兽生物进场时上面均额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

824571.oracleText: Whenever Slinza or another creature with power 4 or greater enters, you may pay {o1o(R/G)}. When you do, Slinza fights target creature you don't control.
824571.translation: 每当斯林沙或另一个力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，你可以支付{o1o(R/G)}。当你如此作时，斯林沙与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

824573.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
824573.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

824575.oracleText: Whenever Sutina attacks, you may return a land you control to its owner's hand. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
824575.translation: 每当苏提娜攻击时，你可以将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。当你如此作时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824579.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains trample until end of turn.
824579.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

824580.translation: 是否要消灭目标非黑色的生物？

824585.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn. (At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1o(W/B)}. When you do, return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.)
824585.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。（在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1o(W/B)}。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。）

824601.oracleText: Target an attacking creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
824601.translation: 指定一个其上有+1/+1指示物且进行攻击的生物为目标。

824604.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever one or more Gorgons and/or Snakes you control deal combat damage to a player, that player loses half their life, rounded up.
824604.translation: 直到回合结束，每当由你操控的一个或数个蛇发妖和／或蛇对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手失去一半数量的生命，小数点后进位。

824607.oracleText: Target a card named Ozox, the Clattering King.
824607.translation: 指定一张名称为碎响骨王奥索兹的牌为目标。

824615.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control{5, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({4, Number} of {5, Number})}}
824615.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物{5, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({4, Number} of {5, Number})}}

824616.oracleText: Choose one. Destroy all permanents of the chosen type{3, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({2, Number} of {3, Number})}}
824616.translation: 选择一个类别，消灭所有具有所选类别的永久物{3, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({2, Number} of {3, Number})}}

824617.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature{4, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({3, Number} of {4, Number})}}
824617.translation: 牺牲一个生物{4, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({3, Number} of {4, Number})}}

824632.oracleText: Forage: Exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.
824632.translation: 觅粮：从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌或牺牲一个食品。

824635.oracleText: Forage a Food you control or three cards from your graveyard?
824635.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌或牺牲一个食品以觅粮？

824636.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, another target permanent gains indestructible for as long as you control CARDNAME.
824636.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，另一个目标永久物获得不灭异能。

824638.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 3 life.
824638.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得3点生命。

824640.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
824640.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

824642.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature to its owner's hand.
824642.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

824644.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with three wish counters on it.
824644.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有三个祈愿指示物。

824646.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, tap target permanent. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
824646.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，横置目标永久物。它于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

824651.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
824651.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

824653.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target artifact.
824653.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标神器。

824655.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target artifact, enchantment, or land.
824655.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标神器，结界或地。

824657.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may search your library for up to two land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
824657.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

824659.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
824659.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物。

824665.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped unless you control a Mountain or a Forest.
824665.translation: 除非你操控山脉或树林，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

824673.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
824673.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

830329.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature with power less than or equal to CARDNAME's power can't block this turn.

830779.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for any number of cards named Legion Conquistador, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
830779.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量名称为军团征服者的牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

830873.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for an Equipment or Vehicle card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

836139.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary.
836139.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成任一由你操控之生物或鹏洛客的复制品来进入战场，但如果它是生物，则它进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，如果它是鹏洛客，则它进场时上面额外有一个忠诚指示物，且它不是传奇。

836153.oracleText: Exile target permanent you control. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. If it enters as a creature, it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
836153.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的永久物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将所放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。如果它进场时是生物，则它进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

836214.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice any number of other permanents, then draw that many cards.
836214.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，牺牲任意数量的其他永久物，然后抓等量的牌。

836215.oracleText: When God-Eternal Bontu enters, sacrifice any number of other permanents, then draw that many cards.
836215.translation: 当永生煞神芭图进场时，牺牲任意数量的其他永久物，然后抓等量的牌。

836241.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each other creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than CARDNAME gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
836241.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每个其他生物各得-1/-1直到回合结束。本回合中，每当一个生物死去时，CARDNAME以外的每个生物各得-1/-1直到回合结束。

836242.oracleText: When Massacre Girl enters, each other creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than Massacre Girl gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
836242.translation: 当杀戮女郎进场时，每个其他生物各得-1/-1直到回合结束。本回合中，每当一个生物死去时，杀戮女郎以外的每个生物各得-1/-1直到回合结束。

836274.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
836274.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。

836320.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures and/or planeswalkers. If you do, it enters with twice that many +1/+1 counters on it.
836320.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲任意数量的生物和／或鹏洛客。如果你如此作，则它进场时上面有该数量两倍的+1/+1指示物。

836394.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.
836394.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控另一个力量等于或大于4的生物，则CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

836399.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
836399.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。

836402.oracleText: Each creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
836402.translation: 由你操控且为狼或狼人的生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

836430.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, proliferate.
836430.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，增殖。

836440.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, double the power of each other creature you control until end of turn. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.
836440.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将每个由你操控的其他生物之力量加倍直到回合结束。这些生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

836441.oracleText: When God-Eternal Rhonas enters, double the power of each other creature you control until end of turn. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.
836441.translation: 当永生煞神罗纳斯进场时，将每个由你操控的其他生物之力量加倍直到回合结束。这些生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

836451.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
836451.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

836475.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. 
• Proliferate.
836475.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•增殖。

836494.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, other creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
836494.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由你操控的其他生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

836516.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each loyalty counter on planeswalkers you control.
836516.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控的鹏洛客上之忠诚指示物总数量。

836547.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 3 life and draw a card.
836547.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

836584.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal the top ten cards of your library. For each color pair, choose a card that's exactly those colors from among them. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
836584.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，展示你牌库顶的十张牌。从中为每组双色色组各选择一张颜色正好为该色组的牌。将所选的牌置于你手上，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

836588.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
836588.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

836589.oracleText: When Oath of Kaya enters, it deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
836589.translation: 当卡娅的誓约进场时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

836606.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put two +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control.
836606.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

836620.oracleText: During your turn, creatures and planeswalkers you control have lifelink.
836620.translation: 于你的回合中，由你操控的生物和鹏洛客具有系命异能。

836648.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create Voja, Friend to Elves, a legendary 3/3 green and white Wolf creature token.
836648.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出传奇衍生生物妖精狼伴沃亚，其为3/3，绿白双色的狼。

836650.oracleText: Whenever a Wolf you control enters, you gain 3 life and that creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.
836650.translation: 每当一个由你操控的狼进场时，你获得3点生命，且该生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

836672.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.
836672.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，抓一张牌。

836675.oracleText: During your turn, creatures you control have first strike and equip abilities you activate cost {o1} less to activate.
836675.translation: 于你的回合中，由你操控的生物具有先攻异能，且你起动的佩带异能减少{o1}来起动。

836707.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top card of target opponent's library.
836707.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视目标对手的牌库顶牌。

836787.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a charge counter on it.
836787.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有一个充电指示物。

836813.oracleText: Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
836813.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回场上。

836826.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than CARDNAME gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
836826.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物死去时，CARDNAME以外的每个生物各得-1/-1直到回合结束。

836836.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
836836.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

836845.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for any number of cards named Battalion Foot Soldier, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
836845.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量名称为步兵大队的牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

836849.oracleText: Whenever an Angel you control enters, you gain 4 life.
836849.translation: 每当一个由你操控的天使进场时，你获得4点生命。

836856.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token.
836856.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。

836895.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may have your life total become the total toughness of creatures you control.
836895.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以令你的总生命成为由你操控之生物的防御力总和。

836905.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
836905.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。

836923.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature you control.
836923.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控之其他生物的数量。

836940.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, gain control of target permanent.
836940.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，获得目标永久物的操控权。

836971.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control CARDNAME.
836971.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

836975.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control another creature named Faerie Miscreant, draw a card.
836975.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控另一个名称为仙灵恶徒的生物，则抓一张牌。

837014.oracleText: Whenever another blue creature you control enters, target player mills two cards.
837014.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的蓝色生物进场时，目标牌手磨两张牌。

837017.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to two target instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
837017.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多两张目标瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

837026.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return another creature you control to its owner's hand.
837026.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将另一个由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

837046.oracleText: During your turn, CARDNAME has lifelink.
837046.translation: 于你的回合中，CARDNAME具有系命异能。

837060.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
837060.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

837063.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls.
837063.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物。

837075.oracleText:
Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one — 
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life. 
• CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
837075.translation:
每当一个由你操控的沼泽进场时，选择一项～ 
•你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。 
•CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

837080.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each different mana cost among nonland cards in your graveyard.
837080.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你坟墓场中非地牌间不同法术力费用的种数。

837084.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill four cards. You gain 1 life for each creature card milled this way.
837084.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨四张牌。每以此法将一张生物牌置入你的坟墓场，你便获得1点生命。

837088.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals damage to target opponent or planeswalker equal to the number of creatures you control.
837088.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标对手或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

837126.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each card named Undead Servant in your graveyard.
837126.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你坟墓场中每有一张名称为不死仆从的牌，便派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

837144.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent exiles a card from their hand.
837144.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各从其手上放逐一张牌。

837149.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
837149.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，弃任意数量的牌，然后抓等量的牌。

837184.oracleText: During your turn, CARDNAME has flying.
837184.translation: 于你的回合中，CARDNAME具有飞行异能。

837220.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all Goblin cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
837220.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，展示你牌库顶的四张牌。将以此法展示的所有鬼怪牌置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

837235.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to it. If a Dinosaur is dealt damage this way, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
837235.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME对它造成2点伤害。若有恐龙以此法受到伤害，则CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

837238.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
837238.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1红色元素衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

837261.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens. Elementals you control gain haste until end of turn.
837261.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1红色元素衍生生物。由你操控的元素获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

837277.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
837277.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

837285.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal the top five cards of your library. Put a land card from among them onto the battlefield and the rest into your graveyard.
837285.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，展示你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中的一张地牌放进战场，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

837311.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 2/2 green Wolf creature tokens.
837311.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

837324.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target player shuffles any number of target cards from their graveyard into their library.
837324.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标牌手将任意数量的目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

837339.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on another target Elemental you control.
837339.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的元素上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

837349.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, scry 1.
837349.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，占卜1。

837377.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Double the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME. 
• CARDNAME fights target creature you don't control.
837377.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•将CARDNAME上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。 
•CARDNAME与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

837386.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
837386.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

837391.oracleText: Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
837391.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个衍生物进场时，在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

837395.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life.
837395.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

837411.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an Angel card, a Demon card, and/or a Dragon card from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
837411.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张天使牌，一张恶魔牌和／或一张龙牌，并将它们置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

837431.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals damage to any target equal to the number of Elementals you control.
837431.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的元素数量。

837433.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target Elemental you control. If you control eight or more lands, draw a card.
837433.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在目标由你操控的元素上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若你操控八个或更多地，则抓一张牌。

837436.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Elemental you control enters, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
837436.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的元素进场时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若该牌是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

837443.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
837443.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

837447.oracleText: If a permanent entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
837447.translation: 如果某个进场的永久物触发由你操控之永久物的触发式异能，则该异能额外触发一次。

837467.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
837467.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

837488.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a card with the same name as another creature you control, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
837488.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，且此牌须与另一个由你操控的生物同名，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

837528.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another land you control enters, if you control seven or more lands with different names, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
837528.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的地进场时，若你操控七个或更多地，且其名称各不相同，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

837535.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice two lands.

837575.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Ajani, Inspiring Leader, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
837575.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为励志领袖阿耶尼的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

837593.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Mu Yanling, Celestial Wind, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
837593.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为天界清风沐燕灵的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

837603.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Sorin, Vampire Lord, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
837603.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为吸血领主索霖的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

837631.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Vivien, Nature's Avenger, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
837631.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为护世侠客薇薇安的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。
