839275.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，所结附的生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

839339.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
839339.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

839346.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• CARDNAME gains haste until end of turn.
839346.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•CARDNAME获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

839352.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 2 damage to any target.
839352.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

839398.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return any number of Aura cards from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to creatures you control. Exile those Auras at the beginning of your next end step. If those Auras would leave the battlefield, exile them instead of putting them anywhere else.
839398.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将任意数量的灵气牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在由你操控的一个或数个生物上。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐这些灵气。若这些灵气将离开战场，则改为将它们放逐，而非置入其他区域。

839443.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature with flying an opponent controls.
839443.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标由对手操控且具飞行异能的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

839462.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on enchanted creature.
839462.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在所结附的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

839499.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
839499.translation: 星彩～每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中的一张地牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

839503.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, you gain 2 life.
839503.translation: 星彩～每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，你获得2点生命。

839511.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is your devotion to green.
839511.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为你的绿色献力。

839541.oracleText: Each other creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
839541.translation: 由你操控的其他生物进场时上面上面均额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

839545.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and draw a card.
839545.translation: 星彩～每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

839549.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain life equal to your devotion to green.
839549.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得若干生命，其数量等同于你的绿色献力。

839553.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
839553.translation: 星彩～每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

839569.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, enchanted creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.
839569.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，所结附的生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

839577.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill two cards, then you may return a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
839577.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨两张牌，然后你可以将一张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

839588.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent looks at the top three cards of your library and separates them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
839588.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手检视你牌库顶的三张牌，并分成牌面朝下与牌面朝上各一堆。将其中一堆置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。

839620.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains flying until end of turn.
839620.translation: 星彩～每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

839628.oracleText: As Haktos enters, choose 2, 3, or 4 at random.
839628.translation: 于哈克托斯进场时，随机选择2，3或4。

839632.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
839632.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

839637.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a land card, add {oR} or {oG}. Otherwise, you gain 2 life and Klothys deals 2 damage to each opponent.
839637.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。若该牌是地牌，则加{oR}或{oG}。若否，则你获得2点生命且克洛缇丝向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

839640.oracleText: When Kroxa enters, sacrifice it unless it escaped.
839640.translation: 当克罗刹进场时，除非它已逸脱，否则牺牲之。

839641.oracleText: Whenever Kroxa enters or attacks, each opponent discards a card, then each opponent who didn't discard a nonland card this way loses 3 life.
839641.translation: 每当克罗刹进场或攻击时，每位对手各弃一张牌，然后每位未以此法弃掉非地牌的对手各失去3点生命。

839653.oracleText: Polukranos enters with six +1/+1 counters on it. It escapes with twelve +1/+1 counters on it instead.
839653.translation: 波禄卡诺斯进场时上面有六个+1/+1指示物。它逸脱时改为上面有十二个+1/+1指示物。

839662.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal an Aura card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
839662.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中的一张灵气牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

839675.oracleText: When Uro enters, sacrifice it unless it escaped.
839675.translation: 当乌洛进场时，除非它已逸脱，否则牺牲之。

839676.oracleText: Whenever Uro enters or attacks, you gain 3 life and draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
839676.translation: 每当乌洛进场或攻击时，你获得3点生命且抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

839704.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target card from a graveyard.
839704.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

839748.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Elspeth, Undaunted Hero, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
839748.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为无畏英雄艾紫培的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

839771.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Ashiok, Sculptor of Fears, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
839771.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为恐惧塑师安梭苛的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

839786.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent mills ten cards.
839786.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各磨十张牌。

839803.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creatures you control gain double strike until end of turn.
839803.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

839861.oracleText: Exile those Auras at the beginning of your next end step.
839861.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐这些灵气。

839907.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with your choice of a flying counter or a first strike counter on it.
839907.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面依你的选择有一个飞行指示物或一个先攻指示物。

839917.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a vigilance counter on target non-Human creature you control.
839917.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个警戒指示物。

839922.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose odd or even.
839922.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择奇数或偶数。

839940.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target Human you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
839940.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由你操控的人类得+2/+2直到回合结束。

840068.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, counter target artifact or creature spell.
840068.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，反击目标神器或生物咒语。

840072.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with your choice of a flying counter or a hexproof counter on it.
840072.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面依你的选择有一个飞行指示物或一个辟邪指示物。

840076.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a flying counter on target non-Human creature you control.
840076.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个飞行指示物。

840085.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Remove all counters from that creature.
840085.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。移去该生物上的所有指示物。

840092.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with your choice of a deathtouch counter or a lifelink counter on it.
840092.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面依你的选择有一个死触指示物或一个系命指示物。

840121.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a lifelink counter on target non-Human creature you control.
840121.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个系命指示物。

840136.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with your choice of two different counters on it from among menace, deathtouch, and lifelink.
840136.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面依你的选择有威慑、死触和系命三种指示物其中之二。

840145.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent puts a deathtouch counter on a creature they control.
840145.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手在一个由其操控的生物上放置一个死触指示物。

840152.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target creature that was dealt damage this turn.
840152.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标本回合中受过伤害的生物。

840164.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
840164.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你本回合中攻击过，则派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

840222.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with your choice of a trample counter or a menace counter on it.
840222.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面依你的选择有一个践踏指示物或一个威慑指示物。

840241.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a menace counter on target non-Human creature you control.
840241.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个威慑指示物。

840285.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target card with a cycling ability from your graveyard. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
840285.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标具任一循环异能的牌从你的坟墓场放逐。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

840358.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with your choice of a vigilance counter or a reach counter on it.
840358.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面依你的选择有一个警戒指示物或一个延势指示物。

840376.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a trample counter on target non-Human creature you control.
840376.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个践踏指示物。

840468.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Human you control enters, exile target card from an opponent's graveyard.
840468.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的人类进场时，将目标牌从任一对手的坟墓场放逐。

840599.oracleText: When Gyruda enters, each player mills four cards. Put a creature card with an even mana value from among the milled cards onto the battlefield under your control.
840599.translation: 当翟鲁达进场时，每位牌手各磨四张牌。你将这些牌其中一张法术力值为偶数的生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。

840615.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card for each other permanent you control with mana value 3 or greater.
840615.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个法术力值等于或大于3的其他永久物，便抓一张牌。

840623.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
840623.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它是由你施放，则复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

840638.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose a card type.
840638.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择一种牌张类别。

840644.oracleText: When Yorion enters, exile any number of other nonland permanents you own and control. Return those cards to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step.
840644.translation: 当约力昂进场时，放逐任意数量由你拥有且操控的其他非地永久物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将这些牌移回战场。

840795.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 2 life for each creature you control with flying.
840795.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个具飞行异能的生物，便获得2点生命。

840808.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two other target creatures you control.
840808.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在至多两个其他目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

840822.oracleText: If a nontoken creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead.
840822.translation: 如果某非衍生物的生物将进场，且未有牌手施放之，则改为将它放逐。

840844.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile all creature cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
840844.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐你坟墓场中所有法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

840868.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
840868.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

840910.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one other target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
840910.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多另一个目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。

840914.oracleText: During your turn, this spell costs {o2oUoU} less to cast.
840914.translation: 于你的回合中，此咒语减少{o2oUoU}来施放。

840961.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one target non-Spirit creature to its owner's hand.
840961.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一个目标非精怪生物移回其拥有者手上。

840968.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
840968.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

840972.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, you may draw X cards, where X is the number of Shrines you control. If you do, discard a card.
840972.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，你可以抓X张牌，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

841023.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it entered from your graveyard or you cast it from your graveyard, exile it. If you do, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.
841023.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它是从你的坟墓场进场或你是从你的坟墓场中施放它，则将它放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个5/5黑色，具飞行异能的恶魔衍生生物。

841037.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice a creature or discard a creature card. If you do, draw a card.
841037.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个生物或弃一张生物牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

841078.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw X cards, where X is the number of creatures that died under your control this turn.
841078.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓X张牌，X为本回合中在你的操控下死去之生物数量。

841085.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a soul counter on it.
841085.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有一个灵魂指示物。

841095.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn.
841095.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

841111.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
841111.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，每位对手各失去X点生命，且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

841126.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Rogue you control enters, each opponent mills two cards.
841126.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的浪客进场时，每位对手各磨两张牌。

841148.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature gets +4/+0 until end of turn.
841148.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标生物得+4/+0直到回合结束。

841213.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
841213.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

841233.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target.
841233.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于进场之生物的力量。

841284.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value 6 or greater, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
841284.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或大于6的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

841301.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
841301.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则抓一张牌。

841347.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
841347.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

841367.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. 
• You gain 4 life.
841367.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

841378.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a card named Alpine Watchdog and/or a card named Igneous Cur, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
841378.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为山地看护犬的牌和／或一张名称为火热杂狗的牌，展示它们，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

841406.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may return another target creature you control to its owner's hand. If you do, you gain life equal to that creature's mana value.
841406.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将另一个目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则你获得等同于该生物法术力值的生命。

841424.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with flying enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
841424.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物进场时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

841432.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control two or more nonland, nontoken permanents with the same name as one another, create a 4/4 colorless Construct artifact creature token.
841432.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若在所有由你操控且既非地也非衍生物的永久物中，具相同名称者有两个或更多，则派出一个4/4无色组构体衍生神器生物。

841446.oracleText: When Meteorite enters, it deals 2 damage to any target.
841446.translation: 当陨星进场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

841492.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Teferi, Timeless Voyager, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
841492.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为历时旅客泰菲力的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

843106.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

843109.oracleText: If CARDNAME was kicked, it enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
843109.translation: 如果CARDNAME已增幅，则它进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

843148.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
843148.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

843163.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
843163.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

843175.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card for as long as it remains exiled.
843175.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以使用该牌。

843206.oracleText: If CARDNAME was kicked, it enters with four +1/+1 counters on it.
843206.translation: 如果CARDNAME已增幅，则它进场时上面有四个+1/+1指示物。

843233.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life.
843233.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，你获得1点生命。

843236.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to two lands you control to their owner's hand.
843236.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多两个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

843246.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, add one mana of any color.
843246.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，加一点任意颜色的法术力。

843256.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, return target card with a kicker ability from your graveyard to your hand.
843256.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则将目标具任一增幅异能的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

843275.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. If you control six or more lands, create a token that's a copy of CARDNAME instead.
843275.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。若你操控六个或更多地，则改为派出一个为CARDNAME之复制品的衍生物。

843280.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, equipped creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
843280.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

843299.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, reveal the top six cards of your library. You may put a card that shares a creature type with it from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
843299.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则展示你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张与之具共通生物类别的牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

843311.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, all creatures able to block target creature this turn do so.
843311.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则本回合中，所有能阻挡目标生物的生物皆须阻挡之。

843351.oracleText: Whenever another Cleric you control enters, you gain 1 life.
843351.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的僧侣进场时，你获得1点生命。

843386.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
843386.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

843392.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 4 life if this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn. If it's the second time, add {oRoGoWoU}. If it's the third time, Omnath deals 4 damage to each opponent and each planeswalker you don't control.
843392.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，如果这是此异能在本回合第一次的结算，则你获得4点生命。如果是第二次的结算，则加{oRoGoWoU}。如果是第三次的结算，则欧那斯向每位对手和每个不由你操控的鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。

843398.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token for each basic land you control.
843398.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个基本地，便派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物。

843400.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put four +1/+1 counters on target Plant you control.
843400.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在目标由你操控的植物上放置四个+1/+1指示物。

843416.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each mana spent to cast it.
843416.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为施放它时用来支付费用的法术力数量。

843423.oracleText: When Yasharn enters, search your library for a basic Forest card and a basic Plains card, reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
843423.translation: 当牙刹进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌和一张基本的平原牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

843446.oracleText: If CARDNAME was kicked, it enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each nonbasic land your opponents control.
843446.translation: 如果CARDNAME已增幅，则它进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由所有对手操控的非基本地数量。

843472.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, create two tapped tokens that are copies of CARDNAME.
843472.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则派出两个已横置的衍生物，这些衍生物为CARDNAME的复制品。

843534.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put four +1/+1 counters on target Plant you control. It gains trample until end of turn.
843534.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在目标由你操控的植物上放置四个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

843599.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.
843599.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

843601.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile all graveyards.
843601.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐所有坟墓场。

843625.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create four 1/1 green Insect creature tokens with flying and deathtouch.
843625.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出四个1/1绿色，具飞行与死触异能的昆虫衍生生物。

843649.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was the second spell you cast this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
843649.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它是你本回合中施放的第二个咒语，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

843666.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile any number of non-Angel creatures you control until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
843666.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以放逐任意数量由你操控的非天使生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

843694.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
843694.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

843701.oracleText: Snow lands your opponents control enter tapped.
843701.translation: 由对手操控的雪境地须横置进场。

843708.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or dies, you may exile another creature card from your graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control other than CARDNAME that shares a creature type with the exiled card.
843708.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或死去时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐另一张生物牌。当你如此作时，在CARDNAME以外每个由你操控且与所放逐之牌具共通生物类别的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

843712.oracleText: Whenever another Angel or Cleric you control enters, you gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
843712.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的天使或僧侣进场时，你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。

843721.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a Rune card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
843721.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张符文牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

843728.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
843728.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

843754.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o4oW}. If you do, create a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying and vigilance, then attach CARDNAME to it.
843754.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o4oW}。若你如此作，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使／战士衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

843797.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls. If {oSi} was spent to cast this spell, that permanent doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
843797.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物。如果施放此咒语时支付过{oSi}，则该永久物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

843801.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap enchanted creature. It deals damage to you equal to its power.
843801.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置所结附的生物。该生物对你造成等同于其力量的伤害。

843808.oracleText: Whenever a land you control enters, if Cosima is exiled, you may put a voyage counter on it. If you don't, return Cosima to the battlefield with X +1/+1 counters on it and draw X cards, where X is the number of voyage counters on it.
843808.translation: 每当一个由你操控的地进场时，若寇西玛已放逐，则你可以在其上放置一个远行指示物。若你未如此作，则将寇西玛移回战场且上面有X个+1/+1指示物，并抓X张牌，X为其上的远行指示物数量。

843809.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile Cosima. If you do, it gains "Whenever a land you control enters, if Cosima is exiled, you may put a voyage counter on it. If you don't, return Cosima to the battlefield with X +1/+1 counters on it and draw X cards, where X is the number of voyage counters on it."
843809.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以放逐寇西玛。若你如此作，则它获得「每当一个由你操控的地进场时，若寇西玛已放逐，则你可以在其上放置一个远行指示物。若你未如此作，则将寇西玛移回战场且上面有X个+1/+1指示物，并抓X张牌，X为其上的远行指示物数量。」

843819.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it from your hand, return all permanents to their owners' hands except for Giants, Wizards, and lands.
843819.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你从你手上施放之，则将所有永久物移回其拥有者手上，但巨人、法术师与地除外。

843828.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top card of target player's library. You may put that card into their graveyard.
843828.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视目标牌手的牌库顶牌。你可以将该牌置入其坟墓场。

843839.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for an instant or sorcery card with the same name as a card in your graveyard, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
843839.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张瞬间或法术牌，且其须与你坟墓场中的某张牌同名，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

843842.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o3oU}. If you do, create a 4/4 blue Giant Wizard creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
843842.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o3oU}。若你如此作，则派出一个4/4蓝色巨人／法术师衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

843859.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, artifacts and creatures target opponent controls don't untap during that player's next untap step.
843859.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由目标对手操控之神器和生物于该牌手的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

843866.translation: 当符眼茵嘉进场时，占卜3。

843874.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control three or more creatures that share a creature type, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME, then scry 1.
843874.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控三个或更多具共通生物类别的生物，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后占卜1。

843884.oracleText: Choose target nonlegendary creature. The next time one or more creatures or planeswalkers enter this turn, they enter as copies of the chosen creature.
843884.translation: 选择目标非传奇的生物。本回合中，下一次有一个或数个生物或鹏洛客进场时，它们作为所选生物之复制品来进入战场。

843923.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for exactly two cards not named Burning-Rune Demon that have different names. If you do, reveal those cards. An opponent chooses one of them. Put the chosen card into your hand and the other into your graveyard, then shuffle.
843923.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻正好两张不同名称的牌，且其名称都不能是焚符恶魔。若你如此作，则展示这些牌。任一对手从中选择一张。将该牌置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

843946.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o2oB}. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie Berserker creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
843946.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o2oB}。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／狂战士衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

843999.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, up to two target creatures each get +1/+0 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
843999.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

844034.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Each opponent loses X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common. 
• You gain X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
844034.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•每位对手各失去X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。 
•你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

844053.oracleText: When Valki enters, each opponent reveals their hand. For each opponent, exile a creature card they revealed this way until Valki leaves the battlefield.
844053.translation: 当瓦尔基进场时，每位对手各展示其手牌。为每位对手各进行以下流程～放逐一张其以此法展示的生物牌，直到瓦尔基离开战场为止。

844058.oracleText: As Tibalt enters, you get an emblem with "You may play cards exiled with Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells."
844058.translation: 于提勃进场时，你获得具有「你可以使用以寰宇冒名客提勃放逐的牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术为来支付施放这类咒语的费用」的徽记。

844084.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
844084.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

844118.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
844118.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

844127.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
844127.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则派出一个2/1红色矮人／狂战士衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

844237.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, if {oSi} of any of that spell's colors was spent to cast it, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
844237.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语，若施放它时支付过该咒语所具有之任一颜色的{oSi}，则该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

844243.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
844243.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

844247.oracleText: Whenever one or more other Elves you control enter, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
844247.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他妖精进场时，派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

844258.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 2/2 green Cat creature tokens.
844258.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个2/2绿色的猫衍生生物。

844259.oracleText: When Esika's Chariot enters, create two 2/2 green Cat creature tokens.
844259.translation: 当埃西卡的战车进场时，派出两个2/2绿色的猫衍生生物。

844297.oracleText: {oT}: You may play target snow permanent card from your graveyard this turn. If you do, it enters tapped.
844297.translation: {oT}：本回合中你可以从你的坟墓场中使用目标雪境永久物牌。若你如此作，则它须横置进场。

844308.oracleText: As The Ringhart Crest enters, choose a creature type.
844308.translation: 于林哈特饰冠进场时，选择一种生物类别。

844317.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, exile target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
844317.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则放逐目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

844359.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a snow land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
844359.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张雪境地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

844426.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal an Elf, Warrior, or Tyvar card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
844426.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张妖精，战士或泰瓦牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

844443.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.
844443.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到你的下一个回合，由对手操控的生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击，且若能攻击除你以外的牌手，则必须如此作。

844477.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token.
844477.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个1/1白色人类／战士衍生生物。

844479.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of a permanent you control, except it's legendary and snow in addition to its other types and, if it's a creature, it enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it and has changeling.
844479.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成任一由你操控之永久物的复制品来进入战场，但它额外具有传奇与雪境此两种类别，且如果它是生物，则它进场时上面额外有两个+1/+1指示物且具有化形异能。

844487.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create X Shard tokens.
844487.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出X个碎片衍生物。

844488.oracleText: When Niko Aris enters, create X Shard tokens.
844488.translation: 当尼科阿理斯进场时，派出X个碎片衍生物。

844529.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control of the chosen type enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
844529.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的该类别之生物进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

844556.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library, hand, and/or graveyard for a Rune card and put it onto the battlefield attached to CARDNAME. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
844556.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库，手牌和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张符文牌，将之放进战场并贴附在CARDNAME上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

844625.oracleText: {o2oGoGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
844625.translation: {o2oGoGoU}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控之生物的复制品，但它进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

844697.oracleText: Whenever another Angel you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

847394.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多另一个目标生物。该生物的操控者获得等同于其力量的生命。

847409.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
847409.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

847416.oracleText: When Tourach enters, if it was kicked, target opponent discards two cards at random.
847416.translation: 当妥拉克进场时，若它已增幅，则目标对手随机弃两张牌。

847418.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
847418.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任意数量的目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共4点伤害，你可以任意分配。

847432.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, up to one target player puts all the cards from their graveyard on the bottom of their library in a random order.
847432.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，至多一位目标牌手将其坟墓场中的所有牌以随机顺序置于其牌库底。

847467.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying, then attach CARDNAME to it.
847467.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

847485.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
847485.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

847560.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying.
847560.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

847612.oracleText: Whenever a token you control enters, tap target nonland permanent an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
847612.translation: 每当一个由你操控的衍生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的非地永久物。它于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

847657.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token and a 0/3 blue Crab creature token.
847657.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物和一个0/3蓝色的蟹衍生生物。

847663.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, untap CARDNAME.
847663.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，重置CARDNAME。

847796.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a card, put that card into your graveyard, then shuffle.
847796.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

847803.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile two cards from your graveyard. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
847803.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐两张牌。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

847926.oracleText: Aeve enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Ooze you control.
847926.translation: 艾夫进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控的其他流浆数量。

847965.oracleText: Morbid — When CARDNAME enters, if a creature died this turn, investigate.
847965.translation: 丧心～当CARDNAME进场时，若本回合中有生物死去，则探查。

847988.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two Food tokens.
847988.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个食品衍生物。

848003.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.
848003.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

848014.oracleText: Whenever a green creature you control enters, scry 1.
848014.translation: 每当一个由你操控的绿色生物进场时，占卜1。

848016.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
848016.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

848020.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a Food token or a Treasure token.
848020.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个食品衍生物或珍宝衍生物。

848035.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other artifact creature you control.
848035.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在每个由你操控的其他神器生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

848049.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control enters, if that creature entered from a graveyard or you cast it from a graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
848049.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，若该生物是从坟墓场进场或是由你从坟墓场施放之，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

848059.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard. If you put an artifact card into your hand this way, you gain 3 life.
848059.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，展示你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。如果你以此法将一张神器牌置于你手上，则你获得3点生命。

848076.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens.
848076.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

848108.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, investigate.
848108.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物进场时，探查。

848132.oracleText:
Delirium — When CARDNAME enters, choose one. If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, choose both instead. 
• CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target. 
• Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
848132.translation:
躁狂～当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项。如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则改为都选。 
•CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。 
•检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

848369.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control enters, if you didn't cast it from your hand, it gains haste until your next turn.
848369.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物进场时，若你未从你手上施放之，则它获得敏捷异能直到你的下一个回合。

848421.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control a token, tap enchanted creature, then scry 2.
848421.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控衍生物，则横置所结附的生物，然后占卜2。

848480.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
848480.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

848485.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
848485.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

848508.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, venture into the dungeon.

848525.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Cure Wounds — You gain 2 life. 
• Dispel Magic — Destroy target enchantment. 
• Gentle Repose — Exile target card from a graveyard.
848525.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•治疗伤痛～你获得2点生命。 
•解除魔法～消灭目标结界。 
•遗体防腐～将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

848533.oracleText: Beacon of Hope — When CARDNAME enters, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
848533.translation: 希望信标～当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

848540.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, you may reveal a Dragon card from your hand. If you do or if you control a Dragon, CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
848540.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，你可以从手上展示一张龙牌。如果你如此作或如果你操控龙，则CARDNAME进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

848562.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, any number of other target creatures you control phase out.
848562.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，任意数量目标由你操控的其他生物跃离。

848570.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
848570.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张神器牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

848572.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifacts you control enter, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
848572.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个神器进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

848579.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a basic Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
848579.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

848593.oracleText: Divine Intervention — When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for an enchantment card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
848593.translation: 神力干预～当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张结界牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

848598.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, venture into the dungeon.
848598.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，深入地城。

848624.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
848624.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

848633.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
848633.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

848651.oracleText: Cold Breath — When CARDNAME enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
848651.translation: 寒冷喷吐～当CARDNAME进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

848669.oracleText: Psionic Spells — When CARDNAME enters, choose target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard, then roll a d20. 1-9 | You may put that card on top of your library. 10-20 | Return that card to your hand.
848669.translation: 灵能咒语～当CARDNAME进场时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌，然后掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 你可以将该牌置于你的牌库顶。10-20 | 将该牌移回你手上。

848674.oracleText: Whirlwind — When CARDNAME enters, return up to one other target creature to its owner's hand.
848674.translation: 旋风～当CARDNAME进场时，将至多另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

848689.oracleText: Lightning Breath — When CARDNAME enters, until your next turn, target creature an opponent controls gets -3/-0, up to one other target creature gets -2/-0, and up to one other target creature gets -1/-0.
848689.translation: 闪电喷吐～当CARDNAME进场时，直到你的下一个回合，目标由对手操控的生物得-3/-0，至多另一个目标生物得-2/-0，且至多再另一个目标生物得-1/-0。

848713.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, roll a d20. 1-9 | Scry 1. 10-19 | Scry 2. 20 | Scry 3.
848713.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 占卜1。10-19 | 占卜2。20 | 占卜3。

848716.oracleText: Drag Below — When CARDNAME enters, tap it and up to one target creature an opponent controls. They don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.
848716.translation: 拖入水底～当CARDNAME进场时，将它和至多一个目标由对手操控的生物横置。它们于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

848742.oracleText: Dominate Monster — When CARDNAME enters, gain control of target creature for as long as you control CARDNAME.
848742.translation: 支配怪物～当CARDNAME进场时，于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，获得目标生物的操控权。

848760.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if enchanted creature is red, tap it.
848760.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若所结附的生物是红色，则将它横置。

848768.oracleText: Cone of Cold — When CARDNAME enters, choose target creature an opponent controls, then roll a d20. 1-9 | Tap that creature. 10-20 | Tap that creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
848768.translation: 寒冰锥～当CARDNAME进场时，选择目标由对手操控的生物，然后掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 横置该生物。10-20 | 横置该生物。它于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

848840.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you haven't completed Tomb of Annihilation, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand and venture into the dungeon.
848840.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你未曾完成湮灭之墓，则将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上并深入地城。

848841.oracleText: When Acererak the Archlich enters, if you haven't completed Tomb of Annihilation, return Acererak the Archlich to its owner's hand and venture into the dungeon.
848841.translation: 当高阶巫妖阿瑟瑞拉克进场时，若你未曾完成湮灭之墓，则将高阶巫妖阿瑟瑞拉克移回其拥有者手上并深入地城。

848862.oracleText: Acid Breath — When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
848862.translation: 强酸喷吐～当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

848913.oracleText: Engulf — When CARDNAME enters, exile target non-Ooze creature an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
848913.translation: 吞没～当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的非流浆生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

848933.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if mana from a Treasure was spent to cast it, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
848933.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若施放它时支付过来自珍宝的法术力，则你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

848984.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X void counters on it.
848984.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个虚空指示物。

849087.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, roll a d20. 1-9 | Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. 10-20 | Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token, then attach CARDNAME to it.
849087.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。10-20 | 派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

849111.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if mana from a Treasure was spent to cast it, it gains first strike and haste until end of turn.
849111.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若施放它时支付过来自珍宝的法术力，则它获得先攻与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

849138.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Smash the Chest — Destroy target artifact. 
• Pry It Open — Create a Treasure token.
849138.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•砸碎宝箱～消灭目标神器。 
•用力撬开～派出一个珍宝衍生物。

849145.oracleText: Fire Breath — When CARDNAME enters, it deals 4 damage to each opponent.
849145.translation: 火焰喷吐～当CARDNAME进场时，它向每位对手各造成4点伤害。

849153.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, roll a d20. 1-9 | Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. 10-19 | Create two of those tokens. 20 | Create three of those tokens.
849153.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。10-19 | 派出两个上述衍生物。20 | 派出三个上述衍生物。

849220.oracleText: Bear Form — During your turn, CARDNAME is a Bear with base power and toughness 4/2.
849220.translation: 熊形态～于你的回合中，CARDNAME是基础力量与防御力为4/2的熊。

849258.oracleText: Poison Breath — When CARDNAME enters, until end of turn, whenever a creature an opponent controls is dealt damage, destroy it.
849258.translation: 剧毒喷吐～当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，每当一个由对手操控的生物受到伤害时，消灭受到伤害的该生物。

849276.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Bardic Inspiration — Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. 
• Song of Rest — You gain 3 life.
849276.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•诗人鼓励～目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。 
•休憩曲～你获得3点生命。

849304.oracleText: Split — When CARDNAME dies, if it had two or more +1/+1 counters on it, create a token that's a copy of it at the beginning of the next end step. The token enters with half that many +1/+1 counters on it, rounded down.
849304.translation: 分裂～当CARDNAME死去时，若其上有两个或更多+1/+1指示物，则在下一个结束步骤开始时，派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。该衍生物进场时上面有该数量一半的+1/+1指示物，小数点后舍去。

849311.oracleText: Keen Senses — When CARDNAME enters, draw a card.
849311.translation: 感官异常灵敏～当CARDNAME进场时，抓一张牌。

849388.oracleText: Legendary creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them.
849388.translation: 由你操控的传奇生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

849404.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create Guenhwyvar, a legendary 4/1 green Cat creature token with trample.
849404.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出传奇衍生生物关海法，其为4/1绿色，具践踏异能的猫。

849414.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for an Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
849414.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

849432.oracleText: Other creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast them.
849432.translation: 对其他由你操控的生物而言，你施放该咒语时每支付过一点来自珍宝的法术力，该生物进场时上面便额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

849440.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create Boo, a legendary 1/1 red Hamster creature token with trample and haste.
849440.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出传奇衍生生物布布，其为1/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的仓鼠。

849457.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Each other creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. You lose X life. 
• Return up to X target creature cards with total mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. They gain haste until end of turn.

当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～

849470.oracleText: Bewitching Whispers — When CARDNAME enters, target creature blocks this turn if able.
849470.translation: 惑人低语～当CARDNAME进场时，目标生物本回合若能进行阻挡，则须如此作。

849479.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw two cards, then discard two cards.
849479.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

849514.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you draw a card and you lose 2 life.
849514.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你抓一张牌且失去2点生命。

849515.oracleText: When Eye of Vecna enters, you draw a card and you lose 2 life.
849515.translation: 当威可那法眼进场时，你抓一张牌且失去2点生命。

849552.oracleText: If you control two or more other lands, CARDNAME enters tapped.
849552.translation: 如果你操控两个或更多其他地，则CARDNAME须横置进场。

849579.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, you may reveal a Dragon card from your hand. CARDNAME enters tapped unless you revealed a Dragon card this way or you control a Dragon.
849579.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，你可以从手上展示一张龙牌。除非你以此法展示龙牌或你操控龙，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

849728.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile another target creature.
849728.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以放逐另一个目标生物。

849926.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile target non-Angel creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
849926.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以放逐目标由你操控的非天使生物，然后将该牌在你的操控下移回战场。

849954.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice another creature. You gain X life and draw X cards, where X is that creature's power.
849954.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，牺牲另一个生物。你获得X点生命且抓X张牌，X为该生物的力量。

850012.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile target nonland permanent not named Detention Sphere and all other permanents with the same name as that permanent.
850012.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以放逐目标名称不为扣留法球的非地永久物，以及所有与该永久物同名的其他永久物。

850171.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a number of 1/0 blue Elemental creature tokens equal to your devotion to blue.
850171.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出若干1/0蓝色元素衍生生物，其数量等同于你的蓝色献力。

850245.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
850245.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌置于你手上。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

850251.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X charge counters on it.
850251.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个充电指示物。

850264.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
850264.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

850268.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever CARDNAME or another enchantment you control enters, creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn.
850268.translation: 星彩～每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

850288.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever CARDNAME or another enchantment you control enters, draw a card.
850288.translation: 星彩～每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，抓一张牌。

850336.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard.
850336.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成坟墓场中任一生物牌的复制品来进入场。

850470.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 blue Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying.
850470.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

850531.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token.
850531.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则派出一个1/1白色战士衍生生物。

850554.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile target creature with toughness 3 or greater until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
850554.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以放逐目标防御力等于或大于3的生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

850560.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
850560.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

850572.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, create a 3/4 white Bird creature token with flying.
850572.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则派出一个3/4白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

850582.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any nonland permanent on the battlefield.
850582.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一非地永久物的复制品来进入战场。

850668.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, you lose 4 life unless you attacked this turn.
850668.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，除非你于本回合中曾进行攻击，否则你失去4点生命。

850825.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, add {oRoWoB}.
850825.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则加{oRoWoB}。

850935.oracleText: Whenever a face-down creature you control enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
850935.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后将你的牌库洗牌。

850980.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 4/4 green Bear creature token.
850980.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一个4/4绿色的熊衍生生物放进战场。

851005.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, another target creature you control gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
851005.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或翻回正面时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+3/+0直到回合结束。

851056.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, create three 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.

851089.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各失去3点生命，且你获得3点生命。

851106.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
851106.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

851111.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, you may draw a card.
851111.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，你可以抓一张牌。

851122.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
851122.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标非生物且非地的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

851131.oracleText: During your turn, CARDNAME has indestructible.
851131.translation: 于你的回合中，CARDNAME具有不灭异能。

851140.oracleText: Whenever another permanent you control enters, each opponent mills a card.
851140.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的永久物进场时，每位对手各磨一张牌。

851143.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X gem counters on it.
851143.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个宝石指示物。

851278.oracleText: Until end of turn, if a creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead.
851278.translation: 直到回合结束，如果某生物将进场，且未有牌手施放之，则改为将它放逐。

851310.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
851310.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

851333.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 3 or greater enters, draw a card.
851333.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或大于3的生物进场时，抓一张牌。

851347.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent loses life equal to the number of Elves you control.
851347.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手失去等同于由你操控之妖精数量的生命。

851411.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 5/5 red and green Elemental creature token.
851411.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个5/5，红绿双色的元素衍生生物。

851416.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands.
851416.translation: 除非你操控两个或更多基本地，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

851444.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card.
851444.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌，并放逐该牌。

851476.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand. That creature's owner can't cast spells with the same name as that creature until your next turn.
851476.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。直到你的下一个回合，该生物的拥有者不能施放与该生物同名的咒语。

851485.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card for each green creature you control.
851485.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个绿色生物，便抓一张牌。

851525.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one —

• Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
851525.translation:

851623.oracleText: Whenever another red creature you control enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

851626.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
851626.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场施放目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该牌将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。

851631.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, CARDNAME deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.
851631.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则CARDNAME对任意数量的目标造成共4点伤害，你可以任意分配。

851635.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Shaman creature you control.
851635.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在由你操控的其他祭师生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

851710.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或从战场进入坟墓场时，抓一张牌。

851721.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token.
851721.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生物。

851727.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，取出一张在你牌库中生物类别最普遍的生物牌。

851728.oracleText: When Faceless Agent enters, seek a creature card of the most prevalent creature type in your library.
851728.translation: 当无面密探进场时，取出一张在你牌库中生物类别最普遍的生物牌。

851740.oracleText: When Lumbering Lightshield enters, target opponent reveals a nonland card at random from their hand. It perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} more to cast."
851740.translation: 当缓行幻光盾进场时，目标对手从其手上随机展示一张非地牌。它永久获得「此咒语增加{o1}来施放」。

851761.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose a creature card in your hand. It perpetually gains flying.
851761.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得飞行异能。

851762.oracleText: When Mentor of Evos Isle enters, choose a creature card in your hand. It perpetually gains flying.
851762.translation: 当伊弗斯岛明师进场时，选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得飞行异能。

851764.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile a Merfolk card or a land card from your hand. If you do, conjure a card named Tropical Island into your hand.
851764.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张人鱼牌或地牌。若你如此作，则将一张名称为热带岛的牌幻变进你手上。

851765.oracleText: When Shoreline Scout enters, you may exile a Merfolk card or a land card from your hand. If you do, conjure a card named Tropical Island into your hand.
851765.translation: 当沿岸斥候进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张人鱼牌或地牌。若你如此作，则将一张名称为热带岛的牌幻变进你手上。

851785.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose a creature card in your hand. It perpetually gains deathtouch.

851786.translation: 当播疫师佣兽进场时，选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得死触异能。

851800.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得敏捷异能。

851801.translation: 当鲁莽魁首进场时，选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久获得敏捷异能。

851837.translation: 当冲阵老兵进场时，选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久得+2/+2。

851893.oracleText: If it's neither day nor night, it becomes day as CARDNAME enters.
851893.translation: 如果当前既非白昼也非黑夜，则于CARDNAME进场时成为白昼。

851942.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o1oW} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many valor counters on CARDNAME.

851985.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, return up to two target creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
851985.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则将至多两张目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

851990.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one target card from a graveyard.

851995.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
851995.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

852026.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may shuffle up to three target cards from your graveyard into your library.
852026.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将至多三张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

852044.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target player mills three cards.
852044.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标牌手磨三张牌。

852052.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
852052.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

852081.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if there are five or more cards in your graveyard, tap enchanted creature.
852081.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你坟墓场中有五张或更多牌，则横置所结附的生物。

852103.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, up to one target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
852103.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，至多一个目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

852112.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

852130.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a card with flashback or disturb, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle.
852130.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张具返照或惊扰异能的牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

852158.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, put a slime counter on up to one other target creature.
852158.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，在至多另一个目标生物上放置一个黏菌指示物。

852195.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
852195.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

852206.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, each opponent discards a card.
852206.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则每位对手各弃一张牌。

852210.oracleText: Whenever another Zombie you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
852210.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的灵俑进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

852213.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标不由你操控的生物，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。

852233.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens with decayed. When you do, exile up to two target cards from graveyards.
852233.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。当你如此作时，将至多两张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

852260.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

852284.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or another nontoken Human you control dies, you lose 1 life and create a 1/1 white Human creature token.

852299.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.

852300.oracleText: When The Meathook Massacre enters, each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.

852335.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

852342.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o2oB} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then create twice that many 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens with decayed.
852342.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o2oB}任意次数。当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后派出两倍的2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

852364.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o2oR} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then exile up to that many target instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard and copy them. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
852364.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o2oR}任意次数。当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后将至多等量之目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐并复制。你可以施放任意数量的复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

852400.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, add {oRoRoR}.
852400.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则加{oRoRoR}。

852517.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, it deals X damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of Vampires you control.
852517.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则它对至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的吸血鬼数量。

852582.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards, then you may return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
852582.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨三张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

852593.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if enchanted creature is a Wolf or Werewolf, untap that creature.
852593.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若所结附的生物是狼或狼人，则重置该生物。

852614.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o1oG} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then up to that many target lands you control become 3/3 Wolf creatures with haste that are still lands.
852614.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o1oG}任意次数。当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后至多等量目标由你操控的地成为3/3，具敏捷异能的狼生物，并且仍然是地。

852646.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, create two 2/2 green Wolf creature tokens.
852646.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，派出两个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

852673.oracleText: Until your next turn, you may cast creature spells as though they had flash, and each creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
852673.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，你可以将生物咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放，且每个由你操控的生物进场时上面均额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

852760.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, mill a card.
852760.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，磨一张牌。

852774.oracleText: Whenever a creature or enchantment you control enters this turn, draw a card.
852774.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物或结界进场时，抓一张牌。

852826.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Vampire you control.
852826.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则在每个由你操控的其他吸血鬼上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

852828.oracleText: As long as an opponent lost life this turn, each other Vampire you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
852828.translation: 只要本回合中有对手失去过生命，每个由你操控的其他吸血鬼进场时上面便额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

852836.oracleText: If it's neither day nor night, it becomes day as The Celestus enters.
852836.translation: 如果当前既非白昼也非黑夜，则于穹天仪进场时成为白昼。

852871.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands.
852871.translation: 除非你操控两个或更多其他地，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

852924.oracleText: When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many valor counters on CARDNAME.
852924.translation: 当你支付此费用一次或数次时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的勇气指示物。

852937.oracleText: When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then up to that many other target artifacts, creatures, and/or enchantments phase out.
852937.translation: 当你支付此费用一次或数次时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后至多等量的其他目标神器，生物和／或结界跃离。

852943.oracleText: Exile up to two target cards from graveyards.
852943.translation: 将至多两张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

852947.oracleText: When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then create twice that many 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens with decayed.
852947.translation: 当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后派出两倍的2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

852948.oracleText: When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then exile up to that many target instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard and copy them. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
852948.translation: 当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后将至多等量之目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐并复制。你可以施放任意数量的复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

852959.oracleText: When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then up to that many target lands you control become 3/3 Wolf creatures with haste that are still lands.
852959.translation: 当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在CARDNAME上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后至多等量目标由你操控的地成为3/3，具敏捷异能的狼生物，并且仍然是地。

852972.oracleText: Whenever a creature or enchantment you control enters this turn, draw a card.
852972.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物或结界进场时，抓一张牌。

852974.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it becomes day.
852974.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，当前成为白昼。

852988.oracleText: Exile all artifacts and creatures with mana value 3 or less. They perpetually gain "This spell costs {o2} more to cast" and "This permanent enters tapped." For as long as each of them remain exiled, its owner may play it.
852988.translation: 放逐所有法术力值等于或小于3的神器和生物。它们永久获得「此咒语增加{o2}来施放」与「此永久物须横置进场。」于它们持续放逐的时段内，其拥有者可以使用之。

852990.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, choose a card in your hand. It perpetually gains lifelink.
852990.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，选择你手上的一张牌。它永久获得系命异能。

852998.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it and there are twenty or more creature cards with mana value 3 or less among cards in your graveyard, hand, and library, seek two creature cards with mana value 3 or less. Put one of them onto the battlefield and shuffle the other into your library.
852998.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，且你坟墓场、手牌和牌库中法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌有二十张或更多，则取出两张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。将其中一张放进战场，另一张则洗入你的牌库。

853001.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card named Sigardian Evangel into your hand. Discard that card at the beginning of the next end step.
853001.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一张名称为席嘉妲福音师的牌幻变进你手上。在下一个结束步骤开始时，弃掉该牌。

853003.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap target permanent you don't control.
853003.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置目标不由你操控的永久物。

853006.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the creature cards in target opponent's hand.
853006.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视目标对手手上的生物牌。

853007.oracleText: When Slayer's Bounty enters, look at the creature cards in target opponent's hand.
853007.translation: 当克星悬赏进场时，检视目标对手手上的生物牌。

853018.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a duplicate of a random creature card from an opponent's library into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
853018.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将对手牌库中随机生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

853023.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a random instant card from your library into your graveyard. Then put a random sorcery card from your library into your graveyard.
853023.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一张随机瞬间牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场。然后将一张随机法术牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场。

853028.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose an instant or sorcery card in your hand with mana value 3 or greater. It perpetually gains "This spell costs {o2} less to cast."
853028.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择你手上的一张法术力值等于或大于3的瞬间或法术牌。它永久获得「此咒语减少{o2}来施放。」

853046.oracleText: Whenever an Island or Swamp you control enters, draft a card from Tireless Angler's spellbook.
853046.translation: 每当一个由你操控的海岛或沼泽进场时，从不倦钓客的法术书中抽选一张牌。

853056.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent discards a nonland card with the greatest mana value among cards in their hand. Create a Blood token.
853056.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手弃一张非地牌，且须为其手牌中法术力值最大者。派出一个血滴衍生物。

853060.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each player discards a nonland card.
853060.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位牌手各弃一张非地牌。

853066.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose a permanent you don't control. When the chosen permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, conjure a card named Predatory Sludge into your hand.
853066.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择一个不由你操控的永久物。当该永久物从战场进入坟墓场时，将一张名称为掠食泥泞怪的牌幻变进你手上。

853071.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Blood token and conjure a card named Blood Artist onto the battlefield.
853071.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个血滴衍生物并将一张名称为鲜血画家的牌幻变进战场。

853085.oracleText: When this creature enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
853085.translation: 当此生物进场时，它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

853086.oracleText: When you cast a Wolf or Werewolf creature spell, it gains "When this creature enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control."
853086.translation: 当你施放狼或狼人生物咒语时，它获得「当此生物进场时，它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。」

853087.oracleText: You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a Wolf or Werewolf creature spell, it gains ‘When this creature enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.'"
853087.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放狼或狼人生物咒语时，它获得『当此生物进场时，它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。』」

853088.oracleText: You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a Wolf or Werewolf creature spell, it gains ‘When this creature enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.'"
853088.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放狼或狼人生物咒语时，它获得『当此生物进场时，它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。』」

853089.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Another target Wolf or Werewolf you control fights target creature you don't control. 
• You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a Wolf or Werewolf creature spell, it gains ‘When this creature enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.'"
853089.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•另一个目标由你操控的狼或狼人与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。 
•你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放狼或狼人生物咒语时，它获得『当此生物进场时，它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。』」

853106.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if there are twenty or more instant and/or sorcery cards among cards in your graveyard, hand, and library, you may discard a card. If you do, seek an instant or sorcery card.
853106.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你坟墓场、手牌和牌库中的瞬间和／或法术牌有二十张或更多，则你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则取出一张瞬间或法术牌。

853125.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target nonbasic land you don't control loses all abilities except mana abilities and gains "At the beginning of your upkeep, this permanent deals 2 damage to you unless you sacrifice it."
853125.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标不由你操控的非基本地失去法术力异能以外的所有异能，且获得「在你的维持开始时，除非你牺牲此永久物，否则它对你造成2点伤害。」

853130.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creatures you control perpetually gain "When this creature dies, you may shuffle it into its owner's library if it's in your graveyard. If you do, investigate."
853130.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由你操控的生物永久获得「当此生物死去时，如果它在你的坟墓场中，则你可以将它洗入其拥有者的牌库。若你如此作，则探查。」

853140.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile a creature card from your hand. If you do, search your hand and library for any number of cards with the same name, exile them, then shuffle. Choose a creature card you own from outside the game. Conjure a duplicate of that card into your hand for each card exiled from your hand this way.
853140.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则从你的手牌和牌库中搜寻任意数量与之同名的牌，将它们放逐，然后洗牌。从游戏外选择一张由你拥有的生物牌。每以此法从你手上放逐一张牌，便将该牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。

853144.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draft a card from Hinterland Chef's spellbook. It perpetually becomes a Food artifact in addition to its other types and gains "{o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: You gain 3 life."
853144.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从内陆厨师的法术书中抽选一张牌。它永久成为食品神器，仍具有原本类别，且永久获得「{o2}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：你获得3点生命。」

853147.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, seek a land card.
853147.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，取出一张地牌。

853156.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of turns you've begun since it was foretold.
853156.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物，X为它被预示后你开始过的回合数量。

853164.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter, trample counter, and vigilance counter on it.
853164.translation: 当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，一个践踏指示物和一个警戒指示物。

853176.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draft a card from Key to the Archive's spellbook, then discard a card.
853176.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从书库钥匙的法术书中抽选一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

853186.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draft a card from Ominous Traveler's spellbook. That card perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell" and "When you cast this spell, return a creature named Ominous Traveler you control to its owner's hand."
853186.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从恶兆旅人的法术书中抽选一张牌。该牌永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」与「当你施放此咒语时，将一个由你操控且名称为恶兆旅人的生物移回其拥有者手上。」

853191.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, scry 1. If you weren't the starting player, you may untap CARDNAME instead.
853191.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，占卜1。如果你不是先手牌手，可以改为重置CARDNAME。

853202.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control enters, CARDNAME can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
853202.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，CARDNAME于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

853213.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, gain control of target creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of Vampires you control until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
853213.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择目标生物，且其法术力值须等于或小于由你操控的吸血鬼数量。获得该生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

853226.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards, then put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME for each creature card in your graveyard.
853226.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨三张牌，然后你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，便在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

853237.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or transforms into Wildsong Howler, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
853237.translation: 每当此生物进场或转化为野调嚎狼时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

853247.oracleText: Discard that card at the beginning of the next end step.
853247.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，弃掉该牌。

853262.oracleText: When the chosen permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, conjure a card named Predatory Sludge into your hand.
853262.translation: 当该永久物从战场进入坟墓场时，将一张名称为掠食泥泞怪的牌幻变进你手上。

853267.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two other target creatures.
853267.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在至多两个其他目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

853278.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile a card from a graveyard.
853278.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。

853369.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
853369.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

853370.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "Whenever a creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn."
853370.translation: 所结附的生物具有「每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。」

853400.oracleText: Creatures enchanted player controls enter tapped.
853400.translation: 由所结附之牌手操控的生物须横置进场。

853403.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control another Human, draw a card.
853403.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控另一个人类，则抓一张牌。

853477.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile a card from a graveyard.
853477.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。

853554.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
853554.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场，但它额外具有精怪此类别。

853567.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken Zombie you control enters, create a token that's a copy of that creature.
853567.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的灵俑进场时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品。

853596.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile two creature cards from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card.
853596.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐两张生物牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

853599.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with three omen counters on it.
853599.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有三个预兆指示物。

853655.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Blood token.
853655.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

853686.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters or dies, exile another card from a graveyard. When you do, choose one — 
• Remove X counters from target permanent, where X is the mana value of the exiled card. 
• Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
853686.translation:
当CARDNAME进场或死去时，从任一坟墓场放逐另一张牌。当你如此作时，选择一项～ 
•从目标永久物上移去X个指示物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。 
•目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

853698.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you gained life this turn, return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
