855778.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile up to one other target creature until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield. If a creature is put into exile this way, return each other card exiled with CARDNAME to the battlefield under its owner's control.
855778.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，放逐至多另一个目标生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。如果以此法将生物置入放逐区，则将其他以CARDNAME放逐的牌分别在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

855801.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, scry 1. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, draw a card instead.
855801.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，占卜1。如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则改为抓一张牌。

855803.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with two shield counters on it.
855803.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有两个后盾指示物。

855805.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may remove a counter from a creature or planeswalker you control. If you do, draw a card and create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
855805.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以从由你操控的生物或鹏洛客上移去一个指示物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌并派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

855813.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 1 life for each other creature you control.
855813.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个其他生物，便获得1点生命。

855881.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it connives. When it connives this way, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
855881.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，令它筹谋。当它以此法筹谋时，将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

855908.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it enters with a shield counter on it if you control that creature.
855908.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场，但如果你操控后者，则它进场时上面有一个后盾指示物。

856039.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, double CARDNAME's power until end of turn.
856039.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，将CARDNAME的力量加倍直到回合结束。

856044.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token. 
• Create a Treasure token.
856044.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。 
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。

856100.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, target creature an opponent controls can't block this turn. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, that creature attacks during its controller's next combat phase if able.
856100.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则该生物于其操控者的下一个战斗阶段中若能攻击，则必须攻击。

856128.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
856128.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

856134.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
856134.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

856151.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
856151.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

856164.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Exile target card from a graveyard. 
• You gain 4 life.
856164.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。 
•你获得4点生命。

856167.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
856167.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

856174.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, target creature other than CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
856174.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，直到回合结束，目标CARDNAME以外的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

856193.oracleText:
Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. 
• Create a tapped Treasure token. 
• You gain 2 life.
856193.translation:
联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的～ 
•在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。 
•你获得2点生命。

856223.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.
856223.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，你获得1点生命。

856234.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose two — 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment. 
• Target player gains 5 life. 
• Create a 4/4 green Rhino Warrior creature token. 
• Put a shield counter on a creature you control.
856234.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择两项～ 
•消灭目标神器或结界。 
•目标牌手获得5点生命。 
•派出一个4/4绿色犀牛／战士衍生生物。 
•在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

856243.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, all creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn.
856243.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则所有由你操控的生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

856296.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose target creature you don't control and tap it. If you control a creature with a counter on it, the chosen creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
856296.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择目标不由你操控的生物并将它横置。如果你操控其上有指示物的生物，则所选生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤不能重置。

856313.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If a card is put into exile this way, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
856313.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一张目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。若以此法将牌置入放逐区，则检视你牌库顶的三张牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

856321.oracleText: CARDNAME has indestructible as long as it entered this turn.
856321.translation: 只要CARDNAME是于本回合进场，它便具有不灭异能。

856335.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Vampire you control enters, exile the top card of each player's library with a collection counter on it.
856335.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的吸血鬼进场时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌，且其上有一个收藏指示物。

856353.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 2 damage to each opponent and you scry 2.
856353.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害且你占卜2。

856382.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent discards half the cards in their hand, rounded down.
856382.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手弃一半数量的手牌，小数点后舍去。

856412.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact, instant, or sorcery card from it and exile that card.
856412.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张神器，瞬间或法术牌，并放逐该牌。

856429.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it connives. When it connives this way, return up to one target spell to its owner's hand.
856429.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，令它筹谋。当它以此法筹谋时，将至多一个目标咒语移回其拥有者手上。

856463.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
856463.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你施放之，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

856466.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, you may choose a nonland permanent.
856466.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，你可以选择一个非地永久物。

856486.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy up to three other target nonland permanents. For each of those permanents, its controller creates a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
856486.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭至多三个其他目标非地永久物。对每个这类永久物而言，其操控者派出一个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

856489.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls can't attack or block until your next turn.
856489.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到你的下一个回合，目标由对手操控的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

856561.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, attach it to target creature you control. That creature gains first strike until end of turn.
856561.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。该生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

856579.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Forest, Plains, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856579.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，平原或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856583.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856583.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，树林或平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856591.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856591.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，沼泽或山脉牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856595.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Plains, Island, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856595.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，海岛或沼泽牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856608.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856608.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，山脉或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856690.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life. Scry 2.
856690.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。占卜2。

856730.oracleText: When it connives this way, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
856730.translation: 当它以此法筹谋时，将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

856759.oracleText: When it connives this way, return up to one target spell to its owner's hand.
856759.translation: 当它以此法筹谋时，将至多一个目标咒语移回其拥有者手上。

856773.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Forest, Plains, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856773.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，平原或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856775.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.

856777.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856777.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，沼泽或山脉牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856779.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Plains, Island, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856779.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，海岛或沼泽牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856781.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
856781.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，山脉或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

856787.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy each permanent you don't control that has the same name as a permanent that dealt damage to you last turn.
856787.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭所有不由你操控且与上回合中对你造成过伤害之任一永久物同名的永久物。

856790.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return a permanent you control to its owner's hand. If it's a non-Angel creature card, it perpetually gets +1/+1, gains flying, and becomes an Angel in addition to its other types.
856790.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一个你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果它是非天使生物牌，则它永久得+1/+1，获得飞行异能，且额外具有天使此类别。

856799.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand. It perpetually gains "This spell costs {o2} more to cast."
856799.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标由对手操控的非地永久物牌移回其拥有者手上。它永久获得「此咒语增加{o2}来施放。」

856804.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if its additional cost was paid, conjure a card named Demonic Pact onto the battlefield.
856804.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若曾支付其额外费用，则将一张名称为恶魔契约的牌幻变进战场。

856823.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card, then draft a card from Loose in the Park's spellbook and exile it.
856823.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓一张牌，然后从放归林园的法术书中抽选一张牌并将它放逐。

856856.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one target creature. Its controller seeks a creature card.
856856.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多一个目标生物。其操控者取出一张生物牌。

856860.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose up to two creature and/or planeswalker cards in your hand. They perpetually gain "When you cast this spell, create a Treasure token and this spell perpetually loses this ability."
856860.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择你手上的至多两张生物和／或鹏洛客牌。它们永久获得「当你施放此咒语时，派出一个珍宝衍生物且此咒语永久失去此异能。」

856863.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose a creature card in your hand without blitz. It perpetually gains blitz. The blitz cost is equal to its mana cost.
856863.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择你手上的一张不具急袭异能的生物牌。它永久获得急袭异能。其急袭费用等同于其法术力费用。

856867.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
856867.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

856868.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creature cards in your hand perpetually gain "When this creature enters, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token."
856868.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你手上的生物牌永久获得「当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。」

856876.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose an instant or sorcery card in your hand. It perpetually gains casualty 2.
856876.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择你手上一张瞬间或法术牌。它永久获得催命2。

856879.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill four cards. Then if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, conjure a card named Dig Up the Body into your hand.
856879.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨四张牌。然后如果你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则将一张名称为挖起尸体的牌幻变进你手上。

856892.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, it perpetually gets +1/+0."
856892.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语时，它永久得+1/+0。」

856906.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card named Soldiers of the Watch onto the battlefield.
856906.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一张名称为监视者士兵的牌幻变进战场。

856914.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, nontoken creatures you control perpetually gain double team.
856914.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由你操控且非衍生物的生物永久获得双打异能。

856935.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, seek two instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3, then exile them.
856935.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，取出两张法术力值为3的瞬间和／或法术牌，然后将它们放逐。

856942.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card named Lightning Bolt into your hand, then discard a card.
856942.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一张名称为闪电击的牌幻变进你手上，然后弃一张牌。

856966.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draft a card from The Hourglass Coven's spellbook twice, then put those cards onto the battlefield.
856966.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从沙漏巫团的法术书中抽选一张牌两次，然后将这些牌放进战场。

856967.oracleText: When The Hourglass Coven enters, draft a card from The Hourglass Coven's spellbook twice, then put those cards onto the battlefield.
856967.translation: 当沙漏巫团进场时，从沙漏巫团的法术书中抽选一张牌两次，然后将这些牌放进战场。

857028.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 4 damage to any target.
857028.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

857036.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, note the most prevalent creature type in an opponent's library.
857036.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，记下任一对手牌库中最普遍的生物类别。

857038.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control fights up to one target creature you don't control.
857038.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由你操控的生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

857078.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, another target nontoken creature you control gains double team until end of turn.
857078.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物获得双打异能直到回合结束。

857109.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creature cards in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.
857109.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你手上的所有生物牌永久得+1/+1。

857154.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell without flying, it perpetually gains flying."
857154.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放不具飞行异能的生物咒语时，它永久获得飞行异能。」

857217.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
857217.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

857335.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
857335.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

857369.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, up to one target creature you control fights target creature you don't control. If the creature you don't control would die this turn, exile it instead.
857369.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，至多一个目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。如果本回合中该不由你操控的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

857410.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, gain control of target artifact or creature an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less until the end of your next turn.
857410.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，获得目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于4的神器或生物直到你下一个回合的回合结束。

857451.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, seek a land card with a basic land type.
857451.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则取出一张具基本地类别的地牌。

857563.oracleText: During your turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to CARDNAME.
857563.translation: 防止于你的回合中将对CARDNAME造成的所有伤害。

859152.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another legendary creature you control enters, return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
859152.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的传奇生物进场时，将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

859172.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
859172.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

859183.oracleText: Return target artifact or creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. If a creature enters this way, it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

859198.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 2 life and create a tapped Powerstone token.
859198.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得2点生命并派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

859206.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

859209.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control with mana value 3 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

859229.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.

859357.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, exile target instant or sorcery card with mana value less than or equal to CARDNAME's power from your graveyard. Copy that card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

859370.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of an artifact or creature you control, except it's an artifact creature in addition to its other types, and its power and toughness are equal to CARDNAME's power and toughness.
859370.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成任一由你操控之神器或生物的复制品来进入战场，但它额外是神器生物，且其力量和防御力各等同于CARDNAME的力量和防御力。

859373.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, scry X, where X is its power.

859667.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters from your graveyard, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw three cards.

859688.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, create two tokens that are copies of it.
859688.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则派出两个为其复制品的衍生物。

859710.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among the cards milled this way into your hand. If you don't, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

859748.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
859748.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

859768.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.

859778.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, you gain 1 life. If this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
859778.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，你获得1点生命。如果这是此异能在本回合第一次的结算，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

859922.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于施放它时所支付之{oGoG}份数的三倍。

859924.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose up to two other target creatures you control. For each {oWoW} spent to cast CARDNAME, put a +1/+1 counter on each of them.
859924.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择至多两个其他目标由你操控的生物。施放CARDNAME时，每支付过一份{oWoW}，便在这些生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

860078.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, untap target land you control. It becomes a Treefolk creature with haste and base power and toughness equal to CARDNAME's power and toughness. It's still a land.

860194.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose artifact, creature, enchantment, instant, or sorcery.

860447.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, other creatures you control of the chosen type and creature cards of that type in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.

862225.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向另一个目标战役或对手造成4点伤害，且对至多一个目标生物造成1点伤害。

862230.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal any number of Dragon cards from your hand. When you do, CARDNAME deals X plus 2 damage to any other target, where X is the number of cards revealed this way.
862230.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你手上展示任意数量的龙牌。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意另一个目标造成X加2点伤害，X为以此法所展示之牌的数量。

862334.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each creature that convoked it.
862334.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于召集它之生物数量的两倍。

862397.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library and/or graveyard for a non-Human creature card with mana value X or less and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
862397.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库和／或你坟墓场中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于X的非人类生物牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

862403.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
862403.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张永久物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

862410.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.
862410.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

862416.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to three target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.
862416.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多三张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

862422.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
862422.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

862438.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a land or double-faced card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
862438.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张地牌或双面牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

862462.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one —

• Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
862462.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。 • 消灭目标神器或结界。

862465.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent cast a blue and/or black spell this turn, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
862465.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若本回合中有对手施放过蓝色和／或黑色咒语，则检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张永久物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

862482.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 5 life and incubate 5.
862482.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得5点生命且抚育5。

862490.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, draw a card if its power is 3 or greater. Otherwise, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
862490.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，若其力量等于或大于3，则抓一张牌。若否，则在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

862495.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for up to two Forest cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
862495.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张树林牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

862496.oracleText: When Vorinclex enters, search your library for up to two Forest cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
862496.translation: 当弗霖凯进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张树林牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

862516.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature or battle card from your graveyard to your hand.
862516.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标生物或战役牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

862528.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, draw a card, then you may discard any number of land cards. When you discard one or more cards this way, CARDNAME deals twice that much damage to target creature.
862528.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，抓一张牌，然后你可以弃任意数量的地牌。每当你以此法弃一张或数张牌时，CARDNAME对目标生物造成该数量两倍的伤害。

862529.oracleText: Whenever Borborygmos and Fblthp enters or attacks, draw a card, then you may discard any number of land cards. When you discard one or more cards this way, Borborygmos and Fblthp deals twice that much damage to target creature.
862529.translation: 每当咕噜力莫与夫毕佐进场或攻击时，抓一张牌，然后你可以弃任意数量的地牌。每当你以此法弃一张或数张牌时，咕噜力莫与夫毕佐对目标生物造成该数量两倍的伤害。

862569.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {oX}. When you do, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value X from a graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
862569.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{oX}。当你如此作时，你可以从任一坟墓场中施放目标法术力值为X的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。若该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

862573.oracleText: When Hidetsugu and Kairi enters, draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.
862573.translation: 当碑出告与开璃进场时，抓三张牌，然后将两张牌从你手上以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

862580.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile two nonland cards with mana value 4 or less. You may cast one of those two cards without paying its mana cost. Put one of them into your hand. Then put the other cards exiled this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
862580.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐两张法术力值等于或小于4的非地牌为止。这两张牌中，你可以施放其中一张，且不需支付其法术力费用；将其中一张置于你手上。然后将以此法放逐的其他牌依随机顺序置于你牌库底。

862586.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each player mills three cards, then each opponent discards a card and you draw a card.
862586.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位牌手各磨三张牌，然后每位对手各弃一张牌，且你抓一张牌。

862590.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.
862590.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成坟墓场中任一生物牌的复制品来进入战场，但它是4/4黑色灵俑，且仍具有原本的颜色和类别。

862601.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Treasure token. Then you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
862601.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

862605.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may discard a card. If you do, search your library for a land or battle card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
862605.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌或战役牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

862613.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, up to two target creatures each get +2/+0 and gain vigilance and haste until end of turn.
862613.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+2/+0且获得警戒与敏捷异能。

862620.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target non-Elf creature an opponent controls with power X or less, where X is the number of lands you control.
862620.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于X的非妖精生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

862630.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. When you do, exile target artifact or creature an opponent controls.
862630.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由对手操控的神器或生物。

862636.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create X 2/2 white and blue Knight creature tokens with vigilance.
862636.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出X个2/2，白蓝双色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

862644.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, scry 3, then reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land or double-faced card, draw a card.
862644.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，占卜3，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌或双面牌，则抓一张牌。

862650.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target nonbattle permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
862650.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标非战役永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

862679.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐五张牌。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

862680.oracleText: Whenever Kroxa and Kunoros enters or attacks, you may exile five cards from your graveyard. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
862680.translation: 每当克罗刹与库诺罗斯进场或攻击时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐五张牌。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

862695.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card if it has three or more colored mana symbols in its mana cost. If you do, add three mana in any combination of its colors and put it into your hand. If you don't reveal it, put it into your hand.

862770.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Phyrexian you control enters, incubate 2.

862782.oracleText:

862885.oracleText: When you discard one or more cards this way, CARDNAME deals twice that much damage to target creature.

862907.oracleText: Whenever Slimefoot and Squee enters or attacks, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
862907.translation: 每当黏足与斯奎进场或攻击时，派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

862910.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, bolster 1.
862910.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物进场时，振励1。

862960.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped with five slumber counters on it.
862960.translation: CARDNAME须横置进场，且上面有五个静眠指示物。

862979.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 2 or less enters, you get an experience counter.
862979.translation: 每当一个力量等于或小于2的生物在你操控下进场时，你得到一个经验指示物。

862984.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择一种鹏洛客类别。

863008.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在每个由对手操控的生物上各放置一个拒斥指示物。

863024.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭所有本回合中受过伤害的其他生物。

863028.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile target card from a graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
863028.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

863033.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks or a creature you control enters attacking, you may pay {o1oR}. If you do, you may put a creature card with mana value less than that creature's mana value from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
863033.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击或一个由你操控的生物以正进行攻击之状态进场时，你可以支付{o1oR}。若你如此作则你可以将一张法术力值小于该生物的生物牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。

863055.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, add one mana of any color. Then if this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal an Elf or Elemental card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

863066.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever CARDNAME or another enchantment you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
863066.translation: 星彩～每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

863087.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target player's graveyard.
863087.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

863094.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to two target legendary creature cards from your graveyard. You draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is the greatest mana value among cards exiled this way.
863094.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多两张目标传奇生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。你抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为以此法放逐之牌中的最大法术力值。

863201.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。当你如此作时，你每操控一个食品，目标由你操控的生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

863211.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card. Then if you don't control a legendary creature, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library.

863232.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标武具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

864758.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已加码，则派出一个倒楣鬼角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由对手操控的生物上。

864762.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to X target creatures. For each of those cards, its owner may play it for as long as it remains exiled.
864762.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多X个目标生物。对每张此类牌而言，于它持续放逐的时段内，其拥有者可以使用之。

864764.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures enter, if one or more of them entered from exile or was cast from exile, you draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
864764.translation: 每当一个或数个非衍生物的生物进场时，若其中有由放逐区进入或从放逐区施放者，则你抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

864778.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped unless it's your turn.
864778.translation: 除非是在你的回合中，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

864824.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped with three stun counters on it.
864824.translation: CARDNAME须横置进场，且上面有三个晕眩指示物。

864829.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o2}. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
864829.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o2}。当你如此作时，横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

864849.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was bargained, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
864849.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已加码，则将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

864911.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, up to one target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
864911.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，至多一个目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

864915.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was bargained, each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
864915.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已加码，则每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

864918.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent discards a card and loses 2 life.
864918.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌且失去2点生命。

864928.oracleText: Whenever another Rat you control enters, exile up to one target card from an opponent's graveyard.
864928.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的老鼠进场时，将至多一张目标牌从对手坟墓场放逐。

864931.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Wicked Role token attached to target creature you control.
864931.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

864967.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile one or more creature cards from your graveyard. When you do, each other creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards exiled this way.
864967.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张或数张生物牌。当你如此作时，每个其他生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为以此法放逐之牌的数量。

864971.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Cursed Role token attached to target creature you control.
864971.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个倒楣鬼角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

864991.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block." Then for each Rat you control, create a Wicked Role token attached to that Rat.
864991.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」然后为每个由你操控的老鼠各派出一个恶人角色衍生物并贴附在该老鼠上。

865027.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Discard a card, then draw a card. 
• Create a Treasure token. 
• Create a Wicked Role token attached to target creature you control.
865027.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。 
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。 
•派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

865081.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o1}. When you do, create a Young Hero Role token attached to target creature you control.
865081.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

865098.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was bargained, add four mana in any combination of colors.
865098.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已加码，则加四点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

865151.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was bargained, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
865151.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已加码，则它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

865162.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, mill three cards, then return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
865162.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，磨三张牌，然后将一张地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

865180.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifacts you control enter, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
865180.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个神器进场时，在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

865182.oracleText: Whenever one or more enchantments you control enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
865182.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个结界进场时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

865195.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it isn't a token, create two tokens that are copies of it.
865195.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它不是衍生物，则派出两个为其复制品的衍生物。

865240.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one or more — 
• Return target card you own in exile that has an Adventure to your hand. 
• Put target card you don't own in exile that has an Adventure on the bottom of its owner's library. 
• Exile target player's graveyard.
865240.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项或多项～ 
•将目标在放逐区中由你拥有且具历险的牌移回你手上。 
•将目标在放逐区中不由你拥有且具历险的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。 
•放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

865255.oracleText: Whenever an Aura you control enters, draw a card.
865255.translation: 每当一个由你操控的灵气进场时，抓一张牌。

865271.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was bargained, exile target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
865271.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已加码，则放逐目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

865275.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, draw a card.
865275.translation: 当CARDNAME进场和每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，抓一张牌。

865305.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Monster Role token attached to it.
865305.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个怪物角色衍生物并贴附于其上。

865311.oracleText: The Goose Mother enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
865311.translation: 鹅鹅妈进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物。

865312.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create half X Food tokens, rounded up.
865312.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出X一半数量的食品衍生物，小数点后进位。

865313.oracleText: When The Goose Mother enters, create half X Food tokens, rounded up.
865313.translation: 当鹅鹅妈进场时，派出X一半数量的食品衍生物，小数点后进位。

865335.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
865335.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标生物或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

865341.oracleText: Whenever another Faerie you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life.
865341.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的仙灵进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

865353.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Monster Role token attached to another target creature you control.
865353.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个怪物角色衍生物，并贴附在另一个目标由你操控的生物上。

865357.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose a number between 1 and 10.
865357.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择一个1到10之间的数字。

865381.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature that died under your control this turn.
865381.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于本回合中在你操控下死去的生物数量。

865481.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
865481.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

865482.oracleText: When Eriette's Tempting Apple enters, gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
865482.translation: 当艾纶缇的诱人苹果进场时，获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

865493.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, you may have CARDNAME become a legendary Equipment artifact named Everflame, Heroes' Legacy. If you do, it gains equip {o3} and "Equipped creature gets +3/+3" and loses all other abilities.
865493.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传奇生物进场时，你可以使CARDNAME成为名称为英雄传承永焰剑的传奇武具神器。若你如此作，则它获得佩带{o3}与「佩带此武具的生物得+3/+3」，并失去所有其他异能。

865494.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, you may have The Irencrag become a legendary Equipment artifact named Everflame, Heroes' Legacy. If you do, it gains equip {o3} and "Equipped creature gets +3/+3" and loses all other abilities.
865494.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传奇生物进场时，你可以使伊雷岩成为名称为英雄传承永焰剑的传奇武具神器。若你如此作，则它获得佩带{o3}与「佩带此武具的生物得+3/+3」，并失去所有其他异能。

865538.oracleText: {oUoR}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a 2/1 blue and red Elemental creature with "During your turn, this creature has first strike." It's still a land.
865538.translation: {oUoR}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为2/1，蓝红双色的元素生物，且具有「于你的回合中，此生物具有先攻异能。」它仍然是地。

865549.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield. Create a Food token.
865549.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。派出一个食品衍生物。

865570.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice any number of artifacts, enchantments, and/or tokens, then draw that many cards.
865570.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，牺牲任意数量的神器，结界和／或衍生物，然后抓等量的牌。

865597.oracleText: Whenever a token you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
865597.translation: 每当一个由你操控的衍生物进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

865626.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
865626.translation: 横置一个目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

865635.oracleText: Each other creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards exiled this way.
865635.translation: 每个其他生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为以此法放逐之牌的数量。

865638.oracleText: Create a Young Hero Role token attached to target creature you control.
865638.translation: 派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

865641.oracleText: Artifacts and creatures your opponents control enter tapped.
865641.translation: 由对手操控的神器与生物须横置进场。

865645.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, for each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
865645.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～放逐至多一个目标由该牌手操控的非地永久物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

865671.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any enchantment on the battlefield.
865671.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一结界的复制品来进入战场。

865685.oracleText: Whenever a creature enters, untap all creatures.
865685.translation: 每当一个生物进场时，重置所有生物。

865709.oracleText: Whenever a land an opponent controls enters, that player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
865709.translation: 每当一个地在对手操控下进场时，该牌手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

865727.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
865727.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

865781.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying for each mana from a Cave spent to cast it.
865781.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，施放它时每支付过一点来自洞窟的法术力，便派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

865783.oracleText: Whenever a Cave you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
865783.translation: 每当一个洞窟在你操控下进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

865785.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 2 life.
865785.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得2点生命。

865790.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens.
865790.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物。

865820.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
865820.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。当你如此作时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

865837.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME for each creature that left the battlefield under your control this turn. 
• You gain 2 life and scry 2. 
• Exile target player's graveyard.
865837.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•本回合中每有一个生物在你操控下离开战场，便在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•你获得2点生命且占卜2。 
•放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

865841.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn.
865841.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

865869.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand. 
• Scry 3.
865869.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 
•占卜3。

865873.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature token.
865873.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物。

865891.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or dies, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
865891.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或死去时，派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

865896.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 5 damage to target tapped creature an opponent controls.
865896.translation: 当CARDNAME进入战场时，它向目标由对手操控的已横置生物造成5点伤害。

865914.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, you may tap five untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control. If you do, transform CARDNAME.
865914.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，你可以横置五个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物。若你如此作，则转化CARDNAME。

865915.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, you may tap five untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control. If you do, transform Thousand Moons Smithy.
865915.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，你可以横置五个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物。若你如此作，则转化千月军锻冶场。

865926.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, for each player, choose a creature with power 2 or less that player controls. Then destroy all creatures except creatures chosen this way.
865926.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则为每位牌手各选择一个由其操控且力量等于或小于2的生物。然后消灭所有生物，但以此法选中的生物除外。

865950.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with three net counters on it.
865950.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有三个罗网指示物。

865968.oracleText: Descend 4 — When CARDNAME enters, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, return up to one target nonland permanent other than CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
865968.translation: 落坟4～当CARDNAME进场时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则将至多一个目标CARDNAME以外的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

865989.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill two cards, then draw two cards.
865989.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨两张牌，然后抓两张牌。

865990.oracleText: When The Everflowing Well enters, mill two cards, then draw two cards.
865990.translation: 当汩汩涌井进场时，磨两张牌，然后抓两张牌。

866009.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill a card, then draw a card.
866009.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨一张牌，然后抓一张牌。

866017.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, for each player, choose up to one other target artifact or creature that player controls. For as long as CARDNAME remains on the battlefield, the chosen permanents become Treasure artifacts with "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color" and lose all other abilities.
866017.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，为每位牌手各选择至多另一个目标由该牌手操控的神器或生物。于CARDNAME仍在战场上的时段内，所选永久物成为珍宝神器，且具有「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力」，并失去所有其他异能。

866020.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap up to one target artifact or creature and put two stun counters on it.
866020.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置至多一个目标神器或生物并在其上放置两个晕眩指示物。

866066.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may put one of those cards back on top of your library. Put the rest into your graveyard.
866066.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以将其中一张放回你的牌库顶。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

866075.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of Caves you control plus the number of Cave cards in your graveyard. Put two of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
866075.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控的洞窟数量与你坟墓场中的洞窟牌数量之总和。将其中两张置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

866083.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Map token.
866083.translation: 当CARDNAME进入战场时，派出一个地图衍生物。

866087.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact or Pirate card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
866087.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张神器或海盗牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

866090.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, counter up to one target activated or triggered ability. If an ability of an artifact, creature, or planeswalker is countered this way, that permanent loses all abilities for as long as CARDNAME remains on the battlefield.
866090.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，反击至多一个目标起动式或触发式异能。如果以此法反击神器，生物或鹏洛客的异能，则于CARDNAME仍在战场上的时段内，该永久物失去所有异能。

866104.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control an artifact, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
866104.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控神器则横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

866134.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, each player sacrifices all other creatures they control. Then each player returns all creature cards from their graveyard that weren't put there this way to the battlefield.
866134.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则每位牌手各牺牲所有由其操控的其他生物。然后每位牌手各从其坟墓场中将所有并非以此法进入该处的生物牌移回战场。

866146.oracleText: Fathomless descent — When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
866146.translation: 落坟无边～当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。

866150.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 black Skeleton Pirate creature token.
866150.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/2黑色骷髅妖／海盗衍生生物。

866164.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at target opponent's hand. You may exile a nonland card from it until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
866164.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视目标牌手的手牌。你可以放逐其中一张非地牌直到CARDNAME离开战场。

866196.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
866196.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或从战场进入坟墓场时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

866208.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, return up to one target Vampire card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. You lose life equal to its mana value.
866208.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标吸血鬼牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。你失去等同于其法术力值的生命。

866211.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
866211.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得不灭异能。

866223.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent exiles a card from their hand.
866223.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手从其手上放逐一张牌。

866235.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, surveil 2. Then for each card you put on top of your library, you draw a card and you lose 3 life.
866235.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，刺探2。然后你每将一张牌置于你的牌库顶，便抓一张牌且失去3点生命。

866253.oracleText: {oT}: You may cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn. If you do, it enters with a finality counter on it and is a Vampire in addition to its other types.
866253.translation: {oT}：本回合中，你可以从你坟墓场中施放一个生物咒语。若你如此作，则它进场时上面有一个终命指示物，且额外具有吸血鬼此类别。

866264.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it. That player discards that card.
866264.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张神器或生物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

866270.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may mill two cards.
866270.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以磨两张牌。

866281.oracleText: Whenever another Dinosaur you control enters, you may have CARDNAME's base power become equal to that creature's power until end of turn.
866281.translation: 每当另一个恐龙在你操控下进场时，你可以使CARDNAME的基础力量成为等同于该生物的力量直到回合结束。

866287.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards plus one.
866287.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，弃任意数量的牌，然后抓该数量加一的牌。

866288.oracleText: When Brass's Tunnel-Grinder enters, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards plus one.
866288.translation: 当霸司的掘隧机进场时，弃任意数量的牌，然后抓该数量加一的牌。

866325.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control gains menace until end of turn.
866325.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

866335.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another artifact you control enters, up to one target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. Then transform CARDNAME if you control four or more artifacts.
866335.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个神器在你操控下进场时，直到回合结束，至多一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。然后如果你操控四个或更多神器，则转化CARDNAME。

866350.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, discover 3.
866350.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则倾探3。

866372.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 5 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
866372.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成5点伤害。

866438.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may reveal a Dinosaur card from your hand. If you do or if you control another Dinosaur, you gain 3 life.
866438.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从手上展示一张恐龙牌。若你如此作或你操控另一个恐龙，则你获得3点生命。

866446.oracleText: During your turn, creatures you control have hexproof.
866446.translation: 于你的回合中，由你操控的生物便有辟邪异能。

866456.oracleText: Descend 4 — When CARDNAME enters, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
866456.translation: 落坟4～当CARDNAME进场时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

866465.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card for each other Dinosaur you control.
866465.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个其他恐龙，便抓一张牌。

866474.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put any number of creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
866474.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将任意数量的生物牌从你手上放进战场。

866499.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, add {oGoG}.
866499.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，加{oGoG}。

866503.oracleText: You may cast Dinosaur creature spells from among cards you own exiled with CARDNAME. If you cast a spell this way, that creature enters with a finality counter on it.
866503.translation: 你可以从由你拥有且以CARDNAME放逐的牌之中施放恐龙生物咒语。如果你以此法施放咒语，则该生物进场时上面有一个终命指示物。

866509.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.
866509.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标由你操控的生物。

866514.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain life equal to the mana value of the exiled card used to craft it.
866514.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得若干生命，其数量等同于用以化炼它所放逐之牌的法术力值。

866518.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it explores X times.

866521.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
866521.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

866528.oracleText: Choose target creature you control and target creature you don't control. If the creature you control entered this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then those creatures fight each other.
866528.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物和目标不由你操控的生物。如果该由你操控的生物是于本回合进场，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后这些生物互斗。

866543.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token.
866543.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个3/3绿色恐龙衍生生物。

866575.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, create a Map token.
866575.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，派出一个地图衍生物。

866581.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you put a Cave onto the battlefield this way, you gain 4 life.
866581.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。如果你以此法将洞窟放进战场，则你获得4点生命。

866583.translation: 由你操控的地都未横置地进场。

866592.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control explores.
866592.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，令目标由你操控的生物勘察。

866594.oracleText: When a land you control enters, if you control seven or more lands, transform CARDNAME.
866594.translation: 当一个地在你操控下进场时，若你操控七个或更多地，则转化CARDNAME。

866630.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target Pirate you control.
866630.translation: 每当一个神器在你操控下进场时，在目标由你操控的海盗上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

866637.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay {o2}. When you do, target Dinosaur you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.
866637.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付{o2}。当你如此作时，目标由你操控的恐龙对另一个目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

866648.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 4/4 white and blue Golem artifact creature token.
866648.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个4/4，白蓝双色的魔像衍生神器生物。

866669.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 0/1 green Dinosaur Egg creature tokens.
866669.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个0/1绿色恐龙／蛋衍生生物。

866711.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a basic land card or Cave card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
866711.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或洞窟牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

866732.oracleText: Equipped creature has deathtouch during your turn. Otherwise, it has reach.
866732.translation: 于你的回合中，佩带此武具的生物具有死触异能。其余回合，它具有延势异能。

866752.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card or Cave card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
866752.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或洞窟牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

866770.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, create a number of 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
866770.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，派出若干1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物，其数量等同于其力量。

866788.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter tapped as a copy of any land card in a graveyard, except it's a Cave in addition to its other types.
866788.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成坟墓场中任一地牌的复制品来横置进入战场，但它额外具有洞窟此类别。

866815.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to three target cards from graveyards.
866815.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多三张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

866899.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 6 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
866899.translation: 当CARDNAME战场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成6点伤害。

866909.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
866909.translation: 在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

866957.oracleText: Target Dinosaur you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.
866957.translation: 指定一个由你操控的恐龙为目标，对另一个目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

866969.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Dinosaur you control enters, you may discover X, where X is that creature's toughness. Do this only once each turn.
866969.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的恐龙进场时，你可以倾探X，X为该生物的防御力。每回合只能如此作一次。

866985.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, put a flood counter on target land. That land is an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it.
866985.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，在目标地上放置一个洪水指示物。只要该地上有洪水指示物，它便额外具有海岛此类别。

866989.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create X Treasure tokens, where X is the number of artifacts and enchantments your opponents control.
866989.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出X个珍宝衍生物，X为由对手操控之神器和结界的总数量。

866992.oracleText: When this Case enters, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
866992.translation: 当此案件进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

866997.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, all suspected creatures are no longer suspected.
866997.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，所有已遭疑的生物不再遭疑。

867020.oracleText: When this Case enters, choose target creature you don't control. Each creature you control deals 1 damage to that creature.
867020.translation: 当此案件进场时，选择目标不由你操控的生物。每个由你操控的生物各对该生物造成1点伤害。

867025.oracleText: Whenever a Detective you control enters or is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
867025.translation: 每当一个侦探在你操控下进场或翻回正面时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

867044.oracleText: Artifacts and creatures entering don't cause abilities to trigger.
867044.translation: 进场的神器和生物不会触发异能。

867047.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control other than enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
867047.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，目标所结附生物以外由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得警戒异能。

867061.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard.
867061.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。

867065.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control with power 2 or less.
867065.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，在目标由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

867068.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
867068.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

867085.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.
867085.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。你获得2点生命。

867091.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn.
867091.translation: 每当另一个力量等于或小于2的生物在你操控下进场时，CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

867099.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
867099.translation: 每当另一个力量等于或小于2的生物在你操控下进场时，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

867117.oracleText: Whenever another Detective you control enters and whenever a Detective you control is turned face up, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
867117.translation: 每当另一个侦探在你操控下进场和每当一个由你操控的侦探翻回正面时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

867142.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your graveyard, hand and/or library for a card named Magnifying Glass and/or a card named Thinking Cap and put them onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
867142.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场，手牌和／或牌库中搜寻一张名称为放大镜的牌和／或一张名称为思考帽的牌，并将它们放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

867149.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, draw a card.
867149.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

867178.oracleText: You may collect evidence 10 rather than pay the mana cost for spells you cast.
867178.translation: 你可以搜证10，而不支付你施放之咒语的法术力费用。

867188.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap target creature. If evidence was collected, put a stun counter on it.
867188.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置目标生物。如果已搜证，则在后者上放置一个晕眩指示物。

867191.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, cloak the top card of your library, then attach CARDNAME to it.
867191.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，匿伏你的牌库顶牌，然后将CARDNAME贴附于其上。

867232.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one other target creature to its owner's hand. If you controlled it, investigate.
867232.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。如果你操控它，则探查。

867245.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap X target creatures. Put a stun counter on each of those creatures you don't control.
867245.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置X个目标生物。在其中不由你操控的生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

867255.oracleText: When Proft's Eidetic Memory enters, draw a card.
867255.translation: 当波费的清晰记忆进场时，抓一张牌。

867259.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Detective you control enters and whenever a Detective you control is turned face up, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
867259.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个侦探在你操控下进场和每当一个由你操控的侦探翻回正面时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

867271.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an instant or sorcery card or a creature card with flying.
867271.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓两张牌。然后除非你弃一张瞬间或法术牌或一张具飞行异能的生物牌，否则弃两张牌。

867299.oracleText: When this Case enters, create a 2/1 black Skeleton creature token and suspect it.
867299.translation: 当此案件进场时，派出一个2/1黑色骷髅妖衍生生物并怀疑它。

867323.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent creates two 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
867323.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手派出两个1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

867329.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put an impostor counter on each creature you control.
867329.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个冒名指示物。

867355.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you lose 3 life.
867355.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你失去3点生命。

867366.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top four cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 2 life.
867366.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。你失去2点生命。

867389.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, surveil 1.
867389.translation: 每当另一个力量等于或小于2的生物在你操控下进场时，刺探1。

867392.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn.
867392.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。

867400.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. When you do, exile target creature an opponent controls.
867400.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物。

867417.oracleText: When this Case enters, it deals 3 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
867417.translation: 当此案件进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成3点伤害。

867422.oracleText: When this Case enters, discard a card, then draw two cards.
867422.translation: 当此案件进场时，弃一张牌，然后抓两张牌。

867444.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, suspect enchanted creature.
867444.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，怀疑所结附的生物。

867450.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice an artifact. When you do, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
867450.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

867473.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control enter, if CARDNAME is suspected, you may suspect one of the other creatures. If you do, CARDNAME is no longer suspected.
867473.translation: 每当一个或数个其他生物在你操控下进场时，若CARDNAME已遭疑，则你可以怀疑这些其他生物中的一个。若你如此作，则CARDNAME不再遭疑。

867489.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Destroy up to one target artifact. 
• Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
867489.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•消灭至多一个目标神器。 
•牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

867507.oracleText: During your turn, equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has first strike.
867507.translation: 于你的回合中，佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有先攻异能。

867514.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, for each player, destroy up to one nonbasic land that player controls. For each land destroyed this way, its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
867514.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，为每位牌手各进行以下流程～消灭至多一个由该牌手操控的非基本地。对每个以此法消灭的地而言，其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

867523.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, up to one target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
867523.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或翻回正面时，至多一个目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

867527.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, suspect it. Create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
867527.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，怀疑它。派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

867564.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, untap enchanted creature. It gains hexproof until end of turn. If it's suspected, it's no longer suspected.
867564.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，重置所结附的生物。它获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。如果它已遭疑，则它不再遭疑。

867588.oracleText: When this Case enters, distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control.
867588.translation: 当此案件进场时，将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标由你操控的生物。

867597.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, target creature blocks this turn if able.
867597.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或翻回正面时，目标生物本回合若能进行阻挡，则必须阻挡。

867614.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures, then you gain life equal to the greatest toughness among creatures you control.
867614.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标生物，然后你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控之生物中的最大防御力。

867632.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Human creature token, a 1/1 blue Merfolk creature token, and a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. Then secretly choose Human, Merfolk, or Goblin.
867632.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物，一个1/1蓝色人鱼衍生生物和一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。然后私下选择人类，人鱼或鬼怪。

867653.oracleText: During your turn, CARDNAME has hexproof.
867653.translation: 于你的回合中，CARDNAME具有辟邪异能。

867674.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, if its power is greater than CARDNAME's power or its toughness is greater than CARDNAME's toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and investigate.
867674.translation: 每当一个生物在你操控下进场时，若其力量大于CARDNAME的力量或其防御力大于CARDNAME的防御力，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物并探查。

867699.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if evidence was collected, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and you gain 2 life.
867699.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若已搜证，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你获得2点生命。

867703.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, choose up to one target creature. If it's suspected, exile it. Otherwise, suspect it.
867703.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，选择至多一个目标生物。如果它已遭疑，则将它放逐。若否，则怀疑它。

867720.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 3 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
867720.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成3点伤害。

867725.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target nonland permanent you don't control until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
867725.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标不由你操控的非地永久物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

867732.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of other creatures you control.
867732.translation: 于CARDNAME进场或翻回正面时，在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的其他生物数量。

867776.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
867776.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或翻回正面时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

867797.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may collect evidence 4. If you do, create two 2/1 black and green Spider creature tokens with menace and reach.
867797.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以搜证4。若你如此作，则派出两个2/1，黑绿双色，具威慑与延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

867864.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, target creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
867864.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或翻回正面时，目标生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

867878.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, suspect up to one target creature you control.
867878.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，怀疑至多一个目标由你操控的生物。

867904.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create Voja Fenstalker, a legendary 5/5 green and white Wolf creature token with trample.
867904.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出传奇衍生生物沼行沃亚，其为5/5，绿白双色，具践踏异能的狼。

867931.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
867931.translation: 每当另一个力量等于或小于2的生物在你操控下进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

867979.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to CARDNAME.
867979.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标武具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在CARDNAME上。

868016.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice it unless you tap an untapped artifact or land you control.
868016.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，除非你横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器或地，否则牺牲之。

868037.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and whenever you solve a Case, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an enchantment card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
868037.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或每当你侦办一个案件时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张结界牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来施放案件咒语。

868050.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may collect evidence 4.

868054.oracleText: When this Case enters, destroy up to one target creature that was dealt damage this turn.
868054.translation: 当此案件进场时，消灭至多一个目标本回合中受过伤害的生物。

868059.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, suspect up to one other target creature you control.
868059.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，怀疑至多另一个目标由你操控的生物。

868071.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target token an opponent controls.
868071.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的衍生物。

868118.oracleText: Exile target creature an opponent controls.
868118.translation: 放逐目标由对手操控的生物。

868121.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
868121.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

868127.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one other target nonland, nontoken permanent. Its controller creates a token that's a copy of it, except it's not legendary and it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
868127.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多另一个目标非地且非衍生物的永久物。其操控者派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它不是传奇，且额外具有神器此类别。

868141.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one target spell or nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If CARDNAME was bargained, that card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o2} more to cast."
868141.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一个目标咒语或非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果CARDNAME已加码，则该牌永久获得「此咒语增加{o2}来施放。」

868154.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a one-time boon with "At the beginning of your end step, if three or more creatures died this turn, each opponent loses 5 life and you gain 5 life."
868154.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有三个或更多生物死去，则每位对手各失去5点生命且你获得5点生命。」

868200.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Conjure a card of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield. 
• Return up to three target Boar creature cards with different names from your graveyard to the battlefield.
868200.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•从三只小猪的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进战场。 
•将至多三张目标名称各不相同的野猪生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

868213.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose up to one — 
• Perpetually exchange target creature's base power with another target creature's base power. 
• CARDNAME perpetually has base power and toughness 4/1.
868213.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•永久将目标生物与另一个目标生物的基础力量互换。 
•CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力永久为4/1。

868218.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure seven cards named Seven Dwarves on top of your library. They perpetually gain "When this creature enters, draw a card." Then shuffle.
868218.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将七张名称为七个矮人的牌幻变进你的牌库顶。它们永久获得「当此生物进场时，抓一张牌。」然后洗牌。

868222.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card named Steelclaw Lance and a card named Brawler's Plate onto the battlefield and attach them to CARDNAME.
868222.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一张名称为钢爪长枪的牌和一张名称为喧哗兵护甲的牌幻变进战场并将它们贴附在CARDNAME上。

868227.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield.
868227.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从三只小猪的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进战场。

868242.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may put any number of Aura cards from your graveyard and/or hand onto the battlefield attached to it.
868242.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将任意数量的灵气牌从你的坟墓场和／或手上放进战场并贴附于其上。

868306.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile all Mountain cards from your library. When you do, CARDNAME deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
868306.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐你牌库中所有的山脉牌。当你如此作时，CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

868327.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure two cards named Propagator Primordium into your graveyard.
868327.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将两张名称为繁殖原基的牌幻变进你的坟墓场。

868335.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draft a card from Scalespeaker Shepherd's spellbook.
868335.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从鳞语牧者的法术书中抽选一张牌。

868342.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Conjure a card named Savage Stomp into your hand. 
• Conjure a card named Naturalize into your hand.
868342.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•将一张名称为蛮野重跺的牌幻变进你手上。 
•将一张名称为回归自然的牌幻变进你手上。

868359.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
868359.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标生物，直到映象网阵离开战场为止。

868389.oracleText: CARDNAME deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
868389.translation: CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成该数量的伤害。

868398.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target spell. It becomes plotted.
868398.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标咒语。它成为已设谋。

868415.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you may search your library for a Plains card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. Then if an opponent controls more lands than you, repeat this process once. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
868415.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张平原牌，并将之横置放进战场。然后如果某对手操控的地比你多，则将此流程再重复一次。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

868418.oracleText: If you control five or more untapped lands, CARDNAME enters with two +1/+1 counters and a lifelink counter on it.
868418.translation: 如果你操控五个或更多未横置的地，则CARDNAME进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物和一个系命指示物。

868435.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Mount creature card or a Plains card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
868435.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张坐骑生物牌或平原牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

868449.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 2 life and scry 1.
868449.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得2点生命且占卜1。

868458.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
868458.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

868466.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one target non-Faerie, nonland permanent you control to its owner's hand. If a permanent was returned this way, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
868466.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控、且既非仙灵也非地的永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果以此法移回了永久物，则在育幼碧仙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

868502.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand. Return that card to the battlefield instead if you control a Mount.
868502.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果你操控坐骑，则改为将该牌移回战场。

868505.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it plus an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature you control.
868505.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控的其他生物数量加一。

868519.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control.
868519.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

868578.oracleText: Whenever a Zombie you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
868578.translation: 每当一个灵俑在你的操控下进场时，本回合中每有一个其他灵俑在你操控下进过战场，便在该进战场的灵俑上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

868596.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you've cast two or more spells this turn, draw a card.
868596.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则抓一张牌。

868613.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 blue and black Zombie Rogue creature token, then put two +1/+1 counters on that token for each spell you've cast this turn other than the first.
868613.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/2，蓝黑双色的灵俑／浪客衍生生物，然后你于本回合施放的第一个咒语以外每多施放过一个咒语，便在该衍生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

868618.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one target tapped creature to its owner's hand.
868618.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一个目标已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上。

868680.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
868680.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

868723.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, any number of target opponents each discard a card. For each of those opponents who didn't discard a card with mana value 4 or greater, draw a card.
868723.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，任意数量的目标对手各弃一张牌。每有一位未弃掉法术力值等于或大于4之牌的对手，你便抓一张牌。

868767.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if a creature died this turn, create a 2/2 blue and black Zombie Rogue creature token.
868767.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若本回合中有生物死去，则派出一个2/2，蓝黑双色的灵俑／浪客衍生生物。

868787.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, any number of target players each discard a card.
868787.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，任意数量的目标牌手各弃一张牌。

868788.oracleText: When Tinybones Joins Up enters, any number of target players each discard a card.
868788.translation: 当细骨入伙进场时，任意数量的目标牌手各弃一张牌。

868789.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, any number of target players each mill a card and lose 1 life.
868789.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传奇生物进场时，任意数量的目标牌手各磨一张牌并失去1点生命。

868802.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice a creature. When you do, target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
868802.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

868809.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target player draws a card and loses 1 life.
868809.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

868826.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains haste until end of turn.
868826.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得敏捷异能。

868872.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 red Mercenary creature tokens with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
868872.translation: 当CARDNAME首领进场时，派出两个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

868896.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control another outlaw, create a Treasure token.
868896.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控另一个狂徒，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

868973.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
868973.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

868995.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with two +1/+1 counters on it if it wasn't cast or no mana was spent to cast it.
868995.translation: 如果CARDNAME未经施放或施放时未支付过法术力，则它进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

869034.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
869034.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

869039.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, add one mana of any color.
869039.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，加一点任意颜色的法术力。
