869041.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.
869041.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，抓一张牌。

869045.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards. Put a land card from among the milled cards into your hand. If you can't, create a Treasure token.
869045.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨三张牌。将一张地牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。若你无法如此作，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

869048.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is its power.
869048.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为该生物的力量。

869056.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that entered this turn.
869056.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且为本回合进场的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

869097.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
869097.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。

869102.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
869102.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

869103.oracleText: When Annie Joins Up enters, it deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
869103.translation: 当安妮入伙进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

869106.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one target creature until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
869106.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多一个目标生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

869111.oracleText: During your turn, outlaws you control have first strike.
869111.translation: 于你的回合中，由你操控的狂徒生物具有先攻异能。

869118.oracleText: Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, create a 1/1 black Vampire Rogue creature token with lifelink. This ability triggers only once each turn.
869118.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个衍生物进场时，派出一个1/1黑色，具系命异能的吸血鬼／浪客衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

869130.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile the top card of your library. If it's a land card, create a 2/2 white Ox creature token. Otherwise, you may cast it until the end of your next turn.
869130.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，派出一个2/2白色的牛衍生生物。若否，则直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

869154.oracleText: {oT}: Create a token that's a copy of target token you control that entered this turn.
869154.translation: {oT}：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控且为本回合进场的衍生物之复制品。

869155.oracleText: Nontoken creatures you control have "{oT}: Create a token that's a copy of target token you control that entered this turn."
869155.translation: 由你操控且非衍生物的生物具有「{oT}：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控且为本回合进场的衍生物之复制品。」

869162.oracleText: When Honest Rutstein enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
869162.translation: 当诚实的鲁斯登进场时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

869164.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent loses 1 life, you gain 1 life, and you draw a card.
869164.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命，你获得1点生命，且你抓一张牌。

869177.oracleText: Whenever one or more tokens your opponents control enter, for each of them, create a tapped token that's a copy of it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
869177.translation: 每当一个或数个衍生物在对手的操控下进场时，对每个此类衍生物而言，你派出一个已横置且为其复制品的衍生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

869178.oracleText: Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
869178.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个衍生物进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

869180.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your hand. If you do, it becomes plotted.
869180.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌。若你如此作，则它成为已设谋。

869181.oracleText: When Kellan Joins Up enters, you may exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your hand. If you do, it becomes plotted.
869181.translation: 当凯澜入伙进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌。若你如此作，则它成为已设谋。

869182.oracleText: Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
869182.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传奇生物进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

869208.oracleText: During your turn, Mounts and Vehicles you control have hexproof.
869208.translation: 于你的回合中，由你操控的坐骑和载具具有辟邪异能。

869224.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
869224.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面额外有两个+1/+1指示物。

869225.oracleText: When Rakdos Joins Up enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
869225.translation: 当拉铎司入伙进场时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面额外有两个+1/+1指示物。

869252.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME and/or one or more other nontoken creatures you control enter, if none of them were cast or no mana was spent to cast them, draw a card.
869252.translation: 每当CARDNAME和／或一个或数个其他非衍生物的生物在你操控下进场时，若它们都未经施放或施放它们时未支付过法术力，则抓一张牌。

869273.oracleText: Whenever another outlaw you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent.
869273.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的狂徒进场时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成1点伤害。

869277.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a deathtouch counter on each creature you control.
869277.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个死触指示物。

869278.oracleText: When Vraska Joins Up enters, put a deathtouch counter on each creature you control.
869278.translation: 当瓦丝卡入伙进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个死触指示物。

869319.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, reveal it, then shuffle and put it on top.
869319.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

869329.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 1 damage to target opponent.
869329.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标对手造成1点伤害。

869333.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return a land you control to its owner's hand. If another Desert was returned this way, surveil 1.
869333.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。如果以此法移回的是另一个沙漠，则刺探1。

869415.oracleText: Target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
869415.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

869422.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature.
869422.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标生物。

869445.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you draw three cards, gain 6 life, and create three 2/1 black Bat creature tokens with flying.
869445.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你抓三张牌，获得6点生命并派出三个2/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

869451.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, other creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
869451.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，其他生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

869474.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, exile target artifact or land.
869474.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则放逐目标神器或地。

869486.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for up to five land cards that have different names, exile them, then shuffle.
869486.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多五张名称各不相同的地牌，将它们放逐，然后洗牌。

869492.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token.
869492.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。

869496.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, you gain 3 life and draw a card.
869496.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个力量等于或大于4的生物在你操控下进场时，你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

869542.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, draw a card.
869542.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲一个地。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

869550.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/1 white Cat Warrior creature token.
869550.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/1白色猫／战士衍生生物。

869573.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may change the target of target instant or sorcery spell with a single target to CARDNAME.
869573.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择目标仅指定单一目标的瞬间或法术咒语，你可以将其目标更改为CARDNAME。

869624.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with an additional loyalty counter on him for each instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn.
869624.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面额外有数个忠诚指示物，其数量等同于你本回合中施放过的瞬间与法术咒语数量。

869644.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, you gain X life and draw X cards, where X is that creature's power.
869644.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则你获得X点生命且抓X张牌，X为该生物的力量。

869766.oracleText: Whenever another colorless creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
869766.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的无色生物进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

869802.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the greatest mana value among cards in exile.
869802.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于放逐区中牌的最大法术力值。

869852.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life and get {oE}.
869852.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，你获得1点生命且得到{oE}。

869867.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• You get {oEoEoE}. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. 
• Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
869867.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•你得到{oEoEoE}。 
•在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

869876.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, proliferate.
869876.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物进场时，增殖。

869884.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token. Then if you have the city's blessing, for each token you control that entered this turn, create a token that's a copy of it.
869884.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则派出一个1/1白色的猫衍生生物。然后如果你有黄金城祝福，则对每个由你操控且于本回合进场的衍生物而言，派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。

869895.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put a shield counter on target permanent. 
• Proliferate.
869895.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标永久物上放置一个后盾指示物。 
•增殖。

869898.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact or enchantment card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
869898.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张神器或结界牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。如果你未以此法将牌置于手上，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

869906.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield. You get {oEoE}.
869906.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。你得到{oEoE}。

869908.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, sacrifice CARDNAME unless you pay {oE}.
869908.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，除非你支付{oE}，否则牺牲CARDNAME。

869926.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy up to one target nonbasic land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
869926.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭至多一个目标非基本地。其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

869953.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has "Whenever this creature attacks, it connives."
869953.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场，但它具有「每当此生物攻击时，令它筹谋。」

869958.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, it becomes your choice of a 3/3 creature with flying, a 2/5 creature with vigilance, or a 0/12 creature with defender.
869958.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，它依你的选择成为具飞行异能的3/3生物，具警戒异能的2/5生物，或具守军异能的0/12生物。

869973.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, tap CARDNAME unless you pay {oE}.
869973.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，除非你支付{oE}，否则横置CARDNAME。

869995.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you get {oE}.
869995.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，你得到{oE}。

870002.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card, then scry 2.
870002.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓一张牌，然后占卜2。

870038.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exchange control of CARDNAME and target creature an opponent controls. If you do, you get {oEoEoEoE}, then sacrifice that creature unless you pay an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value.
870038.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，交换CARDNAME和目标由对手操控之生物的操控权。若你如此作，则你得到{oEoEoEoE}，然后除非你支付等同于后者生物之法术力值数量的{oE}，否则牺牲之。

870046.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
870046.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

870061.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent exiles the top card of their library, a card at random from their graveyard, and a card at random from their hand. You may cast a spell from among cards exiled this way without paying its mana cost.
870061.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手放逐其牌库顶牌，其坟墓场中随机一张牌，以及其手上随机一张牌。你可以从以此法放逐的牌之中施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

870108.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a card with mana value less than or equal to your devotion to black, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.
870108.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于你黑色献力的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你失去3点生命。

870120.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and whenever you draw your third card each turn, amass Zombies 3.
870120.translation: 当CARDNAME进场和每当你抓每回合中你的第三张牌时，囤兵灵俑3。

870130.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a quest counter on CARDNAME.
870130.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个探索指示物。

870136.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent discards a card. For each opponent who can't, you draw a card.
870136.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌。每有一位无法如此作的对手，你便抓一张牌。

870144.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, mill three cards. Then you may pay {o1} and 3 life. If you do, put a card from among those cards into your hand.
870144.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，磨三张牌。然后你可以支付{o1}和3点生命。若你如此作，则将这些牌其中一张置于你手上。

870148.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, it connives.
870148.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，令它筹谋。

870170.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get {oEoE}. Then if you cast it from your hand, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast that card by paying an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
870170.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你得到{oEoE}。然后若你从你手上施放之，则从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，但须支付等同于其法术力值数量的{oE}，而不支付其法术力费用。

870224.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, you may discard a card. If you do, exile the top two cards of your library, then choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
870224.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则放逐你牌库顶的两张牌，然后选择其中一张。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

870238.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME gains battle cry until end of turn.
870238.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME获得战嚎异能直到回合结束。

870281.oracleText: If CARDNAME was kicked, it enters with two +1/+1 counters and a trample counter on it and with haste.
870281.translation: 如果CARDNAME已增幅，则它进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物和一个践踏指示物，且具有敏捷异能。

870373.oracleText: During your turn, nonland permanent cards in your graveyard have retrace.
870373.translation: 于你的回合中，你坟墓场中的非地永久物牌具有追溯异能。

870388.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, look at the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.
870388.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是生物牌，你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。如果你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

870450.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is half the number of artifacts you control, rounded down.
870450.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为由你操控之神器数量的一半，小数点后舍去。

870468.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token. If you control seven or more lands with different names, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token instead.
870468.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物。如果你操控七个或更多名称各不相同的地，则改为派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

870479.oracleText: When Phlage enters, sacrifice it unless it escaped.
870479.translation: 当斐拉革进场时，除非它已逸脱，否则牺牲之。

870480.oracleText: Whenever Phlage enters or attacks, it deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
870480.translation: 每当斐拉革进场或攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

870500.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill six cards. You may put a card with {oX} in its mana cost from among them into your hand.
870500.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨六张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力费用中包含{oX}的牌置于你手上。

870505.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 red Gremlin creature tokens. Then you get an amount of {oE} equal to the number of creatures you control.
870505.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1红色怪灵衍生生物。然后你得到等同于由你操控之生物数量的{oE}。

870608.oracleText: Imprint — When CARDNAME enters, you may exile a colorless card with mana value 7 or greater from your hand.
870608.translation: 压印～当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张法术力值等于或大于7的无色牌。

870621.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments.
870621.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多两个目标神器和／或结界。

870639.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of an enchantment you control, except it has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile this enchantment. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control."
870639.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成任一由你操控的结界之复制品来进入战场，但它具有「在你的维持开始时，你可以放逐此结界。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。」

870659.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste.
870659.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，你可以使其成为战场上任一生物的复制品直到回合结束，但它具有敏捷异能。

870710.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, put an everything counter on each of up to one target land and up to one target creature.
870710.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，在至多一个目标地和至多一个目标生物上各放置一个万物指示物。

870733.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
870733.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你本盘游戏中每从统帅区施放过一次你的指挥官，便派出一个1/1绿色树林／树灵衍生地生物。

870738.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may choose a creature card in your hand. If you do, that card perpetually incorporates {oW} and gains "When you cast this spell, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token."
870738.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以选择你手上的一张生物牌。若你如此作，则该牌永久添补{oW}且获得「当你施放此咒语时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。」

870752.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may choose an instant or sorcery card in your hand. If you do, that card perpetually incorporates {oR} and gains "When you cast this spell, it deals 2 damage to each opponent."
870752.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以选择你手上的一张瞬间或法术牌。若你如此作，则该牌永久添补{oR}且获得「当你施放此咒语时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。」

870757.oracleText: When this Case enters, it deals 1 damage to any target.
870757.translation: 当此案件进场时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

870765.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may choose a creature card in your hand. If you do, that card perpetually incorporates {o1oG} and gets +4/+4.
870765.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以选择你手上的一张生物牌。若你如此作，则该牌永久添补{o1oG}且得+4/+4。

870781.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draft a card from Emmara, Voice of the Conclave's spellbook.
870781.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从盟会之音艾玛拉的法术书中抽选一张牌。

870800.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if evidence was collected, conjure a card named Spotlight Falcon into your hand.
870800.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若已搜证，则将一张名称为探灯猎鹰的牌幻变进你手上。

870811.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, secretly choose a number between 1 and 20.
870811.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，私下选择一个1到20之间的数字。

870830.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, for each creature your opponents control, conjure a card named Stab Wound onto the battlefield attached to that creature.
870830.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，为每个由对手操控的生物各进行以下流程～将一张名称为刺创伤的牌幻变进战场，并贴附在该生物上。

870834.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand. You choose one of those cards and exile it.
870834.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手上的所有非地牌。你选择其中一张并将它放逐。

870860.oracleText: When this Case enters, conjure four cards named Fblthp, the Lost into your library, then shuffle. Draw a card.
870860.translation: 当此案件进场时，将四张名称为迷途的夫毕佐的牌幻变进你的牌库，然后洗牌。抓一张牌。

870899.oracleText: When Teysa enters, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying. Teysa intensifies by 1.
870899.translation: 当泰莎进场时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。泰莎强化1。

870913.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card of your choice from Saint Elenda's spellbook into your hand. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost.
870913.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从圣依莲达的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进你手上。本回合中，你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

870914.oracleText: When Saint Elenda enters, conjure a card of your choice from Saint Elenda's spellbook into your hand. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost.
870914.translation: 当圣依莲达进场时，从圣依莲达的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进你手上。本回合中，你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

870919.oracleText: When Vona de Iedo enters, destroy target nonland, nontoken permanent an opponent controls. Then you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of that permanent into your hand, and the duplicate perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
870919.translation: 当伊埃多的沃娜进场时，消灭目标由对手操控之非地且非衍生物的永久物。然后你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则将该永久物的一张副本幻变进你手上，且该副本永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

870947.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, the next noncreature spell target opponent casts costs {o2} more to cast.
870947.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手施放的下一个非生物咒语增加{o2}来施放。

870965.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, discard a card, then heist target opponent's library.
870965.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，弃一张牌，然后偷窃目标对手的牌库。

870969.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, heist target opponent's library twice.
870969.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，偷窃目标对手的牌库两次。

870973.oracleText: When Nashi enters, secretly choose a card in your graveyard and conjure a duplicate of it into your hand. If the duplicate isn't a land card, it perpetually gains flash.
870973.translation: 当哪失进场时，私下选择你坟墓场中的一张牌，并将它的一张副本幻变进你手上。如果该副本不是地牌，则它永久获得闪现异能。

872042.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
872042.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

872057.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may tap or untap target permanent.
872057.translation: 当CARDNAME进场和每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以横置或重置目标永久物。

872061.oracleText: Whenever another creature enters, you gain 1 life.
872061.translation: 每当另一个生物进场时，你获得1点生命。

872068.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an Illusion in addition to its other types and it has "When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it."
872068.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进场，但它额外具有虚影此类别，且具有「当此生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，将它牺牲。」

872107.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of creature and/or land cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
872107.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，展示你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中任意数量的生物和／或地牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

872666.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
872666.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，由你操控的生物得+1/+0并获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

872705.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may return target tapped creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
872705.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将目标由对手操控且已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上。

872733.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a divinity counter on it if you cast it from your hand.
872733.translation: 如果你从你手上施放CARDNAME，则它进场时上面有一个神威指示物。

872734.oracleText: Myojin of Night's Reach enters with a divinity counter on it if you cast it from your hand.
872734.translation: 如果你从你手上施放夜幕明神，则它进场时上面有一个神威指示物。

872751.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for an artifact card, exile it, then shuffle.
872751.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，将它放逐，然后洗牌。

872805.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the greatest power among other creatures you control.
872805.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的其他生物中力量最大者的数值。

872806.oracleText: Prime Speaker Zegana enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the greatest power among other creatures you control.
872806.translation: 首席洁加娜进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的其他生物中力量最大者的数值。

872807.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw cards equal to its power.
872807.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓等同于其力量的牌。

872808.oracleText: When Prime Speaker Zegana enters, draw cards equal to its power.
872808.translation: 当首席洁加娜进场时，抓等同于其力量的牌。

872962.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each player loses 3 life.
872962.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位牌手失去3点生命。

872976.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may destroy target nonblack creature.
872976.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以消灭目标非黑色生物。

873015.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target player reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then puts those cards into their graveyard.
873015.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标牌手从其牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止，然后将这些牌置入其坟墓场。

873043.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, destroy target creature.
873043.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，消灭目标生物。

873065.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice another creature you control. If you do, create a number of Treasure tokens equal to that creature's power.
873065.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲另一个由你操控的生物。若你如此作，则派出若干珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于该生物的力量。

873081.oracleText: Morbid — When CARDNAME enters, if a creature died this turn, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
873081.translation: 丧心～当CARDNAME进场时，若本回合中有生物死去，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

873097.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control enters, tap target creature an opponent controls.
873097.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

873122.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent draws a card and you draw three cards.
873122.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手抓一张牌且你抓三张牌。

873144.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. 
• Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
873144.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌并将该牌置于牌库顶。

873148.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME gets +4/+4 and gains trample until end of turn.
873148.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME得+4/+4且获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

873158.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 3 or greater enters, you may draw a card.
873158.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且力量等于或大于3的生物进场时，你可以抓一张牌。

873162.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may gain 2 life.
873162.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，你可以获得2点生命。

873169.oracleText: Whenever another green creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
873169.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的绿色生物进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

873173.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may pay {o3oG}. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
873173.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，你可以支付{o3oG}。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

873179.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
873179.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

873182.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the total number of cards in all players' hands.
873182.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物，X为所有牌手手牌的总数。

873187.oracleText:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. 
• You gain 2 life.
873187.translation:
地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•你获得2点生命。

873190.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
873190.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

873193.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token, a 3/3 green Beast creature token, and a 4/4 green Beast creature token.
873193.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物，一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物和一个4/4绿色野兽衍生生物。

873207.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, create X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
873207.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则派出X个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

873258.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a number of 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of opponents you have.
873258.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出若干1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其数量等同于你的对手数量。

873263.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile the top card of your library. During any turn you attacked with CARDNAME, you may play that card.
873263.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于你以CARDNAME攻击过的回合中，你可以使用该牌。

873268.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
873268.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得践踏异能。

873274.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Vampire you control enters, CARDNAME fights up to one target creature an opponent controls.
873274.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的吸血鬼进场时，CARDNAME与至多一个目标由对手操控的生物互斗。

873362.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
873362.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

873373.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for up to two creature cards with mana value 1 or less, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
873373.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，且每张牌的法术力值均须等于或小于1，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。若你如此作，则洗牌。

873439.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it from your hand, destroy all creatures your opponents control, then tap all other creatures you control.
873439.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你从手上施放之，消灭所有由对手操控的生物，横置所有由你操控的其他生物。

873478.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all artifact cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
873478.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，展示你牌库顶的三张牌。将所有以此法展示的神器牌置于你的手上，并将其他的牌置入你的坟墓场。

873487.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it from your hand, exile all artifacts.
873487.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你从手上使用之，则将所有神器放逐。

873494.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, remove all charge counters from CARDNAME. Add one mana of any color for each charge counter removed this way.
873494.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，移去CARDNAME上的所有充电指示物。每以此法移去一个充电指示物，便加一点任意颜色的法术力。

873721.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield.
873721.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场。

873751.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.
873751.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的山脉数量。

873886.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any artifact or creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
873886.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一神器或生物的复制品来进入战场，但它额外具有神器此类别。

874022.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may return target Dragon permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
874022.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将目标龙永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

874158.oracleText: If CARDNAME would enter, you may discard a land card instead. If you do, put CARDNAME onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard.
874158.translation: 如果CARDNAME将进场，则你可以改为弃一张地牌。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME放进战场。若你未如此作，则将它置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

874235.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it's on the battlefield, it becomes an Aura with "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Necromancy." Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control and attach CARDNAME to it. When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it.
874235.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它在战场上，则它成为具有「结附于以死灵术放进战场的生物」的灵气。将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场，并将此结界贴附于其上。当此结界离开战场时，该生物之操控者牺牲该生物。

874296.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, destroy target nonbasic land.
874296.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，消灭目标非基本地。

874317.oracleText: Whenever a Mountain you control enters, if you control at least five other Mountains, you may have CARDNAME deal 3 damage to any target.
874317.translation: 每当一个由你操控的山脉进场时，若你操控至少五个其他山脉，则你可以使CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

874319.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 1 life. You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter, trample counter, and vigilance counter on it."
874319.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得1点生命。你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，一个践踏指示物和一个警戒指示物。」

874390.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken artifact you control enters, exile a random nonland artifact card with lesser mana value from your library. You may cast that card until the end of your next turn.
874390.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的神器进场时，从你的牌库中放逐一张法术力值比该神器小的随机非地神器牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

874450.oracleText: This creature enters with an additional shield counter on it.
874450.translation: 此生物进场时上面有一个后盾指示物。

874451.oracleText: Exile target nonartifact creature you control. It perpetually gains "This creature enters with an additional shield counter on it." Then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
874451.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的非神器生物。它永久获得「此生物进场时上面额外有一个后盾指示物。」然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

874480.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may choose a creature card in your hand. If you do, it perpetually gains "This creature enters with an additional shield counter on it." Otherwise, put a shield counter on CARDNAME.
874480.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以选择你手上鄂一张生物牌。若你如此作，则它永久获得「此生物进场时上面额外有一个后盾指示物。」若否，则在CARDNAME上放置一个后盾指示物。

874738.oracleText: When this creature enters or specializes, seek a nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less.
874738.translation: 当此生物进场或精进时，取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌。

874742.oracleText: When this creature enters or specializes, conjure a duplicate of a random creature card from an opponent's library into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
874742.translation: 当此生物进场或精进时，将任一对手牌库中随机生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

874745.oracleText: When this creature enters or specializes, return up to two target creature cards with total mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
874745.translation: 当此生物进场或精进时，将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于3。

874748.oracleText: When this creature enters or specializes, create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
874748.translation: 当此生物进场或精进时，派出两个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

874751.oracleText: When this creature enters or specializes, other creatures you control and creature cards in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.
874751.translation: 当此生物进场或精进时，由你操控的其他生物和你手上的生物牌永久得+1/+1。

874753.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
874753.translation: 当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

874754.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enlists a creature, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it."
874754.translation: 每当CARDNAME征列生物时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。」

874839.oracleText: Whenever a Swamp or Forest you control enters, draft a card from Slimefoot, Thallid Transplant's spellbook.
874839.translation: 每当一个由你操控的沼泽或树林进场时，从散绿植菌黏足的法术书中抽选一张牌。

874942.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
874942.translation: 当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

874943.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or leaves the battlefield, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it."
874943.translation: 当CARDNAME进入或离开战场时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。」

874981.oracleText: When you cast a Phyrexian creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter and deathtouch counter on it.
874981.translation: 当你施放非瑞人生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物和一个死触指示物。

874982.oracleText: You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a Phyrexian creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter and deathtouch counter on it."
874982.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放非瑞人生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物和一个死触指示物。」

874985.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a card is exiled this way, you may conjure a duplicate of that card into the top five cards of your library at random.
874985.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果以此法放逐一张牌，则你可以将该牌的一张副本随机幻变进你牌库顶的五张牌中。

875023.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X oil counters on it.
875023.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个烁油指示物。

875164.oracleText: During your first three turns of the game, CARDNAME enters tapped if you were the starting player.
875164.translation: 于本盘游戏你的前三个回合中，如果你是先手牌手，则CARDNAME须横置进场。

875170.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters tapped and with a stun counter on it.
875170.translation: 当你施放生物咒语时，该生物须横置进场，且上面有一个晕眩指示物。

875171.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Scry 3. Target opponent gets a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters tapped and with a stun counter on it." Activate only during your turn and only once.
875171.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：占卜3。目标对手获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语时，该生物须横置进场，且上面有一个晕眩指示物。」只能于你的回合中起动，且只能起动一次。

875277.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or is turned face up, it deals X damage to target opponent, where X is the number of noncreature spells you've cast since the beginning of your last turn.
875277.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或翻回正面时，它向目标对手造成X点伤害，X为你在你上一个回合开始后施放过的非生物咒语数量。

875281.oracleText: When Jessie Zane enters and whenever you cast a Snake spell, conjure a card named Ambush Viper into the top six cards of your library at random. It perpetually gains "When this creature enters, draw a card."
875281.translation: 当杰西赞恩进场和每当你施放蛇咒语时，将一张名称为伏击毒蛇的牌随机幻变进你牌库顶的六张牌中。它永久获得「当此生物进场时，抓一张牌。」

875288.oracleText: When Grenzo enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, heist target opponent's library.
875288.translation: 当格伦佐进场和在你的维持开始时，偷窃目标对手的牌库。

875325.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, that creature perpetually gains haste if its power is 4 or greater. If its toughness is 4 or greater, you gain 4 life. If its mana value is 4 or greater, seek a creature card.
875325.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，如果该生物的力量等于或大于4，则它永久获得敏捷异能。如果其防御力等于或大于4，则你获得4点生命。如果其法术力值等于或大于4，则取出一张生物牌。

875597.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or attacks, conjure a card named Stormfront Pegasus into your hand.
875597.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，将一张名称为暴锋飞马的牌幻变进你手上。

875598.oracleText: When Wingsteed Trainer enters or attacks, conjure a card named Stormfront Pegasus into your hand.
875598.translation: 当飞马训练师进场或攻击时，将一张名称为暴锋飞马的牌幻变进你手上。

875673.oracleText: Whenever Longtusk Stalker enters or attacks, you get {oE}.
875673.translation: 每当长牙伏猫进场或攻击时，你得到{oE}。

875694.oracleText: Whenever one or more Humans and/or Warriors you control enter, conjure a card named Utility Knife onto the battlefield. This ability triggers only once each turn.
875694.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个人类和／或战士进场时，将一张名称为万用刀具的牌幻变进战场。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

875746.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever one or more other creatures you control enter, seek a land card, then put it onto the battlefield tapped. This ability triggers only once each turn.
875746.translation: 联手～每当由你操控的一个或数个其他生物进场时，取出一张地牌，然后将它横置放进战场。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

875748.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals all creature and land cards in their hand. Choose one of them. That card perpetually gains "This permanent enters tapped."
875748.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手上的所有生物和地牌。选择其中一张。该牌永久获得「此永久物须横置进场。」

875753.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with your choice of a +1/+1 counter, a flying counter, or a lifelink counter on it.
875753.translation: 当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面依你的选择有一个+1/+1指示物，一个飞行指示物，或一个系命指示物。

875754.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with your choice of a +1/+1 counter, a flying counter, or a lifelink counter on it."
875754.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面依你的选择有一个+1/+1指示物，一个飞行指示物，或一个系命指示物。」

875900.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter, reach counter, and trample counter on it.
875900.translation: 当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，一个延势指示物和一个践踏指示物。

875901.oracleText: You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter, reach counter, and trample counter on it."
875901.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，一个延势指示物和一个践踏指示物。」

875980.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with a lifelink counter on it.
875980.translation: 当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面有一个系命指示物。

875981.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with a lifelink counter on it."
875981.translation: 当此生物精进时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语，该生物进场时上面有一个系命指示物。」

876905.oracleText: When Titania enters, return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
876905.translation: 当泰坦尼亚进场时，将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

876964.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken artifacts you control enter, creatures you control perpetually get +1/+1.
876964.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的神器进场时，由你操控的生物永久得+1/+1。

876990.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any permanent on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
876990.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一永久物的复制品来进场，但它额外具有神器此类别。

877033.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, cards you own named Arek, False Goldwarden intensify by 1.
877033.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，由你拥有且名称为假意金坚卫阿列克的牌强化1。

877060.oracleText: When one or more creatures you control enter, create a Wicked Role token attached to one of them.
877060.translation: 当一个或数个由你操控的生物进场时，派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在其中一个生物上。

877061.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a one-time boon with "When one or more creatures you control enter, create a Wicked Role token attached to one of them." Then if CARDNAME was bargained, return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
877061.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当一个或数个由你操控的生物进场时，派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在其中一个生物上。」然后若CARDNAME已加码，则将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

877130.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken lands you control enter, for each of them, conjure a duplicate of it onto the battlefield. This ability triggers only once each turn.
877130.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的地进场时，对每个这类地而言，将它的一张副本幻变进战场。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

877157.oracleText: Whenever one or more Merfolk you control enter, target Merfolk creature you control explores.
877157.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的人鱼进场时，令目标由你操控的人鱼生物勘察。

877158.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a three-time boon with "Whenever one or more Merfolk you control enter, target Merfolk creature you control explores."
877158.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得具有以下异能的三次恩泽～「每当一个或数个由你操控的人鱼进场时，令目标由你操控的人鱼生物勘察。」

877431.oracleText: Target a token you control that entered this turn.
877431.translation: 指定一个由你操控，且于本回合进场的衍生物为目标。

877432.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than black.
877432.translation: CARDNAME须横置进场。于它进场时，选择一种黑色以外的颜色。

877447.oracleText: Look a card at random in target player's hand.
877447.translation: 随机检视目标牌手手上的一张牌。

877452.oracleText: Choose up to {2, plural, =1 {1 nonland permanent to sacrifice or card to discard. You will lose 4 life if nothing is selected.} other {{2, Number} nonland permanents to sacrifice and/or cards to discard. You will lose life if fewer than {2, Number} are selected.}}
877452.translation: 选择至多{2, plural, =1 {牺牲一个非地永久物或弃一张牌。否则便失去4点生命。} other {{2, Number}次牺牲一个非地永久物和/或弃一张牌。若选择数量少于{2, Number}次，便会失去生命。}}

877454.oracleText: Exile up to one card of each type.
877454.translation: 每种牌张类别放逐至多一张。

877455.oracleText: Tap an untapped creature you control. ({o4}, {oT}: Draw a card. For each mana in this ability's activation cost, you may tap an untapped creature you control rather than pay that mana. Activate only as a sorcery.)
877455.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物。（{o4}，{oT}：抓一张牌。对此异能起动费用中的每点法术力而言，你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物，而不支付该法术力。只能于法术时机起动。）

877456.oracleText: Cast a spell from among the exiled cards without paying its mana cost?
877456.translation: 是否要从所放逐的牌之中施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

877461.oracleText: Whenever a player plays a Desert, that player draws a card and you gain 3 life.
877461.translation: 每当任一牌手使用沙漠时，该牌手抓一张牌且你获得3点生命。

877463.oracleText: "Quickly now, gather around. We're about to set off on today's adventure!"
877463.translation: 「快点，集合！我们即将开始今天的冒险！」

877464.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose a white creature card in your hand. That card perpetually gains offspring {o1}.
877464.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择你手上的一张白色生物牌。该牌永久获得繁生{o1}。

877467.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell without flying, conjure a duplicate of it into your hand. The duplicate perpetually gains flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
877467.translation: 每当你施放不具飞行异能的生物咒语时，将它的一张副本幻变进你手上。该副本永久获得飞行异能。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

877471.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Rat you control enters, conjure a card named Think Twice into your graveyard.
877471.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的老鼠进场时，将一张名称为再次考虑的牌幻变进你的坟墓场。

877473.oracleText: Threshold — {oT}: Spells you cast from your graveyard this turn cost {o2} less to cast. Activate only if seven or more cards are in your graveyard.
877473.translation: 门槛～{oT}：你本回合从你坟墓场中施放的咒语减少{o2}来施放。只能于你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌时起动。

877476.oracleText: Draw two cards. If the gift was promised, seek two nonland cards instead.
877476.translation: 抓两张牌。如果已应诺礼赠，则改为取出两张非地牌。

877478.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast instant or sorcery spells.
877478.translation: {oT}：加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语。

877482.oracleText: Shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library, then draw seven cards. If the gift wasn't promised, each other player also shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards.
877482.translation: 将你的手牌和坟墓场洗入你的牌库然后抓七张牌。如果未应诺礼赠，则每位其他牌手再将其手牌与坟墓场洗入其牌库，然后各抓七张牌。

877493.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target nonland permanent with mana value 3 or less an opponent controls.
877493.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物。

877495.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner seeks a card that shares a card type with the exiled card.
877495.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者取出一张与该牌具共通牌张类别的牌。

877498.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card named Might of the Meek into your hand.
877498.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一张名称为驯良者之威的牌幻变进你手上。

877502.oracleText:
Walk loudly, and carry a lot of things.
—Racoonfolk travel motto
877502.translation:
大声走路，多带东西。
～浣熊民旅行格言

877506.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, instant and sorcery cards in your hand perpetually gain "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
877506.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你手上的瞬间和法术牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

877507.oracleText: Sacrifice this enchantment: Conjure a card of your choice from Charged Conjuration's spellbook into your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
877507.translation: 牺牲此结界：从充能交换术的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进你手上。只能于法术时机起动。

877513.oracleText: You don't need to know the words to sing along.
877513.translation: 你不需要知道歌词就能跟着唱。

877514.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creature cards in your hand perpetually gain "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
877514.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你手中的生物牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

877517.oracleText: Sometimes it's nice to take the scenic route home.
877517.translation: 有时沿着风景优美的路线回家也不错。

877521.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a noncreature spell, creature cards in your library perpetually get +1/+1.
877521.translation: 每当任一对手施放非生物咒语时，你牌库中的生物牌永久得+1/+1。

877523.oracleText: Whenever a Boar you control attacks, each nonland card in defending player's hand perpetually gains "When you cast this spell, you lose 1 life."
877523.translation: 每当一个由你操控的野猪攻击时，防御牌手手中的每张非地牌均永久获得「当你施放此咒语时，你失去1点生命。」

877528.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Lizard you control enters, CARDNAME perpetually gains battle cry.
877528.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的蜥蜴进场时，CARDNAME永久获得战嚎异能。

877530.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Lizard you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
877530.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的蜥蜴死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

877534.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this artifact: You gain 3 life.

877537.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control a tapped creature, seek a nonland permanent card with mana value X or less, where X is the number of tapped creatures you control. Put that card onto the battlefield.
877537.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控已横置的生物，则取出一张法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物牌，X为由你操控且已横置的生物数量。将该牌放进战场。

877539.oracleText: You may pay {o0} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
877539.translation: 你可以支付{o0}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

877540.oracleText: When this permanent enters, draw a card.
877540.translation: 当此永久物进场时，抓一张牌。

877549.oracleText: No harvest method is too nuts.
877549.translation: 没有什么收成方式是疯狂的。

877555.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 white Mouse creature token.
877555.translation: 英武～每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，派出一个1/1白色家鼠衍生生物。

877558.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME and that creature perpetually get +1/+1.
877558.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME和该生物永久得+1/+1。

877560.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Return another target creature you control to its owner's hand.
877560.translation: {o1}，{oT}：将另一个目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

877561.oracleText: Choose a white creature card in your hand.
877561.translation: 选择你手上的一张白色生物牌。

877562.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent with mana value 3 or less an opponent controls.
877562.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物为目标。

877563.oracleText: Seek a card that shares a card type with the exiled card.
877563.translation: 取出一张与所放逐之牌具共通牌张类别的牌。

877565.oracleText: Seek a nonland permanent card with mana value {2, Number} or less.
877565.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的非地永久物牌。

878466.oracleText: Reveal a creature card with power 3 or less?
878466.translation: 是否要展示一张力量等于或小于3的生物牌？

878467.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may put a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
878467.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的手上或坟墓场放进战场。该生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

878470.oracleText: When Oath of Chandra enters, it deals 3 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
878470.translation: 当茜卓的誓约进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成3点伤害。

878471.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, gain control of target creature or planeswalker for as long as you control CARDNAME.
878471.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，获得目标生物或鹏洛客的操控权。

878472.oracleText: When Dragonlord Silumgar enters, gain control of target creature or planeswalker for as long as you control Dragonlord Silumgar.
878472.translation: 当龙王席穆嘉进场时，于你操控龙王席穆嘉的时段内，获得目标生物或鹏洛客的操控权。

878473.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose Khans or Dragons.
878473.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择可汗或龙王。

878475.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it and exile that card.
878475.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张瞬间或法术牌，并放逐该牌。

878477.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
878477.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

878481.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target instant, sorcery, or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
878481.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标瞬间，法术或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

878485.oracleText: Converge — CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each color of mana spent to cast it.
878485.translation: 聚辉～CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为施放它支付的法术力颜色数量。

878489.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control two or more Gates, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
878489.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控两个或更多门，则目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

878491.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.
878491.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个5/5黑色，具飞行异能的恶魔衍生生物。

878494.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has "At the beginning of your upkeep, if this creature isn't a token, create a token that's a copy of this creature."
878494.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进场，但它具有「在你的维持开始时，若此生物不是衍生物，则派出一个为此生物之复制品的衍生物。」

878496.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent has more life than you, you gain 5 life.
878496.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若某对手的生命比你多，则你获得5点生命。

878498.oracleText: When Linvala enters, if an opponent controls more creatures than you, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
878498.translation: 当琳法拉进场时，若某对手操控的生物比你多，则派出一个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

878499.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature with mana value 3 or less an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
878499.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

878501.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Dragon you control enters, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of Dragons you control.
878501.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的龙进场时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的龙数量。

878503.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, for each opponent, destroy target noncreature permanent that player controls. For each permanent destroyed this way, search your library for a Forest card and put that card onto the battlefield tapped. Then shuffle.
878503.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～从由其操控的永久物中选择一个目标非生物永久物，消灭该永久物。每有一个以此法消灭的永久物，便从你的牌库中搜寻一张树林牌，并将其横置进战场。然后洗牌。

878505.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a creature, land, or planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
878505.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中一张生物，地或鹏洛客牌，并将其置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

878506.oracleText: When Oath of Nissa enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a creature, land, or planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
878506.translation: 当妮莎的誓约进场时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中一张生物，地或鹏洛客牌，并将其置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

878507.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, detain target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
878507.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，拘留目标由对手操控的非地永久物。

878509.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap target red or green creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control CARDNAME.
878509.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置目标由对手操控的红色或绿色生物。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

878512.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a green or white creature card from it and exile that card.
878512.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张绿色或白色的生物牌，并放逐该牌。

878514.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you control two or more Gates, you may draw a card.
878514.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你操控两个或更多门，你可以抓一张牌。

878516.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may tap or untap target creature.
878516.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以横置或重置目标生物。

878518.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a number of 1/1 black Harpy creature tokens with flying equal to your devotion to black.
878518.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出若干1/1黑色，具飞行异能的哈痞衍生生物，其数量等同于你的黑色献力。

878520.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a number of 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens equal to your devotion to white.
878520.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出若干1/1白色士兵衍生生物，其数量等同于你的白色献力。

878522.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, Purphoros deals 2 damage to each opponent.
878522.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，普罗烽斯向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

878523.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your devotion to green.
878523.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你的绿色献力。

878525.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target player reveals a number of cards from their hand equal to your devotion to black. You choose one of them. That player discards that card.
878525.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标牌手从其手上展示若干牌，其数量等同于你的黑色献力。你从中选择一张。该牌手弃掉该牌。

878527.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
878527.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的其他生物数量。

878530.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card for each Aura you control that's attached to a creature.
878530.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个贴附在生物上的灵气，便抓一张牌。

878534.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand this turn, it gains rebound.
878534.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次从你手上施放瞬间或法术咒语时，它获得弹回异能。

878535.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw three cards, then discard two cards.
878535.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓三张牌，然后弃两张牌。

878536.oracleText: When Oath of Jace enters, draw three cards, then discard two cards.
878536.translation: 当杰斯的誓约进场时，抓三张牌，然后弃两张牌。

878538.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if its surge cost was paid, other creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
878538.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若曾支付其潮涌费用，则直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

878542.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 white Kor Ally creature tokens.
878542.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1白色寇族／伙伴衍生生物。

878543.oracleText: When Oath of Gideon enters, create two 1/1 white Kor Ally creature tokens.
878543.translation: 当基定的誓约进场时，派出两个1/1白色寇族／伙伴衍生生物。

878544.oracleText: Each planeswalker you control enters with an additional loyalty counter on it.
878544.translation: 每个由你操控的鹏洛客进场时上面额外有一个忠诚指示物。

878545.oracleText: Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
878545.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

878547.oracleText: Cast those cards without paying their mana costs?
878547.translation: 是否要施放这些牌，且不需支付其法术力费用？

878548.translation: 指定一个生物为目标得+2/+2。

878549.translation: 指定一个生物为目标得+1/+1。

878551.oracleText: Have target opponent draw a card?
878551.translation: 是否要令目标对手抓一张牌？

878552.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield, then conjure a duplicate of that card onto the battlefield. The duplicate perpetually has base power and toughness 1/1. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
878552.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌放进战场，然后将该牌的一张副本幻变进战场。该副本的基础力量与防御力永久为1/1。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

878553.oracleText: "We frogfolk can foresee many things, including your need for help."
878553.translation: 「我们蛙民可以预见很多事情，包括你需要帮助。」

878554.oracleText: Whenever you cast your third spell each turn, exile a random card from your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card without paying its mana cost.
878554.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第三个咒语时，随机放逐一张你牌库中的牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

878555.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, cards you own named Chittering Skullspeaker intensify by 1. Then you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is CARDNAME's intensity.
878555.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由你拥有且名称为吱响骨语术士的牌强化1。然后你抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为CARDNAME的强度。

878557.oracleText:
"This will make a fine tribute."
—Laxel, rotcaller
878557.translation:
「这将是一份精美的贡品。」
～唤腐师拉克塞尔

878558.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice one or more permanents, seek a nonland card.
878558.translation: 每当你牺牲一个或数个永久物时，取出一张非地牌。

878559.oracleText: You get a two-time boon with "Whenever you sacrifice one or more permanents, seek a nonland card."
878559.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的两次恩泽～「每当你牺牲一个或数个永久物时，取出一张非地牌。」

878560.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature. Then create a Treasure token if you weren't the starting player.
878560.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害。然后如果你不是先手牌手，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

878561.oracleText: Cindercone Smite deals 2 damage to target creature. Then create a Treasure token if you weren't the starting player.
878561.translation: 烬锥重击对目标生物造成2点伤害。然后如果你不是先手牌手，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

878562.oracleText: Whenever this land is tapped for mana, add an additional {oG}.
878562.translation: 每当横置此地以产生法术力时，额外加{oG}。

878563.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, the topmost land card in your library perpetually gains "Whenever this land is tapped for mana, add an additional {oG}."
878563.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你牌库最顶上的地牌永久获得「每当横置此地以产生法术力时，额外加{oG}。」

878565.oracleText: Seek a nonbasic land card. If this spell was kicked, put that card onto the battlefield tapped.
878565.translation: 取出一张非基本地牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则将该牌横置放进战场。

878571.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, a random non-Food permanent card in your graveyard perpetually becomes a Food artifact in addition to its other types and gains "{o2}, Exile this artifact: You gain 3 life." You may play that card for as long as it's in your graveyard.
878571.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你坟墓场中的一张随机非食品永久物牌永久成为食品神器，仍具有原本类别，且获得「{o2}，放逐此神器：你获得3点生命。」于该牌在你坟墓场中的时段内，你可以使用该牌。

878572.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, conjure a card named Sanguine Bond into the top fifteen cards of your library at random. It perpetually gains "You may pay {o0} rather than pay this spell's mana cost" and "When this permanent enters, draw a card."
878572.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将一张名称为血色羁绊的牌随机幻变进你牌库顶的十五张牌中。它永久获得「你可以支付{o0}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用」与「当此永久物进场时，抓一张牌。」

878574.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card named Lightning Bolt into your library. It perpetually gains storm. Then shuffle.
878574.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将一张名称为闪电击的牌幻变进你的牌库。它永久获得风暴异能。然后洗牌。

878576.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may forage. When you do, conjure a card named Chitterspitter onto the battlefield.
878576.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以觅粮。当你如此作时，将一张名称为叽响喷吐器的牌幻变进战场。

878578.oracleText: Whenever one or more Squirrels you control deal combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice a token. If you do, put an acorn counter on each permanent you control named Chitterspitter.
878578.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的松鼠对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以牺牲一个衍生物。若你如此作，则在每个由你操控且名称为叽响喷吐器的永久物上各放置一个橡实指示物。

878579.oracleText:
Kicking the warren
—Argivian expression meaning "causing trouble"
878579.translation:
踹醒繁殖地
～阿基夫用语，意指「惹麻烦」

878581.oracleText: "Your friends stayed quiet, and look what happened to them. You feeling a little more talkative yet?"
878581.translation: 「你朋友什么话都没说，看看他们的下场。你现在有没有想说几句？」

878582.oracleText: Draw a card for each creature that died under your control this turn.
878582.translation: 本回合中每有一个生物在你的操控下死去，便抓一张牌。

878586.oracleText: Conjure a card named Chitterspitter onto the battlefield.
878586.translation: 将一张名称为叽响喷吐器的牌幻变进战场。

878590.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell each turn, Discover X, where X is that spell's mana value.
878590.translation: 每当你于本回合第一次施放咒语时，倾探X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

878592.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell each turn, Discover X, where X is that spell's mana value minus 1.
878592.translation: 每当你于本回合第一次施放咒语时，倾探X，X为该咒语的法术力值减1。

878729.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
878729.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

878730.oracleText: Search for a card named Altanak, the Thrice-Called.
878730.translation: 搜寻一张名称为三呼现身阿纳克的牌。

878732.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a land entered the battlefield under your control this turn and you control a prime number of lands, create Primo, the Indivisible, a legendary 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token, then put that many +1/+1 counters on it.
878732.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若由你操控的地数量为质数、且本回合中有地在你的操控下进战场，则派出传奇衍生生物不可分的质灵，其为0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵，然后在其上放置该数量的+1/+1指示物。

878733.oracleText:
"Whatever happens, we need to stick togeth—AAAAGGGHHH!"
—Recovered tape fragment
878733.translation:
「不管发生什么，我们都要在一～啊啊啊啊啊！」
～修复的磁带片段

878734.oracleText:
"not dead just gone
IT WILL COME BACK"
—Note scrawled on a scrap of paper
878734.translation:
「没死的只是离开。
它们还会再来。」
～纸片上的潦草笔记

878735.oracleText:
"Rachel, it's me! I've . . . I've brought you back. We can finally be together! R-Rachel? Rach—"
—Recovered tape fragment
878735.translation:
「蕾秋，是我！我…我把你救回来了。我们终于能在一起了！蕾、蕾秋？蕾～」
～修复的磁带片段

878736.oracleText:
"DO NOT OPEN. Not a door."
—Bloodstained note
878736.translation:
「不要打开。这不是门。」
～沾满血迹的便笺

878737.oracleText:
"Where do they keep coming [unintelligable screaming]"
—Recovered tape fragment
878737.translation:
「他们都从哪一直出来［听不清的惨叫声］」
～修复的磁带片段

878739.oracleText: Wherever the racers go, help follows.

878741.oracleText: Creatures you control get +0/+1 and have vigilance.
878741.translation: 由你操控的生物得+0/+1且具有警戒异能。

878742.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose up to one target Mount or Vehicle you control. Until end of turn, that permanent becomes saddled if it's a Mount and becomes an artifact creature if it's a Vehicle.
878742.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择至多一个目标由你操控的坐骑或载具。直到回合结束，对该永久物而言，如果其是坐骑，则它成为已乘驾，且如果其是载具，则它成为神器生物。

878744.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Exert Basri: Create a 1/1 white Cat creature token with lifelink.
878744.translation: {oW}，{oT}，耗竭巴席利：派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物。

878745.oracleText: When you cycle this card, Cats you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
878745.translation: 当你循环此牌时，由你操控的猫获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

878747.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gets +1/+2 and gains flying until end of turn.
878747.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，直到回合结束，它得+1/+2且获得飞行异能。

878749.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, untap it and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
878749.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，将它重置并在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

878751.oracleText: To keep up with the Grand Prix, reporters trained just as hard as the racers themselves.
878751.translation: 为能跟进报道大奖赛实况，记者所受的训练可不下于赛手。

878752.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
878752.translation: 当此载具进场时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

878755.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
878755.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

878756.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Creatures you control with counters on them gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
878756.translation: 牺牲此生物：由你操控且其上有指示物的生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

878759.oracleText: Some seek thrills in watching the show. Some seek thrills in being the show.
878759.translation: 有人靠观看比赛来寻求刺激。有人则靠参加比赛来寻求刺激。

878760.oracleText: Whenever this creature saddles a Mount or crews a Vehicle during your main phase, that Mount or Vehicle gains flying until end of turn.
878760.translation: 每当此生物于你的行动阶段乘驾坐骑或搭载载具时，该坐骑或载具获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

878762.oracleText: Cloudspire's might comes from its unparalleled coordination.
878762.translation: 鼎云侠队员之间的非凡协作，凝聚成整支队伍的超群实力。

878763.oracleText: Mounts and Vehicles you control get +1/+1.
878763.translation: 由你操控的坐骑和载具得+1/+1。

878764.oracleText: This creature saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.
878764.translation: 此生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。

878766.translation:
「这些鳄鱼开起车来就跟白痴一样！」
～红挡

878767.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of permanents you control that are creatures and/or Vehicles.
878767.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控且为生物和／或载具的永久物数量。

878768.oracleText: Collision Course deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of permanents you control that are creatures and/or Vehicles.
878768.translation: 赛道相撞对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控且为生物和／或载具的永久物数量。

878769.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of permanents you control that are creatures and/or Vehicles. 
• Destroy target artifact.
878769.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控且为生物和／或载具的永久物数量。 
•消灭目标神器。

878770.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Collision Course deals X damage to target creature, where X is the number of permanents you control that are creatures and/or Vehicles. 
• Destroy target artifact.
878770.translation:
选择一项～ 
•赛道相撞对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控且为生物和／或载具的永久物数量。 
•消灭目标神器。

878772.oracleText: "Just a few more bolts—SHARK ON YOUR RIGHT—and we should be good to go."
878772.translation: 「只要再打几个螺栓～小心右边的鲨鱼！～就完事了。」

878773.oracleText: {o3oW}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target Mount or Vehicle.
878773.translation: {o3oW}：在目标坐骑或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

878775.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, exile target artifact or creature an opponent controls until this Vehicle leaves the battlefield.
878775.translation: 当此载具进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的神器或生物，直到此载具离开战场为止。

878777.oracleText: The ghost shrieked as Terrin's blade sank deep. Perhaps a second death would teach it not to mess with his dog.
878777.translation: 当特林的利刃深深插入其躯体之中时，鬼魂发出了刺耳尖鸣。也许它再死一次才能明白：不能乱惹他的狗。

878780.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
878780.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

878782.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, search your library for a nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
878782.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

878785.oracleText: "Declarative: A unit is only as strong as its network."

878786.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each artifact you control.
878786.translation: 你每操控一个神器，此生物便得+1/+0。

878789.oracleText: To the Guidelight Voyagers, a vehicle is just another hardware upgrade.
878789.translation: 对循光云游械的队员们来说，载具只不过是另一次硬体升级。

878790.oracleText: This creature saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles using its toughness rather than its power.
878790.translation: 此生物利用其防御力来乘驾坐骑和搭载载具，而不是力量。

878791.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped during your turn, untap it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
878791.translation: 每当此生物于你的回合中成为横置时，将它重置。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

878794.oracleText: Max speed — {o3}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card.
878794.translation: 速度极限～{o3}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：抓一张牌。

878796.oracleText: The Quickbeasts' diet of aether makes them capable of astonishing maneuvers.
878796.translation: 捷兽队的坐骑以乙太为食，这让它们能够作出许多惊人行动。

878798.oracleText: Enchanted permanent gets +1/+1 and has vigilance.
878798.translation: 所结附的永久物得+1/+1且具有警戒异能。

878799.oracleText: Max speed — You may cast this card from your graveyard.
878799.translation: 速度极限～你可以从你坟墓场施放此牌。

878801.oracleText:
"No one dies under my watch."
—Sektem, Lotusguard veteran
878801.translation:
「在我的守护下，绝不会让任何人丧命。」
～莲花卫长师瑟屯

878802.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature or Vehicle gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
878802.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标生物或载具获得系命与不灭异能直到回合结束。

878804.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
878804.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

878807.oracleText: When this artifact enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
878807.translation: 当此神器进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，直到此神器离开战场为止。

878808.oracleText: Max speed — {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
878808.translation: 速度极限～{oT}：在目标由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

878811.oracleText: Max speed — At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature or Vehicle you control gains double strike until end of turn.
878811.translation: 速度极限～在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物或载具获得连击异能直到回合结束。

878813.oracleText: Their race ended much the same way it began, walking through a sandstorm on a world that ended long ago.
878813.translation: 在一个早已毁灭的世界中徒步穿越重重沙暴：他们退赛时的情境与开赛时没两样。

878814.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a tapped permanent.
878814.translation: 如果此咒语以已横置的永久物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

878817.oracleText: No road has to be traveled alone.

878818.oracleText: This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.
878818.translation: 此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。

878819.oracleText: When this Aura enters, create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
878819.translation: 当此灵气进场时，派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

878820.oracleText: Enchanted permanent gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
878820.translation: 所结附的永久物得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

878822.oracleText:
"The Guidelight Voyagers seem to exhibit more humanity than their flesh-and-blood competitors."
—Pia Nalaar
878822.translation:
「循光云游械的这群机器人，似乎比它们的血肉对手更讲人性。」
～琵雅纳拉

878823.oracleText: Other artifact creatures you control get +2/+2.
878823.translation: 由你操控的其他神器生物得+2/+2。

878824.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, return up to one target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
878824.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，将至多一张目标神器牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

878826.oracleText: "It's the dawn of a new era, and we shall rise like the suns to greet it."
878826.translation: 「如今新时代正初现曙光，我们应像日出一般起身相迎。」

878827.oracleText: As this Vehicle enters, choose a nonland card name.
878827.translation: 于此载具进场时，选择一个非地牌的名称。

878828.oracleText: Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name cost {o2} more to activate.
878828.translation: 具有该名称之来源的起动式异能增加{o2}来起动。

878830.oracleText: The first four crashes were accidental. Then the Endriders joined the fun.
878830.translation: 头四起撞击纯属意外，之后送终士们开始乐在其中。

878831.oracleText: All creatures and Vehicles lose indestructible until end of turn, then destroy all creatures and Vehicles.
878831.translation: 所有生物和载具都失去不灭异能直到回合结束，然后消灭所有生物和载具。

878835.oracleText:
"We follow as it walks at the head of the ever-breaking day. Is it leading the dawn, or does it march to some forgotten celestial order? It does not answer our questions, so faith must sustain us."
—Chakshi, Dawnchaser pilgrim
878835.translation:
「我们从白昼破晓开始便一直追随它不断前行。它是在引领曙光，还是在遵循早已佚失的天象而动？它不作回答，因此信念是我们的唯一支柱。」
～追晓客恰希

878837.oracleText: Max speed — This creature gets +0/+1 and has vigilance.
878837.translation: 速度极限～此生物得+0/+1且具有警戒异能。

878839.oracleText:
"For most people? The odds would be insurmountable," Daretti said.
"But we're not most people," Pia replied.
878839.translation:
「普通人？几乎不可能成功。」达雷迪说。
「但我们不是普通人。」琵雅答。

878840.oracleText: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If it's a Vehicle, it becomes an artifact creature.
878840.translation: 将目标神器牌从你坟墓场移回战场。如果它是载具，则其成为神器生物。

878844.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gains indestructible until end of turn. Untap all creatures you control.
878844.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。重置所有由你操控的生物。

878847.oracleText: When you cycle this card, create X 1/1 colorless Pilot creature tokens with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
878847.translation: 当你循环此牌时，派出X个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

878851.oracleText: Tap three other untapped creatures you control: Until end of turn, this Vehicle becomes an artifact creature and gains flying. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
878851.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的其他生物：直到回合结束，此载具成为神器生物且获得飞行异能。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

878853.oracleText: The Guidelight Voyagers had been stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home. They considered every last unit essential, down to the glitchiest grunt.
878853.translation: 循光云游械已在阿维什卡受困良久，找不到办法脱身返乡。因此它们视全员为重要伙伴，无论谁出了点细微故障都不会置之不理。

878856.oracleText: Max speed — Whenever you draw a card, each opponent mills two cards.
878856.translation: 速度极限～每当你抓一张牌时，每位对手各磨两张牌。

878858.oracleText:
Control lost is adventure gained.
—Keelhauler proverb
878858.translation:
失控在前，冒险在后。
～沧海盗队的格言

878859.oracleText: Return target creature or Vehicle to its owner's hand.
878859.translation: 将目标生物或载具移回其拥有者手上。

878861.oracleText: For centuries, she grew in her benthic home, safe from Muraganda's moonfalls, feeding on the raw leylines that run below the water. When she emerged, the coral depths she called home came with her.
878861.translation: 数百年来，她都潜居深洋之中，依靠汲取深入水底的原初地脉不断生长，未受莫甘达的落月陨击浩劫影响。浮出水面时，她视作家园的海底珊礁也随她一同出现。

878864.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target instant or sorcery spell unless its controller pays {o3}.
878864.translation: {oU}，牺牲此生物：除非目标瞬间或法术咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

878866.oracleText: There had been a time when the Endriders would've killed for water.
878866.translation: 以前水还真能让送终士送命。

878867.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted permanent.
878867.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置所结附的永久物。

878868.oracleText: The biggest collector of vehicles on Avishkar is also the largest.
878868.translation: 阿维什卡最大的载具收藏家，收藏量大个头也大。

878872.oracleText: "Analysis: Systems operating at 125% efficiency. Stress within expected tolerances. Exclamatory: Punch it."
878872.translation: 「分析：系统效率达125%。压力在预期范围内。喊叫：冲啊。」

878873.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to cast an artifact spell or activate an ability.
878873.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语或起动异能。

878876.oracleText: "It takes a thick skin to ride among the Keelhaulers."
878876.translation: 「要成为沧海盗的一员，皮一定要厚。」

878877.oracleText: When you cycle this card, target creature or Vehicle an opponent controls gets -3/-0 until end of turn.
878877.translation: 当你循环此牌时，目标由对手操控的生物或载具得-3/-0直到回合结束。

878879.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, draw two cards.
878879.translation: 当此载具进场时，抓两张牌。

878882.oracleText: "The secret to good piratin' is being ready for anything. That, and havin' eight arms."
878882.translation: 「当好海盗的秘诀在于，准备好应付各种情况。以及，有八只手。」

878883.oracleText: Exhaust — {o1oU}: Draw a card, then discard a card. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
878883.translation: 竭绝～{o1oU}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

878885.oracleText: For the Guidelight Voyagers, there is no such thing as junk.
878885.translation: 在循光云游械眼中，没有东西可以废弃不顾。

878887.oracleText:
"Is someone asleep at the wheel, or are the wheels driving themselves?!"
—Vnwxt, Grand Prix host
878887.translation:
「是有人在车上睡着了，还是车轮自己在开？」
～大奖赛主持维夕特

878888.oracleText: During turns other than yours, this Vehicle is an artifact creature.
878888.translation: 于不是你的回合中，此载具是神器生物。

878890.oracleText: The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths. Since then, they had fully integrated into Avishkari society.
878890.translation: 非瑞克西亚大侵攻唤醒了隐居深洋的杰帕理人鱼。到了现在，他们已经完全融入阿维什卡社会。

878891.oracleText: Exhaust — {oXoUoU}, {oT}: Draw X cards. Put a +1/+1 counter on each Merfolk creature you control.
878891.translation: 竭绝～{oXoUoU}，{oT}：抓X张牌。在每个由你操控的人鱼生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

878894.oracleText: The search for her lost mentor continued.
878894.translation: 她仍在探寻养父的下落。

878896.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control with flying deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
878896.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

878898.oracleText: The Aether Rangers repurposed thopters once used for Consulate surveillance so they could scout the track.
878898.translation: 乙太流浪者队将原本执政院用来监视的扑翼机加以改造，方便他们探查赛道。

878899.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
878899.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

878901.oracleText: "Here's a tip: If your ride needs souls for fuel, make sure to always keep one handy."
878901.translation: 「提醒一下：如果你的坐驾需要添加灵魂当燃料，请务必时刻备好补充品。」

878902.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, gain control of target creature an opponent controls for as long as you control this Vehicle. That creature can't attack or block for as long as you control this Vehicle.
878902.translation: 当此载具进场时，于你操控此载具的时段内，获得目标由对手操控的生物之操控权。于你操控此载具的时段内，该生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

878904.oracleText: Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, draw a card.
878904.translation: 每当你起动任一竭绝异能时，抓一张牌。

878905.oracleText: Exhaust — {o4}: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
878905.translation: 竭绝～{o4}：此载具成为神器生物。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

878907.oracleText: By the end of the race, few of the Aether Rangers' vehicles resembled what they started as.
878907.translation: 到比赛结束的时候，乙太流浪者队的车辆都已经被改得面目全非。

878908.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice another artifact: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
