878908.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲另一个神器：从你牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，且其法术力值须等同于所牺牲之神器的法术力值加1，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

878910.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Any number of target players each mill two cards.
878910.translation: {o1}，{oT}：任意数量的目标牌手各磨两张牌。

878911.oracleText: Exhaust — {o2oUoU}, {oT}: Any number of target players each mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard.
878911.translation: 竭绝～{o2oUoU}，{oT}：任意数量的目标牌手各磨若干牌，其数量等同于各自坟墓场中牌的数量。

878913.oracleText:
"In cases of extreme emergency, just wing it."
—Rocketeer safety manual, full text
878913.translation:
「如出现极端紧急情况，凭直觉行事就好。」
～窜天鬼队安全手册全文

878914.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a permanent with mana value 1.
878914.translation: 如果此咒语以法术力值为1的永久物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

878915.oracleText: Return target creature or Vehicle an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
878915.translation: 将目标由对手操控的生物或载具移回其拥有者手上。

878918.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures attack you, those creatures get -1/-0 until end of turn.
878918.translation: 每当一个或数个生物攻击你时，这些生物得-1/-0直到回合结束。

878919.oracleText: Exhaust — {o5oUoU}: Put three +1/+1 counters on this creature.
878919.translation: 竭绝～{o5oUoU}：在此生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

878922.oracleText: "Oi, you ain't gonna believe what these kelpheads just threw away!"
878922.translation: 「嘿，你肯定不敢相信那帮海藻头们刚把什么给丢了！」

878923.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
878923.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

878925.oracleText: Garima was delighted to finally test out her design. The amazing views were a bonus.
878925.translation: 伽理玛很高兴自己的设计终于付诸现场实验。还收获了壮丽美景这一意外之喜。

878926.oracleText: Exhaust — {o4oU}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
878926.translation: 竭绝～{o4oU}：在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

878929.oracleText: Max speed — {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: Copy target spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
878929.translation: 速度极限～{o1}，牺牲此生物：复制目标由你操控的咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

878931.oracleText: "So many fears. Let's make them all come true."
878931.translation: 「恐惧那么多。就让它们都成真。」

878932.oracleText: The druid's aim was dead on. But their choice of target was dead wrong.
878932.translation: 德鲁伊目的想得很正确。但目标选得很失败。

878936.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target creature or Vehicle an opponent controls to its owner's hand. If that opponent's speed is greater than each other player's speed, reduce that opponent's speed by 1. This effect can't reduce their speed below 1.
878936.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标由对手操控的生物或载具移回其拥有者手上。如果该对手的速度比每位其他牌手都高，则将该对手的速度减少1。此效应不能将其速度减到小于1。

878938.oracleText: Tap target creature or Vehicle, then put three stun counters on it.
878938.translation: 横置目标生物或载具，然后在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。

878940.oracleText: "We are now accepting over eleven different interplanar currencies, including polished moonfall!"
878940.translation: 「我们如今接受超过十一种跨时空货币，包括精制陨月！」

878941.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
878941.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

878943.oracleText: Every camera had a backup, and every backup had a backup, and every backup's backup had a backup, too.
878943.translation: 每台摄像机都有后备，每台后备也都有后备，每台后备的后备亦还有后备。

878944.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
878944.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

878946.oracleText: "This looks like a winning vehicle. But you lot ain't a winning team."
878946.translation: 「你这车看起来能赢。但你的车队不行。」

878947.oracleText: Exchange control of target artifact or creature you control and target artifact or creature an opponent controls.
878947.translation: 交换目标由你操控的神器或生物和目标由对手操控的神器或生物之操控权。

878949.oracleText: "Remember: You can take the wheel if you want, but I choose the music."
878949.translation: 「记住：你想的话，车随你开，但音乐由我选。」

878950.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card with mana value 4 or 5, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
878950.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值为4或5的神器牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

878952.oracleText: "That net was made to hold skywhales. Good luck getting to the next checkpoint!"
878952.translation: 「这张网原本是用来捆飞鲸的。希望你还能开到下个检查点！」

878953.oracleText: Target nonland permanent's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
878953.translation: 目标非地永久物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

878955.oracleText: Jace knew that if he just had time to explain his plan, he would find support. Unfortunately, time was in short supply.
878955.translation: 杰斯知道，如果他有足够时间来说清计划的话，就能获得足够支持。但可惜的是时间不够。

878956.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, untap all nonland permanents you control.
878956.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，重置所有由你操控的非地永久物。

878958.translation: 「赛手们！各就各位！预备！发动引擎！！！」

878959.oracleText: Max speed — If you would draw a card, draw two cards instead.
878959.translation: 速度极限～如果你将抓一张牌，则改为抓两张牌。

878961.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of an artifact or creature you control.
878961.translation: 你可以使此生物当成任一由你操控之神器或生物的复制品来进场。

878963.oracleText:
"Make peace with your end, for not even your legacy will remain."
—Zahur
878963.translation:
「平静地接受你的结局，最终你什么东西都不会剩下。」
～札豪尔

878964.oracleText: Choose a card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for up to four cards with that name and exile them. Then that player shuffles.
878964.translation: 选择一个牌名。从目标对手的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻至多四张具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。然后该牌手洗牌。

878966.oracleText: At the Tombs Before Time, the living of Amonkhet made vital alliances with the honored dead.
878966.translation: 在纪前陵墓内，现世阿芒凯生灵与过往荣耀亡者联手，重振生机。

878967.oracleText: Return target creature or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
878967.translation: 将目标生物或载具牌从你坟墓场移回战场。派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

878968.oracleText: Summoning it is easy. Controlling it is another matter.
878968.translation: 召唤它并不难。指挥它就是另一回事了。

878970.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, mill two cards. Then return a creature or Vehicle card from your graveyard to your hand.
878970.translation: 当此载具进场时，磨两张牌。然后将一张生物或载具牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

878972.oracleText: The Speedbrood doesn't differentiate between salvage and carrion.
878972.translation: 在极速虫队眼中，锈铁与腐肉都一样。

878973.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
878973.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张神器和／或生物牌，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

878975.oracleText:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur
878975.translation:
「它们也应当来见证阿芒凯的重生。」
～札豪尔

878976.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, create that many tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
878976.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，派出等量已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

878978.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature card in your graveyard gains embalm until end of turn. The embalm cost is equal to its mana cost.
878978.translation: {oT}：目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌获得遗存异能直到回合结束。其遗存费用等同于其法术力费用。

878981.oracleText: Amonkhet champions become markedly more reckless after dying.
878981.translation: 阿芒凯的豪杰死后就会变得更加无所畏惧。

878982.oracleText: {o3oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
878982.translation: {o3oB}：将此牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

878984.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, for each player, destroy up to one target creature that player controls. If a creature you controlled was destroyed this way, put two +1/+1 counters on this Vehicle.
878984.translation: 当此载具进场时，为每位牌手各进行以下流程～消灭至多一个目标由该牌手操控的生物。如果以此法消灭一个由你操控的生物，则在此载具上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

878986.oracleText: In a land of undeath, permanent pest control solutions are few and far between.
878986.translation: 在亡灵国度，几乎不存在什么有效的永久性虫害控制手段。

878989.oracleText: Gastal's vampires took fuel from the dead.
878989.translation: 嘉斯达的吸血鬼会从死者身上汲取燃料。

878991.oracleText: Max speed — {oB}, Sacrifice another creature or Vehicle: Draw a card.
878991.translation: 速度极限～{oB}，牺牲另一个生物或载具：抓一张牌。

878993.oracleText: Win or lose, she will sate her hunger.
878993.translation: 不论输赢，她都能填饱自己的饥渴。

878994.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it. That player discards that card.
878994.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张瞬间或法术牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

878995.oracleText: Max speed — This creature gets +1/+1 and has menace.
878995.translation: 速度极限～此生物得+1/+1且具有威慑异能。

878997.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell they don't own, that player creates a Treasure token.
878997.translation: 每当任一牌手施放不由其拥有的咒语时，该牌手派出一个珍宝衍生物。

878998.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to one of your opponents, its controller looks at the top card of that opponent's library and exiles it face down. They may play that card for as long as it remains exiled. Mana of any type can be spent to cast a spell this way.
878998.translation: 每当一个生物对你的任一对手造成战斗伤害时，其操控者检视该对手的牌库顶牌并牌面朝下地放逐该牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，该生物的操控者可以使用该牌。能用任意种类的法术力来以此法施放咒语。

879000.oracleText: When this artifact enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
879000.translation: 当此神器进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

879003.oracleText: Kheti lost everything to the Eternals and the Phyrexians. What she gained was an intimate knowledge of death in its myriad forms.
879003.translation: 永生者和非瑞克西亚人夺走了刻提的一切。她所留下的，就只有对各种死亡方式的详尽认知。

879004.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. When that creature dies this turn, surveil 1.
879004.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。本回合中，当该生物死去时，刺探1。

879007.oracleText: Destroy target creature or Vehicle. If the sacrificed permanent was a Vehicle, draw a card.
879007.translation: 消灭目标生物或载具。如果所牺牲的永久物是载具，则抓一张牌。

879009.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
879009.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

879010.oracleText: Max speed — {o1oB}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
879010.translation: 速度极限～{o1oB}，牺牲此结界：从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

879012.oracleText:
"This is still a negotiation. We haven't broken anything . . . yet." 
—Far Fortune
879012.translation:
「这还只在谈判。我们没打破任何东西…暂时还没。」
～法芙琼

879013.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it. Exile that card.
879013.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张神器或生物牌。放逐该牌。

879015.oracleText: Galadak's Scar is full of craters which are home to terrifying predators of immense size and savagery. Yet even among such company, Kalakscion—and her insatiable hunger—eclipses them all.
879015.translation: 加拉达创痕满目疮痍、遍布陨坑，各类巨型野蛮捕食者栖居此处，令人胆寒。尽管如此，它们在卡拉塞恩～以及她的无餍饥渴～面前，都还要逊色三分。

879017.oracleText: The rearview mirror showed Winter what awaited him should he fail.
879017.translation: 温特在后视镜中，看到了他失败之后的下场。

879018.oracleText: The Last Ride gets -X/-X, where X is your life total.
879018.translation: 送终号得-X/-X，X为你的总生命。

879021.oracleText:
"Captain, the cowards are throwing bugs at us!"
—Sphyr, Keelhauler lookout
879021.translation:
「船长，那些胆小鬼在朝我们扔虫子！」
～沧海盗队警戒员斯非尔

879023.oracleText: Compared to the Fuel Wars on Gastal, this Grand Prix is a thrilling vacation.
879023.translation: 跟嘉斯达上的燃料战争相比，这个大奖赛只不过是度假的余兴节目。

879024.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.
879024.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得死触与不灭异能直到回合结束。

879026.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature or Vehicle of their choice. Each opponent who can't discards a card.
879026.translation: 当此结界进场时，每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个生物或载具。每位无法如此作的对手各弃一张牌。

879027.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this enchantment: You gain life equal to your speed.
879027.translation: {o2}，牺牲此结界：你获得等同于你速度的生命。

879031.oracleText:
"And you're telling me this was designed for children?"
—Sita Varma
879031.translation:
「你跟我说这是准备给儿童用的？」
～西塔瓦玛

879032.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another artifact you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
879032.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的神器进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

879034.oracleText: Speedbrood racers are gregarious while not racing, but everyone must eat.
879034.translation: 极速虫队的赛手不比赛时喜欢跟大家聚在一起，但大家都得有东西吃。

879035.oracleText: Choose target creature, planeswalker, or Vehicle. Mill two cards, then destroy the chosen permanent if its mana value is less than or equal to the number of cards in your graveyard.
879035.translation: 选择目标生物，鹏洛客或载具。磨两张牌，然后如果所选永久物之法术力值等于或小于你坟墓场中牌的数量，则消灭之。

879037.oracleText: By the time Shantanu heard the Endriders chanting "The claw!" he was already in its grasp.
879037.translation: 等到山塔努听到送终士队的人大喊「小心爪子！」的时候，他已经被抓住了。

879038.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, each opponent discards a card.
879038.translation: 当此载具进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌。

879041.oracleText: In life, she commanded the respect of her army. In death, she demands it.
879041.translation: 在生时，她号令全军凭的是威信。在死后，她凭的是威势。

879042.oracleText: Max speed — At the beginning of your end step, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
879042.translation: 速度极限～在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

879044.oracleText:
"Don't think of it as cheating, think of it as track they forgot to lay out for us."
—Rido, Endrider
879044.translation:
「别觉得这是在作弊，把它当成忘了铺的路就好。」
～送终士队的里多

879045.oracleText: Draw two cards. Each player loses 2 life.
879045.translation: 抓两张牌。每位牌手各失去2点生命。

879047.oracleText: It yields only to the gods themselves.

879048.oracleText: When this creature enters, all other creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
879048.translation: 当此生物进场时，所有其他生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

879050.oracleText: Caution is for those who falter.

879051.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is your speed.
879051.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为你的速度。

879053.oracleText:
"Good sportsmanship wins the crowd. Bad sportsmanship wins the race."
—Winter
879053.translation:
「讲究运动风范能帮你赢得观众，不讲风范则能帮你赢得比赛。」
～温特

879055.oracleText:
"They feed on OIL? Where were they during the Phyrexian Invasion?!"
—Chandra Nalaar
879055.translation:
「他们靠喝油为生？非瑞克西亚大侵攻时怎么没见他们？！」  
～茜卓纳拉

879056.oracleText: Max speed — This creature has lifelink.
879056.translation: 速度极限～此生物具有系命异能。

879058.oracleText: After years of hunger, the oil-thirsting vampires of Gastal finally had their fill.
879058.translation: 经过常年饥渴之后，这群渴求油料的嘉斯达吸血鬼终于能够饱餐一顿。

879059.oracleText: Target creature gets -6/-6 until end of turn. You gain 2 life.
879059.translation: 目标生物得-6/-6直到回合结束。你获得2点生命。

879061.oracleText: Some horrors are created. Others are the recognition of a possibility that has always existed.
879061.translation: 有些恐惧是凭空捏造的，有些则是发觉自己可能会落到一直存在的悲惨下场后产生的。

879062.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying 2 life and sacrificing an artifact or creature in addition to paying its other costs.
879062.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场施放此牌，但在其他费用以外，还须额外支付2点生命并牺牲一个神器或生物。

879065.oracleText:
"Lot of folks on Duskmourn are more scared of dying than what comes after. Oh, how wrong they are."
—Winter
879065.translation:
「暮悲邸中许多人更惧怕死亡，而不太担心身后之事。他们简直大错特错。」  
～温特

879069.oracleText: "Either I win or we both lose. Take your pick."

879070.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, if it's not their turn, this creature deals 4 damage to them.
879070.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语时，若当前不是该牌手的回合，则此生物对其造成4点伤害。

879071.oracleText: Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
879071.translation: 每当你起动任一竭绝异能时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879073.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, add four mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.
879073.translation: 当此载具进场时，加四点任意颜色的单色法术力。此法术力只能用来起动异能。

879074.oracleText: Exhaust — {oXo2oR}: This Vehicle deals X damage to any target. Put a +1/+1 counter on this Vehicle.
879074.translation: 竭绝～{oXo2oR}：此载具对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。在此载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879076.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
879076.translation: 当此载具进场时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。

879078.oracleText: Max speed — This creature has double strike.
879078.translation: 速度极限～此生物具有连击异能。

879080.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose up to one target Vehicle you control. Until end of turn, it becomes an artifact creature and gains haste.
879080.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择至多一个目标由你操控的载具。直到回合结束，它成为神器生物且获得敏捷异能。

879081.oracleText: You may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
879081.translation: 你可以牺牲一个神器或弃一张牌。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌。

879082.oracleText: Create a 3/2 colorless Vehicle artifact token with crew 1.
879082.translation: 派出一个3/2无色，具搭载1的载具衍生神器。

879083.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, this emblem deals 3 damage to any target.
879083.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

879084.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever an artifact you control enters, this emblem deals 3 damage to any target."
879084.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。」

879087.oracleText: "With your help, Loot, we're going to make a hell of an entrance," said Chandra. In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.
879087.translation: 「烂宝，多亏你的帮忙，我们的出现一定会震撼全场。」茜卓说。短短一刻钟之后，她就后悔说过这些话。

879089.oracleText: Redshift told his team to destroy the competition. They were thrilled to discover he meant it literally.
879089.translation: 红挡让自己的队伍设法消除竞争。队员们兴奋地发现，老大指的是字面上的消除。

879091.oracleText: Crash and Burn deals 6 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
879091.translation: 打砸抢烧对目标生物或鹏洛客造成6点伤害。

879092.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target Vehicle. 
• CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
879092.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭目标载具。 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成6点伤害。

879093.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target Vehicle. 
• Crash and Burn deals 6 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
879093.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭目标载具。 
•打砸抢烧对目标生物或鹏洛客造成6点伤害。

879095.oracleText: Daretti's power is equal to the greatest mana value among artifacts you control.
879095.translation: 达雷迪的力量等同于由你操控之神器中的最大法术力值。

879096.oracleText: Whenever Daretti enters or attacks, choose target artifact card in your graveyard. You may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, return the chosen card to the battlefield.
879096.translation: 每当达雷迪进场或攻击时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的神器牌。你可以牺牲一个神器。如果你如此作，则将所选之牌移回战场。

879098.oracleText: Exhaust — {oR}: Other creatures you control gain haste until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
879098.translation: 竭绝～{oR}：由你操控的其他生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879099.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3oR}: Create a 4/4 red Dinosaur Dragon creature token with flying.
879099.translation: 竭绝～{o3oR}：派出一个4/4红色，具飞行异能的恐龙／龙衍生生物。

879102.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it deals 2 damage to any target.
879102.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

879105.oracleText:
"Launch the explosives! No, you idiot, not like that!"
—Redshift, Rocketeer chief
879105.translation:
「发射炸药！不，你这蠢蛋，不是那样！」
～窜天鬼领袖红挡

879107.oracleText: Endrider magic was developed on a world that was constantly on the move—the higher the velocity, the stronger the magic.
879107.translation: 送终士的世界每时每刻都移动不停，由此而来的魔法也充满当地特色～速度越快，威力越大。

879110.oracleText: Max speed — At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
879110.translation: 速度极限～在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

879112.oracleText:
"Our world died, but we survived. Funny how it's the opposite for you."
—Rido, Endrider
879112.translation:
「我们的世界毁灭了，我们活了下来。你却刚好相反，真有趣。」
～送终士队的里多

879113.oracleText: Fuel the Flames deals 2 damage to each creature.
879113.translation: 火上浇油对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

879115.oracleText:
"You wanted a fight. Now you've got two."
—Chandra Nalaar
879115.translation:
「你想打一架。我们有两个人奉陪。」
～茜卓纳拉

879116.oracleText: After this main phase, there are two additional combat phases.
879116.translation: 在此行动阶段后，额外多出两个战斗阶段。

879117.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat this turn, untap all creatures that attacked this turn.
879117.translation: 在本回合的每次战斗开始时，重置所有本回合攻击过的生物。

879119.oracleText: "Consider me an accident no longer waiting to happen."
879119.translation: 「把我当成不愿等人来撞，而去主动撞人的事故。」

879120.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature or Vehicle. When you do, destroy target artifact an opponent controls.
879120.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个生物或载具。当你如此作时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器。

879122.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, it becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
879122.translation: 当此载具进场时，它成为神器生物直到回合结束。

879123.oracleText: {o2oR}, Discard a card: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
879123.translation: {o2oR}，弃一张牌：将此牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

879125.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, create a Treasure token.
879125.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

879128.oracleText: Killswitch finally had the right wrench for the job. Now she needed to remember what the job was.
879128.translation: 婷机终于找到了干活要用的钳子。现在她只要想起来是要干什么活就好。

879129.oracleText: Exhaust — {o2oR}: Discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
879129.translation: 竭绝～{o2oR}：弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879131.oracleText: Hazoret can't attack or block unless you have max speed.
879131.translation: 除非你达到速度极限，否则哈佐蕾不能进行攻击或阻挡。

879133.oracleText: Other Goblins you control have haste.
879133.translation: 由你操控的其他鬼怪具有敏捷异能。

879134.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. That token attacks this combat if able.
879134.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。该衍生物本次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

879135.oracleText: Max speed — {oT}: Add {oR} for each Goblin you control.
879135.translation: 速度极限～{oT}：你每操控一个鬼怪，便加{oR}。

879137.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
879137.translation: 当此结界进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

879138.oracleText: Max speed — Sacrifice this enchantment: Creatures and Vehicles you control gain haste until end of turn.
879138.translation: 速度极限～牺牲此结界：由你操控的生物和载具获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

879139.oracleText:
"No, it's not quite as simple as ‘point and boom,' but if you must summarize."
—Daretti
879139.translation:
「不对，这没有『指哪打哪』这么简单，但如果你硬要这么概括的话倒也没错。」
～达雷迪

879142.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, this creature deals that much damage to each opponent.
879142.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，此生物向每位对手各造成等量的伤害。

879143.oracleText: When you cycle this card, it deals 1 damage to each opponent.
879143.translation: 当你循环此牌时，它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

879145.oracleText: "What a bunch of junk. I'll take the lot."

879147.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, it deals 5 damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
879147.translation: 当此结界进场时，它对至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

879148.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this enchantment: It deals 2 damage to each player who doesn't have max speed.
879148.translation: {o2}，牺牲此结界：它对每位未达到速度极限的牌手各造成2点伤害。

879150.oracleText: Exhaust — {o2oR}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. It gains double strike until end of turn.
879150.translation: 竭绝～{o2oR}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得连击异能直到回合结束。

879152.oracleText: In lieu of brakes, the Rocketeers installed a second accelerator pedal.
879152.translation: 窜天鬼队的车上没装刹车，而是安上了第二个油门踏板。

879153.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
879153.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+X/+0且获得先攻异能。

879155.oracleText: "Don't you know it's dangerous to go faster than us?"
879155.translation: 「难道你不知道超过我们会有危险吗？」

879156.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3oR}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
879156.translation: 竭绝～{o3oR}：在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

879158.oracleText: Return all Mount and Vehicle cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
879158.translation: 将所有坐骑和载具牌从你坟墓场移回战场。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

879159.oracleText: Vehicles you control become artifact creatures until end of turn. Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
879159.translation: 由你操控的载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

879162.oracleText: Whenever this creature saddles a Mount or crews a Vehicle during your main phase, that Mount or Vehicle gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
879162.translation: 每当此生物于你的行动阶段乘驾坐骑或搭载载具时，直到回合结束，该坐骑或载具得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。

879164.oracleText: Endriders learned the rules of the road on Gastal, which meant they didn't learn any rules at all.
879164.translation: 送终士队的队员们掌握的是嘉斯达的道路规则～也就是没有规则。

879165.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is 2 plus the number of Mounts and Vehicles you control.
879165.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的坐骑和载具数量加2。

879166.oracleText: Road Rage deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is 2 plus the number of Mounts and Vehicles you control.
879166.translation: 路怒斗车对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的坐骑和载具数量加2。

879168.oracleText: Under moonfall conditions, there's nothing you can do but drive and hope for the best.
879168.translation: 落月陨击时，只管低头开车，希望自己安然避过就好，因为也没有其他方法可躲。

879170.oracleText: Exhaust — Tap another untapped Mount or Vehicle you control: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each Mount and/or Vehicle you control other than this Vehicle.
879170.translation: 竭绝～横置另一个由你操控且未横置的坐骑或载具：此载具成为神器生物。你在此载具以外每操控一个坐骑和／或载具，便在此载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879172.oracleText:
"Fire the cannon, mates, fire it quick!
The sea's full of chum and we want our pick!"
—Keelhauler shanty
879172.translation:
「伙计就位把炮开，
海中财富任我摘！」
～沧海盗队船夫号子

879173.oracleText: Discard a card: Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
879173.translation: 弃一张牌：抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动，且每回合限一次。

879176.oracleText: The Avishkari delegation considered their treaties with the Saurid Autocracy settled, but that was a crucial misunderstanding. To the Autocracy, diplomacy is a matter of power, not paper; testing the Grand Prix's defenses is merely their way of making a counteroffer.
879176.translation: 阿维什卡代表团以为自己已跟人龙王国订好合约，但实际上他们完全会错了对方的意思。在人龙王国看来，外交成果体现在力量上，而非纸面上；因此测试大奖赛的防御情况，只不过是他们在提条件而已。

879178.oracleText: Speedbump has miraculously survived ninety-nine rocket crashes, and he's aiming for an even hundred.
879178.translation: 速蹦在九十九次火箭失事中都奇迹般地活了下来，而他还想挑战第一百次。

879179.oracleText: Exhaust — {o2oGoG}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
879179.translation: 竭绝～{o2oGoG}：在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

879180.oracleText: Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
879180.translation: 每当你起动任一竭绝异能时，将此牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

879182.oracleText: When you cycle this card, put two +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature or Vehicle. It gains trample and indestructible until end of turn.
879182.translation: 当你循环此牌时，在至多一个目标生物或载具上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏与不灭异能直到回合结束。

879184.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
879184.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

879187.oracleText: When this creature enters and whenever it attacks while saddled, create a 3/3 green Elephant creature token.
879187.translation: 当此生物进场和每当它于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个3/3绿色的象衍生生物。

879190.oracleText: "She knows what I'm thinking before I do. That is what true partnership means."
879190.translation: 「她能先我一步知道我在想什么。这才是真正搭档该有的样子。」

879191.oracleText: {o4oG}: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
879191.translation: {o4oG}：检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中一张永久物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

879193.oracleText:
Exercise kindness, for nothing remains small forever.
—Alacrian proverb
879193.translation:
勿以善小而不为，凡物均有成长时。
～阿拉奇亚谚语

879194.oracleText: An early lead puts a target on your back.
879194.translation: 领先在前会让你后背受敌。

879196.translation: 拉古凌不会再失去另一个伙伴。

879197.oracleText: Target permanent you control gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
879197.translation: 目标由你操控的永久物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

879198.oracleText: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
879198.translation: 派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

879199.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target permanent you control gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. 
• Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
879199.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标由你操控的永久物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。 
•派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

879202.oracleText: {o1oG}, Remove two +1/+1 counters from this creature: Destroy target artifact.
879202.translation: {o1oG}，从此生物上移去两个+1/+1指示物：消灭目标神器。

879203.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
879203.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879205.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifact and/or creature cards leave your graveyard, you gain 1 life.
879205.translation: 每当一张或数张神器和／或生物牌离开你坟墓场时，你获得1点生命。

879206.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, mill four cards. You may put an artifact, creature, or land card from among the milled cards into your hand.
879206.translation: 当此结界进场时，磨四张牌。你可以将一张神器、生物或地牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。

879208.oracleText: The Brood aspires to become speed itself.
879208.translation: 极速虫队的每一分子都立志让自己成为极速象征。

879209.oracleText: Exile an artifact or creature card from your graveyard: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
879209.translation: 从你坟墓场放逐一张神器或生物牌：此载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

879212.oracleText: During your turn, as long as you haven't activated an exhaust ability this turn, you may activate exhaust abilities as though they haven't been activated.
879212.translation: 于你的回合中，只要你本回合中还未起动过任何竭绝异能，你便可以将竭绝异能视同从未起动过地来起动。

879213.oracleText: Exhaust — {o1oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
879213.translation: 竭绝～{o1oG}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879216.oracleText: Though the Fang Druids desired peace, the Grand Prix's interference threatened to awaken old dangers on Muraganda.
879216.translation: 虽然长齿德鲁伊希望能和平共处，但如今大奖赛的滋扰已有可能唤醒莫甘达内沉眠已久的远古威胁，他们不得不出手干预。

879217.oracleText: When this creature enters, another target creature or Vehicle you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
879217.translation: 当此生物进场时，另一个目标由你操控的生物或载具得+2/+2直到回合结束。

879219.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a creature card with no abilities, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
879219.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张不具异能的生物牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

879221.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3oG}: Put three +1/+1 counters on this creature.
879221.translation: 竭绝～{o3oG}：在此生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

879223.oracleText:
"It's aggravating that nature can build better hazards than I ever could."
—Termin, track designer
879223.translation:
「大自然所造障碍的巧妙程度远胜于我，真令人窝火。」  
～赛道设计师特明

879224.oracleText: Exhaust — {o6oG}: Put three +1/+1 counters on this creature.
879224.translation: 竭绝～{o6oG}：在此生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

879226.oracleText: "Roadkill" takes on an entirely different meaning when the beast you crash into is more likely to kill you.
879226.translation: 「路上撞杀」这一概念，在你撞到的野兽更有可能杀掉你的情况下，有了全新的解释。

879230.oracleText: This Vehicle's power is equal to the number of lands you control.
879230.translation: 此载具的力量等同于由你操控的地数量。

879231.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle enters or attacks, you may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
879231.translation: 每当此载具进场或攻击时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

879233.oracleText:
"The fauna here functions as a planar antibody." 
—Rashmi, aether-seer
879233.translation:
「这里的动物群在保护整个时空，就像抗体一样。」
～乙太预言师列施蜜

879234.oracleText: Creatures you control have base power and toughness 6/6 and are Oozes in addition to their other types.
879234.translation: 由你操控的生物之基础力量与防御力为6/6，且额外具有流浆此类别。

879235.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, if it's not their turn, you create a 3/3 green Elephant creature token.
879235.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，若当前不是该牌手的回合，则你派出一个3/3绿色的象衍生生物。

879237.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 4 life.
879237.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得4点生命。

879239.oracleText: The Speedbrood regards molting as a selfless act worthy of the highest of honors. It allows one to be born anew for the good of the brood.
879239.translation: 极速虫将蜕皮视作最高荣耀的无私举动。这样能让个体获得新生，为虫群效力。

879240.oracleText: {oT}, Exile a card from your graveyard: Add one mana of any color.
879240.translation: {oT}，从你坟墓场放逐一张牌：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

879242.oracleText: As it digested the demonic roadster, it too learned the thrill of speed.
879242.translation: 消化掉恶魔跑车之后，它也领会到了飞速的快感。

879243.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill two cards, then put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
879243.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨两张牌，然后你坟墓场中每有一张神器和／或生物牌，便在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879245.oracleText: Each creature that's attacking one of your opponents has trample.
879245.translation: 每个正向你的任一对手进行攻击之生物均具有践踏异能。

879246.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: You may put a creature or Vehicle card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you put an artifact onto the battlefield this way, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
879246.translation: {oG}，{oT}：你可以将一张生物或载具牌从你手上放进战场。如果你以此法将神器放进战场，则在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

879248.oracleText: Like most goblins, Rocketeers value nothing more than a good old-fashioned near-death experience.
879248.translation: 跟大多数鬼怪一样，窜天鬼最期望的，便是一次优良的传统濒死体验。

879249.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature you control fights target creature an opponent controls. 
• Destroy target Vehicle.
879249.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标由你操控的生物与目标由对手操控的生物互斗。 
•消灭目标载具。

879251.oracleText: {o3oG}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is your speed. Put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
879251.translation: {o3oG}，牺牲此结界：从你牌库中搜寻至多X张基本地牌，X为你的速度。将这些牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

879253.oracleText:
"Someone please call pest control. Again."
—Termin, track designer
879253.translation:
「赶紧叫人来除灭害虫。再来一次。」
～赛道设计师特明

879254.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards, then you may return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
879254.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨三张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

879256.oracleText: Initially frustrated by Muraganda's inconsistent biodiversity, Avishkari researchers made a breakthrough after mapping the plane's aetheric index—the wide variety of fauna was the result of raw magic, not evolution.
879256.translation: 莫甘达生物多元，不符合一般规律，阿维什卡的研究者最初对此百思不得其解；但在绘制完整个时空的乙太指标之后，他们有了重大发现～此处广泛的动物种群分布与进化无关，而是原始魔法的结果。

879258.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card, up to one target Mount card, up to one target Vehicle card, and up to one target creature card with no abilities from your graveyard to your hand.
879258.translation: 将至多一张目标生物牌，至多一张目标坐骑牌，至多一张目标载具牌，和至多一张目标不具异能的生物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

879260.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if it targets a Mount or Vehicle you control.
879260.translation: 如果此咒语以由你操控的坐骑或载具为目标，则它减少{o1}来施放。

879261.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
879261.translation: 目标由你操控的生物向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

879263.oracleText: When this Aura enters, untap enchanted permanent.
879263.translation: 当此灵气进场时，重置所结附的永久物。

879264.oracleText: Enchanted permanent gets +1/+2 and has reach.
879264.translation: 所结附的永久物得+1/+2且具有延势异能。

879266.oracleText: All creatures great and small contribute to the stampede.
879266.translation: 所有生物，无论身形大小，都能参与狂奔。

879267.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Create a 3/3 green Elephant creature token.
879267.translation: 竭绝～{o3oG}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。派出一个3/3绿色的象衍生生物。

879270.oracleText: The Fang Druids call it the World Tyrant, for it has consumed entire ecosystems that it keeps suspended in its core. To look upon it is to see the world as it was eons ago.
879270.translation: 长齿德鲁伊将其称为世界暴君，全因它曾将一个整个生态系统吞进肚中，令其停滞不再发展。如今抬头仰望它时，就能看到千万年前世界的模样。

879272.oracleText: Each other Vehicle and creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if its mana value is 4 or less. Otherwise, it enters with three additional +1/+1 counters on it.
879272.translation: 对每个由你操控的其他载具和生物而言，如果其法术力值等于或小于4，则其进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则其进场时上面额外有三个+1/+1指示物。

879274.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, you gain 2 life.
879274.translation: 当此载具进场时，你获得2点生命。

879276.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gets +0/+3 until end of turn.
879276.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，它得+0/+3直到回合结束。

879280.oracleText: When you cycle this card, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment with mana value X.
879280.translation: 当你循环此牌时，消灭至多一个目标法术力值为X的神器或结界。

879282.oracleText: When Aatchik enters, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
879282.translation: 当阿奇克进场时，你坟墓场中每有一张神器和／或生物牌，便派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

879283.oracleText: Whenever another Insect you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Aatchik. Each opponent loses 1 life.
879283.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的昆虫死去时，在阿奇克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。每位对手各失去1点生命。

879285.oracleText:
"Don't avoid the wreck. Survive it."
—Far Fortune
879285.translation:
「有东西撞上来时不要躲。撞赢它。」
～法芙琼

879286.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature you control with power 2 or less gains lifelink until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
879286.translation: {oT}：目标由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

879288.oracleText: Exhaust abilities of other permanents you control cost {o2} less to activate.
879288.translation: 由你操控的其他永久物之竭绝异能减少{o2}来起动。

879289.oracleText: Exhaust — {o4oRoG}: Creatures and Vehicles you control gain trample until end of turn. Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
879289.translation: 竭绝～{o4oRoG}：你操控的生物和载具获得践踏，直到回合结束。在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

879291.oracleText: Whenever you attack, draw a card, then discard a card.
879291.translation: 每当你攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

879293.oracleText: "A new day dawns for Avishkar, and we shall draw our power from its light."
879293.translation: 「阿维什卡新的一天迎来破晓，我们应从其光芒当中汲取力量。」

879294.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for up to two artifact, creature, and/or enchantment cards with mana value 1 or less, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
879294.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻至多两张法术力值等于或小于1的神器，生物和／或结界牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

879296.oracleText: "Let's show 'em how the Keelhaulers say hello!"
879296.translation: 「让我们教教他们，沧海盗是怎么打招呼的！」

879297.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Draw a card, then discard a card.
879297.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

879298.oracleText: Broadside Barrage deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Draw a card, then discard a card.
879298.translation: 舷侧齐射对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

879300.oracleText: The only honor greater than piloting a Speedbrood vehicle is becoming one yourself.
879300.translation: 比担任极速虫车辆驾手更高的荣誉，就只有成为车辆本身。

879301.oracleText: {o2oBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return target creature or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
879301.translation: {o2oBoG}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：将目标生物或载具牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

879303.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn for each card discarded this way. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player this turn, you draw a card.
879303.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，选择目标生物。每以此法弃掉一张牌，该生物便得+2/+0直到回合结束。本回合中，每当该生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌。

879304.translation: 阿拉奇亚之心卡拉朵拉

879305.oracleText: When Caradora enters, you may search your library for a Mount or Vehicle card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
879305.translation: 当卡拉朵拉进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张坐骑或载具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

879306.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature or Vehicle you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
879306.translation: 如果将在某个由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

879309.oracleText: {oT}: Create X 1/1 colorless Pilot creature tokens, where X is the number of Mounts and/or Vehicles that entered the battlefield under your control this turn. The tokens have "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
879309.translation: {oT}：派出X个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，X为本回合中在你操控下进战场之坐骑和／或载具数量。这些衍生物具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

879311.oracleText: For Team Cloudspire, the track is merely a suggestion.
879311.translation: 对鼎云侠队来说，赛道只不过是一种建议走法而已。

879312.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two other target Vehicles and/or creatures you control.
879312.translation: 当此载具进场时，将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个其他目标由你操控的载具和／或生物。

879314.oracleText: When this creature enters, put target creature card with mana value 4 or less from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control with a finality counter on it. That creature gains menace, deathtouch, and haste. At the beginning of your next end step, exile that creature.
879314.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于4的生物牌在你操控下从坟墓场放进战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。该生物获得威慑、死触与敏捷异能。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该生物。

879316.oracleText: Many brought weapons to the race. This crew built theirs as they went.
879316.translation: 许多赛手携武器参赛。这辆车的武器则是一边走，一边造。

879317.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
879317.translation: 当此载具进场时，每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

879319.oracleText: It was easy for them to replace lost crew members once they reached home turf.
879319.translation: 等他们回到主场之后，更替损失的队员就简单多了。

879320.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, return target artifact or creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
879320.translation: 当此载具进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器或生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

879322.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
879322.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

879323.oracleText: Max speed — Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
879323.translation: 速度极限～每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

879325.oracleText: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.
879325.translation: 烂宝确定这次的救援队比前几次的要好得多。

879326.oracleText: Exile up to one target artifact or creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
879326.translation: 放逐至多一个目标神器或生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

879327.oracleText: Explosive Getaway deals 4 damage to each creature.
879327.translation: 爆破脱逃对每个生物各造成4点伤害。

879329.oracleText: Whenever you attack, Far Fortune deals 1 damage to each opponent.
879329.translation: 每当你攻击时，法芙琼向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

879330.oracleText: Max speed — If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.
879330.translation: 速度极限～如果某个由你操控的来源将向任一对手或任一由对手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加1点伤害。

879332.translation: 由你操控的载具具有敏捷异能。

879333.oracleText: Whenever you attack, if a Pirate and a Vehicle attacked this combat, draw three cards, then discard two cards.
879333.translation: 每当你攻击时，若本次战斗中同时有海盗和载具攻击过，则抓三张牌，然后弃两张牌。

879336.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to target opponent and you gain 1 life.
879336.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向目标对手造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

879337.oracleText: Max speed — This creature has deathtouch and haste.
879337.translation: 速度极限～此生物具有死触与敏捷异能。

879341.oracleText: Choose target opponent. Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying. Then the chosen player loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
879341.translation: 选择目标对手。派出两个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。然后所选牌手失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的神器数量。

879343.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains deathtouch until end of turn. Untap it.
879343.translation: 每当你攻击时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得死触异能。将它重置。

879345.oracleText: Let the past die so the future might live.
879345.translation: 让过往消逝，还未来生机。

879346.oracleText: Ketramose can't attack or block unless there are seven or more cards in exile.
879346.translation: 除非放逐区中有七张或更多牌，否则柯塔摩斯不能进行攻击或阻挡。

879347.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile from graveyards and/or the battlefield during your turn, you draw a card and lose 1 life.
879347.translation: 每当一张或数张牌于你的回合中从坟墓场和／或战场进入放逐区时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

879349.oracleText: "Stay in formation! We win this together, or not at all."
879349.translation: 「保持阵型！要赢一起赢，要输一起输。」

879350.oracleText: Mounts and Vehicles you control have haste.
879350.translation: 由你操控的坐骑和载具具有敏捷异能。

879351.oracleText: Whenever a Mount you control enters, it becomes saddled until end of turn.
879351.translation: 每当一个由你操控的坐骑进场时，它成为已乘驾直到回合结束。

879352.oracleText: Whenever a Vehicle you control enters, it becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
879352.translation: 每当一个由你操控的载具进场时，它成为神器生物直到回合结束。

879354.oracleText: Whenever Lagorin attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target Mounts and/or Vehicles.
879354.translation: 每当拉古凌于已乘驾时攻击，在至多两个目标坐骑和／或载具上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879356.oracleText: Exhaust — {oG}, {oT}: Add three mana of any one color.
879356.translation: 竭绝～{oG}，{oT}：加三点任意颜色的单色法术力。

879358.oracleText: Exhaust — {oR}, {oT}: Loot deals 3 damage to any target.
879358.translation: 竭绝～{oR}，{oT}：烂宝对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

879360.oracleText: Mendicant Core's power is equal to the number of artifacts you control.
879360.translation: 济缘核心的力量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

879361.oracleText: Max speed — Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you may pay {o1}. If you do, copy it.
879361.translation: 速度极限～每当你施放神器咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则将它复制。

879362.oracleText: Max speed — Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you may pay {o1}. If you do, copy it. (The copy becomes a token.)
879362.translation: 速度极限～每当你施放神器咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则将它复制。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

879364.oracleText: As Mimeoplasm enters, exile up to X creature cards from your graveyard. It enters with three +1/+1 counters on it for each creature card exiled this way.
879364.translation: 于拟生原浆进场时，从你坟墓场放逐至多X张生物牌。它进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于以此法放逐之生物牌数量的三倍。

879365.oracleText: {o2}: Mimeoplasm becomes a copy of target creature card exiled with it, except it's 0/0 and has this ability.
879365.translation: {o2}：拟生原浆成为目标以其放逐之生物牌的复制品，但它是0/0且具有此异能。

879367.oracleText: Oil-actuated inventions raised eyebrows after the Invasion, but no one could argue against the efficacy of the design.
879367.translation: 大侵攻后，尽管以油料驱动的发明会引来非议，但从来没人质疑过这类设计的出众功效。

879368.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a card from it. If you do, that player discards that card, then draws a card.
879368.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视目标牌手的手牌。你可以选择其中一张牌。若你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌，然后抓一张牌。

879370.oracleText: A mighty memorial to a fallen savior.
879370.translation: 对已逝救世主的崇高纪念。

879371.oracleText: When this creature enters, other creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain vigilance and menace until end of turn. Damage can't be prevented this turn.
879371.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+2/+2且获得警戒与威慑异能。本回合中，伤害不能被防止。

879373.oracleText: Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
879373.translation: 每当你起动任一竭绝异能时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

879375.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is Redshift's power. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.
879375.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为红挡的力量。此法术力只能用来起动异能。

879376.oracleText: Exhaust — {o10oRoG}: Put any number of permanent cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
879376.translation: 竭绝～{o10oRoG}：将任意数量的永久物牌从你手上放进战场。

879378.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each opponent, put up to one target nonland permanent that player controls into its owner's library third from the top.
879378.translation: 当此生物进场时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～将至多一个目标由该牌手操控的非地永久物置于其拥有者牌库顶上数来第三张的位置。

879380.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, create a Treasure token.
879380.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

879381.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3}: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
879381.translation: 竭绝～{o3}：此载具成为神器生物。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879384.oracleText: Sab-Sunen can't attack or block unless it has an even number of counters on it. (Zero is even.)
879384.translation: 除非萨苏恩上的指示物数量为偶数，否则它不能进行攻击或阻挡。（零是偶数。）

879385.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on Sab-Sunen. Then if it has an odd number of counters on it, draw two cards.
879385.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，在萨苏恩上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后如果其上的指示物数量为奇数，则抓两张牌。

879387.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +X/+0, where X is your speed.
879387.translation: 由你操控的其他生物得+X/+0，X为你的速度。

879388.oracleText: Noncreature spells you cast cost {oX} less to cast, where X is your speed.
879388.translation: 你施放的非生物咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为你的速度。

879390.oracleText: Exhaust — {oXoGoGoU}: Put X +1/+1 counters on Sita Varma. Then you may have the base power and toughness of each other creature you control become equal to Sita Varma's power until end of turn.
879390.translation: 竭绝～{oXoGoGoU}：在西塔瓦玛上放置X个+1/+1指示物。然后你可以令每个由你操控的其他生物之基础力量与防御力成为等同于西塔瓦玛之力量直到回合结束。

879392.oracleText: Exhaust — {o4}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal two land cards. Put those land cards onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
879392.translation: 竭绝～{o4}：从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出两张地牌为止。将这些地牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879394.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less.
879394.translation: 当此载具进场时，消灭目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于4的非地永久物。

879396.oracleText: "Your enemies will underestimate you, but you must never underestimate yourself."
879396.translation: 「你的对手会低估你，但你绝对不能低估你自己。」

879397.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, untap each creature you control.
879397.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，重置所有由你操控的生物。

879398.oracleText: {o2oGoW}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
879398.translation: {o2oGoW}：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

879400.oracleText: "Observation: At current rate of travel, eventual rediscovery of home is a mathematical inevitability. Firm imperative: Let's go."
879400.translation: 「观察：按照目前的移动速率，最终重新发现家园是数学上的必然事件。坚定命令：出发。」

879401.oracleText: You draw three cards and gain 3 life.
879401.translation: 你抓三张牌且获得3点生命。

879403.translation: 由你操控的神器具有「守护～支付2点生命。」

879404.oracleText: Exhaust — {o2oUoB}, {oT}, Exile X artifact cards from your graveyard: Each other nonartifact creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
879404.translation: 竭绝～{o2oUoB}，{oT}，从你坟墓场放逐X张神器牌：每个其他非神器生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束。

879406.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Surveil 1. Activate only once each turn.
879406.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：刺探1。每回合只能起动一次。

879407.oracleText: Max speed — Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
879407.translation: 速度极限～每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

879409.oracleText: The Sting Strike model saved thousands of lives during the Invasion and quickly became a bestseller for Shadowblayde Craftworks.
879409.translation: 这款「针刺」型号产品在大侵攻期间曾救下无数性命，很快便成为幽锐精工坊公司的畅销之作。

879410.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy another target artifact. Activate only as a sorcery.
879410.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：消灭另一个目标神器。只能于法术时机起动。

879413.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage during your turn, put that many loyalty counters on The Aetherspark.
879413.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物于你的回合中造成战斗伤害时，在乙太火花上放置等量的忠诚指示物。

879414.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is attached to a creature, CARDNAME can't be attacked and has "Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage during your turn, put that many loyalty counters on The Aetherspark."
879414.translation: 只要CARDNAME贴附在某生物上，CARDNAME便不能被攻击，且具有「每当佩带此武具的生物于你的回合中造成战斗伤害时，在乙太火花上放置等量的忠诚指示物。」

879415.oracleText: As long as The Aetherspark is attached to a creature, The Aetherspark can't be attacked and has "Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage during your turn, put that many loyalty counters on The Aetherspark."
879415.translation: 只要乙太火花贴附在某生物上，乙太火花便不能被攻击，且具有「每当佩带此武具的生物于你的回合中造成战斗伤害时，在乙太火花上放置等量的忠诚指示物。」

879416.oracleText: Attach CARDNAME to up to one target creature you control. Put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
879416.translation: 将CARDNAME贴附到至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879417.oracleText: Attach The Aetherspark to up to one target creature you control. Put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
879417.translation: 将乙太火花贴附到至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879419.oracleText: Add ten mana of any one color.
879419.translation: 加十点任意颜色的单色法术力。

879421.oracleText: Vnwxt's contract demanded at least one dedicated camera on him at all times.
879421.translation: 维夕特的合约要求每时每刻都要有至少一颗镜头专门对着他。

879422.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
879422.translation: 竭绝～{o3}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

879424.oracleText: When this artifact enters, draw a card.
879424.translation: 当此神器进场时，抓一张牌。

879425.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Target Mount you control becomes saddled until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
879425.translation: {o2}，{oT}：目标由你操控的坐骑成为已乘驾直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

879426.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Target Vehicle you control becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
879426.translation: {o2}，{oT}：目标由你操控的载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

879428.oracleText: As this Vehicle enters, choose a creature type.
879428.translation: 于此载具进场时，选择一种生物类别。

879429.oracleText: Vehicle creatures you control are the chosen creature type in addition to their other types.
879429.translation: 由你操控的载具生物均额外具有所选生物类别。

879430.oracleText: Each creature you control of the chosen type other than this Vehicle gets +1/+1.
879430.translation: 每个由你操控且为所选类别的生物均得+1/+1，但此载具除外。

879432.oracleText: Many of the inventions built to fight the Phyrexians have since been repurposed for civilian use.
879432.translation: 许多为对抗非瑞克西亚人而制造的军用发明，如今都已重新改造供民间使用。

879433.oracleText: This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
879433.translation: 此生物进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物。

879434.oracleText: {o4}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
879434.translation: {o4}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

879435.oracleText: When this creature dies, draw a card for each +1/+1 counter on it.
879435.translation: 当此生物死去时，其上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便抓一张牌。

879437.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
879437.translation: 当此载具进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

879438.oracleText: Exhaust — {oWoUoBoRoG}: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature. Put two +1/+1 counters on it.
879438.translation: 竭绝～{oWoUoBoRoG}：此载具成为神器生物。在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

879440.oracleText: Loss is not the end of the journey.

879441.translation: 每位对手各失去3点生命。

879442.translation: 每位对手各失去3点生命。

879443.oracleText:
Whenever you discard a card, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — 
• Draw a card. 
• Create a Treasure token. 
• Each opponent loses 3 life.
879443.translation:
每当你弃一张牌时，选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的～ 
•抓一张牌。 
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。 
•每位对手各失去3点生命。

879447.oracleText: When this artifact enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
879447.translation: 当此神器进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

879448.oracleText: Max speed — Spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
879448.translation: 速度极限～你施放的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

879451.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice one or more artifacts: Choose a color. Target player adds three mana of the chosen color for each artifact sacrificed this way.
879451.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个或数个神器：选择一种颜色。目标牌手加若干所选颜色的法术力，其数量等同于以此法牺牲之神器数量的三倍。

879455.oracleText: From the screaming of Duskmourn's possessed metal came the happy cries of freed souls.
879455.translation: 在暮悲邸着魔金属的悲惨尖鸣中，夹杂着重获自由灵魂的快乐欢呼。

879456.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 3 damage to target creature.
879456.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。

879457.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target creature or Vehicle.
879457.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：消灭目标生物或载具。

879460.oracleText: Ten teams. Ten dreams. One winner.
879460.translation: 十支车队。十种梦想。一个冠军。

879461.oracleText: Max speed — {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
879461.translation: 速度极限～{oT}，牺牲此神器：抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

879464.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you create a Treasure token.
879464.translation: 当此生物进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

879466.oracleText: The warrior rose in a very different world from the one he'd left behind.
879466.translation: 战士起身时已位于另一世界，跟先前离开之处已大不相同。

879469.oracleText:
"Don't get too cocky. We're all junk to the cleanup crew."
—Far Fortune
879469.translation:
「别觉得自己了不起。在清障组眼里我们都是垃圾。」
～法芙琼

879470.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. You gain 1 life.
879470.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。你获得1点生命。

879472.oracleText: Stage 2: The sands and waters of Amonkhet.
879472.translation: 第二阶段：阿芒凯的沙地水道。

879473.oracleText: Max speed — {oT}: Target creature gains haste until end of turn.
879473.translation: 速度极限～{oT}：目标生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

879475.oracleText: Stage 1: The winding streets of Ghirapur.
879475.translation: 第一阶段：吉拉波的蜿蜒街巷。

879476.oracleText: Max speed — {o3}, {oT}, Discard a card: Draw a card.
879476.translation: 速度极限～{o3}，{oT}，弃一张牌：抓一张牌。

879478.oracleText:
"Despite being older than nearly every living thing here, Loot is still just a kid. That doesn't change what we need from him."
—Jace
879478.translation:
「虽然烂宝比此处几乎所有生灵都要年长，他依然童心未泯。但这也并未改变我们对他的期待。」
～杰斯

879479.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW}. Activate only if you control a Plains or a Swamp.
879479.translation: {oT}：加{oW}。只能于你操控平原或沼泽时起动。

879480.oracleText: To the Endriders, racing is worship. Their prayers rise on the howls of straining engines. Explosions punctuate their chorus of shouts, forming a hymn of glory to the open road and all roads to come.
879480.translation: 对送终士队来说，比赛是礼拜的一部分。他们的祷词随着引擎轰鸣愈发响亮。吼声齐诵加上点缀其间的阵阵爆炸声响，共同组成一曲对过往道路及未来通途的光荣赞歌。

879481.oracleText: The Alacrian Quickbeasts desire not only to win, but to forge new alliances against the unknown threats of this interconnected Multiverse.
879481.translation: 阿拉奇亚捷兽队不仅想赢下比赛，还想与其他势力组成同盟，携手对抗多重宇宙相通后出现的未知威胁。

879483.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Mount or Vehicle.
879483.translation: 除非你操控坐骑或载具，否则此地须横置进场。

879484.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
879484.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

879485.oracleText: The doomed souls of the Speed Demons race in uneasy unity, each one hoping to escape their own fate.
879485.translation: 迅疾魔队由注亡邪灵构成，他们能够共组一队参赛实属不易，因为大家都只想着藉此机会让自己免遭苦难。

879487.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
879487.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

879488.oracleText: When asked, the Speedbrood never put their motives into words; they simply say that velocity is their way of life. Only by becoming speed itself can one truly understand their reason for racing.
879488.translation: 极速虫队从不会向他人透露自身的参赛动机，而只是简单概括说速度是它们生活方式的一部分。自身成为极速后，才能真正了解到投身竞速的原因。

879490.oracleText: Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.
879490.translation: 第三阶段：莫甘达坠星天空下的茂密丛林。

879493.oracleText: The Indigo Revolution changed more about Avishkar than just its name. Even Gonti's infamous night markets had gone legitimate.
879493.translation: 靛蓝革命改变了阿维什卡的方方面面，并非只有名称。就连贡提那恶名晚市，如今都能够合法运营。

879494.oracleText: This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color.
879494.translation: 此地须横置进场。于它进场时，选择一种颜色。

879496.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
879496.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

879498.oracleText:
"While Loot's ability to predict Omenpaths is extraordinary, I'm more impressed by his unrelenting curiosity."
—Pia Nalaar
879498.translation:
「虽然烂宝预测预兆径路的能力确实出色，我更欣赏的是他那颗永无止境的好奇心。」
～琵雅纳拉

879499.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Activate only if you control an Island or a Mountain.
879499.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。只能于你操控海岛或山脉时起动。

879501.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
879501.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

879502.oracleText: The Goblin Rocketeers want nothing more than to push the limits of kinetic energy and see if their machines can go the farthest, fastest, first.
879502.translation: 窜天鬼队的目的，就只是想要推高动能引擎的极限，看看自己的成果能否开得最远，跑得最快，赢得最多。

879503.oracleText: For the Champions of Amonkhet, the stakes go beyond victory. They race to show the Multiverse that their home is not a dead plane to be mourned, but a living world just beginning to awaken.
879503.translation: 阿芒凯豪杰队的目标远超争冠。他们参赛，更多是为了向多重宇宙展现自己的家园：原本令人悲悯的败亡时空，如今已转变为即将觉醒的生机世界。

879505.oracleText:
"Loot is free to go where he wants, so let's make sure the kid gets there in one piece."
—Chandra Nalaar
879505.translation:
「烂宝想去哪里都可以，我们来保护这孩子，让他能够安全抵达。」
～茜卓纳拉

879506.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Activate only if you control a Mountain or a Plains.
879506.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。只能于你操控山脉或平原时起动。

879507.oracleText: The Keelhaulers channel their prey drive into thrilling, cutthroat pursuits. Glory is all the sweeter when it's won at the expense of others.
879507.translation: 沧海盗队将猎物赶入紧张刺激的残酷追逐。荣光虽然可贵，但踩在别人身上赢回来的才更甜美。

879508.oracleText: The Indigo Revolution ousted the Consulate once and for all. Now the citizens of Avishkar cheer for the Aether Rangers as they try to bring victory and glory to their new nation.
879508.translation: 靛蓝革命彻底推翻了执政院的统治。如今阿维什卡的市民共同为乙太流浪者队助威，期望他们能为自己的全新国度赢回胜利与荣耀。

879509.oracleText: The Guidelight Voyagers seek only a means to return home, hoping to one day discover a way back among the many worlds they race across.
879509.translation: 循光云游械队一心想要返回家园，希冀最终能从参赛经过的众多世界当中寻得归乡之路。

879511.oracleText:
"I'm worried about Loot. He has great power but lacks the experience to know what dangers await him."
—Vraska
879511.translation:
「我很担心烂宝。他力量非凡，但毫无经验，不知道前面有什么危险在等着他。」
～瓦丝卡

879512.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oB}. Activate only if you control a Swamp or a Forest.
879512.translation: {oT}：加{oB}。只能于你操控沼泽或树林时起动。

879514.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
879514.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

879516.oracleText:
"If nothing else, that Loot is one brave little rat."
—Winter
879516.translation:
「别的不说，烂宝就像只勇敢的小老鼠。」
～温特

879517.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG}. Activate only if you control a Forest or an Island.
879517.translation: {oT}：加{oG}。只能于你操控树林或海岛时起动。

879518.oracleText: Team Cloudspire burns with the pride and passion typical of competitors on Kylem. As the reigning champions of the Ghirapur Grand Prix, they have no intention of losing their title.
879518.translation: 鼎云侠队满怀骄傲与激情，与凯勒姆上的选手一般无二。作为吉拉波大奖赛的卫冕冠军，他们绝不会将这一头衔旁落他人。

879521.translation: 指定一个坐骑或载具为目标。

879522.oracleText: Search for a nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less.
879522.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌。

879523.oracleText: Spend only on: An Artifact Spell or an Ability
879523.translation: 只能用于支付：神器咒语或异能

879524.oracleText: Target a creature or Vehicle an opponent controls.
879524.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的生物或载具为目标。

879525.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with mana value 4 or 5.
879525.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值为4或5的神器牌。

879526.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value 4 or 5?
879526.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值为4或5的神器牌？

879528.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, surveil 1.
879528.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，刺探1。

879530.oracleText: Target a creature, planeswalker, or Vehicle.
879530.translation: 指定一个生物、鹏洛客或载具为目标。

879531.oracleText: Target up to one Vehicle you control.
879531.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的载具为目标。

879533.translation: 是否要牺牲一个生物或载具？

879534.oracleText: Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
879534.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们牺牲。

879535.oracleText: Target up to one creature or Vehicle.
879535.translation: 指定至多一个生物或载具为目标。

879536.oracleText: Put an artifact, creature, or land card into your hand?
879536.translation: 是否要将一张神器、生物或地牌置于你手上？

879537.oracleText: Search for a creature card with no abilities.
879537.translation: 搜寻一张不具异能的生物牌。

879538.oracleText: Put a creature or Vehicle card onto the battlefield?
879538.translation: 是否要将一张生物牌或载具牌放进战场？

879539.oracleText: Target up to one Mount card.
879539.translation: 指定至多一张坐骑牌为目标。

879540.oracleText: Target up to one Vehicle card.
879540.translation: 指定至多一张载具牌为目标。

879541.oracleText: Target up to one creature card with no abilities.
879541.translation: 指定至多一张不具异能的生物牌为目标。

879542.oracleText: Search for up to two artifact, creature, and/or enchantment cards with mana value 1 or less.
879542.translation: 搜寻至多两张法术力值等于或小于1的神器、生物和／或结界牌。

879543.oracleText: Search your library for up to two artifact, creature, and/or enchantment cards with mana value 1 or less?
879543.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张法术力值等于或小于1的神器，生物和／或结界牌？

879544.oracleText: Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player this turn, you draw a card.
879544.translation: 每当该生物在本回合中对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌。

879545.oracleText: Search for a Mount or Vehicle card.
879545.translation: 搜寻一张坐骑或载具牌。

879546.oracleText: Search your library for a Mount or Vehicle card?
879546.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张坐骑或载具牌？

879548.oracleText: Target a creature card with mana value 4 or less.
879548.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于4的生物牌为目标。

879549.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
879549.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

879550.oracleText: Target up to two Mounts and/or Vehicles.
879550.translation: 指定至多两个坐骑和／或载具为目标。

879551.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Exile up to {2, Number} creature card.} other {Exile up to {2, Number} creature cards.}}
879551.translation: {2, plural, =1 {放逐至多{2, Number}张生物牌。} other {放逐至多{2, Number}张生物牌。}}

879552.oracleText: Target a creature card exiled with it.
879552.translation: 指定一张以其放逐的生物牌为目标。

879555.oracleText: "Exist in the moment. Ignore the world around you. Embrace the one truth of reality, that all life is motion."
879555.translation: 「聚心念于当下。忽略周遭一切。接纳现实这一真理：所有生命皆运动不停。」

879557.oracleText: "I scream, you scream, we all scream . . . forever."
879557.translation: 「我嚎，你嚎，众生齐嚎…永世难逃。」

879558.oracleText: Whenever you discard a creature card, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
879558.translation: 每当你弃一张生物牌时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

879559.oracleText: Whenever you discard a land card, add {oBoB}.
879559.translation: 每当你弃一张地牌时，加{oBoB}。

879560.oracleText: Whenever you discard a noncreature, nonland card, draw a card.
879560.translation: 每当你弃一张非生物且非地的牌时，抓一张牌。

879561.oracleText: "Where do you think you're going, chum?"

879563.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, creatures you control gain trample and get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
879563.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+X，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。

879565.oracleText: Ferren Gibrar's award-winning invention from the Inventor's Fair—now available to the general public.
879565.translation: 费伦杰波在发明家博览会上荣获大奖的发明～如今寻常百姓也能入手。

879566.oracleText: Engineers take inspiration from nature when it comes to efficiency and aerodynamics. Why not intimidation too?
879566.translation: 在追求转化效率和空气动力时，工程师就会从自然造物中去找灵感。那为什么威慑力的方面不能也试试呢？

879567.oracleText: Return an enchantment card to your hand.
879567.translation: 将一张结界牌移回你手上。

879568.oracleText: Unlock a locked door of a Room you control.
879568.translation: 解锁任一由你操控之隔间的一扇已上锁偏门。

879569.oracleText: Lock or unlock a door of target Room you control.
879569.translation: 上锁或解锁目标由你操控之隔间的一扇偏门。

879570.translation: 指定一个由你操控的隔间为目标。

879575.oracleText: Search for a Room card that doesn't have the same name as a Room you control.
879575.translation: 搜寻一张隔间牌，且其不能与任一由你操控的隔间同名。

879579.oracleText: Unlock a locked door of up to one target Room you control.
879579.translation: 解锁至多一个目标由你操控之隔间的一扇已上锁偏门。

879580.oracleText: Target up to one Room you control.
879580.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的隔间为目标。

879587.oracleText: When it dies this turn, manifest dread.
879587.translation: 本回合中，当它死去时，显化惧象。

879589.oracleText: Search for a number of basic land cards equal to the number of creatures they controlled exiled this way.
879589.translation: 搜寻若干基本地牌，其数量等同于由其操控且以此法放逐的生物数量。

879591.oracleText: Choose a non-Food permanent card in your graveyard at random.
879591.translation: 随机选择你坟墓场中的一张非食品永久物牌。

879592.oracleText: Choose a permanent owned by the voter.
879592.translation: 选择一个由投该票者拥有的永久物。

879602.oracleText: {o3}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card.
879602.translation: {o3}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：抓一张牌。

879604.oracleText: Put one of those MANIFEST _ DREAD _ PUT _ INTO _ GRAVEYARD cards into your hand.
879604.translation: 将其中一张MANIFEST _ DREAD _ PUT _ INTO _ GRAVEYARD牌置于你手上。

879627.oracleText: Exile each creature you don't control. Each player who controlled a creature exiled this way searches their library for a number of basic land cards equal to the number of creatures they controlled exiled this way, puts those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffles.
879627.translation: 放逐每个不由你操控的生物。每位操控以此法放逐之生物的牌手，便从其牌库中搜寻数量等同于由其操控且以此法放逐之生物数量的基本地牌，各将所搜寻的牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

879694.oracleText:
"I'll teach you the leyline paratrigonometrics, no problem. But you need to show me how to make that fiery swirly thing."
—Zimone, to Rootha
879694.translation:
「没问题，我可以教你地脉对三角学。但你得告诉我怎么画出那道火热涡旋。」
～琦梦答应如莎

879805.oracleText: Attach to another one of your opponents.

880001.oracleText: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, add {oR} for each 1 life your opponents have lost this turn.
880001.translation: 在你的每个战斗后的行动阶段开始时，所有对手于本回合中每失去过1点生命，便加{oR}。

880832.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. You get {oEoE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}. CARDNAME deals that much damage to that permanent.
880832.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。你得到{oEoE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。CARDNAME对该永久物造成等量的伤害。

880833.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. You get {oEoE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}. Galvanic Discharge deals that much damage to that permanent.
880833.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。你得到{oEoE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。电流涌射对该永久物造成等量的伤害。

880835.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may pay {oEoEoEoE}. When you do, put two +1/+1 counters and a flying counter on target attacking creature. It becomes an Angel in addition to its other types.
880835.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以支付{oEoEoEoE}。当你如此作时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物和一个飞行指示物。它成为天使，且仍具有原本类别。

880938.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters and a flying counter on target attacking creature. It becomes an Angel in addition to its other types.
880938.translation: 在目标进行攻击的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物和一个飞行指示物。它成为天使，且仍具有原本类别。

881022.oracleText: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, exile CARDNAME, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
881022.translation: 在你的每个战斗后的行动阶段开始时，若你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则放逐CARDNAME，然后将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

881056.oracleText: Tap all creatures target player controls. You may pay any amount of {oE}. If you do, choose up to that many creatures tapped this way. Put a stun counter on each of them.
881056.translation: 横置由目标牌手操控的所有生物。你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。若你如此作，则选择至多等量之以此法横置的生物。在这些生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

881064.oracleText: Choose a creature to take 5 damage.
881064.translation: 选择一个生物受到5点伤害。

881145.oracleText: At the beginning of each of enchanted player's postcombat main phases, there is an additional beginning phase after this phase.
881145.translation: 在每个所结附的牌手之战斗后的行动阶段开始时，在该阶段后额外多出一个开始阶段。

881146.oracleText: At the beginning of each of enchanted player's postcombat main phases, there is an additional beginning phase after this phase. (The end step happens after the added untap, upkeep, and draw steps.)
881146.translation: 在每个所结附的牌手之战斗后的行动阶段开始时，在该阶段后额外多出一个开始阶段。（在新多出来的重置、维持和抓牌步骤后，才是结束步骤。）

881166.oracleText: Spend only on: Turning Permanents Face Up
881166.translation: 只能用于支付：将永久物翻回正面

881169.oracleText: Whenever one or more opponents lose life during your turn, if your speed is less than 4, increase your speed by 1. This ability triggers only once each turn.
881169.translation: 每当一个或多个对手在你的回合中失去生命时，如果你的速度小于4，则将你的速度增加1。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

881183.oracleText: Spend only on: Face-Down Spells or Turning Creatures Face Up
881183.translation: 只能用于支付：牌面朝下的咒语或将生物翻回正面

881226.oracleText: You get {oEoEoE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}.
881226.translation: 你得到{oEoEoE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。

881227.oracleText: Each player may exile their hand and draw a number of cards equal to the amount of {oE} paid this way. If seven or more {oE} was paid this way, you may play cards you own exiled this way until the end of your next turn.
881227.translation: 每位牌手各可以放逐其手牌并抓等同于以此法支付之{oE}数量的牌。如果以此法支付了七个或更多{oE}，则直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用以此法放逐且由你拥有的牌。

881327.oracleText: Choose up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} creatures tapped thi} other {{2, Number} creatures tapped this}} way.
881327.translation: 选择至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个以此法横置的生物} other {{2, Number}个以此法横置的生物}}。

881372.oracleText: Exile target nontoken creature. If the gift wasn't promised, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
881372.translation: 放逐目标非衍生物的生物。如果未应诺礼赠，则在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

881428.oracleText: {oHoH} — Draw a card for each creature that died under your control this turn.
881428.translation: {oHoH}～本回合中每有一个生物在你的操控下死去，便抓一张牌。

881470.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control dies, exile the top card of your library. You may play it until the end of your next turn.
881470.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

881546.oracleText: Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
881546.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

884542.oracleText: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the total amount of life your opponents lost this turn. Exile one of those cards and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may play the exiled card this turn.
884542.translation: 在你的每个战斗后的行动阶段开始时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为本回合中对手失去的生命总数量。放逐其中一张，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。本回合中，你可以使用所放逐的牌。

884635.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy it.
884635.translation: 本回合中，当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。

886024.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage during your turn, put that many +1/+1 counters on it. (It must survive to get the counters.)
886024.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物于你的回合中造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。（它要活下来才能得到指示物。）

886026.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
886026.translation: {oT}：在目标由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

886027.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature or Vehicle you control gains double strike until end of turn.
886027.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物或载具获得连击异能直到回合结束。

886030.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature or Vehicle: Draw a card.
886030.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物或载具：抓一张牌。

886033.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
886033.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

886035.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR} for each Goblin you control.

886037.oracleText: If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.
886037.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将向任一对手或任一由对手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加1点伤害。

886039.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you may pay {o1}. If you do, copy it.
886039.translation: 每当你施放神器咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则将它复制。

886040.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
886040.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

886043.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Discard a card: Draw a card.

886044.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或载具。

886045.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Exile {2, Number} artifact card.} other {Exile {2, Number} artifact cards.}}
886045.translation: {2, plural, =1 {放逐{2, Number}张神器牌。} other {放逐{2, Number}张神器牌。}}

886048.oracleText:
"We must never stoop to violence in the name of conquest or hatred, but when evil threatens, we must face it with courage and ferocity."
—Ajani Goldmane
886048.translation:
「我们绝不能以征服或仇恨之名行暴力之事，但当邪恶来袭时，我们必须以勇气与凶猛来应对。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

886049.oracleText: The rumble of his roar is a call to the hunt.
886049.translation: 他咆哮的轰鸣是狩猎的号召。

886050.oracleText: "Have patience, brave one. Just as the sun returns each morning, I will be there to drive back the terrors of night."
886050.translation: 「耐心静候，勇者。正如太阳每日清晨归来，我必在此驱散夜晚的恐惧。」

886051.oracleText: Conyan the Great carefully selected his last words as he lay bleeding on the battlefield. Moments later, he snapped awake in a body of stone, with a startled, curious face peering at him.
886051.translation: 孔扬大帝躺在战场上血流不止，仔细斟酌着自己的遗言。片刻之后，他在一具石头身躯中猛然醒来，一张惊讶而好奇的脸注视着他。

886052.oracleText: Helle soared joyfully through the icy dawn. After hearing one thousand tales of her ancestors, she'd finally taken her place among the honored host.
886052.translation: 海勒在冰冷的黎明欢快翱翔。在听过一千个先祖传奇后，她终得跻身荣耀军团之列。

886053.oracleText: The giants of Kaldheim have over two hundred runes for "squish."
886053.translation: 凯德海姆的巨人有两百多个符文用于表达「压扁」。

886054.oracleText:
"To whoever left their homunculus experiment unattended: you will not be penalized if you come forward and tell us how to make it stop."
—Laboratory notice
886054.translation:
「致把造妖实验放着不管的某人：只要你愿意站出来告诉我们怎么让它停下，就不会受罚。」
～实验室告示

886055.oracleText:
"When wolves howl at the moon, I can't help but wonder: Does it answer? What secrets might it share when humans aren't listening?"
—Elinor, philosopher
886055.translation:
「当狼对着月亮嚎叫时，我不禁想问：月亮会回应吗？在人类没有聆听时，它会分享什么秘密？」
～哲人艾琳诺

886056.oracleText:
"I sincerely regret that your place of business burned itself down after you declined our protection."
—Gazenio, New Capenna crime lord
886056.translation:
「在你拒绝了我们的保护后，你的生意场所自己着火了，对此我真心感到遗憾。」
～新卡佩纳罪犯头目哥赞尼亚

886057.oracleText:
"Knowing everything reveals not answers, but in fact their profound absence."
—Gadwick, the Wizened
886057.translation:
「知晓一切后展露的并非答案，而是答案的深切缺失。」
～老年法师盖威克

886058.oracleText: "What arrives uninvited, overstays its welcome, and is blown away with a single breath?"
886058.translation: 「什么东西不请自来，逗留过久，轻轻一吹就飞走？」

886059.oracleText: "Hmm . . . I'm of two minds about this."

886060.oracleText: Final moments stricken by terror make the corpses into potent magical fuel.
886060.translation: 临终恐惧将尸体化作强大法术燃料。

886061.oracleText: "Your death will be neither quick nor painless. Agony makes blood so much sweeter."
886061.translation: 「你的死亡不会迅速无痛。苦痛会让鲜血更加甘甜。」

886062.oracleText: She preys on Thraben's elites, known for their sophisticated taste.
