886062.translation: 她以瑟班的精英为食，毕竟他们以兴味高雅闻名。

886063.oracleText: The gladiatorial stadiums on New Phyrexia echo day and night with the sounds of grinding metal and tearing flesh.
886063.translation: 新非瑞克西亚的角斗场日夜回响着金属磨擦与肉体撕裂的声音。

886064.oracleText: The empire expanded hungrily, every bloody conquest seeding the ground with the corpses of all who resisted. One moonless night, the corpses rose to take back what was theirs.
886064.translation: 帝国贪婪地扩张，每次血腥征服都令反抗者的尸体深埋大地。某个无月之夜，尸体苏醒，夺回属于他们的一切。

886065.oracleText: "Using blood to shed more blood—tell me that's not inspired!"
886065.translation: 「用血来放出更多血～告诉我这不是灵感！」

886066.oracleText: While her foes took stock of their casualties, she ordered hers to renew the assault.
886066.translation: 敌人的伤亡，她则下令自家的伤亡再度出击。

886067.oracleText: Selis entered the storm brimming with confidence. Her courage crumbled almost as fast as her shield.
886067.translation: 赛莉丝满怀信心地冲入风暴之中。她的勇气和她的盾牌几乎同时崩溃了。

886068.oracleText:
"What's a more fitting shape for a storm than a dragon?"
—Niv-Mizzet
886068.translation:
「还有什么比龙更适合担当风暴的形态？」
～尼米捷

886069.oracleText: He is the roaring hurricane, the earthquake's sundering fury, the embodiment of wild, untamable power.
886069.translation: 他是咆哮的飓风，是地震的怒火，是狂野力量的不驯化身。

886070.oracleText: Among the akki, promotions are regularly earned through important criteria like "having the biggest weapon."
886070.translation: 在恶鬼之间，升迁一般要按某些重要标准来，比如「拿着最大个的武器」。

886071.oracleText: She is the predator's appetite, the hunter's ferocity, the primordial progenitor of claws and fangs.
886071.translation: 她是掠食的饥渴，是猎人的凶猛，是尖牙利爪的原初始祖。

886072.oracleText:
"I think you mean giant lemures, a type of malevolent spirit that . . . OH GODS, WHAT IS THAT?!"
—Uriah the Smug, last words
886072.translation:
「我觉得你说的是巨型游魂，那是一种恶灵…噢，天哪，那是什么？！」
～自负的乌赖亚，遗言

886073.oracleText: "Our home may have no walls, but it is far from undefended."
886073.translation: 「我们的家园或许没有围墙，但绝非无人防守。」

886074.oracleText: "The land is my steed, and I am its champion!"
886074.translation: 「大地是我的坐骑，而我则是它的勇士！」

886075.oracleText: Some called him a monster. Others called him a god. All who beheld him knew his power.
886075.translation: 有人称他为怪物。有人称他为神明。所有见证过他的人都知晓他的力量。

886076.oracleText: Sharp enough to carve a swath through history.
886076.translation: 锋利到足以在历史上留痕。

886077.oracleText:
"We will sow perfection into the soft flesh of the Multiverse."
—Argent Etchings, plate 38, passage 8
886077.translation:
「我们必将把完美播撒于多重宇宙的软弱血肉中。」
～《银蚀圣典》第38片，第8段

886078.oracleText:
"Start with small, careful steps. I've had customers accidentally jog themselves halfway across the continent in these things."
—Norris, arcane cobbler
886078.translation:
「先从小心迈小步开始。我有顾客穿上这东西后，竟然不小心跑到了大陆另一边。」
～玄秘鞋匠诺里斯

886079.oracleText: Explorers mistakenly focused on the hands, not what they could be grasping towards.
886079.translation: 探险家们误将注意力放在手上，而非用手能抓住的东西。

886080.oracleText: "Proper chronomancy research can't be rushed. Luckily, I've got all the time in the world."
886080.translation: 「严谨的时间法术研究不能急于求成。 幸运的是，我有的是时间。」

886084.translation: 由你操控的其他反派得+2/+2。

886085.oracleText: Your maximum hand size is eight.

886086.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have fewer than eight cards in hand, draw cards equal to the difference.
886086.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你的手牌数量少于八张，则抓等同于该差距数量的牌。

886089.oracleText: When this creature deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it.
886089.translation: 当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它牺牲。

886095.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 1/1 green and white Human Citizen creature token.
886095.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的人类／市民衍生生物。

886096.oracleText: {o3oGoW}: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
886096.translation: {o3oGoW}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得警戒异能。

886098.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure three cards named Sunscorched Desert into the top ten cards of each player's library at random.
886098.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将三张名称为日灼荒漠的牌随机幻变进每位牌手牌库顶的十张牌中。

886277.oracleText: Target a creature with a stun counter on it.
886277.translation: 指定一个其上有晕眩指示物的生物为目标。

886278.oracleText: Exile two other cards named Say Its Name.
886278.translation: 放逐两张名称为直呼其名的其他牌。

886279.translation: 平原／海岛／沼泽／山脉／树林

886371.oracleText: Spend only on: An Enchantment Spell or Unlocking a Door or Turning a Permanent Face Up
886371.translation: 只能用于支付：结界咒语，解锁偏门或是将永久物翻回正面

886394.oracleText: Spend only on: Room Spells or Unlocking Doors
886394.translation: 只能用于支付：隔间咒语或解锁偏门

887292.oracleText: Real or not, here it comes.
887292.translation: 无论是真是假，它终将降临。

887294.oracleText: As long as you control another creature, Ethrimik can't attack or block.
887294.translation: 只要你操控另一个生物，艾斯瑞米克便不能进行攻击或阻挡。

887296.oracleText: "Uh, what did you mean, ‘First time for everything'?"
887296.translation: 「呃，你说『凡事都有第一次』是什么意思？」

887300.oracleText: Enchantment spells you cast have convoke.
887300.translation: 你施放的结界咒语具有召集异能。

887301.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, conjure a card named Mothlight Processionist into your hand. Discard that card at the beginning of the next end step.
887301.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，将一张名称为蛾光游行僧的牌幻变进你手上。在下一个结束步骤开始时，弃掉该牌。

887307.oracleText: Keep your hands to yourself if you want to stay yourself.
887307.translation: 若想保持本我，最好别动手动脚。

887314.oracleText: Whenever you seek one or more cards during your turn, conjure a duplicate of each of those cards into your hand, then manifest those duplicates.
887314.translation: 每当你于你的回合中取出一张或数张牌时，将这些牌各自的一张副本幻变进你手上，然后显化这些副本。

887316.oracleText: Enchantment creatures you control have menace.
887316.translation: 由你操控的结界生物具有威慑异能。

887317.oracleText: Whenever one or more enchantment creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, exile a random creature card from that player's library. Create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 1/1 enchantment creature.
887317.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的结界生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从该牌手的牌库中随机放逐一张生物牌。派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该牌的复制品，但它是1/1结界生物。

887319.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if CARDNAME is tapped, you lose 1 life and draft a card from Glimmer Hoarder's spellbook. That card perpetually becomes an enchantment in addition to its other types.
887319.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若CARDNAME已横置，则你失去1点生命并从烁光匿集者的法术书中抽选一张牌。该牌永久成为结界，且仍具有原本类别。

887322.oracleText: When you cast this spell, target opponent drafts a card from Razor Demon's spellbook. They may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
887322.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，目标对手从锐锋恶魔的法术书中抽选一张牌。其可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

887324.oracleText: Endless terror leads to an endless feast.

887327.oracleText: Draw X cards. Create an X/X black Demon creature token with flying. Your life total becomes X.
887327.translation: 抓X张牌。派出一个X/X黑色，具飞行异能的恶魔衍生生物。你的总生命成为X。

887328.oracleText: You can't gain life for the rest of the game.
887328.translation: 在本盘游戏接下来的时段，你不能获得生命。

887330.oracleText: Looking at the picture kept his grief fresh and his anger stoked.
887330.translation: 凝视那幅画，他的悲伤永不褪色，怒火始终炽烈。

887331.oracleText: Discard a card. If you do, seek two cards that don't share a card type with the discarded card.
887331.translation: 弃一张牌。若你如此作，则取出两张与所弃之牌不具共通牌张类别的牌。

887332.translation: 粗制屠宰场//恶臭烹饪间

887333.oracleText: When you unlock this door, this Room deals 2 damage to target creature.
887333.translation: 当你解锁此偏门时，此隔间对目标生物造成2点伤害。

887334.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to a creature, choose a creature card in your hand. It perpetually gets +2/+0 and gains haste.
887334.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源对任一生物造成非战斗伤害时，选择你手上的一张生物牌。它永久得+2/+0且获得敏捷异能。

887340.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, add {oCoCoC}. Spend this mana only to cast creature spells.
887340.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，加{oCoCoC}。此法术力只能用于施放生物咒语。

887342.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may cast creature spells from among the exiled cards.
887342.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以从所放逐之牌中施放生物咒语。

887348.oracleText: As long as the top card of your library is a creature card, you may look at it any time and you may cast it.
887348.translation: 只要你的牌库顶牌是生物牌，你便可以随时检视之且你可以施放之。

887350.oracleText: This permanent costs {o2} less to turn face up.
887350.translation: 此永久物减少{o2}来翻为牌面朝上。

887351.oracleText: When this permanent is turned face up, if it's a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
887351.translation: 当此永久物翻为牌面朝上时，若其为生物，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

887352.oracleText: Manifest dread. Then each face-down creature you control gains "This permanent costs {o2} less to turn face up" and "When this permanent is turned face up, if it's a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it."
887352.translation: 显化惧象。然后每个由你操控且牌面朝下的生物均获得「此永久物减少{o2}来翻为牌面朝上」与「当此永久物翻为牌面朝上时，若其为生物，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」

887354.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another permanent you control named Verdant Dread enters, manifest dread.
887354.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且名称为新绿颤栗的永久物进场时，显化惧象。

887356.oracleText: {o3oGoG}: Conjure a card named Verdant Dread onto the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
887356.translation: {o3oGoG}：将一张名称为新绿颤栗的牌幻变进战场。只能于法术时机起动。

887359.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if CARDNAME is tapped, return up to one target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield. CARDNAME perpetually gets +1/+1.
887359.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若CARDNAME已横置，则将至多一张目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。CARDNAME永久得+1/+1。

887366.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Effie is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on each tapped creature you control. Then seek a Survivor card with mana value less than or equal to the number of tapped creatures you control.
887366.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若埃菲已横置，则在每个由你操控且已横置的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后取出一张法术力值等于或小于由你操控且已横置之生物数量的求生者牌。

887369.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, creatures you control that are Otters and/or enchantments get +1/+1 until end of turn.
887369.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，由你操控且为水獭和／或结界的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

887370.oracleText: When Enduring Friendship dies, if it was a creature, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. It's an enchantment. (It's not a creature.)
887370.translation: 当永续友谊体死去时，若它是生物，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。它是结界。(移回后它便不再是生物。)

887375.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another nonland permanent. When you do, each opponent exiles a nonland, nontoken permanent they control and a random nonland card from their library, then CARDNAME deals damage to them equal to the total mana value of the cards exiled this way.
887375.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个非地永久物。当你如此作时，每位对手各放逐一个由其操控，非地且非衍生物的永久物，及其牌库中随机一张非地牌，然后CARDNAME对其造成伤害，其数量等同于以此法放逐的牌之法术力值总和。

887379.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, a random creature card in your hand perpetually gets +X/+X, where X is the amount of life you gained.
887379.translation: 每当你获得生命时，你手上的一张随机生物牌永久得+X/+X，X为你获得的生命数量。

887381.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, switch its power and toughness.
887381.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，将它的力量与防御力互换。

887382.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, switch the power and toughness of each creature on the battlefield. You get a twelve-time boon with "Whenever a creature you control enters, switch its power and toughness."
887382.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将战场上每个生物的力量与防御力互换。你获得具有以下异能的十二次恩泽～「每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，将它的力量与防御力互换。」

887387.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a permanent spell from among non-Aura, noncreature permanent cards in your graveyard. If you do, it perpetually becomes a 2/1 Rat creature in addition to its other types.
887387.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从你坟墓场的非灵气且非生物的永久物牌中，施放一个永久物咒语。若你如此作，则它永久成为2/1老鼠生物，且仍具有原本类别。

887389.oracleText: It feeds, but it's never satiated. It takes, but it's never enough.
887389.translation: 它不断吞噬，却永不满足。它贪婪掠夺，却总嫌不够。

887390.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, heist target opponent's library.
887390.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，偷窃目标对手的牌库。

887393.oracleText:
"The All-Devouring Father calls to you. The All-Devouring Father bids you to emerge."
—Victor, Valgavoth's seneschal
887393.translation:
「噬尽万物之父在召唤你。噬尽万物之父命令你现身。」
～瓦伽沃总管维克托

887396.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, target creature you control perpetually gets +1/+0.
887396.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，目标由你操控的生物永久得+1/+0。

887398.oracleText: If a creature you control becoming the target of a spell or ability causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
887398.translation: 如果由你操控之永久物的触发式异能因某个由你操控之生物成为咒语或异能的目标而触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

887401.oracleText: When you cast this spell, each opponent draws a card and gains 3 life.
887401.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，每位对手各抓一张牌且获得3点生命。

887402.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand. You choose one of them. That card perpetually gains "When you cast this spell, each opponent draws a card and gains 3 life."
887402.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手上的所有非地牌。你选择其中一张牌。该牌永久获得「当你施放此咒语时，每位对手各抓一张牌且获得3点生命。」

887412.oracleText: Seek two cards that don't share a card type with the discarded card.
887412.translation: 取出两张与所弃之牌不具共通牌张类别的牌。

887414.translation: 放逐另一个由你操控的生物。

887416.translation: 是否要牺牲另一个非地永久物？

887441.translation: 此衍生物不能进行阻挡

887442.oracleText: Exile a nonland, nontoken permanent you control.
887442.translation: 放逐一个由你操控，非地且非衍生物的永久物。

887456.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is that amount of life. (Whenever you gain life, you may pay {o(G/W)}. When you do, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the amount of life you gained.)
887456.translation: 指定一个目标生物获得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你获得的生命数量。（每当你获得生命时，你可以支付{o(G/W)}。当你如此作时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你获得的生命数量。）

887458.oracleText: Exile a nonland, nontoken permanent they control and a random nonland card from their library.
887458.translation: 放逐一个由其操控，非地且非衍生物的永久物，及其牌库中随机一张非地牌。

887459.oracleText: Seek a Survivor card with mana value less than or equal to the number of tapped creatures you control.
887459.translation: 取出一张法术力值等于或小于由你操控且已横置之生物数量的求生者牌。

887460.oracleText: Put any number of permanent cards with mana value {2, Number} or less onto the battlefield?
887460.translation: 是否要将任意数量之法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的永久物牌放进战场？

887482.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if CARDNAME is tapped, CARDNAME and the topmost creature card in your library without flying perpetually gain flying.
887482.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若CARDNAME已横置，则CARDNAME与你牌库中最顶上且不具飞行异能的生物牌各永久获得飞行异能。

887583.translation: 是否要放逐其中一个生物？

888338.oracleText: Target up to two creatures and/or artifacts you control.
888338.translation: 指定至多两个由你操控的生物和／或神器为目标。

888339.oracleText: As you cascade, you may put a land card from among the exiled cards onto the battlefield tapped. (Do this after the last card is exiled but before deciding whether to cast a nonland card.)
888339.translation: 于你倾曳时，你可以将所放逐之牌中的一张地牌横置放进战场。（如此作的时机，是在放逐最后一张牌之后，但在决定要施放哪张非地牌之前。）

888453.oracleText: Put {2, Number} +1/+1 counters on each creature you control?
888453.translation: 是否要在每个由你操控的生物上各放置{2, Number}个+1/+1指示物？

888454.oracleText: Leave one on top of your library? The rest will go to your graveyard.
888454.translation: 是否要将一张牌保留于你的牌库顶？其余的牌将置入你的坟墓场。

888455.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
888455.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

889276.translation: 将指示物分配到其他生物上。

889958.oracleText: Create a tapped and attacking token that is a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice the token at the beginning of the next end step.
889958.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物。派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

889959.oracleText: You control no creature with power 4 or greater.
889959.translation: 你未操控力量等于或大于4的生物。

889972.oracleText: You control no creature with power 3 or greater.
889972.translation: 你未操控力量等于或大于3的生物。

889973.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
889973.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

889975.oracleText: As this creature enters, choose a creature type.
889975.translation: 于此生物进场时，选择一种生物类别。

889976.oracleText: This creature is the chosen type in addition to its other types.
889976.translation: 此生物额外具有该类别。

889979.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+2 as long as you have 25 or more life.
889979.translation: 只要你的总生命为25或更多，此生物便得+2/+2。

890076.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
890076.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

890180.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may have it fight target creature you don't control.
890180.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以令它与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

890237.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
890237.translation: {oT}，牺牲此地：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

890835.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices an attacking creature of their choice.
890835.translation: 目标对手依其选择牺牲一个进行攻击的生物。

890836.oracleText:
Choose one or more — 
• Target player gains 4 life. 
• Untap up to two target creatures. 
• Target opponent sacrifices an attacking creature of their choice.
890836.translation:
选择一项或多项～ 
•目标牌手获得4点生命。 
•重置至多两个目标生物。
•目标对手依其选择牺牲一个进行攻击的生物。

890966.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice, then discards a card. You return a creature or planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand, then draw a card.
890966.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物或鹏洛客，然后各弃一张牌。你将一张生物或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上，然后抓一张牌。

891111.oracleText: Repeat the following process X times. Each opponent loses 3 life unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice or discards a card.
891111.translation: 将以下流程重复X次。对每位对手而言，除非该牌手牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则便失去3点生命。

891114.oracleText: At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent of their choice or discard a card.
891114.translation: 在所结附的牌手之维持开始时，除非该牌手牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则便失去3点生命。

891674.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, target opponent sacrifices a permanent of their choice.
891674.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，若你于本回合中曾以生物攻击，则目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的永久物。

891791.oracleText: When this Aura enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
891791.translation: 当此灵气进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

891955.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target Pirate you control.
891955.translation: 当此武具进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的海盗上。

891973.oracleText: As this artifact enters, look at an opponent's hand, then choose any card name.
891973.translation: 于此神器进场时，检视任一对手的手牌，然后任意选择一个牌名。

892113.oracleText: This creature has flying as long as it's attacking.
892113.translation: 只要此生物正进行攻击，它便具有飞行异能。

892259.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. If you have the city's blessing, instead each opponent sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice, rounded up.
892259.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。如果你有黄金城祝福，则改为每位对手各依其选择牺牲一半数量由其操控的生物，小数点后进位。

892291.oracleText: Whenever Etali attacks, exile the top card of each player's library, then you may cast any number of spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs.
892291.translation: 每当埃泰力攻击时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌，然后你可以从这些牌之中施放任意数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

892294.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 1 damage to any target.
892294.translation: {oT}，牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

892343.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, each opponent sacrifices a permanent of their choice.
892343.translation: 激怒～每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的永久物。

892450.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
892450.translation: {o1}，牺牲此生物：消灭目标神器或结界。

892577.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a Treasure token.
892577.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

892658.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 as long as any player controls a black permanent.
892658.translation: 只要任一牌手操控黑色永久物，此生物便得+1/+0。

892772.oracleText: If a Wizard you control entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
892772.translation: 如果在你操控下进场的法术师触发由你操控之永久物的触发式异能，则该异能额外触发一次。

892803.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each basic Island you control.
892803.translation: 你每操控一个基本海岛，此生物便得+1/+0。

892879.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice.
892879.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物或鹏洛客。

892904.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 as long as any player controls a white permanent.
892904.translation: 只要任一牌手操控白色永久物，此生物便得+1/+0。

893020.oracleText: As long as there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+0 and has haste.
893020.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有两张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，此生物便得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

893361.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by Walls.

893407.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 2 life.
893407.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你获得2点生命。

893429.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you gain 1 life.
893429.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多生物，则此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束，且你获得1点生命。

893463.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you gain 3 life.
893463.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你获得3点生命。

893636.oracleText: Each player loses half their life, then discards half the cards in their hand, then sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice. Round up each time.
893636.translation: 每位牌手各失去一半数量的生命，然后各弃一半数量的手牌，然后各依其选择牺牲一半数量由其操控的生物。各数量小数点后均进位。

893697.oracleText: {o1oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
893697.translation: {o1oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

893749.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 5 damage to target opponent unless that player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
893749.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，除非目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的生物，否则它对该牌手造成5点伤害。

893778.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
893778.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

893830.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 2 damage to target player or planeswalker.
893830.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

906237.oracleText: Each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice. If you sacrificed a permanent this way, you may return another permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.

906511.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.

907161.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
907161.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个地。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

907235.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

907246.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择至多一个目标生物咒语或鹏洛客咒语。该咒语的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

907563.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, target opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice, discards a card, and loses 3 life. You draw a card and gain 3 life.
907563.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的生物或鹏洛客，弃一张牌，且失去3点生命。你抓一张牌且获得3点生命。

907676.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a card, put that card into your graveyard, then shuffle.

908607.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, for each opponent, you create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token unless that player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
908607.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，对每位对手而言，除非该牌手牺牲一个依其选择的生物，否则你派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

908618.translation: 防魔法锥～每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的结界。

908836.oracleText: Siege Monster — When CARDNAME enters, roll a d20. 1-9 | Each player sacrifices a permanent of their choice. 10-19 | Each opponent sacrifices a permanent of their choice. 20 | Each opponent sacrifices two permanents of their choice.
908836.translation: 攻城怪物～当CARDNAME进场时，掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的永久物。10-19 | 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的永久物。20 | 每位对手各牺牲两个依其选择的永久物。

909403.oracleText: Sandfall Cell — Each player loses 2 life unless they sacrifice a creature, artifact, or land of their choice.
909403.translation: 落砂牢笼 — 对每位牌手而言，除非他牺牲一个依其选择的生物，神器或地，否则失去2点生命。

909471.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Return this land to its owner's hand: Search your library for a Gate card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. If you control ten or more Gates with different names, you win the game.
909471.translation: {o3}，{oT}，将此地移回其拥有者手上：从你的牌库中搜寻一张门牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。如果你操控十个或更多名称各不相同的门，你便赢得这盘游戏。

910102.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice."

910828.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, enchanted permanent's controller sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice, then that player loses 1 life.

916296.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice and gets a poison counter.
916296.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物或鹏洛客并得到一个中毒指示物。

916812.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature or planeswalker of their choice.

917457.translation: 每当欧瑞梨每回合首度攻击时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

917884.translation: 每当一个或数个生物对你造成战斗伤害时，每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个本回合中对你造成过战斗伤害的生物。魔戒引诱你。

918289.oracleText: Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. If you sacrificed a creature this way, you may return another permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
918289.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。如果你以此法牺牲一个生物，则你可以将另一张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

918538.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Abolisher of Bloodlines, target opponent sacrifices three creatures of their choice.
918538.translation: 当此生物转化为血脉破弃体时，目标对手牺牲三个依其选择的生物。

918726.oracleText: The owner of target attacking creature you don't control puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
918726.translation: 选择目标不由你操控且进行攻击的生物，其拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

918899.oracleText:
Choose one or more — 
• Each player discards two cards. 
• Each player loses 4 life. 
• Each player sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
918899.translation:
选择一项或多项～
•每位牌手各弃两张牌。
•每位牌手各失去4点生命。
•每位牌手各牺牲两个依其选择的生物。

919049.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This token can't block."
919049.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

919050.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
919050.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

919290.oracleText: Whenever Ruby attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Ruby gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
919290.translation: 每当小红玉于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时攻击，小红玉得+2/+2直到回合结束。

919358.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, each other player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
919358.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位其他牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

919386.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, this enchantment deals 1 damage to each opponent.
919386.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，此结界向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

919476.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to one other target permanent you control to its owner's hand.
919476.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多另一个目标由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

919711.oracleText: Target artifact or creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
919711.translation: 目标神器或生物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

919729.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each player sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
919729.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位牌手各牺牲两个依其选择的生物。

919875.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
919875.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

920317.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, each opponent may discard a card or sacrifice a permanent of their choice. CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent who didn't.
920317.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则每位对手各可以弃一张牌或牺牲一个依其选择的永久物。CARDNAME向每位未如此作的对手各造成3点伤害。

920397.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, each opponent sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice. Then you may put an exiled creature card used to craft CARDNAME onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
920397.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物。然后你可以将一张用以化炼CARDNAME所放逐之生物牌在你操控下放进战场，其为横置且正进行攻击。

920398.oracleText: Whenever The Grim Captain attacks, each opponent sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice. Then you may put an exiled creature card used to craft The Grim Captain onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
920398.translation: 每当司命攻击时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物。然后你可以将一张用以化炼司命所放逐之生物牌在你操控下放进战场，其为横置且正进行攻击。

920717.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. If evidence was collected, instead each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control.
920717.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。如果已搜证，则改为每位对手各牺牲一个由其操控之生物中力量最大的生物。

921056.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices an artifact of their choice.
921056.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的神器。

921057.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices an enchantment of their choice.
921057.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的结界。

921058.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature with flying of their choice.
921058.translation: 每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个具飞行异能的生物。

921059.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Each opponent sacrifices an artifact of their choice. 
• Each opponent sacrifices an enchantment of their choice. 
• Each opponent sacrifices a creature with flying of their choice.
921059.translation:
选择一项～ 
•每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的神器。 
•每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的结界。 
•每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个具飞行异能的生物。

921270.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, target opponent may sacrifice two nonland, nontoken permanents of their choice. If they don't, you draw two cards.
921270.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，目标对手可以依其选择牺牲两个非地且非衍生物的永久物。若其未如此作，则你抓两张牌。

921457.oracleText: The owner of target spell or nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
921457.translation: 目标咒语或非地永久物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

921656.oracleText: + {o2} — Target artifact or creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
921656.translation: + {o2}～目标神器或生物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

921657.oracleText:
Spree 
+ {o3} — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It can't be blocked this turn. 
+ {o2} — Target artifact or creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
921657.translation:
追欢 
+ {o3}～在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它本回合不能被阻挡。 
+ {o2}～目标神器或生物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

921841.oracleText: + {o1} — Target opponent sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice, rounded up.
921841.translation: + {o1}～目标对手依其选择牺牲一半数量由其操控的生物，小数点后进位。

921844.oracleText:
Spree 
+ {o1} — Target opponent sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice, rounded up. 
+ {o2} — Target opponent discards half the cards in their hand, rounded up. 
+ {o2} — Target opponent loses half their life, rounded up.
921844.translation:
追欢 
+ {o1}～目标对手依其选择牺牲一半数量由其操控的生物，小数点后进位。 
+ {o2}～目标对手弃一半数量的手牌，小数点后进位。 
+ {o2}～目标对手失去一半生命，小数点后进位。

922450.oracleText: You can't cast Jace Reawakened during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
922450.translation: 本盘游戏中，你在你的第一，第二或第三回合都不能施放重新觉醒的杰斯。

922521.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice, discards three cards, then loses 5 life. You return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand, draw three cards, then gain 5 life.
922521.translation: 目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的生物，弃三张牌，然后失去5点生命。你将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上，抓三张牌，然后获得5点生命。

923021.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
923021.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

923426.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, put a blight counter on it. Then for each blight counter on it, each opponent loses 4 life unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice or discards a card.
923426.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，在其上放置一个枯萎指示物。然后对其上的每个枯萎指示物而言，每位对手除非牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则便失去4点生命。

923446.oracleText: {oH} — Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
923446.translation: {oH}～每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

923449.oracleText:
Choose up to five {oH} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
{oH} — Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. 
{oHoH} — Draw a card for each creature that died under your control this turn. 
{oHoHoH} — Each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
923449.translation:
选择数量加总不超过五个{oH}的模式。你可以多次选择同一项。
{oH}～每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。
{oHoH}～本回合中每有一个生物在你的操控下死去，便抓一张牌。
{oHoHoH}～每位对手各失去X点生命，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

923464.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent of their choice or discard a card.
923464.translation: 当此生物进场时，除非目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则其失去3点生命。

923937.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained or lost life this turn, target opponent loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent of their choice or discard a card.
923937.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得或失去过生命，则除非目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则其失去3点生命。

924250.oracleText: Target nonland permanent's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library. Surveil 1.
924250.translation: 目标非地永久物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。刺探1。

924342.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each player sacrifices X creatures of their choice.
924342.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位牌手各牺牲X个依其选择的生物。

924343.oracleText: When Meathook Massacre II enters, each player sacrifices X creatures of their choice.
924343.translation: 当肉钩大屠杀二进场时，每位牌手各牺牲X个依其选择的生物。

924356.oracleText: Delirium — At the beginning of your end step, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, each opponent may sacrifice a nonland permanent of their choice or discard a card. Then CARDNAME deals damage equal to its power to each opponent who didn't sacrifice a permanent or discard a card this way.
924356.translation: 躁狂～在你的结束步骤开始时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则每位对手各可以牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌。然后CARDNAME向每位未以此法牺牲永久物或弃牌的对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

924372.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target player sacrifices a creature of their choice other than enchanted creature.
924372.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标牌手依其选择牺牲一个所结附之生物以外的生物。

924393.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent sacrifices a nontoken enchantment of their choice, then sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
924393.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的结界，然后各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

924423.oracleText: When this creature dies, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
924423.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出两个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

924427.oracleText: {o4oBoB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
924427.translation: {o4oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

924887.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target player's graveyard.
924887.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

924933.oracleText: Ferocious — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, you may pay {oR}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
924933.translation: 威猛～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

924936.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {oR}. If you do, target creature can't block this turn.
924936.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

924955.oracleText: Whenever Dwynen attacks, you gain 1 life for each attacking Elf you control.
924955.translation: 每当德维恩攻击时，你每操控一个进行攻击的妖精，便获得1点生命。

924963.oracleText: {o3oG}: This creature becomes a Werewolf. Put two +1/+1 counters on it and you draw a card. Activate only once.
924963.translation: {o3oG}：此生物成为狼人。在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物且你抓一张牌。只能起动一次。

924968.oracleText: Whenever Lathril deals combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens.
924968.translation: 每当拉席莉对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出等量的1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

924997.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target enchantment.
924997.translation: 牺牲此生物：消灭目标结界。

924999.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
924999.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

925003.oracleText: {o2oUoU}: Return Arcanis to its owner's hand.
925003.translation: {o2oUoU}：将全能的阿卡尼思移回其拥有者手上。

925010.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature.
925010.translation: 防止此生物将受到与造成的所有战斗伤害。

925013.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return target tapped creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
925013.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将目标由对手操控且已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上。

925025.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, any opponent may sacrifice a creature of their choice. If a player does, tap this creature and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
925025.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，任意对手可以牺牲一个依其选择的生物。若有牌手如此作，则横置此生物且在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

925031.oracleText: When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
925031.translation: 当此生物死去时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

925035.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Vampire you control dies, you may pay {oB}. If you do, target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
925035.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的吸血鬼死去时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，则目标牌手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

925045.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses 1 life.
925045.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

925048.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. You gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
925048.translation: 目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的生物。你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。

925057.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card, exile it, then shuffle.
925057.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，将它放逐，然后洗牌。

925058.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may put the exiled card into its owner's hand.
925058.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以将所放逐的牌置于其拥有者手上。

925060.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a white or blue instant or sorcery spell, this creature deals 2 damage to that player.
925060.translation: 每当任一对手施放白色或蓝色的瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物对该牌手造成2点伤害。

925063.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by Humans.
925063.translation: 此生物不能被人类阻挡。

925066.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
925066.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，你可以在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

925070.oracleText: This creature enters with four +1/+1 counters on it.
925070.translation: 此生物进场时上面有四个+1/+1指示物。

925071.oracleText: {o2oGoG}: Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is its power.
925071.translation: {o2oGoG}：在此生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为其力量。

925075.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a blue or black spell, you may put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
925075.translation: 每当一位对手施放蓝色或黑色咒语时，你可以在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

925077.oracleText: Whenever enchanted creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then if it has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, sacrifice this Aura.
925077.translation: 每当所结附的生物攻击时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后若其上有三个或更多+1/+1指示物，则牺牲此灵气。

925078.oracleText: When you sacrifice this Aura, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
925078.translation: 当你牺牲此灵气时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

925106.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, add {oRoRoRoGoGoG}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
925106.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，加{oRoRoRoGoGoG}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

925109.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may destroy target artifact or enchantment that player controls.
925109.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以消灭目标由该牌手操控的神器或结界。

925113.oracleText: If a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard this card, put it onto the battlefield instead of putting it into your graveyard.
925113.translation: 如果由对手操控的咒语或异能使得你弃掉此牌，则改为将它放进战场，而非置入你的坟墓场。

925118.oracleText: {oT}, Exile this artifact: Shuffle your graveyard into your library.
925118.translation: {oT}，放逐此神器：将你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

925123.oracleText: {oX}: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X whose controller was dealt combat damage by this creature this turn. Activate only once each turn.
925123.translation: {oX}：对本回合中受过此生物之战斗伤害的牌手而言，消灭所有由其操控且法术力值为X的非地永久物。每回合只能起动一次。

925129.oracleText: Put up to two creature cards into your hand?
925129.translation: 是否要将至多两张生物从置于你手上？

925130.oracleText: Put up to one creature card into your hand.
925130.translation: 将至多一张生物牌置于你手上。

925139.oracleText: If a creature you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.
925139.translation: 如果某个由你操控的生物将对任一永久物或牌手造成伤害，则改为它造成两倍的伤害。

925147.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
925147.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

925241.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
925241.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，由你操控的生物得+1/+0并获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

925560.oracleText: Reveal the top six cards of your library. You may put up to one land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped and up to one Elf card from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
925560.translation: 展示你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中的一张地牌横置放进战场，并将其中的一张妖精牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

925955.oracleText: Put up to one land card onto the battlefield?
925955.translation: 是否要将至多一张地牌放进战场？

926094.oracleText: Target player sacrifices a creature of their choice, then gains life equal to that creature's toughness.
926094.translation: 目标牌手牺牲一个依其选择的生物，然后获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。

926096.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
926096.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

926522.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, Mogis deals 2 damage to that player unless they sacrifice a creature of their choice.
926522.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，除非该牌手牺牲一个依其选择的生物，否则墨癸斯对他造成2点伤害。

926586.oracleText: When Oath of Liliana enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
926586.translation: 当莉莲娜的誓约进场时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

926616.oracleText: "Daxos, I'm in need of a champion. Who else would I turn to but you?"
926616.translation: 「在这战争中，赫利欧德时而赐予凡人恩惠，时而拒伸援手。我们只不过是他的棋子吗？」～疑神论者波吕谢涅

926617.oracleText: The Izzet are searching for something. Discern what or die trying."
926617.translation: 「伊捷联盟正在搜寻某样东西。死都要给我搞清楚。」

926621.oracleText: Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. If it's your turn, end the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card. Discard down to your maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects end.)
926621.translation: 每位牌手将其手牌与坟墓场洗入其牌库，然后各抓七张牌。如果是在你的回合中，则结束本回合。（放逐堆叠上的所有咒语和异能，包括此牌。你将手牌弃掉，直到满足手牌上限为止。生物上的伤害消失，并且注记着「本回合」与「直到回合结束」的效应均结束。）

926622.oracleText: When the worst happens, rely on the best.
926622.translation: 最糟情况发生时，只能仰仗最佳救援。

926629.oracleText: This car is what dreams are made of.

926630.oracleText: Don't buy the rest. Possess the best!
926630.translation: 别买剩下的。只要最好的！

926631.oracleText: Take it for a spin. That's not a request.

926632.oracleText: Style that never runs on fumes.

926633.oracleText: Take flight on the wings of true innovation.
926633.translation: 装上真正革新的翅膀起飞。

926634.oracleText: Go where only death dares follow.
926634.translation: 所去之处，唯有亡者无畏相随。

926635.oracleText: Leave a nightmare in your wake.
926635.translation: 清醒时也能看到身后梦魇轨迹。

926636.oracleText: Seize the day . . . and anything else that happens to catch your eye.
926636.translation: 把握今朝…顺便也把所有碍眼的东西握下。

926637.oracleText: A ride worth dying for. Or in.
926637.translation: 这车开着搏命。但搏了命也要开一次。

926638.oracleText: Cut through the air like a corsair!

926641.oracleText: Don't let the end of days stand in your way.

926642.oracleText: Take a bite out of life.

926643.oracleText: The road is where you take it.
926643.translation: 你走过的地方，也就成了路。

926644.oracleText: Get things rolling . . . and never stop.

926645.oracleText: Vintage is back, and it's hunting you.
926645.translation: 老东西回来了，而且还在找你。

926646.oracleText: A car you'd sell your soul for.
926646.translation: 一辆你甘愿出卖灵魂的好车。

926647.translation: 包含扑翼机，但需满足一定条件。

926649.oracleText: Some say they want to see the world. We say why stop at just one?
926649.translation: 有人说他想看看世界。我们说世界只看一个怎么够？

926651.oracleText: "I served the Scarab in an age long past, in another form, under another name. No matter their visage, I serve."
926651.translation: 「在遥远的过去，我也曾侍奉过甲虫神，尽管它彼时还不是这副模样，也不叫这个名字。但无论神明尊容为何，我都会虔诚侍奉。」

926652.oracleText: Whenever you discard a creature card, you may pay {o2oU}. If you do, create a tapped token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.
926652.translation: 每当你弃一张生物牌时，你可以支付{o2oU}。若你如此作，则派出一个已横置的衍生物，此衍生物为所弃之牌的复制品，但它是4/4黑色灵俑。

926654.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifact creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you get {oEoE}.
926654.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个神器生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你得到{oEoE}。

926657.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Artificer or artifact spell, you get {oE}.
926657.translation: 每当你施放神器师或神器咒语时，你得到{oE}。

926658.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oEoEoE}. When you do, create a token that's a copy of target permanent you control, except it's a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
926658.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。当你如此作时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的永久物之复制品，但它是5/5神器生物，仍具有原本类别，且具有敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

926660.oracleText: Each time he glimpsed oblivion, he learned another lesson.
926660.translation: 他每次瞥见毁灭未来之时，都会学到新的教训。

926661.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, Zombies you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
926661.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，由你操控的灵俑得+1/+1直到回合结束。

926663.oracleText: Create a token that is a copy of target permanent you control, except it is a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
926663.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的永久物之复制品，但它是5/5神器生物，仍具有原本类别，且具有敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

926668.oracleText: When you cast this spell, exile up to one target permanent that's one or more colors.
926668.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，放逐至多一个目标有色永久物。

926669.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell, exile up to one target permanent that's one or more colors.
926669.translation: 每当你施放无色咒语时，放逐至多一个目标有色永久物。

926670.oracleText: You gain 3 life and draw a card.
926670.translation: 你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

926672.oracleText: Search your library for any number of colorless nonland cards, exile them, then shuffle. Until end of turn, you may cast those cards without paying their mana costs.
926672.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量的无色非地牌，放逐它们，然后洗牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放这些牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

926674.oracleText: "Kin and clan call to me—and I will always answer."
926674.translation: 「我听到亲族在呼唤我～而我都会回应。」

926675.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, Anafenza endures 2.
926675.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，阿娜芬札续战2。

926677.oracleText:
"The best way to protect the citizens is to defend Arashin, not hunt dragonstorms across Tarkir."
—Sadesh of House Mevak
926677.translation:
「保护人民最好的方式，应该是守卫阿拉辛，而不是追着龙袭风暴满鞑契跑。」
～梅瓦克眷族的萨迪许

926678.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard.
926678.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。

926680.oracleText: Morale stands so long as he does.

926682.translation: 挑战者原本的壮志豪言，转眼之间就变得鸦雀无声。

926683.oracleText: Activated abilities of artifacts, creatures, and planeswalkers can't be activated.
926683.translation: 神器、生物和鹏洛客之起动式异能都不能起动。

926685.oracleText:
"We follow the dragonstorms, and we take down any threats that emerge from them!"
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
926685.translation:
「龙袭风暴去到哪，我们就跟到哪；威胁出来一个，我们就收拾一个！」
～玛尔都可汗珠高

926686.oracleText: Coordinated Maneuver deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker.
926686.translation: 协同计略对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

926687.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target enchantment.
926687.translation:
选择一项～
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。
•消灭目标结界。

926688.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Coordinated Maneuver deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Destroy target enchantment.
926688.translation:
选择一项～
•协同计略对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。
•消灭目标结界。

926690.oracleText:
A burden shared is a burden lightened.
—Mardu proverb
926690.translation:
重物同担，负荷共减。
～玛尔都谚语

926693.oracleText: The most elite of the Abzan are selected to join the Yathan: a prestigious group acting outside khan supervision for the good of the clan.
926693.translation: 阿布赞内最精锐的战士会被选入雅善会。雅善会为部族利益而战，其地位显赫，甚至不受可汗指挥。

926694.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, it endures 1.
926694.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则它续战1。

926696.oracleText: The Mardu's standing army need not always stand on the ground.
926696.translation: 玛尔都的常驻军队并非都常常驻扎在地上。

926699.oracleText: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
926699.translation: 由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

926701.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain flying until your next turn.
926701.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。这些生物获得飞行异能直到你的下一个回合。

926702.oracleText: Destroy target creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater.
926702.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或大于3的生物。

926704.oracleText: All through the night, the ancestor whispered of ancient battles fought from this very rampart atop Arashin City.
926704.translation: 先祖一直在低语往事，讲述阿拉辛城顶壁垒上曾经发生的大小战斗，整夜都未曾停歇。

926705.oracleText: When this creature enters, it endures 1.
926705.translation: 当此生物进场时，它续战1。

926707.oracleText:
"Your hatred dampens the land with my kin's blood. My love will flood it with yours."
—Hazena, spirit of House Emesh
926707.translation:
「你心有仇恨，故而洒我族人鲜血沾染大地。我满怀热爱，必将用你鲜血冲洗干净。」
～埃梅许眷族先魂哈泽娜

926708.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies while this card is in your graveyard, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
926708.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物于此牌在你坟墓场中时死去，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

926710.oracleText: Jeskai monks spreading the Way in Abzan territories develop swift reflexes or find their travels abruptly cut short.
926710.translation: 在阿布赞境内传扬灵道的洁斯凯修行僧大都反应了得～不然他们的旅程很快就会到达终点。

926711.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains flying and indestructible until end of turn.
926711.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得飞行与不灭异能直到回合结束。

926713.oracleText: "I grant you the strength of Qatros's walls and the tenacity of Arashin's oasis."
926713.translation: 「我赋你力量，令你坚如夸托斯城墙，韧如阿拉辛绿洲。」

926714.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control.
926714.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

926716.oracleText: Eskeg and his companion stood watch, the sights of the steppe a constant inspiration.
926716.translation: 埃西格和伙伴不禁停下脚步：这草原上的奇妙景象每时每刻都能激起灵跃思绪。

926717.oracleText: {o1}: Add {oR}, {oW}, or {oB}. Activate only once each turn.

926719.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may behold a Dragon.
926719.translation: 你可以请援龙，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

926720.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If a Dragon was beheld, you gain 2 life.
926720.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成5点伤害。如果已请援龙，则你获得2点生命。

926721.oracleText: Osseous Exhale deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If a Dragon was beheld, you gain 2 life.
926721.translation: 白骨吐息对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成5点伤害。如果已请援龙，则你获得2点生命。

926723.oracleText:
"Excellent form, Jun! Just keep your weight on that back foot, and you'll master this in no time."
—Narset
926723.translation:
「小俊，做得很好！记得把重心放在后脚上，这样很快就能练成了。」
～娜尔施

926724.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Scry 1.
926724.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。占卜1。

926727.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you've cast another spell this turn.
926727.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过其他咒语，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

926728.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess.
926728.translation: 派出两个1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

926729.oracleText: Up to two target creatures you control each get +2/+2 until end of turn.
926729.translation: 至多两个目标由你操控的生物各得+2/+2直到回合结束。

926730.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Create two 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess. 
• Up to two target creatures you control each get +2/+2 until end of turn. 
• Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.
926730.translation:
选择一项～
•派出两个1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。
•至多两个目标由你操控的生物各得+2/+2直到回合结束。
•消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

926732.oracleText:
"Even if you battle unseen, even if there is no one to witness your sacrifice—strike! Strike true. Strike from the heart. Let that be your legacy."
—Shiko
926732.translation:
「就算战斗无人知晓，哪怕牺牲没人见证～也要勇敢出手！打出全力。打出斗志。让这段经历成为你的传说。」
～席科

926735.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Soldier creature token.
926735.translation: 派出一个2/2白色士兵衍生生物。

926738.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if you've cast another spell this turn, copy this spell.
926738.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若你本回合中施放过其他咒语，则复制此咒语。

926739.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if you've cast another spell this turn, copy this spell. (The copy becomes a token.)
926739.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若你本回合中施放过其他咒语，则复制此咒语。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

926741.oracleText:
"She huffs like she's Queen Hellkite of the Scour, but we've been together for many journeys and she's never let me down."
—Mandakh, Mardu scout
926741.translation:
「她生气的时候就像扫平残虐龙似的，一点都不好惹；但我们已经一同走过无数旅程，她从未令我失望。」
～玛尔都斥候曼达卡

926743.oracleText:
"Khan Alesha ensured our survival. Now we will forge our future."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
926743.translation:
「阿列莎可汗保佑我们活到现在。如今我们要自己铸造未来。」
～玛尔都可汗珠高

926744.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return up to two target creature cards with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures.
926744.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将至多两张目标力量等于或小于2的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。在这些生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

926746.oracleText: Too late, the elders realized the young prodigies shared a love of adventure and mischief.
926746.translation: 长老这才知道，年轻人的冒险精神和捣蛋脾气早已感染了它们，但已经晚了。

926747.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.
926747.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

926748.oracleText: Attacking tokens you control have flying.
926748.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的衍生物具有飞行异能。

926750.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target artifact or creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
926750.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的神器或生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

926753.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, draw a card if you control three or more attacking creatures.
926753.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，如果你操控三个或更多进行攻击的生物，则抓一张牌。

926755.oracleText: Elspeth saw their capture as an inconvenience, costing them precious time. Narset saw it as an opportunity to recruit allies to their cause.
926755.translation: 艾紫培对有人拦下他们颇为不满，觉得这纯粹是在浪费时间。娜尔施则觉得这是招募助力帮手的好机会。

926757.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to one other target nonland permanent you control to its owner's hand. If it was a token, draw a card.
926757.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多另一个目标由你操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。若其是衍生物，则抓一张牌。

926759.oracleText:
"So, these dragons intend to also manifest through a sandstorm? I take some offense to that."
—Felothar, khan of the Abzan
926759.translation:
「所以说，龙群也想要穿过沙尘暴突然现身？这冒犯到我了。」
～阿布赞可汗芾洛塔

926760.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create two 2/2 white Soldier creature tokens.
926760.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出两个2/2白色士兵衍生生物。

926761.oracleText: When a Dragon you control enters, return this enchantment to its owner's hand.
926761.translation: 当一个由你操控的龙进场时，将此结界移回其拥有者手上。

926763.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may search your library for a card named Tempest Hawk, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
926763.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张名称为暴风翔鹰的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

926764.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Tempest Hawk.
926764.translation: 名称为暴风翔鹰的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

926766.oracleText: The Abzan forces rallied to the call, driving back Sarkhan's feral dragon horde.
926766.translation: 阿布赞大军响应召唤，击退了来袭的萨坎残暴龙群。

926768.oracleText:
"Come crackling spear, come beating wing!
Come cavalier, come taut bowstring!"
926768.translation:
「长枪尖锐熠光彩，狂风翅翼奈我何！
骠骑整装旌旗摆，强弓劲弦响天彻！」

926772.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
926772.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

926773.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, tap target creature an opponent controls.
926773.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

926775.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile two cards from your graveyard. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
926775.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以从你坟墓场放逐两张牌。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

926777.oracleText:
"I trust Narset. I do not trust those she keeps counsel with."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper
926777.translation:
「我相信娜尔施。我只是不相信她身边那些人。」
～龙牙卫柯提斯

926778.oracleText: Renew — {o3oU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
926778.translation: 复新～{o3oU}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

926781.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, put three stun counters on it and draw three cards.
926781.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，在其上放置三个晕眩指示物并抓三张牌。

926782.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Turtle spell, untap this creature.
926782.translation: 每当你施放龟咒语时，重置此生物。

926784.oracleText: Temur scouts reported the arrival of unwanted visitors, and the whisperers ensured a chilling welcome.
926784.translation: 铁木尔斥候回报有不速之客来访，于是低语者准备好了冰冷的欢迎仪式。

926785.oracleText: Draw three cards. Creatures your opponents control get -3/-0 until end of turn.
926785.translation: 抓三张牌。由对手操控的生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。

926787.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
926787.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

926788.oracleText: Renew — {o2oU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
926788.translation: 复新～{o2oU}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

926791.oracleText: Tap up to one target creature. Draw a card.
926791.translation: 横置至多一个目标生物。抓一张牌。

926793.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}. If a Dragon was beheld, counter that spell unless its controller pays {o4} instead.
926793.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。如果已请援龙，则改为除非该咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。

926795.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an instant, sorcery, or Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
926795.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张瞬间，法术或龙牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

926796.oracleText: Untapped Dragons you control have hexproof.
926796.translation: 由你操控且未横置的龙具有辟邪异能。

926798.oracleText: "This can't be right. I should cross-reference with the archives immediately."
926798.translation: 「这太奇怪了。我要立刻去找古籍来比对。」

926799.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Search your library for a card named Dragonstorm Globe or Boulderborn Dragon, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
926799.translation: {o2}，{oT}：从你牌库中搜寻一张名称为龙袭暴示球或石生巨龙的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

926801.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token. Activate only during your turn and only if a card left your graveyard this turn.
926801.translation: {oT}：派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。只能于你的回合且本回合中有牌离开过你坟墓场时起动。

926803.oracleText: Asham discovered it was impossible to learn if he thought he already knew everything.
926803.translation: 阿山发现，如果自己已经无所不知，就没办法再做到渴求新知。

926805.oracleText:
"I know leaving your old life was no easy choice. Welcome, Novice Sardul."
—Elsha
926805.translation:
「完全抛却过往确实并非易事。新僧萨尔杜，欢迎加入我们。」
～艾尔莎

926806.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets -5/-0 and loses all abilities.
926806.translation: 所结附的生物得-5/-0且失去所有异能。

926808.oracleText: The sequence of chimes rang out a specific alarm: dragonstorm, half a day, southwest.
926808.translation: 钟声根据轻重缓急不同，能够确切预报来袭情况。这一段钟声的警报就是：龙袭风暴，历时半日，方向西南。

926810.oracleText:
"There is no better way to measure a person's true character than to let them think they're above you."
—Master Xian
926810.translation:
「要想摸清对方的本性，最好的方法莫过于让对方觉得他自己比较厉害。」
～高僧贤师

926811.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
926811.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

926813.oracleText:
"Even dragons avoid Glintglaze Lake in this season. Which of you youngsters can tell me why?"
—Teacher Eliam
926813.translation:
「到了这个季节，就连巨龙都会避开炫镜湖。你们这些年轻人，有谁知道为什么呀？」
～埃连姆老师

926815.oracleText:
"Fish are like any other crop or flock. They must be carefully tended and never overharvested."
—Nasath, Kishla fisher
926815.translation:
「鱼群其实跟其他作物或畜产没什么区别，都需精心照护、适量捕捞，才能保证收成。」
～济奇拉渔人娜萨丝

926816.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. When you do, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
926816.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。当你如此作时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

926818.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to two other target nonland permanents to their owners' hands.
926818.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多两个其他目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

926822.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield.
926822.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进场。

926823.oracleText: Renew — {o2oU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target nonlegendary creature you control. Each other creature you control becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
926823.translation: 复新～{o2oU}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标由你操控的非传奇生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。每个由你操控的其他生物均成为该生物的复制品直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

926826.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "{o5}: Untap this creature."
926826.translation: 所结附的生物具有「{o5}：重置此生物。」

926828.oracleText: Since the reestablishment of Highspire Monastery, its favored fighting styles have also resurged in popularity.
926828.translation: 峰顶寺院重建之后，其最推崇的格斗技法也重新流行起来。

926829.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library. 
• Counter target noncreature spell.
926829.translation:
选择一项～
•目标非地永久物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。
•反击目标非生物咒语。

926831.oracleText:
"Beware dragonstorms that strike from the sea. Their size always disguises their force."
—Narset
926831.translation:
「当心从海上过来的龙袭风暴。其强度总比看起来的要大得多。」
～娜尔施

926832.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
926832.translation: 当此结界进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

926835.oracleText: "Oh, I can absolutely verify its authenticity," chuckled Sarnai. "I was there when it was made."
926835.translation: 「噢，我当然看得出这东西是不是真的。」萨尔奈咯咯笑道。「造出来的时候我就在现场。」

926836.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
926836.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

926838.oracleText: Elementals conjured by Temur mages are forever watchful and swift.
926838.translation: 铁木尔法师召唤出来的元素由始至终都能保持高度警觉，动作迅速。

926839.oracleText: During your turn, this creature has base power and toughness 5/2.
926839.translation: 于你的回合中，此生物的基础力量与防御力为5/2。

926840.oracleText: {o5oUoU}: This creature can't be blocked this turn.

926842.oracleText: Temur mages are experts at channeling elemental energy, shaping it into familiar forms from the world around them.
926842.translation: 铁木尔法师精于通导元素能量，将其转化为身边常见形态。

926843.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature you control with power 4 or greater.
926843.translation: 你每操控一个力量等于或大于4的生物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

926845.oracleText: "The Meditation Realm is a willful puzzle. Seek, and it will impede. Wait, and it will permit passage."
926845.translation: 「冥想境像是个在玩弄你的谜团：主动探寻，入口会远在天边；耐心等待，道路就近在眼前。」

926846.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, mill three cards. Then if your library has no cards in it, exile this enchantment and put five cards from your graveyard on top of your library in any order.
926846.translation: 在你的维持开始时，磨三张牌。然后如果你的牌库没有牌，则放逐此结界并将五张牌从你坟墓场以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

926848.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy it, then exile the spell you cast with four time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
926848.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，将它复制，然后放逐所施放之咒语，且其上有四个计时指示物。如果它原本不具有延缓，则它获得延缓异能。

926850.oracleText: Whisperers are conduits to the spirits of the land. They provide healing, guidance, and support to the Temur people.
926850.translation: 低语者能通联大地之灵，为铁木尔人民提供疗愈、指导与支持。

926851.oracleText: {o1}: Add {oG}, {oU}, or {oR}. Activate only once each turn.

926853.oracleText: In the Endless Song, Temur's whisperers hear spirits murmur of the past, present, and future.
926853.translation: 在连绵颂曲中，铁木尔低语者能够听闻灵魂来自过去、现在和未来的幽声。

926856.oracleText: "You say you come in peace. That you come here at all is an act of war."
926856.translation: 「你说你为和平而来。但你来这就意味着战争。」

926858.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, up to one target player mills cards equal to this creature's power.
926858.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，至多一位目标牌手磨若干牌，其数量等同于此生物的力量。

926860.oracleText: "Our greatest teachers are those which the natural world has so thoroughly refined."
926860.translation: 「业经大自然精心塑造的一切事物，就是我们最好的老师。」

926861.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying.
926861.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

926863.oracleText:
"Yes, yes, very good. However, I believe you were supposed to be working on your sword techniques?"
—Taigam
926863.translation:
「不错，非常好。不过你原本是不是该把心思花在提升剑法上面？」
～泰伽姆

926864.oracleText: {o2oU}: Return this Aura to its owner's hand.
926864.translation: {o2oU}：将此灵气移回其拥有者手上。

926869.oracleText: The Kin-Trees rediscovered after Dromoka's fall are tended by carefully chosen wardens.
926869.translation: 在卓茉卡覆亡后重见天日的族树，如今都由精心挑选的护卫来照顾。

926870.oracleText: {o1}: Add {oW}, {oB}, or {oG}. Activate only once each turn.

926871.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
926871.translation: {o2oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

926873.oracleText:
"Eat you? Of course she won't. Pherah's got better taste than that."
—Visk, Qarsi Palace caretaker
926873.translation:
「吃掉你？她当然不会了。费拉的品味才没那么差。」
～卡尔西宫殿照护人维斯克

926874.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token.
926874.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。

926875.oracleText: Renew — {oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
926875.translation: 复新～{oB}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

926877.oracleText:
"When an alliance outlasts its usefulness it's best to end it quickly."
—Heng, Sultai ambassador
926877.translation:
「当一段联盟关系好处都被用尽之后，快速结束才是最佳做法。」
～苏勒台使节阿衡

926878.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.
926878.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌，并放逐该牌。在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

926880.oracleText:
"Do not test the mandrill. He knows a thief when he sees one."
—Notice posted at Lu Fen's apothecary
926880.translation:
「切勿以身试猴。心中有偷念的人他一眼就能看出来。」
～卢纷药房外的告示

926881.oracleText: Renew — {o1oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a lifelink counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
926881.translation: 复新～{o1oB}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置一个系命指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

926883.oracleText: "If I die today, I will ensure my death is worthy of legend."
926883.translation: 「如果我今天一去无回，我一定会死得名留青史。」

926884.oracleText: Target creature you control gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.
926884.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得死触与不灭异能直到回合结束。

926886.oracleText: Mobilize X, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
926886.translation: 动员X，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

926888.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, behold a Dragon or pay {o1}.
926888.translation: 请援龙或支付{o1}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

926890.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. Surveil 2.
926890.translation: 当此结界进场时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。刺探2。

926892.oracleText:
"Who are you to defy me? In my time, the sibsig knew their place."
—Sidisi, to Nishang
926892.translation:
「你竟敢违抗我？在我的时代，尸虏都很听话。」
～谢迪西怒斥倪尚

926894.oracleText: With the rising waters, bloodflies were found far from their usual swamps.
926894.translation: 水位上涨后，血蝇的活动范围也随之增大，经常能在远离沼泽之处遇到它们。

926895.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if you control a creature with a counter on it, each opponent loses 1 life.
926895.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你操控一个其上有指示物的生物，则每位对手各失去1点生命。

926897.oracleText:
"Sing for us when we depart for battle, and sing for us if we fail to return."
—Mardu parting
926897.translation:
「开赴沙场有歌壮行，战死不归得曲送终。」
～玛尔都离别祝语

926898.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn. When it dies under your control this turn, draw two cards.
926898.translation: 目标生物得+1/-1直到回合结束。本回合中，当它在你的操控下死去时，抓两张牌。

926900.oracleText:
"To escape Teval's justice, one must have a better plan than ‘run away.'"
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper
926900.translation:
「想要躲过特瓦尔的惩罚，光想着『跑快点』可不够。」
～龙牙卫柯提斯

926901.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} more to cast if it targets a Dragon.
926901.translation: 如果此咒语以龙为目标，则它增加{o2}来施放。

926904.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. Draw a card.
926904.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。抓一张牌。

926906.oracleText: "It's a pity to hoard life essence in a form so weak. Give it to me."
926906.translation: 「以这般孱弱的身躯来囤积生命菁华太浪费了。给我吧。」

926907.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn and target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
926907.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束，且目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

926909.oracleText: She's eager to start a new winning streak.
926909.translation: 她迫不及待想要再创连胜纪录。

926910.oracleText: As long as there are three or more different kinds of counters among creatures you control, this creature gets +2/+4.
926910.translation: 只要由你操控的生物上总共有三种或更多不同种类的指示物，此生物便得+2/+4。

926911.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard. If you do, it enters with a finality counter on it.
926911.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场施放此牌。如果你如此作，则它进场时上面有一个终命指示物。

926913.oracleText: "Thank the ancestors. A few more weeks, and we would have discovered nothing but dead wood and lost kin."
926913.translation: 「感谢先祖。再有数周时间，我们就能够找到枯死树株，寻回失落族亲。」

926915.oracleText: "Welcome," the spirits of House Emesh whispered to Cemal. "Welcome, newest sprout of our Kin-Tree."
926915.translation: 「欢迎你，」埃梅许眷族先魂向瑟玛低语道。「欢迎你成为族树的新生枝桠。」

926916.oracleText: {oXoB}, {oT}, Pay X life: This creature endures X. Activate only as a sorcery.
926916.translation: {oXoB}，{oT}，支付X点生命：此生物续战X。只能于法术时机起动。

926920.oracleText:
"Evil wears many faces. Keep your windows closed at night, or it might wear yours."
—Sultai warning
926920.translation:
「恶灵有许多副面孔。夜里务必紧闭门窗，否则其中有副就是你的。」
～苏勒台警语

926921.oracleText: Renew — {o2oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a flying counter, a deathtouch counter, and a lifelink counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
926921.translation: 复新～{o2oB}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置一个飞行指示物、一个死触指示物和一个系命指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

926923.oracleText: Renew — {oXoBoB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a decayed counter on each of X target creatures. Activate only as a sorcery.
926923.translation: 复新～{oXoBoB}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在X个目标生物上各放置一个败朽指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

926925.oracleText: Dariya's first mistake was thinking they could short the Mardu trader on a deal. Their last was not considering the trader would bring backup.
926925.translation: 达理亚的第一个失误，是觉得自己能逼迫玛尔都商人降价成交。最后一个失误，是没想到对方会搬救兵。

926926.oracleText: Destroy target creature. Create two 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
926926.translation: 消灭目标生物。派出两个1/1红色战士衍生生物。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

926928.oracleText: "There's a new sinkhole, seven leagues east. I'll take Scratchy."
926928.translation: 「发现了一个新地坑，在东边七里开外。我跟小刺一起去。」

926929.oracleText: When this creature enters, it endures 2.
926929.translation: 当此生物进场时，它续战2。

926932.oracleText: Each non-Dragon creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
926932.translation: 每个非龙生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束。

926934.oracleText: "Once flesh, now gold and jade. Once dead, now alive again. Once respected, now honored beyond imagination."
926934.translation: 「往昔鲜活生命去，如今镶金戴玉回。往昔永眠深墓往，如今生龙活虎来。往昔尊荣地位走，如今显赫身份归。」

926935.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, if you cast it, destroy that creature, then create a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token.
926935.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，若它经你施放，则消灭该生物，然后派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。

926938.oracleText: As the rebels breached Qarsi Palace, she realized her time in power was at its end.
926938.translation: 眼见反抗军冲进卡尔西宫殿，她意识到自己大权在握的时间已走到终点。

926939.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a creature you control with mana value X other than Sidisi: Return target creature card with mana value X plus 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
926939.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个谢迪西以外由你操控且法术力值为X的生物：将目标法术力值为X加1的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

926941.oracleText: Vast sinkholes in the Shifting Wastes revealed long-buried structures—and long-buried dangers.
926941.translation: 变幻荒漠中众多地坑让许多长埋已久的建筑重见天日～随之而来还有许多长埋已久的危险。

926942.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you lose 1 life and this creature endures 1.
926942.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你失去1点生命且此生物续战1。

926944.oracleText: As Sultai blades threatened Qatros city walls, Mehtma of House Fenzala turned her weapons on her political rivals.
926944.translation: 眼见苏勒台部队已然威胁到夸托斯城墙安全，芬札拉眷族的梅缇玛转而将自己的武器对准了政敌。

926945.oracleText: Target opponent exiles a creature they control and their graveyard.
926945.translation: 目标对手放逐一个由其操控的生物和其坟墓场。

926947.oracleText:
"Unless you actually see my spirit join the Kin-Tree, never assume me so unprofessional as to die on the job."
—Ezcul of House Zanhar
926947.translation:
「除非你亲眼见到我的灵魂荣登族树，否则出任务时遇难这么不专业的事情肯定轮不到我。」
～赞哈尔眷族的依奇库

926948.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
926948.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

926950.oracleText: Abzan spirits bereft of a Kin-Tree are condemned to a restless existence. Absent the purpose of family connection, many grow angry and violent.
926950.translation: 被驱离族树的阿布赞灵魂会沦为孤魂野鬼，不得安宁。由于这样家族连系也会随之破裂，许多遭此惩罚的灵魂因此变得愈发愤怒，更加暴力。

926951.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
926951.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

926953.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
926953.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

926955.oracleText: Mardu war shrieks ensure their enemies are defeated before the battle even starts.
926955.translation: 玛尔都战嚎凶狠异常，能让对方在开战之前就已落荒而逃。

926956.oracleText: Creatures target opponent controls get -1/-1 until end of turn.
926956.translation: 由目标对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

926957.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Creatures target opponent controls get -1/-1 until end of turn. 
• Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
926957.translation:
选择一项～
•由目标对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。
•将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

926959.oracleText:
"‘Victory is survival' is the tenet that guides us. My love, know that I will always ensure your survivial."
—Duvir, Mardu warrior, final letter
926959.translation:
「『以生定输赢』是领导我们的信条。亲爱的，希望你也能坚信，我永远都会把生的希望留给你。」
～玛尔都战士杜威的绝笔信

926961.oracleText: "Our khan would grant you clemency. She is naive. And unfortunately for you, she is also not here."
926961.translation: 「我们可汗在的话就会给你一条活路。她太天真了。而且你倒霉的是，她还不在。」

926962.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a counter on it deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
926962.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有指示物的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

926964.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast it without paying its mana cost if that spell's mana value is 8 or less. If you don't, put that card into your hand.
926964.translation: 当此结界进场时，从你牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地牌为止。如果所成咒语之法术力值等于或小于8，则你可以施放它，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你未如此作，则将该牌置于你手上。

926966.oracleText: Channeled Dragonfire deals 2 damage to any target.
926966.translation: 通贯龙炎对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

926969.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has trample and haste.
926969.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有践踏与敏捷异能。

926970.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, create a 1/1 white Monk creature token with prowess. You may attach this Equipment to it.
926970.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。你可以将此武具贴附到其上。

926973.translation: 「箭矢？哈！木头和羽毛吧？玩具而已！」

926974.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
926974.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

926976.oracleText:
"Let the dragonstorms rage. Let what seeks sustenance feed. Let Tarkir be what it was always meant to be."
—Sarkhan
926976.translation:
「让龙袭风暴怒意得以积蓄。让寻求滋养者得以满足。让鞑契变回它一直以来就该有的样子。」
～萨坎

926977.oracleText: You may cast Dragon spells without paying their mana costs.
926977.translation: 你可以施放龙咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

926980.oracleText: He regained balance while his opponent regained consciousness.
926980.translation: 他的对手意识逐渐复苏，他也慢慢回归原本的平衡姿态。

926981.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
926981.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

926982.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, this creature gains double strike until end of turn.
926982.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，此生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

926984.oracleText: When this Aura enters, enchanted creature gains first strike until end of turn.
926984.translation: 当此灵气进场时，所结附的生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

926986.oracleText: The brushfires of Cori Mountain take on a life all their own.
926986.translation: 科黎山脉的火焰自己就变得鲜活起来。

926987.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return this creature to its owner's hand. (Return it only if it's on the battlefield.)
926987.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，将此生物移回其拥有者手上。（若它在战场上，才须将它移回。）

926988.oracleText: {o2oR}: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

926990.oracleText: The power of the dragonstorms transformed not only the land but many of the creatures within it.
926990.translation: 龙袭风暴不仅改变了大地，同时也影响了其中许多生物。

926991.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it, add {oWoUoBoRoG}.
