926991.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它经你施放，则加{oWoUoBoRoG}。

926993.oracleText: A master of the Whirling Blade technique, he did not hesitate to leap to the monastery's defense.
926993.translation: 他身为旋风斩大师，迫不及待地想要冲到寺院防卫第一线。

926994.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
926994.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

926995.oracleText: {o1}: Add {oU}, {oR}, or {oW}. Activate only once each turn.

926997.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Its controller searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield tapped with a stun counter on it, then shuffles.
926997.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。其操控者从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场且其上有一个晕眩指示物，然后洗牌。

927000.oracleText: "It isn't about expression or results. Doing the thing is itself the point."
927000.translation: 「这并非关乎外观或结果。动手本身就是意义所在。」

927002.oracleText: You may cast this spell as though it had flash if you behold a Dragon as an additional cost to cast it.
927002.translation: 如果你施放此咒语时多支付了「请援龙」此费用，则你可以将它视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

927003.oracleText: Molten Exhale deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
927003.translation: 熔铁吐息对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

927005.oracleText: With a swift motion Narset struck Sarkhan down. She would not let his fevered dreams of draconic dominance come to fruition. Not after all she had done to free Tarkir.
927005.translation: 娜尔施以迅雷不及掩耳之势将萨坎击倒。她已耗费了太多心血帮助鞑契摆脱龙王统治，绝不会让对方巨龙再统天下的狂热梦想成真。

927006.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature. Add {oUoRoW}. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
927006.translation: 娜尔施的拒斥对目标生物造成5点伤害。加{oUoRoW}。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

927007.oracleText: Narset's Rebuke deals 5 damage to target creature. Add {oUoRoW}. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
927007.translation: 娜尔施的拒斥对目标生物造成5点伤害。加{oUoRoW}。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

927009.oracleText: Mardu lightning rods disperse the energy of dragonstorms—or whatever happens to be touching the rods.
927009.translation: 玛尔都的霹雳权杖能够驱散龙袭风暴中的能量～或是它碰到的任何东西。

927010.oracleText: Overwhelming Surge deals 3 damage to target creature.
927010.translation: 超幅电涌对目标生物造成3点伤害。

927011.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. 
• Destroy target noncreature artifact.
927011.translation:
选择一项或都选～
•CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。
•消灭目标非生物神器。

927012.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Overwhelming Surge deals 3 damage to target creature. 
• Destroy target noncreature artifact.
927012.translation:
选择一项或都选～
•超幅电涌对目标生物造成3点伤害。
•消灭目标非生物神器。

927014.oracleText:
"The scouts should have been back hours ago. They might be in trouble. I'm sending Kyra."
—Eshki Dragonclaw
927014.translation:
「探子几个小时前应该就已经回来。他们可能有麻烦了。我派奇拉去看看。」
～龙爪艾丝琦

927016.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if you've cast two or more spells this turn, this enchantment becomes a 3/3 Monk creature with haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
927016.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则此结界成为具敏捷异能的3/3修行僧生物直到回合结束，且仍具有原本类别。

927017.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice this enchantment: Draw two cards.
927017.translation: {o1oR}，弃掉你的手牌，牺牲此结界：抓两张牌。

927019.oracleText: When Sarkhan enters, you may behold a Dragon. If you do, create a Treasure token.
927019.translation: 当萨坎进场时，你可以请援龙。若你如此作，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

927020.oracleText: Whenever a Dragon you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Sarkhan. Until end of turn, Sarkhan becomes a Dragon in addition to its other types and gains flying.
927020.translation: 每当一个由你操控的龙进场时，在萨坎上放置一个+1/+1指示物。直到回合结束，萨坎额外具有龙此类别，且获得飞行异能。

927022.oracleText: In this year's Lightning Proving, Paala reclaimed her confidence and her place in the Mardu.
927022.translation: 在今年的霹雳考验当中，帕拉不仅寻回了信心，也夺回了她在玛尔都部落中的地位。

927023.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+1 until end of turn.
927023.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+2/+1直到回合结束。

927024.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards. 
• Up to two target creatures each get +2/+1 until end of turn.
927024.translation:
选择一项～
•放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。
•至多两个目标生物各得+2/+1直到回合结束。

927026.oracleText: "From Alesha to Zurgo, all Mardu khans started right here. At the front lines."
927026.translation: 「从阿列莎到珠高，所有玛尔都可汗都是从这里拼出来的。从前线杀敌开始。」

927028.oracleText:
"An arrow alone can't fell a dragon, but an added bolt of lightning brings it tumbling to the ground."
—Balur, Mardu warrior
927028.translation:
「单凭一支弓箭本身当然没法射落飞龙，不过加上一点雷电之力后，就能令其颤抖坠地。」
～玛尔都战士巴鲁尔

927029.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to target opponent.
927029.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物向目标对手造成1点伤害。

927031.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature.
927031.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲此生物：它对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

927033.oracleText: Dragons of Tarkir are born fully formed, roars blending with the storms as a single, inseparable voice.
927033.translation: 鞑契的飞龙诞生时就已完全成型，吼声与雷鸣融合为一。

927036.oracleText: {o1oR}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

927038.oracleText: Discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
927038.translation: 弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

927040.oracleText:
"If you see a yeti of Qadat, then it has surely already seen you. And if you are within sight, you are within range."
—Nitula, Temur hunter
927040.translation:
「如果你看到了克达的雪怪，那它肯定也已经看到你了。而且如果它看得到你，就能逮得到你。」
～铁木尔猎人尼图拉

927041.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature can't block this turn.
927041.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

927043.oracleText: "Help the villagers to safety! I will hold the gate!"
927043.translation: 「快带村民去避难！我来守住村口！」

927044.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 6 damage to target creature with flying.
927044.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：它对目标具飞行异能的生物造成6点伤害。

927046.oracleText: When Tersa Lightshatter enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
927046.translation: 当折雳缇莎进场时，弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

927047.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, exile a card at random from your graveyard. You may play that card this turn.
927047.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则从你坟墓场中随机放逐一张牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

927048.oracleText: Whenever Tersa Lightshatter attacks, if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, exile a card at random from your graveyard. You may play that card this turn.
927048.translation: 每当折雳缇莎攻击时，若你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则从你坟墓场中随机放逐一张牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

927049.oracleText:
"Fire is only as precise as your control over it."
—Danfeng, Jeskai mage
927049.translation:
「控得越稳，火焰就越准。」
～洁斯凯法师丹丰

927051.oracleText: They're just as renowned for their banter as they are for their tactical teamwork.
927051.translation: 他们打出配合能收到全场欢呼，他们搞笑时赢得的喝彩也不遑多让。

927052.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
927052.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

927053.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Target creature you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
927053.translation: {o1}，{oT}：目标由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

927055.oracleText: Zurgo valued those who took initiative.
927055.translation: 珠高看重那些主动的人。

927056.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 5 damage to target creature an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
927056.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择目标由对手操控的生物，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。此生物对后者造成5点伤害。

927058.oracleText:
Community is strength.
—Tenet of the Decree of Thunder
927058.translation:
以合聚力量。
～雷霆喻令信条

927059.oracleText: Whenever you attack, create a 1/1 red Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
927059.translation: 每当你攻击时，派出一个1/1红色战士衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

927065.oracleText: "There has to be a faster route through Sagu Jungle. Give me a week."
927065.translation: 「穿越萨谷丛林肯定还有其他捷径。给我一周时间。」

927066.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among them into your hand. If you don't, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
927066.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨三张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌置于你手上。若你未如此作，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927068.oracleText: "Sokran is no mere bear. She is friend, family, and confidante—and more intelligent than some of my blood relatives."
927068.translation: 「舒澜并非只是一头熊。她是我的朋友、家人、知己～甚至比我的某些亲戚还聪明。」

927069.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
927069.translation: 每当一张或数张牌于你的回合中离开你坟墓场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927071.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Dragon you control enters, you gain 3 life.
927071.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的龙进场时，你获得3点生命。

927073.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic Forest cards, reveal them, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
927073.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本的树林牌，展示这些牌，将一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927075.oracleText: Dusan boxing matches allow contestants no weapons, no allies, and no excuses.
927075.translation: 参加独缮拳赛的选手，不得携带武器，不得场外呼援，不得寻故避战。

927076.oracleText: Renew — {o1oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter and a trample counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
927076.translation: 复新～{o1oG}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物和一个践踏指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

927077.oracleText:
"Some days, you wish you were fighting a dragon."
—Eshki Dragonclaw
927077.translation:
「有些时候你更希望对手是龙。」
～龙爪艾丝琦

927079.oracleText: During Dromoka's reign, Qatros Karst City was a haven for the Abzan rebellion. Its current residents have not lost their proficiency against their former foes.
927079.translation: 在卓茉卡统治时，喀斯特城夸托斯曾是阿布赞反抗军的庇护地。如今此地住民也还没有丢掉对抗过往宿敌的本领。

927081.oracleText: When this token enters, it deals 3 damage to any target.
927081.translation: 当此衍生物进场时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

927082.oracleText: {o3oWoUoBoRoG}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create a 4/4 Dragon creature token named Reliquary Dragon that's all colors. It has flying, lifelink, and "When this token enters, it deals 3 damage to any target." Activate only as a sorcery.
927082.translation: {o3oWoUoBoRoG}，牺牲此神器：派出一个4/4五色，名称为圣物龙的龙衍生生物。它具有飞行、系命与「当此衍生物进场时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。」只能于法术时机起动。

927085.oracleText: Created by a sudden sinking, Dusyut Forest attracts earthcarvers eager to explore its mysteries and test their magic.
927085.translation: 杜修特树林由地坑突现而成，因此也吸引了诸多雕地师来到此地探寻其间奥秘，一试自己身手。

927086.oracleText: When this creature enters, it endures 3.
927086.translation: 当此生物进场时，它续战3。

927088.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
927088.translation: 当此结界进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

927090.oracleText:
"The war chargers seem restless. Let them out to play."
—Ermaz, Abzan border guard
927090.translation:
「这些冲锋部队看起来没完没了。派他们出去玩一玩。」
～阿布赞边境守卫厄玛兹

927091.oracleText: Creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block it.
927091.translation: 力量小于此生物的生物不能阻挡它。

927092.oracleText: As long as you control a creature with a counter on it, this creature gets +1/+2.
927092.translation: 只要你操控其上有指示物的生物，此生物便得+1/+2。

927094.oracleText: {oT}: Until end of turn, target creature you control with power 4 or greater gains trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
927094.translation: {oT}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物获得践踏与「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。」

927096.oracleText: With an echoing crash the effigy fell, the symbol of Atarka's tyranny expunged from Temur lands.
927096.translation: 随着一声回响轰鸣，整座雕像就此倒塌，安塔卡暴政的威严象征自此就从铁木尔土地上清除一空。

927097.oracleText: Exile up to one target card from a graveyard. Draw a card.
927097.translation: 将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。抓一张牌。

927098.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Exile up to one target card from a graveyard. Draw a card.
927098.translation:
选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。抓一张牌。

927100.oracleText: Abzan soldiers know they never enter battle alone.
927100.translation: 阿布赞士兵知道他们绝不是孤身作战。

927101.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, it endures 2.
927101.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，它续战2。

927103.oracleText: An exceptional bout during the Zenith celebration will be noted by Temur elders and result in recruitment for higher ranks.
927103.translation: 日至庆典时摔出的精彩对局，都会被铁木尔长老看在眼里，后续更会依此选定高阶军官人选。

927104.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, then it deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
927104.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后它向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

927106.oracleText: The bushwhacker's machete glanced off the root with a sickening crack. Slowly, the entire undergrowth turned to face him.
927106.translation: 开路兵的砍刀劈过树根，听到一阵令人胆寒的断裂声。然后整个矮丛林地都缓慢起身向他扑去。

927107.oracleText: {o2oG}: This creature can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
927107.translation: {o2oG}：此生物于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

927110.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may mill cards equal to the number of lands you control.
927110.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以磨等同于由你操控之地数量的牌。

927111.oracleText: Renew — {o1oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature, where X is the number of land cards in your graveyard. Activate only as a sorcery.
927111.translation: 复新～{o1oG}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你坟墓场中的地牌数量。只能于法术时机起动。

927115.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker. If a Dragon was beheld, surveil 2.
927115.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。如果已请援龙，则刺探2。

927117.oracleText: In the aftermath of war, Temur mages nurtured the land back to its former vitality.
927117.translation: 大战过后，铁木尔法师滋养大地，令其恢复过往活力。

927118.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may mill three cards.
927118.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以磨三张牌。

927119.oracleText: {oT}: Add an amount of {oG} equal to this creature's power.
927119.translation: {oT}：加若干{oG}，其数量等同于此生物的力量。

927121.oracleText: The greatest honor a Sultai can receive is to be returned to the realm of the living.
927121.translation: 苏勒台人能得到的最高荣誉，便是重返生者世界。

927122.oracleText: Return up to two target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand. Target player shuffles up to four target cards from their graveyard into their library. Exile CARDNAME.
927122.translation: 将至多两张目标永久物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。目标牌手将至多四张目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。放逐CARDNAME。

927123.oracleText: Return up to two target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand. Target player shuffles up to four target cards from their graveyard into their library. Exile Rite of Renewal.
927123.translation: 将至多两张目标永久物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。目标牌手将至多四张目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。放逐复新仪式。

927127.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
927127.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927128.oracleText: Renew — {o3oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
927128.translation: 复新～{o3oG}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后将该生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。只能于法术时机起动。

927130.oracleText:
Like talking to a grokmaul
—Tarkir expression meaning "a failure of diplomacy"
927130.translation:
对钩毛兽说话
～鞑契用语，意指「交涉失败」

927131.oracleText: Renew — {o4oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters and a reach counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
927131.translation: 复新～{o4oG}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物和一个延势指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

927133.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 3 life.
927133.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得3点生命。

927136.oracleText: With Taigam whispering encouragement in his ear, Sarkhan threw aside his misgivings. The ritual would return him to his former glory. All he needed was a dragon's heart.
927136.translation: 听闻泰伽姆的低声鼓舞，萨坎将一切担忧都抛诸脑后。这一仪式将助他重拾往日荣光。现在需要的，就只剩一颗龙心。

927137.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. 
• Destroy target creature with flying.
927137.translation:
选择一项～ 
•目标生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。 
•消灭目标具飞行异能的生物。

927138.oracleText: "Now I wonder . . . will anyone come to protect you?"
927138.translation: 「现在我倒要看看…还有谁会来保护你？」

927140.oracleText: Many Sultai villages are protected by naga who weave magics to bless or curse as needed.
927140.translation: 那伽的魔法或祝福、或诅咒，他们可以根据情况自如施放，也以此来保护大多数苏勒台村民免受侵扰。

927141.oracleText: {o1}: Add {oB}, {oG}, or {oU}. Activate only once each turn.

927143.oracleText: "I've spent my life feeding Atarka's desire and hungers. It's time to see to my own."
927143.translation: 「我已经花了一辈子来满足安塔卡的欲望与饥渴。现在该来满足自己的了。」

927144.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control or a creature spell you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, draw a card.
927144.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物或由你操控的生物咒语成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你抓一张牌。

927146.oracleText: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control. Creatures you control with counters on them gain vigilance and trample until end of turn.
927146.translation: 将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标由你操控的生物。由你操控且其上有指示物的生物获得警戒与践踏直到回合结束。

927148.oracleText: The Abzan pride themselves on the safety of their roads. To reject their escorts invites storm and sorrow.
927148.translation: 阿布赞人能保证路途平安并以此为傲。拒绝他们护卫，就等于选择面对风暴与悲剧。

927149.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card if you control a creature with a counter on it. If you don't draw a card this way, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
927149.translation: 当此生物进场时，如果你操控其上有指示物的生物，抓一张牌。若你未以此法抓牌，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927151.oracleText: Every part of every plant is useful—for food, for medicine, and for ceremonies.
927151.translation: 每株植物的各个部分都能派上用场～或以果腹，或以入药，或以祭祀。

927152.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.
927152.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，检视你的牌库顶牌。如果其是地牌，你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。若你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

927154.oracleText: There are those who developed peculiar tastes after generations of dining upon the remains of interclan rivalry.
927154.translation: 有些动物几十代以来一直都以部族冲突的遗骸为食，由此演化出了奇怪品味。

927156.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
927156.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927157.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, it endures X, where X is the number of counters on this creature.
927157.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物进场时，它续战X，X为此生物上的指示物数量。

927159.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.
927159.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+1且具有死触异能。

927160.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, if it's your main phase, there is an additional combat phase after this phase followed by an additional main phase. When you next attack this turn, untap each creature you control.
927160.translation: 当此结界进场时，若当前是你的行动阶段，则在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段，以及接于其后之一个额外的行动阶段。当你本回合中下一次攻击时，重置所有由你操控的生物。

927162.oracleText:
"Dragons working alongside the Abzan, not as overlords but as equals. It feels like a dream."
—Anafenza
927162.translation:
「巨龙不再作为龙王高高在上，而是作为族人与阿布赞人一道同甘共苦。这就像在梦里一样。」
～阿娜芬札

927163.oracleText: When this creature enters, distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.
927163.translation: 当此生物进场时，将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标由你操控的生物。

927165.oracleText: The Temur celebrate the end of the Unbroken Night with stories, dances, and feasts. They gather to witness the first light of dawn as the land sings in harmony.
927165.translation: 在夜至行将结束之时，铁木尔人会齐聚一处，以故事、舞蹈、盛宴来庆祝这一时刻。他们等着见证破晓的第一缕曙光，等着聆听大地和声吟唱。

927169.oracleText: You may discard a card. When you do, return target creature or land card from your graveyard to your hand.
927169.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。当你如此作时，将目标生物或地牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

927171.oracleText: • Abzan — At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
927171.translation: •阿布赞～在你的结束步骤开始时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927172.oracleText: • Mardu — At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
927172.translation: •玛尔都～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物在你的操控下死去，则每个对手各依其选择牺牲一个生物。

927173.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose Abzan or Mardu.
927173.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择阿布赞或玛尔都。

927176.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if creatures you control have total toughness 10 or greater, draw a card. Then if creatures you control have total toughness 20 or greater, untap each creature you control. Then if creatures you control have total toughness 40 or greater, each opponent loses half their life, rounded up.
927176.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若由你操控之生物的防御力总和等于或大于10，则抓一张牌。然后如果由你操控之生物的防御力总和等于或大于20，则重置每个由你操控的生物。然后如果由你操控之生物的防御力总和等于或大于40，则每位对手各失去其一半数量的生命，小数点后进位。

927178.oracleText: In power, in hunger, in cruelty—insatiable.
927178.translation: 力量，饥渴，残酷～每方面都永不餍足。

927179.oracleText: Attacking tokens you control have deathtouch.
927179.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的衍生物具有死触异能。

927181.oracleText: The essence of Tarkir was shaped into draconic embodiments of the re-formed clans.
927181.translation: 鞑契菁华化作五个重塑部落的龙形具现。

927182.translation: 由你操控的龙具有不灭异能。

927183.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, for each color, put a +1/+1 counter on a Dragon you control of that color. If you put +1/+1 counters on five Dragons this way, you win the game.
927183.translation: 在你的维持开始时，为每种颜色各进行以下流程～在一个由你操控且为该色的龙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若你以此法在五个龙上放置了+1/+1指示物，则你赢得这盘游戏。

927185.oracleText: Zhao had resolved to hold the bridge, defending the village behind him. But the villagers decided Zhao would not stand alone.
927185.translation: 老赵决心坚守桥梁，保护身后村庄。村民也决意不让老赵孤身坚守。

927186.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
927186.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

927188.oracleText:
"You need not mourn. Their life essence has returned to the earth, where it will eventually bloom into a new form."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper
927188.translation:
「你不必哀伤。他们的生命菁华已重归大地，最终会以其他形态焕发新生。」
～龙牙卫柯提斯

927189.oracleText: Destroy all creatures and enchantments. Draw a card for each permanent destroyed this way.
927189.translation: 消灭所有生物和结界。每以此法消灭一个永久物，便抓一张牌。

927191.oracleText:
A small shock to save a life, a large one to take it away.
—Mardu healer's adage
927191.translation:
轻触救命，重击害命。
～玛尔都治疗师箴言

927192.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain 2 life.
927192.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害且你获得2点生命。

927193.oracleText: Defibrillating Current deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain 2 life.
927193.translation: 震颤电流对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害且你获得2点生命。

927195.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment.
927195.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。

927198.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, it deals 3 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
927198.translation: 当此结界进场时，它对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成3点伤害。

927199.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
927199.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个4/4红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

927201.oracleText: Some had doubted the whisperers' choice of Eshki for Dragonclaw. None did so after witnessing her in battle.
927201.translation: 原本还有人质疑低语者为何推选艾丝琦就任龙爪之位。但在见过她战场上的英勇表现后，再也无人非议。

927202.oracleText: Double the power and toughness of target creature you control until end of turn. Then it fights up to one target creature an opponent controls.
927202.translation: 将目标由你操控之生物的力量和防御力均加倍直到回合结束。然后它与至多一个目标由对手操控的生物互斗。

927204.oracleText: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it if you've cast two or more spells this turn.
927204.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则此生物进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

927206.oracleText: "The Twice Whisperer heals. The Dragonclaw protects. Together, we will rebuild the Temur."
927206.translation: 「通灵语者疗愈伤痕。龙爪可汗保卫家园。齐心协力，我们定能重现铁木尔荣光。」

927207.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've cast both a creature spell and a noncreature spell this turn, draw a card and put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
927207.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你本回合中生物咒语和非生物咒语都施放过，则抓一张牌并在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

927208.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've cast both a creature spell and a noncreature spell this turn, draw a card and put two +1/+1 counters on Eshki Dragonclaw.
927208.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你本回合中生物咒语和非生物咒语都施放过，则抓一张牌并在龙爪艾丝琦上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

927213.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• You gain 3 life and surveil 3. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Counter target creature spell.
927213.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～
•你获得3点生命且刺探3。
•消灭目标结界。
•反击目标生物咒语。

927215.oracleText: "Through perennation, we stand together, families—ancestor and kin—united as one clan! Abzan!"
927215.translation: 「经年轮回，我们齐聚此处，家人们，算上先祖与亲族的份，让我们整个部落团结为一！阿布赞！」

927216.oracleText: Whenever Felothar enters or attacks, you may sacrifice a nonland permanent. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
927216.translation: 每当芾洛塔进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲一个非地永久物。当你如此作时，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927218.oracleText: "A flurry of fists doesn't impress you? Perhaps if they're on fire?"
927218.translation: 「拳头连击还觉得不够看？那加把火呢？」

927220.oracleText: When this creature enters, copy the next spell you cast this turn when you cast it. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
927220.translation: 当此生物进场，本回合中，当你施放你的下一个咒语时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

927222.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
927222.translation: 目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的生物数量。

927223.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens. 
• Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
927223.translation:
选择一项～
•派出两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。
•目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的生物数量。

927225.oracleText: Differing philosophies were debated by bloodshed.
927225.translation: 理念差异诉诸鲜血争锋。

927226.oracleText: • Jeskai — Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
927226.translation: •洁斯凯～每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

927227.oracleText: • Temur — Creatures you control get +1/+0 and have trample and haste.
927227.translation: •铁木尔～由你操控的生物得+1/+0且具有践踏与敏捷异能。

927228.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose Jeskai or Temur.
927228.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择洁斯凯或铁木尔。

927230.oracleText: Draw a card, then you may discard a card. When you discard a nonland card this way, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature.
927230.translation: 抓一张牌，然后你可以弃一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张非地牌时，CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。

927231.oracleText: Draw a card, then you may discard a card. When you discard a nonland card this way, Glacial Dragonhunt deals 3 damage to target creature.
927231.translation: 抓一张牌，然后你可以弃一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张非地牌时，冰川猎龙对目标生物造成3点伤害。

927234.oracleText: The Sultai approach was silent. The Temur response was deafening.
927234.translation: 苏勒台进击悄然无声。铁木尔反攻震耳欲聋。

927235.oracleText: • Temur — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, target player mills four cards.
927235.translation: •铁木尔～每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，目标牌手磨四张牌。

927236.oracleText: • Sultai — You may play lands from your graveyard.
927236.translation: •苏勒台～你可以从你坟墓场中使用地。

927237.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose Temur or Sultai.
927237.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择铁木尔或苏勒台。

927239.oracleText: "The fishers were probably exaggerating the size of the crocodile they spotted, but maybe they weren't. Let's check it out."
927239.translation: 「渔人可能夸大了看到的鳄鱼体型，不过他们也许说的是实话。让我们亲自去看看。」

927240.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may put one of those cards back on top of your library. Put the rest into your graveyard.
927240.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以将其中一张放回你的牌库顶。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

927242.oracleText:
"Life is full of tough calls. We honor the dead today to make better decisions tomorrow."
—Uruna, Mardu lieutenant
927242.translation:
「生活满是艰难抉择。我们今天纪念亡者，是为了明天能做出更好决策。」
～玛尔都副官乌鲁娜

927243.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a token: Draw a card.

927245.oracleText: • Sultai — Whenever a counter is put on a creature you control, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
927245.translation: •苏勒台～每当在一个由你操控的生物上放置指示物时，你抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

927246.oracleText: • Abzan — Whenever you attack, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature. It gains menace until end of turn.
927246.translation: •阿布赞～每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

927247.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose Sultai or Abzan.
927247.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择苏勒台或阿布赞。

927249.oracleText: "I agreed to return and aid the Sultai. My friends here agreed to return and aid me."
927249.translation: 「我同意回来帮苏勒台。我的伙伴同意回来帮我。」

927250.oracleText: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
927250.translation: 此生物进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

927251.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had counters on it, put its counters on up to one target creature you control.
927251.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有指示物，则将它的指示物放置在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

927253.oracleText:
"We came seeking a challenge. It seems we must continue searching."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
927253.translation:
「我们在寻找挑战。我们还得接着找。」
～玛尔都可汗珠高

927254.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
927254.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

927256.oracleText: Elegance. Precision. Grace. Qualities that must be practiced in writing as well as combat.
927256.translation: 优雅。精准。端庄：这些书法上需要苦练的要点，在战斗中也一样重要。

927258.oracleText:
"No one of us could have built all this alone. A clan, a school, hope for the future. Thank you all."
—Narset, to Shiko, Taigam, and Elsha
927258.translation:
「团结部落、求知学堂、明日希望：单凭一己之力，我们谁都无法实现如今所构建的一切。感谢大家。」
～娜尔施致谢席科、泰伽姆、艾尔莎

927259.oracleText: Return target spell or permanent to its owner's hand. CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target. Create two 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess. Draw two cards. You gain 4 life.
927259.translation: 将目标咒语或永久物移回其拥有者手上。CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。派出两个1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。抓两张牌。你获得4点生命。

927260.oracleText: Return target spell or permanent to its owner's hand. Jeskai Revelation deals 4 damage to any target. Create two 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess. Draw two cards. You gain 4 life.
927260.translation: 将目标咒语或永久物移回其拥有者手上。洁斯凯启示对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。派出两个1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。抓两张牌。你获得4点生命。

927262.oracleText: Like clouds and snow, Jeskai dragons prefer to drift among the monastery's highest spires.
927262.translation: 洁斯凯巨龙就像云雪一般，喜欢在寺院顶峰之间穿梭。

927263.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
927263.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

927265.oracleText: As the Temur returned to Karakyk during the chill of winter, some shadows overhead were a blessing rather than a threat.
927265.translation: 当铁木尔人在寒冬时节回到凯拉奇时，头顶上不时会有阴影掠过：这些并非都是威胁，有些更是祝福。

927266.oracleText: This creature has hexproof if it hasn't dealt damage yet.
927266.translation: 如果此生物还未造成过伤害，则它具有辟邪异能。

927268.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard during your turn, create a Treasure token.
927268.translation: 每当一张或数张牌于你的回合中离开你坟墓场时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

927269.oracleText: Renew — {o2oBoGoU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters and a flying counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
927269.translation: 复新～{o2oBoGoU}，从你坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物和一个飞行指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

927271.oracleText:
"For his crimes—burn his blood and cut him from his ancestors. Perennation is only for family."
—Dictate of House Mevak in the banishment of Oret
927271.translation:
「至于他的罪行～须烧干血液，斩断先祖联系以示惩戒。唯家人配享经年轮回。」
～梅瓦克眷族关于驱逐欧列特的裁定

927272.oracleText: Exile target permanent with mana value 3 or greater.
927272.translation: 放逐目标法术力值等于或大于3的永久物。

927274.oracleText: "Rising waters have flooded many old places from the dragon's rule. I do not miss them."
927274.translation: 「水位上涨已经淹没了许多龙王统治时期的遗迹。我一点也不怀念。」

927275.oracleText: Whenever a card leaves your graveyard during your turn, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
927275.translation: 每当一张牌于你的回合中离开你的坟墓场时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

927277.oracleText: Whenever Kotis deals combat damage to a player, exile the top X cards of their library, where X is the amount of damage dealt. You may cast any number of spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs.
927277.translation: 每当柯提斯对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐其牌库顶的X张牌，X为所造成的伤害数量。你可以从其中施放任意数量法术力值等于或小于X的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

927279.oracleText: Some paths through Gurmag Swamp are deserted for good reason.
927279.translation: 有些能够穿越谷尔玛沼泽的路径再也没人去走，背后都是有原因的。

927280.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's power to target creature.
927280.translation: 将目标生物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的力量。

927281.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Lie in Wait deals damage equal to that card's power to target creature.
927281.translation: 将目标生物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。待机而动对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的力量。

927284.oracleText: They've attained a level of synchronicity beyond what's possible in a single lifetime.
927284.translation: 他们舞蹈动作完全划一，绝非一辈子可成之功。

927285.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a black card, a green card, and a blue card. Put those cards into your graveyard, then shuffle.
927285.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张黑色牌、一张绿色牌和一张蓝色牌。将这些牌置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

927287.oracleText: Create a 5/5 green Elephant creature token.
927287.translation: 派出一个5/5绿色的象衍生生物。

927290.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one other target creature you control until this creature leaves the battlefield.
927290.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐至多另一个目标由你操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

927293.oracleText: Gvar carved his way through the Ancestral Maelstrom, seeking to restore the withered Kin-Tree and soothe the raging spirits.
927293.translation: 格瓦一路闯过先祖涡心，想要复原族树，安抚愤怒灵魂。

927294.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
927294.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为进行攻击的生物数量。

927296.oracleText: Lanniao soared from Highspire Monastery all throughout Tarkir, carrying messages for monks and villagers alike.
927296.translation: 蓝鸟从峰顶寺院出发，一路穿越整个鞑契，为僧人与村名传递书信。

927297.oracleText: When this creature enters, put up to one target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard on top of your library.
927297.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一张目标非生物且非地的牌从你坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

927299.oracleText: "Each step we take is a decision that changes the course of our futures. We must be careful where we tread."
927299.translation: 「我们所踏出的每一步，都会改变我们未来的方向。必须留意我们落脚之处。」

927300.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw cards equal to the number of spells you've cast this turn.
927300.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以弃掉你的手牌。若你如此作，则抓若干牌，其数量等同于你本回合中施放过的咒语数量。

927302.oracleText: Scales streaked with lightning, trailing thunder in his wake, Neriv is the living banner around which the Mardu rally.
927302.translation: 涅雳伏周身闪电不断，身后雷鸣不停，它就是玛尔都部队拥护的活军旗。

927303.oracleText: If a creature you control that entered this turn would deal damage, it deals twice that much damage instead.
927303.translation: 如果某个本回合中进场之由你操控的生物将造成伤害，则改为它造成两倍该数量的伤害。

927305.oracleText: The next time a source of your choice would deal damage to you this turn, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, CARDNAME deals that much damage to that source's controller and you draw that many cards.
927305.translation: 选择一个来源。于本回合中，防止该来源下一次将对你造成的伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，CARDNAME对该来源的操控者造成等量的伤害且你抓等量的牌。

927306.oracleText: The next time a source of your choice would deal damage to you this turn, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, New Way Forward deals that much damage to that source's controller and you draw that many cards.
927306.translation: 选择一个来源。于本回合中，防止该来源下一次将对你造成的伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，灵道辟路对该来源的操控者造成等量的伤害且你抓等量的牌。

927308.oracleText: The Abzan believe in perennation—death is not only an end, but a return to the beginning.
927308.translation: 阿布赞人相信经年轮回～死亡并非到达终点，而是重回起点。

927309.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a hexproof counter and an indestructible counter on it.
927309.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个辟邪指示物和一个不灭指示物。

927311.oracleText: When this creature enters, remove all counters from up to one target creature.
927311.translation: 当此生物进场时，从至多一个目标生物上移去所有指示物。

927313.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains lifelink and hexproof until end of turn.
927313.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得系命与辟邪异能。

927315.oracleText: "You know you shouldn't and the Sultai forbid you. But you can't resist the temptation, can you?"
927315.translation: 「你知道你不该如此，苏勒台也禁止此事。但你还是抵挡不住诱惑，对吗？」

927316.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
927316.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余则置入你坟墓场。

927318.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
927318.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

927319.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
927319.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

927320.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell this turn, target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn.
927320.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放非生物咒语时，目标由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

927322.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
927322.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

927324.oracleText: "Dried durian from the Marang River Valley! Candied cherries from the slopes of Cori! Genuine dragon scale cookware!"
927324.translation: 「马兰河谷的榴莲果干！科黎山脊的樱桃蜜饯！绝对正宗的龙鳞厨具！」

927325.oracleText: When this creature enters or dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
927325.translation: 当此生物进场或死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927327.oracleText: Create three 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens.
927327.translation: 派出三个1/1白色精怪衍生生物。

927328.oracleText: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.
927328.translation: 将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标由你操控的生物。

927329.oracleText: Creatures you control gain trample and lifelink until end of turn.
927329.translation: 由你操控的生物获得践踏与系命异能直到回合结束。

927331.oracleText: Tap target creature. Put three stun counters on it.
927331.translation: 横置目标生物。在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。

927333.oracleText: Create a 5/5 green Elephant creature token.
927333.translation: 派出一个5/5绿色的象衍生生物。

927334.oracleText: Create a 5/5 green Elephant creature token.
927334.translation: 派出一个5/5绿色的象衍生生物。

927335.oracleText: Double the power and toughness of each creature you control until end of turn.
927335.translation: 将每个由你操控之生物的力量和防御力均加倍直到回合结束。

927337.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell or a Dragon spell, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
927337.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语或龙咒语时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

927341.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, exile that card.
927341.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。若你如此作，则放逐该牌。

927342.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner creates an X/X white Spirit creature token, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
927342.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者派出一个X/X白色精怪衍生生物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

927345.oracleText: When Shiko enters, exile target nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. Copy it, then you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
927345.translation: 当席科进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌从你坟墓场放逐。将它复制，然后你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

927347.oracleText: Slowly, the clans have begun to recover and adapt long-forgotten tactics.
927347.translation: 部落缓慢恢复生息，重新拾回早已遗忘的战术。

927349.oracleText: When this creature enters, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains harmonize until end of turn. Its harmonize cost is equal to its mana cost.
927349.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得谐颂异能直到回合结束。其谐颂费用等同于其法术力费用。

927351.oracleText: To ensure a fair competition, the Great Assemblage's war shriek contest has two divisions: dragons, and everyone else.
927351.translation: 为保证公平竞争，盛大集庆上的战嚎比赛分为两组来进行：龙组和其他组。

927352.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life. If a player is dealt damage this way, they discard a card.
927352.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向任意一个目标造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。若以此法对某牌手造成伤害，则该牌手弃一张牌。

927354.oracleText: Whenever one or more counters are put on a creature you control, if it's the first time counters have been put on that creature this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
927354.translation: 每当在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个指示物时，若此次是本回合中首度在该生物上放置指示物，则在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927356.oracleText: When called to the land's defense, all come to protect their shared home. It's why many of the Temur use "family" and "herd" interchangeably.
927356.translation: 在需要防卫领地时，会召集所有族群的力量来保护共同家园。正因如此，许多铁木尔人口中的「家人」和「族人」都是指的大家。

927357.oracleText: During your turn, spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each creature you control with power 4 or greater.
927357.translation: 于你的回合中，你每操控一个力量等于或大于4的生物，由你施放的咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

927359.oracleText:
"He just kind of followed me home one day. I mean, could you say no to this face?"
—Karasi, Mistrise provisioner
927359.translation:
「他那天就是想跟我回家的样子。你能拒绝这张脸吗？」
～漫雾村贩商卡拉熙

927361.oracleText: "As you act, so shall you be judged."

927362.translation: 由你施放的咒语具有掘穴异能。

927363.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you lose life equal to its mana value.
927363.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，你失去等同于其法术力值的生命。

927365.oracleText: You draw two cards and you lose 2 life.
927365.translation: 你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

927366.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters this turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
927366.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

927367.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters this turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
927367.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

927369.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 5 life.
927369.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得5点生命。

927371.oracleText: Charring Bite deals 5 damage to target creature without flying.
927371.translation: 焦热撕咬对目标不具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。

927373.oracleText: When Ureni enters, it deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers your opponents control, where X is the number of lands you control.
927373.translation: 当乌列尼进场时，它对任意数量目标由对手操控之生物和／或鹏洛客造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配，X为由你操控的地数量。

927375.oracleText: You may cast sorcery spells and Dragon spells as though they had flash.
927375.translation: 你可以将法术咒语和龙咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

927377.oracleText: Put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
927377.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

927379.oracleText: • Mardu — If a creature attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
927379.translation: •玛尔都～如果由你操控之永久物具有的触发式异能因生物攻击而触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

927380.oracleText: • Jeskai — At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. It gains lifelink and haste until end of turn.
927380.translation: •洁斯凯～在你的维持开始时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。它获得系命与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

927381.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose Mardu or Jeskai.
927381.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择玛尔都或洁斯凯。

927383.oracleText: She keeps watch for dragonstorms and rival clans alike. For dragons, she raises an alarm. For thieves, her blade.
927383.translation: 她尽职守护，无论是龙袭风暴还是敌对部落来袭都逃不过她的眼睛。若是巨龙来袭，她会发出警报。若是贼人来袭，她会使出刀剑。

927384.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it, mill four cards. When you do, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
927384.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它经你施放，则磨四张牌。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

927386.oracleText: "Hear me, Mardu! Our freedom is only beginning!"
927386.translation: 「玛尔都人，听我说！自由只是刚刚开始！」

927388.oracleText: During your end step, Warrior tokens you control have "This token can't be sacrificed."
927388.translation: 于你的结束步骤中，由你操控的战士衍生物具有「不能牺牲此衍生物。」

927390.oracleText: When this artifact enters, search your library for a basic Plains, Swamp, or Forest card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
927390.translation: 当此神器进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，沼泽或树林牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927391.oracleText: {o1oWoBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create an X/X white Spirit creature token, where X is the greatest toughness among creatures you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
927391.translation: {o1oWoBoG}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：派出一个X/X白色精怪衍生生物，X为由你操控之生物中的最大防御力。只能于法术时机起动。

927393.oracleText: The draconic power that flowed out from the dragonstorms imbued the landscape with draconic features—scales, claws, and appetites.
927393.translation: 龙袭风暴中满溢而出的巨龙力量也会侵蚀地貌，令其生出龙形特征～龙鳞、龙爪，乃至食欲。

927394.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，刺探1。

927396.oracleText: It's as if the metal itself rages.
927396.translation: 好似金属本身即怒火满溢。

927397.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has hexproof from monocolored.
927397.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有反单色辟邪异能。

927398.oracleText: Equip {o4}. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each color of the creature it targets.
927398.translation: 佩带{o4}。此异能的目标每有一种颜色，它便减少{o1}来起动。

927400.oracleText: Jeskai scholars fashioned devices to forecast the behavior of the dragonstorms.
927400.translation: 洁斯凯学者将毕生所学制成特别装置，用于预报龙袭风暴走势。

927401.oracleText: Each Dragon you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
927401.translation: 每个由你操控的龙进场时上面均额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

927403.oracleText: Its eternal glow lights the way for weary travelers through the misty heights surrounding Pearl Lake.
927403.translation: 它口中亮光永不熄灭，引领疲惫旅人走出珠湖周围的雾锁山路。

927404.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top. If you control a Dragon, put that card onto the battlefield tapped instead.
927404.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。若你操控龙，则改为将该牌横置放进战场。

927407.oracleText: Set in motion by artificers long forgotten, it remained loyal through the ages to the occupants of Kheru City.
927407.translation: 它由谁起动早已无从考究，但这么多年来它一直忠于赫鲁城的占有者。

927409.oracleText: When this artifact enters, search your library for a basic Island, Mountain, or Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
927409.translation: 当此神器进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，山脉或平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927410.oracleText: {o1oUoRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create two 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying. Activate only as a sorcery.
927410.translation: {o1oUoRoW}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

927412.oracleText: When this artifact enters, search your library for a basic Mountain, Plains, or Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
927412.translation: 当此神器进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，平原或沼泽牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927413.oracleText: {o2oRoWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create three 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. They gain menace and haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
927413.translation: {o2oRoWoB}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：派出三个1/1红色战士衍生生物。它们获得威慑与敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

927415.oracleText:
"Rage. Greed. Arrogance. People only accuse dragons of what they fear in themselves."
—Sarkhan
927415.translation:
「愤怒。贪婪。傲慢。人类只会将自己不想沾上的缺点强加于龙身上。」
～萨坎

927416.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Activate only if you control a Dragon.
927416.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。只能于你操控龙时起动。

927418.oracleText: When this artifact enters, search your library for a basic Swamp, Forest, or Island card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
927418.translation: 当此神器进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，树林或海岛牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927419.oracleText: {o2oBoGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create two 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
927419.translation: {o2oBoGoU}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：派出两个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

927421.oracleText: When this artifact enters, search your library for a basic Forest, Island, or Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
927421.translation: 当此神器进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，海岛或山脉牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927422.oracleText: {o3oGoUoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create a 5/5 green Elephant creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
927422.translation: {o3oGoUoR}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：派出一个5/5绿色的象衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

927424.oracleText: Against dragonlords, khans, and Ugin himself, the golem survived. Original purpose forgotten, it awaits orders that will never come, from a world that has moved on without it.
927424.translation: 这魔像曾直面龙王、可汗、甚至乌金本尊，如今依然留存于世。它早已忘记原本目的，仍在等待永不会到来的命令，但创造它的世界没在等待，而是照着自己的步伐继续前行。

927425.oracleText: When this creature enters, target player mills two cards. You gain 2 life.
927425.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标牌手磨两张牌。你获得2点生命。

927426.oracleText:
"These caves hide beasts above and below their waters. For safe passage, the Sultai agree a small cargo trade is fair for risking our necks."
—Samor, Mardu border guard
927426.translation:
「这些洞窟水上水下都藏有野兽。为能安全通过，苏勒台人觉得付出小小货物代价，远比冒着生命风险硬闯划算。」
～玛尔都边境守卫萨摩尔

927427.oracleText:
"It's rare to see Temur so far from their own lands. I see no reason to interfere, but keep an eye on them nonetheless."
—Hamza of House Fenzala
927427.translation:
「很少看到铁木尔人会离开领地来到这么远的地方。暂虽无需干涉，但仍要盯着他们。」
～芬札拉眷族的哈姆札

927429.oracleText: Every spire is a physical dedication to the Way.
927429.translation: 每座尖顶都是灵道的信念具现。

927430.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Plains or an Island.
927430.translation: 除非你操控平原或海岛，否则此地须横置进场。

927431.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
927431.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

927433.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Swamp or a Mountain.
927433.translation: 除非你操控沼泽或山脉，否则此地须横置进场。

927434.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}: Whenever you attack this turn, create two 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
927434.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}：本回合中，每当你攻击时，派出两个1/1红色战士衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

927435.oracleText:
"I ask only that the winds return you to me as swiftly as they bear you and the Storm Crane away."
—Samthar, Sultai merchant, to Jialing, Jeskai monk
927435.translation:
「希望清风能像带着你和疾鹤院轻盈而去一般，再度将你带回我身旁。」
～苏勒台商人萨曼沙向洁斯凯僧人佳玲祈祷

927436.oracleText: Dragonstorm chasers are not deterred by danger—they claim there is nothing like witnessing the land embracing the power of a storm.
927436.translation: 追踪龙袭风暴的人并不会被危险吓退～它们觉得没有其他景观能比见证风暴力量吞没大地更壮美。

927437.oracleText: With a warm fire and a fresh catch, Temur hunters find respite in even the coldest climates.
927437.translation: 只要有温暖营火和新鲜收获，就算在最冷的地方，铁木尔猎人也能寻得休憩之所。

927439.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Forest or a Plains.
927439.translation: 除非你操控树林或平原，否则此地须横置进场。

927440.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token.
927440.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，从你坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个1/1白色精怪衍生生物。

927441.oracleText: Long-standing disagreements between the Sultai and Abzan about how to honor their dead have led to rare but fierce skirmishes.
927441.translation: 在如何纪念亡者方面，苏勒台与阿布赞各执一词。这番长久争议偶尔也会导致激烈冲突。

927443.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control an Island or a Swamp.
927443.translation: 除非你操控海岛或沼泽，否则此地须横置进场。

927446.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Dragon spell or an Omen spell.
927446.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放龙咒语或预兆咒语。

927447.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a Dragon card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
927447.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻一张龙牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927449.oracleText: Built on a fumarole field, the village is a refuge of warmth amid the ice of the Qal Sisma mountains.
927449.translation: 这座建在地热孔上的村庄，是冰寒黑山之中难得的温暖地带。

927450.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Mountain or a Forest.
927450.translation: 除非你操控山脉或树林，否则此地须横置进场。

927451.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: The next spell you cast this turn can't be countered.
927451.translation: {oU}，{oT}：你本回合中施放的下一个咒语不能被反击。

927452.oracleText: Through sun and storm, across steppe and swamp, Storm Crane Monastery flies wherever aid is needed.
927452.translation: 穿越烈日风暴，飞过草原泥沼，疾鹤院翱翔四处，总会在最需要帮助的地方出现。

927453.oracleText:
"The Mardu breathe life into what was lost under the dragonlords. If the Abzan are upset, it should be at themselves."
—Tersa Lightshatter
927453.translation:
「玛尔都人为龙王时期失落的一切重新注入生机。阿布赞人要有不满的话，也应该先从自己身上找原因。」
～折雳缇莎

927454.oracleText:
"The people must know that the former seat of their oppression is cleansed. Throw open Qarsi's gates and let them see for themselves."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper
927454.translation:
「人民必须知道原本压迫他们的暴君已被除去。打开卡尔西宫殿的大门，让他们进来亲眼看看。」
～龙牙卫柯提斯

927455.oracleText:
"The most important part of a stronghold isn't its armaments or its walls. It's the reason people have to defend it."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar captain
927455.translation:
「城塞里头最重要的，并非武器储备或城墙厚度。而是必须坚守的理由。」
～孑遗队长格瓦巴泽

927456.oracleText: By the codes of Mardu and Abzan alike, both sides allowed their enemies time to grieve after a battle.
927456.translation: 无论是玛尔都还是阿布赞，他们原则上都会在战后给对手留出时间来哀悼逝者。

927457.oracleText: When spring melted the snow, fishers downstream of the Qadat Fire Rim learned of conflict between Temur and Jeskai from the gruesome flotsam.
927457.translation: 到了春季冰雪融化时，圜焰克达下游的渔民才会从腥红流水中得知铁木尔和洁斯凯曾有过一番恶战。

927458.oracleText: By morning the only evidence of conflict between Temur hunters and Sultai scouts were abandoned banners in the freshly fallen snow.
927458.translation: 待到清晨，就只能从残留新雪中的遭弃旗帜勉强看出，铁木尔猎人和苏勒台斥候之间曾有过一番争斗。

927459.oracleText:
"Abzan vintages are nice, but the sorghum wine made in Riverwheel Village is beyond compare."
—Iramaz, Abzan trader
927459.translation:
「阿布赞佳酿虽然不错，但什么都比不过河轮村酿造的高粱酒。」
～阿布赞商人拉马兹

927460.oracleText: The Mardu are centered in the present. The Jeskai look to the future. But both know when the time for talking is past.
927460.translation: 玛尔都人着眼现在。洁斯凯人放眼未来。但双方都知道，商谈的最好时机是在过去。

927464.oracleText: Target up to one permanent that is one or more colors.
927464.translation: 指定至多一个有色永久物为目标。

927465.oracleText: Search for any number of colorless nonland cards.
927465.translation: 搜寻任意数量的无色非地牌。

927466.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater.
927466.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或大于3且由对手操控的生物为目标。

927467.oracleText: Target up to one other nonland permanent you control.
927467.translation: 指定至多另一个由你操控的非地永久物为目标。

927468.oracleText: Search for a card named Tempest Hawk.
927468.translation: 搜寻一张名称为暴风翔鹰的牌。

927469.oracleText: Search your library for a card named Tempest Hawk?
927469.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为暴风翔鹰的牌？

927470.oracleText: Put up to two noncreature, nonland permanent cards with mana value 3 or less onto the battlefield.
927470.translation: 将至多两张非生物，非地，且法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌放进战场。

927471.oracleText: Reveal an instant, sorcery, or Dragon card?
927471.translation: 是否要展示一张瞬间，法术或龙牌？

927472.oracleText: Search for a card named Dragonstorm Globe or Boulderborn Dragon.
927472.translation: 搜寻一张名称为龙袭暴示球或石生巨龙的牌。

927474.oracleText: Target up to two other nonland permanents.
927474.translation: 指定至多两个其他非地永久物为目标。

927475.oracleText: Put five cards into your library. (ordering will be done in next step)
927475.translation: 将五张牌置入你的牌库。（顺序将在后续步骤中确定）

927476.oracleText: When it dies under your control this turn, draw two cards.
927476.translation: 本回合中，当它在你的操控下死去时，抓两张牌。

927477.oracleText: Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
927477.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

927478.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature you control with mana value {2, Number} other than {1, CardId}.
927478.translation: 牺牲一个由你操控，法术力值为{2, Number}，且不是{1, CardId}的生物。

927479.translation: 指定一张法术力值加1的生物牌。

927483.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
927483.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

927484.oracleText: Target a creature you control with power 4 or greater.
927484.translation: 指定一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物为目标。

927487.oracleText: Return target creature or land card from your graveyard to your hand.
927487.translation: 将目标生物或地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

927489.oracleText: When you discard a nonland card this way, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature.
927489.translation: 当你以此法弃掉一张非地牌时，CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。

927490.oracleText: Target a permanent with mana value 3 or greater.
927490.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或大于3的永久物为目标。

927491.oracleText: Search for a black card, a green card, and a blue card.
927491.translation: 搜寻一张黑色牌，一张绿色牌和一张蓝色牌。

927493.oracleText: Target up to one noncreature, nonland card.
927493.translation: 指定至多一张非生物且非地的牌为目标。

927494.oracleText: When damage is prevented this way, CARDNAME deals that much damage to that source's controller and you draw that many cards.
927494.translation: 当以此法防止伤害时，CARDNAME对该来源的操控者造成等量的伤害且你抓等量的牌。

927495.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell this turn, target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn.
927495.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放非生物咒语时，目标由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

927496.oracleText: Target a nonland card with mana value 3 or less.
927496.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌为目标。

927497.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters this turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
927497.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

927498.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters this turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
927498.translation: 本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

927500.oracleText: Whenever you attack this turn, create two 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
927500.translation: 本回合中，每当你攻击时，派出两个1/1红色战士衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

927502.oracleText: Spend only on: A Dragon Spell or an Omen Spell
927502.translation: 只能用于支付：龙咒语或预兆咒语

927503.oracleText:
"We are the voice of the untethered and lost ancestors. The memory of the Abzan. We guide those that yet live."
—Betor
927503.translation:
「我们是失落祖灵之声。阿布赞的记忆。我们指引尚存于世者。」
～贝托

927504.oracleText:
"I will give you a fair and beautiful judgment."
—Teval
927504.translation:
「我将赐予你公正而美丽的裁决。」
～特瓦尔

927505.oracleText:
"We sing and the chorus of creation responds."
—Ureni
927505.translation:
「我们歌唱，造物的和声随之而起。」
～乌列尼

927506.oracleText:
"The Way tells us we must strive towards unity of mind. Through shared understanding, we may yet put an end to strife on Tarkir."
—Shiko
927506.translation:
「道指引我们必须积力同心。唯有达成共识，我们才能终结鞑契的纷争。」
～席科

927507.oracleText:
"Strength comes from community. Together, we can destroy any enemy."
—Neriv
927507.translation:
「力量源自团结。众志成城，可灭万敌。」
～涅雳伏

927508.oracleText:
"This was where I fought my first battle under Kolaghan. How I have outgrown her."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
927508.translation:
「这里是我在寇安甘麾下初战之地。如今我已超越了她。」
～玛尔都可汗珠高

927509.oracleText:
"We remember all the world has endured, everything it has gone through to bring us to today. We are proud of Tarkir."
—Betor
927509.translation:
「我们铭记这世界经历的一切苦难，正是这些历程引领我们行至今日。我们为鞑契感到骄傲。」
～贝托

927510.oracleText:
In the mist, turbulent enough to deafen.
Beneath the boughs, serene enough to soothe.
927510.translation:
雾中喧嚣，足以蔽聪。
林下静谧，足以宁神。

927511.oracleText:
"I came here often to meditate on Ojutai's teachings. Now, I must also consider his failings."
—Narset
927511.translation:
「我常来此地冥想，参悟欧祝泰的教诲。如今，我还会思量他的过失。」
～娜尔施

927512.oracleText: Where dragonlords once schemed, their memory now dissipates.
927512.translation: 龙王谋策处，空余忆飘散。

927514.translation: 是否要移去三个喂养指示物？

927515.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, copy the card encoded onto this creature. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
927515.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以复制赋码于此生物上的牌，同时可以施放此复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

927516.translation: 是否要选择一个由你操控的生物？

927517.oracleText: Search for up to three basic Forest cards.
927517.translation: 搜寻至多三张基本的树林牌。

927523.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
927523.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

927524.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
927524.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

927525.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield, Outpost Siege deals 1 damage to any target.
927525.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，围攻哨站对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

927529.oracleText: Cast instant and sorcery spells with mana value {2, Number} or less from among them without paying their mana costs?
927529.translation: 是否要施放法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的瞬间和法术咒语，而不支付它们的法术力费用？

927530.oracleText:
"I freely trade away my breaths, for the only one I must keep is my last."
—Sopia, Skelle cleric
927530.translation:
「我愿意将呼吸全数抛弃，唯独要保留最后一息。」
～死灵僧侣索菲亚

927582.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand this turn, it gains rebound.
927582.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次从你手上施放瞬间或法术咒语时，它获得弹回异能。

927585.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
927585.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927586.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
927586.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物在你的操控下死去，则每个对手各依其选择牺牲一个生物。

927589.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and have trample and haste.
927589.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+0且具有践踏与敏捷异能。

927591.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, target player mills four cards.
927591.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，目标牌手磨四张牌。

927592.oracleText: Whenever a counter is put on a creature you control, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
927592.translation: 每当在一个由你操控的生物上放置指示物时，你抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

927593.oracleText: Whenever you attack, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature. It gains menace until end of turn.
927593.translation: 每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

927594.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. It gains lifelink and haste until end of turn.
927594.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。它获得系命与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

927602.oracleText: Destroy up to one target nonland permanent.
927602.translation: 消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。

927603.oracleText: Destroy up to one target nonland permanent.
927603.translation: 消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。

927605.oracleText: Mega Flare — This creature deals damage equal to the total mana value of other permanents you control to each opponent.
927605.translation: 百万核爆～此生物向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之其他永久物的法术力值总和。

927607.translation: 原初的生命体阿尔蒂玛

927608.oracleText: Whenever Ultima attacks, put a blight counter on target land. For as long as that land has a blight counter on it, it loses all land types and abilities and has "{oT}: Add {oC}."
927608.translation: 每当阿尔蒂玛攻击时，在目标地上放置一个枯萎指示物。只要该地上有枯萎指示物，它便失去所有地类别与异能，且具有「{oT}：加{oC}。」

927609.oracleText: Whenever you tap a land for {oC}, add an additional {oC}.
927609.translation: 每当你横置一个地以产生{oC}时，额外加{oC}。

927611.oracleText: "Chivalry requires a knight to look after his comrades-in-arms. I will not abandon you!"
927611.translation: 「如果放着你这家伙不管的话，身为一名骑士的荣耀该放在哪里？！」

927612.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each Equipment you control.
927612.translation: 你每操控一个武具，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

927613.oracleText: Adelbert Steiner gets +1/+1 for each Equipment you control.
927613.translation: 你每操控一个武具，阿德尔伯特·斯坦纳便得+1/+1。

927615.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Aerith Gainsborough.
927615.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在爱丽丝·盖恩斯巴勒上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927616.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put X +1/+1 counters on each legendary creature you control, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
927616.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，在每个由你操控的传奇生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为爱丽丝·盖恩斯巴勒上的+1/+1指示物数量。

927617.oracleText: When Aerith Gainsborough dies, put X +1/+1 counters on each legendary creature you control, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on Aerith Gainsborough.
927617.translation: 当爱丽丝·盖恩斯巴勒死去时，在每个由你操控的传奇生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为爱丽丝·盖恩斯巴勒上的+1/+1指示物数量。

927619.oracleText: Take the Elevator — Create three 1/1 colorless Hero creature tokens.
927619.translation: 乘电梯～派出三个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。

927621.oracleText: Take 59 Flights of Stairs — Tap up to three target creatures. Put a stun counter on one of them.
927621.translation: 走59层楼梯～横置至多三个目标生物。在其中一个上放置一个晕眩指示物。

927623.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Take the Elevator — Create three 1/1 colorless Hero creature tokens. 
• Take 59 Flights of Stairs — Tap up to three target creatures. Put a stun counter on one of them.
927623.translation:
选择一项～
•乘电梯～派出三个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。
•走59层楼梯～横置至多三个目标生物。在其中一个上放置一个晕眩指示物。

927624.translation: 罗扎利亚之心安布洛西亚

927625.oracleText: When Ambrosia Whiteheart enters, you may return another permanent you control to its owner's hand.
927625.translation: 当罗扎利亚之心安布洛西亚进场时，你可以将另一个由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

927626.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
927626.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

927627.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, Ambrosia Whiteheart gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
927627.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，罗扎利亚之心安布洛西亚得+1/+0直到回合结束。

927630.oracleText: "I am simply myself. No more and no less. And I want only to be free."
927630.translation: 「都不是。我就是我～只是想要自由罢了。」

927631.oracleText: Whenever Ashe attacks, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
927631.translation: 每当雅雪攻击时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张神器牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

927633.oracleText:
"Now is the time to choose! Now is the time to shape your stories! Your fate is in your hands!"
—Auron
927633.translation:
「现在正是做出抉择的时候。现在是顺从着自己心中的感觉，让故事进展下去的时刻了！」
～奥隆

927636.oracleText: Attack — Create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.
927636.translation: 攻击～派出一个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

927638.oracleText: Ability — Target creature gets +0/+4 until end of turn.
927638.translation: 能力～目标生物得+0/+4直到回合结束。

927640.oracleText: Magic — Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.
927640.translation: 魔法～消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

927644.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Attack — Create a 2/2 white Knight creature token. 
• Ability — Target creature gets +0/+4 until end of turn. 
• Magic — Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater. 
• Item — You gain 4 life.
927644.translation:
选择一项～
•攻击～派出一个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。
•能力～目标生物得+0/+4直到回合结束。
•魔法～消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。
•道具～你获得4点生命。

927647.oracleText: When Cloud enters, search your library for an Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
927647.translation: 当克劳德进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

927648.oracleText: As long as Cloud is equipped, if an ability of Cloud or an Equipment attached to it triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
927648.translation: 只要克劳德佩带武具，如果克劳德或贴附于其上之武具的异能触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

927652.oracleText: A lean and limber predator whose whiskers acquire charge from naturally-occurring electric particles in the atmosphere.
927652.translation: 兼有柔韧肌肉体质与卓越运动能力的肉食野兽。象征性的鞭须拥有能使大气中的雷元素与带电粒子发生反应以产生高压电流的功能。

927655.oracleText: {o5oWoW}: Exile this Equipment, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
927655.translation: {o5oWoW}：放逐此武具，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

927658.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to creatures you control this turn.
927658.translation: 于本回合中，防止将对由你操控的生物造成的所有伤害。

927659.oracleText: Tap all creatures your opponents control.
927659.translation: 横置所有由对手操控的生物。

927661.oracleText: Within the light, the will of the crystal surged through them. They decided to accept their destiny. And so began a journey to dispel the darkness and return light to the world . . .
927661.translation: 四个人站在光芒中，感受到被赋予自己的强大使命，决心踏上征程。去吧，挥去黑暗，再一次让光明降临于世界。

927662.oracleText: Create four 1/1 colorless Hero creature tokens. Then put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
927662.translation: 派出四个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。然后在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927664.oracleText: "A new letter has arrived just for you, kupo!"

927665.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library and/or graveyard for an artifact card with mana value 2 or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
927665.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于2的神器牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻了你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

927668.oracleText: Dragonfire Dive — During your turn, Dion and other Knights you control have flying.
927668.translation: 龙炎冲～于你的回合中，狄翁和由你操控的其他骑士具有飞行异能。

927670.oracleText: When Dion enters, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.
927670.translation: 当狄翁进场时，派出一个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

927671.oracleText: {o4oWoW}, {oT}: Exile Dion, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
927671.translation: {o4oWoW}，{oT}：放逐狄翁，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

927673.oracleText: Wings of Light — Put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. Those creatures gain flying until end of turn.
927673.translation: 巴哈姆特飞翼～在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。这些生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

927674.oracleText: Wings of Light — Put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. Those creatures gain flying until end of turn.
927674.translation: 巴哈姆特飞翼～在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。这些生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

927676.oracleText: Gigaflare — Destroy target permanent. Exile Bahamut, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
927676.translation: 十亿火光～消灭目标永久物。放逐巴哈姆特，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

927680.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and is a Knight in addition to its other types.
927680.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0，且额外具有骑士此类别。

927681.oracleText: During your turn, equipped creature has flying.
927681.translation: 于你的回合中，佩带此武具的生物具有飞行异能。

927686.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token.
927686.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。

927688.oracleText:
"You would have me destroy the Empire? Is this my duty? Is this what you want?"
—Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca
927688.translation:
「要用破魔石消灭帝国吗？破坏就是你的心愿吗？而我的义务是复仇吗？！」
～雅雪·巴拿干·达玛斯卡

927690.oracleText: Search your library for a Vehicle card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, put that card onto the battlefield instead. Then shuffle.
927690.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张载具牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果此咒语是从坟墓场中施放，则改为将该牌放进战场。然后洗牌。

927694.oracleText: The Allagan Eye — Whenever one or more other creatures and/or artifacts you control die, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
927694.translation: 红血魔眼～每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物和／或神器死去时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

927697.oracleText:
"That's the ticket! Now, let's get moving to North Mountain!"
—Galuf Baldesion
927697.translation:
「正好啊。那我们就赶快去北山吧！」
～加拉夫·巴尔德西昂

927698.oracleText: As long as you control two or more artifacts, this creature gets +2/+0.
927698.translation: 只要你操控两个或更多神器，此生物便得+2/+0。

927700.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 for each artifact you control and is an Artificer in addition to its other types.
927700.translation: 你每操控一个神器，佩带此武具的生物便得+2/+2，且额外具有神器师此类别。

927704.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token.
927704.translation: 当此载具进场时，派出一个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。

927707.oracleText: These cybersoldiers were specifically engineered to excel in combat, and serve as the powerhouse of the imperial infantry.
927707.translation: 战斗特化型的人造兵，现在已经成为尼弗尔海姆军的主力士兵。

927708.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 as long as you control another artifact.
927708.translation: 只要你操控另一个神器，此生物便得+1/+0。

927709.oracleText: {o2oW}: Search your library for a card named Magitek Infantry, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
927709.translation: {o2oW}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为魔导兵的牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

927711.oracleText: "I shall remain here and devote myself to the care of the wounded."
927711.translation: 「我要留在这里专心治疗众人。就在这里和诸君告别吧。」

927712.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on each Cleric you control.
927712.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在每个由你操控的僧侣上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927714.oracleText:
"Thanks, moogles! We're in your debt!"
—Locke Cole

927715.oracleText: For each creature you control, create a 1/2 white Moogle creature token with lifelink. Then creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
927715.translation: 你每操控一个生物，便派出一个1/2白色，具系命异能的莫古力衍生生物。然后由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

927717.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+1, has ward {o1}, and is a Knight in addition to its other types.
927717.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+1，具有守护{o1}，且额外具有骑士此类别。

927718.translation: 光明使者与英雄之盾～佩带{o4}

927721.oracleText: A feather with the power to revive those who have exhausted their strength.
927721.translation: 能令力竭者恢复活力的羽毛。
