927736.oracleText: "I am Noctis, Prince of Lucis and King of Fishing!"

927737.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. If it's an artifact or creature card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you put a card into your hand this way, create a Food token and transform this enchantment.
927737.translation: 在你的维持开始时，检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是神器或生物牌，则你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。若你以此法将牌置于你手上，则派出一个食品衍生物并转化此结界。

927739.oracleText:
"Seeing how you enjoy fishing, you should learn how to prepare your catch."
—Ignis Scientia
927739.translation:
「学一下鱼的处理方法应该会有裨益吧？」
～伊格尼斯·斯堪提亚

927740.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
927740.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲一个神器：在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

927742.oracleText: The endless struggle that raged over two thousand years had ended, and peace prevailed once more.
927742.translation: 无限之战得以终结，世界再次迎来了和平。

927743.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control plus the number of Equipment you control to target creature.
927743.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量和由你操控的武具数量之总和。

927744.oracleText: Slash of Light deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control plus the number of Equipment you control to target creature.
927744.translation: 光之一闪对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量和由你操控的武具数量之总和。

927747.oracleText: "All I can do is go forward. Keep fighting and surviving, until I find the answers I need."
927747.translation: 「眼前我只有前进。直到我找到赎罪的方法，都要战斗并留下一条命歹活。」

927748.oracleText: Snow Villiers's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
927748.translation: 斯诺·维里耶的力量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

927749.translation: 莫古力商人斯蒂尔兹金

927750.oracleText: "How about a three-piece combo of Hi-Potion, Ether, and Phoenix Pinion for 444 Gil?"
927750.translation: 「高级恢复药、以太药、不死鸟之羽，三件套装卖你444金币，买不买？」

927751.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Target opponent gains control of another target permanent you control. If they do, you draw a card.
927751.translation: {o2}，{oT}：目标对手获得另一个目标由你操控的永久物之操控权。若其如此作，则你抓一张牌。

927755.oracleText: Stampede! — Other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
927755.translation: 必杀技！！～由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

927756.oracleText: Stampede! — Other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
927756.translation: 必杀技！！～由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

927757.oracleText: Stampede! — Other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
927757.translation: 必杀技！！～由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

927758.oracleText: Stampede! — Other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
927758.translation: 必杀技！！～由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

927761.oracleText: Create three 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.
927761.translation: 派出三个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

927762.oracleText: Create three 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.
927762.translation: 派出三个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

927763.oracleText: Create three 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.
927763.translation: 派出三个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

927764.oracleText: Create three 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.
927764.translation: 派出三个2/2白色骑士衍生生物。

927765.oracleText: Ultimate End — Other creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn. Put an indestructible counter on each of them.
927765.translation: 万物终结～由你操控的其他生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。在其上各放置一个不灭指示物。

927769.oracleText: Aerial Blast — This creature deals 4 damage to target tapped creature an opponent controls.
927769.translation: 大气爆发～此生物对目标由对手操控且已横置的生物造成4点伤害。

927771.oracleText: Slipstream — Another target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains flying until end of turn.
927771.translation: 螺旋气流～另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

927772.oracleText: Slipstream — Another target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains flying until end of turn.
927772.translation: 螺旋气流～另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

927774.oracleText:
"Such devastation . . . this was not my intention!"
—Gaius van Baelsar
927774.translation:
「这…这种威力…在究极神兵的体内竟然还有这样强大的武器…」
～盖乌斯·范·巴埃萨

927775.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts and creatures. End the turn.
927775.translation: 消灭所有神器和生物。结束本回合。

927776.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts and creatures. End the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card. The player whose turn it is discards down to their maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects end.)
927776.translation: 消灭所有神器和生物。结束本回合。（放逐堆叠上的所有咒语和异能，包括此牌。轮到此回合的牌手将手牌弃至其手牌上限。生物上的伤害消失，并且注记着「本回合」与「直到回合结束」的效应均结束。）

927780.oracleText: Whenever you cast a legendary spell, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
927780.translation: 每当你施放传奇咒语时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

927781.oracleText: Hero's Sundering — {o7}, {oT}: Exile target nonland permanent. Transform Venat. Activate only as a sorcery.
927781.translation: 守护者的斩断～{o7}，{oT}：放逐目标非地永久物。转化维涅斯。只能于法术时机起动。

927784.oracleText: "For the sake of all, I beseech thee: deliver us from this fate!"
927784.translation: 「你有着不向黑暗屈服的光之意志，请你拯救这颗星球…」

927785.oracleText: Blessing of Light — At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control. Until your next turn, it gains indestructible. If that creature is legendary, draw a card.
927785.translation: 光之加护～在你回合的战斗开始时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。直到你的下一个回合，该生物获得不灭异能。如果它是传奇，则抓一张牌。

927788.oracleText: "Man in your line of work needs weapons, no? Why not try that one on for size?"
927788.translation: 「你工作应该会需要武器吧？不嫌弃的话，这个给你。」

927789.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control an Equipment, you may pay {o1}. When you do, attach target Equipment you control to target creature you control.
927789.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控武具，则你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，将目标由你操控的武具贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

927791.oracleText: "She gave her life that we might defeat the Ascians. Her sacrifice must not be in vain."
927791.translation: 「多亏了她，我们又向前迈出了一步。我们绝对不会让她白白牺牲！」

927793.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 1 life.
927793.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你获得1点生命。

927794.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1, has "Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 1 life," and is a Cleric in addition to its other types.
927794.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1，具有「每当此生物攻击时，你获得1点生命」，且额外具有僧侣此类别。

927796.oracleText: "I give unto you the last of my light, and with it, the last hope of a fading world."
927796.translation: 「请收下我体内残留的光…收下最后的希望。」

927797.oracleText: {o4oWoW}, {oT}: Creatures you control gain flying and lifelink until end of turn.
927797.translation: {o4oWoW}，{oT}：由你操控的生物获得飞行与系命异能直到回合结束。

927799.oracleText:
"You've always protected us. But you still don't understand that we looked out for you, too!"
—Dagger
927799.translation:
「就像吉坦保护着我们一样…我也想保护你…吉坦…」
～小刀

927800.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control three or more creatures, it gets +4/+4 until end of turn instead.
927800.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果你操控三个或更多生物，则改为它得+4/+4直到回合结束。

927802.oracleText: Zack Fair enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
927802.translation: 扎克斯·菲尔进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

927803.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. Put CARDNAME's counters on that creature and attach an Equipment that was attached to CARDNAME to that creature.
927803.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将CARDNAME上的指示物放置在该生物上，并将一个原本CARDNAME上贴附的武具贴附在该生物上。

927804.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Zack Fair: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. Put Zack Fair's counters on that creature and attach an Equipment that was attached to Zack Fair to that creature.
927804.translation: {o1}，牺牲扎克斯·菲尔：目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将扎克斯·菲尔上的指示物放置在该生物上，并将一个原本扎克斯·菲尔上贴附的武具贴附在该生物上。

927806.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell and whenever you draw your third card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
927806.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语和每当你抓每回合中你的第三张牌时，在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927807.oracleText: Equipped creature is a Wizard in addition to its other types and has "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell and whenever you draw your third card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
927807.translation: 佩带此武具的生物额外具有法术师此类别，且具有「每当你施放非生物咒语和每当你抓每回合中你的第三张牌时，在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」

927811.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Spend this mana only to cast an artifact spell or activate an ability of an artifact source.
927811.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语或起动神器来源的异能。

927813.oracleText:
"Clueless, aren't you? Good thing I'm here."
—Lulu
927813.translation:
「你什么都不懂啊…往后可有得操心了。」
～露露

927814.oracleText: Target player draws two cards. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.
927814.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌。在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

927816.oracleText:
"I heard that to become a dragoon, you had to make a pact with a living wyvern. However, thanks to the dragonslayers, there aren't that many dragons left."
—Ceraulian, San d'Oria citizen
927816.translation:
「据说想成为龙骑士，就要与龙缔结契约。但龙如今愈发稀少，恐怕是一露面就被屠龙者猎杀了吧。」
～桑多利亚市民瑟罗连

927817.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token.
927817.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。

927819.oracleText: "Don't go back on your word. C'mon, go wave to her."
927819.translation: 「别辜负别人的期待。上台去，和她搭讪。」

927823.oracleText: "Sabin . . . let's settle this with the toss of a coin."
927823.translation: 「马修，我们用父王给的这枚硬币决定吧。」

927824.oracleText: When Edgar enters, draw a card for each artifact you control.
927824.translation: 当埃德加进场时，你每操控一个神器，便抓一张牌。

927825.oracleText: Two-Headed Coin — The first time you flip one or more coins each turn, those coins come up heads and you win those flips.
927825.translation: 托付之币～于你每回合首度掷一枚或数枚硬币时，每掷皆为硬币正面朝上且你均猜对。

927830.oracleText: {oT}, Exile this artifact: Add {oU}. When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
927830.translation: {oT}，放逐此神器：加{oU}。本回合中，当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

927832.oracleText: "I see . . . so, you seek to save the world. Then I guess that means I shall save the world as well. Lead on! I will copy your every move."
927832.translation: 「原来如此，你们想要拯救世界啊。那我也模仿你们，去拯救世界吧。」

927833.oracleText: {oXoX}, {oT}: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control X times. You may choose new targets for the copies. This ability can't be copied and X can't be 0.
927833.translation: {oXoX}，{oT}：将目标由你操控的起动式或触发式异能复制X次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。此异能不能被复制，且X不能为0。

927834.oracleText: {oXoX}, {oT}: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control X times. You may choose new targets for the copies. This ability can't be copied and X can't be 0. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
927834.translation: {oXoX}，{oT}：将目标由你操控的起动式或触发式异能复制X次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。此异能不能被复制，且X不能为0。（其目标不能是法术力异能。）

927837.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on it.
927837.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物。在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

927839.oracleText: Blizzard — {o0} — Return target creature to its owner's hand.
927839.translation: 冰结～{o0}～将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

927840.oracleText: Blizzara — {o2} — Target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
927840.translation: 冰冻～{o2}～目标生物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

927842.oracleText: Blizzaga — {o5oU} — Target creature's owner shuffles it into their library.
927842.translation: 冰封～{o5oU}～目标生物的拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

927844.oracleText:
Tiered 
• Blizzard — {o0} — Return target creature to its owner's hand. 
• Blizzara — {o2} — Target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library. 
• Blizzaga — {o5oU} — Target creature's owner shuffles it into their library.
927844.translation:
分级
•冰结～{o0}～将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。
•冰冻～{o2}～目标生物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。
•冰封～{o5oU}～目标生物的拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

927846.oracleText: "Well now, aren't you just brimming with life? I'd love to suck up all that aether like nectar from a flower!"
927846.translation: 「你这个人真是浑身上下都充满了活力呢！要是有机会的话真想尝尝你的以太把你吃掉！」

927849.oracleText: "I'm going to help you. To give you what you need to protect us all."
927849.translation: 「我会和你一起战斗到最后一刻。我活着就是为了保护你。」

927850.oracleText: When Jill enters, return up to one other target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
927850.translation: 当吉尔进场时，将至多另一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

927851.oracleText: {o3oUoU}, {oT}: Exile Jill, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
927851.translation: {o3oUoU}，{oT}：放逐吉尔，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

927854.oracleText: "I will be your monster no more."

927855.oracleText: Mesmerize — Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
927855.translation: 冰引锥～目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

927856.oracleText: Mesmerize — Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
927856.translation: 冰引锥～目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

927858.oracleText: Cold Snap — Tap all lands your opponents control. Exile Shiva, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
927858.translation: 希瓦滑移～横置所有由对手操控的地。放逐希瓦，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

927860.oracleText:
"Thank you . . . for everything . . . Pray take your rest, Grandfather . . . You deserve it."
—Alisaie Leveilleur
927860.translation:
「爷爷…谢谢…我会继续坚持的…所以请您…安息吧…」
～阿莉塞·莱韦耶勒尔

927861.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a legendary creature or pay {o2}.
927861.translation: 牺牲一个传奇生物或支付{o2}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

927862.oracleText: Counter target activated ability, triggered ability, or noncreature spell.
927862.translation: 反击目标起动式异能，触发式异能或非生物咒语。

927864.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME attacked this turn, you may play the top card of your library.
927864.translation: 只要CARDNAME本回合中攻击过，你便可以使用你的牌库顶牌。

927865.oracleText: As long as The Lunar Whale attacked this turn, you may play the top card of your library.
927865.translation: 只要魔导船本回合中攻击过，你便可以使用你的牌库顶牌。

927869.oracleText: "Don't you know it's rude to enter without knocking? Hmph, the youth of today . . ."
927869.translation: 「这是谁啊吵吵闹闹地闯进别人住的地方。没人教过你们敲了门再进是最基本的礼仪吗？」

927870.oracleText: Whenever you scry or surveil, draw a card.
927870.translation: 每当你占卜或刺探时，抓一张牌。

927872.oracleText: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand. Then choose an opponent. They put one on the bottom of your library. Then you put one into your hand. Then they put one on the bottom of your library. Put the other into your hand.
927872.translation: 展示你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上。然后选择一位对手。他将其中一张置于你的牌库底。然后你将其中一张置于你手上。然后他将其中一张置于你的牌库底。将其他牌置于你手上。

927875.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
927875.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少四点法术力，则CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

927876.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, The Prima Vista becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
927876.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少四点法术力，则剧场艇初见号成为神器生物直到回合结束。

927879.oracleText: Small Beastmen that live alongside humans in the Aht Urhgan Empire. Their ancestors were nomads in the north, and their unique culture and customs can be seen even now.
927879.translation: 与艾拉吉亚帝国的人类共同生活的小个子兽人。祖先是北方游牧民族，至今仍然保持着独特的文化和风俗。喜爱闪闪金币。

927880.oracleText: {o7}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Draw three cards. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each Town you control.
927880.translation: {o7}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：抓三张牌。你每操控一个市镇，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

927882.oracleText: "It's not like everyone can get by on their own, you know?"
927882.translation: 「斯考尔。独自生活，不依靠任何人，这根本就不现实，明白吗？」

927883.oracleText: Blue Magic — When CARDNAME enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
927883.translation: 青魔法～当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从任一坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放该咒语。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

927884.oracleText: Blue Magic — When Quistis Trepe enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
927884.translation: 青魔法～当奎斯缇丝进场时，你可以从任一坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放该咒语。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

927887.oracleText: In her pictures she captures everything: forests, water, light . . . the very essence of the things she paints.
927887.translation: 她手中的画笔，能够将世间万物描绘到画布上…不论是森林、水、阳光，还是人的内心。

927888.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact, creature, or land.
927888.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标神器，生物或地之复制品。

927890.oracleText: Create a 3/3 blue Robot Warrior artifact creature token. Then if this spell was cast from a graveyard, put two +1/+1 counters on that token.
927890.translation: 派出一个3/3蓝色机器人／战士衍生神器生物。然后如果此咒语是从坟墓场中施放，则在该衍生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

927893.oracleText:
"'Tis unfortunate that many Ishgardians cannot appreciate the practicality of my work."
—Stephanivien de Haillenarte
927893.translation:
「我所开发出的各种机工兵器以及操纵这些兵器的机工士技巧，将彻底改写腐朽的战争史！」
～斯特凡尼维安·德·艾因哈特

927894.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
927894.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

927896.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, untap target attacking creature.
927896.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，重置目标进行攻击的生物。

927897.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0, has "Whenever this creature attacks, untap target attacking creature," and is a Cleric in addition to its other types.
927897.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0，具有「每当此生物攻击时，重置目标进行攻击的生物」且额外具有僧侣此类别。

927901.oracleText: "Pshhh . . . Shhhilence, shhhorewalker! Try to eshhhcape, and I'll shhhlice gills into your neck!"
927901.translation: 「呼嘶…给我闭嘴，无鳍类！你要是敢乱来，信不信我在你脖子上开几道鳃口？」

927902.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and it can't be blocked this turn.
927902.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少四点法术力，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且它本回合不能被阻挡。

927905.oracleText:
"Barret, be careful! Attack while its tail's up, it's gonna counterattack with its laser."
—Cloud Strife
927905.translation:
「巴雷特，当心！在它竖起尾巴的时候进攻，它就会用激光反击。」
～克劳德·斯特莱夫

927906.oracleText: As long as you control seven or more lands, this creature gets +3/+0.
927906.translation: 只要你操控七个或更多地，此生物便得+3/+0。

927908.oracleText: The glory of the tourney awaits!

927909.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, draw three cards, then discard two cards.
927909.translation: 当此结界进场时，抓三张牌，然后弃两张牌。

927910.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if eight or more cards are in your graveyard, transform this enchantment.
927910.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，则转化此结界。

927913.oracleText: When enchanted creature is dealt damage, sacrifice this Aura.
927913.translation: 当所结附的生物受到伤害时，牺牲此灵气。

927915.oracleText: "It's a little tight, but the price was right!"

927916.oracleText: Choose target creature you control and target Equipment. Gain control of that Equipment until end of turn. Attach it to the chosen creature. When you lose control of that Equipment this turn, if it's attached to a creature you control, unattach it.
927916.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物和目标武具。获得该武具的操控权直到回合结束。将它贴附在该生物上。本回合中，当你失去该武具的操控权时，若它贴附在由你操控的生物上，则将它卸装。

927920.oracleText: Return each creature that isn't a Kraken, Leviathan, Merfolk, Octopus, or Serpent to its owner's hand.
927920.translation: 将每个不是巨海兽、海怪、人鱼、章鱼或巨蛇的生物移回其拥有者手上。

927921.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a Kraken, Leviathan, Merfolk, Octopus, or Serpent attacks, draw a card.
927921.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个巨海兽、海怪、人鱼，章鱼或巨蛇攻击时，抓一张牌。

927922.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a Kraken, Leviathan, Merfolk, Octopus, or Serpent attacks, draw a card.
927922.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个巨海兽、海怪、人鱼，章鱼或巨蛇攻击时，抓一张牌。

927924.oracleText: "Let us summon a sea in a new dream world."
927924.translation: 「在新的梦中世界里创造一片海吧…」

927925.oracleText: Heavenly Strike — Tap target creature an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on it.
927925.translation: 天降一击～横置目标由对手操控的生物。在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

927926.oracleText: Heavenly Strike — Tap target creature an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on it.
927926.translation: 天降一击～横置目标由对手操控的生物。在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

927927.oracleText: Diamond Dust — Draw a card for each tapped creature your opponents control.
927927.translation: 钻石星尘～所有对手每操控一个已横置的生物，你便抓一张牌。

927930.oracleText: Choose target spell. Surveil 2, then counter the chosen spell unless its controller pays {o1} for each card in your graveyard.
927930.translation: 选择目标咒语。刺探2，然后除非该咒语的操控者为每张在你坟墓场中的牌各支付{o1}，否则反击之。

927931.oracleText: "Your eyes, they burn with resolve . . . beautiful."
927931.translation: 「那全力以赴的眼神，实在很美。」

927933.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1, has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card," and is a Rogue in addition to its other types.
927933.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1，具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌」，且额外具有浪客此类别。

927935.oracleText:
"My dad always wanted me to go out and travel the world. But it also feels like . . . like the wind is calling me."
—Bartz Klauser
927935.translation:
「我老爸临终前告诉我，要我到世界各地旅行，增长见识…而且…风在呼唤我！」
～巴兹·克劳泽

927938.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
927938.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少四点法术力，则横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

927939.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least eight mana was spent to cast it, put eight +1/+1 counters on Ultros.
927939.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少八点法术力，则在奥尔特罗斯上放置八个+1/+1指示物。

927942.oracleText:
"Crystal of water, may you regain your light."
—Aria Benett
927942.translation:
「水之水晶啊…重现光芒吧！！」
～艾丽娅·贝尼特

927943.oracleText: If an opponent would mill one or more cards, they mill that many cards plus four instead.
927943.translation: 如果某对手将磨一张或数张牌，则改为该牌手磨该数量加四的牌。

927944.oracleText: {o4oUoU}, {oT}: Each opponent mills cards equal to the number of cards in your hand.
927944.translation: {o4oUoU}，{oT}：每位对手各磨等同于你手牌数量的牌。

927946.oracleText: "As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."
927946.translation: 「这里的以太流动紊乱果然是人为的。」

927947.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. Then if it's the first end step of the turn, there is an additional end step after this step.
927947.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，放逐目标由你操控的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。然后若当前是本回合的首个结束步骤，则在此步骤后额外多出一个结束步骤。

927949.oracleText: "The Wrath of Dark has nearly reached its zenith! No one can stop it! Least of all you!"
927949.translation: 「很快黑暗的泛滥就将完全开始！谁也无法阻止了！你们将会葬身于此！！」

927950.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Draw a card.
927950.translation: {o3}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：抓一张牌。

927953.oracleText: "We found the airship! The records were right."
927953.translation: 「终于找到飞空艇了啊！记录是正确的。」

927954.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature or artifact you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
927954.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物或神器死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

927957.oracleText: Demons you control have menace, lifelink, and haste.
927957.translation: 由你操控的恶魔具有威慑、系命与敏捷异能。

927958.oracleText: Starscourge — At the beginning of combat on your turn, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If you exiled a card this way, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 5/5 black Demon.
927958.translation: 星之病～在你回合的战斗开始时，将至多一张目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。如果你以此法放逐了牌，则你派出一个为该牌之复制品的衍生物，但它是5/5黑色恶魔。

927961.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0, has "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent," and is a Wizard in addition to its other types.
927961.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0，具有「每当你施放非生物咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害」，且额外具有法术师此类别。

927963.oracleText: "I suppose this is my fate as a dark knight. Soon, I won't even feel remorse for my actions."
927963.translation: 「和我这身暗黑骑士的装扮一样…我的内心也被染黑了…」

927964.oracleText: Darkness — Whenever Cecil deals damage, you lose that much life. Then if your life total is less than or equal to half your starting life total, untap Cecil and transform it.
927964.translation: 暗黑～每当塞西尔造成伤害时，你失去等量的生命。然后如果你的总生命等于或小于你起始总生命的一半，则重置塞西尔并转化它。

927966.oracleText: "This is my battle, one I must fight alone to atone for my wrongs."
927966.translation: 「这是我与自己的战斗！为了赎清曾经犯下的罪孽…我要把这家伙，把过去的自己打倒！」

927967.oracleText: Protect — Whenever Cecil attacks, other attacking creatures gain indestructible until end of turn.
927967.translation: 护盾～每当塞西尔攻击时，其他进行攻击的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

927969.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this token deals 1 damage to each opponent.
927969.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此衍生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

927970.oracleText: You draw two cards and you lose 2 life. Create a 0/1 black Wizard creature token with "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this token deals 1 damage to each opponent."
927970.translation: 你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。派出一个0/1黑色法术师衍生生物，且具有「每当你施放非生物咒语时，此衍生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。」

927971.oracleText: Wizards you control get +1/+0 and gain lifelink until end of turn.
927971.translation: 由你操控的法术师得+1/+0且获得系命异能直到回合结束。

927973.oracleText:
"Kuja called them black mages, dark spawn of the mist."
—The Soulcage
927973.translation:
「有了黑魔法师军团和召唤兽，布拉妮女王已经所向无敌了！」
～亚历山德里亚士兵

927974.oracleText: Create a 0/1 black Wizard creature token with "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this token deals 1 damage to each opponent."
927974.translation: 派出一个0/1黑色法术师衍生生物，且具有「每当你施放非生物咒语时，此衍生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。」

927975.translation: 「我们是天使无影…是为了让这颗星球取回『真正的姿态』，驱逐光明、散播黑暗的使者…」

927977.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+0 and is a Knight in addition to its other types.
927977.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+0，且额外具有骑士此类别。

927978.oracleText: Chaosbringer — Equip—Pay 3 life. Activate only once each turn.
927978.translation: 混沌使者～佩带～支付3点生命。每回合只能起动一次。

927981.oracleText: If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, instead exile it and you gain 2 life.
927981.translation: 如果某个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐且你获得2点生命。

927982.oracleText: {o4oBoB}, {oT}: Put target creature card exiled with CARDNAME onto the battlefield tapped under your control with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
927982.translation: {o4oBoB}，{oT}：将目标以CARDNAME放逐的生物牌在你的操控下横置放进战场，且上面额外有两个+1/+1指示物。

927983.oracleText: {o4oBoB}, {oT}: Put target creature card exiled with The Darkness Crystal onto the battlefield tapped under your control with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
927983.translation: {o4oBoB}，{oT}：将目标以暗之水晶放逐的生物牌在你的操控下横置放进战场，且上面额外有两个+1/+1指示物。

927985.oracleText: As long as this creature has a counter on it, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
927985.translation: 只要此生物上有指示物，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

927986.oracleText: {o5oB}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
927986.translation: {o5oB}：在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

927988.oracleText: "Galuf. It's good to see you again . . . Mwa-hahahahaha!"

927989.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
927989.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面额外有两个+1/+1指示物。

927991.oracleText: "If I don't figure out our Focus soon . . . Vanille's gonna be a Cie'th. I'll tear down the sky if it'll save her."
927991.translation: 「我只想赶快找出使命并解决这一切…否则班尼拉便会变成尸骸。只要那女孩平安，我怎样都无所谓。」

927992.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, you draw a card and you lose 1 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.
927992.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

927994.oracleText: "Just hang in there! Someday we'll look back at these hard times and laugh."
927994.translation: 「坚持，坚持！现在的辛苦，将来一定可以笑着回顾的。」

927996.oracleText: Create two tapped 2/2 black Horror creature tokens. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, instead create X of those tokens, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
927996.translation: 派出两个2/2黑色，已横置的惊惧兽衍生生物。如果此咒语是从坟墓场中施放，则改为派出X个此类衍生物，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

927999.oracleText: Each player sacrifices a creature token of their choice.
927999.translation: 每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个衍生生物。

928000.oracleText: Each player sacrifices a creature token of their choice.
928000.translation: 每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个衍生生物。

928001.oracleText: Each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
928001.translation: 每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

928002.oracleText: Each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
928002.translation: 每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

928003.oracleText: Each player sacrifices an enchantment of their choice.
928003.translation: 每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个结界。

928004.oracleText: Each player sacrifices an enchantment of their choice.
928004.translation: 每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个结界。

928005.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Each player sacrifices a creature token of their choice. 
• Each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice. 
• Each player sacrifices an enchantment of their choice.
928005.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～
•每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个衍生生物。
•每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。
•每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个结界。

928006.oracleText:
When Gaius van Baelsar enters, choose one — 
• Each player sacrifices a creature token of their choice. 
• Each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice. 
• Each player sacrifices an enchantment of their choice.
928006.translation:
当盖乌斯·范·巴埃萨进场时，选择一项～
•每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个衍生生物。
•每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。
•每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个结界。

928009.oracleText:
"Once, the monsters of Hell poured forth into the world. They entered using a path known as the Jade Passage." 
—Hilda, Princess of Fynn
928009.translation:
「魔物们通过名叫『翡翠通道』的道路来到了这个世界。」
～菲因公主希尔妲

928011.oracleText: "Well, well, trying to follow in my footsteps, are you?"
928011.translation: 「哎呀呀～这不是杰克特家的小少爷吗？」

928012.oracleText: Whenever Jecht deals combat damage to a player, you may exile it, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.
928012.translation: 每当杰克特对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以放逐它，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

928015.oracleText: Jecht Beam — Each opponent discards a card and you draw a card.
928015.translation: 杰克特光束～每位对手各弃一张牌，且你抓一张牌。

928016.oracleText: Jecht Beam — Each opponent discards a card and you draw a card.
928016.translation: 杰克特光束～每位对手各弃一张牌，且你抓一张牌。

928017.oracleText: Ultimate Jecht Shot — Each opponent sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
928017.translation: 真·杰克特射门～每位对手各依其选择牺牲两个生物。

928020.oracleText: Jump — During your turn, Kain has flying.
928020.translation: 跳跃～于你的回合中，凯因具有飞行异能。

928021.oracleText: Whenever Kain deals combat damage to a player, that player gains control of Kain. If they do, you draw that many cards, create that many tapped Treasure tokens, then lose that much life.
928021.translation: 每当凯因对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手获得凯因的操控权。若其如此作，则你抓等量的牌，派出等量已横置的珍宝衍生物，然后失去等量的生命。

928023.oracleText: Bad Breath — When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card, loses 2 life, and exiles the top three cards of their library.
928023.translation: 臭气～当此生物进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌，失去2点生命，并放逐其牌库顶的三张牌。

928027.oracleText: When this creature enters, you lose 1 life and create a Treasure token.
928027.translation: 当此生物进场时，你失去1点生命并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

928028.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, surveil 2.
928028.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则刺探2。

928030.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card. That player loses life equal to the discarded card's mana value.
928030.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。该牌手失去等同于所之弃牌法术力值的生命。

928031.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1, is a Ninja in addition to its other types, and has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card. That player loses life equal to the discarded card's mana value."
928031.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1，额外具有忍者此类别，且具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。该牌手失去等同于所之弃牌法术力值的生命。」

928035.oracleText:
"Hey why don't ya try out that sword I gave you!"
—Wakka

928036.oracleText: Target creature gets -0/-9999 until end of turn.
928036.translation: 目标生物得-0/-9999直到回合结束。

928038.oracleText: Sacrifice another artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this Vehicle. It becomes a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
928038.translation: 牺牲另一个神器或生物：在此载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。直到回合结束，它成为精怪神器生物，且仍具有原本类别。

928040.oracleText: "Hee-hee . . . Nothing beats the sweet music of hundreds of voices screaming in unison! Uwee-hee-hee!"
928040.translation: 「嘻嘻嘻…由成百上千的悲鸣奏响的交响乐…真是优美动听啊。嘻嘻嘻…」

928041.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• All creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn. 
• Target player reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it. That player discards that card.
928041.translation:
选择一项～
•所有生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。
•目标牌手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张神器或生物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

928043.oracleText: They willfully attain an undead existence to serve their foul mistresses for eternity.
928043.translation: 腐尸鬼生前受到拉米亚的蛊惑，为了永远侍奉她们而在活着时通过特殊修炼成为了不死者。

928044.oracleText: Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard.
928044.translation: 将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。

928045.oracleText: Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard.
928045.translation: 将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。

928046.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Destroy target creature that was dealt damage this turn. 
• Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard.
928046.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～
•消灭目标本回合中受过伤害的生物。
•将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。

928048.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of that player's library. Then you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, you may play the exiled card this turn, and mana of any type can be spent to cast it.
928048.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐该牌手的牌库顶牌。然后你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则本回合中你可以使用所放逐的牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放之。

928049.oracleText: Whenever Reno and Rude deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of that player's library. Then you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, you may play the exiled card this turn, and mana of any type can be spent to cast it.
928049.translation: 每当雷诺与路德对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐该牌手的牌库顶牌。然后你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则本回合中你可以使用所放逐的牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放之。

928051.oracleText: "The Jenova Project resulted in my conception."
928051.translation: 「…我就是那个被制造出来的人。」

928052.translation: 传奇神罗战士萨菲罗斯

928054.oracleText: Whenever Sephiroth enters or attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card.
928054.translation: 每当萨菲罗斯进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

928055.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. If this is the fourth time this ability has resolved this turn, transform Sephiroth.
928055.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。如果这是此异能在本回合第四次的结算，则转化萨菲罗斯。

928058.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
928058.translation: 每当一个生物死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

928059.oracleText: Super Nova — As this creature transforms into CARDNAME, you get an emblem with "Whenever a creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
928059.translation: 超新星～于此生物转化为CARDNAME时，你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当一个生物死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。」

928060.oracleText: Super Nova — As this creature transforms into Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel, you get an emblem with "Whenever a creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
928060.translation: 超新星～于此生物转化为孤翼天使萨菲罗斯时，你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当一个生物死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。」

928062.oracleText: Whenever Sephiroth attacks, you may sacrifice any number of other creatures. If you do, draw that many cards.
928062.translation: 每当萨菲罗斯攻击时，你可以牺牲任意数量的其他生物。若你如此作，则抓等量的牌。

928064.oracleText: "Fate is not to be taken lightly, Cloud."

928065.oracleText: Destroy target creature. You gain 2 life.
928065.translation: 消灭目标生物。你获得2点生命。

928068.oracleText: Cie'th are damned to wander the world unliving and undying, until their corrupted flesh at last can move no more.
928068.translation: 变成尸骸后的人，非但内心被万般的悔恨与悲叹覆盖，且会丧失那以外的一切。变成尸骸后的人没有任何得救的方法。

928069.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {oB}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
928069.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

928072.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards and you gain 3 life.
928072.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨三张牌且你获得3点生命。

928074.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, destroy up to one target creature.
928074.translation: 当此结界进场时，消灭至多一个目标生物。

928075.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under an opponent's control this turn, create a Treasure token. Then if you control three or more Treasures, transform this enchantment.
928075.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物在对手的操控下死去，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后如果你操控三个或更多珍宝，则转化此结界。

928077.oracleText: Legend says it is an Anima, guardian to a sacred blade. Though most sacred amongst its kind, its great power drove it to madness, and in the end, it became a threat to its own creator.
928077.translation: 传说中守护圣剑的神兽。虽是龙中最为神圣的存在，但由于力量太过强大而丧失理性，最终成为神无法掌控的危险存在。

928078.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Yiazmat gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
928078.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：亚兹马特获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

928081.oracleText: Pain — You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
928081.translation: 痛苦～你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

928082.oracleText: Pain — You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
928082.translation: 痛苦～你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

928083.oracleText: Pain — You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
928083.translation: 痛苦～你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

928084.oracleText: Oblivion — Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice and loses 3 life.
928084.translation: 忘却～每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个生物并失去3点生命。

928086.oracleText: The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.

928087.oracleText: Gungnir — Destroy target creature an opponent controls.
928087.translation: 神枪昆古尼尔～消灭目标由对手操控的生物。

928089.oracleText: Zantetsuken — This creature gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game."
928089.translation: 斩铁剑～此生物获得「每当此生物对牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏。」

928091.oracleText: Hall of Sorrow — Draw two cards. Each player loses 2 life.
928091.translation: 悔恨殿～抓两张牌。每位牌手各失去2点生命。

928095.oracleText: Fearful monsters that creep ever forward, knives poised with deadly intent.
928095.translation: 恐怖魔物缓缓逼近，摆刀架势露出致命恶意。

928096.oracleText: This creature enters tapped with a stun counter on it.
928096.translation: 此生物须横置进场，且上面有一个晕眩指示物。

928097.oracleText: Chef's Knife — During your turn, this creature has first strike and deathtouch.
928097.translation: 菜刀～于你的回合中，此生物具有先攻与死触异能。

928100.oracleText:
"I finally worked out how to get the door on the left side open! I hope there's somethin' in there besides rats . . ."
—Kytes, street urchin
928100.translation:
「总算做好打开左侧的门的准备了。一直打老鼠，你应该也腻了吧？」
～街头孤儿凯兹

928101.oracleText: Rat Tail — When this creature dies, create a Treasure token.
928101.translation: 鼠尾巴～当此生物死去时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

928105.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME equal to that creature's power.
928105.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于该生物的力量。

928106.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters on Vincent Valentine equal to that creature's power.
928106.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在文森特·瓦伦丁上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于该生物的力量。

928107.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may transform it.
928107.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以转化它。

928108.oracleText: Whenever Vincent Valentine attacks, you may transform it.
928108.translation: 每当文森特·瓦伦丁攻击时，你可以转化它。

928111.oracleText: "This body is . . . the punishment that's been given to me . . ."

928112.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return it to the battlefield tapped.
928112.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它横置移回战场。

928113.oracleText: When Galian Beast dies, return it to the battlefield tapped (front face up).
928113.translation: 当加利亚野兽死去时，将它横置移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

928123.oracleText: My First Friend — When CARDNAME enters, choose a creature an opponent controls. Until end of turn, creatures other than CARDNAME and the chosen creature get -2/-2.
928123.translation: 我的挚友～当CARDNAME进场时，选择一个由对手操控的生物。直到回合结束，除CARDNAME与所选生物以外的其他生物得-2/-2。

928124.oracleText: My First Friend — When Zenos yae Galvus enters, choose a creature an opponent controls. Until end of turn, creatures other than Zenos yae Galvus and the chosen creature get -2/-2.
928124.translation: 我的挚友～当芝诺斯·耶·加尔乌斯进场时，选择一个由对手操控的生物。直到回合结束，除芝诺斯·耶·加尔乌斯与所选生物以外的其他生物得-2/-2。

928126.oracleText: When the chosen creature leaves the battlefield, transform CARDNAME.
928126.translation: 当所选生物离开战场时，转化CARDNAME。

928127.oracleText: When the chosen creature leaves the battlefield, transform Zenos yae Galvus.
928127.translation: 当所选生物离开战场时，转化芝诺斯·耶·加尔乌斯。

928129.oracleText: "The heavens are too small a field for our dance. Let us transcend this mortal coil!"
928129.translation: 「这片天空对神龙来说太狭窄了…让我们去更高的地方一决死战！」

928130.oracleText: As this creature transforms into Shinryu, choose an opponent.
928130.translation: 于此生物转化为神龙时，选择一位对手。

928131.oracleText: Burning Chains — When the chosen player loses the game, you win the game.
928131.translation: 火焰链～当该牌手输掉这盘游戏时，你赢得这盘游戏。

928134.oracleText: When Zodiark enters, each player sacrifices half the non-God creatures they control of their choice, rounded down.
928134.translation: 当佐迪亚克进场时，每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一半由其操控且非神的生物，小数点后舍去。

928135.oracleText: Whenever a player sacrifices another creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Zodiark.
928135.translation: 每当任一牌手牺牲另一个生物时，在佐迪亚克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928137.oracleText: "You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain?"

928138.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals damage equal to the number of equipped creatures you control to defending player.
928138.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对防御牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控且佩带武具的生物数量。

928139.oracleText: Whenever Barret Wallace attacks, it deals damage equal to the number of equipped creatures you control to defending player.
928139.translation: 每当巴雷特·华莱士攻击时，它对防御牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控且佩带武具的生物数量。

928141.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
928141.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少四点法术力，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928142.oracleText: Blow Up — {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals damage equal to its power to target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
928142.translation: 自爆～{oT}，牺牲此生物：它对目标生物造成等同于其力量的伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

928145.oracleText: Whenever a land you control enters, this token gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
928145.translation: 每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此衍生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

928146.oracleText: Search your library for a Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Create a 2/2 green Bird creature token with "Whenever a land you control enters, this token gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
928146.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张山脉牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。派出一个2/2绿色鸟衍生生物，且具有「每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此衍生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

928148.oracleText: The other colorations of chocobo tend to be quite violent, giving rise to the saying: "Yellow, best for riding; aught else, best be hiding."
928148.translation: 黄色的陆行鸟是最为普遍的一种，业已确认尚有数种野生种，黄色以外的基本上都具有凶暴、易怒的性格。

928149.oracleText: Choco-Comet deals X damage to any target.
928149.translation: 陆行鸟彗星对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

928150.oracleText: Create a 2/2 green Bird creature token with "Whenever a land you control enters, this token gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
928150.translation: 派出一个2/2绿色鸟衍生生物，且具有「每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此衍生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

928151.translation: 伊弗利特显化者克莱夫

928152.oracleText: When Clive enters, you may discard your hand, then draw cards equal to your devotion to red.
928152.translation: 当克莱夫进场时，你可以弃掉你的手牌，然后抓等同于你红色献力数量的牌。

928153.oracleText: {o4oRoR}, {oT}: Exile Clive, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
928153.translation: {o4oRoR}，{oT}：放逐克莱夫，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

928156.oracleText: "Let the flames burn within you! No . . . let them burn without!"
928156.translation: 「我已经认同了自己！我可以使用那股力量！」

928157.oracleText: Lunge — Ifrit fights up to one other target creature.
928157.translation: 突刺～伊弗利特与至多另一个目标生物互斗。

928158.oracleText: Brimstone — Add {oRoRoRoR}. If Ifrit has three or more lore counters on it, exile it, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
928158.translation: 硫磺石壁～加{oRoRoRoR}。如果伊弗利特上有三个或更多学问指示物，则放逐它，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

928159.oracleText: Brimstone — Add {oRoRoRoR}. If Ifrit has three or more lore counters on it, exile it, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
928159.translation: 硫磺石壁～加{oRoRoRoR}。如果伊弗利特上有三个或更多学问指示物，则放逐它，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

928161.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control. That creature gains first strike until end of turn.
928161.translation: 当此武具进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。该生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

928163.oracleText: "Warriors of Light . . . Only you can restore hope to the world, for yours is the light that can balance out the darkness . . ."
928163.translation: 「光之战士们…平衡光与暗的勇者们啊，让希望再次降临于这个世界吧…」

928164.oracleText: {o4oRoR}, {oT}: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
928164.translation: {o4oRoR}，{oT}：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

928166.oracleText: Fire — {o0} — CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature.
928166.translation: 火炎～{o0}～CARDNAME对每个生物各造成1点伤害。

928167.oracleText: Fire — {o0} — Fire Magic deals 1 damage to each creature.
928167.translation: 火炎～{o0}～火魔法对每个生物各造成1点伤害。

928168.oracleText: Fira — {o2} — CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature.
928168.translation: 烈炎～{o2}～CARDNAME对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

928169.oracleText: Fira — {o2} — Fire Magic deals 2 damage to each creature.
928169.translation: 烈炎～{o2}～火魔法对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

928171.oracleText: Firaga — {o5} — CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each creature.
928171.translation: 爆炎～{o5}～CARDNAME对每个生物各造成3点伤害。

928172.oracleText: Firaga — {o5} — Fire Magic deals 3 damage to each creature.
928172.translation: 爆炎～{o5}～火魔法对每个生物各造成3点伤害。

928174.oracleText:
Tiered 
• Fire — {o0} — CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature. 
• Fira — {o2} — CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature. 
• Firaga — {o5} — CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each creature.
928174.translation:

928324.oracleText: "Call me Bartz. Me and my chocobo just go wherever the trail leads us . . ."
928324.translation: 「我叫巴兹。和陆行鸟一起四处旅行…」

928326.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each other Bird you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
928326.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每个由你操控的其他鸟各向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

928327.oracleText: When Bartz and Boko enters, each other Bird you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
928327.translation: 当巴兹与波可进场时，每个由你操控的其他鸟各向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

928329.oracleText:
"Everyone seems to be calling for Wakka, folks!"
—Blitzball announcer
928329.translation:
「全场观众们热烈地高呼着瓦卡选手的名字！」
～水斗球主播

928331.oracleText: A cactus with legs that loves to run hither and thither. Watch out for its thorns!
928331.translation: 会动的仙人掌，触碰到会有危险，小心四处奔跑的它吧。

928332.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if this creature didn't enter the battlefield this turn, return it to its owner's hand.
928332.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若此生物并非本回合中进战场，则将它移回其拥有者手上。

928334.oracleText: Kicker—Return a land you control to its owner's hand.
928334.translation: 增幅～将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

928335.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls. If this spell was kicked, the creature you control deals twice that much damage instead.
928335.translation: 目标由你操控的生物向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为该由你操控的生物造成该数量两倍的伤害。

928337.oracleText:
"No matter how you make your bet, you win some and you lose some. It all comes down to skill and luck."
—Racing expert
928337.translation:
「不管你怎样下注，都可能有赢有输，结果取决于技巧和运气。」
～赛鸟专家

928338.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 2/2 green Bird creature token with "Whenever a land you control enters, this token gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
928338.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个2/2绿色鸟衍生生物，且具有「每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此衍生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

928340.oracleText: Remove a lore counter from target Saga you control.
928340.translation: 从目标由你操控的传纪上移去一个学问指示物。

928341.oracleText: Put a lore counter on target Saga you control.
928341.translation: 在目标由你操控的传纪上放置一个学问指示物。

928342.oracleText:
Choose one or more — 
• Target creature you control fights target creature an opponent controls. 
• Remove a lore counter from target Saga you control. 
• Put a lore counter on target Saga you control.
928342.translation:
选择一项或多项～
•目标由你操控的生物与目标由对手操控的生物互斗。
•从目标由你操控的传纪上移去一个学问指示物。
•在目标由你操控的传纪上放置一个学问指示物。

928344.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment. 
• Draw a card.
928344.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～
•消灭目标神器或结界。
•抓一张牌。

928347.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact, creature, or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
928347.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中一张神器，生物或地牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

928349.oracleText: A tutelary creature said only to appear when the planet is in grave danger.
928349.translation: 星球制造的怪兽。星球遇到危机的时候，它们就会出现，扫平一切。

928350.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each permanent card in your graveyard.
928350.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张永久物牌，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

928351.oracleText: Immune — Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to CARDNAME.
928351.translation: 无效～防止将对CARDNAME造成的所有战斗伤害。

928352.oracleText: Immune — Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to Diamond Weapon.
928352.translation: 无效～防止将对钻石神兵造成的所有战斗伤害。

928355.oracleText: {o4oGoG}, {oT}: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control.
928355.translation: {o4oGoG}，{oT}：将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标由你操控的生物。

928357.oracleText: Surveil 2. You gain 2 life. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, exile it, then put it onto the battlefield transformed under its owner's control with a finality counter on it.
928357.translation: 刺探2。你获得2点生命。如果此咒语是从坟墓场施放，则将它放逐，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下放进战场，其为已转化且上面有一个终命指示物。

928359.oracleText: "I've chosen a name for her . . . Terra."

928360.oracleText: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a permanent card, put it into your hand.
928360.translation: 展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是永久物牌，则将它置于你手上。

928362.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.
928362.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

928364.oracleText: "I'll destroy you Exdeath . . . even if it means I have to take you into the afterlife myself!"
928364.translation: 「即使燃尽生命！我也要将你打倒！！」

928365.oracleText: When this creature dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on up to one target creature.
928365.translation: 当此生物死去时，在至多一个目标生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于前者的力量。

928366.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on up to one target creature."
928366.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得「当此生物死去时，在至多一个目标生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于前者的力量。」

928368.oracleText: The gigantoad is known to venture outside of its comfort zone during downpours—much to the surprise of unsuspecting hikers.
928368.translation: 巨蟾蜍在雨天时，行动范围一下子就变得十分之广，可能会在意想不到的地方遇见它。

928369.oracleText: As long as you control seven or more lands, this creature gets +2/+2.
928369.translation: 只要你操控七个或更多地，此生物便得+2/+2。

928371.oracleText: The parasitic moss that grows in the folds of the goobbue's back is highly valued as an ingredient in various potions and medicines.
928371.translation: 因寄生在古菩猩猩背部皱褶里的苔藓可作为秘药与妙药的珍贵原料，为此而来的挑战者亦不在少数。

928373.oracleText: A mysterious beast that has grown large on its journey across Gran Pulse. Its children, known as microchus, accompany the ochu in combat against adventurers.
928373.translation: 识破了名为极限的狡猾幻象，逆天演之流而上的「食腐兽」。

928374.oracleText: {o8}: Until end of turn, this creature gets +1/+1 for each permanent card in your graveyard.
928374.translation: {o8}：你坟墓场中每有一张永久物牌，此生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

928377.oracleText: Some Cactuars live long lives and grow huge. This Jumbo Cactuar is one of them.
928377.translation: 一些仙人刺由于生长时间过久而十分巨大，这个巨型仙人刺无疑就是其中之一。

928378.oracleText: 10,000 Needles — Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +9999/+0 until end of turn.
928378.translation: 万针刺～每当此生物攻击时，它得+9999/+0直到回合结束。

928382.oracleText: "I've come to realize that it's important to put down the book every now and then, and experience some adventures for myself."
928382.translation: 「虽然像这样读书也不错，但我今后更想直接去亲身体验一下。」

928383.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
928383.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

928385.oracleText: "There's only one reason. They smell an adventure! C'mon! We've got no time to lose!"
928385.translation: 「他们都去了那还用说吗！肯定是有乐子啊！该死，我们也去！」

928386.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card or Town card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. When you search your library this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
928386.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或市镇牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。当你以此法搜寻你的牌库时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928389.oracleText: "World only have two things: Things you can eat and things you no can eat."
928389.translation: 「世界上只有两种东西：可以吃的和不可以吃的的说！」

928390.oracleText: If one or more tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus a 1/1 green Frog creature token are created instead.
928390.translation: 如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出该些衍生物加上一个1/1绿色蛙衍生生物。

928391.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a Frog: Put a +1/+1 counter on Quina.
928391.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个蛙：在阿馋上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928393.oracleText:
"Guess this is goodbye, City of Mako."
—Tifa Lockhart
928393.translation:
「要向米德加告别了呢。」
～蒂法·洛克哈特

928394.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Town cards with different names, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
928394.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多两张名称各不相同的基本地牌和／或市镇牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

928396.translation: 「从现在起我们正式进入第七星历！」

928397.oracleText: Other permanents you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
928397.translation: 由你操控的其他永久物具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

928400.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
928400.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928401.oracleText: {o5oGoG}: This enchantment becomes a 7/7 Beast creature in addition to its other types.
928401.translation: {o5oGoG}：此结界成为7/7野兽生物，且仍具有原本类别。

928403.oracleText:
"Are you okay? You should be able to move now."
—Rydia, Summoner of Mist
928403.translation:
「没事了，已经可以动了！」
～迷雾召唤师莉迪亚

928404.oracleText:
Choose one —

选择一项～

928408.translation: 当萨兹·卡兹罗伊进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张鸟或基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

928409.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature.
928409.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后将该生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

928410.oracleText: Whenever Sazh Katzroy attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature.
928410.translation: 每当萨兹·卡兹罗伊攻击时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后将该生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

928412.oracleText: The chick has no name, as voicing the true identity of the animal might trigger ripples of destiny across Cocoon and cause a hurricane in Eden. Either that, or Sazh just hasn't thought of one yet.
928412.translation: 本名不明，其真实身份隐藏了攸关「茧」存亡的秘密…是太离谱的假设，单纯只是因为萨兹还没决定名字。

928413.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
928413.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928415.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 2/2 green Bird creature token with "Whenever a land you control enters, this token gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
928415.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个2/2绿色鸟衍生生物，且具有「每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此衍生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

928416.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, if you control four or more Birds, transform this enchantment.
928416.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，若你操控四个或更多鸟，则转化此结界。

928418.oracleText: When this permanent transforms into CARDNAME, search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
928418.translation: 当此永久物转化为CARDNAME时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

928419.oracleText: When this permanent transforms into Black Chocobo, search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
928419.translation: 当此永久物转化为黑陆行鸟时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

928420.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, Birds you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
928420.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，由你操控的鸟得+1/+0直到回合结束。

928424.oracleText: Wark — Create a 2/2 green Bird creature token with "Whenever a land you control enters, this token gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
928424.translation: 咕哎～派出一个2/2绿色鸟衍生生物，且具有「每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此衍生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

928426.oracleText: Kerplunk — Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
928426.translation: 庞大重击～由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

928427.oracleText: Kerplunk — Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
928427.translation: 庞大重击～由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

928428.oracleText: Kerplunk — Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
928428.translation: 庞大重击～由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

928431.oracleText: "Who dares summon me from the darkness?"
928431.translation: 「是谁将吾从幽暗天穹中唤醒…」

928432.oracleText: Crescent Fang — Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
928432.translation: 新月利齿～从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

928434.oracleText: Heavenward Howl — When you next cast a creature spell this turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
928434.translation: 苍穹狼嚎～本回合中，当你下一次施放生物咒语时，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

928436.oracleText: Ecliptic Growl — Draw a card if you control the creature with the greatest power or tied for the greatest power.
928436.translation: 蚀日长啸～如果你操控力量最大或与他者同为最大的生物，则抓一张牌。

928441.oracleText: Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
928441.translation: 将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

928442.oracleText: Until end of turn, another target creature you control gains trample and gets +X/+X, where X is the number of lands you control.
928442.translation: 直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+X，X为由你操控的地数量。

928444.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If that card is an enchantment card, it enters tapped and attacking.
928444.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。如果该牌是结界牌，则它须横置进场且正进行攻击。

928445.oracleText: Equipped creature is a Shaman in addition to its other types and has "Whenever this creature attacks, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If that card is an enchantment card, it enters tapped and attacking."
928445.translation: 佩带此武具的生物额外具有祭师此类别，且具有「每当此生物攻击时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。如果该牌是结界牌，则它须横置进场且正进行攻击。」

928449.oracleText: "I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know."
928449.translation: 「我自己就够强了，不需要保护。」

928450.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, double CARDNAME's power until end of turn.
928450.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，将CARDNAME的力量加倍直到回合结束。

928451.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, double Tifa Lockhart's power until end of turn.
928451.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，将蒂法·洛克哈特的力量加倍直到回合结束。

928453.oracleText: Somersault — {o0} — Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
928453.translation: 倒挂金钩～{o0}～目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

928455.translation: 陨石强击～{o2}～将目标生物的力量与防御力加倍直到回合结束。

928457.translation: 最终天堂～{o6oG}～将目标生物的力量与防御力加两倍直到回合结束。

•倒挂金钩～{o0}～目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

•最终天堂～{o6oG}～将目标生物的力量与防御力加两倍直到回合结束。

928461.oracleText:
"Thank you, Torgal. For never giving up."
—Clive Rosfield
928461.translation:
「谢谢你，托加尔…谢谢你一直记得克莱夫·罗兹菲尔德。」
～克莱夫·罗兹菲尔德

928462.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first Human creature spell each turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each Dog and/or Wolf you control.
928462.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个人类生物咒语时，你每操控一个狗和／或狼，该生物进场时上面便额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

928464.oracleText: "This is Cornelia, the city of dreams."

928465.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill four cards. You may put a land card from among them into your hand. If you put a Town card into your hand this way, you gain 2 life.
928465.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨四张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌置于你手上。如果你以此法将一张市镇牌置于你手上，则你获得2点生命。

928467.oracleText: You may play lands and cast Bird spells from the top of your library.
928467.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放鸟咒语。

928468.oracleText: If a land or Bird you control entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
