928470.oracleText: When Vanille enters, mill two cards, then return a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
928470.translation: 当班尼拉进场时，磨两张牌，然后将一张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

928471.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, if you both own and control Vanille and a creature named Fang, Fearless l'Cie, you may pay {o3oBoG}. If you do, exile them, then meld them into Ragnarok, Divine Deliverance.
928471.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，若你同时拥有并操控班尼拉和一个名称为无畏路希牙的生物，则你可以支付{o3oBoG}。若你如此作，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为神圣救赎诸神黄昏。

928474.oracleText: You have protection from each of your opponents.
928474.translation: 你具有反每位对手保护。

928476.oracleText: Vehicles you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance and reach.
928476.translation: 由你操控的载具得+1/+1且具有警戒与延势异能。

928477.oracleText: Whenever a Vehicle crewed by CARDNAME this turn attacks, if it's the first combat phase of the turn, you may pay {o1oRoG}. If you do, after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
928477.translation: 每当一个本回合中由CARDNAME搭载的载具攻击时，若当前是本回合的首个战斗阶段，则你可以支付{o1oRoG}。若你如此作，则在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

928478.oracleText: Whenever a Vehicle crewed by Balthier and Fran this turn attacks, if it's the first combat phase of the turn, you may pay {o1oRoG}. If you do, after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
928478.translation: 每当一个本回合中由巴夫雷尔与法兰搭载的载具攻击时，若当前是本回合的首个战斗阶段，则你可以支付{o1oRoG}。若你如此作，则在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

928480.oracleText: "You fool. Do I look like some lowly black mage soldier?"
928480.translation: 「别把我和那些低等的杂种相提并论，你这蠢货！」

928481.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Black Waltz No. 3 deals 2 damage to each opponent.
928481.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，黑色华尔兹3号向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

928483.oracleText: Whenever one or more Birds you control attack, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may put one of them into your hand. Then put any number of land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped and the rest into your graveyard.
928483.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个鸟攻击时，检视你牌库顶等量的牌。你可以将其中一张置于你手上。然后将其中任意数量的地牌横置放进战场，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

928484.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, Choco gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
928484.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，巧克得+1/+0直到回合结束。

928486.oracleText: Artifact creatures and Heroes you control get +1/+1 for each Artificer you control and each Artificer card in your graveyard.
928486.translation: 你每操控一个神器师或你坟墓场中每有一张神器师牌，由你操控的神器生物和英雄便得+1/+1。

928487.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Cid, Timeless Artificer.
928487.translation: 名称为历时神器师西德的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

928490.oracleText: "We are the Cloud of Darkness! Bringer of wrath and destroyer of light!"
928490.translation: 「哈哈哈！我是暗黑之云！我要让黑暗泛滥，然后让这个世界和你们的光之世界都归于虚无…」

928491.oracleText: Particle Beam — When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
928491.translation: 波动炮～当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。

928492.oracleText: Particle Beam — When Cloud of Darkness enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
928492.translation: 波动炮～当暗黑之云进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。

928494.translation: 原生种无影爱梅特赛尔克

928495.oracleText: Whenever Emet-Selch enters or attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
928495.translation: 每当爱梅特赛尔克进场或攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

928496.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are fourteen or more cards in your graveyard, you may transform Emet-Selch.
928496.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有十四张或更多牌，则你可以转化爱梅特赛尔克。

928498.oracleText: "What will become of our triumphs? Our hopes? Our . . . our despair?"
928498.translation: 「这幅身躯消失…我将去往何方…我们的记忆…执着…希望…绝望！」

928499.oracleText: Echo of the Lost — During your turn, you may play cards from your graveyard.
928499.translation: 逝者的回声～于你的回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场使用牌。

928502.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU} or {oR}. Spend this mana only to cast a noncreature spell.
928502.translation: {oT}：加{oU}或{oR}。此法术力只能用来施放非生物咒语。

928503.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, transform it.
928503.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少四点法术力，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后若其上有三个或更多+1/+1指示物，则转化它。

928504.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, put a +1/+1 counter on The Emperor of Palamecia. Then if it has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, transform it.
928504.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，若施放它时支付过至少四点法术力，则在帕拉美奇亚皇帝上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后若其上有三个或更多+1/+1指示物，则转化它。

928507.oracleText: "All the world shall fall by my hand."
928507.translation: 「我要杀掉所有生灵，将世界毁灭殆尽！」

928508.oracleText: Starfall — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of noncreature, nonland cards in your graveyard.
928508.translation: 陨石～每当CARDNAME攻击时，它向每位对手各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中非生物且非地的牌数量。

928509.oracleText: Starfall — Whenever The Lord Master of Hell attacks, it deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of noncreature, nonland cards in your graveyard.
928509.translation: 陨石～每当地狱的支配者攻击时，它向每位对手各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中非生物且非地的牌数量。

928510.translation: 无之魔法师艾克斯迪司

928511.oracleText: "Mwa-hahahaha! Witness what befalls those who stand against me!"
928511.translation: 「哈哈哈…这就是与我为敌的下场！！」

928512.oracleText: When Exdeath enters, you gain 3 life.
928512.translation: 当艾克斯迪司进场时，你获得3点生命。

928513.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are six or more permanent cards in your graveyard, transform Exdeath.
928513.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你坟墓场中有六张或更多永久物牌，则转化艾克斯迪司。

928514.translation: 万物归无新生艾克斯迪司

928515.oracleText: "All memories . . . dimensions . . . existence . . . All that is shall be returned to nothing."
928515.translation: 「我要销毁…一切记忆…一切生灵…一切次元…然后再将自己销毁，将一切永远销毁！！」

928516.oracleText: Neo Exdeath's power is equal to the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
928516.translation: 新生艾克斯迪司的力量等同于你坟墓场中永久物牌的数量。

928518.oracleText: "I, Garland, will knock you all down!"
928518.translation: 「我乃是加兰德，你们能胜过我手中的剑吗！」

928519.oracleText: {o3oBoBoRoR}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield transformed. Activate only as a sorcery.
928519.translation: {o3oBoBoRoR}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

928521.oracleText: "Even as you die again and again, I shall return!"
928521.translation: 「你们将在这里永久地死去…而我将永久地活下去…」

928522.oracleText: When Chaos dies, put it on the bottom of its owner's library.
928522.translation: 当卡奥斯死去时，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

928523.translation: 亚历山德里亚公主嘉妮特

928525.oracleText: "Someday I will be queen, but I will always be myself."
928525.translation: 「并不是要『像个公主』，我想要找到真正的自己…」

928526.oracleText: Whenever Garnet attacks, you may remove a lore counter from each of any number of Sagas you control. Put a +1/+1 counter on Garnet for each lore counter removed this way.
928526.translation: 每当嘉妮特攻击时，你可以从任意数量由你操控的传纪上各移去一个学问指示物。每以此法移去一个学问指示物，便在嘉妮特上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928528.oracleText: "We will fight along with you for the planet, our home!"
928528.translation: 「为了孕育我们的母亲大地，我们也要战斗！」

928529.oracleText: Whenever Giott or another Dwarf you control enters and whenever an Equipment you control enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
928529.translation: 每当乔特或另一个由你操控的矮人进场或每当一个由你操控的武具进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

928530.translation: 古拉迪欧拉斯·阿米西提亚

928531.oracleText: "Guard the king with our lives—that's the way it's always been."
928531.translation: 「以身躯为盾守护国王～从懂事起就被灌输这样的想法。」

928532.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
928532.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

928533.oracleText: When Gladiolus Amicitia enters, search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
928533.translation: 当古拉迪欧拉斯·阿米西提亚进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

928534.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, another target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
928534.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

928536.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, surveil 1.
928536.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，刺探1。

928537.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control four or more artifacts, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Then if you control eight or more artifacts, each opponent loses life equal to that card's power.
928537.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控四个或更多神器，则将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。然后若你操控八个或更多神器，则每位对手各失去等同于该牌力量的生命。

928539.oracleText: "If we have the power to destroy Cocoon, then we have the power to save it."
928539.translation: 「既是能消灭的力量…自然亦能成为拯救的力量！」

928540.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent mills X cards, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
928540.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每位对手各磨X张牌，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

928542.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
928542.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

928543.oracleText: When Ignis Scientia enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
928543.translation: 当伊格尼斯·斯堪提亚进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

928544.oracleText: I've Come Up with a New Recipe! — {o1oGoU}, {oT}: Exile target card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, create a Food token.
928544.translation: 刚想到了新的食谱！～{o1oGoU}，{oT}：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果以此法放逐的是生物牌，则派出一个食品衍生物。

928545.oracleText: I've Come Up with a New Recipe!

928548.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Jenova's power on up to one other target creature. That creature becomes a Mutant in addition to its other types.
928548.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在至多另一个目标生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于杰诺瓦的力量。该生物额外具有突变体此类别。

928549.oracleText: Whenever a Mutant you control dies during your turn, you draw cards equal to its power.
928549.translation: 每当一个由你操控的突变体于你的回合中死去时，你抓等同于其力量的牌。

928551.oracleText: "In ashen grip, let ember glow, to kindle flames anew."
928551.translation: 「万物之骸，缠裹亘久之火，化作重生之火焰…！」

928552.oracleText: When Joshua enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
928552.translation: 当约书亚进场时，弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

928553.oracleText: {o3oRoW}, {oT}: Exile Joshua, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
928553.translation: {o3oRoW}，{oT}：放逐约书亚，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

928556.oracleText: Rising Flames — Phoenix deals 2 damage to each opponent.
928556.translation: 升腾火焰～不死鸟对每位对手各造成2点伤害。

928557.oracleText: Rising Flames — Phoenix deals 2 damage to each opponent.
928557.translation: 升腾火焰～不死鸟对每位对手各造成2点伤害。

928559.oracleText: Flames of Rebirth — Return any number of target creature cards with total mana value 6 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Exile Phoenix, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
928559.translation: 转生之炎～将任意数量的目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于6。放逐不死鸟，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

928563.oracleText: "I slew your king. I slew your country. Do these deeds not demand vengeance?"
928563.translation: 「面对杀害你父亲的我，你不复仇行吗！杀害国王、毁掉国家的人现在正站在你面前！」

928564.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
928564.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928565.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Judge Magister Gabranth.
928565.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器死去时，在最高审判者加布蓝斯上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928567.oracleText: Whenever Kefka enters or attacks, each player discards a card. Then you draw a card for each card type among cards discarded this way.
928567.translation: 每当凯夫卡进场或攻击时，每位牌手各弃一张牌。然后以此法弃掉的牌中每有一种牌张类别，你便抓一张牌。

928568.oracleText: {o8}: Each opponent sacrifices a permanent of their choice. Transform Kefka. Activate only as a sorcery.
928568.translation: {o8}：每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个永久物。转化凯夫卡。只能于法术时机起动。

928571.oracleText: Whenever an opponent loses life during your turn, you draw that many cards.
928571.translation: 每当任一对手于你的回合中失去生命时，你抓等量的牌。

928574.oracleText: "Peace is but a shadow of death, desperate to forget its painful past . . ."
928574.translation: 「祈祷明日幸福的人沉睡了，为了忘却昨日所有的不幸…」

928575.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a tapped 0/1 black Wizard creature token with "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this token deals 1 damage to each opponent." Then if you control four or more Wizards, transform Kuja.
928575.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个已横置的0/1黑色法术师衍生生物，且具有「每当你施放非生物咒语时，此衍生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。」然后如果你操控四个或更多法术师，则转化库加。

928577.oracleText: "Yes, this is it! This is the power I've always wanted!"
928577.translation: 「看见了吗！这就是我梦寐以求的力量！」

928578.oracleText: Flare Star — If a Wizard you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.
928578.translation: 耀星～如果某个由你操控的法术师将对任一永久物或牌手造成伤害，则改为它造成两倍的伤害。

928581.oracleText: "Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys."
928581.translation: 「『雷光』～发光后消逝，不留下一切。偏偏遑论守护，我只会伤害她。」

928582.oracleText: Stagger — Whenever Lightning deals combat damage to a player, until your next turn, if a source would deal damage to that player or a permanent that player controls, it deals double that damage instead.
928582.translation: 击倒～每当雷光对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，直到你的下一个回合，如果某来源将对该牌手或由该牌手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成两倍的伤害。

928585.oracleText: "As long as there are people who need to be protected, I'll keep on fighting!"
928585.translation: 「只要世界上还有需要保护的人，我就要战斗下去。」

928586.oracleText: Whenever Locke Cole deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
928586.translation: 每当洛克·科尔对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

928588.oracleText: Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.
928588.translation: 弃生命之喜悦，成就王之使命吧。

928589.oracleText: You may cast artifact spells from your graveyard by paying 3 life in addition to paying their other costs. If you cast a spell this way, that artifact enters with a finality counter on it.
928589.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场施放神器咒语，但在其他费用以外，还须额外支付3点生命。如果你以此法施放咒语，则该神器进场时上面有一个终命指示物。

928591.oracleText: Wave Cannon — When Omega enters, for each opponent, tap up to one target nonland permanent that opponent controls. Put X stun counters on each of those permanents and you gain X life, where X is the number of nonbasic lands you control.
928591.translation: 波动炮～当欧米茄进场时，对每位对手而言，横置至多一个目标由该对手操控的非地永久物。在这些永久物上各放置X个晕眩指示物且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的非基本地数量。

928595.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create Angelo, a legendary 1/1 green and white Dog creature token.
928595.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出传奇衍生生物安杰洛，其为1/1，绿白双色的狗。

928596.oracleText: When Rinoa Heartilly enters, create Angelo, a legendary 1/1 green and white Dog creature token.
928596.translation: 当莉诺雅·哈提利进场时，派出传奇衍生生物安杰洛，其为1/1，绿白双色的狗。

928597.oracleText: Angelo Cannon — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature you control.
928597.translation: 安杰洛加农炮～每当CARDNAME攻击时，你每操控一个生物，另一个目标由你操控的生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

928598.oracleText: Angelo Cannon — Whenever Rinoa Heartilly attacks, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature you control.
928598.translation: 安杰洛加农炮～每当莉诺雅·哈提利攻击时，你每操控一个生物，另一个目标由你操控的生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

928601.oracleText: "I'll control the world with fear. It takes too much to do it like my old man."
928601.translation: 「我要用恐怖支配世界，老爸那种做法实在是太花钱了。」

928602.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you don't control a creature named Darkstar, create Darkstar, a legendary 2/2 white and black Dog creature token.
928602.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你未操控名称为漆黑猎犬的生物，则派出传奇衍生生物漆黑猎犬，其为2/2，白黑双色的狗。

928603.oracleText: Whenever Rufus Shinra attacks, if you don't control a creature named Darkstar, create Darkstar, a legendary 2/2 white and black Dog creature token.
928603.translation: 每当路法斯·神罗攻击时，若你未操控名称为漆黑猎犬的生物，则派出传奇衍生生物漆黑猎犬，其为2/2，白黑双色的狗。

928605.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
928605.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

928606.oracleText: Summon — {oX}, {oT}: Return target Saga card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
928606.translation: 召唤～{oX}，{oT}：将目标法术力值为X的传纪牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

928609.oracleText: The first legendary creature spell you cast each turn costs {o2} less to cast.
928609.translation: 你每回合中施放的第一个传奇生物咒语减少{o2}来施放。

928610.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control two or more other legendary creatures, you may transform CARDNAME.
928610.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控两个或更多其他传奇生物，则你可以转化CARDNAME。

928611.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control two or more other legendary creatures, you may transform Serah Farron.
928611.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控两个或更多其他传奇生物，则你可以转化莎拉·法隆。

928613.oracleText: L'Cie who fulfill their Focus for their fal'Cie master are transformed into crystal and granted life eternal.
928613.translation: 达成法尔希使命的路希，会变成水晶并得到永恒。

928615.oracleText: "Ohohoho! I might be the harshest mistress in all of Vana'diel. But I may yet forgive you, if at my feet you kneel."

928616.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Shantotto gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. If X is 4 or more, draw a card.
928616.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，香托托得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量。如果X等于或大于4，则抓一张牌。

928619.oracleText: Whenever Sin enters or attacks, exile a permanent card from your graveyard at random, then create a tapped token that's a copy of that card. If the exiled card is a land card, repeat this process.
928619.translation: 每当辛进场或攻击时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张永久物牌，然后派出一个已横置且为该牌之复制品的衍生物。如果所放逐的牌是地牌，则重复此流程。

928622.oracleText: Rough Divide — Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gains double strike until end of turn.
928622.translation: 断裂斩～每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，它获得连击异能直到回合结束。

928624.oracleText: Whenever Squall deals combat damage to a player, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
928624.translation: 每当斯考尔对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

928626.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token. If four or more mana was spent to cast that spell, draw two cards. If eight or more mana was spent to cast that spell, sacrifice Tellah and it deals that much damage to each opponent.
928626.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。如果施放该咒语时支付过四点或更多法术力，则抓两张牌。如果施放该咒语时支付过八点或更多法术力，则牺牲泰拉，且它对每位对手各造成等同于该数量的伤害。

928629.oracleText: When Terra enters, mill five cards. Put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
928629.translation: 当蒂娜进场时，磨五张牌。将至多一张以此法磨掉的结界牌置于你手上。

928630.oracleText: Trance — {o4oRoG}, {oT}: Exile Terra, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
928630.translation: 幻化～{o4oRoG}，{oT}：放逐蒂娜，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

928633.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary enchantment you control. It gains haste. If it's a Saga, put up to three lore counters on it. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
928633.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控且非传奇的结界之复制品。它获得敏捷异能。若它是传纪，则在其上放置至多三个学问指示物。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

928634.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary enchantment you control. It gains haste. If it's a Saga, put up to three lore counters on it. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
928634.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控且非传奇的结界之复制品。它获得敏捷异能。若它是传纪，则在其上放置至多三个学问指示物。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

928635.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary enchantment you control. It gains haste. If it's a Saga, put up to three lore counters on it. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
928635.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控且非传奇的结界之复制品。它获得敏捷异能。若它是传纪，则在其上放置至多三个学问指示物。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

928636.oracleText: Add {oWoW}, {oUoU}, {oBoB}, {oRoR}, and {oGoG}. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
928636.translation: 加{oWoW}，{oUoU}，{oBoB}，{oRoR}和{oGoG}。放逐幻兽蒂娜，然后将它移回战场。

928637.oracleText: Add {oWoW}, {oUoU}, {oBoB}, {oRoR}, and {oGoG}. Exile Esper Terra, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
928637.translation: 加{oWoW}，{oUoU}，{oBoB}，{oRoR}和{oGoG}。放逐幻兽蒂娜，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

928639.oracleText: "Every blitzer knows: when you got the ball, you gotta score!"
928639.translation: 「气势正旺的话就要乘胜追击！这是水斗球的铁则！！」

928640.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Tidus.
928640.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，在提达上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928641.oracleText: Whenever Tidus attacks, tap target creature an opponent controls.
928641.translation: 每当提达攻击时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

928642.translation: 时之魔女阿尔提米西亚

928643.oracleText: Whenever Ultimecia enters or attacks, surveil 2.
928643.translation: 每当阿尔提米西亚进场或攻击时，刺探2。

928644.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o4oUoUoBoB} and exile eight cards from your graveyard. If you do, transform Ultimecia.
928644.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o4oUoUoBoB}并从你的坟墓场放逐八张牌。若你如此作，则转化阿尔提米西亚。

928647.oracleText: "Time . . . it will not wait . . . no matter . . . how hard you hold on. It escapes you . . ."
928647.translation: 「时间从不等人。即使紧紧握住，张开手时仍会离我而去。」

928649.oracleText: Time Compression — When this creature transforms into Ultimecia, Omnipotent, take an extra turn after this one.
928649.translation: 时间压缩～当此生物转化为全能阿尔提米西亚时，于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。

928652.oracleText: {o0}: Add X mana in any combination of {oU} and/or {oR}, where X is CARDNAME's power. Activate only during your turn and only once each turn.
928652.translation: {o0}：加X点法术力，且为{oU}和／或{oR}的任意组合，X为CARDNAME的力量。只能于你的回合中起动，且每回合限一次。

928653.oracleText: {o0}: Add X mana in any combination of {oU} and/or {oR}, where X is Vivi Ornitier's power. Activate only during your turn and only once each turn.
928653.translation: {o0}：加X点法术力，且为{oU}和／或{oR}的任意组合，X为比比·奥尼提尔的力量。只能于你的回合中起动，且每回合限一次。

928654.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and it deals 1 damage to each opponent.
928654.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

928655.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Vivi Ornitier and it deals 1 damage to each opponent.
928655.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在比比·奥尼提尔上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

928657.oracleText: The Minstrel's Ballad — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control five or more Towns, create a 2/2 Elemental creature token that's all colors.
928657.translation: 究极幻想～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控五个或更多市镇，则派出一个2/2五色元素衍生生物。

928659.oracleText: {o3oWoUoBoRoG}: Other creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Towns you control.
928659.translation: {o3oWoUoBoRoG}：由你操控的其他生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的市镇数量。

928661.oracleText: During your turn, Yuna and enchantment creatures you control have trample, lifelink, and ward {o2}.
928661.translation: 于你的回合中，尤娜与由你操控的结界生物具有践踏，系命与守护{o2}。

928662.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return up to one target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
928662.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，将至多一张目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。

928665.oracleText: When Zidane enters, gain control of target creature an opponent controls until end of turn. Untap it. It gains lifelink and haste until end of turn.
928665.translation: 当吉坦进场时，获得目标由对手操控的生物之操控权直到回合结束。将它重置。它获得系命与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

928666.oracleText: Whenever an opponent gains control of a permanent from you, you create a Treasure token.
928666.translation: 每当任一对手获得一个由你操控的永久物之操控权时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

928668.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
928668.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

928670.oracleText:
"The pinnacle o' perfection, forged from blood, sweat, an' tears!"
—Gerolt Blackthorne
928670.translation:
「这是我们三人血水、汗水、泪水的结晶！」
～盖罗尔特·布拉克索恩

928671.oracleText: Equipped creature has base power and toughness X/X, where X is your life total.
928671.translation: 佩带此武具的生物之基础力量和防御力为X/X，X为你的总生命。

928673.oracleText: GOOOOAAAALLL! — {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw two cards. Activate only if an opponent was dealt combat damage by a legendary creature this turn.
928673.translation: 得分！～{oT}，牺牲此神器：抓两张牌。只能于有传奇生物向对手造成过战斗伤害的回合中起动。

928676.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then you may cast a spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to that damage without paying its mana cost.
928676.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于该伤害数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

928679.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Exile this artifact: Shuffle all nonland cards from your graveyard into your library. You gain life equal to the number of cards shuffled into your library this way.
928679.translation: {o5}，{oT}，放逐此神器：将所有在你坟墓场中的非地牌洗入你的牌库。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于以此法洗入你牌库的牌张数量。

928681.oracleText: The ultimate sword, used by a legendary king. It was forged in another world.
928681.translation: 终极之剑，曾为一位传奇国王所使用。其铸造于另一个世界。

928682.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a charge counter on CARDNAME.
928682.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个充电指示物。

928683.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a charge counter on Excalibur II.
928683.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在王者之剑II上放置一个充电指示物。

928684.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each charge counter on Excalibur II.
928684.translation: 王者之剑II上每有一个充电指示物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

928686.oracleText: "I must say, I quite enjoy these tussles."
928686.translation: 「这是我和你们第四次干架啊，哈哈哈…真让我开心！」

928687.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, if it's the first combat phase of the turn, untap it. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
928687.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，若当前是本回合的首个战斗阶段，则将之重置。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

928689.oracleText: "It's not about finding the single best ingredient. It's about crafting that perfect blend of meat, egg, and shrimp. That harmony of flavors is key."
928689.translation: 「肉、蛋、虾，必须三种原料和谐共存，哪一样太出挑都不行。」

928691.oracleText: The iron giant is both hostile and powerful, using a giant blade to fell its foes. The mere mention of its name strikes fear in the hearts of drivers who know how perilous the roads are at night.
928691.translation: 不但身躯庞大，而且手持巨刃，强壮有力，无疑是一名强敌。除了荒野之外，有时还会在道路上出现，就连普通人对其也有较高认知度，使它成为了恐怖使骸的代名词。

928693.oracleText: "Lions are known for their great strength and pride."
928693.translation: 「要说枪刃中的最强型号，便是这把『雄狮之心』了！」

928694.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, it deals 2 damage to any target.
928694.translation: 当此武具进场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

928696.oracleText:
"Inside the Lunatic Pandora is this thing called a Crystal Pillar. It calls monsters from the Moon."
—Zell Dincht
928696.translation:
「在那个疯狂潘多拉内部，有个叫『大石柱』的东西。那东西能从月球上召唤怪物。」
～塞尔·迪恩

928697.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target nonland permanent.

928698.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice Lunatic Pandora: Destroy target nonland permanent.
928698.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲疯狂潘多拉：消灭目标非地永久物。

928702.oracleText: As long as equipped creature is attacking, it has first strike and must be blocked if able.
928702.translation: 只要佩带此武具的生物正进行攻击，它便具有先攻异能且若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

928703.oracleText: If a creature dying causes a triggered ability of this creature or an emblem you own to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
928703.translation: 如果此生物或由你拥有之徽记的触发式异能因生物死去而触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

928704.oracleText: Equipped creature has "If a creature dying causes a triggered ability of this creature or an emblem you own to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time."
928704.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「如果此生物或由你拥有之徽记的触发式异能因生物死去而触发，则该异能额外触发一次。」

928706.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and is a Monk in addition to its other types.
928706.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0，且额外具有修行僧此类别。

928710.oracleText: {o3}: Until end of turn, this creature's base power becomes equal to the number of Towns you control.
928710.translation: {o3}：直到回合结束，此生物的基础力量成为等同于由你操控的市镇数量。

928712.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
928712.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止。将该牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

928713.oracleText: Whenever The Regalia attacks, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
928713.translation: 每当雷迦利亚攻击时，从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止。将该牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

928716.oracleText:
"Let's get the hell out of here!"
—Zell Dincht
928716.translation:
「我们趁现在快逃吧！」
～塞尔·迪恩

928717.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked except by three or more creatures.
928717.translation: 此生物只能被三个或更多生物阻挡。

928718.oracleText: {o8}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a finality counter on it.
928718.translation: {o8}：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。

928720.oracleText:
"Kings of Lucis . . . come to me!"
—Noctis Lucis Caelum
928720.translation:
「路西斯之王啊…集结！」
～诺克提斯·路西斯·切拉姆

928721.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Pay 1 life: Tap target nonland permanent.
928721.translation: {o2}，{oT}，支付1点生命：横置目标非地永久物。

928724.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
928724.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

928725.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
928725.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

928728.oracleText:
"Welcome! We have rooms for 200 gil a night. Would you like to stay and rest your body and mind?"
—Innkeep
928728.translation:
「欢迎光临。只需要200金币就可以恢复。想留宿吗？」
～旅店主

928729.oracleText: When this land enters, you gain 2 life.
928729.translation: 当此地进场时，你获得2点生命。

928731.oracleText: {o5oGoU}, {oT}: Transform this land. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each other Town you control.
928731.translation: {o5oGoU}，{oT}：转化此地。你每操控一个其他市镇，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

928733.oracleText: Whenever Balamb Garden attacks, draw a card.
928733.translation: 每当巴拉姆学苑攻击时，抓一张牌。

928735.oracleText: The advent of the airship marked the realization of Baron's dreams, but also the birth of its militarism.
928735.translation: 驰骋天际的飞空艇曾是人们的梦想…然而，助飞空艇冲上云霄的动力却没有因梦想的实现而止步，甚至变成了满足欲望的手段。

928737.oracleText: A city built upon the Isles of Ark that straddle the continents of Storm and Ash.
928737.translation: 夹在风暴大陆和灰烬大陆之间，位于方舟群岛上的自治国家。

928739.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: You may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost if you control four or more legendary creatures.
928739.translation: {o2}，{oT}：如果你操控四个或更多传奇生物，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

928741.oracleText:
"You've got to destroy the Dreadnought!"
—Bafsk resident
928741.translation:
「拜托了，请破坏掉大战舰。」
～巴弗斯科镇居民

928743.oracleText: This city, Cocoon's capital, shares its name with its fal'Cie patron.
928743.translation: 因法尔希·伊甸而命名的「茧」首都。

928744.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Mill two cards. Then you may sacrifice this land. When you do, return another target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
928744.translation: {o5}，{oT}：磨两张牌。然后你可以牺牲此地。当你如此作时，将另一张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

928746.oracleText:
"They say that beyond the dunes is the Town of Ruin, but no one can even enter the desert to find out, let alone cross it."
—Cid Previa
928746.translation:
「那是人类无法步入的世界…沙漠的尽头据说是废墟之镇…」
～西德·普利维亚

928748.oracleText: After relaxing at Costa del Sol, stop by the Gold Saucer. It's a rich and exciting place to play!
928748.translation: 「在阳光海岸休息以后，就到金碟游乐园去玩玩吧。那是有钱人的好去处！」

928749.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, create a Treasure token.
928749.translation: {o2}，{oT}：掷一枚硬币。如果你猜对此掷，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

928750.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice two artifacts: Draw a card.

928752.oracleText:
"The Shinra people told us that everyone would be happy once the reactor was built. But all it brought us was sadness . . ."
—Gongaga villager
928752.translation:
「神罗的那帮家伙告诉我们，魔晄炉会带给大家幸福。可是它带给我们的却只有痛苦…」
～贡加加村村长

928753.translation: 异界门户古阿多萨拉姆

928754.oracleText:
"We Guado protect the Farplane so the dead can rest in peace."
—Guadosalam citizen
928754.translation:
「古阿多族守护着异界，所以亡者才能安息喔。」
～古阿多萨拉姆居民

928756.oracleText: "I need only know that you are ready to leave home behind," said King Regis. "Don't know about you, but I'm ready as I'll ever be," replied Noctis.
928756.translation: 「至少做好短期内无法回国的心理准备。」雷吉斯国王说。「也没打算轻易回来，只管放心。」诺克提斯应道。

928758.oracleText: A great and proud nation devoted to Halone, the Fury.
928758.translation: 伊修加德以「伊修加德正教」为国教，信仰战争神哈罗妮。

928760.oracleText: Return up to two target artifact and/or enchantment cards from your graveyard to your hand.
928760.translation: 将至多两张目标神器和／或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

928762.oracleText:
"You're the spitting image of Maria!"
—Jidoor resident
928762.translation:
「你简直和玛利亚长得一模一样！」
～吉多尔居民

928764.oracleText: Target opponent mills half their library, rounded down.
928764.translation: 目标对手磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

928766.oracleText: A city encircled by the ramparts of a massive castle.
928766.translation: 被巨大城的城墙包围的都市。

928769.oracleText: A triumph of technology and testament to man's potential.
928769.translation: 米德加成长为大都市，一跃成为世界的中心。

928771.oracleText: You may sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do, draw two cards.
928771.translation: 你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

928773.oracleText: The town proper of Rabanastre is divided into four sections by the cardinal directions of the compass. The east and west are merchant districts, the streets lined with shops and stalls of every description.
928773.translation: 拉巴纳斯塔的主城由东南西北基本方向划分为四个部分。东区和西区是商业区，大街上各种商店摊贩林林总总地排列着。

928775.oracleText:
"The Sharlayans were the keepers of wisdom both old and new. Their mastery over magic and aether was unsurpassed, and even the Garleans knew to fear them."
—Minfilia Warde
928775.translation:
「那里的人们精通考古，在以太学和魔法方面的知识和技术甚至要高于加雷马帝国。」
～敏菲利亚·沃德

928777.oracleText: When darkness veils the world, four Warriors of Light shall come.
928777.translation: 当世界被黑暗侵染之时，四位光之战士将会现身于世。

928778.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless it's your first, second, or third turn of the game.
928778.translation: 本盘游戏中，除非当前是你的第一、第二或第三回合，否则此地须横置进场。

928780.oracleText:
"There aren't many nobles living here. The nights are long. It's a great place for thieves."
—Marcus, Tantalus thief
928780.translation:
「这里并没有多少贵族居住…由于夜晚比较长的关系，盗贼们非常喜欢这里。」
～坦塔罗斯盗贼马卡斯

928782.oracleText:
"If we allow the Empire to continue expanding its Magitek arsenal . . . history's greatest mistake will be repeated."
—Banon, Leader of the Returners
928782.translation:
「如果帝国继续获得魔导之力，就难免会重演过去的悲剧…」
～回归者领袖巴南

928784.oracleText: The first Star Sibyl gained the powers of the stars and moon at Full Moon Fountain. She found the stars of hope from within the darkness, and led Windurst to glory.
928784.translation: 初代的神子大人在满月之泉获得星月之力，自黑暗中发现希望之星，才终将温达斯引向繁荣之世。

928785.translation: 古代大都市札纳尔坎德

928786.oracleText: A city dead for a thousand years. The end of Yuna's journey.
928786.translation: 1000年前毁灭的都市。尤娜旅行的目的地。

928788.oracleText: Create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each land you control.
928788.translation: 派出一个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。你每操控一个地，便在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928791.oracleText: When prayers turn to promises, not even fate can stand in their way.
928791.translation: 愿望变成誓言的那刻，也产生了改变命运的希望。

928792.oracleText: When Ragnarok dies, destroy target permanent and return target nonlegendary permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
928792.translation: 当诸神黄昏死去时，消灭目标永久物并将目标非传奇的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

928794.oracleText: "It's not over yet . . . this isn't the end!"

928795.oracleText: During your turn, as long as Cloud is equipped, it has double strike and indestructible.
928795.translation: 于你的回合中，只要克劳德佩带武具，它便具有连击与不灭异能。

928796.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate that target Cloud cost {o2} less to activate.
928796.translation: 你起动之以克劳德为目标的佩带异能减少{o2}来起动。

928798.oracleText: "This is the end . . . for all of you."
928798.translation: 「这是你们的末日～所有人的末日。」

928799.oracleText: When Sephiroth enters, creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn.
928799.translation: 当萨菲罗斯进场时，由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

928800.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Sephiroth.
928800.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在萨菲罗斯上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928802.oracleText: "I commend your courage, but I will show you no mercy."
928802.translation: 「我承认你的那份勇气，但是我不会因此手下留情的。」

928803.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may attach any number of Equipment you control to target creature you control.
928803.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以将任意数量由你操控的武具贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

928805.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains lifelink until end of turn.
928805.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

928807.oracleText:
"Ultimecia is a fearful sorceress. Her heart is filled with anger and hate."
—Edea Kramer
928807.translation:
「阿尔提米西亚非常可怕。她的内心充满了愤怒与仇恨。」
～伊迪雅‧克莱默

928808.oracleText: When Ultimecia enters, tap all creatures your opponents control.
928808.translation: 当阿尔提米西亚进场时，横置所有由对手操控的生物。

928810.oracleText: "Come, little lamb . . . to the slaughter with you!"
928810.translation: 「家畜只要温顺地接受驯养就好。」

928811.oracleText: Destroy target creature an opponent controls. Then draw a card for each creature that died this turn.
928811.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控的生物。然后本回合中每有一个生物死去，你便抓一张牌。

928813.oracleText: "Your hope ends here. And your meaningless existence with it."
928813.translation: 「不过，那份绝望也将在此消失。由我来将一切的悲叹斩断吧。」

928814.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay 1 life. If you do, draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
928814.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以支付1点生命。若你如此作，则你抓一张牌且在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928815.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay 1 life. If you do, draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on Seymour Flux.
928815.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以支付1点生命。若你如此作，则你抓一张牌且在希摩尔：终极变异体上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928816.oracleText: "I'm here to even the odds. Any objections?"

928817.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature and X damage to that creature's controller, where X is the number of Equipment you control.
928817.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成5点伤害，并对该生物的操控者造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的武具数量。

928818.oracleText: Judgment Bolt deals 5 damage to target creature and X damage to that creature's controller, where X is the number of Equipment you control.
928818.translation: 制裁之雷对目标生物造成5点伤害，并对该生物的操控者造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的武具数量。

928820.oracleText: Whenever Lightning deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card for as long as you control Lightning.
928820.translation: 每当雷光对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于你操控雷光的时段内，你可以使用该牌。

928822.oracleText: "But your struggle was all for naught. Don't you see how close the darkness has drawn?"
928822.translation: 「但是黑暗马上就要降临了…已经太晚了！」

928823.oracleText: Xande gets +1/+1 for each noncreature, nonland card in your graveyard.
928823.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张非生物且非地的牌，赞德便得+1/+1。

928825.oracleText: A Test of Your Reflexes! — When this Equipment enters, you may attach it to target creature you control. If you do, that creature gains first strike until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.
928825.translation: 你能应付吗？～当此武具进场时，你可以将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。若你如此作，则该生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束，且本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

928828.oracleText: "This will be the end of it."
928828.translation: 「就在这里…把一切都了结了吧！」

928829.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, destroy target creature an opponent controls.
928829.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物。

928839.oracleText: Put a stun counter on one of them.
928839.translation: 在其中之一上放置一个晕眩指示物。

928840.translation: 指定一个非结界生物为目标。

928841.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with mana value 2 or less.
928841.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于2的神器牌。

928843.oracleText: Search for a card named Magitek Infantry.
928843.translation: 搜寻一张名称为魔导兵的牌。

928844.oracleText: Target a Skeleton, Spirit, or Zombie.
928844.translation: 指定一个骷髅妖，精怪或灵俑为目标。

928845.oracleText: Attach target Equipment you control to target creature you control.
928845.translation: 将目标由你操控的武具贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

928846.oracleText: Attach an Equipment that was attached to {1, CardId}.
928846.translation: 贴附一个曾贴附在{1, CardId}上的武具。

928849.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard?
928849.translation: 是否要从坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌？

928850.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a Kraken, Leviathan, Merfolk, Octopus, or Serpent attacks, draw a card.
928850.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个巨海兽、海怪、人鱼，章鱼或巨蛇攻击时，抓一张牌。

928851.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a Kraken, Leviathan, Merfolk, Octopus, or Serpent attacks, draw a card.
928851.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个巨海兽、海怪、人鱼，章鱼或巨蛇攻击时，抓一张牌。

928852.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of other creatures?
928852.translation: 是否要牺牲任意数量的其他生物？

928853.oracleText: Sacrifice {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} non-God creature} other {{2, Number} non-God creatures}} you control.
928853.translation: 牺牲{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}个由你操控且非神的生物} other {{2, Number}个由你操控且非神的生物}}。

928854.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
928854.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

928855.oracleText: Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next upkeep.
928855.translation: 在下一个维持开始时牺牲该衍生物。

928856.oracleText: Spend only on: An Equipment Spell or an Equip Ability
928856.translation: 只能用于支付：武具咒语或佩带异能

928858.translation: 指定一个进行攻击且佩带武具的生物为目标。

928859.oracleText: Destroy up to one Equipment attached to that creature.
928859.translation: 消灭至多一个贴附在该生物上的武具。

928860.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, return those creatures to their owner's hand.
928860.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将这些生物移回其拥有者手上。

928861.oracleText: Target an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard or exiled card with flashback you own.
928861.translation: 指定一张瞬间或法术牌为目标，且须为在你坟墓场中，或由你拥有、已放逐、且具返照异能者。

928862.oracleText: When you next cast a creature spell this turn, it gains haste until end of turn.
928862.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放生物咒语时，它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

928863.oracleText: When you next cast a creature spell this turn, it gains haste until end of turn.
928863.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放生物咒语时，它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

928866.oracleText: Unattach it at the beginning of the next end step.
928866.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它卸装。

928867.oracleText: Reveal an artifact, creature, or land card?
928867.translation: 是否要展示一张神器、生物或地牌？

928869.oracleText: Search for a Bird or basic land card.
928869.translation: 搜寻一张鸟或基本地牌。

928870.oracleText: Search your library for a Bird or basic land card?
928870.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张鸟或基本地牌？

928872.oracleText: Return a permanent card to your hand.
928872.translation: 将一张永久物牌移回你手上。

928873.oracleText: Protection from each of your opponents

928874.oracleText: Put one of them into your hand?
928874.translation: 是否要将其中一张置于你手上？

928875.oracleText: Target any number of creature cards with total mana value 6 or less.
928875.translation: 指定任意数量法术力值总和等于或小于6的生物牌为目标。

928876.oracleText: Exile a permanent card from your graveyard at random.
928876.translation: 随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张永久物牌。

928877.oracleText: Put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
928877.translation: 将至多一张以此法磨掉的结界牌置于你手上。

928884.oracleText: Target up to two artifact and/or enchantment cards.
928884.translation: 指定至多两张神器和／或结界牌为目标。

928885.translation: 指定一张非传奇的永久物牌为目标。

928899.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for an Equipment card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
928899.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

928906.oracleText: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, you may pay X life, where X is the number of opponents that were dealt combat damage this turn. If you do, draw X cards.
928906.translation: 在你的每个战斗后的行动阶段开始时，你可以支付X点生命，X为本回合中受过战斗伤害的对手数量。若你如此作，则抓X张牌。

928910.oracleText: Creatures you control gain lifelink, indestructible, and protection from each color until end of turn.
928910.translation: 由你操控的生物获得系命、不灭与反五色保护异能直到回合结束。

928911.oracleText:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead. 
• Creatures you control gain flying, vigilance, and double strike until end of turn. 
• Creatures you control gain lifelink, indestructible, and protection from each color until end of turn.
928911.translation:
选择一项。如果你于施放此咒语时操控指挥官，则你可以改为两项都选。
•由你操控的生物获得飞行、警戒与连击异能直到回合结束。
•由你操控的生物获得系命、不灭与反五色保护异能直到回合结束。

928913.translation: 诺克提斯·路西斯·切拉姆

928914.translation: 嘉妮特·提尔·亚历山德罗斯十七世

928934.oracleText: Whenever a Warrior attacks, you may have its controller create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking.
928934.translation: 每当一个战士攻击时，你可以令其操控者派出一个1/1白色战士衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

928935.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}: Untap all attacking creatures. They gain trample, lifelink, and haste until end of turn. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. Activate only during combat.
928935.translation: {oWoUoBoRoG}：重置所有进行攻击的生物。它们获得践踏、系命与敏捷异能直到回合结束。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。只能于战斗中起动。

928944.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, target creature you control gains double strike and lifelink until end of turn.
928944.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，目标由你操控的生物获得连击与系命异能直到回合结束。

928949.oracleText: Eminence — Whenever another nontoken Wizard you control enters, if CARDNAME is in the command zone or on the battlefield, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that Wizard. The token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
928949.translation: 威仪～每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的法术师进场时，若CARDNAME在统帅区中或战场上，则你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则派出一个为该法术师之复制品的衍生物。该衍生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它放逐。

928951.oracleText: Tap five untapped Wizards you control: Target player loses 7 life.
928951.translation: 横置五个由你操控且未横置的法术师：目标牌手失去7点生命。

928965.oracleText: Have its controller create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking?
928965.translation: 是否要令其操控者派出一个1/1白色战士衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击？

928967.oracleText: Tap three other untapped creatures you control.
928967.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的其他生物。

928968.oracleText: Return a creature or Vehicle card to your hand.
928968.translation: 将一张生物或载具牌移回你手上。

928969.oracleText: Tap another untapped Mount or Vehicle you control.
928969.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的坐骑或载具。

928970.oracleText: Exile an artifact or creature card.
928970.translation: 放逐一张神器或生物牌。

928971.oracleText: Distribute counters among one or two other target Vehicles and/or creatures you control.
928971.translation: 将指示物分配给一个或两个其他目标由你操控的载具和／或生物。

928972.oracleText: Target one or two other Vehicles and/or creatures you control.
928972.translation: 指定一个或两个由你操控的其他载具和／或生物为目标。

928973.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less.
928973.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于4的非地永久物为目标。

928979.oracleText: Search for a basic land card or Town card.
928979.translation: 搜寻一张基本地牌或市镇牌。

928980.oracleText: When you search your library this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
928980.translation: 当你以此法搜寻你的牌库时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

928981.oracleText: Search for up to two basic land cards and/or Town cards with different names.
928981.translation: 搜寻至多两张名称各不相同的基本地牌和／或市镇牌。

929035.oracleText: Put up to one Elf card into your hand?
929035.translation: 是否要将至多一张妖精牌置于你手上？

929036.oracleText: It'll satisfy your need for steed!
929036.translation: 它能满足你的骑速快感！

929038.oracleText: "This baby runs on unleaded O negative."

929040.oracleText: "You've got the dream machine. I've got the nightmare mach-ightmare."
929040.translation: 「你得到了你的梦想好车。我得到了我的梦魇恶车。」

929041.translation: 「有人在找爱扭扳手的呆子吗？」

929043.oracleText: The one and only velocity raptor.

930858.oracleText: Distribute damage among any number of target creatures your opponents control.
930858.translation: 将伤害分配给任意数量由你对手控制的目标生物。

930859.oracleText: Target any number of creatures your opponents control.
930859.translation: 指定任意数量由你对手操控的生物为目标。

930869.oracleText: Target a non-Gorgon creature an opponent controls.
930869.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的非龙生物为目标。

930921.oracleText: Target a noncreature permanent an opponent controls.
930921.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的非生物永久物为目标。

930956.oracleText: Have the base power and toughness of each other creature you control become equal to {1, CardId}'s power until end of turn?
930956.translation: 是否要使由你操控的每个其他生物的基础力量与防御力成为等同于{1, CardId}的力量直到回合结束？

930958.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only a single creature you control, you may pay {o1}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
930958.translation: 每当你施放仅以单一由你操控之生物为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

930963.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell or ability, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand. This ability triggers only twice each turn.
930963.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，展示你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，将之放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。此异能每回合只会触发两次。

930967.oracleText: Once each turn, you may pay {o0} rather than pay the mana cost for a spell you cast that you don't own with mana value 3 or less.
930967.translation: 限每回合一次，你可以支付{o0}，而不支付你施放之不由你拥有且法术力值等于或小于3的咒语之法术力费用。

930970.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has ward {o1}.
930970.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有守护{o1}。

930971.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, conjure a random card from Tome of Gadwick's spellbook into your hand.
930971.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，从盖威克的巨著的法术书中将一张随机牌幻变进你手上。

931995.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
931995.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

931996.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
931996.translation: 当此生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

931998.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to creatures you control this turn.
931998.translation: 于本回合中，防止将对由你操控的生物造成的所有伤害。

931999.oracleText: Exile a creature named Fang, Fearless l ' Cie.
931999.translation: 放逐一个名称为无畏路希牙的生物。

932002.oracleText: When this creature dies, exile target permanent.
932002.translation: 当此生物死去时，放逐目标永久物。

932004.oracleText: When this Aura enters, you gain 3 life.
932004.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你获得3点生命。

932008.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
932008.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，你可以将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

932009.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target creature to its owner's hand.
932009.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

932010.oracleText: Whenever a source deals damage to this creature, that source's controller mills that many cards.
932010.translation: 每当任一来源对此生物造成伤害时，该来源的操控者磨等量的牌。

932011.oracleText: This creature enters with three wish counters on it.
932011.translation: 此生物进场时上面有三个祈愿指示物。

932012.oracleText: {o2oUoU}, Remove a wish counter from this creature: Reveal the top card of your library. You may play that card without paying its mana cost. If you don't, exile it.
932012.translation: {o2oUoU}，从此生物上移去一个祈愿指示物：展示你的牌库顶牌。你可以使用该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未如此作，则将它放逐。

932013.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {o2}.
932013.translation: 每当此生物成为由对手操控的咒语或异能之目标时，除非该咒语或异能的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。

932014.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, tap target permanent. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
932014.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，横置目标永久物。它于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

932018.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
932018.translation: 牺牲一个生物：此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

932020.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may have it deal 1 damage to any target.
932020.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以让它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

932022.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Exile two cards from your graveyard: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
932022.translation: {oR}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐两张牌：此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

932023.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target artifact.
932023.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标神器。

932024.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target artifact, enchantment, or land.
932024.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标神器，结界或地。

932026.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may search your library for up to two land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
932026.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

932033.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
932033.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此地：将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

932036.oracleText: When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
932036.translation: 当此结界离开战场时，将所放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

932038.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
932038.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

932039.oracleText: This creature can't block and can't be blocked.
932039.translation: 此生物不能进行阻挡，也不能被阻挡。

932040.oracleText: This creature enters with five +1/+1 counters on it.
932040.translation: 此生物进场时上面有五个+1/+1指示物。

932058.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, it deals 1 damage to target opponent for each Swamp you control.
932058.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你从你手上施放之，你每操控一个沼泽，它便对目标对手造成1点伤害。

932082.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 3 damage to each other creature.
932082.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对每个其他生物各造成3点伤害。

932086.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player discards a card.
932086.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各弃一张牌。

932129.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
932129.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

932146.oracleText: When this creature dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
932146.translation: 当此生物死去时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

932157.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control named Charmed Stray.
932157.translation: 当此生物进场时，在每个由你操控之其他名称为迷人野猫的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

932163.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, other creatures you control gain double strike until end of turn.
932163.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，由你操控的其他生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

932172.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create two 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink that are tapped and attacking.
932172.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出两个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。

932175.oracleText: {o2oW}: This creature gains first strike until end of turn.
932175.translation: {o2oW}：此生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

932199.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
932199.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

932219.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with flying enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
932219.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

932235.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
932235.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

932260.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. (Damage causes loss of life.)
932260.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手失去过生命，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

932313.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 2 or less attacks, this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking.
932313.translation: 每当一个由你操控、且力量等于或小于2的生物攻击时，此结界对其所攻击的牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

932320.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy all Walls your opponents control.
932320.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭所有由对手操控的墙。

932321.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if defending player controls no Walls, it deals 2 damage to each creature without flying that player controls.
932321.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若防御牌手未操控墙，则它对每个由该牌手操控且不具飞行异能的生物各造成2点伤害。

932326.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
932326.translation: 每当此生物被阻挡时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

932331.oracleText: When this creature enters, put two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control named Baloth Packhunter.
932331.translation: 当此生物进场时，在每个由你操控之其他名称为巴洛西猎群的生物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

932351.oracleText: {o3oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
932351.translation: {o3oG}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

932354.oracleText: All creatures able to block this creature do so.
932354.translation: 所有能够阻挡此生物的生物皆须阻挡之。

932360.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each land you control.
932360.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你每操控一个地，它便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

932375.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may mill three cards.
932375.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以磨三张牌。

932376.oracleText: When this creature dies, return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
932376.translation: 当此生物死去时，将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

932394.oracleText: Destroy target creature if it has mana value 2 or less. Revolt — Destroy that creature if it has mana value 4 or less instead if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn.
932394.translation: 如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于2，则消灭之。反抗～如果本回合中有永久物在你操控下离开战场，则改为如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于4，则消灭之。

932395.oracleText:
Destroy target creature if it has mana value 2 or less. 
Revolt — Destroy that creature if it has mana value 4 or less instead if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn.
932395.translation:
如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于2，则消灭之。
反抗～如果本回合中有永久物在你操控下离开战场，则改为如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于4，则消灭之。

932406.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw two cards.
932406.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓两张牌。

932410.oracleText: When this creature enters, creatures you control gain trample and get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
932410.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+X，X为由你操控的生物数量。

932414.oracleText: Sacrifice two artifacts: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
932414.translation: 牺牲两个神器：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

932443.oracleText: Iymrith has ward {o4} as long as it's untapped.
932443.translation: 只要艾穆莉丝未横置，它便具有守护{o4}。

932448.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard if a creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
932448.translation: 如果本回合中有名称不为龙巫妖黑檀死神的生物死去，则你可以从你的坟墓场中施放此牌。

932459.oracleText: Whenever a Dragon you control enters, put a gold counter on this artifact.
932459.translation: 每当一个由你操控的龙进场时，在此神器上放置一个黄金指示物。

932460.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a gold counter from this artifact: Draw a card.
932460.translation: {oT}，从此神器上移去一个黄金指示物：抓一张牌。

932486.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, if you chose a creature other than Gandalf as your Ring-bearer, draw a card.
932486.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，若你选择甘道夫以外的生物作你的持戒人，则抓一张牌。

932490.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
932490.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此地：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

932492.oracleText: Put a loyalty counter on Huatli for each creature you control.
932492.translation: 你每操控一个生物，便在华特莉上放置一个忠诚指示物。

932500.oracleText: Tezzeret deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of artifacts you control. You gain X life.
932500.translation: 泰兹瑞向每位对手各造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的神器数量。你获得X点生命。

932509.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another Spirit, you gain 3 life.
932509.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个精怪，则你获得3点生命。

932528.oracleText: Sacrifice another permanent: Attach this Aura to target creature. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
932528.translation: 牺牲另一个永久物：将此灵气贴附在目标生物上。只能于法术时机起动，且每回合限一次。

932537.oracleText: {o1oW}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying. Activate only as a sorcery.
932537.translation: {o1oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

932548.oracleText: {o3oW}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
932548.translation: {o3oW}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在目标生物上。只能于法术时机起动。

932551.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control four or more creatures, transform this creature.
932551.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控四个或更多生物，转化此生物。

932565.oracleText: Delirium — Sacrifice another creature: This creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
932565.translation: 躁狂～牺牲另一个生物：此生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。只能于你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多时起动此异能。

932577.oracleText: {oT}, Tap an untapped creature you control: Transform this creature.
932577.translation: {oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物：转化此生物。

932602.oracleText: When you sacrifice a Clue, transform this creature.
932602.translation: 当你牺牲一个线索时，转化此生物。

932648.oracleText: When this creature enters, target Spirit gains hexproof until end of turn.
932648.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标精怪获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

932657.oracleText: {o3oUoU}: Put this card from your graveyard onto the battlefield transformed. Activate only as a sorcery.
932657.translation: {o3oUoU}：将此牌从你的坟墓场放进战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

932660.oracleText: When this creature deals combat damage to a player, return it to its owner's hand.
932660.translation: 当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

932663.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard two cards: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
932663.translation: {o1oU}，弃两张牌：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

932665.oracleText: This creature enters with four ice counters on it.
932665.translation: 此生物进场时上面有四个寒冰指示物。

932666.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, remove an ice counter from this creature. Then if it has no ice counters on it, transform it.
932666.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，从此生物上移去一个寒冰指示物。然后若其上没有寒冰指示物，转化它。

932678.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost {o1} less to cast.
932678.translation: 对手施放之以此生物为目标的咒语增加{o1}来施放。

932679.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target opponent.
932679.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化，并贴附在目标对手上。

932692.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each Zombie card in your graveyard.
932692.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你坟墓场中的灵俑牌数量。

932710.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oB}: Transform this creature. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
932710.translation: 躁狂～{o2oB}：转化此生物。只能于你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多时起动此异能。

932729.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may pay {oB}. If you do, return it to its owner's hand.
932729.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，将它移回其拥有者手上。

932730.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may pay {oX}. If you do, return another target Zombie creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield.
932730.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以支付{oX}。若你如此作，将另一张目标法术力值为X的灵俑生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

932742.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
932742.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

932763.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform this creature.
932763.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若上回合没有任一咒语施放过，则转化此生物。

932766.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform this creature.
932766.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若某牌手上回合施放了两个或更多咒语，则转化此生物。

932769.oracleText: When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target.
932769.translation: 当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

932770.oracleText: Create two 1/1 red Devil creature tokens. They have "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
932770.translation: 派出两个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物。它们具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

932784.oracleText: Whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to you or a permanent you control, you may have this creature deal 1 damage to that source's controller.
932784.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的来源对你或任一由你操控的永久物造成伤害时，你可以让此生物对该来源的操控者造成1点伤害。

932795.oracleText: This creature can't block unless you control another Wolf or Werewolf.
932795.translation: 除非你操控另一个狼或狼人，否则此生物不能进行阻挡。

932801.oracleText: Discard a card, Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card.
932801.translation: 弃一张牌，牺牲此生物：抓一张牌。

932887.translation: 每当你牺牲一个线索时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

932902.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it enters with X additional +1/+1 counters on it.

932916.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's end step, that player draws a card. If the player is your opponent and has four or more cards in hand, this enchantment deals 2 damage to that player.
932916.translation: 在每位牌手的结束步骤开始时，该牌手抓一张牌。若该牌手是你的对手，且其手牌为四张或更多，则此结界对他造成2点伤害。

932927.oracleText: Whenever a creature enters, if it entered from your graveyard or you cast it from your graveyard, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped at the beginning of the next end step.
932927.translation: 每当一个生物进场，若它是从你的坟墓场进入战场或是由你从你的坟墓场施放，则在下一个结束步骤开始时，将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

933154.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add two mana in any combination of colors.
