933572.translation: 当李什克进场时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

933593.oracleText: When you cast a Bolas planeswalker spell, exile this card from your graveyard. That planeswalker enters with an additional loyalty counter on it.
933593.translation: 当你施放波拉斯鹏洛客咒语时，从你的坟墓场中放逐此牌。该鹏洛客进场时上面额外有一个忠诚指示物。

933596.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
933596.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

933598.oracleText: Create a colorless artifact token named Etherium Cell with "{oT}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color."
933598.translation: 派出一个无色，名称为乙金源的衍生神器，它具有「{oT}，牺牲此衍生物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

933606.oracleText: At end of combat, if this Vehicle attacked or blocked this combat, put a velocity counter on it. Then if it has two or more velocity counters on it, sacrifice it and draw two cards.
933606.translation: 在战斗结束时，若此载具在本次战斗中攻击或阻挡过，则在其上放置一个速度指示物。然后如果其上有两个或更多速度指示物，则牺牲它且抓两张牌。

933626.oracleText: Whenever this creature dies or another artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return to your hand target artifact card in your graveyard with lesser mana value.
933626.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的神器从战场进入坟墓场时，将目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值小于前述神器的神器牌移回你手上。

933628.oracleText: When this creature dies, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card with mana value 3 or less. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
933628.translation: 当此生物死去时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。将所有以此法展示且未施放的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

933660.oracleText: Until end of turn, Gideon becomes a 4/4 Human Soldier creature with indestructible that's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
933660.translation: 直到回合结束，基定成为4/4，具不灭异能的人类／士兵生物，且仍然是鹏洛客。防止本回合中将对他造成的所有伤害。

933664.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose a card name.
933664.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择一个牌名。

933671.oracleText: Oketra can't attack or block unless you control at least three other creatures.
933671.translation: 除非你操控至少三个其他生物，否则欧柯塔不能进行攻击或阻挡。

933682.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may gain 2 life.
933682.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以获得2点生命。

933687.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile target creature if it attacked or blocked this turn. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
933687.translation: 当此生物进场时，如果目标生物本回合曾进行攻击或阻挡，你可以放逐该生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将所放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

933692.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a time counter on this enchantment.
933692.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在此结界上放置一个计时指示物。

933693.oracleText: Once each turn, you may pay {o0} rather than pay the mana cost for a spell you cast with mana value X or less, where X is the number of time counters on this enchantment.
933693.translation: 你于施放法术力值等于或小于X的咒语时，可以支付{o0}，而不支付其法术力费用，X为此结界上的计时指示物数量。每回合限如此作一次。

933717.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, draw three cards.
933717.translation: 当此结界进场时，抓三张牌。

933729.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except if this creature was embalmed, the token has no mana cost, it's white, and it's a Zombie in addition to its other types.
933729.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场，但如果此生物已遗存，则该衍生物没有法术力费用，是白色且额外具有灵俑此类别。

933735.oracleText: When you cycle this card, untap target permanent.
933735.translation: 当你循环此牌时，重置目标永久物。

933739.oracleText: {o1}: This creature gains haste until end of turn.
933739.translation: {o1}：此生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

933744.oracleText: Bontu can't attack or block unless a creature died under your control this turn.
933744.translation: 除非本回合有生物在你的操控下死去，否则芭图不能进行攻击或阻挡。

933753.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
933753.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

933755.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you have one or fewer cards in hand.
933755.translation: {o2oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动，且于你的手牌为一张或更少时才能起动。

933767.oracleText: When this creature enters, put two -1/-1 counters on target creature you control.
933767.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个-1/-1指示物。

933778.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, target creature can't block this turn.
933778.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

933781.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks.
933781.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。

933787.oracleText: If this creature hasn't been exerted this turn, you may exert it as it attacks. When you do, untap all other creatures you control and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
933787.translation: 如果本回合尚未耗竭此生物，则你可以于其攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，重置所有由你操控的其他生物，且在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

933791.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
933791.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

933798.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it deals 4 damage to target non-Dragon creature an opponent controls.
933798.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它向目标由对手操控的非龙生物造成4点伤害。

933801.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact, creature, or land on the battlefield, if it isn't a mana ability, this creature deals 2 damage to that player.
933801.translation: 每当任一对手起动战场上任一神器、生物或地的起动式异能时，若其不是法术力异能，则此生物对该牌手造成2点伤害。

933803.oracleText: Hazoret can't attack or block unless you have one or fewer cards in hand.
933803.translation: 除非你的手牌为一张或更少，否则哈佐蕾不能进行攻击或阻挡。

933809.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, this creature deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target.
933809.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，此生物对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量。

933824.oracleText: When this Aura enters, you may have enchanted creature fight target creature an opponent controls.
933824.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你可以让所结附的生物与目标由对手操控的生物互斗。

933828.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
933828.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

933830.oracleText: When this creature enters, put three -1/-1 counters on target creature you control.
933830.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置三个-1/-1指示物。

933834.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, remove a -1/-1 counter from it. If you do, you gain 1 life.
933834.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，从其上移去一个-1/-1指示物。若你如此作，你获得1点生命。

933848.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each kind of counter on target permanent, put another counter of that kind on it or remove one from it.
933848.translation: 当此生物进场时，对目标永久物上每种指示物而言，在其上放置另一个该种类的指示物或从其上移去一个该种类的指示物。

933854.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
933854.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

933859.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, untap all other creatures you control.
933859.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，重置所有其他由你操控的生物。

933864.oracleText: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card or a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of loyalty counters on Nissa, you may put that card onto the battlefield.
933864.translation: 检视你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是地牌或法术力值等于或小于妮莎上忠诚指示物数量的生物牌，则你可以将该牌放进战场。

933911.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your graveyard, hand, and/or library for a card named God-Pharaoh's Gift and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle. Activate only if there are six or more creature cards in your graveyard.
933911.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你的坟墓场，手牌和／或牌库中搜寻一张名称为法老神赋礼的牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。只能于你的坟墓场中有六张或更多生物牌时起动。

933958.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, you gain 3 life.
933958.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，则你获得3点生命。

933975.oracleText: {oT}, Exert this creature: Create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token with vigilance.
933975.translation: {oT}，耗竭此生物：派出一个1/1白色，具警戒异能的战士衍生生物。

933978.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may draw cards equal to its power. If you do, discard two cards.
933978.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以抓等同于其力量的牌。若你如此作，则弃两张牌。

933994.oracleText: When you cycle this card, counter target activated or triggered ability you don't control.
933994.translation: 当你循环此牌时，反击目标不由你操控的起动式或触发式异能。

933997.oracleText: {oU}: This creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

934011.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, put a -1/-1 counter on this creature.
934011.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，在此生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

934012.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, remove all -1/-1 counters from it.
934012.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，移去其上所有的-1/-1指示物。

934042.oracleText: {oT}, Exert this creature: It deals 1 damage to target creature.
934042.translation: {oT}，耗竭此生物：它对目标生物造成1点伤害。

934046.oracleText: This enchantment enters with a doom counter on it.
934046.translation: 此结界进场时上面有一个末日指示物。

934047.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value equal to the number of doom counters on this enchantment, this enchantment deals that much damage to any target. Then put a doom counter on this enchantment.
934047.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等同于此结界上末日指示物数量的咒语时，此结界对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。然后在此结界上放置一个末日指示物。

934054.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, you may have this creature deal 3 damage to target creature.
934054.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，则你可以使此生物对目标生物造成3点伤害。

934058.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, this creature gains flying until end of turn if you control a creature with flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
934058.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若某个由你操控的生物具有飞行异能，则此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束；且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

934061.oracleText: {oT}, Exert this creature: Add two mana of any one color.
934061.translation: {oT}，耗竭此生物：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。

934064.oracleText: Samut deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.
934064.translation: 撒姆特对一个或两个目标生物和／或牌手造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。

934097.oracleText: {o2}: This artifact becomes a copy of target artifact, creature, enchantment, or land until end of turn.
934097.translation: {o2}：此神器成为目标神器，生物，结界或地的复制品直到回合结束。

934110.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return each creature card exiled with this land to the battlefield under its owner's control.
934110.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲此地：将所有以此地放逐的生物牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

934116.oracleText: {o2oRoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Desert: This land deals 2 damage to each opponent.
934116.translation: {o2oRoR}，{oT}，牺牲一个沙漠：此地向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

934143.oracleText: As long as this creature is attacking, it gets +2/+0.
934143.translation: 只要此生物正进行攻击，它便得+2/+0。

934144.oracleText: Pay 4 life: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
934144.translation: 支付4点生命：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

934154.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
934154.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

934159.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
934159.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

934171.oracleText: When this creature enters, it explores.
934171.translation: 当此生物进场时，令它勘察。

934174.oracleText: {o7oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
934174.translation: {o7oW}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

934177.oracleText: Pay 2 life: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
934177.translation: 支付2点生命：此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

934178.oracleText: Pay 2 life: This creature gains vigilance until end of turn.
934178.translation: 支付2点生命：此生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

934181.oracleText: When this creature enters, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
934181.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

934184.oracleText: This creature has double strike as long as you control a Dinosaur.
934184.translation: 只要你操控恐龙，此生物便具有连击异能。

934198.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for any number of cards named Legion Conquistador, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
934198.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量名称为军团征服者的牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

934218.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
934218.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

934221.oracleText: When this Aura enters, you gain 2 life.
934221.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你获得2点生命。

934224.oracleText: {o3oWoW}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a Dinosaur card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
934224.translation: {o3oWoW}，牺牲此生物：从你的牌库中搜寻一张恐龙牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

934227.oracleText: This creature has flying as long as you control a Dinosaur.
934227.translation: 只要你操控恐龙，此生物便具有飞行异能。

934258.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: This creature deals damage equal to its toughness to target creature blocking or blocked by it.
934258.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：此生物对目标阻挡它或被它阻挡的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于它的防御力。

934262.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, tap target creature an opponent controls.
934262.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

934272.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, destroy all non-Dinosaur creatures.
934272.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你从你手上施放之，则消灭所有非恐龙的生物。

934274.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose a creature type.
934274.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择一种生物类别。

934282.oracleText: {o2oU}: This creature can't be blocked this turn.

934283.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
934283.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

934286.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an Equipment or Vehicle card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
934286.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张武具或载具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

934297.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another Pirate, tap up to two target nonland permanents.
934297.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个海盗，则横置至多两个目标非地永久物。

934306.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target player mills half their library, rounded up.
934306.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标牌手将其牌库从顶上算起一半数量的牌置入其坟墓场，小数点后进位。

934314.oracleText: When this token becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it.
934314.translation: 当此衍生物成为咒语的目标时，将它牺牲。

934315.oracleText: Create a 2/2 blue Illusion creature token with "When this token becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it."
934315.translation: 派出一个2/2蓝色虚影衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物成为咒语的目标时，将它牺牲。」

934316.oracleText: Create two tokens that are copies of Jace, except they're not legendary.
934316.translation: 派出两个衍生物，这些衍生物为杰斯的复制品，但不是传奇。

934344.oracleText: Whenever another Merfolk you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
934344.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的人鱼进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

934362.oracleText: This creature has flying as long as you control another Merfolk.
934362.translation: 只要你操控另一个人鱼，此生物便具有飞行异能。

934365.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
934365.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾以生物攻击，则你可以抓一张牌。如果你如此作，则弃一张牌。

934368.oracleText: {o7oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Draw three cards.

934373.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target spell or ability that targets you or a creature you control.
934373.translation: {oU}，牺牲此生物：反击目标咒语或异能，且其须以你或由你操控的生物为目标。

934390.oracleText: When this creature enters, return a creature you control to its owner's hand.
934390.translation: 当此生物进场时，将一个由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

934393.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap all creatures target opponent controls.
934393.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置由目标对手操控的所有生物。

934411.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent loses 1 life for each Vampire you control.
934411.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个吸血鬼，目标对手便失去1点生命。

934415.oracleText: {o7oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Target opponent loses 4 life and you gain 4 life.
934415.translation: {o7oB}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：目标对手失去4点生命且你获得4点生命。

934418.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature that died this turn.
934418.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于本回合中死去的生物数量。

934433.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, target opponent discards a card.
934433.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾以生物攻击，则目标对手弃一张牌。

934435.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}: Exile two target cards from an opponent's graveyard. This creature explores.
934435.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}：将两张目标在同一对手坟墓场中的牌放逐。令此生物勘察。

934438.oracleText: Tap three untapped Vampires you control: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
934438.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的吸血鬼：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

934441.oracleText: This creature can't attack unless you control an artifact.
934441.translation: 除非你操控神器，否则此生物不能攻击。

934449.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player loses a third of their life, rounded up.
934449.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各失去三分之一的生命，小数点后进位。

934455.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if you control another nontoken Pirate, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 2/2 black Pirate creature token with menace.
934455.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你操控另一个非衍生物的海盗，则你可以支付{o2}。如果你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色，具威慑异能的海盗衍生生物。

934458.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target creature an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
934458.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。

934466.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature, nonland card from it. Exile that card until this creature leaves the battlefield.
934466.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非生物且非地的牌。放逐该牌，直到此生物离开战场为止。

934502.oracleText: {oB}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
934502.translation: {oB}：此生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

934508.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
934508.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

934529.oracleText: When this creature dies, target opponent creates two Treasure tokens.
934529.translation: 当此生物死去时，目标对手派出两个珍宝衍生物。

934539.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 3 damage to target opponent or planeswalker and 3 damage to up to one target creature.
934539.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向目标对手造成3点伤害，且对至多一个目标生物造成3点伤害。

934569.oracleText: {o7oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 3 damage to each of up to two target creatures.
934569.translation: {o7oR}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：它对至多两个目标生物各造成3点伤害。

934578.oracleText: This creature has menace as long as you control another Pirate.
934578.translation: 只要你操控另一个海盗，此生物便具有威慑异能。

934589.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Pirate spell, untap this creature.
934589.translation: 每当你施放海盗咒语时，重置此生物。

934592.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: This enchantment deals 1 damage to any target.
934592.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个神器或生物：此结界对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

934599.oracleText: Whenever another creature enters, this creature deals 1 damage to that creature's controller.
934599.translation: 每当另一个生物进场时，此生物对该生物的操控者造成1点伤害。

934602.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, create a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token with trample.
934602.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，派出一个3/3绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物。

934605.oracleText: Raid — {o3oRoR}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you attacked this turn.
934605.translation: 突击～{o3oRoR}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你曾以生物攻击的回合中起动。

934613.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw three cards, then discard two cards at random. If two cards that share a card type are discarded this way, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
934613.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓三张牌，然后随机弃两张牌。如果以此法弃掉的两张牌之间具共通的牌类别，则在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

934622.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, target opponent sacrifices a permanent of their choice.
934622.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾以生物攻击，则目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的永久物。

934628.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals 3 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
934628.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，它向目标对手造成3点伤害。

934637.oracleText: As long as you control another Dinosaur, this creature gets +2/+0 and has trample.
934637.translation: 只要你操控另一个恐龙，此生物便得+2/+0且具有践踏异能。

934640.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if you control a Dinosaur, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
934640.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你操控恐龙，则此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

934643.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it becomes a copy of another target nonlegendary attacking creature until end of turn.
934643.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，选择另一个目标进行攻击且非传奇的生物。它成为该生物的复制品直到回合结束。

934684.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may exile target card from a graveyard. If a creature card is exiled this way, you gain 2 life. If a noncreature card is exiled this way, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
934684.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，你可以将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果以此法放逐的是生物牌，则你获得2点生命。如果以此法放逐的是非生物牌，则此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

934689.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
934689.translation: 每当此生物被阻挡时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

934692.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+2 as long as you control a Dinosaur.
934692.translation: 只要你操控恐龙，此生物便得+2/+2。

934697.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, it explores.
934697.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，令它勘察。

934711.oracleText: {o7oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn.
934711.translation: {o7oG}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：直到回合结束，目标生物得+5/+5且获得践踏异能。

934714.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target Merfolk you control.
934714.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的人鱼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

934717.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you control another Merfolk or an Island.
934717.translation: 只要你操控海岛或另一个人鱼，此生物便得+1/+1。

934724.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
934724.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后将其牌库洗牌。

934730.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
934730.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

934733.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you gain 2 life.
934733.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，你获得2点生命。

934736.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, draw a card.
934736.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，抓一张牌。

934750.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
934750.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

934753.oracleText: This creature can block an additional creature each combat.
934753.translation: 此生物每次战斗可以额外多阻挡一个生物。

934765.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control enters, you gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
934765.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。

934768.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target Merfolk you control.
934768.translation: 当此生物进场时，在至多两个目标由你操控的人鱼上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

934774.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and you gain 3 life.
934774.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你获得3点生命。

934790.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each other attacking Pirate.
934790.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每有一个进行攻击的其他海盗，它便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

934792.oracleText: Whenever Gishath deals combat damage to a player, reveal that many cards from the top of your library. Put any number of Dinosaur creature cards from among them onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
934792.translation: 每当基撒斯对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你的牌库顶展示等量的牌。将其中任意数量的恐龙生物牌放进战场，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

934794.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile another target creature or artifact until this creature leaves the battlefield. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
934794.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐另一个目标生物或神器，直到人质挟匪离开战场为止。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放之，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放。

934798.oracleText: Huatli deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures. Creatures dealt damage this way can't block this turn.
934798.translation: 华特莉对任意数量的目标生物造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。以此法受到伤害的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

934804.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each other creature.
934804.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对每个其他生物各造成1点伤害。

934808.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token with trample.
934808.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个3/3绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物。

934816.oracleText: Tishana's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
934816.translation: 雷霆之声提莎娜的力量和防御力各等同于你的手牌数量。

934830.oracleText: When this Vehicle attacks, exile it at end of combat, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.
934830.translation: 当此载具攻击，在战斗结束时放逐它，然后将其在你的操控下移回战场且已转化。

934836.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, target opponent creates two 0/2 green Plant creature tokens with defender.
934836.translation: 当此武具进场时，目标对手派出两个0/2绿色，具守军异能的植物衍生生物。

934838.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may transform this Equipment.
934838.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以转化此武具。

934845.oracleText: This artifact doesn't untap during your untap step.
934845.translation: 此神器于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

934846.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: This artifact deals 2 damage to any target.
934846.translation: {o4}，{oT}：此神器对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

934847.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may discard a card. If you do, untap this artifact.
934847.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则重置此神器。

934850.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card.
934850.translation: 每当此载具对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手弃一张牌。

934855.oracleText: When this artifact enters, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
934855.translation: 当此神器进场时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

934857.oracleText: As this artifact enters, choose a creature type.
934857.translation: 于此神器进场时，选择一种生物类别。

934862.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a charge counter on this artifact. Then if there are four or more charge counters on it, you may remove those counters and transform it.
934862.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在此神器上放置一个充电指示物。然后如果其上有四个或更多充电指示物，你可以移去这些指示物并转化它。

934869.oracleText: {oT}, Exile this artifact: Exile all graveyards.
934869.translation: {oT}，放逐此神器：放逐所有坟墓场。

934871.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, put a +1/+1 counter on this Vehicle.
934871.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，在此载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

934880.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control seven or more lands, transform this artifact.
934880.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控七个或更多地，转化此神器。

934885.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Scry 1. Put a landmark counter on this artifact. Then if there are three or more landmark counters on it, remove those counters, transform this artifact, and create three Treasure tokens.
934885.translation: {o1}，{oT}：占卜1。在此神器上放置一个地标指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多地标指示物，则移去这些指示物，转化此神器，并派出三个珍宝衍生物。

934895.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Each player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield, then shuffles.
934895.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此地：消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。每位牌手各从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

934913.oracleText: As long as you control a Jace planeswalker, this creature gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
934913.translation: 只要你操控杰斯鹏洛客，此生物便得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

934927.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Huatli, Dinosaur Knight, reveal it, then put it into your hand. If you searched your library this way, shuffle.
934927.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为恐龙骑士华特莉的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

934999.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less.
934999.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物。

935000.oracleText: When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, target opponent creates a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token with trample.
935000.translation: 当此结界离开战场时，目标对手派出一个3/3绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物。

935002.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
935002.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

935003.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target Vampire gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the power of the exiled card.
935003.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标吸血鬼得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为所放逐之牌的力量。

935016.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature.
935016.translation: 防止将对此生物造成的所有战斗伤害。

935022.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, untap this creature.
935022.translation: 每当你获得生命时，重置此生物。

935024.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Vampire card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
935024.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张吸血鬼牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于其上。

935032.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target Dinosaur you control gains flying until end of turn.
935032.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的恐龙获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

935035.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
935035.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

935041.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if you lost life last turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
935041.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若你上回合曾失去生命，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

935042.oracleText: When this creature dies, you gain life equal to its toughness.
935042.translation: 当此生物死去时，你获得等同于其防御力的生命。

935051.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on another target Vampire you control.
935051.translation: 当此生物进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的吸血鬼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

935054.oracleText: This creature has flying as long as you have the city's blessing.
935054.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，此生物便具有飞行异能。

935060.oracleText: This creature gets +3/+0 as long as you have the city's blessing.
935060.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，此生物便得+3/+0。

935066.oracleText: When this Aura enters, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
935066.translation: 当此灵气进场时，派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

935071.oracleText: This creature has vigilance as long as you control another Dinosaur.
935071.translation: 只要你操控另一个恐龙，此生物便具有警戒异能。

935077.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
935077.translation: 激怒～每当此生物受到伤害时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

935085.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create two 1/1 blue Merfolk creature tokens with hexproof.
935085.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出两个1/1蓝色，具辟邪异能的人鱼衍生生物。

935089.oracleText: When this creature enters, each token that would be created under an opponent's control this turn is created under your control instead.
935089.translation: 当此生物进场时，所有将于本回合中在对手操控下派出的衍生物，改为在你的操控下派出之。

935095.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't attack with a creature this turn, sacrifice this Aura.
935095.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你于本回合中未以生物攻击，则牺牲此灵气。

935098.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, you may return target creature to its owner's hand.
935098.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾以生物攻击，则你可以将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

935109.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, target player exiles all cards from their hand face down, then draws that many cards.
935109.translation: 当此结界进场时，目标牌手牌面朝下地放逐其手牌，然后抓等量的牌。

935110.oracleText: When this enchantment is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return the exiled cards to their owner's hand.
935110.translation: 当此结界从战场进入坟墓场时，将所放逐的牌移回其拥有者手上。

935127.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by Dinosaurs.
935127.translation: 此生物不能被恐龙阻挡。

935130.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.
935130.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓三张牌，然后将两张牌从你手上以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

935149.oracleText: As long as you have the city's blessing, this creature has hexproof and can't be blocked.
935149.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，此生物便具有辟邪异能且不能被阻挡。

935153.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you have the city's blessing.
935153.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，此生物便得+1/+1。

935155.oracleText: {o2oUoU}, {oT}, Put this creature on the bottom of its owner's library: Take an extra turn after this one. Activate only if you have the city's blessing.
935155.translation: {o2oUoU}，{oT}，将此生物置于其拥有者的牌库底：于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。只能于你有黄金城祝福时起动。

935157.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature defending player controls loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
935157.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，直到回合结束，目标由防御牌手操控的生物失去所有异能，且基础力量与防御力为0/1。

935165.oracleText: When this creature enters, you draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is the number of Vampires you control.
935165.translation: 当此生物进场时，你抓X张牌且你失去X点生命，X为由你操控的吸血鬼数量。

935174.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage to a Dinosaur, destroy that creature.
935174.translation: 每当此生物对任一恐龙造成伤害时，消灭后者。

935179.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+2 as long as you have the city's blessing.
935179.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，此生物便得+2/+2。

935185.translation: 当此生物进场时，除非你操控另一个海盗，否则你失去2点生命。

935187.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Pirate card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
935187.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张海盗牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于其上。

935193.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 as long as it's attacking.

935205.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, if you have the city's blessing, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

935211.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard if you gained life this turn.

935217.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target creature an opponent controls.
935217.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物。

935227.oracleText: {oB}, Reveal this card from your hand: Put a prey counter on target creature. Activate only during your turn.

935270.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张恐龙牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于其上。

935919.translation: 你每操控一个其他的老鼠，此生物便得+1/+0。

935924.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice another creature. If you can't, this token deals 6 damage to you.
935924.translation: 在你的维持开始时，牺牲另一个生物。若你无法如此作，则此衍生物对你造成6点伤害。

935925.oracleText: Create a 6/6 black Demon creature token with flying, trample, and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice another creature. If you can't, this token deals 6 damage to you."
935925.translation: 派出一个6/6黑色，具飞行与践踏异能的恶魔衍生生物，且具有「在你的维持开始时，牺牲另一个生物。若你无法如此作，则此衍生物对你造成6点伤害。」

935936.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If a Saproling was sacrificed this way, you gain 2 life.
935936.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果以此法牺牲的是腐生物，则你获得2点生命。

935942.oracleText: When Torgaar enters, up to one target player's life total becomes half their starting life total, rounded down.
935942.translation: 当饥馑化身托迦尔进场时，至多一位目标牌手的总生命成为其起始总生命的一半，小数点后舍去。

935945.oracleText: Whenever Urgoros deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card at random. If the player can't, you draw a card.
935945.translation: 每当虚无幽灵乌格洛对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手随机弃一张牌。若该牌手无法如此作，则你抓一张牌。

935965.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if that spell was kicked, this creature gets +1/+1 and gains menace until end of turn.
935965.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若该咒语已增幅，则直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+1且具有威慑异能。

935968.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+2 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it.
935968.translation: 此生物上每贴附一个灵气和武具，便得+2/+2。

935985.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals X damage to target creature an opponent controls, where X is the number of Wizards you control.
935985.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的法术师数量。

935987.oracleText: This Saga deals 1 damage to each creature without flying.
935987.translation: 此传纪对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成1点伤害。

935989.oracleText: Sacrifice a Mountain. If you do, this Saga deals 3 damage to each creature.
935989.translation: 牺牲一个山脉。如果你如此作，则此传纪对每个生物各造成3点伤害。

936000.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
936000.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

936003.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another Wizard, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
936003.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个法术师，则此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

936013.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.
936013.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

936019.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, choose four nonenchantment permanents you don't control and put an aim counter on each of them.
936019.translation: 当此结界进场时，选择四个不由你操控的非结界永久物，并在其上各放置一个瞄准指示物。

936031.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
936031.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

936034.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
936034.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

936037.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, put a lore counter on target Saga you control.
936037.translation: 当此生物攻击时，在目标由你操控的传纪上放置一个学问指示物。

936040.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
936040.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器：此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

936047.oracleText: This creature gets -2/-0 as long as two or more creatures are blocking it.
936047.translation: 只要此生物被两个或更多生物阻挡，它便得-2/-0。

936060.oracleText: When this creature enters, create three 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
936060.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出三个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

936061.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice a Goblin: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
936061.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲一个鬼怪：此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

936068.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, if this creature wasn't kicked, sacrifice it.
936068.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，若此生物未增幅，则将它牺牲。

936071.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard or from exile.
936071.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场或放逐区中施放此牌。

936075.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, flip two coins. If both coins come up heads, this creature gains double strike until end of turn. If both coins come up tails, this creature gains menace until end of turn.
936075.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，掷两枚硬币。如果两枚硬币均是正面，则此生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。如果两枚硬币均是反面，则此生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

936078.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, for each Aura and Equipment attached to Valduk, create a 3/1 red Elemental creature token with trample and haste. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step.
936078.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，源火守卫瓦杜克上每贴附一个灵气和武具，便派出一个3/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的元素衍生生物。在下一结束步骤开始时，放逐这些衍生物。

936083.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may pay {o2oR}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
936083.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，你可以支付{o2oR}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

936102.oracleText: If this creature was kicked, it enters with three +1/+1 counters on it.
936102.translation: 如果此生物已增幅，则它进场时上面有三个+1/+1指示物。

936108.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by an equipped creature, destroy all Equipment attached to that creature at end of combat.
936108.translation: 每当此生物阻挡一个佩带武具的生物，或被一个佩带武具的生物阻挡，在战斗结束时消灭所有贴附在后者生物上的武具。

936118.oracleText: When this card is put into your graveyard from your library, shuffle your graveyard into your library.
936118.translation: 当此牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场时，将你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

936129.oracleText: If Grunn was kicked, it enters with five +1/+1 counters on it.
936129.translation: 如果孤独猴王古恩已增幅，它进场时上面有五个+1/+1指示物。

936138.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, you gain 10 life.
936138.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则你获得10点生命。

936149.oracleText: Whenever another Elf you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Marwyn.
936149.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的妖精进场时，在培育人玛雯上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

936157.oracleText: Multani gets +1/+1 for each land you control and each land card in your graveyard.
936157.translation: 你每操控一个地或你坟墓场中每有一张地牌，亚维马雅化身穆塔尼便得+1/+1。

936188.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it fights another target creature.
936188.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则它与另一个目标生物互斗。

936199.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
936199.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

936210.oracleText: If Darigaaz would die, instead exile it with three egg counters on it.
936210.translation: 如果复焚龙王达里迦将死去，则改为将它放逐且上面有三个蛋卵指示物。

936211.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled with an egg counter on it, remove an egg counter from it. Then if this card has no egg counters on it, return it to the battlefield.
936211.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐且其上有蛋卵指示物，则从其上移去一个蛋卵指示物。然后如果此牌上没有蛋卵指示物，则将它移回战场。

936213.oracleText: When Garna enters, return to your hand all creature cards in your graveyard that were put there from anywhere this turn.
936213.translation: 当炎脉加娜进场时，将所有于本回合中从任何区域置入你坟墓场的生物牌移回你手上。

936219.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if that spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on Hallar, then Hallar deals damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.
936219.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若该咒语已增幅，则在炎箭贺拉尔上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后贺拉尔向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于其上的+1/+1指示物数量。

936239.oracleText: When Rona enters, you may exile target historic card from your graveyard.
936239.translation: 当基克斯信徒罗娜进场时，你可以将目标史迹牌从你的坟墓场放逐。

936244.oracleText: Shanna can't be the target of abilities your opponents control.
936244.translation: 西赛后人莎娜不能成为由对手操控之异能的目标。

936248.oracleText: Whenever a Saproling you control dies, Slimefoot deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.
936248.translation: 每当一个由你操控的腐生物死去时，寄舱客黏足向每位对手各造成1点伤害，且你获得1点生命。

936268.oracleText: {o2}: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
936268.translation: {o2}：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

936276.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.
936276.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。

936283.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, attach this Equipment to target creature you control.
936283.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，将此武具贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

936288.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return another target historic permanent you control to its owner's hand.
936288.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将另一个目标由你操控的史迹永久物移回其拥有者手上。

936295.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, each player draws a card.
936295.translation: 每当此生物攻击或阻挡时，每位牌手各抓一张牌。

936308.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this creature.
936308.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为此生物之复制品。

936314.oracleText: When this artifact enters, you gain 3 life.
936314.translation: 当此神器进场时，你获得3点生命。

936328.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
936328.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

936338.oracleText: Traxos enters tapped and doesn't untap during your untap step.
936338.translation: 萼城劫运刹索斯须横置进场，且于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

936354.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Mountain or a Plains.
936354.translation: 除非你操控山脉或平原，否则此地须横置进场。

936357.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Forest or an Island.
936357.translation: 除非你操控树林或海岛，否则此地须横置进场。

936360.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Plains or a Swamp.
936360.translation: 除非你操控平原或沼泽，否则此地须横置进场。

936362.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
936362.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，牺牲此地：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

936364.oracleText: {o4oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw two cards.

936366.oracleText: {o3oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
936366.translation: {o3oW}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出两个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

936368.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Then put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
936368.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，牺牲此地：检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。然后将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

936370.oracleText: {o4oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target land.

936373.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control an Island or a Mountain.
936373.translation: 除非你操控海岛或山脉，否则此地须横置进场。

936376.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a Swamp or a Forest.
936376.translation: 除非你操控沼泽或树林，否则此地须横置进场。

936389.oracleText: When Niambi enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Teferi, Timebender, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
936389.translation: 当可靠疗疾师妮安碧进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为曲时大师泰菲力的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

936392.oracleText: As long as you control a Teferi planeswalker, this creature gets +4/+0.
936392.translation: 只要你操控泰菲力鹏洛客，此生物便得+4/+0。

936396.oracleText: Add {oRoR}. Chandra deals 2 damage to target player.
936396.translation: 加{oRoR}。舞焰勇将茜卓对目标牌手造成2点伤害。

936397.oracleText: Chandra deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
936397.translation: 舞焰勇将茜卓对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

936398.oracleText: Chandra deals 10 damage to target player and each creature and planeswalker they control.
936398.translation: 舞焰勇将茜卓对目标牌手及每个由其操控的生物与鹏洛客各造成10点伤害。

936405.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if you control a Chandra planeswalker, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
936405.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你操控茜卓鹏洛客，则此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

936485.oracleText: Whenever a creature or planeswalker you control dies, you may sacrifice this enchantment. If you do, create a 4/4 white Avatar creature token with flying.
936485.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客死去时，你可以牺牲此结界。若你如此作，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的圣者衍生生物。

936494.oracleText: When this creature enters, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
936494.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

936496.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
936496.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得先攻异能。

936506.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 1 life for each creature you control.
936506.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个生物，便获得1点生命。

936509.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
936509.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

936524.oracleText: When this Aura enters, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
936524.translation: 当此灵气进场时，派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

936528.oracleText: When Lena enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token for each nontoken creature you control.
936528.translation: 当无私斗士莉娜进场时，你每操控一个非衍生物的生物，便派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

936541.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with power 2 or less from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
936541.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张力量等于或小于2的生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

936544.oracleText: As long as this creature is enchanted or equipped, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
936544.translation: 只要此生物上结附了灵气或佩带了武具，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

936549.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Exile target player's graveyard.
936549.translation: 牺牲此生物：放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

936552.oracleText: {o3oWoWoW}: Until end of turn, this creature gets +2/+2 and gains lifelink.
936552.translation: {o3oWoWoW}：直到回合结束，此生物得+2/+2且获得系命异能。

936560.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by red creatures.
936560.translation: 此生物不能被红色生物阻挡。

936561.oracleText: When this creature enters or becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you gain 3 life.
936561.translation: 每当此生物进场或成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你获得3点生命。

936567.oracleText: Remove all counters from target creature. It can't have counters put on it for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield.
936567.translation: 移去目标生物上的所有指示物。于此生物仍在战场上的时段内，该生物上不能放置指示物。

936569.oracleText: Target opponent loses all counters. That player can't get counters for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield.
936569.translation: 目标对手失去所有指示物。于此生物仍在战场上的时段内，该牌手不能得到指示物。

• Target opponent loses all counters. That player can't get counters for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield.

当此生物进场时，选择一项～

936573.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

936586.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
936586.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

936595.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked except by Spirits.
936595.translation: 此生物只能被精怪阻挡。

936610.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 as long as you control an artifact.
936610.translation: 只要你操控神器，此生物便得+1/+0。

936615.oracleText: As this Aura enters, choose a creature.
936615.translation: 于此灵气进场时，选择一个生物。

936619.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature you control.
936619.translation: 你可以使此生物当成任一由你操控之生物的复制品来进入场。

936622.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Until end of turn, if a nontoken creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead.
936622.translation: 牺牲此生物：直到回合结束，如果某非衍生物的生物将进场，且未有牌手施放之，则改为将它放逐。

936648.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control an artifact, draw a card.
936648.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控神器，则抓一张牌。

936653.oracleText: When this creature enters, target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/5 for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield.
936653.translation: 当此生物进场时，于此生物仍在战场上的时段内，目标由你操控的神器成为基础力量与防御力为5/5的神器生物。

936662.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by green creatures.
936662.translation: 此生物不能被绿色生物阻挡。

938266.oracleText: {o3oR}: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

938269.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this creature deals 1 damage to each player. Then if you have 10 or less life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
938269.translation: 在你的维持开始时，此生物对每位牌手各造成1点伤害。然后如果你的总生命为10或更少，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

938272.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control with flying gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
938272.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控且具飞行异能的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

938275.oracleText: {o2oB}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

938278.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature, then scry 2.
938278.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物，然后占卜2。

938284.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.
938284.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

938286.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Until your next turn, this creature's base power becomes twice that card's power and its base toughness becomes twice that card's toughness. Put the revealed cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
938286.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到你展示出一张生物牌为止。直到你的下一个回合，此生物的基础力量成为该牌力量的两倍，且其基础防御力成为该牌防御力的两倍。将所展示的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

938290.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
938290.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

938293.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 1 or less attacks, this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking.
938293.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或小于1的生物攻击时，此结界对其所攻击的牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

938296.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature an opponent controls can't block this turn.
938296.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

938300.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent and 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
938300.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每位对手各造成1点伤害并向由对手操控的每个生物各造成1点伤害。

938323.oracleText: {o3oG}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

938327.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact, creature, or land that isn't a mana ability, this creature deals 1 damage to that player.
938327.translation: 每当任一对手起动神器、生物或地上不属法术力异能之异能时，此生物对该牌手造成1点伤害。

938328.oracleText: {o3oRoR}: This creature gets +3/+3 and gains menace until end of turn.
938328.translation: {o3oRoR}：直到回合结束，此生物得+3/+3且获得威慑异能。

938337.oracleText: When this creature enters, discard a card, then draw a card. If this creature's spectacle cost was paid, instead discard your hand, then draw three cards.
938337.translation: 当此生物进场时，弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。若曾支付此生物的揭幕费用，则改为弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

938346.oracleText: When this creature enters, count the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures you control. Creatures your opponents control with power less than or equal to that number can't block this turn.
938346.translation: 当此生物进场时，计算由你操控的生物上之+1/+1指示物总数量数量。本回合中，由对手操控且力量等于或小于该数量的生物不能进行阻挡。

938352.oracleText: {o3oR}: This creature deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets. Activate only if this creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
938352.translation: {o3oR}：此生物对任意一个或两个目标造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。只能于此生物上有+1/+1指示物时起动。

938358.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice this creature: Gain control of target creature with power 3 or less until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
938358.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲此生物：获得目标力量等于或小于3之生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

938361.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to each player.
938361.translation: {oT}：此生物对每位牌手各造成1点伤害。

938367.oracleText: {oR}: This creature can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with defender.
938367.translation: {oR}：此生物本回合只能被具守军异能的生物阻挡。

938371.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 green Ooze creature token.
938371.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2绿色流浆衍生生物。

938379.oracleText: When this creature enters, other creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain vigilance and trample until end of turn.
938379.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+2/+2且获得警戒与践踏异能。

938384.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each Gate you control.
938384.translation: 你每操控一个门，此生物便得+1/+1。

938385.oracleText: As long as you control two or more Gates, this creature has vigilance and trample.
938385.translation: 只要你操控两个或更多门，此生物便具有警戒与践踏异能。

938392.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, you may search your library for a card named Growth-Chamber Guardian, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
938392.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为生长室守护者的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

938394.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
938394.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

938399.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any type that a land you control could produce. If this creature has a +1/+1 counter on it, add three mana of that type instead.
938399.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其类别为由你操控的地能产生之任一类别。如果此生物上有+1/+1指示物，则改为加三点该类别的法术力。

938426.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it on top of your library. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
938426.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物或地牌，并将它置于你的牌库顶。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

938430.oracleText: {o3oU}: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
938430.translation: {o3oU}：此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

938433.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 2 life.
938433.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得2点生命。

938436.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, this creature gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
938436.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

938468.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card and you gain 3 life.
938468.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌，且你获得3点生命。

938477.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
938477.translation: {oT}，从由你操控的生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物：此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

938479.oracleText: This enchantment enters under the control of an opponent of your choice.

938497.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
938497.translation: {oR}，{oT}：此生物向目标对手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

938499.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls and all other nonland permanents that player controls with the same name as that permanent until this creature leaves the battlefield.
938499.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，以及由该牌手操控且与该永久物同名的所有其他非地永久物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

938506.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, put a loyalty counter on Dovin.
938506.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在大仲裁者多温上放置一个忠诚指示物。

938511.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you gain 2 life and draw a card.

938525.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice a creature. When you do, this creature deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.

938528.oracleText: {o4oRoG}: This creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn.

938572.oracleText: Kaya deals damage to target player equal to the number of cards that player owns in exile and you gain that much life.

938595.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.

938601.translation: 当此生物进场时，若曾支付其揭幕费用，则每位对手各弃一张牌。

938604.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 2 damage to target opponent and 2 damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker.

938607.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
938607.translation: 每当此生物被阻挡时，它对所攻击之牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

938610.oracleText: When Rakdos enters, flip a coin for each creature that isn't a Demon, Devil, or Imp. Destroy each creature whose coin comes up tails.
938610.translation: 当镇场拉铎司进场时，为每个不是恶魔、魔鬼或小恶魔的生物各掷一枚硬币。消灭所有掷出反面的生物。

938613.oracleText: This creature fights target creature you don't control.
938613.translation: 此生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

When this creature enters, choose up to one — 
• This creature fights target creature you don't control.

当此生物进场时，选择至多一项～

938637.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on a creature you control, put that many growth counters on this enchantment.

938649.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, destroy target artifact or enchantment that player controls.

938658.oracleText: During your turn, if an opponent lost life this turn, you may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled with this enchantment.

938659.oracleText: {o3oR}: This enchantment deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.

938672.oracleText: As long as this creature has a +1/+1 counter on it, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
938672.translation: 只要此生物上有+1/+1指示物，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

938817.translation: 只要你操控多温鹏洛客，此生物便得+2/+2且具有警戒异能。

938820.translation: 焚城暴徒多密对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

938827.oracleText: As long as you control a Domri planeswalker, this creature gets +1/+1 and has trample.
938827.translation: 只要你操控多密鹏洛客，此生物便得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

938830.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Domri, City Smasher, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.

938886.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to this creature while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove that many +1/+1 counters from this creature.

938925.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, proliferate.

938939.oracleText: Battalion — Whenever this creature and at least two other creatures attack, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
938939.translation: 协战～每当此生物与至少两个其他生物攻击时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

939071.oracleText: As this creature enters, you may return a nonland permanent you control to its owner's hand. If you do, this creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
