939076.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

939078.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary.
939078.translation: 你可以使此生物当成任一由你操控之生物或鹏洛客的复制品来进入战场，但如果它是生物，则它进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，如果它是鹏洛客，则它进场时上面额外有一个忠诚指示物，且它不是传奇。

939081.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
939081.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

939094.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
939094.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

939118.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has one or fewer cards in hand, Davriel deals 2 damage to them.
939118.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，若该牌手的手牌为一张或更少，则离群影法师达夫黎对其造成2点伤害。

939131.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature or planeswalker: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
939131.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物或鹏洛客：在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

939134.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 4 or greater.
939134.translation: 此生物不能被力量等于或大于4的生物阻挡。

939140.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {o2oB}. If you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
939140.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{o2oB}。若你如此作，则将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

939151.oracleText: When this creature dies, amass Zombies 2.
939151.translation: 当此生物死去时，囤兵灵俑2。

939173.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card, Ob Nixilis deals 1 damage to that player.
939173.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌时，忿恨欧尼希兹对该牌手造成1点伤害。

939200.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
939200.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。

939203.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
939203.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

939218.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn, then scry 1.
939218.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束，然后占卜1。

939223.oracleText: Whenever one or more loyalty counters are removed from Chandra, she deals that much damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
939223.translation: 每当从炎技茜卓上移去一个或数个忠诚指示物时，她向目标对手或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

939237.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals X damage to target creature an opponent controls, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
939237.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的数量加总。

939241.oracleText: As this creature enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures and/or planeswalkers. If you do, it enters with twice that many +1/+1 counters on it.
939241.translation: 于此生物进场时，你可以牺牲任意数量的生物和／或鹏洛客。如果你如此作，则它进场时上面有该数量两倍的+1/+1指示物。

939243.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value less than or equal to this creature's power from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
939243.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，选择目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值等于或小于此生物力量的瞬间或法术牌。你可以从该处施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该牌于将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。

939252.oracleText: When this creature dies, amass Zombies 1.
939252.translation: 当此生物死去时，囤兵灵俑1。

939262.oracleText: Whenever Ilharg attacks, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. Return that creature to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
939262.translation: 每当蛮野猪神衣哈格攻击时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该生物移回你手上。

939263.oracleText: When Ilharg dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put it into its owner's library third from the top.
939263.translation: 当蛮野猪神衣哈格死去或从战场进入放逐区时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

939269.oracleText: Jaya deals 2 damage to any target.
939269.translation: 焰法明范雅亚对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

939276.oracleText: Whenever Krenko attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it, then create a number of 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens equal to Krenko's power.
939276.translation: 每当锡街头目克仑可攻击时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后派出若干1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其数量等同于克仑可的力量。

939278.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this Vehicle becomes an artifact creature and gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
939278.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此载具成为神器生物且得+1/+1，直到回合结束。

939283.oracleText: Whenever Neheb deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, you may discard any number of cards. If you do, draw that many cards and add that much {oR}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
939283.translation: 每当震惧军斗士内赫布对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成伤害时，你可以弃任意数量的牌。若你如此作，则抓等量的牌并加等量的{oR}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

939297.oracleText: Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
939297.translation: 派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

939302.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
939302.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个力量等于或大于4的生物，则此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

939306.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
939306.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。

939355.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
939355.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

939358.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on Mowu, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
939358.translation: 如果将会在忠诚旅伴默武上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

939376.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. 
• Proliferate.
939376.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•增殖。

939383.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
939383.translation: 每当此生物阻挡一个具飞行异能的生物时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

939393.oracleText: When this creature enters, other creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
939393.translation: 当此生物进场时，由你操控的其他生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

939415.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each loyalty counter on planeswalkers you control.
939415.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控的鹏洛客上之忠诚指示物总数量。

939416.oracleText: Whenever one or more loyalty counters are put on planeswalkers you control, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
939416.translation: 每当在由你操控的鹏洛客上放置一个或数个忠诚指示物时，在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

939423.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature or planeswalker you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
939423.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

939437.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
939437.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

939438.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
939438.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

939441.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 3 life and draw a card.
939441.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

939459.oracleText: Whenever a player sacrifices a permanent, this creature deals 1 damage to any target.
939459.translation: 每当任一牌手牺牲一个永久物时，此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

939466.oracleText: Nicol Bolas has all loyalty abilities of all other planeswalkers on the battlefield.
939466.translation: 龙尊尼可波拉斯具有战场上所有其他鹏洛客的所有忠诚异能。

939472.oracleText: When Niv-Mizzet enters, reveal the top ten cards of your library. For each color pair, choose a card that's exactly those colors from among them. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
939472.translation: 当新生尼米捷进场时，展示你牌库顶的十张牌。从中为每组双色色组各选择一张颜色正好为该色组的牌。将所选的牌置于你手上，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

939483.oracleText: Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, Ral deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
939483.translation: 每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，召雷拉尔向目标对手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

939492.oracleText: When Roalesk enters, put two +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control.
939492.translation: 当无上综源罗列茨进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

939499.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
939499.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为由你操控的生物中力量最大者的数值。

939505.oracleText: Sorin deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
939505.translation: 复仇血领索霖对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

939513.oracleText: Whenever Storrev deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, return to your hand target creature or planeswalker card in your graveyard that wasn't put there this combat.
939513.translation: 每当戴卡林巫妖司陀娃对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的生物或鹏洛客牌，且不能是本次战斗中进入该处者。将该牌移回你手上。

939524.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then scry 1.
939524.translation: 每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后占卜1。

939529.oracleText: When Tolsimir enters, create Voja, Friend to Elves, a legendary 3/3 green and white Wolf creature token.
939529.translation: 当狼友托西密进场时，派出传奇衍生生物妖精狼伴沃亚，其为3/3，绿白双色的狼。

939553.oracleText: Nahiri deals X damage to target tapped creature.
939553.translation: 飞石暴娜希丽对目标已横置的生物造成X点伤害。

939569.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add two mana of different colors.
939569.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：加两点不同颜色的法术力。

939579.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top card of target opponent's library.
939579.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视目标对手的牌库顶牌。

939582.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
939582.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此地：本回合中，你可以将咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

939592.oracleText: {o4}: This land becomes a 3/3 Citizen creature with vigilance until end of turn. It's still a land. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature and planeswalker you control.
939592.translation: {o4}：直到回合结束，此地成为3/3，具警戒异能的市民生物。它仍然是地。你每操控一个传奇生物或传奇鹏洛客，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

939595.oracleText: Until end of turn, Gideon becomes a 5/5 white Soldier creature that's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
939595.translation: 直到回合结束，守誓卫士基定成为5/5士兵生物，且仍然是鹏洛客。防止本回合中将对他造成的所有伤害。

939596.oracleText: Exile Gideon and each creature your opponents control.
939596.translation: 放逐守誓卫士基定和所有由对手操控的生物。

939605.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
939605.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

939635.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard a land card: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
939635.translation: {o1oR}，弃一张地牌：此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

939639.oracleText: Whenever this token deals damage to a planeswalker, destroy that planeswalker.
939639.translation: 每当此衍生物对任一鹏洛客造成伤害时，消灭该鹏洛客。

939640.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black Assassin creature token with deathtouch and "Whenever this token deals damage to a planeswalker, destroy that planeswalker."
939640.translation: 派出一个1/1黑色杀手衍生生物，且具有死触与「每当此衍生物对任一鹏洛客造成伤害时，消灭该鹏洛客。」

939642.oracleText: This land enters with a charge counter on it.
939642.translation: 此地进场时上面有一个充电指示物。

939643.oracleText: {oXoX}, {oT}: Put X charge counters on this land.
939643.translation: {oXoX}，{oT}：在此地上放置X个充电指示物。

939644.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on this land.
939644.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲此地：消灭所有法术力值等同于此地上充电指示物数量的非地永久物。

939699.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this token.
939699.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在此衍生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

939700.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Cat Soldier creature token named Ajani's Pridemate with "Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this token."
939700.translation: 派出一个2/2白色，名称为阿耶尼的群伴之猫／士兵衍生生物，且具有「每当你获得生命时，在此衍生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」

939701.oracleText: If you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, exile Ajani and each artifact and creature your opponents control.
939701.translation: 如果你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多15点，则放逐狮群之力阿耶尼和所有由对手操控的神器与生物。

939703.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
939703.translation: 当此武具进场时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

939710.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for any number of cards named Battalion Foot Soldier, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
939710.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量名称为步兵大队的牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

939720.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token.
939720.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。

939721.oracleText: When this creature dies, return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
939721.translation: 当此生物死去时，将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

939737.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap target creature an opponent controls.
939737.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

939744.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
939744.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

939745.oracleText: {o3oW}, Exile this creature: Exile target creature.

939755.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may have your life total become the total toughness of creatures you control.
939755.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以令你的总生命成为由你操控之生物的防御力总和。

939756.oracleText: {o5oW}: This creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your life total.
939756.translation: {o5oW}：此生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你的总生命。

939762.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
939762.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。

939779.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature you control.
939779.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控之其他生物的数量。

939783.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
939783.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

939793.oracleText: When this creature enters, gain control of target permanent.
939793.translation: 当此生物进场时，获得目标永久物的操控权。

939797.oracleText: Whenever Atemsis deals damage to an opponent, you may reveal your hand. If cards with at least six different mana values are revealed this way, that player loses the game.
939797.translation: 每当全观爱缇席向任一对手造成伤害时，你可以展示你的手牌。若以此法展示出之各牌的法术力值有至少六种，则该对手输掉这盘游戏。

939808.oracleText: When this creature dies, shuffle it into its owner's library, then scry 2.
939808.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它洗入其拥有者的牌库，然后占卜2。

939811.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Counter target spell that targets you.
939811.translation: 牺牲此生物：反击目标咒语，且该咒语须以你为目标。

939818.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control this creature.
939818.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。于你操控此生物的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

939821.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another creature named Faerie Miscreant, draw a card.
939821.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个名称为仙灵恶徒的生物，则抓一张牌。

939860.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to two target instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
939860.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多两张目标瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

939870.oracleText: When this creature enters, return another creature you control to its owner's hand.
939870.translation: 当此生物进场时，将另一个由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

939879.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
939879.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

939888.oracleText: During your turn, this creature has lifelink.
939888.translation: 于你的回合中，此生物具有系命异能。

939900.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
939900.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

939902.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls.
939902.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物。

939903.oracleText: When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
939903.translation: 当此生物死去时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

939911.oracleText: This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
939911.translation: 此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

939912.oracleText:
Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one — 
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life. 
• This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
939912.translation:
每当一个由你操控的沼泽进场时，选择一项～ 
•你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。 
•此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

939917.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each different mana cost among nonland cards in your graveyard. (For example, {o2oB} and {o1oBoB} are different mana costs.)
939917.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你坟墓场中非地牌间不同法术力费用的种数。（举例来说，{o2oB}和{o1oBoB}属于两种不同的法术力费用。）

939920.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill four cards. You gain 1 life for each creature card milled this way.
939920.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨四张牌。每以此法将一张生物牌置入你的坟墓场，你便获得1点生命。

939924.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals damage to target opponent or planeswalker equal to the number of creatures you control.
939924.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向目标对手或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

939926.oracleText: {o2oB}: This creature gets +3/+3 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
939926.translation: {o2oB}：直到回合结束，此生物得+3/+3且获得死触异能。

939928.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. (Damage causes loss of life.)
939928.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌手失去过4点或更多生命，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

939947.oracleText: {o5oB}, {oT}: This creature deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
939947.translation: {o5oB}，{oT}：此生物向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

939950.oracleText: You may sacrifice a Vampire. When you do, Sorin deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
939950.translation: 你可以牺牲一个吸血鬼。当你如此作时，骄傲血领索霖对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

939957.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each card named Undead Servant in your graveyard.
939957.translation: 当此生物进场时，你坟墓场中每有一张名称为不死仆从的牌，便派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

939966.oracleText: Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. (Damage causes loss of life.)
939966.translation: 每当你每回合首度失去生命时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

939974.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent exiles a card from their hand.
939974.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各从其手上放逐一张牌。

939977.oracleText: When this creature enters, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
939977.translation: 当此生物进场时，弃任意数量的牌，然后抓等量的牌。

939978.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals X damage to each opponent and each planeswalker they control, where X is the number of land cards in your graveyard.
939978.translation: 当此生物死去时，它向每位对手和每个由对手操控的鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中的地牌数量。

939986.oracleText: Chandra deals 3 damage to each non-Elemental creature.
939986.translation: 觉醒炼狱茜卓对每个非元素的生物各造成3点伤害。

939987.oracleText: Chandra deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
939987.translation: 觉醒炼狱茜卓对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

939991.oracleText: Chandra deals 2 damage to any target.
939991.translation: 舞焰新手茜卓对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

940004.oracleText: Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, this creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
940004.translation: 每当任一对手受到非战斗伤害时，此生物得+3/+0直到回合结束。

940007.oracleText: During your turn, this creature has flying.
940007.translation: 于你的回合中，此生物具有飞行异能。

940019.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 2 damage to any target.
940019.translation: {o1}，牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

940030.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
940030.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

940031.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard a card: Draw a card. Activate only if this creature is attacking.
940031.translation: {o1oR}，弃一张牌：抓一张牌。只能于此生物进行攻击时起动。

940034.oracleText: {oR}: This creature gains flying until end of turn. Activate only if you control a creature with flying.
940034.translation: {oR}：此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。只能于你操控具飞行异能的生物时起动。

940036.oracleText: When this creature enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all Goblin cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
940036.translation: 当此生物进场时，展示你牌库顶的四张牌。将以此法展示的所有鬼怪牌置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

940042.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Elemental you control.
940042.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你每操控一个元素，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

940044.oracleText: Whenever you and/or at least one permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, this enchantment deals 2 damage to that player.
940044.translation: 每当你和／或至少一个由你操控的永久物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，此结界向该对手造成2点伤害。

940047.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals 2 damage to it. If a Dinosaur is dealt damage this way, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
940047.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物对它造成2点伤害。若有恐龙以此法受到伤害，则此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

940049.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
940049.translation: 当此武具进场时，派出一个1/1红色元素衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

940070.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens. Elementals you control gain haste until end of turn.
940070.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个1/1红色元素衍生生物。由你操控的元素获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

940074.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
940074.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它对所攻击之牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

940076.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, choose target Elemental creature card in your graveyard with toughness less than this creature's toughness. Return that card to the battlefield tapped and attacking. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
940076.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的元素生物牌，且其防御力须小于此生物的防御力。将该牌横置移回战场且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

940082.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 as long as it's attacking.
940082.translation: 只要此生物正进行攻击，它便得+2/+0。

940085.oracleText: {o1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: This creature gains hexproof until end of turn.
940085.translation: {o1}，从此生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物：此生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

940090.oracleText: When this creature enters, reveal the top five cards of your library. Put a land card from among them onto the battlefield and the rest into your graveyard.
940090.translation: 当此生物进场时，展示你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中的一张地牌放进战场，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

940091.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may exile it. If you do, put another target card from your graveyard on top of your library.
940091.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则将另一张目标牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

940093.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+2 as long as there are three or more land cards in your graveyard.
940093.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有三张或更多地牌，此生物便得+2/+2。

940099.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
940099.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

940102.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell, Gargos fights up to one target creature you don't control.
940102.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物成为咒语的目标时，卫护恶龙加戈斯与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

940111.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 2/2 green Wolf creature tokens.
940111.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

940122.oracleText: When this creature enters, target player shuffles any number of target cards from their graveyard into their library.
940122.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标牌手将任意数量的目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

940138.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on another target Elemental you control.
940138.translation: 当此生物进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的元素上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

940139.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life. If that creature was an Elemental, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
940139.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。若该生物是元素，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

940152.oracleText: {oG}: This creature gains your choice of reach, trample, or haste until end of turn.
940152.translation: {oG}：选择延势，践踏或敏捷。此生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

940168.oracleText: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.
940168.translation: 将此生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

940169.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Double the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature. 
• This creature fights target creature you don't control.
940169.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•将此生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。 
•此生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

940177.oracleText: When this Aura enters, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
940177.translation: 当此灵气进场时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

940179.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
940179.translation: 当此武具进场时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

940183.oracleText: Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
940183.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的衍生物进场时，在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

940190.oracleText: {o2oRoG}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Elemental you control.
940190.translation: {o2oRoG}：你每操控一个元素，此生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

940201.oracleText: When Kaalia enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an Angel card, a Demon card, and/or a Dragon card from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
940201.translation: 当探峰卡莉雅进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张天使牌，一张恶魔牌和／或一张龙牌，并将它们置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

940221.oracleText: When Omnath enters, it deals damage to any target equal to the number of Elementals you control.
940221.translation: 当狂搅核欧那斯进场时，它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的元素数量。

940225.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Elemental you control enters, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
940225.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的元素进场时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若该牌是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

940230.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
940230.translation: 每当此生物进场或对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

940238.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return all cards exiled with this artifact to their owner's hand.
940238.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：将所有以此神器放逐的牌移回其拥有者的手上。

940244.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen color, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
940244.translation: 每当你施放该色的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

940247.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Choose a card name, then reveal the top card of your library. If that card has the chosen name, sacrifice this artifact and draw three cards. Activate only as a sorcery.
940247.translation: {o1}，{oT}：选择一个牌名，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌具有该名称，则牺牲此神器且抓三张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

940249.oracleText: When Golos enters, you may search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
940249.translation: 当不倦朝圣械戈罗斯进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

940256.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, this Equipment deals 1 damage to target creature defending player controls.
940256.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，此武具对目标由防御牌手操控的生物造成1点伤害。

940267.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a card with the same name as another creature you control, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
940267.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，且此牌须与另一个由你操控的生物同名，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

940271.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: This artifact deals 1 damage to any target.
940271.translation: {o3}，{oT}：此神器对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

940272.oracleText: When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, it deals 5 damage to any target.
940272.translation: 当此神器从战场进入坟墓场时，它对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

940275.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Choose target permanent card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn. Return it to your hand.
940275.translation: 牺牲此生物：选择目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌，且须为于本回合中从战场进入该处者。将该牌移回你手上。

940286.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 2 damage to target creature.
940286.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：它对目标生物造成2点伤害。

940294.oracleText: Whenever this land or another land you control enters, if you control seven or more lands with different names, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
940294.translation: 每当此地或另一个由你操控的地进场时，若你操控七个或更多地，且其名称各不相同，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

940297.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice two lands.
940297.translation: 当此地进场时，牺牲两个地。

940314.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Ajani, Inspiring Leader, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
940314.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为励志领袖阿耶尼的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

940326.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Yanling planeswalker.
940326.translation: 只要你操控燕灵鹏洛客，此生物便得+1/+1。

940328.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Mu Yanling, Celestial Wind, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
940328.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为天界清风沐燕灵的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

940331.oracleText: Sorin deals 4 damage to any target. You gain 4 life.
940331.translation: 吸血领主索霖对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。你获得4点生命。

940336.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Sorin, Vampire Lord, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
940336.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为吸血领主索霖的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

940340.oracleText: Chandra deals 2 damage to any target.
940340.translation: 盛焰怒火茜卓对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

940341.oracleText: Chandra deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller.
940341.translation: 盛焰怒火茜卓对目标生物造成4点伤害，且对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

940342.oracleText: Chandra deals 10 damage to target player and each creature that player controls.
940342.translation: 盛焰怒火茜卓对目标牌手和每个由该牌手操控的生物各造成10点伤害。

940349.oracleText: {o1oRoR}: This creature deals 1 damage to target player.
940349.translation: {o1oRoR}：此生物对目标牌手造成1点伤害。

940359.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Vivien, Nature's Avenger, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
940359.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为护世侠客薇薇安的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

940366.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Vivien planeswalker.
940366.translation: 只要你操控薇薇安鹏洛客，此生物便得+1/+1。

940397.oracleText: {o1oG}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
940397.translation: {o1oG}：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

940444.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another Knight, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Knight, Aura, Equipment, or legendary artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
940444.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个骑士，则检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张骑士、灵气、武具或传奇神器牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

940451.oracleText: Adamant — If at least three white mana was spent to cast this spell, this creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
940451.translation: 固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点白色法术力，则此生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

940457.oracleText: When this creature dies and when you discard this card, create a Food token.
940457.translation: 当此生物死去或当你弃掉它时，派出一个食品衍生物。

940461.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater.
940461.translation: 此生物不能被力量等于或大于3的生物阻挡。

940480.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact or enchantment, this creature has flying.
940480.translation: 只要你操控神器或结界，此生物便具有飞行异能。

940483.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a Food token.
940483.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

940490.oracleText: When this artifact enters, exile target creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
940490.translation: 当此神器进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物，直到此神器离开战场为止。

940492.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, each player gains 5 life and draws a card.
940492.translation: 当此结界进场时，每位牌手获得5点生命且各抓一张牌。

940497.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 white Human creature tokens.
940497.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

940528.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target Knight you control.
940528.translation: 当此武具进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的骑士上。

940546.oracleText: When this creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target Knight you control.
940546.translation: 当此生物死去时，在目标由你操控的骑士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

941904.translation: 每当另一个生物成为由你操控、且名称为斯科福司迷宫的地之异能目标时，你可以令此生物与该生物互斗。

941907.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice another creature or an enchantment: This creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
941907.translation: {oR}，牺牲另一个生物或一个结界：直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

941910.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
941910.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

941912.oracleText: When this creature enters, return any number of Aura cards from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to creatures you control. Exile those Auras at the beginning of your next end step. If those Auras would leave the battlefield, exile them instead of putting them anywhere else.
941912.translation: 当此生物进场时，将任意数量的灵气牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在由你操控的一个或数个生物上。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐这些灵气。若这些灵气将离开战场，则改为将它们放逐，而非置入其他区域。

941919.oracleText: This creature deals 3 damage to each opponent.
941919.translation: 此生物向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

941922.oracleText:
Whenever this creature attacks or becomes the target of a spell an opponent controls, choose one — 
• This creature deals 3 damage to each opponent. 
• Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
941922.translation:
每当此生物攻击或成为由对手操控之咒语的目标时，选择一项～ 
•此生物向每位对手各造成3点伤害。 
•放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。从中选择一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

941925.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on this Saga.
941925.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为此传纪上的学问指示物数量。

941926.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on this Saga.
941926.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为此传纪上的学问指示物数量。

941927.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on this Saga.
941927.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为此传纪上的学问指示物数量。

941931.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this enchantment.
941931.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，牺牲此结界。

941950.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature with flying an opponent controls.
941950.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向目标由对手操控且具飞行异能的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

941952.oracleText: This creature escapes with three +1/+1 counters on it.
941952.translation: 此生物逸脱时上面有三个+1/+1指示物。

941967.oracleText: When this Aura enters, put a +1/+1 counter on enchanted creature.
941967.translation: 当此灵气进场时，在所结附的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

941971.oracleText: When this creature enters, untap target creature.
941971.translation: 当此生物进场时，重置目标生物。

941984.oracleText: When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create two 2/2 green Wolf creature tokens.
941984.translation: 当此灵气从战场进入坟墓场时，派出两个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

941992.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller draws a card.
941992.translation: 每当此生物被一个生物阻挡时，该生物的操控者抓一张牌。

942010.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is your devotion to green.
942010.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为你的绿色献力。

942028.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
942028.translation: 当此结界进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

942041.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card.
942041.translation: 星彩～每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

942044.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain life equal to your devotion to green.
942044.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得若干生命，其数量等同于你的绿色献力。

942047.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
942047.translation: 星彩～每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

942060.oracleText: When this Aura enters, enchanted creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.
942060.translation: 当此灵气进场时，所结附的生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

942064.oracleText: {o4oG}, Sacrifice this Aura: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token. Activate only during your turn.
942064.translation: {o4oG}，牺牲此灵气：派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。只能于你的回合中起动。

942067.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill two cards, then you may return a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
942067.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨两张牌，然后你可以将一张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

942072.oracleText: Whenever this token attacks or blocks, each opponent exiles the top two cards of their library.
942072.translation: 每当此衍生物攻击或阻挡时，每位对手各放逐其牌库顶的两张牌。

942073.oracleText: Create a 2/3 blue and black Nightmare creature token with "Whenever this token attacks or blocks, each opponent exiles the top two cards of their library."
942073.translation: 派出一个2/3，蓝黑双色的梦魇衍生生物，且具有「每当此衍生物攻击或阻挡时，每位对手各放逐其牌库顶的两张牌。」

942077.oracleText: When Atris enters, target opponent looks at the top three cards of your library and separates them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
942077.translation: 当虚实先知阿提理斯进场时，目标对手检视你牌库顶的三张牌，并分成牌面朝下与牌面朝上各一堆。将其中一堆置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。

942079.oracleText: {oGoW}: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
942079.translation: {oGoW}：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

942081.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield. It's an Aura enchantment with enchant creature you control and "{oGoW}: Enchanted creature gains indestructible until end of turn," and it loses all other abilities.
942081.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它移回战场。它是灵气结界，且具有「结附于由你操控的生物」与「{oGoW}：所结附的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束」，并失去所有其他异能。

942092.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into your graveyard from your library, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
942092.translation: 每当一张或数张牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

942095.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
942095.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

942097.oracleText: Discard a card: This creature gains hexproof until end of turn. Tap it.
942097.translation: 弃一张牌：此生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

942109.oracleText: Haktos attacks each combat if able.
942109.translation: 历战无伤哈克托斯每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

942114.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
942114.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

942129.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent. Scry 1.
942129.translation: 每当你施放每个对手回合中你的第一个咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。占卜1。

942142.oracleText: When Siona enters, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal an Aura card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
942142.translation: 当皮勒阿斯号船长西俄娜进场时，检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中的一张灵气牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

942146.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
942146.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

942147.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another creature or an enchantment: This creature gains first strike until end of turn.
942147.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个生物或一个结界：此生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

942157.oracleText: This creature can't attack unless you control another creature with power 4 or greater.
942157.translation: 除非你操控另一个力量等于或大于4的生物，否则此生物不能进行攻击。

942165.oracleText: You may choose not to untap this artifact during your untap step.
942165.translation: 你可以选择于你的重置步骤中不重置此神器。

942166.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: Tap target creature with power X or less. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as this artifact remains tapped.
942166.translation: {oX}，{oT}：横置目标力量等于或小于X的生物。于此神器持续横置的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

942189.oracleText: Sacrifice this Equipment: Equipped creature can't be blocked this turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
942189.translation: 牺牲此武具：佩带此武具的生物本回合不能被阻挡。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

942208.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Elspeth, Undaunted Hero, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
942208.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为无畏英雄艾紫培的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

942211.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 as long as you control an Elspeth planeswalker.
942211.translation: 只要你操控艾紫培鹏洛客，此生物便得+1/+0。

942219.oracleText: This creature gets +3/+0 as long as there are ten or more cards in a single graveyard.
942219.translation: 只要某个坟墓场中有十张或更多牌，此生物便得+3/+0。

942220.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as you control an Ashiok planeswalker.
942220.translation: 只要你操控安梭苛鹏洛客，此生物便不能被阻挡。

942226.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Ashiok, Sculptor of Fears, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
942226.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为恐惧塑师安梭苛的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

942233.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked by a creature, exile that creature until this creature leaves the battlefield.
942233.translation: 每当此生物被生物阻挡时，放逐该生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

942239.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent mills ten cards.
942239.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各磨十张牌。

942246.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, exile target creature card from your graveyard.
942246.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。

942247.oracleText: When this creature dies, put all cards exiled with it onto the battlefield.
942247.translation: 当此生物死去时，将所有以它放逐的牌放进战场。

942256.oracleText: If a creature would deal combat damage to this creature, prevent that damage and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
942256.translation: 如果某生物将对此生物造成战斗伤害，则防止该伤害且在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

942259.oracleText: When this creature dies, draw three cards.
942259.translation: 当此生物死去时，抓三张牌。

942371.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
942371.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

942374.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

942378.oracleText: This creature enters with your choice of a flying counter or a first strike counter on it.

942387.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a vigilance counter on target non-Human creature you control.
942387.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个警戒指示物。

942392.oracleText: As this creature enters, choose odd or even. (Zero is even.)
942392.translation: 于此生物进场时，选择奇数或偶数。（零是偶数。）

942393.oracleText: This creature has protection from each mana value of the chosen quality.
942393.translation: 此生物具有「保护～反该种数值的法术力值」。

942408.oracleText: When this creature enters, target Human you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
942408.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的人类得+2/+2直到回合结束。

942411.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, other Humans you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
942411.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，由你操控的其他人类得+1/+0直到回合结束。

942425.oracleText: When you cycle this card, put a lifelink counter on target creature you control.
942425.translation: 当你循环此牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个系命指示物。

942432.oracleText: If noncombat damage would be dealt to this creature, prevent that damage. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each 1 damage prevented this way.
942432.translation: 如果此生物将受到非战斗伤害，则防止该伤害。每以此法防止1点伤害，便在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

942452.oracleText: When you cycle this card, put a flying counter on target creature you control.
942452.translation: 当你循环此牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个飞行指示物。

942488.oracleText: When this token enters, if it's a creature, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
942488.translation: 当此衍生物进场时，若它是生物，则它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

942496.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a foreshadow counter on this enchantment.
942496.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在此结界上放置一个预兆指示物。

942497.oracleText: Remove eight foreshadow counters from this enchantment: Create an 8/8 blue Kraken creature token.
942497.translation: 从此结界上移去八个预兆指示物：派出一个8/8蓝色巨海兽衍生生物。

942501.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn.
942501.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

942518.oracleText: When you cycle this card, create an X/X blue Shark creature token with flying.
942518.translation: 当你循环此牌时，派出一个X/X蓝色，具飞行异能的鲨鱼衍生生物。

942530.oracleText: This creature enters with your choice of a flying counter or a hexproof counter on it.
942530.translation: 此生物进场时上面依你的选择有一个飞行指示物或一个辟邪指示物。

942533.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个飞行指示物。

942537.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

942574.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a lifelink counter on target non-Human creature you control.
942574.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个系命指示物。

942588.oracleText: This creature enters with your choice of two different counters on it from among menace, deathtouch, and lifelink.
942588.translation: 此生物进场时上面依你的选择有威慑、死触和系命三种指示物其中之二。

942596.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent puts a deathtouch counter on a creature they control.
942596.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手在一个由其操控的生物上放置一个死触指示物。

942602.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target creature that was dealt damage this turn.
942602.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标本回合中受过伤害的生物。

942613.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.

942661.translation: {o1}，牺牲此衍生物：将目标凤凰牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

942702.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若它具有先攻异能，则它获得连击异能直到回合结束。

942712.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

942721.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, you may have this enchantment become a 5/4 Dinosaur creature with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
942721.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，你可以使此结界成为5/4，具践踏与敏捷异能的恐龙生物直到回合结束，且仍具有原本类别。

942724.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target card with a cycling ability from your graveyard. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
942724.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标具任一循环异能的牌从你的坟墓场放逐。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

942732.oracleText: When you cycle this card, put a first strike counter on target creature you control.
942732.translation: 当你循环此牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个先攻指示物。

942740.oracleText: This creature has double strike as long as there are three or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.
942740.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有三张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，此生物便具有连击异能。

942748.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a creature: This enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.
942748.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个生物：此结界对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

942751.oracleText: When you cycle this card, shuffle it into your library from your graveyard. If you've cycled a card named Yidaro, Wandering Monster four or more times this game, put it onto the battlefield from your graveyard instead.
942751.translation: 当你循环此牌时，将它从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。若本盘游戏中你已将名称为游荡怪兽依达罗的牌循环过四次或更多，则改为将它从你的坟墓场放进战场。

942756.oracleText: {o3oG}: This creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

942781.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may change the base power and toughness of target Human you control to this creature's power and toughness until end of turn.
942781.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以将目标由你操控之人类生物的基础力量与防御力更改为此生物的力量与防御力直到回合结束。

942783.oracleText: {o1oG}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Target player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffles.
942783.translation: {o1oG}，从此生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物：目标牌手从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

942787.oracleText: This creature enters with your choice of a vigilance counter or a reach counter on it.
942787.translation: 此生物进场时上面依你的选择有一个警戒指示物或一个延势指示物。

942804.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a trample counter on target non-Human creature you control.
942804.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的非人类生物上放置一个践踏指示物。

942812.oracleText: When Kogla enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
942812.translation: 当庞巨猿猴寇格拉进场时，它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

942849.oracleText: When you cycle this card, put a trample counter on target creature you control.
942849.translation: 当你循环此牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个践踏指示物。

942865.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard using its mutate ability.
942865.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用此牌的合变异能来施放之。

942893.oracleText: Whenever General Kudro or another Human you control enters, exile target card from an opponent's graveyard.
942893.translation: 每当寇卓将军或另一个由你操控的人类进场时，将目标牌从任一对手的坟墓场放逐。

942925.oracleText: Draw a card, then you may discard a card. When you discard a nonland card this way, Narset deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker.
942925.translation: 抓一张牌，然后你可以弃一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张非地牌时，古道娜尔施对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。

942955.oracleText: Rielle gets +1/+0 for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
942955.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，全知利艾尔便得+1/+0。

942962.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, you may pay {o2}. When you do, this creature deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.
942962.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，你可以支付{o2}。当你如此作时，此生物对目标生物造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

942968.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature you control with flying.
942968.translation: 你每操控一个具飞行异能的其他生物，此生物便得+1/+1。

943033.oracleText: When Keruga enters, draw a card for each other permanent you control with mana value 3 or greater.
943033.translation: 当庞巨智者刻卢佳进场时，你每操控一个法术力值等于或大于3的其他永久物，便抓一张牌。

943040.oracleText: When Lutri enters, if you cast it, copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
943040.translation: 当逐咒獭灵拉翠进场时，若它是由你施放，则复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

943053.oracleText: As Umori enters, choose a card type.
943053.translation: 于集晶流浆乌墨理进场时，选择一种牌张类别。

943065.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose a kind of counter at random that this creature doesn't have on it from among flying, first strike, deathtouch, hexproof, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance, and +1/+1. Put a counter of that kind on this creature.
943065.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，从飞行、先攻、死触、辟邪、系命、威慑、延势、践踏、警戒和+1/+1等十种指示物内此生物上面尚不具有者中随机选择一种。在此生物上放置一个该种指示物。

943087.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
943087.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：目标生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

943090.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 3 damage to any target.
943090.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

943182.oracleText: Ugin deals 3 damage to any target.
943182.translation: 灵龙乌金对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

943192.oracleText: {o4oW}: This creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

943196.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 2 life for each creature you control with flying.
943196.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个具飞行异能的生物，便获得2点生命。

943210.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
943210.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有+1/+1指示物，则派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

943223.oracleText: When this Aura enters, you gain 4 life.
943223.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你获得4点生命。

943227.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking.
943227.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

943232.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gains flying until end of turn.
943232.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

943239.oracleText: When this artifact enters, exile all creature cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
943239.translation: 当此神器进场时，放逐你坟墓场中所有法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌，直到此神器离开战场为止。

943240.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Until end of turn, you may cast a creature spell from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying its mana cost.
943240.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：直到回合结束，你可以从以此神器放逐的牌中施放一个生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

943249.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to you, prevent that damage and put an incarnation counter on this enchantment.
943249.translation: 如果某来源将对你造成伤害，则防止该伤害且在此结界上放置一个转生指示物。

943250.oracleText: When there are nine or more incarnation counters on this enchantment, exile it.
943250.translation: 当此结界上有九个或更多转生指示物时，将它放逐。

943251.oracleText: When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, you lose the game.
943251.translation: 当此结界离开战场时，你输掉这盘游戏。

943255.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn to Dogs you control.
943255.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防止本回合中将对由你操控的狗造成之所有战斗伤害。

943258.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
943258.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

943266.oracleText: Discard a card: Tap this creature. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
943266.translation: 弃一张牌：横置此生物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

943272.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Another target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
943272.translation: 牺牲此生物：另一个目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

943294.oracleText: When Barrin enters, return up to one other target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
943294.translation: 当陶拉里亚大法师巴林进场时，将至多另一个目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。

943307.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes untapped, you may pay {o2}. If you do, draw a card.
943307.translation: 每当此生物成为未横置时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

943309.oracleText: Discard a card: This creature can't be blocked this turn.
943309.translation: 弃一张牌：此生物本回合不能被阻挡。

943328.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent creates a 1/1 red Pirate creature token with "This token can't block" and "Creatures you control attack each combat if able."
943328.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各派出一个1/1红色海盗衍生生物，且具有「此衍生生物不能进行阻挡」与「由你操控的生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。」

943329.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost {o3} more to cast.
943329.translation: 对手施放之以此生物为目标的咒语增加{o3}来施放。

943340.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may have this enchantment become a 3/3 Sphinx creature with flying in addition to its other types until end of turn.
943340.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以令此结界成为3/3，具飞行异能的史芬斯生物直到回合结束，且仍具有原本类别。

943344.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to one target non-Spirit creature to its owner's hand.
943344.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一个目标非精怪生物移回其拥有者手上。

943350.oracleText: When this Aura enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
943350.translation: 当此灵气进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

943382.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, draw a card, then discard a card.
943382.translation: 当此结界进场时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

943392.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.

943399.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it entered from your graveyard or you cast it from your graveyard, exile it. If you do, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.
943399.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它是从你的坟墓场进场或你是从你的坟墓场中施放它，则将它放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个5/5黑色，具飞行异能的恶魔衍生生物。

943407.oracleText: This creature gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in your graveyard.
943407.translation: 此生物得+X/+0，X为你坟墓场中生物牌的最大力量。

943410.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature or discard a creature card. If you do, draw a card.
943410.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个生物或弃一张生物牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

943413.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying 3 life and discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs.
943413.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放此牌，但在其他费用以外，还须额外支付3点生命并弃一张牌。

943422.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
943422.translation: 每当此生物被一个生物阻挡时，该生物的操控者失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

943424.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature.
943424.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各牺牲一个生物。

943448.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw X cards, where X is the number of creatures that died under your control this turn.
943448.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓X张牌，X为本回合中在你的操控下死去之生物数量。

943451.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Target opponent discards a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
943451.translation: {oT}，牺牲此生物：目标对手弃一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

943453.oracleText: This Equipment enters with a soul counter on it.
943453.translation: 此武具进场时上面有一个灵魂指示物。

943454.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each soul counter on this Equipment.
943454.translation: 此武具上每有一个灵魂指示物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

943455.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, put a soul counter on this Equipment.
943455.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，在此武具上放置一个灵魂指示物。

943483.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

943484.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card.

943490.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, this creature gets +2/+1 and has deathtouch.
943490.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，此生物便得+2/+1且具有死触异能。

943505.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
943505.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

943508.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gets +4/+0 until end of turn.
943508.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标生物得+4/+0直到回合结束。

943511.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target opponent.
943511.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，它向目标对手造成等量的伤害。

943512.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: This creature fights another target creature.
943512.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：此生物与另一个目标生物互斗。

943518.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, this creature deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
943518.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，此生物对目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

943523.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, this creature gets +1/+0 and gains double strike until end of turn.
943523.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+0 且获得连击异能。

943526.oracleText: As long as the top card of your library is a Goblin card, this creature has all activated abilities of that card.
943526.translation: 只要你的牌库顶牌是鬼怪牌，此生物便具有该牌的所有起动式异能。

943541.oracleText: Gadrak can't attack unless you control four or more artifacts.
943541.translation: 除非你操控四个或更多神器，否则戴冠祸害加札克不能攻击。

943548.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, this creature deals 1 damage to any target.
943548.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

943560.oracleText: When this creature enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
943560.translation: 当此生物进场时，弃至多两张牌，然后抓等量的牌。

943563.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

943576.translation: 对手施放之以此生物为目标的咒语须额外支付3点生命来施放。

943577.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target.
943577.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于进场之生物的力量。

943603.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

943606.translation: 当此生物死去时，本回合中每有一个生物死去，你便获得1点生命。

943612.oracleText: As long as you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.
943612.translation: 只要你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，此生物便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

943640.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, this creature gets +0/+2 and has vigilance.
943640.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，此生物便得+0/+2且具有警戒异能。

943660.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

943667.translation: 每当你施放含白色、蓝色、黑色或红色的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

943676.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。
