944354.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +4/+0 until end of turn.
944354.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物得+4/+0直到回合结束。

944357.oracleText: {oXoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals X damage to any target.
944357.translation: {oXoR}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

944375.oracleText: When this creature enters, copy target instant or sorcery spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
944375.translation: 当此生物进场时，复制目标瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

944389.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to target creature and 1 damage to you.
944389.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对目标生物造成1点伤害，且对你造成1点伤害。

944394.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 2 damage to target creature.
944394.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对目标生物造成2点伤害。

944397.oracleText: This creature can't attack unless you control more creatures than defending player.
944397.translation: 除非由你操控的生物比防御牌手多，否则此生物不能攻击。

944398.oracleText: This creature can't block unless you control more creatures than attacking player.
944398.translation: 除非你比攻击牌手操控更多生物，否则此生物不能进行阻挡。

944408.oracleText: Whenever another creature enters, you may put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is that creature's power.
944408.translation: 每当另一个生物进场时，你可以在此生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为该生物的力量。

944411.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, this creature deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
944411.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，此生物对所攻击之牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

944422.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
944422.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物得+3/+0直到回合结束。

944428.oracleText: When this Aura enters, it deals 2 damage to any target.
944428.translation: 当此灵气进场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

944431.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, this creature's owner shuffles it into their library.
944431.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，此生物的拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

944442.oracleText: When this creature enters, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
944442.translation: 当此生物进场时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

944470.oracleText: When this creature enters, creatures without flying can't block this turn.
944470.translation: 当此生物进场时，不具飞行异能的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

944477.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, untap this creature.
944477.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，重置此生物。

944480.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact.

944489.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature deals 1 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
944489.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物向目标由对手操控的生物造成1点伤害。

944497.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
944497.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

944503.oracleText: When this creature enters, target Forest becomes a 4/5 green Treefolk creature for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield. It's still a land.
944503.translation: 当此生物进场时，只要此生物仍在战场，目标树林便成为4/5绿色的树妖生物。它仍然是地。

944506.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 3/3 green Boar creature token.
944506.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个3/3绿色野猪衍生生物。

944512.oracleText: Creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block creatures you control.
944512.translation: 力量小于此生物的生物不能阻挡由你操控的生物。

944517.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
944517.translation: {oG}，牺牲此生物：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

944531.oracleText: {o3}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Any player may activate this ability.
944531.translation: {o3}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。任何牌手均可以起动。

944539.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, untap target creature or land.
944539.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置目标生物或地。

944567.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 2/1 black Cat creature token.
944567.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个2/1黑色的猫衍生生物。

944600.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
944600.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

944603.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
944603.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

944619.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more lands, this creature gets +4/+4 and has trample.
944619.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，此生物便得+4/+4且具有践踏异能。

944630.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target permanent to its owner's hand, then that player discards a card.
944630.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标永久物移回其拥有者手上，然后该牌手弃一张牌。

944635.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
944635.translation: 每当此生物对牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你手上使用一张非地的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

944638.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
944638.translation: {oU}，牺牲此神器：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

944639.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

944644.oracleText: When this creature enters, return a nonland permanent you control to its owner's hand.
944644.translation: 当此生物进场时，将一个由你操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

944650.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color. Draw a card.
944650.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力。抓一张牌。

944653.oracleText: As long as you control a Dragon, this creature gets +1/+1 and has flying and trample.
944653.translation: 只要你操控龙，此生物便得+1/+1且具有飞行与践踏异能。

944657.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw three cards.

944659.oracleText: {o2}: This artifact becomes a 2/2 Golem artifact creature until end of turn.
944659.translation: {o2}：此神器成为2/2魔像神器生物直到回合结束。

944670.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token.
944670.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／秘耳衍生神器生物。

944673.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals 2 damage to any target.
944673.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

944677.oracleText: When this creature dies, each player draws a card.
944677.translation: 当此生物死去时，每位牌手各抓一张牌。

944684.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card. If you control an Angel, you gain 5 life.
944684.translation: {o1}，牺牲此神器：抓一张牌。如果你操控天使，则你获得5点生命。

944692.oracleText: {oT}: Put a charge counter on this land.
944692.translation: {oT}：在此地上放置一个充电指示物。

944693.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a charge counter from this land: Add one mana of any color.
944693.translation: {oT}，从此地上移去一个充电指示物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

944709.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
944709.translation: {oB}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

944713.oracleText: This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it.
944713.translation: 此生物进场时上面有两个-1/-1指示物。

944714.oracleText: {oB}, Remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature: Put a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
944714.translation: {oB}，从此生物上移去一个-1/-1指示物：在每个其他生物上各放置一个-1/-1指示物。

944717.oracleText: This creature enters with X +1/+0 counters on it.
944717.translation: 此生物进场时上面有X个+1/+0指示物。

944722.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals damage to each opponent equal to your devotion to red.
944722.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于你的红色献力。

944751.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, each player this creature attacked this turn loses the game.
944751.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多15点，则此生物本回合中攻击过的每位牌手各输掉这盘游戏。

944754.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
944754.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

944778.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature in your party.
944778.translation: 当此生物进场时，你冒险团中每有一个生物，便在前者上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

944786.oracleText: As this land enters, you may pay 3 life. If you don't, it enters tapped.
944786.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以支付3点生命。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

944789.oracleText: This creature has lifelink as long as you control another Cleric.
944789.translation: 只要你操控另一个僧侣，此生物便具有系命异能。

944792.oracleText: When this creature enters, you and target opponent each draw a card.
944792.translation: 当此生物进场时，你和目标对手各抓一张牌。

944795.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. It gains flying until end of turn.
944795.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

944806.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature in your party.
944806.translation: 当此生物进场时，你冒险团中每有一个生物，目标生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

944816.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, tap up to two target creatures.
944816.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则横置至多两个目标生物。

944822.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.
944822.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，你获得1点生命。

944825.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may reveal a card you own named Legion Angel from outside the game and put it into your hand.
944825.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从游戏外展示一张由你拥有且名称为军团天使的牌，并将它置于你手上。

944838.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control.
944838.translation: 当此武具进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

944843.oracleText: During turns other than yours, this creature gets +0/+2.
944843.translation: 只要不在你的回合，此生物得+0/+2。

944855.oracleText: Whenever this creature and at least one other Warrior attack, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
944855.translation: 每当此生物与至少另一个战士攻击时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

944877.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 2 life for each creature in your party.
944877.translation: 当此生物进场时，你冒险团中每有一个生物，你便获得2点生命。

944880.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one target nonland, nontoken permanent you don't control with mana value 4 or less.
944880.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐至多一个目标不由你操控、既非地也非衍生物的永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于4。

944881.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner creates an X/X blue Illusion creature token, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
944881.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者派出一个X/X蓝色虚影衍生生物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

944888.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Kor Warrior creature token for each creature in your party.
944888.translation: 当此生物进场时，你冒险团中每有一个生物，便派出一个1/1白色寇族／战士衍生生物。

944894.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return a land you control to its owner's hand.
944894.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

944908.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if it was kicked, tap enchanted creature.
944908.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若它已增幅，则横置所结附的生物。

944911.oracleText: When this creature enters, scry X, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
944911.translation: 当此生物进场时，占卜X，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

944915.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target Charix cost {o2} more to cast.
944915.translation: 对手施放之以岛身怒怪凯立茨为目标的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

944927.oracleText: Whenever a land an opponent controls enters, if that player had another land enter the battlefield under their control this turn, they return a land they control to its owner's hand.
944927.translation: 每当一个地在任一对手的操控下进场时，若该牌手本回合中有另一个地在其操控下进战场，则他将一个由他操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

944930.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a card with a kicker ability from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
944930.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张具任一增幅异能的牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

944933.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return up to one other target creature to its owner's hand.
944933.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则将至多另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

944939.oracleText: As long as you control another Wizard, this creature has "When this creature dies, draw a card."
944939.translation: 只要你操控另一个法术师，此生物便具有「当此生物死去时，抓一张牌。」

944948.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature you control, except it's a Shapeshifter Rogue in addition to its other types.
944948.translation: 你可以使此生物当成任一由你操控的生物之复制品来进入场，但它额外具有「变形兽／浪客」此两个类别。

944960.oracleText: When Jace enters, if Jace was kicked, create a token that's a copy of Jace, except it's not legendary and its starting loyalty is 1.
944960.translation: 当镜像法师杰斯进场时，若杰斯已增幅，则派出一个为镜像法师杰斯之复制品的衍生物，但它不是传奇，且起始忠诚为1。

944962.oracleText: Draw a card and reveal it. Remove a number of loyalty counters equal to that card's mana value from Jace.
944962.translation: 抓一张牌并展示之。从镜像法师杰斯上移去若干忠诚指示物，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。

944979.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
944979.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

944980.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, you may have this creature's base power and toughness become 4/1 or 1/4 until end of turn.
944980.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，你可以使此生物的基础力量与防御力成为4/1或1/4直到回合结束。

944985.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player mills a card.
944985.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手磨一张牌。

944986.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card. Activate only if an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
944986.translation: 牺牲此生物：抓一张牌。只能于任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌时起动。

944989.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked if you had another Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
944989.translation: 如果本回合中有另一个僧侣，浪客，战士或法术师在你的操控下进战场，则此生物不能被阻挡。

944993.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, this creature has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
944993.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，此生物的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

944995.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, if it was kicked, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
944995.translation: 当此结界进场时，若它已增幅，则派出一个2/2蓝色，具飞行异能的龙兽衍生生物。

945008.oracleText: When this creature enters, copy the next instant or sorcery spell with mana value 2 or less you cast this turn when you cast it. If this creature was kicked, copy that spell twice instead. You may choose new targets for the copies.
945008.translation: 当此生物进场，本回合中，当你施放你的下一个法术力值等于或小于2的瞬间或法术咒语时，将它复制。若此生物已增幅，则改为将该咒语复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

945011.oracleText: {o4oU}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each creature in your party.
945011.translation: {o4oU}：此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。你冒险团中每有一个生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

945025.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
945025.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

945028.oracleText: Tap another untapped Rogue you control: This creature can't be blocked this turn.
945028.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的浪客：此生物本回合不能被阻挡。

945033.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, gain control of target artifact with mana value X or less. If that artifact is an Equipment, attach it to this creature.
945033.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则获得目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器之操控权。若该神器是武具，则将它贴附在此生物上。

945036.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, this creature gains flying until end of turn.
945036.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

945044.oracleText: When this creature enters, up to one target creature gets -2/-0 until end of turn. Its controller mills two cards.
945044.translation: 当此生物进场时，至多一个目标生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。其操控者磨两张牌。

945046.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals a number of cards from their hand equal to the number of creatures in your party. You choose one of those cards. That player discards that card.
945046.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手从其手上展示若干牌，其数量等同于你冒险团中的生物数量。你从中选择一张。该牌手弃掉该牌。

945056.oracleText: This creature gets +3/+0 as long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
945056.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，此生物便得+3/+0。

945075.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice.
945075.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物或鹏洛客。

945077.oracleText: Whenever Drana attacks, defending player chooses a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard. You return that card to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. The creature is a Vampire in addition to its other types.
945077.translation: 每当最终血侯哲娜攻击时，防御牌手选择你坟墓场中的一张非传奇生物牌。你将该牌移回战场，且其上额外有一个+1/+1指示物。该生物额外具有吸血鬼此类别。

945080.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
945080.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

945084.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
945084.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

945087.oracleText: This creature has deathtouch as long as you control another Rogue.
945087.translation: 只要你操控另一个浪客，此生物便具有死触异能。

945115.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
945115.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各失去X点生命，且你获得X点生命，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

945136.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, this creature gets +1/+0 and has menace.
945136.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，此生物便得+1/+0且具有威慑异能。

945139.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent mills two cards.
945139.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手磨两张牌。

945159.oracleText: Tap another untapped Rogue you control: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
945159.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的浪客：此生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

945160.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player mills three cards.
945160.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手磨三张牌。

945165.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, if this card is in your graveyard and it's your turn, you may cast it from your graveyard this turn.
945165.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，若此牌在你的坟墓场，且当前是你的回合，则本回合中，你可以从你坟墓场中施放它。

945169.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
945169.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

945177.oracleText: Taborax has lifelink as long as it has five or more +1/+1 counters on it.
945177.translation: 只要葬望魔塔博锐上有五个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有系命异能。

945190.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
945190.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

945199.oracleText: When this creature enters, add {oR} for each creature in your party.
945199.translation: 当此生物进场时，你冒险团中每有一个生物，便加{oR}。

945209.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 as long as you control another Warrior.
945209.translation: 只要你操控另一个战士，此生物便得+2/+0。

945212.oracleText: As long as this creature is equipped, it has haste.
945212.translation: 只要此生物佩带武具，它便具有敏捷异能。

945217.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature an opponent controls with power less than or equal to the number of Warriors you control can't block this turn.
945217.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，选择目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于由你操控之战士数量的生物。该生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

945220.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each creature in your party.
945220.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你冒险团中每有一个生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

945223.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
945223.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

945230.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
945230.translation: 此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

945235.oracleText:
{o1}: Choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — 
• This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. 
• Target creature becomes a Coward until end of turn. 
• Target Warrior gains trample until end of turn.
945235.translation:
{o1}：选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的～ 
•此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。 
•目标生物成为懦夫直到回合结束。 
•目标战士获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

945244.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may pay any amount of {oR}. When you do, it deals that much damage to any target.
945244.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以支付任意数量的{oR}。当你如此作时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

945246.oracleText: As long as there are four or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +3/+1.
945246.translation: 只要你的坟墓场中有四张或更多瞬间和／或法术牌，此生物便得+3/+1。

945262.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return a land you control to its owner's hand. When you do, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
945262.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。当你如此作时，此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

945265.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this token deals 1 damage to you.
945265.translation: 在你的维持开始时，此衍生物对你造成1点伤害。

945266.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player creates a 0/1 colorless Goblin Construct artifact creature token with "This token can't block" and "At the beginning of your upkeep, this token deals 1 damage to you."
945266.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手派出一个0/1无色鬼怪／组构体衍生神器生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡」与「在你的维持开始时，此衍生物对你造成1点伤害。」

945269.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, this creature deals 1 damage to any target.
945269.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

945276.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, this enchantment deals 1 damage to them.
945276.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，此结界对其造成1点伤害。

945277.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, if no mana was spent to cast that spell, this enchantment deals 5 damage to that player.
945277.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语，若施放该咒语时未支付过法术力，则此结界对该牌手造成5点伤害。

945284.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it gains haste until end of turn.
945284.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

945286.oracleText: If this creature was kicked, it enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
945286.translation: 如果此生物已增幅，则它进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

945287.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if this creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it, return it to its owner's hand.
945287.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若此生物上没有+1/+1指示物，则将它移回其拥有者手上。

945332.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
945332.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

945343.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are cards exiled with this enchantment, put them into their owner's graveyard, then this enchantment deals that much damage to each opponent.
945343.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若放逐区中有以此结界放逐的牌，则将其置入其拥有者的坟墓场，然后此结界向每位对手各造成等量的伤害。

945346.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, return a land you control to its owner's hand.
945346.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

945354.oracleText: Ashaya's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
945354.translation: 荒野之魂艾莎娅的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

945393.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to two lands you control to their owner's hand.
945393.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多两个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。

945411.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target card with a kicker ability from your graveyard to your hand.
945411.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则将目标具任一增幅异能的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

945415.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each attacking creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
945415.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，在每个进行攻击且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

945427.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. If you control six or more lands, create a token that's a copy of this creature instead.
945427.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。若你操控六个或更多地，则改为派出一个为此生物之复制品的衍生物。

945440.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
945440.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

945447.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, reveal the top six cards of your library. You may put a card that shares a creature type with it from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
945447.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则展示你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张与之具共通生物类别的牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

945457.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, all creatures able to block target creature this turn do so.
945457.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则本回合中，所有能阻挡目标生物的生物皆须阻挡之。

945481.oracleText: Whenever you cast a kicked spell, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
945481.translation: 每当你施放已增幅的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

945490.oracleText: Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
945490.translation: 每当你每回合首度获得生命时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

945493.oracleText: Grakmaw enters with three +1/+1 counters on it.
945493.translation: 空境噬怪血盆口进场时上面有三个+1/+1指示物。

945511.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on a creature you control, if this card is in your graveyard, you may put this card on top of your library.
945511.translation: 每当在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，若此牌在你的坟墓场中，则你可以将此牌置于你的牌库顶。

945519.oracleText: Nahiri deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to twice the number of Equipment you control.
945519.translation: 先民后裔娜希丽对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之武具数量的两倍。

945521.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a loyalty counter on Nissa.
945521.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在妮莎上放置一个忠诚指示物。

945525.oracleText: When Omnath enters, draw a card.
945525.translation: 当生机核欧那斯进场时，抓一张牌。

945529.oracleText: Whenever Orah or another Cleric you control dies, return target Cleric card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield.
945529.translation: 每当空境法皇奥拉或另一个由你操控的僧侣死去时，将目标法术力值小于前述生物的僧侣牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

945531.oracleText: When Phylath enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token for each basic land you control.
945531.translation: 当塑世灵菲拉斯进场时，你每操控一个基本地，便派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物。

945544.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
945544.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

945546.oracleText: Verazol enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each mana spent to cast it.
945546.translation: 断流怪威拉佐进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为施放它时用来支付费用的法术力数量。

945558.oracleText: {o2oUoB}, Return an unblocked attacking Rogue you control to its owner's hand: Put this card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
945558.translation: {o2oUoB}，将一个由你操控、进行攻击且未受阻挡的浪客移回其拥有者手上：将此牌从你手上横置放进战场且正进行攻击。

945573.oracleText: If this creature was kicked, it enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each nonbasic land your opponents control.
945573.translation: 如果此生物已增幅，则它进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由所有对手操控的非基本地数量。

945574.oracleText: When this creature becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it and create a number of 1/1 colorless Construct artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
945574.translation: 当此生物成为咒语的目标时，将它牺牲，并派出若干1/1无色组构体衍生神器生物，其数量等同于它的力量。

945577.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, put a charge counter on this artifact.
945577.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，在此神器上放置一个充电指示物。

945578.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove all charge counters from this artifact: It deals that much damage to target creature.
945578.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从此神器上移去所有充电指示物：它对目标生物造成等量的伤害。

945583.oracleText: This creature can't attack or block unless an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
945583.translation: 除非任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，否则此生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

945586.oracleText: As long as you control a Cleric, this artifact has "Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
945586.translation: 只要你操控僧侣，此神器便具有「每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。」

945592.oracleText: When this artifact enters, if it was kicked, create two tapped tokens that are copies of this artifact.
945592.translation: 当此神器进场时，若它已增幅，则派出两个已横置的衍生物，这些衍生物为此神器的复制品。

945596.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

945633.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a charge counter on this land.
945633.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在此地上放置一个充电指示物。

945634.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a charge counter from this land: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast kicked spells.
945634.translation: {oT}，从此地移去一个充电指示物：加两点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放已增幅的咒语。

945732.oracleText: Put this card on top of your library?
945732.translation: 是否要将此牌置于你的牌库顶？

945734.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
945734.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

945742.oracleText: When this Aura enters, create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token with vigilance.
945742.translation: 当此灵气进场时，派出一个1/1白色，具警戒异能的战士衍生生物。

945752.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, untap target creature you control.
945752.translation: 当此生物攻击时，重置目标由你操控的生物。

945768.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+3 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
945768.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+3且获得系命异能。

945771.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
945771.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

945778.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
945778.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，防止本回合中将对它造成的所有战斗伤害。

945780.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile all graveyards.
945780.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐所有坟墓场。

945786.oracleText: This creature has lifelink as long as you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard.
945786.translation: 只要你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，此生物便具有系命异能。

945788.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain life equal to its power.
945788.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得等同于其力量的生命。

945792.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control a tapped creature, create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token with vigilance.
945792.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控已横置的生物，则派出一个1/1白色，具警戒异能的战士衍生生物。

945794.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
945794.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

945799.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, creatures you control get +2/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
945799.translation: 当此结界进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+2/+1且获得警戒异能。

945800.oracleText: When a Cartouche you control enters, return this enchantment to its owner's hand.
945800.translation: 当一个由你操控的魔符进场时，将此结界移回其拥有者的手上。

945803.oracleText: Whenever a Zombie you control enters, you may pay {oW}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
945803.translation: 每当一个由你操控的灵俑进场时，你可以支付{oW}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

945819.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked, draw a card.
945819.translation: 每当此生物攻击且未受阻挡时，抓一张牌。

945824.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
945824.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

945828.oracleText: Kefnet can't attack or block unless you have seven or more cards in hand.
945828.translation: 除非你的手牌有七张或更多，否则心智神刻法涅不能进行攻击或阻挡。

945854.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, draw three cards, then discard a card.
945854.translation: 当此结界进场时，抓三张牌，然后弃一张牌。

945859.oracleText: Whenever Unesh or another Sphinx you control enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
945859.translation: 每当乌纳许或另一个由你操控的史芬斯进场时，展示你牌库顶的四张牌。由任一对手将它们分成两堆。将其中一堆置于你手上，另一堆置入你的坟墓场。

945861.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, tap enchanted creature.
945861.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，则横置所结附的生物。

945863.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with eternalize or embalm, put that card into your graveyard, then shuffle.
945863.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张具永生或遗存异能的生物牌，将该牌置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

945873.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a -1/-1 counter on target creature you control.
945873.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

945875.oracleText: When this Aura enters, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
945875.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你可以在目标生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

945896.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
945896.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以在目标生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

945901.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard another card, this creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
945901.translation: 每当你循环或弃另一张牌时，此生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

945915.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
945915.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出两个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

945922.oracleText: This creature can't block unless you control another Zombie.
945922.translation: 除非你操控另一个灵俑，否则此生物不能进行阻挡。

945928.oracleText: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, this creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
945928.translation: 每当你循环或弃一张牌时，此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

945937.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature for each -1/-1 counter on this creature.
945937.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以在目标生物上放置若干-1/-1指示物，其数量等同于此生物上-1/-1指示物的数量。

945949.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
945949.translation: 当此结界进场时，目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

945954.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each card with cycling in your graveyard.
945954.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张具循环异能的牌，此生物便得+1/+0。

945959.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Bolas planeswalker spell, you may sacrifice this creature. If you do, destroy target creature.
945959.translation: 每当你施放波拉斯鹏洛客咒语时，你可以牺牲此生物。若你如此作，则消灭目标生物。

945976.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard a card: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
945976.translation: {o1oR}，弃一张牌：此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

945982.oracleText: When this Aura enters, target creature can't block this turn.
945982.translation: 当此灵气进场时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

945985.oracleText: Chandra deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and 1 damage to up to one target creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls. That creature can't block this turn.
945985.translation: 茜卓对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害，并对至多一个目标由该牌手或鹏洛客的操控者所操控的生物造成1点伤害。该生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

945996.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may have it deal 2 damage to target creature.
945996.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以让它对目标生物造成2点伤害。

946001.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature with power less than or equal to this creature's power can't block this turn.
946001.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标力量等于或小于此生物的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

946008.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, target creature can't block this turn.
946008.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，则目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

946015.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
946015.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

946022.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature.
946022.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，从此生物上移去一个-1/-1指示物。

946025.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+2 until end of turn.
946025.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+1/+2直到回合结束。

946048.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+2 as long as you have one or fewer cards in hand.
946048.translation: 只要你的手牌为一张或更少，此生物便得+1/+2。

946051.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, it deals 3 damage to any target.
946051.translation: 当此结界进场时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

946055.oracleText: {o4oR}: This creature deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
946055.translation: {o4oR}：此生物向目标对手造成2点伤害。

946065.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more -1/-1 counters on this creature, remove a -1/-1 counter from another target creature you control.
946065.translation: 每当你在此生物上放置一个或数个-1/-1指示物时，从另一个目标由你操控的生物上移去一个-1/-1指示物。

946074.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
946074.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

946078.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exert this creature: Untap two target lands.
946078.translation: {o1}，{oT}，耗竭此生物：重置两个目标地。

946080.oracleText: When this creature enters, create four 1/1 green Insect creature tokens with flying and deathtouch.
946080.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出四个1/1绿色，具飞行与死触异能的昆虫衍生生物。

946086.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may destroy target artifact.
946086.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以消灭目标神器。

946090.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
946090.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

946094.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each other Cat you control.
946094.translation: 你每操控一个其他的猫，此生物便得+1/+1。

946095.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Exert this creature: Create two 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink.
946095.translation: {oW}，{oT}，耗竭此生物：派出两个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物。

946100.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may have target creature get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
946100.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以使目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

946103.oracleText: Rhonas can't attack or block unless you control another creature with power 4 or greater.
946103.translation: 除非你操控另一个力量等于或大于4的生物，否则罗纳斯不能进行攻击或阻挡。

946107.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn and can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
946107.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束，且本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

946114.oracleText: As long as you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+0 and has trample.
946114.translation: 只要你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌，此生物便得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

946117.oracleText: When this creature enters, scry 3, then reveal the top card of your library. You gain life equal to that card's mana value.
946117.translation: 当此生物进场时，占卜3，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。你获得等同于该牌之法术力值的生命。

946129.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 4/2 green Beast creature token.
946129.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个4/2绿色野兽衍生生物。

946132.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, draw a card.
946132.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，抓一张牌。

946176.oracleText: Whenever Hapatra deals combat damage to a player, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
946176.translation: 每当司毒维齐尔哈芭恰对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以在目标生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

946180.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, other attacking creatures get +1/+0 until end of turn.
946180.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，其他进行攻击的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

946201.oracleText: Whenever Neheb deals combat damage to a player, each player discards a card.
946201.translation: 每当内赫布对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，每位牌手各弃一张牌。

946205.oracleText: Nicol Bolas deals 7 damage to target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
946205.translation: 尼可波拉斯向目标对手，由对手操控的生物或由对手操控的鹏洛客造成7点伤害。

946208.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, put a -1/-1 counter on that creature.
946208.translation: 每当此生物对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，在后者上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

946258.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Target creature can't attack this turn. Put a brick counter on this artifact.
946258.translation: {o1}，{oT}：目标生物本回合不能攻击。在此神器上放置一个石砖指示物。

946259.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Until your next turn, target creature can't attack or block and its activated abilities can't be activated. Activate only if there are three or more brick counters on this artifact.
946259.translation: {o1}，{oT}：直到你的下一个回合，目标生物不能进行攻击或阻挡，其起动式异能也不能起动。只能于此神器上有三个或更多石砖指示物时起动。

946276.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Exile this artifact: Exile all nonland permanents.
946276.translation: {o5}，{oT}，放逐此神器：放逐所有非地永久物。

946283.oracleText: This artifact enters with three brick counters on it.
946283.translation: 此神器进场时上面有三个石砖指示物。

946284.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove a brick counter from this artifact: Draw a card.
946284.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从此神器上移去一个石砖指示物：抓一张牌。

946290.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker. Activate only if you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard.
946290.translation: {oT}：此生物对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。只能于你操控沙漠或你坟墓场中有沙漠牌时起动。

946293.oracleText: Exile this creature: Each opponent chooses two cards in their graveyard and exiles the rest.
946293.translation: 放逐此生物：每位对手各从其坟墓场中选择两张牌，并将其余的牌放逐。

946321.oracleText: When this land enters, it deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
946321.translation: 当此地进场时，它对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

946381.oracleText: Boast — {o1oW}: Untap this creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
946381.translation: 炫威～{o1oW}：重置此生物。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

946389.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token.
946389.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色人类／战士衍生生物。

946398.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was the second spell you cast this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
946398.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它是你本回合中施放的第二个咒语，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

946411.oracleText: This creature crews Vehicles using its toughness rather than its power.
946411.translation: 此生物利用其防御力来搭载载具，而不是力量。

946413.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile any number of non-Angel creatures you control until this creature leaves the battlefield.
946413.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以放逐任意数量由你操控的非天使生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

946440.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
946440.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

946452.oracleText: When this creature enters or dies, you may exile another creature card from your graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control other than this creature that shares a creature type with the exiled card.
946452.translation: 当此生物进场或死去时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐另一张生物牌。当你如此作时，在此生物以外每个由你操控且与所放逐之牌具共通生物类别的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

946463.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a Rune card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
946463.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张符文牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

946469.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
946469.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

946473.oracleText: When Sigrid enters, exile up to one target attacking or blocking creature until Sigrid leaves the battlefield.
946473.translation: 当西格莉德进场时，放逐至多一个目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物，直到西格莉德离开战场为止。

946475.oracleText: {o1oW}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target Aura or Equipment card from your graveyard to your hand.
946475.translation: {o1oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：将另一张目标灵气或武具牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

946492.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, you may pay {o4oW}. If you do, create a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying and vigilance, then attach this Equipment to it.
946492.translation: 当此武具进场时，你可以支付{o4oW}。若你如此作，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使／战士衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

946508.oracleText: Whenever Hakka deals combat damage to a player, return it to its owner's hand, then scry 2.
946508.translation: 每当哈卡对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它移回其拥有者手上，然后占卜2。

946518.oracleText: {oSioSi}: This creature becomes a Spirit Warrior with base power and toughness 2/3.
946518.translation: {oSioSi}：此生物成为基础力量与防御力为2/3的精怪／战士。

946519.oracleText: {oSioSioSi}: If this creature is a Warrior, put a flying counter on it and it becomes a Spirit Warrior Angel with base power and toughness 4/4.
946519.translation: {oSioSioSi}：如果此生物是战士，则在其上放置一个飞行指示物且它成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的精怪／战士／天使。

946520.oracleText: {oSioSioSioSi}: If this creature is an Angel, put two +1/+1 counters on it and it gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
946520.translation: {oSioSioSioSi}：如果此生物是天使，则在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物且它获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。」

946530.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls. If {oSi} was spent to cast this spell, that permanent doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
946530.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物。如果施放此咒语时支付过{oSi}，则该永久物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

946533.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature. It deals damage to you equal to its power.
946533.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置所结附的生物。该生物对你造成等同于其力量的伤害。

946549.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, return all permanents to their owners' hands except for Giants, Wizards, and lands.
946549.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你从你手上施放之，则将所有永久物移回其拥有者手上，但巨人、法术师与地除外。

946557.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top card of target player's library. You may put that card into their graveyard.
946557.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视目标牌手的牌库顶牌。你可以将该牌置入其坟墓场。

946563.oracleText: {o1oSi}: This creature can't be blocked this turn.

946566.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for an instant or sorcery card with the same name as a card in your graveyard, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
946566.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张瞬间或法术牌，且其须与你坟墓场中的某张牌同名，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

946568.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, you may pay {o3oU}. If you do, create a 4/4 blue Giant Wizard creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
946568.translation: 当此武具进场时，你可以支付{o3oU}。若你如此作，则派出一个4/4蓝色巨人／法术师衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

946571.oracleText: As long as you control a Giant, you may cast this card from your graveyard by paying {oU} rather than paying its mana cost. If you cast this card this way and it would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
946571.translation: 只要你操控巨人，你便可以从你的坟墓场中施放此牌，但须支付{oU}，而非支付其法术力费用。如果你以此法施放此牌，且它将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

946582.oracleText: When this creature enters, artifacts and creatures target opponent controls don't untap during that player's next untap step.
946582.translation: 当此生物进场时，由目标对手操控之神器和生物于该牌手的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

946583.oracleText: Return three snow lands you control to their owner's hand: Return this creature to its owner's hand.
946583.translation: 将三个由你操控的雪境地移回其拥有者手上：将此生物移回其拥有者手上。

946595.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control three or more creatures that share a creature type, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then scry 1.
946595.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控三个或更多具共通生物类别的生物，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后占卜1。

946601.oracleText: {o1oU}: This creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

946635.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature. It gains menace until end of turn.
946635.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

946638.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for exactly two cards not named Burning-Rune Demon that have different names. If you do, reveal those cards. An opponent chooses one of them. Put the chosen card into your hand and the other into your graveyard, then shuffle.
946638.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻正好两张不同名称的牌，且其名称都不能是焚符恶魔。若你如此作，则展示这些牌。任一对手从中选择一张。将该牌置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

946645.oracleText: When this creature dies, if its power was 3 or greater, create a 2/2 black Zombie Berserker creature token.
946645.translation: 当此生物死去时，若它的力量等于或大于3，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／狂战士衍生生物。

946660.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, you may pay {o2oB}. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie Berserker creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
946660.translation: 当此武具进场时，你可以支付{o2oB}。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／狂战士衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

946667.oracleText: Whenever you foretell a card, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
946667.translation: 每当你预示牌时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

946692.oracleText: {o1oSi}: This creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
946692.translation: {o1oSi}：直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

946695.oracleText: {oSioSi}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

946701.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and it gains flying until end of turn.
946701.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

946706.oracleText: When this creature enters, up to two target creatures each get +1/+0 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
946706.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

946709.oracleText: When this creature dies, each player mills three cards.
946709.translation: 当此生物死去时，每位牌手各磨三张牌。

946714.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of snow lands you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
946714.translation: {oT}，牺牲此生物：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的雪境地数量。只能于法术时机起动。

946737.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Each opponent loses X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common. 
• You gain X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
946737.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•每位对手各失去X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。 
•你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

946781.oracleText: Boast — {o1}: You may change Arni's base power to 1 plus the greatest power among other creatures you control until end of turn.
946781.translation: 炫威～{o1}：你可以将亚尼的基础力量更改为「由你操控之其他生物中力量最大者的数值加1」直到回合结束。

946786.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
946786.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

946804.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals 7 damage to a creature an opponent controls chosen at random.
946804.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对随机选择之一个由对手操控的生物造成7点伤害。

946816.oracleText: When this creature enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
946816.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

946824.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
946824.translation: 当此武具进场时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则派出一个2/1红色矮人／狂战士衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

946835.oracleText: Boast — {o2oR}: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
946835.translation: 炫威～{o2oR}：此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

946838.oracleText: Whenever you activate a boast ability, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
946838.translation: 每当你起动炫威异能时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

946844.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or becomes the target of a spell, create a Treasure token.
946844.translation: 每当此生物攻击或成为咒语的目标时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

946850.oracleText: Boast — {o1oR}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
946850.translation: 炫威～{o1oR}：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

946932.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
946932.translation: 当此武具进场时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

946969.oracleText: {oSioSi}: This creature gets +2/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
946969.translation: {oSioSi}：直到回合结束，此生物得+2/+0且获得不灭异能。将之横置。

947004.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, exile target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
947004.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则放逐目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

947012.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
947012.translation: 当此结界进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

947013.oracleText: {o2oWoUoBoRoG}, Sacrifice this enchantment: You gain 2 life and draw two cards. Target opponent loses 2 life. This enchantment deals 2 damage to up to one target creature. You create a 2/2 green Bear creature token.
947013.translation: {o2oWoUoBoRoG}，牺牲此结界：你获得2点生命且抓两张牌。目标对手失去2点生命。此结界对至多一个目标生物造成2点伤害。你派出一个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物。

947020.oracleText: When this creature dies, search your library for a creature card with power or toughness 6 or greater, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
947020.translation: 当此生物死去时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张力量或防御力等于或大于6的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

947037.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a snow land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
947037.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张雪境地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

947038.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each other snow permanent you control.
947038.translation: 你每操控一个其他雪境永久物，此生物便得+1/+0。

947042.oracleText: Toski attacks each combat if able.
947042.translation: 托斯奇每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

947069.oracleText: This Saga deals 4 damage to each non-Giant creature and each planeswalker.
947069.translation: 此传纪对每个非巨人生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。

947101.oracleText: When Harald enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal an Elf, Warrior, or Tyvar card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
947101.translation: 当哈拉德进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张妖精、战士或泰瓦牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

947111.oracleText: Draw a card. Then you may reveal a Giant card from your hand. When you do, this Saga deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
947111.translation: 抓一张牌。然后你可以从你手上展示一张巨人牌。当你如此作时，此传纪向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

947114.oracleText: When Kardur enters, until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.
947114.translation: 当卡尔杜进场时，直到你的下一个回合，由对手操控的生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击，且若能攻击除你以外的牌手，则必须如此作。

947117.oracleText: You may sacrifice a creature. When you do, this Saga deals 3 damage to any target.
947117.translation: 你可以牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，这个传纪对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

947128.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among cards exiled with this Saga, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
947128.translation: 直到回合结束，你可以从以此传纪放逐的牌之中施放咒语，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来施放这类咒语。

947129.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among cards exiled with this Saga, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
947129.translation: 直到回合结束，你可以施放以此传纪放逐的牌中的咒语，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这些咒语的费用。

947139.oracleText: Koma gains indestructible until end of turn.
947139.translation: 寇玛获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

947140.oracleText:
Sacrifice another Serpent: Choose one — 
• Tap target permanent. Its activated abilities can't be activated this turn. 
• Koma gains indestructible until end of turn.
947140.translation:
牺牲另一个巨蛇：选择一项～ 
•横置目标永久物。本回合中其起动式异能不能起动。 
•寇玛获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

947145.oracleText: You may have Moritte enter as a copy of a permanent you control, except it's legendary and snow in addition to its other types and, if it's a creature, it enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it and has changeling.
947145.translation: 你可以使冰霜摩立特当成任一由你操控之永久物的复制品来进入战场，但它额外具有传奇与雪境此两种类别，且如果它是生物，则它进场时上面额外有两个+1/+1指示物且具有化形异能。

947149.oracleText: {oSioSioSi}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
947149.translation: {oSioSioSi}：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

947166.oracleText: Whenever a permanent an opponent controls is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on Sarulf.
947166.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的永久物从战场进入坟墓场时，在噬境巨狼萨茹夫上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

947191.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control of the chosen type enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
947191.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的该类别之生物进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

947193.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, add {oWoWoW} and you gain 3 life. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
947193.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，加{oWoWoW}且你获得3点生命。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

947206.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped.
947206.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。

947211.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a night counter on this artifact. Then if it has eight or more night counters on it, remove all of them and create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
947211.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在此神器上放置一个夜晚指示物。然后若其上有八个或更多夜晚指示物，则移去所有此类指示物，并派出八个无色，名称为受造指环的衍生雪境神器，且具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

947213.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, you may search your library, hand, and/or graveyard for a Rune card and put it onto the battlefield attached to this Equipment. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
947213.translation: 当此武具进场时，你可以从你的牌库，手牌和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张符文牌，将之放进战场并贴附在此武具上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

947225.oracleText: {o1oRoRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for an Aura card and/or an Equipment card, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
947225.translation: {o1oRoRoW}，{oT}，牺牲此地：从你的牌库中搜寻一张灵气牌和／或一张武具牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

947235.oracleText: {oGoWoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control. They gain vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
947235.translation: {oGoWoW}，{oT}，牺牲此地：在至多两个目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。它们获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

947242.oracleText: {oSioSioSi}: This land becomes a 4/3 creature with vigilance and all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.
947242.translation: {oSioSioSi}：直到回合结束，此地成为4/3，具警戒异能的生物且具有所有生物类别。它仍然是地。

947244.oracleText: {o2oWoUoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: You gain 2 life and draw two cards.
947244.translation: {o2oWoUoU}，{oT}，牺牲此地：你获得2点生命且抓两张牌。

947248.oracleText: {o3oRoGoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target land. Create a 4/4 green Troll Warrior creature token with trample.
947248.translation: {o3oRoGoG}，{oT}，牺牲此地：消灭目标地。派出一个4/4绿色，具践踏异能的巨魔／战士衍生生物。

947250.oracleText: {oWoWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land and a creature you control: Create a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying and vigilance. Activate only as a sorcery.
947250.translation: {oWoWoB}，{oT}，牺牲此地与一个由你操控的生物：派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使／战士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

947260.oracleText: {o1oBoRoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: It deals 3 damage to target player. That player discards a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
947260.translation: {o1oBoRoR}，{oT}，牺牲此地：它对目标牌手造成3点伤害。该牌手弃一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

947262.oracleText: {o2oGoGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
947262.translation: {o2oGoGoU}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控之生物的复制品，但它进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

947264.oracleText: {o3oUoBoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Mill four cards, then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
947264.translation: {o3oUoBoB}，{oT}，牺牲此地：磨四张牌，然后将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

947269.oracleText: As this land enters, choose a color.
947269.translation: 于此地进场时，选择一种颜色。

947271.oracleText: {o2oBoBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Up to one target creature you don't control gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Create two 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
947271.translation: {o2oBoBoG}，{oT}，牺牲此地：至多一个目标不由你操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。派出两个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

947277.oracleText: {o2oUoUoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Scry 2. This land deals 2 damage to each creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
947277.translation: {o2oUoUoR}，{oT}，牺牲此地：占卜2。此地对每个生物各造成2点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

947280.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Put an indestructible counter on target God.
947280.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲此地：在目标神上放置一个不灭指示物。

947287.oracleText: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for any number of God cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
947287.translation: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}，{oT}，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻任意数量的神牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

947293.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
947293.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以从你手上施放一张瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

947296.oracleText: Pay 3 life: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you had an Angel or Berserker enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
947296.translation: 支付3点生命：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于有天使或狂战士在你的操控下进战场之回合中起动。

947299.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, this creature deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target. If the sacrificed creature was a Giant, this creature deals twice that much damage instead.
947299.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，此生物对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。若所牺牲的生物是巨人，则改为此生物造成该数量两倍的伤害。

947311.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, if it's enchanted or equipped, create a 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token.
947311.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，若它受有灵气或佩带武具，则派出一个2/1红色矮人／狂战士衍生生物。

947320.oracleText: When this Aura enters, gain control of target nonland permanent for as long as this Aura remains on the battlefield.
947320.translation: 当此灵气进场时，于此灵气仍在战场上的时段内，获得目标非地永久物的操控权。

947323.oracleText: When this creature dies, return another target Elf card from your graveyard to your hand.
947323.translation: 当此生物死去时，将另一张目标妖精牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

947325.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill four cards. If at least one Angel card is milled this way, you gain 4 life.
947325.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨四张牌。若以此法磨掉至少一张天使牌，则你获得4点生命。

947331.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Remove X counters from target permanent, where X is the number of Elves you control. 
• Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Elves you control.
947331.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•从目标永久物上移去X个指示物，X为由你操控的妖精数量。 
•目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的妖精数量。

947339.oracleText: Sacrifice two Treasures: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
947339.translation: 牺牲两个珍宝：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

947348.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
947348.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使衍生生物。

947518.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
947518.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

947520.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control enters, you get {oE}.
947520.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，你得到{oE}。

947521.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it and tap up to one target creature defending player controls.
947521.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，并横置至多一个目标由防御牌手操控的生物。

947525.oracleText: Revolt — When this creature enters, if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, you gain 5 life.
947525.translation: 反抗～当此生物进场时，若本回合中曾有由你操控的永久物离开战场，则你获得5点生命。

947534.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by artifact creatures.
947534.translation: 此生物不能被神器生物阻挡。

947537.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return another permanent you control to its owner's hand.
947537.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将另一个由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

947543.oracleText: {oW}: Return this Aura to its owner's hand.
947543.translation: {oW}：将此灵气移回其拥有者手上。

947546.oracleText: Revolt — When this creature enters, if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
947546.translation: 反抗～当此生物进场时，若本回合中曾有由你操控的永久物离开战场，则派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

947550.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {oE}. If you do, another target attacking creature gains flying until end of turn.
947550.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{oE}。若你如此作，则另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

947563.oracleText: {oW}, Sacrifice this creature: Return up to one target artifact card and up to one target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
947563.translation: {oW}，牺牲此生物：将至多一张目标神器牌和至多一张目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

947576.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile another target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
947576.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以放逐另一个目标由你操控的生物，然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

947578.oracleText: When this Aura enters, you get {oEoE}.
947578.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你得到{oEoE}。

947598.oracleText: {o5oU}: This creature can't be blocked this turn.

947603.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
947603.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张神器牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

947606.oracleText: This creature can't block artifact creatures.
947606.translation: 此生物不能阻挡神器生物。

947621.oracleText: {o3oUoU}, Exile this enchantment: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you control six or more artifacts.
947621.translation: {o3oUoU}，放逐此结界：将所有瞬间与法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你操控六个或更多神器时起动。

947635.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks, you get {oE}.
947635.translation: 每当此生物阻挡时，你得到{oE}。

947639.oracleText: Pay {oE}: This creature gets +2/-2 until end of turn.
947639.translation: 支付{oE}：此生物得+2/-2直到回合结束。

947647.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card with mana value 3, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
947647.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于3的神器牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

947650.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, this creature gains flying until end of turn.
947650.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

947659.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
947659.translation: 牺牲一个神器或生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

947666.oracleText: This creature has menace as long as you control an artifact.
947666.translation: 只要你操控神器，此生物便具有威慑异能。

947679.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn.
947679.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控其上有+1/+1指示物的生物，则由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

947684.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may have target creature get -1/-1 until end of turn.
947684.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以使目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

947687.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and you lose 1 life.
947687.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你失去1点生命。

947689.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you get {oE}.
