948546.oracleText: {oT}, Discard a card: Create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
948546.translation: {oT}，弃一张牌：派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

948564.oracleText: Rowan deals 1 damage to each opponent. If you've drawn three or more cards this turn, she deals 3 damage to each opponent instead.
948564.translation: 火花学者萝婉向每位对手各造成1点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过三张或更多牌，则改为她向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

948575.oracleText: Exile this creature: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
948575.translation: 放逐此生物：由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

948584.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature, then Embrose deals 2 damage to that creature.
948584.translation: {oT}：在另一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后黯影院长安博斯对该生物造成2点伤害。

948587.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on this creature equal to half that card's mana value, rounded up.
948587.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。在此生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于所放逐之牌法术力值的一半，小数点后进位。

948600.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, put a +1/+1 counter on Nassari.
948600.translation: 每当你从放逐区中施放咒语时，在展现院长纳撒理上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

948603.oracleText: If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead. When you do, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
948603.translation: 如果某个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。当你如此作时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

948612.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
948612.translation: 在每个维持开始时，派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

948616.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on each Fractal you control.
948616.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在每个由你操控的分灵上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

948638.oracleText: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}, Discard this card: Create a Treasure token.
948638.translation: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}，弃掉此牌：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

948648.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, sacrifice a creature.
948648.translation: 每当此生物攻击或阻挡时，牺牲一个生物。

948651.oracleText: When you sacrifice this creature, each opponent discards a card, you draw a card, and you gain 2 life.
948651.translation: 当你牺牲此生物时，每位对手各弃一张牌，你抓一张牌，且你获得2点生命。

948661.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Dina gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
948661.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：浸灵迪娜得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

948710.oracleText: When this token leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to its owner's graveyard.
948710.translation: 当此衍生物离开战场时，将所放逐之牌移回其拥有者的坟墓场。

948711.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, exile it. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types and it has "When this token leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to its owner's graveyard."
948711.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，将它放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品，但它额外具有精怪此类别，且具有「当此衍生物离开战场时，将所放逐之牌移回其拥有者的坟墓场。」

948721.oracleText: Each other planeswalker you control has the loyalty abilities of Kasmina.
948721.translation: 每个由你操控的其他鹏洛客均具有克蜜娜的所有忠诚异能。

948738.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, mill a card. If a land card was milled this way, you gain 1 life. Otherwise, this enchantment deals 1 damage to each opponent.
948738.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，磨一张牌。若以此法磨掉一张地牌，则你获得1点生命。若否，则此结界向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

948745.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {oX} less to cast, where X is this creature's power as this ability resolves.
948745.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你本回合中施放的下一个瞬间或法术咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为于此异能结算时此生物的力量。

948754.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
948754.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你的手牌数量。

948771.oracleText: Create two 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
948771.translation: 派出两个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

948777.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, this creature can't be blocked this turn. If that spell has mana value 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
948777.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物本回合不能被阻挡。如果该咒语的法术力值等于或大于5，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

948786.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, this creature can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
948786.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

948796.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic Forest or Island card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
948796.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林或海岛牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

948813.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target Spirit, instant, or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
948813.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标精怪，瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

948825.oracleText: {o2}, Return Rootha to its owner's hand: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
948825.translation: {o2}，将善变艺家如莎移回其拥有者手上：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

948847.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gains your choice of flying or lifelink until end of turn.
948847.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，选择飞行或系命，此生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

948850.oracleText: As this creature enters, choose a nonland card name.
948850.translation: 于此生物进场时，选择一个非地牌的名称。

948876.oracleText: Create X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life," where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
948876.translation: 派出X个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，你获得1点生命」，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

948887.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage this creature dealt to that player.
948887.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为此生物对该牌手造成的伤害数量。

948905.oracleText: When this creature enters, put up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard on top of your library.
948905.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

948922.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only this creature, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
948922.translation: 每当你施放仅以此生物为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

948924.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a book counter on this artifact.
948924.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在此神器上放置一个书籍指示物。

948925.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a book counter from this artifact: Add {oC}.
948925.translation: {oT}，从此神器上移去一个书籍指示物：加{oC}。

948926.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Remove three book counters from this artifact: Draw a card.
948926.translation: {o3}，{oT}，从此神器上移去三个书籍指示物：抓一张牌。

948928.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Put a point counter on this artifact.
948928.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。在此神器上放置一个得分指示物。

948929.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, remove a point counter from this artifact.
948929.translation: 每当一个生物对你造成战斗伤害时，从此神器上移去一个得分指示物。

948930.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a point counter on this artifact. Then if it has ten or more point counters on it, remove them all and that player loses the game.
948930.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，在此神器上放置一个得分指示物。然后如果其上有十个或更多得分指示物，则移去所有此类指示物且该牌手输掉这盘游戏。

948945.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal an Island or Mountain card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
948945.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张海岛或山脉牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

948948.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Mountain or Plains card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
948948.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张山脉或平原牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

948956.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Swamp or Forest card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
948956.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张沼泽或树林牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

948963.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Plains or Swamp card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
948963.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张平原或沼泽牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

948968.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Forest or Island card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
948968.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张树林或海岛牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

949041.oracleText: Return this card to the battlefield?
949041.translation: 是否要将此牌移回战场？

949062.oracleText: You may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
949062.translation: 你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

949105.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 colorless Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
949105.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2无色，具化形异能的变形兽衍生生物。

949120.oracleText: When this Aura enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this Aura leaves the battlefield.
949120.translation: 当此灵气进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此灵气离开战场为止。

949123.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value 1 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
949123.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于1的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

949124.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells this turn.
949124.translation: 牺牲此生物：所有对手本回合都不能施放非生物咒语。

949170.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, return target creature card with power 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
949170.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，将目标力量等于或小于1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

949174.oracleText: {oW}: This creature can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
949174.translation: {oW}：此生物于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

949192.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw two cards, then discard three cards.
949192.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃三张牌。

949202.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may tap target creature.
949202.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以横置目标生物。

949216.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
949216.translation: 只要你本回合已抓两张或更多牌，此生物便得+2/+0。

949246.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a token that's a copy of this creature.
949246.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为此生物的复制品。

949249.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token with flying.
949249.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的虚影衍生生物。

949258.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top three cards of your library, then put them back in any order. You may shuffle. Draw a card.
949258.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌，然后将它们以任意顺序放回。你可以洗牌。抓一张牌。

949273.oracleText: When a Ninja you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to that creature.
949273.translation: 当一个由你操控的忍者进场时，你可以将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在该生物上。

949292.oracleText: When Urza enters, create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
949292.translation: 当克撒进场时，派出一个0/0无色组构体衍生神器生物，且具有「你每操控一个神器，此衍生物便得+1/+1。」

949300.oracleText: When you cycle this card, target creature gains flying until end of turn.
949300.translation: 当你循环此牌时，目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

949310.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
949310.translation: 牺牲一个生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

949315.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
949315.translation: 每当此生物或另一个生物死去时，在每个由你操控的吸血鬼上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

949332.oracleText: {oB}: This creature gains menace until end of turn.
949332.translation: {oB}：此生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

949333.oracleText: {oB}: This creature gains undying until end of turn.
949333.translation: {oB}：此生物获得不息异能直到回合结束。

949334.oracleText: {o1}: This creature gets +1/-1 or -1/+1 until end of turn.

949360.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is the only creature card in your graveyard, you may return this card to the battlefield.
949360.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若此牌是你坟墓场中唯一的生物牌，则你可以将此牌移回战场。

949407.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Zombie you control dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
949407.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的灵俑死去时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

949414.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, scry 1.
949414.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1。

949430.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Until end of turn, this creature becomes a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4, flying, and haste.
949430.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：直到回合结束，此生物成为基础力量与防御力为4/4，具飞行与敏捷异能的龙。

949454.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle.
949454.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

949458.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Goblin card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
949458.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张鬼怪牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

949470.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may have it deal 2 damage to target creature.
949470.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以令它对目标生物造成2点伤害。

949502.oracleText: When this creature enters, up to two target creatures can't block this turn.
949502.translation: 当此生物进场时，至多两个目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

949510.oracleText: When this creature enters, discard two cards, then draw two cards. For each nonland card discarded this way, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token.
949510.translation: 当此生物进场时，弃两张牌，然后抓两张牌。每以此法弃掉一张非地牌，便派出一个1/1红色元素衍生生物。

949511.oracleText: {o3oRoR}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens.
949511.translation: {o3oRoR}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出两个1/1红色元素衍生生物。

949517.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, this creature has double strike.
949517.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，此生物便具有连击异能。

949573.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, draw a card.
949573.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个地。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

949597.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
949597.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

949602.oracleText: {o3oGoG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create two 2/2 green Bear creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
949602.translation: {o3oGoG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出两个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

949605.oracleText: This creature gets +3/+3 as long as there is a land card in your graveyard.
949605.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有地牌，此生物便得+3/+3。

949609.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may discard any number of land cards. Put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature and draw that many cards.
949609.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以弃掉任意数量的地牌。在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物且抓等量的牌。

949655.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/2 green Spider creature token with reach.
949655.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/2绿色，具延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

949663.oracleText: When this creature enters, if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, you gain 5 life.
949663.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则你获得5点生命。

949683.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles the top two cards of their library. Until end of turn, you may play those cards without paying their mana costs.
949683.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手放逐其牌库顶的两张牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用这些牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

949713.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player discards two cards.
949713.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手弃两张牌。

949716.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may have it deal damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of Goblins you control.
949716.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以令它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的鬼怪数量。

949728.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may have it deal damage to any target equal to the number of land cards in your graveyard.

950953.translation: 于此生物进场时，你可以从手上展示一张龙牌。如果你如此作或如果你操控龙，则此生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

950957.oracleText: As long as this creature is equipped, it gets +0/+2.

950964.oracleText: As long as you've completed a dungeon, this creature has double strike.
950964.translation: 只要你完成过地城，此生物便具有连击异能。

950971.oracleText: When this creature enters, any number of other target creatures you control phase out.
950971.translation: 当此生物进场时，任意数量目标由你操控的其他生物跃离。

950978.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

950985.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a basic Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

950992.translation: 疾风连击～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

950997.oracleText: Divine Intervention — When this creature enters, you may search your library for an enchantment card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
950997.translation: 神力干预～当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张结界牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

951082.translation: 闪电喷吐～当此生物进场时，直到你的下一个回合，目标由对手操控的生物得-3/-0，至多另一个目标生物得-2/-0，且至多再另一个目标生物得-1/-0。

951094.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。将其复制。你可以施放该复制品。

951142.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if enchanted creature is red, tap it.

951457.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal a Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
951457.translation: {oR}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中的一张龙牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

951466.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Smash the Chest — Destroy target artifact. 
• Pry It Open — Create a Treasure token.
951466.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•砸碎宝箱～消灭目标神器。 
•用力撬开～派出一个珍宝衍生物。

951472.oracleText: Fire Breath — When this creature enters, it deals 4 damage to each opponent.
951472.translation: 火焰喷吐～当此生物进场时，它向每位对手各造成4点伤害。

951476.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
951476.translation: 牺牲一个神器：此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

951478.oracleText: When this creature enters, roll a d20. 1-9 | Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. 10-19 | Create two of those tokens. 20 | Create three of those tokens.
951478.translation: 当此生物进场时，掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。10-19 | 派出两个上述衍生物。20 | 派出三个上述衍生物。

951481.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, this creature deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to target creature.
951481.translation: 集群战术～每当此生物攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，此生物对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。

951517.oracleText: Whenever Zalto is dealt damage, venture into the dungeon.
951517.translation: 每当火巨人公爵札尔托受到伤害时，深入地城。

951520.oracleText: Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
951520.translation: 派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

951525.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
951525.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

951542.oracleText: Bear Form — During your turn, this creature is a Bear with base power and toughness 4/2. (It loses all other creature types.)
951542.translation: 熊形态～于你的回合中，此生物是基础力量与防御力为4/2的熊。（它失去所有其他生物类别。）

951549.oracleText: {o1oG}: This creature gets +2/+2 and gains haste until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
951549.translation: {o1oG}：直到回合结束，此生物得+2/+2且获得敏捷异能。每回合只能起动一次。

951568.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, exile up to that many target cards from their graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each creature card exiled this way. You gain 1 life for each noncreature card exiled this way.
951568.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将至多等量的目标牌从其坟墓场放逐。每以此法放逐一张生物牌，便在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。每以此法放逐一张非生物牌，你便获得1点生命。

951571.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
951571.translation: 集群战术～每当此生物攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

951574.oracleText: Poison Breath — When this creature enters, until end of turn, whenever a creature an opponent controls is dealt damage, destroy it.
951574.translation: 剧毒喷吐～当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，每当一个由对手操控的生物受到伤害时，消灭受到伤害的该生物。

951590.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Bardic Inspiration — Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. 
• Song of Rest — You gain 3 life.
951590.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～

•休憩曲～你获得3点生命。

951598.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, venture into the dungeon.
951598.translation: 集群战术～每当此生物攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则深入地城。

951600.oracleText: {o3oG}: Roll a d20. Activate only if this card is in your graveyard. 1-9 | Put this card on top of your library. 10-19 | Return this card to your hand. 20 | Return this card to the battlefield tapped.
951600.translation: {o3oG}：掷一颗d20。只能于此牌在你的坟墓场中时起动。 1-9 | 将此牌置于你的牌库顶。10-19 | 将此牌移回你手上。20 | 将此牌横置移回战场。

951609.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a basic Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
951609.translation: {o2}，牺牲此生物：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

951611.oracleText: Split — When this creature dies, if it had two or more +1/+1 counters on it, create a token that's a copy of it at the beginning of the next end step. The token enters with half that many +1/+1 counters on it, rounded down.
951611.translation: 分裂～当此生物死去时，若其上有两个或更多+1/+1指示物，则在下一个结束步骤开始时，派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。该衍生物进场时上面有该数量一半的+1/+1指示物，小数点后舍去。

951617.oracleText: Keen Senses — When this creature enters, draw a card.
951617.translation: 感官异常灵敏～当此生物进场时，抓一张牌。

951626.oracleText: When this Class enters, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
951626.translation: 当此职业进场时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

951642.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, roll a d20. 1-9 | You gain 1 life. 10-19 | You gain 2 life. 20 | You gain 5 life.
951642.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 你获得1点生命。10-19 | 你获得2点生命。20 | 你获得5点生命。

951659.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, draw a card.
951659.translation: 集群战术～每当此生物攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则抓一张牌。

951660.oracleText: {o3oG}: Until end of turn, this creature has base power and toughness 5/3, gains trample, and isn't a Human.
951660.translation: {o3oG}：直到回合结束，此生物的基础力量与防御力为5/3，获得践踏异能，且不是人类。

951697.oracleText: When Barrowin enters, venture into the dungeon.
951697.translation: 当乌杜尔部族的芭罗雯进场时，深入地城。

951698.oracleText: Whenever Barrowin attacks, return up to one creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield if you've completed a dungeon.
951698.translation: 每当乌杜尔部族的芭罗雯攻击时，如果你完成过地城，则将至多一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

951704.oracleText: When Drizzt enters, create Guenhwyvar, a legendary 4/1 green Cat creature token with trample.
951704.translation: 当崔斯特杜垩登进场时，派出传奇衍生生物关海法，其为4/1绿色，具践踏异能的猫。

951709.oracleText: Dark One's Own Luck — Whenever you roll one or more dice, Farideh gains flying and menace until end of turn. If any of those results was 10 or higher, draw a card.
951709.translation: 黑暗强运～每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，魔王子民法莉黛获得飞行与威慑异能直到回合结束。如果其中任一掷骰结果为10点或更大，则抓一张牌。

951712.oracleText: When this Class enters, search your library for an Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
951712.translation: 当此职业进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

951728.oracleText: When Kalain enters, create a Treasure token.
951728.translation: 当画家隐士卡莱茵进场时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

951732.oracleText: Whenever Krydle deals combat damage to a player, that player loses 1 life and mills a card, then you gain 1 life and scry 1.
951732.translation: 每当博德之门的克吕德对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手失去1点生命且磨一张牌，然后你获得1点生命且占卜1。

951736.oracleText: When Minsc enters, create Boo, a legendary 1/1 red Hamster creature token with trample and haste.
951736.translation: 当厚爱游侠明斯克进场时，派出传奇衍生生物布布，其为1/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的仓鼠。

951752.oracleText:
When Orcus enters, choose one — 
• Each other creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. You lose X life.

当死亡王子欧库斯进场时，选择一项～ 
•每个其他生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束。你失去X点生命。 
•选择至多X张目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于X。将它们从该处移回战场。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

951758.translation: 你可以使用以此职业放逐的牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来施放这些咒语。

951759.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3+] [] [You may play cards exiled with this Class, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.]

951762.translation: 惑人低语～当亡者嗫声谢丝拉进场时，目标生物本回合若能进行阻挡，则须如此作。

951770.oracleText: When this Class enters, draw two cards, then discard two cards.
951770.translation: 当此职业进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

951779.translation: 集群战术～每当魔齿豺狼人塔格纳攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则进行攻击的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

951823.translation: {o2}：此神器成为基础力量与防御力为3/3的变形兽神器生物直到回合结束。

951828.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Choose target creature, then roll a d20. 1-9 | This artifact deals 5 damage to that creature. 10-20 | This artifact deals 5 damage to that creature. Create a Treasure token.
951828.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲刺坑陷阱：选择目标生物，然后掷一颗d20。 1-9 | 刺坑陷阱对该生物造成5点伤害。10-20 | 刺坑陷阱对该生物造成5点伤害。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

951830.oracleText: {o4}, Sacrifice this artifact: Roll a d20. 1 | Trapped! — You lose 3 life. 2-9 | Create five Treasure tokens. 10-19 | You gain 3 life and draw three cards. 20 | Search your library for a card. If it's an artifact card, you may put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put that card into your hand. Then shuffle.
951830.translation: {o4}，牺牲此神器：掷一颗d20。 1 | 陷阱！～你失去3点生命。2-9 | 派出五个珍宝衍生物。10-19 | 你获得3点生命且抓三张牌。20 | 从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌。如果它是神器牌，则你可以将之放进战场。若否，则将该牌置于你手上。然后洗牌。

951833.oracleText: If you control two or more other lands, this land enters tapped.
951833.translation: 如果你操控两个或更多其他地，则此地须横置进场。

951834.oracleText: {o4oW}: This land becomes a 3/4 white Dragon creature with flying until end of turn. It's still a land.
951834.translation: {o4oW}：此地成为一个3/4白色，具飞行异能的龙生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

951837.oracleText: {o3oR}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 3/2 red Goblin creature with "Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking." It's still a land.
951837.translation: {o3oR}：直到回合结束，此地成为3/2红色哥布林生物，且具有「每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1红色哥布林衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。」它仍然是地。

951842.oracleText: {o5oU}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 7/7 blue Giant creature with ward {o3}. It's still a land.
951842.translation: {o5oU}：直到回合结束，此地成为7/7蓝色，具守护{o3}的巨人生物。它仍然是地。

951845.oracleText: {o3oB}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 3/3 black Beholder creature with menace and "Whenever this creature attacks, exile target card from defending player's graveyard." It's still a land.
951845.translation: {o3oB}：直到回合结束，此地成为3/3黑色眼魔生物，具有威慑与「每当此生物攻击时，将目标牌从防御牌手的坟墓场放逐。」它仍然是地。

951847.oracleText: {oXoG}: Until end of turn, this land becomes an X/X green Hydra creature. It's still a land. X can't be 0.
951847.translation: {oXoG}：直到回合结束，此地成为X/X绿色多头龙生物。它仍然是地。X不能为0。

951849.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Dragon card from your hand. This land enters tapped unless you revealed a Dragon card this way or you control a Dragon.

951852.oracleText: {oXoX}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create X Treasure tokens.
951852.translation: {oXoX}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出X个珍宝衍生物。

952007.oracleText: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand?
952007.translation: 是否要将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上？

952029.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
952029.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

952031.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile another target creature.
952031.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以放逐另一个目标生物。

952032.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
952032.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，将所放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

952059.oracleText: When this creature enters, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.

952111.oracleText: When Garruk has two or fewer loyalty counters on him, transform him.
952111.translation: 当无情贾路的忠诚指示物为两个或更少时，转化他。

952112.oracleText: Garruk deals 3 damage to target creature. That creature deals damage equal to its power to him.
952112.translation: 贾路对目标生物造成3点伤害。该生物对他造成等同于该生物力量的伤害。

952136.oracleText: Grimgrin enters tapped and doesn't untap during your untap step.
952136.translation: 邪笑须横置进场，且于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

952144.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
952144.translation: {oT}，牺牲此地：消灭目标地。其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

952226.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile target non-Angel creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
952226.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以放逐目标由你操控的非天使生物，然后将该牌在你的操控下移回战场。

952235.oracleText: You may cast this card from exile.
952235.translation: 你可以从放逐区中施放此牌。

952251.oracleText: When this creature enters, sacrifice another creature. You gain X life and draw X cards, where X is that creature's power.
952251.translation: 当此生物进场时，牺牲另一个生物。你获得X点生命且抓X张牌，X为该生物的力量。

952285.oracleText: {o2oB}, Discard a card: Create a token that's a copy of this creature.
952285.translation: {o2oB}，弃一张牌：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为此生物之复制品。

952304.oracleText: When this creature dies, create three 5/5 green Wurm creature tokens with trample.
952304.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出三个5/5绿色，具践踏异能的亚龙衍生生物。

952311.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you may exile target nonland permanent not named Detention Sphere and all other permanents with the same name as that permanent.
952311.translation: 当此结界进场时，你可以放逐目标名称不为扣留法球的非地永久物，以及所有与该永久物同名的其他永久物。

952312.oracleText: When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, return the exiled cards to the battlefield under their owner's control.
952312.translation: 当此结界离开战场时，将所放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

952342.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Counter target instant or sorcery spell unless its controller pays {o1}.
952342.translation: 牺牲此生物：除非目标瞬间或法术咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

952396.oracleText: When Obzedat enters, target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
952396.translation: 当欧节达进场时，目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

952411.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target.
952411.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

952412.oracleText: {o(R/W)}: This creature gains first strike until end of turn.
952412.translation: {o(R/W)}：此生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

952421.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: This land becomes a copy of target land, except it has this ability.
952421.translation: {o2}，{oT}：此地成为目标地的复制品，但它具有此异能。

952426.oracleText: {oU}: Exile this creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
952426.translation: {oU}：放逐此生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

952427.oracleText: {oU}: This creature can't be blocked this turn.

952428.oracleText: {o1}: This creature gets -1/+1 until end of turn.

952435.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, that player exiles it, then exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a card that shares a card type with it. 952435.translation: 每当一位牌手从其手牌中施放咒语时，该牌手将它放逐，然后自其牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张与该咒语具有共通牌类别的牌为止。该牌手可以施放该牌且不需支付其法术力费用。然后他将所有被此结界放逐的牌以随机顺序置于其牌库底。

952443.oracleText: This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
952443.translation: 此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的生物数量。

952444.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell during your turn and when this creature dies, create a green and white Elemental creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control."
952444.translation: 每当任一对手在你的回合中施放咒语和当此生物死去时，派出一个绿白双色的元素衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的生物数量。」

952502.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Human creature you control dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
952502.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的人类生物死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

952521.oracleText: {o1}: This land becomes a 2/2 creature with all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.
952521.translation: {o1}：直到回合结束，此地成为2/2生物并具有所有生物类别。它仍然是地。

952524.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
952524.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

952527.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
952527.translation: 勇行～每当你施放一个以此生物为目标的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，并防止本回合中将对它造成的所有伤害。

952533.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
952533.translation: 勇行～每当你施放一个以此生物为目标的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

952540.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a number of 1/0 blue Elemental creature tokens equal to your devotion to blue.
952540.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出若干1/0蓝色元素衍生生物，其数量等同于你的蓝色献力。

952561.oracleText: When this creature becomes monstrous, it deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of cards in that player's hand.
952561.translation: 当此生物蛮化时，它向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌手的手牌数量。

952580.oracleText: When Polukranos becomes monstrous, it deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures your opponents control. Each of those creatures deals damage equal to its power to Polukranos.
952580.translation: 当波禄卡诺斯蛮化时，它对任意数量之目标由对手操控的生物造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。这些生物各对波禄卡诺斯造成等同于前者力量的伤害。

952583.oracleText: Put a creature card with mana value X exiled with Ashiok onto the battlefield under your control. That creature is a Nightmare in addition to its other types.
952583.translation: 将一张以安梭苛放逐且法术力值为X的生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。该生物额外具有梦魇此类别。

952586.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then scry 1.
952586.translation: 勇行～每当你施放一个以此生物为目标的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后占卜1。

952588.oracleText: Whenever Medomai deals combat damage to a player, take an extra turn after this one.
952588.translation: 每当墨冬迈对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。

952589.oracleText: Medomai can't attack during extra turns.
952589.translation: 在额外的回合中，墨冬迈不能攻击。

952623.oracleText: When this creature enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
952623.translation: 当此生物进场时，展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌置于你手上。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

952631.oracleText: This artifact enters with X charge counters on it.
952631.translation: 此神器进场时上面有X个充电指示物。

952632.oracleText: {oT}: Choose a color. Add one mana of that color for each charge counter on this artifact.
952632.translation: {oT}：选择一种颜色。此神器上每有一个充电指示物，便加一点该色法术力。

952649.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card until this creature leaves the battlefield.
952649.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌，直到此生物离开战场为止。

952652.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever this creature or another enchantment you control enters, creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn.
952652.translation: 星彩～每当此生物或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

952663.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, this creature deals 2 damage to that player.
952663.translation: 每当任一牌手施放法术力值等于或小于3的咒语时，此生物对该牌手造成2点伤害。

952670.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever this creature or another enchantment you control enters, draw a card.
952670.translation: 星彩～每当此生物或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，抓一张牌。

952673.oracleText: {o1oBoG}, Exile this creature: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
952673.translation: {o1oBoG}，放逐此生物：将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

952702.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard.
952702.translation: 你可以使此生物当成坟墓场中任一生物牌的复制品来进入场。

952735.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add three mana of any one color.
952735.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：加三点任意颜色的单色法术力。

952738.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 2 damage to any target.
952738.translation: {oR}，牺牲此神器：它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

952744.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, this Equipment deals 2 damage to any target and you draw a card.
952744.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，此武具对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你抓一张牌。

952763.oracleText: Remove a fade counter from this enchantment: Exile target creature.
952763.translation: 从此结界上移去一个消退指示物：放逐目标生物。

952792.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if it's on the battlefield, it loses "enchant creature card in a graveyard" and gains "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with this Aura." Return enchanted creature card to the battlefield under your control and attach this Aura to it. When this Aura leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it.
952792.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若它在战场上，则它失去「结附于坟墓场中的生物牌」且获得「结附于以此灵气放进战场的生物」。将所结附的生物牌在你的操控下移回战场，并将此灵气贴附于其上。当此灵气离开战场时，该生物之操控者牺牲该生物。

952816.oracleText: Whenever you play a land, if it wasn't the first land you played this turn, this enchantment deals 1 damage to you.
952816.translation: 每当你使用地时，若它不是你本回合中使用的第一个地，则此结界对你造成1点伤害。

952839.oracleText: Discard your hand, Sacrifice this artifact: Add three mana of any one color. Activate only as an instant.
952839.translation: 弃掉你的手牌，牺牲此神器：加三点任意颜色的单色法术力。只能于瞬间时机起动。

952841.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, flip a coin. If you lose the flip, this artifact deals 3 damage to you.
952841.translation: 在你的维持开始时，掷一枚硬币。若你猜错此掷，则此神器对你造成3点伤害。

952843.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Each player exiles all cards from their hand face down and draws seven cards. At the beginning of the next end step, each player discards their hand and returns to their hand each card they exiled this way.
952843.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：每位牌手牌面朝下地放逐其手牌并各抓七张牌。在下一个结束步骤开始时，每位牌手弃掉其手牌，并各将每张以此法放逐的牌移回其手上。

952863.oracleText: When Breya enters, create two 1/1 blue Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying.
952863.translation: 当布莱娅进场时，派出两个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

952870.oracleText: {o1}: This land becomes a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature with flying until end of turn. It's still a land.
952870.translation: {o1}：此地成为1/1，具飞行异能的光蛾神器生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

952879.oracleText: When this creature dies, create X 1/1 blue Squid creature tokens with islandwalk, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.
952879.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出X个1/1蓝色，具海岛行者异能的乌贼衍生生物，X为此生物上的+1/+1指示物数量。

952937.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} or {oU}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

952965.oracleText: {o3oR}: This creature gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
952965.translation: {o3oR}：直到回合结束，此生物得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。

952968.oracleText: Whenever you activate this creature's outlast ability, create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token.
952968.translation: 每当你起动此生物的延生异能时，派出一个1/1白色战士衍生生物。

952976.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token.
952976.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则派出一个1/1白色战士衍生生物。

952979.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
952979.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

952990.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
952990.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

952996.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you may exile target creature with toughness 3 or greater until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
952996.translation: 当此结界进场时，你可以放逐目标防御力等于或大于3的生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

953001.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
953001.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

953009.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, you gain 2 life.
953009.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，你获得2点生命。

953011.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, create a 3/4 white Bird creature token with flying.
953011.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则派出一个3/4白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

953012.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 1 life for each attacking creature.
953012.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每有一个进行攻击的生物，你便获得1点生命。

953019.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any nonland permanent on the battlefield.
953019.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一非地永久物的复制品来进入战场。

953027.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, look at target opponent's hand.
953027.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，检视目标对手的手牌。

953030.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
953030.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置进战场，然后将你的牌库洗牌。

953048.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled.
953048.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，反击目标咒语。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将其放逐，而非置入拥有者的坟墓场。于该牌持续被放逐期间，你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。

953051.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn.
953051.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，目标由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

953058.oracleText: Return three lands you control to their owner's hand: Return this creature to its owner's hand.
953058.translation: 将三个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上：将此生物移回其拥有者手上。

953066.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 2 damage to any target.
953066.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

953083.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, return all other tapped creatures to their owners' hands.
953083.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，将所有其他已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上。

953095.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, you lose 4 life unless you attacked this turn.
953095.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，除非你于本回合中曾进行攻击，否则你失去4点生命。

953101.oracleText: Raid — {o1oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only if you attacked this turn.
953101.translation: 突击～{o1oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于你攻击过的回合中起动。

953124.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
953124.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

953158.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, target player loses 2 life.
953158.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，目标牌手失去2点生命。

953169.oracleText: {o1oW}: This creature gains first strike until end of turn.
953169.translation: {o1oW}：此生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

953181.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield face down under your control.
953181.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它牌面朝下地移回战场。

953183.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, it deals 2 damage to each player.
953183.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，它对每位牌手各造成2点伤害。

953209.oracleText: Ferocious — If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, you may cast this spell as though it had flash.
953209.translation: 威猛～如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，你可以将此咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

953217.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks, it deals 1 damage to you.
953217.translation: 每当此生物进行阻挡时，它对你造成1点伤害。

953219.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, target creature can't block this turn.
953219.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

953226.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, if it's your turn, gain control of another target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
953226.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，若是在你的回合中，则获得另一个目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

953229.oracleText: {o2oW}: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
953229.translation: {o2oW}：此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

953232.oracleText: When this creature attacks or blocks, sacrifice it at end of combat.
953232.translation: 当此生物攻击或阻挡，在战斗结束时将它牺牲。

953237.oracleText: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, add {oRoWoB}.
953237.translation: 突击～当此生物进场时，若你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则加{oRoWoB}。

953241.oracleText: Until end of turn, Sarkhan becomes a legendary 4/4 red Dragon creature with flying, indestructible, and haste.
953241.translation: 直到回合结束，萨坎成为传奇的4/4红色龙生物，且具有飞行，不灭与敏捷异能。

953242.oracleText: Sarkhan deals 4 damage to target creature.
953242.translation: 萨坎对目标生物造成4点伤害。

953256.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 1 or less.
953256.translation: 此生物不能被力量等于或小于1的生物阻挡。

953278.oracleText: Ferocious — Whenever this creature attacks, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
953278.translation: 威猛～每当此生物攻击时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则蛮荒传人得+1/+1直到回合结束。

953282.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 green Snake creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
953282.translation: 当此生物死去时，其上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便将一个1/1绿色的蛇衍生生物放进战场。

953284.oracleText: As this creature is turned face up, put five +1/+1 counters on it.
953284.translation: 于此生物翻回正面时，在其上放置五个+1/+1指示物。

953299.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, exile it. Return it to the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking at the beginning of the declare attackers step on your next turn.
953299.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将它放逐。在你下一个回合的宣告攻击者步骤开始时，将它在你的操控下横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

953303.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control is turned face up, untap that creature.
953303.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物翻回正面时，重置该生物。

953306.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, add {oGoUoR}.
953306.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，加{oGoUoR}。

953333.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, target creature gains trample until end of turn.
953333.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，目标生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

953352.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
953352.translation: 当此结界进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

953363.oracleText: Whenever Anafenza attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on another target tapped creature you control.
953363.translation: 每当阿娜芬札攻击时，在另一个目标由你操控且已横置的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

953367.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, creatures you control gain first strike and deathtouch until end of turn.
953367.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，由你操控的生物获得先攻与死触异能直到回合结束。

953370.oracleText: When this creature enters, distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control.
953370.translation: 当此生物进场时，将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标由你操控的生物。

953373.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature defending player controls blocks it this combat if able.
953373.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控的生物本次战斗中若能阻挡它，则必须如此作。

953376.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 4/4 green Bear creature token.
953376.translation: 当此生物进场时，将一个4/4绿色的熊衍生生物放进战场。

953378.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: This creature gains your choice of vigilance, lifelink, or haste until end of turn.
953378.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：选择警戒，系命或敏捷。此生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

953399.oracleText: When this creature enters or is turned face up, another target creature you control gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
953399.translation: 当此生物进场或翻回正面时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+3/+0直到回合结束。

953408.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, you may return another target creature to its owner's hand.
953408.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，你可以将另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

953430.oracleText: Sacrifice this enchantment: Creatures you control get +0/+3 until end of turn.
953430.translation: 牺牲此结界：由你操控的生物得+0/+3直到回合结束。

953438.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature can't block this turn.
953438.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

953448.oracleText: Whenever Narset attacks, exile the top four cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may cast noncreature spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs.
953448.translation: 每当娜尔施攻击时，放逐你牌库顶的四张牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放本回合中以娜尔施放逐的非生物牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

953450.oracleText: When this creature enters or is turned face up, create three 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
953450.translation: 当此生物进场或者翻回正面时，派出三个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

953453.oracleText: {oBoG}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

953456.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile from your graveyard, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
953456.translation: 每当一张或数张牌从你的坟墓场置入放逐区时，在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

953467.oracleText: {o2oG}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
953467.translation: {o2oG}：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

953468.oracleText: {o2oU}: Return this creature to its owner's hand.
953468.translation: {o2oU}：将此生物移回其拥有者手上。

953473.oracleText: Whenever Sidisi enters or attacks, mill three cards.
953473.translation: 每当谢迪西进场或攻击时，磨三张牌。

953477.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
953477.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各失去3点生命，且你获得3点生命。

953493.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
953493.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

953512.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
953512.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标非生物且非地的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

953519.oracleText: Zurgo attacks each combat if able.
953519.translation: 珠高每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

953520.oracleText: During your turn, Zurgo has indestructible.
953520.translation: 于你的回合中，珠高具有不灭异能。

953521.oracleText: Whenever a creature dealt damage by Zurgo this turn dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Zurgo.
953521.translation: 每当一个本回合中曾受到珠高伤害的生物死去时，在珠高上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

953524.oracleText: {oWoBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

953530.oracleText: This artifact enters with X gem counters on it.
953530.translation: 此神器进场时上面有X个宝石指示物。

953531.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Remove a gem counter from this artifact: Target creature can't attack or block this turn.
953531.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从此神器上移去一个宝石指示物：目标生物本回合不能进行攻击或阻挡。

953533.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this artifact: Target player shuffles their graveyard into their library. Draw a card.
953533.translation: {o2}，放逐此神器：目标牌手将其坟墓场洗回牌库。抓一张牌。

953540.oracleText: This Equipment's equip ability costs {o2} less to activate if it targets a colorless creature.
953540.translation: 如果此武具之佩带异能的目标是无色生物，则该异能减少{o2}来起动。

953544.oracleText: {oUoRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

953550.oracleText: {oRoWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

953553.oracleText: {oBoGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

953556.oracleText: {oGoUoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

953567.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a Swamp or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
953567.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命，牺牲此地：从你的牌库中搜寻一张沼泽或山脉牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

953570.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a Plains or Island card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
953570.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻一张平原或海岛牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

953580.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for an Island or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
953580.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻一张海岛或沼泽牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

953588.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a Forest or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
953588.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻一张树林或平原牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

953591.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a Mountain or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
953591.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻一张山脉或树林牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

953664.oracleText: If a creature card with flying was exiled with this creature's delve ability, this creature has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, reach, trample, and vigilance.
953664.translation: 如果以此生物的掘穴异能放逐了具飞行异能的生物牌，此生物便具有飞行异能。且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

953667.oracleText: Whenever Alesha attacks, you may pay {o(W/B)o(W/B)}. If you do, return target creature card with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
953667.translation: 每当阿列莎攻击时，你可以支付{o(W/B)o(W/B)}。若你如此作，则将目标力量等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

953693.oracleText: As long as this creature is untapped, creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {o1} for each of those creatures.
953693.translation: 只要此生物未横置，对每个生物而言，除非其操控者为其支付{o1}，否则它不能攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客。

953694.oracleText: As long as this creature is attacking, creatures can't block unless their controller pays {o1} for each of those creatures.
953694.translation: 只要此生物正进行攻击，对每个生物而言，除非其操控者为其支付{o1}，否则它不能进行阻挡。

953699.oracleText: At end of combat, if Kytheon and at least two other creatures attacked this combat, exile Kytheon, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
953699.translation: 在战斗结束时，若库忒昂和至少两个其他生物在本次战斗中攻击过，则放逐库忒昂，然后将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

953702.oracleText: Up to one target creature an opponent controls attacks Gideon during its controller's next turn if able.
953702.translation: 至多一个目标由对手操控的生物于其操控者的下一个回合中若能攻击基定，则须如此作。

953709.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card. If there are five or more cards in your graveyard, exile Jace, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
953709.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。如果你的坟墓场中有五张或更多牌，则放逐杰斯，然后将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

953724.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
953724.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

953752.oracleText: When Nissa enters, you may search your library for a basic Forest card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
953752.translation: 当广林预言师妮莎进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

953763.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent loses life equal to the number of Elves you control.
953763.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手失去等同于由你操控之妖精数量的生命。

953767.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying for each +1/+1 counter on this creature.
953767.translation: 当此生物死去时，其上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

953778.oracleText: Whenever Ulamog attacks, defending player exiles the top twenty cards of their library.
953778.translation: 每当钨拉莫攻击时，防御牌手放逐其牌库顶的二十张牌。

953816.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only Zada, copy that spell for each other creature you control that the spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those creatures.
953816.translation: 每当你施放仅以查妲为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，该咒语每能以一个由你操控的其他生物为目标，便将该咒语复制一次。每个复制品都要以这些生物之一为目标，且不能重复选择。

953824.oracleText: Whenever Omnath or another Elemental you control dies, Omnath deals 3 damage to any target.
953824.translation: 每当欧那斯或另一个由你操控的元素死去时，欧那斯对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

953827.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands.
953827.translation: 除非你操控两个或更多基本地，否则此地须横置进场。

953833.oracleText: When this creature dies, reveal the top card of your library. You may put that card onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card with mana value 3 or less. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.
953833.translation: 当此生物死去时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌为永久物牌，且其法术力值等于或小于3，则你可以将它放进战场。若否，则将该牌置于你手上。

953840.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card.
953840.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌，并放逐该牌。

953857.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another Vampire or Zombie: Put two +1/+1 counters on Kalitas.
953857.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个吸血鬼或灵俑：在卡力塔上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

953860.oracleText: {o2oC}, Sacrifice a land: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
953860.translation: {o2oC}，牺牲一个地：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

953869.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand. That creature's owner can't cast spells with the same name as that creature until your next turn.
953869.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。直到你的下一个回合，该生物的拥有者不能施放与该生物同名的咒语。

953881.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, untap each creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
953881.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此战斗阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

953882.oracleText: This creature can't attack a player it has already attacked this turn.
953882.translation: 此生物不能攻击它本回合中攻击过的牌手。

953899.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card for each green creature you control.
953899.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个绿色生物，便抓一张牌。

953920.oracleText: Battalion — Whenever this creature and at least two other creatures attack, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
953920.translation: 协战～每当此生物与至少两个其他生物攻击时，此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

953937.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 3/3 white Bird creature token with flying.
953937.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个3/3白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

953941.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. 
• Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
953941.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

953944.oracleText: {o1oW}, Sacrifice this creature: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
953944.translation: {o1oW}，牺牲此生物：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

953955.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks, it gets +0/+2 until end of turn.
953955.translation: 每当此生物进行阻挡时，它得+0/+2直到回合结束。

953957.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Human you control.
953957.translation: 当此生物进场时，在每个由你操控的其他人类上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

953958.oracleText: Whenever another Human you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
953958.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的人类进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

953968.oracleText: When this creature enters, untap another target creature you control.
953968.translation: 当此生物进场时，重置另一个目标由你操控的生物。

953982.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent mills three cards.
953982.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各磨三张牌。

954006.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
954006.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1无色奥札奇／孽裔衍生生物。它具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

954017.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice a Goblin: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
954017.translation: {oB}，牺牲一个鬼怪：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

954020.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
954020.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

954022.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard two cards: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
954022.translation: {o1oB}，弃两张牌：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

954025.oracleText: Discard a card: Transform this creature. Activate only once each turn.
954025.translation: 弃一张牌：转化此生物。每回合只能起动一次。

954036.oracleText: This creature has haste as long as you control another Vampire.
954036.translation: 只要你操控另一个吸血鬼，此生物便具有敏捷异能。

954052.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, exile up to two target cards from that player's graveyard.
954052.translation: 每当此生物对牌手造成战斗伤害时，将至多两张目标牌从该牌手的坟墓场中放逐。

954071.oracleText: Whenever another red creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
954071.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的红色生物进场时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

954074.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may discard a card. If you do, this creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
954074.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则此生物得+3/+0直到回合结束。

954076.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
954076.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场施放目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该牌将置入你的坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。

954082.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, this creature deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.
954082.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则此生物对任意数量的目标造成共4点伤害，你可以任意分配。

954085.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Shaman creature you control.
954085.translation: 当此生物进场时，在由你操控的其他祭师生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954089.oracleText: Discard a card: This creature gets +2/-2 until end of turn.
954089.translation: 弃一张牌：此生物得+2/-2直到回合结束。

954104.oracleText: Whenever a Dragon you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, this creature deals 3 damage to that player.
954104.translation: 每当一个由你操控的龙成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，此生物对该牌手造成3点伤害。

954134.oracleText: When this creature dies, put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.
954134.translation: 当此生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为此生物上+1/+1指示物的数量。

954158.oracleText: When this artifact enters or is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
954158.translation: 当此神器进场或从战场进入坟墓场时，抓一张牌。

954161.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
954161.translation: {oR}，牺牲此神器：它对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

954165.oracleText: When this land enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token.
954165.translation: 当此地进场时，派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物。

954167.oracleText: Adeline's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
954167.translation: 艾德琳的力量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

954170.oracleText: Coven — {o1oWoW}: Transform this creature. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
954170.translation: 鸠集～{o1oWoW}：转化此生物。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

954183.oracleText: When another creature you control dies, transform this creature.
954183.translation: 当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，转化此生物。

954186.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
954186.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

954195.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or transforms into Brutal Cathar, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
954195.translation: 每当此生物进场或转化为护教蛮兵时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

954201.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, this creature gains flying until end of turn.
954201.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

954205.oracleText: Coven — {o2oW}, Sacrifice this Aura: Exile enchanted creature. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
954205.translation: 鸠集～{o2oW}，牺牲此灵气：放逐所结附的生物。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

954213.oracleText: If it's neither day nor night, it becomes day as this creature enters.
954213.translation: 如果当前既非白昼也非黑夜，则于此生物进场时成为白昼。

954223.oracleText: As this Aura enters, choose a card name.
954223.translation: 于此灵气进场时，选择一个牌名。

954225.oracleText: Whenever enchanted player casts a spell with the chosen name, you may sacrifice this Aura. If you do, draw a card.
954225.translation: 每当所结附的牌手施放具该名称的咒语时，你可以牺牲此灵气。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

954230.oracleText: If your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, instead transform this creature and your life total becomes 3. Then if this creature didn't transform this way, you lose the game.
954230.translation: 如果你的总生命将降至0或更少，则改为转化此生物且你的总生命成为3。然后如果此生物未以此法转化，则你输掉这盘游戏。

954234.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, double your life total.
954234.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将你的总生命加倍。

954245.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
954245.translation: 当此生物进场时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954256.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay {o1oW} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many valor counters on this creature.
954256.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以支付{o1oW}任意次数。当你支付此费用一次或数次时，根据该数量在此生物上放置等量的勇气指示物。

954257.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 for each valor counter on this creature.
954257.translation: 此生物上每有一个勇气指示物，由你操控的生物便得+1/+1。

954260.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return another creature you control to its owner's hand.
954260.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将另一个由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

954274.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
954274.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954277.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, this creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
954277.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则此生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

954286.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, note your life total.
954286.translation: 于此结界进场时，记下你的总生命。

954287.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card if your life total is greater than or equal to the last noted life total for this enchantment. Then note your life total.
954287.translation: 在你的维持开始时，如果你的总生命等于或大于最后为此结界记下的总生命，则抓一张牌。然后记下你的总生命。

954291.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it, return up to two target creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
954291.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它经你施放，则将至多两张目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

954299.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
954299.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

954300.oracleText: Coven — {o1oW}: Choose a color. This creature gains hexproof from that color until end of turn and can't be blocked by creatures of that color this turn. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
954300.translation: 鸠集～{o1oW}：选择一种颜色。此生物获得反该色辟邪异能直到回合结束，且本回合不能被该色生物阻挡。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

954324.oracleText: When this creature dies, mill three cards.
954324.translation: 当此生物死去时，磨三张牌。

954327.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may shuffle up to three target cards from your graveyard into your library.
954327.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将至多三张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

954334.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card. If an instant or sorcery card is revealed this way, transform this creature.
954334.translation: 在你的维持开始时，检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以展示该牌。如果以此法展示出一张瞬间或法术牌，则转化此生物。

954343.oracleText: When this creature enters, target player mills three cards.
954343.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标牌手磨三张牌。

954349.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
954349.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

954376.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if there are five or more cards in your graveyard, tap enchanted creature.
954376.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若你坟墓场中有五张或更多牌，则横置所结附的生物。

954378.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o3}.
954378.translation: {oU}，牺牲此生物：除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

954389.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Draw a card. Transform this artifact.

954392.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Tap target nonland permanent. Transform this artifact.
954392.translation: {o1}，{oT}：横置目标非地永久物。转化此神器。

954394.oracleText: When this creature enters, up to one target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
954394.translation: 当此生物进场时，至多一个目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

954397.oracleText: This token can block only creatures with flying.
954397.translation: 此衍生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。

954398.oracleText: When this enchantment enters and whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard, create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying and "This token can block only creatures with flying."
954398.translation: 当此结界进场时和每当你从你坟墓场中施放咒语时，派出一个1/1蓝色的鸟衍生生物，且具有飞行与「此衍生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

954401.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
954401.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

954416.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a card with flashback or disturb, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle.
954416.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张具返照或惊扰异能的牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

954419.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control three or more creature tokens, you may transform this creature.
954419.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控三个或更多衍生生物，则你可以转化此生物。

954423.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may transform this artifact.
954423.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以转化此神器。

954433.oracleText: Whenever you discard a Spirit card or a card with disturb, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
954433.translation: 每当你弃一张精怪牌或一张具惊扰异能的牌时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954439.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, put a slime counter on up to one other target creature.
954439.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，在至多另一个目标生物上放置一个黏菌指示物。

954442.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay {o1oU} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then up to that many other target artifacts, creatures, and/or enchantments phase out.
954442.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以支付{o1oU}任意次数。当你支付此费用一次或数次时，根据该数量在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后至多等量的其他目标神器，生物和／或结界跃离。

954448.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
954448.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

954460.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
954460.translation: 当此生物进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

954464.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocking this creature dies, that creature's controller loses 1 life.
954464.translation: 每当一个阻挡此生物的生物死去时，该生物的操控者失去1点生命。

954467.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
954467.translation: 当此生物进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

954481.oracleText: Whenever another Zombie you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
954481.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的灵俑进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954483.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target creature you don't control that was dealt damage this turn.
954483.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标不由你操控的生物，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。

954502.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens with decayed. When you do, exile up to two target cards from graveyards.
954502.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。当你如此作时，将至多两张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

954512.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw a card, then transform this creature. Activate only once each turn.
954512.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物：抓一张牌，然后转化此生物。每回合只能起动一次。

954523.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put all creature cards exiled with Gisa onto the battlefield under your control. They gain decayed.
954523.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将所有以基沙放逐的生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。它们获得败朽异能。

954525.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
954525.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果以此法放逐一张生物牌，则每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

954527.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. For each creature card exiled this way, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
954527.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，将至多两张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。每以此法放逐一张生物牌，每位对手便失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

954530.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Pay 1 life, Discard a card: Draw a card, mill a card, then put a ritual counter on this artifact. Then if it has three or more ritual counters on it, remove them and transform it. Activate only as a sorcery.
954530.translation: {o1}，{oT}，支付1点生命，弃一张牌：抓一张牌，磨一张牌，然后在此神器上放置一个仪式指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多仪式指示物，则移去这类指示物并转化它。只能于法术时机起动。

954533.oracleText: {o2oB}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
954533.translation: {o2oB}：将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954536.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
954536.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

954544.oracleText: Whenever Jerren enters or another nontoken Human you control dies, you lose 1 life and create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
954544.translation: 每当耶仑进场或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的人类死去时，你失去1点生命并派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

954576.oracleText: When this creature dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
954576.translation: 当此生物死去时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

954593.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent creates a 1/1 white Human creature token.
954593.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

954598.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay {o2oB} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then create twice that many 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens with decayed.
954598.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以支付{o2oB}任意次数。当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后派出两倍的2/2黑色，具败朽异能的灵俑衍生生物。

954603.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
954603.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化，并贴附在目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客上。

954615.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay {o2oR} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then exile up to that many target instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard and copy them. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
954615.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以支付{o2oR}任意次数。当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后将至多等量之目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐并复制。你可以施放任意数量的复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

954617.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
954617.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

954621.oracleText: Create three 1/1 red Devil creature tokens with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target." They gain haste until end of turn.
954621.translation: 派出三个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

954622.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 5 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. 
• Create three 1/1 red Devil creature tokens with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target." They gain haste until end of turn.
954622.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成5点伤害。 
•派出三个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

954623.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Burn Down the House deals 5 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. 
• Create three 1/1 red Devil creature tokens with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target." They gain haste until end of turn.
954623.translation:
选择一项～ 
•焚毁房屋对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成5点伤害。 
•派出三个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

954636.oracleText: Whenever enchanted player casts a spell other than the first spell they cast each turn or copies a spell, this Aura deals 2 damage to them.
954636.translation: 每当所结附的牌手复制咒语或于其每回合施放的第一个咒语以外再施放咒语时，此灵气对其造成2点伤害。

954640.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to defending player.
954640.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它对防御牌手造成1点伤害。

954646.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, add {oRoRoR}.
954646.translation: 当此生物进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则加{oRoRoR}。

954649.oracleText: {o1oR}: This creature gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
954649.translation: {o1oR}：直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。

954656.oracleText: When a spell you control deals damage, transform this creature.
954656.translation: 每当一个由你操控的咒语造成伤害时，转化此生物。

954659.oracleText: Whenever a spell you control deals damage, put a flame counter on this creature.
954659.translation: 每当一个由你操控的咒语造成伤害时，在此生物上放置一个烈焰指示物。

954660.oracleText: {o1}, Remove a flame counter from this creature: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
954660.translation: {o1}，从此生物上移去一个烈焰指示物：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

954662.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a charge counter on this artifact.
954662.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在此神器上放置一个充电指示物。

954663.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Remove any number of charge counters from this artifact: It deals that much damage to any target.
954663.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，从此神器上移去任意数量的充电指示物：它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

954687.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of colors among permanents you control.
954687.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之永久物中的颜色数量。

954690.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if an opponent lost life this turn.
954690.translation: 如果有对手本回合中失去过生命，则此生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

954707.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to target creature defending player controls. If that creature is a Zombie, this creature deals 2 damage to it instead.
954707.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它对目标由防御牌手操控的生物造成1点伤害。如果该生物是灵俑，则改为此生物对它造成2点伤害。

954717.oracleText: This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard plus the number of cards with flashback you own in exile.
954717.translation: 此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌数量和放逐区中由你拥有且具返照异能的牌数量之总和。

954718.oracleText: Create a red Elemental creature token with trample and "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard plus the number of cards with flashback you own in exile."
954718.translation: 派出一个红色元素衍生生物，且具有践踏与「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌数量和放逐区中由你拥有且具返照异能的牌数量之总和。」

954721.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a number of ember counters on this creature equal to the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. Then if this creature has seven or more ember counters on it, remove them and transform this creature.
954721.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在此生物上放置若干余烬指示物，其数量等同于施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量。然后如果此生物上有七个或更多余烬指示物，则移去这类指示物并转化此生物。

954724.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
954724.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

954727.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
954727.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

954732.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, you may pay {o1oR}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
954732.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，你可以支付{o1oR}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

954745.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, it deals X damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of Vampires you control.
954745.translation: 当此生物进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则它对至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的吸血鬼数量。

954759.oracleText: As long as you control a token, this creature gets +2/+0.
954759.translation: 只要你操控衍生物，此生物便得+2/+0。

954762.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/2 green Spider creature token with reach.
954762.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/2绿色，具延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

954767.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, this creature gains trample until end of turn.
954767.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则此生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。
