954774.oracleText: This token's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
954774.translation: 此衍生物的力量等同于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

954775.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a green Ooze creature token with "This token's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1."
954775.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个绿色流浆衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物的力量等同于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。」

954784.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, mill a card. Then if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, transform this creature.
954784.translation: 在你的维持开始时，磨一张牌。然后若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则转化此生物。

954788.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile a card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
954788.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。若以此法放逐一张生物牌，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954802.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, this creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
954802.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则此生物本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

954808.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if enchanted creature is a Wolf or Werewolf, untap that creature.
954808.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若所结附的生物是狼或狼人，则重置该生物。

954816.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, destroy target artifact or enchantment defending player controls.
954816.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，消灭目标由防御牌手操控的神器或结界。

954821.oracleText: {o2oG}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
954821.translation: {o2oG}：此生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

954824.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay {o1oG} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then up to that many target lands you control become 3/3 Wolf creatures with haste that are still lands.
954824.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以支付{o1oG}任意次数。当你支付一次或数次此费用时，根据该数量在此生物上放置等量的+1/+1指示物，然后至多等量目标由你操控的地成为3/3，具敏捷异能的狼生物，并且仍然是地。

954852.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create two 2/2 green Wolf creature tokens.
954852.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，派出两个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

954862.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
954862.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

954866.oracleText: This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
954866.translation: 此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

954867.oracleText: Create a green Treefolk creature token with reach and "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control."
954867.translation: 派出一个绿色树妖衍生生物，且具有延势与「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。」

954881.oracleText: Until end of turn, Arlinn becomes a 5/5 Werewolf creature with trample, indestructible, and haste.
954881.translation: 直到回合结束，皎月之怒雅琳成为5/5，具践踏、不灭与敏捷异能的狼人生物。

954905.oracleText: If Dennick would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
954905.translation: 如果虔敬新魂丹尼克将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

954924.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
954924.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

954952.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, add {oR} or {oG}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
954952.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，加{oR}或{oG}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

954957.oracleText: Whenever Ludevic enters or attacks, mill a card.
954957.translation: 每当卢德维进场或攻击时，磨一张牌。

954979.oracleText: {oGoU}, {oT}, Exile this creature: Return target card with flashback you own from exile to your hand.
954979.translation: {oGoU}，{oT}，放逐此生物：将目标由你拥有且具返照异能的牌从放逐区移回你手上。

954991.oracleText: Whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, put a +1/+1 counter on Slogurk.
954991.translation: 每当一张地牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，在斯罗咕上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

955014.oracleText: If it's neither day nor night, it becomes day as Vadrik enters.
955014.translation: 如果当前既非白昼也非黑夜，则于瓦垂格进场时成为白昼。

955018.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Vampire you control.
955018.translation: 当此生物进场时，若有对手本回合中失去过生命，则在每个由你操控的其他吸血鬼上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

955035.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile up to one target card from a graveyard. Draw a card.
955035.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。抓一张牌。

955036.oracleText: {o1}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Add one mana of any color.
955036.translation: {o1}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

955039.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for an artifact card with a mana ability or a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
955039.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你牌库中搜寻一张具法术力异能的神器牌或一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

955047.oracleText: As this artifact enters, choose a card name.
955047.translation: 于此神器进场时，选择一个牌名。

955050.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 3 damage to target creature. If a Werewolf is dealt damage this way, destroy it.
955050.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果某狼人以此法受到伤害，则消灭该狼人。

955053.oracleText: {o2}: This artifact becomes a 4/4 green Bear artifact creature until end of turn.
955053.translation: {o2}：此神器成为4/4绿色的熊神器生物直到回合结束。

955056.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands.
955056.translation: 除非你操控两个或更多其他地，否则此地须横置进场。

955061.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Put a soul counter on this land. Then if there are three or more soul counters on it, remove those counters, transform it, then untap it. Activate only as a sorcery.
955061.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：在此地上放置一个灵魂指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多灵魂指示物，则移去这些指示物，转化它，然后将它重置。只能于法术时机起动。

955064.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of creature cards exiled with this creature.
955064.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。若你如此作，则每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为以此生物放逐的生物牌数量。

955371.oracleText: {o3oW}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying. Activate only if you control an enchantment and only as a sorcery.
955371.translation: {o3oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。只能于你操控结界时起动，且仅限法术时机。

955377.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control enters, this creature can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
955377.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，此生物于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

955379.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Zombie you control dies, look at the top card of your library. If it's a Zombie card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.
955379.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的灵俑死去时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是灵俑牌，则你可以展示该牌并将它置于你手上。若你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

955382.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another nontoken Zombie you control dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
955382.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的灵俑死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

955385.oracleText: When this creature enters, gain control of target creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of Vampires you control until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
955385.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择目标生物，且其法术力值须等于或小于由你操控的吸血鬼数量。获得该生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

955388.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
955388.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

955392.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If it's a Wolf or Werewolf, untap this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
955392.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}：你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。如果它是狼或狼人，则重置此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

955395.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards, then put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each creature card in your graveyard.
955395.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨三张牌，然后你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，便在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

955403.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Wolf or Werewolf you control dies, draw a card.
955403.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的狼或狼人死去时，抓一张牌。

955408.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two other target creatures.
955408.translation: 当此生物进场时，在至多两个其他目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

955418.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile a card from a graveyard.
955418.translation: 当此生物进场时，从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。

955421.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
955421.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

955422.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a Vampire spell with the same name as a card exiled with this enchantment, you gain 2 life.
955422.translation: 每当对手施放与以此结界放逐之牌同名的吸血鬼咒语时，你获得2点生命。

955442.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {o1}. If you do, it gains indestructible until end of turn.
955442.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

955444.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this creature has two or fewer judgment counters on it, put a judgment counter on it.
955444.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若此生物上有两个或更少裁决指示物，则在其上放置一个裁决指示物。

955445.oracleText: As long as this creature has three or more judgment counters on it, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
955445.translation: 只要此生物上有三个或更多裁决指示物，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

955448.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a judgment counter on this Aura. Then if there are three or more judgment counters on it, enchanted player loses the game.
955448.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在此灵气上放置一个裁决指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多裁决指示物，则所结附的牌手输掉这盘游戏。

955456.oracleText: {oW}, Exile three cards from your graveyard: This creature gains first strike until end of turn.
955456.translation: {oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：此生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

955457.oracleText: Discard a card: Exile this creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
955457.translation: 弃一张牌：放逐此生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

955461.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, target attacking creature without flying gains flying until end of turn.
955461.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则目标进行攻击且不具飞行异能的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

955464.oracleText: This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Spirits you control.
955464.translation: 此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的精怪数量。

955465.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, create a white Spirit Cleric creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Spirits you control."
955465.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，派出一个白色精怪／僧侣衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的精怪数量。」

955467.oracleText: {o1oW}: This creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
955467.translation: {o1oW}：此生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

955472.oracleText: Katilda's power and toughness are each equal to the number of permanents you control that are Spirits and/or enchantments.
955472.translation: 凯蒂妲的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控且为精怪和／或结界之永久物的数量。

955490.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, untap target creature.
955490.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，重置目标生物。

955496.oracleText: When this Aura enters, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
955496.translation: 当此灵气进场时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

955499.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
955499.translation: 牺牲此生物：目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得系命与不灭异能直到回合结束。

955502.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life.
955502.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

955503.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, transform this creature.
955503.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则转化此生物。

955506.oracleText: {o1oB}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
955506.translation: {o1oB}：此生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

955515.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return this card to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target opponent.
955515.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将此牌在你的操控下移回战场且已转化，并贴附在目标对手上。

955521.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another Human, draw a card.
955521.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个人类，则抓一张牌。

955525.oracleText: Whenever this creature trains, exile up to one other target creature from the battlefield or creature card from a graveyard.
955525.translation: 每当此生物见习时，选择至多另一个目标战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌。将从该处它放逐。

955526.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, put the exiled cards onto the battlefield under their owners' control.
955526.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，将所放逐之牌在其拥有者的操控下放进战场。

955551.oracleText: {o4oW}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
955551.translation: {o4oW}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

955554.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage to a Vampire, destroy that creature.
955554.translation: 每当此生物对一个吸血鬼造成伤害时，消灭后者。

955556.oracleText: As long as this creature has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and vigilance.
955556.translation: 只要此生物上有四个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有飞行与警戒异能。

955557.oracleText: As long as this creature has ten or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has indestructible.
955557.translation: 只要此生物上有十个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有不灭异能。

955559.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an invitation counter on this enchantment. If you attacked with two or more creatures this turn, draw a card. Otherwise, create a 1/1 white Human creature token. Then if this enchantment has three or more invitation counters on it, transform it.
955559.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在此结界上放置一个请柬指示物。若你本回合中曾以两个或更多生物攻击，则抓一张牌。若否，则派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。然后若此结界上有三个或更多请柬指示物，则转化它。

955577.oracleText: When you sacrifice this creature, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
955577.translation: 当你牺牲此生物，在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

955580.oracleText: Sacrifice two Islands: This creature can't be blocked this turn.
955580.translation: 牺牲两个海岛：此生物本回合不能被阻挡。

955582.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile a card from a graveyard.
955582.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。

955583.oracleText: Once each turn, you may cast a spell from the top of your library if it shares a card type with a card exiled with this creature.
955583.translation: 限每回合一次，你可以从你的牌库顶施放咒语，但其须与以此生物放逐的任一牌具共通之牌张类别。

955590.oracleText: {o3oU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card.
955590.translation: {o3oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：抓一张牌。

955600.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
955600.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，选择目标生物。该生物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

955603.oracleText: {o3oUoU}: This creature can't be blocked this turn. Activate only if you own a card in exile.
955603.translation: {o3oUoU}：此生物本回合不能被阻挡。只能于放逐区中有由你拥有的牌时起动。

955610.oracleText: When this Aura enters, mill two cards.
955610.translation: 当此灵气进场时，磨两张牌。

955636.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand face down. You may look at that card for as long as it remains exiled. You may pay {o4oUoU}. If you do, transform Jacob Hauken.
955636.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后从你手上牌面朝下地放逐一张牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视它。你可以支付{o4oUoU}。如果你如此作，则转化雅各布豪肯。

955652.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
955652.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场，但它额外具有精怪此类别。

955665.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.
955665.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。

955667.oracleText: {o2oU}: Exile target creature card from your graveyard and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
955667.translation: {o2oU}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐，并在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

955668.oracleText: This creature has all activated abilities of all creature cards exiled with it.
955668.translation: 此生物具有所有以它放逐之生物牌的所有起动式异能。

955671.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
955671.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

955677.oracleText: {o2oU}: Put this card from your graveyard into your library second from the top.
955677.translation: {o2oU}：将此牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶数来第二张的位置。

955687.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile two creature cards from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card.
955687.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐两张生物牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

955689.oracleText: This artifact enters with three omen counters on it.
955689.translation: 此神器进场时上面有三个预兆指示物。

955691.oracleText: Whenever a creature card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, remove an omen counter from this artifact. Then if it has no omen counters on it, transform it.
955691.translation: 每当一张生物牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，从此神器上移去一个预兆指示物。然后若其上没有预兆指示物，则转化它。

955696.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, scry 1, then draw a card.
955696.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

955699.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell you control, draw a card.
955699.translation: 每当此生物成为由你操控之咒语的目标时，抓一张牌。

955728.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may search your library for a card named Wretched Throng, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
955728.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张名称为污劣大群的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

955738.oracleText: When this artifact enters, create a Blood token.
955738.translation: 当此神器进场时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

955739.oracleText: {o3oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
955739.translation: {o3oB}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

955741.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a Blood token.
955741.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

955742.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice a Blood token. If you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
955742.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个血滴衍生物。若你如此作，则它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

955744.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard a card: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it. Then if there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, transform this creature.
955744.translation: {o1oB}，弃一张牌：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。然后如果你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，则转化此生物。

955747.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard a card: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
955747.translation: {o1oB}，弃一张牌：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

955750.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Blood token defending player controls.
955750.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手每操控一个血滴衍生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

955753.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures that each have toughness greater than their power, transform this creature.
955753.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多防御力比力量大的生物，则转化此生物。

955762.oracleText:
When this creature enters or dies, exile another card from a graveyard. When you do, choose one — 
• Remove X counters from target permanent, where X is the mana value of the exiled card. 
• Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
955762.translation:
当此生物进场或死去时，从任一坟墓场放逐另一张牌。当你如此作时，选择一项～ 
•从目标永久物上移去X个指示物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。 
•目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

955765.oracleText: {o2oB}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
955765.translation: {o2oB}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

955772.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you gained life this turn, return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
955772.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

955782.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
955782.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。若以此法放逐一张生物牌，则每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

955790.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice a non-Demon creature. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this creature.
955790.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲一个非恶魔生物。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为此生物的复制品。

955796.oracleText: When you discard this card, you may pay {oB}. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
955796.translation: 当你弃掉此牌时，你可以支付{oB}。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

955798.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a Blood token.
955798.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

955799.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice two Blood tokens: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
955799.translation: {oB}，牺牲两个血滴衍生物：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

955803.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
955803.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

955810.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, destroy target planeswalker.
955810.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，消灭目标鹏洛客。

955819.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one that hasn't been chosen — 
• Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. 
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life. 
• Transform Henrika.
955819.translation:
在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ 
•每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。 
•你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 
•转化亨莉卡。

955829.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, any opponent may sacrifice a creature of their choice. If no one does, transform this creature.
955829.translation: 在你的维持开始时，任意对手可以牺牲一个依其选择的生物。若无人如此作，则转化此生物。

955834.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 as long as an opponent controls a Human.
955834.translation: 只要任一对手操控人类，此生物便得+2/+0。

955839.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, each opponent exiles a card from their hand.
955839.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，每位对手各从其手上放逐一张牌。

955854.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
955854.translation: {o2oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

955860.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you discarded a card this turn, transform this creature.
955860.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中弃过牌，则转化此生物。

955863.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
955863.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

955866.oracleText: Sacrifice two Blood tokens: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
955866.translation: 牺牲两个血滴衍生物：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

955872.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
955872.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

955875.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn if that opponent controls no other creatures.
955875.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择目标由对手操控的生物。如果该对手未操控其他生物，则该生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

955879.oracleText: Sorin deals 13 damage to any target. You gain 13 life.
955879.translation: 索霖对任意一个目标造成13点伤害。你获得13点生命。

955887.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may exile it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
955887.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以将它放逐。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

955896.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another nontoken creature you control dies, create a Blood token.
955896.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

955897.oracleText: Whenever you create a Blood token, if you control five or more Blood tokens, transform this creature.
955897.translation: 每当你派出一个血滴衍生物时，若你操控五个或更多血滴衍生物，则转化此生物。

955906.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice a Blood token. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card.
955906.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个血滴衍生物。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并抓一张牌。

955915.oracleText: When you attack with exactly two creatures, transform this creature.
955915.translation: 当你以正好两个生物攻击时，转化此生物。

955919.oracleText: {oRoR}: This creature and another target creature each get +1/+0 until end of turn.
955919.translation: {oRoR}：此生物与另一个目标生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。

955925.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
955925.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

955927.oracleText: {o2oR}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target. A creature dealt damage this way can't block this turn.
955927.translation: {o2oR}：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。以此法受到伤害的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

955933.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a Blood token.
955933.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

955937.oracleText: Whenever a player plays a land or casts a spell, if it shares a card type with the exiled card, this creature deals 2 damage to that player.
955937.translation: 每当任一牌手使用地或施放咒语时，若它与所放逐的牌具共通之牌张类别，则此生物对该牌手造成2点伤害。

955939.oracleText: Add {oR}. Chandra deals 1 damage to up to one target player or planeswalker.
955939.translation: 加{oR}。茜卓对至多一位目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

955947.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with exactly one other creature this combat, you may have that creature's base power and toughness become 4/3 until end of turn.
955947.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你本次战斗中还以正好一个其他生物攻击，则你可以使后者生物之基础力量与防御力成为4/3直到回合结束。

955958.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two Blood tokens.
955958.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个血滴衍生物。

955969.oracleText: Tap two untapped creatures you control: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
955969.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的生物：此载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

955972.oracleText: As long as you control another Wolf or Werewolf, this creature gets +1/+0 and has trample.
955972.translation: 只要你操控另一个狼或狼人，此生物便得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

955975.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control is dealt damage, this creature deals that much damage to any target.
955975.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物受到伤害时，此生物对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

955989.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
955989.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

955992.oracleText: {o1oR}: This creature gains first strike until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
955992.translation: {o1oR}：此生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

955994.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to this creature while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove that many +1/+1 counters from it. When one or more counters are removed from this creature this way, it deals that much damage to any target.
955994.translation: 如果此生物于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从其上移去等量的+1/+1指示物。当以此法从此生物上移去一个或数个指示物时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

956001.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage, create that many Blood tokens.
956001.translation: 每当此生物造成伤害时，派出等量的血滴衍生物。

956002.oracleText: {o2oR}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
956002.translation: {o2oR}：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

956013.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}: This creature deals damage equal to the number of Wolves and Werewolves you control to target opponent.
956013.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}：此生物向目标对手造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的狼和狼人数量。

956015.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Blood token, you may have this artifact become a 3/3 Vampire artifact creature with haste until end of turn.
956015.translation: 每当你牺牲血滴衍生物时，你可以使此神器成为3/3，具敏捷异能的吸血鬼神器生物直到回合结束。

956018.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 red Human creature token. Then if you control exactly thirteen permanents, you may sacrifice this enchantment. When you do, it deals 7 damage to any target.
956018.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个1/1红色人类衍生生物。然后若你操控正好十三个永久物，则你可以牺牲此结界。当你如此作时，它对任意一个目标造成7点伤害。

956027.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to each of up to one target creature, up to one target player, and/or up to one target planeswalker.
956027.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它对至多一个目标生物，至多一位目标牌手和／或至多一个目标鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

956029.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 2 damage to each of up to one target creature, up to one target player, and/or up to one target planeswalker.
956029.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它对至多一个目标生物，至多一位目标牌手和／或至多一个目标鹏洛客各造成2点伤害。

956032.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent. Create a Blood token.
956032.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。派出一个血滴衍生物。

956035.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 2 damage to you. Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
956035.translation: {oT}：此生物对你造成2点伤害。放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。只能于法术时机起动。

956036.oracleText: When you play a card exiled with this creature, transform this creature.
956036.translation: 当你使用以此生物放逐的牌时，转化此生物。

956046.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if you control a permanent with mana value 4 or greater.
956046.translation: 如果你操控法术力值等于或大于4的永久物，则此生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

956047.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
956047.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于4的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

956054.oracleText: {o2oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: You gain 5 life.
956054.translation: {o2oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：你获得5点生命。

956059.oracleText: Spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each card type they share with cards exiled with this creature.
956059.translation: 对你施放的咒语而言，它与以此生物放逐的各牌每有一种共通之牌张类别，便减少{o1}来施放。

956068.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. If you do, draw a card and repeat this process.
956068.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。若你如此作，则抓一张牌并重复此流程。

956071.oracleText: Whenever another Human you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
956071.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的人类进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

956079.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then if that creature has toughness 6 or greater, transform this enchantment.
956079.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后若该生物的防御力等于或大于6，则转化此结界。

956084.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain life equal to the greatest toughness among other creatures you control.
956084.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控之其他生物中的最大防御力。

956094.oracleText: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each other nontoken Human you control.
956094.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于由你操控且非衍生物之其他人类数量的两倍。

956096.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may search your library for a basic land card that doesn't share a land type with a land you control, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
956096.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，且其不得与由你操控的地有共通之地类别，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。

956107.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
956107.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

956110.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create two 1/1 green Insect creature tokens.
956110.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，派出两个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

956131.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another Wolf or Werewolf, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
956131.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控另一个狼或狼人，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

956134.oracleText: This creature gets +3/+2 as long as there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard.
956134.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，此生物便得+3/+2。

956143.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 3/1 green Boar creature token.
956143.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个3/1绿色野猪衍生生物。

956148.oracleText: This creature fights target Zombie an opponent controls.
956148.translation: 此生物与目标由对手操控的灵俑互斗。

956149.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose up to one — 
• Destroy target artifact an opponent controls. 
• This creature fights target Zombie an opponent controls.
956149.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择至多一项～ 
•消灭目标由对手操控的神器。 
•此生物与目标由对手操控的灵俑互斗。

956162.oracleText: When this creature enters, another target creature you control gains deathtouch until end of turn.
956162.translation: 当此生物进场时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

956183.oracleText: Whenever Anje and/or one or more other Vampires you control enter, create a Blood token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
956183.translation: 每当安姬和／或一个或数个由你操控的其他吸血鬼进场时，派出一个血滴衍生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

956186.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is twice the number of Blood tokens you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
956186.translation: {oT}，牺牲此生物：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之血滴衍生物数量的两倍。只能于法术时机起动。

956188.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or becomes the target of an Aura spell, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
956188.translation: 每当此生物进场或成为灵气咒语的目标时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

956191.oracleText: Whenever this Aura enters or enchanted creature becomes the target of an Aura spell, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
956191.translation: 每当此灵气进场或所结附的生物成为灵气咒语之目标时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

956200.oracleText: When Dorothea attacks or blocks, sacrifice it at end of combat.
956200.translation: 当多萝霞攻击或阻挡，在战斗结束时将它牺牲。

956207.oracleText: When Edgar dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.
956207.translation: 当艾德嘉死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

956237.oracleText: When Odric enters, create X Blood tokens, where X is the number of abilities from among flying, first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance found among creatures you control. (Count each ability only once.)
956237.translation: 当欧吉克进场时，派出X个血滴衍生物，X为见于由你操控的生物上之飞行、先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒各异能的数量。（每种异能仅计算一次。）

956244.oracleText: Whenever Olivia attacks, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking. It gains "When you don't control a legendary Vampire, exile this creature."
956244.translation: 每当奥莉薇亚攻击时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。它获得「当你未操控传奇吸血鬼时，放逐此生物。」

956247.oracleText: When Runo enters, put up to one target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
956247.translation: 当卢诺进场时，将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

956248.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card. If a creature card with mana value 6 or greater is revealed this way, transform Runo.
956248.translation: 在你的维持开始时，检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以展示该牌。若以此法展示出一张法术力值等于或大于6的生物牌，则转化卢诺。

956250.oracleText: Whenever Krothuss attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of another target attacking creature. If that creature is a Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, or Serpent, create two of those tokens instead.
956250.translation: 每当寇瑟斯攻击时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标进行攻击之生物的复制品，并为横置且正进行攻击。若该生物是巨海兽、海怪、章鱼或巨蛇，则改为派出两个上述衍生物。

956252.oracleText: As long as you've put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature this turn, this creature has trample and lifelink.
956252.translation: 只要你本回合中在生物上放置过一个或数个+1/+1指示物，此生物便具有践踏与系命异能。

956261.oracleText: {o2oGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Create a 1/1 green Insect creature token for each creature card in your graveyard. Activate only as a sorcery.
956261.translation: {o2oGoU}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，便派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

956263.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a noncreature, nonland card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
956263.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张非生物且非地的牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

956269.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you were dealt 4 or more damage this turn, exile this artifact.
956269.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中受过4点或更多伤害，则放逐此神器。

956271.oracleText: This token gets +1/+1 for each Construct you control.
956271.translation: 你每操控一个组构体，此衍生物便得+1/+1。

956272.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 0/0 Construct artifact in addition to its other types and it has "This token gets +1/+1 for each Construct you control." It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
956272.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为所放逐之牌的复制品，但它是0/0组构体神器，仍具有原本类别，且具有「你每操控一个组构体，此衍生物便得+1/+1。」它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

956275.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Put an omen counter on this creature.
956275.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在此生物上放置一个预兆指示物。

956276.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are three or more omen counters on this creature, untap it, then transform it.
956276.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若此生物上有三个或更多预兆指示物，则将它重置，然后转化它。

956284.oracleText: This artifact enters with a number of suspect counters on it equal to the greatest number of creatures a player controls.
956284.translation: 此神器进场时上面有数个怀疑指示物，其数量等同于各牌手所操控之生物数量中的最大值。

956285.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove a suspect counter from this artifact: Draw a card.
956285.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从此神器上移去一个怀疑指示物：抓一张牌。

956288.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exile this artifact: Exile all cards from all graveyards, then draw a card.
956288.translation: {o1}，{oT}，放逐此神器：放逐所有坟墓场，然后抓一张牌。

956291.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature can't be blocked this turn. If it's a Vampire, it also gains lifelink until end of turn.
956291.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。如果它是吸血鬼，则它再获得系命异能直到回合结束。

956380.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
956380.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

956404.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may pay {o1}. When you do, attach this Equipment to it.
956404.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，将此武具贴附于其上。

956411.oracleText:
When Ao dies, choose one — 
• Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of nonland permanent cards with total mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on each permanent you control that's a creature or Vehicle.
956411.translation:
当猗旺死去时，选择一项～ 
•检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中任意数量的非地永久物牌放进战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于4。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。 
•在每个由你操控的生物或载具永久物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

956427.oracleText: This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.
956427.translation: 此衍生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。

956428.oracleText: Channel — {o2oW}, Discard this card: Create two 1/1 colorless Pilot creature tokens with "This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
956428.translation: 魂力～{o2oW}，弃掉此牌：派出两个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

956471.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, return target creature or Vehicle card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
956471.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物或载具牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

956485.oracleText:
Whenever a Vehicle you control attacks, choose one — 
• That Vehicle gains first strike until end of turn. 
• Untap this creature.
956485.translation:
每当一个由你操控的载具攻击时，选择一项～ 
•该载具获得先攻异能直到回合结束。 
•重置此生物。

956487.oracleText: When Kyodai enters, another target permanent gains indestructible for as long as you control Kyodai.
956487.translation: 当香醍进场时，于你操控香醍的时段内，另一个目标永久物获得不灭异能。

956495.oracleText: Whenever an Aura you control enters, if you cast it, you may search your library for an Aura card with mana value less than or equal to that Aura and with a different name than each Aura you control, put that card onto the battlefield attached to Light-Paws, then shuffle.
956495.translation: 每当一个由你操控的灵气进场时，若它经你施放，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于该灵气的灵气牌，且其不得与任一由你操控的灵气同名，将该牌放进战场且贴附于轻脚上，然后洗牌。

956498.oracleText: {oW}: Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a permanent card, put a +1/+1 counter on this permanent.
956498.translation: {oW}：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果它是永久物牌，则在此永久物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

956499.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on this Equipment.
956499.translation: 此武具上每有一个+1/+1指示物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

956512.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
956512.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，此生物便得+1/+1。

956530.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
956530.translation: 每当此生物攻击或阻挡时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

956536.oracleText: When this creature enters or dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle you control.
956536.translation: 当此生物进场或死去时，在目标由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

956542.oracleText: Channel — {o2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 2 life.
956542.translation: 魂力～{o2}，弃掉此牌：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得2点生命。

956544.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target artifact or creature until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
956544.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐至多一个目标神器或生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

956545.oracleText: Channel — {o1oW}, Discard this card: Exile target artifact or creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
956545.translation: 魂力～{o1oW}，弃掉此牌：放逐目标神器或生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

956561.oracleText: Whenever this creature or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
956561.translation: 每当此生物或佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

956570.oracleText: When this Aura enters, put X +1/+1 counters on enchanted permanent.
956570.translation: 当此灵气进场时，在所结附的永久物上放置X个+1/+1指示物。

956577.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each card in your hand.
956577.translation: 你每有一张手牌，此生物便得+1/+1。

956579.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may put an artifact card with mana value less than or equal to that damage from your hand onto the battlefield.
956579.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于该伤害的神器牌从你手上放进战场。

956588.oracleText: As long as this creature is tapped, it's a Human Citizen with base power and toughness 1/1 and can't be blocked.
956588.translation: 只要此生物已横置，它便是基础力量与防御力为1/1的人类／市民，且不能被阻挡。

956617.oracleText:
When Kairi dies, choose one — 
• Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands. 
• Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
956617.translation:
当开璃死去时，选择一项～ 
•选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。 
•磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

956622.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, this Vehicle becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying.
956622.translation: 每当此载具每回合首度成为已搭载时，直到回合结束，此载具成为目标本回合中搭载它之非传奇生物的复制品，但它是4/3，额外是载具神器，且具有飞行异能。

956624.oracleText: Channel — {o2oU}, Discard this card: Counter target spell or ability unless its controller pays {o3}.
956624.translation: 魂力～{o2oU}，弃掉此牌：除非目标咒语或异能的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

956627.oracleText: {o1oU}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw two cards.

956628.oracleText: Channel — {oU}, Discard this card: Draw a card.
956628.translation: 魂力～{oU}，弃掉此牌：抓一张牌。

956630.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed, up to one other target Vehicle you control becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
956630.translation: 每当此载具成为已搭载时，至多另一个目标由你操控的载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

956638.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card unless this creature entered this turn.
956638.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则除非此生物是于本回合进场，否则你弃一张牌。

956642.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, scry 1.
956642.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，占卜1。

956645.oracleText: Channel — {o4oU}, Discard this card: The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
956645.translation: 魂力～{o4oU}，弃掉此牌：目标非地永久物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

956647.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to one target creature to its owner's hand.
956647.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

956651.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target permanent.
956651.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标永久物。

956671.oracleText: Channel — {o3oU}, Discard this card: Tap up to two target creatures you don't control. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
956671.translation: 魂力～{o3oU}，弃掉此牌：横置至多两个目标不由你操控的生物。这些生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

956686.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted permanent. If it's an Equipment, unattach it.
956686.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置所结附的永久物。若它是武具，则将它卸装。

956697.oracleText: When this creature enters from your hand, if it's attacking, create a token that's a copy of another target attacking creature. The token enters tapped and attacking.
956697.translation: 当此生物从你手上进场时，若它正进行攻击，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标进行攻击之生物的复制品。该衍生物须横置进场，且正进行攻击。

956703.oracleText: This creature enters with a menace counter on it.
956703.translation: 此生物进场时上面有一个威慑指示物。

956704.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may remove a menace counter from it. When you do, that player reveals their hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card.
956704.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去一个威慑指示物。当你如此作时，该牌手展示其手牌且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。

956711.oracleText: Whenever this creature or equipped creature attacks, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
956711.translation: 每当此生物或佩带此武具的生物攻击时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

956729.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may discard a creature card. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
956729.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以弃一张生物牌。当你如此作时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

956732.oracleText: Whenever this Equipment becomes attached to a creature, tap that creature.
956732.translation: 每当此武具新贴附在生物上时，横置该生物。

956738.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card if a creature died this turn. Otherwise, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
956738.translation: 当此生物进场时，如果本回合中有生物死去，则你抓一张牌。若否，则每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

956742.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you exile a nonland card this way, Hidetsugu deals damage equal to the exiled card's mana value to any target.
956742.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。当你以此法放逐一张非地牌时，碑出告对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所放逐之牌的法术力值。

956745.oracleText: {o3oB}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

956754.oracleText:
When Junji dies, choose one —

956754.translation:
当殉至死去时，选择一项～

•将目标非龙生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。你失去2点生命。

956763.oracleText:

956763.translation:

956766.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control an artifact and an enchantment, you draw a card and you gain 1 life.
956766.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你同时操控神器和结界，则你抓一张牌且获得1点生命。

956785.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in defending player's graveyard.
956785.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为防御牌手坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

956796.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, you may sacrifice another artifact or creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this Vehicle and it gains menace until end of turn.
956796.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则在此载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

956798.oracleText: Whenever Nashi deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of each player's library. Until end of turn, you may play one of those cards. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
956798.translation: 每当哪失对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用其中一张。如果你以此法施放咒语，则支付等同于其法术力值的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

956802.oracleText: This creature has deathtouch as long as you control an artifact.
956802.translation: 只要你操控神器，此生物便具有死触异能。

956803.oracleText: This creature has menace as long as you control an enchantment.
956803.translation: 只要你操控结界，此生物便具有威慑异能。

956805.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn.
956805.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。

956830.oracleText: {o1o(G/U)}: Tatsunari and target Frog you control can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with flying or reach.
956830.translation: {o1o(G/U)}：达成与目标由你操控的蛙本回合只能被具飞行或延势异能的生物阻挡。

956835.oracleText: When this creature enters, gain control of all Rat tokens.
956835.translation: 当此生物进场时，获得所有老鼠衍生物的操控权。

956836.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card.
956836.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

956840.oracleText: When this Aura enters, destroy target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
956840.translation: 当此灵气进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

956846.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the number of modified creatures you control.

956869.oracleText:

956869.translation:
当轧赐死去时，选择一项～ 
•放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。 
•派出三个珍宝衍生物。

956877.oracleText: If enchanted land would be destroyed, instead sacrifice this Aura and that land gains indestructible until end of turn.
956877.translation: 如果所结附的地将被消灭，则改为牺牲此灵气且该地获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

956879.oracleText: Whenever this artifact or another artifact you control enters, put a charge counter on this artifact.
956879.translation: 每当此神器或另一个由你操控的神器进场时，在此神器上放置一个充电指示物。

956880.oracleText: {o4}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals damage equal to the number of charge counters on it to target player and that much damage to up to one target creature.
956880.translation: {o4}，牺牲此神器：它对目标牌手造成等同于其上充电指示物数量的伤害，并对至多一个目标生物造成等量的伤害。

956882.oracleText: When this artifact enters or leaves the battlefield, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
956882.translation: 当此神器进入或离开战场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

956883.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with vigilance. Activate only as a sorcery.
956883.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲此神器：派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

956892.oracleText: Whenever this token attacks, create a Treasure token.
956892.translation: 每当此衍生物攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

956893.oracleText: Create a 2/2 red Goblin Shaman creature token with "Whenever this token attacks, create a Treasure token."
956893.translation: 派出一个2/2红色鬼怪／祭师衍生生物，且具有「每当此衍生物攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

956904.oracleText: When this Aura leaves the battlefield, create a 2/2 red Spirit creature token with menace.
956904.translation: 当此灵气离开战场时，派出一个2/2红色，具威慑异能的精怪衍生生物。

956920.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard this card: Target creature gets +3/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
956920.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉此牌：直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+1且获得践踏异能。

956923.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target artifact card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
956923.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

956931.oracleText: This Saga deals 1 damage to each opponent and each planeswalker they control.
956931.translation: 此传纪向每位对手和每个由对手操控的鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

956944.oracleText: Whenever this creature or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
956944.translation: 每当此生物或佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

956954.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard this card: Draw a card.
956954.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉此牌：抓一张牌。

956960.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another artifact: This creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
956960.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个神器：此生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

956972.oracleText: Whenever this creature or equipped creature becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to defending player.
956972.translation: 每当此生物或佩带此武具的生物被阻挡时，它对防御牌手造成1点伤害。

956980.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then this creature deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of modified creatures you control other than this creature.
956980.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后此生物向每位对手各造成X点伤害，X为此生物以外由你操控且有饰装的生物数量。

956983.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
956983.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

956987.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 2 damage to any target.
956987.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。
