956988.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉此牌：它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

956993.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 for each other modified creature you control.
956993.translation: 你每操控一个其他有饰装的生物，此生物便得+2/+0。

957003.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, untap up to three lands you control.
957003.translation: 每当此生物被阻挡时，重置至多三个由你操控的地。

957006.oracleText: Channel — {o4oG}, Discard this card: Destroy target creature with flying.
957006.translation: 魂力～{o4oG}，弃掉此牌：消灭目标具飞行异能的生物。

957011.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature or enchantment card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, you gain 4 life.
957011.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物或结界牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果你未以此法将牌置于你手上，则你获得4点生命。

957020.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each land you control.
957020.translation: 你每操控一个地，此生物便得+1/+1。

957023.oracleText: Channel — {o1oG}, Discard this card: Create a 1/1 green Human Monk creature token with "{oT}: Add {oG}."
957023.translation: 魂力～{o1oG}，弃掉此牌：派出一个1/1绿色人类／修行僧衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：加{oG}。」

957026.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control that doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
957026.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在目标由你操控且其上没有+1/+1指示物的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957034.oracleText: Whenever this creature or a Dragon you control dies, you may cast a creature spell from among cards you own in exile with hatching counters on them without paying its mana cost.
957034.translation: 每当此生物或一个由你操控的龙死去时，你可以从放逐区里由你拥有且其上有孵化指示物的牌之中施放一个生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

957042.oracleText: Channel — {o1oG}, Discard this card: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains reach until end of turn.
957042.translation: 魂力～{o1oG}，弃掉此牌：直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得延势异能。

957048.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return an enchantment you control to its owner's hand. If you do, you gain 3 life.
957048.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将一个由你操控的结界移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则你获得3点生命。

957053.oracleText: When this Aura enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle you control.
957053.translation: 当此灵气进场时，在目标由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957056.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
957056.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉此牌：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

957063.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if you control a modified creature.
957063.translation: 如果你操控有饰装的生物，则此生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

957065.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if enchanted permanent is a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield, draw a card.
957065.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若所结附之永久物是生物且其力量为战场上生物中的最大值，则抓一张牌。

957074.oracleText: As long as you control five or more modified creatures, this creature gets +5/+5 and has trample.
957074.translation: 只要你操控五个或更多有饰装的生物，此生物便得+5/+5且具有践踏异能。

957077.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard this card: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control.
957077.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉此牌：在至多两个目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957080.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
957080.translation: 每当此生物进行阻挡或被阻挡时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

957082.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if an enchantment was put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn, you may return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
957082.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有结界从战场进入你的坟墓场，则你可以将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

957085.oracleText: This creature enters with a deathtouch counter on it.
957085.translation: 此生物进场时上面有一个死触指示物。

957086.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may remove a deathtouch counter from it. When you do, exile target artifact or enchantment that player controls.
957086.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去一个死触指示物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由该牌手操控的神器或结界。

957095.oracleText:
When Kura dies, choose one — 
• Search your library for up to three land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. 
• Create an X/X green Spirit creature token, where X is the number of lands you control.
957095.translation:
当空罗死去时，选择一项～ 
•从你牌库中搜寻至多三张地牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。 
•派出一个X/X绿色精怪衍生生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

957103.oracleText: As long as this creature is modified, it has "{oT}: Add {oGoG}."
957103.translation: 只要此生物有饰装，它便具有「{oT}：加{oGoG}。」

957106.oracleText: Channel — {oXoGoG}, Discard this card: Put X +1/+1 counters on target land you control. It becomes a 0/0 green Spirit creature with haste. It's still a land.
957106.translation: 魂力～{oXoGoG}，弃掉此牌：在目标由你操控的地上放置X个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0绿色，具敏捷异能的精怪生物。它仍然是地。

957112.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Return Shigeki to its owner's hand: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest into your graveyard.
957112.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，将茂树移回其拥有者手上：展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中的一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

957113.oracleText: Channel — {oXoXoGoG}, Discard this card: Return X target nonlegendary cards from your graveyard to your hand.
957113.translation: 魂力～{oXoXoGoG}，弃掉此牌：将X张目标非传奇的牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

957120.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
957120.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

957142.oracleText:
Whenever this creature attacks, choose one — 
• Exile target creature card from a graveyard. When you do, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token. 
• Exile target noncreature card from a graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
957142.translation:
每当此生物攻击时，选择一项～ 
•将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。 
•将目标非生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957154.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard this card: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
957154.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉此牌：将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

957155.oracleText: Channel — {o1oU}, Discard this card: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
957155.translation: 魂力～{o1oU}，弃掉此牌：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

957171.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
957171.translation: 每当此生物造成伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957172.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage to a player, if it has dealt 10 or more damage to that player this turn, they lose the game.
957172.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成伤害时，若它本回合中对该牌手已造成10点或更多伤害，则该牌手输掉这盘游戏。

957179.oracleText: This enchantment enters with four +1/+1 counters on it.
957179.translation: 此结界进场时上面有四个+1/+1指示物。

957181.oracleText: Remove a +1/+1 counter from this enchantment: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
957181.translation: 从此结界上移去一个+1/+1指示物：在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动，且每回合限一次。

957188.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if Kaito entered this turn, he phases out.
957188.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若魁渡是于本回合进场，则他跃离。

957191.oracleText: Create a 1/1 blue Ninja creature token with "This token can't be blocked."
957191.translation: 派出一个1/1蓝色忍者衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能被阻挡。」

957199.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player chooses a nonland card in your graveyard. Return that card to your hand. This creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the mana value of that card.
957199.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手选择一张在你坟墓场中的非地牌。将该牌移回你手上。此生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为该牌的法术力值。

957201.oracleText: When Kotose enters, exile target card other than a basic land card from an opponent's graveyard. Search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that card and exile them. Then that player shuffles. For as long as you control Kotose, you may play one of the exiled cards, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
957201.translation: 当琴濑进场时，将目标不是基本地牌的牌从对手坟墓场放逐。从该牌手的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与该牌同名的牌，并将它们放逐。然后该牌手洗牌。于你操控琴濑的时段内，你可以使用所放逐之牌中的一张，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放它的费用。

957204.oracleText: Whenever Naomi enters or attacks, if you control an artifact and an enchantment, create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with vigilance.
957204.translation: 每当秩序柱础直美进场或攻击时，若你同时操控神器和结界，则派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。

957207.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: This artifact deals 1 damage to each opponent. You gain 1 life.
957207.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器：此神器向每位对手各造成1点伤害。你获得1点生命。

957209.oracleText: Whenever one or more Vehicles you control attack, create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
957209.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个载具攻击时，派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

957214.oracleText: Whenever Risona deals combat damage to a player, if it doesn't have an indestructible counter on it, put an indestructible counter on it.
957214.translation: 每当浅利军指挥官理想那对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若其上没有不灭指示物，则在其上放置一个不灭指示物。

957225.oracleText:
When Satsuki dies, choose up to one — 
• Return target Saga or enchantment creature you control to its owner's hand. 
• Return target Saga card from your graveyard to your hand.
957225.translation:
当现世识库佐津树死去时，选择至多一项～ 
•将目标由你操控的传纪或结界生物移回其拥有者手上。 
•将目标传纪牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

957248.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, draw a card.
957248.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，抓一张牌。

957259.oracleText: When this artifact enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
957259.translation: 当此神器进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

957260.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
957260.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

957262.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, tap up to one target creature.
957262.translation: 当此载具进场时，横置至多一个目标生物。

957265.oracleText: When this creature dies, if it had counters on it, put those counters on target creature you control.
957265.translation: 当此生物死去时，若其上有指示物，则将这些指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

957267.oracleText: {o5}, Exile this Vehicle and four other artifact creatures and/or Vehicles you control: Create Mechtitan, a legendary 10/10 Construct artifact creature token with flying, vigilance, trample, lifelink, and haste that's all colors. When that token leaves the battlefield, return all cards exiled with this Vehicle except this card to the battlefield tapped under their owners' control.
957267.translation: {o5}，放逐此载具和四个由你操控的其他神器生物和／或载具：派出传奇衍生神器生物机体泰坦，其为10/10，具飞行、警戒、践踏、系命与敏捷异能且是五色的组构体。当该衍生物离开战场时，将所有以此载具放逐的牌分别在其拥有者之操控下横置移回战场，但此牌除外。

957281.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, you may pay {o2}. If you do, draw a card.
957281.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

957284.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
957284.translation: 每当你施放神器咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957286.oracleText: This Vehicle enters with three charge counters on it.
957286.translation: 此载具进场时上面有三个充电指示物。

957287.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove a charge counter from this Vehicle: Draw a card. Then if there are no charge counters on this Vehicle, create a Treasure token and a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
957287.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从此载具上移去一个充电指示物：抓一张牌。然后如果此载具上没有充电指示物，则派出一个珍宝衍生物和一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且后者具有「此衍生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

957292.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each artifact and/or enchantment card in your graveyard.
957292.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张神器和／或结界牌，此生物便得+1/+0。

957295.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
957295.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

957298.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an Aura or Shrine card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
957298.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张灵气或祭祠牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

957300.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, it deals damage equal to twice the number of Vehicles you control to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
957300.translation: 当此载具进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之载具数量的两倍。

957308.oracleText: Channel — {o1oG}, Discard this card: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or nonbasic land an opponent controls. That player may search their library for a land card with a basic land type, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
957308.translation: 魂力～{o1oG}，弃掉此牌：消灭目标由对手操控的神器，结界或非基本地。该牌手可以从其牌库中搜寻一张具基本地类别的地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。你每操控一个传奇生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

957310.oracleText: Channel — {o2oW}, Discard this card: It deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
957310.translation: 魂力～{o2oW}，弃掉此牌：它对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。你每操控一个传奇生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

957315.oracleText: Channel — {o3oU}, Discard this card: Return target artifact, creature, enchantment, or planeswalker to its owner's hand. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
957315.translation: 魂力～{o3oU}，弃掉此牌：将目标神器，生物，结界或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。你每操控一个传奇生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

957318.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card if you control an artifact. Draw a card if you control an enchantment.
957318.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此地：如果你操控神器，则抓一张牌。如果你操控结界，则抓一张牌。

957322.oracleText: Channel — {o3oR}, Discard this card: Create two 1/1 colorless Spirit creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
957322.translation: 魂力～{o3oR}，弃掉此牌：派出两个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。你每操控一个传奇生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

957324.oracleText: Channel — {o3oB}, Discard this card: Mill three cards, then return a creature or planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
957324.translation: 魂力～{o3oB}，弃掉此牌：磨三张牌，然后将一张生物或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。你每操控一个传奇生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

957499.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, this creature and up to one other target creature you control both gain your choice of first strike or lifelink until end of turn.
957499.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，此生物和至多另一个目标由你操控的生物均依你的选择获得先攻或系命异能直到回合结束。

957506.oracleText: {o4o(G/U)}: This creature has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
957506.translation: {o4o(G/U)}：此生物的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

957512.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
957512.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957515.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
957515.translation: 当此武具进场时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

957520.oracleText: This creature enters with a shield counter on it.
957520.translation: 此生物进场时上面有一个后盾指示物。

957529.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature can't attack or block for as long as you control this creature.
957529.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。于你操控此生物的时段内，该生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

957532.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for any number of cards named Gathering Throng, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
957532.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻任意数量名称为集群民众的牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

957547.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell you control, it connives.
957547.translation: 每当此生物成为由你操控之咒语的目标时，令它筹谋。

957559.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this token: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o1}.
957559.translation: {o1}，牺牲此衍生物：除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

957560.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 blue Wizard creature token with "{o1}, Sacrifice this token: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o1}."
957560.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1蓝色法术师衍生生物，且具有「{o1}，牺牲此衍生物：除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。」

957562.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle enters or attacks, exile up to one other target creature until this Vehicle leaves the battlefield. If a creature is put into exile this way, return each other card exiled with this Vehicle to the battlefield under its owner's control.
957562.translation: 每当此载具进场或攻击时，放逐至多另一个目标生物，直到此载具离开战场为止。如果以此法将生物置入放逐区，则将其他以此载具放逐的牌分别在其操控者的操控下移回战场。

957570.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying {o2oW} rather than paying its mana cost.
957570.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放此牌，但须支付{o2oW}，而不支付其法术力费用。

957573.oracleText: When this creature enters, it connives.
957573.translation: 当此生物进场时，令它筹谋。

957584.oracleText: This creature enters with two shield counters on it.
957584.translation: 此生物进场时上面有两个后盾指示物。

957585.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may remove a counter from a creature or planeswalker you control. If you do, draw a card and create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
957585.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，你可以从由你操控的生物或鹏洛客上移去一个指示物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌并派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

957592.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 1 life for each other creature you control.
957592.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个其他生物，便获得1点生命。

957595.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, draw two cards, then discard a card.
957595.translation: 当此生物进场或攻击时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

957600.oracleText: As long as there are two or more counters among creatures you control, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.
957600.translation: 只要由你操控的生物上总共有两个或更多指示物，此生物便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

957603.oracleText: When this creature dies, put a shield counter on target creature you control.
957603.translation: 当此生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

957623.oracleText: {o1oU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This token can't be blocked." Activate only as a sorcery.
957623.translation: {o1oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能被阻挡。」只能于法术时机起动。

957630.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, this creature connives.
957630.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中他的第二个咒语时，令此生物筹谋。

957640.oracleText: {o1o(W/B)}: This creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
957640.translation: {o1o(W/B)}：此生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

957650.oracleText: When this creature enters, it connives. When it connives this way, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
957650.translation: 当此生物进场时，令它筹谋。当它以此法筹谋时，将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

957656.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if this creature is untapped, any opponent may tap an untapped creature they control. If they do, tap this creature and create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This token can't be blocked."
957656.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若此生物未横置，则任意对手可以横置一个由其操控且未横置的生物。若他如此作，则你横置此生物并派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能被阻挡。」

957666.oracleText: {o3oU}: This creature can't be blocked this turn. This ability costs {o3} less to activate if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
957666.translation: {o3oU}：此生物本回合不能被阻挡。如果你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则此异能减少{o3}来起动。

957668.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature and you create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This token can't be blocked."
957668.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置所结附的生物，且你派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，并具有「此衍生物不能被阻挡。」

957673.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it enters with a shield counter on it if you control that creature.
957673.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场，但如果你操控后者，则它进场时上面有一个后盾指示物。

957675.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, up to one other target creature gains flying until end of turn.
957675.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，至多另一个目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

957686.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, this creature connives.
957686.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，令此生物筹谋。

957687.oracleText: When this creature dies, return another target non-Rogue creature card with equal or lesser power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
957687.translation: 当此生物死去时，将另一张目标力量等于或小于它的非浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

957700.oracleText: Pay 1 life: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
957700.translation: 支付1点生命：此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

957710.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice, discards a card, and loses 4 life.
957710.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物、弃一张牌且失去4点生命。

957718.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Rogue creature token.
957718.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色浪客衍生生物。

957736.oracleText: {o4o(U/R)}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
957736.translation: {o4o(U/R)}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

957743.oracleText: When this creature dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
957743.translation: 当此生物死去时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

957756.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player may have you draw a card. If they do, untap this creature and remove it from combat.
957756.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手可以令你抓一张牌。若他如此作，则重置此生物并将其移出战斗。

957760.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard using its blitz ability.
957760.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用此牌的急袭异能来施放之。

957763.oracleText: Whenever you gain life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
957763.translation: 每当你于你的回合中获得生命时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957764.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
957764.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957772.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. Then copy each card exiled with this enchantment. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
957772.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。然后复制每张以此结界放逐的牌。你可以施放任意数量的复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

957784.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, double this creature's power until end of turn.
957784.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，将此生物的力量加倍直到回合结束。

957788.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token. 
• Create a Treasure token.
957788.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。 
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。

957791.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Put a stash counter on this artifact.
957791.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。在此神器上放置一个匿物指示物。

957792.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of stash counters on this artifact.
957792.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为此神器上的匿物指示物数量。

957796.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Add one mana of any color.
957796.translation: {oT}，牺牲此生物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

957798.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token for each artifact they control.
957798.translation: 每当此载具对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，他每操控一个神器，你便派出一个珍宝衍生物。

957804.oracleText: When this token dies, draw a card.
957804.translation: 当此衍生物死去时，抓一张牌。

957805.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Discard a card: Create a token that's a copy of another target creature you control. It gains haste and "When this token dies, draw a card." Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.
957805.translation: {oR}，{oT}，弃一张牌：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标由你操控的生物之复制品。它获得敏捷与「当此衍生物死去时，抓一张牌。」在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。只能于法术时机起动。

957810.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
957810.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

957816.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
957816.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，其为已横置且正进行攻击，并具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

957820.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: This creature deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of permanents you've sacrificed this turn.
957820.translation: {o1}，{oT}：此生物对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为你本回合中已牺牲的永久物数量。

957829.oracleText: {o1o(B/G)}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
957829.translation: {o1o(B/G)}：此生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

957852.oracleText: When this creature dies, exile the top two cards of your library. Until your next end step, you may play one of those cards.
957852.translation: 当此生物死去时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用其中的一张。

957861.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
957861.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

957866.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
957866.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

957879.oracleText: {o2o(R/W)}: This creature gains double strike until end of turn.
957879.translation: {o2o(R/W)}：此生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

957881.oracleText: When this creature enters, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
957881.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

957884.oracleText: Sacrifice a Treasure: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
957884.translation: 牺牲一个珍宝：此载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

957887.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, untap target creature or land.
957887.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，重置目标生物或地。

957891.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Exile target card from a graveyard. 
• You gain 4 life.
957891.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。 
•你获得4点生命。

957893.oracleText: When this artifact enters, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
957893.translation: 当此神器进场时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

957894.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw three cards.

957897.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, target creature other than this creature gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
957897.translation: 联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，直到回合结束，目标此生物以外的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

957909.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest power and/or toughness among other creatures you control.
957909.translation: 每当此生物进行攻击或阻挡时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之其他生物中的最大力量和／或防御力。

957913.oracleText:
Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. 
• Create a tapped Treasure token. 
• You gain 2 life.
957913.translation:
联手～每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的～ 
•在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。 
•你获得2点生命。

957932.oracleText: This creature has trample as long as it has a shield counter on it.
957932.translation: 只要此生物上有后盾指示物，它便具有践踏异能。

957948.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose two — 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment. 
• Target player gains 5 life. 
• Create a 4/4 green Rhino Warrior creature token. 
• Put a shield counter on a creature you control.
957948.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择两项～ 
•消灭目标神器或结界。 
•目标牌手获得5点生命。 
•派出一个4/4绿色犀牛／战士衍生生物。 
•在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

957951.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
957951.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

957952.oracleText: This creature can't attack or block unless you control seven or more lands.
957952.translation: 除非你操控七个或更多地，否则此生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

957960.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature you control has base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn.
957960.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由你操控的生物之基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。

957965.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 4/4 green Rhino Warrior creature token.
957965.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个4/4绿色犀牛／战士衍生生物。

957969.oracleText: As long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +2/+2 and has deathtouch.
957969.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，此生物便得+2/+2且具有死触异能。

957970.oracleText: When this creature dies, mill two cards, then draw a card.
957970.translation: 当此生物死去时，磨两张牌，然后抓一张牌。

957973.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this creature deals 2 damage to you for each Treasure you control.
957973.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你每操控一个珍宝，此生物便对你造成2点伤害。

957976.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
957976.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个生物时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

957977.oracleText: {oBoR}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature gains menace until end of turn.
957977.translation: {oBoR}，牺牲另一个生物：此生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

957980.oracleText: When this creature dies, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
957980.translation: 当此生物死去时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

957996.oracleText: When this creature enters, choose target creature you don't control and tap it. If you control a creature with a counter on it, the chosen creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
957996.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择目标不由你操控的生物并将它横置。如果你操控其上有指示物的生物，则所选生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤不能重置。

958003.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may tap another untapped Citizen you control. If you do, this creature gets +1/+0 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
958003.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以横置另一个由你操控且未横置的市民。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+0且获得系命异能。

958007.oracleText: When Cormela dies, return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
958007.translation: 当美魅盗贼科梅拉死去时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

958010.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If a card is put into exile this way, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
958010.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一张目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。若以此法将牌置入放逐区，则检视你牌库顶的三张牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

958017.oracleText: This creature has indestructible as long as it entered this turn.
958017.translation: 只要此生物是于本回合进场，它便具有不灭异能。

958021.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
958021.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

958028.oracleText: Whenever Evelyn or another Vampire you control enters, exile the top card of each player's library with a collection counter on it.
958028.translation: 每当艾弗琳或另一个由你操控的吸血鬼进场时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌，且其上有一个收藏指示物。

958032.oracleText: Create two 1/1 blue Fish creature tokens with "This token can't be blocked." Then for each kind of counter among creatures you control, put a counter of that kind on either of those tokens.
958032.translation: 派出两个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能被阻挡。」然后为由你操控的生物上每种指示物各进行以下流程～在前述衍生物之一上放置一个同类的指示物。

958035.oracleText: Falco Spara enters with a shield counter on it.
958035.translation: 冯柯斯帕拉进场时上面有一个后盾指示物。

958042.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice one or more other creatures, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent. This ability triggers only once each turn.
958042.translation: 每当你牺牲一个或数个其他生物时，此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

958044.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 2 damage to each opponent and you scry 2.
958044.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害且你占卜2。

958046.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your hand: Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oU}, {oB}, or {oR}" until this card is cast from exile. You may cast this card for as long as it remains exiled.
958046.translation: {o2}，从你手上放逐此牌：直到从放逐区施放此牌为止，目标地获得「{oT}：加{oU}，{oB}或{oR}。」于此牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放它。

958062.oracleText: {oRoG}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If mana from a Treasure was spent to activate this ability, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature instead.
958062.translation: {oRoG}：此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果起动此异能时支付过来自珍宝的法术力，则改为在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

958067.oracleText: When Lagrella enters, exile any number of other target creatures controlled by different players until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. When an exiled card enters under your control this way, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
958067.translation: 当鹊姐莱格丽进场时，选择任意数量其他目标生物，且其操控者须各不相同。放逐这些生物，直到莱格丽离开战场为止。当一张已放逐的牌以此法在你的操控下进场时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

958070.oracleText: When Lord Xander enters, target opponent discards half the cards in their hand, rounded down.
958070.translation: 当收集魔尚夺尔勋爵进场时，目标对手弃一半数量的手牌，小数点后舍去。

958083.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if you don't control a Devil token, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
958083.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你未操控魔鬼衍生生物，则派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，其为已横置且正进行攻击，并具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

958086.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your hand: Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oB}, {oR}, or {oG}" until this card is cast from exile. You may cast this card for as long as it remains exiled.
958086.translation: {o2}，从你手上放逐此牌：直到从放逐区施放此牌为止，目标地获得「{oT}：加{oB}，{oR}或{oG}。」于此牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放它。

958097.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact, instant, or sorcery card from it and exile that card.
958097.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张神器，瞬间或法术牌，并放逐该牌。

958103.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if its mana value is equal to 1 plus the number of soul counters on this enchantment, put a soul counter on this enchantment, then create a 2/2 white Spirit creature token with flying.
958103.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若其法术力值等同于此结界上的灵魂指示物数量加1，则在此结界上放置一个灵魂指示物，然后派出一个2/2白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

958104.oracleText: As long as there are five or more soul counters on this enchantment, Spirits you control get +3/+3.
958104.translation: 只要此结界上有五个或更多灵魂指示物，由你操控的精怪便得+3/+3。

958111.oracleText: When this creature enters, it connives. When it connives this way, return up to one target spell to its owner's hand.
958111.translation: 当此生物进场时，令它筹谋。当它以此法筹谋时，将至多一个目标咒语移回其拥有者手上。

958117.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card if you had two or more creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
958117.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，如果本回合中有两个或更多生物在你的操控下进战场，则抓一张牌。

958129.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your hand: Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oR}, {oG}, or {oW}" until this card is cast from exile. You may cast this card for as long as it remains exiled.
958129.translation: {o2}，从你手上放逐此牌：直到从放逐区施放此牌为止，目标地获得「{oT}：加{oR}，{oG}或{oW}。」于此牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放它。

958131.oracleText: Rigo enters with a shield counter on it.
958131.translation: 瑞格进场时上面有一个后盾指示物。

958142.oracleText: When Rocco enters, if you cast it, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
958142.translation: 当乐舞会主厨罗孔进场时，若你施放之，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

958144.oracleText: As this creature enters, you may choose a nonland permanent.
958144.translation: 于此生物进场时，你可以选择一个非地永久物。

958146.oracleText: This creature has all activated abilities of the chosen permanent except for loyalty abilities. You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to activate those abilities.
958146.translation: 此生物具有所选永久物的所有起动式异能，但忠诚异能除外。你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付起动这些异能的费用。

958153.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your hand: Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oW}, {oU}, or {oB}" until this card is cast from exile. You may cast this card for as long as it remains exiled.
958153.translation: {o2}，从你手上放逐此牌：直到从放逐区施放此牌为止，目标地获得「{oT}：加{oW}，{oU}或{oB}。」于此牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放它。

958155.oracleText: As long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
958155.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，此生物便得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

958158.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy up to three other target nonland permanents. For each of those permanents, its controller creates a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
958158.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭至多三个其他目标非地永久物。对每个这类永久物而言，其操控者派出一个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

958160.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls can't attack or block until your next turn.
958160.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到你的下一个回合，目标由对手操控的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

958162.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your hand: Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oG}, {oW}, or {oU}" until this card is cast from exile. You may cast this card for as long as it remains exiled.
958162.translation: {o2}，从你手上放逐此牌：直到从放逐区施放此牌为止，目标地获得「{oT}：加{oG}，{oW}或{oU}。」于此牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放它。

958164.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create two Treasure tokens.
958164.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出两个珍宝衍生物。

958168.oracleText: As long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +2/+2.
958168.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，此生物便得+2/+2。

958173.translation: 当机敏行控涂璐丝进场时，令它筹谋。

958183.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, Ziatora deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target and you create three Treasure tokens.
958183.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，焚炎魔齐朵拉对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量，且你派出三个珍宝衍生物。

958185.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, look at the top card of your library. You may play a land from the top of your library or cast a spell with mana value less than or equal to the damage dealt from the top of your library without paying its mana cost. If you don't, put that card into your hand.
958185.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以从你的牌库顶使用一张地牌，或从该处施放一个法术力值等于或小于所造成伤害之数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你皆未作，则将该牌置于你手上。

958203.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks or blocks, return up to one target creature that crewed it this turn to its owner's hand.
958203.translation: 每当此载具攻击或阻挡时，将至多一个目标本回合中搭载它的生物移回其拥有者手上。

958207.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a Treasure token.
958207.translation: {o2}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

958215.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
958215.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

958216.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 4 damage to target creature.
958216.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：它对目标生物造成4点伤害。

958219.oracleText: {o3}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If exactly three colors of mana were spent to activate this ability, put a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
958219.translation: {o3}：此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果起动此异能时支付过正好三色的法术力，则改为在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

958224.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control two or more multicolored permanents, this creature gains double strike until end of turn.
958224.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控两个或更多的多色永久物，则此生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

958232.oracleText: {o2oGoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

958235.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Forest, Plains, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
958235.translation: 当此地进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，平原或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

958238.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
958238.translation: 当此地进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，树林或平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

958244.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
958244.translation: 当此地进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，沼泽或山脉牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

958247.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Plains, Island, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
958247.translation: 当此地进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，海岛或沼泽牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

958250.oracleText: {o2oRoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

958256.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
958256.translation: 当此地进场时，将它牺牲。当你如此作时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，山脉或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌且你获得1点生命。

958259.oracleText: {o2oWoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

958265.oracleText: {o2oBoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

958268.oracleText: {o2oUoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

958416.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
958416.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

959131.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. You create a number of 1/1 blue Faerie Dragon creature tokens with flying equal to the result.
959131.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。你派出若干1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵／龙衍生生物，其数量等同于掷骰结果。

959144.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control leaves the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
959144.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

959146.oracleText: During your turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature.
959146.translation: 防止于你的回合中将对此生物造成的所有伤害。

959156.oracleText: Protection Fighting Style — When this creature enters, exile up to one target non-Warrior creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
959156.translation: 防御战斗风格～当此生物进场时，放逐至多一个目标由你操控的非战士生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

959166.oracleText: Natural Shelter — When this creature enters, you may return another permanent you control to its owner's hand.
959166.translation: 匿身自然～当此生物进场时，你可以将另一个由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

959169.oracleText: Keen Sight — When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a basic Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
959169.translation: 敏锐视觉～当此生物进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

959186.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. Draw cards equal to the result. You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
959186.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。抓等同于掷骰结果的牌。在本盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌数量没有上限。

959208.oracleText: Ceremorphosis — When this creature enters, turn any number of target tapped nontoken creatures face down. They're 2/2 Horror creatures.
959208.translation: 蜕变～当此生物进场时，将任意数量目标已横置且非衍生物的生物翻为牌面朝下。它们是2/2惊惧兽生物。

959216.oracleText: Confounding Clouds — When this creature enters, for each opponent, tap up to one target creature that player controls. Each of those creatures doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
959216.translation: 混乱迷云～当此生物进场时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～横置至多一个目标由该牌手操控的生物。这些生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

959221.oracleText: Homunculus Servant — When this creature enters, put three +1/+1 counters on up to one target noncreature artifact. That artifact becomes a 0/0 Homunculus artifact creature with flying.
959221.translation: 人工生命仆从～当此生物进场时，在至多一个目标非生物的神器上放置三个+1/+1指示物。该神器成为0/0，具飞行异能的造妖神器生物。

959236.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as you've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
959236.translation: 只要你本回合中施放过非生物咒语，此生物便不能被阻挡。

959251.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. When you do, put any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control, where X is the result.
959251.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。当你如此作时，将任意数量的目标生物牌从坟墓场在你操控下放进战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于X，X为掷骰结果。

959271.oracleText: {o3oB}, Sacrifice this creature: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
959271.translation: {o3oB}，牺牲此生物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

959275.oracleText: Animate Chains — When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
959275.translation: 活化锁链～当此生物进场时，每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

959284.oracleText: As long as there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, this creature has menace and deathtouch.
959284.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，此生物便具有威慑与死触异能。

959293.oracleText: When this creature dies, if it wasn't blocking, draw a card.
959293.translation: 当此生物死去时，若它并非正进行阻挡，则抓一张牌。

959295.oracleText: Devour Intellect — When this creature enters, each opponent exiles a card from their hand until this creature leaves the battlefield.
959295.translation: 吞噬智力～当此生物进场时，每位对手各从其手上放逐一张牌，直到此生物离开战场为止。

959296.oracleText: Body Thief — You may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled with this creature. If you cast a spell this way, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
959296.translation: 窃夺躯体～你可以从以此生物放逐的牌之中使用地和施放咒语。如果你以此法施放咒语，则你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放它的费用。

959302.oracleText: As long as this Equipment is attached to a creature, you don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
959302.translation: 只要此武具贴附在某生物上，你便不会因总生命为0或更少而输掉这盘游戏。

959314.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. You create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the result.
959314.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。你派出若干珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于掷骰结果。

959351.oracleText: This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control and creature cards in your graveyard.
959351.translation: 此生物进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控之生物与你坟墓场内生物牌中的最大力量。

959353.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. When you do, put X +1/+1 counters on each of up to two target creatures, where X is the result.
959353.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掷一颗d20。当你如此作时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为掷骰结果。

959360.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may mill four cards.
959360.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以磨四张牌。

959361.oracleText: Natural Recovery — When this creature dies, return target land card from your graveyard to your hand.
959361.translation: 自然恢复～当此生物死去时，将目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

959365.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may search your library for a Dragon card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
959365.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张龙牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

959369.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or less.
959369.translation: 此生物不能被力量等于或小于3的生物阻挡。

959374.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for up to two basic land cards and reveal them, then roll a d20. 9 or less | Put those cards into your hand, then shuffle. 10-19 | Put one of those cards onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle. 20+ | Put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
959374.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌并展示之，然后掷一颗d20。 9或更少 | 将这些牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。 10-19 | 将这些牌其中一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。 20+ | 将这些牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

959381.oracleText: {o2oG}, Sacrifice a land: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
959381.translation: {o2oG}，牺牲一个地：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

959416.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or dies, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
959416.translation: 每当此生物进场或死去时，派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

959432.oracleText: Whenever Catti-brie attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each Equipment attached to it.
959432.translation: 每当凯蒂布莉儿攻击时，在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于贴附于其上的武具数量。

959441.oracleText: Whenever Kagha attacks, it gains deathtouch until end of turn. Mill two cards.
959441.translation: 每当卡格佳攻击时，它获得死触异能直到回合结束。磨两张牌。

959448.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure or Dragon spell, Lozhan deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target that isn't a commander.
959448.translation: 每当你施放历险咒语或龙咒语时，龙族传承洛珊对任意一个不为指挥官的目标造成伤害，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

959456.oracleText: When Minsc & Boo enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, you may create Boo, a legendary 1/1 red Hamster creature token with trample and haste.
959456.translation: 当明斯克与布布进场和在你的维持开始时，你可以派出传奇衍生生物布布，其为1/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的仓鼠。

959458.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature. When you do, Minsc & Boo deals X damage to any target, where X is that creature's power. If the sacrificed creature was a Hamster, draw X cards.
959458.translation: 牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，历时英雄明斯克与布布对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为该生物的力量。如果所牺牲的生物是仓鼠，则抓X张牌。

959467.oracleText: When Oji enters, you gain 2 life and scry 2.
959467.translation: 当欧寄进场时，你获得2点生命且占卜2。

959482.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if a creature card was put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn, create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
959482.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场，则派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

959486.oracleText: Whenever Thrakkus attacks, double the power of each Dragon you control until end of turn.
959486.translation: 每当屠夫斯拉库斯攻击时，将每个由你操控之龙的力量加倍直到回合结束。

959497.oracleText: When this artifact enters, put a rope counter on target creature you control.
959497.translation: 当此神器进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个绳索指示物。

959498.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player may pay {o2}. If they do, they put a rope counter on a creature they control. Otherwise, exile this artifact and each creature without a rope counter on it, then remove all rope counters from all creatures.
959498.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，该牌手可以支付{o2}。若他如此作，则他在一个由其操控的生物上放置一个绳索指示物。若否，则放逐此神器和每个其上没有绳索指示物的生物，然后移去所有生物上的所有绳索指示物。

959504.oracleText: Whenever a creature enters, if it was cast, exile it, then return all other permanent cards exiled with this artifact to the battlefield under their owners' control.
959504.translation: 每当一个生物进场时，若它经牌手施放，则将之放逐，然后将所有以此神器放逐的其他永久物牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

959507.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
959507.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或门牌，展示这些牌，将一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

959693.oracleText: As this creature enters, look at an opponent's hand, then choose any card name.
959693.translation: 于此生物进场时，检视任一对手的手牌，然后任意选择一个牌名。

959697.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it deals 2 damage to any target.
959697.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

959698.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked twice, it deals 2 damage to any target.
959698.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅两次，则它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

959715.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
959715.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则每位牌手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

959725.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
959725.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为进行攻击的生物数量。

959731.oracleText: When Danitha enters, you may put an Aura or Equipment card from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield attached to Danitha.
959731.translation: 当宾纳里亚之望达妮莎进场时，你可以将一张灵气或武具牌从你手上或你坟墓场放进战场并贴附在达妮莎上。

959741.oracleText: Whenever this creature enlists a creature, scry 2.
959741.translation: 每当此生物征列生物时，占卜2。

959742.oracleText: Discard a card: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
959742.translation: 弃一张牌：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

959751.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
959751.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

959754.oracleText: {o1oW}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

959767.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
959767.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

959779.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and scry 1.
959779.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，你获得1点生命并占卜1。

959791.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile each nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
959791.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐所有法术力值小于或等于2的非地永久物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

959799.oracleText: {o3oWoW}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Soldier you control.
959799.translation: {o3oWoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：在每个由你操控的士兵上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

959801.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying for each creature with defender you control.
959801.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个具守军异能的生物，便派出一个1/1白色，具有飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

959814.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying. 
• Return another target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. 
• Draw a card.
959814.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•派出一个1/1白色，具有飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。 
•将另一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。 
•抓一张牌。

959816.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, discard your hand, then draw two cards.
959816.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则弃掉你的手牌，然后抓两张牌。

959828.oracleText: Exile this creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
959828.translation: 放逐此生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

959829.oracleText:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, choose one — 
• This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. 
• Exile this creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. 
• Scry 1.
959829.translation:
每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，选择一项～ 
•此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。 
•放逐此生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。 
•占卜1。

959845.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
959845.translation: 只要你本回合中施放过瞬间或法术咒语，此生物便不能被阻挡。

959858.oracleText: Another target nonland permanent phases out. It can't phase in for as long as you control this Saga.
959858.translation: 另一个目标非地永久物跃离。于你操控此传纪的时段内，它不能跃回。

959859.oracleText: Another target nonland permanent phases out. It can't phase in for as long as you control this Saga.
959859.translation: 另一个目标非地永久物跃离。于你操控此传纪的时段内，它不能跃回。

959878.oracleText: You may cast this spell as though it had flash if X is 3 or less.
959878.translation: 如果X小于等于3，则你可以将此咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

959883.oracleText: Domain — Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, reveal the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. (Piles can be empty.)
959883.translation: 领土～每当此生物对任意牌手造成战斗伤害时，展示你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。由任一对手将它们分为两堆。将其中一堆置于你的手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。（牌堆可以是空的。）

959886.oracleText: When this creature dies, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
959886.translation: 当此生物死去时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你的手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

959901.oracleText: Domain — When this creature enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. You may put one of those cards on top of your library. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
959901.translation: 领土～每当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶牌的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。你可以将其中一张置于你的牌库顶。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

959906.oracleText: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each time it was kicked.
959906.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于它增幅次数的两倍。

959907.oracleText: When this creature enters, gain control of target creature with power less than this creature's power for as long as you control this creature.
959907.translation: 当此生物进场时，于你操控伏特里亚调念师的时段内，获得目标力量小于此生物之生物的操控权。

959916.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
959916.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始，将它牺牲。

959942.oracleText: {o1oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only if a non-Skeleton creature died under your control this turn.
959942.translation: {o1oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于有非骷髅妖生物在你操控下死去的回合中起动。

959953.oracleText: {o4oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
959953.translation: {o4oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：将另一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

959955.oracleText: {oB}: This creature becomes a Human Cleric with base power and toughness 2/2.
959955.translation: {oB}：此生物成为基础力量与防御力为2/2的人类／僧侣。

959956.oracleText: {o1oB}: If this creature is a Cleric, put a deathtouch counter on it and it becomes a Phyrexian Human Cleric with base power and toughness 3/3.
959956.translation: {o1oB}：如果此生物是僧侣，则在其上放置一个死触指示物且它成为基础力量与防御力为3/3的非瑞人／人类／僧侣。

959957.oracleText: {o1oBoB}: If this creature is a Phyrexian, put a +1/+1 counter on it, then you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
959957.translation: {o1oBoB}：如果此生物是非瑞人，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

959971.oracleText: As this creature enters, if it was kicked, mill four cards.
959971.translation: 于此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则磨四张牌。

959980.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
959980.translation: 于此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

959981.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
959981.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个其他生物：此生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

959985.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if a player discarded a card this turn, create a 1/1 black Bird creature token with flying and "This token can't block."
959985.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌手弃过牌，则派出一个1/1黑色，具有飞行异能与「此生物不能进行阻挡」的鸟衍生生物。

959989.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures die, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. This ability triggers only once each turn.
959989.translation: 每当有一个或数个生物死去时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

960007.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you gain 3 life for each time it was kicked.
960007.translation: 当此结界进场时，它每增幅过一次，你便获得3点生命。

960014.oracleText: When this creature enters, you lose 2 life.
960014.translation: 当此生物进场时，你失去2点生命。

960030.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red permanent spell, this creature deals 1 damage to any target.
960030.translation: 每当你施放红色永久物咒语时，此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

960032.oracleText: {oR}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. If this ability has been activated four or more times this turn, sacrifice this creature at the beginning of the next end step.
960032.translation: {oR}：此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。如果此异能本回合起动过四次或更多，则在下一个结束步骤开始牺牲此生物。

960034.oracleText: This Saga deals 2 damage to each creature and each opponent.
960034.translation: 此传纪向每个生物和每位对手各造成2点伤害。

960040.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
960040.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在此生物放置一个+1/+1指示物。

960049.oracleText: {oR}: This creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

960054.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
960054.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

960060.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
960060.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个其他生物：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

960070.oracleText: Choose target creature an opponent controls. Whenever you attack this turn, Jaya deals damage equal to the number of attacking creatures to that creature.
960070.translation: 选择目标由对手操控的生物。本回合中，每当你攻击时，烈火来使雅亚对该生物造成伤害，其数量等同于进行攻击的生物数量。

960078.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is this creature's power. You may exile an instant or sorcery card with mana value X or less from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
960078.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为此生物的力量。你可以放逐其中一张法术力值等于或小于X的瞬间或法术牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

960080.oracleText: As long as this creature entered this turn, creatures you control have haste.
960080.translation: 只要此生物是于本回合进场，由你操控的生物便具有敏捷异能。

960084.oracleText: Domain — When this creature enters, it deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control.
960084.translation: 领土～当此生物进场时，它对每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

960088.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may pay {oRoR}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with a +1/+1 counter on it.
960088.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，你可以支付{oRoR}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，其为正进行攻击且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

960090.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature defending player controls with power less than this creature's power can't block this turn.
960090.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控且力量小于此生物之生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

960091.oracleText: Domain — {o5oR}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
960091.translation: 领土～{o5oR}：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。由你操控之地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。每回合只能起动一次。

960093.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Goblin you control dies, exile the top card of your library. If it's a Goblin creature card, you may cast that card until the end of your next turn.
960093.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的鬼怪死去时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。若它是鬼怪生物牌，则直到你的下一个回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

960102.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, search your library for a land card with a basic land type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
960102.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张具基本地类别的地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你的手上，然后洗牌。

960105.oracleText: Whenever Squee attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
960105.translation: 每当伪王斯奎攻击时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

960106.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying {o3oR} and exiling four other cards from your graveyard rather than paying its mana cost.
960106.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放此牌，但须支付{o3oR}并从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌，而非支付其法术力费用。

960120.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact.

960123.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped artifacts you control. When you do, this Saga deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker.
960123.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的神器。当你如此作时，此传纪对目标生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

960130.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, creatures you control gain menace until end of turn.
960130.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则由你操控的生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

960143.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.
960143.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。

960145.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
960145.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张地牌并置于你的手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

960151.oracleText: {o1oG}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 3 life.
960151.translation: {o1oG}，弃掉此牌：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得3点生命。

960158.oracleText: Domain — {o7oG}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. It gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else." This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
960158.translation: 领土～{o7oG}：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。它获得「如果此永久物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。」由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

960175.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
960175.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

960176.oracleText: When this creature dies, distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.
960176.translation: 当此生物死去时，将X个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量目标由你操控的生物，X为此生物上的+1/+1指示物数量。

960191.oracleText: Domain — {o3oG}: Until end of turn, this creature gets +1/+1 for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
960191.translation: 领土～{o3oG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此生物便得+1/+1。每回合只能起动一次。

960204.oracleText: As this creature enters, mill three cards for each time it was kicked.
960204.translation: 于此生物进场时，它每增幅过一次，便磨三张牌。

960208.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
960208.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

960219.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it gets +1/+1 and gains haste until end of turn.
960219.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，则直到回合结束，它得+1/+1且获得敏捷异能。

960231.oracleText: When Astor enters, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal an Equipment or Vehicle card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
960231.translation: 当利刃之主阿斯托进场时，检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中一张武具或载具牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

960260.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell that targets only a single creature other than Ivy, you may copy that spell. The copy targets Ivy.
960260.translation: 每当任一牌手施放仅以单一生物为目标的咒语，且目标不是欢笑窃咒客艾薇时，你可以复制该咒语。该复制品以艾薇为目标。

960262.oracleText: {oT}: Put two ingenuity counters on Jhoira, then you may put an artifact card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield, where X is the number of ingenuity counters on Jhoira.
960262.translation: {oT}：在长生发明家尤依拉上放置两个精妙指示物，然后你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于X的神器牌从你手上放进战场，X为尤依拉上精妙指示物的数量。

960277.oracleText: Domain — Whenever Nael deals combat damage to a player, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom in a random order. Then if there are five basic land types among lands you control, draw a card.
960277.translation: 领土～每当佐雅飞兽乘员妮尔对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。将其中至多一张置于你的牌库顶，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。然后若由你操控的地中有五种基本地类别，则抓一张牌。

960280.oracleText: Whenever Najal attacks, you may pay {o2}. If you do, when you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
960280.translation: 当追风魔纳贾尔攻击时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则本回合中，当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

960283.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice a Saproling: Nemata gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
960283.translation: {oG}，牺牲一个腐生物：太古守护灵奈玛塔得+2/+2直到回合结束。

960290.oracleText: Domain — Whenever Radha becomes tapped, another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
960290.translation: 领土～每当联盟军阀拉妲成为横置时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

960310.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding two cards in addition to paying its other costs.
960310.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场施放此牌，但在其他费用之外，还须弃两张牌。

960312.oracleText: Whenever Rulik Mons attacks, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you didn't put a card onto the battlefield this way, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
