961091.oracleText: When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
961091.translation: 当此灵气从战场进入坟墓场时，抓一张牌。

961098.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among the cards milled this way into your hand. If you don't, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
961098.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨三张牌。你可以将以此法磨掉的一张地牌置于你手上。若你未如此作，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

961101.oracleText: When this creature dies, mill four cards.
961101.translation: 当此生物死去时，磨四张牌。

961126.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, draw a card.
961126.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则抓一张牌。

961133.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
961133.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

961137.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on Gwenna and untap it.
961137.translation: 每当你施放力量等于或大于5的生物咒语时，在盖亚之眼关娜上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

961140.oracleText: When this creature dies, put up to one other target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
961140.translation: 当此生物死去时，将至多另一张目标牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

961155.oracleText: This creature has deathtouch as long as you control three or more artifacts.
961155.translation: 只要你操控三个或更多神器，此生物便具有死触异能。

961156.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, you gain 1 life. If this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
961156.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，你获得1点生命。如果这是此异能在本回合第一次的结算，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

961178.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice this creature: Exile target noncreature artifact or noncreature enchantment.
961178.translation: {oG}，牺牲此生物：放逐目标非生物神器或非生物结界。

961180.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target attacking creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
961180.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

961182.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create an X/X colorless Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
961182.translation: {oX}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：派出一个X/X无色魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

961187.oracleText: {o3oGoG}, Sacrifice this creature: Create an X/X colorless Golem artifact creature token, where X is three times this creature's power. It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
961187.translation: {o3oGoG}，牺牲此生物：派出一个X/X无色魔像衍生神器生物，X为此生物力量的三倍。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

961191.oracleText: When this creature enters, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
961191.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

961195.oracleText: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
961195.translation: 此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

961199.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• This creature deals 1 damage to any target. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains trample and haste until end of turn. 
• Create a tapped Powerstone token.
961199.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。 
•在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。 
•派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

961209.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, this creature gets +1/+0 and has menace.
961209.translation: 只要你本回合已抓两张或更多牌，此生物便得+1/+0且具有威慑异能。

961212.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control enters, target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
961212.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，目标生物得得+2/+0直到回合结束。

961215.oracleText: Sacrifice Hajar: Legendary creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
961215.translation: 牺牲忠诚保镖哈札：直到回合结束，由你操控的传奇生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

961221.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target artifact or creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
961221.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

961247.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target nonland permanent.
961247.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，消灭目标非地永久物。

961258.oracleText: {o2oGoGoWoWoUoU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return any number of target artifact cards with total mana value 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
961258.translation: {o2oGoGoWoWoUoU}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：将任意数量的目标神器牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于10。只能于法术时机起动。

961274.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each {oUoU} spent to cast it, draw a card.
961274.translation: 当此生物进场时，释放它时每支付过一份{oUoU}，便抓一张牌。

961275.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each {oBoB} spent to cast it, each opponent discards a card.
961275.translation: 当此生物进场时，释放它时每支付过一份{oBoB}，每位对手便各弃一张牌。

961276.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each {oRoR} spent to cast it, it gets +1/+0 and gains trample and haste until end of turn.
961276.translation: 当此生物进场时，释放它时每支付过一份{oRoR}，直到回合结束，它便得+1/+0且获得践踏与敏捷异能。

961278.oracleText: This creature enters with three +1/+1 counters on it for each {oGoG} spent to cast it.
961278.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于施放它时所支付之{oGoG}份数的三倍。

961279.oracleText: When this creature enters, choose up to two other target creatures you control. For each {oWoW} spent to cast this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on each of them.
961279.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择至多两个其他目标由你操控的生物。施放此生物时，每支付过一份{oWoW}，便在这些生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

961285.oracleText: {o1}: Until end of turn, this creature gets -1/-1 and gains your choice of flying, vigilance, deathtouch, or haste.
961285.translation: {o1}：选择飞行，警戒，死触或敏捷。直到回合结束，此生物得-1/-1且获得该异能。

961287.oracleText: When you cast this spell and whenever this creature attacks, destroy up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a tapped Powerstone token.
961287.translation: 当你施放此咒语和每当此生物攻击时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

961294.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on this artifact.
961294.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在此神器上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

961295.oracleText: {o2}: This artifact becomes a 1/1 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
961295.translation: {o2}：此神器成为1/1组构体神器生物直到回合结束。

961298.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana spent to cast that spell is greater than Liberator's power, put a +1/+1 counter on Liberator.
961298.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量大于克撒战翼机解放者号之力量，则在解放者号上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

961306.oracleText: You may activate the loyalty abilities of Urza twice each turn rather than only once.
961306.translation: 你每回合可以起动克撒的忠诚异能两次，而不是只能起动一次。

961316.oracleText: When this artifact enters, each opponent sacrifices three creatures of their choice.
961316.translation: 当此神器进场时，每位对手各牺牲三个依其选择的生物。

961320.oracleText: {o3}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control creatures named Mine Worker and Tower Worker, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature instead. Activate only once each turn.
961320.translation: {o3}：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果你操控名称为矿脉工人和高塔工人的生物，则改为在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。每回合只能起动一次。

961324.oracleText: Whenever this artifact or another nontoken artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield or is put into exile from the battlefield, create a tapped Powerstone token.
961324.translation: 每当此神器或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的神器从战场进入坟墓场或放逐区时，派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

961333.oracleText: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it unless two or more colors of mana were spent to cast it.
961333.translation: 除非施放此生物时支付过两种或更多颜色的法术力，否则它进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

961340.oracleText: When this creature dies, add eight {oC}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
961340.translation: 当此生物其死去时，加八点{oC}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

961343.oracleText: When this artifact enters, target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
961343.translation: 当此神器进场时，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

961344.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

961347.oracleText: When this creature enters, put up to one target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
961347.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

961354.oracleText: When this creature enters, you and target opponent each create a tapped Powerstone token.
961354.translation: 当此生物进场时，你和目标对手各派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

961360.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a legendary green creature.
961360.translation: 除非你操控传奇绿色生物，否则此地须横置进场。

961364.oracleText: Titania's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
961364.translation: 盖亚化身泰坦尼亚的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地之数量。

961369.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR} or {oW}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

961372.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} or {oW}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

961377.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Soldier card from your hand. This land enters tapped unless you revealed a Soldier card this way or you control a Soldier.
961377.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从手上展示一张士兵牌。除非你以此法展示士兵牌或你操控士兵，否则此地须横置进场。

961384.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oB} or {oG}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

961386.oracleText: {o2}: This land becomes a 2/2 Assembly-Worker artifact creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
961386.translation: {o2}：此地成为2/2组装工人神器生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

961393.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU} or {oB}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

961396.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Soldier you control.
961396.translation: 当此生物进场时，在每个由你操控的其他士兵上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

961400.oracleText: {o6}: Draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
961400.translation: {o6}：抓一张牌并在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

961402.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls.
961402.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物。

961406.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it, untap target land you control. It becomes a Treefolk creature with haste and base power and toughness equal to this creature's power and toughness. It's still a land.
961406.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它经你施放，则重置目标由你操控的地。它成为树妖生物，具敏捷异能。且基础力量与防御力等同于此生物的力量和防御力。它仍然是地。

961531.oracleText: As this artifact enters, choose artifact, creature, enchantment, instant, or sorcery.
961531.translation: 于此神器进场时，选择神器，生物，结界，瞬间或法术。

961539.oracleText: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target player loses the game.
961539.translation: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：目标牌手输掉这盘游戏。

961543.oracleText: Sacrifice this artifact: Choose a basic land type. Each land you control becomes that type until end of turn.
961543.translation: 牺牲此神器：选择一种基本地类别。每个由你操控的地均成为该类别直到回合结束。

961548.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. This artifact deals damage equal to the number of nonland cards revealed this way to any target. If the revealed land card was a Mountain, this artifact deals double that damage instead. Put the revealed cards on the bottom of your library in any order.
961548.translation: {o3}，{oT}：从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止。此神器对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于以此法展示之非地牌数量。如果展示出的地牌是山脉，则改为此神器造成两倍的伤害。将所展示的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

961551.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's draw step, if this artifact is untapped, that player draws an additional card.
961551.translation: 在每位牌手的抓牌步骤开始时，若此神器未横置，则该牌手额外抓一张牌。

961586.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Look at the top card of target player's library. Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
961586.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：检视目标牌手的牌库顶牌。在下一个回合维持开始时，抓一张牌。

961594.oracleText: As this artifact enters, pay any amount of life.
961594.translation: 于此神器进场时，支付任意数量的生命。

961595.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Create an X/X black Phyrexian Minion creature token, where X is the life paid as this artifact entered.
961595.translation: {o4}，{oT}：派出一个X/X黑色非瑞人／奴仆衍生生物，X为此神器进场时所支付的生命数量。

961604.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature tokens.
961604.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。

961631.oracleText: Imprint — When this artifact enters, you may exile a nonland card from your hand.
961631.translation: 压印～当此神器进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张非地牌。

961649.oracleText: When this creature enters or leaves the battlefield, choose a land of each basic land type, then destroy those lands.
961649.translation: 当此生物进战场或离开战场时，为每种基本地类别各选择一个地，然后消灭这些地。

961654.oracleText: Whenever a 1/1 creature you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield, then attach it to that creature.
961654.translation: 每当一个由你操控的1/1生物进场时，你可以将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，然后将它贴附在该生物上。

961667.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with deathtouch and a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with lifelink.
961667.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个3/3无色，具死触异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物，和一个3/3无色，具系命异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物。

961674.oracleText: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield?
961674.translation: 是否将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场？

961679.oracleText: Whenever Laelia attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
961679.translation: 每当拉耶梨攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

961682.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token with flying, a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token with vigilance, and a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token with trample.
961682.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个3/3无色、具飞行的魔像衍生神器生物，一个3/3无色、具警戒的魔像衍生神器生物和一个3/3无色、具践踏的魔像衍生神器生物。

961684.oracleText: When this artifact enters, draw three cards.
961684.translation: 当此神器进场时，抓三张牌。

961685.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked, that player draws three cards and gains control of this artifact. Untap it.
961685.translation: 每当由对手操控的一个或数个生物攻击你且未受阻挡时，该牌手抓三张牌并获得此神器的操控权。将之重置。

961690.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a nonland permanent: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
961690.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个非地永久物：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

961698.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target artifact or creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less until this creature leaves the battlefield.
961698.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

961702.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, this creature has double strike.
961702.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，此生物便具有连击异能。

961705.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961705.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

961709.oracleText: This creature enters with an oil counter on it.
961709.translation: 此生物进场时上面有一个烁油指示物。

961710.oracleText: {o1}, Remove an oil counter from this creature: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
961710.translation: {o1}，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

961714.oracleText: Create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961714.translation: 派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

961715.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961715.translation:
选择一项～ 
•CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。 
•派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

961716.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Charge of the Mites deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. 
• Create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961716.translation:
选择一项～ 
•虫械冲锋对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。 
•派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

961722.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961722.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

961735.oracleText: When this creature enters, another target creature you control with toxic gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
961735.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控且具下毒异能的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

961746.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever this creature attacks, if an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
961746.translation: 腐化～每当此生物攻击时，若某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

961748.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return another permanent you control to its owner's hand. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961748.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将另一个由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

961750.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961750.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

961754.oracleText: Whenever Kemba or another Cat you control enters, attach up to one target Equipment you control to that creature.
961754.translation: 每当肯芭或另一个由你操控的猫进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控的武具贴附在该生物上。

961760.oracleText: As long as this creature is equipped, it gets +1/+1.
961760.translation: 只要此生物佩带武具，它便得+1/+1。

961763.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
961763.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

961769.oracleText: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}, Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures: Put an indestructible counter on Mondrak.
961769.translation: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}，牺牲两个其他神器和／或生物：在荣光圣主蒙垂克上放置一个不灭指示物。

961772.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, scry 1 and put an oil counter on this artifact.
961772.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1并在此神器上放置一个烁油指示物。

961773.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Remove two oil counters from this artifact: Draw a card.
961773.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从此神器上移去两个烁油指示物：抓一张牌。

961776.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 as long as you control two or more artifacts.
961776.translation: 只要你操控两个或更多神器，此生物便得+2/+0。

961780.oracleText: When this Aura enters, exile target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls until this Aura leaves the battlefield.
961780.translation: 当此灵气进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客，直到此灵气离开战场为止。

961783.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to this creature, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, this creature deals that much damage to any other target.
961783.translation: 如果此生物将受到伤害，则防止该伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，此生物对任意另一个目标造成等量的伤害。

961801.translation: 叛逃虫械斯勒夫不能进行阻挡。

961804.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
961804.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命并派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

961813.oracleText: Whenever this artifact or another artifact you control enters, target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
961813.translation: 每当此神器或另一个由你操控的神器进场时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

961815.oracleText: You gain X life. Create X 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block." If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures.
961815.translation: 你获得X点生命。派出X个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」如果X等于或大于5，则消灭所有其他生物。

961824.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on this creature.
961824.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在此生物上放置一个烁油指示物。

961825.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from this creature: Target creature gains flying until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
961825.translation: 从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

961827.oracleText: Whenever this Equipment becomes attached to a creature, for as long as this Equipment remains attached to it, you may have that creature become a copy of another target creature you control.
961827.translation: 每当此武具新贴附在任一生物上时，于此武具持续贴附于其上期间，你可以使该生物成为另一个目标由你操控之生物的复制品。

961838.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls.
961838.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

961848.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-0 until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
961848.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-0直到回合结束，X为由你操控的神器数量。

961852.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, this artifact becomes a 4/4 Phyrexian Eye artifact creature until end of turn.
961852.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，此神器成为4/4非瑞人／眼神器生物直到回合结束。

961855.oracleText: This artifact enters with two oil counters on it.
961855.translation: 此神器进场时上面有两个烁油指示物。

961856.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target player mills X cards, where X is the number of oil counters on this artifact.
961856.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标牌手磨X张牌，X为此神器上的烁油指示物数量。

961859.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may tap it. If you do, proliferate.
961859.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将它横置。若你如此作，则增殖。

961862.oracleText: This creature enters with three oil counters on it.
961862.translation: 此生物进场时上面有三个烁油指示物。

961863.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from this creature: This creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn.
961863.translation: 从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：此生物得+1/-1直到回合结束。

961867.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from this creature: Scry 1.
961867.translation: {oT}，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：占卜1。

961870.oracleText: As long as this creature has four or more oil counters on it, it gets +2/+0 and can't be blocked.
961870.translation: 只要此生物上有四个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+2/+0且不能被阻挡。

961886.oracleText: This Vehicle enters with an oil counter on it.
961886.translation: 此载具进场时上面有一个烁油指示物。

961887.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from this Vehicle: It becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
961887.translation: 从此载具上移去一个烁油指示物：它成为神器生物直到回合结束。

961890.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may remove two oil counters from it. If you do, when you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
961890.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去两个烁油指示物。若你如此作，则本回合中，当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

961892.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature, then proliferate.
961892.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置所结附的生物，然后增殖。

961894.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put an oil counter on this artifact.
961894.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在此神器上放置一个烁油指示物。

961895.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each oil counter on this artifact.
961895.translation: 此神器上每有一个烁油指示物，你施放的瞬间与法术咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

961914.oracleText: This artifact enters with four oil counters on it.
961914.translation: 此神器进场时上面有四个烁油指示物。

961915.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from this artifact: Tap target artifact or creature.
961915.translation: {oT}，从此神器上移去一个烁油指示物：横置目标神器或生物。

961920.oracleText: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}, Remove three counters from among other artifacts, creatures, and planeswalkers you control: Put an indestructible counter on Tekuthal.
961920.translation: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}，从由你操控的其他神器、生物和鹏洛客上移去总共三个指示物：在求知圣主特库索上放置一个不灭指示物。

961923.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, proliferate.
961923.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，增殖。

961927.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each oil counter on it.
961927.translation: 此生物上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+1。

961941.oracleText: When this creature dies, draw cards equal to the number of oil counters on it.
961941.translation: 当此生物死去时，抓若干牌，其数量等同于其上的烁油指示物数量。

961944.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay 2 life. When you do, target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
961944.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以支付2点生命。当你如此作时，目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

961953.oracleText: This creature enters with four oil counters on it.
961953.translation: 此生物进场时上面有四个烁油指示物。

961954.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from this creature. Then if it has no oil counters on it, you lose the game.
961954.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物。然后如果其上没有烁油指示物，则你输掉这盘游戏。

961965.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, this creature has deathtouch and lifelink.
961965.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，此生物便具有死触和系命异能。

961972.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card. For each opponent who can't, you gain 4 life.
961972.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌。每有一位无法如此作的对手，你便获得4点生命。

961976.oracleText: Sacrifice another artifact or creature: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
961976.translation: 牺牲另一个神器或生物：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

961978.oracleText: {o(B/P)o(B/P)}, Exile three creature cards from your graveyard: Put an indestructible counter on Drivnod.

961996.translation: 当此生物进场或死去时，增殖。

962006.oracleText: This creature enters with two oil counters on it.
962006.translation: 此生物进场时上面有两个烁油指示物。

962007.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on this creature.
962007.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在此生物上放置一个烁油指示物。

962020.oracleText: Whenever a source deals damage to this creature, that source's controller sacrifices that many permanents of their choice.
962020.translation: 每当一个来源对此生物造成伤害时，该来源的操控者依其选择牺牲等量的永久物。

962024.oracleText: Corrupted — When this creature enters, sacrifice a creature unless an opponent has three or more poison counters.
962024.translation: 腐化～当此生物进场时，除非某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，否则你牺牲一个生物。

962040.oracleText: When this creature dies, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
962040.translation: 当此生物死去时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

962045.oracleText: Whenever another artifact or creature you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on this artifact.
962045.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器或生物从战场进入坟墓场时，在此神器上放置一个烁油指示物。

962046.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Remove four oil counters from this artifact: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
962046.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，从此神器上移去四个烁油指示物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

962064.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more counters on a permanent or player, this enchantment deals that much damage to target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
962064.translation: 每当你在一个永久物或一位牌手上放置一个或数个指示物时，此结界对目标对手，由对手操控的生物或由对手操控的鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

962070.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from this creature, Discard a card: Draw a card.
962070.translation: {oT}，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物，弃一张牌：抓一张牌。

962086.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile three cards at random from your graveyard. Choose a noncreature, nonland card from among them and copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
962086.translation: 当此生物进场时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌。选择其中一张非生物且非地的牌并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

962089.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature token.
962089.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1红色非瑞人／鬼怪衍生生物。

962097.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each oil counter on it.
962097.translation: 此生物上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+0。

962098.oracleText: When this creature enters and whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on this creature.
962098.translation: 当此生物进场和每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在此生物上放置一个烁油指示物。

962100.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may remove two oil counters from it. When you do, target creature can't block this turn.
962100.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以从其上移去两个指示物。若你如此作，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

962106.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, this creature deals 2 damage to that player unless they control two or more basic lands.

962110.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from this creature: Target creature you control gains haste until end of turn.
962110.translation: 从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：目标由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

962125.oracleText: Koth deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.
962125.translation: 志士烈火寇斯对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的山脉数量。

962133.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控的神器或生物上放置两个烁油指示物。

962134.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return this creature to its owner's hand unless you remove two oil counters from it.
962134.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，除非你从此生物上移去两个烁油指示物，否则将它移回其拥有者手上。

962160.translation: {oT}，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

962164.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器。

962172.oracleText: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}, Discard two cards: Put an indestructible counter on Solphim.
962172.translation: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}，弃两张牌：在破坏圣主索非穆上放置一个不灭指示物。

962176.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of permanents you control with oil counters on them.
962176.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为由你操控且其上有烁油指示物的永久物数量。

962179.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put an oil counter on this artifact, then create an X/1 red Phyrexian Horror creature token with trample and haste, where X is the number of oil counters on this artifact. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.

962182.oracleText: {o6oR}, Sacrifice this creature: Discard your hand, then draw four cards. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each oil counter on this creature.

962193.translation: 只要此生物上有三个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+3/+0。

962194.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐并在此生物上放置一个烁油指示物。

{o1}, Sacrifice this creature: Choose one —

962208.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, proliferate.

962214.oracleText: This creature has trample as long as it has two or fewer oil counters on it. Otherwise, it has hexproof.
962214.translation: 只要此生物上有两个或更少烁油指示物，它便具有践踏异能。若否，则它具有辟邪异能。

962215.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from this creature. Then if it has no oil counters on it, sacrifice it.

962227.translation: 此神器进场时上面有三个烁油指示物。

962228.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from this artifact: Create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
962228.translation: {o4}，{oT}，从此神器上移去一个烁油指示物：派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962234.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may remove an oil counter from it. If you do, untap it and it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
962234.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以从其上移去一个烁油指示物。若你如此作，则将它重置且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

962236.oracleText: When this Aura enters, if enchanted creature has toxic, that creature gains hexproof until end of turn.
962236.translation: 当此灵气进场时，若所结附的生物具有下毒异能，则该生物获得辟邪直到回合结束。

962238.oracleText: Create an X/X green Phyrexian Horror creature token, where X is Nissa's loyalty.
962238.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色非瑞人／惊惧兽衍生生物，X为升华物灵师妮莎的忠诚。

962247.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 3 life. Then if you control a permanent with an oil counter on it, draw a card.
962247.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得3点生命。然后如果你操控其上有烁油指示物的永久物，则抓一张牌。

962256.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from this creature: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
962256.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

962260.oracleText: {oT}: Put an oil counter on this creature.
962260.translation: {oT}，在此生物上放置一个烁油指示物。

962261.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from this creature: Untap target land.
962261.translation: {oT}，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：重置目标地。

962267.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with flying.
962267.translation: 此生物不能被具飞行异能的生物阻挡。

962274.oracleText: Thrun can't be the target of nongreen spells your opponents control or abilities from nongreen sources your opponents control.
962274.translation: 对由对手操控之非绿色咒语或由对手操控之非绿色来源的异能而言，破诫巨魔图伦不能成为其目标。

962293.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay {o1oG}. If you do, proliferate.
962293.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以支付{o1oG}。若你如此作，则增殖。

962298.oracleText: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}, Sacrifice two other creatures: Put an indestructible counter on Zopandrel.
962298.translation: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}，牺牲两个其他生物：在饥渴圣主佐潘坠上放置一个不灭指示物。

962301.oracleText: When Atraxa enters, reveal the top ten cards of your library. For each card type, you may put a card of that type from among the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. (Artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, instant, land, planeswalker, and sorcery are card types.)
962301.translation: 当大一统飞将亚崔夏进场时，展示你牌库顶的十张牌。对每种牌张类别而言，你可以将一张为该类别的牌从所展示牌之中置于你手上。将其余的以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。（牌张类别包括神器、战役、生物、结界、瞬间、地、鹏洛客以及法术。）

962310.oracleText: Remove three oil counters from this creature: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
962310.translation: 从此生物上移去三个烁油指示物：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

962313.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
962313.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

962316.oracleText: When Ezuri enters, you may pay {o3}. If you do, proliferate twice.
962316.translation: 当狱界行者伊祖黎进场时，你可以支付{o3}。若你如此作，则增殖两次。

962327.oracleText: Whenever Jor Kadeen attacks, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of equipped creatures you control. Then if Jor Kadeen's power is 4 or greater, draw a card.
962327.translation: 每当金坚卫之首尤克定攻击时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控且佩带武具的生物数量。然后如果尤克定的力量等于或大于4，则抓一张牌。

962331.oracleText: When this token leaves the battlefield, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
962331.translation: 当此衍生物离开战场时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

962332.oracleText: Create a 2/2 colorless Drone artifact creature token with deathtouch and "When this token leaves the battlefield, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life."
962332.translation: 派出一个2/2无色奴兽衍生神器生物，且具有死触与「当此衍生物离开战场时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。」

962345.oracleText: When Malcator enters, create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
962345.translation: 当纯净督理麻卡特进场时，派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。

962349.oracleText: Exile Melira: Choose another target creature or artifact. When it's put into a graveyard this turn, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
962349.translation: 放逐活疗方梅梨莱：选择另一个目标生物或神器。本回合中，当它进入坟墓场时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

962351.oracleText: Migloz enters with five oil counters on it.
962351.translation: 迷林碾兽冥洛兹进场时上面有五个烁油指示物。

962368.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, the next time target creature would deal combat damage to one or more players this combat, prevent that damage. If damage is prevented this way, create that many 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
962368.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择目标生物。于本次战斗中，防止该生物下一次将对一位或多位牌手造成的战斗伤害。如果以此法防止伤害，则派出等量的1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

962371.oracleText: Remove three oil counters from this creature: Draw a card. Then you may discard a nonland card. When you discard a card this way, this creature deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Activate only as a sorcery.
962371.translation: 从此生物上移去三个烁油指示物：抓一张牌。然后你可以弃一张非地牌。当你以此法弃牌时，浆液核盖美拉对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

962390.oracleText: Corrupted — When this creature enters, if an opponent has three or more poison counters, destroy target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
962390.translation: 腐化～当此生物进场时，若某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则消灭目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

962393.oracleText: When you proliferate, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
962393.translation: 当你增殖时，将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

962396.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this creature unless you discard a card. When you discard a card this way, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to the mana value of the discarded card.
962396.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你弃一张牌，否则牺牲 此生物。当你以此法弃牌时，消灭目标由对手操控的非地永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于所弃之牌的法术力值。

962398.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may remove an oil counter from this creature. When you do, target creature you control gains your choice of flying, vigilance, deathtouch, or lifelink until end of turn.
962398.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物。当你如此作时，选择飞行，警戒，死触或系命，目标由你操控的生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

962401.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
962401.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲此神器：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得飞行异能。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

962404.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
962404.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲此神器：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

962416.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice this artifact: Put two oil counters on target artifact or creature you control. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
962416.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲此神器：在目标神器或生物上放置两个烁油指示物。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

962426.oracleText: {o2oG}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature you control gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
962426.translation: {o2oG}，牺牲此神器：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

962429.oracleText: As long as this artifact is on the battlefield, it has all activated abilities of all land cards in all graveyards.
962429.translation: 只要此神器在战场上，它便具有所有坟墓场中所有地牌的所有起动式异能。

962432.oracleText: {o3}: This artifact becomes a 9/9 Phyrexian Construct artifact creature, loses all abilities, and gains indestructible and toxic 9. Activate only if there are nine or more lands with different names among the basic, Sphere, and Locus lands you control.
962432.translation: {o3}：此神器成为9/9非瑞人／组构体神器生物，失去所有异能，并获得不灭与下毒9。只能于你操控九个或更多不同名称的基本、域界与处所地时起动。

962439.oracleText: When this creature enters, scry 2. Then each opponent may scry 1.
962439.translation: 当此生物进场时，占卜2。然后每位对手各可以占卜1。

962442.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Myr card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
962442.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张秘耳牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

962445.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever this artifact becomes tapped, each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 1 life.
962445.translation: 腐化～每当此神器成为横置时，每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去1点生命。

962462.oracleText: {o2oU}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
962462.translation: {o2oU}，牺牲此神器：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

962467.oracleText: {oT}: Put an oil counter on this artifact.
962467.translation: {oT}，在此神器上放置一个烁油指示物。

962468.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Activate only if this artifact has two or more oil counters on it.
962468.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。只能于此神器上有两个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

962469.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if this artifact has five or more oil counters on it.
962469.translation: {o1}，{oT}：抓一张牌。只能于此神器上有五个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

962475.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

962484.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

962487.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

962490.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

962492.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Activate only if this land entered this turn.
962492.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。只能于此地进场的回合中起动。

962493.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
962493.translation: {o3}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

962495.oracleText: This land enters with two oil counters on it.
962495.translation: 此地进场时上面有两个烁油指示物。

962496.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from this land: Put an oil counter on target artifact or creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
962496.translation: {oT}，从此地移去一个烁油指示物：在目标由你操控的神器或生物上放置一个烁油指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

962499.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: This land becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X.
962499.translation: {oX}，{oT}：此地成为目标由你操控、法术力值为X且非衍生物的神器之复制品。

962509.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

962513.oracleText: {o3o(W/P)}: Create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
962513.translation: {o3o(W/P)}：派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

962516.oracleText: {oU}, Remove an oil counter from this creature: Draw a card, then scry 2.
962516.translation: {oU}，从此生物上移去一个烁油指示物：抓一张牌，然后占卜2。

962522.oracleText: Whenever an equipped creature you control other than Rhuk attacks or dies, you may attach all Equipment attached to that creature to Rhuk.
962522.translation: 每当一个金角板袭鬼鲁刻以外由你操控且佩带武具的生物攻击或死去时，你可以将所有贴附在该生物上的武具贴附于鲁刻。

962524.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create two 3/3 green Phyrexian Beast creature tokens with toxic 1.
962524.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出两个3/3绿色，具下毒1的非瑞人／野兽衍生生物。

962586.oracleText: When this Siege enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls that isn't exactly two colors.
962586.translation: 当此围攻进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且不是正好两色的非地永久物。

962605.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, transform up to one target Incubator token you control.
962605.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，转化至多一个目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

962615.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
962615.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

962625.oracleText: Destroy all other permanents except for artifacts, lands, and Phyrexians. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
962625.translation: 消灭所有其他永久物，但神器、地和非瑞人除外。放逐此传纪，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

962636.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one other target creature or artifact you control. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
962636.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐至多另一个目标由你操控的生物或神器。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

962639.oracleText: When Heliod enters, return target enchantment card that isn't a God from your graveyard to your hand.
962639.translation: 当曙光耀辉赫利欧德进场时，将目标不是神的结界牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

962640.oracleText: {o3o(U/P)}: Transform Heliod. Activate only as a sorcery.
962640.translation: {o3o(U/P)}：转化曙光耀辉赫利欧德。只能于法术时机起动。

962650.oracleText: When this Siege enters, create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance.
962650.translation: 当此围攻进场时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

962654.oracleText: When this Siege enters, you gain 4 life and draw a card.
962654.translation: 当此围攻进场时，你获得4点生命且抓一张牌。

962658.oracleText: When this Siege enters, look at target opponent's hand. You may exile a nonland card from it. For as long as that card remains exiled, its owner may play it. A spell cast this way costs {o2} more to cast.
962658.translation: 当此围攻进场时，检视目标对手的手牌。你可以放逐其中一张非地牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，其拥有者可以使用之。以此法施放的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

962662.oracleText: Sacrifice this enchantment: Creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
962662.translation: 牺牲此结界：由你操控的生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

962664.oracleText: When this Siege enters, search your library for an Aura, God, or Demigod card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
962664.translation: 当此围攻进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张灵气，神或半神牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

962667.oracleText: Ephara has lifelink and indestructible as long as you control at least three other enchantments.
962667.translation: 只要你操控至少三个其他结界，尽责庇护厄芳拉便具有系命与不灭异能。

962674.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance.
962674.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

962676.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal up to two creature cards with mana value X or less from among them, where X is the number of creatures that convoked this creature. Put the revealed cards into your hand, then shuffle.
962676.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中至多两张法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌，X为召集亿欧游侠骑士的生物数量。将所展示的牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。

962694.oracleText: When this creature enters, incubate 3 X times.
962694.translation: 当此生物进场时，抚育3 X次。

962704.oracleText: {o4o(B/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
962704.translation: {o4o(B/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962707.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, this creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
962707.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则此生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

962712.oracleText: {o5o(R/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
962712.translation: {o5o(R/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962715.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of it. Put a +1/+1 counter on that token for each +1/+1 counter on this creature. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
962715.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个为它复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。此生物上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便在该衍生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

962728.oracleText: This creature has first strike as long as another Knight entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
962728.translation: 只要本回合中有另一个骑士在你的操控下进战场，此生物便具有先攻异能。

962732.oracleText: {o4o(G/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
962732.translation: {o4o(G/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962740.oracleText: Whenever another Knight you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
962740.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的骑士进场时，直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

962750.oracleText: {o3o(R/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
962750.translation: {o3o(R/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962770.oracleText: When this Aura enters, each player mills two cards.
962770.translation: 当此灵气进场时，每位牌手各磨两张牌。

962776.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender and it can't be blocked.
962776.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，此生物便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击，且不能被阻挡。

962788.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player mills two cards. Then you may put an instant, sorcery, or battle card from your graveyard on top of your library.
962788.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各磨两张牌。然后你可以将一张瞬间，法术或战役牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

962790.oracleText: When this Siege enters, search your library, graveyard, and/or outside the game for an instant or sorcery card you own, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
962790.translation: 当此围攻进场时，从你牌库，你坟墓场和／或游戏外搜寻一张由你拥有的瞬间或法术牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

962795.oracleText: When this Siege enters, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
962795.translation: 当此围攻进场时，横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

962799.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, draw a card.
962799.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

962801.oracleText: When this Siege enters, create two 1/1 blue Kraken creature tokens with trample.
962801.translation: 当此围攻进场时，派出两个1/1蓝色，具践踏异能的巨海兽衍生生物。

962806.oracleText: When this Siege enters, draw three cards, then discard a card.
962806.translation: 当此围攻进场时，抓三张牌，然后弃一张牌。

962810.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Copy target spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
962810.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：复制目标由你操控的咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

962816.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand. You have no maximum hand size for as long as you control this Saga.
962816.translation: 抓等同于你手牌数量的牌。于你操控此传纪的时段内，你的手牌数量没有上限。

962819.oracleText: You may cast any number of spells from your hand without paying their mana costs. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
962819.translation: 你可以从你手上施放任意数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐此传纪，然后将它移回战场。（移回时为正面朝上）

962828.oracleText: As long as you control a transformed permanent, this creature has "When this creature dies, draw a card."
962828.translation: 只要你操控已转化的永久物，此生物便具有「当此生物死去时，抓一张牌。」

962837.oracleText:
When this creature enters or dies, choose one — 
• Draw a card, then discard a card. 
• Shuffle up to four target cards with mana value 3 or greater from your graveyard into your library.
962837.translation:
当此生物进场或死去时，选择一项～ 
•抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。 • 将至多四张目标法术力值等于或大于3的牌从你的坟墓场洗入你牌库。

962840.oracleText: {o3o(W/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
962840.translation: {o3o(W/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962843.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked by a creature, the blocking creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
962843.translation: 每当此生物被阻挡时，每个阻挡它的生物各得-1/-1直到回合结束。

962847.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature token.
962847.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

962850.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on that creature if you control another Knight.
962850.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。如果你操控另一个骑士，则在该目标生物上放置一个晕眩指示物。

962852.oracleText: Whenever you cast a legendary spell, untap Rona.
962852.translation: 每当你施放传奇咒语时，重置进军传令罗娜。

962856.oracleText: Whenever a source deals damage to Rona, that source's controller exiles a card from their hand at random. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield under your control. Otherwise, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
962856.translation: 每当一个来源对陶拉里亚抹煞兽罗娜造成伤害时，该来源的操控者随机从其手上放逐一张牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之在你的操控下放进战场。若否，则你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

962882.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may tap two other untapped creatures you control. If you do, this creature can't be blocked this turn.
962882.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他生物。若你如此作，则此生物本回合不能被阻挡。

962892.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a flying counter on each creature that convoked it.
962892.translation: 当此生物进场时，在每个召集它的生物上各放置一个飞行指示物。

962898.oracleText: {o4o(U/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
962898.translation: {o4o(U/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962904.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Ayara deals X damage to target opponent or battle and you gain X life, where X is the sacrificed permanent's mana value.
962904.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：世境寡人阿娅拉向目标对手或战役造成X点伤害且你获得X点生命。X为所牺牲永久物的法术力值。

962911.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control. That creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
962911.translation: 当此武具进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。该生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

962914.oracleText: {o3o(G/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
962914.translation: {o3o(G/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

962920.oracleText: Sacrifice another Phyrexian: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
962920.translation: 牺牲另一个非瑞人：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

962921.oracleText: When this creature dies, incubate X, where X is its power.
962921.translation: 当此生物死去时，抚育X，X为其力量。

962946.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. 
• Choose target battle. If an opponent protects it, remove three defense counters from it. Otherwise, put three defense counters on it.
962946.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。 
•选择目标战役。若任一对手防卫之，则从其上移去三个布防指示物。若否，则在其上放置三个布防指示物。

962954.oracleText: When this creature dies, each player mills two cards. Then you may exile this card. When you do, put target creature or battle card from your graveyard on top of your library.
962954.translation: 当此生物死去时，每位牌手各磨两张牌。然后你可以放逐此牌。当你如此作时，将目标生物或战役牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

962965.oracleText: When this creature enters, Phyrexians you control gain menace until end of turn.
962965.translation: 当此生物进场时，由你操控的非瑞人获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

962967.oracleText: {o3oB}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
962967.translation: {o3oB}，牺牲一个神器或生物：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

962969.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle. For as long as that card remains exiled, you may play it.
962969.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它牌面朝下地放逐，然后洗牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以使用之。

962976.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an artifact or creature was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
962976.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有神器或生物从战场进入坟墓场，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

962978.oracleText: When this Siege enters, target opponent discards two cards.
962978.translation: 当此围攻进场时，目标对手弃两张牌。

962981.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has two or fewer cards in hand, this creature deals 2 damage to them.
962981.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，若该牌手的手牌为两张或更少，则此生物对其造成2点伤害。

962987.oracleText:
When this Siege enters, choose one or both — 
• Destroy all legendary creatures. 
• Destroy all nonlegendary creatures.
962987.translation:
当此围攻进场时，选择一项或都选～ 
•消灭所有传奇生物。 
•消灭所有非传奇生物。

962989.oracleText: Whenever Marchesa attacks, remove all counters from up to one target permanent.
962989.translation: 每当坚毅君主玛切莎攻击时，移去至多一个目标永久物上的所有指示物。

962992.oracleText: When this Siege enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -13/-13 until end of turn.
962992.translation: 当此围攻进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-13/-13直到回合结束。

962997.oracleText: When this Siege enters, it deals 3 damage to any other target and you gain 3 life.
962997.translation: 当此围攻进场时，它对任意另一个目标造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

963008.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player mills three cards.
963008.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各磨三张牌。

963009.oracleText: {o5o(W/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
963009.translation: {o5o(W/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

963034.oracleText: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
963034.translation: 将所有坟墓场中的所有生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。放逐化真经文，然后将它移回战场。（移回时为正面朝上）

963036.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, each player mills a card.
963036.translation: 每当此生物攻击或阻挡时，每位牌手各磨一张牌。

963050.oracleText: Whenever an instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage to an opponent or battle, you may pay {oR}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn.
963050.translation: 每当一个由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语向任一对手或战役造成伤害时，你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

963058.oracleText: Chandra deals X damage to each of up to two targets.
963058.translation: 希望信标茜卓对至多两个目标各造成X点伤害。

963064.oracleText: When Etali enters, each player exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card. You may cast any number of spells from among the nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
963064.translation: 当始霸埃泰力进场时，每位牌手各从其牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地牌为止。你可以从以此法放逐的非地牌之中施放任意数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

963069.oracleText: Whenever Etali deals combat damage to a player, they get that many poison counters.
963069.translation: 每当始病埃泰力对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手得到等量的中毒指示物。

963093.oracleText: When this Siege enters, exile all cards from your hand, then draw that many cards. Until the end of your next turn, you may play cards exiled this way.
963093.translation: 当此围攻进场时，放逐你手上的所有牌，然后抓等量的牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用以此法放逐的牌。

963096.oracleText: Discard a land card: This enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.
963096.translation: 弃一张地牌：此结界对任意一个目标造成2点伤害

963099.oracleText: When this Siege enters, it deals 3 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
963099.translation: 当此围攻进场时，它对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成3点伤害。

963102.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
963102.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

963104.oracleText: When this Siege enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
963104.translation: 当此围攻进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

963110.oracleText: When this Siege enters, it deals 4 damage to another target battle or opponent and 1 damage to up to one target creature.
963110.translation: 当此围攻进场时，它向另一个目标战役或对手造成4点伤害，且对至多一个目标生物造成1点伤害。

963115.oracleText: When this Siege enters, reveal any number of Dragon cards from your hand. When you do, this Siege deals X plus 2 damage to any other target, where X is the number of cards revealed this way. (X can be 0.)
963115.translation: 当此围攻进场时，从你手上展示任意数量的龙牌。当你如此作时，此围攻对任意另一个目标造成X加2点伤害，X为以此法所展示之牌的数量。

963121.oracleText: As long as this creature's power is 5 or greater, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
963121.translation: 只要卡瑟斯深渊卫士的力量等于或大于5，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

963123.oracleText: {o3o(U/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
963123.translation: {o3o(U/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

963141.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 2 damage to target player or battle.
963141.translation: {oT}：此生物对目标牌手或战役造成2点伤害。

963144.oracleText: {o3o(B/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
963144.translation: {o3o(B/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

963148.oracleText: When this creature dies, each opponent sacrifices an artifact or creature of their choice.
963148.translation: 当此生物死去时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的神器或生物。

963155.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to target planeswalker that player controls or battle that player protects.
963155.translation: 每当此生物向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，它对目标由该牌手操控的鹏洛客或由该牌手防卫的战役造成等量的伤害。

963162.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, up to one target attacking creature gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. Return that creature to its owner's hand at end of combat. (Return it only if it's on the battlefield.)
963162.translation: 每当该生物攻击时，直到回合结束，至多一个目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。在战斗结束时，将该生物移回其拥有者的手上。（若它在战场上，才须将它移回。）

963180.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks a battle, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
963180.translation: 每当此生物攻击任一战役时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

963190.oracleText: This Saga deals 3 damage to target opponent and each creature they control.
963190.translation: 此传纪向目标对手和每个由其操控的生物各造成3点伤害。

963193.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from any graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
963193.translation: 直到回合结束，你可以从任意坟墓场中施放瞬间和法术咒语。若以此法施放的咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。放逐该传记，然后将它移回战场。（移回时为正面朝上）

963204.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks a battle, double its power until end of turn.
963204.translation: 每当此生物攻击任一战役时，将其力量加倍直到回合结束。

963208.oracleText: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each creature that convoked it.
963208.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于召集它之生物数量的两倍。

963219.oracleText: {o4o(R/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
963219.translation: {o4o(R/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

963237.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, surveil 1, then you may return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
963237.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，刺探1，然后你可以将一张地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

963248.oracleText: {o5o(U/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
963248.translation: {o5o(U/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

963252.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, up to one other target creature has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
963252.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，至多另一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

963255.oracleText: {o6o(B/P)}: Transform this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
963255.translation: {o6o(B/P)}：转化此生物。只能于法术时机起动。

963260.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Malady Invoker, target creature an opponent controls gets -0/-X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
963260.translation: 当此生物转化为疫病召现师时，目标由对手操控的生物得-0/-X直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

963262.oracleText: When this Siege enters, search your library and/or graveyard for a non-Human creature card with mana value X or less and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
963262.translation: 当此围攻进场时，从你牌库和／或你坟墓场中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于X的非人类生物牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

963267.oracleText: When this Siege enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
963267.translation: 当此围攻进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张永久物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

963270.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, this creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
963270.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

963272.oracleText: When this Siege enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.
963272.translation: 当此围攻进场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

963277.oracleText: When this Siege enters, return up to three target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.
963277.translation: 当此围攻进场时，将至多三张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

963282.oracleText: When this Siege enters, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
963282.translation: 当此围攻进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

963285.oracleText: As long as this creature is on the battlefield, it's a land in addition to its other types.
963285.translation: 只要此生物在战场上，它便额外具有地此类别。

963291.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is this creature's power.
963291.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为此生物的力量。

963294.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a land or double-faced card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
963294.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张地牌或双面牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

963301.oracleText: {o2oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
963301.translation: {o2oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

963308.oracleText: Whenever Polukranos or another nontoken Hydra you control dies, create a 3/3 green and white Phyrexian Hydra creature token with reach and a 3/3 green and white Phyrexian Hydra creature token with lifelink.
963308.translation: 每当破坏引擎波禄卡诺斯或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的多头龙死去时，派出一个3/3，绿白双色，具延势异能的非瑞人／多头龙衍生生物和一个3/3，绿白双色，具系命异能的非瑞人／多头龙衍生生物。

963314.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• This creature gains haste until end of turn. 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
963314.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•此生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。 • 消灭目标神器或结界。

963316.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent cast a blue and/or black spell this turn, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
963316.translation: 当此生物进场时，若本回合中有对手施放过蓝色和／或黑色咒语，则检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张永久物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

963332.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you gain 5 life and incubate 5.
963332.translation: 当此结界进场时，你获得5点生命且抚育5。

963353.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control gain "{o1}: This creature fights target creature you don't control." Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
963353.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得「{o1}：此生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。」放逐此传纪，然后将它移回战场（移回时为正面朝上）。

963356.oracleText: This creature has indestructible as long as it attacked a battle this turn.
963356.translation: 只要此生物本回合中攻击过任一战役，它便具有不灭异能。

963363.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target creature or battle card from your graveyard to your hand.
963363.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标生物或战役牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

963378.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another permanent you control, if it's the first time +1/+1 counters have been put on that permanent this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
963378.translation: 每当在另一个由你操控的永久物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，若这是本回合中第一次在该永久物上放置+1/+1指示物，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

963411.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may pay {oX}. When you do, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value X from a graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
963411.translation: 每当此生物进场时，你可以支付{oX}。当你如此作时，你可以从任一坟墓场中施放目标法术力值为X的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。若该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

963422.oracleText: When this Siege enters, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile two nonland cards with mana value 4 or less. You may cast one of those two cards without paying its mana cost. Put one of them into your hand. Then put the other cards exiled this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
963422.translation: 当此围攻进场时，从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐两张法术力值等于或小于4的非地牌为止。这两张牌中，你可以施放其中一张，且不需支付其法术力费用；将其中一张置于你手上。然后将以此法放逐的其他牌依随机顺序置于你牌库底。

963427.oracleText: When this Siege enters, each player mills three cards, then each opponent discards a card and you draw a card.
963427.translation: 当此围攻进场时，每位牌手各磨三张牌，然后每位对手各弃一张牌，且你抓一张牌。

963430.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.
963430.translation: 你可以使此生物当成坟墓场中任一生物牌的复制品来进入战场，但它是4/4黑色灵俑，且仍具有原本的颜色和类别。

963432.oracleText: When this Siege enters, target player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice and loses 1 life.
963432.translation: 当此围攻进场时，目标牌手牺牲一个依其选择的生物或鹏洛客且失去1点生命。

963436.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature if a permanent was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
963436.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，如果本回合中有永久物从战场进入坟墓场，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

963438.oracleText: When this Siege enters, create a Treasure token. Then you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
963438.translation: 当此围攻进场时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

963441.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may discard a card. If you do, search your library for a land or battle card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
963441.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌或战役牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

963443.oracleText: When this Siege enters, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
963443.translation: 当此围攻进场时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

963446.oracleText: Aetherwing's power is equal to the number of artifacts you control.
963446.translation: 金鳞旗舰乙太翼号的力量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

963448.oracleText: When this Siege enters, up to two target creatures each get +2/+0 and gain vigilance and haste until end of turn.
963448.translation: 当此围攻进场时，直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+2/+0且获得警戒与敏捷异能。

963454.oracleText: When this Siege enters, destroy target non-Elf creature an opponent controls with power X or less, where X is the number of lands you control.
963454.translation: 当此围攻进场时，消灭目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于X的非妖精生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

963459.oracleText: When this Siege enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
963459.translation: 当此围攻进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

963463.oracleText: When this Siege enters, you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. When you do, exile target artifact or creature an opponent controls.
963463.translation: 当此围攻进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由对手操控的神器或生物。

963468.oracleText: When this Siege enters, create X 2/2 white and blue Knight creature tokens with vigilance.
963468.translation: 当此围攻进场时，派出X个2/2，白蓝双色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

963475.oracleText: When this Siege enters, scry 3, then reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land or double-faced card, draw a card.
963475.translation: 当此围攻进场时，占卜3，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌或双面牌，则抓一张牌。

963480.oracleText: When this Siege enters, return target nonbattle permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
963480.translation: 当此围攻进场时，将目标非战役永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

963486.oracleText: When this Siege enters, return up to one target creature to its owner's hand.
963486.translation: 当此围攻进场时，将至多一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

963491.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature tokens.
963491.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个1/1，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

963492.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that has convoke, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent and each battle they protect.
963492.translation: 每当你施放具召集异能的咒语时，此生物向每位对手和每个由其防卫的战役各造成1点伤害。

963501.oracleText: {o2oRoG}, Discard this card: Destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment. Shuffle this card into your library from your graveyard, then draw a card.
963501.translation: {o2oRoG}，弃掉此牌：消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。将此牌从你的坟墓场洗入你牌库，然后抓一张牌。

963516.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each transformed permanent you control.
963516.translation: 你每操控一个已转化的永久物，此生物便得+1/+0。

963540.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
963540.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

963559.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Activate only if this permanent is a creature.
963559.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。只能于此永久物是生物时起动。

963569.oracleText: {o10}, {oT}, Sacrifice Realmbreaker: Search your library for any number of Praetor cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
963569.translation: {o10}，{oT}，牺牲移行洞境树：从你牌库中搜寻任意数量的魔判官牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

963576.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target creature or enchantment.
963576.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：消灭目标生物或结界。

963594.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Phyrexian you control enters, incubate 2.
963594.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的非瑞人进场时，抚育2。

963597.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target attacking creature without flying gains flying until end of turn.
963597.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击且不具飞行异能的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

963604.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target artifact or creature you control. 
• Transform target Incubator token you control.
963604.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标由你操控的神器或生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•转化目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

963607.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
963607.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

963611.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, untap up to one target creature.
963611.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置至多一个目标生物。

963619.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {o3oB}. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It's a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.
963619.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{o3oB}。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它额外具有非瑞人此类别。

963622.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature for the first time each turn, create a Treasure token.
963622.translation: 每当每回合首度在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

963730.oracleText: {o1oBoRoG}, Sacrifice a Saproling: Return this card and up to one other target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
963730.translation: {o1oBoRoG}，牺牲一个腐生物：将此牌和至多另一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

963764.oracleText: {oB}: Skithiryx gains haste until end of turn.
963764.translation: {oB}：枯萎巨龙极兹锐获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

963782.oracleText: Arixmethes enters tapped with five slumber counters on it.
963782.translation: 静眠岛屿阿力马昔斯须横置进场，且上面有五个静眠指示物。

963807.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on Juri.
963807.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，在剧团业主裘里上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

963822.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand, if Taigam attacked this turn, that spell gains rebound.
963822.translation: 每当你从你手上施放瞬间或法术咒语时，若欧祝泰族宗师泰伽姆本回合中攻击过，则该咒语获得弹回异能。

963827.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose a planeswalker type.
963827.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择一种鹏洛客类别。

963832.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
963832.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

963835.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you gain that much life.
963835.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，你获得等量的生命。

963847.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, put a rejection counter on each creature your opponents control.
963847.translation: 当此结界进场时，在每个由对手操控的生物上各放置一个拒斥指示物。

963852.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you reveal a creature card this way, this creature becomes a copy of that card until end of turn, except it has flying.
963852.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。若你以此法展示出一张生物牌，则此生物成为该牌的复制品直到回合结束，但它具有飞行异能。

963854.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it has fewer than four +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then if it has exactly four +1/+1 counters on it, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
963854.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若其上的+1/+1指示物数量少于四个，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后如果其上正好有四个+1/+1指示物，则从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

963860.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy all other creatures that were dealt damage this turn.
963860.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭所有本回合中受过伤害的其他生物。

963863.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile target card from a graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
963863.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

963864.oracleText: This creature has flying as long as a card exiled with it has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
963864.translation: 只要以它放逐的某张牌具有飞行异能，此生物便具有飞行异能。且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

963869.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
963869.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张龙牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

963892.oracleText:
When this creature enters, you may pay {oG} up to three times. When you pay this cost one or more times, choose up to that many — 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment. 
• Exile target player's graveyard. 
• You gain 4 life.
963892.translation:
当此生物进场时，你可以支付至多三次{oG}。当你支付一次或数次此费用时，选择至多等量的模式～ 
•消灭目标神器或结界。 
•放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。 
•你获得4点生命。

963897.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever Calix or another enchantment you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
963897.translation: 星彩～每当凯利斯或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

963917.oracleText: When Jirina enters, exile target player's graveyard.
963917.translation: 当不屈将军杰琳娜进场时，放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

963940.oracleText: Whenever Narset attacks, exile target noncreature, nonland card with mana value less than Narset's power from a graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
963940.translation: 每当受启黜人娜尔施攻击时，将目标既非生物也非地、且法术力值小于娜尔施力量的牌从坟墓场放逐并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

963945.oracleText: Whenever Nashi attacks, exile up to one target legendary or Rat card from your graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy. (You still pay its costs. A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
963945.translation: 每当月智传承哪失攻击时，将至多一张目标传奇或老鼠牌从你的坟墓场放逐并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品。（你依旧要支付其费用，永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

963950.oracleText: Whenever one or more opponents each lose exactly 1 life, put a +1/+1 counter on Ob Nixilis. Exile the top card of your library. Until your next end step, you may play that card.
963950.translation: 每当一位或多位对手各失去正好1点生命时，在受困魔头欧尼希兹上放置一个+1/+1指示物。放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用该牌。

963967.oracleText: Whenever a Dragon you control enters, you may have Sarkhan become a copy of it until end of turn, except its name is Sarkhan, Soul Aflame and it's legendary in addition to its other types.
963967.translation: 每当一个由你操控的龙进场时，你可以使昂焰灵魂萨坎成为前者的复制品直到回合结束，但它的名称是昂焰灵魂萨坎，且额外是传奇。

963976.oracleText: Karn's power and toughness are each equal to the greatest mana value among artifacts you control.
963976.translation: 神兵重铸卡恩的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器中的最大法术力值。

964001.oracleText: Sacrifice Boromir: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.
964001.translation: 牺牲白塔守护波洛米尔：由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。魔戒引诱你。

964003.oracleText: This enchantment enters with a hope counter on it for each creature you control.
964003.translation: 此结界进场时上面有数个希望指示物，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

964004.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, remove a hope counter from this enchantment. If you do, draw a card. Then if this enchantment has no hope counters on it, sacrifice it and you gain 4 life.
964004.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，从此结界上移去一个希望指示物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。然后如果此结界上没有希望指示物，则将它牺牲且你获得4点生命。

964009.oracleText: When this creature enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain first strike until end of turn.
964009.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。

964013.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a Food token. When you do, target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Food you control.
964013.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。当你如此作时，你每操控一个食品，目标由你操控的生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

964016.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage to a Goblin or Orc, destroy that creature.
964016.translation: 每当此生物对任一鬼怪或半兽人造成伤害时，消灭后者。

964021.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card. Then if you don't control a legendary creature, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library.
964021.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓一张牌。然后若你未操控传奇生物，则将一张牌从你手上置于你的牌库底。

964030.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, if you chose a creature other than Faramir as your Ring-bearer, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
964030.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，若你选择战场指挥法拉米尔以外的生物作你的持戒人，则派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

964040.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, return target Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
964040.translation: 当此结界进场时，将目标武具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

964044.oracleText: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}: If Frodo is a Citizen, it becomes a Halfling Scout with base power and toughness 2/3 and lifelink.
964044.translation: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}：如果索隆克星弗罗多是市民，则它成为基础力量与防御力为2/3、具系命异能的半身人／斥候。

964063.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice a Food or pay {o2oW}. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls.
964063.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品或支付{o2oW}。当你如此作时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

964072.oracleText: When Rosie Cotton enters, create a Food token.
964072.translation: 当南小路的罗西·科顿进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

964073.oracleText: Whenever you create a token, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control other than Rosie Cotton.
964073.translation: 每当你派出一个衍生物时，在目标罗西以外由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

964076.oracleText: When Samwise enters, choose up to one target permanent card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn. Return it to your hand. Then the Ring tempts you.
964076.translation: 当勇敢的山姆怀斯进场时，选择至多一张目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌，且须为于本回合中从战场进入该处者。将该牌移回你手上。然后魔戒引诱你。

964083.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a token. When you do, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
964083.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个衍生物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

964089.oracleText: When this creature enters, the Ring tempts you.
964089.translation: 当此生物进场时，魔戒引诱你。

964091.oracleText: Target creature you control gains indestructible for as long as you control this Saga.
964091.translation: 于你操控此传纪之时段内，目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能。

964096.oracleText: When this creature dies, the Ring tempts you.
964096.translation: 当此生物死去时，魔戒引诱你。

964103.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Activate only as a sorcery.
964103.translation: 牺牲此生物：消灭目标神器或结界。只能于法术时机起动。

964120.oracleText:
Whenever Bill Ferny becomes blocked, choose one — 
• Create a Treasure token. 
• Target opponent gains control of target Horse you control. If they do, remove Bill Ferny from combat and create three Treasure tokens.
964120.translation:
每当布理骗子比尔·蕨尼被阻挡时，选择一项～ 
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。 
•目标对手获得目标由你操控的马之操控权。若其如此作，则将比尔·蕨尼移出战斗且你派出三个珍宝衍生物。

964131.oracleText: Whenever you scry, if you control an Island, you may exile this card from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card.
964131.translation: 每当你占卜时，若你操控海岛，则你可以从你的坟墓场放逐此牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。
