964140.oracleText: Whenever Elrond or another creature you control enters, scry 1. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, the Ring tempts you.
964140.translation: 每当埃尔隆德或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，占卜1。若这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则魔戒引诱你。

964147.oracleText: {oT}: Move a counter of each kind not on Goldberry from another target permanent you control onto Goldberry.
964147.translation: {oT}：选择另一个目标由你操控的永久物。将该永久物上河之女金莓没有的指示物每种各从该处移一个到金莓上。

964174.oracleText: {o4oUoU}, Exile this enchantment: Draw a card for each verse counter on this enchantment. If it had seven or more verse counters on it, take an extra turn after this one. Activate only as a sorcery.
964174.translation: {o4oUoU}，放逐此结界：此结界上每有一个词句指示物，便抓一张牌。如果其上有七个或更多词句指示物，则于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。只能于法术时机起动。

964177.oracleText: Whenever Meneldor deals combat damage to a player, exile up to one target creature you own, then return it to the battlefield under your control.
964177.translation: 每当迅捷救星美尼尔多对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐至多一个目标由你拥有的生物，然后将它在你的操控下移回战场。

964180.oracleText: Whenever you scry, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
964180.translation: 每当你占卜时，此生物看守得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

964189.oracleText: When this creature enters, gain control of up to one target creature with lesser power for as long as you control this creature. Then the Ring tempts you.
964189.translation: 当此生物进场时，于你操控此生物的时段内，获得至多一个目标力量比它小的生物之操控权。然后魔戒引诱你。

964196.oracleText: Gain control of up to one target artifact for as long as you control this Saga. The Ring tempts you.
964196.translation: 于你操控此传纪之时段内，获得至多一个目标神器的操控权。魔戒引诱你。

964238.oracleText: When this creature enters, amass Orcs 2.
964238.translation: 当此生物进场时，囤兵半兽人2。

964241.oracleText: When this creature dies, amass Orcs 1.
964241.translation: 当此生物死去时，囤兵半兽人1。

964244.oracleText: When Gollum leaves the battlefield, the Ring tempts you.
964244.translation: 当耐心谋策鬼咕噜离开战场时，魔戒引诱你。

964245.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
964245.translation: {oB}，牺牲一个生物：将咕噜从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于法术时机起动。

964248.oracleText: {o3oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: The Ring tempts you. Activate only as a sorcery.
964248.translation: {o3oB}，从你的坟墓场中放逐此牌：魔戒引诱你。只能于法术时机起动。

964252.translation: 当魔古尔副头领勾斯魔格进场时，囤兵半兽人1。

964256.oracleText: As long as it's your turn and you control an Army, Grond is an artifact creature.
964256.translation: 只要是在你的回合中且你操控军队，破门械格龙得便是神器生物。

964260.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Activate only if you control a legendary creature.
964260.translation: {o2oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。只能于你操控传奇生物时起动。

964269.oracleText: When Lobelia enters, exile target creature card from an opponent's graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn, then create X Treasure tokens, where X is the exiled card's power.
964269.translation: 当洛比莉亚·萨克维尔巴金斯进场时，将目标生物牌从对手坟墓场放逐，且须为于本回合中从战场进入该处者，然后派出X个珍宝衍生物，X为所放逐之牌的力量。

964272.oracleText: When this enchantment enters and whenever an Army you control attacks, amass Orcs 1.
964272.translation: 当此结界进场和每当一个由你操控的军队攻击时，囤兵半兽人1。

964301.oracleText: When this creature enters and whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, this creature deals 1 damage to any target. Then amass Orcs 1.
964301.translation: 当此生物进场和每当任一对手抓一张牌，且不是其于自己的每个抓牌步骤中所抓的第一张牌时，奥克弓手对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。然后囤兵半兽人1。

964309.oracleText: Whenever Sauron attacks, exile target creature card from your graveyard. Create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 3/3 black Wraith with menace. At the beginning of the next end step, exile that token unless Sauron is your Ring-bearer.
964309.translation: 每当死灵法师索隆攻击时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。派出一个已横置且正进行攻击的衍生物，此衍生物为该牌的复制品，但它是3/3黑色，具威异能的鬼魂。在下一个结束步骤开始时，除非索隆是你的持戒人，否则放逐该衍生物。

964318.oracleText: As long as you control a Goblin or Orc, this creature gets +1/+0.
964318.translation: 只要你操控鬼怪或半兽人，咆哮座狼便得+1/+0。

964330.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. Create a Food token for each creature sacrificed this way.
964330.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。每有一个以此法牺牲的生物，你便派出一个食品衍生物。

964338.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to each creature blocking it.
964338.translation: 每当此生物被阻挡时，它对每个阻挡它的生物各造成1点伤害。

964359.oracleText: Whenever Eomer attacks, if you control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
964359.translation: 每当里德马克的伊奥梅尔攻击时，若你操控力量为战场上生物中最大值的生物，则派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

964364.oracleText: Whenever Erkenbrand or another Human you control enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
964364.translation: 每当埃肯布兰德或另一个由你操控的人类进场时，由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

964367.oracleText: {o7oR}: This enchantment deals 7 damage to target creature.
964367.translation: {o7oR}：此结界对目标生物造成7点伤害。

964373.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, the Ring tempts you.
964373.translation: 当此结界进场时，魔戒引诱你。

964374.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this enchantment deals 2 damage to each opponent.
964374.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此结界向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

964383.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, Gimli deals 1 damage to that creature's controller.
964383.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，争功吉姆利对该生物的操控者造成1点伤害。

964394.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
964394.translation: 当此生物死去时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

964396.oracleText: When Grishnakh enters, amass Orcs 2. When you do, until end of turn, gain control of target nonlegendary creature an opponent controls with power less than or equal to the amassed Army's power. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
964396.translation: 当争斗傲领格里什纳赫进场时，囤兵半兽人2。当你如此作时，直到回合结束，获得目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于该受囤兵军队的非传奇生物之操控权。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

964409.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
964409.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。

964414.oracleText: This creature can't block unless you control a Goblin or Orc.
964414.translation: 除非你操控鬼怪或半兽人，否则此生物不能进行阻挡。

964441.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, it deals X damage to each creature.
964441.translation: 当此结界进场时，它对每个生物各造成X点伤害。

964445.oracleText: Up to one target creature can't block for as long as you control this Saga. The Ring tempts you.
964445.translation: 于你操控此传纪的时段内，至多一个目标生物不能进行阻挡。魔戒引诱你。

964447.oracleText: When Smaug dies, create fourteen Treasure tokens.
964447.translation: 当斯毛格死去时，派出十四个珍宝衍生物。

964448.oracleText: Create Smaug, a legendary 6/6 red Dragon creature token with flying, haste, and "When Smaug dies, create fourteen Treasure tokens."
964448.translation: 派出传奇衍生生物斯毛格，其为6/6红色的龙，且具有飞行、敏捷与「当斯毛格死去时，派出十四个珍宝衍生物。」

964451.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control with power 4 or greater dies, amass Orcs 2.
964451.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物死去时，囤兵半兽人2。

964454.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of legendary creatures you control.
964454.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的传奇生物数量。

964460.oracleText: When this creature enters or leaves the battlefield, create a Food token.
964460.translation: 当此生物进入或离开战场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

964464.oracleText: Whenever you scry, Celeborn gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each card looked at while scrying this way.
964464.translation: 每当你占卜时，以此法占卜期间每检视过一张牌，智者凯勒博恩便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

964467.oracleText: Whenever you scry, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. This ability triggers only once each turn.
964467.translation: 每当你占卜时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

964498.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control. Untap that creature.
964498.translation: 当此武具进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。重置该生物。

964517.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets Legolas, put a +1/+1 counter on Legolas.
964517.translation: 每当你施放一个以百中弓手莱戈拉斯为目标的咒语时，在莱戈拉斯上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

964520.oracleText: Note a creature type that hasn't been noted for this Saga. When you next cast a creature spell of that type this turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
964520.translation: 记下一种生物类别，且须为此传纪未曾记录者。本回合中，当你下一次施放该类别的生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

964521.oracleText: Note a creature type that hasn't been noted for this Saga. When you next cast a creature spell of that type this turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
964521.translation: 记下一种生物类别，且须为此传纪未曾记录者。本回合中，当你下一次施放该类别的生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

964522.oracleText: Note a creature type that hasn't been noted for this Saga. When you next cast a creature spell of that type this turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
964522.translation: 记下一种生物类别，且须为此传纪未曾记录者。本回合中，当你下一次施放该类别的生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

964523.oracleText: Note a creature type that hasn't been noted for this Saga. When you next cast a creature spell of that type this turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
964523.translation: 记下一种生物类别，且须为此传纪未曾记录者。本回合中，当你下一次施放该类别的生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

964524.oracleText: Note a creature type that hasn't been noted for this Saga. When you next cast a creature spell of that type this turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
964524.translation: 记下一种生物类别，且须为此传纪未曾记录者。本回合中，当你下一次施放该类别的生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

964525.oracleText: Note a creature type that hasn't been noted for this Saga. When you next cast a creature spell of that type this turn, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
964525.translation: 记下一种生物类别，且须为此传纪未曾记录者。本回合中，当你下一次施放该类别的生物咒语，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

964536.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target legendary creature you control gains deathtouch until end of turn.
964536.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由你操控的传奇生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

964541.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
964541.translation: 牺牲一个食品：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

964551.oracleText: Whenever Quickbeam or another Treefolk you control enters, up to two target creatures each get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.
964551.translation: 每当急楸或另一个由你操控的树妖进场时，直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

964553.oracleText: Whenever Radagast or another nontoken creature you control enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is that creature's mana value. You may reveal a creature card that doesn't share a creature type with a creature you control from among those cards and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
964553.translation: 每当拉达加斯特或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为该生物的法术力值。你可以展示其中一张与由你操控之生物不具共通生物类别的生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

964571.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, if you chose a creature other than Aragorn as your Ring-bearer, put your choice of a counter from among first strike, vigilance, deathtouch, and lifelink on Aragorn.
964571.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，若你选择阿拉贡以外的生物作你的持戒人，则在阿拉贡上依你的选择放置一个先攻，警戒，死触或系命指示物。

964576.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red spell, Aragorn deals 3 damage to target opponent.
964576.translation: 每当你施放红色咒语时，阿拉贡向目标对手造成3点伤害。

964579.oracleText: Arwen enters with an indestructible counter on it.
964579.translation: 阿尔玟进场时上面有一个不灭指示物。

964588.oracleText: The Balrog can't be blocked except by legendary creatures.
964588.translation: 都林克星炎魔只能被传奇生物阻挡。

964592.oracleText: When Bilbo enters or leaves the battlefield, the Ring tempts you.
964592.translation: 当退休小偷比尔博进入或离开战场时，魔戒引诱你。

964609.oracleText: When Eowyn enters, exile target creature an opponent controls with greater power. Legendary creatures you control gain protection from each of that creature's colors until end of turn.
964609.translation: 当无畏骑士伊奥温进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且力量比它大的生物。每个由你操控的传奇生物均获得反所放逐生物之各色的保护异能直到回合结束。

964626.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is your Ring-bearer, it must be blocked if able.
964626.translation: 只要CARDNAME是你的持戒人，则若能阻挡它，便必须阻挡之。

964627.oracleText: As long as Frodo Baggins is your Ring-bearer, it must be blocked if able.
964627.translation: 只要弗罗多是你的持戒人，则若能阻挡它，便必须阻挡之。

964630.oracleText: Whenever the Ring tempts you, if you chose a creature other than Galadriel as your Ring-bearer, scry 3.
964630.translation: 每当魔戒引诱你时，若你选择洛丝罗瑞恩的加拉德瑞尔以外之生物作你的持戒人，则占卜3。

964636.oracleText: Gandalf deals 3 damage to each opponent.
964636.translation: 灰袍甘道夫向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

964641.oracleText:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, choose one that hasn't been chosen — 
• You may tap or untap target permanent. 
• Gandalf deals 3 damage to each opponent. 
• Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy. 
• Put Gandalf on top of its owner's library.
964641.translation:
每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ 
•你可以横置或重置目标永久物。 
•灰袍甘道夫向每位对手各造成3点伤害。 
•复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。 
•将甘道夫置于其拥有者的牌库顶。

964647.oracleText: Gimli has indestructible as long as two or more creatures died under your control this turn.
964647.translation: 只要本回合中有两个或更多生物在你的操控下死去，悲恸复仇者吉姆利便具有不灭异能。

964660.oracleText: Whenever you scry, if Legolas is tapped, you may untap it. Do this only once each turn.
964660.translation: 每当你占卜时，若争功莱戈拉斯已横置，则你可以将它重置。每回合只能如此作一次。

964670.oracleText: Merry has first strike as long as it's equipped.
964670.translation: 只要洛汗侍从梅里佩带武具，它便具有先攻异能。

964710.oracleText: Whenever Shadowfax attacks, you may put a creature card with lesser power from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
964710.translation: 每当马中王者捷影攻击时，你可以将一张力量比它小的生物牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。

964712.oracleText: Whenever Shagrat attacks, attach up to one target Equipment to it. Then amass Orcs X, where X is the number of Equipment attached to Shagrat.
964712.translation: 每当掠物加身沙格拉特攻击时，将至多一个目标武具贴附于其上。然后囤兵半兽人X，X为贴附在沙格拉特上的武具数量。

964716.oracleText: Sharkey has all activated abilities of lands your opponents control except mana abilities.
964716.translation: 夏尔暴君沙基具有由对手操控之地的所有起动式异能，但法术力异能除外。

964721.oracleText: Whenever another creature dealt damage this turn by a Spider you controlled dies, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a Food artifact with "{o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life," and it loses all other card types.
964721.translation: 每当另一个本回合中受过由你操控之蜘蛛伤害的生物死去时，派出一个为该生物复制品的衍生物，但它是食品神器，且具有「{o2}，{oT}，牺牲此衍生物：你获得3点生命」，并失去所有其他牌张类别。

964730.oracleText: Whenever Theoden or another Human you control enters, target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
964730.translation: 每当希奥顿或另一个由你操控的人类进场时，目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

964738.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Ugluk. If that creature was a Goblin or Orc, put two +1/+1 counters on Ugluk instead.
964738.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在白手的乌格鲁克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若该生物是鬼怪或半兽人，则改为在乌格鲁克上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

964759.oracleText: When this artifact enters, the Ring tempts you.
964759.translation: 当此神器进场时，魔戒引诱你。

964762.oracleText: When this artifact enters, scry 1, then draw a card.
964762.translation: 当此神器进场时，占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

964763.oracleText: When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, its owner shuffles it into their library.
964763.translation: 当此神器从战场进入坟墓场时，其拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

964793.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add X mana in any combination of colors.
964793.translation: {oX}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：加X点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

964839.oracleText: When this creature enters, put an indestructible counter on another target creature you control. Draw a card if that creature's power is 2 or less.
964839.translation: 当此生物进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个不灭指示物。若该生物的力量等于或小于2，抓一张牌。

964843.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may tap any number of untapped Humans you control. Draw a card for each Human tapped this way.
964843.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以横置任意数量由你操控的未横置人类。每以此法横置一个人类，便抓一张牌。

964849.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if this creature attacked this turn, return it to its owner's hand. If you do, create a number of 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens equal to its toughness.
964849.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若此生物本回合中曾进行攻击，将它移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则派出若干1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物，且数量等同于其防御力。

964854.oracleText: Whenever Saradoc or another nontoken creature you control with power 2 or less enters, create a 1/1 white Halfling creature token.
964854.translation: 每当雄鹿地统领萨拉道克或另一个力量等于或小于2且非衍生物的生物在你操控下进场时，派出一个1/1白色半身人衍生生物。

964860.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -3/-3 until end of turn. If that creature is legendary, its controller loses 3 life.
964860.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。若该生物是传奇，则其操控者失去3点生命。

964861.oracleText: When the Ring tempts you, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
964861.translation: 当魔戒引诱你时，将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

964866.oracleText: When Elanor enters, create a Food token.
964866.translation: 当埃拉诺·加德纳进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

964871.oracleText: Whenever Frodo enters or attacks, you may attach target Equipment you control with mana value 2 or 3 to Frodo.
964871.translation: 每当坚定英雄弗罗多进场或攻击时，你可以将目标由你操控且法术力值等于2或3的武具贴附于弗罗多上。

964876.oracleText: When Gandalf dies, you may put it into its owner's library fifth from the top.
964876.translation: 当白骑士甘道夫死去时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第五张的位置。

964879.oracleText: Whenever Gollum attacks, look at the top two cards of your library, put them back in any order, then choose land or nonland. An opponent guesses whether the top card of your library is the chosen kind. Reveal that card. If they guessed right, remove Gollum from combat. Otherwise, you draw a card and Gollum can't be blocked this turn.
964879.translation: 每当密谋向导咕噜攻击时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌，将它们以任意顺序放回，然后选择地或非地。任一对手猜你的牌库顶牌是否为所选类别。展示该牌。若其猜对，则将咕噜移出战斗。若否，则你抓一张牌且咕噜本回合不能被阻挡。

964882.oracleText: Whenever Witch-king attacks, defending player sacrifices a creature with the least power among creatures they control.
964882.translation: 每当毁灭使者巫王攻击时，防御牌手牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最小者。

964892.oracleText:
Whenever Galadriel enters or attacks, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature. 
• Create a Food token. 
• Create a Treasure token.
964892.translation:
每当赠礼者加拉德瑞尔进场或攻击时，选择一项～ 
•在另一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个食品衍生物。 
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。

964895.oracleText: When a legendary creature an opponent controls dies, put The Balrog on the bottom of its owner's library.
964895.translation: 当一个由对手操控的传奇生物死去时，将乌顿之火炎魔置于其拥有者的牌库底。

964903.oracleText: Whenever Aragorn and Arwen enters or attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. You gain 1 life for each other creature you control.
964903.translation: 每当新婚燕尔阿拉贡与阿尔玟进场或攻击时，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。你每操控一个其他生物，便获得1点生命。

964906.oracleText: When Sauron enters, gain control of target creature an opponent controls until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn.
964906.translation: 当无睑魔眼索隆进场时，获得目标由对手操控的生物之操控权直到回合结束。将它重置。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

964925.oracleText: Exile this card from your graveyard?
964925.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场放逐此牌？

964952.oracleText: When this land enters, exile target player's graveyard.
964952.translation: 当此地进场时，放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

964968.oracleText: This creature has hexproof as long as it entered this turn.
964968.translation: 只要此生物是于本回合进场，它便具有辟邪异能。

964975.oracleText: When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, exile this creature.
964975.translation: 当此生物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，放逐此生物。

964989.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a Human card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
964989.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张人类牌，并将其置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

965000.oracleText: When this creature enters, other creatures you control get +0/+1 until end of turn.
965000.translation: 当此生物进场时，由你操控的其他生物得+0/+1直到回合结束。

965008.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
965008.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

965017.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return target Aura or Equipment card from your graveyard to your hand.
965017.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将目标灵气或武具牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

965020.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, transform this creature.
965020.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，若本回合中你获得了3点或更多生命，则转化此生物。

965034.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
965034.translation: 牺牲此生物：由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

965044.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +0/+2 until end of turn.
965044.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它得+0/+2直到回合结束。

965050.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap all creatures your opponents control.
965050.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置所有由对手操控的生物。

965055.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a legendary card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
965055.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张传奇牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

965060.oracleText: {o2oU}, Discard two cards: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
965060.translation: {o2oU}，弃两张牌：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

965063.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are three or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, transform this creature.
965063.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有三张或更多瞬间和／或法术牌，则转化此生物。

965069.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 blue Human Wizard creature token. Then if you control three or more Wizards, transform this creature.
965069.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个1/1蓝色人类／法术师衍生生物。然后如果你操控三个或更多法术师，则转化此生物。

965085.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
965085.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

965089.oracleText: This creature gets -1/-1 for each card in your hand.
965089.translation: 你每有一张手牌，此生物便得-1/-1。

965090.oracleText: {o3oU}, Discard three cards: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
965090.translation: {o3oU}，弃三张牌：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

965138.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, sacrifice another creature or land.
965138.translation: 每当此生物进行攻击或阻挡时，牺牲另一个生物或地。

965140.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
965140.translation: 当任一牌手施放咒语时，从此生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

965146.oracleText: Discard a card: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
965146.translation: 弃一张牌：此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

965158.oracleText: Delirium — This creature gets +1/+1 and has menace as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
965158.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，此生物便得+1/+1且具有威慑异能。

965160.oracleText: Sacrifice three other creatures: Transform this creature.
965160.translation: 牺牲三个其他生物：转化此生物。

965171.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, this creature deals 3 damage to that creature and 3 damage to that creature's controller.
965171.translation: 每当此生物阻挡生物或被生物阻挡时，此生物对该生物造成3点伤害，且对该生物的操控者造成3点伤害。

965193.oracleText: Create four 1/1 red Devil creature tokens. They have "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
965193.translation: 派出四个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物。它们具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

965205.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to this creature, it deals double that damage to this creature instead.
965205.translation: 如果某来源将对此生物造成伤害，则改为它对此生物造成两倍的伤害。

965213.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token. It has "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
965213.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物。它具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

965214.oracleText: Make Mischief deals 1 damage to any target. Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token. It has "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
965214.translation: 魔鬼恶戏对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生物。它具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

965226.oracleText: Delirium — This creature has double strike as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
965226.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，此生物便具有连击异能。

965235.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
965235.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

965252.oracleText: Delirium — This creature has deathtouch as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
965252.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，此生物便具有死触异能。

965258.oracleText: Delirium — This creature gets +2/+2 as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
965258.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，此生物便得+2/+2。

965271.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, other Humans you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
965271.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，由你操控的其他人类得+1/+1直到回合结束。

965278.oracleText: When this creature enters, another target Human you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
965278.translation: 当此生物进场时，另一个目标由你操控的人类得+2/+2直到回合结束。

965280.oracleText: Delirium — When Ishkanah enters, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, create three 1/2 green Spider creature tokens with reach.
965280.translation: 躁狂～当墓寡妇伊什卡娜进场时，若你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，则派出三个1/2绿色，具延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

965287.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may discard a land card. If you do, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
965287.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以弃一张地牌。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

965290.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, that creature becomes a copy of this creature.
965290.translation: 每当此生物对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，该生物成为此生物的复制品。

965295.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a 3/2 colorless Eldrazi Horror creature token.
965295.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个3/2无色奥札奇／惊惧兽衍生生物。

965298.oracleText: When this creature enters, each other creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf gets +0/+3 until end of turn.
965298.translation: 当此生物进场时，每个由你操控且为狼或狼人的其他生物各得+0/+3直到回合结束。

965313.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, if you have no cards in hand, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
965313.translation: 当此生物进场或攻击时，若你没有手牌，则血厅僧侣对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

965316.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, surveil 3.
965316.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，刺探3。

965319.oracleText: When this creature enters, other Humans you control get +1/+1 and gain lifelink until end of turn.
965319.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的其他人类得+1/+1且获得系命异能。

965323.oracleText: Delirium — When this creature enters, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, creatures with power 2 or less can't block this turn.
965323.translation: 躁狂～当此生物进场时，若你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，则力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

965331.oracleText: Sorin deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life.
965331.translation: 凛仇索霖对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。

965345.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform Ulrich.
965345.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若某牌手上回合施放了两个或更多咒语，则转化服众首领乌力奇。

965348.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if each player has 10 or less life, transform this artifact.
965348.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若每位牌手的总生命都为10或更少，则转化此神器。

965352.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses 3 life.
965352.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每位对手各失去3点生命。

965356.oracleText: This creature can't attack or block unless a player has no cards in hand.
965356.translation: 除非某位牌手没有手牌，否则此生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

965359.oracleText: When equipped creature transforms, transform this Equipment.
965359.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物转化时，转化此武具。

965364.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile target creature card from your graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's 1/1, it's a Spirit in addition to its other types, and it has flying. Create a black Zombie creature token with power equal to that card's power and toughness equal to that card's toughness.
965364.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该牌的复制品，但它是1/1，额外具有精怪此类别，且具有飞行异能。派出一个黑色灵俑衍生生物，其力量等同于该牌的力量，其防御力等同于该牌的防御力。

965367.oracleText: Whenever this Equipment becomes unattached from a permanent, sacrifice that permanent.
965367.translation: 每当此武具从永久物上卸装时，牺牲该永久物。

965373.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
965373.translation: {o2}，牺牲此生物：从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。然后洗牌。

965375.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal an Island or Swamp card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
965375.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张海岛或沼泽牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

965378.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Swamp or Mountain card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
965378.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张沼泽或山脉牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

965380.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Forest or Plains card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
965380.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张树林或平原牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

965383.oracleText: As this land enters, you may reveal a Mountain or Forest card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
965383.translation: 于此地进场时，你可以从你手上展示一张山脉或树林牌。如果你未如此作，则此地须横置进场。

965393.oracleText: When this creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. If that creature is a Human, put two +1/+1 counters on it instead.
965393.translation: 当此生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。如果该生物是人类，则改为在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

965420.oracleText: {oB}: Transform this creature. Activate only if you control five or more Vampires.
965420.translation: {oB}：转化此生物。只能于你操控五个或更多吸血鬼时起动。

965434.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, it deals that much damage to each creature that player controls.
965434.translation: 每当此生物对一位牌手造成战斗伤害时，它对每个由该牌手操控的生物各造成等量的伤害。

965446.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
965446.translation: {oR}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

965454.oracleText: When this creature enters, gain control of target permanent until end of turn. Untap that permanent. It gains haste until end of turn.
965454.translation: 当此生物进场时，获得目标永久物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该永久物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

965458.oracleText: This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of slime counters on Gutter Grime.
965458.translation: 此衍生物的力量与防御力各等同于水沟污迹上的黏菌指示物数量。

965459.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, put a slime counter on this enchantment, then create a green Ooze creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of slime counters on Gutter Grime."
965459.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，在此结界上放置一个黏菌指示物，然后派出一个绿色流浆衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物之力量与防御力各等同于水沟污迹上的黏菌指示物数量。」

965462.oracleText: Morbid — When this creature enters, if a creature died this turn, you gain 5 life.

965498.oracleText: When this artifact enters, put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.

965502.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return a creature card at random from your graveyard to your hand.

965644.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.

965649.oracleText: As long as this creature is equipped, it has first strike and lifelink.

965658.oracleText: Metalcraft — When this creature enters, if you control three or more artifacts, this creature gets +3/+3 and gains haste until end of turn.

965663.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, creatures with power 1 or less can't block this turn.

965694.oracleText: Celebration — This creature gets +0/+2 as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

966179.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Discard a card: Return this creature to its owner's hand.
966179.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，弃一张牌：将此生物移回其拥有者手上。

966190.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifacts you control enter, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature. This ability triggers only once each turn.
966190.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个神器进场时，在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

966204.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it isn't a token, create two tokens that are copies of it.
966204.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它不是衍生物，则派出两个为其复制品的衍生物。

966205.oracleText: When this creature dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
966205.translation: 当此生物死去时，在每个由你操控且名称为粗野三人众的生物上各放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于死去者的力量。

966208.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a Food: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
966208.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个食品：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

966212.oracleText: This creature has haste as long as you own a card in exile that has an Adventure.
966212.translation: 只要放逐区中有由你拥有之具历险的牌，此生物便具有敏捷异能。

966222.oracleText: {o5oGoG}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Foods you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
966222.translation: {o5oGoG}，牺牲此结界：由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的食品数量。只能于法术时机起动。

966227.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control enters, you may pay {o2}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
966227.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界进场时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

966240.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one or more — 
• Return target card you own in exile that has an Adventure to your hand. 
• Put target card you don't own in exile that has an Adventure on the bottom of its owner's library. 
• Exile target player's graveyard.
966240.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项或多项～ 
•将目标在放逐区中由你拥有且具历险的牌移回你手上。 
•将目标在放逐区中不由你拥有且具历险的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。 
•放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

966255.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
966255.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

966264.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was bargained, exile target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
966264.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已加码，则放逐目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

966267.oracleText: When this enchantment enters and whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, draw a card.
966267.translation: 当此结界进场和每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，抓一张牌。

966270.oracleText: {o1oG}: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
966270.translation: {o1oG}：此生物本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

966279.oracleText: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {oX} less to activate, where X is Agatha's power. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
966279.translation: 由你操控的生物之起动式异能减少{oX}来起动，X为巫鼎镬阿加莎的力量。此效应无法将该费用中的法术力减少到少于一点法术力。

966287.oracleText: Celebration — Whenever Ash attacks, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Ash.
966287.translation: 欢庆～每当舞会红人灰钴娘攻击时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则在灰钴娘上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

966293.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a Monster Role token attached to it.
966293.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个怪物角色衍生物并贴附于其上。

966294.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an Aura attached to this creature: This creature fights target creature you don't control. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
966294.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个贴附在此生物上的灵气：此生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。如果本回合中后者将死去，则改为将它放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

966303.oracleText: When Greta enters, create a Food token.
966303.translation: 当甘饴村之灾格蕾特进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

966318.oracleText: {oX}: This creature becomes a copy of target creature card in your graveyard with mana value X, except it has flying and this ability. Activate only as a sorcery.
966318.translation: {oX}：选择目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值为X的生物牌。此生物成为该牌的复制品，但它具有飞行与此异能。只能于法术时机起动。

966320.oracleText: When Neva enters, return target creature or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
966320.translation: 当梦魇缠身白涅娃进场时，将目标生物或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

966333.oracleText: When Sharae enters, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
966333.translation: 当迷醉渊的莎蕾进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

966336.oracleText: When Syr Armont enters, create a Monster Role token attached to another target creature you control.
966336.translation: 当救赎者娅蒙爵士进场时，派出一个怪物角色衍生物，并贴附在另一个目标由你操控的生物上。

966339.oracleText: As Talion enters, choose a number between 1 and 10.
966339.translation: 于仁慈仙王塔莱恩进场时，选择一个1到10之间的数字。

966344.oracleText: Whenever Totentanz or another nontoken creature you control dies, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This token can't block."
966344.translation: 每当鼠群笛手托腾坦或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

966354.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose target enchantment you control that doesn't have the same name as another permanent you control. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it isn't legendary. If the token is an Aura, untap Yenna, then scry 2. Activate only as a sorcery.
966354.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择目标由你操控的结界，且其不能与由你操控的其他永久物同名。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它不是传奇。如果该衍生物是灵气，则重置赤牙砦摄政叶娜，然后占卜2。只能于法术时机起动。

966360.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature that died under your control this turn.
966360.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于本回合中在你操控下死去的生物数量。

966371.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token. If you don't, tap this creature.
966371.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲一个神器，结界或衍生物。若你未如此作，则横置此生物。

966391.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+0 for each Aura and Equipment attached to Kellan.
966391.translation: 仙儿血脉凯澜上每贴附一个灵气和武具，由你操控的其他生物便得+1/+0。

966395.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn.
966395.translation: 当此生物死去时，直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以从你的坟墓场中将它作为历险施放。

966398.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature gains double strike until end of turn.
966398.translation: 每当此生物于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时攻击，此生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

966410.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, this creature deals 1 damage to that player.
966410.translation: 每当任一对手施放法术力值等于或小于3的咒语时，此生物对该牌手造成1点伤害。

966413.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
966413.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

966418.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
966418.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

966439.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life and draw a card.
966439.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

966464.oracleText: Syr Ginger has trample, hexproof, and haste as long as an opponent controls a planeswalker.
966464.translation: 只要任一对手操控鹏洛客，封餐绝点姜饼爵士便具有践踏、辟邪与敏捷异能。

966469.oracleText: This artifact deals 2 damage to target creature.
966469.translation: 此神器对目标生物造成2点伤害。

966471.oracleText: Sacrifice this artifact. You gain 3 life.
966471.translation: 牺牲此神器。你获得3点生命。

966472.oracleText:
{o2}, {oT}: Choose one that hasn't been chosen — 
• This artifact deals 2 damage to target creature. 
• Tap target creature. 
• Sacrifice this artifact. You gain 3 life.
966472.translation:
{o2}，{oT}：选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ 
•此神器对目标生物造成2点伤害。 
•横置目标生物。 
•牺牲此神器。你获得3点生命。

966475.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return target card that has an Adventure from your graveyard to your hand.
966475.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲此地：将目标具历险的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

966478.oracleText: {o1oRoW}: This land becomes a 2/2 red and white Ox creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
966478.translation: {o1oRoW}：此地成为2/2，红白双色的牛生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

966479.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
966479.translation: 每当此地攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

966481.oracleText: {o2oBoG}: This land becomes a 4/4 black and green Horror creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
966481.translation: {o2oBoG}：此地成为4/4，黑绿双色的惊惧兽生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

966482.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, create a Food token and exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
966482.translation: 每当此地攻击时，派出一个食品衍生物，并将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

966484.oracleText: {o2oWoB}: This land becomes a 1/4 white and black Nightmare creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
966484.translation: {o2oWoB}：此地成为1/4，白黑双色的梦魇生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

966485.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, defending player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
966485.translation: 每当此地攻击时，防御牌手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

966487.oracleText: {oUoR}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 2/1 blue and red Elemental creature with "During your turn, this creature has first strike." It's still a land.
966487.translation: {oUoR}：直到回合结束，此地成为2/1，蓝红双色的元素生物，且具有「于你的回合中，此生物具有先攻异能。」它仍然是地。

966490.oracleText: {o3oGoU}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 5/5 green and blue Plant creature with trample. It's still a land.
966490.translation: {o3oGoU}：直到回合结束，此地成为5/5，绿蓝双色，具践踏异能的植物生物。它仍然是地。

966491.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, up to one other target creature has base power and toughness 3/3 until end of turn.
966491.translation: 每当此地攻击时，至多另一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为3/3直到回合结束。

966494.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. Create a Food token.
966494.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。派出一个食品衍生物。

966499.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
966499.translation: 欢庆～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

966501.oracleText: Return all creatures to their owners' hands. For each opponent who controlled a creature returned this way, you create two 1/1 blue Faerie creature tokens with flying and "This token can block only creatures with flying."
966501.translation: 将所有生物移回其拥有者手上。每有一位所操控之生物被此法移回的对手，你便派出两个1/1蓝色仙灵衍生生物，且具有飞行与「此衍生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

966508.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Food, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This token can't block."
966508.translation: 每当你牺牲食品时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

966512.oracleText: When this creature enters, sacrifice any number of artifacts, enchantments, and/or tokens, then draw that many cards.
966512.translation: 当此生物进场时，牺牲任意数量的神器，结界和／或衍生物，然后抓等量的牌。

966522.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each attacking creature. If a Rat is attacking, this creature gains trample until end of turn.
966522.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每有一个进行攻击的生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。若有老鼠正进行攻击，则此生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

966524.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create two 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This token can't block." Then if you control five or more Rats, each Rat you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
966524.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，派出两个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」然后若你操控五个或更多老鼠，则每个由你操控的老鼠各得+2/+0直到回合结束。

966526.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks alone, create a Food token.
966526.translation: 每当此生物单独攻击时，派出一个食品衍生物。

966530.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice a Food. If you do, attacking creatures get +1/+1 and gain trample until end of turn.
966530.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，进行攻击的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

966533.oracleText: Whenever a token you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
966533.translation: 每当一个由你操控的衍生物进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

966534.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target attacking creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
966534.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

966591.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, for each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
966591.translation: 当此结界进场时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～放逐至多一个目标由该牌手操控的非地永久物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

966614.oracleText: {o1oU}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Draw a card.

966617.oracleText: You may have this enchantment enter as a copy of any enchantment on the battlefield.
966617.translation: 你可以使此结界当成战场上任一结界的复制品来进入战场。

966625.oracleText: When this enchantment is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw three cards.
966625.translation: 当此结界从战场进入坟墓场时，抓三张牌。

966677.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {o1}. If you do, this enchantment deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
966677.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则此结界对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

966684.oracleText: Whenever a creature is dealt damage, this enchantment deals that much damage to that creature's controller.
966684.translation: 每当一个生物受到伤害时，此结界对该生物的操控者造成等量的伤害。

966692.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent controls three or more creatures, sacrifice this enchantment, search your library for up to two creature cards, put those cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
966692.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若某对手操控三个或更多生物，则牺牲此结界，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，将这些牌放进在战场，然后洗牌。

966710.oracleText: As this Aura enters, choose a color.
966710.translation: 于此灵气进场时，选择一种颜色。

966718.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
966718.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

966722.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying for each mana from a Cave spent to cast it.
966722.translation: 当此结界进场时，施放它时每支付过一点来自洞窟的法术力，便派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

966725.oracleText: When this artifact enters, search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 2 life.
966725.translation: 当此神器进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得2点生命。

966729.oracleText: When this artifact enters, create two 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens.
966729.translation: 当此神器进场时，派出两个1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物。

966735.oracleText: {oXoXoW}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy each artifact with mana value X.
966735.translation: {oXoXoW}，牺牲此生物：消灭所有法术力值为X的神器。

966741.oracleText: When this artifact enters, exile target artifact or creature an opponent controls until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
966741.translation: 当此神器进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的神器或生物，直到此神器离开战场为止。

966757.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
966757.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。当你如此作时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

966769.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each creature that left the battlefield under your control this turn.
966769.translation: 本回合中每有一个生物在你操控下离开战场，便在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

966771.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each creature that left the battlefield under your control this turn. 
• You gain 2 life and scry 2. 
• Exile target player's graveyard.
966771.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•本回合中每有一个生物在你操控下离开战场，便在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•你获得2点生命且占卜2。 
•放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

966774.oracleText: When this creature enters, creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn.
966774.translation: 当此生物进场时，由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

966777.oracleText: When this creature dies, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
966777.translation: 当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

966778.oracleText: When this creature is exiled from the battlefield while you're activating a craft ability, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
966778.translation: 当此生物于你起动任一化炼异能期间被从战场上放逐时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

966783.oracleText: When this creature dies, target creature you control explores.
966783.translation: 当此生物死去时，令目标由你操控的生物勘察。

966792.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}: Transform this land. Activate only if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn and only as a sorcery.
966792.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}：转化此地。 只能于你以三个或更多生物攻击的回合中起动，且仅限法术时机。

966796.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand. 
• Scry 3.
966796.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 
•占卜3。

966799.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature token.
966799.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物。

966814.oracleText: When this creature enters or dies, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
966814.translation: 当此生物进场或死去时，派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

966817.oracleText: When this artifact enters, it deals 5 damage to target tapped creature an opponent controls.
966817.translation: 当此神器进入战场时，它向目标由对手操控的已横置生物造成5点伤害。

966820.oracleText: Tap two other untapped artifacts you control: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
966820.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他神器：此载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

966823.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {o2oW}. When you do, tap target creature.
966823.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{o2oW}。若你如此作，横置目标生物。

966826.oracleText: Untap this creature during each other player's untap step.
966826.translation: 在每位其他牌手的重置步骤中重置此生物。

966828.oracleText: This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control.
966828.translation: 此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。

966829.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a white Gnome Soldier artifact creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control."
966829.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个白色地侏／士兵衍生神器生物，且具有「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。」

966830.oracleText: When Thousand Moons Smithy enters, create a white Gnome Soldier artifact creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control."
966830.translation: 当千月军锻冶场进场时，派出一个白色地侏／士兵衍生神器生物，且具有「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。」

966835.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell using mana produced by CARDNAME, create a white Gnome Soldier artifact creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control."
966835.translation: 每当你利用CARDNAME产生之法术力来施放神器或生物咒语，派出一个白色地侏／士兵衍生神器生物，且具有「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。」

966836.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell using mana produced by Barracks of the Thousand, create a white Gnome Soldier artifact creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control."
966836.translation: 每当你利用千月军兵营产生之法术力来施放神器或生物咒语，派出一个白色地侏／士兵衍生神器生物，且具有「此衍生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。」

966839.oracleText: {oW}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.

966841.oracleText: When this artifact enters, if you cast it, for each player, choose a creature with power 2 or less that player controls. Then destroy all creatures except creatures chosen this way.
966841.translation: 当此神器进场时，若它经你施放，则为每位牌手各选择一个由其操控且力量等于或小于2的生物。然后消灭所有生物，但以此法选中的生物除外。

966848.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
966848.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

966850.oracleText: As long as this creature has three or more counters on it, it has flying and vigilance.
966850.translation: 只要此生物上有三个或更多指示物，它便具有飞行与警戒异能。

966851.oracleText: Tap three untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Scry 1. Activate only as a sorcery.
966851.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。占卜1。只能于法术时机起动。

966861.oracleText: This artifact enters with three net counters on it.
966861.translation: 此神器进场时上面有三个罗网指示物。

966862.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a net counter from this artifact: Tap another target nonland permanent. Its activated abilities can't be activated for as long as it remains tapped.
966862.translation: {oT}，从此神器上移去一个罗网指示物：横置另一个目标非地永久物。于该永久物持续横置的时段内，其起动式异能都不能起动。

966866.oracleText: {o3oU}, {oT}: Draw a card for each artifact you control, then put this artifact into its owner's library third from the top.
966866.translation: {o3oU}，{oT}：你每操控一个神器，便抓一张牌，然后将此神器置于其拥有者的牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

966875.oracleText: Descend 4 — When this creature enters, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, return up to one target nonland permanent other than this creature to its owner's hand.
966875.translation: 落坟4～当此生物进场时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则将至多一个目标此生物以外的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

966879.oracleText: Descend 4 — This creature has flying as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
966879.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，此生物便具有飞行异能。

966903.oracleText: Descend 4 — This creature gets +2/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
966903.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，此生物便得+2/+0。

966906.oracleText: {o1oU}: This creature gets +3/-3 until end of turn.

966910.oracleText: When this artifact enters, mill a card, then draw a card.
966910.translation: 当此神器进场时，磨一张牌，然后抓一张牌。

966914.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may tap or untap target artifact or creature.
966914.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以横置或重置目标神器或生物。

966916.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each player, choose up to one other target artifact or creature that player controls. For as long as this creature remains on the battlefield, the chosen permanents become Treasure artifacts with "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color" and lose all other abilities.
966916.translation: 当此生物进场时，为每位牌手各选择至多另一个目标由该牌手操控的神器或生物。于此生物仍在战场上的时段内，所选永久物成为珍宝神器，且具有「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力」，并失去所有其他异能。

966918.oracleText: When this artifact enters, tap up to one target artifact or creature and put two stun counters on it.
966918.translation: 当此神器进场时，横置至多一个目标神器或生物并在其上放置两个晕眩指示物。

966923.oracleText: Whenever Malcolm deals combat damage to a player, put a chorus counter on it. Draw a card, then discard a card. If there are four or more chorus counters on Malcolm, you may cast the discarded card without paying its mana cost.
966923.translation: 每当迷声恶棍马科姆对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个合韵指示物。抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。如果马科姆上有四个或更多合韵指示物，则你可以施放所弃之牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

966928.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
966928.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

966937.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Remove a time counter from this land.
966937.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。从此地上移去一个计时指指示物。

966938.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: Transform this land. Activate only if it has no time counters on it and only as a sorcery.
966938.translation: {o2oU}，{oT}：转化此地。只能于其上没有计时指示物时起动，且仅限法术时机。

966941.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
966941.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

966961.oracleText: As long as an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.
966961.translation: 只要本回合中有神器在你操控下进战场，此生物便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

966963.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of Caves you control plus the number of Cave cards in your graveyard. Put two of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
966963.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控的洞窟数量与你坟墓场中的洞窟牌数量之总和。将其中两张置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

966965.oracleText: When this Aura enters, you may mill two cards.
966965.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你可以磨两张牌。

966969.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a Map token.
966969.translation: 当此生物进入战场时，派出一个地图衍生物。

966972.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact or Pirate card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
966972.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张神器或海盗牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

966975.oracleText: When this creature enters, counter up to one target activated or triggered ability. If an ability of an artifact, creature, or planeswalker is countered this way, that permanent loses all abilities for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
966975.translation: 当此生物进场时，反击至多一个目标起动式或触发式异能。如果以此法反击神器，生物或鹏洛客的异能，则于此生物仍在战场上的时段内，该永久物失去所有异能。（不能以法术力异能为目标。）

966982.oracleText: Descend 8 — This Vehicle can't be blocked as long as there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
966982.translation: 落坟8～只要你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，此载具便不能被阻挡。

966986.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control an artifact, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
966986.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控神器则横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

966989.oracleText: When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, discover 3.
966989.translation: 当此灵气从战场进入坟墓场时，倾探3。

966992.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
966992.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各牺牲两个依其选择的生物。

967000.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}: Transform this land. Activate only if a player has one or fewer cards in hand and only as a sorcery.
967000.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}：转化此地。 只能于某牌手的手牌为一张或更少时起动，且仅限法术时机。

967012.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it, each player sacrifices all other creatures they control. Then each player returns all creature cards from their graveyard that weren't put there this way to the battlefield.
967012.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它经你施放，则每位牌手各牺牲所有由其操控的其他生物。然后每位牌手各从其坟墓场中将所有并非以此法进入该处的生物牌移回战场。

967015.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, create a 1/1 black Fungus creature token with "This token can't block."
967015.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则派出一个1/1黑色真菌衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

967018.oracleText: {o5oBoB}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Create a 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.
967018.translation: {o5oBoB}，牺牲此结界：派出一个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

967022.oracleText: Fathomless descent — When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
967022.translation: 落坟无边～当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。

967025.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 2/2 black Skeleton Pirate creature token.
967025.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个2/2黑色骷髅妖／海盗衍生生物。

967026.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return this enchantment to its owner's hand.
967026.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则你可以支付1点生命。若你如此作，则将此结界移回其拥有者手上。

967030.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may mill two cards.
967030.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以磨两张牌。

967033.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
967033.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

967036.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at target opponent's hand. You may exile a nonland card from it until this creature leaves the battlefield.
967036.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视目标牌手的手牌。你可以放逐其中一张非地牌直到此生物离开战场。

967039.oracleText: Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
967039.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，此生物便得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

967047.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. Put a dread counter on this enchantment. Then if there are three or more dread counters on it, transform it.
967047.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，它获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。在此结界上放置一个怖惧指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多怖惧指示物，则转化它。

967050.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}, Remove a dread counter from this land: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
967050.translation: {oB}，{oT}，从此地上移去一个怖惧指示物：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

967053.oracleText: When this creature dies, scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
967053.translation: 当此生物死去时，占卜1并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

967063.oracleText: When this artifact enters or is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
967063.translation: 当此神器进场或从战场进入坟墓场时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

967065.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
967065.translation: 每当此生物攻击总生命最高或与他者同为最高的牌手时，派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

967066.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while you have the most life or are tied for most life, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
967066.translation: 每当此生物于你是总生命最高或与他者同为最高的牌手时攻击，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

967071.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, return up to one target Vampire card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. You lose life equal to its mana value.
967071.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标吸血鬼牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。你失去等同于其法术力值的生命。

967073.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
967073.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得不灭异能。

967079.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, mill a card.
967079.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，磨一张牌。

967083.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent exiles a card from their hand.
967083.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手从其手上放逐一张牌。

967086.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
967086.translation: {oB}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

967088.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice this creature: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
967088.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲此生物：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

967091.oracleText: When this creature enters, surveil 2. Then for each card you put on top of your library, you draw a card and you lose 3 life.
967091.translation: 当此生物进场时，刺探2。然后你每将一张牌置于你的牌库顶，便抓一张牌且失去3点生命。

967095.oracleText: Descend 4 — Whenever this creature attacks, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
967095.translation: 落坟4～每当此生物攻击时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

967099.oracleText: When this creature dies, create two 1/1 black Fungus creature tokens with "This token can't block."
967099.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出两个1/1黑色真菌衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

967111.oracleText: When this artifact enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
967111.translation: 当此神器进场时，每位对手各牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

967117.oracleText: When this artifact enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it. That player discards that card.
967117.translation: 当此神器进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张神器或生物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

967122.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may mill two cards.
967122.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，你可以磨两张牌。

967125.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. It gains menace until end of turn.
967125.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得威慑直到回合结束。

967131.oracleText: Whenever another Dinosaur you control enters, you may have this creature's base power become equal to that creature's power until end of turn.
967131.translation: 每当另一个恐龙在你操控下进场时，你可以使此生物的基础力量成为等同于该生物的力量直到回合结束。

967141.oracleText: Whenever you cast a permanent spell using mana produced by Tecutlan, discover X, where X is that spell's mana value.
967141.translation: 每当你利用炙热裂缝蒂库澜产生之法术力来施放永久物咒语时，倾探X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

967144.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while you control two or more artifacts, it gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
967144.translation: 每当此生物于你操控两个或更多神器时攻击，它得+2/+1直到回合结束。

967152.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks or blocks while you control a Dinosaur, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
967152.translation: 每当此生物于你操控恐龙时攻击或阻挡，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

967170.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gains menace until end of turn.
967170.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

967179.oracleText: Whenever this artifact or another artifact you control enters, up to one target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. Then transform this artifact if you control four or more artifacts.
967179.translation: 每当此神器或另一个神器在你操控下进场时，直到回合结束，至多一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。然后如果你操控四个或更多神器，则转化此神器。

967192.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it, discover 3.
967192.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它经你施放，则倾探3。

967195.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact, this creature gets +1/+0 and has haste.
967195.translation: 只要你操控神器，此生物便得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

967210.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, it deals 5 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
967210.translation: 当此载具进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成5点伤害。

967217.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Transform this land. Activate only if red sources you controlled dealt 4 or more noncombat damage this turn and only as a sorcery.
967217.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：转化此地。 只能于由你操控的红色来源总共造成过4点或更多非战斗伤害的回合中起动，且仅限法术时机。

967220.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
967220.translation: {oT}：此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

967231.oracleText: When this artifact enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
967231.translation: 当此神器进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

967248.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: This creature deals 1 damage to each opponent. Activate only as a sorcery.
967248.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和/或生物：此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

967259.oracleText: {o2oR}, Discard this card: It deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
967259.translation: {o2oR}，弃掉此牌：它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

967266.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may reveal a Dinosaur card from your hand. If you do or if you control another Dinosaur, you gain 3 life.
967266.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从手上展示一张恐龙牌。若你如此作或你操控另一个恐龙，则你获得3点生命。

967269.oracleText: Descend 4 — This creature gets +3/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
967269.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，此生物便得+3/+0。

967274.oracleText: {o3oG}: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
967274.translation: {o3oG}：此生物本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

967279.oracleText: Descend 4 — When this creature enters, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
967279.translation: 落坟4～当此生物进场时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

967287.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card for each other Dinosaur you control.
967287.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个其他恐龙，便抓一张牌。

967289.oracleText: This artifact enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
967289.translation: 此神器进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

967290.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, put a +1/+1 counter on this artifact.
967290.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物死去时，在此神器上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

967293.oracleText: When Ghalta enters, put any number of creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
967293.translation: 当狂奔暴龙戈厄塔进场时，将任意数量的生物牌从你手上放进战场。

967304.oracleText: When Huatli enters, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
967304.translation: 当合众诗人华特莉进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

967309.oracleText: This Saga gains "Creatures you control have ‘{oT}: Add {oR}, {oG}, or {oW}.'"
967309.translation: 此传纪获得「由你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加{oR}，{oG}或{oW}。」」

967321.oracleText: You may cast Dinosaur creature spells from among cards you own exiled with this creature. If you cast a spell this way, that creature enters with a finality counter on it.
967321.translation: 你可以从由你拥有且以此生物放逐的牌之中施放恐龙生物咒语。如果你以此法施放咒语，则该生物进场时上面有一个终命指示物。

967326.oracleText: When this artifact enters, distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.
967326.translation: 当此神器进场时，将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标由你操控的生物。

967330.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain life equal to the mana value of the exiled card used to craft it.
967330.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得若干生命，其数量等同于用以化炼它所放逐之牌的法术力值。

967333.oracleText: When this creature enters, it explores X times.
967333.translation: 当此生物进场时，令它勘察X次。

967335.oracleText: When this artifact enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
967335.translation: 当此神器进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

967344.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target attacking creature gains trample until end of turn.
967344.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

967348.oracleText: Descend 4 — Whenever this creature attacks, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
967348.translation: 落坟4～每当此生物攻击时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

967352.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token.
967352.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个3/3绿色恐龙衍生生物。

967358.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}: Transform this land. Activate only if you control ten or more permanents and only as a sorcery.
967358.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}：转化此地。只能于你操控十个或更多永久物时起动，且仅限法术时机。

967366.oracleText: {o2}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
967366.translation: {o2}：此生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

967369.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while you don't control another Dinosaur, put a stun counter on it.
967369.translation: 每当此生物于你未操控另一个恐龙时攻击，在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

967373.oracleText: {o2oG}: This creature explores. Activate only as a sorcery.
967373.translation: {o2oG}：令此生物勘察。只能于法术时机起动。

967377.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create a Map token.
967377.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，派出一个地图衍生物。

967382.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you put a Cave onto the battlefield this way, you gain 4 life.
967382.translation: 当此结界进场时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。如果你以此法将洞窟放进战场，则你获得4点生命。

967392.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, target creature you control explores.
967392.translation: 当此结界进场时，令目标由你操控的生物勘察。

967393.oracleText: When a land you control enters, if you control seven or more lands, transform this enchantment.
967393.translation: 当一个地在你操控下进场时，若你操控七个或更多地，则转化此结界。

967402.oracleText: Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, Akawalli gets +2/+2 and has trample.
967402.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，阿卡瓦利便得+2/+2且具有践踏异能。

967430.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, this creature explores. Then you may have it become a copy of another creature you control until end of turn.
967430.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，令此生物勘察。然后你可以使它成为另一个由你操控的生物之复制品直到回合结束。

967433.oracleText: When Itzquinth enters, you may pay {o2}. When you do, target Dinosaur you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.
967433.translation: 当基撒斯之后伊金斯进场时，你可以支付{o2}。当你如此作时，目标由你操控的恐龙对另一个目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

967436.oracleText: Whenever Kellan attacks, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card with mana value 3 or less, put it into your hand. Otherwise, you may put it into your graveyard.
967436.translation: 每当凯澜攻击时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌，则将它置于你手上。若否，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

967442.oracleText: When this artifact enters, create a 4/4 white and blue Golem artifact creature token.
967442.translation: 当此神器进场时，派出一个4/4，白蓝双色的魔像衍生神器生物。

967446.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 4/4 white and blue Golem artifact creature token. Activate only if this artifact or another artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
967446.translation: {oT}：派出一个4/4， 白蓝双色的魔像衍生神器生物。只能于此神器或另一个神器在你操控下进战场的回合中起动。

967454.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create X 1/1 black Fungus creature tokens with "This token can't block," where X is the number of times you descended this turn.
967454.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出X个1/1黑色真菌衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡」，X为你本回合的落坟次数。

967458.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on Nicanzil.
967458.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察到非地牌时，在水流通导师妮坎琪上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

967460.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 0/1 green Dinosaur Egg creature tokens.
967460.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个0/1绿色恐龙／蛋衍生生物。

967481.oracleText: Descend 8 — {o4oUoB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard and only as a sorcery.
967481.translation: 落坟8～{o4oUoB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌时起动，且仅限法术时机。

967487.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, each opponent may discard a card or sacrifice a permanent of their choice. Zoyowa deals 3 damage to each opponent who didn't.
967487.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则每位对手各可以弃一张牌或牺牲一个依其选择的永久物。熔岩舌佐佑瓦向每位未如此作的对手各造成3点伤害。

967489.oracleText: {o5}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Discover 5. Activate only as a sorcery.
967489.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：倾探5。只能于法术时机起动。

967496.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card or Cave card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
967496.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或洞窟牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

967498.oracleText: Whenever you're dealt combat damage, the attacking player gains control of this artifact and untaps it.
967498.translation: 每当你受到战斗伤害时，攻击牌手获得此神器的操控权并将它重置。

967499.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Draw a card and put a point counter on this artifact. Then if it has five or more point counters on it, sacrifice it and create a Treasure token.
967499.translation: {o2}，{oT}：抓一张牌并在此神器上放置一个得分指示物。然后如果其上有五个或更多得分指示物，则牺牲它并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

967501.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Exile up to four target cards from a single graveyard. Activate only as a sorcery.
967501.translation: 牺牲此生物：将至多四张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

967502.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may pay {o4}. If you do, discover 4.
967502.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以支付{o4}。若你如此作，则倾探4。

967505.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, exile target card from an opponent's graveyard.
967505.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将目标牌从任一对手的坟墓场放逐。

967514.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Transform Matzalantli. Activate only if there are four or more permanent types among cards in your graveyard. (Artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, land, and planeswalker are permanent types.)
967514.translation: {o4}，{oT}：转化通核伟门玛察栏蒂。只能于你坟墓场中牌的永久物类别有四种或更多时起动。（永久物的类别包括神器、战役、生物、结界、地以及鹏洛客。）

967529.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a basic land card or Cave card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
967529.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或洞窟牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

967535.oracleText: {oT}: For each color among the exiled cards used to craft this creature, add one mana of that color.
967535.translation: {oT}：用以化炼此生物所放逐之牌中每包括一种颜色，便加一点该色的法术力。

967544.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create a number of 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
967544.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，派出若干1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物，其数量等同于其力量。

967545.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
967545.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个神器：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

967555.oracleText: {o2}: This land becomes a 3/3 Elemental creature until end of turn. It's still a Cave land. Activate only if the number of other Caves you control plus the number of Cave cards in your graveyard is three or greater.
967555.translation: {o2}：此地成为3/3元素生物直到回合结束。它仍然是洞窟地。只能于由你操控的其他洞窟数量与你坟墓场中的洞窟牌数量之总和等于或大于三时起动。

967558.oracleText: You may have this land enter tapped as a copy of any land card in a graveyard, except it's a Cave in addition to its other types.
967558.translation: 你可以使此地当成坟墓场中任一地牌的复制品来横置进场，但它额外具有洞窟此类别。

967563.oracleText: {o4oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Discover 4. Activate only as a sorcery.
967563.translation: {o4oU}，{oT}，牺牲此地：倾探4。只能于法术时机起动。

967565.oracleText: {o4oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Discover 4. Activate only as a sorcery.
967565.translation: {o4oW}，{oT}，牺牲此地：倾探4。只能于法术时机起动。

967567.oracleText: {o4oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Discover 4. Activate only as a sorcery.
967567.translation: {o4oB}，{oT}，牺牲此地：倾探4。只能于法术时机起动。

967569.oracleText: {o4oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Discover 4. Activate only as a sorcery.
967569.translation: {o4oG}，{oT}，牺牲此地：倾探4。只能于法术时机起动。

967571.oracleText: {o4oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Discover 4. Activate only as a sorcery.
967571.translation: {o4oR}，{oT}，牺牲此地：倾探4。只能于法术时机起动。

967573.oracleText: When this land enters, exile up to three target cards from graveyards.
967573.translation: 当此地进场时，将至多三张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

967578.oracleText: {o1oWoU}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 2/3 white and blue Bird creature with flying. It's still a land.
967578.translation: {o1oWoU}：直到回合结束，此地成为2/3，白蓝双色，具飞行异能的鸟生物。它仍然是地。

967579.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, create a Map token.
967579.translation: 每当此地攻击时，派出一个地图衍生物。

967581.oracleText: {o2oGoW}: This land becomes a 3/3 green and white Llama creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
967581.translation: {o2oGoW}：此地成为3/3，绿白双色的骆马生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

967582.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
967582.translation: 每当此地攻击时，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

967584.oracleText: {o2oUoB}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 4/4 blue and black Shark creature with deathtouch. It's still a land.
967584.translation: {o2oUoB}：直到回合结束，此地成为4/4，蓝黑双色，具死触异能的鲨鱼生物。它仍然是地。

967585.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, target player mills four cards.
967585.translation: 每当此地攻击时，目标牌手磨四张牌。

967587.oracleText: {o2oRoG}: This land becomes a 3/4 red and green Dinosaur creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
967587.translation: {o2oRoG}：此地成为3/4，红绿双色的恐龙生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

967588.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, another target attacking creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn. Untap that creature.
967588.translation: 每当此地攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。重置该生物。

967590.oracleText: {o1oBoR}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 2/3 black and red Insect creature with menace. It's still a land.
967590.translation: {o1oBoR}：直到回合结束，此地成为2/3，黑红双色，具威慑异能的昆虫生物。它仍然是地。

967591.oracleText: Whenever this land attacks, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
967591.translation: 每当此地攻击时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

967595.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. That player may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. You create a Treasure token.
967595.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此地：消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。该牌手可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

967615.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, target creature that crewed it this turn explores.
967615.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，令目标本回合中搭载它的生物勘察。

967640.oracleText: When this artifact enters, it deals 6 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
967640.translation: 当此神器战场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成6点伤害。

967699.oracleText: When Admiral Brass enters, mill four cards.
967699.translation: 当不沉传奇霸司总帅进场时，磨四张牌。

967705.oracleText: Whenever Pantlaza or another Dinosaur you control enters, you may discover X, where X is that creature's toughness. Do this only once each turn.
967705.translation: 每当潘塔札或另一个由你操控的恐龙进场时，你可以倾探X，X为该生物的防御力。每回合只能如此作一次。

967708.oracleText: Whenever Xolatoyac enters or attacks, put a flood counter on target land. That land is an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it.
967708.translation: 每当笑面浪涛索拉托雅进场或攻击时，在目标地上放置一个洪水指示物。只要该地上有洪水指示物，它便额外具有海岛此类别。

967711.oracleText: When this creature enters, create X Treasure tokens, where X is the number of artifacts and enchantments your opponents control.
