967711.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出X个珍宝衍生物，X为由对手操控之神器和结界的总数量。

967714.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
967714.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

967717.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
967717.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

967722.oracleText: This creature has haste as long as an opponent has 10 or less life.
967722.translation: 只要任一对手的总生命为10或更少，此生物便具有敏捷异能。

967723.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
967723.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，你可以将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

967730.oracleText: When this creature enters, all suspected creatures are no longer suspected.
967730.translation: 当此生物进场时，所有已遭疑的生物不再遭疑。

967731.oracleText: When this creature dies, you gain 3 life and suspect up to one target creature an opponent controls.
967731.translation: 当此生物死去时，你获得3点生命且怀疑至多一个目标由对手操控的生物。

967738.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, exile up to X other target creatures from the battlefield and/or creature cards from graveyards.
967738.translation: 当欧瑞梨的雪恨使此生物翻回正面时，将若干其他目标战场上的生物和／或坟墓场中的生物牌从该处放逐，上述数量至多为X。

967739.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled cards to their owners' hands.
967739.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，将所放逐的牌移回其拥有者手上。

967775.oracleText: When this Aura enters, target creature you control other than enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
967775.translation: 当此灵气进场时，直到回合结束，目标所结附生物以外由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得警戒异能。

967779.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn. Untap them.
967779.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。将它们重置。

967782.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, return another target permanent you control to its owner's hand and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
967782.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，将另一个目标由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上，并在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

967789.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control with power 2 or less.
967789.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，在目标由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

967791.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
967791.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

967799.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this Equipment: You gain 3 life.

967800.oracleText: When this Equipment is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, create two 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
967800.translation: 当此武具从战场进入坟墓场时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则派出两个1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

967806.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.
967806.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。你获得2点生命。

967811.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, this creature gains flying until end of turn.
967811.translation: 每当另一个力量等于或小于2的生物在你操控下进场时，此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

967814.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
967814.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

967834.oracleText: Whenever another Detective you control enters and whenever a Detective you control is turned face up, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
967834.translation: 每当另一个侦探在你操控下进场和每当一个由你操控的侦探翻回正面时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

967836.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}: Tap target creature. You may put a stun counter on it. If you do, put a stun counter on this creature.
967836.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}：横置目标生物。你可以在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置一个晕眩指示物。

967839.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
967839.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

967841.oracleText: {o1oW}, Collect evidence 2: This creature becomes a Human Detective with base power and toughness 4/4 and gains vigilance.
967841.translation: {o1oW}，搜证2：此生物成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的人类／侦探且获得警戒异能。

967843.oracleText: {o2oW}, Collect evidence 4: If this creature is a Detective, it becomes a legendary creature named Mileva, the Stalwart, it has base power and toughness 5/5, and it gains "Other creatures you control have indestructible."
967843.translation: {o2oW}，搜证4：如果此生物是侦探，则它成为名称为坚兵米勒娃的传奇生物，其基础力量与防御力为5/5，且获得「由你操控的其他生物具有不灭异能。」

967845.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, exile another target nonland permanent. If you controlled it, return it to the battlefield tapped. Otherwise, its controller creates a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
967845.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，放逐另一个目标非地永久物。如果你操控它，则将它横置移回战场。若否，则其操控者派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

967850.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this Equipment: Draw a card.

967853.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your graveyard, hand and/or library for a card named Magnifying Glass and/or a card named Thinking Cap and put them onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
967853.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的坟墓场，手牌和／或牌库中搜寻一张名称为放大镜的牌和／或一张名称为思考帽的牌，并将它们放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

967859.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, draw a card.
967859.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

967864.oracleText: As this creature is turned face up, put four +1/+1 counters on it.
967864.translation: 于此生物翻回正面时，在其上放置四个+1/+1指示物。

967887.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, gain control of target permanent you own but don't control.
967887.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，获得目标由你拥有但不由你操控之永久物的操控权。

967889.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, target opponent gains control of any number of target permanents you control. Draw a card for each one they gained control of this way.
967889.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，目标对手获得任意数量目标由你操控之永久物的操控权。该牌手每以此法获得一个永久物的操控权，你便抓一张牌。

967892.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target creature. If evidence was collected, put a stun counter on it.
967892.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标生物。如果已搜证，则在后者上放置一个晕眩指示物。

967894.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, cloak the top card of your library, then attach this Equipment to it.
967894.translation: 当此武具进场时，匿伏你的牌库顶牌，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

967896.oracleText: {o1oU}: Return this Equipment to its owner's hand.
967896.translation: {o1oU}：将此武具移回其拥有者手上。

967910.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, return another target creature to its owner's hand.
967910.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，将另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

967922.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as you've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
967922.translation: 只要你本回合中牺牲过神器，此生物便不能被阻挡。

967926.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to one other target creature to its owner's hand. If you controlled it, investigate.
967926.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。如果你操控它，则探查。

967931.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, this creature loses defender and gains vigilance until end of turn.
967931.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，此生物失去守军异能并获得警戒异能。

967934.oracleText: As long as there are no cards in your library, this creature has base power and toughness 10/10 and has flying and vigilance.
967934.translation: 只要你牌库没有牌，此生物的基础力量与防御力便为10/10且具有飞行与警戒异能。

967936.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, tap X target creatures. Put a stun counter on each of those creatures you don't control.
967936.translation: 当此结界进场时，横置X个目标生物。在其中不由你操控的生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

967939.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
967939.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

967948.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Detective you control enters and whenever a Detective you control is turned face up, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
967948.translation: 每当此生物或另一个侦探在你操控下进场和每当一个由你操控的侦探翻回正面时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

967959.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an instant or sorcery card or a creature card with flying.
967959.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓两张牌。然后除非你弃一张瞬间或法术牌或一张具飞行异能的生物牌，否则弃两张牌。

967970.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, target opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
967970.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，目标对手失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

967972.oracleText: When this creature enters, suspect it.
967972.translation: 当此生物进场时，怀疑它。

967973.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
967973.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

967974.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, target opponent loses that much life.
967974.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，目标对手失去等量的生命。

967977.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you gain 1 life and surveil 1.
967977.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你获得1点生命且刺探1。

967994.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you mill two cards.
967994.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你磨两张牌。

967995.oracleText: {o1oB}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
967995.translation: {o1oB}：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

968002.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent creates two 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
968002.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手派出两个1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

968003.oracleText: When this creature dies, each opponent loses 3 life.
968003.translation: 当此生物死去时，每位对手各失去3点生命。

968006.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, put an impostor counter on each creature you control.
968006.translation: 当此结界进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个冒名指示物。

968016.oracleText: {o2oBoB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create two tapped 1/1 black Bat creature tokens with flying.
968016.translation: {o2oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出两个已横置的1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

968029.oracleText: When this creature enters, you lose 3 life.
968029.translation: 当此生物进场时，你失去3点生命。

968038.oracleText: When this artifact enters, look at the top four cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 2 life.
968038.translation: 当此神器进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。你失去2点生命。

968046.oracleText: {o2oB}: If this creature is suspected, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Otherwise, suspect it.
968046.translation: {o2oB}：如果此生物已遭疑，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则怀疑它。

968049.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace and lifelink until end of turn.
968049.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+0且获得威慑与系命异能。

968061.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn.
968061.translation: 当此结界进场时，目标生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。

968068.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. When you do, exile target creature an opponent controls.
968068.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物。

968101.oracleText: When this Equipment is turned face up, attach it to target creature you control.
968101.translation: 当此武具翻回正面时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

968106.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice this enchantment: Put all cards exiled with this enchantment into their owners' hands.
968106.translation: {o1oR}，弃掉你的手牌，牺牲此结界：将所有以此结界放逐的牌置于其拥有者手上。

968108.oracleText: When this Aura enters, suspect enchanted creature.
968108.translation: 当此灵气进场时，怀疑所结附的生物。

968109.oracleText: {o2oR}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
968109.translation: {o2oR}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

968112.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice an artifact. When you do, this creature deals 3 damage to any target.
968112.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器。当你如此作时，此生物对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

968116.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and add {oR}.
968116.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并加{oR}。

968132.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control enter, if this creature is suspected, you may suspect one of the other creatures. If you do, this creature is no longer suspected.
968132.translation: 每当一个或数个其他生物在你操控下进场时，若此生物已遭疑，则你可以怀疑这些其他生物中的一个。若你如此作，则此生物不再遭疑。

968135.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
968135.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

968145.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
968145.translation: 牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

968146.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Destroy up to one target artifact. 
• Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
968146.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•消灭至多一个目标神器。 
•牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

968150.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, face-down spells you cast this turn cost {o1} less to cast.
968150.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你本回合中施放之牌面朝下的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

968155.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may collect evidence X. When you do, this creature deals X damage to each creature and planeswalker that player controls.
968155.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以搜证X。当你如此作时，此生物对由该牌手操控的每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成X点伤害。

968158.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt 3 or more damage, investigate.
968158.translation: 每当此生物受到3点或更多伤害时，探查。

968166.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each player, destroy up to one nonbasic land that player controls. For each land destroyed this way, its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
968166.translation: 当此生物进场时，为每位牌手各进行以下流程～消灭至多一个由该牌手操控的非基本地。对每个以此法消灭的地而言，其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

968169.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may exile it and collect evidence 4. If you do, return this card to the battlefield tapped.
968169.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以将它放逐并搜证4。若你如此作，则将此牌横置移回战场。

968173.oracleText: When this creature enters or is turned face up, up to one target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
968173.translation: 当此生物进场或翻回正面时，至多一个目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

968176.oracleText: When this creature enters, suspect it. Create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
968176.translation: 当此生物进场时，怀疑它。派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

968181.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control is turned face up, that creature deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
968181.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物翻回正面时，该生物向每位对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

968185.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw a card and this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
968185.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个神器或弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌且此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

968191.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if it's not suspected, you may suspect it.
968191.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若它未遭疑，则你可以怀疑它。

968199.oracleText: Whenever an opponent sacrifices an artifact, this creature deals 2 damage to them.
968199.translation: 每当任一对手牺牲一个神器时，此生物对其造成2点伤害。

968202.oracleText: {o3oG}, Sacrifice this creature: Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
968202.translation: {o3oG}，牺牲此生物：将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

968204.oracleText: When this Aura enters, untap enchanted creature. It gains hexproof until end of turn. If it's suspected, it's no longer suspected.
968204.translation: 当此灵气进场时，重置所结附的生物。它获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。如果它已遭疑，则它不再遭疑。

968236.oracleText: When this creature enters or is turned face up, target creature blocks this turn if able.
968236.translation: 当此生物进场或翻回正面时，目标生物本回合若能进行阻挡，则必须阻挡。

968243.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each Forest you control.
968243.translation: 你每操控一个树林，此生物便得+1/+1。

968244.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, search your library for up to two Forest cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
968244.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张树林牌并展示之。将其中一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

968250.oracleText: When this creature enters, distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures, then you gain life equal to the greatest toughness among creatures you control.
968250.translation: 当此生物进场时，将三个+1/+1指示物分配给一个，两个或三个目标生物，然后你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控之生物中的最大防御力。

968254.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
968254.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

968259.oracleText: You may choose not to untap this creature during your untap step.
968259.translation: 你可以选择于你的重置步骤中不重置此生物。

968260.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}, Collect evidence 4: Target land you control becomes a 5/5 green Plant Boar creature with haste for as long as this creature remains tapped. It's still a land. Activate only as a sorcery.
968260.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}，搜证4：于此生物持续横置的时段内，目标由你操控的地成为5/5绿色，具敏捷异能的植物／野猪生物。它仍然是地。只能于法术时机起动。

968265.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 white Human creature token, a 1/1 blue Merfolk creature token, and a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. Then secretly choose Human, Merfolk, or Goblin.
968265.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物，一个1/1蓝色人鱼衍生生物和一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。然后私下选择人类，人鱼或鬼怪。

968266.oracleText: Sacrifice this enchantment, Reveal the creature type you chose: If target attacking creature token is the chosen type, put three +1/+1 counters on it and it gains deathtouch until end of turn.
968266.translation: 牺牲此结界，展示所选生物类别：如果目标进行攻击的衍生生物为该类别，则在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物且其获得死触异能直到回合结束。

968270.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, this creature gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
968270.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

968273.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, search your library for a land card with a basic land type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
968273.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻一张具基本地类别的地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

968282.oracleText: During your turn, this creature has hexproof.
968282.translation: 于你的回合中，此生物具有辟邪异能。

968283.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures that don't have a name.
968283.translation: 此生物不能被没有名称的生物阻挡。

968291.oracleText: {oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
968291.translation: {oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

968295.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may collect evidence 3. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
968295.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以搜证3。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968297.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, if its power is greater than this creature's power or its toughness is greater than this creature's toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and investigate.
968297.translation: 每当一个生物在你操控下进场时，若其力量大于此生物的力量或其防御力大于此生物的防御力，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并探查。

968310.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a face-down creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
968310.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌面朝下的生物在你操控下进战场，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968317.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
968317.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

968319.oracleText: When this creature enters, if evidence was collected, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and you gain 2 life.
968319.translation: 当此生物进场时，若已搜证，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你获得2点生命。

968322.oracleText: Whenever Agrus Kos enters or attacks, choose up to one target creature. If it's suspected, exile it. Otherwise, suspect it.
968322.translation: 每当正义之魂阿固寇斯进场或攻击时，选择至多一个目标生物。如果它已遭疑，则将它放逐。若否，则怀疑它。

968324.translation: 当大侦探阿奎斯波费进场时，探查。

968329.oracleText: Whenever Anzrag becomes blocked, untap each creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
968329.translation: 每当地动鼹鼠安札格被阻挡时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此战斗阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

968334.oracleText: Whenever a player attacks with five or more creatures, Aurelia deals 3 damage to each of your opponents and you gain 3 life.
968334.translation: 每当任一牌手以五个或更多生物攻击时，苍天铁律欧瑞梨向你的每位对手各造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

968336.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, it deals 3 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
968336.translation: 当此结界进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成3点伤害。

968337.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures die, mill a card and put a bloodstain counter on this enchantment. Then sacrifice it if it has five or more bloodstain counters on it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
968337.translation: 每当一个或数个生物死去时，磨一张牌并在此结界上放置一个血迹指示物。然后如果其上有五个或更多血迹指示物，则牺牲它。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

968339.oracleText: When this Aura enters, exile target nonland permanent you don't control until this Aura leaves the battlefield.
968339.translation: 当此灵气进场时，放逐目标不由你操控的非地永久物，直到此灵气离开战场为止。

968345.oracleText: As this creature enters or is turned face up, put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of other creatures you control.
968345.translation: 于此生物进场或翻回正面时，在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的其他生物数量。

968350.oracleText: When you sacrifice a Clue, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
968350.translation: 当你牺牲一个线索时，将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

968359.oracleText: When this artifact enters, investigate twice.
968359.translation: 当此神器进场时，探查两次。

968363.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, create two tapped 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
968363.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，派出两个已横置之1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

968379.translation: 当魔调局局长伊泽霖进场时，探查两次。

968383.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
968383.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

968385.oracleText: When this creature enters or is turned face up, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
968385.translation: 当此生物进场或翻回正面时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

968388.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
968388.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968392.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, you may tap or untap target creature.
968392.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，你可以横置或重置目标生物。

968402.oracleText: Whenever Izoni enters or attacks, you may collect evidence 4. If you do, create two 2/1 black and green Spider creature tokens with menace and reach.
968402.translation: 每当罗网中心依佐妮进场或攻击时，你可以搜证4。若你如此作，则派出两个2/1，黑绿双色，具威慑与延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

968408.oracleText: When this token dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent.
968408.translation: 当此衍生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

968409.oracleText: Create a 2/2 red Imp creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent."
968409.translation: 派出一个2/2红色小恶魔衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。」

968410.oracleText: Create a 2/2 red Imp creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent."
968410.translation: 派出一个2/2红色小恶魔衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。」

968411.oracleText:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, choose one — 
• That spell gains deathtouch and lifelink. 
• Create a 2/2 red Imp creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent."
968411.translation:
每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，选择一项～ 
•该咒语获得死触与系命异能。 
•派出一个2/2红色小恶魔衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。」

968420.oracleText: Whenever Kellan attacks, destroy up to one target artifact. If you controlled that permanent, draw a card.
968420.translation: 每当奇探逸才凯澜攻击时，消灭至多一个目标神器。如果你操控该永久物，则抓一张牌。

968425.oracleText: Whenever Kylox attacks, sacrifice any number of other creatures, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is their total power. You may cast any number of instant and/or sorcery spells from among the exiled cards without paying their mana costs.
968425.translation: 每当幻视发明家奇洛兹攻击时，牺牲任意数量的其他生物，然后放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为这些生物的力量总和。你可以从所放逐的牌之中施放任意数量的瞬间和／或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

968427.oracleText: Collect evidence 6: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
968427.translation: 搜证6：此载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

968428.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with it. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
968428.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，你可以从以其放逐的牌之中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

968431.oracleText: Whenever Lazav attacks, exile target card from a graveyard, then investigate.
968431.translation: 每当千面变换拉札夫攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐，然后探查。

968442.oracleText: Whenever Niv-Mizzet deals combat damage to a player, it deals X damage to any target, target player draws X cards, and you gain X life, where X is the number of different color pairs among permanents you control that are exactly two colors.
968442.translation: 每当十会盟尼米捷对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，目标牌手抓X张牌，且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控且为正好两色的永久物中不同双色色组的种数。

968461.oracleText: When this creature enters or is turned face up, target creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
968461.translation: 当此生物进场或翻回正面时，目标生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

968474.oracleText: When this creature enters, suspect up to one target creature you control.
968474.translation: 当此生物进场时，怀疑至多一个目标由你操控的生物。

968478.oracleText: When this creature is turned face up, another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
968478.translation: 当此生物翻回正面时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

968487.oracleText: Whenever a face-down permanent you control is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it and a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
968487.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的永久物翻回正面时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968496.oracleText: When Tolsimir enters, create Voja Fenstalker, a legendary 5/5 green and white Wolf creature token with trample.
968496.translation: 当午夜明光托西密进场时，派出传奇衍生生物沼行沃亚，其为5/5，绿白双色，具践踏异能的狼。

968555.oracleText: {oT}, Collect evidence 3: Add one mana of any color. Put an unlock counter on this artifact.
968555.translation: {oT}，搜证3：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在此神器上放置一个解锁指示物。

968556.oracleText: Sacrifice this artifact: Surveil 3, then draw three cards. Activate only if this artifact has five or more unlock counters on it.
968556.translation: 牺牲此神器：刺探3，然后抓三张牌。只能于此神器上有五个或更多解锁指示物时起动。

968559.oracleText: {o2}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Exile target card from a graveyard.
968559.translation: {o2}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

968566.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to this creature.
968566.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标武具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在此生物上。

968576.oracleText: When this land is turned face up, add two mana of any one color. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
968576.translation: 当此地翻回正面时，加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

968582.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
968582.translation: {oT}，牺牲此地：目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

968587.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you tap an untapped artifact or land you control.
968587.translation: 当此地进场时，除非你横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器或地，否则牺牲之。

968590.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.

968596.oracleText: When this creature enters and whenever you solve a Case, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an enchantment card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
968596.translation: 当此生物进场或每当你侦办一个案件时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张结界牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来施放案件咒语。

968608.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may collect evidence 4.
968608.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以搜证4。

968616.oracleText: When this creature enters, suspect up to one other target creature you control.
968616.translation: 当此生物进场时，怀疑至多另一个目标由你操控的生物。

968627.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target token an opponent controls.
968627.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的衍生物。

968633.oracleText: Melek's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
968633.translation: 重铸研究员梅列克的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌之总数量的两倍。

968639.oracleText: Whenever Voja attacks, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of Elves you control. Draw a card for each Wolf you control.
968639.translation: 每当盟会尖颚沃亚攻击时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的妖精数量。你每操控一个狼，便抓一张牌。

968695.oracleText: When equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice this Equipment. If you do, draw three cards.
968695.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，牺牲此武具。若你如此作，则抓三张牌。

968701.oracleText: {o3oW}: This creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is its toughness.
968701.translation: {o3oW}：此生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为其防御力。

968703.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target spell. It becomes plotted.
968703.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标咒语。它成为已设谋。

968707.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. You gain 1 life for each of those creatures.
968707.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。每有一个此类生物，你便获得1点生命。

968714.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, create a 1/1 white Sheep creature token.
968714.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个1/1白色绵羊衍生生物。

968717.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you may search your library for a Plains card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. Then if an opponent controls more lands than you, repeat this process once. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
968717.translation: 当此生物进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张平原牌，并将之横置放进战场。然后如果某对手操控的地比你多，则将此流程再重复一次。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

968719.oracleText: If you control five or more untapped lands, this creature enters with two +1/+1 counters and a lifelink counter on it.
968719.translation: 如果你操控五个或更多未横置的地，则此生物进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物和一个系命指示物。

968731.translation: 当忠诚骏骑福琼进场时，占卜2。

968735.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Mount creature card or a Plains card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
968735.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张坐骑生物牌或平原牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

968743.oracleText: {o4oR}, Sacrifice this enchantment: It deals 5 damage to any target.
968743.translation: {o4oR}，牺牲此结界：它对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

968747.oracleText: When this creature enters, you gain 2 life and scry 1.
968747.translation: 当此生物进场时，你获得2点生命且占卜1。

968750.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and this creature doesn't have a flying counter on it, put a flying counter on it.
968750.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且此生物上没有飞行指示物，则在其上放置一个飞行指示物。

968753.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
968753.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

968758.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to one target non-Faerie, nonland permanent you control to its owner's hand. If a permanent was returned this way, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
968758.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控、且既非仙灵也非地的永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果以此法移回了永久物，则在育幼碧仙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968762.oracleText: This creature has double strike as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
968762.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，此生物便具有连击异能。

968771.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
968771.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968774.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
968774.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

968775.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a token: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
968775.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个衍生物：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

968789.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand. Return that card to the battlefield instead if you control a Mount.
968789.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果你操控坐骑，则改为将该牌移回战场。

968791.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it plus an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature you control.
968791.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控的其他生物数量加一。

968803.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control.
968803.translation: 当此生物进场时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968807.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
968807.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。占卜1。

968810.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control die, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
968810.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物死去时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

968813.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
968813.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

968816.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost. That card gains flashback {o0} until end of turn instead if this creature is saddled.
968816.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得返照异能直到回合结束。其返照费用等同于其法术力费用。如果大法师的蝾螈已乘驾，则改为该牌获得返照{o0}直到回合结束。

968840.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and this enchantment isn't a creature, it becomes a 3/3 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.
968840.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且此结界不是生物，则它成为3/3，具飞行异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

968869.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you've cast two or more spells this turn, draw a card.
968869.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则抓一张牌。

968881.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked if you've committed a crime this turn.
968881.translation: 如果你本回合中曾犯下罪行，则此生物不能被阻挡。

968883.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 blue and black Zombie Rogue creature token, then put two +1/+1 counters on that token for each spell you've cast this turn other than the first.
968883.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2，蓝黑双色的灵俑／浪客衍生生物，然后你于本回合施放的第一个咒语以外每多施放过一个咒语，便在该衍生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

968887.oracleText: When this creature enters, return up to one target tapped creature to its owner's hand.
968887.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一个目标已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上。

968897.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. It can't be blocked this turn.
968897.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它本回合不能被阻挡。

968913.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
968913.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，此生物便得+2/+0。

968916.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature defending player controls gets -3/-0 until end of turn.
968916.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控的生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。

968923.oracleText: This creature has hexproof as long as you haven't cast a spell this turn.
968923.translation: 只要你本回合中未施放过咒语，此生物便具有辟邪异能。

968941.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
968941.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

968946.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if a creature died this turn.
968946.translation: 如果本回合中有生物死去，则此生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

968949.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. This ability triggers only once each turn.
968949.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

968954.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. If an outlaw was sacrificed this way, create a Treasure token.
968954.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。如果以此法牺牲的是狂徒，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

968957.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, reveal the top card of your library and put it into your hand. You lose life equal to that card's mana value if this creature isn't saddled. Otherwise, each opponent loses that much life.
968957.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，展示你的牌库顶牌并置于你手上。如果蚀液野马未乘驾，你失去等同于该牌法术力值的生命。若否，则每位对手各失去该数量的生命。

968969.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, you may pay {oB}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
968969.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

968976.oracleText: When this creature enters, any number of target opponents each discard a card. For each of those opponents who didn't discard a card with mana value 4 or greater, draw a card.
968976.translation: 当此生物进场时，任意数量的目标对手各弃一张牌。每有一位未弃掉法术力值等于或大于4之牌的对手，你便抓一张牌。

969001.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime during your turn, this creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
969001.translation: 每当你于你的回合中犯下罪行时，此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

969016.oracleText: When this creature enters, if a creature died this turn, create a 2/2 blue and black Zombie Rogue creature token.
969016.translation: 当此生物进场时，若本回合中有生物死去，则派出一个2/2，蓝黑双色的灵俑／浪客衍生生物。

969026.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, if you've committed a crime this turn, you may sacrifice this creature. If you do, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
969026.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若你本回合中曾犯下罪行，你可以牺牲此生物。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

969037.oracleText: Whenever Tinybones deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target nonland permanent card from that player's graveyard, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
969037.translation: 每当扒手细骨对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从该牌手的坟墓场中施放目标非地永久物牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放该咒语。

969047.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature. When you do, target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
969047.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个生物。当你如此作时，目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

969049.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, put a +1/+1 counter on Vadmir. This ability triggers only once each turn.
969049.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，在新血瓦米尔上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

969053.oracleText: When this creature enters, target player draws a card and loses 1 life.
969053.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

969059.oracleText: Whenever Calamity attacks while saddled, choose a nonlegendary creature that saddled it this turn and create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of it. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step. Repeat this process once.
969059.translation: 每当疾驰狱火灾祸于已乘驾时攻击，选择一个本回合中乘驾它的非传奇生物并派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。将此流程再重复一次。

969068.oracleText: When this creature enters, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains haste until end of turn.
969068.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得敏捷异能。

969072.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to target opponent.
969072.translation: {o1}，{oT}：此生物向目标对手造成1点伤害。

969093.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
969093.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

969109.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 red Mercenary creature tokens with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
969109.translation: 当此生物首领进场时，派出两个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

969116.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, this creature deals 2 damage to target opponent. Scry 1.
969116.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，此生物向目标对手造成2点伤害。占卜1。

969119.oracleText: When this card becomes plotted, it deals 2 damage to any target.
969119.translation: 当此牌成为已设谋时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

969126.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, this creature deals damage to that player equal to the number of noncreature spells they've cast this turn.
969126.translation: 每当任一牌手施放非生物咒语时，此生物对该牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于其本回合中施放过的非生物咒语数量。

969128.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control another outlaw, create a Treasure token.
969128.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控另一个狂徒，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

969140.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gets +1/+2 and gains menace until end of turn.
969140.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，直到回合结束，它得+1/+2且获得威慑异能。

969143.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card and create a Treasure token.
969143.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲此生物：抓一张牌并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

969147.oracleText: {o3}: This creature can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste.
969147.translation: {o3}：此生物本回合只能被具敏捷异能的生物阻挡。

969158.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a 3/1 red Dinosaur creature token if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
969158.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则派出一个3/1红色恐龙衍生生物。

969180.oracleText: When this card becomes plotted, target creature gets +3/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
969180.translation: 当此牌成为已设谋时，直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+2且获得践踏异能。

969185.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
969185.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则抓一张牌。

969200.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw a card.
969200.translation: 每当此生物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以抓一张牌。

969204.oracleText: {o1oG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Search your library for a Desert card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
969204.translation: {o1oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：从你牌库中搜寻一张沙漠牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

969211.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
969211.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

969214.oracleText: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it if it wasn't cast or no mana was spent to cast it.
969214.translation: 如果此生物未经施放或施放时未支付过法术力，则它进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

969223.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature that saddled it this turn.
969223.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，在目标本回合中乘驾它的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

969229.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to its power.
969229.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出若干已横置的珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于它的力量。

969233.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, untap this creature. This ability triggers only once each turn.
969233.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，重置此生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

969243.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, double the number of +1/+1 counters on target creature.
969243.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，将目标生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

969246.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
969246.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

969247.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each Desert you control.
969247.translation: 你每操控一个沙漠，此生物便得+1/+1。

969249.oracleText: When this creature enters, add one mana of any color.
969249.translation: 当此生物进场时，加一点任意颜色的法术力。

969254.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards. Put a land card from among the milled cards into your hand. If you can't, create a Treasure token.
969254.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨三张牌。将一张地牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。若你无法如此作，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

969259.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gets +1/+2 until end of turn. Then you may return any number of creatures that saddled it this turn to their owner's hand.
969259.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，它得+1/+2直到回合结束。然后你可以将任意数量本回合中乘驾它的生物移回其拥有者手上。

969275.oracleText: {o1oG}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 3 life.
969275.translation: {o1oG}，弃掉此牌：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得3点生命。

969279.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes saddled for the first time each turn, mill two cards, then this creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
969279.translation: 每当此生物每回合首度成为已乘驾时，磨两张牌，然后此生物兽得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

969299.oracleText: When Annie Flash enters, if you cast it, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
969299.translation: 当电闪安妮进场时，若它经你施放，则将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。

969307.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, exile up to one target creature until this Equipment leaves the battlefield.
969307.translation: 当此武具进场时，放逐至多一个目标生物，直到此武具离开战场为止。

969308.oracleText: Whenever this Equipment becomes attached to a creature, for as long as this Equipment remains attached to it, that creature becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with this Equipment.
969308.translation: 每当此武具新贴附在任一生物上时，于此武具持续贴附于其上期间，该生物成为以此武具放逐之任一生物牌的复制品。

969321.oracleText: Beau's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
969321.translation: 伯欧的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

969322.oracleText: When Bonny Pall enters, create Beau, a legendary blue Ox creature token with "Beau's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control."
969322.translation: 当伯妮帕进场时，派出传奇衍生生物伯欧，其为蓝色的牛，且具有「伯欧的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。」

969324.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, flip a coin. When you win the flip, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. When you lose the flip, Breeches deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target.

969328.oracleText: Whenever Bruse Tarl enters or attacks, exile the top card of your library. If it's a land card, create a 2/2 white Ox creature token. Otherwise, you may cast it until the end of your next turn.
969328.translation: 每当布斯陶进场或攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，派出一个2/2白色的牛衍生生物。若否，则直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

969333.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Mounts you control.
969333.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的坐骑数量。

969343.oracleText: When Ertha Jo enters, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
969343.translation: 当尔莎乔进场时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

969354.oracleText: Whenever The Gitrog deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice a creature that saddled it this turn. If you do, draw X cards, then put up to X land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
969354.translation: 每当噬人蛙怪对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以牺牲一个本回合中乘驾它的生物。若你如此作，则你抓X张牌，然后将至多X张地牌从你手上横置放进战场，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

969360.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, each opponent loses 1 life, you gain 1 life, and you draw a card.
969360.translation: 当此结界进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命，你获得1点生命，且你抓一张牌。

969361.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，你可以将此结界移回其拥有者手上。

969368.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲一个珍宝：乔琳对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

969382.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在寇姆上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

969387.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, put a +1/+1 counter on Lazav. Then you may exile a card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, you may have Lazav become a copy of that card until end of turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
969387.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，在拉札夫上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后你可以从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。如果以此法放逐的是生物牌，你可以使拉札夫成为该牌的复制品直到回合结束。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

969403.oracleText: Whenever Obeka deals combat damage to a player, you get that many additional upkeep steps after this phase.
969403.translation: 每当欧蓓卡对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你在此阶段后额外得到等量的维持步骤。

969405.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, Oko becomes a copy of up to one target creature you control until end of turn, except he has hexproof.
969405.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，瓯柯成为至多一个目标由你操控的生物之复制品直到回合结束，但他具有辟邪异能。

969420.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Rakdos gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it. Activate only once each turn.
969420.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：拉铎司获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。每回合只能起动一次。

969425.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on Riku. It gains trample until end of turn.
969425.translation: 在黎库上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

969438.oracleText: Whenever Satoru and/or one or more other nontoken creatures you control enter, if none of them were cast or no mana was spent to cast them, draw a card.
969438.translation: 每当梅泽悟和／或一个或数个其他非衍生物的生物在你操控下进场时，若它们都未经施放或施放它们时未支付过法术力，则抓一张牌。

969444.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while saddled, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
969444.translation: 每当此生物于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

969470.oracleText: Whenever Wylie Duke becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
969470.translation: 每当威利杜克成为横置时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

969472.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, put a loot counter on this artifact. This ability triggers only once each turn.
969472.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，在此神器上放置一个掠物指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

969473.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove two loot counters from this artifact: Draw a card.
969473.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从此神器上移去两个掠物指示物：抓一张牌。

969476.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, and up to one target land.
969476.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：消灭至多一个目标神器，至多一个目标生物和至多一个目标地。

969482.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, create a Treasure token for each creature that crewed it this turn.
969482.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，每有一个本回合中搭载它的生物，便派出一个珍宝衍生物。

969485.oracleText: This Vehicle has haste as long as you control a Mount.
969485.translation: 只要你操控坐骑，此载具便具有敏捷异能。

969500.oracleText: When this land enters, it deals 1 damage to target opponent.
969500.translation: 当此地进场时，它向目标对手造成1点伤害。

969502.oracleText: When this land enters, return a land you control to its owner's hand. If another Desert was returned this way, surveil 1.
969502.translation: 当此地进场时，将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上。如果以此法移回的是另一个沙漠，则刺探1。

969585.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
969585.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

969595.oracleText: When this creature enters, counter target spell.
969595.translation: 当此生物进场时，反击目标咒语。

969600.oracleText: {oT}: This land deals 1 damage to target attacking creature. Activate only during the end of combat step.
969600.translation: {oT}：此地对目标进行攻击的生物造成1点伤害。只能于战斗结束步骤中起动。

969605.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature.
969605.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标生物。

969653.oracleText: Destroy up to X target artifacts and/or enchantments. Create twice X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
969653.translation: 消灭至多X个目标神器和／或结界。派出两倍于X数量的1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

969665.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice this artifact or another artifact, you may pay {o2}. If you do, at the beginning of the next end step, create a token that's a copy of that artifact.
969665.translation: 每当你牺牲此神器或另一个神器时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则在下一个结束步骤开始时，派出一个为该神器复制品的衍生物。

969667.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control with mana value 3 or greater enters, create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
969667.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且法术力值等于或大于3的神器进场时，派出一个0/0无色组构体衍生神器生物，且具有「你每操控一个神器，此衍生物便得+1/+1。」

969672.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you draw three cards, gain 6 life, and create three 2/1 black Bat creature tokens with flying.
969672.translation: 当此结界进场时，你抓三张牌，获得6点生命并派出三个2/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

969674.oracleText: When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, you discard three cards, lose 6 life, and sacrifice three creatures.
969674.translation: 当此结界离开战场时，你弃三张牌，失去6点生命并牺牲三个生物。

969676.oracleText: When this creature enters, other creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
969676.translation: 当此生物进场时，其他生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

969677.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard this card: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
969677.translation: {o1oB}，弃掉此牌：目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

969683.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals damage to defending player equal to the number of artifacts they control.
969683.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它向防御牌手造成等同于由其操控之神器数量的伤害。

969688.oracleText: {oT}, Exile this artifact: Each player exiles the top seven cards of their library. Until your next turn, players may play cards they exiled this way, and they can't play cards from their hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
969688.translation: {oT}，放逐此神器：每位牌手各放逐其牌库顶的七张牌。直到你的下一个回合，所有牌手都可以使用其以此法放逐的牌，且不能从其手上使用牌。只能于法术时机起动。

969693.oracleText: When this artifact enters, if you cast it, exile target artifact or land.
969693.translation: 当此神器进场时，若它经你施放，则放逐目标神器或地。

969694.oracleText: This artifact has all activated abilities of the exiled card.
969694.translation: 此神器具有所放逐之牌的所有起动式异能。

969699.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice a Food. If you do, mill three cards. You may put a permanent card from among them into your hand.
969699.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则磨三张牌。你可以将其中一张永久物牌置于你手上。

969701.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, search your library for up to five land cards that have different names, exile them, then shuffle.
969701.translation: 当此结界进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多五张名称各不相同的地牌，将它们放逐，然后洗牌。

969702.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose a card at random exiled with this enchantment and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
969702.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，随机选择一张以此结界放逐的牌并将之横置放进战场。

969705.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token.
969705.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。

969708.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, you gain 3 life and draw a card.
969708.translation: 每当此生物或另一个力量等于或大于4的生物在你操控下进场时，你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

969709.oracleText: When this creature dies, if it's not a token, create a token that's a copy of it, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
969709.translation: 当此生物死去时，若它不是衍生物，则派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它额外具有神器此类别。

969760.oracleText: Whenever Yuma enters or attacks, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, draw a card.
969760.translation: 每当毓玛进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲一个地。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

969767.oracleText: When Ajani enters, create a 2/1 white Cat Warrior creature token.
969767.translation: 当阿耶尼进场时，派出一个2/1白色猫／战士衍生生物。

969771.oracleText: Create a 2/1 white Cat Warrior creature token. When you do, if you control a red permanent other than Ajani, he deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to any target.
969771.translation: 派出一个2/1白色猫/战士衍生生物。当你如此作时，若你除阿耶尼以外还操控红色永久物，则他对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

969785.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may change the target of target instant or sorcery spell with a single target to this creature.
969785.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择目标仅指定单一目标的瞬间或法术咒语，你可以将其目标更改为此生物。

969796.translation: 每当多美代攻击时，探查。

969813.oracleText: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, exile Sorin, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
969813.translation: 在你的每个战斗后的行动阶段开始时，若你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则放逐索霖，然后将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

969815.oracleText: Sorin deals damage equal to the amount of life you gained this turn to any target.
969815.translation: 索霖对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

969823.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell during your turn, flip a coin. If you lose the flip, Ral deals 1 damage to you. If you win the flip, you may exile Ral. If you do, return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
969823.translation: 每当你于你的回合中施放瞬间或法术咒语时，掷一枚硬币。如果你猜错此掷，拉尔对你造成1点伤害。如果你猜对此掷，你可以放逐拉尔。若你如此作，则将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

969825.oracleText: Ral enters with an additional loyalty counter on him for each instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn.
969825.translation: 拉尔进场时上面额外有数个忠诚指示物，其数量等同于你本回合中施放过的瞬间与法术咒语数量。

969842.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, you gain X life and draw X cards, where X is that creature's power.
969842.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则你获得X点生命且抓X张牌，X为该生物的力量。

969847.oracleText: Whenever Grist or another creature you control enters, if it entered from your graveyard or you cast it from your graveyard, you may pay {oG}. If you do, exile Grist, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.
969847.translation: 每当格蕊斯或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，若它是从你的坟墓场进入战场或是由你从你的坟墓场施放，你可以支付{oG}。若你如此作，则放逐格蕊斯，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

969862.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if {oC} was spent to cast it, create two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
969862.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若施放它时支付过{oC}，则派出两个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

969932.oracleText: When you cast or cycle CARDNAME, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
969932.translation: 当你施放或循环CARDNAME时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

969933.oracleText: When you cast or cycle Drownyard Lurker, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
969933.translation: 当你施放或循环沉船地伏击虫时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

969940.oracleText: Sacrifice two Eldrazi: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
969940.translation: 牺牲两个奥札奇：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

969945.oracleText: When Emrakul leaves the battlefield, sacrifice all creatures you control.
969945.translation: 当伊莫库离开战场时，牺牲所有由你操控的生物。

969948.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
969948.translation: 每当你施放无色咒语时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

969949.oracleText: Whenever another colorless creature you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
969949.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的无色生物进场时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

969964.oracleText: Target player creates X 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
969964.translation: 目标牌手派出X个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

969968.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Target player creates X 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}." 
• Target player scries X, then draws a card. 
• Exile target creature with mana value X or less. 
• Exile up to X target cards from graveyards.
969968.translation:
选择两项～ 
•目标牌手派出X个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」 
•目标牌手占卜X，然后抓一张牌。 
•放逐目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物。 
•将至多X张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

969984.oracleText: Ulamog enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the greatest mana value among cards in exile.
969984.translation: 钨拉莫进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于放逐区中牌的最大法术力值。

969990.oracleText: When you cast or cycle Warped Tusker, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
969990.translation: 当你施放或循环拧曲长牙野猪时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970002.oracleText: Whenever two or more creatures attack, put an oil counter on this artifact.
970002.translation: 每当两个或更多生物攻击时，在此神器上放置一个烁油指示物。

970003.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove two oil counters from this artifact: Exile another target nonland permanent. Its controller draws two cards.
970003.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从此神器上移去两个烁油指示物：放逐另一个目标非地永久物。其操控者抓两张牌。

970005.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, put a collection counter on this enchantment. Then if there are three or more collection counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, draw a card, then you may search your library for a Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
970005.translation: 每当任一牌手施放非生物咒语时，在此结界上放置一个收藏指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多收藏指示物，将它牺牲。若你如此作，则抓一张牌，然后你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

970007.oracleText: As long as another player controls enchanted creature, it can't attack or block. Otherwise, this Aura has umbra armor.
970007.translation: 只要所结附的生物是由另一位牌手操控，它便不能进行攻击或阻挡。若否，则此灵气具有本影甲异能。

970022.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this permanent.
970022.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在此永久物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970023.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on this Aura.
970023.translation: 此灵气上每有一个+1/+1指示物，所结附的生物便得+1/+1。

970030.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, it gains first strike until end of turn.
970030.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

970039.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• You get {oEoEoE}. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. 
• Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
970039.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•你得到{oEoEoE}。 
•在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

970049.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
970049.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

970061.oracleText: Whenever Phelia attacks, exile up to one other target nonland permanent. At the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Phelia.
970061.translation: 每当费利亚攻击时，放逐至多另一个目标非地永久物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。如果它是在你的操控下进场，则在费利亚上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970065.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a shield counter on target permanent. 
• Proliferate.
970065.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标永久物上放置一个后盾指示物。 
•增殖。

970067.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact or enchantment card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
970067.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张神器或结界牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。如果你未以此法将牌置于手上，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970073.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You get {oEoE}.
970073.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，直到此结界离开战场为止。你得到{oEoE}。

970074.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, sacrifice this enchantment unless you pay {oE}.
970074.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，除非你支付{oE}，否则牺牲此结界。

970083.oracleText: This creature gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn.
970083.translation: 此生物获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。

970086.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oEoE}. When you do, choose one — 
• This creature gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. 
• Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
970086.translation:
在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oEoE}。当你如此作时，选择一项～ 
•此生物获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。 
•由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

970089.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy up to one target nonbasic land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
970089.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭至多一个目标非基本地。其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

970103.oracleText: Pay {oEoEoEoE}: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
970103.translation: 支付{oEoEoEoE}：此载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

970114.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has "Whenever this creature attacks, it connives."
970114.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进入战场，但它具有「每当此生物攻击时，令它筹谋。」

970118.oracleText: As this creature enters, it becomes your choice of a 3/3 creature with flying, a 2/5 creature with vigilance, or a 0/12 creature with defender.
970118.translation: 于此生物进场时，它依你的选择成为具飞行异能的3/3生物，具警戒异能的2/5生物，或具守军异能的0/12生物。

970131.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, tap this creature unless you pay {oE}.
970131.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，除非你支付{oE}，否则横置此生物。

970135.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970135.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970146.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 4, 5, or 6, create two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970146.translation: 每当你施放法术力值为4，5或6的生物咒语时，派出两个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970159.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card, then scry 2.
970159.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓一张牌，然后占卜2。

970176.oracleText: As long as this permanent is a creature, it has prowess.
970176.translation: 只要此永久物是生物，它便具有灵技异能。

970182.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may exile this card from your graveyard. When you do, return each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand.
970182.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的无色咒语时，你可以将此牌从你坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，将所有不由你操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

970185.oracleText: Draw three cards and create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970185.translation: 抓三张牌并派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970191.oracleText: When this creature enters, exchange control of this creature and target creature an opponent controls. If you do, you get {oEoEoEoE}, then sacrifice that creature unless you pay an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value.
970191.translation: 当此生物进场时，交换此生物和目标由对手操控之生物的操控权。若你如此作，则你得到{oEoEoEoE}，然后除非你支付等同于后者生物之法术力值数量的{oE}，否则牺牲之。

970194.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
970194.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

970202.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you get {oEoEoE}.
970202.translation: 当此结界进场时，你得到{oEoEoE}。

970203.oracleText: Pay X {oE}, Sacrifice a creature, Return this enchantment to its owner's hand: Return target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
970203.translation: 支付X个{oE}，牺牲一个生物，将此结界移回其拥有者手上：将目标法术力值为X的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

970211.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent exiles the top card of their library, a card at random from their graveyard, and a card at random from their hand. You may cast a spell from among cards exiled this way without paying its mana cost.
970211.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手放逐其牌库顶牌，其坟墓场中随机一张牌，以及其手上随机一张牌。你可以从以此法放逐的牌之中施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

970218.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this Vehicle.
970218.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个神器或生物：在此载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970222.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, it gains menace until end of turn.
970222.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

970229.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, put a creature card exiled with this creature onto the battlefield under your control with a finality counter on it. It gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
970229.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，将一张以此生物放逐的生物牌在你操控下放进战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

970233.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it. When you do, you may remove a counter from another target permanent or opponent.
970233.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。当你如此作时，你可以从另一个目标永久物或对手上移去一个指示物。

970242.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, you may draw two cards. If you do, you lose 2 life.
970242.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以抓两张牌。若你如此作，则你失去2点生命。

970251.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a card with mana value less than or equal to your devotion to black, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.
970251.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于你黑色献力的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你失去3点生命。

970262.oracleText: When this enchantment enters and whenever you draw your third card each turn, amass Zombies 3.
970262.translation: 当此结界进场和每当你抓每回合中你的第三张牌时，囤兵灵俑3。

970271.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a quest counter on this enchantment.
970271.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，在此结界上放置一个探索指示物。

970272.oracleText: {o5oB}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each quest counter on this enchantment. Activate only as a sorcery.
970272.translation: {o5oB}，牺牲此结界：将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。此结界上每有一个探索指示物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。只能于法术时机起动。

970276.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card. For each opponent who can't, you draw a card.
970276.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌。每有一位无法如此作的对手，你便抓一张牌。

970279.oracleText: {o3oB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with two +1/+1 counters on it.
970279.translation: {o3oB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，且上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

970286.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, it connives.
970286.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，令它筹谋。

970296.oracleText: {o1oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
970296.translation: {o1oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

970299.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 1/2 black Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with deathtouch and a 2/1 black Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with lifelink.
970299.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个1/2黑色，具死触异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物，和一个2/1黑色，具系命异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物。

970301.oracleText: Revolt — As long as a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, if a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
970301.translation: 反抗～只要本回合中有由你操控的永久物离开战场，如果某个由你操控的来源将向任一对手或由对手操控的永久物造成非战斗伤害，便改为它造成原数量加2点伤害。

970302.oracleText: Whenever you get one or more {oE}, this enchantment deals that much damage to any target.
970302.translation: 每当你得到一个或数个{oE}时，此结界对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

970304.oracleText: When this creature enters, you get {oEoE}. Then if you cast it from your hand, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast that card by paying an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
970304.translation: 当此生物进场时，你得到{oEoE}。然后若你从你手上施放之，则从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，但须支付等同于其法术力值数量的{oE}，而不支付其法术力费用。

970306.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, discard a card, then draw a card. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, Ashling deals 2 damage to each opponent and each creature they control. If it's the third time, add {oRoRoRoR}.
970306.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则舞焰客灰儿向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物各造成2点伤害。如果是第三次的结算，则加{oRoRoRoR}。

970310.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard using its bestow ability.
970310.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用此牌之神授异能来施放之。

970334.oracleText: Exile the top three cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn. At the beginning of the next end step, if any of those cards remain exiled, put them into your graveyard, then create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token for each card put into your graveyard this way. Those tokens have "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970334.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。在下一个结束步骤开始时，若这些牌中仍有被放逐者，则将它们置入你的坟墓场，然后每以此法将一张牌置入你的坟墓场，便派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物。这些衍生物具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970338.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, gain control of target artifact or creature until end of turn. Untap that permanent. It gains haste until end of turn.
970338.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，获得目标神器或生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该永久物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

970340.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, you get {oEoE}.
970340.translation: 当此武具进场时，你得到{oEoE}。

970344.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: It deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
970344.translation: 牺牲此生物：它对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

970346.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
970346.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

970359.oracleText: This Saga deals 2 damage to each creature and planeswalker your opponents control.
970359.translation: 此传纪向每个由对手操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成2点伤害。

970363.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gains battle cry until end of turn.
970363.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物获得战嚎异能直到回合结束。

970370.oracleText: {o3oR}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 4 damage to target creature.
970370.translation: {o3oR}，牺牲此生物：它对目标生物造成4点伤害。

970376.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a nontoken permanent, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970376.translation: 当你牺牲一个非衍生物的永久物时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970379.oracleText: When Skoa enters, it deals 4 damage to any target.
970379.translation: 当烬法师斯酷进场时，它对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

970383.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {oE}. If you do, another target attacking creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
970383.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{oE}。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

970386.oracleText: When you cast this spell, create three 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970386.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，派出三个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970387.oracleText: {o1oC}, Sacrifice an Eldrazi: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
970387.translation: {o1oC}，牺牲一个奥札奇：此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

970390.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {oEoEoE}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
970390.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。若你如此作，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970392.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, this artifact deals 1 damage to each opponent.
970392.translation: 每当你从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，此神器向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

970393.oracleText: {oT}, Pay {oEoE}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it until you exile another card with this artifact.
970393.translation: {oT}，支付{oEoE}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你以此神器放逐另一张牌为止，你可以使用该牌。

970396.oracleText: If this creature was kicked, it enters with two +1/+1 counters and a trample counter on it and with haste.
970396.translation: 如果此生物已增幅，则它进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物和一个践踏指示物，且具有敏捷异能。

970404.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, you may create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970404.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970419.oracleText: When you cast this spell and when this creature dies, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970419.translation: 当你施放此咒语和当此生物死去时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970424.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
970424.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

970449.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of counters on permanents you control.
970449.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的永久物上之指示物总数量。

970455.oracleText: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a permanent card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard. Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970455.translation: 展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张永久物牌置于你手上。将其余的牌置入你坟墓场。派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970462.oracleText: This permanent enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
970462.translation: 此永久物进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物。

970463.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on this Aura and has reach and trample.
970463.translation: 所结附的生物具有延势与践踏异能，且此灵气上每有一个+1/+1指示物，它便得+1/+1。

970465.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970465.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出两个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970470.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you get {oEoE}.
970470.translation: 当此结界进场时，你得到{oEoE}。

970474.oracleText: {o3oG}: Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970474.translation: {o3oG}：派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970490.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may pay {o1oG} if this permanent is attached to a creature you control. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature. If you didn't create a token this way, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
970490.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，如果此永久物贴附在由你操控的生物上，你可以支付{o1oG}。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品。如果你未以此法派出衍生物，派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

970521.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may pay {oEoEoE}. When you do, this creature deals damage equal to its power to any target.
970521.translation: 当此生物巨人死去时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。当你如此作时，超导独眼巨人对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

970527.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target modified creature you control.
970527.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，在目标由你操控且有饰装的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970541.oracleText: Aura and Equipment spells you cast cost {oX} less to cast, where X is this creature's power.
970541.translation: 你施放的灵气与武具咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为此生物的力量。

970542.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, other modified creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
970542.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，由你操控且有饰装的其他生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

970545.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may draw cards equal to its power. If you do, discard that many cards.
970545.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以抓等同于其力量的牌。若你如此作，则弃等量的牌。

970547.oracleText: When Imskir enters, you draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is half the number of artifacts you control, rounded down.
970547.translation: 当噬铁魔依斯奇进场时，你抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为由你操控之神器数量的一半，小数点后舍去。

970567.oracleText: This creature has flying as long as it's modified.
970567.translation: 只要此生物有饰装，它便具有飞行异能。

970570.oracleText: Whenever another modified creature you control dies, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
970570.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且有饰装的生物死去时，在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

970581.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, draw a card.
