970582.oracleText: Discard a card: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
970582.translation: 弃一张牌：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970583.oracleText: Exile three cards from your graveyard: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
970583.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

970591.oracleText: When Rosheen enters, mill six cards. You may put a card with {oX} in its mana cost from among them into your hand.
970591.translation: 当咆哮先知罗欣进场时，磨六张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力费用中包含{oX}的牌置于你手上。

970595.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create two 1/1 red Gremlin creature tokens. Then you get an amount of {oE} equal to the number of creatures you control.
970595.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出两个1/1红色怪灵衍生生物。然后你得到等同于由你操控之生物数量的{oE}。

970603.oracleText: When you draw your third card in a turn, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
970603.translation: 每当你抓同一回合中你的第三张牌时，将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

970606.oracleText: When you cast this spell and whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
970606.translation: 当你施放此咒语和每当此生物攻击时，在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970611.oracleText: When you cast this spell, create two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970611.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，派出两个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970612.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another Eldrazi, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
970612.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个奥札奇时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970616.oracleText: {o1oC}, {oT}: Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970616.translation: {o1oC}，{oT}：派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970617.oracleText: Whenever another Eldrazi you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on this artifact.
970617.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的奥札奇死去时，在此神器上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970618.oracleText: As long as this artifact has eight or more +1/+1 counters on it, it's a 0/0 creature in addition to its other types and it has annihilator 2.
970618.translation: 只要此神器上有八个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便是0/0生物，仍具有原本类别，且具有歼灭2。

970620.oracleText: When this artifact enters, you get {oEoEoE}.
970620.translation: 当此神器进场时，你得到{oEoEoE}。

970630.translation: {oR}，{oT}，耗竭此地：加{oRoR}。如果该法术力用以支付生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

970661.translation: 躁狂～{o2oGoG}：此地成为目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌之复制品直到回合结束。只能于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多时起动。

970665.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic Forest, Plains, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
970665.translation: {oT}，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，平原或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

970668.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
970668.translation: {oT}，牺牲此地：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，山脉或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

970671.oracleText: Imprint — When this land enters, you may exile a colorless card with mana value 7 or greater from your hand.
970671.translation: 压印～当此地进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张法术力值等于或大于7的无色牌。

970672.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. If a card is exiled with this land, add {oCoC} instead.
970672.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。如果仍有以此地放逐之牌，则改为加{oCoC}。

970677.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
970677.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲此地：从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

970681.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments.
970681.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐至多两个目标神器和／或结界。

970684.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may pay {oX}. If you do, create X 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
970684.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以支付{oX}。若你如此作，则派出X个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

970691.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with toughness 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
970691.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张防御力等于或小于2的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

970701.oracleText: You may have this enchantment enter as a copy of an enchantment you control, except it has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile this enchantment. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control."
970701.translation: 你可以使此结界当成任一由你操控的结界之复制品来进入战场，但它具有「在你的维持开始时，你可以放逐此结界。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。」

970706.oracleText: When this token dies, create a 9/9 blue Kraken creature token.
970706.translation: 当此衍生物死去时，派出一个9/9蓝色巨海兽衍生生物。

970707.oracleText: When this token dies, create a 6/6 blue Whale creature token with "When this token dies, create a 9/9 blue Kraken creature token."
970707.translation: 当此衍生物死去时，派出一个6/6蓝色鲸鱼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，派出一个9/9蓝色巨海兽衍生生物。」

970708.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 3/3 blue Fish creature token with "When this token dies, create a 6/6 blue Whale creature token with ‘When this token dies, create a 9/9 blue Kraken creature token.'"
970708.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个3/3蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「当此衍生物死去时，派出一个6/6蓝色鲸鱼衍生生物，且具有『当此衍生物死去时，派出一个9/9蓝色巨海兽衍生生物』。」

970717.oracleText: Whenever you cast a black spell, put a +1/+1 counter on K'rrik.
970717.translation: 每当你施放黑色咒语时，在格锐克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970728.oracleText: As this artifact enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste.
970728.translation: 于此神器进场时，你可以使其成为战场上任一生物的复制品直到回合结束，但它具有敏捷异能。

970749.oracleText: Whenever Kaalia attacks an opponent, you may put an Angel, Demon, or Dragon creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
970749.translation: 每当卡莉雅攻击任一对手时，你可以将一张天使、恶魔或龙生物牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正向该对手进行攻击。

970772.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

970775.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

970837.oracleText: Return each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand.
970837.translation: 将每个不由你操控的非地永久物各移回其拥有者手上。

970856.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, if any of those cards remain exiled, put them into your graveyard, then create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token for each card put into your graveyard this way. Those tokens have "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
970856.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，若这些牌中仍有被放逐者，则将它们置入你的坟墓场，然后每以此法将一张牌置入你的坟墓场，便派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物。这些衍生物具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

970884.oracleText: Whenever Omo enters or attacks, put an everything counter on each of up to one target land and up to one target creature.
970884.translation: 每当欧茉进场或攻击时，在至多一个目标地和至多一个目标生物上各放置一个万物指示物。

970888.oracleText: Whenever Satya attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of up to one other target nontoken creature you control. You get {oEoE}. At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice that token unless you pay an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value.
970888.translation: 每当乙太流天才萨提亚攻击时，选择至多另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。你得到{oEoE}。在下一个结束步骤开始时，除非你支付等同于该衍生物之法术力值的{oE}，否则牺牲之。

970892.oracleText: Whenever Azlask or another colorless creature you control dies, you get an experience counter.
970892.translation: 每当兹拉克或另一个由你操控的无色生物死去时，你得到一个经验指示物。

970899.oracleText: Coram gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in all graveyards.
970899.translation: 寇劳得+X/+0，X为所有坟墓场内生物牌中的最大力量。

970904.oracleText: When Jyoti enters, create a 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game. (They're affected by summoning sickness.)
970904.translation: 当乔提进场时，你本盘游戏中每从统帅区施放过一次你的指挥官，便派出一个1/1绿色树林／树灵衍生地生物。（它们会受召唤失调影响。）

970914.oracleText: When Beza enters, create a Treasure token if an opponent controls more lands than you. You gain 4 life if an opponent has more life than you. Create two 1/1 blue Fish creature tokens if an opponent controls more creatures than you. Draw a card if an opponent has more cards in hand than you.
970914.translation: 当贝萨进场时，如果某对手操控的地比你多，则你派出一个珍宝衍生物。如果某对手的总生命比你多，你获得4点生命。如果某对手操控的生物比你多，你派出两个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物。如果某对手的手牌比你多，你抓一张牌。

970923.oracleText: When this Class enters, create a 0/4 white Wall creature token with defender.
970923.translation: 当此职业进场时，派出一个0/4白色，具守军异能的墙衍生生物。

970938.oracleText: When this artifact enters and when you sacrifice it, create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token and scry 1.
970938.translation: 当此神器进场和当你牺牲它时，派出一个1/1白色的兔衍生生物且占卜1。

970951.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield. If that creature had power 2 or less, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
970951.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。若该生物的力量等于或小于2，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

970954.oracleText: As long as you've lost life this turn, this creature has flying and vigilance.
970954.translation: 只要你本回合中失去过生命，此生物便具有飞行与警戒异能。

970965.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Rabbit you control enters, target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Then draw a card if this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn.
970965.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的兔进场时，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。然后如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则抓一张牌。

970974.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control with flying dies, return another target creature card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield.
970974.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物死去时，将另一张目标法术力值比死去生物小的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

970988.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, tap target creature an opponent controls.
970988.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

970990.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, it gets +0/+2 until end of turn.
970990.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，它得+0/+2直到回合结束。

970996.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control without flying.
970996.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971004.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Bird you control enters, exile up to one target creature you control without flying. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
971004.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的鸟进场时，放逐至多一个目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个飞行指示物。

971013.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks while you control a token, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
971013.translation: 每当此生物于你操控衍生物时攻击，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

971029.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, untap target nonland permanent.
971029.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，重置目标非地永久物。

971048.oracleText: Whenever you gain or lose life during your turn, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
971048.translation: 每当你于你的回合中获得或失去生命时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

971050.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them. You may put it onto the battlefield if it's your turn. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
971050.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。如果是在你的回合中，你可以将它放进战场。如果你未将它放进战场，则将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

971052.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or greater.
971052.translation: 此生物不能被力量等于或大于2的生物阻挡。

971053.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, up to one target artifact, creature, or planeswalker an opponent controls loses all abilities until your next turn. If it's a creature, it also has base power and toughness 2/2 until your next turn.
971053.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，至多一个目标由对手操控的神器，生物或鹏洛客失去所有异能直到你的下一个回合。若它是生物，则它的基础力量与防御力也为2/2直到你的下一个回合。

971062.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
971062.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你坟墓场施放目标法术力值等于或小于4的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

971076.oracleText: This creature enters tapped if it's not your turn.
971076.translation: 如果不是在你的回合中，则此生物须横置进场。

971077.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap up to two target creatures.
971077.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置至多两个目标生物。

971098.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature. If the gift wasn't promised, put three stun counters on it.
971098.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置所结附的生物。如果未应诺礼赠，则在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。

971110.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control can't be blocked this turn. Whenever that creature deals combat damage this turn, you may exile it. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
971110.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。本回合中，每当该生物造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

971121.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield with mana value less than or equal to the amount of mana spent to cast this creature, except it's a Bird in addition to its other types and it has flying.
971121.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一法术力值等于或小于施放此生物时所支付法术力数量的生物之复制品来进场，但它额外具有鸟此类别，且具有飞行异能。

971133.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn.
971133.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

971149.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one other target creature you control. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
971149.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐至多另一个目标由你操控的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

971160.oracleText: When this Class enters, create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess.
971160.translation: 当此职业进场时，派出一个1/1，蓝红双色，具灵技异能的水獭衍生生物。

971183.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if another creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn, this creature gains flying until end of turn.
971183.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若本回合中有其他生物在你操控下进战场，则水龙卷护卫获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

971185.oracleText: {oT}: Put a coin counter on this artifact. When you do, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value equal to the number of coin counters on this artifact from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
971185.translation: {oT}：在此神器上放置一个钱币指示物。当你如此作时，你可以从你的坟墓场施放目标法术力值等同于此神器上钱币指示物数量的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

971189.oracleText: When this Class enters, each opponent discards two cards unless they discard a nonland card.
971189.translation: 当此职业进场时，每位对手除非弃一张非地牌，否则便弃两张牌。

971199.oracleText: {o3oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
971199.translation: {o3oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：将另一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

971223.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn. 
• Destroy target creature an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
971223.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。 
•消灭目标由对手操控的生物，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。

971263.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, put a blight counter on it. Then for each blight counter on it, each opponent loses 4 life unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice or discards a card.
971263.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，在其上放置一个枯萎指示物。然后对其上的每个枯萎指示物而言，每位对手除非牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则便失去4点生命。

971289.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 2 life, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw two cards. Activate only as a sorcery.
971289.translation: {oT}，支付2点生命，牺牲此神器：抓两张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

971301.oracleText: When this creature enters, choose target opponent. If they lost life this turn, they reveal their hand, you choose a nonland card from it, and they discard that card. Otherwise, they discard a card.
971301.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择目标对手。如果该牌手本回合中失去过生命，则其展示其手牌，你选择其中一张非地牌，该牌手弃掉该牌。若否，则其弃一张牌。

971304.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of other Squirrels, Bats, Lizards, and Rats you control.
971304.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控之其他松鼠、蝙蝠、蜥蜴和老鼠的数量。

971311.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards. When you do, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the greatest mana value among cards in your graveyard.
971311.translation: 当此生物进场时，磨三张牌。当你如此作时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场内各牌中的最大法术力值。

971328.oracleText: When this Class enters, create a colorless Equipment artifact token named Sword with "Equipped creature gets +1/+1" and equip {o2}.
971328.translation: 当此职业进场时，派出一个无色，名称为利剑的武具衍生神器，且具有「佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1」与佩带{o2}。

971340.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
971340.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为此生物的力量。

971343.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, add {oR}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
971343.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，加{oR}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

971354.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
971354.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

971360.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, add {oBoR}.
971360.translation: 当此生物进场时，若本回合中有对手失去过生命，则加{oBoR}。

971375.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, this creature deals 2 damage to target opponent.
971375.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中其第二个咒语时，此生物向目标对手造成2点伤害。

971378.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more Lizards, this creature deals 1 damage to target opponent.
971378.translation: 每当你以一个或数个蜥蜴攻击时，此生物向目标对手造成1点伤害。

971379.oracleText: {o1oR}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only if an opponent lost life this turn and only once each turn.
971379.translation: {o1oR}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于有对手失去过生命的回合中起动，且每回合限一次。

971381.oracleText: When this enchantment enters and whenever you expend 4, put a stash counter on it.
971381.translation: 当此结界进场和每当你花销4时，在其上放置一个匿物指示物。

971382.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the number of stash counters on this enchantment.
971382.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲此结界：弃掉你的手牌，然后抓等同于囤物满溢上匿物指示物数量的牌。

971386.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to target opponent.
971386.translation: {oT}：此生物向目标对手造成1点伤害。

971406.oracleText: When this creature enters, choose target creature. If that creature's power is 2 or less or if you control another Lizard, gain control of that creature until end of turn, untap it, and it gains haste until end of turn.
971406.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择目标生物。若该生物的力量等于或小于2或若你操控另一个蜥蜴，则获得该生物的操控权直到回合结束，将它重置，且它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

971425.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a token that's a copy of this creature. Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step.
971425.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为此生物的复制品。在下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该衍生物。

971429.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals damage to each player equal to the number of nonbasic lands that player controls.
971429.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每位牌手各造成等同于由该牌手操控之非基本地数量的伤害。

971436.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
971436.translation: 每当你花销4时，此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

971443.oracleText: When this Aura enters, target creature an opponent controls can't block this turn.
971443.translation: 当此灵气进场时，目标由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

971447.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
971447.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

971454.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
971454.translation: 每当你花销4时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

971460.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, this creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
971460.translation: 每当你花销4时，此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

971469.oracleText: When this creature enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
971469.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止。将该牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

971473.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may forage. When you do, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
971473.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以觅粮。当你如此作时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

971477.oracleText: As long as you control a token, this creature gets +2/+0 and has trample.
971477.translation: 只要你操控衍生物，此生物便得+2/+0且具有践踏异能。

971481.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control with toughness greater than its power enters, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. Otherwise, put it into your hand.
971481.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控且防御力比力量大的生物进场时，检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，你可以将之横置放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。

971493.oracleText: When this artifact enters and when you sacrifice it, you may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
971493.translation: 当此神器进场和当你牺牲它时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

971501.oracleText: This creature fights target creature token.
971501.translation: 此生物与目标衍生生物互斗。

971502.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. 
• This creature fights target creature token. 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
971502.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•此生物与目标衍生生物互斗。 
•消灭目标神器或结界。

971504.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Squirrel and/or Food you control.
971504.translation: 当此生物进场时，你每操控一个其他松鼠和／或食品，便在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971505.oracleText: Whenever another Squirrel or Food you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
971505.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的松鼠或食品进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971507.oracleText: When this Class enters, target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
971507.translation: 当此职业进场时，目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

971520.oracleText: As long as there are four or more card types among cards exiled with this creature, it gets +4/+4 and has trample.
971520.translation: 只要以此生物放逐之牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，它便得+4/+4且具有践踏异能。

971526.oracleText: Lumra's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
971526.translation: 林间嚎吼卢玛拉的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

971530.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return another creature you control to its owner's hand. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Otherwise, you may return this creature to its owner's hand.
971530.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将另一个由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。如果你如此作，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则你可以将此生物移回其拥有者手上。

971549.oracleText: When this creature enters, if the gift was promised, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
971549.translation: 当此生物进场时，若已应诺礼赠，则消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

971560.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, put a supply counter on this enchantment.
971560.translation: 每当你在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在此结界上放置一个补给指示物。

971561.oracleText: {o2}, Remove a supply counter from this enchantment: Draw a card.
971561.translation: {o2}，从此结界上移去一个补给指示物：抓一张牌。

971565.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and you gain 1 life.
971565.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你获得1点生命。

971579.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control leaves the battlefield without dying, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
971579.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物离开战场而未死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971583.oracleText: When this creature enters, until end of turn, target creature you control gains vigilance and gets +X/+X, where X is the number of creatures you control.
971583.translation: 当此生物进场时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得警戒异能且得+X/+X，X为由你操控的生物数量。

971587.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may forage. If you do, draw a card.
971587.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以觅粮。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

971590.oracleText: Whenever another Frog, Rabbit, Raccoon, or Squirrel you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
971590.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的蛙，兔，浣熊或松鼠进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971602.oracleText: Tap four untapped tokens you control: Put three +1/+1 counters on Baylen. It gains trample until end of turn.
971602.translation: 横置四个由你操控且未横置的衍生物：在拜棱上放置三个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

971612.oracleText: {o1o(B/R)}: This creature gains menace until end of turn.
971612.translation: {o1o(B/R)}：此生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

971614.oracleText: Whenever Clement or another creature you control enters, return up to one target creature you control with lesser mana value to its owner's hand.
971614.translation: 每当克莱门特或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控且法术力值比进场生物小的生物移回其拥有者手上。

971620.oracleText: Whenever you forage, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
971620.translation: 每当你觅粮时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971623.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap up to one target creature and put three stun counters on it. If you control that creature, draw two cards.
971623.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置至多一个目标生物并在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。若你操控该生物，则抓两张牌。

971626.oracleText: Whenever Finneas attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control that's a token or a Rabbit. Then if creatures you control have total power 10 or greater, draw a card.
971626.translation: 每当芬纳斯攻击时，在每个由你操控且为衍生物或兔的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后若由你操控之生物的力量总和等于或大于10，则抓一张牌。

971633.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Lizard spell, Gev deals 1 damage to target opponent.
971633.translation: 每当你施放蜥蜴咒语时，盖夫向目标对手造成1点伤害。

971640.oracleText: When this creature enters, create two 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens.
971640.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出两个1/1白色的兔衍生生物。

971642.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 4 or greater, you draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
971642.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于4的生物咒语时，你抓一张牌，获得1点生命，并在赫尔嘉上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971643.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is Helga's power. Spend this mana only to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {oX} in their mana costs.
971643.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为赫尔嘉的力量。此法术力只能用来施放法术力值等于或大于4的生物咒语或法术力费用中包括{oX}的生物咒语。

971647.oracleText: When Hugs enters, exile the top X cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
971647.translation: 当哈格斯进场时，放逐你牌库顶的X张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

971654.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, this creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
971654.translation: 每当你花销4时，此生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

971670.oracleText: When Mabel enters, create Cragflame, a legendary colorless Equipment artifact token with "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance, trample, and haste" and equip {o2}.
971670.translation: 当玛贝尔进场时，派出传奇衍生神器焰齿剑，其为无色武具，且具有「佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒、践踏与敏捷异能」与佩带{o2}。

971684.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control with flying enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control without flying.
971684.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物进场时，在目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971688.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a loyalty counter on Ral.
971688.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在拉尔上放置一个忠诚指示物。

971697.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature you control without flying gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
971697.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

971709.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, it gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
971709.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。占卜1。

971712.oracleText: When this creature enters or dies, create a Food token.
971712.translation: 当此生物进场或死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。

971714.oracleText: This token gets +1/+1 for each other Rat you control.
971714.translation: 你每操控一个其他老鼠，此衍生物便得+1/+1。

971715.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This token gets +1/+1 for each other Rat you control," where X is the number of creatures that were exiled under your opponents' control this turn.
971715.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，派出X个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「你每操控一个其他老鼠，此衍生物便得+1/+1」，X为本回合中在对手的操控下被放逐的生物数量。

971718.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
971718.translation: 每当你花销4时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971723.oracleText: Whenever a Food is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put two +1/+1 counters on Ygra.
971723.translation: 每当一个食品从战场进入坟墓场时，在依格拉上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

971731.oracleText: When this artifact enters, create a Food token.
971731.translation: 当此神器进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

971732.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
971732.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：消灭目标非地永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

971735.oracleText: When this artifact enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
971735.translation: 当此神器进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

971746.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, if the gift was promised, attach this Equipment to target creature you control.
971746.translation: 当此武具进场时，若已应诺礼赠，则将此武具贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

971750.oracleText: Tap two untapped tokens you control: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
971750.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的衍生物：此载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

971764.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Bat, Bird, Mouse, or Rabbit card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
971764.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}，牺牲此地：检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张蝙蝠，鸟，家鼠或兔牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

971767.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return target Bat, Lizard, Rat, or Squirrel card from your graveyard to your hand.
971767.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，牺牲此地：将目标蝙蝠，蜥蜴，老鼠或松鼠牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

971783.oracleText: When Byrke enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
971783.translation: 当法耳恢恢包尔克进场时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971844.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature on the battlefield named Relentless Rats.
971844.translation: 战场上每有一个名称为无情鼠群的其他生物，此生物便得+1/+1。

971852.oracleText: Whenever Ink-Eyes deals combat damage to a player, you may put target creature card from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
971852.translation: 每当邪鬼仆役墨目对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将目标生物牌在你的操控下从该牌手的坟墓场放进战场。

971869.oracleText: When Derevi enters and whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may tap or untap target permanent.
971869.translation: 当穹光策士德蕾薇进场和每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以横置或重置目标永久物。

971873.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Ishai.
971873.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，在欧祝泰族龙语者依谢上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

971877.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put a flying counter on it. This ability triggers only once.
971877.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则在其上放置一个飞行指示物。此异能只会触发一次。

971882.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, this creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
971882.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，此生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

971906.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target creature an opponent controls.
971906.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物。

971907.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, put each card exiled with it into its owner's hand.
971907.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，将所有以其放逐的牌移回各自拥有者手上。

971910.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap up to one target creature. If an opponent controls that creature, put a stun counter on it.
971910.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置至多一个目标生物。如果该生物由对手操控，则在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

971915.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature gets +2/+4 until end of turn.
971915.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标生物得+2/+4直到回合结束。

971917.oracleText: When this creature enters, return an enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand or unlock a locked door of a Room you control.
971917.translation: 当此生物进场时，将一张结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上或解锁任一由你操控之隔间的一扇已上锁偏门。

971921.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, draw a card if you control a Glimmer creature. If you don't control a Glimmer creature, create a 1/1 white Glimmer enchantment creature token.
971921.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则如果你操控烁光体生物，抓一张牌。如果你未操控烁光体生物，则派出一个1/1白色烁光体衍生结界生物。

971929.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
971929.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

971939.oracleText: When this creature dies, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with power 2 or less from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
971939.translation: 当此生物死去时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张力量等于或小于2的生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

971945.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, tap any number of untapped creatures you control. This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature tapped this way.
971945.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的生物。每以此法横置一个生物，此生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

971948.oracleText: Whenever this permanent enters or attacks, create two 2/1 white Insect creature tokens with flying.
971948.translation: 每当此永久物进场或攻击时，派出两个2/1白色，具飞行异能的昆虫衍生生物。

971951.oracleText: This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it if you cast it from your hand.
971951.translation: 如果你从你手上施放此生物，则它进场时上面有两个-1/-1指示物。

971954.oracleText: {o3}, Discard a card: Put three +1/+1 counters on this creature and it becomes a black Demon in addition to its other colors and types. Activate only once.
971954.translation: {o3}，弃一张牌：在此生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物，它成为黑色恶魔，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。只能起动一次。

971956.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put a flying, lifelink, or +1/+1 counter on it.
971956.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则在其上放置一个飞行，系命或+1/+1指示物。

971957.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had counters on it, put those counters on up to one target creature.
971957.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有指示物，则将这些指示物放置在至多一个目标生物上。

971961.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
971961.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

971966.oracleText: As long as this Aura entered this turn, enchanted creature has hexproof.
971966.translation: 只要此灵气是于本回合进场，所结附的生物便具有辟邪异能。

971968.oracleText: When this Aura enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this Aura leaves the battlefield.
971968.translation: 当此灵气进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，直到此灵气离开战场为止。

971980.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card. Then discard a card unless you control another creature with power 2 or less.
971980.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓一张牌。然后除非你操控另一个力量等于或小于2的生物，否则弃一张牌。

971987.oracleText: This token can't attack or block alone.
971987.translation: 此衍生物不能单独进行攻击或阻挡。

971988.oracleText: When Toby enters, create a 4/4 white Beast creature token with "This token can't attack or block alone."
971988.translation: 当兽伴挚友托比进场时，派出一个4/4白色野兽衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能单独进行攻击或阻挡。」

971992.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
971992.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的神器，生物或结界，直到受困屏中离开战场为止。

971994.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, exile up to one target creature with toughness 5 or less.
971994.translation: 当此载具进场时，放逐至多一个目标防御力等于或小于5的生物。

971995.oracleText: When this Vehicle leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner manifests dread.
971995.translation: 当此载具离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者显化惧象。

971998.oracleText: When this creature enters, manifest dread.
971998.translation: 当此生物进场时，显化惧象。

972003.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
972003.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

972004.oracleText: As long as there are three or more cards exiled with this creature, it gets +3/+3 and has hexproof.
972004.translation: 只要以此生物放逐的牌有三张或更多，它便得+3/+3且具有辟邪异能。

972026.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, manifest dread, then attach this Equipment to that creature.
972026.translation: 当此武具进场时，显化惧象，然后将此武具贴附在该生物上。

972045.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
972045.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

972051.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature defending player controls gets -2/-0 and loses flying until your next turn.
972051.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，直到你的下一个回合，目标由防御牌手操控的生物得-2/-0且失去飞行异能。

972053.oracleText: When this creature enters, counter target spell. Its controller manifests dread.
972053.translation: 当此生物进场时，反击目标咒语。其操控者显化惧象。

972058.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Shuffle this creature and target creature with a stun counter on it into their owners' libraries.
972058.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：将洪坑沉溺客和目标其上有晕眩指示物的生物洗入各自拥有者的牌库。

972066.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, unlock a locked door of up to one target Room you control.
972066.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，解锁至多一个目标由你操控之隔间的一扇已上锁偏门。

972092.oracleText: Whenever this permanent enters or attacks, draw two cards, then discard a card.
972092.translation: 每当此永久物进场或攻击时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

972105.oracleText: This creature becomes a copy of another target creature you control.
972105.translation: 此生物成为另一个目标由你操控之生物的复制品。

972106.oracleText:
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, choose one that hasn't been chosen — 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature. 
• Draw a card. 
• This creature becomes a copy of another target creature you control.
972106.translation:
每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择一项且不得是之前选过的～ 
•在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。 
•抓一张牌。 
•此生物成为另一个目标由你操控之生物的复制品。

972109.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, this creature can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
972109.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，此生物于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

972119.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Glimmer enchantment creature token.
972119.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1白色烁光体衍生结界生物。

972134.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, put a possession counter on this creature.
972134.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，在此生物上放置一个夺身指示物。

972135.oracleText: When this creature dies, create an X/X blue Spirit creature token with flying, where X is the number of counters on this creature.
972135.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个X/X蓝色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物，X为此生物上的指示物数量。

972155.oracleText: When this Aura enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
972155.translation: 当此灵气进场时，检视目标牌手的手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

972159.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked by Glimmers.
972159.translation: 此生物不能被烁光体阻挡。

972160.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, you may search your library for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle.
972160.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

972163.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, this creature gets +2/+0 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
972163.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，直到回合结束，此生物得+2/+0且获得系命异能。

972180.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was cast, each player exiles all but the bottom six cards of their library face down.
972180.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它经施放，则每位牌手各只留下其牌库中底下的六张牌，其余则牌面朝下地放逐。

972187.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player discards a card. If you discarded a card this way, draw a card.
972187.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手各弃一张牌。如果你以此法弃掉一张牌，则抓一张牌。

972190.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target and you gain 1 life.
972190.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

972193.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, if defending player controls no Glimmer creatures, it gains menace and deathtouch until end of turn.
972193.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，若防御牌手未操控烁光体生物，则它获得威慑与死触异能直到回合结束。

972207.oracleText: When this creature dies, manifest dread.
972207.translation: 当此生物死去时，显化惧象。

972224.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may discard any number of cards. When you do, up to that many target creatures each get -2/-2 until end of turn.
972224.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以弃任意数量的牌。当你如此作时，至多该数量的目标生物各得-2/-2直到回合结束。

972227.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
972227.translation: 当此结界进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

972230.oracleText: Delirium — At the beginning of your end step, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, each opponent may sacrifice a nonland permanent of their choice or discard a card. Then this creature deals damage equal to its power to each opponent who didn't sacrifice a permanent or discard a card this way.
972230.translation: 躁狂～在你的结束步骤开始时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则每位对手各可以牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌。然后此生物向每位未以此法牺牲永久物或弃牌的对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

972233.oracleText: Whenever this permanent enters or attacks, mill four cards, then you may return a non-Avatar creature card or a planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
972233.translation: 每当此永久物进场或攻击时，磨四张牌，然后你可以将一张非圣者生物牌或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

972236.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature or enchantment: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
972236.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物或结界：此生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

972239.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oBoB}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard and only as a sorcery.
972239.translation: 躁狂～{o2oBoB}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多时起动，且仅限法术时机。

972242.oracleText: When this Aura enters, target player sacrifices a creature of their choice other than enchanted creature.
972242.translation: 当此灵气进场时，目标牌手依其选择牺牲一个所结附之生物以外的生物。

972250.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, they lose half their life, rounded up.
972250.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手失去一半数量的生命，小数点后进位。

972251.oracleText: When this creature dies, if it had no counters on it, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with two stun counters on it.
972251.translation: 当此生物死去时，若其上没有指示物，则将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，且上面有两个晕眩指示物。

972259.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent sacrifices a nontoken enchantment of their choice, then sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
972259.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的结界，然后各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

972276.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature or enchantment. When you do, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
972276.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或结界。当你如此作时，此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

972278.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, it deals 3 damage to up to one target creature.
972278.translation: 当此武具进场时，它对至多一个目标生物造成3点伤害。

972279.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures die, put a rev counter on this Equipment.
972279.translation: 每当一个或数个生物死去时，在此武具上放置一个轰转指示物。

972280.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +X/+0, where X is the number of rev counters on this Equipment.
972280.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+X/+0，X为此武具上的轰转指示物数量。

972288.oracleText: When this creature dies, exile the top card of your library. You may play it until the end of your next turn.
972288.translation: 当此生物死去时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

972290.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a time counter on this artifact. Then if there are seven or more time counters on it, remove those counters and it deals 20 damage to you.
972290.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在此神器上放置一个计时指示物。然后如果其上有七个或更多计时指示物，则移去这些指示物，且它对你造成20点伤害。

972302.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 4 damage to each opponent.
972302.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向每位对手各造成4点伤害。

972303.oracleText: Delirium — Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, this creature deals that amount of damage to target creature that player controls.
972303.translation: 躁狂～每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则此生物对目标由该牌手操控的生物造成该伤害数量的伤害。

972305.oracleText: When this creature enters, discard a card, then draw a card.
972305.translation: 当此生物进场时，弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。

972306.oracleText: Delirium — Whenever this creature attacks for the first time each turn, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, untap target creature. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
972306.translation: 躁狂～每当此生物每回合首度攻击时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则重置目标生物。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

972318.oracleText: Delirium — Whenever this creature attacks while there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, it gets +2/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
972318.translation: 躁狂～每当此生物于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多时攻击，直到回合结束，它得+2/+0且获得威慑异能。

972324.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
972324.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

972335.translation: 机敏求生家诺林不能进行阻挡。

972339.oracleText: Whenever this permanent enters or attacks, it deals 4 damage to any target.
972339.translation: 每当此永久物进场或攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

972357.oracleText: This creature gets +3/+0 as long as there are two or more unlocked doors among Rooms you control.
972357.translation: 只要由你操控之隔间中有两扇或更多已解锁偏门，此生物便得+3/+0。

972364.oracleText: This creature has first strike during your turn.
972364.translation: 此生物于你的回合中具有先攻异能。

972365.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card, this creature deals 1 damage to them.
972365.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌时，此生物对其造成1点伤害。

972375.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any other target. If a player is dealt damage this way, they can't gain life for the rest of the game.
972375.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，它对任意另一个目标造成等量的伤害。如果以此法对某牌手造成伤害，则该牌手在本盘游戏接下来的时段不能获得生命。

972398.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
972398.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物进场时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

972408.oracleText: Whenever Altanak becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, draw a card.
972408.translation: 每当三呼现身阿纳克成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你抓一张牌。

972409.oracleText: {o1oG}, Discard this card: Return target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
972409.translation: {o1oG}，弃掉此牌：将目标地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

972412.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may discard a card or pay {o2}. When you do, destroy target Room.
972412.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以弃一张牌或支付{o2}。当你如此作时，消灭目标隔间。

972414.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oGoG}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard and only as a sorcery.
972414.translation: 躁狂～{o2oGoG}：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多时起动，且仅限法术时机。

972425.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, you gain 2 life.
972425.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则你获得2点生命。

972431.oracleText: Whenever a face-down permanent you control enters and whenever this creature or another permanent you control is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
972431.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的永久物进场和每当奇妖巡检员或另一个由你操控的永久物翻回正面时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

972434.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, manifest dread.
972434.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则显化惧象。

972443.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gains deathtouch until end of turn.
972443.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

972455.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, manifest dread.
972455.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，显化惧象。（检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张牌面朝下地放进战场，当成2/2生物，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。如果该牌是生物牌，则可随时支付其法术力费用使其翻回正面。）

972458.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, you may mill two cards.
972458.translation: 每当此载具攻击时，你可以磨两张牌。

972464.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
972464.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止。将该牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

972469.oracleText:
{o2}, Sacrifice this creature: Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Draw a card. Then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
972469.translation:
{o2}，牺牲此生物：选择一项～ 
•消灭目标神器。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•抓一张牌。然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。

972473.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Kona is tapped, you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
972473.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若救星兽伴科纳已横置，则你可以将一张永久物牌从你手上放进战场。

972488.oracleText: Delirium — Whenever this creature enters or attacks, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures. Then if there are six or more card types among cards in your graveyard, double the number of +1/+1 counters on those creatures.
972488.translation: 躁狂～每当此生物进场或攻击时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标生物。然后如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有六种或更多，则将这些生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

972494.oracleText: Whenever this permanent enters or attacks, create a tapped colorless land token named Everywhere that is every basic land type.
972494.translation: 每当此永久物进场或攻击时，派出一个已横置，无色，名称为到处的衍生地，且是所有基本地类别。

972497.oracleText: Delirium — This creature can't attack or block unless there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
972497.translation: 躁狂～除非你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，否则此生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

972500.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put three +1/+1 counters on up to one target land you control. That land becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature in addition to its other types. It gains haste until your next turn.
972500.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则在至多一个目标由你操控的地上放置三个+1/+1指示物。该地成为0/0元素生物，且仍具有原本类别。它获得敏捷异能直到你的下一个回合。

972507.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
972507.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

972508.oracleText: Delirium — This creature gets +1/+2 and has vigilance as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
972508.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，此生物便得+1/+2且具有警戒异能。

972510.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, manifest dread.
972510.translation: 当此结界进场时，显化惧象。

972514.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Put a nest counter on this creature.
972514.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在此生物上放置一个巢窝指示物。

972515.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Create a 2/2 green Spider creature token with reach for each counter on this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
972515.translation: {oT}，牺牲此生物：此生物上每有一个指示物，便派出一个2/2绿色，具延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

972518.oracleText: Tap another untapped creature you control: Tyvar gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
972518.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的生物：猛击英杰泰瓦获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

972533.oracleText: Delirium — Whenever this creature attacks, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
972533.translation: 躁狂～每当此生物攻击时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，你可以将之放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

972536.oracleText: Whenever Arabella attacks, it deals X damage to each opponent and you gain X life, where X is the number of creatures you control with power 2 or less.
972536.translation: 每当遭弃娃娃阿拉贝拉攻击时，它向每位对手各造成X点伤害且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物数量。

972543.oracleText: {o4oBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice this creature: Create a number of 1/1 black and green Insect creature tokens with flying equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard.
972543.translation: {o4oBoG}，{oT}，牺牲此生物：派出若干1/1，黑绿双色，具飞行异能的昆虫衍生生物，其数量等同于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量。

972545.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, you may sacrifice another enchantment or creature. If you do, draw two cards.
972545.translation: 当此结界进场时，你可以牺牲另一个结界或生物。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

972546.oracleText: When you sacrifice this enchantment, manifest dread.
972546.translation: 当你牺牲此结界时，显化惧象。

972552.oracleText: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, you may return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
972552.translation: 异景～每当一个由你操控的结界进场和每当你完全解锁一个隔间时，你可以将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

972564.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a Room: This creature deals 2 damage to each opponent. Draw a card.
972564.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个隔间：此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。抓一张牌。

972582.oracleText: Whenever Nashi deals combat damage to a player, you mill that many cards. You may put any number of legendary and/or enchantment cards from among them into your hand. If you put no cards into your hand this way, put a +1/+1 counter on Nashi.
972582.translation: 每当黯境寻客哪失对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你磨等量的牌。你可以将其中任意数量的传奇和／或结界牌置于你手上。如果你未以此法将牌置于你手上，则在哪失上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

972584.oracleText: When Niko enters, create two Shard tokens.
972584.translation: 当希望之光尼科进场时，派出两个碎片衍生物。

972597.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Rip is tapped, reveal the top X cards of your library, where X is its power. Put any number of creature and/or Vehicle cards with different powers from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
972597.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若孽种猎人莉普已横置，则展示你牌库顶的X张牌，X为其力量。将其中任意数量力量各不相同的生物和／或载具牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

972607.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another creature or enchantment: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
972607.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个生物或结界：在此生物人上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

972608.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you sacrificed one or more permanents this turn, this creature deals that much damage to any target.
972608.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中牺牲过一个或数个永久物，则此生物对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

972611.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
972611.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

972614.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, each opponent loses 2 life. You gain 2 life and draw a card.
972614.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，每位对手各失去2点生命。你获得2点生命且抓一张牌。

972629.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard if a non-Zombie creature died this turn. If you do, this creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
972629.translation: 如果本回合中有非灵俑的生物死去，你可以从你的坟墓场施放此牌。如果你如此作，则此生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

972634.oracleText: Delirium — This creature gets +1/+1 and has trample as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
972634.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，此生物便得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

972643.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may have it get +4/+0 until end of turn. If you do, sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
972643.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以令它得+4/+0直到回合结束。若你如此作，则在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

972651.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Surveil 2, then draw a card.
972651.translation: {o2}，牺牲此神器：刺探2，然后抓一张牌。

972657.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Put each creature card exiled with this artifact onto the battlefield under your control with a flying counter on it. Each of them is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types. Activate only as a sorcery.
972657.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：将所有以此神器放逐的生物牌在你操控下放进战场，且上面有一个飞行指示物。它们均为1/1精怪，且仍具有原本类别。只能于法术时机起动。

972660.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 white Glimmer enchantment creature token.
972660.translation: 当此武具进场时，派出一个1/1白色烁光体衍生结界生物。

972663.oracleText: {o7}: Put seven +1/+1 counters on this artifact. It becomes a 0/0 Spirit creature in addition to its other types. Activate only once.
972663.translation: {o7}：在此神器上放置七个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。只能起动一次。

972667.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Lock or unlock a door of target Room you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
972667.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：上锁或解锁目标由你操控之隔间的一扇偏门。只能于法术时机起动。

972673.oracleText: Marvin has all activated abilities of creatures you control that don't have the same name as this creature.
972673.translation: 残暴拟偶马文具有由你操控且名称与此生物不同的生物之所有起动式异能。

972675.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, you may sacrifice a permanent other than that creature or this Equipment. If you do, draw a card.
972675.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个除该生物及此武具以外的永久物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

972678.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless a player has 13 or less life.
972678.translation: 除非有牌手的总生命为13或更少，否则此地须横置进场。

972786.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an Illusion in addition to its other types and it has "When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it."
972786.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进场，但它额外具有虚影此类别，且具有「当此生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，将它牺牲。」

972793.oracleText: Whenever enchanted player casts a noncreature spell, roll a d6. This Aura deals damage to that player equal to the result. Then attach this Aura to another one of your opponents chosen at random.
972793.translation: 每当所结附的牌手施放非生物咒语时，你掷一颗d6。此灵气对该牌手造成等同于掷骰结果的伤害。然后你随机选择另一位对手并将此灵气贴附于其上。

972796.oracleText: Boast — Sacrifice another creature or artifact: This creature deals damage equal to 2 plus the sacrificed permanent's mana value to any target.
972796.translation: 炫威～牺牲另一个生物或神器：此生物对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之永久物的法术力值加2。

972819.oracleText: When this artifact enters, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
972819.translation: 当此神器进场时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

972820.oracleText: Whenever you create one or more creature tokens, put a story counter on this artifact.
972820.translation: 每当你派出一个或数个衍生生物时，在此神器上放置一个叙事指示物。

972821.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Remove a story counter from this artifact: Draw a card.
972821.translation: {oW}，{oT}，从此神器上移去一个叙事指示物：抓一张牌。

972823.oracleText: When Torsten enters, reveal the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of creature and/or land cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
972823.translation: 当托斯滕进场时，展示你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中任意数量的生物和／或地牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

973234.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gains trample and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
973234.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+X，X为此生物的力量。

973236.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever this creature or another enchantment you control enters, choose target creature you control. Until end of turn, that creature has base power and toughness 4/4 and gains flying.
973236.translation: 星彩～每当此生物或另一个由你操控的结界进场时，选择目标由你操控的生物。直到回合结束，该生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4且获得飞行异能。

973243.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. This ability triggers only once each turn.
973243.translation: 每当在此生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

973259.oracleText: When this creature enters, another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
973259.translation: 当此生物进场时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

973262.oracleText: When this creature dies, create two 1/1 black and green Worm creature tokens.
973262.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出两个1/1，黑绿双色的蠕虫衍生生物。

973264.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste.
973264.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个1/1红色，具敏捷异能的士兵衍生生物。

973271.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice the token at the beginning of the next end step.
973271.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，选择目标由你操控的生物。派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

973275.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. You may cast that card until the end of your next turn. (You still pay its costs. Timing rules still apply.)
973275.translation: 当此生物进场时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以施放该牌。（你依旧要支付其费用，且仍须遵守施放时机规则。）

973281.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
973281.translation: {o2}，{oT}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

973284.oracleText: {o8}: This creature and up to one other target creature each get +3/+3 until end of turn.
973284.translation: {o8}：此生物和至多另一个目标生物各得+3/+3直到回合结束。

973289.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. 
• Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
973289.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

973295.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If you control four or more creatures, it gets +2/+2 and gains indestructible until end of turn instead.
973295.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果你操控四个或更多生物，则改为它得+2/+2且获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

973332.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player loses 3 life.
973332.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位牌手失去3点生命。

973344.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may destroy target nonblack creature.
973344.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以消灭目标非黑色生物。

973360.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, you may put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
973360.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语时，你可以在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

973361.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto other creatures.
973361.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以将此生物上任意数量的+1/+1指示物移到其他生物上。

973375.oracleText: {o1oR}: This land becomes a 2/1 red Warrior creature with first strike until end of turn. It's still a land.
973375.translation: {o1oR}：直到回合结束，此地成为2/1红色，具先攻异能的战士生物。它仍然是地。

973382.oracleText: When this creature enters, target player reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then puts those cards into their graveyard.
973382.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标牌手从其牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张地牌为止，然后将这些牌置入其坟墓场。

973391.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
973391.translation: 在你的维持开始时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。你获得等同于以此法所造成的伤害之生命。

973398.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
973398.translation: 牺牲一个生物：此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

973404.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses life equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
973404.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手失去等同于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的生命。

973406.oracleText: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, destroy target creature.
973406.translation: 当此生物进场时，若它已增幅，消灭目标生物。

973412.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
973412.translation: 牺牲一个生物：此生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

973426.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature you control. If you do, create a number of Treasure tokens equal to that creature's power.
973426.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个由你操控的生物。若你如此作，则派出若干珍宝衍生物，其数量等同于该生物的力量。

973429.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may put target creature card from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
973429.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将目标生物牌在你的操控下从该牌手的坟墓场放进战场。

973441.oracleText: Morbid — When this creature enters, if a creature died this turn, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
973441.translation: 丧心～当此生物进场时，若本回合中有生物死去，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

973457.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature you control enters, tap target creature an opponent controls.
973457.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

973464.oracleText: {o1oU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card, then discard a card.
973464.translation: {o1oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

973468.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may tap or untap target permanent.
973468.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以横置或重置目标永久物。

973482.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent draws a card and you draw three cards.
973482.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手抓一张牌且你抓三张牌。

973497.oracleText: This creature has reach as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it.
973497.translation: 只要此生物上面有+1/+1指示物，它便具有延势异能。

973501.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. 
• Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
973501.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～ 
•在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 
•从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌并将该牌置于牌库顶。

973504.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +4/+4 and gains trample until end of turn.
973504.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物得+4/+4且获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

973528.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may pay {o3oG}. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
973528.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，你可以支付{o3oG}。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

973533.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
973533.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

973535.oracleText: This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the total number of cards in all players' hands.
973535.translation: 此生物进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物，X为所有牌手手牌的总数。

973536.oracleText: {o2oG}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
973536.translation: {o2oG}，从此生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物：从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

973541.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
973541.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

973543.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token, a 3/3 green Beast creature token, and a 4/4 green Beast creature token.
973543.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物，一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物和一个4/4绿色野兽衍生生物。

973549.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to this creature while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature.
973549.translation: 如果此生物于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从此生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物。

973553.oracleText: When Verdeloth enters, if it was kicked, create X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
973553.translation: 当先人瓦德洛司进场时，若它已增幅，则派出X个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

973576.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste.
973576.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，派出一个1/1红色，具敏捷异能的士兵衍生生物。

973578.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
973578.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

973581.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, target creature an opponent controls can't block this turn.
973581.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，目标由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

973593.oracleText: You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +1/+1 and gains menace until end of turn.
973593.translation: 你可以于此生物攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+1且获得威慑异能。

973595.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
973595.translation: 每当此生物对一位牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

973603.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of opponents you have.
973603.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出若干1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其数量等同于你的对手数量。

973608.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each other attacking Goblin.
973608.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每有一个进行攻击的其他鬼怪，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

973611.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. During any turn you attacked with this creature, you may play that card.
973611.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于你以此生物攻击过的回合中，你可以使用该牌。

973616.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
973616.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，直到回合结束，此生物得+1/+0且获得践踏异能。

973620.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Vampire you control enters, this creature fights up to one target creature an opponent controls.
973620.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的吸血鬼进场时，此生物与至多一个目标由对手操控的生物互斗。

973621.oracleText: Whenever a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn dies, create a Blood token.
973621.translation: 每当一个本回合中受过此生物伤害的生物死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

973629.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another nontoken Vampire you control dies, create a Treasure token.
973629.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的吸血鬼死去时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

973640.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
973640.translation: 每当此生物每回合首度成为咒语或异能的目标时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

973641.oracleText: As long as this creature has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying.
973641.translation: 只要此生物上有三个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有飞行异能。

973643.oracleText: {o1oW}: Return this Aura to its owner's hand.
973643.translation: {o1oW}：将此灵气移回其拥有者手上。

973650.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, you may tap target creature.
973650.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，你可以横置目标生物。

973658.oracleText: Angel spells and Human spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each +1/+1 counter on this creature.
973658.translation: 此生物上每有一个+1/+1指示物，你施放之天使与人类咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

973664.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each Equipment you control.
973664.translation: 你每操控一个武具，此生物便得+1/+0。

973667.oracleText: This creature gains first strike and lifelink until end of turn.
973667.translation: 此生物获得先攻与系命异能直到回合结束。

973669.oracleText: Exile this creature, then return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control.
973669.translation: 放逐此生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

973670.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, choose one — 
• Tap target creature. 
• This creature gains first strike and lifelink until end of turn. 
• Exile this creature, then return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control.
973670.translation:
每当你施放非生物咒语时，选择一项～ 
•横置目标生物。 
•此生物获得先攻与系命异能直到回合结束。 
•放逐此生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

973695.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
973695.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

973697.oracleText: Whenever Brimaz attacks, create a 1/1 white Cat Soldier creature token with vigilance that's attacking.
973697.translation: 每当俄瑞恣狮王布黎玛攻击时，派出一个1/1白色，具警戒异能的猫／士兵衍生生物且正进行攻击。

973706.oracleText: When Venser enters, return target spell or permanent to its owner's hand.
973706.translation: 当塑形学者凡瑟进场时，将目标咒语或永久物移回其拥有者手上。

973710.oracleText: Whenever Gorex attacks or dies, choose a card at random exiled with Gorex and put that card into its owner's hand.
973710.translation: 每当驮墓龟高雷兹攻击或死去时，随机选择一张以高雷兹放逐的牌，并将该牌置于其拥有者手上。

973729.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets Brigone, put a +1/+1 counter on Brigone.
973729.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以迈勒提斯士兵布莉戈涅为目标的咒语时，在布莉戈涅上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

973733.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if you control five or more enchantments, Psemilla gets +4/+4 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
973733.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若你操控五个或更多结界，则直到回合结束，迈勒提斯诗人普塞弥拉得+4/+4且获得系命异能。

973735.oracleText: Whenever Qala attacks, other attacking creatures you control get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of counters on Qala.
973735.translation: 每当阿耶尼群伴卡拉攻击时，由你操控且进行攻击的其他生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为卡拉上指示物的数量。

973743.oracleText: When Urdnan enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
973743.translation: 当卓茉卡族战士乌尔德南进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

973747.oracleText: When Cynette enters or dies, create a 1/1 blue Jellyfish creature token with flying.
973747.translation: 当水母牧者赛涅蒂进场或死去时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的水母衍生生物。

973749.oracleText: Whenever Neerdiv becomes tapped, target player mills cards equal to its power.
973749.translation: 每当狡诈潜盗涅迪芙成为横置时，目标牌手磨等同于其力量的牌。

973754.oracleText: When Plagon enters, draw a card for each creature you control with toughness greater than its power.
973754.translation: 当滩涂之主普拉贡进场时，你每操控一个防御力比力量大的生物，便抓一张牌。

973759.oracleText: When Pol Jamaar enters, choose a creature type. Draw a card for each creature you control of that type.
973759.translation: 当幻影师波贾玛进场时，选择一种生物类别。你每操控一个该类别的生物，便抓一张牌。

973761.translation: 隐雷崩塔耶壳须横置进场。

973768.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on Evereth. If the sacrificed permanent was a Treasure, Evereth gains lifelink until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
973768.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或神器：在劫夺总督艾霏蕾上放置一个+1/+1指示物。如果所牺牲的永久物是珍宝，则艾霏蕾获得系命异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

973775.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a feeding counter on Nazar.
973775.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在丝绒尖牙纳萨尔上放置一个喂养指示物。

973778.translation: 碎响骨王奥索兹不能进行阻挡。

973780.oracleText: When Jumblebones leaves the battlefield, return target card named Ozox, the Clattering King from your graveyard to your hand.
973780.translation: 当乱骨离开战场时，将目标名称为碎响骨王奥索兹的牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

973781.oracleText: When Ozox dies, create Jumblebones, a legendary 2/1 black Skeleton creature token with "Jumblebones can't block" and "When Jumblebones leaves the battlefield, return target card named Ozox, the Clattering King from your graveyard to your hand."
973781.translation: 当奥索兹死去时，派出传奇衍生生物乱骨，其为2/1黑色的骷髅妖，且具有「乱骨不能进行阻挡」与「当乱骨离开战场时，将目标名称为碎响骨王奥索兹的牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。」

973786.oracleText: You may exert Anep as it attacks. When you do, exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
973786.translation: 于哈佐蕾维齐尔阿内普攻击时，你可以耗竭之。当你如此作时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

973793.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, General Kreat deals 1 damage to each opponent.
973793.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，电光传客克铃将军向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

973798.oracleText: When Ivora enters and whenever it deals combat damage to a player, create a Blood token.
973798.translation: 当无餍传人依沃拉进场和每当它对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

973802.oracleText: Braulios's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
973802.translation: 斐力兹族的鲍里俄斯的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

973803.oracleText: Whenever Braulios attacks, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
973803.translation: 每当斐力兹族的鲍里俄斯攻击时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

973809.oracleText: Whenever Hurska attacks, create a Food token.
973809.translation: 每当甜牙齿赫卡攻击时，派出一个食品衍生物。

973819.oracleText: When Sutina enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
973819.translation: 当特裘如领袖苏提娜进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

973864.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player exiles two permanents they control.
973864.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手放逐两个由其操控的永久物。

973877.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another permanent. If you do, create a 3/2 colorless Eldrazi Horror creature token.
973877.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲另一个永久物。若你如此作，则派出一个3/2无色奥札奇／惊惧兽衍生生物。

973878.oracleText: Delirium — At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, transform this creature.
973878.translation: 躁狂～在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，转化此生物。

973887.oracleText: Until end of turn, Gideon becomes a 5/5 Human Soldier Ally creature with indestructible that's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
973887.translation: 直到回合结束，赞迪卡伙伴基定成为5/5，具不灭异能的人类／士兵／伙伴生物，且仍然是鹏洛客。防止本回合中将对他造成的所有伤害。

973900.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you may search your library for a Plains card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
973900.translation: 当此生物进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张平原牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

973904.oracleText: When Linvala enters, if an opponent has more life than you, you gain 5 life.
973904.translation: 当存护天使琳法拉进场时，若某对手的生命比你多，则你获得5点生命。

973908.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
973908.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

973911.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
973911.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，在每个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

973920.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature with mana value 3 or less an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
973920.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

973931.oracleText: Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, you may cast this spell as though it had flash.
973931.translation: 精熟咒语～如果你坟墓场中有两张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，则你可以将此咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

973941.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, you may have this creature become a copy of target creature, except it has this ability.
973941.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，你可以令此生物成为目标生物的复制品，但它具有此异能。

973962.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control two or more Gates, you may draw a card.
973962.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控两个或更多门，你可以抓一张牌。

973970.oracleText: When this creature becomes monstrous, tap up to four target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controllers' untap steps for as long as you control this creature.
973970.translation: 当此生物蛮化时，横置至多四个目标生物。于你操控此生物的时段内，这些生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

973982.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target red or green creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control this creature.
973982.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的红色或绿色生物。于你操控此生物的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

973984.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, scry 2.
973984.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，占卜2。

974010.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a green or white creature card from it and exile that card.
974010.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张绿色或白色的生物牌，并放逐该牌。

974012.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, exile Liliana, then return her to the battlefield transformed under her owner's control. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
974012.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，放逐异端治疗师莉莲娜，然后将她在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

974020.oracleText: This creature and enchanted creature each get +X/+X, where X is the number of creature cards in all graveyards.
974020.translation: 此生物与所结附的生物各得+X/+X，X为所有坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

974030.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.
974030.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个5/5黑色，具飞行异能的恶魔衍生生物。

974039.oracleText: When Sidisi exploits a creature, you may search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
