974039.translation: 当不死宰相谢迪西榨取生物时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后将你的牌库洗牌。

974043.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
974043.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

974047.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, each opponent loses 1 life. You gain life equal to the life lost this way.
974047.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于以此法失去的生命总和。

974050.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control two or more Gates, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
974050.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你操控两个或更多门，则目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

974057.oracleText: This creature has first strike and trample as long as an instant card and a sorcery card are in your graveyard.
974057.translation: 只要你坟墓场中同时有瞬间牌及法术牌，此生物便具有先攻与践踏异能。

974068.oracleText: Chandra deals X damage to each creature.
974068.translation: 召焰茜卓对每个生物各造成X点伤害。

974084.oracleText: {oT}: Draw two cards. Target opponent gains control of this creature. Activate only during your turn.
974084.translation: {oT}：抓两张牌。目标对手获得此生物的操控权。只能于你的回合中起动。

974087.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Eldrazi creature spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may exile this card from your graveyard. If you do, this card deals 5 damage to each creature.
974087.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的奥札奇生物咒语时，你可以从你的坟墓场放逐此牌。若你如此作，则此牌对每个生物各造成5点伤害。

974090.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
974090.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

974092.oracleText: Battalion — Whenever this creature and at least two other creatures attack, creatures you control gain first strike and trample until end of turn and can't be blocked by creature tokens this turn.
974092.translation: 协战～每当此生物与至少两个其他生物攻击时，由你操控的生物获得先攻与践踏异能直到回合结束，且本回合不能被衍生生物阻挡。

974104.oracleText: When you sacrifice this Aura, it deals 3 damage to any target.
974104.translation: 当你牺牲此灵气时，它对任意目标造成3点伤害。

974106.oracleText: As this enchantment enters, choose Khans or Dragons.
974106.translation: 于此结界进场时，选择可汗或龙王。

974108.oracleText: • Dragons — Whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield, this enchantment deals 1 damage to any target.
974108.translation: •  龙王～每当一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，此结界对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

974118.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a noncreature spell, if this creature is renowned, this creature deals 2 damage to that player.
974118.translation: 每当任一对手施放非生物咒语时，若此生物已铭勇，则此生物对该牌手造成2点伤害。

974120.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Dragon you control enters, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of Dragons you control.
974120.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的龙进场时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的龙数量。

974126.oracleText: Zurgo can't block creatures with power 2 or greater.
974126.translation: 司钟珠高不能阻挡力量等于或大于2的生物。

974139.oracleText: Remove two +1/+1 counters from this creature: Regenerate it.
974139.translation: 从此生物上移去两个+1/+1指示物：重生此生物。

974142.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, you may pay {oX}. If you do, put X +1/+1 counters on this creature.
974142.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以此生物为目标的咒语时，你可以支付{oX}。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物。

974147.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, create that many 1/1 green Insect creature tokens with flying and deathtouch.
974147.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，派出等量的1/1绿色，具飞行与死触异能的昆虫衍生生物。

974165.oracleText: When this creature dies, create an X/X green Elemental creature token, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
974165.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个X/X绿色元素衍生生物，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

974174.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each opponent, destroy target noncreature permanent that player controls. For each permanent destroyed this way, search your library for a Forest card and put that card onto the battlefield tapped. Then shuffle.
974174.translation: 当此生物进场时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～从由其操控的永久物中选择一个目标非生物永久物，消灭该永久物。每有一个以此法消灭的永久物，便从你的牌库中搜寻一张树林牌，并将其横置进战场。然后洗牌。

974183.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Until end of turn, face-up nontoken creatures you control gain "When this creature dies, manifest the top card of your library."
974183.translation: 牺牲此生物：直到回合结束，由你操控、牌面朝上且非衍生物的生物获得「当此生物死去时，显化你的牌库顶牌。」

974186.oracleText: Converge — This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each color of mana spent to cast it.
974186.translation: 聚辉～此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为施放它支付的法术力颜色数量。

974193.oracleText: When this creature enters or dies, exile target permanent.
974193.translation: 当此生物进场或死去时，放逐目标永久物。

974195.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a muster counter on this enchantment. Then create a 1/1 red and white Soldier creature token with haste for each muster counter on this enchantment.
974195.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在此结界上放置一个召集指示物。然后此结界上每有一个召集指示物，便派出一个1/1，红白双色，具敏捷异能的士兵衍生生物。

974197.oracleText: As long as you have 30 or more life and an opponent has 10 or less life, this creature gets +6/+6 and has flying.
974197.translation: 只要你的总生命为30或更多，且某对手的总生命为10或更少，此生物便得+6/+6且具有飞行异能。

974200.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: This creature gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.
974200.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：选择一种颜色。此生物获得反该色保护异能直到回合结束。

974202.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
974202.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1无色奥札奇／孽裔衍生生物。它具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

974240.oracleText: As long as this creature is monstrous, it has hexproof and indestructible.
974240.translation: 只要此生物已蛮化，它便具有辟邪与不灭异能。

974243.oracleText: Bloodrush — {oRoG}, Discard this card: Target attacking creature gets +4/+4 and gains trample until end of turn.
974243.translation: 血激～{oRoG}，弃掉此牌：直到回合结束，目标进行攻击的生物得+4/+4且获得践踏异能。

974250.oracleText: Discard a creature card: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
974250.translation: 弃一张生物牌：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

974254.oracleText: When this creature enters, detain target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
974254.translation: 当此生物进场时，拘留目标由对手操控的非地永久物。

974259.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn and can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
974259.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，此生物得+3/+0直到回合结束，且本回合能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

974262.oracleText: When this creature enters, return target instant, sorcery, or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
974262.translation: 当此生物进场时，将目标瞬间，法术或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

974265.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has "At the beginning of your upkeep, if this creature isn't a token, create a token that's a copy of this creature."
974265.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一生物的复制品来进场，但它具有「在你的维持开始时，若此生物不是衍生物，则派出一个为此生物之复制品的衍生物。」

974267.oracleText: Ruric Thar attacks each combat if able.
974267.translation: 拒降者鲁瑞杂尔每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

974271.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it and exile that card.
974271.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张瞬间或法术牌，并放逐该牌。

974282.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may put a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
974282.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的手上或坟墓场放进战场。该生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

974294.oracleText: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
974294.translation: 每当你起动神器或生物上不属法术力异能之异能时，此生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

974298.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return target Dragon creature card or Ugin planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
974298.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此地：将目标龙生物牌或乌金鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

974308.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create three 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature tokens. They have "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
974308.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出三个1/1无色奥札奇／孽裔衍生生物。它们具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

974311.oracleText: {o2oUoR}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 1/4 blue and red Elemental creature with "{o0}: Switch this creature's power and toughness until end of turn." It's still a land.
974311.translation: {o2oUoR}：直到回合结束，此地成为1/4，蓝红双色的元素生物，且具有「{o0}：将此生物的力量与防御力互换直到回合结束。」它仍然是地。

974315.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens equal to your devotion to white.
974315.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出若干1/1白色士兵衍生生物，其数量等同于你的白色献力。

974317.oracleText: This creature can't be the target of black or red spells your opponents control.
974317.translation: 此生物不能成为由对手操控之黑色或红色咒语的目标。

974321.oracleText: When this creature exploits a creature, counter target creature spell.
974321.translation: 当此生物榨取生物时，反击目标生物咒语。

974324.oracleText: {o2oU}: Draw a card, then put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
974324.translation: {o2oU}：抓一张牌，然后在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

974329.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 black Harpy creature tokens with flying equal to your devotion to black.
974329.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出若干1/1黑色，具飞行异能的哈痞衍生生物，其数量等同于你的黑色献力。

974331.oracleText: When this creature enters, target player reveals a number of cards from their hand equal to your devotion to black. You choose one of them. That player discards that card.
974331.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标牌手从其手上展示若干牌，其数量等同于你的黑色献力。你从中选择一张。该牌手弃掉该牌。

974334.oracleText: When this creature becomes monstrous, destroy target non-Gorgon creature an opponent controls.
974334.translation: 当此生物蛮化时，消灭目标由对手操控的非蛇发妖生物。

974337.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell from a graveyard, this creature deals 3 damage to that player.
974337.translation: 每当任一牌手从坟墓场中施放咒语时，此生物对该牌手造成3点伤害。

974343.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, this enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.
974343.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，此结界对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

974346.oracleText: When this creature becomes monstrous, creatures without flying your opponents control can't block this turn.
974346.translation: 当此生物蛮化时，由对手操控且不具飞行异能的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

974349.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
974349.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的其他生物数量。

974353.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may tap or untap target creature.
974353.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以横置或重置目标生物。

974359.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your devotion to green.
974359.translation: 当此生物进场时，在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你的绿色献力。

974364.oracleText: {o(U/R)}: This creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

974386.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles the top card of their library.
974386.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手放逐其牌库顶牌。

974387.oracleText: You may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled with this creature.
974387.translation: 你可以从以此生物放逐的牌之中使用地和施放咒语。

974397.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each attacking creature you control.
974397.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每有一个由你操控、且进行攻击的生物，便在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

974411.oracleText: When this Aura enters, draw a card for each Aura you control that's attached to a creature.
974411.translation: 当此灵气进场时，你每操控一个贴附在生物上的灵气，便抓一张牌。

974448.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
974448.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，你可以将此牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

974459.oracleText: When this creature enters, if its surge cost was paid, other creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
974459.translation: 当此生物进场时，若曾支付其潮涌费用，则直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

974468.oracleText: When this creature enters, create three 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature tokens. They have "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
974468.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出三个1/1无色奥札奇／孽裔衍生生物。它们具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

974475.oracleText: Formidable — Whenever this creature attacks, if creatures you control have total power 8 or greater, creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
974475.translation: 强横～每当此生物攻击时，若由你操控之生物的力量总和等于或大于8，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

975393.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: When you next activate an exhaust ability that isn't a mana ability this turn, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
975393.translation: {o2}，{oT}：本回合中，当你下一次起动任一竭绝异能时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

975518.oracleText: When you next activate an exhaust ability that isn't a mana ability this turn, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
975518.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次起动任一竭绝异能时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

975535.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, creatures you control gain trample and get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
975535.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+X，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。

975538.oracleText: Imprint — When this artifact enters, you may exile a nonartifact, nonland card from your hand.
975538.translation: 压印～当此神器进场时，你可以从你手上放逐一张非神器且非地的牌。

975642.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Put your commander into your hand from the command zone.
975642.translation: {oT}，牺牲此地：将你的指挥官从统帅区置于你手上。

975669.oracleText: {o9}: Untap this creature. Activate only during your upkeep.
975669.translation: {o9}：重置此生物。只能于你的维持中起动。

975677.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
975677.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

975722.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may search your library for up to two creature cards with mana value 1 or less, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
975722.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，且每张牌的法术力值均须等于或小于1，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。若你如此作，则洗牌。

975737.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Mountain.
975737.translation: 只要你操控山脉，此生物便得+1/+1。

975738.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Plains.
975738.translation: 只要你操控平原，此生物便得+1/+1。

975750.oracleText: {o1}, Exile this artifact: Exile all graveyards. Draw a card.
975750.translation: {o1}，放逐此神器：放逐所有坟墓场。抓一张牌。

975781.oracleText:
Whenever this creature deals damage, choose one — 
• Each player loses 1 life. 
• Each player gains 1 life.
975781.translation:
每当此生物造成伤害时，选择一项～ 
•每位牌手各失去1点生命。 
•每位牌手各获得1点生命。

975829.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Kuro unless you pay {oBoBoBoB}.
975829.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你支付{oBoBoBoB}，否则牺牲暗渊王苦弄。

975860.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, destroy all creatures your opponents control, then tap all other creatures you control.
975860.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你从手上施放之，消灭所有由对手操控的生物，横置所有由你操控的其他生物。

975868.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, this creature deals 3 damage to any target.
975868.translation: 在每个维持开始时，此生物对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

975871.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you control another artifact.
975871.translation: 只要你操控另一个神器，此生物便得+1/+1。

975881.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each land card in your graveyard.
975881.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张地牌，此生物便得+1/+1。

975889.oracleText: When this creature enters, reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all artifact cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
975889.translation: 当此生物进场时，展示你牌库顶的三张牌。将所有以此法展示的神器牌置于你的手上，并将其他的牌置入你的坟墓场。

975897.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, exile all artifacts.
975897.translation: 当此生物进场时，若你从手上使用之，则将所有神器放逐。

975907.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a charge counter on this artifact.
975907.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以在此神器上放置一个充电指示物。

975908.oracleText: When this artifact has twenty or more charge counters on it, you win the game.
975908.translation: 当此神器上有二十个或更多充电指示物时，你赢得这盘游戏。

975956.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile another target permanent. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
975956.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐另一个目标永久物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

975975.oracleText: {oT}: Put a charge counter on this artifact.
975975.translation: {oT}：在此神器上放置一个充电指示物。

975976.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, remove all charge counters from this artifact. Add one mana of any color for each charge counter removed this way.
975976.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，移去此神器上的所有充电指示物。每以此法移去一个充电指示物，便加一点任意颜色的法术力。

976138.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may have target player lose life equal to the number of Zombies on the battlefield.
976138.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以使目标牌手失去X点生命，X为战场上的灵俑数量。

976143.oracleText: When you cycle this card, you may have it deal X damage to target creature, where X is the number of Goblins on the battlefield.
976143.translation: 当你循环此牌时，你可以对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为场上鬼怪数量之总和。

976210.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals damage to an opponent, that player discards a card at random.
976210.translation: 每当此生物向对手造成伤害时，该牌手随机弃一张牌。

976212.oracleText: As long as you have 30 or more life, this creature gets +5/+5 and has flying.
976212.translation: 只要你的总生命为30或更多，此生物便得+5/+5且具有飞行异能。

976234.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
976234.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，派出两个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

976236.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, it deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
976236.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，它对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

976241.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exile target artifact or enchantment.
976241.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以放逐目标神器或结界。

976279.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Look at a card at random in target player's hand. You draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
976279.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：随机检视目标牌手手上的一张牌。在下一个回合维持开始时，你抓一张牌。

976285.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.
976285.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的山脉数量。

976307.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, sacrifice it unless you sacrifice an Island.
976307.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，除非你牺牲一个海岛，否则将它牺牲。

976448.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on this artifact, counter that spell.
976448.translation: 每当任一牌手施放法术力值等同于此神器上充电指示物数量的咒语时，反击该咒语。

976455.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU} or {oB}. This artifact deals 1 damage to you.
976455.translation: {oT}：加{oU}或{oB}。此神器对你造成1点伤害。

976457.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR} or {oG}. This artifact deals 1 damage to you.
976457.translation: {oT}：加{oR}或{oG}。此神器对你造成1点伤害。

976459.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oB} or {oR}. This artifact deals 1 damage to you.
976459.translation: {oT}：加{oB}或{oR}。此神器对你造成1点伤害。

976461.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} or {oW}. This artifact deals 1 damage to you.
976461.translation: {oT}：加{oG}或{oW}。此神器对你造成1点伤害。

976473.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW} or {oU}. This artifact deals 1 damage to you.
976473.translation: {oT}：加{oW}或{oU}。此神器对你造成1点伤害。

976484.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any artifact or creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
976484.translation: 你可以使此生物当成战场上任一神器或生物的复制品来进入战场，但它额外具有神器此类别。

976510.oracleText: {o3}: Return this Equipment to its owner's hand.
976510.translation: {o3}：将此武具移回其拥有者手上。

976526.oracleText: Remove a charge counter from this artifact: Add one mana of any color.
976526.translation: 从此神器上移去一个充电指示物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

976604.oracleText: When Emrakul is put into a graveyard from anywhere, its owner shuffles their graveyard into their library.
976604.translation: 当伊莫库从任何区域进入坟墓场时，其拥有者将其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

976614.oracleText: When Ulamog is put into a graveyard from anywhere, its owner shuffles their graveyard into their library.
976614.translation: 当钨拉莫从任何区域进入坟墓场时，其拥有者将其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

976642.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this creature unless you pay {oRoRoRoR}.
976642.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你支付{oRoRoRoR}，否则牺牲此生物。

976663.oracleText: When Bladewing enters, you may return target Dragon permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
976663.translation: 当复生者锋翼进场时，你可以将目标龙永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

976711.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player reveals their hand. You choose a card from it. That player exiles that card.
976711.translation: 每当此生物对牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手展示其手牌。选择其中一张牌，该牌手将该牌放逐。

976814.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on this artifact.
976814.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：消灭所有法术力值等同于此神器上充电指示物数量的非地永久物。

976834.oracleText: If this artifact would enter, you may discard a land card instead. If you do, put this artifact onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard.
976834.translation: 如果此神器将进场，则你可以改为弃一张地牌。若你如此作，则将此神器放进战场。若你未如此作，则将它置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

976860.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oCoC}. This land deals 2 damage to you.

976976.oracleText: If this card is in your opening hand and you're not the starting player, you may begin the game with CARDNAME on the battlefield with a luck counter on it. If you do, exile a card from your hand.
976976.translation: 如果你的起手牌中包含了此牌，且你不是先手牌手，则你可以让CARDNAME在战场上来开始游戏，且上面有一个运气指示物。如果你如此作，则从你手上放逐一张牌。

976977.oracleText: If this card is in your opening hand and you're not the starting player, you may begin the game with Gemstone Caverns on the battlefield with a luck counter on it. If you do, exile a card from your hand.
976977.translation: 如果你的起手牌中包含了此牌，且你不是先手牌手，则你可以让宝石洞穴在战场上来开始游戏，且上面有一个运气指示物。如果你如此作，则从你手上放逐一张牌。

977037.oracleText: {o1oG}: This land becomes a 3/3 green Ape creature with trample until end of turn. It's still a land.

1000472.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

1000608.oracleText: When CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
1000608.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

1000643.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or battle, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1000643.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

1000662.oracleText: When CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME or dies, create a 1/1 green Phyrexian Saproling creature token.
1000662.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME或死去时，派出一个1/1绿色非瑞人／腐生物衍生生物。

1000776.oracleText: When CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME, put target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
1000776.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

1001035.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or battle, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1001035.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶等量的牌。你可以展示其中一张生物或地牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1001060.oracleText: When CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME, target creature an opponent controls gets -0/-X until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1001060.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，目标由对手操控的生物得-0/-X直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1001143.oracleText: CARDNAME assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
1001143.translation: CARDNAME依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

1001365.oracleText: {o1oRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Spirit: Choose target card exiled with CARDNAME. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
1001365.translation: {o1oRoW}，{oT}，牺牲一个精怪：选择目标以CARDNAME放逐的牌。本回合中，你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

1001549.oracleText: When you pay this cost one or more times, choose up to that many.
1001549.translation: 当你支付一次或数次此费用时，选择至多等量的模式。

1002142.oracleText: CARDNAME must be blocked this turn if able and gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
1002142.translation: CARDNAME本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作，且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

1002144.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by more than one creature each combat this turn and gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
1002144.translation: 本回合中，CARDNAME每次战斗不能被多于一个生物阻挡，且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

1002146.oracleText: Whenever you scry, choose one — • CARDNAME must be blocked this turn if able and gets +1/+1 until end of turn. • CARDNAME can't be blocked by more than one creature each combat this turn and gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
1002146.translation: 每当你占卜时，选择一项～ •CARDNAME本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作，且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。 •本回合中，CARDNAME每次战斗不能被多于一个生物阻挡，且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

1002919.oracleText: When CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME, return all non-Horror creatures to their owners' hands.
1002919.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，将所有非惊惧兽的生物移回其拥有者手上。

1002956.oracleText: When CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME, you may destroy target creature.
1002956.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，你可以消灭目标生物。

1003039.oracleText: When CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME, target opponent sacrifices three creatures of their choice.
1003039.translation: 当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，目标对手牺牲三个依其选择的生物。

1003203.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or transforms into CARDNAME, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token and you gain 2 life.
1003203.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或转化为CARDNAME时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物，且你获得2点生命。

1003207.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME transforms into CARDNAME, it deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker and 2 damage to up to one target creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls.
1003207.translation: 每当CARDNAME转化为CARDNAME时，它向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害，并对至多一个目标由该牌手或该鹏洛客之操控者操控的生物造成2点伤害。

1003688.oracleText: Whenever an instant or sorcery spell you control that targets only a single creature deals damage to that creature, CARDNAME deals that much damage to each opponent.
1003688.translation: 每当一个由你操控且仅以单一生物为目标的瞬间或法术咒语对该生物造成伤害时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成等量的伤害。

1003719.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This token can't block."
1003719.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

1003962.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
1003962.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时攻击，CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

1004221.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life.
1004221.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

1004222.oracleText: When this token is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life.
1004222.translation: 当此衍生物从战场进入坟墓场时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

1004362.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed under its owner's control.
1004362.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场且已转化。

1004540.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed under its owner's control with three time counters on it.
1004540.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，其为已横置、已转化且其上有三个计时指示物。

1004618.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, each opponent discards a card. For each opponent who can't, you draw a card.
1004618.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，每位对手各弃一张牌。每有一位无法如此作的对手，你便抓一张牌。

1004880.oracleText: If a red source you control would deal an amount of noncombat damage less than CARDNAME's power to an opponent, that source deals damage equal to CARDNAME's power instead.
1004880.translation: 如果某个由你操控的红色来源将向任一对手造成数量小于CARDNAME力量的非战斗伤害，则改为该来源造成等同于CARDNAME力量的伤害。

1005052.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, reveal that many cards from the top of your library. You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
1005052.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你的牌库顶展示等量的牌。你可以将其中一张生物牌和／或一张地牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1005124.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more non-Gnome creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME, then create X 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens that are tapped and attacking, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
1005124.translation: 每当你以一个或数个非地侏生物攻击时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后派出X个1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物，其为横置且正进行攻击，X为CARDNAME上的+1/+1指示物数量。

1005364.oracleText: CARDNAME can be used to represent a copy of something else.
1005364.translation: CARDNAME可以用于表示其他物件的复制品。

1005377.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.
1005377.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：令目标由你操控的生物勘察。只能于法术时机起动。

1005378.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.
1005378.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲此衍生物：令目标由你操控的生物勘察。只能于法术时机起动。

1005408.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, choose target creature you don't control. Each creature you control deals 1 damage to that creature.
1005408.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择目标不由你操控的生物。每个由你操控的生物各对该生物造成1点伤害。

1005422.oracleText: Solved — Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creature cards in your graveyard gain "You may cast this card from your graveyard" until end of turn.
1005422.translation: 侦结～牺牲CARDNAME：你坟墓场中的生物牌获得「你可以从你坟墓场中施放此牌」直到回合结束。

1005558.oracleText: Solved — {o2oU}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put four +1/+1 counters on target noncreature artifact. It becomes a 0/0 Bird creature with flying in addition to its other types.
1005558.translation: 侦结～{o2oU}，牺牲CARDNAME：在目标非生物的神器上放置四个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0，具飞行异能的鸟生物，且仍具有原本类别。

1005690.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/1 black Skeleton creature token and suspect it.
1005690.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/1黑色骷髅妖衍生生物并怀疑它。

1005694.oracleText: Solved — {o1oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
1005694.translation: 侦结～{o1oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

1005814.oracleText: Solved — Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile the top three cards of your library. Choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
1005814.translation: 侦结～牺牲CARDNAME：放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。选择其中一张。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

1005817.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, discard a card, then draw two cards.
1005817.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，弃一张牌，然后抓两张牌。

1006450.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy up to one target creature that was dealt damage this turn.
1006450.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭至多一个目标本回合中受过伤害的生物。

1006454.oracleText: Solved — CARDNAME is a 4/4 Gorgon creature with deathtouch and lifelink in addition to its other types.
1006454.translation: 侦结～CARDNAME是4/4，具死触与系命异能的蛇发妖生物，且仍具有原本类别。

1007393.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, it deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
1007393.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

1007725.oracleText: Solved — Whenever you attack with one or more creatures, CARDNAME deals that much damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.
1007725.translation: 侦结～每当你以一个或数个生物攻击时，CARDNAME对任意数量的目标共造成X点伤害，X等同于宣告攻击的生物数量。你可以任意分配。

1007819.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 for each time CARDNAME attacked this game.
1007819.translation: CARDNAME本盘游戏中每攻击过一次，便得+2/+2。

1007827.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure four cards named Fblthp, the Lost into your library, then shuffle. Draw a card.
1007827.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将四张名称为迷途的夫毕佐的牌幻变进你的牌库，然后洗牌。抓一张牌。

1007830.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and whenever you cast a Snake spell, conjure a card named Ambush Viper into the top six cards of your library at random. It perpetually gains "When this creature enters, draw a card."
1007830.translation: 当CARDNAME进场和每当你施放蛇咒语时，将一张名称为伏击毒蛇的牌随机幻变进你牌库顶的六张牌中。它永久获得「当此生物进场时，抓一张牌。」

1007838.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, heist target opponent's library.
1007838.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时和在你的维持开始时，偷窃目标对手的牌库。

1007868.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying. CARDNAME intensifies by 1.
1007868.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。CARDNAME强度增加1。

1007870.oracleText: Spirits you control get +X/+0, where X is CARDNAME's intensity.
1007870.translation: 由你操控的精怪得+X/+0，X为CARDNAME的强度数值。

1007872.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may exile CARDNAME. If you do, at the beginning of your next upkeep, return CARDNAME to the battlefield under its owner's control and it gains haste.
1007872.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以放逐CARDNAME。若你如此作，在你的下一个维持开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。

1007882.oracleText: CARDNAME has lifelink and haste as long as an opponent controls no creatures.
1007882.translation: 只要任一对手未操控生物，CARDNAME便具有系命与敏捷异能。

1007886.oracleText: Whenever a player discards a card, CARDNAME perpetually gets +1/+0.
1007886.translation: 每当任一牌手弃牌时，CARDNAME永久得+1/+0。

1007895.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target nonland, nontoken permanent an opponent controls. Then you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of that permanent into your hand, and the duplicate perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
1007895.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标由对手操控之非地且非衍生物的永久物。然后你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则将该永久物的一张副本幻变进你手上，且该副本永久获得「此咒语能用任意种类的法术力来施放。」

1007950.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, secretly choose a card in your graveyard and conjure a duplicate of it into your hand. If the duplicate isn't a land card, it perpetually gains flash.
1007950.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，私下选择你坟墓场中的一张牌，并将它的一张副本幻变进你手上。如果该副本不是地牌，则它永久获得闪现异能。

1007957.oracleText: At the beginning of your next upkeep, return CARDNAME to the battlefield under its owner's control and it gains haste.
1007957.translation: 在你的下一个维持开始时，将CARDNAME在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且它获得敏捷异能。

1008020.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, Mice you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
1008020.translation: 英武～每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，由你操控的家鼠得+1/+0直到回合结束。

1008161.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, put a flood counter on target land. It's an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it.
1008161.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，在目标地上放置一个洪水指示物。只要该地上有洪水指示物，它便额外具有海岛此类别。

1008166.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.
1008166.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1008183.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy. Activate only if CARDNAME's power is 3 or greater.
1008183.translation: {o2}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。只能于CARDNAME的力量等于或大于3时起动。

1008247.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap up to one target creature and put a stun counter on it.
1008247.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置至多一个目标生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

1008273.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a noncreature, nonland card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1008273.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张非生物且非地的牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1008350.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent.
1008350.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成1点伤害。

1008413.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent of their choice or discard a card.
1008413.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，除非目标对手牺牲一个依其选择的非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则其失去3点生命。

1008424.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Rat you control enters, create a 1/1 black Snail creature token if you don't control a Snail. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on a Snail you control.
1008424.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的老鼠进场时，如果你未操控蜗牛，则派出一个1/1黑色蜗牛衍生生物。若有，则在一个由你操控的蜗牛上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1008426.oracleText: {oUoBoR}, Sacrifice a Snail: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to each opponent. Then draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
1008426.translation: {oUoBoR}，牺牲一个蜗牛：CARDNAME向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。然后你抓等同于所牺牲生物之力量的牌。

1008491.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of creatures you control with power 4 or greater. You may play those cards until your next end step. At the beginning of your next end step, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent for each of those cards that are still exiled.
1008491.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物数量。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用这些牌。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，这些牌中每有一张仍被放逐者，CARDNAME便向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

1008561.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals 1 damage to target player.
1008561.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它对目标牌手造成1点伤害。

1008613.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may forage. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
1008613.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以觅粮。若你如此作，则在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1008768.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if it's the first instant spell, the first sorcery spell, or the first Otter spell other than CARDNAME you've cast this turn, you may have target opponent draw a card. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
1008768.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若这是你本回合中施放的第一个瞬间咒语，第一个法术咒语或第一个CARDNAME以外的水獭咒语，则你可以令目标对手抓一张牌。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1008925.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may pay {oWoB} and 2 life. When you do, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
1008925.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以支付{oWoB}和2点生命。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。

1009055.oracleText: At the beginning of your next end step, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent for each of those cards that are still exiled.
1009055.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，这些牌中每有一张仍被放逐者，CARDNAME便向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

1009074.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
1009074.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。

1009124.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Conjure a card of your choice from Charged Conjuration's spellbook into your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
1009124.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：从充能交换术的法术书中选择一张牌。将该牌幻变进你手上。只能于法术时机起动。

1009595.oracleText: During your turn, you may play cards exiled with CARDNAME. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost.
1009595.translation: 于你的回合中，你可以使用以CARDNAME放逐的牌。如果你以此法施放咒语，则支付等同于其法术力值的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

1009662.oracleText: When you unlock this door, CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
1009662.translation: 当你解锁此偏门时，CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物造成4点伤害。

1009664.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
1009664.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

1009971.oracleText: During your turn, as long as CARDNAME has one or more loyalty counters on him, he's a 3/4 Ninja creature and has hexproof.
1009971.translation: 于你的回合中，只要CARDNAME上有一个或数个忠诚指示物，他便是3/4忍者生物，且具有辟邪异能。

1010009.oracleText: When you unlock this door, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of cards in your hand to target creature an opponent controls.
1010009.translation: 当你解锁此偏门时，CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物造成等同于你手牌数量的伤害。

1010015.oracleText: As long as you control another creature, CARDNAME can't attack or block.
1010015.translation: 只要你操控另一个生物，CARDNAME便不能进行攻击或阻挡。

1010057.oracleText: When you unlock this door, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature.
1010057.translation: 当你解锁此偏门时，CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害。

1010086.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if CARDNAME is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on each tapped creature you control. Then seek a Survivor card with mana value less than or equal to the number of tapped creatures you control.
1010086.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若CARDNAME已横置，则在每个由你操控且已横置的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后取出一张法术力值等于或小于由你操控且已横置之生物数量的求生者牌。

1010093.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or dies, exile another creature you control. If you do, conjure a random creature card with mana value X onto the battlefield, where X is 2 plus the exiled creature's mana value.
1010093.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或死去时，放逐另一个由你操控的生物。若你如此作，则将一张法术力值为X的随机生物牌幻变进战场，X为所放逐之生物的法术力值加2。

1010130.oracleText: Discard that card at the beginning of the next end step.
1010130.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，弃掉该牌。

1010136.oracleText: Defending player exiles a nonland, nontoken permanent they control and a random nonland card from their library, then CARDNAME deals damage to them equal to the total mana value of the cards exiled this way.
1010136.translation: 防御牌手放逐一个由其操控，非地且非衍生物的永久物，及其牌库中随机一张非地牌。然后CARDNAME对其造成伤害，其数量等同于以此法放逐的牌之法术力值总和。

1010143.oracleText: Roll a six-sided die. 1-2 | +2, then create two 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn. 3 | -1, then return a card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand. 4-5 | CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of loyalty counters on him to a creature or player, then -2. 6 | +1. You may activate this ability two more times this turn.
1010143.translation: 掷一颗六面骰。1-2 | +2，然后派出两个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。3 | −1，然后将一张法术力值等于或小于2的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。4-5 | CARDNAME对一个生物或牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于其上忠诚指示物的数量，然后−2。6 | +1，你本回合中可以额外起动此忠诚异能两次。

1010218.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken Cat you control enters, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.
1010218.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的猫进场时，派出一个1/1白色的猫衍生生物。

1010229.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, attach it to target creature you control. That creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
1010229.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。该生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

1010247.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
1010247.translation: 每当你在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

1010257.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 3/3 white Knight creature tokens.
1010257.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个3/3白色骑士衍生生物。

1010261.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
1010261.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出若干1/1白色的兔衍生生物，其数量等同于其他由你操控且名称为兔位继承者的生物数量。

1010280.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.
1010280.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1白色的猫衍生生物。

1010290.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and is a Knight in addition to its other types.
1010290.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有三个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有飞行异能，且额外具有骑士此类别。

1010297.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1010297.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则将目标法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1010317.oracleText: Threshold — CARDNAME can't be blocked as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
1010317.translation: 门槛～只要你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，CARDNAME便不能被阻挡。

1010322.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library and separate them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
1010322.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌，并将它们分成牌面朝下和牌面朝上各一堆。任一对手选择其中一堆。将该堆牌置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。

1010325.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put that many incubation counters on it.
1010325.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置等量的护育指示物。

1010327.oracleText: Remove three incubation counters from CARDNAME: Create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
1010327.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去三个护育指示物：派出一个2/2蓝色，具飞行异能的龙兽衍生生物。

1010345.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a token that's a copy of CARDNAME.
1010345.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出一个为CARDNAME复制品的衍生物。

1010355.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
1010355.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

1010363.oracleText: Threshold — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, you may create Scion of the Deep, a legendary 8/8 blue Octopus creature token.
1010363.translation: 门槛～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则你可以派出传奇衍生生物深洋后裔，其为8/8蓝色章鱼。

1010380.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to that card's mana cost.
1010380.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得返照异能直到回合结束。其返照费用等同于该牌的法术力费用。

1010392.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent discards a card and loses 2 life. You draw a card and gain 2 life.
1010392.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各弃一张牌并失去2点生命。你抓一张牌并获得2点生命。

1010396.oracleText: Threshold — CARDNAME gets +2/+1 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
1010396.translation: 门槛～只要你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+2/+1。

1010407.oracleText: Threshold — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
1010407.translation: 门槛～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

1010410.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, look at the top three cards of your library. You may put one of those cards back on top of your library. Put the rest into your graveyard.
1010410.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，若你本回合中攻击过，则检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以将其中一张放回你的牌库顶。将其余的牌置入你坟墓场。

1010414.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1010414.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1010423.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if it wasn't a Demon, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with two +1/+1 counters on it. It's a Demon in addition to its other types.
1010423.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若其不是恶魔，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有两个+1/+1指示物。它额外具有恶魔此类别。

1010427.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token with flying.
1010427.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1，黑绿双色，具飞行异能的昆虫衍生生物。

1010431.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target opponent loses X life, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
1010431.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标对手失去X点生命，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

1010435.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with eight revival counters on it if you cast it.
1010435.translation: 如果CARDNAME经你施放，则它进场时上面有八个复生指示物。

1010437.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if it had a revival counter on it, return it to the battlefield with one fewer revival counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
1010437.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若其上有复生指示物，则在下一个结束步骤开始时将它移回战场，且上面少一个复生指示物。

1010446.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
1010446.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

1010453.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard. If at least one creature card was exiled this way, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
1010453.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。若以此法放逐至少一张生物牌，则每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

1010466.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card and CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
1010466.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌且CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

1010493.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 8 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
1010493.translation: CARDNAME对任意数量的目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共8点伤害，你可以任意分配。

1010497.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
1010497.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物攻击时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

1010501.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
1010501.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME得+3/+0直到回合结束。

1010505.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
1010505.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个4/4红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

1010532.oracleText: {o1oR}: If CARDNAME is a Scout, it becomes a Human Faerie Detective and gains "Whenever Kellan deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn."
1010532.translation: {o1oR}：如果CARDNAME是斥候，则它成为人类／仙灵／侦探且获得「每当凯澜对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。」

1010534.oracleText: {o2oR}: If CARDNAME is a Detective, it becomes a 3/2 Human Faerie Rogue and gains double strike.
1010534.translation: {o2oR}：如果CARDNAME是侦探，则它成为3/2人类／仙灵／浪客且获得连击异能。

1010546.oracleText: Morbid — At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, untap CARDNAME.
1010546.translation: 丧心～在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则重置CARDNAME。

1010553.oracleText: Raid — When CARDNAME enters, if you attacked this turn, exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
1010553.translation: 突击～当CARDNAME进场时，若你本回合中攻击过，则放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。选择其中一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

1010565.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. 
• You gain 4 life.
1010565.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。 
•你获得4点生命。

1010572.oracleText: Morbid — At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1010572.translation: 丧心～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1010590.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, double the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
1010590.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，将CARDNAME上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

1010617.oracleText: Raid — At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked this turn, return target creature card with mana value less than or equal to CARDNAME's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1010617.translation: 突击～在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中攻击过，则将目标法术力值等于或小于CARDNAME力量的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1010629.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
1010629.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1010631.oracleText: Threshold — CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and has deathtouch as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
1010631.translation: 门槛～只要你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+1且具有死触异能。

1010636.oracleText: As long as your life total is greater than your starting life total, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and has menace. CARDNAME gets an additional +5/+5 as long as your life total is at least 10 greater than your starting life total.
1010636.translation: 只要你的总生命大于你的起始总生命，CARDNAME便得+1/+1且具有威慑异能。只要你的总生命大于你的起始总生命至少10点，CARDNAME便再得+5/+5。

1010640.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target non-Bear creature card with mana value less than or equal to CARDNAME's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1010640.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一张目标法术力值等于或小于CARDNAME力量的非熊生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1010644.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create four 3/3 blue Serpent creature tokens named Koma's Coil.
1010644.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出四个3/3蓝色，名称为寇玛缠蛇的巨蛇衍生生物。

1010667.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose a creature type. CARDNAME enters with a fellowship counter on it for each creature you control of the chosen type.
1010667.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择一种生物类别。CARDNAME进场时上面有若干情谊指示物，其数量等同于由你操控且为所选类别的生物数量。

1010669.oracleText: Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1 for each fellowship counter on CARDNAME.
1010669.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个情谊指示物，由你操控且为所选类别的生物便得+1/+1。

1010674.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature becomes untapped, remove a bait counter from CARDNAME. If you do, create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token.
1010674.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物成为未横置时，从CARDNAME上移去一个钓饵指示物。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物。

1010684.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Draw a card and put a soul counter on CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
1010684.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：抓一张牌并在CARDNAME上放置一个灵魂指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

1010686.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of soul counters on CARDNAME.
1010686.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：每位对手各失去等同于CARDNAME上灵魂指示物数量的生命。

1010695.oracleText: {o4}: CARDNAME becomes a 3/3 creature with vigilance and all creature types. It's still a land.
1010695.translation: {o4}：CARDNAME成为3/3，具警戒异能和所有生物类别的生物。它仍然是地。

1010865.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, any opponent may sacrifice a creature of their choice. If a player does, tap CARDNAME and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
1010865.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，任意对手可以牺牲一个依其选择的生物。若有牌手如此作，则横置CARDNAME且在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1010999.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was kicked, target player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
1010999.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它已增幅，则目标牌手牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

1011087.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield with one fewer revival counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
1011087.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时将它移回战场，且上面少一个复生指示物。

1011093.oracleText: Target a non-Bear creature card with mana value less than or equal to {1, CardId}'s power.
1011093.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于{1, CardId}之力量的非熊生物牌为目标。

1011094.oracleText: Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
1011094.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回场上。

1011757.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1o(B/G)}. If you do, create a 1/1 black Snake creature token with deathtouch.
1011757.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1o(B/G)}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1黑色，具死触异能的蛇衍生生物。

1011784.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets CARDNAME, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until the end of your next turn.
1011784.translation: 勇行～每当你施放以CARDNAME为目标的咒语时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

1011816.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature with power 4 or greater enters, you may pay {o1o(R/G)}. When you do, CARDNAME fights target creature you don't control.
1011816.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，你可以支付{o1o(R/G)}。当你如此作时，CARDNAME与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

1011827.oracleText: Sacrifice the token at the beginning of the next end step. (Create a tapped and attacking token that is a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice the token at the beginning of the next end step. (You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice the token at the beginning of the next end step.))
1011827.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。（选择目标由你操控的生物。派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。（你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，选择目标由你操控的生物。派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。））

1011843.oracleText: When the chosen creature dies this turn, you gain 3 life.
1011843.translation: 当所选生物于本回合中死去时，你获得3点生命。

1011860.oracleText: CARDNAME fights target creature you don't control. (Whenever CARDNAME or another creature with power 4 or greater enters, you may pay {o1o(R/G)}. When you do, CARDNAME fights target creature you don't control.)
1011860.translation: CARDNAME与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。（每当CARDNAME或另一个力量等于或大于4的生物进场时，你可以支付{o1o(R/G)}。当你如此作时，CARDNAME与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。）

1012520.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.
1012520.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

1012551.oracleText: As long as your devotion to white and blue is less than seven, CARDNAME isn't a creature.
1012551.translation: 只要你的白蓝两色献力小于七，CARDNAME便不是生物。

1012564.oracleText: As long as your devotion to red and white is less than seven, CARDNAME isn't a creature.
1012564.translation: 只要你的红白两色献力小于七，CARDNAME便不是生物。

1012568.oracleText: As long as your devotion to green and white is less than seven, CARDNAME isn't a creature.
