1013581.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你坟墓场中每有一张神器和／或生物牌，便派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

1013583.oracleText: Whenever another Insect you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Each opponent loses 1 life.
1013583.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的昆虫死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。每位对手各失去1点生命。

1013592.oracleText: Exhaust — {o4oRoG}: Creatures and Vehicles you control gain trample until end of turn. Put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
1013592.translation: 竭绝～{o4oRoG}：你操控的生物和载具获得践踏，直到回合结束。在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1013599.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for up to two artifact, creature, and/or enchantment cards with mana value 1 or less, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
1013599.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻至多两张法术力值等于或小于1的神器，生物和／或结界牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1013607.oracleText: {o2oBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
1013607.translation: {o2oBoG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物或载具牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

1013612.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a Mount or Vehicle card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1013612.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张坐骑或载具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1013620.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two other target Vehicles and/or creatures you control.
1013620.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个其他目标由你操控的载具和／或生物。

1013624.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put target creature card with mana value 4 or less from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control with a finality counter on it. That creature gains menace, deathtouch, and haste. At the beginning of your next end step, exile that creature.
1013624.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于4的生物牌在你操控下从坟墓场放进战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。该生物获得威慑、死触与敏捷异能。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该生物。

1013632.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target artifact or creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1013632.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器或生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1013644.oracleText: Whenever you attack, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
1013644.translation: 每当你攻击时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

1013654.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 1 damage to target opponent and you gain 1 life.
1013654.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标对手造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

1013657.oracleText: Max speed — CARDNAME has deathtouch and haste.
1013657.translation: 速度极限～CARDNAME具有死触与敏捷异能。

1013669.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless there are seven or more cards in exile.
1013669.translation: 除非放逐区中有七张或更多牌，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

1013678.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target Mounts and/or Vehicles.
1013678.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，在至多两个目标坐骑和／或载具上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1013683.oracleText: Exhaust — {oR}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
1013683.translation: 竭绝～{oR}，{oT}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

1013691.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, exile up to X creature cards from your graveyard. It enters with three +1/+1 counters on it for each creature card exiled this way.
1013691.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，从你坟墓场放逐至多X张生物牌。它进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于以此法放逐之生物牌数量的三倍。

1013693.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME becomes a copy of target creature card exiled with it, except it's 0/0 and has this ability.
1013693.translation: {o2}：CARDNAME成为目标以其放逐之生物牌的复制品，但它是0/0且具有此异能。

1013697.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a card from it. If you do, that player discards that card, then draws a card.
1013697.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视目标牌手的手牌。你可以选择其中一张牌。若你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌，然后抓一张牌。

1013701.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, other creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain vigilance and menace until end of turn. Damage can't be prevented this turn.
1013701.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+2/+2且获得警戒与威慑异能。本回合中，伤害不能被防止。

1013707.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is CARDNAME's power. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.
1013707.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为CARDNAME的力量。此法术力只能用来起动异能。

1013711.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, for each opponent, put up to one target nonland permanent that player controls into its owner's library third from the top.
1013711.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～将至多一个目标由该牌手操控的非地永久物置于其拥有者牌库顶上数来第三张的位置。

1013715.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3}: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
1013715.translation: 竭绝～{o3}：CARDNAME成为神器生物。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1013718.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack or block unless it has an even number of counters on it.
1013718.translation: 除非CARDNAME上的指示物数量为偶数，否则它不能进行攻击或阻挡。（零是偶数。）

1013720.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has an odd number of counters on it, draw two cards.
1013720.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后如果其上的指示物数量为奇数，则抓两张牌。

1013726.oracleText: Exhaust — {oXoGoGoU}: Put X +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME. Then you may have the base power and toughness of each other creature you control become equal to CARDNAME's power until end of turn.
1013726.translation: 竭绝～{oXoGoGoU}：在CARDNAME上放置X个+1/+1指示物。然后你可以令每个由你操控的其他生物之基础力量与防御力成为等同于CARDNAME之力量直到回合结束。

1013729.oracleText: Exhaust — {o4}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal two land cards. Put those land cards onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1013729.translation: 竭绝～{o4}：从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出两张地牌为止。将这些地牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1013732.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less.
1013732.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于4的非地永久物。

1013750.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy another target artifact. Activate only as a sorcery.
1013750.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭另一个目标神器。只能于法术时机起动。

1013763.oracleText: Exhaust — {o3}: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
1013763.translation: 竭绝～{o3}：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

1013772.oracleText: Each creature you control of the chosen type other than CARDNAME gets +1/+1.
1013772.translation: 每个由你操控且为所选类别的生物均得+1/+1，但CARDNAME除外。

1013778.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, draw a card for each +1/+1 counter on it.
1013778.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，其上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便抓一张牌。

1013782.oracleText: Exhaust — {oWoUoBoRoG}: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature. Put two +1/+1 counters on it.
1013782.translation: 竭绝～{oWoUoBoRoG}：CARDNAME成为神器生物。在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1013802.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target creature or Vehicle.

1013808.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
1013808.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1013809.oracleText: Max speed — {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
1013809.translation: 速度极限～{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1013813.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you create a Treasure token.
1013813.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

1013822.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. You gain 1 life.
1013822.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。你获得1点生命。

1013837.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped unless you control a Mount or Vehicle.
1013837.translation: 除非你操控坐骑或载具，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

1013839.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
1013839.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

1013843.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
1013843.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

1013852.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
1013852.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

1013858.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
1013858.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

1013872.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
1013872.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物乘驾坐骑和搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」只能于法术时机起动。

1013900.oracleText: Destroy target artifact an opponent controls.
1013900.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控的神器。

1013919.oracleText: At the beginning of your next end step, exile that creature.
1013919.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该生物。

1013928.translation: 指定一个由你操控的坐骑为目标。

1013943.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. (Create a token that is a copy of target permanent you control, except it is a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. (At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oEoEoE}. When you do, create a token that's a copy of target permanent you control, except it's a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.))
1013943.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。（派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的永久物之复制品，但它是5/5神器生物，仍具有原本类别，且具有敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。（在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。当你如此作时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的永久物之复制品，但它是5/5神器生物，仍具有原本类别，且具有敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。））

1013952.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains "This creature attacks each combat if able" and "When this creature deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it."
1013952.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。它获得「此生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击」与「当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它牺牲。」

1013961.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, CARDNAME endures 2.
1013961.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，CARDNAME续战2。

1013981.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, it endures 1.
1013981.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则它续战1。

1014014.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Scry 1.
1014014.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。占卜1。

1014051.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one other target nonland permanent you control to its owner's hand. If it was a token, draw a card.
1014051.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多另一个目标由你操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。若其是衍生物，则抓一张牌。

1014055.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 2/2 white Soldier creature tokens.
1014055.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个2/2白色士兵衍生生物。

1014057.oracleText: When a Dragon you control enters, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
1014057.translation: 当一个由你操控的龙进场时，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

1014060.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may search your library for a card named Tempest Hawk, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1014060.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张名称为暴风翔鹰的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1014071.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
1014071.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

1014075.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile two cards from your graveyard. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1014075.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以从你坟墓场放逐两张牌。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014082.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put three stun counters on it and draw three cards.
1014082.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在其上放置三个晕眩指示物并抓三张牌。

1014084.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Turtle spell, untap CARDNAME.
1014084.translation: 每当你施放龟咒语时，重置CARDNAME。

1014098.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an instant, sorcery, or Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1014098.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张瞬间，法术或龙牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1014120.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. When you do, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
1014120.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你坟墓场放逐一张生物牌。当你如此作时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

1014123.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to two other target nonland permanents to their owners' hands.
1014123.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多两个其他目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

1014144.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
1014144.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张置入你的坟墓场。

1014148.oracleText: During your turn, CARDNAME has base power and toughness 5/2.
1014148.translation: 于你的回合中，CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力为5/2。

1014156.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, mill three cards. Then if your library has no cards in it, exile CARDNAME and put five cards from your graveyard on top of your library in any order.
1014156.translation: 在你的维持开始时，磨三张牌。然后如果你的牌库没有牌，则放逐CARDNAME并将五张牌从你坟墓场以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

1014169.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, up to one target player mills cards equal to CARDNAME's power.
1014169.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，至多一位目标牌手磨若干牌，其数量等同于CARDNAME的力量。

1014187.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token.
1014187.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。

1014204.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. Surveil 2.
1014204.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。刺探2。

1014210.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control a creature with a counter on it, each opponent loses 1 life.
1014210.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控一个其上有指示物的生物，则每位对手各失去1点生命。

1014223.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn and target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
1014223.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束，且目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

1014227.oracleText: As long as there are three or more different kinds of counters among creatures you control, CARDNAME gets +2/+4.
1014227.translation: 只要由你操控的生物上总共有三种或更多不同种类的指示物，CARDNAME便得+2/+4。

1014234.oracleText: {oXoB}, {oT}, Pay X life: CARDNAME endures X. Activate only as a sorcery.
1014234.translation: {oXoB}，{oT}，支付X点生命：CARDNAME续战X。只能于法术时机起动。

1014259.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a creature you control with mana value X other than CARDNAME: Return target creature card with mana value X plus 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
1014259.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个CARDNAME以外由你操控且法术力值为X的生物：将目标法术力值为X加1的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

1014263.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you lose 1 life and CARDNAME endures 1.
1014263.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你失去1点生命且CARDNAME续战1。

1014270.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1014270.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014274.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
1014274.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

1014289.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast it without paying its mana cost if that spell's mana value is 8 or less. If you don't, put that card into your hand.
1014289.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地牌为止。如果所成咒语之法术力值等于或小于8，则你可以施放它，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你未如此作，则将该牌置于你手上。

1014296.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, create a 1/1 white Monk creature token with prowess. You may attach CARDNAME to it.
1014296.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。你可以将CARDNAME贴附到其上。

1014301.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
1014301.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

1014310.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, CARDNAME gains double strike until end of turn.
1014310.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，CARDNAME获得连击异能直到回合结束。

1014320.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, add {oWoUoBoRoG}.
1014320.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则加{oWoUoBoRoG}。

1014324.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
1014324.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

1014328.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Its controller searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield tapped with a stun counter on it, then shuffles.
1014328.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。其操控者从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场且其上有一个晕眩指示物，然后洗牌。

1014349.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if you've cast two or more spells this turn, CARDNAME becomes a 3/3 Monk creature with haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
1014349.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则CARDNAME成为具敏捷异能的3/3修行僧生物直到回合结束，且仍具有原本类别。

1014351.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw two cards.
1014351.translation: {o1oR}，弃掉你的手牌，牺牲CARDNAME：抓两张牌。

1014354.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may behold a Dragon. If you do, create a Treasure token.
1014354.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以请援龙。若你如此作，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

1014356.oracleText: Whenever a Dragon you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a Dragon in addition to its other types and gains flying.
1014356.translation: 每当一个由你操控的龙进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。直到回合结束，CARDNAME额外具有龙此类别，且获得飞行异能。

1014366.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent.
1014366.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成1点伤害。

1014369.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature.
1014369.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

1014383.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 6 damage to target creature with flying.
1014383.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标具飞行异能的生物造成6点伤害。

1014399.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 5 damage to target creature an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
1014399.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择目标由对手操控的生物，且须为本回合中受过伤害者。CARDNAME对后者造成5点伤害。

1014410.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among them into your hand. If you don't, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1014410.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨三张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌置于你手上。若你未如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014414.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1014414.translation: 每当一张或数张牌于你的回合中离开你坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014417.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Dragon you control enters, you gain 3 life.
1014417.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的龙进场时，你获得3点生命。

1014429.oracleText: {o3oWoUoBoRoG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 4/4 Dragon creature token named Reliquary Dragon that's all colors. It has flying, lifelink, and "When this token enters, it deals 3 damage to any target." Activate only as a sorcery.
1014429.translation: {o3oWoUoBoRoG}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个4/4五色，名称为圣物龙的龙衍生生物。它具有飞行、系命与「当此衍生物进场时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。」只能于法术时机起动。

1014441.oracleText: As long as you control a creature with a counter on it, CARDNAME gets +1/+2.
1014441.translation: 只要你操控其上有指示物的生物，CARDNAME便得+1/+2。

1014451.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, it endures 2.
1014451.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，它续战2。

1014458.oracleText: {o2oG}: CARDNAME can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
1014458.translation: {o2oG}：CARDNAME于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

1014462.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may mill cards equal to the number of lands you control.
1014462.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以磨等同于由你操控之地数量的牌。

1014471.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may mill three cards.
1014471.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以磨三张牌。

1014503.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card if you control a creature with a counter on it. If you don't draw a card this way, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1014503.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，如果你操控其上有指示物的生物，抓一张牌。若你未以此法抓牌，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014507.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.
1014507.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，检视你的牌库顶牌。如果其是地牌，你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。若你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

1014512.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1014512.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014514.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, it endures X, where X is the number of counters on CARDNAME.
1014514.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物进场时，它续战X，X为CARDNAME上的指示物数量。

1014518.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it's your main phase, there is an additional combat phase after this phase followed by an additional main phase. When you next attack this turn, untap each creature you control.
1014518.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若当前是你的行动阶段，则在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段，以及接于其后之一个额外的行动阶段。当你本回合中下一次攻击时，重置所有由你操控的生物。

1014530.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose Abzan or Mardu.
1014530.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择阿布赞或玛尔都。

1014546.oracleText: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
1014546.translation: 连咒～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

1014565.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with two +1/+1 counters on it if you've cast two or more spells this turn.
1014565.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则CARDNAME进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

1014575.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• You gain 3 life and surveil 3. 
• Destroy target enchantment. 
• Counter target creature spell.
1014575.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～ 
•你获得3点生命且刺探3。 
•消灭目标结界。 
•反击目标生物咒语。

1014579.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, you may sacrifice a nonland permanent. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1014579.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲一个非地永久物。当你如此作时，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014583.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, copy the next spell you cast this turn when you cast it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
1014583.translation: 当CARDNAME进场，本回合中，当你施放你的下一个咒语时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1014590.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose Jeskai or Temur.
1014590.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择洁斯凯或铁木尔。

1014600.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose Temur or Sultai.
1014600.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择铁木尔或苏勒台。

1014611.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose Sultai or Abzan.
1014611.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择苏勒台或阿布赞。

1014618.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control dies, if it had counters on it, put its counters on up to one target creature you control.
1014618.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有指示物，则将它的指示物放置在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

1014631.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
1014631.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

1014646.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile the top X cards of their library, where X is the amount of damage dealt. You may cast any number of spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs.
1014646.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐其牌库顶的X张牌，X为所造成的伤害数量。你可以从其中施放任意数量法术力值等于或小于X的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

1014655.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a black card, a green card, and a blue card. Put those cards into your graveyard, then shuffle.
1014655.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张黑色牌、一张绿色牌和一张蓝色牌。将这些牌置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

1014661.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one other target creature you control until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
1014661.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多另一个目标由你操控的生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

1014670.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put up to one target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard on top of your library.
1014670.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一张目标非生物且非地的牌从你坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

1014685.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, remove all counters from up to one target creature.
1014685.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从至多一个目标生物上移去所有指示物。

1014697.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
1014697.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1014701.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
1014701.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014714.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell or a Dragon spell, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
1014714.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语或龙咒语时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

1014719.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, exile that card.
1014719.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。若你如此作，则放逐该牌。

1014721.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner creates an X/X white Spirit creature token, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
1014721.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者派出一个X/X白色精怪衍生生物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

1014724.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. Copy it, then you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
1014724.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌从你坟墓场放逐。将它复制，然后你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

1014729.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains harmonize until end of turn. Its harmonize cost is equal to its mana cost.
1014729.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得谐颂异能直到回合结束。其谐颂费用等同于其法术力费用。

1014733.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life. If a player is dealt damage this way, they discard a card.
1014733.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向任意一个目标造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。若以此法对某牌手造成伤害，则该牌手弃一张牌。

1014756.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers your opponents control, where X is the number of lands you control.
1014756.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任意数量目标由对手操控之生物和／或鹏洛客造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配，X为由你操控的地数量。

1014763.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose Mardu or Jeskai.
1014763.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择玛尔都或洁斯凯。

1014769.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, mill four cards. When you do, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1014769.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则磨四张牌。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1014777.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic Plains, Swamp, or Forest card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1014777.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原、沼泽或树林牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1014779.oracleText: {o1oWoBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create an X/X white Spirit creature token, where X is the greatest toughness among creatures you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
1014779.translation: {o1oWoBoG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个X/X白色精怪衍生生物，X为由你操控之生物中的最大防御力。只能于法术时机起动。

1014793.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top. If you control a Dragon, put that card onto the battlefield tapped instead.
1014793.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。若你操控龙，则改为将该牌横置放进战场。

1014799.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic Island, Mountain, or Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1014799.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛、山脉或平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1014801.oracleText: {o1oUoRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create two 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying. Activate only as a sorcery.
1014801.translation: {o1oUoRoW}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

1014804.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic Mountain, Plains, or Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1014804.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，平原或沼泽牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1014806.oracleText: {o2oRoWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create three 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. They gain menace and haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
1014806.translation: {o2oRoWoB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出三个1/1红色战士衍生生物。它们获得威慑与敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

1014812.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic Swamp, Forest, or Island card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1014812.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，树林或海岛牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1014814.oracleText: {o2oBoGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create two 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
1014814.translation: {o2oBoGoU}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出两个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

1014817.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic Forest, Island, or Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1014817.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林、海岛或山脉牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1014819.oracleText: {o3oGoUoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 5/5 green Elephant creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
1014819.translation: {o3oGoUoR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个5/5绿色的象衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

1014823.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target player mills two cards. You gain 2 life.
1014823.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标牌手磨两张牌。你获得2点生命。

1014846.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a Dragon card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1014846.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张龙牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1014881.oracleText: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
1014881.translation: 将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1014895.oracleText: When you next attack this turn, untap each creature you control.
1014895.translation: 当你本回合中下一次攻击时，重置所有由你操控的生物。

1014901.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1014901.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1014920.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1014920.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

1014922.oracleText: Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. (Whenever you attack this turn, create two 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. ({o2oW}, {oT}: Whenever you attack this turn, create two 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.))
1014922.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。（本回合中，每当你攻击时，派出两个1/1红色战士衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。（{o2oW}，{oT}：本回合中，每当你攻击时，派出两个1/1红色战士衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。））

1014923.oracleText: Return target spell or permanent to its owner's hand.
1014923.translation: 将目标咒语或永久物移回其拥有者手上。

1014924.translation: 对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

1014925.oracleText: Whenever you scry or surveil, draw a card. (Draw after you scry or surveil.)
1014925.translation: 每当你占卜或刺探时，抓一张牌。（占卜或刺探后再抓牌。）

1014928.oracleText: Mega Flare — CARDNAME deals damage equal to the total mana value of other permanents you control to each opponent.
1014928.translation: 百万核爆～CARDNAME向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之其他永久物的法术力值总和。

1014932.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a blight counter on target land. For as long as that land has a blight counter on it, it loses all land types and abilities and has "{oT}: Add {oC}."
1014932.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在目标地上放置一个枯萎指示物。只要该地上有枯萎指示物，它便失去所有地类别与异能，且具有「{oT}：加{oC}。」

1015939.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你坟墓场中永久物牌的数量。

1015950.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may remove a lore counter from each of any number of Sagas you control. Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME for each lore counter removed this way.
1015950.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从任意数量由你操控的传纪上各移去一个学问指示物。每以此法移去一个学问指示物，便在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1015954.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Dwarf you control enters and whenever an Equipment you control enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
1015954.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的矮人进场或每当一个由你操控的武具进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

1015974.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to CARDNAME's power on up to one other target creature. That creature becomes a Mutant in addition to its other types.
1015974.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在至多另一个目标生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于CARDNAME的力量。该生物额外具有突变体此类别。

1015980.oracleText: {o3oRoW}, {oT}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
1015980.translation: {o3oRoW}，{oT}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

1015995.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, each player discards a card. Then you draw a card for each card type among cards discarded this way.
1015995.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，每位牌手各弃一张牌。然后以此法弃掉的牌中每有一种牌张类别，你便抓一张牌。

1015997.oracleText: {o8}: Each opponent sacrifices a permanent of their choice. Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
1015997.translation: {o8}：每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个永久物。转化CARDNAME。只能于法术时机起动。

1016005.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a tapped 0/1 black Wizard creature token with "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this token deals 1 damage to each opponent." Then if you control four or more Wizards, transform CARDNAME.
1016005.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个已横置的0/1黑色法术师衍生生物，且具有「每当你施放非生物咒语时，此衍生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。」然后如果你操控四个或更多法术师，则转化CARDNAME。

1016013.oracleText: Stagger — Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, until your next turn, if a source would deal damage to that player or a permanent that player controls, it deals double that damage instead.
1016013.translation: 击倒～每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，直到你的下一个回合，如果某来源将对该牌手或由该牌手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成两倍的伤害。

1016023.oracleText: Wave Cannon — When CARDNAME enters, for each opponent, tap up to one target nonland permanent that opponent controls. Put X stun counters on each of those permanents and you gain X life, where X is the number of nonbasic lands you control.
1016023.translation: 波动炮～当CARDNAME进场时，对每位对手而言，横置至多一个目标由该对手操控的非地永久物。在这些永久物上各放置X个晕眩指示物且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的非基本地数量。

1016051.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. If X is 4 or more, draw a card.
1016051.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量。如果X等于或大于4，则抓一张牌。

1016055.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile a permanent card from your graveyard at random, then create a tapped token that's a copy of that card. If the exiled card is a land card, repeat this process.
1016055.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张永久物牌，然后派出一个已横置且为该牌之复制品的衍生物。如果所放逐的牌是地牌，则重复此流程。

1016061.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1016061.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

1016064.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token. If four or more mana was spent to cast that spell, draw two cards. If eight or more mana was spent to cast that spell, sacrifice CARDNAME and it deals that much damage to each opponent.
1016064.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个1/1无色英雄衍生生物。如果施放该咒语时支付过四点或更多法术力，则抓两张牌。如果施放该咒语时支付过八点或更多法术力，则牺牲CARDNAME，且它对每位对手各造成等同于该数量的伤害。

1016068.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, mill five cards. Put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
1016068.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，磨五张牌。将至多一张以此法磨掉的结界牌置于你手上。

1016070.oracleText: Trance — {o4oRoG}, {oT}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
1016070.translation: 幻化～{o4oRoG}，{oT}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

1016081.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1016081.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1016085.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, surveil 2.
1016085.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，刺探2。

1016087.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o4oUoUoBoB} and exile eight cards from your graveyard. If you do, transform CARDNAME.
1016087.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o4oUoUoBoB}并从你的坟墓场放逐八张牌。若你如此作，则转化CARDNAME。

1016107.oracleText: During your turn, CARDNAME and enchantment creatures you control have trample, lifelink, and ward {o2}.
1016107.translation: 于你的回合中，CARDNAME与由你操控的结界生物具有践踏，系命与守护{o2}。

1016112.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, gain control of target creature an opponent controls until end of turn. Untap it. It gains lifelink and haste until end of turn.
1016112.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，获得目标由对手操控的生物之操控权直到回合结束。将它重置。它获得系命与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

1016121.oracleText: GOOOOAAAALLL! — {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw two cards. Activate only if an opponent was dealt combat damage by a legendary creature this turn.
1016121.translation: 得分！～{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：抓两张牌。只能于有传奇生物向对手造成过战斗伤害的回合中起动。

1016129.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Shuffle all nonland cards from your graveyard into your library. You gain life equal to the number of cards shuffled into your library this way.
1016129.translation: {o5}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：将所有在你坟墓场中的非地牌洗入你的牌库。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于以此法洗入你牌库的牌张数量。

1016162.oracleText: {o3}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME's base power becomes equal to the number of Towns you control.
1016162.translation: {o3}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME的基础力量成为等同于由你操控的市镇数量。

1016178.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1016178.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1016185.oracleText: {o5oGoU}, {oT}: Transform CARDNAME. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each other Town you control.
1016185.translation: {o5oGoU}，{oT}：转化CARDNAME。你每操控一个其他市镇，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

1016199.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Mill two cards. Then you may sacrifice CARDNAME. When you do, return another target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
1016199.translation: {o5}，{oT}：磨两张牌。然后你可以牺牲CARDNAME。当你如此作时，将另一张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1016234.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped unless it's your first, second, or third turn of the game.
1016234.translation: 本盘游戏中，除非当前是你的第一、第二或第三回合，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

1016249.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, destroy target permanent and return target nonlegendary permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1016249.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，消灭目标永久物并将目标非传奇的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

1016253.oracleText: During your turn, as long as CARDNAME is equipped, it has double strike and indestructible.
1016253.translation: 于你的回合中，只要CARDNAME佩带武具，它便具有连击与不灭异能。

1016255.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate that target CARDNAME cost {o2} less to activate.
1016255.translation: 你起动之以CARDNAME为目标的佩带异能减少{o2}来起动。

1016280.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card for as long as you control CARDNAME.
1016280.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，你可以使用该牌。

1016284.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each noncreature, nonland card in your graveyard.
1016284.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张非生物且非地的牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

1016287.oracleText: A Test of Your Reflexes! — When CARDNAME enters, you may attach it to target creature you control. If you do, that creature gains first strike until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.
1016287.translation: 你能应付吗？～当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。若你如此作，则该生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束，且本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

1016310.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
1016310.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1016321.oracleText: When you put one or more Equipment onto the battlefield this way, you may attach one of them to a Samurai you control.
1016321.translation: 当你以此法将一个或数个武具放进战场时，你可以将其中一个贴附在一个由你操控的武士上。

1016329.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
1016329.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放瞬间或法术咒语时，将其复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1016330.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy it twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
1016330.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放瞬间或法术咒语时，将其复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

1016352.oracleText: Return another target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
1016352.translation: 将另一个目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1016470.oracleText: Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
1016470.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

1016472.oracleText: Choose that player or a planeswalker that player controls.
1016472.translation: 选择该牌手或一个由该牌手操控的鹏洛客。

1016547.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, discard your hand, then investigate four times.
1016547.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，弃掉你的手牌，然后探查四次。

1016549.oracleText: As long as you have one or fewer cards in hand, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 and has menace.
1016549.translation: 只要你的手牌为一张或更少，CARDNAME便得+2/+2且具有威慑异能。

1016556.oracleText: Barrowgoyf's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in all graveyards and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
1016556.translation: 墓冢耶夫的力量等同于所有坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

1016557.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may mill that many cards. If you do, you may put a creature card from among them into your hand.
1016557.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以磨等量的牌。若你如此作，则你可以将其中一张生物牌置于你手上。

1016560.oracleText: Pyrogoyf's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in all graveyards and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
1016560.translation: 烈焰耶夫的力量等同于所有坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

1016561.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Lhurgoyf creature you control enters, that creature deals damage equal to its power to any target.
1016561.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的拉高耶夫生物进场时，该生物对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

1016569.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target spell an opponent controls.
1016569.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的咒语。

1016571.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if a card is exiled with it, you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
1016571.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若仍有以它放逐的牌，则你可以施放所放逐之牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

1016575.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature and at least one other creature attack, draw a card.
1016575.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物与至少另一个生物攻击时，抓一张牌。

1016576.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat this turn, untap all creatures that attacked this turn.
1016576.translation: 在本回合的每次战斗开始时，重置所有本回合攻击过的生物。

1016577.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped Myr you control?
1016577.translation: 是否要横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的秘耳？

1016676.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a colorless Treasure artifact token with "{oT}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color."
1016676.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出一个无色珍宝衍生神器，且具有「{oT}，牺牲此衍生物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

1016862.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, draw a card. Then if you have fewer than three cards in hand, draw cards equal to the difference.
1016862.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。然后若你的手牌数量少于三张，则抓等同于该差距数量的牌。

1016914.oracleText: Revolt — CARDNAME enters with two +1/+1 counters on it if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn.
1016914.translation: 反抗～如果本回合中曾有永久物在你操控下离开战场，则CARDNAME进场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

1017714.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card for each creature you control.
1017714.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个生物，便抓一张牌。

1017986.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy each creature your opponents control with a prey counter on it.
1017986.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭所有由对手操控且其上有猎物指示物的生物。

1018067.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice CARDNAME and return target card named Rekindling Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn.
1018067.translation: 在你的维持开始时，牺牲CARDNAME，并将目标名称为复焰凤凰的牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

1018069.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 0/1 red Elemental creature token with "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this token and return target card named Rekindling Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn."
1018069.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个0/1红色元素衍生生物，且具有「在你的维持开始时，牺牲此衍生物，并将目标名称为复焰凤凰的牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。」

1018209.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oXoWoUoU}. If you do, you gain X life and draw X cards.
1018209.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oXoWoUoU}。若你如此作，则你获得X点生命且抓X张牌。

1018221.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create X 1/1 white Vampire creature tokens with lifelink, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1018221.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出X个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1018298.oracleText: {o2oR}: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature.

1018624.oracleText: {o3oR}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature.

1018651.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice another creature. If you can't, CARDNAME deals 6 damage to you.
1018651.translation: 在你的维持开始时，牺牲另一个生物。若你无法如此作，则CARDNAME对你造成6点伤害。

1018888.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks alone, double its power and toughness until end of turn.
1018888.translation: 每当CARDNAME单独攻击时，将其力量与防御力加倍直到回合结束。

1018988.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if that spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME, then CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.
1018988.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若该咒语已增幅，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后CARDNAME向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于其上的+1/+1指示物数量。

1019011.oracleText: You may cast spells from among cards exiled with CARDNAME.
1019011.translation: 你可以从以CARDNAME放逐的牌之中施放咒语。

1019018.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each creature you control.
1019018.translation: 你每操控一个生物，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

1019129.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, untap CARDNAME.
1019129.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，重置CARDNAME。

1019195.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control with power less than CARDNAME's power gain indestructible until end of turn.
1019195.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控且力量小于CARDNAME的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1019539.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 2/2 red Dragon creature token with flying and "{oR}: This token gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
1019539.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个2/2红色的龙衍生生物，且具有飞行异能与「{oR}：此衍生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

1019960.oracleText: Undergrowth — When this creature enters, choose up to one target creature you don't control with flying. This creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard, then you may have this creature fight that creature.
1019960.translation: 朽力～当此生物进场时，选择至多一个目标不由你操控且具飞行异能的生物。此生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量，然后你可以让此生物与该生物互斗。

1020081.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile target creature that player controls and put a hit counter on that card. That player loses the game if they own three or more exiled cards with hit counters on them. CARDNAME's owner shuffles CARDNAME into their library.
1020081.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐目标由该牌手操控的生物并在该牌上放置一个灭口指示物。如果放逐区中由该牌手拥有且上面有灭口指示物的牌有三张或更多，则该牌手输掉这盘游戏。CARDNAME的拥有者将CARDNAME洗入其牌库。

1020140.oracleText: {oX}: CARDNAME becomes a copy of target creature card in your graveyard with mana value X, except its name is Lazav, the Multifarious, it's legendary in addition to its other types, and it has this ability.
1020140.translation: {oX}：选择目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值为X的生物牌。CARDNAME成为该牌的复制品，但其名称仍是百相拉札夫，额外具有传奇此超类别，且具有此异能。

1020286.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 0/2 blue Illusion creature tokens with "Whenever this token blocks a creature, that creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step."
1020286.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个0/2蓝色虚影衍生生物，它们具有「每当此衍生物阻挡一个生物时，后者于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。」

1020449.oracleText: When CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell, shuffle CARDNAME into its owner's library.
1020449.translation: 当CARDNAME成为咒语的目标时，将CARDNAME洗入其拥有者的牌库。

1020731.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it, then create a number of 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens equal to CARDNAME's power.
1020731.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后派出若干1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其数量等同于CARDNAME的力量。

1021118.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage to a planeswalker, destroy that planeswalker.
1021118.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一鹏洛客造成伤害时，消灭该鹏洛客。

1021135.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies and when you discard this card, create a Food token.
1021135.translation: 当CARDNAME死去或当你弃掉它时，派出一个食品衍生物。

1021754.oracleText: When this token dies, create a Food token.
1021754.translation: 当此衍生物死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。

1022594.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken creature you control dies, create a 1/1 red Satyr creature token with "This token can't block." If the creature had power 4 or greater, create two of those tokens instead.

1022648.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 red Satyr creature token with "This token can't block."

1022905.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, each opponent exiles the top two cards of their library.

1023325.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME mutates, create a red artifact token named Feather with "{o1}, Sacrifice this token: Return target Phoenix card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped."
1023325.translation: 每当CARDNAME合变时，派出一个名称为翎羽的红色衍生神器，此神器具有「{o1}，牺牲此衍生物：将目标凤凰牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。」

1023498.oracleText: {o1oG}: Return target Human you control to its owner's hand. CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.

1023669.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent creates a 1/1 red Pirate creature token with "This token can't block" and "Creatures you control attack each combat if able."

1024146.oracleText: {o4oRoG}: CARDNAME gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of lands you control.

1024233.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each other Goblin you control.

1024383.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from CARDNAME: Put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.

1024598.oracleText: {o3oB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.

1024841.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if CARDNAME was kicked, create a token that's a copy of CARDNAME, except it's not legendary and its starting loyalty is 1.

1025192.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player creates a 0/1 colorless Goblin Construct artifact creature token with "This token can't block" and "At the beginning of your upkeep, this token deals 1 damage to you."

1025441.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

1025517.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may put target permanent card from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

1025998.oracleText: {o2oR}, Discard a card: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.

1028014.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME dies or another artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return to your hand target artifact card in your graveyard with lesser mana value.

1032143.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Elemental you control dies, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
1032143.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的元素死去时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

1032295.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {oC}."
1032295.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1无色奥札奇／孽裔衍生生物。它具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

1032327.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or transforms into CARDNAME, exile target creature an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
1032327.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或转化为CARDNAME时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

1032559.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard, create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying and "This token can block only creatures with flying."
1032559.translation: 当CARDNAME进场和每当你从你坟墓场中施放咒语时，派出一个1/1蓝色的鸟衍生生物，且具有飞行与「此衍生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

1032733.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have exactly 13 life, you may pay {o4oBoB}. If you do, transform CARDNAME.
1032733.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你的总生命正好为13，你可以支付{o4oBoB}。若你如此作，则转化CARDNAME。

1032922.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard plus the number of cards with flashback you own in exile.
1032922.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌数量和放逐区中由你拥有且具返照异能的牌数量之总和。

1033185.oracleText: {oXoUoUoBoB}, Exile X creature cards from your graveyard: Transform CARDNAME. X can't be 0. Activate only as a sorcery.
1033185.translation: {oXoUoUoBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐X张生物牌：转化CARDNAME。X不能为0。只能于法术时机起动。

1033188.oracleText: As this creature transforms into Olag, Ludevic's Hubris, it becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with it, except its name is Olag, Ludevic's Hubris, it's 4/4, and it's a legendary blue and black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME equal to the number of creature cards exiled with it.
1033188.translation: 于此生物转化为卢德维巨作欧拉格时，它成为一张以其放逐之生物牌的复制品，但其名称是卢德维巨作欧拉格，为4/4，额外是蓝黑双色的传奇灵俑，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。在CARDNAME上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于以其放逐的生物牌数量。

1033224.oracleText: Remove three +1/+1 counters from CARDNAME: Return it to its owner's hand.
1033224.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去三个+1/+1指示物：将它移回其拥有者手上。

1033226.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, return up to three target land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
1033226.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，将至多三张目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1033249.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {oX} less to cast, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1033249.translation: 你施放的瞬间与法术咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1033251.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1033251.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1033395.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker unless its controller has CARDNAME deal 4 damage to them. If they do, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
1033395.translation: 除非目标生物或鹏洛客的操控者让CARDNAME对该牌手造成4点伤害，否则CARDNAME对它造成4点伤害。若该牌手如此作，你可以弃一张牌，若你如此作，抓一张牌。

1034489.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}: CARDNAME gets +5/+5 until end of turn.

1035287.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target card other than a basic land card from an opponent's graveyard. Search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that card and exile them. Then that player shuffles. For as long as you control CARDNAME, you may play one of the exiled cards, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
1035287.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标不是基本地牌的牌从对手坟墓场放逐。从该牌手的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与该牌同名的牌，并将它们放逐。然后该牌手洗牌。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，你可以使用所放逐之牌中的一张，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放它的费用。

1035305.oracleText: Whenever combat damage is dealt to you, remove an indestructible counter from CARDNAME.
1035305.translation: 每当你受到战斗伤害时，从CARDNAME上移去一个不灭指示物。

1035363.oracleText: {o5}, Exile CARDNAME and four other artifact creatures and/or Vehicles you control: Create Mechtitan, a legendary 10/10 Construct artifact creature token with flying, vigilance, trample, lifelink, and haste that's all colors. When that token leaves the battlefield, return all cards exiled with CARDNAME except this card to the battlefield tapped under their owners' control.
1035363.translation: {o5}，放逐CARDNAME和四个由你操控的其他神器生物和／或载具：派出传奇衍生神器生物机体泰坦，其为10/10，具飞行、警戒、践踏、系命与敏捷异能且是五色的组构体。当该衍生物离开战场时，将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌分别在其拥有者之操控下横置移回战场，但此牌除外。

1035386.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove a charge counter from CARDNAME: Draw a card. Then if there are no charge counters on CARDNAME, create a Treasure token and a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
1035386.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个充电指示物：抓一张牌。然后如果CARDNAME上没有充电指示物，则派出一个珍宝衍生物和一个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且后者具有「此衍生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

1035499.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
1035499.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

1035574.oracleText: When that token leaves the battlefield, return all cards exiled with CARDNAME except this card to the battlefield tapped under their owners ' control.
1035574.translation: 当该衍生物离开战场时，将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌分别在其拥有者之操控下横置移回战场，但此牌除外。

1035655.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o1}.
1035655.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

1035657.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 blue Wizard creature token with "{o1}, Sacrifice this token: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o1}."
1035657.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1蓝色法术师衍生生物，且具有「{o1}，牺牲此衍生物：除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。」

1035766.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if CARDNAME is untapped, any opponent may tap an untapped creature they control. If they do, tap CARDNAME and create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This token can't be blocked."
1035766.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若CARDNAME未横置，则任意对手可以横置一个由其操控且未横置的生物。若他如此作，则你横置CARDNAME并派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能被阻挡。」

1035780.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap enchanted creature and you create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This token can't be blocked."
1035780.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置所结附的生物，且你派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，并具有「此衍生物不能被阻挡。」

1035947.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
1035947.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，其为已横置且正进行攻击，并具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

1036237.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile any number of other target creatures controlled by different players until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield. When an exiled card enters under your control this way, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
1036237.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，选择任意数量其他目标生物，且其操控者须各不相同。放逐这些生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。当一张已放逐的牌以此法在你的操控下进场时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1036243.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player mills half their library, rounded down.
1036243.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

1036245.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, target opponent sacrifices half the nonland permanents they control of their choice, rounded down.
1036245.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，目标对手牺牲一半数量依其选择之由其操控的非地永久物，小数点后舍去。

1036257.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you don't control a Devil token, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
1036257.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你未操控魔鬼衍生生物，则派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，其为已横置且正进行攻击，并具有「当此衍生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

1036362.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put the cards exiled with it into their owner's hand.
1036362.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将以它放逐的牌移回其拥有者手上。

1036617.oracleText: When an exiled card enters under your control this way, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
1036617.translation: 当一张已放逐的牌以此法在你的操控下进场时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1036754.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put all cards you own exiled with it into your hand. At the beginning of the end step of your next turn, discard those cards.
1036754.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将所有以它放逐且由你拥有的牌置于你手上。在你下一回合的结束步骤开始时，弃等量的牌。

1036821.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, conjure a duplicate of another target nontoken attacking creature into your hand.
1036821.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将另一个目标非衍生物且进行攻击之生物的一张副本幻变进你手上。

1036993.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1036993.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1036998.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
1036998.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

1037003.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
1037003.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

1037008.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.
1037008.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则CARDNAME向每位对手造成2点伤害。

1037013.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card and you may play an additional land this turn.
1037013.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则抓一张牌，且本回合中你可以额外使用一个地。

1037078.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, CARDNAME deals that much damage to each opponent.
1037078.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，CARDNAME向每位对手造成等量的伤害。

1037126.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards. If you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
1037126.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以弃掉手牌，然后抓两张牌。若你如此作，CARDNAME向每位对手造成X点伤害，X为你本回合中弃掉牌的数量。

1037258.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1037258.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1037262.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature gains lifelink and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1037262.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0且获得系命异能直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1037266.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature gains flying and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1037266.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0且获得飞行异能直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1037270.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature gains menace and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1037270.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0且获得威慑异能直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1037274.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature gains first strike and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1037274.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0且获得先攻异能直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1037278.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap another target attacking creature. It gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1037278.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置另一个目标进行攻击的生物。它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1037656.oracleText: {o1}, Remove all +1/+1 counters from CARDNAME: It deals X damage to target attacking or blocking creature an opponent controls, where X is the number of counters removed this way.
1037656.translation: {o1}，从CARDNAME上移去所有+1/+1指示物：它对目标由对手操控且进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成X点伤害，X为以此法移去的指示物数量。

1037829.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step of your next turn, discard those cards.
1037829.translation: 在你下一回合的结束步骤开始时，弃等量的牌。

1037848.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
1037848.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

1037904.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may put an Aura or Equipment card from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield attached to CARDNAME.
1037904.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将一张灵气或武具牌从你手上或你坟墓场放进战场并贴附在CARDNAME上。

1038496.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell that targets only a single creature other than CARDNAME, you may copy that spell. The copy targets CARDNAME.
1038496.translation: 每当任一牌手施放仅以单一生物为目标的咒语，且目标不是CARDNAME时，你可以复制该咒语。该复制品以CARDNAME为目标。

1038499.oracleText: {oT}: Put two ingenuity counters on CARDNAME, then you may put an artifact card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield, where X is the number of ingenuity counters on CARDNAME.
1038499.translation: {oT}：在CARDNAME上放置两个精妙指示物，然后你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于X的神器牌从你手上放进战场，X为CARDNAME上精妙指示物的数量。

1038567.oracleText: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield under an opponent's control.
1038567.translation: 放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在任一对手的操控下移回战场。

1038582.oracleText: {o1oWoU}: Exile CARDNAME. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.

1038827.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
1038827.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

1038922.oracleText: {o1oW}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Scry 2.
1038922.translation: {o1oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：占卜2。

1039282.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, exile that many cards from the top of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
1039282.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，从你牌库顶放逐等量的牌。选择其中一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

1039379.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
1039379.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

1039389.oracleText:

1039641.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana spent to cast that spell is greater than CARDNAME's power, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1039641.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量大于CARDNAME之力量，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1039720.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
1039720.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

1039795.oracleText:
Choose two — 
• Creatures you don't control get -3/-0 until end of turn. 
• Create two tapped Powerstone tokens. 
• Create a tapped 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."

选择两项～

1039802.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile from your library and/or your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1039802.translation: 每当一张或数张牌从你的牌库和／或你的坟墓场进入放逐区时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1039817.oracleText: When this creature enters, destroy target noncreature permanent.
1039817.translation: 当此生物进场时，消灭目标非生物永久物。

1039899.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
1039899.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此衍生物不能进行阻挡。」

1055392.oracleText: Alacrian riders have been known to seek out Oviya to memorialize their fallen Quickbeasts.
1055392.translation: 据闻阿拉奇亚骑手会寻访奥薇亚，为阵亡的捷兽立碑纪念。

1055407.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, draft a card from Support Skyforge's spellbook. That card perpetually becomes an artifact creature.

1055432.oracleText: The edge of Naktamun was once protected by Kefnet. The honored mummies who patrol it now do so in his image.
1055432.translation: 拿塔蒙城边缘原本受到刻法涅的庇护。原本巡逻此处的赐耀木乃伊，如今装扮成它的模样来履行使命。

1055433.oracleText: Creatures you control that are Zombies and/or tokens get +1/+1 and have flying.

1055439.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, this Equipment deals damage to that player equal to the number of cards in their hand and you gain 1 life for each card in your hand.

1055482.translation: 超空洞的光环一旦扫到身上，周遭时间便会就此停止。但灵魂还能领略整个虚空夺命的壮美过程。

1055483.translation: 放逐所有生物和太空船。

1055485.translation: 「心中信念，化作尖锐矛锋。手中长枪，便是此生寄托。整条性命，献给最高摄政。」
