1055487.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+0 as long as you've cast two or more spells this turn.
1055487.translation: 只要你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，此生物便得+2/+0。

1055489.oracleText: Cosmogrands of the Celestial Palatinate always seek to expand their grip on the Edge.
1055489.translation: 天星御庭的宸宇贵族总在设法提升他们于边域中的掌控力。

1055490.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens.
1055490.translation: 派出两个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

1055491.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens.
1055491.translation: 派出两个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

1055492.oracleText:
Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, choose one — 
• Create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1055492.translation:
每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，选择一项～
•派出两个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。
•在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055494.oracleText: "Arrive as the dawn, and banish night through your brilliance!"
1055494.translation: 「如清晨破晓般震撼登场，藉耀眼明辉驱散黑夜！」

1055495.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control other than this creature.
1055495.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控两个或更多已横置的生物，则在此生物以外每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055497.oracleText: Eternity columns are the trade hubs of every solar system.
1055497.translation: 不管在哪个星系中，虚空跃柱都是当地的贸易枢纽。

1055499.oracleText:
"You fight beside me as brilliantly as the dawn. I have nothing more to teach you."
—Master Iridiss
1055499.translation:
「你已能如破晓明辉般与我并肩作战。你已经出师了。」
～依律迪大师

1055501.oracleText:
"Haste begets blunder. Be patient, Aora. As the sun rises, you will yet earn your second blade."
—Master Iridiss
1055501.translation:
「仓促引失误。奥拉，你大可不必心急。待到太阳升起，第二把剑自然就会在你手中出现。」
～依律迪大师

1055502.oracleText: Target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn. If it has a +1/+1 counter on it, draw a card.
1055502.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。如果其上有+1/+1指示物，则抓一张牌。

1055504.oracleText: "This is your captain speaking. Our eternity drive has ruptured. Light be with you all."
1055504.translation: 「现在是舰长广播。本舰虚空引擎已损毁。愿明光与各位同在。」

1055505.oracleText: Destroy target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a Lander token.
1055505.translation: 消灭目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055508.oracleText: "An Astelli once saved me just like this. I aspire to live up to their example every day."
1055508.translation: 「曾有位亡星使像这样救了我一命。之后我就下定决心，每天都要做到跟他们一样。」

1055510.oracleText: The hidden might of the Sunstar Free Company is its technical staff.
1055510.translation: 这些尽职的技术人员，正是辉星自由连的秘密战力所在。

1055511.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, you gain 2 life.
1055511.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控两个或更多已横置的生物，则你获得2点生命。

1055513.oracleText:
"We are the arrows of Sunsolde's Quiver."
—Declaration of Fleet Purpose, Axiom 2
1055513.translation:
「吾人乃是辉灼利箭之尖锋。」
～《舰志宣言》，第二条

1055514.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target attacking or blocking creature, where X is 2 plus the number of creatures and/or Spacecraft you control.
1055514.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的生物和／或太空船总数量加2。

1055515.oracleText: Focus Fire deals X damage to target attacking or blocking creature, where X is 2 plus the number of creatures and/or Spacecraft you control.
1055515.translation: 集中火力对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的生物和／或太空船总数量加2。

1055517.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature or artifact you control enters, you gain 1 life.
1055517.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物或神器进场时，你获得1点生命。

1055518.oracleText: Whenever Haliya or another creature or artifact you control enters, you gain 1 life.
1055518.translation: 每当哈莉娅或另一个由你操控的生物或神器进场时，你获得1点生命。

1055519.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, draw a card if you've gained 3 or more life this turn.
1055519.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，如果你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则抓一张牌。

1055522.oracleText:
"I have forgotten sleep in their prison."
—Korelaa, prison escapee
1055522.translation:
「在牢里的时候我甚至都忘了要睡觉。」
～光牢逃犯寇丽拉

1055523.translation: 所结附的永久物具有守护{o1}。

1055524.oracleText: "With this mantle, you carry the duty to spread light, liberty, and the grace of Taman IV to the stars."
1055524.translation: 「接下此斗篷，即是要肩负起将光明、自由及塔曼四世之美善传扬众星的重任。」

1055526.oracleText: "Hope can never fade so long as there's a hand to carry my sword when I fall."
1055526.translation: 「只要我倒下后还有人捡起我手中的剑，希望便永远不会消逝。」

1055527.oracleText: {o4oWoW}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for an Equipment card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
1055527.translation: {o4oWoW}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

1055528.oracleText: {o4oWoW}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for an Equipment card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
1055528.translation: {o4oWoW}，牺牲此生物：从你牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

1055530.oracleText: "I thank you that I do not shine alone."

1055532.oracleText: Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.
1055532.translation: 亡星使由星体消亡而生，因此他们虽亦会为辉光而战，但也清楚知道空洞是孕育他们生命之所在。

1055533.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent exiles a card from their hand and may play that card for as long as it remains exiled. Each spell cast this way costs {o1} more to cast. Each land played this way enters tapped.
1055533.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各进行以下流程～从其手上放逐一张牌，且只要该牌持续被放逐，其便可以使用该牌。以此法施放的咒语均增加{o1}来施放。以此法使用的地均须横置进场。

1055534.oracleText: When this creature enters, each opponent exiles a card from their hand and may play that card for as long as it remains exiled. Each spell cast this way costs {o1} more to cast. Each land played this way enters tapped.
1055534.translation: 当此生物进场时，每位对手各进行以下流程～从其手上放逐一张牌，且只要该牌持续被放逐，其便可以使用该牌。以此法施放的咒语均增加{o1}来施放。以此法使用的地均须横置进场。

1055539.oracleText:
"Only when a vessel is emptied of shallow ego may the depths of light flow in to fill it."
—Seraphus Chek, Sunstar poet
1055539.translation:
「唯有肤浅认知散去后，方得深邃光流补充来。」
～辉星连诗人瑟拉菲彻

1055540.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature and/or artifact you control.
1055540.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控之其他生物和／或神器的数量加总。

1055541.oracleText: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature and/or artifact you control.
1055541.translation: 此生物进场时上面有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为由你操控之其他生物和／或神器的数量加总。

1055543.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile all artifacts and creatures with mana value 2 or less until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
1055543.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐所有法术力值等于或小于2的神器和生物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

1055544.oracleText: When this artifact enters, exile all artifacts and creatures with mana value 2 or less until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
1055544.translation: 当此神器进场时，放逐所有法术力值等于或小于2的神器和生物，直到此神器离开战场为止。

1055545.oracleText: {o6oWoW}: Put each card exiled with CARDNAME into its owner's graveyard, then create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token for each card put into a graveyard this way. Sacrifice CARDNAME.
1055545.translation: {o6oWoW}：将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌各置入其拥有者的坟墓场，然后每以此法将一张牌置入坟墓场，你便派出一个2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。牺牲CARDNAME。

1055546.oracleText: {o6oWoW}: Put each card exiled with this artifact into its owner's graveyard, then create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token for each card put into a graveyard this way. Sacrifice this artifact.
1055546.translation: {o6oWoW}：将所有以此神器放逐的牌各置入其拥有者的坟墓场，然后每以此法将一张牌置入坟墓场，你便派出一个2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。牺牲此神器。

1055548.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Spacecraft card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1055548.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张太空船牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。若你未以此法将牌置于你手上，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055549.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Spacecraft card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
1055549.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张太空船牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。若你未以此法将牌置于你手上，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055551.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or tapped creature. You gain 3 life.
1055551.translation: 消灭目标神器或已横置的生物。你获得3点生命。

1055553.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
1055553.translation: 每当一个由你操控、其上有+1/+1指示物且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

1055555.oracleText: Target artifact or creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
1055555.translation: 目标神器或生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1055556.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target tapped creature.
1055556.translation: CARDNAME对目标已横置的生物造成2点伤害。

1055557.oracleText: Reroute Systems deals 2 damage to target tapped creature.
1055557.translation: 划径系统对目标已横置的生物造成2点伤害。

1055558.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target artifact or creature gains indestructible until end of turn. 
• CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target tapped creature.
1055558.translation:
选择一项～
•目标神器或生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。
•CARDNAME对目标已横置的生物造成2点伤害。

1055559.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target artifact or creature gains indestructible until end of turn. 
• Reroute Systems deals 2 damage to target tapped creature.
1055559.translation:
选择一项～
•目标神器或生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。
•划径系统对目标已横置的生物造成2点伤害。

1055561.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature or enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1055561.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标生物或结界牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1055562.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, return target creature or enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1055562.translation: 当此太空船进场时，将目标生物或结界牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1055565.oracleText:
"We've received transmission! They're alive—just barely."
—Sunstar Free Company Mission Control
1055565.translation:
「收到信号了！他们还活着～但状况危急。」
～辉星自由连调度中心

1055566.oracleText: Return up to three target creature cards with total mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a +1/+1 counter on each of them.
1055566.translation: 将至多三张目标生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于3。在它们上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055568.oracleText: Drix hunt down Eldrazi Potentiate without hesitation or explanation.
1055568.translation: 卓兹人遇到潜在奥札奇便会当即猎杀，毫不犹豫，毫无解释。

1055569.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
1055569.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

1055571.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a legendary creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1055571.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张传奇生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1055572.oracleText: When The Seriema enters, search your library for a legendary creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1055572.translation: 当瑟黎玛号进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张传奇生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1055576.oracleText: When this creature enters, search your library for a basic Plains card or a creature card with mana value 1 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1055576.translation: 当此生物进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌或一张法术力值等于或小于1的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1055578.oracleText: "Brightstar-1 to FlightComm: Scopes are clear. The stars are yours."
1055578.translation: 「明星1号呼叫空管：空域内一切正常。群星任你掌控。」

1055580.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, surveil 1.
1055580.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，刺探1。

1055582.oracleText: "You are a suspect in an ongoing investigation. Do not resist apprehension."
1055582.translation: 「我们怀疑你与一宗案件密切相关，如遇抓捕切勿抵抗。」

1055583.oracleText: {o3oW}, {oT}: Tap another target creature. This ability costs {o2} less to activate if you control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1055583.translation: {o3oW}，{oT}：横置另一个目标生物。如果你操控其上有+1/+1指示物的生物，则此异能减少{o2}来起动。

1055585.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
1055585.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控两个或更多已横置的生物，则在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055586.oracleText: {o2}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Tap target artifact or creature.
1055586.translation: {o2}，从由你操控的生物上移去一个+1/+1指示物：横置目标神器或生物。

1055588.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, create a Lander token.
1055588.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055589.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, create a Lander token.
1055589.translation: 当此生物进场时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055590.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
1055590.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

1055592.oracleText: She forges blades of incandescence and quenches them in pitch darkness.
1055592.translation: 她用白炽明辉铸剑，而后再经深邃黑暗淬光。

1055593.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card.
1055593.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

1055595.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1055595.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个2/2无色自动机衍生神器生物。

1055596.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1055596.translation: 当此太空船进场时，派出一个2/2无色自动机衍生神器生物。

1055600.oracleText: His people watched the Eldrazi rise and the Fomori fall. Never will they watch again.
1055600.translation: 卓兹人曾亲眼见证奥札奇崛起、佛莫里败亡。他们下定决心，不会再让历史重演。

1055601.oracleText: The Sunstar Free Company is not swayed by profit. Sunstar is their faith, the prism through which they cast light across Sothera.
1055601.translation: 辉星自由连不为利益所动。辉星正是其信念所存，他们坚信只要经之折射，便可将光芒洒遍整个索瑟拉。

1055602.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. If it's not your turn, untap those creatures.
1055602.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。如果当前不是你的回合，则重置这些生物。

1055603.oracleText: "Your ship and crew have been contaminated by the great destroyers. We cannot risk their spread. Prepare for unraveling."
1055603.translation: 「贵舰及船员都已受恶灭体感染。一旦传播开来，我们无法承受此等风险。请做好准备，接受处理。」

1055605.oracleText: When packing for a stealth mission, it's important to fold your dimensions tightly.
1055605.translation: 当你要为潜入任务做准备时，请务必将自己的体态也缩紧。

1055606.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, choose up to one target creature. That creature can't be blocked this turn and has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
1055606.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，选择至多一个目标生物。该生物本回合不能被阻挡，且其基础力量与防御力为1/1直到回合结束。

1055608.oracleText: All Uthros networks are routed through an ancient relic called a memory vessel, which converts data into thought.
1055608.translation: 乌索斯网络由众多称作「容忆皿」的远古遗物相互连结而成，能将数据直接转化为思绪。

1055609.oracleText: Surveil X, where X is the number of artifacts you control. Then draw three cards.
1055609.translation: 刺探X，X为由你操控的神器数量。然后抓三张牌。

1055612.oracleText: A cloudsculptor at work is like a carefully balanced weather system, and just as dangerous to interfere with.
1055612.translation: 认真工作时的刻云师就跟已精妙平衡的天气系统一样～一受惊扰，后患无穷。

1055613.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact, CARDNAME gets +1/+0.

1055614.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact, this creature gets +1/+0.
1055614.translation: 只要你操控神器，此生物便得+1/+0。

1055616.oracleText: Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.
1055616.translation: 就算是在边域当中，狗也还是狗。

1055617.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
1055617.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

1055618.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
1055618.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

1055621.oracleText: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of lands you control. Put one of those cards into your hand. If this spell was kicked, put two of those cards into your hand instead. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1055621.translation: 检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控的地数量。将其中一张牌置于你手上。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为将其中两张牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1055623.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or leaves the battlefield, draw a card.
1055623.translation: 当CARDNAME进入或离开战场时，抓一张牌。

1055624.oracleText: When this artifact enters or leaves the battlefield, draw a card.
1055624.translation: 当此神器进入或离开战场时，抓一张牌。

1055625.oracleText: {o1oU}, Sacrifice this artifact: Put a stun counter on up to one target tapped creature.
1055625.translation: {o1oU}，牺牲此神器：在至多一个目标已横置的生物上放置一个晕眩指示物。

1055627.oracleText: Illvoi are masters of the deep freeze, though conditions must be perfect to avoid going to pieces.
1055627.translation: 依沃伊人是冰冻大师，但保存条件也很有讲究，否则一不小心就会碎落一地。

1055628.oracleText: When enchanted creature becomes tapped or is dealt damage, destroy it.
1055628.translation: 当所结附的生物成为横置或受到伤害时，将它消灭。

1055630.oracleText: "Your atoms will serve my ambitions in a much more useful form."
1055630.translation: 「你身上的原子将会以更有用的方式来帮助我。」

1055631.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If it was attacking, create a 1/1 colorless Drone artifact creature token with flying and "This token can block only creatures with flying."
1055631.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果其正进行攻击，派出一个1/1无色奴兽衍生神器生物，且具有飞行与「此衍生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

1055633.oracleText: Illvoi hope for the best outcomes but engineer for the worst.
1055633.translation: 依沃伊人总是期望最佳结果，但作好最坏打算。

1055634.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}. If they do, you create a Lander token.
1055634.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。如果其如此作，则你派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055636.oracleText: Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.
1055636.translation: 由于密使机体在天顶盟间对话通讯当中起到重要作用，因此都对单独为其安排特殊保安设定。

1055637.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest mana value among other artifacts you control.
1055637.translation: CARDNAME得+X/+0，X为由你操控之其他神器中的最大法术力值。

1055638.oracleText: This creature gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest mana value among other artifacts you control.
1055638.translation: 此生物得+X/+0，X为由你操控之其他神器中的最大法术力值。

1055640.oracleText: The shadow of the godcore falls over Uthros, and the world erupts with storms.
1055640.translation: 神核阴影笼罩乌索斯，整个世界四处风暴肆虐。

1055641.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you've cast another spell this turn.
1055641.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过其他咒语，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

1055644.oracleText: Uthros guards have such rapid reflexes that it has led to rumors of experimental precognition.
1055644.translation: 乌索斯守卫的反应极其敏锐，以至于世间一直都有他们都受过实验改造、具有预知能力的传言。

1055647.oracleText: Cloudkill agents slip in and out like a breeze.
1055647.translation: 刻云灭杀手悄声潜入潜出，一切都很自然写意。

1055648.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked if you've cast two or more spells this turn.
1055648.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则CARDNAME不能被阻挡。

1055649.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked if you've cast two or more spells this turn.
1055649.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则此生物不能被阻挡。

1055651.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, attach it to target creature you control. That creature gains hexproof until end of turn.
1055651.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。该生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

1055652.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control. That creature gains hexproof until end of turn.
1055652.translation: 当此武具进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。该生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

1055654.oracleText: The Uthros Combine's first question for any scientific breakthrough is always: "How can this be used to keep our next breakthrough secret?"
1055654.translation: 乌索斯联合每次科技有所突破时，想到的第一个问题都是：「要怎样用这项技术来为下次突破保密？」

1055656.oracleText: Every so often, the Edge reminds you that there's always more to discover.
1055656.translation: 边域时常都会提醒你，此处幅员辽阔，总有未知之地可供探索。

1055657.oracleText: Target artifact or creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library. Surveil 1.
1055657.translation: 目标神器或生物的拥有者依其选择将之置于其牌库顶或牌库底。刺探1。

1055659.oracleText: Every iteration brings it closer to understanding its own creation.
1055659.translation: 每次组装都会让它更了解自己的创造。

1055660.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
1055660.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，派出一个2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

1055661.oracleText: Illvoi temper their curiosity with caution, deploying mechan pilots before they risk mortal scientists.
1055661.translation: 依沃伊人尽管好奇心旺盛，行事却极为谨慎：他们会采用机体来当驾手，以免无谓损失科学人才。

1055662.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, draw a card, then discard a card.
1055662.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1055664.oracleText:
"Do not mistake a preference for peace for an inability to fight."
—Yvin, Pinnacle envoy
1055664.translation:
「切勿把『喜好和平』当成『无力作战』。」
～天顶盟特使逸云

1055667.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
1055667.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

1055669.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast during your turn.
1055669.translation: 于你的回合中，此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

1055672.oracleText: You may cast artifact spells from the top of your library.
1055672.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶施放神器咒语。

1055673.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand.
1055673.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语。

1055674.oracleText: Artifacts you control have "{oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand."
1055674.translation: 由你操控的神器具有「{oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语。」

1055676.oracleText:
"All is the hand that weaves the Fabric of Being. The Fabric of Being is All."
—Drix Codex, line 1
1055676.translation:
「万物乃编织生灵纽带之手，而生灵纽带正是万物。」
～《卓兹古抄》，第1行

1055677.oracleText: The first time you would create one or more tokens each turn, you may instead create that many tokens that are copies of enchanted permanent.
1055677.translation: 你每回合中首度将派出一个或数个衍生物时，你可以改为派出为所结附永久物之复制品的衍生物，数量不变。

1055679.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creatures your opponents control get -3/-0 until your next turn.
1055679.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由对手操控的生物得-3/-0直到你的下一个回合。

1055681.oracleText: Cloudsculpting naturally led the Illvoi to other methods of reshaping matter.
1055681.translation: 依沃伊人在掌握刻云技术之后，很快就触类旁通地学会了其他重塑物质的方法。

1055682.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, untap another target permanent. This ability triggers only once each turn.
1055682.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，重置另一个目标永久物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

1055683.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, untap another target permanent. This ability triggers only once each turn.
1055683.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，重置另一个目标永久物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

1055685.oracleText: As long as you have one or fewer cards in hand, if you would draw one or more cards, you draw that many cards plus one instead.
1055685.translation: 只要你的手牌为一张或更少，便于如果你将抓一张或数张牌时，改为你抓该数量加一的牌。

1055688.oracleText: The Illvoi hunt for stellar fragments that predate even the Fomori.
1055688.translation: 有些星辰碎片历史比佛莫里人还久远，而这些正是依沃伊人搜寻的目标。

1055689.oracleText:
Choose one or both — 
• Search your library for an artifact card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. 
• Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
1055689.translation:
选择一项或都选～
•从你牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。
•将目标神器牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

1055691.oracleText: Sometimes the best parts are already in use.
1055691.translation: 有时候最好的材料已经派上用场。

1055692.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice an artifact. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and draw a card.
1055692.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器。当你如此作时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并抓一张牌。

1055695.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -3/-0 until end of turn.
1055695.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。

1055696.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -3/-0 until end of turn.
1055696.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。

1055699.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to two target non-Spacecraft creatures to their owners' hands.
1055699.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多两个目标非太空船生物移回其拥有者手上。

1055700.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, return up to two target non-Spacecraft creatures to their owners' hands.
1055700.translation: 当此太空船进场时，将至多两个目标非太空船生物移回其拥有者手上。

1055701.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player mills four cards.
1055701.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手磨四张牌。

1055702.oracleText: Whenever this Spacecraft attacks, defending player mills four cards.
1055702.translation: 每当此太空船攻击时，防御牌手磨四张牌。

1055705.oracleText: If a permanent entering the battlefield causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
1055705.translation: 如果由你操控之永久物具有的触发式异能因永久物进战场而触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

1055707.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may draw that many cards.
1055707.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以抓等量的牌。

1055710.oracleText: It harnesses energy from the brutal, mana-rich storms found deep within Uthros.
1055710.translation: 乌索斯深处有许多法术力满溢的强烈风暴，唯有它才能掌控其间能量。

1055711.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to cast an artifact spell.
1055711.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语。

1055712.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oUoU}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities of artifact sources.
1055712.translation: {oT}：加{oUoU}。此法术力只能用来起动神器来源的异能。

1055716.oracleText: Drix weftwalking requires neither eternity columns nor Pinnacle codebooks. But the art is ancient, and each passing is a leap of faith.
1055716.translation: 卓兹人漫步星丝时，既不会用到虚空跃柱，也无需参阅天顶盟码簿。此等技艺从上古时代流传至今，每一步都是踏向未知的勇敢尝试。

1055717.oracleText: Counter target spell. If the amount of mana spent to cast that spell was less than its mana value, you draw a card.
1055717.translation: 反击目标咒语。如果该咒语施放时所支付的法术力数量小于该咒语的法术力值，则你抓一张牌。

1055720.oracleText: The second spell you cast each turn costs {o2} less to cast.
1055720.translation: 你每回合中施放的第二个咒语减少{o2}来施放。

1055722.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
1055722.translation: 当此太空船进场时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1055724.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it, shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library, then draw seven cards.
1055724.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经你施放，则将你的手牌和坟墓场洗入你的牌库，然后抓七张牌。

1055725.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, if you cast it, shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library, then draw seven cards.
1055725.translation: 当此结界进场时，若它经你施放，则将你的手牌和坟墓场洗入你的牌库，然后抓七张牌。

1055726.oracleText: The first spell each player casts during each of their turns may be cast without paying its mana cost.
1055726.translation: 每位牌手于其每个回合中所施放的第一个咒语，均可以藉由「不需支付其法术力费用」之方式来施放。

1055728.oracleText: "All things end. I'd rather embrace that truth than the fantasy of eternal light."
1055728.translation: 「万物皆有终。与其沉浸在永恒辉光的幻想之中，我更愿意直面真相。」

1055730.oracleText: Void — Whenever Alpharael attacks, if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, defending player loses half their life, rounded up.
1055730.translation: 空洞～每当阿法雷攻击时，若本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则防御牌手失去一半数量的生命，小数点后进位。

1055732.oracleText: Return one or two target creature and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand.
1055732.translation: 将一张或两张目标生物和／或鹏洛客牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

1055733.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. It gains lifelink until end of turn.
1055733.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

1055734.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Exile target creature or planeswalker. 
• Return one or two target creature and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand. 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. It gains lifelink until end of turn.
1055734.translation:
选择一项～
•放逐目标生物或鹏洛客。
•将一张或两张目标生物和／或鹏洛客牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。
•在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

1055736.oracleText: The Kav had learned their lesson about mining too deep. Zern Miffles had not.
1055736.translation: 卡傅人早就知道矿挖得太深会吃苦头。但泽恩米孚还不知道。

1055737.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a Lander token.
1055737.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055738.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a Lander token.
1055738.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055740.oracleText: The Eumidians sought the secret of weftwalking in Drix DNA. Though they failed, their attempts yielded other gains.
1055740.translation: 蝣美迪人想从卓兹人的DNA当中找出星丝漫步的奥秘所在。虽然尝试未果，但也由此得到了其他收获。

1055741.oracleText: Put target exiled card with warp on the bottom of its owner's library.
1055741.translation: 将目标已放逐且具有跃迁异能的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。

1055742.oracleText: Put target exiled card with warp on the bottom of its owner's library.
1055742.translation: 将目标已放逐且具有跃迁异能的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。

1055743.oracleText:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one — 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME. 
• Put target exiled card with warp on the bottom of its owner's library.
1055743.translation:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项～
•在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。
•将目标已放逐且具有跃迁异能的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。

1055744.oracleText:
When this creature enters, choose one — 
• Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature. 
• Put target exiled card with warp on the bottom of its owner's library.
1055744.translation:
当此生物进场时，选择一项～
•在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。
•将目标已放逐且具有跃迁异能的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。

1055746.oracleText: Whenever enchanted creature attacks, put target creature card from defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
1055746.translation: 每当所结附的生物攻击时，将目标生物牌从防御牌手的坟墓场在你操控下横置放进战场且正进行攻击。

1055747.oracleText: Void — At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice CARDNAME unless a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
1055747.translation: 空洞～在你结束步骤开始时，除非本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，否则牺牲CARDNAME。

1055748.oracleText: Void — At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this Aura unless a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
1055748.translation: 空洞～空洞～在你结束步骤开始时，除非本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，否则牺牲此灵气。

1055750.oracleText:
"Found the stranded crew in an icy labyrinth. Well, what's left of them."
—Decrypted log 2.23
1055750.translation:
「在一处寒冰迷宫内找到了受困组员。呃，组员的一部分。」
～解密日志2.23

1055751.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
1055751.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

1055752.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
1055752.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

1055754.oracleText: One last chance. Make it count.

1055755.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if it targets a blocking creature.
1055755.translation: 如果此咒语以正进行阻挡的生物为目标，则它减少{o1}来施放。

1055757.oracleText: "You would kill the Faller—our messiah—and call us monsters?"
1055757.translation: 「你会杀掉我们的救世主斩命使，然后把—我们—当成怪物？」

1055758.oracleText: You draw two cards and lose 2 life. Void — If a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, instead you draw two cards and each opponent loses 2 life.
1055758.translation: 你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。空洞～如果本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则改为你抓两张牌且每位对手各失去2点生命。

1055759.oracleText: The Sunstar faith teaches of Perfect Void—of emptying oneself so that the light may fill the hollow. But in the void of death, its teachings bring little comfort.
1055759.translation: 辉星连的教导当中会宣扬「至美空洞」这一概念～信众唯有掏净自我，方能让辉光填满空白。但当信众真的身处死亡空洞之时，覆念这一教导也不会让自己更好受。

1055762.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, up to one target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
1055762.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，至多一个目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

1055763.oracleText: When this artifact enters, up to one target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
1055763.translation: 当此神器进场时，至多一个目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

1055764.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target opponent loses 3 life.
1055764.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：目标对手失去3点生命。

1055766.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you draw a card and lose 1 life.
1055766.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

1055767.oracleText: Void — At the beginning of your end step, if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1055767.translation: 空洞～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则派出一个2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1055770.translation: 消灭目标生物或太空船。

1055773.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, each opponent discards a card. Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.
1055773.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，每位对手各弃一张牌。每位无法如此作的对手各失去3点生命。

1055774.oracleText: Whenever this Spacecraft attacks, each opponent discards a card. Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.
1055774.translation: 每当此太空船攻击时，每位对手各弃一张牌。每位无法如此作的对手各失去3点生命。

1055776.oracleText:
"Death is a trick of the light. Snuff it out and discover immortality."
—Plummet Record 170.312
1055776.translation:
「死亡不过强光障目。掐灭光芒，发现永生。」
～坠落纪录170.312

1055900.translation: 派出一个探地器衍生物。然后你可以牺牲一个神器。当你如此作时，硬地减速对每个生物各造成2点伤害。

1055902.oracleText: Only the most skilled matter shapers can imbue moxite with other raw energies, but the rewards are well worth the dangers.
1055902.translation: 只有最富经验的塑物师才敢将其他原始能量注入玛珂矿中，但由此带来的丰厚回报值得冒险尝试。

1055903.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a tapped 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1055903.translation: {o3}，牺牲此神器：派出一个已横置的2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1055904.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create a tapped 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1055904.translation: {o3}，牺牲此神器：派出一个已横置的2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1055906.oracleText: Recover the treasures in Kavaron's memorial vaults—by any means necessary.
1055906.translation: 夺回卡傅隆纪念贮窖中的所有宝物～不计手段。

1055907.oracleText: During your turn, other creatures you control get +1/+0.
1055907.translation: 于你的回合中，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0。

1055910.oracleText: Kavaron cannot be saved, but its culture can.
1055910.translation: 救不了卡傅隆本身，但文化还留得住。

1055911.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another artifact: Exile the top X cards of your library, where X is one plus the mana value of the sacrificed artifact. You may play those cards this turn.
1055911.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个神器：放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为所牺牲神器之法术力值加一。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

1055914.oracleText: "Let's show those bugs our own style of splicin'."
1055914.translation: 「让这些虫子见识下我们的拼接方式。」

1055916.oracleText: Legend says the first Regent Maximum was herself a dragon. She illuminated the void and gifted the Celestial Palatinate lightforging.
1055916.translation: 传说，首任最高摄政本身就是一条巨龙。她凭一己之力照亮整个空洞，同时将铸光技术留给天星御庭。

1055917.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 3 damage to any target.
1055917.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

1055919.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 1 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
1055919.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成1点伤害。

1055920.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
1055920.translation: 当此生物进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成1点伤害。

1055922.oracleText: The Kav pilot gleefully ignored his lander's collision warning.
1055922.translation: 卡傅驾手开心地忽略掉了着陆器上弹出的碰撞警报。

1055923.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt this way, create a Lander token.
1055923.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成6点伤害。如果以此法造成过量伤害，则派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055924.oracleText: Orbital Plunge deals 6 damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt this way, create a Lander token.
1055924.translation: 轨道急坠对目标生物造成6点伤害。如果以此法造成过量伤害，则派出一个探地器衍生物。

1055927.oracleText: It wasn't the most efficient design, but the miners refused to part with "Ol' Pangy."
1055927.translation: 虽然这不是最高效的设计，但所有矿工都不愿离开「老穿」。

1055928.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, you may pay {o1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1055928.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055929.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control enters, you may pay {o1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
1055929.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器进场时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1055931.oracleText: The agony that consumed him also gave him clarity of purpose.
1055931.translation: 周身虽遭苦痛吞噬，内心目标却愈加清晰。

1055932.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, enchanted creature deals damage equal to its power to any other target.
1055932.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，所结附的生物对任意另一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

1055933.oracleText: When this Aura enters, enchanted creature deals damage equal to its power to any other target.
1055933.translation: 当此灵气进场时，所结附的生物对任意另一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

1055934.oracleText: Whenever enchanted creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to each opponent.
1055934.translation: 每当所结附的生物受到伤害时，它向每位对手各造成等量的伤害。

1055936.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. Void — CARDNAME deals 3 damage instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
1055936.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。 空洞～如果本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则CARDNAME改为造成3点伤害。

1055937.oracleText:
Plasma Bolt deals 2 damage to any target. 
Void — Plasma Bolt deals 3 damage instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
1055937.translation:
电浆击对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。
空洞～如果本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则电浆击改为造成3点伤害。

1055939.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Kavu you control enters, exile the top card of your library. For as long as that card remains exiled, you may play it if you control a Kavu.
1055939.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的卡甫进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，只要你操控卡甫，你便可以使用之。

1055940.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Kavu you control enters, exile the top card of your library. For as long as that card remains exiled, you may play it if you control a Kavu.
1055940.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的卡甫进场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，只要你操控卡甫，你便可以使用之。

1055943.oracleText: While the Kavaron tiger has been extinct for centuries, its renowned ferocity endures.
1055943.translation: 虽然卡傅隆虎数世纪前早已灭绝，但其凶猛之姿依然流传于世。

1055945.oracleText: Even until Exodus Day, those in power on Kavaron refused to acknowledge that the planet was trying to tell them something.
1055945.translation: 直到离升之日，卡傅隆当权者仍不愿承认自己的星球曾有所警示。

1055946.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
1055946.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

1055947.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
1055947.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，此生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

1055949.oracleText: "We build our beamcutters to mince bedrock. Should slice a Eumidian hull with no issues."
1055949.translation: 「我们的光束砍刀原本准备来切割基岩用的。拿去对付蝣美迪人的外壳应当也没什么问题。」

1055950.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike and reach until end of turn.
1055950.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+0且获得先攻与延势异能。

1055952.oracleText: Void — When CARDNAME enters, if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, exile up to one target instant or sorcery card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
1055952.translation: 空洞～当CARDNAME进场时，若本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则将至多一张目标法术力值等于或小于2的瞬间或法术牌从你坟墓场放逐。将它复制。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

1055953.oracleText: Void — When this creature enters, if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, exile up to one target instant or sorcery card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
1055953.translation: 空洞～当此生物进场时，若本回合有非地永久物离开战场或本回合有咒语跃迁，则将至多一张目标法术力值等于或小于2的瞬间或法术牌从你坟墓场放逐。将它复制。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

1055955.oracleText: Kav battle rhetoric teaches that there are no malfunctions on the battlefield, just equipment that need to be utilized differently.
1055955.translation: 上过战场的卡傅人之间流传着这样一句话：战场上武器没有坏，只是你不会用。

1055956.oracleText: Ruinous Rampage deals 3 damage to each opponent.
1055956.translation: 毁坏狂愤向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

1055957.oracleText: Exile all artifacts with mana value 3 or less.
1055957.translation: 放逐所有法术力值等于或小于3的神器。

1055958.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent. 
• Exile all artifacts with mana value 3 or less.
1055958.translation:
选择一项～
•CARDNAME向每位对手各造成3点伤害。
•放逐所有法术力值等于或小于3的神器。

1055959.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Ruinous Rampage deals 3 damage to each opponent. 
• Exile all artifacts with mana value 3 or less.
1055959.translation:
选择一项～
•毁坏狂愤向每位对手各造成3点伤害。
•放逐所有法术力值等于或小于3的神器。

1055961.oracleText: It scrounges Kavaron's wasteland, unaware that its home can no longer support its purpose.
1055961.translation: 它仍在卡傅隆废土上游荡，浑然不知此处家园已无力支援其运作。

1055962.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile an artifact card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME, then it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
1055962.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从你坟墓场放逐一张神器牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后它对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

1055963.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile an artifact card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
1055963.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从你坟墓场放逐一张神器牌：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后它对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

1055965.oracleText:
"Who cares if it rips the asteroid apart? We got what we needed."
—Viya, Kav moxite baron
1055965.translation:
「就算这样会粉碎小行星又如何？反正我们拿到了我们想要的。」
～卡傅玛珂矿巨头薇雅

1055966.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice another artifact or land: Draw a card.
1055966.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲另一个神器或地：抓一张牌。

1055968.oracleText: Gain control of target artifact or creature until end of turn. Untap that permanent. It gains haste until end of turn. If it's a Spacecraft, put ten charge counters on it. If you do, remove ten charge counters from it at the beginning of the next end step.
1055968.translation: 获得目标神器或生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该永久物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果它是太空船，则在其上放置十个充电指示物。若你如此作，则在下一个结束步骤开始时从其上移去十个充电指示物。

1055971.oracleText: "We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine."
1055971.translation: 「萨米，我们还缺几根骨头才能凑齐骨干小队，不过脊柱倒有很多。」

1055972.oracleText: Artifact cards and red creature cards in your hand have warp {o2oR}.
1055972.translation: 你手上的神器牌和红色生物牌具有跃迁{o2oR}。

1055974.oracleText: A victory was the best retirement gift the admiral could have asked for.
1055974.translation: 胜利是元帅最想要的退休礼物。

1055975.oracleText: When this permanent leaves the battlefield, it deals damage equal to its mana value to each creature.
1055975.translation: 当此永久物离开战场时，它对每个生物各造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的法术力值

1055976.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this permanent.
1055976.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲此永久物。

1055977.oracleText: You may put an artifact or creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That permanent gains haste, "When this permanent leaves the battlefield, it deals damage equal to its mana value to each creature," and "At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this permanent."
1055977.translation: 你可以将一张神器或生物牌从你手上放进战场。该永久物获得敏捷、「当此永久物离开战场时，它对每个生物各造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的法术力值」与「在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲此永久物。」

1055980.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent may have you create two Lander tokens. If they don't, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
1055980.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手可以令你派出两个探地器衍生物。若其未如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1055981.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent may have you create two Lander tokens. If they don't, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
1055981.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手可以令你派出两个探地器衍生物。若其未如此作，则在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1055983.oracleText: Some creatures have adapted to thrive in the unstable chaos of Kavaron That Is.
1055983.translation: 有些生物已悄然生变，以在现今卡傅隆的变幻混沌中求得生存。

1055984.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast that card this turn.
1055984.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，从你牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地牌为止。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。

1055986.translation:
「不计后果，一心向前！」
～卡傅舰队格言

1055987.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw two cards.
1055987.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控两个或更多已横置的生物，则你可以弃掉你的手牌。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

1055989.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals damage equal to the number of artifacts you control to target creature an opponent controls.
1055989.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

1055990.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, it deals damage equal to the number of artifacts you control to target creature an opponent controls.
1055990.translation: 当此太空船进场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

1055992.oracleText:
"Soon we'll have enough firepower to rid Evendo of its bug infestation."
—General Tekvu, Kavaron Memorial Navy
1055992.translation:
「很快我们就会有足够的武器来除尽埃文多上的虫害。」
～卡傅隆纪念军特库将军

1055993.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, it deals 2 damage to any target.
1055993.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

1055994.oracleText: When this token leaves the battlefield, it deals 2 damage to any target.
1055994.translation: 当此衍生物离开战场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

1055995.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken artifact you control enters, create a colorless artifact token named Munitions with "When this token leaves the battlefield, it deals 2 damage to any target."
1055995.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的神器进场时，派出一个名称为军械的无色衍生神器，且具有「当此衍生物离开战场时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。」

1055997.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
1055997.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

1055998.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
1055998.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器进场时，此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

1055999.oracleText: Infinite Guideline's "Fauna from Sothera" exhibit proved popular. Unfortunately, the biological zookeepers kept getting eaten.
1055999.translation: 永继导引基地上的索瑟拉生灵展览观客络绎不绝，可惜活人饲养员的折损率实在太高。

1056001.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a Lander token.
1056001.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个探地器衍生物。

1056002.oracleText: Each creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each land that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
1056002.translation: 每个由你操控的生物进场时上面均额外有数个+1/+1指示物，其数量为本回合中在你操控下进过战场的地数量。

1056004.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains reach, trample, and indestructible until end of turn. Untap it.
1056004.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得延势、践踏与不灭异能直到回合结束。将它重置。

1056007.translation: 死亡的气息从未如此甜美。

1056009.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, put its counters on target creature you control.
1056009.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

1056010.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, put its counters on target creature you control.
1056010.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

1056013.oracleText: Many mistake terrasymbiotic philosophy as pacifism. They are rarely wrong twice.
1056013.translation: 许多人误以为地貌共生思想与和平主义是一回事。他们很少有机会能错两次。

1056014.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, choose a creature you control or a warped creature card you own in exile.
1056014.translation: 选择一个由你操控的生物或放逐区中一张由你拥有的已跃迁生物牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

1056015.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the power of the chosen creature or card to target creature.
1056015.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于所选生物或牌之力量。

1056016.oracleText: Close Encounter deals damage equal to the power of the chosen creature or card to target creature.
1056016.translation: 近距接触对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于所选生物或牌之力量。

1056018.oracleText:
"We will not yield until the Eumidians relinquish our Kavaron Tomorrow."
—Official Kav diplomatic statement
1056018.translation:
「蝣美迪人一日不退出明日卡傅隆，我们的抗争便一日不会终止。」
～卡傅正式外交文告

1056019.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains vigilance until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
1056019.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得警戒异能。它对目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

1056023.oracleText: Charting the Edge, one scan at a time.
1056023.translation: 绘制边域星图，从每次扫描开始。

1056024.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, each player creates a Lander token.
1056024.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，每位牌手各派出一个探地器衍生物。

1056025.oracleText: When this creature dies, each player creates a Lander token.
1056025.translation: 当此生物死去时，每位牌手各派出一个探地器衍生物。

1056027.oracleText:
To plant the seeds of the other is to cultivate the self.
—Eumidian aphorism
1056027.translation:
种植他人之种亦是培育自身。
～蝣美迪警语

1056028.oracleText: A harmonious production for a better world.
1056028.translation: 和谐生产，同创更好世界。

1056029.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1056029.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，派出一个2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1056032.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is CARDNAME's power. Put any number of land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1056032.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为CARDNAME的力量。将其中任意数量的地牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1056033.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is this creature's power. Put any number of land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1056033.translation: 当此生物进场时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为此生物的力量。将其中任意数量的地牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1056035.oracleText: Not all species on Evendo welcomed the thawing of the ice.
1056035.translation: 埃文多星上并非所有物种都希望冰川融解。

1056038.oracleText: When falling shards of Kavaron shattered the icy shell of Evendo, the Eumidian seed pods were far from the only form of life awakened from slumber.
1056038.translation: 当卡傅隆的崩落残垣击碎埃文多星球表面的冰壳时，除蝣美迪殖种舱外，还有其他许多生命形态也从沉眠中醒转过来。

1056039.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the number of differently named lands you control.
1056039.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为由你操控的地中名称不同者的种数。

1056040.oracleText: Most say the Edge cannot be measured, but some will spend their lives trying anyway.
1056040.translation: 都说边域无法走遍，但总有人会用一生来尝试。

1056043.oracleText: Eumidians have engineered a device or species to manage every stage of terrasymbiosis.
1056043.translation: 地貌共生的每个阶段，蝣美迪人都有设备或物种来精密管理。

1056044.oracleText: {oT}, Tap an untapped permanent you control: Add one mana of any color.
1056044.translation: {oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的永久物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

1056047.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance and haste until end of turn.
1056047.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒与敏捷异能。

1056049.oracleText: Beyond the borders of Pinnacle space, alien worlds of untold wonder await.
1056049.translation: 天顶盟空间的边界以外，还有辽阔的异种奇妙世界等你探索。

1056051.oracleText: By stimulating violent behavior in its host, the mite scavenges the remains of prey much too large for it to hunt on its own.
1056051.translation: 这些螨虫在遇到体型巨大、自己难以对付的猎物时，会透过激发宿主的暴力行为借助外力进行捕杀，让自己最终也能从残骸中分到一杯羹。

1056053.oracleText: As warmth crept across Evendo, many long-dormant species grew bolder.
1056053.translation: 随着暖流席卷埃文多星球表面，许多沉眠已久的物种也开始活跃起来。

1056056.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, mill a card.
1056056.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，磨一张牌。

1056058.oracleText: Narix felt their molt coming. Before taking a new form, they had to find what Evendo required of them.
1056058.translation: 纳力兹知道自己下次蜕变的时间很快就要到来。但在化作新的形态之前，他要先知晓埃文多需要他变成什么样子。

1056059.oracleText: {o3}: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
1056059.translation: {o3}：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

1056060.oracleText: {o3}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
1056060.translation: {o3}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

1056062.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice a land or Lander. If you do, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1056062.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个地或探地器。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1056063.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, you may sacrifice a land or Lander. If you do, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1056063.translation: 当此太空船进场时，你可以牺牲一个地或探地器。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1056065.oracleText:
"Oh, look at the size of those petals! That one's eaten well this season."
—Bez, Pinnacle nature surveyor
1056065.translation:
「喔，瞧瞧这些花瓣的大小！这东西本季度的营养一定很好。」
～天顶盟自然勘察员贝兹

1056066.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if your opponents control three or more creatures.
1056066.translation: 如果所有对手操控的生物数量为三个或更多，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

1056068.oracleText: If one or more counters would be put on a creature, Spacecraft, or Planet you control, twice that many of each of those kinds of counters are put on it instead.
1056068.translation: 如果将在某个由你操控的生物，太空船或行星上放置一个或数个指示物，则改为对每种此类指示物而言，在该永久物上放置两倍原数量的指示物。

1056072.oracleText: There are no failures in terrasymbiosis, only lessons learned.
1056072.translation: 地貌共生没有失败，只有教训。

1056074.oracleText: Meltstriders are the bleeding edge of Evendo's frontier thaw.
1056074.translation: 炽行者是开拓埃文多融解疆域的绝对先锋。

1056076.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, enchanted creature fights up to one target creature an opponent controls.
1056076.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，所结附的生物与至多一个目标由对手操控的生物互斗。

1056077.oracleText: When this Aura enters, enchanted creature fights up to one target creature an opponent controls.
1056077.translation: 当此灵气进场时，所结附的生物与至多一个目标由对手操控的生物互斗。

1056078.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +0/+2 and can't be blocked by more than one creature.
1056078.translation: 所结附的生物得+0/+2，且不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

1056080.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, double the power of target creature you control until end of turn.
1056080.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，将目标由你操控的生物之力量加倍直到回合结束。

1056083.oracleText:
"I've found a strange vine in the ice. Thawing for further analysis."
—Meltstrider log, final entry
1056083.translation:
「我在冰里发现一条奇怪的藤蔓。正在解冻以作进一步分析。」
～炽行者日志，最后一笔

1056084.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1056084.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1056085.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is this creature's power.
1056085.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为此生物的力量。

1056087.oracleText: "That which should not have happened is undone, and a new pattern takes its place."
1056087.translation: 「本不应发生之事已恢复往初，而新的趋势正悄然成型。」

1056088.oracleText: Return up to two target nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand, then return up to two target land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
1056088.translation: 将至多两张目标非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上，然后将至多两张目标地牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。

1056090.oracleText: Tannuk's gut warned of danger, but Sami forged ahead without heed.
1056090.translation: 塔努科直觉会有危险，但萨米早已径直动手。

1056093.translation: 知识不是找出来的，而是长出来的。

1056094.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, create a Lander token.
1056094.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，派出一个探地器衍生物。

1056096.oracleText: A new brood finds its home on the doorstep of another's.
1056096.translation: 新族群在别人的家门口找到了属于自己的家园。

1056097.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. If its mana value was 2 or less, create a Lander token.
1056097.translation: 消灭目标神器或结界。如果其法术力值等于或小于2，则派出一个探地器衍生物。

1056099.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying. Surveil 1.
1056099.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。刺探1。

1056101.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME blocks a creature with flying, CARDNAME gets +5/+0 until end of turn.
1056101.translation: 每当CARDNAME阻挡一个具飞行异能的生物时，CARDNAME得+5/+0直到回合结束。

1056102.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +5/+0 until end of turn.
1056102.translation: 每当此生物阻挡一个具飞行异能的生物时，此生物得+5/+0直到回合结束。

1056104.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
1056104.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

1056105.oracleText: Whenever this Spacecraft attacks, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
1056105.translation: 每当此太空船攻击时，你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。

1056107.oracleText: Drix never leave their worlds defenseless.
1056107.translation: 卓兹人绝不会让自己的世界毫无防护。

1056108.oracleText: Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power stations permanents using its toughness rather than its power.
1056108.translation: 每个由你操控且防御力比力量大的生物皆依照其防御力来蓄势永久物，而不是依照力量。

1056110.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, you may draw that many cards. Do this only once each turn.
1056110.translation: 每当你在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以抓等量的牌。每回合只能如此作一次。

1056112.oracleText: "We are as ice," their mentor once told them, "Destined to shed our rigid form and nourish the grounds with our melting."
1056112.translation: 「我们就像这些寒冰一样，」他的导师曾如此教导，「命中注定要舍却坚硬外壳，靠融化他物来滋养地表。」

1056114.oracleText: "I am worthy of the Faller's blessing. I can prove it."
1056114.translation: 「我够格接受斩命使的祝福。我可以证明。」

1056115.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.
1056115.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓两张牌。然后除非你弃一张神器牌，否则弃两张牌。

1056116.oracleText: During your turn, CARDNAME has deathtouch.
1056116.translation: 于你的回合中，CARDNAME具有死触异能。

1056117.oracleText: During your turn, Alpharael has deathtouch.
1056117.translation: 于你的回合中，阿法雷具有死触异能。

1056119.oracleText: "Life is a pattern, not a material."

1056121.translation: 「修饰一下这些等位基因，然后再试一次。」

1056122.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent.
1056122.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，CARDNAME向目标对手造成2点伤害。

1056123.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, this creature deals 2 damage to target opponent.
1056123.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，此生物向目标对手造成2点伤害。

1056124.oracleText:
>Alert: COSMOGOYF
>Recommended Action: RUN
—PSS Erix shipboard computer, final transmission
1056124.translation:
>警告：宇宙耶夫
>建议行动：快跑
～PSS艾力克斯舰载电脑，最终通讯

1056125.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of cards you own in exile and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
1056125.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于放逐区中由你拥有的牌数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

1056127.oracleText: "We can all be more than we are. Let me help."
1056127.translation: 「我们都能超越自身。让我来帮忙。」

1056128.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, target creature has base power and toughness 3/3 until end of turn. If you control six or more lands, that creature has base power and toughness 6/6 until end of turn instead.
1056128.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，目标生物的基础力量与防御力为3/3直到回合结束。若你操控六个或更多地，则改为该生物的基础力量与防御力为6/6直到回合结束。

1056129.oracleText: "By the eternal and everflowing light, I swear myself to this cause."
1056129.translation: 「永恒熠辉、不息明光在上，我宣誓投身于此。」

1056130.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
1056130.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1056131.oracleText: Whenever Haliya enters or attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
1056131.translation: 每当哈莉娅进场或攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1056132.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
1056132.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

1056134.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a tapped 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
1056134.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个多色永久物，便派出一个已横置的2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1056135.oracleText: When Infinite Guideline Station enters, create a tapped 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
1056135.translation: 当永继导引基地进场时，你每操控一个多色永久物，便派出一个已横置的2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1056137.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, draw a card for each multicolored permanent you control.
1056137.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你每操控一个多色永久物，便抓一张牌。

1056138.oracleText: Whenever Infinite Guideline Station attacks, draw a card for each multicolored permanent you control.
1056138.translation: 每当永继导引基地攻击时，你每操控一个多色永久物，便抓一张牌。

1056141.oracleText:
"What crime did you commit that makes me your best option?"
—Tezzeret
1056141.translation:
「你到底犯下了什么罪行，才沦落到选我来帮你？」
～泰兹瑞

1056142.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
1056142.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1056144.oracleText: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.
1056144.translation: 卡傅隆环境恶化致使许多人心神遭毒物侵蚀，奇相教派很乐意利用这点来达成自己目的。

1056145.oracleText: Choose odd or even. Destroy each creature with mana value of the chosen quality. Then gain control of all creatures until end of turn. Untap them. They gain haste until end of turn.
1056145.translation: 选择奇数或偶数。消灭所有法术力值为该种数值的生物。然后获得所有生物的操控权直到回合结束。将它们重置。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

1056146.oracleText: Choose odd or even. Destroy each creature with mana value of the chosen quality. Then gain control of all creatures until end of turn. Untap them. They gain haste until end of turn. (Zero is even.)
1056146.translation: 选择奇数或偶数。消灭所有法术力值为该种数值的生物。然后获得所有生物的操控权直到回合结束。将它们重置。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。（零是偶数。）

1056148.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, create a 1/1 colorless Drone artifact creature token with flying and "This token can block only creatures with flying."
1056148.translation: 每当你施放神器咒语时，派出一个1/1无色奴兽衍生神器生物，且具有飞行与「此衍生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

1056152.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Food: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent.
1056152.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个食品：CARDNAME向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

1056153.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Food: Ragost deals 3 damage to each opponent.
1056153.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个食品：拉戈斯向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

1056154.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, untap CARDNAME.
1056154.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则重置CARDNAME。

1056155.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, untap Ragost.
1056155.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则重置拉戈斯。

1056157.oracleText: Whenever Sami was down on their luck, they returned to an old comfort: the clinks and clanks of tinkering.
1056157.translation: 每当萨米时运不济时，他就会靠作回自己的老本行来排解心情：拿起锤子叮叮当当地敲东西。

1056158.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, create a tapped 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
1056158.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控两个或更多已横置的生物，则派出一个已横置的2/2无色机器人衍生神器生物。

1056161.oracleText: Spells you cast have affinity for artifacts.
1056161.translation: 你施放的咒语具有神器共鸣异能。

1056164.oracleText: {o3oBoG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature or Spacecraft card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
1056164.translation: {o3oBoG}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物或太空船牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

1056165.oracleText: {o3oBoG}, Sacrifice this creature: Return target creature or Spacecraft card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
1056165.translation: {o3oBoG}，牺牲此生物：将目标生物或太空船牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

1056167.oracleText:
"Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin
1056167.translation:
「欢呼吧！一旦死卡起动，终极牺牲开始，你就能看到通往新生虚空的道路。」
～奇相教杀手凯尔南

1056169.oracleText: The howling winds could hardly be heard over the maddening thoughts of the godcore.
1056169.translation: 神核思绪快速翻涌时，甚至无法听清狂风呼啸。

1056170.oracleText: Target player mills cards equal to your life total.
1056170.translation: 目标牌手磨等同于你总生命数量的牌。

1056172.oracleText: "Keeping tabs on a whole station is too much for just one."
1056172.translation: 「只让一个人手来监控整个基地，果然还是顾不过来。」

1056173.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, create a 1/1 colorless Drone artifact creature token with flying and "This token can block only creatures with flying."
1056173.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，派出一个1/1无色奴兽衍生神器生物，且具有飞行与「此衍生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

1056174.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies or is put into exile, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and you gain 1 life.
1056174.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去或进入放逐区时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你获得1点生命。

1056175.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies or is put into exile, put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam and you gain 1 life.
1056175.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去或进入放逐区时，在冯棠爵士上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你获得1点生命。

1056176.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies or is put into exile while its power is 4 or greater, destroy up to one target nonland permanent.
1056176.translation: 当CARDNAME于其力量等于或大于4时死去或进入放逐区时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。

1056177.oracleText: When Syr Vondam dies or is put into exile while its power is 4 or greater, destroy up to one target nonland permanent.
1056177.translation: 当冯棠爵士于其力量等于或大于4时死去或进入放逐区时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。

1056179.oracleText: A new dawn, burning away the darkness.

1056180.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain deathtouch until end of turn.
1056180.translation: 当CARDNAME于其力量等于或大于4时死去或进入放逐区时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。

1056181.oracleText: Whenever Syr Vondam enters or attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain deathtouch until end of turn.
1056181.translation: 每当冯棠爵士进场或攻击时，直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0且获得死触异能。

1056183.oracleText: Serving in the Memorial Navy was nothing like the posters made it out to be.
1056183.translation: 纪念军的军旅生涯与海报宣传截然不同。

1056184.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, draw a card.
1056184.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。若这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则抓一张牌。

1056185.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, Tannuk deals 1 damage to each opponent. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, draw a card.
1056185.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，塔努科向每位对手各造成1点伤害。若这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则抓一张牌。

1056187.oracleText: For navigating that which was, is, and will be.
1056187.translation: 用于引导过去，现在和将来。

1056188.oracleText: {o7}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw X cards, where X is the number of differently named lands you control.

1056189.translation: {o7}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：抓X张牌，X为由你操控的地中名称不同者的种数。

1056192.oracleText: The Edge is littered with the vestiges of civilizations annihilated by the Eldrazi.
1056192.translation: 许多惨遭奥札奇毁灭的文明仍有残迹留存至今，散落在边域当中。

1056195.oracleText: Liberation Station's morale greatly improved after Rover took up residence.
1056195.translation: 路福留下之后，解放基地的气氛便大有改观，变得活跃起来。

1056196.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life.
1056196.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，你获得1点生命。

1056198.oracleText: The wastelands of yesterday's colonies will pave the road to tomorrow's.
1056198.translation: 昨日殖民地的弃物荒野，能够铺就通往明日新家园的道路。

1056199.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token.
1056199.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐每位对手的坟墓场。派出一个探地器衍生物。

1056200.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐每位对手的坟墓场。派出一个探地器衍生物。

1056206.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「{o15}，放逐统御臂环：目标对手在其下个回合由你来操控。此异能减少{oX}来起动，X为此生物的力量。只能于法术时机起动。」

1056208.oracleText: The future is set. The present remains uncertain.
1056208.translation: 未来已定。当下仍不明朗。

1056209.oracleText: Whenever you play a land or cast a spell, draw a card.
1056209.translation: 每当你使用地或施放咒语时，抓一张牌。

1056210.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, your life total becomes half your starting life total, rounded up.
1056210.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你的总生命成为你起始总生命的一半，小数点后进位。

1056215.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target noncreature permanent. Then CARDNAME deals 4 damage to each creature.
1056215.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标非生物永久物。然后此太空船对每个生物各造成4点伤害。

1056216.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, destroy target noncreature permanent. Then this Spacecraft deals 4 damage to each creature.
1056216.translation: 当此太空船进场时，消灭目标非生物永久物。然后此太空船对每个生物各造成4点伤害。

1056219.oracleText:
"What flavor do you want, Sami? Bland, dense, or vanilla?"
—Tannuk
1056219.translation:
「萨米，你想吃哪种口味的？稀的，稠的，还是普通的？」
～塔努科

1056221.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals 10 damage to up to one target creature.
1056221.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对至多一个目标生物造成10点伤害。

1056222.oracleText: When this Spacecraft enters, it deals 10 damage to up to one target creature.
1056222.translation: 当此太空船进场时，它对至多一个目标生物造成10点伤害。

1056224.oracleText: {o10}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 3 damage to any target. Target player draws three cards and gains 3 life. This ability costs {oX} less to activate, where X is the number of differently named lands you control.
1056224.translation: {o10}，牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。目标牌手抓三张牌且获得3点生命。此异能减少{oX}来起动，X为由你操控的地中名称不同者的种数。

1056226.oracleText: A miniature star, replicating the mana-aether reactions in a sun's core.
1056226.translation: 重现恒星核内法术力转乙太连锁反应的微型星体。

1056227.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target nonland permanent. This ability costs {o3} less to activate if you attacked with a Spacecraft this turn.
1056227.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标非地永久物。如果你本回合中以太空船攻击过，则此异能减少{o3}来起动。

1056229.oracleText:
"I'll never escape this rock, but I fear they will."
—Decrypted log 4.11
1056229.translation:
「我绝不会离开这块岩石，但它们可能会。」
～解密日志4.11

1056231.oracleText: Slivers you control have double strike and haste.
1056231.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖具有连击与敏捷异能。

1056232.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create two 1/1 colorless Sliver creature tokens.
1056232.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出两个1/1无色裂片妖衍生生物。

1056233.oracleText: Nano-infectant: A category-Phi substance, capable of infecting both organics and artificials. Weaponizing it is a war crime.
1056233.translation: 纳米级污染物：Φ类物质，有机生命体与无机机械均会受到污染。将之武器化属于战争罪行。

1056239.oracleText:
"Log 1.4.778: Granove, a tropical moon teeming with endemic biota. A must see for any aspiring astrobiologist!"
—Maisie's Edge Chronicles
1056239.translation:
「日志第1.4.778条：格兰诺，充满特色鲜明当地生物系统的热带卫星。想当天体生物学家的你千万不能错过！」
～《麦斯边域编星录》

1056241.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, sacrifice it unless you tap an untapped permanent you control.
1056241.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，除非你横置一个由你操控且未横置的永久物，否则将它牺牲。

1056242.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you tap an untapped permanent you control.
1056242.translation: 当此地进场时，除非你横置一个由你操控且未横置的永久物，否则将它牺牲。

1056245.oracleText:
"Log 1.7.618: Starshadow, a relic of a culture lost to calamity. Its people were eradicated in a single day—but by what?"
—Maisie's Edge Chronicles
1056245.translation:
「日志第1.7.618条：残星影，因灾变而灭绝之文明的残留遗迹。其间住民一天之内就被杀戮殆尽～有什么能做到这一点？」
～《麦斯边域编星录》

1056248.oracleText:
"Log 2.2.119: Kiln, known for its blazing forges and ancient lava seeps. The footing may be treacherous, but the metallurgy is grand!"
—Maisie's Edge Chronicles
1056248.translation:
「日志第2.2.119条：奇逸领，永不停歇的喷火煅炉与随处可见的远古熔岩是此处特色。这里虽然环境凶险，但冶金技术造诣极高！」
～《麦斯边域编星录》

1056250.oracleText: The heat of a sun condensed into a forge.
1056250.translation: 虽只有煅炉大小，却将整颗恒星的高热凝聚其间。

1056251.translation: {o2}，{oT}，横置X个由你操控且未横置的神器：目标生物得+X/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

1056258.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此衍生物：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1056262.translation: 指定至多一个非杀手的生物为目标。

1056272.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

1056273.translation: 是否要将一张神器或者生物牌放进战场？

1056274.translation: 指定至多两张非地永久物牌为目标。

1056275.translation: 是否从两个由你操控的生物上各移去一个+1/+1指示物？

1056277.translation: 是否要横置一个由你操控且未横置的永久物？

1056278.translation: 派出一个1/1无色奥札奇／孽裔衍生生物。它具有「牺牲此衍生物：加{oC}。」

1056281.translation: 星界投射～{o1oW}：佩带此武具的生物跃离。

1056289.translation: 是否要展示一张太空船牌？

1056979.oracleText: If a land entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
1056979.translation: 如果进场的地触发由你操控之永久物的触发式异能，则该异能额外触发一次。

It's an Aura enchantment with enchant Forest you control and "Enchanted Forest has ‘{oT}: Add {oGoG}' and ‘{o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a tapped 4/4 green Troll Warrior creature token with trample.'"
1057672.translation: 当原生林巨魔死去时，若它是生物，则将它移回战场。它是灵气结界，且具有「结附于由你操控的树林」和「所结附的树林具有『{oT}：加{oGoG}』与『{o1}，{oT}：牺牲此地：派出一个已横置的4/4绿色，具践踏异能之巨魔／战士衍生生物。』」

1058458.oracleText: Each other creature you control of the chosen type enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
1058458.translation: 每个由你操控且具该类别的其他生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

1058483.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, each player returns to the battlefield all cards they own exiled with it.
1058483.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，每位牌手将所有由其拥有且以此结界放逐的牌移回战场。

1058484.oracleText: When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, each player returns to the battlefield all cards they own exiled with it.
1058484.translation: 当此结界离开战场时，每位牌手将所有由其拥有且以此结界放逐的牌移回战场。

1058691.oracleText: Whenever you scry, put a verse counter on this enchantment.
1058691.translation: 每当你占卜时，在此结界上放置一个词句指示物。

1059344.oracleText: Arlinn deals 3 damage to any target. Transform Arlinn.
1059344.translation: 雅琳对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。转化雅琳。

1060157.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Exile target nonlegendary creature you control. Shards you control become copies of it until the next end step. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
1060157.translation: {o2}，{oT}：放逐目标由你操控的非传奇生物。直到下一个结束步骤，由你操控的碎片均成为它的复制品。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

1060361.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
1060361.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

1060659.oracleText: Morbid — When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn. If a creature died this turn, that creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead.
1060659.translation: 丧心～当CARDNAME进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。若本回合中有生物死去，则改为该生物得-13/-13直到回合结束。

1060660.oracleText: Morbid — When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn. If a creature died this turn, that creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead.
1060660.translation: 丧心～当此生物进场时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。若本回合中有生物死去，则改为该生物得-13/-13直到回合结束。

1061402.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for an artifact card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield if its mana value is 2 or less. Otherwise, put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
1061402.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张神器牌并展示之。如果其法术力值等于或小于2，则将它放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。然后洗牌。

1061403.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, you may search your library for an artifact card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield if its mana value is 2 or less. Otherwise, put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
1061403.translation: 当此载具进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张神器牌并展示之。如果其法术力值等于或小于2，则将它放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

1061429.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
1061429.translation: 牺牲此生物：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

1061430.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+1 and has "Sacrifice this creature: This creature deals 1 damage to any target."
1061430.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+1且具有「牺牲此生物：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

1061431.oracleText: Seek a card with start your engines !.
1061431.translation: 取出一张具发动引擎！异能的牌。

1061544.translation: 为每位牌手各指定至多一个生物为目标。

1061545.translation: 选择一个生物或鹏洛客来牺牲。

1061546.oracleText: Galian Beast — {o0} — Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control" and has base power and toughness 3/2.
1061546.translation: 加利亚野兽～{o0}～直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场」且基础力量与防御力为3/2。

1061547.oracleText: Death Gigas — {o1} — Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control" and has base power and toughness 5/2.
1061547.translation: 死亡巨人～{o1}～直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场」且基础力量与防御力为5/2。

1061548.oracleText: Hellmasker — {o3} — Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control" and has base power and toughness 7/2.
1061548.translation: 地狱面具人～{o3}～直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场」且基础力量与防御力为7/2。

1061549.oracleText: "Sleep well, and may the shadows keep you."
1061549.translation: 「阿金托塔…祝你有个美好的夜晚。」

1061550.oracleText: "No matter how bitter the truth that awaits me, I will press on."
1061550.translation: 「即使等待着我的是残酷的『现实』，我仍会继续挣扎。」

1061551.oracleText: "Life . . . Dreams . . . Hope . . . Where do they come from? And where do they go? Such meaningless things . . . I'll destroy them all!"
1061551.translation: 「生命…梦想…希望…从哪里来？到哪里去？让我来…将它们一并破坏掉！」

1061553.oracleText:
"Kefka's practically a god now, sitting up in that tower of his with the power of the Warring Triad at his command . . ."
—Albrook citizen
1061553.translation:
「拥有三斗神之力的凯夫卡大人就在那座塔上…他是这个世界的神…」
～阿尔布鲁克镇民

1061554.oracleText:
"Thanks to the miracle of mako energy, our lives are richer and better than ever before. Mako keeps our lights on at night, and made Midgar into the city that never sleeps."
—Shinra guide
1061554.translation:
「魔晄能源的普及让我们的生活更加丰富。灯光不再熄灭，米德加就此成为不夜城。」
～导览

1061555.oracleText:
"The city lights go out one by one. The stars fade . . . then the horizon glows, almost like it's on fire. It's really . . . pretty. I know you'd like it."
—Tidus
1061555.translation:
「看着城里的灯一盏接一盏熄灭，星星也慢慢消失…然后水平线发出光芒…那应该算是…玫瑰色吧。把海面、天空和整座城…都染成那样的色彩。」
～提达

1061556.oracleText: To dizzying heights it rises, the gleaming spire, its tip threatening to pierce the blinding canopy. There it will all begin anew. Between Dark and Light, the pure and the corrupt—the one true struggle.
1061556.translation: 那座塔犹如参天大树般高耸入云，仿佛将要撕裂被光芒笼罩的天空。光明转化成黑暗，正义转变为邪恶，颠覆历史的战斗即将在那里拉开帷幕。

1061562.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on a Dragon you control of that color.
1061562.translation: 在一个由你操控且为该色的龙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1061563.oracleText: When you cast your next spell this turn, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.
1061563.translation: 本回合中，当你施放你的下一个咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1061565.oracleText: Gain a random creature card with the greatest mana value among creature cards in your hand.
1061565.translation: 随机选择一张你手上生物牌中法术力值最大者来获得。

1061675.oracleText: Exile a creature you control and your graveyard.
1061675.translation: 放逐一个由你操控的生物和你的坟墓场。

1061693.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control is turned face up, it endures X, where X is that creature's toughness.
1061693.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物翻回正面时，它续战X，X为该生物的防御力。

1061694.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, seek a creature card and manifest it.
1061694.translation: 地落～每当一个由你操控的地进场时，取出一张生物牌并显化它。

1061696.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的衍生物得+1/+0。

1061700.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, conjure a card named Monastery Mentor onto the battlefield.
1061700.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，将一张名称为寺院明师的牌幻变进战场。

1061702.oracleText: "My dalkovan are those who ran before me, those who fight beside me, and those who bear my banner after me."
1061702.translation: 「我的拓求围包括那些曾为我开路之人，那些此刻与我并肩作战之人，以及那些未来将高举我旗帜之人。」

1061703.oracleText: Thunderbond Vanguard's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
1061703.translation: 霆绊先锋的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的生物数量。

1061704.oracleText: Each creature token you control enters as a copy of CARDNAME.
1061704.translation: 每个由你操控的衍生生物均当成CARDNAME的复制品来进场。

1061705.oracleText: Each creature token you control enters as a copy of this creature.
1061705.translation: 每个由你操控的衍生生物均当成此生物的复制品来进场。

1061707.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each Dragon card in your library.
1061707.translation: 你牌库中每有一张龙牌，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

1061710.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, secretly choose land or nonland. Seek two cards of the chosen kind.
1061710.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，私下选择地或非地。取出两张所选种类的牌。

1061711.oracleText: When this creature enters, secretly choose land or nonland. Seek two cards of the chosen kind.
1061711.translation: 当此生物进场时，私下选择地或非地。取出两张所选种类的牌。

1061713.translation: 私下选择地或非地。取出一张所选种类的牌。
