1069481.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Tajic. Then conjure a card with mana value equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it from Tajic, Legion's Valor's spellbook onto the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn and attacks this combat if able.
1069481.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在塔疾克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后从教团之勇塔疾克的法术书中将一张法术力值等同于其上+1/+1指示物数量的牌幻变进战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束，且本次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

1069482.oracleText: Whenever Skanos attacks, another target attacking creature gains lifelink and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Skanos's power.
1069482.translation: 每当尚诺斯攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得系命异能且得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为尚诺斯的力量。

1069490.oracleText: Whenever Skanos attacks, another target attacking creature gains menace and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Skanos's power.
1069490.translation: 每当尚诺斯攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得威慑异能且得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为尚诺斯的力量。

1069492.oracleText: When this creature enters, if evidence was collected, conjure a card named Spotlight Falcon into your hand.
1069492.translation: 当此生物进场时，若已搜证，则将一张名称为探灯猎鹰的牌幻变进你手上。

1069494.oracleText: Whenever Skanos attacks, another target attacking creature gains first strike and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Skanos's power.
1069494.translation: 每当尚诺斯攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得先攻异能且得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为尚诺斯的力量。

1069495.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
1069495.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

1069498.oracleText: Whenever Skanos attacks, untap another target attacking creature. It gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Skanos's power.
1069498.translation: 每当尚诺斯攻击时，重置另一个目标进行攻击的生物。它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为尚诺斯的力量。

1069500.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another permanent you control is turned face up, seek a non-Elephant creature card with mana value 3 or less and cloak it. This ability triggers only once.
1069500.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的永久物翻回正面时，取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的非象生物牌并匿伏之。此异能只会触发一次。

1069503.oracleText: As this artifact enters, secretly choose a number between 1 and 20.
1069503.translation: 于此神器进场时，私下选择一个1到20之间的数字。

1069504.oracleText: {o1oGoW}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Target creature you control perpetually gains lifelink. Activate only as a sorcery.
1069504.translation: {o1oGoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：目标由你操控的生物永久获得系命异能。只能于法术时机起动。

1069505.oracleText: When an opponent casts a spell with mana value equal to the chosen number, sacrifice this artifact. If you do, copy that spell, and you may choose new targets for the copy.
1069505.translation: 当任一对手施放法术力值等同于所选数字的咒语时，牺牲此神器。若你如此作，则复制该咒语且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1069508.oracleText: {o1oGoU}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Target creature you control perpetually gains "This creature can't be blocked." Activate only as a sorcery.
1069508.translation: {o1oGoU}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：目标由你操控的生物永久获得「此生物不能被阻挡。」只能于法术时机起动。

1069511.oracleText: {o1oBoG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Target creature you control perpetually gains menace. Activate only as a sorcery.
1069511.translation: {o1oBoG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：目标由你操控的生物永久获得威慑异能。只能于法术时机起动。

1069514.oracleText: {o1oRoG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Target creature you control perpetually gains double strike. Activate only as a sorcery.
1069514.translation: {o1oRoG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：目标由你操控的生物永久获得连击异能。只能于法术时机起动。

1069515.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, if that creature is still on the battlefield, suspect that creature. It perpetually gains this ability.
1069515.translation: 每当此生物对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，若该生物仍在战场上，则怀疑该生物。它永久获得此异能。

1069516.oracleText: Whenever a suspected creature an opponent controls dies while this card is in your graveyard, that opponent loses 1 life.
1069516.translation: 每当一个由对手操控且已遭疑的生物于此牌在你坟墓场中时死去，该对手失去1点生命。

1069517.oracleText: {o1oGoG}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Target creature you control perpetually gets +1/+1 and gains reach, trample, and ward {o2}. Activate only as a sorcery.
1069517.translation: {o1oGoG}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：目标由你操控的生物永久得+1/+1且获得延势、践踏与守护{o2}。只能于法术时机起动。

1069520.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each creature your opponents control, conjure a card named Stab Wound onto the battlefield attached to that creature.
1069520.translation: 当此生物进场时，为每个由对手操控的生物各进行以下流程～将一张名称为刺创伤的牌幻变进战场，并贴附在该生物上。

1069524.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand. You choose one of those cards and exile it.
1069524.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手上的所有非地牌。你选择其中一张并将它放逐。

1069526.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner seeks a nonland card with lesser mana value than the exiled card.
1069526.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者取出一张法术力值小于该牌的非地牌。

1069530.oracleText: When this creature enters or is turned face up, it deals X damage to target opponent, where X is the number of noncreature spells you've cast since the beginning of your last turn.
1069530.translation: 当此生物进场或翻回正面时，它向目标对手造成X点伤害，X为你在你上一个回合开始后施放过的非生物咒语数量。

1069534.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, this creature gains flying until end of turn if a creature you control or a card in your hand has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
1069534.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，如果某个由你操控的生物或你手上的某张牌具有飞行异能，则此生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

1069542.oracleText: This creature gets +2/+2 for each time this creature attacked this game.
1069542.translation: 此生物本盘游戏中每攻击过一次，便得+2/+2。

1069551.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, a random nonland card in that player's hand perpetually gains "When you cast this spell, you lose 2 life."
1069551.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手手上的一张随机非地牌永久获得「当你施放此咒语时，你失去2点生命。」

1069562.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oCoC}. Put two charge counters on this artifact.
1069562.translation: {oT}：加{oCoC}。在此神器上放置两个充电指示物。

1069564.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Seek a card with the highest mana value among cards in your library with mana value X or less, where X is the number of charge counters on this artifact.
1069564.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：取出一张牌，且其法术力值须为你牌库中法术力值等于或小于X之牌中最高者，X为此神器上的充电指示物数量。

1069590.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a token, CARDNAME perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if this card is in exile.
1069590.translation: 每当你牺牲一个衍生物时，CARDNAME永久得+1/+1。此异能于此牌在放逐区中时亦可以触发。

1069591.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a token, Albiorix perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if this card is in exile.
1069591.translation: 每当你牺牲一个衍生物时，阿比俄里克斯永久得+1/+1。此异能于此牌在放逐区中时亦可以触发。

1069599.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may pay 1 life. When you do, each player discards a card and sacrifices a creature of their choice.
1069599.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以支付1点生命。当你如此作时，每位牌手各弃一张牌且牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

1069600.oracleText: When Rankle enters, you may pay 1 life. When you do, each player discards a card and sacrifices a creature of their choice.
1069600.translation: 当兰卡进场时，你可以支付1点生命。当你如此作时，每位牌手各弃一张牌且牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

1069620.oracleText: {o2oG}: This creature has base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn.
1069620.translation: {o2oG}：此生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。

1069623.oracleText: At the beginning of your second main phase, if you gained 4 or more life this turn, conjure a card named Mox Pearl into your hand. This ability triggers only once.
1069623.translation: 在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若你本回合中获得过4点或更多生命，则将一张名称为珍珠玛珂的牌幻变进你手上。此异能只会触发一次。

1069631.oracleText: At the beginning of your second main phase, if four or more cards are in your graveyard, conjure a card named Mox Jet into your hand. This ability triggers only once.
1069631.translation: 在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若你的坟墓场中有四张或更多牌，则将一张名称为黑玉玛珂的牌幻变进你手上。此异能只会触发一次。

1069639.oracleText: When this creature enters, the next noncreature spell target opponent casts costs {o2} more to cast.
1069639.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手施放的下一个非生物咒语增加{o2}来施放。

1069647.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to any target. If this creature is saddled and a creature was dealt damage this way, that creature perpetually gains "This creature can't block" and "Damage isn't removed from this creature during cleanup steps."
1069647.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。如果此生物已乘驾且以此法对某生物造成伤害，则该生物永久获得「此生物不能进行阻挡」与「此生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。。」

1069652.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, heist target opponent's library.
1069652.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，偷窃目标对手的牌库。

1069654.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell you don't own, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
1069654.translation: 每当你施放不由你拥有的咒语时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1069657.oracleText: When this creature enters, discard a card, then heist target opponent's library.
1069657.translation: 当此生物进场时，弃一张牌，然后偷窃目标对手的牌库。

1069661.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, heist target opponent's library twice.
1069661.translation: 当此结界进场时，偷窃目标对手的牌库两次。

1069672.oracleText: Each player discards a card and sacrifices a creature of their choice.
1069672.translation: 每位牌手各弃一张牌且牺牲一个依其选择的生物。

1069675.oracleText: When this creature enters, conjure three cards named Sunscorched Desert into the top ten cards of each player's library at random.
1069675.translation: 当此生物进场时，将三张名称为日灼荒漠的牌随机幻变进每位牌手牌库顶的十张牌中。

1069680.oracleText: When this creature enters, choose a white creature card in your hand. That card perpetually gains offspring {o1}.
1069680.translation: 当此生物进场时，选择你手上的一张白色生物牌。该牌永久获得繁生{o1}。

1069687.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Rat you control enters, conjure a card named Think Twice into your graveyard.
1069687.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的老鼠进场时，将一张名称为再次考虑的牌幻变进你的坟墓场。

1069700.oracleText: When this creature enters, cards you own named Chittering Skullspeaker intensify by 1. Then you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is this creature's intensity.
1069700.translation: 当此生物进场时，由你拥有且名称为吱响骨语术士的牌强化1。然后你抓X张牌且失去X点生命，X为此生物的强度。

1069709.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile target nonland permanent with mana value 3 or less an opponent controls.
1069709.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物。

1069711.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner seeks a card that shares a card type with the exiled card.
1069711.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者取出一张与该牌具共通牌张类别的牌。

1069714.oracleText: When this creature enters, conjure a card named Might of the Meek into your hand.
1069714.translation: 当此生物进场时，将一张名称为驯良者之威的牌幻变进你手上。

1069730.oracleText: When this creature enters, creature cards in your hand perpetually gain "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
1069730.translation: 当此生物进场时，你手中的生物牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

1069743.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME's intensity is 3 or more, it has base power and toughness 4/4, has flying and vigilance, and is named Radiant Swan.
1069743.translation: 只要CARDNAME的强度等于或大于3，它的基础力量与防御力便为4/4，具有飞行与警戒异能，且名称为辉煌的天鹅。

1069744.oracleText: As long as this creature's intensity is 3 or more, it has base power and toughness 4/4, has flying and vigilance, and is named Radiant Swan.
1069744.translation: 只要此生物的强度等于或大于3，它的基础力量与防御力便为4/4，具有飞行与警戒异能，且名称为辉煌的天鹅。

1069750.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Lizard you control enters, this creature perpetually gains battle cry.
1069750.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的蜥蜴进场时，此生物永久获得战嚎异能。

1069752.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Lizard you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
1069752.translation: 每当此生物或另一个由你操控的蜥蜴死去时，目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

1069764.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, conjure a card named Sanguine Bond into the top fifteen cards of your library at random. It perpetually gains "You may pay {o0} rather than pay this spell's mana cost" and "When this permanent enters, draw a card."
1069764.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将一张名称为血色羁绊的牌随机幻变进你牌库顶的十五张牌中。它永久获得「你可以支付{o0}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用」与「当此永久物进场时，抓一张牌。」

1069768.oracleText: When Indris enters, conjure a card named Lightning Bolt into your library. It perpetually gains storm. Then shuffle.
1069768.translation: 当印德里斯进场时，将一张名称为闪电击的牌幻变进你的牌库。它永久获得风暴异能。然后洗牌。

1069774.oracleText: When Euru enters, you may forage. When you do, conjure a card named Chitterspitter onto the battlefield.
1069774.translation: 当欧鲁进场时，你可以觅粮。当你如此作时，将一张名称为叽响喷吐器的牌幻变进战场。

1069779.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 white Mouse creature token.
1069779.translation: 英武～每当此生物每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，派出一个1/1白色家鼠衍生生物。

1069782.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature and that creature perpetually get +1/+1.
1069782.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，此生物和该生物永久得+1/+1。

1069792.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, this creature and the topmost creature card in your library without flying perpetually gain flying.
1069792.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则此生物与你牌库中最顶上且不具飞行异能的生物牌各永久获得飞行异能。

1069797.oracleText: When you unlock this door, conjure a duplicate of CARDNAME into your hand. When you do, target creature you control gains first strike until end of turn.
1069797.translation: 当你解锁此偏门时，将CARDNAME的一张副本幻变进你手上。当你如此作时，目标由你操控的生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

1069798.oracleText: When you unlock this door, conjure a duplicate of this Room into your hand. When you do, target creature you control gains first strike until end of turn.
1069798.translation: 当你解锁此偏门时，将此隔间的一张副本幻变进你手上。当你如此作时，目标由你操控的生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

1069808.oracleText: Whenever this permanent enters or attacks, seek a nonland card.
1069808.translation: 每当此永久物进场或攻击时，取出一张非地牌。

1069815.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, you lose 1 life and draft a card from Glimmer Hoarder's spellbook. That card perpetually becomes an enchantment in addition to its other types.
1069815.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则你失去1点生命并从烁光匿集者的法术书中抽选一张牌。该牌永久成为结界，且仍具有原本类别。

1069820.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice. For each creature sacrificed this way, conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard.
1069820.translation: 每位对手各依其选择牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。对每个以此法牺牲的生物而言，将它的一张副本幻变进你的坟墓场。

1069837.oracleText: When this creature enters, add {oCoCoC}. Spend this mana only to cast creature spells.
1069837.translation: 当此生物进场时，加{oCoCoC}。此法术力只能用于施放生物咒语。

1069839.oracleText: When this creature dies, exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may cast creature spells from among the exiled cards.
1069839.translation: 当此生物死去时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以从所放逐之牌中施放生物咒语。

1069850.oracleText: Whenever this enchantment or another permanent you control named Verdant Dread enters, manifest dread.
1069850.translation: 每当此结界或另一个由你操控且名称为新绿颤栗的永久物进场时，显化惧象。

1069854.oracleText: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, return up to one target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield. This creature perpetually gets +1/+1.
1069854.translation: 生还～在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若此生物已横置，则将至多一张目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。此生物永久得+1/+1。

1069868.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another nonland permanent. When you do, each opponent exiles a nonland, nontoken permanent they control and a random nonland card from their library, then Gilded Ambusher deals damage to them equal to the total mana value of the cards exiled this way.
1069868.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个非地永久物。当你如此作时，每位对手各放逐一个由其操控之非地且非衍生物的永久物和其牌库中的一张随机非地牌，然后闪金伏击客对其造成伤害，其数量等同于以此法放逐之牌的法术力值总和。

1069875.oracleText: When this creature enters, switch the power and toughness of each creature on the battlefield. You get a twelve-time boon with "Whenever a creature you control enters, switch its power and toughness."
1069875.translation: 当此生物进场时，将战场上每个生物的力量与防御力互换。你获得具有以下异能的十二次恩泽～「每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，将它的力量与防御力互换。」

1069882.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, heist target opponent's library.
1069882.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，偷窃目标对手的牌库。

1069888.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, target creature you control perpetually gets +1/+0.
1069888.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，目标由你操控的生物永久得+1/+0。

1069894.oracleText: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand. You choose one of them. That card perpetually gains "When you cast this spell, each opponent draws a card and gains 3 life."
1069894.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标对手展示其手上的所有非地牌。你选择其中一张牌。该牌永久获得「当你施放此咒语时，每位对手各抓一张牌且获得3点生命。」

1069896.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures die, CARDNAME perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if this card is in your graveyard.
1069896.translation: 每当一个或数个其他生物死去时，CARDNAME永久得+1/+1。此异能于此牌在你坟墓场中时亦可以触发。

1069897.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures die, Soul Shredder perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if this card is in your graveyard.
1069897.translation: 每当一个或数个其他生物死去时，碎魂机车永久得+1/+1。此异能于此牌在你坟墓场中时亦可以触发。

1069898.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice two creatures: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
1069898.translation: {o1}，牺牲两个生物：将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

1069900.oracleText: Target creature you control gains first strike until end of turn.
1069900.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

1069901.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, that creature's controller gains control of this land.
1069901.translation: 每当一个生物对你造成战斗伤害时，该生物的操控者获得此地之操控权。

1069902.oracleText: {o1}: This land becomes a 1/1 Phyrexian Blinkmoth artifact creature with flying and infect until end of turn. It's still a land.
1069902.translation: {o1}：此地成为1/1，具飞行与侵染异能的非瑞人／光蛾神器生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。（它会以-1/-1指示物的方式对生物造成伤害，并以中毒指示物的方式对牌手造成伤害。）

1069903.oracleText: {o1oBoR}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 2/2 black and red Elemental creature with "{oX}: This creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn." It's still a land.
1069903.translation: {o1oBoR}：直到回合结束，此地成为2/2，黑红双色的元素生物，且具有「{oX}：此生物得+X/+0直到回合结束。」它仍然是地。

1069904.oracleText: {o2oC}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
1069904.translation: {o2oC}，{oT}，牺牲此地：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1069905.oracleText: {o4oC}, {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.
1069905.translation: {o4oC}，{oT}，牺牲此地：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。

1069906.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this land: Return target land card from your graveyard to your hand.
1069906.translation: {oT}，牺牲此地：将目标地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1069907.oracleText: {o2oRoG}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 3/3 red and green Elemental creature with "Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it." It's still a land.
1069907.translation: {o2oRoG}：直到回合结束，此地成为3/3，红绿双色的元素生物，且具有「每当此生物攻击时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」它仍然是地。

1069908.oracleText: {o1oGoW}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 3/4 green and white Elemental creature with reach. It's still a land.
1069908.translation: {o1oGoW}：直到回合结束，此地成为3/4绿白双色，具延势异能的元素生物。它仍然是地。

1069909.oracleText: When this Aura enters, conjure a card named Soldiers of the Watch onto the battlefield.
1069909.translation: 当此灵气进场时，将一张名称为监视者士兵的牌幻变进战场。

1069910.oracleText: Calim's Breath — {o1oU}, Discard this card: Tap up to one target nonland permanent. Draw a card. Then you may exile two other cards named Calim, Djinn Emperor from your graveyard. When you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
1069910.translation: 卡林之息～{o1oU}，弃掉此牌：横置至多一个目标非地永久物。抓一张牌。然后你可以从你的坟墓场放逐两张其他名称为巨灵皇帝卡林的牌。当你如此作时，将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

1069911.oracleText: When this creature enters, conjure a card named Lightning Bolt into your hand, then discard a card.
1069911.translation: 当此生物进场时，将一张名称为闪电击的牌幻变进你手上，然后弃一张牌。

1069912.oracleText: Molting Exoskeleton — When this creature dies, it perpetually gets -1/-1. Then if that card's toughness is 1 or greater, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
1069912.translation: 蜕变外骨骼～当此生物死去时，它永久得-1/-1。然后如果该牌的防御力等于或大于1，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

1069913.oracleText: When this creature dies, seek a creature card with mana value 3 or less. That card perpetually gains haste, "This spell costs {o1} less to cast," and "At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this creature."
1069913.translation: 当此生物死去时，取出一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。该牌永久获得敏捷，「此咒语减少{o1}来施放」，与「在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲此生物。」

1069914.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice a Food: Draft a card from Oyaminartok, Polar Werebear's spellbook. When you do, add {oUoUoU}. Spend this mana only to cast blue creature spells.
1069914.translation: {oU}，牺牲一个食品：从北极熊人欧娅米娜托克的法术书中抽选一张牌。当你如此作时，加{oUoUoU}。此法术力只能用来施放蓝色生物咒语。

1069915.oracleText: Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or Tasha, put a -1/-1 counter on that creature.
1069915.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，每当一个生物攻击你或塔莎时，在该生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物。

1069916.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card. Put a study counter on Vhal.
1069916.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。在瓦洱上放置一个读书指示物。

1069917.oracleText: Shadowheart can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
1069917.translation: 影心不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

1069918.oracleText: Whenever Ambergris attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards.
1069918.translation: 每当安珀葛斯特攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓两张牌。

1069919.oracleText: Whenever Ambergris attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards. When you do, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
1069919.translation: 每当安珀葛斯特攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓两张牌。当你如此作时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中所弃的牌数量。

1069920.oracleText: When Gut enters, up to one target creature you control fights target creature you don't control. If the creature you don't control would die this turn, exile it instead.
1069920.translation: 当古特进场时，至多一个目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。如果本回合中该不由你操控的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

1069921.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you may sacrifice another creature or an artifact. If you do, untap Wyll. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase.
1069921.translation: 当此生物精进时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或一个神器。若你如此作，则重置威迩。在此行动阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段，以及接于其后之一个额外的行动阶段。

1069922.oracleText: Lukamina must be blocked if able.
1069922.translation: 若能阻挡卢卡米娜，则必须阻挡之。

1069923.oracleText: Whenever Skanos attacks, another target attacking creature gains flying and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Skanos's power.
1069923.translation: 每当尚诺斯攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得飞行异能且得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为尚诺斯的力量。

1070031.oracleText: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
1070031.translation: 将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

1070045.oracleText: Add {oUoUoU}. Spend this mana only to cast blue creature spells.
1070045.translation: 加{oUoUoU}。此法术力只能用来施放蓝色生物咒语。

1070067.oracleText: CARDNAME deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
1070067.translation: CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成该数量的伤害。

1070068.oracleText: Remove a lore counter from each of any number of Sagas you control?
1070068.translation: 是否要从任意数量由你操控的传纪上各移去一个学问指示物？

1070069.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
1070069.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

1070070.oracleText: When Rasaad enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
1070070.translation: 当拉萨德进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到此生物离开战场为止。

1070071.oracleText: Put a card on the bottom of your opponent's library.
1070071.translation: 将一张牌置于你对手的牌库底。

1070072.oracleText: Target a Saga you control. Remove a lore counter from it.
1070072.translation: 指定一个由你操控的传纪为目标。从其上移去一个学问指示物。

1070073.oracleText: Target a Saga you control. Put a lore counter on it.
1070073.translation: 指定一个由你操控的传纪为目标。在其上放置一个学问指示物。

1070075.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one other target creature.} other {Put {2, Number} +1/+1 counters on up to one other target creature.}}
1070075.translation: {2, plural, =1 {在至多一个其他目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。} other {在至多一个其他目标生物上放置{2, Number}个+1/+1指示物。}}

1070237.oracleText: Target up to one creature card with mana value {2, Number} or less.
1070237.translation: 指定至多一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌为目标。

1070238.oracleText: Cast a permanent spell with mana value {2, Number} without paying its mana cost?
1070238.translation: 是否要施放一个法术力值为{2, Number}的永久物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

1070239.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, conjure a card named Chromatic Star onto the battlefield. This ability triggers only once.
1070239.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将一张名称为五彩星的牌幻变进战场。此异能只会触发一次。

1070240.oracleText: Beyond the edge of faith lies eternal hope.
1070240.translation: 在信仰的边际之外，是永恒的希望。

1070241.oracleText: Those lucky enough to survive leave with greater perspective of their own importance.
1070241.translation: 有幸生还者会因之更加了解自身的重要性。

1070242.oracleText: Beyond the the edge of devotion lies eternal ambition.
1070242.translation: 在信仰的边际之外，是永恒的野心。

1070243.oracleText: "Tear away the rotten flesh of ‘reality' and behold the pristine bones of Truth."
1070243.translation: 「撕下『现实』的腐烂肉身，便可得见真理的洁净骨骼。」

1070244.oracleText: In desperate times, Kavaron's greatest minds strive to elevate their civilization.
1070244.translation: 在绝望时刻，卡傅隆最高意志奋力提升其文明。

1070245.oracleText: Beyond the edge of doubt lies eternal loyalty.
1070245.translation: 在信仰的边际之外，是永恒的忠诚。

1070246.oracleText: "Some things are bigger than one's self."

1070247.oracleText: Beyond the edge of desperation lies eternal ingenuity.
1070247.translation: 在信仰的边际之外，是永恒的巧思。

1070248.oracleText: At the end of all things, will you find redemption or rebirth?
1070248.translation: 在一切的终点，你将寻到救赎还是重生？

1070249.oracleText: "Perfection lies beyond ego. Only through service can you become complete."
1070249.translation: 「完美超越自我。唯有奉献方能臻于完美。」

1070250.oracleText: Droplets from its breaching splash newborn stars across the void.
1070250.translation: 其破空而出的水花将新生星辰洒向空洞。

1070251.oracleText: Life, in all its explosive emotion, is never shorter than when used as a weapon.
1070251.translation: 生命，虽然充满爆发性的情感，但用作武器时却从未如此短暂。

1070252.oracleText: Flickering through the space between chaos and weft, it glimpses cosmic truths.
1070252.translation: 它在混沌与星丝的夹缝间闪烁，瞥见宇宙的真相。

1070254.oracleText: A welcoming farewell to new neighbors.

1070255.oracleText: Advancement is found in the collision of chaos and order.
1070255.translation: 进步存在于混沌与秩序的碰撞之中。

1070256.oracleText: To exist and to be subject to its hunger are one and the same.
1070256.translation: 存在，就得屈服于它的饥渴。

1070257.oracleText: There is no blade sharper than betrayal.
1070257.translation: 没有比背叛更锋利的刃。

1070258.oracleText: More worlds have been forgotten than any living being could know.
1070258.translation: 被遗忘的世界远比任何生灵所知的都多。

1070259.oracleText: Those who grasp for power may one day find it.
1070259.translation: 渴望权力之人终有一天会得到它。

1070261.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a land: Draw two cards. You may play an additional land this turn.
1070261.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个地：抓两张牌。本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

1070262.oracleText: STATIONLEVEL [2+] [] [{o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a land: Draw two cards. You may play an additional land this turn.]
1070262.translation: STATIONLEVEL [2+] [] [{o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a land: Draw two cards. You may play an additional land this turn.]

1070264.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a land, each opponent loses 2 life.
1070264.translation: 每当你牺牲一个地时，每位对手各失去2点生命。

1070266.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put your choice of a +1/+1 counter or two charge counters on up to one other target artifact.
1070266.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在至多一个目标神器上依你选择放置一个+1/+1指示物或两个充电指示物。

1070267.oracleText: STATIONLEVEL [1+] [] [At the beginning of combat on your turn, put your choice of a +1/+1 counter or two charge counters on up to one other target artifact.]
1070267.translation: STATIONLEVEL [1+] [] [At the beginning of combat on your turn, put your choice of a +1/+1 counter or two charge counters on up to one other target artifact.]

1070269.oracleText: Other artifacts you control have hexproof and indestructible.
1070269.translation: 由你操控的其他神器具有辟邪与不灭异能。

1070271.translation: 既是雕塑作者，也是作品。

1070273.translation: 每当奇洛成为横置时，增殖。

1070275.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another nontoken permanent during your turn, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to CARDNAME's power on up to one other target creature.
1070275.translation: 每当你于你回合中牺牲另一个非衍生物的永久物时，在至多一个目标生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于CARDNAME的力量。

1070276.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another nontoken permanent during your turn, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on up to one other target creature.
1070276.translation: 每当你于你回合中牺牲另一个非衍生物的永久物时，在至多一个目标生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于撒札雷的力量。

1070278.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card. If this spell was kicked, instead search your library for a basic land card and a Shrine card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
1070278.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌和一张祭祠牌。展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1070280.oracleText:
"Darkness thrives in the void, but always yields to purifying light."
—The Lion-Turtle
1070280.translation:
「黑暗在空无中滋长，但终究不敌纯洁的光亮。」
～狮龟兽

1070281.oracleText: Lands you control gain all basic land types until end of turn.
1070281.translation: 由你操控的地获得所有基本地类别直到回合结束。

1070283.oracleText: As punishment for his disobedience, Zuko was banished and sent to capture the Avatar. Only then could he return home with his honor.
1070283.translation: 苏科因以下犯上而遭驱逐，唯有捕获降世神通方能恢复原本身份。

1070284.oracleText: Exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment. Its controller creates a Clue token.
1070284.translation: 放逐目标神器，生物或结界。其操控者派出一个线索衍生物。

1070287.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, airbend up to one other target nonland permanent.
1070287.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，对至多另一个目标非地永久物截气。

1070288.oracleText: When Aang enters, airbend up to one other target nonland permanent.
1070288.translation: 当安昂进场时，对至多另一个目标非地永久物截气。

1070289.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Lesson spell, CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
1070289.translation: 每当你施放课程咒语时，CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

1070290.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Lesson spell, Aang gains lifelink until end of turn.
1070290.translation: 每当你施放课程咒语时，安昂获得系命异能直到回合结束。

1070292.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one other target nonland permanent until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
1070292.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多另一个目标非地永久物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

1070293.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile up to one other target nonland permanent until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
1070293.translation: 当此结界进场时，放逐至多另一个目标非地永久物，直到此结界离开战场为止。

1070294.oracleText: Waterbend {o3}: Sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, scry 2.
1070294.translation: 截水{o3}: 牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则占卜2。

1070295.oracleText: Waterbend {o3}: Sacrifice this enchantment. If you do, scry 2.
1070295.translation: 截水{o3}: 牺牲此结界。若你如此作，则占卜2。

1070297.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, airbend up to one target creature.
1070297.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，对至多一个目标生物截气。

1070298.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, airbend up to one target creature.
1070298.translation: 当此结界进场时，对至多一个目标生物截气。

1070299.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, put a quest counter on CARDNAME.
1070299.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个探索指示物。

1070300.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, put a quest counter on this enchantment.
1070300.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，在此结界上放置一个探索指示物。

1070301.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if CARDNAME has four or more quest counters on it, exile up to one target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
1070301.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若CARDNAME上有四个或更多探索指示物，则放逐至多一个目标由你操控的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

1070302.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if this enchantment has four or more quest counters on it, exile up to one target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
1070302.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若此结界上有四个或更多探索指示物，则放逐至多一个目标由你操控的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

1070304.oracleText: Aang employed the typical Airbender tactics against Zuko: avoid and evade.
1070304.translation: 面对来势汹汹的苏科，安昂用上了截气师最常用的技俩：以虚避实。

1070305.translation: 对目标由你操控的生物截气。

1070306.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target attacking creature. 
• Airbend target creature you control.
1070306.translation:
选择一项～
•消灭目标进行攻击的生物。
•对目标由你操控的生物截气。

1070308.translation:
「这下很有意思啊，年轻人。」
～僧侣嘉措

1070309.translation: 对目标非地永久物截气。

1070312.oracleText: Target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.
1070312.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1070313.oracleText: Target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.
1070313.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1070314.oracleText: Airbend another target nonland permanent you control.
1070314.translation: 对另一个目标由你操控的非地永久物截气。

1070315.oracleText: Airbend another target nonland permanent you control.
1070315.translation: 对另一个目标由你操控的非地永久物截气。

1070316.oracleText:
Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, choose one — 
• Target creature you control gains flying until end of turn. 
• Airbend another target nonland permanent you control.
1070316.translation:
每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，选择一项～
•目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。
•对另一个目标由你操控的非地永久物截气。

1070317.oracleText:
Whenever Appa enters or attacks, choose one — 
• Target creature you control gains flying until end of turn. 
• Airbend another target nonland permanent you control.
1070317.translation:
每当阿柏进场或攻击时，选择一项～
•目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。
•对另一个目标由你操控的非地永久物截气。

1070319.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, airbend any number of other target nonland permanents you control.
1070319.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，对任意数量其他目标由你操控的非地永久物截气。

1070320.oracleText: When Appa enters, airbend any number of other target nonland permanents you control.
1070320.translation: 当阿柏进场时，对任意数量其他目标由你操控的非地永久物截气。

1070321.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token.
1070321.translation: 每当你从放逐区施放咒语时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。

1070324.oracleText: "There he is! There he is! The Avatar's on Kyoshi!"
1070324.translation: 「看呐！快看！降世神通就在虚子岛上！」

1070325.oracleText: Whenever another Ally you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1070325.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的伙伴进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070326.oracleText: Whenever another Ally you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
1070326.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的伙伴进场时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070328.oracleText: Choose up to one target creature, then airbend all other creatures.
1070328.translation: 选择至多一个目标生物，然后对所有其他生物截气。

1070329.oracleText: Until your next turn, your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands.
1070329.translation: 直到你的下个回合，对手均不能从其手牌以外的其他区域施放咒语。

1070332.oracleText: Waterbending does not only heal physical wounds.It can soothe the spirit and calm the mind.
1070332.translation: 截水神功不仅能治愈外伤，还能抚慰思绪、澄净内心。

1070335.oracleText: Earth Kingdom cuisine offers a stunning array of unique meats, like chicken-pork, deer-pork, and beef-pork.
1070335.translation: 土强国料理当中有许多以奇特肉种做成的菜式，例如鸡羽猪肉、鹿角猪肉、牛身猪肉等等。

1070336.oracleText: When this creature dies, you gain 3 life.
1070336.translation: 当此生物死去时，你获得3点生命。

1070337.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment.
1070337.translation: {o2}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。

1070338.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment.
1070338.translation: {o2}，牺牲此生物：消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。

1070340.oracleText:
"Just you and me, brother. The showdown that was always meant to be."
—Azula
1070340.translation:
「只有我和你，皇兄。咱们单挑吧，这不就是你一直想要的吗？」
～阿祖拉

1070342.oracleText: "Go ahead and run. My ostrich-horse loves a good chase."
1070342.translation: 「尽管跑吧。我这匹鸵鸟马就喜欢追人。」

1070343.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one target artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
1070343.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多一个目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或大于3的神器，生物或结界，直到此生物离开战场为止。

1070344.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one target artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater until this creature leaves the battlefield.
1070344.translation: 当此生物进场时，放逐至多一个目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或大于3的神器，生物或结界，直到此生物离开战场为止。

1070346.oracleText: "Stand your ground! The Earth King must be protected!"
1070346.translation: 「坚守岗位！我们一定要守护好土强王！」

1070347.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Another target Ally you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
1070347.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：另一个目标由你操控的伙伴获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1070348.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Another target Ally you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
1070348.translation: 牺牲此生物：另一个目标由你操控的伙伴获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1070350.oracleText:
"The glow is the combination of all your past lives, focusing their energy through your body."
—Avatar Roku
1070350.translation:
「这道光芒汇聚了所有前世神通的能量，而后它们便会充盈全身。」
～降世神通罗库

1070351.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature you control becomes an Avatar in addition to its other types and gains flying, first strike, lifelink, and hexproof.
1070351.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物额外具有圣者此类别，且获得飞行、先攻、系命与辟邪异能。

1070353.oracleText:
"Dancing isn't something you think about. It's a form of self-expression that no one can ever take away from you."
—Aang
1070353.translation:
「跳舞并不像大家想的那样不堪。你可以通过跳舞来展现自我，没人能剥夺这项与生俱来的表现形式。」
～安昂

1070354.oracleText: Untap one or two target creatures. They each get +2/+2 until end of turn.
1070354.translation: 重置一个或两个目标生物。它们各得+2/+2直到回合结束。

1070356.oracleText: "I see you favor the white lotus gambit. Not many still cling to the ancient ways."
1070356.translation: 「看来你喜欢用白莲来开局，现在还走这种老棋路的人已经不多了。」

1070357.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Ally creature token for each Plains you control. Scry 2.
1070357.translation: 你每操控一个平原，便派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。占卜2。

1070360.oracleText: The Fire Nation never expected the Earth Kingdom to take to the skies.
1070360.translation: 烈火国从未想过土强国会善用空路。

1070362.oracleText: More tools than weapons, gliders were used by Air Nomads to harness wind currents for travel.
1070362.translation: 在气和族人手中，翔翼更多是他们用来借助气流来移动的代步工具，而非进攻武器。

1070363.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, airbend up to one target creature.
1070363.translation: 当此武具进场时，对至多一个目标生物截气。

1070365.oracleText: You may cast Ally spells from the top of your library.
1070365.translation: 你可以从你牌库顶施放伙伴咒语。

1070366.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control get +0/+5 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
1070366.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+0/+5且获得不灭异能。

1070367.oracleText: Sacrifice Hakoda: Creatures you control get +0/+5 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
1070367.translation: 牺牲哈库达：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+0/+5且获得不灭异能。

1070369.oracleText: Many of those who aided in the invasion of the Fire Nation were not soldiers by occupation, though they were warriors at heart.
1070369.translation: 许多协助烈火国进军的人虽然本身并非士兵，内在却有高强武艺。

1070370.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token.
1070370.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。

1070371.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token.
1070371.translation: 当此生物进场时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。

1070374.oracleText: To leave the Fire Nation required incredible trust. They had that in Jeong Jeong.
1070374.translation: 唯有深受爱戴的长官，才能在他决心叛离烈火国时，也引得手下死心塌地追随。琤琤正是如此。

1070376.oracleText: As long as a single Kyoshi Warrior is alive, their island remains protected.
1070376.translation: 只要虚子武士仍在，虚子岛便无安全之忧。

1070378.oracleText: Starting with you, each player chooses up to one permanent with mana value 3 or greater from among permanents your opponents control. Exile those permanents.
1070378.translation: 由你开始，每位牌手各从由你对手操控之永久物中选择至多一个法术力值等于或大于3的永久物。放逐这些永久物。

1070379.oracleText: You may have target opponent draw three cards. If you do, draw three cards.
1070379.translation: 你可以令目标对手抓三张牌。若你如此作，则你抓三张牌。

1070381.oracleText: "Selfless duty calls you to sacrifice your own spiritual needs and do whatever it takes to protect the world."
1070381.translation: 「大任在身，意味着你要牺牲自身追求、竭尽所能去保护世界。」

1070382.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, airbend up to one other target nonland permanent.
1070382.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，对至多另一个目标非地永久物截气。

1070384.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Ally, Equipment, or Lesson card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1070384.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张伙伴，武具或课程牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1070385.oracleText: Whenever Master Piandao attacks, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Ally, Equipment, or Lesson card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1070385.translation: 每当劈黯道大师攻击时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张伙伴，武具或课程牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1070388.oracleText: The first non-Lemur creature spell with flying you cast during each of your turns costs {o1} less to cast.
1070388.translation: 你于你的每个回合中施放之第一个具飞行异能的非狐猴生物咒语减少{o1}来施放。

1070389.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with flying enters, Momo gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
1070389.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物进场时，模模得+1/+1直到回合结束。

1070391.oracleText:
When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, choose one — 
• Create a Food token. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. 
• Scry 2.
1070391.translation:
当CARDNAME离开战场时，选择一项～
•派出一个食品衍生物。
•在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070392.oracleText:
When Momo leaves the battlefield, choose one —

当模模离开战场时，选择一项～
•派出一个食品衍生物。
•在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070394.oracleText: "You can't always see the light at the end of the tunnel, but if you just keep moving you will come to a better place."
1070394.translation: 「虽然你并非时刻都能看见隧道尽头的光亮，但只要你不断前进，总会去到更好的地方。」

1070395.oracleText: {o5}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile enchanted creature. Create a 1/1 white Ally creature token. Activate only during your turn.
1070395.translation: {o5}，牺牲CARDNAME：放逐所结附的生物。派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。只能于你的回合中起动。

1070396.translation: {o5}，牺牲此灵气：放逐所结附的生物。派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。只能于你的回合中起动。

1070398.oracleText: Rabaroos are famous enjoyers of hopping and infamous enjoyers of cabbage.
1070398.translation: 兔袋鼠整天蹦蹦跳跳很令人讨喜，但它们整天都想着吃卷心菜就很令人心烦了。

1070399.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn and you gain 1 life.

"There's someone in there! He's bending the vines!"
—Sokka
1070402.translation:
「那里有人！他在操控藤蔓！」
～索卡

1070403.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. You gain life equal to the excess damage dealt this way.
1070403.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。你获得等同于以此法所造成的过量伤害之生命。

1070404.oracleText: Razor Rings deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. You gain life equal to the excess damage dealt this way.
1070404.translation: 锐流环对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。你获得等同于以此法所造成的过量伤害之生命。

1070407.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.

1070407.translation:
选择一项～
•消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

1070409.oracleText: "The winds can be brutal, so be brave."
1070409.translation: 「风可能会很猛，务必勇敢面对。」

1070413.oracleText: The birthplace of the last Airbender.

1070414.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

1070415.oracleText: When Southern Air Temple enters, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
1070415.translation: 当南气和寺进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

1070416.oracleText: Whenever another Shrine you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1070416.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的祭祠进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070419.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的永久物于你回合中离开战场时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

1070421.oracleText: Despite Sokka's best efforts, neither Boomeraang Squad nor Fearsome Foursome caught on.﻿
1070421.translation: 虽然索卡尽力推动，但「飞去飞昂」和「惊人四侠」这两个名字都没叫开。﻿

1070422.oracleText: {o2oW}, Discard this card: It deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature.
1070422.translation: {o2oW}，弃掉此牌：它对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

1070424.oracleText:
"When this is finished, the Avatar will have defeated the Fire Lord, we will have control of the Fire Nation capital, and this war will be over!"
—Hakoda
1070424.translation:
「一切过后，降世神通会击败烈火君，我们会夺下烈火国首都，战争会彻底结束！」
～哈库达

1070425.oracleText: Create X 1/1 white Ally creature tokens, then put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1070425.translation: 派出X个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物，然后在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070428.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, choose target creature an opponent controls. Tap it, then you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do, put a stun counter on the chosen creature.
1070428.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，选择目标由对手操控的生物。将它横置，然后你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则在所选生物上放置一个晕眩指示物。

1070430.oracleText: "Follow me to the bay! Our scouts have spotted the Fire Navy's smoketrail approaching, and we shall meet them with force!"
1070430.translation: 「快跟我来海滩！哨兵已经看到烈火国海军浓烟滚滚，正向我们靠近，我们要热烈迎接他们才行！」

1070432.oracleText: Waterbend {o5}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with power 3 or less from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1070432.translation: 截水{o5}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张力量等于或小于3的生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1070434.oracleText:
"You better throw in an extra ‘yip'! We gotta move!"
—Sokka
1070434.translation:
「你最好再多叫一声『驾！』我们得走了！」
～索卡

1070436.oracleText:
"To prove your worth as scholars, you have to contribute some worthwhile knowledge."
—Wan Shi Tong
1070436.translation:
「你们得先证明自己并非不学无术之辈，所以也要贡献一些有学术价值的知识。」
～万知堂

1070437.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. Put each of those cards into your hand instead if there are three or more Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1070437.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你牌库底。如果你坟墓场中有三张或更多课程牌，则改为将这些牌都置于你手上。

1070439.translation: 截水{o5}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

1070443.translation: 截水{oX}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

1070444.translation: 横置至多X个目标生物，然后将三个晕眩指示物分配给由对手操控且已横置的生物。

1070446.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的生物之复制品，但它不是传奇，且是4/4英雄并仍具有原本类别。

1070447.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target creature an opponent controls, except it's not legendary and it's a 2/2 Coward in addition to its other types.

1070450.oracleText: Aang offered ancient Air Nomad wisdom to the newest generation of glider riders: Keep your mouth closed, so you don't swallow any bugs.
1070450.translation: 安昂亲身把一项气和族的古老智慧传授给了新一代的翔翼飞手：在空中的时候千万要闭紧嘴巴，这样就不会有那么多虫子飞进口中。

1070451.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 as long as there's a Lesson card in your graveyard.
1070451.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有课程牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

1070464.translation: 截水{o4}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1070467.translation: 截水{o3}：此生物本回合不能被阻挡。

1070469.oracleText: "It's been so long since I've had hope, but you brought it back to life."
1070469.translation: 「我已经有很久很久不知道希望是什么滋味了，是你让我再次体会这种感觉。」

1070470.oracleText: Whenever Gran-Gran becomes tapped, draw a card, then discard a card.
1070470.translation: 每当奶奶成为横置时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1070471.oracleText: Noncreature spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast as long as there are three or more Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1070471.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有三张或更多课程牌，你施放之非生物咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

1070473.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap enchanted creature and remove all counters from it.
1070473.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置所结附的生物并从其上移去所有指示物。

1070474.oracleText: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature and remove all counters from it.
1070474.translation: 当此灵气进场时，横置所结附的生物并从其上移去所有指示物。

1070475.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a Citizen with base power and toughness 1/1 and "{oT}: Add {oC}" named Humble Merchant.
1070475.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是名称为普通商人、基础力量与防御力为1/1的市民，并具有「{oT}：加{oC}。」

1070478.oracleText: A common companion for pirates, beloved for their loyalty and craftiness.
1070478.translation: 鬣鹦鹉忠诚、机灵，深受海盗青睐，常被当作他们的航海伴侣。

1070480.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, return up to one other target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
1070480.translation: 当此载具进场时，将至多另一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

1070481.oracleText: Exhaust — Waterbend {o3}: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature. Put three +1/+1 counters on it.
1070481.translation: 竭绝～截水{o3}：CARDNAME成为神器生物。在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

1070482.oracleText: Exhaust — Waterbend {o3}: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature. Put three +1/+1 counters on it.
1070482.translation: 竭绝～截水{o3}：此载具成为神器生物。在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

1070484.oracleText: "Drink cactus juice. Nothing's quenchier. It's the quenchiest!"
1070484.translation: 「来口仙人掌汁。没有更止渴的了。最能解渴就是它。」

1070487.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if CARDNAME is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on her.
1070487.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若CARDNAME已横置，则在她上面放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070488.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if Katara is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on her.
1070488.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若卡塔拉已横置，则在她上面放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070492.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a Clue token.
1070492.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个线索衍生物。

1070493.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a Clue token.
1070493.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个线索衍生物。

1070498.oracleText: CARDNAME can't block or be blocked by non-Spirit creatures.
1070498.translation: CARDNAME不能阻挡非精怪生物，也不能被前述生物阻挡。

1070499.oracleText: This token can't block or be blocked by non-Spirit creatures.
1070499.translation: 此衍生物不能阻挡非精怪生物，也不能被前述生物阻挡。

1070500.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token with "This token can't block or be blocked by non-Spirit creatures."
1070500.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能阻挡非精怪生物，也不能被前述生物阻挡。」

1070501.oracleText: Exhaust — Waterbend {o20}: Take an extra turn after this one.
1070501.translation: 竭绝～截水{o20}：于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。

1070503.oracleText: At every step, his friend was just out of reach.
1070503.translation: 不管走到哪，他的朋友始终都不见踪迹。

1070504.oracleText: The owner of target creature or enchantment puts it into their library second from the top or on the bottom. You create a Clue token.
1070504.translation: 目标生物或结界的拥有者将之置于其牌库顶数来第二张的位置，或牌库底。你派出一个线索衍生物。

1070506.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, target player mills X cards, where X is the number of Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1070506.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，目标牌手磨X张牌，X为你坟墓场中的课程牌数量。

1070507.oracleText: Whenever Master Pakku becomes tapped, target player mills X cards, where X is the number of Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1070507.translation: 每当帕库大师成为横置时，目标牌手磨X张牌，X为你坟墓场中的课程牌数量。

1070510.oracleText: "We're just in the process of improving upon what's already here."
1070510.translation: 「我们只不过是在原有基础之上不断改进。」

1070511.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a Clue token.
1070511.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个线索衍生物。

1070512.oracleText: {oT}: Until end of turn, target artifact token you control becomes a 3/1 Construct artifact creature with flying.
1070512.translation: {oT}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的衍生神器成为3/1，具飞行异能的组构体神器生物。

1070514.oracleText: Waterbenders patrol the coast each day for good fishing spots and bad weather omens.
1070514.translation: 截水师每日巡视岸边，寻找捕鱼佳所，留心天候预兆。

1070515.oracleText: Waterbend {o3}, {oT}: Tap target creature an opponent controls.
1070515.translation: 截水{o3}，{oT}：横置目标由对手操控的生物。

1070517.oracleText: A skilled Waterbender is always well armed.
1070517.translation: 技艺精湛的截水师绝不会缺帮手。

1070520.oracleText:
"Will you go penguin sledding with me?"
—Aang
1070520.translation:
「你要来跟我一起滑企鹅吗？」
～安昂

1070521.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+2 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
1070521.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，CARDNAME得+1/+2直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

1070522.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, this creature gets +1/+2 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
1070522.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，此生物得+1/+2直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

1070524.oracleText: Sokka's training was generally ineffective, but the children of Wolf Cove didn't seem to mind.
1070524.translation: 索卡的修行进展缓慢，但狼湾的孩子们似也不太在意。

1070526.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may waterbend {o10}.
1070526.translation: 你可以截水{o10}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

1070527.oracleText: You control target opponent during their next combat phase. If this spell's additional cost was paid, you control that player during their next turn instead.
1070527.translation: 目标对手于其下一个战斗阶段中由你来操控。如果已支付此咒语的额外费用，则改为该牌手于其下一个回合中由你来操控。

1070530.oracleText: Those who walk the Serpent's Pass quickly discover the origin of its name.
1070530.translation: 经过盘蛇关的人很快就会知道此处名称的由来。

1070531.oracleText: If there are three or more Lesson cards in your graveyard, you may cast this spell as though it had flash.
1070531.translation: 如果你坟墓场中有三张或更多课程牌，则你可以将此咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

1070532.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each noncreature, nonland card in your graveyard.
1070532.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张既非生物也非地的牌，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

1070534.oracleText: Draw a card, then mill three cards.
1070534.translation: 抓一张牌，然后磨三张牌。

1070536.oracleText:
"It's the center of all spiritual energy in our land."
—Princess Yue
1070536.translation:
「这里就是整个地方灵气的中心。」
～月公主

1070537.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card for each Shrine you control.
1070537.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个祭祠，便抓一张牌。

1070538.oracleText: When The Spirit Oasis enters, draw a card for each Shrine you control.
1070538.translation: 当神灵绿洲进场时，你每操控一个祭祠，便抓一张牌。

1070539.oracleText: Whenever another Shrine you control enters, draw a card.
1070539.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的祭祠进场时，抓一张牌。

1070541.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may waterbend {o6}.
1070541.translation: 你可以截水{o6}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

1070542.oracleText: Draw two cards. If this spell's additional cost was paid, instead shuffle your graveyard into your library, draw seven cards, and you have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
1070542.translation: 抓两张牌。如果已支付此咒语的额外费用，则改为将你的坟墓场洗回牌库，抓七张牌，且在本盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌数量没有上限。

1070545.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control with flying attack, draw a card, then discard a card. When you discard a nonland card this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
1070545.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。当你以此法弃一张非地牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070548.oracleText: Every creature in the world felt the Avatar's return and paid respects in whatever way it could.
1070548.translation: 这个世界的所有生灵都感受到降世神通已然轮回，纷纷以自身力所能及的方式致敬。

1070549.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, tap CARDNAME.
1070549.translation: 在你的维持开始时，横置CARDNAME。

1070550.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, tap this creature.
1070550.translation: 在你的维持开始时，横置此生物。

1070551.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, untap CARDNAME.
1070551.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，重置CARDNAME。

1070552.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, untap this creature.
1070552.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，重置此生物。

1070555.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap up to one target creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control CARDNAME.
1070555.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置至多一个目标生物。于你操控泰丽的时段内，它于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

1070556.oracleText: When Ty Lee enters, tap up to one target creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control Ty Lee.
1070556.translation: 当泰丽进场时，横置至多一个目标生物。于你操控泰丽的时段内，它于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

1070559.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws their second card each turn, you draw two cards.
1070559.translation: 每当任一对手抓每回合中其第二张牌时，你抓两张牌。

1070561.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put X +1/+1 counters on him. Then draw half X cards, rounded down.
1070561.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在他上面放置X个+1/+1指示物。然后抓等同于X一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

1070562.oracleText: When Wan Shi Tong enters, put X +1/+1 counters on him. Then draw half X cards, rounded down.
1070562.translation: 当万知堂进场时，在他上面放置X个+1/+1指示物。然后抓等同于X一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

1070563.oracleText: Whenever an opponent searches their library, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and draw a card.
1070563.translation: 每当任一对手搜寻其牌库时，你在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

1070564.oracleText: Whenever an opponent searches their library, put a +1/+1 counter on Wan Shi Tong and draw a card.
1070564.translation: 每当任一对手搜寻其牌库时，你在万知堂上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

1070566.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, put a quest counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has four or more quest counters on it, draw a card.
1070566.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个探索指示物。然后若其上有四个或更多探索指示物，则抓一张牌。

1070567.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, put a quest counter on this enchantment. Then if it has four or more quest counters on it, draw a card.
1070567.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在此结界上放置一个探索指示物。然后若其上有四个或更多探索指示物，则抓一张牌。

1070568.oracleText: Waterbend {o4}: Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
1070568.translation: 截水{o4}：目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

1070570.oracleText:
"Just push and pull the water—like this."
—Katara
1070570.translation:
「只要对水一推一拉就好～就像这样。」
～卡塔拉

1070571.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard a card unless you waterbend {o2}.
1070571.translation: 抓三张牌。然后除非你截水{o2}，否则弃一张牌。

1070573.oracleText: The scroll taught Katara many useful skills. So did fighting the angry pirates she stole it from.
1070573.translation: 卡塔拉从卷轴中学会不少招式，就连当初下手行窃时跟恼怒海盗斗智斗勇的那段经历，也令她获益良多。

1070574.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}: Draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each Island you control.
1070574.translation: {o6}，{oT}：抓一张牌。你每操控一个海岛，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

1070576.oracleText: Waterbend {o5}: Enchanted creature's owner shuffles it into their library.
1070576.translation: 截水{o5}：所结附的生物之拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

1070579.oracleText: "You'll save the world again. But you can't give up."
1070579.translation: 「你还能再次拯救世界。你不能就这么放弃。」

1070580.oracleText: Waterbend {o5}, {oT}: You may cast a noncreature spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
1070580.translation: 截水{o5}，{oT}：你可以从你手上施放一个非生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

1070582.oracleText: Azula is a skilled and deadly warrior, but her true passion is emotional torment.
1070582.translation: 阿祖拉虽有不凡身手，但却热衷于操控人心。

1070584.oracleText: "You can run, but I'll catch you."

1070586.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you lose 1 life and create a Clue token.
1070586.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你失去1点生命并派出一个线索衍生物。

1070587.oracleText: Whenever Azula attacks, you lose 1 life and create a Clue token.
1070587.translation: 每当阿祖拉攻击时，你失去1点生命并派出一个线索衍生物。

1070589.oracleText: To these desert-dwelling traders, there is profit to be found under every dune of sand and in every living thing.
1070589.translation: 在长居沙漠的商人眼中，每座沙丘、每件活物都有利可图。

1070590.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
1070590.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则抓一张牌并在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070591.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
1070591.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则抓一张牌并在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070594.oracleText: Tap an untapped Ally you control: Exile target card from a graveyard.
1070594.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的伙伴：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

1070595.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may cast an Ally spell from among cards you own exiled with CARDNAME.
1070595.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从以此生物放逐且由你拥有的牌之中施放一个伙伴咒语。

1070596.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may cast an Ally spell from among cards you own exiled with this creature.
1070596.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以从以此生物放逐且由你拥有的牌之中施放一个伙伴咒语。

1070599.oracleText: What doesn't survive the Si Wong Desert assures that the buzzard-wasps do.
1070599.translation: 死亡沙漠中逝去的生命养活了秃鹰蜂。

1070600.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do, draw a card.
1070600.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

1070601.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do, draw a card.
1070601.translation: 当此生物进场时，你可以牺牲一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

1070602.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, if it had counters on it, put its counters on CARDNAME.
1070602.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有指示物，则将死去生物上的指示物置于CARDNAME上。

1070604.oracleText: Protection fees can burn a hole in your pocket, but they're better than the alternative.
1070604.translation: 凑保护费可能会掏穿你的口袋，但不交的话烧穿的东西就更多了。

1070605.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals 1 damage to you. Create a Clue token.
1070605.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它对你造成1点伤害。派出一个线索衍生物。

1070606.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to you. Create a Clue token.
1070606.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对你造成1点伤害。派出一个线索衍生物。

1070610.oracleText: People don't go fishing for cat-gators. Cat-gators go fishing for people.
1070610.translation: 人们不会去钓鲶鳄鱼。鲶鳄鱼会来钓人。

1070611.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, it deals damage equal to the number of Swamps you control to any target.
1070611.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，它对任一目标造成等同于由你操控之沼泽数量的伤害。

1070612.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals damage equal to the number of Swamps you control to any target.
1070612.translation: 当此生物进场时，它对任一目标造成等同于由你操控之沼泽数量的伤害。

1070615.oracleText: "There is no war in Ba Sing Se."

1070616.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland permanent card from it. That player discards that card.
1070616.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地永久物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

1070618.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland permanent card from it. That player discards that card. 
• Earthbend 2.
1070618.translation:
选择一项～
•目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地永久物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。
•运土2。

1070620.oracleText: The solar eclipse robbed Firebenders of their ability to firebend, giving Team Avatar an eight-minute window to storm the capital and defeat the Fire Lord.
1070620.translation: 日食来临，令所有振火师顿时熄火，神通小队便抓住这八分钟的机会突袭烈火国首都，直取烈火君。

1070621.oracleText: Each creature with mana value X or less loses all abilities until end of turn. Destroy those creatures.
1070621.translation: 所有法术力值等于或小于X的生物都失去所有异能直到回合结束。消灭这些生物。

1070623.oracleText: Mai didn't always care, but she never missed.
1070623.translation: 梅可能看着漫不经心，但她却从未失手。

1070624.oracleText: With Azula's defeat, all of her nobility, grace, and confidence shattered into harrowing screams from the would-be Fire Lord.
1070624.translation: 随着阿祖拉落败，她再也无法成为烈火君。她所有的华贵气质、优雅举止、必胜信心都随着这声悲恸长啸轰然崩毁。

1070626.oracleText: Long Feng normally used the Dai Li to silence dissidents, but he wasn't above taking a more direct approach.
1070626.translation: 龙凤通常会派戴笠军去处理造反者，但他也不介意直接动手。

1070627.oracleText: Choose target creature. When that creature dies this turn, you earthbend 4.
1070627.translation: 选择目标生物。本回合中，当该生物死去时，你运土4。

1070629.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may tap it. When you do, destroy target creature with power 4 or less.
1070629.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将它横置。当你如此作时，消灭目标力量等于或小于4的生物。

1070630.oracleText: When The Fire Nation Drill enters, you may tap it. When you do, destroy target creature with power 4 or less.
1070630.translation: 当烈火国巨龙钻进场时，你可以将它横置。当你如此作时，消灭目标力量等于或小于4的生物。

1070632.oracleText: A lonely worker can find trouble making friends on an airship so massive.
1070632.translation: 只有一心埋头苦干的工程师，才知道飞船上那些喜欢闹事的伙伴会有多可怕。

1070633.oracleText: Raid — At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature or Vehicle you control.
1070633.translation: 突击～在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合攻击过，则在另一个目标由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070635.oracleText: The trebuchets would be destructive enough even without the fire.
1070635.translation: 就算没点火，投石机的破坏力也已足够。

1070636.oracleText: Whenever you attack, create a 2/1 colorless Construct artifact creature token with flying named Ballistic Boulder that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
1070636.translation: 每当你攻击时，派出一个2/1无色，名称为抛石弹，具飞行异能的组构体衍生神器生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

1070639.oracleText:
"Set my lines by the riverbed! Caught ten fish and I killed 'em dead!"
—Foggy Swamp Tribe ditty
1070639.translation:
「捕鱼线阵河边摆！抓满十鱼全煮开！」
～雾沼水族小曲

1070640.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, CARDNAME has lifelink and menace.
1070640.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，CARDNAME便具有系命与威慑异能。

1070641.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, this creature has lifelink and menace.
1070641.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，此生物便具有系命与威慑异能。

1070643.oracleText: Exile X target creature cards from graveyards. For each creature card exiled this way, create a token that's a copy of it. At the beginning of your next end step, sacrifice those tokens.
1070643.translation: 将X张目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。对每张以此法放逐的生物牌而言，派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲这些衍生物。

1070644.oracleText:
"Put a muzzle on him!"
—Si Wong Sandbender

1070647.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains menace until end of turn.
1070647.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

1070648.oracleText: Exhaust — {o5}: Put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
1070648.translation: 竭绝～{o5}：在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1070649.oracleText: Exhaust — {o5}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
1070649.translation: 竭绝～{o5}：在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1070651.oracleText: "Hello! My name is Joo Dee. You're in Ba Sing Se now. Everyone is safe here."
1070651.translation: 「你们好！我叫朱蒂。这里是永固城。我们在这里很安全。」

1070652.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}: Surveil 1. Create a token that's a copy of CARDNAME, then sacrifice an artifact or creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
1070652.translation: {oB}，{oT}：刺探1。派出一个为CARDNAME的复制品的衍生物，然后牺牲一个神器或生物。只能于法术时机起动。

1070653.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}: Surveil 1. Create a token that's a copy of this creature, then sacrifice an artifact or creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
1070653.translation: {oB}，{oT}：刺探1。派出一个为此生物复制品的衍生物，然后牺牲一个神器或生物。只能于法术时机起动。

1070655.oracleText: "My shirshu can smell a rat a continent away."
1070655.translation: 「我的麝鼠就连远在天边的东西都能闻到。」

1070656.oracleText: June can't be blocked as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
1070656.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，珍便不能被阻挡。

1070657.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Create a Clue token. Activate only during your turn.
1070657.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：派出一个线索衍生物。只能于你的回合中起动。

1070659.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one other target creature.
1070659.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多另一个目标生物。

1070660.oracleText: When Koh enters, exile up to one other target creature.
1070660.translation: 当口进场时，放逐至多另一个目标生物。

1070661.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature dies, you may exile it.
1070661.translation: 每当另一个非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以将它放逐。

1070662.oracleText: Pay 1 life: Choose a creature card exiled with CARDNAME.
1070662.translation: 支付1点生命：选择一张以CARDNAME放逐的生物牌。

1070663.oracleText: Pay 1 life: Choose a creature card exiled with Koh.
1070663.translation: 支付1点生命：选择一张以口放逐的生物牌。

1070664.oracleText: CARDNAME has all activated and triggered abilities of the last chosen card.
1070664.translation: CARDNAME具有最后选中之牌的所有起动式异能和触发式异能。

1070665.oracleText: Koh has all activated and triggered abilities of the last chosen card.
1070665.translation: 口具有最后选中之牌的所有起动式异能和触发式异能。

1070667.oracleText: "Almost perfect," Lo began. Li finished, "One hair out of place."
1070667.translation: 「差不多完美了。」萝婆开口。莉婆紧接道，「有根头发偏了。」

1070668.oracleText: When CARDNAME enter, search your library for a Lesson or Noble card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1070668.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张课程或贵族牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1070669.oracleText: When Lo and Li enter, search your library for a Lesson or Noble card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1070669.translation: 当萝婆与莉婆进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张课程或贵族牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1070670.oracleText: Noble creatures you control and Lesson spells you control have lifelink.
1070670.translation: 由你操控的贵族生物和由你操控的课程咒语均具有系命异能。

1070673.oracleText: "You miscalculated. I love Zuko more than I fear you."
1070673.translation: 「你算错了。我虽然畏惧你，但我更喜欢苏科。」

1070674.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, they lose 2 life.
1070674.translation: 每当任一牌手施放非生物咒语时，该牌手失去2点生命。

1070676.oracleText: Also known as Dock the ferryman, Xu the fishmonger, and Bushi the river cleaner, depending on what job needed to be done in Jang Hui village.
1070676.translation: 他可能是港口帮忙的港伯，鱼店卖鱼的店伯，或是清扫河岸的河伯，全看江汇村需要什么人手。

1070678.oracleText:
"This is supposed to be the history of my people . . ."
—Aang
1070678.translation:
「这里本应该是我族人的故地…」
～安昂

1070679.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
1070679.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

1070680.oracleText: When Northern Air Temple enters, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
1070680.translation: 当北气和寺进场时，每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

1070681.oracleText: Whenever another Shrine you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
1070681.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的祭祠进场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

1070682.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and create a Clue token.
1070682.translation: 当CARDNAME进场和在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命并派出一个线索衍生物。

1070683.oracleText: When this enchantment enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and create a Clue token.
1070683.translation: 当此结界进场和在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命并派出一个线索衍生物。

1070684.oracleText: Whenever you attack, put X +1/+1 counters on target attacking creature, where X is the number of permanents you've sacrificed this turn. If X is three or greater, that creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
1070684.translation: 每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你本回合中牺牲过的永久物数量。如果X等于或大于三，则该生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

1070686.oracleText: "You will learn respect, and suffering will be your teacher."
1070686.translation: 「你终将学会如何尊敬他人，痛苦是你最好的老师。」

1070687.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target player. That player discards two cards.
1070687.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手造成2点伤害。该牌手弃两张牌。

1070688.oracleText: Ozai's Cruelty deals 2 damage to target player. That player discards two cards.
1070688.translation: 敖载无情对目标牌手造成2点伤害。该牌手弃两张牌。

1070690.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you sacrificed a permanent this turn, create a token that's a copy of CARDNAME.
1070690.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中牺牲过永久物，则派出一个为CARDNAME之复制品的衍生物。

1070691.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you sacrificed a permanent this turn, create a token that's a copy of this Vehicle.
1070691.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中牺牲过永久物，则派出一个为此载具之复制品的衍生物。

1070692.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more permanents named Phoenix Fleet Airship, CARDNAME is an artifact creature.
1070692.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多名称为凤凰舰队飞船的永久物，CARDNAME便是神器生物。

1070693.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more permanents named Phoenix Fleet Airship, this Vehicle is an artifact creature.
1070693.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多名称为凤凰舰队飞船的永久物，此载具便是神器生物。

1070694.oracleText: "We prefer to think of ourselves as ‘high-risk traders.' "
1070694.translation: 「我们更喜欢把自己当成『高风险商人』。」

1070696.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card is exiled this way, create a Clue token.
1070696.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。若以此法放逐一张生物牌，则派出一个线索衍生物。

1070697.oracleText: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card is exiled this way, create a Clue token.
1070697.translation: 每当此生物进场或攻击时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。若以此法放逐一张生物牌，则派出一个线索衍生物。

1070698.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
1070698.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

1070701.oracleText: Choose a card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for up to four cards with that name and exile them. Then that player shuffles.
1070701.translation: 选择一个牌名。从目标对手的坟墓场，手牌和牌库中搜寻至多四张具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。然后该牌手洗牌。

1070704.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may pay {oX}. When you do, put any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
1070704.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以支付{oX}。当你如此作时，选择任意数量目标在该牌手坟墓场中的生物牌，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于X，将这些牌从该处在你操控下放进战场。

1070705.oracleText: Whenever Fire Lord Sozin deals combat damage to a player, you may pay {oX}. When you do, put any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
1070705.translation: 每当烈火君苏进对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以支付{oX}。当你如此作时，选择任意数量目标在该牌手坟墓场中的生物牌，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于X，将这些牌从该处在你操控下放进战场。

1070707.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may waterbend {o4}.
1070707.translation: 你可以截水{o4}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

1070708.oracleText: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell's additional cost was paid, whenever a creature dies this turn, you gain 1 life.
1070708.translation: 所有生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。如果已支付此咒语的额外费用，则本回合中，每当一个生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

1070709.oracleText: Haru's good deed went severely punished.
1070709.translation: 哈鲁的好心最终没有得到好报。

1070710.oracleText: Exile target creature. If it was dealt damage this turn, create a Clue token.
1070710.translation: 放逐目标生物。如果其本回合中受过伤害，则派出一个线索衍生物。

1070712.oracleText:
"Just a little closer. Nice and easy. Nothing to worry about. We just fixin' to eat ya."
—Due, Foggy Swamp Tribe member
1070712.translation:
「再靠近点。很好，很好。别害怕。我们很快会吃掉你。」
～雾沼水族颩

1070713.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if it targets a creature with flying.
1070713.translation: 如果此咒语以具飞行异能的生物为目标，则它减少{o1}来施放。

1070716.oracleText: When this Vehicle enters, target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
1070716.translation: 当此载具进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1070719.oracleText: Wolfbats nest in tunnels carved out by badgermoles and hunt for prey in the dark caverns.
1070719.translation: 狼头蝠设巢于獾地鼠挖出来的隧道当中，喜欢在黑暗洞窟中狩猎。

1070720.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, you may pay {oB}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
1070720.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，则将此牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。

1070722.oracleText: "I've always had to struggle and fight, and that's made me strong."
1070722.translation: 「我一直遭受苦难，抗争求存，而这些磨练令我更加坚强。」

1070723.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. If this spell was kicked, instead put that card onto the battlefield tapped.
1070723.translation: 将目标生物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为将该牌横置放进战场。

1070725.oracleText: This fiercely territorial beast uses knife-sharp quills to ensure would-be attackers always get the point.
1070725.translation: 这种凶猛野兽领地意识极强。它们身上还有锋利尖刺，让来者一眼就看到自己擅闯的下场。

1070727.oracleText: "You thought I was a frail old man, but I'm the most powerful Earthbender you'll ever see."
1070727.translation: 「你可能以为我只是个弱不禁风的糟老头，但我会是你所见过最厉害的运土师。」

1070728.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of lands you control to target creature.
1070728.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成等同于由你操控之地数量的伤害。

1070729.oracleText: Bumi Bash deals damage equal to the number of lands you control to target creature.
1070729.translation: 布米重击对目标生物造成等同于由你操控之地数量的伤害。

1070730.oracleText: Destroy target land creature or nonbasic land.
1070730.translation: 消灭目标地生物或非基本地。

1070731.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of lands you control to target creature. 
• Destroy target land creature or nonbasic land.
1070731.translation:
选择一项～
•CARDNAME对目标生物造成等同于由你操控之地数量的伤害。
•消灭目标地生物或非基本地。

1070732.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Bumi Bash deals damage equal to the number of lands you control to target creature. 
• Destroy target land creature or nonbasic land.
1070732.translation:
选择一项～
•布米重击对目标生物造成等同于由你操控之地数量的伤害。
•消灭目标地生物或非基本地。

1070734.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Ally creature tokens.
1070734.translation: 派出两个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。

1070735.oracleText: Search your library for a Mountain or Cave card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
1070735.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张山脉或洞窟牌，展示该牌，将之置于你手上，然后洗牌。

1070738.oracleText:
"The Avatar's alive. I want you to find him, and end him."
—Zuko
1070738.translation:
「降世神通还活着。我要你找到他，然后干掉他。」
～苏科

1070739.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, destroy target permanent unless its controller has CARDNAME deal damage to them equal to his power.
1070739.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择目标永久物，除非该永久物的操控者令CARDNAME依其力量对该牌手造成伤害，否则消灭所选永久物。

1070740.oracleText: Whenever Combustion Man attacks, destroy target permanent unless its controller has Combustion Man deal damage to them equal to his power.
1070740.translation: 每当爆焰男攻击时，选择目标永久物，除非该永久物的操控者令爆焰男依其力量对该牌手造成伤害，否则消灭所选永久物。

1070742.oracleText:
"Sokka, watch out! It's Sparky-Sparky Boom Man!"
—Aang
1070742.translation:
「索卡，当心！是闪闪爆炸男！」
～安昂

1070743.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to 2 plus the number of Lesson cards in your graveyard to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
1070743.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于你坟墓场中的课程牌数量加2。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

1070744.oracleText: Combustion Technique deals damage equal to 2 plus the number of Lesson cards in your graveyard to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
1070744.translation: 爆焰绝技对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于你坟墓场中的课程牌数量加2。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

1070746.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, for each Shrine you control, create a 1/1 red Monk creature token with prowess.
1070746.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你每操控一个祭祠，便派出一个1/1红色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

1070747.oracleText: When Crescent Island Temple enters, for each Shrine you control, create a 1/1 red Monk creature token with prowess.
1070747.translation: 当新月岛烈火寺进场时，你每操控一个祭祠，便派出一个1/1红色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

1070748.oracleText: Whenever another Shrine you control enters, create a 1/1 red Monk creature token with prowess.
1070748.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的祭祠进场时，派出一个1/1红色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

1070750.oracleText:
"Is that all you got? Man, they'll make anyone an admiral these days."
—Aang
1070750.translation:
「你就这点本事？我说，现在要当舰长也太容易了吧。」
～安昂

1070752.oracleText: "Follow me! I can get you outta here!"
1070752.translation: 「跟我来！我能带你们离开这里！」

1070753.oracleText: {oT}: Another target creature you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
1070753.translation: {oT}：另一个目标由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

1070755.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with X fire counters on it.
1070755.translation: CARDNAME进场时上面有X个烈火指示物。

1070756.oracleText: This enchantment enters with X fire counters on it.
1070756.translation: 此结界进场时上面有X个烈火指示物。

1070757.oracleText: If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus an amount of damage equal to the number of fire counters on CARDNAME instead.
1070757.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将任一对手或任一由对手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量的伤害再加上等同于CARDNAME上烈火指示物数量的伤害。

1070758.oracleText: If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus an amount of damage equal to the number of fire counters on this enchantment instead.
1070758.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将任一对手或任一由对手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量的伤害再加上等同于此结界上烈火指示物数量的伤害。

1070761.oracleText: Create two 2/2 red Soldier creature tokens with firebending 1.
1070761.translation: 派出两个2/2红色，具振火1的士兵衍生生物。

1070764.oracleText: Fire Nation training ensures that even the smallest flame burns into a raging inferno.
1070764.translation: 烈火国苦练新兵，就是想让细微火苗也能烧成熊熊烈焰。

1070765.oracleText: CARDNAME has firebending 2 as long as there's a Lesson card in your graveyard.
