1070918.translation: 「携手同心，我们必将坚不可摧。」

1070919.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each color among Allies you control.
1070919.translation: 由你操控的伙伴中每包括一种颜色，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

1070920.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+0 for each color among Allies you control.
1070920.translation: 由你操控的伙伴中每包括一种颜色，此生物便得+1/+0。

1070923.oracleText:
"Understanding others, the other elements, and the other nations will help you become whole."
—Iroh
1070923.translation:
「了解其他人、其他元素、其他国家，会帮你变得更加完整。」
～艾洛

1070924.oracleText: Search your library for up to four land cards with different names and reveal them. An opponent chooses two of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your graveyard and the rest onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1070924.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多四张名称各不相同的地牌并展示之。任一对手选择其中两张牌。将所选之牌置入你坟墓场，其余则横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1070927.oracleText:
"Oh, that's a good boy! Yes, who has a soft belly?"
—Bumi, King of Omashu
1070927.translation:
「噢，这才是我的小乖乖！它肚皮该是软软的。」
～奥玛舒之王布米

1070928.oracleText: When Flopsie enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1070928.translation: 当弗洛布西进场时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070931.oracleText: Waterbend {o5}: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Activate only during your turn.
1070931.translation: 截水{o5}：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于你的回合中起动。

1070932.oracleText: Waterbend {o5}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only during your turn.
1070932.translation: 截水{o5}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于你的回合中起动。

1070934.oracleText: "Who's ready to cross this here canyon?"

1070935.oracleText: Each land and Ally you control has "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
1070935.translation: 每个由你操控的地与伙伴均具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

1070937.oracleText: Haru hid his incredible earthbending abilities out of fear of punishment from the Fire Nation.
1070937.translation: 哈鲁身怀过人运土神功，但由于害怕遭到烈火国迫害，因此一直没有显露出来。

1070938.oracleText: Whenever another Ally you control enters, earthbend 1.
1070938.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的伙伴进场时，运土1。

1070940.oracleText:
"Your moment of truth isn't gonna be in front of some map. It's gonna to be out there on the battlefield."
—Aang
1070940.translation:
「纸上谈兵体现不出你的才华。战场上才是你建功立业的地方。」
～安昂

1070941.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
1070941.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

1070942.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
1070942.translation: 当此结界进场时，由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

1070943.oracleText: Whenever one or more Allies you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
1070943.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的伙伴对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

1070945.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is the number of Shrines you control. Put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1070945.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻至多X张基本地牌，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。将这些牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1070946.oracleText: Whenever another Shrine you control enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
1070946.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的祭祠进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

1070948.oracleText: Mill three cards, then create a Food token.
1070948.translation: 磨三张牌，然后派出一个食品衍生物。

1070949.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control.
1070949.translation: 在至多两个目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1070950.oracleText: Draw a card if there's a creature or Lesson card in your graveyard.
1070950.translation: 如果你坟墓场中有生物或课程牌，则抓一张牌。

1070952.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
1070952.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控之生物中的最大力量。

1070953.oracleText: Earthbend X, where X is the number of cards in your hand. That land becomes an Island in addition to its other types.
1070953.translation: 运土X，X为你的手牌数量。该地成为海岛，且仍具有原本类别。

1070955.translation: 「只有正义裁决才能带来和平。」

1070956.oracleText: Lands you control have trample and hexproof.
1070956.translation: 由你操控的地具有践踏与辟邪异能。

1070957.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
1070957.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。

1070959.oracleText: Metal is just earth that has been purified and refined.
1070959.translation: 金属不过只是净化提纯之后的泥土。

1070960.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
1070960.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1070961.oracleText:
Choose one — 
• Destroy target artifact or enchantment. 
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
1070961.translation:
选择一项～
•消灭目标神器或结界。
•在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

1070964.oracleText: Ostrich-horses are renowned in the Earth Kingdom as reliable steeds for couriers, soldiers, and merchants.
1070964.translation: 鸵鸟马脚程可靠，土强国的邮差、士兵和商人都普遍选择用它来当代步工具。

1070966.oracleText: Toph hated flying. "Launching," however, was a trajectory under her control.
1070966.translation: 拓芙不喜欢腾空的感觉。但「跃升」的话，就能够自己控制轨迹。

1070967.oracleText: "I think The Boulder is going to win back the belt at Earth Rumble Six!"
1070967.translation: 「我看好大块石，这第六届震土大赛他肯定能赢回腰带！」

1070968.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG}. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, add {oGoG} instead.
1070968.translation: {oT}：加{oG}。如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则改为加{oGoG}。

1070970.oracleText: "The Fire Nation will regret the day they set foot on our land!"
1070970.translation: 「烈火国定会为踏足我们的国土付出代价！」

1070971.oracleText: Exhaust — {o6}: Put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME, then earthbend 2.
1070971.translation: 竭绝～{o6}：在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物，然后运土2。

1070972.oracleText: Exhaust — {o6}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature, then earthbend 2.
1070972.translation: 竭绝～{o6}：在此生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物，然后运土2。

1070974.oracleText: Earthbend X, where X is the number of Forests you control.
1070974.translation: 运土X，X为由你操控的树林数量。

1070977.oracleText: "I am the greatest Earthbender in the world; don't you two dunderheads ever forget it!"
1070977.translation: 「我是这世上最强大的运土师；你们两个笨蛋给我记住了！」

1070980.oracleText: Foo Foo Cuddlypoops didn't look much like a saber-tooth moose-lion to Sokka, but his mother certainly did.
1070980.translation: 在索卡眼中，夫夫卡迪仆仆并不像是剑齿麋角狮，但他母亲肯定是。

1070982.oracleText: "Even though I was born blind, I've never had a problem seeing . . . I feel the vibrations in the earth, and I can ‘see' where everything is."
1070982.translation: 「尽管我天生失明，但我依然能够『看到』世界…我能感知大地震动，由此得见万物。」

1070983.oracleText: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of lands you control. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1070983.translation: 检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控的地数量。你可以展示其中一张生物或地牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1070985.oracleText:
"We are all living together even if most folks don't act like it. We all have the same roots, and we are all branches of the same tree."
—Huu
1070985.translation:
「大多数人并未意识到，众生实际彼此命运相系：我们都在同一棵树中，只是分散在不同的枝桠上。」
～咻

1070987.oracleText:
"I am Melon Lord! Mwahaha!"
—Toph, Melon Lord
1070987.translation:
「我是西瓜王！哇哈哈！」
～西瓜王拓芙

1070988.oracleText: {oT}: Mill a card. You may put a land card milled this way into your hand. You gain 2 life if a Lesson card is milled this way.
1070988.translation: {oT}：磨一张牌。你可以将以此磨掉的一张地牌置于你手上。如果以此法磨掉课程牌，则你获得2点生命。

1070992.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on lands you control.
1070992.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于由你操控之地上的+1/+1指示物总数量。

1070993.oracleText: Toph's power is equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on lands you control.
1070993.translation: 拓芙的力量等同于由你操控之地上的+1/+1指示物总数量。

1070995.oracleText:
"Understanding the struggle between your two great-grandfathers can help you better understand the battle within yourself."
—Iroh
1070995.translation:
「了解你两位曾祖父之间的争斗，能帮助你更好理解你内心中的矛盾。」
～艾洛

1070996.oracleText: Return up to one target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
1070996.translation: 将至多一张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

1070999.oracleText: A turtle-duckling's greatest defense comes not from their shell, but from their mother.
1070999.translation: 小龟壳鸭最硬的防御，并不是自己背上的壳，而是自己的母亲。

1071000.oracleText: {o3}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME has base power 4 and gains trample.
1071000.translation: {o3}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME的基础力量为4且获得践踏异能。

1071001.oracleText: {o3}: Until end of turn, this creature has base power 4 and gains trample.
1071001.translation: {o3}：直到回合结束，此生物的基础力量为4且获得践踏异能。

1071004.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Food, you may search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you search your library this way, put CARDNAME on the bottom of its owner's library, then shuffle.
1071004.translation: 每当你牺牲一个食品时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌并横置放进战场。若你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将CARDNAME置于其拥有者的牌库底，然后洗牌。

1071005.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Food, you may search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you search your library this way, put this creature on the bottom of its owner's library, then shuffle.
1071005.translation: 每当你牺牲一个食品时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌并横置放进战场。若你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将此生物置于其拥有者的牌库底，然后洗牌。

1071007.oracleText: "That drill shall not reach Ba Sing Se! This is what we trained for!"
1071007.translation: 「绝不能让巨钻突破永固城！我们毕生所学，就为今日守城之用！」

1071008.oracleText: When this creature dies, if there's a Lesson card in your graveyard, you gain 2 life.
1071008.translation: 当此生物死去时，若你坟墓场中有课程牌，则你获得2点生命。

1071010.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature card with mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1071010.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力值等于或小于4的生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1071011.oracleText: When Aang enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature card with mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
1071011.translation: 当安昂进场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力值等于或小于4的生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

1071012.oracleText: When another creature you control leaves the battlefield, transform CARDNAME at the beginning of the next upkeep.
1071012.translation: 当另一个由你操控的生物离开战场，在下一个维持开始时转化CARDNAME。

1071013.oracleText: When another creature you control leaves the battlefield, transform Aang at the beginning of the next upkeep.
1071013.translation: 当另一个由你操控的生物离开战场，在下一个维持开始时转化安昂。

1071016.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, earthbend 2.
1071016.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，运土2。

1071018.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, airbend up to one other target creature or spell.
1071018.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，对至多另一个目标生物或咒语截气。

1071019.oracleText: When Aang enters, airbend up to one other target creature or spell.
1071019.translation: 当安昂进场时，对至多另一个目标生物或咒语截气。

1071024.oracleText: With the death of the moon spirit, the Avatar's tides of vengeance crashed over the Fire Nation fleet.
1071024.translation: 月神死后，降世神通的复仇浪潮掀翻了整支烈火国舰队。

1071025.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attack, put a +1/+1 counter on each tapped creature you control.
1071025.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个由你操控且已横置的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1071026.oracleText: Whenever Aang and La attack, put a +1/+1 counter on each tapped creature you control.
1071026.translation: 每当安昂与拉攻击时，在每个由你操控且已横置的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1071028.oracleText:
"Learn to let her go, or you cannot let the pure cosmic energy flow in from the universe."
—Guru Pathik
1071028.translation:
「学会忘记她吧，不然你就无法让来自宇宙的纯净能量流通全身。」
～帕提克大师

1071030.oracleText: Ancient stories of flying monks inspired generations of gliders to come.
1071030.translation: 飞天和尚的古老传说，激励后人不断创新翔翼。

1071031.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a Clue token.
1071031.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个线索衍生物。

1071033.oracleText: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.
1071033.translation: 当在世界最需要他的时候，降世神通回归了。

1071034.oracleText: Whenever you waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend, draw a card. Then if you've done all four this turn, transform CARDNAME.
1071034.translation: 每当你截水、运土、振火或截气时，抓一张牌。然后若你本回合中前述四项均作过，则转化CARDNAME。

1071035.oracleText: Whenever you waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend, draw a card. Then if you've done all four this turn, transform Avatar Aang.
1071035.translation: 每当你截水、运土、振火或截气时，抓一张牌。然后若你本回合中前述四项均作过，则转化降世神通安昂。

1071037.oracleText: Spells you cast cost {oWoUoBoRoG} less to cast.
1071037.translation: 你施放的咒语减少{oWoUoBoRoG}来施放。

1071038.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, you may transform CARDNAME. If you do, you gain 4 life, draw four cards, put four +1/+1 counters on him, and he deals 4 damage to each opponent.
1071038.translation: 在每个维持开始时，你可以转化CARDNAME。若你如此作，则你获得4点生命，抓四张牌，在他上面放置四个+1/+1指示物，且他向每位对手各造成4点伤害。

1071039.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, you may transform Aang, Master of Elements. If you do, you gain 4 life, draw four cards, put four +1/+1 counters on him, and he deals 4 damage to each opponent.
1071039.translation: 在每个维持开始时，你可以转化四元素大师安昂。若你如此作，则你获得4点生命，抓四张牌，在他上面放置四个+1/+1指示物，且他向每位对手各造成4点伤害。

1071042.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent exiles a nontoken creature they control, then they exile a nonland card from their graveyard.
1071042.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手放逐一个由其操控且非衍生物的生物，然后他从其坟墓场中放逐一张非地牌。

1071043.oracleText: When Azula enters, target opponent exiles a nontoken creature they control, then they exile a nonland card from their graveyard.
1071043.translation: 当阿祖拉进场时，目标对手放逐一个由其操控且非衍生物的生物，然后他从其坟墓场中放逐一张非地牌。

1071044.oracleText: During your turn, you may cast cards exiled with CARDNAME and you may cast them as though they had flash. Mana of any type can be spent to cast those spells.
1071044.translation: 于你的回合中，你可以施放以CARDNAME放逐的牌，且你可以将这些牌视同具有闪现异能地来施放。能用任意种类的法术力来施放这些咒语。

1071045.oracleText: During your turn, you may cast cards exiled with Azula and you may cast them as though they had flash. Mana of any type can be spent to cast those spells.
1071045.translation: 于你的回合中，你可以施放以阿祖拉放逐的牌，且你可以将这些牌视同具有闪现异能地来施放。能用任意种类的法术力来施放这些咒语。

1071048.oracleText: Whenever a nonland creature you control dies, earthbend X, where X is that creature's power.
1071048.translation: 每当一个由你操控的非地生物死去时，运土X，X为该生物的力量。

1071050.oracleText: Whenever you attack a player with one or more creatures with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
1071050.translation: 每当你以一个或数个力量等于或大于4的生物攻击一位牌手时，抓一张牌。

1071054.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, untap all lands you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. Only land creatures can attack during that combat phase.
1071054.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置所有由你操控的地。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。在该战斗阶段中，只有地生物能攻击。

1071055.oracleText: Whenever Bumi deals combat damage to a player, untap all lands you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. Only land creatures can attack during that combat phase.
1071055.translation: 每当布米对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置所有由你操控的地。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。在该战斗阶段中，只有地生物能攻击。

1071057.oracleText: When it's feeling bored, it chases itself.
1071057.translation: 当它觉得无聊的时候，甚至还会追自己。

1071058.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap target artifact or creature.
1071058.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置目标神器或生物。

1071059.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, untap target artifact or creature.
1071059.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，重置目标神器或生物。

1071060.oracleText: "You're one mistake away from dying where you stand."
1071060.translation: 「你再犯哪怕一点小错就会命丧当场。」

1071061.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 2/2 red Soldier creature token with firebending 1.
1071061.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个2/2红色，具振火1的士兵衍生生物。

1071062.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a 2/2 red Soldier creature token with firebending 1.
1071062.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个2/2红色，具振火1的士兵衍生生物。

1071064.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, earthbend 1, then earthbend 1.
1071064.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，运土1，然后运土1。

1071065.oracleText: When this creature enters, earthbend 1, then earthbend 1.
1071065.translation: 当此生物进场时，运土1，然后运土1。

1071066.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them.
1071066.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物数量。

1071067.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them.
1071067.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物数量。

1071070.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of noncreature, nonland cards in your graveyard.
1071070.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你坟墓场中既非生物也非地之牌的数量。

1071071.oracleText: This creature's power is equal to the number of noncreature, nonland cards in your graveyard.

1071218.translation: 于每位其他牌手的重置步骤中，重置此神器。

1071220.oracleText: When this Vehicle dies, create a Clue token.
1071220.translation: 当此载具死去时，派出一个线索衍生物。

1071222.oracleText: Kyoshi Warriors wield traditional war fans to honor their namesake.
1071222.translation: 虚子武士都如虚子本人一般擅使战扇。

1071223.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
1071223.translation: 当此武具进场时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物，然后将此武具贴附于其上。

1071225.oracleText: Crafted from a fallen meteor, symbolizing the sudden change that wielding it brings.
1071225.translation: 这柄利剑由天外陨星铸成，每挥舞一次都会如飞星一般带来剧变。

1071226.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, destroy target permanent.
1071226.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，消灭目标永久物。

1071227.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, destroy target permanent.
1071227.translation: 当此武具进场时，消灭目标永久物。

1071229.oracleText: It charts the movements of heavenly bodies, forecasting the fates of nations.
1071229.translation: 它描绘天体运动，预示国运走向。

1071230.oracleText: Whenever you scry or surveil, look at the top card of your library. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Do this only once each turn.
1071230.translation: 每当你占卜或刺探时，检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。每回合只能如此作一次。

1071233.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Tap target creature. Return Trusty Boomerang to its owner's hand.
1071233.translation: {o1}，{oT}：横置目标生物。将可靠的飞去来移回其拥有者手上。

1071234.oracleText: Equipped creature has "{o1}, {oT}: Tap target creature. Return Trusty Boomerang to its owner's hand."
1071234.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「{o1}，{oT}：横置目标生物。将可靠的飞去来移回其拥有者手上。」

1071235.oracleText: The Walls of Ba Sing Se

1071236.oracleText:
"That is why the city is named Ba Sing Se. It's the ‘impenetrable city.' "
—General Sung
1071236.translation:
「这就是为什么这座城叫做『永固城』。『永远固若金汤』。」
～宋将军

1071238.oracleText:
"Most people think the lotus tile insignificant, but it is essential for the unusual strategy that I employ."
—Iroh
1071238.translation:
「很多人认为白莲旗子无关紧要，但它却是我接下来奇兵妙计的关键。」
～艾洛

1071239.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
1071239.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的法术力，X为由你操控的生物中各生物类别所具有的生物数量之最大值。

1071241.oracleText: Aang once knew this place to be full of monks, lemurs, and bison.
1071241.translation: 在安昂的记忆中，此处应该热闹非凡，满是和尚、狐猴、野牛的身影。

1071242.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped unless you control a basic land.
1071242.translation: 除非你操控基本地，否则CARDNAME须横置进场。

1071243.oracleText: This land enters tapped unless you control a basic land.
1071243.translation: 除非你操控基本地，否则此地须横置进场。

1071245.oracleText:
"The frozen tundra is treacherous, the landscape itself is an icy fortress."
—Admiral Zhao
1071245.translation:
「在冰冻苔原上行军异常危险，地貌本身俨然就是一座寒冰城池。」
～赵将军

1071246.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}: Earthbend 2. Activate only as a sorcery.

1071247.oracleText:
"The highest security prison in the Fire Nation. It's on an island in the middle of a boiling lake. It's inescapable."
—Zuko
1071247.translation:
「那是烈火国内戒备最森严的监狱，坐落在沸湖中央的孤岛上，简直插翅难飞。」
～苏科

1071249.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}: Target creature you control gains firebending 4 until end of turn.
1071249.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}：目标由你操控的生物获得振火4直到回合结束。

1071251.oracleText: The Foggy Swamp is home to many creatures and many more secrets.
1071251.translation: 雾沼当中居住着很多生灵，也藏着许多秘密。

1071253.oracleText: Where the secret ingredient truly is love.
1071253.translation: 真情投入正是其茶香配方奥秘所在。

1071254.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast an Ally spell or activate an ability of an Ally source.
1071254.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放伙伴咒语或起动伙伴来源的异能。

1071255.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 white Ally creature token.
1071255.translation: {o5}，{oT}：派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。

1071257.oracleText:
"I created Kyoshi Island so my people could be safe from invaders."
—Avatar Kyoshi
1071257.translation:
「我一手将虚子岛分离出来，保护我的子民不受外敌入侵。」
～降世神通虚子

1071259.oracleText:
"As you see, there are several pools where the water swirls around before flowing on. These pools are like our chakras."
—Guru Pathik
1071259.translation:
「如你所见，流水虽在池塘间有些许波折，但仍不断前行去向远方。我们的脉轮也是如此。」
～帕提克大师

1071261.oracleText: A shadow of its former self, a whisper of its eventual glory.
1071261.translation: 古镇往昔倒影，道尽未来繁华。

1071263.oracleText: The Northern Water Tribe knew their safety was earned through diligence and caution.
1071263.translation: 北方水族深知，唯有努力备战、提高警觉，自身安全才会得到保障。

1071265.oracleText:
"The Earth Kingdom city of Omashu! I used to always come here to visit my friend Bumi."
—Aang
1071265.translation:
「这里是土强国的奥玛舒城！我以前经常来这里找朋友布米玩。」
～安昂

1071267.oracleText: Aang delved deep into the spiraling depths in search of wherever Koh called home.
1071267.translation: 安昂深入螺旋深渊，探寻口的生息之处。

1071268.oracleText: {o3oB}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token with "This token can't block or be blocked by non-Spirit creatures."
1071268.translation: {o3oB}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能阻挡非精怪生物，也不能被前述生物阻挡。」

1071271.oracleText:
"I forget the next couple of lines, but then it goes . . . ‘Secret tunnel! Secret tunnel!' "
—Chong, nomad musician
1071271.translation:
「我忘了下面几句怎么唱了，但后面是…秘密隧道！秘密隧道！」
～游牧乐手崇

1071273.oracleText:
"The Serpent's Pass? Only the truly desperate take that deadly route!"
—Ying, Earth Kingdom refugee
1071273.translation:
「盘蛇关？那边有去无回，只有慌不择路的才会往那走！」
～土强国难民莹

1071275.oracleText: The sacred site of firebending's first spark.
1071275.translation: 振火师烧出第一缕火花的圣地。

1071277.oracleText:
"The White Lotus opens wide to those who know her secrets."
—Fung, White Lotus member
1071277.translation:
「白莲教欢迎知晓其秘密的人。」
～白莲教成员方

1071278.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Lesson or Shrine spell.
1071278.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放课程或祭祠咒语。

1071281.oracleText: Target up to one artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater.
1071281.translation: 指定至多一个由对手操控且其法术力值等于或大于3的神器、生物或结界为目标。

1071282.oracleText: Have target opponent draw three cards?
1071282.translation: 是否要令目标对手抓三张牌？

1071283.oracleText: Reveal an Ally, Equipment, or Lesson card?
1071283.translation: 是否要展示一张伙伴，武具或课程牌？

1071284.oracleText: When you discard a nonland card this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
1071284.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。当你以此法弃一张非地牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1071285.oracleText: Cast an Ally spell from among cards you own exiled with {1, CardId}?
1071285.translation: 是否要从由你拥有且以{1, CardId}放逐的牌中施放一个伙伴咒语？

1071286.translation: 选择一张非地永久物牌。

1071287.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 4 or less.
1071287.translation: 消灭目标力量等于或小于4的生物。

1071288.oracleText: Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
1071288.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

1071289.oracleText: At the beginning of your next end step, sacrifice those tokens.
1071289.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，牺牲这些衍生物。

1071290.oracleText: Search for a Lesson or Noble card.
1071290.translation: 搜寻一张课程牌或贵族牌。

1071291.oracleText: Put any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
1071291.translation: 选择任意数量目标在该牌手坟墓场中的生物牌，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于X，将这些牌从该处在你操控下放进战场。

1071292.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies this turn, you gain 1 life.
1071292.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

1071293.oracleText: Target a land creature or nonbasic land.
1071293.translation: 指定一个地生物或非基本地为目标。

1071294.oracleText: Search for a Mountain or Cave card.
1071294.translation: 搜寻一张山脉或洞窟牌。

1071295.oracleText: When you next cast a Lesson spell this turn, copy it and you may choose new targets for the copy.
1071295.translation: 当你下一次施放课程咒语时，将之复制，且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1071296.oracleText: Target an artifact or land an opponent controls.
1071296.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的神器或地为目标。

1071297.oracleText: Target creature can't block this turn.
1071297.translation: 目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

1071298.oracleText: Return up to one creature card milled this way to the battlefield.
1071298.translation: 将至多一张以此法磨掉的生物牌移回战场。

1071299.oracleText: If it has four or more quest counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains trample until end of turn.
1071299.translation: 若其上有四个或更多探索指示物，则在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

1071300.oracleText: Put a land card milled this way into your hand?
1071300.translation: 是否要将一张以此法磨掉的地牌置于你手上？

1071301.oracleText: Put a creature card with mana value 4 or less onto the battlefield?
1071301.translation: 是否要将一张法术力值等于或小于4的生物牌放进战场？

1071302.oracleText: Transform CARDNAME at the beginning of the next upkeep.
1071302.translation: 在下一个维持开始时，转化CARDNAME。

1071303.oracleText: Exile a nontoken creature you control.
1071303.translation: 放逐一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物。

1071304.oracleText: Reveal a Lesson, Saga, or Shrine card?
1071304.translation: 是否要展示一张课程，传纪或祭祠牌？

1071305.translation: 只能用于支付：课程咒语

1071307.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value less than or equal to CARDNAME's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1071307.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于CARDNAME之力量的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1071308.oracleText: Spend only on: An Ally Spell or an Ability of an Ally Source
1071308.translation: 只能用于支付：伙伴咒语或伙伴来源的异能

1071309.oracleText: Target two creatures you control that share a creature type.
1071309.translation: 指定两个由你操控具共通生物类别的生物为目标。

1071310.oracleText: Spend only on: A Lesson or Shrine Spell
1071310.translation: 只能用于支付：课程或祭祠咒语

1071319.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Choose a land to keep.} other {Choose {2, Number} lands to keep.}}
1071319.translation: {2, plural, =1 {选择一个地保留。} other {选择{2, Number}个地保留。}}

1071320.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Choose a card to keep.} other {Choose {2, Number} cards to keep.}}
1071320.translation: {2, plural, =1 {选择一张牌保留。} other {选择{2, Number}张牌保留。}}

1071321.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Choose a creature to keep.} other {Choose {2, Number} creatures to keep.}}
1071321.translation: {2, plural, =1 {选择一个生物保留。} other {选择{2, Number}个生物保留。}}

1071323.oracleText: Roll a six-sided die. 1 or 2 — [+2], then create two 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn. 3 — [-1], then return a card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand. 4 or 5 — Comet deals damage equal to the number of loyalty counters on him to a creature or player, then [-2]. 6 — [+1], and you may activate Comet's loyalty ability two more times this turn.
1071323.translation: 掷一颗六面骰。1或2 — [+2]，然后派出两个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。3 — [-1]，然后将一张法术力值等于或小于2的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。4或5 — 慧慧对一个生物或牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于其上忠诚指示物的数量，然后[-2]。6 — [+1]，且你本回合中可以额外起动慧慧的忠诚异能两次。

1071324.oracleText: Put your commander into your hand.
1071324.translation: 将你的指挥官置于你手上。

1071357.oracleText:
"He must be guilty of something or other, or he wouldn't have attempted to flee the Empire."
—Yotsuyu goe Brutus
1071357.translation:
「想逃离帝国，就说明心里有鬼。你要是真的效忠于帝国，这点小事应该能做到的吧？」
～夜露·苟·布鲁图斯

1071358.oracleText:
"We called this calamity the ‘Flood of Light.' Everything it touched was leeched of life and vigor, leaving naught behind but a luminous wasteland." 
—Moren, Crystarium Librarian
1071358.translation:
「这就是被称为光之泛滥的灾害…被光吞噬的地方生命无法存在，全都变成了空无大地。」
～水晶都图书馆员莫伦

1071359.oracleText:
"So it is you, after all, who will send me. But even after I am gone, Spira's sorrow will prevail."
—Seymour, to Yuna
1071359.translation:
「就算我消失了…史匹拉的悲伤也不会消失。」
～希摩尔对尤娜

1071360.oracleText: "Stay with me until the end. Please."

1071361.oracleText: "Strange as it may seem, the longer I linger here, the less the matter of my epitaph concerns me."
1071361.translation: 「神奇的是，即使像这样站着，也无法像以前那样去思考辞世绝句。」

1071362.oracleText:
"Don't bother going after all of them. Cut the ones that matter, and run!"
—Auron
1071362.translation:
「别想全部打倒。只砍倒挡路的家伙，一路往前冲！」
～奥隆

1071363.oracleText:
"This is your story. It all begins here."
—Auron

1071364.oracleText: "Ok, I'm going to just go ahead and say it . . ."

1071366.oracleText: Wrexsoul is formed of the countless souls lost during the conflict one thousand years past . . .
1071366.translation: 亚历魂…是在1000年前的战争中失去心灵的灵魂的集合…

1071369.oracleText: "The refreshing caress of the wind, the soothing whisper of the waves . . . how liberating!"
1071369.translation: 「在这种时候，就应该去不被任何事物所干扰的无人岛屿上，尽情地享受大自然，度过悠然自得的闲暇时光…」

1071370.oracleText:
"Sir! A mass of high-density energy is heading towards Midgar!"
—Shinra operator
1071370.translation:
「报告！大量高密度能量正朝米德加袭来！」
～神罗操作员

1071371.oracleText:
"If you are ever to become a capable astrologian, you must believe in the path laid out before you, and in your power to read it, follow it, and ultimately control it."
—Leveva Heavensreader
1071371.translation:
「如今你将要学习的是占星术士的正统知识…这是一种通过利用星辰之力发动治疗或强化魔法，使人们获得足以冲破命运桎梏之力的魔法体系。」
～观天者蕾薇瓦

1071372.oracleText:
"When Sin attacked Zanarkand that day, I woke up in Spira."
—Tidus
1071372.translation:
「在札纳尔坎德遭到『辛』袭击之后，醒来时我已经在史匹拉。」
～提达

1071374.oracleText: He knew there was no way back home, back to Zanarkand.
1071374.translation: 他因为找不到回札纳尔坎德的方法，所以觉悟了。

1071376.oracleText: The legacy of Gaius van Baelsar is a towering monument to imperial tyranny.
1071376.translation: 加雷马帝国将军盖乌斯·范·巴埃萨以「封锁被蛮神污染的区域」为由建造的巨大防壁。

1071377.oracleText: "Thou art weak, Hraesvelgr—a slithering wyrm who fawneth on the vermin who should rightly be his prey."
1071377.translation: 「太没用了，赫拉斯瓦尔格。说到底，你只不过是个向人类谄媚的懦夫。」

1071378.oracleText:
"As the fight wore on, blood began to soak through his armor, spreading to every ilm of his body. But when it began to rise and envelop him as a mist, I realized it wasn't blood, but something dark and twisted . . ."
—Ishgardian Citizen
1071378.translation:
「但是，从受到攻击的异端者剑士身上，静悄悄地流下了什么东西…一开始我以为是血呢，可滴下来的却是黑暗…简直是可怕的暗黑之力！」
～皇都的市民

1071379.oracleText:
"Great people here! You can trust everything they say!"
—Zozo resident
1071379.translation:
「这里都是老实人。」
～佐佐镇居民

1071380.oracleText: "We're gonna go into the castle through a secret cave that nobody else knows about!"
1071380.translation: 「那洞窟只有我们知道。就从那里潜入费加罗城。」

1071381.oracleText:
"The world is about to learn . . . the meaning of . . . fear . . ."
—Emperor Geshtahl
1071381.translation:
「恐怖会支配世界的…」
～格斯塔拉皇帝

1071382.oracleText:
"You can't destroy everything! People will always have dreams!"
—Terra Branford
1071382.translation:
「只要有梦想，生命就会延续下去！」
～蒂娜·布兰福德

1071383.oracleText: "Look, I finally found it . . . The legendary treasure that can undo death itself."
1071383.translation: 「我终于找到了…能唤回灵魂的传说中的秘宝…」

1071384.translation:
「这样一来，就更不像人了…」
～文森特·瓦伦丁

1071385.oracleText: "You guys are worthless, but my proud creation is a sure thing!"
1071385.translation: 「用我的绝对得意之作来对付你们，真是杀鸡用牛刀！」

1071386.oracleText: "They say you can't grow grass and flowers in Midgar. But for some reason, the flowers have no trouble blooming here."
1071386.translation: 「人人都说，米德加根本就不长花草。不过不知道为什么，花在这里却长得很好。」

1071387.oracleText: "Hah! That one looks slow," scoffed Tidus. "It's also tough. Let me handle this," replied Auron.
1071387.translation: 「嘿！这家伙看起来很迟钝！」提达嘲笑道。「但也比较耐打。你别出手。」奥隆应道。

1071388.oracleText:
"Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living."
—Auron
1071388.translation:
「你就沉睡在异界吧。史匹拉不属于亡者。」
～奥隆

1071389.oracleText:
"When it starts, I won't be myself any more. I won't be able to hold myself back."
—Jecht
1071389.translation:
「一旦开打…我就不再是我了。到时可就…没办法手下留情之类的咯！」
～杰克特

1071390.oracleText:
"Only the Ancients, only Aerith can save us from Meteor."
—Cloud Strife
1071390.translation:
「能阻止陨星的，就只有古代种…只有爱丽丝。」
～克劳德·斯特莱夫

1071392.oracleText:
"It is up to the planet to decide. What is best for the planet. What is bad for the planet. All that is bad will disappear."
—Bugenhagen
1071392.translation:
「这是由星球来决定的事。什么是对星球有益的。什么是对星球有害的。对星球有害的全都会消失。」
～布根哈根

1071393.oracleText: Skatenes are mind-quickened owls, granted sentience via powerful magicks much in the same way toads are transformed into poroggos.
1071393.translation: 为猫头鹰注入魔力创造的使魔。据说是想要利用猫头鹰的夜视能力，做出一种能在夜间对重要设施提供警备的使魔。

1071394.oracleText: On that day . . . the world was changed forever . . .

1071395.oracleText:
"Think you will win? You not forget who took your horn! Never forget!"
—Biran Ronso
1071395.translation:
「你以为你有胜算吗？应该没忘记是谁折断基马利你的角了吧？」
～比朗·隆索

1071396.oracleText: "No hard feelings, now . . . I'm just going to use this power you've unleashed to put you to sleep . . ."
1071396.translation: 「看在你跟着我这么多年的份上，就用你创造的魔法了结了你吧…」

1071397.oracleText:
"Progress requires sacrifice. Learn to live with it." 
—President Shinra
1071397.translation:
「这都是为了促进发展。狠下心去做吧。」
～神罗总裁

1071398.oracleText:
"I'm scared of lightning! Let's rest, please? Pretty please?"
—Rikku
1071398.translation:
「我真的很怕打雷啊～！休息一下嘛，好不好？拜托啦！」
～琉克

1071399.oracleText:
"Ha-ha! I'm raring to go! Can't be leaving everything up to you whippersnappers!"
—Strago Magus
1071399.translation:
「嗯！一下子就有精神了！好！我也要加油了！！」
～斯特拉格斯·马格斯

1071400.oracleText:
"Espers . . . Who'd have dreamed they were that powerful . . ."
—Imperial soldier
1071400.translation:
「幻兽…拥有那么强大的力量…」
～帝国士兵

1071401.oracleText: "This little hamlet has too much ‘boring' and not enough ‘burning' . . . Torch everything!"
1071401.translation: 「太无聊了，干脆把这村子烧了吧！」

1071402.oracleText:
"I expect some voidsent are more intelligent than others. Perhaps these ones simply do not understand our words."
—Y'shtola Rhul
1071402.translation:
「它们好像听不懂我们说的话，可能妖异的智力也存在着个体差异。」
～雅·修特拉·路尔

1071403.oracleText:
"Lord Kefka's treasure . . . Return . . . the treasure . . ."
—Kefka's cultists
1071403.translation:
「凯夫卡大人的财宝，把财宝，还回来。」
～凯夫卡的信徒

1071404.oracleText:
"To put it simply, the knowledge of the Ancients is sealed within each orb. That knowledge not only connects us to the planet . . . it allows us to tap into her power."
—Sephiroth
1071404.translation:
「…在魔晶石中，封存着古代种的知识。自由操作大地和星球力量的知识。」
～萨菲罗斯

1071405.oracleText:
"I'm a blitzball player. Star player of the Zanarkand Abes!"
—Tidus
1071405.translation:
「我是个水斗球选手，是札纳尔坎德艾普队的王牌！」
～提达

1071406.oracleText:
"I preside over the forces of stasis, tranquility, peace. I will weave this selfsame power into the crystal, granting thee mastery over matter, to give form to the formless."
—Hydaelyn
1071406.translation:
「我所支配的，是掌控停滞、沉寂、平稳的力量。可以让一切事物的存在变得稳固。我会将这份力量与阿谢姆的术式结合，使你能够为无形之物创造实体。」
～海德林

1071407.oracleText: "Sorry to keep you waiting. It's me! I'll handle the rest!"
1071407.translation: 「让你们久等了！！我凯特·西来了！剩下的事情就交给我吧！」

1071408.oracleText: "A Shinra uniform . . . I was so proud when I first put it on."
1071408.translation: 「神罗的制服…第一次穿上它的时候，我是那么的自豪。」

1071409.oracleText:
"Man thinks very highly of himself."
—Barret Wallace
1071409.translation:
「真是个自恋的家伙。」
～巴雷特·华莱士

1071410.oracleText:
"Oh dear . . . We're really in trouble this time . . ."
—The Impresario, opera house manager

1071411.oracleText: A mechanical monster equipped with a massive arsenal of weapons and attacks, including its signature Wave Cannon.
1071411.translation: 配备了各式各样招式的机械兵器，包括其招牌武器「波动炮」。

1071412.oracleText: A relic that greatly enhances the magical power of its wielder.
1071412.translation: 能大幅强化持用者魔导之力的遗宝。

1071413.oracleText:
"A smile better suits a hero."
—Haurchefant Greystone
1071413.translation:
「英雄…可不应该…露出悲伤的…表情…」
～奥尔什方·灰石

1071414.oracleText:
"You can gain all kinds of abilities by equipping relics."
 —South Figaro merchant
1071414.translation:
「装备上饰品后，就能获得许多相应的能力。」
～南费加罗商人

1071415.oracleText:
"The imperials have not gained any ground since our last battle, but neither have we."
—Ala Mhigan resistance fighter
1071415.translation:
「战线目前仍处于胶着状态。」
～阿拉米格解放军战士

1071416.oracleText:
"After we lost the war, we got peace, but with that, we lost something else. Now look at Wutai . . ."
—Yuffie Kisaragi
1071416.translation:
「战争失败以后，我们得到了和平，可是，我们也失去了很多东西。看看现在的五台…」
～尤菲·如月

1071417.oracleText:
"With Gunnhildr's Blades and the Warrior of Light leading the charge, it is only a matter of time before Castrum Lacus Litore is ours."
—Bajsaljen Ulgasch
1071417.translation:
「帝国湖岸堡原本是为抵抗帝国进攻而建的城塞，名为阿拉木特。」
～白沙恩·乌尔嘉失

1071418.oracleText: Eight dragons seal away its awesome might; the might of the one called "Crusader." And when the eight shall fall, the one again shall rise.
1071418.translation: 「将这强大的力量封印在八只龙体内。其名为末日…打倒八龙，唤醒力量…」

1071419.oracleText:
"The maze that surrounds the base of the tower is known as the ‘Labyrinth of the Ancients.'"
—G'raha Tia
1071419.translation:
「围绕着水晶塔的这一片遗构，也就是俗称的『古代人迷宫』。」
～古·拉哈·提亚

1071420.oracleText:
"They were storing an awful lot of flame rods in there . . ."
—Thamasa elder
1071420.translation:
「这房子里堆了好多火焰棒…」
～萨玛莎村长老

1071421.oracleText: Many attractions await you here at the Gold Saucer. You will be moved and excited, thrilled and terrified!
1071421.translation: 金碟游乐园内设有各式各样的游乐设施。感动、兴奋、刺激、悬疑，为您带来全新体验！

1071422.oracleText:
"Legend has it that the Phoenix turned itself to stone ages ago . . . It seems the story was true."
—Locke Cole
1071422.translation:
「传说，不死鸟会把自己变成石头，没想到这是真的…」
～洛克·科尔

1071423.oracleText:
"The entire river glows, like a sea of stars."
—Lulu
1071423.translation:
「整条河闪闪发光，就像星海一样。」
～露露

1071424.oracleText: A butterfly will lead the way to secret things.
1071424.translation: 蝴蝶将引领旅人走向秘密…

1071425.oracleText:
"The Empire is snuffing out Returners wherever it finds them. We must find a way to strike back before it's too late . . ."
—Returner soldier
1071425.translation:
「由于帝国的攻击，各地的回归者处于支离破碎的状态。必须要赶快找到反击的机会了…」
～回归者士兵

1071426.translation:
「这是…萨菲罗斯干的吗？」
～克劳德·斯特莱夫

1071427.oracleText: In order to reach the Sealed Gate and enter the land of the espers, one must brave a volcanic dungeon, fraught with vile monsters.
1071427.translation: 若要抵达封魔壁并进入幻兽界，必须勇闯火山迷宫，面对其中无数邪恶的怪物。

1071428.oracleText:
"A shining monument to corporate greed. One of these days I'm gonna tear it down and burn the rubble."
—Barret Wallace
1071428.translation:
「真让人不爽。总有一天我要粉碎这些亮晶晶的墙壁。」
～巴雷特·华莱士

1071429.oracleText: The legendary treasure sleeps where the mountains form a star.
1071429.translation: 秘宝沉睡在组成星形的群山之中。

1071430.oracleText: Haunting the depths of what is now Loch Seld, Skalla's silent walls lure adventurers into the salt-laden waters with the promise of mysteries unsolved and treasures unclaimed.
1071430.translation: 成功解放了阿拉米格的光之战士们为了寻求新的冒险和隐藏的宝藏，将前往沉睡于盐湖湖底那座经历了悲惨命运的古老遗迹。

1071431.oracleText:
"Are you heading for Kilika Temple? Then just follow this trail. There are poisonous fiends in the forest. Be on your guard!"
—Crusader captain
1071431.translation:
「你们是要去基利卡寺院参拜吗？想去寺院的话，就走那条兽道吧。森林里也会出现有毒的怪物。可别大意了啊！」
～讨伐队队长

1071432.oracleText:
"First down the Moonflow to the Guado city of Guadosalam . . . then we cross the Thunder Plains to the temple of Macalania."
—Lulu
1071432.translation:
「顺幻光河而下之后，就到古阿多族的古阿多萨拉姆。之后是穿越落雷平原到马卡拉尼亚寺院…」
～露露

1071433.oracleText: Remiem Temple. Once a great religious center in the Calm Lands, lost after the battle with Sin.
1071433.translation: 瑞米恩寺院。以前这里是那基平原的中心，但与「辛」交战过后就成了遗迹。

1071434.oracleText: Kilika Temple is the temple of fire. Even the Cloister of Trials is engulfed in flames. Those who disobey the precepts and enter unsanctioned may forfeit their lives.
1071434.translation: 我们基利卡寺院是炎之寺院，就连试炼室也覆盖在烈焰之中。没有资格进入的人要是打破了禁忌进去，也许会因此而送命。

1071435.oracleText: For years, it was not known how the pirates were able to raid areas so far from the coast, until a local shepherd sighted a band of painted ruffians entering the Sastasha Seagrot . . .
1071435.translation: 又有情报说在沙斯塔夏溶洞中有可疑人士出没，这样一来互相的联系就很明显了…

1071436.oracleText:
"Come, summoner. I will bestow you with my power: the Dark Aeon, Anima."
—Seymour's mother
1071436.translation:
「请过来，召唤士。就将我的力量献给你吧。黑暗的召唤兽～『阿尼玛』。」
～希摩尔的母亲

1071437.oracleText: "Monsters instinctively target weaker prey," said Cloud. "Hmm . . . you'd better watch out then," Aerith teased.
1071437.translation: 「那种怪物会先攻击弱者。」克劳德说。「嗯…那你得多加小心了。」爱丽丝打趣道。

1071439.oracleText: Target a creature you control. You may move a counter from that creature.
1071439.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物为目标，你可以移动该生物上的一个指示物。

1071440.oracleText: Target a second creature you control. You may move a counter to that creature.
1071440.translation: 指定第二个由你操控的生物为目标，你可以将一个指示物移动到该生物上。

1071529.oracleText: There's a legend that tells of an ancient battle between the esper Odin and a powerful magus . . . It took place in the great hall of a castle.
1071529.translation: 有这么一个传说…魔导士与幻兽奥丁在殿堂展开殊死搏斗…

1071530.oracleText:
"Welcome to the new world order."
—Rufus Shinra
1071530.translation:
「新时代即将揭开序幕。」
～路法斯·神罗

1071532.oracleText:
"When Sin is defeated here, the Calm will visit Spira once more. That's why this place is now known as the Calm Lands."
—Scholar Maechen
1071532.translation:
「『辛』就是在这块土地上被打倒，让那基节降临于史匹拉。所以这里叫做那基平原。这是大家不约而同取的名字。」
～学者梅辰

1071533.oracleText:
"This here's Mideel. It's a quiet little hot springs town. Just the perfect place for old folks like us to live out our lives."
—Mideel resident
1071533.translation:
「这儿是米迪卢，一个宁静的温泉度假村。像我这种老家伙，在这个地方养老是再好不过了！」
～米迪卢居民

1071534.oracleText:
"Our mission is to survey a run-down reactor."
—Sephiroth
1071534.translation:
「这次的任务是调查老化的魔晄炉。据说它不但有异常情况，而且还会制造出凶残的怪物。」
～萨菲罗斯

1071538.oracleText:
"Both the Crusaders and the Al Bhed truly wish peace for Spira. This Operation Mi'hen was born from that wish they share."
—Seymour Guado
1071538.translation:
「讨伐队和阿尔贝德族都一样真心希望史匹拉能够和平。正是他们纯朴的心愿一致，才实现了这次的米海恩行动。」
～希摩尔·古阿多

1071544.oracleText:
"We've been fighting Shinra on this battlefield for a long time. We've settled in for a long war."
—Fort Condor villager
1071544.translation:
「我们在这里跟神罗作战，已经很久了。现在陷入了苦战。」
～秃鹰堡垒村民

1071545.oracleText:
"It sure helped having Cid here. I had no idea he could drive a train . . ."
—Red XIII
1071545.translation:
「西德在确实管用，连火车都会开！」
～赤红XIII

1071546.oracleText: For as long as their nation has warred with Dravania, there have been Ishgardians who instead chose to ally themselves with the dragons. Shiva is said to have been among the first, hence why the heretics revere her as a saint.
1071546.translation: 魔女希瓦，在伊修加德正教的眼中，是史上第一位与龙族勾结的大罪人，因此也得到了「异端之母」的称谓。

1071549.oracleText:
"This is where I was born. I started blitz when I was five. I joined the Aurochs at thirteen . . . ten years ago. Ten years . . . and we never won a game."
—Wakka
1071549.translation:
「我在那里出生。从5岁就开始打水斗球了呢。进入比塞德野牛队是13岁那年…也就是说总共有10年的选手经验。不过，努力了10年，我在大会中一次都没有赢过。」
～瓦卡

1071550.oracleText: This is the Sealed Gate . . . Beyond there is the esper world.
1071550.translation: 这就是封魔壁…里面就是幻兽界…

1071555.oracleText:
"The excitement here has reached a fever pitch as the opening ceremony gets under way!" 
—Blitzball announcer
1071555.translation:
「开幕式就要开始，气氛非常热络！」
～水斗球主播

1071556.oracleText:
"Hydatos, a reference to its watery disposition. This will be the last corner of the island that the expedition will need to contend with."
—Eureka expedition ferryman
1071556.translation:
「调查队决定将据点所在的地区命名为丰水地带。…这将是在那座岛屿调查的最后的地区吧。」
～优雷卡探险队摆渡人

1071557.oracleText:
"You're not really going to see the dead, more like your memories of them. They take on the form of the dead person—an illusion, nothing else."
—Rikku
1071557.translation:
「其实那不是去见亡者，而是去见回忆的地方。幻光虫会形成人的形貌～简单来说，那只是幻影而已。」
～琉克

1071560.oracleText:
"So this is the power of the Warring Triad! With this and my magicite . . . the world will be mine to command!"
—Emperor Gestahl
1071560.translation:
「这就是三斗神的力量！有了它，再加上魔石的力量！世界就是我的啦！！」
～格斯塔拉皇帝

1071561.oracleText: "The Burn"—once a verdant region teeming with flora and fauna, repeated summonings saw it bled of aether and reduced to a barren desert.
1071561.translation: 这一带曾因接连不断的请神使得环境以太极度枯竭，现在这片被摧毁殆尽的大地被称为终末焦土。

1071564.oracleText: Reports of bloody carnage have reached the Crystarium, and the guard has deployed in force in answer to Holminster's plea for aid.
1071564.translation: 有报告说水滩村被食罪灵袭击。据报敌人数量众多，甚至有可能整个村子都会被消灭！

1071569.oracleText:
"Ah, our guests have arrived!"
—Aenc Thon, Lord of the Lingering Gaze
1071569.translation:
「哎呀哎呀，是客人来了吗？那得好好欢迎才行啊！」
～美眼因克·佐恩

1071570.oracleText:
"I wish I could live in a place like this. Peaceful . . . living with a smile on my face every day."
—Yuna
1071570.translation:
「要是能在这样平静的世界里每天笑眯眯地过日子那就好了…」
～尤娜

1071575.oracleText: Put any number of Equipment cards onto the battlefield?
1071575.translation: 是否要将任意数量的武具牌放进战场？

1071576.oracleText: Attach to a Samurai you control?
1071576.translation: 是否要将其贴附在一个由你操控的武士上？

1071578.oracleText: Choose a number of additional lore counters to put on it.
1071578.translation: 选择要在其上放置的额外学问指示物数量。

1071581.translation: 是否要抓一张牌并增殖？

1071585.oracleText: Hero of Light's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
1071585.translation: 光之英雄的力量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

1071586.oracleText: When Terra Branford enters, create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
1071586.translation: 当蒂娜·布兰福德进场时，派出一个0/0无色组构体衍生神器生物，且具有「你每操控一个神器，此衍生物便得+1/+1。」

1071587.oracleText: When Master Xande enters, return target spell or permanent to its owner's hand.
1071587.translation: 当赞德大师进场时，将目标咒语或永久物移回其拥有者手上。

1071588.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, or a creature card is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, or a creature card leaves your graveyard, Golbez deals 1 damage to each opponent.
1071588.translation: 每当另一个生物死去，或一张生物牌从战场以外的任何区域进入坟墓场，或一张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，高贝扎向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

1071589.oracleText: When Gilgamesh enters, you may search your library for an Equipment card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
1071589.translation: 当吉尔伽美什进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张武具牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

1071590.oracleText: Whenever Gilgamesh attacks for the first time each turn, untap it and all Samurai you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
1071590.translation: 每当吉尔伽美什每回合首度攻击时，重置它和所有由你操控的武士。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

1071591.oracleText: As long as your devotion to red is less than five, Kefka Palazzo isn't a creature.
1071591.translation: 只要你的红色献力小于五，凯夫卡便不是生物。

1071592.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, Kefka Palazzo deals 2 damage to each opponent.
1071592.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，凯夫卡向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

1071593.oracleText: When Garnet Til Alexandros 17th enters, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment.
1071593.translation: 当嘉妮特·提尔·亚历山德罗斯十七世进场时，消灭至多一个目标神器或结界。

1071594.oracleText: Whenever you cast a black spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Emet-Selch.
1071594.translation: 每当你施放黑色咒语时，在爱梅特塞尔克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1071595.oracleText: Whenever Vaan attacks, create a Treasure token.
1071595.translation: 每当梵恩攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

1071596.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Treasure, Vaan gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
1071596.translation: 每当你牺牲一个珍宝时，梵恩得+1/+0直到回合结束。

1071597.oracleText: Thrum of the Vestige deals 3 damage to any target.
1071597.translation: 异迹嗡鸣对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

1071598.oracleText: Exile target card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile Dawn Warriors' Legacy.
1071598.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐晓之战士的遗泽。

1071599.oracleText: Whenever Zidane Tribal deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token and exile the top card of that player's library. Until end of turn, you may cast that card.
1071599.translation: 每当吉坦对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物并放逐该牌手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

1071600.oracleText: Whenever Hugo Kupka enters or attacks, target creature you control gains double strike and lifelink until end of turn.
1071600.translation: 每当胡戈·库普卡进场或攻击时，目标由你操控的生物获得连击与系命异能直到回合结束。

1071601.oracleText: Eminence — Whenever another nontoken Wizard you control enters, if Kuja is in the command zone or on the battlefield, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that Wizard. The token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.

1073309.oracleText: Target creature can't block this turn.
1073309.translation: 目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

1073310.oracleText: Target up to one nonland permanent card from a graveyard.
1073310.translation: 指定至多一张坟墓场中的非地永久物牌为目标。

1073311.oracleText: Spend only on: Spells From Exile
1073311.translation: 只能用于支付：放逐区的咒语

1073312.oracleText: Target a non-Equipment artifact you control.
1073312.translation: 指定一个由你操控且非武具的神器为目标。

1073313.oracleText: Another target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn.
1073313.translation: 另一个目标进行攻击的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

1073314.oracleText: Return a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.
1073314.translation: 将一个由你操控的且已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上。

1073316.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if it was cast, target opponent creates a token that's a copy of it.
1073316.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若它经牌手施放，则目标对手派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。

1073317.oracleText: When this artifact enters, if it was cast, target opponent creates a token that's a copy of it.
1073317.translation: 当此神器进场时，若它经牌手施放，则目标对手派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。

1073318.oracleText: Whenever an opponent who controls an artifact named Wedding Ring draws a card during their turn, you draw a card.
1073318.translation: 每当任一操控名称为婚戒的神器之对手于其回合中抓一张牌时，你抓一张牌。

1073319.oracleText: Whenever an opponent who controls an artifact named Wedding Ring gains life during their turn, you gain that much life.
1073319.translation: 每当任一操控名称为婚戒的神器之对手于其回合中获得生命时，你获得等量的生命。

1073320.oracleText:
"Your attack has been rendered harmless. It is, however, quite pretty."
—Saprazzan vizier
1073320.translation:
「虽然你的攻击已化为乌有，但看来仍十分炫丽。」
～萨帕佐领主

1073321.oracleText: Whenever Lorthos attacks, you may pay {o8}. If you do, tap up to eight target permanents. Those permanents don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.
1073321.translation: 每当罗佐司攻击时，你可以支付{o8}。若你如此作，则横置至多八个目标永久物。这些永久物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

1073322.oracleText: "When you learn to read the tides of fate, it's easy to catch the outcomes you desire."
1073322.translation: 「当你学会解读命运浪潮之后，便能轻松抓到你想要的结果。」

1073323.oracleText: The spineworms' venom contains a powerful anesthetic, allowing victims to stay conscious and watch as their bodies are stripped to the bone.
1073323.translation: 拟脊虫的毒液具有强烈麻醉效果，让受害者能够眼睁睁地看着自己的躯体被啃至白骨。

1073325.oracleText: Destroy target creature. If that creature dies this way, its controller creates two tokens that are copies of that creature, except their power is half that creature's power and their toughness is half that creature's toughness. Round up each time.
1073325.translation: 消灭目标生物。如果该生物以此法死去，则其操控者派出两个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，但它们的力量均为该生物力量的一半，且它们的防御力也均为该生物防御力的一半。各数量小数点后均进位。

1073326.oracleText: Cast this spell only during combat on your turn.
1073326.translation: 只能于你回合的战斗中施放此咒语。

1073327.oracleText: Every movement is a summons—even your screams.
1073327.translation: 一举一动都是召唤～你的尖叫也是。

1073328.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifact creatures you control attack, Alibou deals X damage to any target and you scry X, where X is the number of tapped artifacts you control.
1073328.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个神器生物攻击时，阿力布对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，且你占卜X，X为由你操控且已横置的神器数量。

1073334.translation: 指定一张反派牌为目标。

1073336.oracleText: {o1oBoB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie in addition to its other types. Shuffle the exiled card into its owner's library. Activate only as a sorcery.
1073336.translation: {o1oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它是4/4黑色灵俑，且仍具有原本类别。将所放逐的牌洗入其拥有者的牌库。只能于法术时机起动。

1073337.oracleText: Target creature card in your graveyard perpetually gains "{o1oBoB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie in addition to its other types. Shuffle the exiled card into its owner's library. Activate only as a sorcery."
1073337.translation: 目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌永久获得「{o1oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它是4/4黑色灵俑，且仍具有原本类别。将所放逐的牌洗入其拥有者的牌库。只能于法术时机起动。」

1073338.oracleText: Put a permanent card with mana value less than or equal to {2, Number} onto the battlefield?
1073338.translation: 是否要将一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的永久物牌放进战场？

1073510.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Mill {2, Number} card} other {Mill {2, Number} cards}}?
1073510.translation: {2, plural, =1 {磨{2, Number}张牌} other {磨{2, Number}张牌}}？

1073511.oracleText: When Sephiroth enters, reveal the top ten cards of your library. For each card type, you may put a card of that type from among the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. (Artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, instant, land, planeswalker, and sorcery are card types.)
1073511.translation: 当萨菲罗斯进场时，展示你牌库顶的十张牌。对每种牌张类别而言，你可以将一张为该类别的牌从所展示牌之中置于你手上。将其余的以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。（牌张类别包括神器、战役、生物、结界、瞬间、地、鹏洛客以及法术。）

1073513.oracleText: Giant of Babil enters tapped and doesn't untap during your untap step.
1073513.translation: 巴别巨人须横置进场，且于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

1073514.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, untap Giant of Babil.
1073514.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，重置巴别巨人。

1073515.oracleText: Whenever this Vehicle attacks or blocks, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.‎
1073515.translation: 每当此载具进攻或阻挡时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。

1073580.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard this card: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
1073580.translation: {o1oU}，弃掉此牌：检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

1074734.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Move a counter from target permanent you control onto a second target permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
1074734.translation: {o1}，{oT}：将一个指示物从目标由你操控的永久物移到第二个目标永久物上。只能于法术时机起动。

1075112.oracleText: When Mu Yanling enters, create a 3/2 colorless Vehicle artifact token with crew 1.
1075112.translation: 当沐燕灵进场时，派出一个3/2无色，具搭载1的载具衍生神器。

1076168.oracleText: Cast a noncreature spell from your hand without paying its mana cost?
1076168.translation: 是否要不支付其法术力费用从你手上施放一个非生物咒语？

1076174.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, you earthbend 4.
1076174.translation: 当该生物死去时，你运土4。

1076192.oracleText: Up to one target creature you control fights target creature an opponent controls.
1076192.translation: 至多一个目标由你操控的生物与目标由对手操控的生物互斗。

1076200.oracleText: Exile up to one noncreature, nonland card.
1076200.translation: 放逐至多一张既非生物也非地的牌。

1076203.oracleText: Choose a number of additional lore counters to put on the created token.
1076203.translation: 选择要在派出衍生物上放置的额外学问指示物数量。

1076208.oracleText: Tap a creature to add charge counters equal to its power.
1076208.translation: 横置一个生物依其力量放置等量的充电指示物。

1076209.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step on your next turn, sacrifice that token.
1076209.translation: 在你下一个回合的结束步骤开始时，牺牲该衍生物。

1077191.translation: 是否要牺牲任意数量的地？

1077204.oracleText: Exile this at the beginning of the next end step. You may cast it from exile on a later turn.
1077204.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时将此放逐，过了该回合后，你可以从放逐区施放之。

1078040.oracleText: Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.
1078040.translation: 僧侣嘉措教了安昂许多事，最重要的是要快乐地生活。

1078042.oracleText:
"I guess you've never fought an Airbender before."
—Aang
1078042.translation:
「我猜你从没跟截气师交过手。」
～安昂

1078043.oracleText: Target blocking creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
1078043.translation: 目标由你操控且进行阻挡的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

1078045.oracleText: Even Firebenders hate fire ants, so the Sun Warriors ensure the sloths are free to eat their fill.
1078045.translation: 就连振火师也讨厌火蚁，所以太阳武士会确保树懒能尽情饱餐。

1078047.oracleText: Jet's Freedom Fighters are a dangerous band whose strength lies in three things: their purpose, their numbers, and their bond.
1078047.translation: 杰的自由战士是一支危险的队伍，而他们的力量源自三个基石：他们的信念，他们的数量，还有他们的系绊。

1078048.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token.
1078048.translation: 当此结界进场时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。

1078051.oracleText: A sky bison is a companion for life.
1078051.translation: 飞天野牛与旅伴终身相随。

1078052.oracleText: Whenever Appa attacks, another target attacking creature without flying gains flying until end of turn.
1078052.translation: 每当阿柏攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击且不具飞行异能的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1078054.oracleText: "Calm down. It's going to be okay."

1078055.oracleText: When Katara enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
1078055.translation: 当卡塔拉进场时，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1078057.oracleText: Kyoshi Warrior drills are designed to encourage individual discipline as well as uncompromising trust in their fellow warriors.
1078057.translation: 虚子武士的训练旨在培养个人纪律意识，以及对战友不可动摇的信任。

1078059.oracleText:
"Where's Momo?"
—A common query among Team Avatar
1078059.translation:
「模模去哪了？」
～神通小队的常见疑问

1078060.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, he deals 4 damage to target tapped creature an opponent controls.
1078060.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，他对目标由对手操控且已横置的生物造成4点伤害。

1078061.oracleText: When Momo enters, he deals 4 damage to target tapped creature an opponent controls.
1078061.translation: 当模模进场时，他对目标由对手操控且已横置的生物造成4点伤害。

1078063.oracleText: Otter-penguins often play with humans, carrying them on their backs as they sled down snowy embankments.
1078063.translation: 企鹅獭常与人类玩耍，背着他们滑下积雪的路堤。

1078064.oracleText: {o3}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
1078064.translation: {o3}：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1078066.oracleText: "It's important that you show no fear when you face a Firebender."
1078066.translation: 「你们面对振火师时，最重要的是不能流露出惧意。」

1078068.oracleText: Wolf Cove's snow fort doubles as Sokka's watchtower and a playground for Water Tribe children.
1078068.translation: 狼湾的雪堡既是索卡的岗哨，也是水善族孩子们的游乐场。

1078070.oracleText: Life is simply slower in the snow. Nobody knows that better than the villagers of Wolf Cove.
1078070.translation: 雪中的生活总归会慢一些。没有谁比狼湾村民更清楚这一点。

1078072.oracleText: Her judgment was swift and final . . . and rather rude.
1078072.translation: 她的判断高效且不容辩驳…但尤为粗暴。

1078073.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. Draw a card, then discard a card.
1078073.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

1078076.oracleText: Schools of dolphin-fish follow Fire Nation vessels, hoping to score an easy meal from broken nets.
1078076.translation: 成群的海豚鱼尾随着烈火国船只，希望从破损的渔网中捡到便宜的大餐。

1078078.oracleText: A place of infinite wonders and endless perils.
1078078.translation: 无限奇观与无尽险境并存之地。

1078079.oracleText: Return up to one target creature to its owner's hand. Create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token with "This token can't block or be blocked by non-Spirit creatures."
1078079.translation: 将至多一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物，且具有「此衍生物不能阻挡非精怪生物，也不能被前述生物阻挡。」

1078081.oracleText:
"I think I just figured out why they call it the Serpent's Pass!"
—Sokka
1078081.translation:
「我总算知道为什么这里叫盘蛇关了！」
～索卡

1078084.oracleText: Their underwater ice caves weave throughout the north pole, providing traversal for those willing to brave the cold.
1078084.translation: 它们的水下冰洞遍布北极，可供勇于挑战冰寒者穿越其间。

1078086.oracleText: "The key is getting the wrist movement right."
1078086.translation: 「诀窍就在于手腕动作要做对。」

1078087.oracleText: Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands. Draw two cards.
1078087.translation: 将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。抓两张牌。

1078090.oracleText:
"The rats that scurried across the floor of my cage were nothing more than skins filled with liquid."
—Hama
1078090.translation:
「在我笼子底板上乱窜的老鼠，不过是装满液体的皮囊罢了。」
～哈玛

1078094.oracleText: "The Fire Nation shall be victorious by any means necessary."
1078094.translation: 「烈火国必将胜利，为此可尽一切必要手段。」

1078095.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
1078095.translation: 每当一个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1078097.oracleText: For any creature to survive in the Si Wong Desert, they must be hardworking, extremely opportunistic, or both.
1078097.translation: 生物要想在死亡沙漠中活下去，要么刻苦拼搏，要么极度投机，亦或是两者兼具。

1078099.oracleText: Fire Nation circuses captivate audiences with even more captive animals.
1078099.translation: 烈火国马戏团俘获观众的手段，便是俘获来更多的动物。

1078100.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and draw a card.
1078100.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手失去过生命，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

1078101.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card. (Damage causes loss of life.)
1078101.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手失去过生命，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

1078104.oracleText: Useful for whipping up a fictional plague in a pinch.
1078104.translation: 应急时，可用来快速伪装出一场假冒的瘟疫。

1078105.oracleText: {o2oB}, Tap an untapped creature you control: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
1078105.translation: {o2oB}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物：将此牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

1078107.oracleText: Fire Nation guards rely more on fear than fire.
1078107.translation: 烈火国警卫倚赖恐惧更甚于烈火。

1078110.translation: 高贵的乘客需要高贵的交通工具。

1078112.oracleText:
"You're not to blow the dam until I give the signal."
—Jet
1078112.translation:
「在我发出信号之前，你可别炸掉水坝。」
～杰

1078113.oracleText: Explosive Shot deals 4 damage to target creature.
1078113.translation: 爆破射击对目标生物造成4点伤害。

1078115.oracleText: {o5}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent. Create a 2/2 red Soldier creature token.
1078115.translation: {o5}：CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。派出一个2/2红色士兵衍生生物。

1078116.oracleText: {o5}: This creature deals 2 damage to each opponent. Create a 2/2 red Soldier creature token.
1078116.translation: {o5}：此生物向每位对手各造成2点伤害。派出一个2/2红色士兵衍生生物。

1078118.oracleText: Fire Nation soldiers spread like wildfire during the Hundred Year War.
1078118.translation: 烈火国士兵在百年大战期间如野火般蔓延。

1078120.oracleText:
"Come out, Avatar! You can't hide from me forever."
—Zuko
1078120.translation:
「出来吧，降世神通！ 你不可能永远躲着我。」
～苏科

1078122.oracleText: "Pride is not the opposite of shame, but its source. True humility is the only antidote to shame."
1078122.translation: 「骄傲并非羞耻的反面，而是其源头。真正的谦逊才是羞耻的唯一解药。」

1078123.oracleText: Whenever Iroh attacks, attacking creatures get +1/+1 until end of turn.
1078123.translation: 每当艾洛攻击时，进行攻击的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

1078126.oracleText: The Komodo Rhino embodies the spirit of Fire Nation soldiers. They are aggressive, disciplined, and feared.
1078126.translation: 科莫多犀牛正体现了烈火国士兵的精神。它们气势汹汹，严守纪律，且令人畏惧。

1078128.oracleText: "You wish to speak to Avatar Roku. I can take you to him."
1078128.translation: 「你想见降世神通罗库。我可以带你去。」

1078130.oracleText: Though Avatar Roku mastered all four elements, nothing seemed to quell a brewing conflict like a sun-sized ball of fire.
1078130.translation: 降世神通罗库精通全部四种元素，但要论平息争端，大概没什么比得过一颗太阳大的火球。

1078131.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature. If X is 4 or greater, scry 2.
1078131.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害。如果X等于或大于4，则占卜2。

1078132.oracleText: Roku's Mastery deals X damage to target creature. If X is 4 or greater, scry 2.
1078132.translation: 罗库的奇技对目标生物造成X点伤害。如果X等于或大于4，则占卜2。

1078134.oracleText: "For the glory of the Fire Nation!"

1078138.oracleText: "Once I deliver the Avatar to my father, he will welcome me home with honor and restore my rightful place on the throne."
1078138.translation: 「只要我将降世神通送到父亲手中，他就会带着荣耀迎我回家，并恢复我理应拥有的王位。」

1078139.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red spell, create a 2/2 red Soldier creature token.
1078139.translation: 每当你施放红色咒语时，派出一个2/2红色士兵衍生生物。

1078142.oracleText: Zuko's Offense deals 2 damage to any target.
1078142.translation: 苏科进犯对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

1078145.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put two +1/+1 counters on each land creature you control.
1078145.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个由你操控的地生物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1078146.oracleText: Whenever Bumi attacks, put two +1/+1 counters on each land creature you control.
1078146.translation: 每当布米攻击时，在每个由你操控的地生物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

1078150.oracleText:
"Nothing runs faster over land or swims quicker than a giant eel-hound."
—Master Piandao
1078150.translation:
「在陆上没有什么东西比巨大的鳗猎犬跑得更快，也没有什么比它游得更快。」
～劈黯道大师

1078151.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
1078151.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

1078152.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
1078152.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

1078155.oracleText: Some of the mysterious croaking and chittering heard in the Foggy Swamp can be traced back to frog-squirrels, who hop along the canopy and snack on giant insects.
1078155.translation: 雾沼中的一些神秘蛙鸣与吱叫出自蛙松鼠之口，它们在树冠间跳跃，以巨型昆虫为食。

1078158.oracleText: While hippo-cows are relatively docile, wise farmers still prefer to keep a safe distance.
1078158.translation: 河马牛性情相对温顺，但明智的农夫仍会保持安全距离。

1078160.oracleText:
"Here's your chance, Earthbenders! Take it! Your fate is in your own hands!"
—Katara
1078160.translation:
「运土师们，机会来了！把握住！你们的命运掌握在自己手中！」
～卡塔拉

1078166.translation: 没有什么东西能比猪面猴更野蛮。

1078167.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物和目标由对手操控的生物。如果该由你操控的生物力量等于或大于4，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后这些生物互斗。

1078183.translation: {oT}，从公爵上移去一个指示物：在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

1078185.translation: 多亏了卡塔拉，本该用作敌舰燃料的煤炭转而点燃了囚犯的解放之火。

1078191.oracleText:

1078196.translation: 「你惦记的应该不止我的蛋糕制作古法，是吧，安昂？」

1078201.translation: 除非反抗军强臂矮人上有+1/+1指示物，否则他不能单独进行攻击。

1078203.translation: 索卡精通剑术，就如朋友们精通元素之力一般。

1078204.oracleText: Equipment spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each Ally you control.
1078204.translation: 你每操控一个伙伴，你施放的武具咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

1078210.translation: 「绸编象征着我们血脉中流淌的英勇之血。金徽象征着战士心中的光荣。」

1078213.translation: 雨水灌满阿柏的脚印，模模的心也被绝望填满。

1086479.oracleText: {o1}: Ademi gains flying until end of turn.
1086479.translation: {o1}：阿德米获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1086489.translation: 当伊兹缇进场时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1086492.oracleText: When Generous Betty Wray enters, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature.

1086493.oracleText: Whenever Generous Betty Wray attacks, target modified creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
1086493.translation: 每当慷慨的贝蒂雷攻击时，目标由你操控且有饰装的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

1086501.oracleText: When Surris enters, create a 2/1 green Spider creature token with reach.
1086501.translation: 当苏里进场时，派出一个2/1绿色，具延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

1086502.oracleText: {o1oGoWoU}: Transform Surris. Activate only as a sorcery.
1086502.translation: {o1oGoWoU}：转化苏里。只能于法术时机起动。

1086505.oracleText: When Verilax enters, if he was cast, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
1086505.translation: 当维里拉司进场时，若他经施放，则将目标生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1086506.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to Verilax, prevent that damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on him.
1086506.translation: 如果维里拉司将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并在他上面放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

1086512.oracleText: When Argyr enters, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
1086512.translation: 当厄哲进场时，将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

1086519.oracleText: {o1oUoBoR}: Transform Goben. Activate only as a sorcery.

1086523.oracleText: Whenever you cast a blue spell, if Belion is a creature, he gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
1086523.translation: 每当你施放蓝色咒语时，若贝利翁是生物，则他得+1/+1直到回合结束。

1086526.oracleText: Whenever you draw your first or second card each turn, put an ingenuity counter on Merata.
1086526.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第一或第二张牌时，在梅拉塔上放置一个精妙指示物。

1086527.oracleText: {oT}: You may cast an artifact spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to the number of ingenuity counters on Merata without paying its mana cost.
1086527.translation: {oT}：你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于梅拉塔上精妙指示物数量的神器咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

1086532.oracleText: As long as there are eight or more cards in your graveyard, Ozor has base power and toughness 8/8.
1086532.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，奥泽的基础力量与防御力便为8/8。

1086533.oracleText: As long as you control another Villain, Ozor has hexproof.
1086533.translation: 只要你操控另一个反派，奥泽便具有辟邪异能。

1086535.oracleText: Conceal — Until end of turn, target creature you control becomes a Citizen with base power and toughness 1/1 and gains hexproof.
1086535.translation: 隐瞒～直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物成为基础力量与防御力为1/1的市民，且获得辟邪异能。

1086537.oracleText: Reveal — Until end of turn, target creature you control becomes a Hero with base power and toughness 3/4 and gains flying and vigilance.
1086537.translation: 公开～直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物成为基础力量与防御力为3/4的英雄，且获得飞行与警戒异能。

1086539.oracleText:
Choose one —

1086543.oracleText: You may have Vazin enter as a copy of a creature you control, except his name is Vazin, Two-Faced Trickster.
1086543.translation: 你可以使瓦津当成任一由你操控的生物之复制品来进入战场，但他的名称仍是双面诈术师瓦津。

1086546.oracleText: When The Watcher on the Road enters, create a 3/3 blue Illusion Villain creature token for each nontoken Villain you control. Exile those tokens when The Watcher on the Road leaves the battlefield.
1086546.translation: 当拦路看守人进场时，你每操控一个非衍生物的反派，便派出一个3/3蓝色虚影／反派衍生生物。当拦路看守人离开战场时，放逐这些衍生物。

1086555.oracleText: Whenever Egrix attacks, until end of turn, you may look at the top card of your library any time and you may play cards from the top of your library. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost.
1086555.translation: 每当伊格锐司攻击时，直到回合结束，你可以随时检视你的牌库顶牌，且你可以从你的牌库顶使用牌。如果你以此法施放咒语，则支付等同于其法术力值的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

1086560.translation: 路易斯进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物。

1086561.translation: 当路易斯进场时，他向目标对手造成X点伤害。

1086566.translation: 犯罪头目斯科维阿姆斯

1086570.translation: 依格十字路执行者维果

1086571.translation: 当维果进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于1的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

1086572.oracleText: {o3oBoRoG}: Transform Viggo. Activate only as a sorcery.
1086572.translation: {o3oBoRoG}：转化维果。只能于法术时机起动。

1086574.translation: 每当维果攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则抓X张牌，然后你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于X的永久物牌从你手上放进战场，X为所牺牲生物的法术力值。

1086577.oracleText: When Wrench enters, look at the top nine cards of target opponent's library, exile two of them face down, then put the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order. You may play the exiled cards for as long as they remain exiled. Mana of any type can be spent to cast spells this way.
1086577.translation: 当扳手进场时，检视目标对手牌库顶的九张牌，将其中两张牌面朝下地放逐，然后将其余的牌以随机顺序置于其牌库底。于所放逐之牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以使用它们。能用任意种类的法术力来以此法施放咒语。

1086580.oracleText: When Bayo leaves the battlefield, you may pay {oX}. When you do, he deals X damage to target player.
1086580.translation: 当巴约离开战场时，你可以支付{oX}。当你如此作时，他对目标牌手造成X点伤害。

1086581.translation: 浩劫双煞卡姆与法瑞克

1086582.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, Cam and Farrik gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

1086603.oracleText: {o2oUoRoW}: Transform Nia. Activate only as a sorcery.

1086606.oracleText: Remove two counters from Nia: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
1086606.translation: 从妮雅上移去两个指示物：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

1086610.oracleText: Whenever you attack with two or more Spiders, put a +1/+1 counter on Rizna.
1086610.translation: 每当你以两个或更多蜘蛛攻击时，在蕾姿娜上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1086611.oracleText: Whenever Rizna deals 4 or more damage, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
1086611.translation: 每当蕾姿娜造成4点或更多伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

1086615.translation: 每当银网峰蛛卫成为横置时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

1086635.oracleText: The Scouring Stormsoul can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
1086635.translation: 席卷暴风魂不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

1086636.oracleText: Look Around — Mill three cards. You may put a permanent card from among them into your hand. You gain 3 life.

1086638.oracleText: Bring Down — Destroy target creature with flying.

• Bring Down — Destroy target creature with flying.

1086652.translation: 如果波瑞斯经缠网异能施放，则他进场时上面有X个+1/+1指示物，X为所移回之生物的法术力值。

1086654.translation: 每当一个由对手操控、且力量为由其操控之生物中最大者的生物死去时，你抓一张牌并在布拉可上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1086656.oracleText: Whenever another Villain you control enters, Carlo connives.
1086656.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的反派进场时，令卡罗筹谋。

1086658.oracleText: During your turn, Cirina Bargainspinner has flying.
1086658.translation: 于你的回合中，贩商织匠茜莉娜具有飞行异能。

1086659.oracleText: When Cirina Bargainspinner enters, search your library for an Aura or Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
