1086664.translation: 当德亵瑞司进场时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。它获得「此生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击」与「当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它牺牲。」

1086667.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value equal to Druneth's power, copy that spell, except the copy isn't legendary. Then put a +1/+1 counter on Druneth. (The copy becomes a token.)
1086667.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等同于朱奈特力量的生物咒语时，复制该咒语，但该复制品不是传奇。然后在朱奈特上放置一个+1/+1指示物。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

1086670.oracleText: During your turn, Janai and Hoppy has flying.
1086670.translation: 于你的回合中，雅奈与霍比具有飞行异能。

1086671.oracleText: When Janai and Hoppy leaves the battlefield, create a 1/1 green and white Human Citizen creature token.
1086671.translation: 当雅奈与霍比离开战场时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色的人类／市民衍生生物。

1086673.oracleText: You may have Kavaero enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard, except his name is Kavaero, Mind-Bitten and he's a 4/4 Spider Human Hero in addition to his other types. When you do, exile that card.
1086673.translation: 你可以使卡瓦罗当成任一坟墓场中的生物牌之复制品来进战场，但他的名称仍是卡瓦罗，且是4/4蜘蛛／人类／英雄，并仍具有原本类别。当你如此作时，放逐该牌。

1086675.oracleText: When Kivni enters, you may discard a card. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on him.
1086675.translation: 当基维尼进场时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1086677.oracleText: Knife Trick deals 3 damage to target creature.
1086677.translation: 小刀恶戏对目标生物造成3点伤害。

1086679.oracleText: When Kumonosu enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
1086679.translation: 当蜘蛛巢进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

1086686.oracleText: Whenever Nu and Sumi attacks, discard a card. Then draw a card for each card you've discarded this turn.
1086686.translation: 每当奴与墨攻击时，弃一张牌。然后你本回合中每弃过一张牌，便抓一张牌。

1086688.oracleText: When Qoneus enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent and up to one target nonland permanent card from a graveyard.
1086688.translation: 当屈努斯进场时，选择至多一个目标非地永久物和至多一张目标在坟墓场中的非地永久物牌。将它们从原区域放逐。

1086689.oracleText: When Qoneus dies, put him on the bottom of his owner's library. If you do, return the exiled cards to their owners' hands.
1086689.translation: 当屈努斯死去时，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。若你如此作，则将所放逐的牌移回各自拥有者手上。

1086691.oracleText: Whenever Rishei attacks, other Villains you control gain flying until end of turn.
1086691.translation: 每当莱西攻击时，由你操控的其他反派获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

1086697.oracleText: You can't cast Uharis, the Stormspinner during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
1086697.translation: 本盘游戏中，你在你的第一，第二或第三回合都不能施放纺岚师尤哈里。

1086698.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you've played a land or cast a spell this turn from anywhere other than your hand, Uharis deals damage equal to his power to any target.
1086698.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中从你手牌以外的任何区域使用过地或施放过咒语，则尤哈里对任意一个目标造成等同于它力量的伤害。

1086700.oracleText: When Withar enters, you may exchange life totals with target opponent. If you lost life this way, draw that many cards.
1086700.translation: 当萎撒进场时，你可以与目标对手交换总生命。若你以此法失去生命，则抓等量的牌。

1086703.oracleText: Whenever Xecau attacks, if you've cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater this turn, draw a card.
1086703.translation: 每当谢卡乌攻击时，若你本回合中施放过法术力值等于或大于4的咒语，则抓一张牌。

1086711.oracleText: Whenever Goro Rel deals damage to a Spider, destroy that creature.
1086711.translation: 每当格罗雷对任一蜘蛛造成伤害时，消灭后者。

1086724.oracleText: Buzzard-wasps single-mindedly scour the Si Wong Desert in search of dead or dying prey.
1086724.translation: 秃鹫蜂在死亡沙漠中专心扫荡，只为搜寻已死或濒死的猎物。

1086725.oracleText: Even without its rider, a Komodo Rhino will cause its fair share of destruction—unaided and unprompted.
1086725.translation: 即便没有骑手，科莫多犀牛也能造成相当程度的破坏～无需协助或唆使。

1086726.oracleText: Sky bison know no boundaries by land or sea, for the sky above them is boundless.
1086726.translation: 飞天野牛不知大地与海洋的边界为何物，因为它们头顶的天空无边无际。

1086727.oracleText: Makapu Village was a highly desirable place to live and farm. Though the local fortune teller claimed the volcano was dormant, the Avatar thought otherwise.
1086727.translation: 马卡普村非常适合居住与耕作。虽然当地算命师宣称火山已经休眠，但降世神通却不这么认为。

1086728.oracleText: With the Avatar's aid, the Ba Sing Se Zoo became a safe haven for animals across the four nations.
1086728.translation: 在降世神通的协助之下，永固城动物园成了四国动物的避难所。

1086729.oracleText: Outside the sanctuary of Ba Sing Se's walls, humble Earth Kingdom villages hope to stave off the news of war for just one more day.
1086729.translation: 在永固城围墙的庇护外，脆弱的土强国村庄都希望战火的消息能晚一天到来。

1086730.oracleText:
"Ember Island gives everyone a clean slate. Ember Island reveals the true you."
—Lo and Li
1086730.translation:
「余烬岛还每个人一片清白。余烬岛让你看到真正的自己。」
～萝婆与莉婆

1086731.oracleText:
"In the Swamp, we see visions of people we've lost, people we've loved, folks we think are gone."
—Huu
1086731.translation:
「在雾沼，我们能看见失去的人，爱过的人，我们以为已经离去的人。」
～胡

1086734.oracleText: Target opponent skips all combat phases of their next turn.
1086734.translation: 目标对手略过其下个回合中所有战斗阶段。

1086737.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, untap each other artifact creature you control.
1086737.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，重置所有由你操控的其他神器生物

1086738.oracleText: {o3oW}, {oT}: Create a 5/5 colorless Vehicle artifact token named Zeppelin with flying and crew 3.
1086738.translation: {o3oW}，{oT}：派出一个5/5无色，名称为飞艇的载具衍生神器，且具有飞行与搭载3。

1086741.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of another creature you control, except it has CARDNAME's other abilities.
1086741.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成另一个由你操控之生物的复制品来进场，但它具有逆岛的其他异能。

1086742.oracleText: You may have Sakashima enter as a copy of another creature you control, except it has Sakashima's other abilities.
1086742.translation: 你可以使逆岛当成另一个由你操控之生物的复制品来进场，但它具有逆岛的其他异能。

1086743.oracleText: When a player casts a spell, sacrifice this enchantment. If you do, each of that player's opponents draws three cards.
1086743.translation: 当任一牌手施放咒语时，牺牲此结界。若你如此作，则该牌手的每位对手各抓三张牌。

1086745.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if an opponent lost 2 or more life this turn, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment. (Damage causes loss of life.)
1086745.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若有对手本回合失去过2点或更多生命，则你可以在此结界上放置一个探索指示物。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

1086746.oracleText: Whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, if this enchantment has three or more quest counters on it, you may have that player lose 2 life. If you do, you gain 2 life.
1086746.translation: 每当一张牌从任何区域进入对手的坟墓场时，若此结界上有三个或更多探索指示物，则你可以令该牌手失去2点生命。若你如此作，则你获得2点生命。

1086751.oracleText: {oT}: Destroy target creature of your choice, then destroy target creature of an opponent's choice. Activate only during your turn, before attackers are declared.
1086751.translation: {oT}：你选择目标生物，消灭该生物，然后任一对手选择目标生物，消灭该生物。只能于你的回合中、宣告攻击者之前起动。

1086752.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment.
1086752.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，你可以在此结界上放置一个探索指示物。

1086753.oracleText: As long as this enchantment has seven or more quest counters on it, creatures you control get +5/+5.
1086753.translation: 只要此结界上有七个或更多探索指示物，由你操控的生物便得+5/+5。

1086762.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. This land deals 3 damage to you.
1086762.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此地对你造成3点伤害。

1086764.oracleText:
"All the past Avatars, all their experience and wisdom, is available to you if you look deep inside yourself."
—Avatar Roku
1086764.translation:
「只要你深入内省，历代的降世神通，他们历代的经验与智慧都会向你敞开。」
～降世神通罗库

1086765.oracleText: "The Fire Lord is Aang's fight. We need to stay focused on stopping that fleet from burning down the Earth Kingdom."
1086765.translation: 「烈火君是安昂的对手。我们必须集中精力阻止舰队烧毁土强国。」

1086767.oracleText:
"Even the separation of the four elements is an illusion. If you open your mind you will see all the elements are one, four parts of the same whole."
—Guru Pathik
1086767.translation:
「就连四种元素之别也是一种幻觉。只要敞开心扉，你就会看到所有元素实为一体，是同一整体的四个部分。」
～帕提克大师

1086768.oracleText: "True power is something you're born with."

1086769.oracleText: "I could spend an eternity in here."

1086770.oracleText:
"If you let the energy in your own body flow, the lightning will follow it."
—Iroh
1086770.translation:
「如果你让体内的能量流动起来，闪电就自会跟随。」
～艾洛

1086771.oracleText: "Everyone guesses wrong because the dealer moves the rock at the last minute, but I can feel it with my earthbending."
1086771.translation: 「庄家总会在最后关头移动石头，让大家猜错，但我能用运土术感觉到它。」

1086772.oracleText:
"Toph, there's too many of them. We need an Earthbender. We need you."
—Katara
1086772.translation:
「拓芙，他们人数太多了。我们需要一位运土师。我们需要你。」
～卡塔拉

1086773.oracleText: "Sharing tea with a fascinating stranger is one of life's true delights."
1086773.translation: 「与迷人陌客共同饮茶，是人生真正的乐趣之一。」

1086774.oracleText:
"You chose them from among thousands of toys, Aang. The toys you picked were the four Avatar relics. These items belonged to Avatars past. Your own past lives."
—Monk Tashi
1086774.translation:
「你从数千个玩具中选出了它们，安昂。你选的玩具是四件降世神通的遗物。这些物品属于前任的降世神通。你的前世。」
～僧侣扎西

1086775.oracleText:
"The road ahead of us is challenging. A hundred years of fighting has left the world scarred and divided. But with the Avatar's help, we can get it back on the right path and begin a new era of love and peace."
—Zuko
1086775.translation:
「我们的前路充满挑战。百年战火让世界伤痕累累，四分五裂。但有了降世神通相助，我们能让一切重回正轨，开启爱与和平的新纪元。」
～苏科

1086778.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain flying and vigilance until end of turn.
1086778.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的伙伴进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行与警戒异能。

1086779.oracleText: Whenever Appa or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain flying and vigilance until end of turn.
1086779.translation: 每当阿柏或另一个由你操控的伙伴进场时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行与警戒异能。

1086781.oracleText: Counter up to four target spells and/or abilities.
1086781.translation: 反击至多四个目标咒语和／或异能。

1086782.oracleText: Untap up to four target artifacts and/or creatures.
1086782.translation: 重置至多四个目标神器和／或生物。

1086784.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one target creature gets +2/+0 and gains firebending 2 until end of turn.
1086784.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，至多一个目标生物得+2/+0且获得振火2。

1086785.oracleText: {oR}: Put a charge counter on CARDNAME.

1086786.oracleText: {oR}: Put a charge counter on this artifact.
1086786.translation: {oR}：在此神器上放置一个充电指示物。

1086787.oracleText: Remove fifty charge counters from CARDNAME: It deals 50 damage to any target.
1086787.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去五十个充电指示物：它对任意一个目标造成50点伤害。

1086788.oracleText: Remove fifty charge counters from this artifact: It deals 50 damage to any target.
1086788.translation: 从此神器上移去五十个充电指示物：它对任意一个目标造成50点伤害。

1086790.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Swamps on the battlefield.
1086790.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于战场上的沼泽数量。

1086791.oracleText: Swampbenders's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Swamps on the battlefield.
1086791.translation: 沼宗的力量和防御力各等同于战场上的沼泽数量。

1086792.oracleText: Lands you control are Swamps in addition to their other types.
1086792.translation: 由你操控的地额外具有沼泽此类别。

1086794.oracleText: During your turn, Allies you control have double strike and lifelink.
1086794.translation: 于你的回合中，由你操控的伙伴具有连击与系命异能。

1086796.oracleText: Earthbend 3. Then each creature you control with power less than or equal to that land's power gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
1086796.translation: 运土3。然后每个由你操控且力量等于或小于该地力量的生物各获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

1086797.oracleText: You gain hexproof until end of turn.
1086797.translation: 你获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

1086799.oracleText: You may cast Ally spells and artifact spells as though they had flash.
1086799.translation: 你可以将伙伴咒语与神器咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

1086801.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enter or attack, create X 1/1 white Ally creature tokens, where X is the number of tapped artifacts and/or creatures you control.
1086801.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，派出X个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物，X为由你操控且已横置的神器和／或生物数量。

1086802.oracleText: Whenever Aang and Katara enter or attack, create X 1/1 white Ally creature tokens, where X is the number of tapped artifacts and/or creatures you control.
1086802.translation: 每当安昂与卡塔拉进场或攻击时，派出X个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物，X为由你操控且已横置的神器和／或生物数量。

1086804.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, earthbend X, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast her.
1086804.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，运土X，X为施放她时所支付的法术力数量。

1086805.oracleText: When Toph enters, earthbend X, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast her.
1086805.translation: 当拓芙进场时，运土X，X为施放她时所支付的法术力数量。

1086806.oracleText: Land creatures you control have double strike.
1086806.translation: 由你操控的地生物具有连击异能。

1086808.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Ally you control enters, attach up to one target Equipment you control to that creature.
1086808.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的伙伴进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控的武具贴附在该生物上。

1086809.oracleText: Whenever Sokka and Suki or another Ally you control enters, attach up to one target Equipment you control to that creature.
1086809.translation: 每当索卡与苏琪或另一个由你操控的伙伴进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控的武具贴附在该生物上。

1086810.oracleText: Whenever an Equipment you control enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token.
1086810.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武具进场时，派出一个1/1白色伙伴衍生生物。

1086812.oracleText: Gain control of target artifact. Untap it. It gains haste. At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice it.
1086812.translation: 获得目标神器的操控权。重置它。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

1086814.oracleText: Converge — Return up to X permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.
1086814.translation: 聚辉～将至多X张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上，X为施放此咒语支付的法术力颜色数量。

1086817.oracleText: Target up to four spells and/or abilities.
1086817.translation: 指定至多四个咒语和／或异能为目标。

1086818.oracleText: Target up to four artifacts and/or creatures.
1086818.translation: 指定至多四个神器和／或生物为目标。

1086819.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice it.
1086819.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

1086820.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Return up to {2, Number} permanent card to your hand.} other {Return up to {2, Number} permanent cards to your hand.}}
1086820.translation: {2, plural, =1 {将至多{2, Number}张永久物牌移回你手上。} other {将至多{2, Number}张永久物牌移回你手上。}}

1086825.oracleText: Target a permanent to remove a counter.
1086825.translation: 指定一个永久物为目标，从其上移去一个指示物。

1086826.oracleText: Target a second permanent to receive a counter.
1086826.translation: 指定第二个永久物接收一个指示物。

1086827.translation: 阿达吉亚之盾坎德拉号

1086828.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one target creature you control to its owner's hand. It perpetually gets +1/+1.
1086828.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。它永久得+1/+1。

1086829.oracleText: When Candela enters, return up to one target creature you control to its owner's hand. It perpetually gets +1/+1.
1086829.translation: 当坎德拉号进场时，将至多一个目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。它永久得+1/+1。

1086830.oracleText: Whenever Candela deals combat damage to a player, you may put a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.
1086830.translation: 每当坎德拉号对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你手上放进战场。

1086833.oracleText: Exhaust — {oW}: Conjure a card named Starfighter Pilot onto the battlefield.
1086833.translation: 竭绝～{oW}：将一张名称为星际战机驾手的牌幻变进战场。

1086834.oracleText: Spacecraft you control have "Exhaust — {oW}: Conjure a card named Starfighter Pilot onto the battlefield."
1086834.translation: 由你操控的太空船具有「竭绝～{oW}：将一张名称为星际战机驾手的牌幻变进战场。」

1086838.translation: 竭绝～{o1oW}：取出一张太空船牌。

1086840.oracleText:
"It is no longer enough to align myself to the greatest power. I must find ways to align them to me."
—Tezzeret
1086840.translation:
「追随至高之力已然不够。我必须找到办法让它为我所用。」
～泰兹瑞

1086843.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a shield counter on target artifact or creature.
1086843.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标神器或生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

1086844.oracleText: When this creature enters, put a shield counter on target artifact or creature.
1086844.translation: 当此生物进场时，在目标神器或生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

1086845.oracleText: Whenever one or more counters are removed from a permanent you control, seek a nonland card.
1086845.translation: 每当从任一由你操控的永久物上移去一个或数个指示物时，取出一张非地牌。

1086847.oracleText: When this land enters, draw a card.
1086847.translation: 当此地进场时，抓一张牌。

1086848.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, a random land card in your library perpetually becomes a basic Island in addition to its other types and gains "When this land enters, draw a card."
1086848.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你牌库中的一张随机地牌永久成为基本海岛，仍具有原本类别，且获得「当此地进场时，抓一张牌。」

1086849.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, a random land card in your library perpetually becomes a basic Island in addition to its other types and gains "When this land enters, draw a card."
1086849.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你牌库中的一张随机地牌永久成为基本海岛，仍具有原本类别，且获得「当此地进场时，抓一张牌。」

1086851.oracleText:

1086873.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，将一张法术力值为X的随机生物牌幻变进战场，X为此生物的力量。该生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

1086893.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature perpetually gains flying if that creature has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.

1086909.oracleText: Sliver cards in your hand have warp {o3}.

1086911.oracleText: Sliver creatures you control have "When this creature enters, conjure a random card from the Slivers Spellbook into the top ten cards of your library at random, then draw a card."

1086914.translation: 每当你倾探，探查，占卜，刺探或取出一张或数张牌时，瓦尔向每位对手各造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

1086916.oracleText:
"My past ambitions lack the scope the Edge presents to me. I must dream bigger."

1086916.translation:
「昔日之志与边域所呈现的相比已然相形见绌。我当有更伟大的图谋。」

选择一项～
•反击目标神器或结界咒语。如果以此法反击了该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入拥有者的坟墓场。
•反击目标起动式或触发式异能。

1106533.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may gain 1 life for each creature card in your graveyard. If you do, exile this card from your graveyard.
1106533.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以获得等同于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的生命。若你如此作，则从你的坟墓场放逐此牌。

1106534.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may gain 1 life for each creature card in your graveyard. If you do, exile this card from your graveyard.
1106534.translation: 当此生物死去时，你可以获得等同于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的生命。若你如此作，则从你的坟墓场放逐此牌。

1106577.oracleText: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose life equal to that card's mana value.
1106577.translation: 将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。你失去等同于该牌法术力值的生命。

1106696.oracleText: Search for a basic land card and a Shrine card.
1106696.translation: 搜寻一张基本地牌和一张祭祠牌。

1107024.oracleText: Zurgo's Vanguard's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
1107024.translation: 珠高的先锋的力量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

1107504.oracleText: {o2}: Put a +1/+1 counter on Cren of the Spider Brood. He gains hexproof and becomes colorless until end of turn.
1107504.translation: {o2}：在蛛巢的柯恩上放置一个+1/+1指示物。直到回合结束，他获得辟邪异能且成为无色。

1107510.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, if you cast it, sacrifice it. If you do, conjure a duplicate of it onto the battlefield. The duplicate perpetually becomes a Robot artifact in addition to its other types.
1107510.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，若你施放之，则牺牲之。若你如此作，则将它的一张副本幻变进战场。该副本永久成为机器人神器，且仍具有原本类别。

1108143.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying.
1108143.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：派出两个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

1108144.oracleText: Max speed — Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying.
1108144.translation: 速度极限～牺牲CARDNAME：派出两个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

1108145.oracleText: Max speed — Sacrifice this enchantment: Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying.
1108145.translation: 速度极限～牺牲此结界：派出两个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

1108147.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, it gains your choice of prowess or haste.
1108147.translation: 当你施放生物咒语时，它依你的选择获得灵技或敏捷异能。

1108148.oracleText: You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, it gains your choice of prowess or haste."
1108148.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的一次性恩泽～「当你施放生物咒语时，它依你的选择获得灵技或敏捷异能。」

1108154.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first creature spell each turn, that spell gains mobilize 1.
1108154.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个生物咒语时，该咒语获得动员1。

1109546.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana in any combination of {oU} and/or {oR}, where X is CARDNAME's power.
1109546.translation: {oT}：加X点法术力，且为{oU}和／或{oR}的任意组合，X为CARDNAME的力量。

1109547.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana in any combination of {oU} and/or {oR}, where X is Vivi Ornitier's power.
1109547.translation: {oT}：加X点法术力，且为{oU}和／或{oR}的任意组合，X为比比·奥尼提尔的力量。

1109552.oracleText: STATIONLEVEL [8+] [3/3] [Flying] [Whenever Candela deals combat damage to a player, you may put a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.]
1109552.translation: STATIONLEVEL [8+] [3/3] [Flying] [Whenever Candela deals combat damage to a player, you may put a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.]

1109559.oracleText: Each creature you control crews Vehicles and stations permanents as though its power were 2 greater.
1109559.translation: 每个由你操控的生物搭载载具和蓄势永久物时视同其力量为原数值加2。

1109580.oracleText: When you cast a spell for its warp cost, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It perpetually gets +1/+0.
1109580.translation: 当你以跃迁费用施放咒语时，将此牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它永久得+1/+0。

1109594.oracleText: {oT}: Put a card exiled with CARDNAME into its owner's graveyard. If it's a land card, create a Treasure token. If it's a nonland card, create a 2/2 black Rogue creature token.
1109594.translation: {oT}：将一张以CARDNAME放逐的牌置入其拥有者的坟墓场。如果它是地牌，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。如果它是非地牌，则派出一个2/2黑色浪客衍生生物。

1109595.oracleText: {oT}: Put a card exiled with this artifact into its owner's graveyard. If it's a land card, create a Treasure token. If it's a nonland card, create a 2/2 black Rogue creature token.
1109595.translation: {oT}：将一张以此神器放逐的牌置入其拥有者的坟墓场。如果它是地牌，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。如果它是非地牌，则派出一个2/2黑色浪客衍生生物。

1109796.oracleText: Waterbend {oX} rather than paying its mana cost, where X is its mana value
1109796.translation: 截水{oX}，而非支付此咒语的法术力费用，X为其法术力值。

1110817.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Sacrifice a land.} other {Sacrifice {2, Number} lands.}}
1110817.translation: {2, plural, =1 {牺牲一个地。} other {牺牲{2, Number}个地。}}

1110818.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Search for a basic land card.} other {Search for {2, Number} basic land cards.}}
1110818.translation: {2, plural, =1 {搜寻一张基本地牌。} other {搜寻{2, Number}张基本地牌。}}

1112012.translation: 是否要令该对手失去2点生命？

1112013.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
1112013.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

1114006.oracleText: Create that many tokens that are copies of {2, CardId}?
1114006.translation: 是否要派出等量为{2, CardId}复制品的衍生物？
